reviews.title: Nice dock, allows multiple monitors with MacBook Pro M1, but network port is broken
reviews.text: I have a MacBook Pro with MY chip that only supports 1 external monitor by default. In order to connect more then one, you have to use a dock that supports DisplayLink and install DisplayLink driver on the Mac (it's free). My previous setup was CalDigit dock that does not support DisplayLink which I daisy chained to an older Dell dock that supports it....which was a bit messy and took extra space on my desk. I got this Pluggable dock to replace the two since it works with Mac and supports DisplayLink. It has nice features - 3 HDMI/Display ports, 6 high speed USB ports (4 in the back, and two front ones), audio out, network port, usb-c in, and plenty of power. It is also fairly small so it doesn't take that much space. It immediately recoflgnized 3 monitors I connected to it and they worked beautifully with my Mac M1. It would be a perfect dock if it wouldn't be for a broken network port. As someone else mentioned in another review, my dock had an issue with the network connection - it doesn't work. It is intermittent and most of the time my MacBook can't connect to wired lan via the port on the doc and I have to switch to wireless. I have tried a different laptop with the same result as well so it is definitely a dock issue. It is really disappointing that $250 docking station doesn't have a functioning basic network port. This should be addressed before I would recommend it to anyone.

reviews.title: Best dock I have used, Supports all of my laptops and work setup just fine!
reviews.text:
I recently was looking into getting a new dock as my current one (TBT3-UDC3) had some issues with my current setup and did not support dual screens on an M1 mac. I had a great experience in the past with pluggable products and support so I bought this one seeing it allowed two displays on an M1. To my surprise, it worked even better than expected and fixed all of the previous issues.

Here are more details about the issues I had with my current setup on my old dock:

I currently use a surface book 3 for work to hook into one 4k and 2k display. As these displays are also hooked to my desktop, I have the dock hooked to the second channel of each display for work.

The issue with my old dock is that the surface book 3 does not support thunderbolt so because of this I can only run 2k on one of the displays while being limited to 1080p for a while. So for the longest time, I was running 1080p on my 4k display. I was curious about this dock as it had " DisplayLink" and I was wondering if it could theoretically allow my displays to run at native resolution.

To my surprise, after setting up the dock I was able to run both displays at full resolution!!!

(They both are locked to 60hz. But I'm find with that for work)

I have also had issues with an HP laptop disconnecting power as it was demanding too much power from the dock. It would disconnect the displays and reconnect them again and again. That has also been fixed.

I'm super happy with this purchase and the money is well spent. Thank you Pluggable!

I would also like to note that my previous dock was the TBT3-UDC3. It was a really good dock. I have used it for about 1 year. I did end up reaching out to pluggable support a couple of times and each time they were helpful and great. Even one time giving me a replacement HDMI to DP adapter as I lost the one that came with the box. So their support is amazing if you need it.

I don't write amazon reviews like ever, but thought to share my experience as it has exceeded my expectations.

Thank you Pluggable for making a new dock that fills all of my needs now I can do my work in native screen resolution!

reviews.title: Perfect for my needs
reviews.text:
When my office Lenovo notebook died a few weeks ago, I was happy that I had another backup unit available to deploy. However, this device is newer and has USB-C Charging and output, so it became necessary to obtain a new docking station that would support the displays I need for my work. I have a Pluggable docking station I use for my personal workstation and that performs beyond my expectations, so I expected the same from this. Needless to say, I'm just as happy with this choice.

I use this workspace for remote consulting with business clients. I'm using 4 monitors (3 external plus the Notebook display) and 1 is 4K, the others are FullHD, with Windows 10 and an extended display to all monitors. I'm not using this to provide power, as my system's power requirements are a touch higher than its rating. 2 of the monitors are HDMI while the third is DisplayPort. I also have a number of devices including an SSD hard drive, printers, design tablet and other devices connected via USB as well as my keyboard/mouse combo. I'm also using the Ethernet connection through the device. I did locate and install the latest DisplayLink driver on my system as well. The system performs flawlessly... the first time everything was connected within about a minute, thereafter there are no delays.

Visually, my displays are crisp and clean, and I have no extraneous flicker or any other issues for that matter. I do very much like the fact that this supports both HDMI and DisplayPort devices natively, as I never know while format my next monitor will require. I don't find that the device runs overly hot as someone else mentioned, but that may be because I'm not using it as a power source or charger for my notebook. My work incudes programming, support and some photographic manipulation.

My ideal scenario is that I have a dock I can use for my notebook that functions equally as well as directly connected devices. This meets all of my criteria and all of my expectations. I would order it again, and I recommend it to others who have similar needs.

The dock is loaded with other features: Ethernet port, Thunderbolt 3&4 and plenty of USB ports. The only thing I would have liked to have seen were additional USB-C ports. Given everything else it has, I’m surprised it doesn’t have at least one for peripherals.

Each port can use HDMI or DisplayPort. The USB-C connection will charge a laptop up to 60W.
US based company with support out of Washington that backs it up with a 2 year (limited) warranty.

You want the best you do have to pay but if you need 2-3 monitors at 60mhz this delivers and is the answer.

reviews.title: Another Plugable good design and function...with some limitations that may affect purchase.
reviews.text:
Plugable is a great company and makes some really fine and useful computer products. Usually on the cutting edge, and this one almost reaches that level with a couple of considerations that may affect a purchase decision.

The unit overall is extremely well-made and very robust. All the features that are advertised DO work seamlessly and without issues. It is compatible with Thunderbolt 3/4 and USB-C of all levels.

It provides the ability to power up to three external monitors off of a single connection to an appropriate computer. In addition, it provides 1gbps ethernet connection, as well as a total of six USB 3.0 Gen1 ports.
One of the USB ports is used for the connection to the base computer.
The unit is capable of powering a laptop up to 65W.

Considerations:
🟡 Surprisingly, as new as this unit is, the USB 3.0 ports are all Gen 1 an limited to 5Gbps, whereas the latest and readily available USB 3.1 Gen 2 are rated at up to 10Gbps. It won't matter for many, but that double speed can be useful for very large data transfers
🟡 The ability of the system to power three external monitors on Mac is contingent on downloading and running an app from your computer. ("computers that only support one display, the UD-6950PDZ laptop dock has you covered with DisplayLink technology. Just a heads up, you’ll need to download a DisplayLink driver to get full functionality.")

Additionally, the unit has a combined audio/mic port and requires a 3-band TRRS cable to function.

All in all, this is a very good design and a robust, compact build. While compatible with Thunderbolt, it is based on USB-C for connectivity.
I rate this design and features at 4.3 Stars after subtracting for the lower USB speed than what's available, and for the need for the DisplayLink software required to take full advantage of the 3-monitor capability.
Fully compatible with all Apple M1 CPU model computers. Recommended if the limitations meet or exceed your needs.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I really wanted this to work but was very disappointed at the support for two 1080p LG external monitors that are less than 2 years old a for new MacBook Pro M1 Max (64 GB Ram). Yes, both external displays were able to connect, but the displays did not match brightness and overall quality and the dock did not play nicely with clamshell mode which is important to me. It's advertised and plug and play. That was not my experience, so I returned it (return and credit went very well, no issues there). Sadly, back to using 2 Anker dongles which are messier with more wires showing and more to unplug when disconnecting the notebook, but they work. This was my 2nd dock advertised to work with M1 Max that I had to return. Next up, when it's available, I'm going to try the CalDigit, though those have mixed reviews also. It's inexcusable that Apple does not make, or work with a vendor on a docking station to properly support their notebooks for multiple monitors, especially since Apple supposedly caters to a market of creators that commonly use multiple screens. Gave 2 stars only because the return and refund experience was good. For the product I give 1 star. reviews.title: Not as advertised
reviews.text:

The first issue that popped up was the 2nd monitor was color shifted. My previous dock did not do this. Plugging in the monitors directly and through another dock showed that this doc caused the 2nd monitor to be shifted red.

Main monitor looked fine which made it even more glaring.

The second issue popped up when I tried to run ethernet. It did not even work. The dock was recognized, the connection showed active in the network settings but no traffic was getting through. It just flat didn't work.

I bought a dock HALF the price and have had ZERO issues running at 1440p 144hz with the other dock with no color shifting on the monitors and no issues with ethernet.

For the price and the hype? No way would I recommend this. It's going right back.

reviews.title: Needs DisplayLink to work
reviews.text:
I’m using the Plugable 12-in-1 USB C Docking Station Triple Monitor with my 2017 Intel MacBook Pro, with Thunderbolt 3. My current laptop is on the list of compatible devices, and I’m hopeful the dock will also work when I upgrade to an M1 Mac (M1 is also on the list).

The dock isn’t quite “Plug and Display.” For Macs, you need to install a DisplayLink driver. Windows also needs DisplayLink, but I believe it will install automatically via Windows Update. For Macs, Plugable has step-by-step instructions to configure DisplayLink for different versions of Mac OS. The instructions are clear, but I can’t help compare this dock to others I’ve tried. Every other dock I’ve used has worked without needing extra software. For this one, I needed to set up DisplayLink to use even one external monitor.

Once I got the software configured properly, I was able to use two HDMI monitors with the dock. Having the option of three monitors is a plus for me. I don’t always use three, but having the capability is good for when I need it. I do not use the dock for gaming or anything intensive. If I were to use it for gaming, I would only use one monitor, not two or three.

I wish the dock had a USB-C port. I do like that it has two USB-A ports on the front, and four more on the back.

reviews.title: Plug & Display No Joke
reviews.text:
Pros:
- 3 HDMI and 3 DisplayPorts that you can mix and match. There’s hardly any other docks that have this many display inputs, nor 3 DisplayPorts in general.
- Plug & Display is no joke. On windows, when you first plug it in, windows automatically installs drivers and will detect all plugged in displays. For Mac, download the DisplayLink app which takes a few seconds to setup.
- Both a pro and con; wish it had more than 60W charging, however, my MacBook Pro 15” 2019 Intel version does get charged by it, so i can’t complain too much.

Cons:
- I do wish it had an extra USB-C input
- External power supply, another brick and wire to worry about and cable manage. I’d rather the unit be bigger and heavier with the power supply being internal.

reviews.title: MAKE SURE MONITOT SPECS ARE COMPATIBLE - Especially Refresh Rate
reviews.text:
It appears that not all of the ports are compatible with various monitors. I have two professional level monitors that will only work on ports 2 and three with a Windows machine. With a MacBook Pro, only one of the ports will work with it - neither the professional level monitors or the lower level HDMI monitors will work. Both of the systems loaded up all of the recommended software and neither had all three ports working. I found it especially odd that port one worked with the mac and 2 & 3 worked with the PC.
I did not even try to hook up any other connections (i.e., Internet). This system was a disappointment, but at least connected to the Mac which another dock would not send out any signal to the monitor. I chose to give it two stars since I consider it my fault for not doing deeper research into which ports will support which monitors (not all ports have the same specs) - I would otherwise give it one star. If my application was more in tune with the hardware, I would have given it 5 stars, but I find it difficult to believe that if someone was going to connect three monitors to a laptop, they are likely to have three similar if not identical monitors.
Lastly, there does not seem to be any live tech support, either on the telephone or through Internet chat.

The issue I had was with the network port. It would get link but never obtain an IP address. I downloaded drivers from Pluggables website, rebooted, same issue. Tried on another laptop, different cable, even different network switch, but same lack of dhcp address.

I am an IT professional of 25 years, so better at diagnostics than the average user, but unfortunately this one stumped me. It is either a defective unit or an incompatibility with the x360 series notebooks.

reviews.title: good but could use some improvements
reviews.text:
I searched high and low for a docking station that would serve my needs and also have DisplayLink included in the technology. Overall I think this is a good option for the price point. There are plently of connections which I may or may not use all up although I like having the extra if needed.
I connected 2 monitors to this docking station (1 4k and 1 1080p) and have been able to extend to those monitors from a HP Spectre, Dell work laptop, Lenevo work laptop and the newest Ipad Pro with M2 (only works with 1 monitor but thats Apple's fault). There are a few minor details that could be fixed or improved to make this a great product
1) how you connect the monitors actually matters and I had to play around with how I connected to displays. Currently I have the 4k monitor connected to "Display 2" using a DisplayPort connection and the 1080p monitor to "Display 3" using HDMI. Previously the 4k monitor was on Display1 and the 1080P on Display 2, using this set up some of the laptops would only extend to Display2 but not Display1 while other laptops would connect to both. Unfortunately, the laptops that were only connecting to one monitor we could not download the software that Plugable recommends because its a worklap and IT is very strict with downloading software. Not sure if downloading the software would fix it or not. I was able to 'fix' this is by switching to Display 2 and Display 3 now all laptops have been able to extend to both monitors connected.
2) sometimes the display layout on the main monitor gets wonky so I have to reconnect the laptop or completely restart it to fix it
3) sometimes the mouse goes crazy and starts moving on its own and I have to restart the laptop to fix this
4) Would love to have an option where you can turn off the power pass-through since the laptop is constantly charging. Not sure if this is healthy in the long run for the battery.

reviews.title: 4.9/5 | Great Docking Station, But a Couple Minor Criticisms
reviews.text:
I'm coming off a RAZER Thunderbolt 4 Chroma Dock that died after less than a year. (DO NOT BUY FROM RAZER!! Their support is AWFUL!!)

After my RAZER Dock died, I found this from Plugable and thought it'd give it a go. I have A LOT of peripherals to connect to my Mac. I've got a Yeti USC Mic, Web Cam, 2x 27" monitors, a Focusrite Scarlet Solo, Harmon Kardon USB speakers, a Web Cam that's mounted on one of my monitors, and a 4 port USB hub for extra measure.

It has just the right amount of ports and a little more!

The reason I wouldn't give it a full 5/5 is the setup process is actually 'not quite' plug n' play.

The RAZER Dock I had required no additional drivers or software for my M1 MacBook Pro. This Dock on the other hand, there is some software you need to install and the setup can be a little confusing. Coming from someone who used to be an IT pro, it even took me a few minutes to figure out.

With that said, it's a good idea to have the software (DisplayLink Manager) up and running upon OS launch or else you may run into some minor issues. I'm also almost positive that you need to quit the software if you're going to unplug your Mac from a single, dual or triple monitor setup to use the MacBook as is, or else you end up with a black screen.

Someone else mentioned in the reviews that their unit got really hot. I held a conference call on Zoom through this earlier, and rendered a 5 minute video through this earlier and did not appear to experience any outrageous temperatures from the Plugable Docking Station.

One other thing, and this is super super minor. I personally thing the Dock is kinda plain and ugly looking, but it sits under my monitors and in the dark. It would look kinda nice with some under glow to it, but... meh. It's black and my desk is black, I work with the lights out and LED accent lighting behind my desk, so I don't really see it.

Hope this helps someone out there!

reviews.title: Exactly what I was looking for
reviews.text:
First off the four stars is for the seam and zipper stress on the first use since I used every inch of space I could, but at least the stress isn’t at a part where it would cause the product to fail. I am not so concerned by this stress that I wouldn’t recommend it. Quite the opposite! I am really happy with this bag!

I bought this for a trip and to replace an expensive messenger style camera bag I already have. What I really liked about this item is that my gear is easily accessible by a side zipper “door” containing a pull out padded tray for quick access and stow of my camera. The tray has removable dividers that I used to separate my camera body from the lens (I prefer to do this to prevent damage during TSA screening bin use), 1 smallish lens with attached hood, and 1 small bag containing camera batteries and cleaning cloths. When I used it around town, I removed a divider which gave me plenty of space for the assembled camera. Most other backpacks I’ve seen/used are awkward and less secure, and if I wanted something smaller to accommodate my torso height, the zipper was in the middle which would essentially dump the entire bottom contents out upon opening. I didn’t have any troubles with the zippered side access, and it was used frequently. This backpack separates items stored in the upper section from your camera with a liner (my expensive messenger bag required you to dig down through stuff to access the camera, meaning everything was on top of the camera), which is also removable when using as a regular backpack. It’s surprisingly lightweight even when fully loaded (my messenger bag is impossibly heavy and cumbersome when fully loaded), has a nice slim profile for under airplane seat carry on storage, and feels more secure that other backpacks. It also fit my back perfectly from shoulders to the small of my back (I’m 5’3”) and is stylish enough to be gender neutral. I secured the zipper pulls for the upper section in the Velcro catch of the lower side access to make any theft attempt while wearing difficult. Walking all over San Francisco it was invaluable to stow or pull my camera quickly without fuss, and even more invaluable at the airports that required you to remove cameras from bags because it was quick to get out for a bin, and just as quick to put away while collecting everything after screening. A security guard even pointed out how “neat” this feature was. It also has room for a laptop which can just as easily be removed and restored for screening. I didn’t bring a laptop so I can’t add that to my review.
I haven’t used the underside clips for travel tripods yet simply because my travel tripod is quite small and easily fit into the upper pouch, but I like that it’s possible. The straps for that are secured and won’t dangle. I’ll probably use this feature for a larger tripod at a later date. I did need to purchase a small travel strap at the airport to attach the top of the bag to my luggage so it wouldn’t topple the whole thing over. I figured out later I could minimize the backpack falling over while on top of a case by pulling the shoulder straps tighter. The straps are easily adjustable, so this didn’t cause any extra fuss, which is what I’m trying to eliminate after years of fighting with my other bag.

This backpack has now officially replaced my other bag that cost twice as much!

reviews.title: High-quality, compact space
reviews.text:
Recently, I've been working with a new Odin, an android-based handheld device designed for gaming. In addition to android-based titles, it can also run software for older gaming systems. A well-adjusted individual who plays games for fun and doesn't run the YouTube channel BaneShake would be content and just have fun playing the games, but most tragically, that description doesn't qualify for me, and every time I go to play anything these days, the little voice in the back of my head cannot help but scream " MAKE CONTENT!" Now, said Odin (as all android devices) does have a built-in screen recorder, but I knew I could push for even higher quality recording using the micro-hdmi option.

Now, with recording, I didn't want something huge that would be cumbersome. I already have to plug in a USB A-to-C adapter just so that I can plug my capture card into my Macbook in the first place, and as I have played around with the miles of cords and HDMI cables for other, less feature-intensive device recording in the past (such as an old iPad, which itself requires a unique adapter to plug into a standard HDMI cable), I'm painfully aware that more complex setups simply give more room for error. So this appealed to me; since I'm recording right at my computer, it wasn't ideal to find multiple feet of cords that could just easily get caught on a drawer handle or somehow under a chair wheel.

This cable is perfect. It's the perfect, close size, flexible enough to never have any issues as I move around, and gives no noticeable delay of any sort even with the HD video recording at 60fps.

So, with this extreme potential now complete in the palm of my hand, you might think I will now cover some of the greatest, most acclaimed gaming experiences known to mankind-- and I'll have to stop you right there. It's LarryBoy. I have all this capability and my first action is LarryBoy and the Bad Apple for PS2.

So, even if you have better priorities than BaneShake's Charlie, this cable will do the trick nicely.

It exceeded my expectations as far as build quality and it looks much better in person. One word of advice, when putting it together don't tighten any screws, so all the pieces can be adjusted. The support post have and angle to them so the platform tilts up, you want to make sure that the angles match before tightening all the screws. reviews.title: The Best Stand Ever!
reviews.text: This stand is the perfect solution for a center channel or large R/Left front or back monitors that you just want raised a little over 10" inches off the floor. The other reviewer stated that holes for pouring sand into the pillars on this stand are too small. This is true, but not an issue. Why? Because this stand is extremely heavy and well built. A car subwoofer could play on top of this stand perfectly isolated from any vibration or resonance. If the 10 pound base plate were not enough, this stand comes with cast iron spikes and thick plastic discs that fit under the spikes to protect your A/V stand from scratches. Here's a tip, Put a drop of Super Glue into the spike hole on the plastic disc before resting the spikes into the disc. This will insure that the spikes will not come off of the disks, this is unlikely given the shear mass of this stand, but it makes it one solid unit! This stand is very attractive and looks far more expensive than what it cost here... I have seen stands that look very Sim. to this on other sites that cost 4Xs as much. The entire stand is made of an extremely thick and heavy steel. My plasma monitor is wall mounted and this stand sits below it on my A.V. Stand. I previously had the center( BIC America Center)channel speaker resting way below the plasma monitor on the A.V. stand. I was shocked to hear how this stand improved the vertical soundstage of my center channel by bringing it ear level. I purchased this stand for the look of it but got exellent sound improvements to boot. One last thing. If your receiver has a speaker set-up system like Odesy or Pioneer MEEC or some other Mic/set up software, you may want to run it again when changing the localization of your Center Channel for accuracy. I cann't Recmnd. this stand highly enough! You will see what I mean when you pick up the box it comes in. This is the real deal.

A more permanent solution would be to drill some holes in the top plate and then screw the cabinet of the speaker to the plate to forever prevent the speaker from getting knocked off of the plate by a passing wild animal (or children) as I don't think the sticky pads would keep everything together. Other than that, a fine stand for the price.

The charging cord is only 2 feet long; so you need to find a place near your USB hub to place the headset - I hang it over an adjustable multi-joint desk lamp. 3. reviews.title: With software update, just what I needed.
reviews.text:
EDIT: I have now given this item five stars. With one of the Windows updates that has automatically applied, the problem of the sound cutting out when I turn my head seems to have vanished. The only real detracting point is that it doesn't feel like there is as wide a frequency range as I would like on the microphone, but this tends to be common to most of the lower priced computer headsets have used, so I can't really see taking a star off for that.

Initial review:

Battery life is awesome. Comfort is great. I only took one points off for sound quality, because if I turn my head in a certain direction, the sound breaks up. If my head is pointed straight at where the USB dongle is on my computer, it is fine. If I put my head at a 90-degree angle, it is fine. If I hold my head at, say, a 45-degree angle to where the dongle is, the audio breaks up. This happens even at very close range. Distance doesn't seem to affect it much. I have walked into the next room with the headset on, and have not had significant audio loss.

Note that there is no Windows 10 driver for this headset. I have no idea whether that plays into the audio quality issue at all, but it seems quite usable on Windows 10, even without a specific driver for that operating system.

I was specifically looking for a headset that does *not* use Bluetooth, as audio quality can suffer quite a bit with two-way Bluetooth transmission- and I am using the headset primarily for Zoom meetings. The breakup when turning my head at certain angles is acceptable, as it rarely hits when I am the one speaking.

reviews.title: Great sound, reliable, decent battery life
reviews.text: Like most gamers, I've bought dozens of headsets and I have to say I am happy with this one. I actually prefer the on-ear style, because I like to hear the ambient sounds of my house, if my kids need me or my wife says something, I don't want total sound canceling. If that's what you're wanting, I would recommend a different style. The microphone is well placed and works well. I've never had anyone tell me my sound was bad, something I've struggled with with other headsets, including Logitech. The battery life is good, and I've had these for a year or so and it is still good. It is a rare weekend gamefest that kills the headset, but would kill many headsets. But for evening sessions of an hour or so, it has been reliable and I only charge it every 2 or 3 uses. I never feel like I always have to have them charging when not in use. I like the placement of the volume controls, but rarely need to adjust mine, and habitually adjust the sound from my computer, but the rare times I've used the controls they are easy to locate and use. Occasionally, I'll start up a game and have no sound, but powering off and powering back on the headphones usually quickly re-links the headphones and restores sound. I normally just lay them on the table when not in use, so folding the mic up is well designed and easy to do. The headband folding option works well, but I don't use it often to be able to add more. I do not travel with these. The other small issue is when I flex my jaw, you get this odd creaking sound from the hard plastics in the earpieces (my wife asked me if I was grinding my teeth, so she could even hear it sitting next to me). But this is not unique to this headset, but it is a trait I find annoying. However, it is a bit of a nit, and generally I am very pleased with these.

Frutta Bowls is right around the corner from where I live - I've never had an acai bowl before, and so I stopped by to finally give it a try! They have two sizes, and as you can (maybe) tell from my bowl, the size I got was huge! (I got the bigger of the two, definitely could have been satisfied with just the smaller size). It's pretty generous in terms of fruit and toppings. They have preset options or you can make your own combination, and that's what I opted for. You have different bases you can choose from as well, such as the classic acai or pitaya, which is the kind my partner got. The acai is on the sweeter side, and the pitaya was a little more tart so I kind of liked that better. I also got it topped with nutella and caramel and they didn't shy away from giving me generous amounts of both. If I had one tiny criticism, it was that I think the smoothie base was just so much more present than the toppings and fruit, but also I did get a huge size so maybe that's just how that is! I just wished it was a *tiny* bit more balanced all around, but they did give me a lot of fruit also so I can't complain too much! They also do takeout and delivery through Yelp it appears and we were able to take ours on the go :)

Almost every Friday a few co-workers and myself would order from this location. I usually get the Frutella Bowl with some minor adjustments. I change the fruit to mango and banana, add almond butter instead of the peanut butter and add sliced almonds instead of the coconut flakes. The taste itself has always been pretty consistent, however, the amount and the way it is packaged has not been. How much you get inside the bowl and the order of placements of each ingredients varies by hands, which is unfortunate. When you are used to gettin a full bowl that is very nicely displayed and then the next week it is just a little pass halfway full, it is a little disappointing (not pictured, it didn't look pretty that I just didn't want to take picture). Other than the inconsistency in the bowl itself; I have no other complaints. The place is kept clean, the manager/owner (or whom I believe is one) is very nice; he always greets when he see my co-workers and I and he remember us as well. They also have an app that allows you to collect points and order in advance for pick up (and they are always ready by the pick up time), which is very handy when you only have 30 mins for lunch.

Addicting! I cannot say enough great things about this place. Delivery or in store - you can't go wrong. Everyone here is super friendly and the store is extremely clean and well decorated. Delivery on door dash was fast and super convenient too. I love their açaí bowls and smoothies! I would recommend this to anyone who wants something refreshing and delicious!

I honestly wish the service here was a little better because I genuinely enjoy the food items here. It seems like every time I try to give this place the benefit of the doubt, the women working the counter just get worse. I've been waiting about 15 minutes for a smoothie and there were only 2 other orders before me, who were also waiting a while..(obviously being able to tell from the looks on their faces) When the woman took my order she blatantly stopped listening as the other coworker just rudely interrupted my order about something non work related. I keep trying here but I'm not sure if it's going to change...

This place is honestly one of the most fantastic healthy food places that I've been to all year in the US and I loved in NYC. They have it all. Amazing menu with numbers selections, amazing customer service, great pitaya bowls, great peanut butter, great ambience.....I literally ate my plate and then started eating through my cousin and niece's plates too. Did I mention that the prices are affordable too? Honestly, my entire family will be back. Wish more businesses had customer service that was this great.
Good Acai bowls - they had good portions and were very nice. The place is clean and not too noisy, great location.

The owner is friendly & efficient! I've never called ahead to order and bowl and upon arrival, it NOT be ready. They're always on-time and on-point! Have also had bowls at a ton of açaí places ever since this trend began and this location's are by far the best. Just had a bowl so good I literally jumped on Yelp to write this review. Keep on fightin the good fight Frutta Bowls!

Was looking for something refreshing on a nice day and stumbled upon Frutta Bowls! They have a nice assortment of options including açaí, pitaya, or kale bowls, toast, smoothies, and oatmeal. We both decided to get pitaya bowls and loved the Jamaica and Barbados bowls. They were both refreshing and fruity. The pitaya mixture is not freshly made so at times it tasted icy but was still very good. We decided on the small to go size instead of the regular and was still plenty of food. This is a great choice for a refreshing treat on a hot day!

I love the superfood bowl! Very tasty and a good size portion for the price. The place is super cute, has couches and high tops to sit at. I walk by often and usually not busy. It's conveniently located to where I live and the closest place that sells açaí bowls. However, the reason I'm giving 3 stars is because the staff is not very friendly. Hopefully that is able to change!

Not great at all. I was craving a fresh and refreshing açaí bowl and this was neither. The bowls with granola toppings are pre-made, and the fruit was nothing to write home about. The bowl tasted frost bitten unfortunately.

Have tried the açaí bowls, smoothies and toast. All are great. Specifically enjoy the açaí bowls, they are very generous with their portions and everything is fresh. I live nearby so this is also very convenient spot for me. My only feedback is I've noticed the staff at times are not friendly. Additionally, the staff do not seem to be educated on the ingredients in the food. I've asked a few times whether the granola has nuts and have not gotten a clear answer. As someone with a food allergy, this concerns me when the staff are unsure of ingredients in their food. Also makes me worry about safety of cross contamination. Also another note, hours state they open at 8am. Was here at 8:10am on a Tuesday and it was not open.

Came here yesterday and my husband and we both had the "Frutta bowl". The fruit doesn't seem to be high quality. The pineapple was not yellow/ripe. The worst thing about the bowl was the granola. It didn't seem fresh and it seemed to have a banana flavor to it. Although we didn't enjoy the bowls, the place itself is nice and comfortable and is in a great location. I've had many acai bowls in philly and the best ones are at SoBol so I would recommend going there.
their frutella bowl and plant protein bites gave me more dopamine and serotonin than my antidepressants

The shop itself was cute and there was plenty of room if you wanted to meet a friend to chat, or set up shop and get some work done. So many great toppings to choose from at no additional cost. They also have a rewards program. 2 points per $1 spent, you get $10 off an order after 300 points. Will definitely be returning!

Other than that, everything else tasted pretty good.

Their oatmeal is amazing as well as their smoothies ! The place is really cute inside and has lots of little treats to offer and coffee.

I do wish there is more variety of açaí bowls with fruit without peanut or peanut butter. Because of that, I almost always order the same thing when I come. Either the superfood bowl or build your own bowl. I also wish it's cheaper, but I understand fruit and health food ain't cheap.

I ended up getting the combo for $11, I chose the Jamaican pittaya bowl and the bravado toast. The bowl was yummy and about a pints worth. It was tasty but the granola was very sweet which makes me wonder how much sugar there is in it. The bravacado toast was a thin layer of mashed avocado and like a roasted red pepper spread and sliced boiled egg on top. It was just good, nothing spectacular. All the ingredients were frozen and obviously weren't made fresh. Quality has gone down since its opening

Wow. This place is so good! Very nice atmosphere! One of the açaí bowls I've gotten! They also have a nice assortment of smoothies or you can make your own! The avocado toast is also amazing!!! The staff is super friendly and always ready to make suggestions.

Ok... I was very hesitant but my wife persuaded me to try it. First and foremost ... I love Ice cream. If given a choice what to eat on my last day on earth, I would choose Ice cream. UNTIL... I ate at this place. I would pick this over Ice cream or gelato any day now. I ordered the Acai bowl with the nutella banana and granola. I forgot the name specifically but it was delicious!!!! I couldn't stop thinking about it. Even my very picky son loved it and for him to order anything in the realm of healthy is already a miracle. I then tried a lot of different places since (playa bowl, costco, etc etc) and I have to say nothing was near the taste and freshness of this place. We moved out of Philadelphia but it's definitely one of the places I look for reasons to visit the city. Keep up the good work!

A better than expected experience with this restaurant when we first time ever discovered a Pizza Hut store that also had a full salad bar. There were many dressing flavors with tons of topping and even some sweet treats like chocolate pudding and vanilla pudding. The pizza quality maybe was just similar to other Pizza Hut locations, but the salad bar was unexpectedly good and service was nice and friendly. The restaurant is right next to the U.S. 19, so it is probably a right choice as a quick stop for lunch on the way to Weeki Wachee to the North or New Port Richey and St. Petersburg to the South.

I decided to order a pizza while at work Friday, and was going to pick it up on my lunch. They guy on the phone said 15 minutes. I get there and there's no record of my order at all; name, phone number or pizza. After waiting several minutes of them trying the order. They asked if I wanted to place it again. I was on my lunch and had no time to wait. Today I finally had a moment to call and talk to a manager. Who was no help at all and said he couldn't help unless there was an order placed. What the f@&&@! I did place an order but some dummy did it wrong. Never going back. Will be going to Guidos for now on.

Sparse toppings, low quality pizza. I honestly don't understand why anyone still goes here. There are so many better options. Grocery store "frozen pizza" is a better choice. I will not waste my money at Pizza Hut again.
Great food however wings are suppose to look like wings not chickens nuggets. Just because it's on the lunch special doesn't mean you shrink them to nuggets

Although I have seen stupid issues with this Pizza Hut in the past it is very close to where we live so decided to stop here Friday night for dinner. At 6 pm on Friday night during season when every restaurant in town has a wait this place is about 1/3 empty so no waiting but that should tell you something. We were seated and left with menus. After about 15 minutes we had not even seen a waitress to order drinks although they were waiting on other tables in between the stand around and chat sessions. We finally got up and left as we could not get any service from anyone. On the way out we passed three wait staff talking who looked at us and I told them we could not get waited on so we are leaving. All three were laughing and just thought this was the highlight of the day. This place really needs a manager.

If I could give less I would. Simple order. Medium Pepperoni Pan Pizza with extra cheese, and buffalo sauce instead of marinara. Requested cooked well done. Pizza Hut can be a bit soggy. Delivery driver was fast, and courteous. The pizza was completely wrong. The cheese was still cold, and not melted. The dough was soggy, and the pizza was just nasty. I gave them the benefit of the doubt, and called to request a fix. Rico put me on hold for 20 minutes while he was "getting a manager" I finally hung up and called back with a bit more of a temper until I got the manager. His apology was not sincere, and he offered to make a new one correctly. I accepted with the condition that he take the bad one back and show the cooks how to cook a pizza if they want to make people sick. Time will tell if they remake my order correct, and don't mess with it. Either way they have lost a customer. See the pictures if you want to know what we went thru.
Terrible customer service and pizzas. Manager was rude and unhelpful. Instead of being helpful with my issue she was openly laughing with employees. Will not go back.

Great! I'm new to the area, saw this Pizza Hut as I drove by to our new home, needed to eat after 24 hours of traveling,ordered my pizza, I was Told it would be ready in 15 minuets, I was there in 12 minuets, my name was called as i walked in, they opened the box to show me my order to make sure it was right, it was, they thanked me as I paid. This Pizza Hut was very courteous and professional the best I've been to, the pizza was great too, thanks I'll be back.

Very good service and easy check out service. Delivery time was faster then they said it would be and the food tasted fresh and was awesome. Delivery driver was polite and courteous. Wonderful experience. Will most definitely eat and order here again. A+ service
With Pizza Hut, if your car is down a quart of oil, just squeeze it out of the pizza. There is plenty to spare and more. Yuck!!!

Ordered a pizza while I was at work and about to go to lunch. The guy said 15 minutes. I drive all the way there and they have no record of my order at all. What a waste of my lunch. They didn't even offer me anything for this huge inconvenience.

This is one of the nicest Pizza Huts I have ever been it. It was very clean and the staff was very nice!!! Went with a friend and enjoyed a pizza together. I am not a fan of chain pizza joints but I have to admit Pizza Hut is one of my favorites. It was not always. I think they changed their sauce at some point!!!

I liked this location as Agave but love it as The Banks Drinkery & Kitchen. The service is good. The food is good. The cocktails are good. And on top of that, the rooftop is a super cute place to chill and enjoy your drinks and/or meal. The owner was very helpful and accommodating at their grand opening despite all of the chaos. There was a lot of confusion going on and he handled it well. I tried to sample a little bit of everything. I had a few friends with me so we tried to get different things. The chargrilled oysters were very good as were the buffalo wings. The southwest rolls were okay. I ordered the blackened shrimp pasta for my entree but there was nothing blackened about the shrimp. Don't get me wrong, it was good but the shrimp were in no way blackened, quite pale. The pasta had good flavor though and I didn't need to add any salt. I also tried the blackened and fried crawfish pasta that my friend ordered. I didn't spot any fried crawfish on it but it was good as well. I tried a couple of their signature cocktails, all of which I enjoyed (the Crowley, the Elder Bull, & the Swamp Donkey). I also ordered a French 75 (my favorite cocktail) and it was made very well. I think this place has the potential to do very well and I really hope it does.

Wow Grand Opening Very nice place The staff is incredibly attentive Wow this is impressive There is a small hallway next to the bar which leads to the outside It was me and an employee head on Since I have worked in the food and beverage industry before it was natural for me to step to the side But she was so polite and said no allow me And I passed I definitely told her thank you This small gesture means A LOT to me There are three areas Inside Outside Outside upstairs We enjoyed the oysters The oysters were very good Generous size lots of meat for oysters Unfortunately no bread I think because it is open house and they are so busy it slipped Easily forgiven The oysters are the main feature and they were good

Please take this review with a grain of salt because I went on their opening night (featuring an open bar) because of an unofficial Yelp elite event. By the time I got there the place was very crowded between the main dining area, backyard, and patio there was no place to sit. Included in my Yelp event was a free dinner entree. My friend and I got some of their free cocktails and waited for a table to open inside (because it was grossly hot outside). we finally got a table and the waitress was very persistent (because of her manager) that we had to order the yelp entrees at the bar and we couldn't sit in the dining room because we weren't paying customers. Ok, so you expect us to stand and eat a plate of food? We ended up ordering off the regular menu just so we could sit down there. We had the southwest egg rolls which were pretty dang good and chargrilled oysters. I tried my first oyster and it wasn't bad so yay. After much back and forth and ordering our Yelp entrees at the bar (which mind you- the bartender never placed and the waitress had to check on it multiple times) our burger and pasta finally arrived. The pasta was filled with seafood so I wasn't about that, but the burger was also just ok. The bun was far too large for the what seemed frozen not fresh patty. Unfortunately we found an unnamed foreign object in our pasta and when we told the waitress her response was "well.. I think that was one of your free dishes anyways..." are you kidding me??!! We aren't telling you to get free dinner, we are telling you to make sure the kitchen staff doesn't let this happen again! The manager was much more apologetic than the waitress. I'm not saying don't come here, hence the grain of salt in the opening sentence. I think with the stress of opening night while also inviting Yelpers caused too much commotion for perfection.

Let me just start with Jai (I hope I'm spelling this right) is the bartender we all need and deserve to have in our lives. Honestly, he is enough reason to go here. He is super cool, friendly, efficient, the man is HARDWORKING gets the job done and even make sure your food situation gets handled properly ever. I truly enjoyed sitting at the bar. I went out my norm with drinks and tried the Bellini, which was the right amount alcohol to the sweetness it may get you too right I must say. For food, I went with chargrilled oysters and the Treme pasta. My favorite was the oysters. I started with a Half- Dozen and proceeded to order yet ANOTHER half dozen because these oysters were seriously good. They were sizzling and great sized and very tasty oysters. The pasta was pretty good, they definitely give you your fill of pasta and plenty great sized crawfish and shrimp. The atmosphere is truly laid back. You can come here to relax with a friend or two and even a good spot for a first date. The inside portion is small but you can get a table of about 4 maybe 5 in there. The patio is really nice outside and can probably fit a few bigger groups in the area. The parking is no issues, it's street parking but you shouldn't have any issues getting something in a 1 to 2 block radius.

THE BEST PLACE ON BANKS!!!!! Everything on the menu is bomb asf. I go here on the usual and every time​ friends and family come​ down I​ take them here. It is a must try. They have a rooftop chill spot too you can bring your boo and get drinks and live music!! There's no other place like, gooooodddddd food, chill vibes and nice people! And girls, the pics WILL be bomb.

My date and I had a great time on their Grand Opening. We wanted to sit outside at the rooftop to enjoy the live band but it was a full house and no place for us to find a seat. We grabbed our cocktails and headed indoor instead. Our cocktails were The Crowley and Swamp Donkeys. Both were very strong but my date love it. We started out with the Drinkery Crawfish Queso Dip. It was delish with all those crawfish and cheese. I would have stick my finger inside the cup to get it all out if I was not with a date...lol. Next I had the Treme Pasta. I'm not big in pasta but the Treme has two of my favorite in it. Crawfish and shrimp! I was served a really good size of pasta with loads of crawfish and plump size shrimp. The cheese sauce was well season and delish. Best pasta so far for me. Next came the Chargrilled Oysters, they came to our table plump and juicy buttery hot from the grill. I would have ordered more but I was getting full. The only thing was missing was some bread to dip the juice from the oyster shell. Even though my date got the grill chicken, I can't rate it because it came out very late so we had it Togo. It looks very yummy with mash potatoes and grill veggies. I want to give a shout out to Kay for helping us with our food. It did took forever to get our food but Kay made sure we got it. It was a full house with it being their Grand Opening so I understand there will be some hiccup but Kay made our experience enjoyable.

I want to start off by saying the chargrilled oysters were delicious. The bread brought with it was soft and made a great vessel to munch down on those bad boys with. I recommend dipping the bread in the butter under the oysters before inserting into face. Main course I got the red beans and rice. It was massive. They had the flavor and consistency of Popeyes. (Which is my favorite) It wasn't as spicy though. The sausage made of for it. The sausage had a bit of kick. Definitely will be back to try some of the other options on the menu.

Grand Opening, Happy Hour and a FULL house!! We met up with some friends for a total of 6 of us, including two kids. We sat inside because we arrived before the rush and once that happened there were too many of us to grab a seat outside. Inside was air conditioned, and the atmosphere was fun. Service was great and we enjoyed ourselves. Outside was fun as well with live music and rooftop access. We ordered drinks from the rooftop bar and the bartenders were fast and friendly. We sampled The Crowley, Swamp Donkey and The Elder Bull. Elder Bull was my favorite as the others were a bit too sweet for my taste. As soon as the place became full, it appeared as though staff was overwhelmed at the bar and it took awhile to get our order in. However, Kay stepped up and turned it all around. She definitely wanted customers to be happy and thanks to her, we were!! Also, Walter had set our table up with waters and appetizer when we arrived and kindly checked on us throughout the evening. The food was delish y'all!! Banks Street Burger: 10oz burger! Was big and tasty, fully dressed and the fries were crisp, fresh and seasoned perfectly. Drinkery Crawfish Queso dip: Great appetizer! The dip was full of crawfish and we loved it. We ordered a 2nd one but it never made it to the table, but understandable as it was crazy busy. Chargrilled Oysters: Sizzling hot and oh so yummy! Coming back for more of those. Red beans and rice: I didn't taste it but those who did said it was great, large portion and not skimpy on the sausage. The Tremé Pasta: This was the best pasta I've had in a restaurant. The flavor was delicious and the portion size was enough to fill you! There was shrimp and/or crawfish in every bite. Overall, cute little place with easy street parking, fabulous staff, and delicious food.

Great night at the opening of this new restaurant and bar on Banks St! The food was all delicious and the drinks were excellent! Really enjoyed the ambience upstairs on the rooftop! The live music was a added treat too! They have a great menu and spectacular cocktail menu ! They charbroiled oysters were my favorite but I also enjoyed the spinach dip , the crawfish dip and the spinach dip. The crawfish and shrimp pasta was very tasty and included some slices of french bread covered in a delicious butter sauce! The buffalo wings were the bomb!!! I am looking forward to going back here and trying more dishes on the menu as well as cocktails!

Yet start this review off by saying it was a great atmosphere tonight at the Banks Drinkery and Kitchen. There was a great crowd to welcome in the new local spot in Mid-City. The location has a great patio area and a rooftop bar in addition to the indoor seating area and the seating area outside if you would like to enjoy the weather in New Orleans. The menu has a nice balance of options to the point where everyone will be able to find a great dish or appetizer to meet there expectations. We had the buffalo wings, the crab cake pasta, the spinach dip and the fried crawfish pasta. And how can I forget the Treme pasta and the glazed pork chops and mashed potatoes and Grilled vegetables. The service we received from the Operation Manager Kay was outstanding. She ensured that my whole party was taking care of and that all of orders where correct. She had the perfect attitude and personality to ensure that this new restaurant will be around for a long time.

Rating this based on other reviews and what I've seen of their great deals and atmosphere--I had heard about this place for weeks leading up to my long visit to New Orleans. Staying in Mid-City and having a craving for a casual neighborhood spot, I was excited to try this place out last night. I know a lot of places can be closed up on Mondays, though I was surprised to see a printed sign on the door saying they're closed for summer. Couldn't find any information about this anywhere else online and was a little taken aback to see them closed when they just celebrated a grand opening a month ago. Hope I'll get the chance to visit them on another trip.

Firstly I love restaurants with rooftop dining areas, so this was a win for me. I am very picky on portion size and presentation of dishes and The Banks Drinkery & Kitchen did not disappoint. There was more than enough food and the ambiance was so perfect. I recommend for dates and even just watching the game at the downstairs bar. I am here about once a week now and it is always perfection.

The Banks is such a cute Mid City drinkery with indoor, rooftop, and outdoor patio seating. I was lucky enough to experience the Banks during one of their grand openings and had the privilege to taste some of their signature cocktails, apps, and entrees. The Banks boasts themselves as a Cajun-Creole eatery, but I wouldn't make this a dinner choice, or would highlight them as a Cajun or Creole restaurant. In my opinion I think it's a great neighborhood spot with great outdoor seating with good drinks and food that helps to sop up the liquor. Service was pretty fast even with the high demand put on the staff and everyone was super friendly and welcoming. I would definitely make this a weekday Summer spot specifically for the happy hour specials and rooftop!

Delicious! I remember coming here when it was something else, but not this fabulous. The decor is very very nice, Gabriella was my waitress and EVERYTHING she recommended was delicious. The Southwest rolls .....yeah! The drinks hit the spot. I live in the neighborhood and this is our new spot. 5 stars. The rooftop is aaahhhhhjh.

Upon arriving I noticed the address seemed familiar....Its the Agave House! My wife and I loved going here before the change so I would expect to get the same experience....not quite. The food prior was great and did cater to more people. We missed the vegetarian options from the previous menu. Typical red beans and seafood. The drinks were a little watered down but it was extremely busy. Over all it's a good place to meet for drinks but the menu has room for growth.

Came here late around 9:45pm Friday night 6/14. Was greeted instantly and I requested the upstairs patio seating ( beautiful view of the neighborhood and sky)Not a problem at all seeing the restaurant was fairly slow ( prob bc it's brand new) ordered crawfish queso as an app and was delicious. Entree I ordered the shrimp platter. Came with 12 of the biggest fried shrimp I've ever seen at a Louisiana restaurant (born and raised and have lived in in New Orleans/mandeville for 26 years)fried perfect and delicious hush puppies and fries. My buddy got the burger and he said it was outstanding. The drinks are a little steep but delicious. Definitely coming back. Wayyyyy better than agave house!!! Finally good use out of this prime location

Definitely loved the vibe, atmosphere, and food! The Grand Opening was very nice. The staff was very inviting and friendly, eager to help and serve. I ordered the Treme Seafood Pasta and Chargrilled Oysters. The chargrilled oysters were really big and flavorful.. I must say they topped Acme Oyster house hands down! The pasta was filled with large shrimp and crawfish... DELICIOUS. I certainly will be making this a frequent spot.
I ordered the Southwest rolls, very spicy and savory. The serving was small but the flavors made up for it. The burger was huge and tasty. I highly recommend this new establishment.

Great open atmosphere and friendly, helpful staff. Would have never found this place without being referred here and glad I was. Had the blackened oyster poboy with the grilled veggies. Veggies were amazing. Poboy was very good. Definitely recommend the crawfish queso too!

Had the chance to attend the grand opening of The Banks Drinkery and Kitchen thanks to Yelp, and I enjoyed every second of the experience. I tried the Treme Pasta which was nothing short of flavorful, the Southwest Rolls were delectable and the chargrilled oysters would land a spot on my top 5 best chargrilled oysters. They also had an open patio and rooftop bar which was the perfect setting for a summer evening. And what's a summer evening without one of their Summer Original cocktails. I had the Crowley and The Elder Bull. Both had a kick but also a sweet flavor which was right up my alley. I'll definitely be spreading the word about this new spot and I'm anxious to go back!

I was bit sad when I first learned that beloved taco and marg spot Agave House was closing so abruptly. But I've got to say, The Banks Drinkery & Kitchen grand opening definitely showcased that this new spot will hold a special place in my heart. Shoutout to my Yelp Elite NOLA squad for hooking me up with the chance to try some items from the new menu! When I first walked in, the place was booming. You could tell a grand opening was going on and everyone was excited about trying all of the new food and drinks. I started off with some chargrilled oysters which were the absolute best I've had so far (O.K., this was only the second time I had them in my life, but they were so tasty!) They were only $1 each for a half dozen which was a great deal for the grand opening. Next it was time for an appetizer, and the Mid-City Buffalo wings did not disappoint. These were big, juicy chicken wings glazed with spicy buffalo sauce and creamy ranch on the side. An 8 piece was the perfect size, since many places I know only give about 5 wings for an appetizer. But by far my favorite part of this delicious food experience at The Banks was the Banks Street Burger. 8oz of pure C.A.B. ground chuck, short rib and brisket mixed together to create the best damn burger I've had in a while. It was fully dressed with lettuce, tomato and pickle, served on a brioche bun which pulled everything together so nicely. The french fries were seasoned to perfection. "Real french fries!" as my mother called them once she took a bite; us New Orleanians don't like fries unless they're bigger than shoestrings and seasoned more than Ronald McDonald ever could. These were indeed, "real fries". Aside from the food, the Summer Originals cocktails are what will have me coming back to this spot as well. I tried two of them, The Crowley: mezcal, lime juice, orange juice, passion fruit syrup, angostura bitters, coconut cream (pinkish in hue, sweet in flavor!) and the Elder Bull: Absolut vanilla, St. Germain, Regan's orange bitters, lemon juice, simple syrup, Red Bull⁣ (light yellow, lightly sweet; the Absolut vanilla really shows out in this drink) I loved the cocktails!! Not only were they delish but they looked so cute and since they were complimentary with the grand opening, you could pick from a list of them to try. Overall, I love this spot and I can't wait to come back, lounge on the rooftop and sip more of these cocktails and order more oysters. Next time, I'm dying to try the Treme pasta and the Southwest Rolls!

Thanks Tomas,yelp and the Staff for the invite to the Grand opening and glad to see what they do to this place (making a bet for this new one to be better). I loved the rooftop,the ambience of course next to fellow yelpers was perfect for the sunset. The music,the vibes,amazing .The bartenders were so nice and I LOVED the drinks I had,the makers mark drink and the makers by itself. Sweet in a good proportion and a really nice kick,perfect for the weather. So glad to see Oscar there (los jefes) and he was nice enough to take care of us despite the crowd. The oysters were out of this world, hands down. Just wao wao wao. We ordered the burgers (we always try to get different stuffs but we thought would be easier for the restaurant cause it was Packed. The fries were excellent but the first burger that came in the meat was super salty,had a slight line of dressing and even tho the meat was of good quality...extremely salty. The second one (we had to wait a lil bit) was ok but zero dressing,not out of this world BUT...we know it was crowded and still have a great time,good drinks and amazing oysters...and I saw everybody enjoying their meals so I wont judge at all this time. Thank you guys and I wish you nothing but the best!see you soon!!!

On May 24th, 2016 after school I drove my sweet (totes) car to Sonic. Today at Sonic it was fifty cent corndogs because it was national last day of school. I ordered eight corndogs, which is not vegan certified, and scarfed all them down (I ate all of them while driving, which is not a safety hazard). I was eating them like when Ralphie shot his eye out in that one Christmas movie. The corndog itself was majestic. If Luke Skywalker's lightsaber was a corndog I think he would choose a corndog from Sonic. The corny crispy exterior and a nice juicy warm frank on the inside. The succulent frank on my tongue felt like I was watching the movie "The Nut Job" a million times with Josh Groban singing softly in the background. I always hate the little crispy part on the bottom of the corndog because it is hard to bite off. And it was not even crispy it was kind of soggy for my taste. And they served the corndog too hot and my tongue suffered burns like when I get roasted in class by my Latin teacher. This really warmed my entire body like when penguins huddle for warmth in the North Pole. But I was salty in the way the carhop presented me my food. It is common to see a carhop wearing roller skates to serve food, but I felt like a donut because my body was filled with jelly (means I was jealous of her roller skates). I mean if my Latin teacher were there she would be appalled because of the roller skates. In conclusion, Sonic was mkay. But if you want a cheap corndog I would head to Sonic. I give Sonic 69 hams out of 100 hams.
Awesome place, great food, friendly staff, car shows every Friday night. A lot of fun
Respectful staff, quick service, on-par food. They even host events such as the car shows! -1 for not having working card readers at all stalls. That's a hassle

Love the burgers. However, we stopped by around 11pm an hour before they close and they refused to answer the drive through speaker... So we didn't get serviced even though they were in there. There were a couple cars parked at the park and order as well. Big bummer we wanted some food and they didn't get our business. We wasted our time.

If you feel the urge for Sonic, find a different location. Screwing up orders is this site's specialty. I drive farther to get to the store at 601 Big Bend Rd. in Manchester, MO (BB Rd at Sulphur Springs Rd), where the staff actually seems to care about what they do. TL;DR-- Quality control is non-existent. Unless you like to play the "Let's see what we got!" lottery, go to a different store.

This is my favorite fast food place, and really the only one that I visit, being a vegetarian. Sometimes it's late, you're starving, don't feel like cooking or getting out of your lounge clothes. Sonic to the rescue! Standard order includes a grilled cheese, fries (theirs are so good - the best!), and a strawberry limeade. Occasionally there are cheddar bites consumed. It's always consistent and good. The drinks are the best! It's cheap too. Always give your car hop a buck and they will love you for it!

Frequently eat there while motorcycle is being serviced across the street. Very professional and friendly servers. Food always correct order. Ask for the grilled chicken wrap , you won't be disappointed. Best Sonic I have been to.
I wouldn't even give this place any stars, the lady this morning at the drive thru, Sam, I believe is her name was so so rude!!! she talked to me like I was a dog

Insanely salty! I came here on my way home tonight. The chilli dog was incredibly salty from the bun to the actual hot dog & maybe the chilli! As was the tater tots! I pretty much had reached my salt limit for the entire month after tonight. I drank my strawberry slushie in between bites of the salty meal. Bad idea! The salt overempowered the sweetness of the slushie. Not good! I don't think that has ever happened to me. By itself, the slushie was incredibly sweet. Soooo sweet that I had to dilute it. Major amounts of water. Nevertheless, the service was great. It was cheap. But cheap bad salty & super sweet food. It's a marriage of diabetes & high blood pressure.

I work in the area. The young girl who always brings my drink is very nice and polite. For the most part the food is satisfactory, although the tater tots last few times a bit greasy. I love their choices of drinks. The only real negative thing I can say was recent trip and I tried their pretzel dog with bacon and cheese. Huge disappointment. Very little bacon, the pretzel bun so stale and saturated in the cheese it broke apart. I had taken this to go and ended up throwing the bulk of it away. I may just stick to hamburgers here.
Very slow, took about 10 minutes at the stall without anyone asking for my order before I left to go through the drive through where it still took forever.

Went here tonight to get some shakes for the crew at my work. Order was okay, but the employee working the drive thru intercom was extremely rude and insulting. I was reading off a list from what my employees wanted and there was nothing wrong with what was written, it was all detailed accordingly, he was just flat out rude. $14 for 3 large shakes?!?! No thanks... Food here is only okay anyways. You honestly cant go here and not drop at least $20 on just two people for simple combo meals....

Never had bad service the food was always on par. The sweet tea always tastes old. I don't usually buy sweet tea from restaurants but if I'm out that day I usually pick up a Route 44 from Sonic and this one just has old tasting tea

You wow'd me today. I have been to this Sonic a few times in the past. Normally to get a cold drink, a few food items for kids, etc. My experience today topped them all. Served with a smile, food was hot, and gentleman (maybe a manager?) fixed my order quickly (just forgot a condiment, that was all), and....my daughter changed her mind....wanted milk instead of Powerade. And....unnecessarily comped our order. Made my day to know a business cares to correct an error and please the guest/customer! We will be back! Thank you.
Great customer service and the milkshakes were yummy! So glad we finally got to taste what Sonic is all about.

All I have to say is CHOCOLATE MALT!!! They have the best in town! I also like their onion rings and hot dogs. I find it impressive that they will bring people with drink orders only their order out first so they don't have to wait unnecessarily and to get the line moving faster. Also like the skates!!
Great service and food. A group of us (almost 50) surprised them on Saturday afternoon, at lunch time, after a car show. Service was quick and everyone had a good time! Thanks Sonic!!

Incompetent employees, disgusting restrooms, and burnt food. I stopped by to grab a snack on the way home from vacation and just so happened to pick the wrong place to eat. When I first ordered the employee had no idea what I was talking about even though the item I wanted was plastered the menu. Once I finally ordered I went to the bathroom while my order was made. Big mistake. Needless to say I'm doing the pee dance while finishing my hour drive. When my food arrived I was beyond ready to go. But it gets worse. I was happy to see the pancake on a stick on the menu. That feeling quickly faded as I pulled them out of the wrapper with BROKEN sticks and discovered they were burnt beyond being able to be eaten. My specialty drink also tastes nothing like what I ordered. I never complain, I'm usually the one talking other people out of complaining, but not today. The only reason this review has one star is because I couldn't submit it with none.

Took 15 minutes to get a chicken sandwich, tots, and soda. On top of that, they messed up my order and gave me grilled instead of crispy chicken. They kindly volunteered to get me the right sandwich but I wasn't going to wait another 15 minutes. Chicken sandwich was really bland. And the tots were way too salty. I could've gone home and cooked a cheaper and better meal in the time it took for them to bring this out. It's a fast food place so i didnt come in with high expectations but for the almost $9 it cost me I did expect the food to come fast and be reasonably edible :(

This is the poorest and most expensive Sonic I've ever been to and I've been to many. Their speakers were so awful the man taking orders had to come to the car to take the order for 2 waters! They charged me $2.72 for 2 large waters with strawberry and lime and it was during typical "happy hour" time. Then the server walked off with my change just assuming it was her tip!!! I would NOT recommend this place to anyone!
Ordered this and got this smh at 12:15pm. So I'm at work all day and won't get home until about 8pm....sooooo hungry.

Hey Sonic. Wtf!!! Got your #1 combo today and you charged me 50 cents more than ur menu says. Nice racket to steal that much from every order pretty soon it turns into real $. Be careful and check your receipt to see if they try this with you. If I want to be stolen from I can get the tax man to do it better. Share this with all your friends!!!

this was awful...i pulled into sonic tonight with respectfully high hopes. FUCK THIS MOTHER FUCKING SONIC!!! i pulled into the car hop station with intentions of trying the new boba drink, alongside a small order of mozzarella sticks...WTF SONIC! soon after i placed my order, i was approached by a worker named indigo. she not only came up to my passenger side window, she did not have a mask, and she questioned my competence in driving my own car. because apparently i was parked next her car. as i mentioned prior, i was parked in a car hop stall. WHY TF WERE YOU PARKED IN CUSTOMER PARKING???? the whole encounter was very unpleasant, unprofessional, and dare i say uncomfortable. not to mention the mozzarella sticks gave me a mad case of the shits later that night. so girl, save yourself the trouble. don't do it! go to mcdonald's instead. it's cheaper and better anyways. AND INDIGO DOES NOT WORK THERE!
Was super busy during the corona virus pandemic however, they were amazing and efficient! Our waitress was a red head with a few nasal piercings and she was so so sweet! Bravo!

The worst Sonic I've ever been to!! Do not waste your time. The person who took our order was extremely rude and not helpful. My father ordered a kids chicken nugget kids meal and the employee said "we don't have chicken nuggets" probably 3 times and he said, "I'm sorry I meant chicken tenders" and the man said "ohmygod" and just dropped off for a few minutes. I jumped in to help my father order and the guy was so rude, took forever, and when our food finally came the service didn't say a word to us. This location needs to train their employees to wear smiles and be kind.

Bunch of dopes work here, they are clueless about specials they run on TV and via their text program. Food is fair at best as it's usually not fresh, don't waste your time move on to another fast food joint, youll thank me later.
Consistently Goodl!!! They Have Great Salads, Wings and Pasta! ALWAYS FRESH TOO!! They are a bit pricier than other spots but totally Worth it!

These people want to make you fat!!! Just kidding but when you order an entree it's enough for 2 people plus having left overs the next day!!!! Vodka rigatoni and seafood appetizer was awesome. Definitely order from them!!!! Love it

Just went here for the first time after reading the good reviews on Yelp. The portion size will blow you away. Each one of the three of us had enough food for a complete meal the following day. The prices are very reasonable, especially considering the portion sizes. We ordered the turkey club, the pulled pork burger, the chicken parmigiana dinner, and the Eagle fries. All were excellent and we will certainly be back.

First time ordering. Delivery was prompt. The food was beyond delicious. The chicken & potatoes were cooked perfectly and the lemon sauce that went with the dish was outstanding. I also ordered their chicken soup which was definitely homemade and quite good. I will definitely be ordering again and/or visiting.
We are new to the area and DiCarlo has quickly become our go to spot! We order from here at least once a week. The food is always great, delivery is quick and customer service is excellent!!

We love De Carlos!! Service is great, delivery is usually very prompt and the chicken dishes, calamari with shrimp app and pizza are amazing! You will not be disappointed, but if by smallest chance you are, Carlos and team go out of their way to make sure that you are happy!!! We also appreciate Carlos, who will actually get on the phone with us and help with a special order or suggest some great dishes! Definitely support this small business. My family and friends want to see this restaurant in our community for a very long time!

We did this last night and it was fantastic! From the pleasant person on the phone who recommended "Grandmom's Pizza" (yah, do this, you won't regret it!) to the specialty dishes we had as entrees, everything was fresh and really tasty. We will definitely eat here (well, takeout) again. Keep up the great work DiCarlo's!!!

Just ordered takeout... we ordered a Provonella Pizza, Chicken Francaise, and a Chicken Scarpariello... and for a pizza place the food is delicious and amazing.. also the people who work there are so friendly!!! We will be returning!!!

Delicious dinner! Our family of 6 ordered chicken parm, penne pasta with vodka sauce, came with a delicious salad( house balsamic is superb)and garlic knots. Everyone enjoyed the meal! And we have enough for dinner tomorrow night. Carlos was helpful from start to finish. We will be back! Thank you!!

The service was friendly and the food was prepared as ordered and quick. Unfortunately, those are the bright spots for my experience. The pizza was very average. The crust was floppy and a bit bland, the cheese was fine but a little greasy. The sauce had a nice tang and was the best part of the pizza. If I had just ordered the pizza, I probably would've rated it 3*. I made the mistake of ordering the wings. I ordered them with the standard buffalo/hot sauce. The sauce on them was shockingly greasy. There was little to no heat or wing sauce flavor. I could only stomach 2 wings before the grease became too much. I dried them off myself with paper towels, tossed them in the oven for a few minutes to try and dry them out, then used my own sauce to try to salvage the wings. If I had ordered just the wings, this would've been a 1* rating. Overall, the wings were some of the worst I've ever had due to the grease. The pizza is OK, but there are better options very close by. I don't see myself ordering here again.

I have had take out here three times now. Everybody is always very pleasant and friendly. We have had their seafood salad which is to die for! I have also had their cheesesteak sandwiches and wings. All have been excellent. I am looking forward to trying out other menu items. I would strongly recommend Di Carlos.
Ordered Delivery for 1st time. Portions were HUGE!! Great food, great wings, and quick delivery.

DiCarlo does itself a disservice by letting itself be called only a pizza joint. The "restaurant" is really the more important piece of the action at this small Italian kitchen in the Mallard Creek Shopping Center, Richboro. There is an extensive menu with some interesting dishes that cry for attention. Very glad we went that way, rather than limiting ourselves to a couple of pies as suggested by the restricted name. We ordered Chicken Francaise with Linguini, Veal Bruschetta with Broccoli, Carlos Junior with Linguini and a Chicken Parmigiana Sandwich.
