They were all huge portions, well designed and surprisingly tasty. The francaise was three large breast medallions in a decent butter, lemon, white wine sauce. It could have been more tender and penne would have worked better than the messy linguini. Still it was good, if not best of breed. On the other hand, the veal was lightly breaded and pan fried before being topped with fresh chopped tomato bruschetta. It was delicious even if the broccoli had long tough stalks. The Junior was basically an Italian Sausage and Penne dish with a garlicky sauce. Good, but its name was the most creative part. Finally, the Chicken Parm sandwich was immense and very good. Each dish was enough for at least two meals, so in combination with the reasonable prices, made for an economical family feast to celebrate surviving another week of Covid. Because of the lack of attention to detail on a few of our choices, the actual score is 3.5 Stars, rounded up. Refine the francaise sauce a bit, pare down the broccoli to remove more tough stalk, use real Italian loaf for garlic bread, offer choice of pasta on phone orders; and this simple house could approach a five star takeout experience.
Another amazing meal! We enjoyed every bite! The Chicken Della Casa is delicious! Thanks for your terrific service. We'll continue to order family dinners from you- always an awesome experience!

Was so pleasantly pleased (even a little surprised) with this pizzeria! To be honest, didn't even know it existed until trying to order for our regular place, which was unfortunately closed for 4th of July weekend. Who does that?! Ordered a Brooklyn pie, vodka rigatoni with chicken and three salads with salmon. Delivered within 35 minutes and everything was superb! Pizza, supper crunchy on the bottom, great sauce, very generous size. The Vodka rigatoni (I think it was like $13) came in a large metal container. I was shocked with how large the portion was and my son said it was best he's ever had. We also ordered what I believe what was called the "Nona" salad. Mixed greens, with tomatoes, olives, onions and a very generous portion of salmon that was topped with mango salsa. Came with a very tangy mango dressing. It was very gourmet. Again, I was pleasantly surprised ($10) not a bad price for a salad with salmon! They also included three large slices of garlic bread and a small side salad with the pasta. I definitely want to try more options, but so far, we might have to switch to Di Carlo's Pizza for our pizza nights.

This place is amazing! I was looking for a sushi place on Uber Eats and found Sushi Stop because it was offering the 3 roll special. If you are able to order in directly from the store, it will be cheaper than the prices on Uber Eats. At $15 for any 3 rolls, it's a pretty good deal for the quality of the sushi. I ordered the salmon avocado roll, the spicy tuna roll, and the eel roll. The first thing J noticed was how much salmon came in each of the salmon avocado rolls. The salmon was delicious and fresh, probably my favorite roll. The spicy tuna and eel rolls were also great, and you could tell the rice was fresh and a great texture. The 3 rolls came with a miso soup and a salad, which I was pleasantly surprised by. Sushi stop is a must try restaurant!
Always fresh, delicious, fast!!! Highly recommend raw fish and sushi! My recent go to!!
FABULOUS presentation and taste! Delightful service and an all around must eat here establishment.

I think this will be our new go-to local sushi place. It has been hard to find good sushi places in the area. This place is great- the fish was fresh and the rolls were constructed well, even for takeout. The rolls are definitely plentiful and I think we ordered too much but it was very good. It is a little expensive but the quality is the best we have had. Definitely try this place!

As usual I forget to take a photo. Anyways... So good! I used to work at sushi restaurants and I studied and learned a lot about sushi. And I can say with confidence DELICIOUS! The rice IS EVERYTHING when it comes to sushi (sushi means seasoned rice) and the rice here was perfect, well seasoned and not too sticky. We orders the Sushi Lunch and Dance Monkey roll, soooooo delicious! I'm addicted! Most sushi places don't give you a great assortment of sushi's, but my Sushi Lunch looked like it consisted Salmon nigiri, red tuna nigiri, White tuna nigiri, yellow tail nigiri and the last one tasted kinda like red snapper maybe? Not sure. I love that they don't over rice or over stuff the inside, to me it was well balanced Now the Dance Monkey roll made me go "WOAH MMMM" **eyes bugle** it was right up my alley, it was so clean in flavor and not over sauced. I wanted to eat more ! I really hope everyone who is reads this review orders from Sushi Stop and falls in love with this place! And next time I'll remember to takes photos :)

This was our first time ordering food in over a year due to the pandemic. We also moved right before it began, so we don't know the restaurants in town. But the food was excellent and we will definitely be ordering again and hopefully dining in the future!

I ordered from here yesterday first time and I must say everything was absolutely insane my husband got the steak and shrimp hibachi and the presentation was beautiful it looked and smelled amazing he said it was so tasty I got the Naruto roll and it was so fresh and the sushi stop roll I believe it was and it was beyond great I definitely think I found a new sushi spot! It was really nice too that they threw in a sample of the crab salad which was also amazing!!!! Def order from here if u have the chance u will not be disappointed!!!!!!
Such a clean place with friendly service. Delicious sushi, seafood soup & bento boxes. And my child got a cute present at the end of the meal!

Sushi Stop became our to-go sushi place recently. So happy they opened right by our house with a quick drive for pick up. I do love their online ordering, which definitely eliminates confusion and allows advance ordering as well. With the pandemic, the added benefit of being able to pay online, eliminates the transaction at the restaurant. We've ordered sushi here probably 5 or 6 times to date. Always surprised with how quickly it is ready. The rolls are tasty, with max fish and minimal rice. They have a nice assortment of rolls as well. We've gotten some teriyaki and hibachi dishes as well. All very fresh and tasty. Their pricing is very competitive. On a separate occasion, I ordered a lunch of chicken katsu curry. That, unfortunately, was very disappointing. The typically thick curry sauce, resembled consistency of a miso soup, just pure water (as can be seen on the picture). Not sure if something went wrong here or that was their typical curry. Would definitely go back for the sushi an other entrées!

Ordered twice from them within 4 days. The first time was to see if we liked their food ( we loved it) and the second was for company from NY who are foodies. They loved it too. Will be back again, and again. Tasty, plentiful and nicely presented.
Great spot for quality sushi. It's pretty busy and they sometimes off free appetizer to try! Def one of my fav spots in warminster
Our new favorite spot, quality food! Sashimi is always fresh. We have been ordering from here almost weekly, since discovering it on Yelp.

Very very good and local sushi! We ordered sushi for Mother's Day this year and glad we did! We normally go to a different sushi place but think we are going to stick with this one! We got the tempura, Philly roll, the pink girl, volcano roll and sweet 16. All were delicious we especially loved the volcano roll and the pink girl! Can't wait to try more specialty rolls and they even gave us a sample of the cooked fish tempura roll which was right up my mother in law's liking! That was very nice of them! The place looked small on the inside but that doesn't matter for take out!

The sushi was excellent, the seaweed salad as well. The California rolls we chose were well turned out, but the yaki with shrimp could have had a little more zing and the shrimp were over cooked. We would definitely go back.
Most of the time I go here the food is cold, stale, or just plain bad. The only carls jr around that has this problem. Not sure why.

Went here for the last time last night! All the buns were crunchy and tasted stale. I paid over $9 for a PROMO guacamole bacon thick burger got one piece of bacon folded in half two burger patties that had been in the warmer since lunch and a teaspoon of guacamole. To top it off it was the size of a jbc at jack in the box which is sold for $1.49....complete waste of time and money. Went next door to taco Del Mar for good food! Wife got chicken strips they weren't horrible but very small and way over priced and to top that all off they were outta all their chicken for their sandwiches. I guess when you're not selling anything because your service and food suck it doesn't make much sense to restock.

Look, this is simply one of the worst fast food joints you can eat at. Watch my YouTube video on the chicken sandwich they served me. Amazing anyone on the planet would be proud to serve that. I have gone to this joint since created and it was amazing 20 years ago. It was my favorite. Now the only consistency is bad bad food and average service. Want a chicken sandwich, go to chick filet. So sad it has gone this far down hill. So far they resort to ads that are totally disgusting selling nothing but sex or a hamburger in their minds. Carl's, can't wait till your gone. HEY Carl's, do you even follow or give a crap about social media? Look at your reviews. Maybe corporate needs to pay a visit. Well we all know your employees are just a reflection of your superiors or should we say the PRESIDENT of the company.
The only reason we eat this crappy food is because it falls under "fast"... and its not even that. 11 min in the drive thru.. seriously??? Never again.

Horrible service! We ordered a 2 BACON & egg burritos and 1 country style burrito and received 2 STEAK & egg burritos and 1 country style burrito. When I notified the cashier, who gave us our receipt then ran off, she was already handing me the bag of food. I was the passenger and let her know that our order was incorrect and she looked at my husband like she was expecting him to say something. It was weird! She then goes back to have our order corrected and came back to double-check that we wanted 2 BACON & egg burritos and 1 country style burrito. I said yes! We got the corrected order and she handed us some change, which was the difference in price between the steak & egg to the bacon & egg burritos. We thanked her and left. I opened up the order and found only 1 BACON & egg burrito with unmelted shredded cheese. so I ate a cold burrito basically as that is how it tasted. I wouldn't have eaten it hadn't I been so hungry and headed out of town on HWY 55. I'm very sadly disappointed in the service we receive and WOULD not recommend this location to anyone.
They were closed 45 minutes before closing time and when I went through the drive through in attempt to order, they turned the lights off

I don't eat at fast food much- but when I do- I will pick a place like this one- as always the nicest people, always very clean (incl bathrooms) & menu includes ability to avoid gluten in buns by requesting lettuce wrapped. They have also been paying t about my speech issues here too. It saddens me to see the other poor reviews... as in the 7+ yrs I've lived here... my 1-2 times a yr here hsve always been lovely (as compared to similar type restaurants.)

I'm fairly conscientious about not going into restaurants within 30 minutes of closing. When we went into this place at 8pm (with an 11pm) close time on door, I was a little surprised to have to walk around a week floors sign, see the garbages all emptied and the crew in process of cleaning out the back. We ordered nonetheless and the food was delivered quickly and it tasted fresh. The service was nice and quick but couldn't get over the constant feeling that me being there was getting in their way. 3 hours before closing.

Today was my last visit to Carl's Jr. I shop at the drive-through after working out. My old standby, Chicken Taco Salad w/o cream is no longer available. One of the few healthier alternatives, gone. So am I.
I always have a good experience here and some of the best burgers for the money in town. They need an app though.. Coupons are nice but an app would be better.
Filthy store, cold food, mistakes on orders,getting worse by the week. Done giving this place a chance. Decided to pay more and go next door to Freddys. Do yourself a favor.

I've been here a handful of times since they opened long ago. For fast food, it's been edible and satisfied my hunger pains when I was starving and had zero time to drive to and/or wait at a decent place. Other than that, this place is a dump. Dirty floors, dirty tables, dirty surfaces everywhere. Not out of the norm for sodas to be out. Got the last drop of iced tea today. Fry sauce dispenser handle was all sticky and frozen in place. Had to force it down which sprayed fry sauce all over me. Same with the ketchup dispenser. However, it did dispense a small amount of dark red tomato paste. Gross. I could have made a sculpture with it. Today seemed worse than times in the past. The men's bathroom smelled like a high school locker room with wafts of fry and burger grease. From what I remember, the bathrooms have always been dirty and beat up. The people here have always been nice, though. If you eat here, use the drive thru and spare yourself the dining room experience, or lack thereof.

Happened to be in the area so decided to try the local BBQ place which opened in Jan 2016. There are the staple ribs, pulled pork, chicken and brisket on the menu along with a few other options such as turkey. I decided to try the BBQ pulled pork sandwich lunch special which came with a side and a drink. Decided to try their hand-cut fries as a side. The cut was nice and thick but unfortunately the potatoes were not twice fried or were fried at a lower temp than needed as they were a bit soggy. Twice frying thick cut fried would be ideal so as not to undercook the potatoes but also give it a crunchy exterior. The pork was succulent and juicy, on a potato bun. Though all meats are smoked with a dry rub, in this case, the best part were the wide variety of sauces on the table. I liked the sweet chili bbq sauce but their regular bbq was also quite good. The sandwich came with pickles which seemed to be housemade but I cannot confirm that. Half slab of ribs were $13.99 which is not outrageous, but a tad high for the area. The restaurant itself was large and clean and I hope they have enough local support to not face the same faith as other BBQ places in the area. I will be back to try their smoked wings and brisket and chicken .... and...

My husband and I have eaten here twice. First, I have to say I was really excited when this place opened because this area has way too many chain restaurants. The first thing I noticed when I walked in was that I had no idea what to do! It was our first time there and there wasn't anyone to direct us on how to order. As I sat waiting for my food (keeping in mind that I was told it would be 10 minutes, when it actually took close to 25 minutes), I noticed a lot of the same confusion from other patrons entering the restaurant. Now on to the food. The redneck baked potato was, by far, the best item we ordered. My husband ordered the ribs and beef brisket. Both had very good flavoring, but the ribs were so tough, it was nearly jerky! The beef brisket wasn't as tough, but it definitely wasn't juicy. I gave this place the benefit of the doubt and tried it twice, but I doubt I'll be returning. Such a shame.
Food was good but they were out of ribs, pulled pork at 7:00 on a Saturday. Don't know what was up and three young boys in late teens or early twenties running the joint.

I was just at this place for the first time tonight, I was so disappointed, our food came out cold, the bread was super soggy, and we didn't even receive all of our food at the same time. As we were sitting there waiting for our food a couple walked out cause it turned out that they served us the other tables appetizers. When our food came out, the bread was soggy and we never received our sides. Also my boyfriend's sons food never came out. My bf went up twice to ask where his sons food was and it never came until finally the third time he went up and said something. He told them to just put it in a to-go container that we were leaving. Upon getting home, the brisket sandwich was fatty, and rubbery, the side of Mac an cheese was tasteless and just downright horrible. We will never go there again. I'll drive to Unionville and have Hood's BBQ before I step foot in this place again. They should be shut down for the kind of service and so called "quality" food.

We deviated from our hurdle of greater than 3 stars and 15 reviews since we haven't had BBQ for quite awhile. I stayed away from the brisket as advised and went for the pulled pork since they said it was freshly made. We just found that the food was on the bland side. The coleslaw was not bad. The sauces were pretty ordinary and sorry, but store bought BBQ sauces are better. The Jalapeño Cheddar cornbread was awful. Too crumbly and no flavor. Didn't taste like fresh baked. The chili had no heat at all. The folks running the place were very friendly that we might go back to see if they listen to their food reviews. Please work on the Mac n Cheese. It was horrible.

I went there for lunch today. The bread on the sandwich was stale. There were files all over and the macaroni and cheese was all mushed up and salty, Kraft Mac and cheese would be better than that. The best part of my meal was the sweet tea from the fountain. Gross is the best word I can use. The food seriously made me sick in my stomach and very bloated!

No reason to go back. On a Wednesday night around 7 my buddy and I went in and were the only 2 people there. Everything we ordered was just "meh" and we both shared the same opinion. Service was OK, not slow, but then again no one else was there. I'd go there again if someone else wanted to.

Nice people, but the BBQ is poor. They offered us a taste of their special that night, brisket sloppy joe. It tasted OK, but I am always concerned about places that sell chopped brisket because it often means they need to mask it with sauce. The brisket slices I ordered were sliced paper thin and were not well trimmed, even for a fatty cut. The taste was like roast beef and there was plenty of grease on my plate. My wife's 1/2 rack of pork ribs tasted OK, but were dry and the fat had not rendered enough. The ribs were very thin, although there was an ample number. The sides were not good either. The cole slaw had some kind of fruity edge, but something else off putting that I could not describe. The baked beans tasted as if they had come from a can. The potato salad was overdressed and the potatoes themselves had a crusty edge as if they had been fried first. It was a pity that they abused the collard greens to the point where they had no flavor without adding some of the spicy mustard BBQ sauce. Actually the three sauces on the table may have been the best part of the offerings. (They were out of mac and cheese.) Given the chance to return, I would take a pass.

Although the rack of ribs were good the Cole slaw needs some work plus Forget the mac and cheese, being only open 9 weeks they should have time to tune up there food, by the way the brisket needs to be cut against the grain so that you can enjoy it better

I've eaten here twice now in the past week as I just bought a house in the neighborhood. The pulled pork is great. Like the other reviewer said the mac n cheese is pretty awful. The Brisket needs some work it was really dry. They just opened a couple months ago. I'll keep going for now and stick to the good stuff. I hope they improve.

The owner was very nice but the food was bland. The pulled pork was sufficient, but prices were high for the portions provided. The sides were very ordinary. They don't have anything fried, so the sides are all vegetables for the most part. That would be fine but out of the four sides I asked about, they didn't have any of them. On my two trips in it was completely empty both times. You can't really blame the owner because this spot has had several other restaurants cycle through it over the past 5-7 years.

We ordered the supreme dinner meal. It definitely fed 6 people. The pulled pork, ribs and wings were tasty. The spices on the ribs were good with a nice rub with cayenne pepper. The wings were really good and no need for additional sauce as the rub on the meat was sufficient. The flavor of the pork was good as well, just needed a little BBQ sauce to moisten it. Very disappointed in the size of the sandwich, for $7.99 should have been a hoagie roll (6in). What you received was more like a small round dinner roll. Cornbread was good, had the jalapeno cornbread too and was not spicy...didn't taste the jalapeno pepper at all. Will order again, but will eat in next time. Would have given you 4 stars, however part of the order was not provided and had to return to pick it up.

I had the chopped brisket sandwich during my visit. I thought it was pretty decent! I would have liked to have the option to control my own sauce portion on the meat, but unfortunately the chopped sandwich comes premixed. All in all, a fairly solid sandwich.

Don't believe the hype- this place is great ! I think people get used to the fact that most BBQ joints in the area all tend to taste the same. This guy's doing something different and it's worth it. He likes what he does and you can tell. I work nearby and come for lunch as often as my health and wallet can afford it ... BTW - the Turkey is bangin' I agree with another reviewer about 1 thing - the building has had many a failed business there ... it's like 1 of those cursed spots but working near I have found most of them were good but Rick's got something better going here

This place serves great BBQ. Brisket and pulled pork are always excellent. Sides are usually good too, although I wasn't a fan of their cornbread because it was served at room temperature. One of my favorite stops in the area.

I'll start out by saying I really like this place, and the people here are always extremely nice and accommodating. I want this place to succeed, and I hope it does because the things that they do well, they do really well. For starters, the redneck baked potato (baked potato topped with pulled pork, chili and cheddar cheese) is a stroke of genius. The pulled pork is very good, as is the turkey thigh (which is tastily seasoned and served off the bone). The flavor of the smoked wings is incredible, my only complaint is that I would prefer them a little crispier. I disagree with a previous review about the BBQ sauce, I find all three varieties to be flavorful and really good. I have not tried the ribs yet, so I can't comment on them. I can't recommend the brisket, as it was tough and sliced like roast beef when I had it, unlike your typical BBQ brisket which falls apart. I love cornbread, but I don't care for the cornbread here unfortunately. The mac and cheese is just okay. Overall, I like this place and I plan to keep coming back. I hope they improve some of their offerings to round out their menu, because they do have some great food so there's no reason to believe they can't have a whole menu that is great.

A new place on Charlotte in Pottstown close to home. It Is a counter joint and I am judging it as a counter joint. I am happy that it is not another pizza place and thrilled that the food is good. The ham is tasty, and the turkey is good as well. The pulled pork is the best I ever had since it is not overly greasy or too fatty and seemed like high quality meat. They have 3 sauces. I liked the regular BBQ sauce, which is a little spicy, but not too much. Mac and cheese is just okay, certainly not the best I ever had. I love the French fries because they are nice thick cuts of potatoes. The chili has big chucks of beef in it and is not too soupy, and has a nice little kick of spice. Everything I have tried so far seemed to have high quality ingredients and was freshly made. Service is friendly. Overall, really good!
Closed now, apparently. Mediocre food and service. No bbq nearby that I know of, either.
I went here once before it closed and loved it! I was thrilled to see they opened a new location even closer to me on Charlotte St near Redner's and the Brookside Diner. Can't wait to check it out!

This place should be ashamed that they call themselves a BBQ place. I ate at their original location near the mall. Now, they are around the corner from where I live and I'd never eat there again. The only time we ate there, our server literally threw our utensils on the table. I have smokers and have been smoking for the last 9 years and will tell you this place does not know how to smoke meats. I'd be very surprised if they last a year.

In the past, this place had been much better. I had noticed increasing prices, decreasing quantities, and slowly declining service. I had always sat in the "more casual" front area although the latest time I went we were forced to sit in the dining room in the back which is much more formal (and unexpected). I love the clear soup and the sampler with all the rolls/dumplings (four seasons I think is the name?!?). I'm not sure when I'll come back, but there have been a coupe good meals there once upon a time.
Closed for business spring 2013. Replaced by Biryani King.

At onetime this was an upscale Vietnamese restaurant. While some vestiges of its prior glory remain, a slimmed down menu, strong pho inclination, and dumbed down spice for American taste buds have left it a shadow of its former self. Good lunch spot, but I guess I miss the Old one when it comes to dinner.

I love Vietnamese food. This was some of the worst I've ever had, which is extra painful because it was also way overpriced. Ordered the appetizer sampler ($25) and the flank steak pho ($10) The sampler was super disappointing - the ingredients appeared to be old and of poor quality. Lemongrass shrimp wasn't terrible, but the meatballs and grape leaves were. The two other rolls were nothing to write home about. The pho was probably the most heartbreaking dish I've ever been served. It was served in laughably small bowl, with a few greenish slices of flank steak. My mom actually couldn't believe that it was beef when she saw it - "No...that must be a mushroom or something". It was served only with bean sprouts and lime. No cilantro or basil? Perhaps then we could have masked the sickeningly sweet flavor of the broth.

The Green Papaya is one of my favorite restaurants in the area. Their food and service are consistently excellent and there's never any waiting to be seated. The menu is fairly extensive as they're technically a Vietnamese/Thai place and they have good coverage of both. The atmosphere isn't bad, but its nothing to write home about either, just a plain jane place for dinner. They serve, in my opinion, the best Pad Thai there. Granted, I don't have extensive experience, but its the best to me. They also have an "appetizer" called the four seasons which is a sample of their snow, summer, autumn and spring rolls and really excellent. They also recently started serving Pho, which is excellent also. The prices are very reasonable for the area and they often have coupons in The Clipper for 20% off which makes it a steal.
Update. This place is awful. Vietnamese summer rolls with NO HERBS in them whatsoever. No mint, no basil, no cilantro.

Prices are a bit high for Vietnamese food but they have fresh/crisp vegetables and beautifully prepared meat in their noodle dishes(bun). Fish sauce here is also top notch, which is paramount in eating authentic Vietnamese food. Overall, a nice find for good vietnamese food in Exton.

We stopped here to get a quick bite on a Saturday and it wasn't crowded. We will have to go back another time to try some different stuff. The egg roles were excellent the other things with a spongy paper roll with shrimp was just OK. I would go again and hopefully update the review accordingly.

Over the past few years we have had some fairly decent meals at Green Papaya. The one consistent element to the restaurant is the absolutely horrible service. Sure, you get seated right away, but then you wait and wait to even be acknowledged. This evening we were seated immediately upon entering. Of concern was the fact that there only seemed to be one waitress and one busboy for the entire place. After 20 minutes of waiting and not being spoken to we left.... I don't care how good the food might be, you just can't treat customers that way....

Location is good, the food is generally good. I like the variety and the sort of pan-Southeast Asian theme. With appetizers and all, it can be a bit pricey. But if the weather's nice you can sit outside. The service runs from OK to poor. While dining here for an anniversary, my long-suffering spouse remarked: Except for the food, the atmosphere and the service, it was good. Ouch. But she had the Malaysian Beef, which I've always avoided. I still go here from time to time, but not with my spouse.
The best Vietnamese I've ever had. If you get take-out pho, they wrap up the ingredients separately - including the raw meat - so you can make it perfect at home.

This review is only applicable to the Pho. The broth was very good, but the portion was small. In other words, over priced. I don't mind spending $10 on soup, but it better fill me up and come in a very large bowl. The bean sprouts, mint and jalapenos could have been more fresh. I would love to have it again, but based on my first impression I will probably not go back for Pho, as it was not as filling as it should be and cost too much for a snack.

Quite a good little place, convenient to PHL airport, which was why we were in the area to begin with. My best friend's son had a sore throat and pho ga seemed like the way to go, so I found it on Yelp and we popped off of the highway for some dinner. The server was very sweet, attentive, and doting. The goi cuon (summer rolls) were outstanding, the cha gio (spring rolls) were amongst the best I've had. The pho looked a bit small compared to California standards, but my nephew liked it... my friend chicken dish in peanut sauce, he loved. My bun ga nuong cha gio was quite good, though I found it odd that the noodles were cut, never saw that anywhere before. Great food, great service. A little pricey compared to what I'm used to, especially the seafood, but it was a good meal overall, and if I were in the area, I'd return.
This place sucks. Vietnamese food is supposed to be flavorful and come alive with fresh, fresh herbs. Everything here tastes flat and not too fresh. Service is standard. Not good, not bad.

A gem in the sea of restaurants in Exton. I had the coconut shrimp which was very good, although I might not get that as dinner again. The service was great and friendly. Food was excellent, from appetizers to dinner. Atmosphere is quaint and inviting.

Golden One is a new Chinese American kitchen just behind Neshaminy Mall in the same center as DMV. It is a large room with well spaced tables and a fast takeaway operation. The menu is extensive and they do have a sushi guy slicing and wrapping seaweed. My first impression was positive for a simple Egg Foo Young plate with Egg Roll, Wonton Soup and white rice. The base stock for the soup was chicken broth that was not too salty and had decent wonton/dumplings that were not thick skinned, nor with questionable meat filling. The egg roll was even better with adequate roast pork mixed with cabbage and a few greens. The EFY was two pancakes filled with more pork and veggies and a better than average brown sauce that seems to have been prepared just in time. Overall, I liked this meal on their Combination menu for dinner. I particularly appreciated the absence of obligatory broccoli florets, which is way overdone by most Chinese restaurants. The house being clean with friendly service was also a pleasant positive touch. Yes. I grade these places on a curve.

Stopped in for lunch today despite 3 1/2 stars. After reading the negative reviews I decided it was worth a shot and for the most part I was not disappointed. Lunch menu general tso chicken comes with soup and fried noodles Value - prices are high everywhere now so I expected to pay more but overall not bad Food. Shrimp fried rice lacked a tremendous amount of flavor general tso chicken was pretty good Restaurant. This place was pretty spotless Friendliness. People there were very nice Overall 4 stars...could be 5 if rice had more flavor

Good food, wife and I had a sit down late lunch, got two different combo meals. Egg rolls were nice size and good,wonton soup was good also,The 4 stars is for comparison purposes to other chinese restaurants

Well i am so glad we came back here. I must have hit this place on a bad night a few months back because the last two times we ordered from here it was really good. I do miss the sheds of chicken in the wonton soup like way back but their wonton/egg drop soup was pretty good. Shrimp &lobster sauce yummy nice big shrimp, the loi mein is also pretty good not greasy.
This is my favorite Chinese food restaurant in the area. Everything is fresh and made to order! Delicious and it isn't greasy!

I am so happy a new Chinese Restaurant in Bensalem. We tried it for the first time tonight. The wonton soup is the best I have had in a long time. I ordered General Tso's Chicken. The pork fried rice was loaded with pork and the rice was light. The chicken had just the right amount of kick. My husband hand the Shrimp in Lobster sauce. He was delighted to find lobster! Definitely headed there again!
I haven't dined in, but have ordered delivery several times since they've been open and the food has been delicious and consistent. It also always arrives very quickly.
Best Chinese food in Bensalem!! Super clean and food is fresh very quick made to order food. Over all great experience
This place is a Rip off .try getting pork fried rice, prices are high vs what you get,

This place is great! Sushi was fresh and serving sizes were larger than we expected. We have ordered twice from here each time trying different items and the entrees were delicious. Staff was friendly and the pick up followed all social distancing guidelines. Glad to support a small business.

Finally a more than good Chinese/Japanese restaurant in the actual neighborhood! They just opened a couple of weeks ago with their grand opening delayed by the virus. At this time it's takeout only, with ordering on-line or by phone. Pickup is by their front door which is set up in a safe social distancing manner. We were hoping to order the Peking Duck but it looks like at this time the complete menu is not available. What we did have was delicious. The Soft Shell Crab appetizer was very good, generous in it's size and was delicately fried and had a delicate dipping sauce. The Orange Chicken was slightly spicy (as ordered) and served with broccoli and again a nice size portion. White rice was included. There was an assortment of Ramens, which in this area, is very unusual. Although our first pick was not available, they picked a Tonkotsu Ramen which, with its smokey broth, shrimp and delicious noodles, was excellent. Hope that all this virus stuff goes away really soon so that we can enjoy a meal with them inside their restaurant. With tip, the bill came to around $35.00
Nit sure ufvwe hit this place on a bad night but seemed to a lot better the first time we ordered. One day maybe they will open a good Chinese food place in this area

First time ordering. Food was very good and we certainly need a good Chinese restaurant around here. I really don't know what they have or don't have because they seem to keep their phone off the hook. I actually got someone to answer after an hour of a busy signal but the person picked up the phone and must have just placed it down. You could hear them talking but never came back on so I ended up just ordering our usual. I know they just opened but maybe get someone that knows how to take orders via the phone. I certainly will order again if I can reach the place.

We tried this place because it was new. We ordered simple items that every Chinese restaurant has. 1. Fried rice. Not good. 2. Wonton soup. Flavorless. If they can't get these basic items to taste good, I can't imagine the rest of the items being good. Maybe it's because they are new and still figuring it out, but for now I have no interest in returning.
Food was pretty good. Ordered some kung pao shrimp and some shrimp curry. They also included some free sweets for my order. This might be my new goto chinese spot
Delicious Food.Service is amazing everyone is super nice. They also give freebies My family and I have had take out and it always come with some free stuff. Great price, Great Food,Great service.
P.s they use the cheapest oil,shortening,lard. That's why some people comment they taste a funny taste.
Best Chinese food in this area! Still fairly new to the Bensalem area, but reasonably priced, order is always ready when they say and their dining area is low key and never crowded.

Horrible! We all got sick on their food! We only ordered from the combination menu, egg rolls, soup, pork fried rice, shrimp fried dumplings. Everything was super greasy! I think the shrimp in the dumplings may have been turned. I took one bite of the greasiest egg roll ever and spit it out! Couldn't tell you what the mush was inside of it! Completely unidentifiable! Will never try it again! Go somewhere else!

Found the online ordering unfriendly and unnecessarily confusing. Because I ordered online they charged me "a convenience fee"... then to add insult to injury the included a tip automatically.... Why for takeout! So when you pay with a card online , they keep the credit card/ Debt card info on file.... Why? Felt very uneasy when I went to Pickup my order, only to find they said they didn't have my order on record. Only tried this place because Hong Kong Pearl in Langhorne was closed... I'll never go back.
Very good crabragoon and hot and sour soup! Finally a good carry out Chinese food! You won't be disappointed.
Horrible. The chicken was horrible and the fried rice and egg roll wasn't even good, it was all hard and old tasting. Not one good taste here, I wouldn't advise anyone to go here.
Very good neighborhood fast food Chinese. Their prices were reasonable and the food was fresh & hot.

Their chicken is probably not chicken. Their beef is probably not beef. At least not ANY form of chicken/beef I've ever tasted. I will say that their pork dumplings are pretty good. Nothing else worth ordering.

Not sure if we ordered the wrong thing or not but we could not eat the food. We ordered hot and sour soup, wonton soup, crab Rangoon, chicken lo mein and shrimp fried rice. The rice was dark brown and tasted like dirty grease. The lo mein was dry and dark too. The soup didn't have much taste and had oil sitting on top. The crab Rangoon was filled with a lot of cream cheese that tasted sweet but had no taste of crab. We will never go there again.

From the minute I walked into this place, I knew that the food was going to be good. Plus it helped that I read the other reviews first. Lol This place literally puts the "S" in Super. This is a carry out only restaurant, and I'm okay with it. I placed my order on line and when I arrived it was ready and hot. I didn't even have to wait. The staff was super friendly, which was great - as normally I don't get the same warm welcome from other walk-in locations. It's more like yeah, what do you want? Anyway, I ordered the Shrimp with Garlic Sauce lunch special and I have to admit that I ate all of it. Normally with my orders, I have a little left over - but honestly the food was so good that I couldn't stop eating it. Lol Their fried rice is probably going to be my new favorite. It was flavorful and perfect. The price that I paid for the lunch special was also a win for my wallet. In addition to the food and the service, I swear I smelled incense when I was up by the register, which totally had me sold. The smell just gave me the feeling of good vibes, which was fantastic since I was heading back to work on a beautiful sunny day. I would definitely recommend this place. I know I'll be back again.
Great customer service. Always a pleasure to spend my money and time there. I come back into town and this is my first stop!
This place is one of my hidden gems I feel like its some of the best Chinese food I get in town and the owner and his wife are so amazing and friendly is such a pleasure to come in every single time
I get takout at Super Wok on a weekly basis. The owners are very friendly, and the food is always delicious. The lo mein is especially good. Highly recommend!

Your family may be nothing like mine in this way, but we are extremely loyal to our favorite Chinese restaurant for years. Super Wok has been a part of our family for nearly a decade. This family-run business is plain and simple, kind and convenient. Our allegiance really boils down to two word explanation: Lunch. Special. You get a ridiculous amount of food for under 5 bucks: an entree, rice and side. We are big fans of the hot and sour soup (quality can be hit or miss), egg rolls and crab rangoon. Our favorite entrees are chicken & broccoli, garlic chicken and sweet and sour chicken but with general tso sauce. Picking 8 lunch specials up right now. You should too!
Some of the worst special fried rice I've had in awhile....Dark in color , sticky, .... veggies, meat, and shrimp were nothing special ( pun intended ) ....will never go back.....Booooooo !

Consistently good food, great portions. Can leave salt out if you ask, and very friendly. Pricing, and I've compared, is very competitive. Their crab Rangoon is amazing. And their pork egg rolls yummy. Highly recommend.
Great spot for Chinese food! Never disappoints. The employees are very friendly and we love getting takeout from here.

Went there for the first time a few minutes ago. We had just talked about the tendency of poultry growers to load up the chicks with hormones, making for chicken so fat-loaded that it's inedible. Such was the case here. The wife ordered General Tzo's, and it could not be eaten. The chicken was chock full of the most rubbery, gross looking white fat that she gave it to me and went without. I tried going through a few bites - and I'm not what you'd call picky - but no, I couldn't eat it either. Threw it in the trash, where it sits as I write. So, for $11.38 she got a half-order of fried rice. Won't even think of returning. We'll take our losses and run.
This place is not good. Crab rangoon? Did you mean strawberry cream puff?? What am I eating? I'll tell you I'm not eating...something worthwhile. Now I just feel guilty... no pleasure.

We ate at Super Wok for the first time tonight. It was outstanding! The food was very fresh and tasty, and the prices were quite reasonable. I ordered the Kung Pap Shrimp. It was nicely spiced. Lots of perfectly cooked shrimp, vegetables, and peanuts. My wife ordered a beef with broccoli combination plate. The entre was delicious as was the accompanying fried rice. For years we have gone to a Chinese carry out place near Big Bend and 141. The food had become unacceptable. We have been looking for something new and better and found it. Super Wok just became our go-to place for Chinese carry out! Try this place. You won't be disappointed.

If you like really good Chinese food this is the spot. It's in the $. I've never ordered food from them and my party not love everything. Best crab Rangoon. I like how much fresh vegetables go in to each dish. 7-8 tables inside. We always order to go. I'm very picky about Chinese food. This is the only place in West county I'd go besides PF Chang. The dinner portions are huge. The owners do the cooking. Very nice people. Easy to talk to about how you want your food spiced.

About 6 months old, and a great place to get good, clean, cheap unauthentic Chinese food. Nothing out of the ordinary, just solid predictable goodness. Personal suggestion: "Lunch special, Sweet Sour Chicken w/ General Cho sauce instead of sweet sour sauce, white rice, Hot-Sour soup." -- all for $4.55 before 2:30. It's perfect every time.

Terrible service, terrible food. Forgot to add vegetables to vegetable lomein!? How's that possible? Then argued with me saying I was wrong. Wouldn't refund, wouldn't bring the correct order. I gave them every chance to fix it but no such luck.

My daughter and I tried this place out as it was close to where she lives. Three good was hot and fresh, but incredibly bland. I assume they are tailoring it for their customers, but man, I stopped eating it and had an apple instead.
I've ordered takeout from Super Wok many, many times. The owners are extremely friendly and the food is quite good. That is all.

Finding Chinese food that I actually want to eat anywhere in St. Louis has been a big challenge during my 12+ years here. But Super Wok, I would definitely come to again. Seems their Americanized Chinese menu is consistently good, but really where they shine is the specials you see scrawled on the white board. The Singapore Chow Fun I had today was as good and authentic as I've had at any restaurant. (To be honest, this probably deserves 4 stars, not 5, but someone has to counteract the undoubtedly unfair 1 star rating left previously.)

I was one of Sonnys first customers and this place is absolutely delicious. The crab rangoons are sweet and savory, the food is always hot and fresh, and the owners are always willing to make something extra spicy for you. I absolutely adore super wok and have been going for at least 10 years. I will always go here for delicious, fast, fresh, Chinese food. The wonton soup is my absolute favorite!

I love the food here the owner is ever so friendly and kind. It is always clean the food is always pipeimg hot and delicious! I would recomend super wok to anyone who really wants great chinese cuisine! They are the absolute best. :)

Love this place. This place seriously has the best lo mein. It's ...is that garlic? Do you know how much I love garlic? Maybe I'm hallucinating, but I always imagine garlic. Maybe because it has actual grilled marks on the noodles I'm making myself taste garlic, but their vegetable lo mein is amazzznnnggg. I wish they had the vegetable steamed pot stickers like the Panda chinese restaurant by my old house, but the lo mein makes up for it. One day I'll branch into their fried rice[which I've only seen but it also looks good], but I guess Ican't help it, I'm a pastafarian. The rumors are true, their crab rangoons are rather sweet, almost dessert-ish. Not my cuppa tea. My only reeaal complaint with this place is everything comes on styrofoam and there is a lot of waste. I hate being wasteful. -The rundown: Great little place for cheap Americanized Chinese food.

Visiting from TN. The house lo mein was ok. I think it had more of a fishy taste to it from the shrimp. But at least the noodles weren't mushy soft. The fried chicken wings were really bland. Thank gawd for hot sauce. The fried rice was just ok, per my husband. The food was just ok. Nothing I would go back for.

Visiting relatives here. Great Chinese, favorite General Tso chicken, egg roll is crispy and delicious. Great portions/value!!! Crab Rangoons are awesome!! Wish I lived closer!! My relatives are very lucky!!

Great Chinese food! Reasonable priced. Generous portion size. Fast. We ordered mainly from the lunch special menu. Each dish was large enough to be two meals for a hungry person. Roasted pork egg foo young was excellent. The fried eggs were crispy! The side pork fried rice was tasty, but a bit too salty for us. We will ask for less soy sauce next time. The side crab Rangoon was the best and likely biggest we had. The stuffing was unique that it was slightly sweet (a good surprise) and slightly tangy. Very generous stuffing. The crispy shell was yummy...crispy and chewy at the same time! The best. Another lunch special item was curry chicken. White meat. Tasty curry. Lots of vegetables. Ate over the side fried rice and it was perfect (the side fried rice tasted more well balanced with the curry). We will order this dish again. The appetizer spicy chicken wings were also yummy. Jumbo wings. Looked like they were marinated in yellow curry powder before they were dipped in the batter. The batter wasn't too thick, and sweet and a little spicy. Yum. One side dish we will not repeat is the hot and sour soup. It didn't taste hot or sour, mainly salty...not too salty but it wasn't the taste I expected. It had big mushrooms, bamboo shoots, etc. Big portion for a side soup. We ordered 4 items, spent less than $30, and still had lots of leftovers. I think it's going to be 3 meals for two people at least. Oh, they packed the food well in aluminum containers and plastic lids. (I preferred these over foam.) Under each container, they put a clean cardboard piece to stabilize so they were stackable. I thought that was neat.
Huge Portions but Low Prices I spent $20 for myself and boyfriend and we ate for three days. The fried dumplings are amazing and the crab Rangoon is no joke.
Sorry...terrible Chinese. Ended up throwing everything away. Only thing that was edible was the hot and sour soup.
This is my favorite place for American Chinese. Great lunch specials made fresh, friendly people, and great service.

Say hello to your new favorite Chinese spot! I refuse to go anywhere else. The owners are BEYOND amazing! Nice, helpful, patient, kind.... I could go on and on about them. The food is delish!!!! Cooked to perfection, however you choose. Great people making food. What more could you ask for?

Wow! Best in town. I got the white meat general tsos chicken and the veggie fried rice. Also, a order of the crab Rangoon! Sooo delicious. Very impressed! Normally I'm super skeptical about Chinese restaurants. I was worried bc of the reviews. This did not disappoint!

Your family may be nothing like mine in this way, but we are extremely loyal to our favorite Chinese restaurant for years. Super Wok has been a part of our family for nearly a decade. This family-run business is plain and simple, kind and convenient. Our allegiance really boils down to two word explanation: Lunch. Special. You get a ridiculous amount of food for 6 bucks: an entree, rice and side. We are big fans of the hot and sour soup (quality can be hit or miss), egg rolls and crab rangoon. Our favorite entrees are chicken & broccoli, garlic chicken and sweet and sour chicken but with general tso sauce. Picking 8 lunch specials up right now. You should
I ordered beef and brocolli and the beef was still bloody. Horrible! I was the only person in there so they had plenty of time to make my order.

This place is even more horrible than expected. I ordered online and it said 20 minutes. I got there in 15 minutes and my food was waiting for me in a bag. The sesame chicken had zero sauce because it had been made earlier and was just sitting there waiting. It was so gross. Completely dry and rubbery, completely inedible. The vegetable chow mein was strange. I was thinking it would be more like Panda Express chow mein but it was white flavorless noodles. The fried rice was dry and the crab Rangoon was the only thing that didn't completely suck. $30 dollars down the drain.
Great place. Nice staff. Food is solid. Quick. Better than alternatives in the area. Just moved nearby and it has become our preferred Chinese pickup.

Incredibly friendly and fast. The portions are very large and the food was delicious. Crab Rangoons are some of the best I've had. They're also very clean and do a great job making the pick-up safe. I was very happy with this place and will be returning!

One of my favorite strip mall Chinese Restaurants of all time. Solid on everything and the price is perfect for their lunch and dinner specials. If you like sweet crab rangoons, this is the ultimate. The best in my opinion. My regular dishes are Kung Pao Chicken and Springfield Cashew Chicken. The owners is super friendly and always say hello when they are not slammed.
Good, fresh food in huge portions. The only thing I don't like here is the crab rangoon, too sweet and too much filling.

Three stars because we had a great takeout order, surprisingly good for a hole-in-the-wall takeout place. Then they fell flat on their face for our second takeout order. Absolutely tasteless, replete with uncooked shrimp.

One of the worst chinese food i ever tasted in my life.I had ordered for vegetable Lo Mein and veg Kung Pao but got chicken instead.The food was bland n tasteless. The only vegetable in the dish was zucchini. Would not recommend this place to anyone.Waste of money n disappointment.

What a great family owned business. Super nice and friendly. Always fast to prepare your order. Even after the 10 minute ride home the items are Super Wok hot! Always tasty and well made. Thanks for helping out every time we do not feel like cooking and want take out.

Walked in 9pm on a Tues on the way home from picking up a friend at STLCC Meramec, who warned me these stripmall Chinese joints tend to taste as crappy as they look. But I thought I'd give them a chance. After all, they could have just called this place Wok. Place was empty. Greeted by a man with a big fake smile and an expressionless woman who said nothing. Placed my order but never heard food cooking so what I got was aging reheated crap in a tin tray eaten with a plastic fork and a drink in a styrofoam cup. Clearly these people don't like to wash things and couldn't care less about the environment or the food quality. An hour before close, they certainly weren't gonna fire up the "super wok" just for me. What I got tasted like it came from a microwave. My all-night indigestion confirmed this. There's nothing super about Super Wok; Clark Kent wouldn't even switch outfits in this place. The name should be Wok Away.

I went for their live music and carry out food. The employees were so friendly even with the adverse conditions. I was very impressed. The drinks were great and the Mahi Tacos were amazing!!!! I will definitely go back.

Went and saw the Scott Templeton Trio and Greg Sover Band last night. Great music, sound was excellent and the food and drinks were very good. Service (by one of the bartenders) was very attentive and he had a lot of tables to take care of. Will definitely be back

This place is an awesome spot. They have a wonderful food selection, with nightly rotating specials. The service we had last night was TOP NOTCH. The place was slammed packed, and there was not a single misstep. The waitress, Lily, was a rockstar. She was just spectacular getting us drinks, bringing food promptly, and helping suggest top choices! The food was delicious, and the drinks, too. The live bands are so so fun. We loved it! Space to dance, and good food, and great service? Rare find these days. VERY happy with this spot.

Wish I could give a 0 star review on this establishment. Went to the bar at 11 bar tender asked for my Id and I provided it. He came back very rude and stated that my REAL ID was fake and continued to kick me and the group of friends I was with out of the bar. On the way back the bartender and or waiter with the red beard said "ur a white and entitled. Go spend daddy's money somewhere else". From that he should be fired. I will never recommend this establishment to anyone especially if you are 21. They will accuse you of having a fake ID even if it real. I think it's best to find a different spot and go to a better establishment.

My friends and I, 3 21 year olds, a 22 year old, and a 25 year old were excited to try some new restaurants on North Wayne recently and were especially enticed by the promise of live music. Unfortunately our experience was marred by an overprotective and rude manager who accused us of possessing fake Pennsylvania IDs based on "misaligned holograms" and kicked us out of the bar and continued to accost us outside on the sidewalk. I believe the owner needs to reconsider this persons employment as they are costing their restaurant money and customers. And by the way, no live music in sight :(
We love this local spot that brings a much-needed hip and fun vibe to the heart of town! The food is really really good and the vibes are never dull. Great drinks too

Very cool restaurant and venue. We came here for drinks and to watch a show. The place gets pretty crowded and they try to serve food at the same time which makes the place that much more chaotic. We had a terrible experience with a waitress with dark brown curly hair who kept barreling into the crowd to serve the tables in the front. We go to crowded bars often so we're used to waitresses getting frustrated having to work their way through a crowd but there's a polite way to do it and a rude way. She pushed us countless times out of the way and we watched her do the same to an older crowd in the front. Other than that experience we had a fun night.
Exciting new music venue ! Food, drinks and service were great - I wish they had desserts. I look forward to going back with more friends.
Excellent apps and awesome band Good crowd of friendly and attentive servers Overall - excellent. Try the Hot Fried Chicken !

Pretty awesome find. I was visiting Philadelphia for business & staying by a massive mall with every dining option in the area being a chain. No thanks. So I googled. Bars, good food, live music plus my location. The 118 North came up as an option and it looked really cool. Appealing website which posted having a band that night called Mas Tequila ... I mean it was Halloween, the menu looked fantastic and "more tequila" sounded a'ok so off I went! Quick drive, cute little shopping district with lots of parking options. I sat at the bar, the bartender was attentive and checked in with me often. I think it was either the owner or the GM who was also behind the bar concocting a new drink he created- it was really good! My bartender made a kick ass Negroni too. I ordered the Filet Mignon salad. It was arugula, kale, roasted Brussel sprouts plus the filet. Very yummy- Yes I ate the entire thing, no shame! Nice crowd of friendly patrons, some people were in costumes for Halloween. Big foot was definitely there & I'm pretty sure PeeWee Herman was in the band. lol The band was just ok. The scrumptious food and finely crafted cocktails is what will bring me back. Looking forward to another visit when I'm back in town.

I went to 118 N in Wayne PA with my team mates. They had a decent live music scene. We had a couple of bitters and an avocado cocktail. It was worth trying, but I'd say that the avocado cocktail was so-so. The waitress, Andrianna did a good job practically ordering for us with the popular dishes in the restaurant. We had the filled garlic bread and the fried chicken - they were good ones! The only reason I knocked off a star was because of the prices, which did seem a little too high for the quality and ambience.

I.LOVE.THIS.PLACE! Great food for dinner or snacks/apps for sharing with friends! The garlic knots and fried cheese curds are awesome! The drinks are not watered down, the wait staff and bartenders are friendly! And you can always hear great bands playing for a REASONABLE ticket prices. We find ourselves here several times a month and have NEVER been disappointed!

okay. the food was not bad but was not the greatest. we got brussel sprouts (Asian sauce but salty), brisket flat bread (too small for price) and mussels (little expensive but worth). i'd go back to try a couple other things if i happen to be there for an event but i wouldn't voluntarily go there again for food. perhaps more for live music and vibe.

Randomly found an resi last minute on OpenTable. Had no idea what to expect but was very pleasantly surprised to find a small; but smart and ambitious menu! A couple of cocktails I would LOVE to try when I have an Uber! Also a few excellent micro-brew draught selections that are NOT in every brew pub! BONUS! The "specials" included a white pizza with ramps and several delish Italian cheeses. We also ordered the wings which were well done. They are not your typical "Buffalo" wings at all! So much flavor and a little kick! Dessert we ordered the chocolate doughnuts! They were pretty good. I never know what to expect from doughnuts. They were kind of a cross between beignet and funnel cake. 80% to what I would have hoped for but a large order!

The hottest new music venue on the Main Line. We went for the opening weekend performances which were fabulous... great ambience and energy. Powerful and fun. Decent beer and food options. They just opened and didn't have dessert options yet, but wee were promised dessert is in the plans. Not the most inspired specialty cocktails, but they have a full bar. A great kickoff weekend... the place will be spectacular. Looking forward to coming back.

Music selection is good. Always some interesting artists performing. I like how it mixes a sit down restaurant and bar area then opens up into a dance floor and stage area. The food from here is on point. I highly recommend checking it out.

We decided to order from here after hearing about their tailgate takeout and it did not disappoint! Our favorite was probably the Mac and cheese and prickly pear margarita, but the lamb burger and fish tacos were very good as well. We'll definitely be back again!

While I understand this was a Saturday night, this restaurant treated us absolutely terribly. We came here because of the good reviews. Atmosphere was great, the host was also very kind. Sat at the bar very briefly while we waiting for our high top table (only seats available since it was kind of late ~8pm). Bartender acted pretentious... quickly took our drink orders and couldn't get away from us faster. Get to our high top table with the host a few minutes later, and a gentleman came shortly after asking if we needed more drinks. He took that order and disappeared for awhile, even though our table was literally touching the bar. Finally comes back with the drinks and disappears for pretty much good, bussing other tables and never tried to take our food order. Finally we flag a random waitress down who took one out of the four of our orders. She tells a group of fellow waiters that we ordered, and a few moments later the bartender comes over and snarkely asks for the rest of our food order. No one told us the bartender was our waiter ?? He never showed his face to us the entire time we were sitting at our table. I guess we were supposed to read their minds and assume he was our waiter. The rest of the night we had to flag him or anyone down for anything. It was a disgrace. The food was great but not sure it's worth coming back to since we were so mistreated.

Not a great music venue. The layout tends to isolate band from audience. The crowd chatter was more audible than the music. Great beer selection and very good bartenders. They are friendly and work hard. I won't go back though for music.

Hiya! My band, THIS NOT THAT, performed at the open mic night yesterday. Great place, great host, Raef, and a most gracious bartender, Steve. We had guests in attendance and everyone echoed how great this place is. Excellent service, yummy things to eat and enough beer and wine selections to please them all. We will be back!!!
One of our first post vaccine dinners out. Lovely live jazz guitarist and to die for north buyers. Add a beer and I felt like it was 2019 again.

Table for four last night. Terrific atmosphere, great music on stage inside (two different solo acts - pianist and then Acoustic guitar/singer). Brought another couple with us that had never been to 118. They've really upped their game on the specials. Mushroom and artichoke pizza, steak salads, lamb burger, and a few apps were all delicious. The cocktails we prepared perfectly. The service was outstanding. Not sure who our server was, people just kept coming to attend to us - very well coordinated. Manager stopped by twice to see how the evening was going. Great experience. They are doing a terrific job at 118N...

What makes this venue worth visiting? Great music, great food and a friendly staff! For the Music Lover- The variety of artists and genres means you will never get bored and will most likely discover some new bands. Because the venue is intimate, many of the artists will take the time to chat with you after their sets. That's fun for any music lover. For the Food Lover- The creative variations of pub fare are reasonably priced allowing you to try several items from the menu without breaking the bank. Happy Hour and After Hour menus are actually really cheap and have a great selection for those who like to nibble instead of eating a full meal. For the "I Want It All" Lover- If great food and great music aren't enough consider this. Even when the place is crowded, the staff goes out of their way to make you feel welcome. The bartenders know their craft and can produce some delicious cocktails as well as serve from their fine selection of beers and wines. The waitresses are attentive and helpful when making food and drink selections. The managers are available and willing to step in to help make your visit the first of many. If you're looking for somewhere new to go, give 118North a try! You won't be disappointed!

Interesting spot in the middle of Wayne. Lots of character, live music was decent. Apps were solid, drinks were ok, and our food was on the south side of ok due to bad service. We were a party of 4 and our respective meals were delivered separately, 1 at a time over 30 mins. So by the time we ate together, everyone's food was cold.

Last night on the early side 5 PM my husband and I decided to go for a bite to eat and check out some live music under the tent. We had truly a five-star experience. When we arrived at 118 North, the restaurant was impeccably clean and ready for business. Before the pandemic my husband and I have attended many live music events and had some food ranging from dinner to snacks. All enjoyable. Last night we both left thinking that they have even upped their game from before. I enjoyed their 118 N. burger through and through. I love their french fries that were crispy and lightly seasoned but The burger was absolutely outstanding. It's no wonder it took first place in "best of mainline". This burger is a double stack with Bree and American cheese, special sauce and onion jam. i cannot say enough good things about this phenomenal burger. My husband was equally impressed with his brisket sandwich that was very rich with its own Dipping bowl of dip of Beef Jus, and topped with shaved horseradish and Gouda. I had a bite it was excellent. The top-notch service at 118 started With our dinner and ended under the tent with tables service. The tent last night was perfectly packed allowing for everyone to be socially distance while we all enjoyed a phenomenal acoustic Grateful Dead band called Four Lean Hounds. On a chilly misty night wayne Locals gathered around some having takeout, others having drinks to go from across the street all having fun. It was so nice to be with great music and the camaraderie. FYI these bands often are playing for free a woman went around with her face mask on and a bucket for tips.. Four lean hounds were awesome. I love the Band. They Play music with a short break from 6 to 9ish. We are home by 10. The tent in Wayne is a lovely phenomenon and we are grateful to the police who have lifted the open container laws. A friendly police officer was outside of the tent the whole evening. I did not see him question anybody.

This is definitely a welcome addition to the local music scene. My only visit so far, but I think they should reconsider the volume versus the size of the space. Overwhelming wall of sound that precludes all else. Could use some additional high tops - even if standing only for drink rests. Lots of dancing space. We'll give it another try to see how things play out...

Im 24 and they took my Drivers Liscense, accusing me of it not being real. They then googled [my] address and questioned me about my personal home and neighborhood, which made me feel extremely violated and uneasy. After the questioning, they still continued to refuse to serve me. It makes me uncomfortable that these men now know exactly where my home is and what it looks like. I am unsure of what provoked this aggressive behavior on their part. I will never go back. I made this account just to warn people.

After hearing good things about 118 North from friends and neighbors, I decided to try 118 North for dinner. We were instantly greeted by the host, as well as the bartender behind the bar. Our server, like the other staff members we encountered was very friendly and warm. We tried the Mahi Mahi tacos which were absolutely delicious. The fish was perfectly breaded and crispy and the pickled cabbage offered a brightness and acidity. The tortillas tightly wrapping the fish and pickled cabbage were pressed and toasted, giving the tacos a little extra crunch. The next appetizer we tried was one of the specials, the Broccoli Cheddar Rarebit. The sourdough bread was perfectly toasted and there was definitely tons of cheese and fresh, al dente cooked broccoli. The only negative about the dish was it was incredibly salty and I'm someone who loves to add salt to many of the things I eat. All in all, I will definitely be back to 118 North in the future!

This was our first visit here after hearing how good it is. After getting an unpleasantly warm draft beer we were served our food which was somewhere between mediocre and blah. Sadly, the waitress was on a par with the food and beer. In fairness, the beer was replaced cheerfully by the bartender as we couldn't get the attention of our waitress, even though the place was mostly empty. Not sure what the attraction is here. Oh well, live and learn.

Went there with a small group of friends. There was an older guy creeping around and groping women. A couple people reported him but bartenders did nothing about it. We found out later that the creepy guy was friends with the owner of the bar. The bartenders kept defending him and it was disgusting. Will never go there again.
This is a piece of trash worthy of bringing a date you never want to see again. It is dirty and the bartenders are disgusting. Especially the one with short blonde hair.

So, this place used to be a great place to come hear music. Apparently there is new management and everything has changed. The menu is now super expensive and, unless you have a reservation for dinner, there is no place to sit down. (unless you are lucky to get a spot at the bar) This is not my kind of place anymore.

This is a review for the Tailgate Under the Tent music event in which 118 north was "serving" drinks and food at. Besides the terrible acoustics (couldn't hear each other at all and we were sitting at the back) and the lackluster seating arrangements, the service was well below par. We waited an hour for two simple glasses of wine. They never entered our order of a pizza but we got my fish tacos a hour later- cold, small, and very blah for what we paid. My husband had to go up to figure out our order three separate times and the kid ringing up the orders seemed very lost. The manager did come over and hurriedly apologize for the wait for our drinks but nothing about the food. For that super quick attempt at remedying it I bumped them up a star. I felt bad for the one server they had working having to walk across the street multiple times with orders and then with the most confused look on her face try to find the minuscule table numbers to deliver them to the right place. Nice thought to have music and food to support local businesses but I have definitely seen it executed a lot better elsewhere.

Went to check out a band and have dinner- small menu but great choices. We had the pork belly and short ribs, both were done perfectly. Drinks were great too- I think I had the muddy water which was whiskey lilac and lemon. The venue is small but set up the right way. Well def be back!

We live nearby but never visited or ordered from 118 North. Our county (Delaware) had advanced to the yellow stage during the Coronavirus pandemic which means there was no indoor seating but we could take out. Wayne Avenue was very festive as many of the restaurants had outdoor seating, there was music playing and everyone was so happy to be outside. We ordered fish and chips and an old fashioned, and they did not disappoint. The staff was very helpful and worked hard to make sure all guests were accommodated. We will be back soon and look forward to when we can eat inside.
There was a mistake with our reservation on a busy night, the staff went out of their way to accommodate our party. Much appreciated!

I love this place! Great food and service at the bar. However... I've been here since earlier this afternoon and a show started at 9pm. I step outside for 3 minutes and they want to charge me a cover charge? I'm their best customer today and they give me beef? Bad service. My jacket is still at the bar 6 feet from you. Thumbs down. No. Two thumbs down. Recognize a good customer when you have one.

Stop reading and go get a burger. The North Burger to be exact. Why? Because it's everything you've been hoping for in a burger. And maybe a little more. Need more reasons to head to 118 North? The beer selection was pretty darn good (we each found a few to try), they have a kids menu (yay!), and the hot fried chicken will take your taste buds for a ride. On top of all this, our service was excellent- our waiter and the lovely young lady he was training were so kind, patient, and on top of things with our kids (and us), and we couldn't have been more thankful. Seriously though, we had a great time grabbing a quick bite to eat at 118 North. I won't lie, when our cheese curds came out and lacked a little something something, we may have been worried, but our entrees more than made up for it. They also have some pretty creative weekly specials (I just looked at this week's specials and we may be making another trip). I highly recommend trying 118 North out - they even have live music! We were there too early to enjoy it, but it looks like an awesome venue.

Fun! The place is clean... the night we were enjoying our time, Steve was busy making sure all beer bottles were dust free and ready for enjoyment! Music was most enjoyable too! Look forward to our return

Finally got here to see a band, Newspaper Taxis and Dead Flowers on Friday 11/13. Had a good night here, mostly due to the decent band and nice employees. But it is an odd layout and a bit of a strange experience seeing a band here. Bit of an identity crisis, is this a music venue or a bar restaurant? The front part of the restaurant seems to be just that, a bar\restaurant with lots of people having dinner and drinks at the bar\tables. Do these people pay a cover charge to have dinner? Or do you get a free show by having dinner? I'm not sure how that works... They really need some more space here, it's quite tight with their layout. The music area starts abruptly where the tables stop, and the dance floor begins...Is this what intimate means? It's quite tight in the stage area, and since the kitchen is back there as well as the bathrooms...there is a constant flow of people back and forth. It seems funny to see servers dancing thru the crowd with someone's dinner in their hands. Unless it's your dinner, then it may seem a bit gross...your food having to traipse thru the dance floor to get to your table... It is also tough to eat if you are going to a show. The dining area was packed, as was the bar. So I didn't know where I would order, or where I would eat. I ended up waiting till the bar started to clear out and got a spot at the bar. Ordered their burger from the late night menu(which I can't find online), which was decent for 9 bucks. Bartenders were on point, friendly and efficient. I forgot this place is run by the folks at Ripplewood. When I ordered the burger I was asked the same question...Pink or No Pink. I got the Pink at Ripplewood and it was a huge mistake. It was almost like beef tartar on a bun and I absolutely detested it. I got the No Pink this time, and was surprised at how pink the No Pink still was, but it was definitely more to my liking. Same fries as ripplewood too, very good. I'm also glad there wasn't any bologna\pickled onions on my burger...Where would I eat if I didn't snag a spot at the bar? Stand on the dance floor with a burger and drink in my hand? Best thing going here...The staff... Everyone was very nice and personable, from the front desk ticket takers, to the bartenders and barbacks dancing thru the dance floor with their buckets of ice and trays of food... I'm glad to see another place for live music on the main line, but the space isn't the best for this concept.

Recently got take out from 118 North. The babaganoush was a perfect consistency; the charred bread was a spectacular accompaniment. Impressively, the Mahi tacos kept the crispy texture despite take out status. It was paired with a perfectly ripe avocado. Would have personally liked a little more slaw and sauce, but the taste/texture was really good. But most of all, try the brookie! Holy cow. The brownie part of the brookie was one of the best I've ever had. (And I come from generations of scratch bakers). The brookie was warm with cold vanilla ice cream on the side. Well done, 118 North. I'll be back. No photos because I was too busy inhaling the food.

This was our first time at 118 North. It's a very narrow space. There was a guitarist playing in the front with many small children dancing (this was 6:30pm on Friday so I think it was the end of happy hour). The bar is along the left wall. There's high top seating in the middle aisle and regular tables along the right side wall. It's very tight in between tables and difficult to walk especially with all the coats hanging off chairs. I applaud the servers and bussers who have to navigate through the people and tables. There's a large stage in the back but we didn't go in that direction. Our server Andriana was ok in the beginning greeting us and giving us menu suggestions. As the dinner progressed I think she became overwhelmed because she really didn't check in and we had to wave her over to get her attention. The table next to us seemed even more frustrated. They ordered dessert but it took so long that they just left after finally being able to settle their check. At her suggestion, we tried the Hot Chicken and the Pork Mac and cheese. The chicken was large enough to share and really delicious. It definitely had a spicy kick and I would order it again. The Pork Mac and cheese was also very good. We didn't order any appetizers or dessert this time yet it took well over an hour because the service was slow. Luckily we weren't starving when we arrived and we weren't in a hurry. The kids dancing to the guitarist was a pleasant distraction while we waited.
