Because the tables are so close and it's noisy, it's not the ideal place for a date or to discuss anything you don't want everyone else to hear. Parking is on the street or the township lots. Andriana said it was Diet Coke but the check just lists it as soda so I'm not convinced they serve Coke products.
Food is UNBELIEVABLE. Server was in training, but she was amazing and adorable. Highly recommend.

This is an awesome place to go see music!! The music has been great- the wait staff is so friendly and quick, and the food was really good!! Love hanging at this new place in Wayne!! Keep up the great music!
Best chicken parmigina and excellent pizza and pasta and Moore I will go back for Moore .
The thin pizza comes fast and its good. Go simple. Pepperoni or or cheese. Kids will love it also. It came through door dash in 20 minutes. Will order again
Delicious dinner. All 4 of us enjoyed our meals. Great service, nice folks and just all around solid Italian food.

Ordered a few pizzas from this place on Friday night and it was solid. It was not the best Pizza I have ever had, but it was a solid choice for anyone having friends over for a meal. Good was hot, filled with flavor, and hit the spot. My guests had multiple slices and raved how good the pizza was. Sonya is a server at the establishment and is a total sweetheart. Make sure you ask for her, as she is super nice and very knowledgeable about all things Villa Rosa. They even have various discount available. Inquire writhing to save a few bucks. Will definitely be ordering again soon.

We love Villa Rosa and a week feels incomplete without their Friday night pizza and I often crave their a la vodka, rolls, and love the house dressing. Plus, the service is always great! My son loves it here!

First of all, this was a really good place to eat at one time. Was always a little pricey for what you are getting. However, recently, 2 times, I went to relax and have a nice dinner when they allowed a screaming child to upset all guests. NOT PLEASANT! Also, the bread seemed stale, and the prices were that of a 5 star restaurant. Quality of food was so so. Now dessert, horrible. For one, the tiramisu did not even look close to what was shown on the menu. It was some made up, cheap pudding with little coffee taste in a plastic cup- $4.50- a lot of that mess. The creme brûlée was some non quality pudding, with no crisp top or burn sugar. Again, $4.50. We go into Morrisville at AJ's pizza, a little strip mall place and their food and desserts are more authentic and they are not even Italian. For these prices, I wanted a way better experience all way round. I wouldn't have mind the prices if the food was better quality. Sorry, but not worth your time, taste or money. That baby screaming was just the tip of it all. Could not wait to get out of there!!!!!!!!

We had my Father-in-law's repass at Villa Rosa this past weekend. The staff was wonderful! 50 of us converged on them and they handled us professionally, efficiently and with respect for our reason to gather. The food was delicious and generously portioned and served in a smooth continuous manner which allowed our family and friends to visit and reminisce uninterrupted. Thank you Villa Rosa for being a light for us in an otherwise solemn day.

For an Italian Pizzeria that is constantly busy in Yardley, the food isn't that great. I sometimes ask myself why do people constantly hand this place their money. The flavor isn't unique or memorable of any of the dishes. The menu is rather limited and basic. There are several other Pizzeria choices within the area that are cheaper and more enjoyable. The pick up ordering is a joke and there's no proper line to know who is next. I had called in to order a Turkey Club but in a wrap and replace the French fries with broccoli. I picked up my order, drove home, and opened up the wrap made with chicken and broccoli and French fries. So I had went back to explain the order. They remade the order, with no apology. They tried to tell me I was in the wrong. They made me a new wrap. I get home and low and behold, I have turkey with bacon and broccoli with French fries on the side. It was truly unbelievable. I'm stuck in shock as I write this at how ignorant this place can be. I should have rated them a one star but I try and support my local family owned business but this place has become an absolute disgrace to the locals. At one point in time this place had originality, back when they had extra large cheese steaks and friendly staff. I would not recommend this to restaurant to anyone and would suggest going to any other eatery in the area other than Villa Rosa.

Living in Yardley there are not many options for good quality food. The organic chicken entrees are really good! We get the chicken parm all the time. The ranch and olive gourmet pizza is really good too. We are regulars here and they have something for the whole family.

Best Pizza option within a 15 mile radius. Trust me, we moved to the area and made it our mission to find the best pizza possible as close as possible. Seriously, get the Brooklyn Pie. You won't regret it. Delicious!
Nice little local Italian place! I had the Chicken Vesuvio and it was delicious! Service was very good as well :)

Food was ok...Very small portions for the dinner price...The caesar salad was smaller than the size of a side salad...extremely disappointing...The chicken and veal dishes were also very small portions...not sure we would ever go back.
An all time family favorite ! Love their pizza and they recently renovated the front of the restaurant. Definitely worth checking out !!

Came in with some friends one evening for an outing that wouldn't cost us all too much money. We were in the mood for some genuine Italian pizza. We came in as a group of about 10, and we were seated promptly. We had called ahead to let the restaurant know that a larger group would be coming. Some of us had called ahead to let them know that we wanted certain pizza pie flavors ready when we came. We were served our beverages and brought out some fresh Italian bread when we were first seated. Within about 20 minutes, the pre-ordered pies as well as some additional items that we ordered were brought out. The waitress serving us as well as another server who I believe was the owner were both friendly and accommodating. The two menu items the I had tried were the Buffalo Chicken Pizza and the White Pizza with Spinach and Garlic. I was impressed by the flavor quality of both items. The white pizza had a nice thin crust, but the toppings and cheese were extremely fresh and flavorful. The Buffalo Chicken Pizza was extremely large and hearty. I like that the restaurant did not skimp with the chicken topping. I found that the Buffalo Chicken Pizza was extremely filling. After one slice of each pizza flavor, I was stuffed. Overall, the group I came with all enjoyed our food quality and experience. We were additionally able to use a coupon to take 20% off our entire bill, which was great. I would recommend this place for some tasty and genuine non-chain pizza.

After much looking around, I decided to have Villa Rosa cater my daughter's graduation party! Food was absolutely fabulous and they gave us lots of it! Egg plant rollatini was awesome..... definitely the best meatballs in Bucks County!! And all the entrees came with wonderful pasta! I have to admit their chopped antipasto is our favorite.....if you haven't tried it you have to!!

Solid, affordable basics in the strip malls of bucks county. Big portions, and tasty!! One caveat - I was shocked that they still use styrofoam and plastic bags for take-away. Come on guys, it's 2019!

We love Villa Rosa! We have lived here over 30 years and have tasted multiple pizza joints, but this is the best. But not just for pizza; they have a nice atmosphere for dinner too! I love that they are BYOB which keeps our costs down. The food is delicious and I enjoy that they sometimes have coupons. Highly recommend!
Food is good not great but very family friendly. Usually offer great coupons in the local mailers too. Pizza and Entrees are both available.

Really great Italian food! I've been eating here for years and Villa Rosa never disappoints. Favorites garlic knots, all of the soups, sausage pizza, meatballs, chicken francese, and eggplant parm! They do catering too and it's always a big hit with my guests.

My husband and I live a very short distance from Villa Rosa, so over the past 4 years we have frequented this restaurant quite often. I feel the need to write a review now, after all this time, because of how impressed I have been by them lately. In my opinion, the food has always been decent but more recently it has been GREAT. First of all, they are BYOB, so that is a win from the start for me. Although they don't deliver, I don't see this as a negative because I think the best way to eat pizza is straight out of the oven at a restaurant. Their crust is cooked to perfection with enough crisp to give the slice some stability without being overdone. Our most recent eat-in order was a large cheese pizza with mushrooms, sausage and vodka sauce instead of marinara. I can say with confidence it was one of the best pizzas I have ever had in this area. Our waitress, Megan, was extremely friendly and attentive. After devouring the pizza and hanging around a bit longer to finish our bottles of wine (don't worry we walked!) the manager (owner?) asked how our meal was, when we told him how thrilled we were with everything he thanked us and brought us out two cannolis on the house which were also delicious! Another fantastic dish of theirs is the veal parm. The serving is huge, it is incredibly tender and the outside coating is perfectly crisp (I also recommend getting this dish with their vodka sauce!). They also have a new salad on their menu, I can't remember what it is called but it comes with seasoned shrimp, crab meat, asparagus, fresh mozz, roasted peppers, and housemade balsamic... it is a must try as well!

Eat here roughly once every two weeks or so, usually take out. For my money, it's the best pizza in the area. I was surprised to read all of the negative reviews, as I can't say I've ever had a bad interaction here. Service has always been timely and helpful, though admittedly that's just for take out. But I really like their pizza, as does my wife. That's pretty much all that I ask from a local pizza shop.
Got a few delivery orders from here. A Sicilian with sausage and extra sauce and a grandma pie. I like their pizza and their service. Delivery was pretty quick too.

I went to Villa Rosa last Sunday night with a friend. I was skeptical at first because of the previous reviews. But I have to say that the food was really good. The calamari was lightly breaded, fried perfectly, had a great texture, and was served with a nice marinara sauce. My friend had the mussels with pasta and cream sauce and really enjoyed it. The crab meat ravioli had a nice flavor and paired well with the cognac cream sauce. Most of all I would have to say that the staff was very attentive and made sure we were ok from start to finish. I will probably come back to try their mussels next time.

I love this place! I've been going here my entire life and it's been delicious food the entire time. They are nice people, the food is great, and I go there whenever I can get a chance. The pizza is amazing and I think they have the best Italian food in the area. I have never ordered something that I didn't like here!

5 stars for Chicken Ramanoe Pizza!! Garlicky, cheesy, spinachy goodness all on a pie. Get out your knife and fork for this heavy handed pizza. I've never seen this pizza outside of Villa. I get it whenever I can when I'm back in Yardley.

I believe this place has changed hands a couple of times. Since the last change, things have been noticeably different. I was disappointed in the quality of the pizza and cheesesteaks. Venezia, around the shopping center has taken their place in my book.
My husband and son go here every Friday night. They love the food, friendly staff, and warm family feeling. It's great all around.

Dear Villa Rosa I grew up eating your food. I was home Saturday night and decided to get some take out. I was so disappointed. Your Caesar salad was a sloppy mess. The vodka rigatoni tasted like butter and fat and nothing good. The shrimp francese was a muddled mess (and what was with that gravy?). The only thing I enjoyed was the side of ziti with sauce. That is very sad to say. I hope you re-focus on your food that I so fondly remember as a kid.

How are they still in business? I ordered an ice tea and grilled chicken sandwich. The ice tea was brown tasteless water. There was a chopped up little piece of dry chicken on a big hoagie roll with a mountain of lettuce sheds and a couple chunks of tomato & no dressing. When I tracked down the waiter, he brought me 2 ice cold bottles...one with oil and the other vinegar. More than $10 for this. The same order at Delorenzos on Trenton Rd is heavenly. Skip this place that once was good but no more.

Come here frequently. Food and service have always been excellent. HOWEVER, was here last night with three people for dinner with a 25% off coupon from my email. We ordered three dinners and two of the special $5 appetizers. Gave the waitress the coupon and she checked with manager and said we couldn't use the coupon since we got special $5 apps. Offered to pay for apps separately. But that didn't work. So why send coupons? Very disappointed. Get coupons from many local restaurants, will try others now. I have a loyalty card also!

Not my favorite Italian joint in the area but my kids love their oats fagioli soup. Food is flavored nicely but portions are anemic for the price. Ordered a bunch of items including chicken piccata. I was disappointed to see that for $16+ the order included pasta and two very small chicken breast. Do we need huge portions, no, but they charge less. Their freshly baked rolls, that were included with our order, were amazingly good. Actually dangerously good since they are very hard to resist. My chicken Marsala, again while flavored well, was anemic portion wise for the price. So over all the flavors are good the value is not as high as I would expect for the price charged. Would I come back here, for sure, my kids eat their soup like animals and for that, there is value for me.

This is my family's go- to spot whenever we can go for a quick, inexpensive, filling meal. You are not going to be wow-ed here. The food is good if you order the right things. Try: Vodka Rigatoni (best I have had in Bucks County), Eggplant Rollatini, Chicken Marsala, and the Chicken Francese, and the Pasta Figoli. Also- always check for coupons on their website!

I used to come to this restaurant when i was younger and remember it being great. It used to be one of my favorites and a go-to place for a good meal. I visited Villa Rosa last night and quickly re-evaluated my opinion of this restaurant. I'm not sure if it's under new management, or i just remember the quality as being better than what we experienced but overall the food we were served was horrible. We ordered the stuffed mushroom appetizer which turned out to be soggy and greasy with a mess of oily spinach on the side. We had chicken and pasta entrees but the chicken was dry and flavorless and our pasta was just plane weird tasting. I don't know if they forgot to change the water the pasta was cooked in but it tasted like it had been sitting in the same pot, in the same water for a week. The artichokes in my girlfriends dish looked like they were pulled out of the jar and slapped onto her plate, not cooked, not seasoned, nothing. I COULD COOK BETTER FOOD THAN THIS which is sad considering a pasta or chicken dish goes for about $15 a plate. We got a doggy bag but i think we will end up throwing everything out. It was that bad. I'm sure the pizza is as good as ever ( it's kind of hard to screw up pizza), but the price of anything else on the menu definitely does not match the quality of product we received. If you go here, stick with the pizza. Everything else is overpriced and poorly cooked.
Awful, Dishes do not contain ingredients stated in menu, Says prosciutto, get something barely above spam. Says Parmesan bowl, nope, just skipped that ingredient.

I called to place my order and had to be handed to another person because the first didn't understand what I was asking. I specifically asked what was in the eggplant roll and was told cheese rolled into the eggplant and baked with sauce and cheese on top. Imagine my surprise when I buy into it and are ham. I haven't eaten pork for 15 yrs. thanks for making me sick. Luckily it's not religious or health reasons. You need to be more aware of your customers needs and be sure you have reliable people interacting with the customers.

I have been coming to this restaurant as a favorite for a long time. I was very disappointed in our recent visit. Got Spinach Ravioli w/Rosa sauce. Sauce was greasy, thick and not tasty. Ravioli was good. My Honey got linguine w/mussels. I have never seen mussels so tiny! I guess they are under new management or have a new cook but not as good as it used to be. Don't know if we will return.

We have ordered here many times before. Tonight I was in the mood for broccoli rabe (who knows why?). So when I called, my first question was, "do you guys have sauteed broccoli rabe?" She said yes. So I placed my order and lo and behold... I paid, like 8 dollars for 2 sides of regular broccoli because she said 1 side want enough to share. Um... broccoli is NOT broccoli rabe. Otherwise everything was delicious. Staff needs to be educated, sorry.

Extreme disappointment. Choose a different place. We are from out of town and wanted Stombolis for New Years Eve. They were supposed to be 12" but one was about 10" and 3" wide and the other 7" or 8" and 3" wide. One (the smaller one) was supposed to have pepperoni and sausage and it only had like 2 or 3 pieces of pepperoni (no sausage). The other was to be spinach, mushroom, ricotta, and mushrooms. Awful. Canned mushrooms, next to no ricotta. Very stingy on fillings. The tomato sauce tastes just like tomato soup and was a horrible excuse for italian sauce. We were actually quite angered that this was our New Years Eve dinner.

Villa Rosa was a regular stop in my early years in Bucks County, but as Newtown evolved into a community with many good restaurants, the need to travel to Lower Makefield (not Yardley), became an unnecessary time expense. Last night I was driving back from a meeting and found myself hungry and very near Villa Rosa, and decided to stop in and have something light. I ordered an Eggplant Parm sandwich. It arrived a few minutes later in the hands of a pleasant server. Although the store was scheduled to close in 30 minutes I felt no pressure to eat quickly, and my server returned a few times to check on my satisfaction. The meal itself was quite good. The Eggplant was very thinly sliced and lightly sautéed in olive oil before placement in the Torpedo Roll for toasting in the oven. It was not breaded and held up well with the Mozza and Red Gravy. The Roll itself was crisped nicely before arrival. I normally just eat the innards and have only a few bites of the bread, which is what I did this time. It was as filling as I needed it to be. Overall, I was satisfied with my repast, and will have no hesitancy to return next time in the area. Besides, there are a few other decent food outlets in this commercial center, not the least of which is Indian Garden, an excellent curry house.

Not great... MY work ordered lunch from there- my chicken parm was very dry not much sauce at all, they messed up my boss' pasta dish, and someone else wasn't crazy about the salad they had. haven't tried their pizza. not going back . Venezia pizza rest is much bettter!

As far as Italian restaurants and pizza places go, Villa Rosa sets the standard. The pizza is great (you really can't go wrong), but they are not just a pizza joint. Their penne vodka competes with any of the top Italian restaurants in the area, and the rest of their Italian dishes are killer. Chicken Vesuvio is unreal. If you're looking to get take-out or sit down and enjoy pizza/Italian - look no further

My family ordered for pick up, a Sicilian Pizza extra cheese and sausage, 2 cheese Steaks with fried onions and mushrooms, and French Fries. I was told 25 minutes, and I was there exactly in time to pick up my order, and it was ready. The young man at the counter was very friendly and pleasant. He even asked me if I needed help opening the door on my way out. The pizza was very nice covered in cheese and shredded sausage. The cheese steaks were very full of meat, and delicious. The only thing was the fries were a bit on the cold side. I live only a few blocks away, and it was a warm 60 degree spring day, so maybe they made the fries too early because it takes the Sicilian Pizza 20 minutes to cook. Whatever, everything was good and I am not going to give a bad review over some cold fries. We ate them.
Very solid pizza place. Highly recommend you try the Chicken Parmigiana Pizza - it is one of a kind. One of those can feed your entire family, it is massive.

The pizza is okay but the service is terrible. 2 visits ago they misplaced our order and we waited 20 minutes. The last visit to this they burned our pizza and the solution was to give us $3 off. Today we came in 30 minutes after order (they said 15) and the pizzas were lost again. Found unmade and we are waiting again. Hopefully the new pizzeria coming to LMT will have a focus on their customers.

This is by far the BEST pizza we have had so far in Bucks. I love that they allow half and half of the specialty pizza. Best Buffalo Chicken pizza we had in our entire life. The other half was Chicken Parm which was unique and also quite good. Almost a tie, I also loved the Brooklyn Pizza with Extra Cheese. It is a thin crust square pizza. I'm so happy that this is close by us too. We are new to the area, and have been trying a new pizza place every week. Brothers was our go-to before but this place is now our new favorite. Also, although it was very busy the staff was very friendly and accommodating.
Horrible lunch today. For someone who has gone to this restaurant for 30 years I was shocked at the poor quality of the pizza, other food, and especially the service. Where is the Capuano family?

We have ordered take out from here several times in the last six months. They have gotten the order wrong every. Single. Time. One time, we ordered a pasta seafood dish -- it arrived with NO PASTA in it! Next time we ordered a side of spinach and a side of pasta ( two separate sides). They arrived mixed together in a soupy mess. Management did nothing to fix the obvious problems. We will not be back
Best Italian food around! Great family business that keeps a clean kitchen, wonderful Italian foods, and great service. For those trying to save money, you can always find coupons for here.

My friends and I are regulars at Villa Rosa. I have never felt more welcomed at an eating establishment in my entire life. The owners and cooks/ cashiers are amazing and know us all my names and pretty much know our orders by heart. It is the cleanest, best tasting, greatest pizza/ italian food place of all time. We have a regular table that we eat at at least 3 times a week. Great bike parking. The Lads feel as though this is the best eatery of all time.

My husband and I stumbled upon this place while both of us were working from home and looking for a place to get a quick lunch. What a hidden gem. We have since ordered pizza, eggplant rollatini and pannins since then, all delicious. The place is spotless and the staff friendly. So happy to have found a neighborhood go to!
Best pizzeria/Italian restaurant around. Vince's in Yardley a close second.
More like a 3.5. Always solid and reliable and occasionally very good. There are a handful of highlights and the rest of the food is generally solid. I am a fan of the tomato pie.

This restaurant is FILTHY, which is bad enough, but the worst part is that the owner doesn't care. I went in this afternoon with my sons for an early dinner. There was literally not a soul in the restaurant except for the manager and a handful of employees. We ordered and went to sit in the section reserved for quick service only to find EVERY table dirty. I went over to the counter and asked them to please wipe down the table. The manager gruffly told me to move to another table. I told him that ALL of the tables were dirty. The placemats has been used at each table and there crumbs and grease on every single table. He said something unintelligible, which I assumed was about his intention to come wipe off the table in short order. In fact, the boys' food came out, they ate it and he never came over to clean the tables. A female server walked in so I asked to speak with the manager. She pointed to the man who had already ignored my request. She asked what the problem was so I told her. She went over to tell the manager that the tables were dirty. He shrugged and said "Its self-Service over there," as of the customers are responsible for cleaning the tables. It wasn't our first time there but it will surely be the last. If they willingly tolerate dirt in the dining room, I can only imagine what they tolerate in the kitchen.
Beautiful restaurant nice waitress n waiters but their tomato sauce taste like campells spaghetti os

A friend wanted to go here for her birthday...but in the end she wasn't very happy with it anymore than I was. I had gnocchi and at first glance they looked a bit different than what I'm used to, but I was staying optimistic. So, I started this review months ago thinking I'd get back to it and never did. I don't really remember exactly what this place was like, but I know I wasn't satisfied. The gnocchi was either bland... or just tasted bad... and really why does it matter because either way it was disappointing.

Having lived in New Jersey for 6 years I've come to expect great pizza. With that said, this place didn't meet the bar set by even the standard pizza restaurant. The crust on our pizza was undercooked as was 50% of the inside of my mom's calzone. Long story short, this place's pizza was a disappointment.

Good find at the last minute. Food was above average, atmosphere is family oriented and the service is good, too. Came here when we realized Shady Brook Christmas light show doesn't have food and we had 3 hungry kids. We'd come here again if we are in the area.

This place used to be good but stick with cheesesteaks, pizza or calzone. Everything else starts to fall off. Just today ordered online just to give them a second chance and what I got as a take out, is simply not how a takeout should be handled. Lunch stromboli was just put in a brown bag with a plate underneath and voila, good day. No utensil, no napkins, nada. Way to make a paying customer want to take the business somewhere else. Do yourself a favor and go to somewhere else. Really disappointing.
Been going to this restaurant for many years and the staff and food has always been consistently good. Their Pizza and steaks are very good which isn't always easy to find anymore.
Hmmm...decent pizza, decent dishes, an above-average salad. I can see why the locals return, but if you are in the mood for some driving, go to Meglio.

Very, very good pizza! My wife and I just moved from Philly and were looking for a new local pizza place and Villa Rosa nailed it! We ordered a large half cheese half pepperoni with a half dozen garlic knots. The pizza had a nice, crispy crust with the perfect amount of chewiness. The sauce was great, not too sweet and it was well cooked! Nice and thin as well, not too doughy. The garlic knots were good, they certainly didn't skimp on the garlic! We will definitely be ordering from here again very soon. Highly recommend!!

I always have enjoyed Villa Rosa and last night was especially terrific. Every Tues. night they have Unlimited Mussels over pasta. As usual the Mussels were Medium, Juicy and fantastic. Villa Rosa's Spicy Red sauce has the right touch of flavor. I look forward to when I get to eat there specifically when my Mussels craving hits! My wife continues to get her staple of Chicken Parmigiana over Penne and likes the crispy breading. These are two of our favorite dishes.

My family was looking for spaghetti and meatballs and found that and more. The atmosphere was very casual pizza parlor type. The food was good, although not extraordinary. Unfortunately our waitress was not familiar with the soup of the day and gave us incorrect information that led to an allergic reaction. I would recommend this restaurant if you don't want fancy but are looking for a solid dish of pasta or chicken for the family.

One of my top pizza places. Just stopped by and had the tomato pie. Perfect thin crust and just right amount of garlic. Other favorites are the chicken parm and chicken Romano. chicken Romano in particular is like nothing else I've had in a slice at other pizza places

Paulos has the authentic tastes I remember from when I lived in Philly. Paulos not only have great Philly cheese steaks, but they also make the best white pizza in the world (and I have searched). I recommend the white pizza with chicken/spinach/mushroom. Mom loves the calzone. most items are enough for 2 meals. they deliver locally and were on a first name basis with my parents when they had a house nearby. I've never been disappointed no matter what the selection.
the best pizza in years and lve had it all from Giannis to Lil Italys and they pale. AWESOME

Have picked up food there on numerous occasions. I wont anymore. The food is good but the guy who answers the phone is nothing short of MISERABLE. Wow. If he's that unhappy than just quit. I don't know about you but I like to spend money where it's appreciated. I wont be back. After all, its just pizza and fast food.

So I just called paulo's to order a hoagie and I told the guy my order and then I told him it was for delivery and he got all pissed off at me because I didn't tell him it was for delivery first. last time I ever ate there just want to let everybody know about the attitude these people have the guy actually hung up on me and then called my phone back and gave me a hard time I guess he used his caller ID to call me back that was honestly the rudest man I ever spoke to!!!!!!!!!!! Oh and by the way that was the owner Joe that spoke to me that way

Cozy and Mediocre It's nice to have a little neighborhood Italian restaurant nearby. This one isn't it. The interior has a vaguely California 1960's surfer vibe and is comfortable enough. The staff is very pleasant and friendly. My wife had the lasagna which was a bit bland and could have used a lot more seasoning. I had a medium pizza which had good flavor. But as another reviewer complained, the central region of the pizza was hopelessly soggy. So that part had to be eaten with a knife and fork. Only then could I lift the piece with a standard New York middle fold to be eaten as pizza should be. I was also a bit miffed about the salads. The lasagna came with a side salad. I ordered a side salad and it was pricey at $5 for a plate of basic lettuce greens, two pieces of cucumber and 2 slices of tomato. When main dishes are under $10, that $5 was out of whack and was a substantial mark-up. While Paulo's is fine, it should be better.

Looking over the local delivery places, we came across Paulos. The menu seemed like it had a lot of different options so we decided to try it out. We ordered a large pepperoni pizza and a capicola sub. Both were just ok. Prices seemed fine for the most part. Delivery was relatively fast and the delivery guy was nice. I was hoping for a bit more when it came to the pizza as I need to find my must have area pizza delivery.
Delicious thin crust white pizza. Friendly staff. Consistently good in a time when restaurants blame lack of staff for bad service and cutting corners. Never disappoints! Thank you!
We ordered a pizza tonight and when it showed up as we were eating it we noticed it was two topping that we paid for. What a shame!

BEST steak and cheese around! Where do I begin?...I used to go to this place as a kid when it was off of 66 and Central. Now, 25 years later I drive by with my daughter and stop by the " new/old" location. Get a steak bomb sandwich or a hot slice of pizza. This place never disappoints. Restaurants don't stick around this long without making awesome food! Our food was amazing and the atmosphere was relaxed. Perfect place to unwind after a long day at the beach. Bring your kids! These guys do it right!!!

Paulo's used to be my favorite pizza shop proximate to my house. The last two times I've ordered pizza from there the crust was soggy in the middle of the pizza. Seems like an easy fix, maybe leave the pie in a few more minutes? Their spicy pasta salad is great and never disappoints. They have an impressive sub menu but I've never tried their subs because I don't eat meat.

This place reminds me of an old neighborhood pizza place from when I was a kid. Low key, comfortable, away from the crowds, with great food! The menu is really large and they've got daily specials. The staff make you feel like they've known you forever. Very welcoming and helpful people. I've actually been here a few times over the past couple months. The food is made to order and fantastic. My only "complaint" is the menu lacks descriptions of what's in/on the sandwiches. Both the Steak Bomb and Chicken Bomb are great tasting sandwiches. The roll comes toasted so it's hard on the outside and soft inside. The blanket of cheese does hold the heat in - the sandwiches stay hot inside for a long time. Homemade chicken minestrone soup finished out the plate tonight.
Pizza is Great and they have the best steak & cheese in town. Get the steak bomb and you won't be disappointed.

Been going here since I was a kid. One of the best Calzones in St Pete. I love thier Steak n Cheese it's really solid. I don't think I've ever gotten bad food here, & I eat here a lot lol. The staff is awesome. It's family run. I think.its on the second generation now. Ed is a staple at this place. Don't miss out. You won't be disappointed.

I tried Paulo's large pizza for the first time after reading several reviews and trying multiple top rated establishments in the area. All I can saw is Wow! I was satisfied with the other local spots but this place outshined all. The crust and ingredients were superb. I enjoyed the leftovers the following day. Service was excellent and friendly. Try it, you won't be disappointed.
Moved to the neighborhood a few months ago and have absolutely loved this pizza place. Always fresh hot pizza with amazing crust!

Always great. We have been eating with these guys for years, since their previous whole in the wall shop up the street. Great pie, fresh ingredients, and always consistent. Most importantly, their shop is clean!!!! Not like the others in the vicinity who have a screen door, front and back, limited AC, and stuff all over the place. Paulo's is a great pick
Excellent little place I've been eating there for years. Strongly suggested if If you're in the area and want some good food.
I highly recommend the Steak Bomb, it is consistently good & somewhat spicy. Good local place for sandwiches.
Paulo's has been one of my GoTo spots for a while. Nothing fancy but a very good solid sub and pizza shop. Pro tip.. Order steak and cheese and have them add sauce. Major bonus is DELIVERY!

I agree with the other post, if you don't know the drill then you could get lost. BUT go to the counter and order one of the most tasty pies of your life. The Greek salad is awesome! One of the best I've ever had...plentiful feta, amazing dressing and super yummy potato salad. Wish it was closer to where we lived but we drive 20 mins to get there and aren't dissatisfied.

Came here the other night and ordered their popular steak bomb sub. I have to say I was left a little disappointed. First of all the subs are only 10 inch which is no big deal as long as the ingredients are quality, but I was not bowled over this trip. The steak was okay, nothing special, seasoned well and they add pepperoni to the sandwich which is different, but I dug it. The problem for me was the briny peppers and pepperchinis added to the mix. The vinegar of the peppers overpowered the sub and drowned out the flavor of the meat. Next time I may try it without. They have a nice menu of salads, pizza, etc and will be back to try more and may update my review when I do, but this trip I was not left that impressed.

I come here semi-regularly... and specifically for the grilled cheese sandwich. It is literally perfect. I'm not even tempted to try anything else. Casual, low key spot on Central, in the opposite direction of downtown.

Went for lunch today and had the Greek salad and the white pizza with chicken, mushrooms and spinach. The pizza was delicious! Delicious crispy crust and fresh ingredients but could have used a touch of garlic in the white sauce. However, the Greek salad dressing was wayyyyy too vinegary and the salad had mustard based potato salad on it. Overpoweringly sour! Will not order that salad again.
This is a great place. We ordered a medium pizza with mushrooms and onion. Great sauce, fresh dough. Something special about the cheese. I pick this place as The Best pizza in St Petersburg

We were looking for a pizza place after 8:00pm Most places were closed so as we drove down the street we saw Paulo's was open. It was just my niece and I. We ordered mozzarella sticks and a medium cheese pizza. This place was awesome from the moment we ordered. All the guys behind the counter were so friendly and nice. My niece is 5 and will talk to anyone and once she gets going she doesn't stop. These guys were so good about it. One second we're ordering pizza and the next talking about American Girl dolls. The whole staff was so friendly Now onto the food! The mozzarella sticks were good and the pizza was delicious!!! I'm not much of a leftover person but we got back to the hotel and I ended up eating another slice and then the next day I heated up a slice in the microwave and it still tasted good!! I will definitely go back and get another pizza!! And I'd like to try a sub next time!!

Food was pretty good and that's the only thing keeping this review from 1 star, unfortunately. I was in town on business, no car, at a hotel. Heard this place was good so I ordered. Nice and easy. Guy on the phone was great! Food arrived earlier than expected which was another plus but this is where it went all downhill Guy that's delivering off the bat has an attitude. Clearly had a bad day and was upset about something. Says he tried to call 5-10 times to no answer until I finally received the call and came down. I didn't not receive any phone calls besides the call I answered. It was very evident he thought I was lying by How LOUDLY he was huffing and puffing and shaking his head, literally, the entire time he was running my card. After running the card, it declined. My fault entirely, probably didn't pay it off in time. Gave him a new card that worked fine. To which he responded "why didn't you use that card to start?". My bad, guy. I didn't plan on giving you a declined card. He was upset about god knows what so I simply apologized for the inconvenience. He then goes on to sarcastically tell me to tip whatever because the pizza place was right down the road as if it was an inconvenience to drive 2 miles... I don't have a care and delivery is your job. Again, this guy clearly had a bad day and was not a representation of this business but I was definitely let down over this very awkward experience. I ordered 6/10 around 7pm.

The older gentleman who took my order yesterday seemed to have a major attitude problem, and he was very rude to me as I was trying to give this establishment business. If this is the normal operating standard for this place, count me out as I am not going to handover hard earned money to somebody for a sandwich and an attitude. I wish I went else where for lunch as this place is not that great food wise.

Pizza: the best in the bay. It's made to order and you can taste how fresh the sauce and cheese is! Subs: We always get the cheeseburger sub and a turkey sandwich. Both are prepared to perfection. Sides: I find myself ordering the spicy Mac salad over and over again. So creamy and delicious, the best I've ever had. Paulos has been around for 3 decades, they're the real deal!
My son and I got an 18" Pepperoni on Sat. night and it was great! And it was even better the next day! Will be making this our Pizza Shop from now on. Next its the Steak Bomb.

Ordered a sausage sub with cheese and peppers for a total of $9.36 out the door. The sausage portion was very small, like about 1/2 anywhere else, and they sliced it so it would spread out over the sandwich. I will forever pass on this place. Also, this place doesn't even have an online menu......how pathetic.
They have great food. Great specials and very friendly staff. Paulo"s is also very family friendly. It is great place to eat.

The food is okey, I am new to the area so we are eating take out until we get settled. I have ordered four times and each time my Oder was screwed up. I don't mean that the food was bad, but incomplete orders. Food or drinks not included in order etc. they don't listen when you order and the check only has a total amount so you don't know what or how much your being charged for. Only a total amount. The most frustrating thing is by the time you get the food and only a incomplete order at that, your left dissatisfied at the price of $ 29.00 for one large house pizza and a bottle of coke. Add the delivery tip and charge it's $35.00. Totally not worth the wait or the money.

The interior needs updating but the service is better than average. The food is excellent and the portions are very generous. The prices are very reasonable considering the amount of food you get.Overall I think this is a good family restaurant. A good place to eat.

One of my favorite places for pizza pies and calzones. I have loved these pizzas for almost 30 years. Since it was across the street and up a block or two. Paulo's has remained fantastic all thru the years. Excellent

The previous reviewer said this was a bad place to go for pizza and sit-down service, so upon hearing that we headed in for pizza and sit-down service. Ordered their current sweet-spot deal, a 2-topping large for $10.99 (prices subject to change I am sure, but it lured me in...a 2-topping, hopefully superior pie at the price point of Papa John's latest deal-du-jour...SOLD!). The pizza here is very much in the vein of Dal'Italia or Paisano's (both on 4th St): a Clark-Griswold-takes-Rusty-and-Audrey-out-for-pizza kind of vibe. Suburban, with kind of dated recipes (yes, I realize that sounds ridiculous, like how could a classic Italian recipe be dated? But I mean to say these are old-school 70's and 80's American adaptions that - I am willing to bet - have not evolved in those 25+ years). It arrives: We ordered green peppers and pepperoni, and they generously gave us red peppers too. What's more, the peppers appeared to be herb-marinated with basil or something, a nice touch that added to presentation, if not subtleties of flavor. First bites: let me start by saying that this is perfectly acceptable, family-style pizza. Good for kids, good for adults, etc. Restaurant is clean and pleasant. Wholesome, fresh, etc. Price is right. OK, now I rip into it... The crust (my fetish) has this sort of water cracker plainness to it. No yeast notes; instead, a prominent fragrance and taste is white flour. Before you think I am so plebian as to be asking for a few shakes of Hungry Howie's butter-buds-style crust flavoring compound, I am not. Just asking for maybe some developed yeast aromas or some kind of complimentary flavor arising from at least a little dough-love would be nice. This is by no means horrible, but not my first choice. Does not ruin the pizza, but does it no great favors either. Functions as a canvas. Again - good pizza. Good people. I can see how previous reviewer would think the hostess lady was gruff - I could perceive it was probably a component of her personality and him saying that doesn't surprise me. But she was sweet as pie to us. Maybe she reads Yelp. Four stars on here is "Yay! I'm a fan" and three is "A-OK." I agree with previous reviewer, this is an "A-OK" place that deserves an extra half star for integrity, good people and product freshness. We wouldn't drive too far to come back, but if in the area would certainly return (and stick with the vaunted subs). It's a solid Proximity Pick.

I have found few pizza places in St Pete that make real thin crust pizza. Many places say they make thin crust pizzas but they are usually doughy and have a gooey texture. I passed Paulo's Pizza on my way to the store and decided tonight to order one of their pizzas. It is a hole in the wall kind of place, which is where you often find good food. The inside is unpretentious, very clean, and a very wonderful staff, friendly and welcoming. The pizza maker, he was working on Saturday night, really listened to what I wanted and when he finished making and baking the pizza, I was excited because it appeared to be a real New York style thin crust pizza. I took it home, and as my partner Jim and I sampled a slice, we couldn't believe the texture of the crust, the flavorful sauce, and the good flavor of all the ingredients. For every good pizza we have tried, only a couple are true New York style. The great thing about Paulo's Pizza is it is in the hood so we don't have to travel far to get a great pizza. They offer other items such as Calzones, chicken wings, and subs. We haven't tried those, as we are Pizza and Spaghetti lovers. I would suggest when going there you do as I did and ask for a true thin crust pizza, as the standard is a little thicker. You can dine in as well, but we prefer to do take out.

We find that when we order from here there is an inconsistency in the pizzas. Sometimes the pizza is perfect and other times it's off, crust, shape, how long it was or wasn't cooked etc. haven't ordered in a while because of.

Great pizza and great customer service. I just moved to this neighborhood and have been very satisfied. I've only picked up never delivery so I can't judge the timeliness of delivery. They have an extensive menu of food that goes beyond pizzas. Must try
This is one of my favorite local spots! The food is delicious and the service is friendly. If you like white pizza try the Margarita Pizza, I always get a side a sauce

Ordered take out from Paulo's tonight. Daughter had a medium cheese pizza (not much I can say about that, although she gave the pizza a 4 out of 5 star rating). I, on the other hand, ordered a meatball sub & Antipasto Salad. I could not finish either.... Meaning the quantity is more than impressive. I enjoyed the meatball sandwich very much, the meatballs are tender and the sauce is just as I like... Not acidic, not sweet... Just right! The Antipasto Salad includes all the likely Italian characters... Black Olives, ham, salami, cheese etc... Both the meats & cheeses and the the greens were very fresh & tender. I normally am a Toby's Little Italy fan, but I will have to seriously consider changing my go to Italian take out joint.

I've been eating at Paulo's since 1985. I live in San Diego now, but I include a stop at Paulo's on every Florida trip I make. The food is that good. Their pizzas and salads are good. Their hot sandwiches are amazing!!!!!! The Steak Bomb is not so much a sammich as it is a religious experience: great steak, great bread, great peppers, great cheese...wait, there's more: PEPPERONI too! Your mouth will think it's died and gone to heaven! I would kill a man, in front of his momma, for a Paulo's Steak Bomb!!!! (Kidding. I think)
I gotta say, this is possibly the best pizza in Saint Petersburg. What more do you need to know?
Tried this place again, it was very good. We got a really great pizza and the wing had a great taste. Phone people are much more polite as well. New favorite

I'm working up here from out of town I stopped in to grab a couple slices and a Coke this is the best pizza I have had in a long time I would definitely recommend this place to my friends family and co-workers if I didn't live over 70 miles away I would have come here more often

Very nice staff, but the cheese pie I ordered didn't quite make the grade. The weakness was in the sauce, which tasted just a little too much like plain tomato sauce. I'm from New York and I could go to just about any local pizza joint there and get a better slice - maybe that's the problem, that I'm spoiled.

The Pizza is I would say a six out of 10 but the delivery time and temperature of the pizza when it arrives is not acceptable. I run an Airbnb and I have informed my guests that this establishment is known for their good pizza and delivery options. We ordered only one large pizza and we open the box the second that it was handed to us. The pizza was ice cold. Anyone who has ever tried to reheat a pizza that has been fresh cooked, knows that there is no possible way you are going to get it to taste the same. This was the first time we ordered from them so I will give them one more chance but I will not recommend them to my guests until I have seen that they can deliver a hot pizza that isn't sloppily made. We ordered half sausage and pepperoni and half mushroom and cheese. I do not like the taste of sausage and although I do understand on the edges of where the pizza is cut in half some of the little pieces of sausage might come over to my side of the pizza but the entire pizza had a little bits of sausage that I had rolled over or melted into the cheese on my side. By the time I got finished taking all of the sausage out of my cheese and mushroom side, There was hardly any cheese left in the pizza was colder than ever. That was your one screw up. I believe in second chances so I will order again. I really want this to be the pizza place that we can use consistently but you guys need to deliver a consistent product if I'm going to recommend your pizza shop to my 25 guests a week. I would understand if we were on the outer limits of your delivery zone but we are literally eight blocks away so there is no excuse for a cold pizza.

Delicious! We are always looking for places that we can bike or walk to from home and this place is perfect. The staff was SO attentive and the food was awesome, particularly the breadsticks :O soooo garlicky and cheesy and crisp...exactly what you want. My boyfriend had been before with his sister, he got a "GIANT..Truly enormous" calzone and she got "killer" wings...and they talked about it so much that I finally had to put my foot down and demanded we go so I could try it. We WILL be back.
Always great pizza at an affordable price. Love their wings, hot Italian sandwich, steak sandwich and pasta in any form.

I've only been there once, but prior to my 1st time visit, I heard good things about this place so I decided to give it a chance. Although I can't give you a rating on their pizza, or the salads, I can say that their subs are pretty darn good. They had a wide variety from Chicken, Steak, Meat lovers, Pepperoni, Gyros, and some more which is a plus. The service was fast and friendly which is another plus. It's a subtle little place on Central Ave; I'd go there again next time I'm in the area.

Subs- Amazing! (esp. the grilled chicken) Pizza- As good as you can find in St Pete. I've been eating here most of my life. I love this place. That said, I know what to get, and what to expect. Everyone I've brought here loves the place. The hot subs: Awesome. Grilled steak, chicken or hot Italian, put on a fresh roll, topped with cheese and thrown in the oven for a few mintues to melt the cheese. Then some fresh lettuce and tomatoes, and you're in heaven. The Pizza: personally I love it. The sauce is NOT sweet (gross). The toppings are plentiful. I prefer a thin crust, so order my pizza XL, as I suspect they use the same amount of dough for both L and XL. Oh, and a XL is 18 inches, you can feed the whole family with one of these things... The service: Can be lacking. Half the staff is awesome, the other half (including the owner) leaves something to be desired. Get to know Mark and Eddie, and you'll always be taken care of. Great food, good portions, and very fair prices. Try it.

Fantastic meal! Stopped In for our first time after playing golf on Treasure Island. We ordered a Hawaiian pizza with pineapple and ham but we added bacon, then we also had a white pizza with chicken, spinach and mushrooms- both were great! Also had cheese sticks as an appetizer. Everything came out hot and with a nice smile- under their mask of course, but great customer service!!!! Would definitely recommend!!
Just got done with a late lunch. Awesome food every time. Friendly atmosphere too. A great affordable place for lunch or dinner!
Went back ordered same pizza and spicy Mac.. yummy - fresh and very good Of course we will go back

Subs: Outstanding (especially the "Steak Bomb") Pizza: I've had better but they are OK Salads: Good Service: None to speak of I almost gave this place a 4 star rating, and it's close, but they just don't quite make the cut for 4 stars (3.5 stars if that was an option). If you like hot peppers you absolutely have to try the Steak Bomb Sub. It's basically a Philly Cheese Steak sandwich with Pepperoni, Pizza Sauce, and Hot Peppers added. Yummm. They are fantastic for take-out or to-go. If you are going to eat there, you have to know the drill. You still go up front and order your food. Sit down, and they'll bring you your order. Now, here's part of what earned them a demotion from four stars to three. The first time I went in there to eat in, we didn't know the drill, so we grabbed some menus, sat down and waited for someone to come over... and waited... and waited some more. They flat ignored us and when we finally asked, a female worker fairly rudely told us that we had to order up front and let on that she would have let us sit there all night if we had wanted to. So, maybe this is a good place for the homeless to get out of the weather and not be bothered -- I don't know. In my opinion, the pizza is just OK, but pizza really is a personal thing and so others may love it. The crust is average thickness (not thin crust, but certainly not thick crust either). I thought it was way too light on the sauce, but the toppings were all very fresh and good. Another service issue -- we asked for extra pizza sauce after the pizza was delivered and they brought it to us refrigerator cold. We had to send the pizza sauce back to be heated. All the while, the female employee seemed to have a bit of an attitude all night like we were inconveniencing her by being there. For me, this place is great for take-out subs and salads, but I won't be going here for pizza or sit down service.

We have driven by so much that we decided to give it a go. While it was yummy, it was just your basic pizza. I'd rate it better than a Pappa John's. Crust was good, not thick but not thin. It says NY style but I wouldn't call it that. The sauce and cheese flavors were great. Ultimately, I did enjoy it but it's not somewhere I see myself going often.

I love this place but I started calling at 9:30, no one answered. I called 4 times, I live 6 blocks away I arrived at 9:45 only to be told kitchen is closed. Great food but poor Friiggen customer service I DO NOT RECOMMEND ANYMORE

Decided to give these guys a shot. Called and ordered a large pie and cheese steak for pickup. Was told about 25mins. Got there and waited at the counter. The guy I passed coming out the front door as i entered eventually came back from outside and asked what I needed. I asked for my pickup order and he said give him a minute they were melting the cheese on the cheesesteak. So I pulled out a chair by a table near the counter and waited. Sat there almost 20 mins waiting while others showed for pickup orders and left. Finally the guy who helped me said something to the two old guys in the kitchen about my order. Then under his breath said "why hasn't he got his order yet"? Finally the delivery driver brought my order out to me. As I drove home I was thinking this had better be good. Unfortunately it wasn't that great. The pizzas crust was bland along with the sauce. Neither had anything appealing to them and the crust was to thick for my liking. Toppings were adequate but nothing special. The meatball in particular was very lacking and had no decernable flavor. Then came the cheesesteak. The portion of steak was good but again flavor was lacking. The only real flavor was from the cherry pepper relish which I opted for. Overall I wasn't impressed with the food or service and won't return. Was a waste of time. I will stick with TOBY'S LITTLE ITALY which has an awesome pie and cheesesteak. These guys aren't even on the same level.

I've been to Saint Peters Village many times over the past 30 yrs. This time I tried this bakery. I had the asparagus quiche 8$ , girlfriend had the pilgrim sandwich with the turkey, goat cheese, and a type of raisin bread 9$. She loved it and my daughter had the grilled cheese on rustic white bread 6$, and a brownie. Great little place to check out. Very small menu, but it is a bakery. There is a parking lot across the street , i had no problem finding parking when I was there on a Sunday. Friendly staff.
I dream about coming here everyday and getting every item on the menu.... so you can assume I loved it here and will return!!!!

The St. Peter's Bakery was, up until June, the best coffee shop in the area, bar none. Poor management decisions and personnel shake-ups ruined the place since then. Now the former chef, Melanie has leased the bakery back from its owners. She's brought back her former workers and is once again producing excellent, excellent pastries, her full menu of signature sandwiches, great coffee and best of all, a friendly atmosphere. If you have been, like me, an unhappy exile from this place then be assured that your exile is over. Come back and see! If you haven't been here before, you owe it to yourself to check this place out. Free wifi too!

Decent sandwiches and baked goods, great Cafe Excellence coffee, pleasant ambience, but most prices require a downward adjustment, for sure. You may want to splurge on a small square of cheesecake brownie for $5 or a loaf of bread for $7 but probably recoil, and rightfully so, at paying $25 for a pie! Truth to tell, the best baked goods are indeed quite good, but, honestly, I've tasted better at Panera, Shady Maple, Trader Joe's and Wegmans in some cases, for less money. Sandwiches are very good but often skimpy for the price, especially if you are unlucky enough to get the short end of the bread loaf. But overall, this place can still be worth a visit.

Some friends and I stumbled through the little village of St. Peter's on our way home from a small road trip. We had sandwiches and they were all delicious. The bread tasted so fresh and was full of flavor. They give you a small salad of dark greens with the sandwiches and that was so much more refreshing than a side of fries or chips. If you happen by the area, stop by! The service is friendly, good food, and great atmosphere. We sat on the deck right by the creek and it was lovely. I wish we wouldn't have been too full for dessert.
Very cute place for coffee and brunch. So many tasty options to choose from. Go out on the back deck if the weather is good. Walk around the little village afterwards for a quiet stroll.

We love this bakery and visit when we are in town for Thanksgiving. My fiancé and I each ordered a bacon egg and cheese on their homemade whole grain bread. The sandwiches were absolutely delicious (the homemade bread was a game changer) and came with a side of roasted potatoes, which was a nice surprise. I had to get a chocolate croissant to go, which I normally order from the bakery. The croissant was the best I've ever had (and I have had my fair share of them). It was super light, airy and flaky, with the perfect amount of chocolate. My wallet and waistline are thanking me that this bakery is not close by. We will definitely be back!

Nice little bakery in historic St. Peter's Village serving up some delicious sweets and eats. You can enjoy those yummy treats either inside or on their deck overlooking folks climbing the big boulders in the creek behind the bakery. This was our first visit here and I had the key lime bar while my sons had butter cookies and a chocolate torte. All were very good and next time, we would be inclined to try some of their sandwiches and salads that we saw coming out from the kitchen as they looked good. Definitely worth a stop in and you can easily work off those calories by hiking along the creek afterwards!

Dense, under hydrated, flavorless bread, flat mushy croissants, and the rudest staff ever make this place very undesirable. Also, what kind of bakery that serves breakfast and coffee opens at 9 am. Overrated!!!

Our family recently ate lunch at the Bakery. We had soup and sandwiches. We found the food to be delicious, fresh, and a decent sized portion. We do not recommend them for a family meal, as the selections are not exactly kid friendly. They are also on the pricier side as well. The scenery canNOT be beat though...and the items in the bakery showcase...WELL, they are by far superior to any baked goods we've had in recent years. We suggest the apple danish cheesecake, chocolate cupcake and the oatmeal raisin jumbo cookies...again a bit on the pricey side but worth every penny. Service was excellent and friendly. Restaurant was clean. Atmosphere exceptional.

Spectacular view off the back balcony dining area, and the food more than meets expectations! The "Pilgrim" sandwich: fresh apple raisin walnut bread, with sliced turkey, creamy herb chevre, cranberry sauce and more was one of the best sandwiches I've had since . . . Plymouth Rock was discovered. Friends enjoyed a beautiful quiche and the Britain sandwich (roast beef and horseradish mayo-yum!). We'll be back for breakfast or dinner or something (everything! )from the bakery case!

I'm going to say my fiancé and I have been coming to the village since I was little. Our parents have as well. We love the bakery the handful of times we have stopped and eaten here. I've brought friends of mine from the city here (since now I live in the city). One of my best friends was married here. It was only natural that I would suggest this as a top location for my bridal shower. What a mistake I made. My sister had a hard time getting in touch with the Owner Melanie to secure details after it was agreed that we would host the shower here. It was agreed that in rain or super hot weather we could be seated inside, but that the Bakery wouldn't close so it wouldn't be a private event. I said no problem I don't need a private event - just set us up in a corner. If it was nice, we would take up part of the back deck. My estimate to her was 20 people months prior to sending out invites. When my sister confirmed with her that it was only 15 she was rude and said "that was way less then I was told". My mom and my sister flew up from Florida to host my bridal shower here. Neither has ever been to the Bakery itself. The owner Melanie was on vacation. Yet she never mentioned to either of them she was away in any of the emails. My mom and sister show up to set up and were told Melanie was on vacation and that Matt would help them with some things. Our shower was agreed for 2pm. Apparently Melanie told Matt a time of 3pm and he had to rush and prepare everything ahead of schedule. Not only that, but she didn't convey to Matt the menu she told us we would be having. Sandwiches, mini quiche, cheese, and lavender shortbread cookies/lemon bars/peach pie for dessert. All served with iced tea lemonade and at the end coffee and tea. My mom and sister brought juices, fruit, and champagne to set up a mimosa bar and they did all the decorating themselves. (Melanie had agreed). Not once was anyone offered a drink of iced tea or lemonade and at the end when I asked to have the desserts set up inside (which Matt was kind enough to do) coffee/iced coffee/tea was never set out or offered. I think a few people asked for coffee and it was provided, but they didn't have any iced coffee. One other woman. A heavy set woman with a fowl face was just rude the entire time. No matter what was asked. Main issues here? The owner went on vacation without even letting any of us know The proper time was not conveyed to her staff The proper menu was not communicated to her chef There were no plates set out with the cheese Not one person was offered lemonade or iced tea in extreme heat It was not discussed that the sandwiches would be miniature - which do not taste like the sandwiches on the menu. It would have been nice to know. In the heat wave with a basically empty Bakery we were not offered an alternative set up spot in 98 degree weather. Inside in a corner possibly with the mimosa bar on the back deck or from porch? The three things for dessert requested neither the lemon bars or peach pie were served which were a little disappointing since those are what I requested and what was agreed on. All in all my mother and sister worked really hard to make it beautiful. The servers did their best and seemed sweet and Matt was really helpful even helping my mom and sister carry some things that were heavy, getting them scissors to trim the flowers etc. I'm pretty sure that Matt was the head of the kitchen. The rude woman I am not sure who she was - she never introduced herself to anyone even when my mother greeted her. I just would avoid hosting any event here. It was a big disappointment.

Tip for the girl who waited on me today: Don't give one of the few customers you had a hard time about something as petty as a small dog coming inside for two minutes while I placed my order. I've been coming to the bakery longer than you've been alive, no one has ever said anything to me before. It had nothing to do with training new people. I drove 20 miles to sit outside for lunch on a nice day with my 15 lb. dog, who I've been told is better behaved than most children. The food was very good as usual but the service was annoying.

Saint Peter's Village does not boast a ton of places to shop or dine, but this bakery is certainly worthy of a visit. There aren't a ton of tables inside, but they also have some out back on the deck and the place doesn't get too crazy, even on the weekends. Selection is not huge for pastries or breads, but you'll have no trouble finding something to enjoy in house or to go. This past weekend, they had baguettes and 3 other breads to choose from, 5-6 cookies, a couple muffin options and a few other treats. Tea and coffee, obviously with quite a number of whole leaf teas packaged for sale, as well as Valerio coffee beans. The chai menu was pretty extensive, plus a few espresso and lattes to choose from. For lunch, they boasted at least 7-8 menu items and 2 specials, plus soup. I opted for a brie, basil, tomato on a baguette and it came with a decent spinach salad on the side for $10. Quite reasonable for the size of the sandwich. It took them approximately 15 minutes to prepare, so it is made fresh to order, so don't expect a quick run in and out if a sandwich is the plan. Very friendly service too. Recommend if you are driving past on Rte. 23 or doing some hiking at French Creek State Park.

The service is always leaves a lot to be desired. The best you can do is serve yourself. The quality of food is good but expensive for the area. Throw the adjective "French" and double the price. Not quite. I was still willing to give the cash to support a local place but I never knew a bakery to open at 9AM! 7 or 8 AM yes. This is a sleepy baker. Zzzzzzzzzz. I guess he relies on catering

I've been here several times in the past year. I always come by bicycle. I often come with a tad rowdy group of cyclists (good hearted and goofy, but rowdy) and we are usually starving, thirsty, impatient, in a hurry, but willing to relax and enjoy the beautiful scenery (we've come when it was 20*F and today when it was 90*F). With that said, the workers here always strive to get us in and out quickly, and cater fairly to each customer in line. Their Russian Tea Cookies are my favorite, the Almond Croissant was so mouth watering today, and their coffee: medium roast: was delectable. Also, they have an amazing Strawberry Rhubarb Pie. I do wish they had for Gluten Free options, but I'm not strict GF, so coming here allows me to enjoy foods I normally don't treat myself win anyways. My friends have ordered full egg sandwiches and parfaits, meals, etc, and we have never been displeased. In addition, I came through a few Saturday's ago on a Solo Adventure. I was worried that I had left too late and this place wouldn't be open, which I was planning as a vital re-fuel station for my body to get back to Philly on a 90*F day. They were still open around 4-5 on a Saturday. It was such a relief. They were very accommodating, friendly, and non-judge mental to a smelly, sweaty, delirious young woman in specialty bike gear. Thanks for all your hard work, ladies and gentlemen. Keep it up!!
My wife and I had coffee and dessert while sitting outside on the balcony. Quite possibly the best view in Southeastern PA.

"Fresh" sums up the quality of the items on the menu at this cozy eatery in tranquil Saint Peter's Village. Sandwiches made with perfectly baked breads and delectable pastries accompanied by a scenic outdoor space to enjoy your meal makes the experience idyllic. While the menu staples are reliably perfect, I only wish that it could be upgraded more frequently by adding a few more options to the list, after all- variety is the spice of life!

Myself and a friend happened upon this wonderful little strip of shoppes while cycling from Philadelphia and a gem of a cafe was found. The st. peters bakery is right out of a film (not a movie a film). A perfectly quaint and cozy interior is complemented by the charming staff and the amazing menu. Hot cocoa and a pecan cinnamon roll was the choice for a rainy day as the cold damp was creeping in. For cyclist, the interior floor is cleat friendly and we were able to sit on their front porch in view of our bikes. The they have cafe drinks but also a cold fridge with some to go beverages for the rest of your ride. It's part of the philadelphia gran fondo course ride so don't miss this place of you're out there. All thumbs, fingers and toes up!

We hosted my sister's bridal shower at the bakery and it was absolutely perfect. The staff was friendly and attentive, the food was was delicious and the DESSERTS!!!! The staff quickly jumped on chilling the champagne we had brought and were on top of making sure there was plenty of food. They provided linens, flowers, prepared champagne flutes with raspberries, juices for the mimosa bar, and the best food I've had at a bridal shower all at a very reasonable price. I feel guilty taking credit for all the compliments we received from the guests when Saint Peter's Bakery deserves all the credit. Thank you, thank you, thank you all for making the day so special for all of us!!

The food was delicious with nice choices. I wanted one of everything. Service was good and there was enough seating. The cappuccino was very weak which is why I wouldn't give it 5 stars. That being said, I'd definitely come back and probably. Update: came back and the campfire chai is amazing!!

The food is fantastic the location is amazing and the service is fairly good. This is a nice spot to visit during the summer on the weekends. The food it's self is nice and the proportions are good, however the one reason that I am only giving this bakery two stars is because the prices are simply terrible! $14 for a bread and ham sandwich! That's crazy! It's nice to visit maybe once a year with friends and family, however I would never visit more than that. The bakery is mostly a tourist trap and is ideal for people visiting from far away. Overall I have to give this bakery two stars due to the prices.

This is always my first and last stop when hiking in St. Pete's. First stop because I always forget a drink and need to use their restroom. And last stop because their food is a delicious post hike treat! Since my last vist I was diagnosed as gluten intolerant, and wasn't sure there'd be much here for me to enjoy. But there was cheese cake, delicious tea, and a chicken salad sandwich on a bed of greens instead of a wrap. All quite delicious. Other gluten free offerings include a selection of salads and soups. Also the staff are quite friendly. All this with a great view! Well worth the long drive from DE!

Nice spot to check out after a hike around Saint Pete's. Be careful when you go because the line can be out the door. They have a good selection of specialty coffees and pastries. Their small menu has some good sandwiches and soups as well. We had brunch there on a Sunday and we waited about 10 minutes in line and about 20 minutes for our food. We only ordered a parfait to split. It was worth the wait though. Very good! And so was the matcha green tea lattes we ordered.

I love this place. I love this town. Stepping into the bakery is like stepping into a different time in a different part of the world where things are simple and people are happy. This isn't even the best part about this bakery. What makes it even better is the quality and care that is put in so everything on the menu and the service is excellent. Every employee has a smile on their face and cares about what they do. Oh! And that view out the back! It's priceless.

This place is amazing! In addition to being a top notch bakery, they also serve fresh, healthy sandwiches. You can eat inside or venture out into the patio and listen to the creek while you eat. The staff is always friendly and knowledgeable and the food is consistently delicious. Also, if you can't make it to the bakery, they have a stand at the Phoenixville farmers market every Saturday selling a variety of their breads and other baked goods. Their homemade soups are awesome.

I've passed this place several times on my weekend rides; as I passed by this morning @ 7:30, I noticed they were loading a van with fresh baked bread. The aroma was enough to stop me dead in my tracks. I got off my bike, went in and had some fresh coffee and double-chocolate-with-walnuts cookie for my breakfast. The atmosphere was lovely and the staff were wonderful - especially when I realized that they don't usually open til 9 and I had, literally, caught them as they were getting ready to make a delivery to a local farmer's market. I'm definitely planning to go back again!

I came at 3:04 the day before thanksgiving and I guess they closed at 3. The door was open and the one girl behind the counter with dark hair was obviously upset. They let me in but she was pretty rude and any questions I had she pretty much rushed an answer. For instance, there was a gingerly loaf that was covered in some type of frosting with nuts. I asked her what she said it was and she said "pretty much the same as banana bread but with gingerbread". It had frosting glazed on that was the color the color of caramel but she rushed to lick the door, and pretty much rushed me out the back. My card was having a hard time tapping and she also told me it won't go through unless I put a tip. I inserted it instead. The blond girl was really nice however. Yelp says that it closed at 4 and it's pretty out the way. I've worked retail and this type of stuff happens all the time. It wasn't even that busy to not grab an extra 40-50 dollars I would have spent if I wasn't rushed out a few minutes after closing. It's a cute little village with boulders in the back but because of the poor service I probably will not be back.

Stopped here for a takeout coffee and a croissant for the guys at home. By 10:30 on Saturday the croissants choices were chocolate, almond and ham and cheese. No plain - quel dommage! So I opted for two of the large coconut macaroons - large, chewy, sweet and drizzled with chocolate. French roast coffee was strong and not the least bit bitter. There were quite a number of tables populated with the older set but no wheelchair access to this building is evident. Street angle parking is available across the street.

Fresh artisan breads and boutique-y desserts that don't just sit there looking pretty, but come through with major flavor! Their sourdough starter (I think this means yeast pot?) dates back 100 years, and they bake in French steam injected ovens. I'm not versed in the kitchen equipment part, though I do know about yeast pots, but regardless, the baked goods are really really good! Interior is quaint and chic. They had luxe fresh flowers on all the cafe tables, gorgeous old wood flooring, and upscale bakery displays with European-pretty confections inside. Staff is dressed barista style, in all black, with black waist aprons. Everyone was extremely polite, professional, and helpful. Prices were very reasonable for the quality and serving size. We missed the chance to try them for lunch (we'd eaten in Phoenixville), but we're glad we stopped for a quick sweet after a visit to Welkinweir. We asked for dessert specialties and were directed to the "Black Granite Torte," a layered chocolate torte with chocolate cream, and the "Cowboy Cookie," a raisin oatie with coconut, nuts, chocolate, and more! We also tried the turtle brownie because it looked gorgeous! Total was under $14 for all three, and each one could feed two. The Black Granite Torte had to be eaten there, but the other two could ride home with us for the next day or so. So now that all have been eaten, here's the comparison: The torte was chocolatey and sweet, but more subtle and sophisticated than the brownie. Both were very good, but had their own strengths. The textures of the torte were a strong contrast of dense, solid torte, against frothy, moussey cream. The thin ganache(?) icing on top was very rich in powerful chocolate, while the cream was more playful, and the torte was a cocoa flavor foundation. Each component had its own version of choco flavor, which all synthesized in that regal way that is characteristic of European bakeries. It was really good, and HUGE! The brownie was a lot more sweet tasting than the torte, but it was worth it for such delicious flavor. I did not get that overall caramel/nutty sense that I normally do when something is labeled "turtle," but the topping did have those components. The dominant flavor was the brownie itself, which was a dense, ganachey feel, not moist per se, but not dry or cakey at all, which is totally preferred by me. It too was very large, and I had to eat my half over a couple sittings. I was not crazy about the Cowboy Cookie, but my husband loved it, which is weird because he normally doesn't like oats. He happily finished it after I had a bite. The texture was there, the flavors too, it was just not a combo I can get into, personal preferences and all.
