But if you like those flavors, it was well crafted and, yet again, XL in size. The staff were friendly and chatted with us about the area, making sure we knew all the fun places to visit nearby. There are tons of neat spots in Hopewell Big Woods, so this area could easily be a day or weekend destination, and I recommend stopping at this bakery for a meal and dessert to refuel. Everything is made with great skill, love, and attention! This place is worth a visit for the ambiance and back deck view, alone. I don't care what season it is, or even if it's rainy, you NEED to go out on that deck and take a look at the amazing glacial till in the creek bed below! It is one of the coolest things you've seen in a long time! Oh, and they have live music on Fridays! A+++++

Love to go here after my local hikes. They have fresh breads, desserts and sandwiches. It is great to sit outside and view the boulders of the French Creek. Always have their Latte and the desserts are not to be missed. On Friday evenings you can go and have pizza night with friends. Sometimes they have live music too.
A great place for lunch! Try the salad with pizza! Fun and relaxing. Great place to revitalize on a bike ride.

Best lunch in a long time! We had the Greek salad and the Calabrese Sandwich - prosciutto, tomato, peppers, fresh herbs, balsamic reduction, mozzarella on crusty bread. Amazing! Just perfect with a small salad in the side. Nice staff- gorgeous setting overlooking the Creek.

Best quiche I've ever tasted, and a super-nice staff who told us about the quarry and a local glass-blowing studio nearby. We went on a cold day and sat inside on comfy chairs, but next time we'll try to sit on the deck overlooking the creek.

Beautiful place to stop and have a yummy sandwich, but... The 30 plus minute wait for two sandwiches to be prepared and finally arrive to our table was a huge detraction from how tasty they were. Maybe more staff? Seemed like the 3 who were working the whole place were over whelmed and unprepared for a beautiful day crowd? Ps having the cashier cough all over my utensils was a bit gross too

Terrific bakery. We stopped in after hiking up the river this weekend. It gave us a little shelter from the cold before driving home. I had the chai tea and a croissant. Too often bakeries that I visit do not have croissants, or do not know how to properly make them. The croissant was made in house, buttery, flaky, delicious. Really perfect and exactly what I want whenever I walk into a bakery. I forget the brand of tea that they offer, but it was one that I have not tried before. The chai was spicy. I wish I remembered so I could buy a box of my own. Some others in my group got apple cider, the blood orange tea, and pesto bread. The apple cider looked good, had some thickness to it. I tried a bite of the pesto bread, it had a nice firm crust, a soft warm inside that pulled apart easily, with swirls of basil pesto inside. This bread would make a great meal on its own, or would make any sandwich out of this world. I plan to go hiking on the river again. And further stops in this bakery will be a highlight of the trip.

What a local gem. St Peter's has a great lunch menu along with coffee and baked goods. I always get a few loaves of bread to take home. I've been going as long as they've been open. Whether you take a hike before, after or not at all, it's worth a visit.

Stopped here on the way back from a hiking excursion at French Creek State Park. We enjoyed breakfast sandwiches the back deck with our golden doodle, listening to the stream that runs nearby. The staff was very accommodating, brought out a water bowl for the puppy and was very attentive with water etc. We'll be back for sure!!

Sweet bakery in historical Saint Peter's Village, with a warm cozy atmosphere. Fresh baked bread, pies, cakes and cookies. We bought a loaf of rustic apple walnut bread, and a box of assorted cookies.. lavender triangles! Liliana baby sandwich cookies with butter cream filling, ginger etc.. staff is very friendly, sandwiched looked great too.

I stopped in on Christmas Eve for some last minute treats and thought the entire bakery was incredibly cute, like a true small town shop. I ordered some breakfast pastries and a cranberry apple pie. The pie was a little pricey BUT comparable to other places selling homemade pies in the area. Only think I didn't love was that my almond croissant and chocolate croissant could have each used more filling. Other than that, everything was great and I'll definitely be back for more treats soon!

Came in here alone for coffee and breakfast. After the cashier getting my order wrong and incorrectly charging me, the manager came over and recharged my card for more money to make up the difference. After sitting down at a table, I was then asked by the manager if I could move to another table because a party of 6 had come in, despite other tables being open at the time. I obliged and moved all of my belongings across the cafe to another, smaller table, only then to wait 30 minutes for my order to arrive (which was only a slice of quiche by the way) while watching the party of 6 get served ahead of me in the meantime. The staff seemed surprised when I asked for my meal to be boxed to go when it was finally served 30 minutes later. The food was very good, but overall a very embarrassing and uncomfortable experience. Don't plan to return.

The food was delicious with nice choices. I wanted one of everything. Service was good and there was enough seating. The cappuccino was very weak which is why I wouldn't give it 5 stars. That being said, I'd definitely come back and probably will!

It's pretty far out there but worth the trip. Great for pastries, espresso drinks and some lunch items. I had a nice veggie quiche (came with a side of greens). It's very rustic inside but the best part was sitting on the back deck in the sun and listening to the water rushing over the rocks and looking out into the trees.

My hubby and I stopped in for a coffee and snack. The selection of pastries and sweets was great. They had just baked pecan pies and we had to try them. They were ah-mazing! The service was excellent. The woman behind the counter was helpful and friendly. The atmosphere is rustic and cozy inside, and beautiful on the deck outside. If I had to give a suggestion to the owner it would only be that I would prefer a better cup of coffee than cafe excellence. I expected a local or unique cup of coffee. Overall, great experience and will definitely be back soon!

This place is in the center of the quaint little village of Saint Peter's It has a back deck looking over waterfalls of French Creek. We went for lunch several times. They have assorted sandwiches ,soups, quiche. Everything we ordered was top notch. They also have decadent bake goods for desert or to take along. Their fresh baked breads are the wonderful chewy variety. It is a lovely place to lunch.

If you can afford to gain a pound get the marble brownie. That's what happened to me. Trust me it's worth it. Everything is scratch. They make their own bread too. The inside is beautifully restored. If the weather is good like it was when we went, you should sit on their back deck andview the beautiful French Creek. Their bathroom is one of the nicest I've ever used.

The place is charming when u enter, but when u go to order the owners just kind of stare at you without greeting u or prompting you to order... normally it goes like this: "good morning, welcome to our restaurant. can I take your order?" Make the customer feel welcomed and appreciated, right? Instead a grumpy long faced curmudgeon of a man is staring at us awkwardly not saying can I take your order. A women is standing next to him silently staring at us too. I say ok, who do we speak to? They say either of us. I order food. Apparently not enough so the woman asks if we want more food and we decline. We pay and she asks me to select a tip. Not sure what I'm tipping for if all she is doing is passing me food over the counter. I select 20%--kill em with kindness approach. Instead of saying ok thanks we get a stone face glare and we walk over to our table. At no point in the transaction did either of them say "thanks" or "how's the food." We ordered more cake and as we were leaving I said thanks again, have a nice day and the lady says "yep" and we slink out the door. I guess moral of story is treat your customers like u are grateful to have them in your establishment, make them feel welcomed, not judged, say kind things like "thank you, please come again" and we (customers) will leave saying that was a pleasant experience and we can't wait to return and give our business to that lovely couple and their bakery. I hope our feedback is appreciated and serves as some sort of a learning experience. We as humans can always do better and treat each other with kindness and respect. ps: excuse the grammar. I don't care about punctuation, just pure free-flow communication of ideas.

The lady behind the counter today was cold and far from friendly.I wanted to buy more items but she made it out to be like I was bothering her.The place was adorable. What we did try was excellent .Would love to have tried more.
Delicious fresh baked goods. Pain au chocolat, almond croissants, pecan sticky buns. All very good.

Really cute place with indoor and outdoor seating, free parking and hiking nearby. Their chai lattes are sooooo good and I love their brunch specials on Sundays. So far I've had the French toast and waffles with fresh berries, cream and bacon and the portion sizes are huge. It's a bit of a winding drive for me but worth it!

Stopped in on our way home from getting our Christmas tree! Wanted to support a local small business. I purchased 4 chocolate croissants and six cookies...$31.80. Well the croissants were ok. The cookies; 2 gingerbread were burnt and stale. The other four cookies were not much better, ugh. I don't mind supporting and spending money, yet please provide an edible product. What a waste of money!

Love love love Westshore Pizza , they make GR8 Pizza! I was a regular until I moved to Tampa, now it's 20 minutes away. Come CLOSER and by the time it's dinner the pizza wouldn't be the same warmed up in the Oven! Ya know what I am sayin. Please..today I got dominos! Need some Westshore Pizza!

Westside Pizza is my family's top pizza location in New Tampa. Customer service is always professional and food is delicious. They are timely with getting the orders ready and on top of resolving any potential issues or concerns.

I like this place because I like its NY style pizza... & the guys at the counter have been consistently friendly. Its location is also convenient if one lives or works in the New Tampa area or in the Wesley Chapel & San Antonio areas. USE THE YELP CHECK IN OFFER for free Garlic Knots. (I forgot to:) After reading the less-than-favorable reviews, it appears delivery orders haven't been well received (no pun intended). I have never sat inside to eat or had the food here delivered; I've always walked inside to order takeout. The interior is small, clean, & consists of approximately 8 high, round metal tables w/ red padded stools. There's now one lower table as well. Two vertical refrigerator cases hold bottles of water & individual sodas, as well as 2-liter bottles. On the counter is a soda machine w/ ice dispenser. (See pics.) The menu @ this time consists of 3 types of wings, 4 salads, 3 hoagie/grinders, 3 cheesesteaks, 2 baked sandwiches, calzones, strombolis, 12 types of NY style pizza (16" & 18" = $11.99 to $19.99), 4 toasted deli sandwiches, five 100% Angus burgers, 7 baked dinners (ex. spaghetti, ziti, ravioli, lasagna, & parmigiana), 10 appetizers & sides, 4 desserts, & miscellaneous beverages-- sodas & water. NO beer or other alcoholic beverages are available. Is it the best NY pizza in the area that I've eaten? No. Is it worthy? Definitely! They've never skimped on either ingredients or quality-- nor have they omitted excellent customer service.
Buyer beware ! That's not cheese they are putting on the pizza ! horrendous experience had to toss the whole box . And trust me I love pizza .
Probably the best delivery experience I have ever had. Ian was the coolest delivery guy. He should be promoted with how great he is in customer service. A++

Service was horrible, I received my order 40 min after the anticipated online delivery time. On top of that, I ordered wet wings and received dry wings and was told that the manager is out and they could only offer me a discount on future orders or deliver the wings again. I opted for the new delivery only to receive a call back stating that the manager refuse to send another order. They instead will send the sauce. They currently have a 2 hour delivery time. Customer service is non-existent here. I'll order else where and suggest you do the same. Horrible!

Annette the manager is always willing to fix a challenge. Call her if things are not right. Pizza was over sauced and she credited me right away. Food is always good and service is spot on. Don't let the bad reviews keep you away. Give Annette and this location a try. Still one of the better pies available that is not wood fired.

I got a calzone delivered to me that managed to be both burnt and soggy, which would be impressive if it weren't so revolting. I cut off two pieces and my gf and I each had a bite. Her piece had around nine pepperonis all stacked atop each other. Seriously, can you not distribute toppings? Additionally the whole thing was so greasy, we each only took a couple of bites before we tossed them. I picked up the whole calzone and it sloshed around like a wet rag from all the grease. I called to complain and was told that I could get half off the price of the inedible calzone on my next order. As if I'd ever order anything from them again. So I got the pleasure of paying 18 bucks to sit here sick to my stomach. Do yourself, your stomach, and your piece of mind a favor and avoid this place at all costs.

I always thought I wouldn't be the person to write a bad review. Today we ordered a burger, salad, chicken Parmesan dinner, and wings. First off the address given to us was wrong and took forever to find the place. My boyfriend gets there and they acted like they had no clue what was going on he had to explain to them what we ordered. When he got home instead of his chicken Parmesan dinner he brought home a sub they gave him instead. Which he agreed to just taking instead of having to wait even longer for them to make what he really ordered. The salad wasn't even with the order until he had to remind them that we ordered one which never came with the promised garlic knots. The burger had absolutely nothing on it. There was ranch spilled inside everything it was disgusting. And the worst of the worst - the chicken was undercooked. I called to talk about this and was put on hold for about ten minutes then was waiting for the girl to find the order for another ten minutes only for her to tell me "somebody will call you back" After that I was just done. We ended up just picking at the $50 food we ordered. We tipped them nicely and was taking care of like shit. We should've went back dropped the 'food' off and got our money back. I have worked in the industry my whole life and couldn't understand why there were all these problems and complete clueless and carelessness. All I have to say is - DO NOT waste your time and money on this place!!
Pizza is very good. But if you try to use the free garlic knots coupon from Yelp, you will get raw garlic rolls. It seems like the establishment is not aware of the coupon.

Quality has suffered lately, hot dishes no longer taste fresh. The reward program is not accepted at this location even though the corporate entity awards points for orders at this location. The new delivery service (SLICE) is neither convenient nor accurate. First the wrong order was delivered and they also let my dog out. I called and they came and picked up that order but told me it would be another 30 minutes before my correct order would be delivered. When I finally got the correct pizza it was burnt. I feel sorry for the person that got the soggy pepperoni pizza that sat in my kitchen for so long. It may be time to try another location.

The pizza was decent, but the pros end there. Cons: Lasagna so cold upon delivery (5min away) that it wouldn't come out of the container to reheat; missing items from the order; and the worst - lack of customer service. Sorry, but offering to send the delivery guy back with the missing items doesn't make up for the subpar food in the first place. My $40 will go much further at another place next time. You can keep the oh so generous $5 credit offered in place of getting it right the first time.

We've tried a few times now. Lasagna and eggplant parm are generally good, with large portions. Garlic rolls are little burnt blobs of dough..horrible. We added meatballs and those were burnt too. It was the same last time so I should have checked before leaving with my to go order, but didn't. But then again, I shouldn't have to. Ordered a side salad and got a small box of cut up lettuce with a pile of onions and an unbelievably small piece of a tomato, not my definition of salad. So, just won't waste my money again.

Amazing customer service! They are loyal and very fast w/ deliveries! I would say the pizza is GOOD, not the best I've ever had but it hits the spot! Always fresh ingredients and it's not dinged up and weird looking when you get it like the bigger chains. This pizza is good for a family night or if you're girlfriend is gone on a girls trip and you got the boys over to watch the Lakers play and play spades and drink beer and yell at the tv!

I used to order from Westshore Pizza all the time when I lived close by. I wish I still lived close by because their food is so good! My favorite is the chicken philly and my boyfriend really enjoys the wings. The delivery was always fast. I still stop by whenever I'm in the area.

Surprisingly good quality pizza! I also love the zeppole. Friendly service (though they have a tendency to get the order wrong very often, but to their honor they never fail to correct the mistake at their own expense). Best pizza I've found around New Tampa so far.

Terrible customer service experience. After working a long shift and not feeling like cooking we decided to order a pizza. Sounds simple right? I placed my order and was told it would be ready in about 30 minutes. I show up and my order was picked up by another customer. The cashier didn't even bother to offer a discount or anything for the inconvenience and just looked at me like I was in the wrong. I asked if they could make my order again then she said yes it will be another 20 minutes...still no offer to add anything on or add discount for me having to wait for their mistake. When I asked for a refund her demeanor was extremely rude and her fellow coworker was too busy eating her dinner in front of customers to bother to help her out until she was asked. I do not plan on returning and I will be trying "Taste of New York" which has better reviews anyway.

Just had the worst experience with Westshore Pizza in New Tampa. First of all, this was a corporate catering order. When I called on the phone to place the order the woman kept talking over me so that should have been a sign. She delivered the lunch 45 minutes late, did not bring the drinks, and mislabeled EVERYTHING!!! Never again! Absolutely never again! Ugh!

BLACK PEOPLE - DO NOT ORDER FROM HERE. They are liars & racist. I ordered from them on 8/26/21. When I went to go pick up my order the lady at the counter was extremely rude and disrespectful, so rude to the point where while I was talking to her she was on her cell phone with another person & did not acknowledge me at all. She couldn't even look me in my face when she was responding to my questions. Told me a bold face lie that she could not accept my payment form and laughed while I was leaving the store. I later called as if I was another person to see if they would accept my payment form and they did. Blatant Discrimination. Obviously, they don't want our money. Buy else where.

Delivery has always been great and faster than we expect them to arrive. The pizzas are large and filled with toppings. Unfortunately there is something we don't like about the pizzas. We are thinking it's the sauce. Makes it taste off. We stopped ordering from here because of it.

I ordered pizza off of DoorDash and when I first got it it was hot which showed great signs. Then I opened it and it was not the pizza that I ordered. When I called the restaurant the manager was so deeply rude and kept stating that she could not help me with my problem of getting a new pizza. After being on the phone for 15 minutes of trying to tell her my problem she kept stating that she could not help me and hung up in my face.

Sorry. Poor business. I called asked them if they sold by the slice. Lady said yes. Went in no slices were available for purchase and that I needed to wait 15-20 minutes. Why waste my time? Huge fan of pizza, this place is a disaster. Lady looked stressed no ambiance and boxes and dirty everywhere. I'm sure they get no actual lunch crowd and just use the spot to deliver the pizzas. Thursday 12:05pm 4/13. If you're reading this (to the lady or manager) I give 5 stars out for 95% of my reviews to get 1 star you must totally fail. Please hire consultant to help with the business but I'm sure you're saying to yourself "I don't care" well we don't care about you all either.

The poorest service I have ever encountered.... A restaurant staffed of moderately trained zoo animals could provide more efficient and competent service than I've encountered from this specific Westshore Pizza. My first time I ordered from this location I ordered a Philly pizza, I replaced an ingredient that was in the description of the pizza with extra mushrooms. As in if it came with steak, onions, bell peppers, I asked for bell peppers to be substituted with mushroom. Simple right? Apparently this simple request was far too complicated as the delivered pizza I received just came with all mushrooms. When I called the store to inquire about why I received a pizza that was obviously not what I ordered. I received an immediate apology and was offered "half off" my next order from a woman on the phone. The immediate apology for a screwed up order is the only reason I wouldn't give the rating of this store a -2 star review (if that was even possible). My next encounter with ordering from this store was when I called back to redeem my "half off" order by getting a sandwich and fries. Apparently my "half off" order amounted to be $2 off a single priced item, my immediate thought was "Oh, not only are the people who work there incapable of comprehending the ingredients on their menu for a pizza and then replacing one item but now they're also liars". Of course this was never explained to me before and as someone ordering from the restaurant there just wasn't a whole lot I felt I could do about this. My third and quite frankly LAST encounter with this store is when I ordered a meal for a friend and I that included a philly cheese steak hoagie and jalapeño poppers. I get a call after placing this order and they are out of jalapeño poppers and asked me to pick a replacement. Like, ok thank you for charging my card the amount of jalapeño poppers and then forcing me pick something I didn't want or otherwise I would have ordered in the first place all because someone clearly didn't do inventory right....or maybe they just don't have the money to order the quantity of items their menu provides. Once this order arrived(delivery) my phillycheese steak hoagie is missing half the ingredients listed on the description of the sandwich.....missing lettuce, tomato, and onion. I called the store to once again point out an order that I did not ask for and they did make me my corrected sandwich to bring to my home....30 minutes later, after my friend was done with what he ordered that we intended to eat together. The level of inconsistency and inadequacy of the service and ordered food from this store is not worth the investment of my hard earned dollars. As I indicated earlier, it is my belief that a hired crew of moderately trained zoo animals could provide me with an accurate food order and not lie to me about compensation for screwing something up.

UPDATE: They have completely ruined what used to be one of my favorite pizza joints. To those that are not aware, WP has been trying to expand and rebrand, changing their recipes to ensure a consistent product at all locations. As a result, they're going the way of other shitty national pizza chains. Ahh, the sick smell of commercialization. Last time we ordered from Westshore Pizza it was like getting a completely different product. The crust was more thick and doughy, the sauce sweeter, it was just awful. Such a shame, but I won't be getting Westshore Pizza anymore. OLD: Oh, Westshore. I have given you so much of my money in the last few months since I moved to Tampa Palms. I crave your tasty, cheesy, perfectly saucy, crisp-but-foldable pizza and deliciously crispy, saucy wings way more than I should. I've had pizza from plenty of Westshore locations, but you, you're my favorite and I attribute that to your freaking amazing wings. How do you get them so crispy and your sauce so spicy and flavorful without burning my tongue off? I don't know, but no one makes buffalo wings like you do, and I love you for that. Four stars for having my second favorite pizza in Tampa (second to 900 degree wood fired at Wiregrass) and an extra star for the magical chicken wings.

Fantastic cheese pizza. The sauce, cheese, and crest are all perfect. The Philly cheese steak is the best I have ever had. I don't get these reviews. Well, service isn't too fast. But it is worth the wait.

Not only do they have the best pizza in the area, but I tried the veal parm and baked spaghetti. I discovered that all entrees are homemade, no frozen or premade food. If your in the mood for authentic Italian food, give Westshore on highlands preserve road in the Best Buy shopping center in New Tampa.

Westshore is DEF our favorite pizza place in the New Tampa area! LOVE their calzone which we probably get more than anything else because we fill it so full of toppings that it is HUGE and so good!! Their pizza is equally amazing! this is def our favorite spot! :)

Im 32 and I have lived in Chicago (67th and Merrill), Vegas (Henderson, NV), Canada (Edmonton, AB), North Carolina (Raleigh) and by far this is the best local chain I have ever ordered from. It starts with customer service! Whenever I call I get the nicest welcome on the phone! The delivery drivers are nice, very speedy, and actually TAKE CARE OF YOUR PIZZA! They follow directions! The pizza is piping hot EVERY TIME! I have ordered here atleast 40 times the past 2 years and everytime I have tried somewhere else (even the big chains) nothing comes close! I usually order the 15" works but my girlfriend (Who doesnt usually eat pizza) decided to order the White Spinach Ricotta, which was bomb and she was surprised (I told her so). I know my pizza's and have had pizza all over the US (One Bite Everyone Knows the Rules). I have not had their wings, sides, or calzones. But the works and White Spinach Ricotta are on point!

The delivery service was great and even showed up before the estimated arrival time, but that was the last redeeming quality from this pizza place. The pizza dough was very generic and tasted like it came from a cafeteria (along with the toppings). I got BBQ wings (which were definitely not cooked in BBQ sauce) more like baked and then doused with sauce that literally overwhelmed my nose with the sweet/tangy sauce. I couldn't eat it. The $7 burger should be priced more like a McDonald's burger because that's the sort of quality it was: small overcooked patty painted with BBQ sauce without any toppings (i.e. lettuce, tomato, etc.) To be fair though, I missed seeing the option to add those condiments on the online ordering system. I also ordered a Greek Salad, but haven't eaten it yet. It looks like a generic salad. Don't be fooled by the toppings they offer either. The Greek Salad was supposed to come with all of the usual accoutrements, but failed to add the beets and cucumbers that they advertised came with the dish. All in all, a place I would never return to, or recommend to a friend (maybe an enemy.)
No idea why there are so many bad reviews, I eat here frequently and have never had a problem, pizza is pretty good and their gluten free crust is among the best in the area

I stopped going here because I thought the Pizza was awful. Too much sauce. I don't like any of the other pizza places in the area, and certainly do not like the chains. Being from the northeast I am very picky about my pizza. It had been over a year, but I ordered from them a few weeks ago. This time I told them light on the sauce. To my surprise, the pizza was actually good! I recommend the white spinach (light on the riccotta). Since then I have been back twice and the pizzas were good. I hope they keep up the consistancy!

Service is horrible. Online said order would take 80 minutes. Called restaurant to request pick up. Told me 30 minuets. Went to pick up order & they sent it out for delivery. Pizza arrived at my house before I returned home. They really need to get there stuff to together.

Word of advice: don't order delivery, go to the place and eat! I've had the pizza, garlic knots, and philly-- all are absolutely delicious when fresh! I suggest you go in and get a large cheese pie-- definitely the best in the area. It's a small place but has a good amount of seating. I've ordered delivery once and it took two hours to get to me when the original ETA was 40 minutes. Pizza definitely did not taste as good and we were obviously annoyed.

I am from NY and can tell you this is NOT NY pizza. Ordered a large pie with fresh garlic and fresh basil. Pizza was dry and salty as anything. This was seriously the worse pizza I have had in Tampa...ended up throwing it out. I have had frozen pizza that was better than this.

True fold and stuff it! Customer service, fierce! Cheese pizza huge loaded with flavor, wings best with crispy outsiders! Garlic knots, bland not worth calories, salad freshly prepared. Hold the!! Extra charge for crushed pepper, and grated pram sprinkles. The only place you can charge for things you sprinkle is at an ice cream parlor. When I spend fourty for pizza, wings and salad it should come with. Where's the west coast love?
Small place in strip mall Owner and staff very courteous. Had a medium works pizza. Fresh ingredients not too heavy on the sauce.

Ordered take out. Should be simple for an Italian place. 2 calzones and 6 garlic rolls. The rolls were just that. Barely any garlic or flavoring on them. The calzones were not calzones. There was no ricotta cheese, the dough was flat and not domed shaped. While they may have been in the traditional half moon shape that's where they stopped being calzones. They were much more like a Stromboli but really quite bland. A whole lot of crust and not much cheese. Oh did I say NO ricotta cheese?!!! I tried calling to tell them. She insisted it had ricotta. No, it did not. Out of four of us no one saw or tasted ricotta. She did offer to come pick them up and give me store credit. Never mind. My family was starving. We ate it. But we won't be repeating as customers.
This pizza is amazing! I ordered a pepperoni pizza and got it delivered. The crust was amazing and the amount of cheese was perfect. It was may first time trying it and I will definitely be back!

I would HIGHLY recommend this location. Excellent service and speedy delivery on a Friday night. The pizza hit the spot and was great for a party! The ingredients were fresh and hot! Thank you so much to the wonderful staff for their speedy service.

Pizza is good and they have really fast delivery. If you order cheese fries they give u regular fries with cheese on the side when :/ Overall they're nice, food is good, but they're a little more expensive then your regular pizza store.

Ordered a pizza and fries this Friday afternoon for lunch. After taking around 2 hours to arrive, I asked the deliver guy if the food was cold. His exact response, "idk we're real busy so probably. Just as I suspected, BOTH my fries and pizza were cold. I understand restaurants can become busy however the pizza place is less than 10 minutes from my house. So it should not have taken 2 hours and judging by the delivery guys response, he didn't seem to care about the quality of their food or service, let alone about getting a tip.

I've been looking for a new place I could get square pizza from, sadly this will not be the place. After reading the reviews and seeing the pictures, I decided to give Philomena Santucci's a shot. Honestly, it was the greasiest pizza I've ever had. It gave me terrible acid reflux. I had to use at least six napkins to get all of the grease off, it was soaked. I'm not originally from this area, and have been on the hunt for some legit old forge style pizza. While I knew this wasn't going to happen at this place, I was hoping for some great pizza to tide me over until I visit home again. Everyone has their own taste, this may be the go to for some people, but will definitely not be my new go to pizza place.

Santuccis isn't just a pizza place, it's a Philly staple. My mom grew up with it, I grew up with it, and I'm sure my future non existent children will grow up with it. Pizza pie is their thing and they do it best. They are expensive but it's worth the extra price for the quality. And nothing is better than having leftover cold Santuccis pizza for breakfast. Their cheesesteaks are also pretty darn good.

Ordered here several times and it is always excellent! The pizza never disappoints. The meat lovers pizza is great and very thick. The pepperoni pizza is also really good. For sides we've only tried the mozzarella sticks and Caesar salad, which are both great. Definitely the best pizza spot in the northeast

I ordered dinner for pick up last night. I got two Italian dishes, baked ziti added chicken parm & gnocchis and added sausage. First of all when I ordered I was told it would be ready in 20 minutes, so I got there in 20 minutes. I was told my food would be ready in 5 minutes. I waited an ADDITIONAL 25 minutes for my food. 45 minutes for pickup on a Tuesday! Three people came in AFTER ME picked up there food and left before mine was ready. I understand that they happened to be busy, but if its no where near ready don't tell me it will be 5 minutes. I could have went home or got some other errands done while I sat there and waited, didn't even get a sorry. To make matters worse the food was very small compared to other times I've ordered the same thing. The food is always delicious but with smaller portions for the same HIGH price its not worth it anymore. I paid $28 for two dinners that were chinsy at best. Very disappointed. I've been a long time lover of santuccis I guess ill have to order from a different location from now on.

I always loved Santucci's sauce and since we have not indulged in a while what better way then to order some. I never knew they could mix types of pizza together so we Frankensteined this pizza monster. It was good. Why chose only one measly kind of pie when you got your imagination. The buffalo rolls were good but it needed a tad more sauce in it. Great flavors still. My burger was a true hero. Pillow like bun and steak meat on top of a very scrumptious burger patty. I was shocked how much the pizza haven shook me with this meaty creation of whimsy. I need to get to their other location in Warminster since they have a larger menu that needs a going through by my gullet.

The buffalo chicken pizza is the best I love it so much. Had to do 4 stars just because I think they should handle customer service better if they take too long (an hour and a half) to deliver sometimes

My husband and I have heard so many good things about this restaurant and decided to give it a try. We ordered a chicken Caesar wrap, and requested french fries on the side, a personal pizza, and 2 red velvet cakes. We didn't end up getting any fries which we were disappointed about. As for the pizza, it was good, but we received it almost cold. As for the red velvet cake, we were satisfied with that!
I've continued to eat at Santucci's over the years, and its still just as good. I always just get a plain pizza. I absolutely love the crust, too.

We used to love this place. Ordered a medium pizza, 2 orders of chicken fingers, mozzarella fries, and pasta e fagioli soup. Total was over $42.00. The pizza was very thin...way thinner than we remember. Like, you could call it thin crust it was so thin. I guess they must be really cutting back. The chicken fingers were ok - not worth $7 for 4. The mozzarella fries were fine. But the "soup" was terrible. It was literally tomato sauce with over cooked pasta and beans. No broth at all. I've had this soup many times at many places as it is one of my favorites, and this...just , no. Way too expensive for sub-par food.
Really good pizza. They put sliced chunks of mozzarella cheese on the square crust with buckets of sauce on top. While they have other menu items, the focus is on the pizza.

Totally agree with what another reviewer said about it being hit or miss. When they are on point, the pizza is amazing, but too many times lately I've gotten a gross, soggy (almost wet) pizza with barely any sauce. They are also one of the highest priced pizza places in the neighborhood (come on, it's dough and sauce). I wouldn't mind paying 15 bucks for a pie if they were consistent with what they deliver. There are too many good places nearby I would rather order from that I don't have to play the "gross or not" game with. Step it up Santucci's.

Stopped in for a small pizza before a doctor's appt. My family has been eating pizza from this branch of the family tree's locations for as long as I can remember (the O street location was a family favorite well before I was born) and the great thing is that today its the same family, same product, same recipe. There's a flavor profile you've come to expect when getting a Santuccis pizza and every bite was a blast of nostalgia. We also picked up a couple bottles of the newly released sauce. I cant wait to cook with it and have those amazing flavors available whenever I want here at home.

I visit Philly a couple of times a year to visit family. Every time I go, I order a Santucci (pepperoni, mushrooms) for delivery. If I had my way, I'd order it every night while visiting Philadelphia...but family won't let me. It is, by far, the best pizza I've ever had in the United States (and I've been to over 45 of those states, and have ordered pizza in many of them). I'm writing this revue while I'm in Jacksonville, Florida. I just ate a grilled ham and cheese sandwich, and am not the least bit hungry. Yet, my mouth is watering as I write this review on Santucci's. Pavlov's dog, I am... The last time my sister came from Philadelphia to Florida to visit me, I BEGGED her to bring a Santucci's with her on the plane. I had an answer for every excuse that she gave me. She was taking the train to the airport (I would have Santucci's deliver the pizza to her in front of the airport!). She wouldn't be able to get it through security (Not true! I verified that you can bring a pizza as carry-on!). The other passengers would be annoyed by the smell coming from the overhead storage bins (Screw them! They're from Philadelphia...they've smelled things much worse! Plus, all she'd have to do is wrap it in a plastic trash bag!). Alas, I didn't get my Santucci's delivered to Florida by my sister. I hope she never needs a kidney donor... People in Philadelphia are spoiled rotten. I don't think they have any idea for how privileged they are to have access (at any time!) to one of the best-tasting pizza's in the country! If anybody happens to be flying from Philadelphia to Jacksonville, Florida, I'll happily PAY YOU to bring me a Santucci's!!! I'll meet you at the JAX airport with cash in hand!!! Just don't expect me to share a slice...

I've been a huge fan of santucci's pizza for years but recently, not so much. This week, my husband & I ordered a pizza from the cottman ave location. He got half mushrooms. I to half roasted peppers. He's fine. I got food poisoning! They need to be really careful how thy store that stuff. I've been sick for 3 days! Joe Sr. Would be rolling over in his grave!

Santuccis has by the best cheesesteaks . They get every request down to the T . Even when ordering several cheesesteaks they get each one correct . More expensive than other pizzerias but definitely worth it . Had a cheesesteak from A well know spot not too long ago and got so sick . Santuccis is the place to eat !

I really like Santucci's. The pizza is okay, but it would be so much better if it wasn't so greasy. The prices are a little hefty too. It's not that bad now, but it is still kinda high. As for everything else; it is perfect.
The price of a pizza is damn high but the sauce is crazy great to me. I don't know why it is that good. I would order it everyday but afford this pizza.

I moved out of the area many years ago, but always lovingly remembered Santuccis pizza. I went to visit family today and drove by the one on Cottman ( I grew up eatting the one on "O" sts) my NY pizza snob of a husband said he would try my childhood pizza but expects it to be trash since he's a Brooklyn boy and no one makes pizza better. Well we went in and had to do takeout (dining room area closed) so we waited for our pie and went to see the family. Was it as good as I remember? Yes...AND my hubby gave it a "not bad...for Philly". Take it as a compliment fellas...
Just so you people not from philly aren't confused. The "original" santuccis is not in south Philly or this one. But in a little neighborhood juniata. This one is definitely like the original though.

I ordered a cheesesteak Stromboli and fries. It was very good, and the sauce was amazing!! I tried Santucci's when I first moved to Mayfair 9 years ago and didn't like it but they have definitely improved!! Definitely recommend!!

Good pizza is really hard to come by nowadays. Santucci's is one of the few great pizza places left around, in my opinion. The sauce is different from other pizzerias, with a little bit of spice to it, and very smooth. Cheese is on bottom with sauce on top. I think its a little less cheesier than most pizzas, and usually that would be a bad thing, but all of the ingredients must be very high quality because this ends up being my second favorite pizza place of all time, and that's saying a lot. Like the other poster, I usually don't like pizza crust, but Santucci's is the perfect level of crispiness. Would never throw away a crust from this place! Worth driving out of the way for!
Love their pizza but we ordered 45 minutes ago, told us it would be 20 minutes still waiting .... never again ... there are other pizza places to order from and not wait over an hour

Great pizza, but it's hit or miss! Sometimes the pizza is amazingly delicious and sometimes it tastes as if it's been sitting for 2 hours. But overall definitely a competitor with other Mayfair pizza joints!
I go here for the pizza and that's it. Very flavorful sauce, nice and crispy chewing pizza dough. The service however is not that great. They have rude counter people. Just try it out.
Always good and reliable. I order extra sauce well done each time. Total game changer and makes awesome pizza even more amazing!

The prices are going out the roof now , pizza has been hit or miss for the last two years , my last orde was $41 and my family of 4 was still hungry , I thing a few years ago what I just got this week would of been about $10 less and much better

Let me start by saying that the pizza is excellent. Pricey, but excellent. Okay. We walked in to sit down, and the heat was off. These things happen. And hey, someone would be right with us. Well, after ten minutes, I went back and got menus, and the two women in the back were on their phones giggling over "adorable" pictures. Then things started happening. The waitress would not shut up. The food was good, but we may not be back. The other reviews indicate that they don't care about their customers, and we kinda think it may be true.

I've been eating at Santucci's for 15 years, the other night the girl screwed up my order and send out a mushroom pizza to my house I called spoke to the manager she said she would get the right order out and keep the pizza, I said I don't like mushrooms I don't want to keep the pizza I just want my dinner, she said I'll give you two dollar credit and send out the right food I said OK today I called for an order today and she said I kept the pizza I said no I didn't I sent it back with the driver because we don't eat mushrooms, She said well you're screwed I'm not giving you the credit I will never return to this place again 15 years out the window what a horrible customer service and the quality has gone way down hill, I CANT BELIEVE THE CUSTOMER SERVICE,

Santucci's is Philly fast food pizza done right. This is a staple in the Northeast and it's expanded to locations all over the city. They're all pretty good. Square pizza, cheese under the sauce. A classic. Acidic, unique, no Friday night feels complete without a Santucci's. Beats Taconelli's any day.

Used to be great lately it's jus eh. And I will never eat there again after some dude Rob was at a mutual friends house. And said he used to do sexual stuff with the food when he made it. I dunno his last name but his name was rob n he worked there like 4 years ago or I dunno if he still does but after I heard that I will never eat from there again. He went into detail with all the stuff he would do with people's food. Made me sick I almost hit him.

I was starving and on my way back to the city from a tennis match, and was trying to figure out where to get lunch. I drove by Santucci's and then turned around to go back. I just ordered the basic pizza. Wait time was about 10 minutes. I like the idea of having the tomato sauce on top because I love tomato pie, and this pizza was good, but I didn't love the crust. It was a little too chewy. The sauce has a really good flavor though.

I ordered dinner for pick up tonight. I got two Italian dishes, baked ziti added chicken parm & gnocchis and added sausage. First of all when I ordered I was told it would be ready in 20 minutes, so I got there in 20 minutes. I was told my food would be ready in 5 minutes. I waited an ADDITIONAL 25 minutes for my food. 45 minutes for pickup on a Tuesday! Three people came in AFTER ME picked up there food and left before mine was ready. I understand that they happened to be busy, but if its no where near ready don't tell me it will be 5 minutes. I could have went home or got some other errands done while I sat there and waited, didn't even get a sorry. To make matters worse the food was very small compared to other times I've ordered the same thing. The food is always delicious but with smaller portions for the same HIGH price its not worth it anymore. I paid $28 for two dinners that were chinsy at best. Very disappointed. I've been a long time lover of santuccis I guess ill have to order from a different location from now on.

Food is great, but we ordered online and didn't get an email confirmation. But checked our account and the money came out. An hour later we call and they never received our order, and apparently only one person can refund so we have to wait two days to get a call about a refund, and since the people who work there can't see that we paid they can't just put our order in while we are on the phone with them. Not to mention they said this has happened before, so why not fix the problem! Don't order online!!
Thank you Nick, I appreciate the thoughtfulness in your response. That changed a poor experience to a very nice one.

Ugh, good grief...tried them again today and it took almost an hour to deliver a pizza. That's right, a Monday night, 1 single pizza took an hour. Oh, when it arrived it was wet and cold. I'm finally throwing in the towel. If I have another craving I'll pick up from the one on Woodhaven.

First, I love Santucci's and the Cottman Ave location is my normal pickup location. This evening, however, I ordered a cheesesteak Stromboli (my daughters choice for movie night). When I ordered over the phone, I was asked "just cheese, steak and sauce in it correct?". I picked up and got home and discovered it was a pizza with steak meat on it. I called to speak about the situation and was told that the ticket said pizza, not Stromboli. When I explained that I clearly ordered a Stromboli I was told that I could bring the pie back and a Stromboli would be ready in 25 minutes. Are you for real? Customer blamed, has to come back out for the correct order in 25 minutes taking the pizza to "return" it when it will go to waste and the family is waiting hungry? The solution should have been a) keep it and come pick up the correct order with no extra charge, b) we will deliver the Stromboli or c) if you'd like to keep the pizza can I give you a discount on your next order/refund your current order. Not satisfied with the customer service but not worth my time to "return" an incorrect order.
Just had the best meatball sandwich I've ever had in the Northeast. Prices are reasonable considering the size of the entrees. Must try.

Absolutely the biggest waste of money ever. Pizza tasted like stuffing, cheese fries taste like cardboard my dog ain't even fw i was gonna give it to a homeless person but that would be a sin. Gtfo my neighborhood pawsy!! The cashier was bad asf tho
"BEST" Pizza in Philly, from a Great Family got to meet most of the Santucci's. They never disappoint!!!
Awesome and simple. Nothing like the authentic taste of this pizza. Family friendly and easy pick up available.

I typically love Santucci Pizza. I grew up on it. My parents Would order it as a treat for us as kids. But my experience with the Cottman Avenue Santucci has not been positive. I live 10 minutes away, but delivery routinely takes over an hour or sometimes up to an hour and a half. The wings are absolutely terrible, small and with sauce on the side. To be fair, the pizza is still delicious. I'd recommend pick up, pizza only, avoid the wings. I have heard from others that the sandwiches aren't good either, but I can't attest to this personally.

Having grown up eating at Santucci's and having worked at 2 of the locations, I'm a huge fan! Unfortunately, last week wasn't the best we've ever had. With the ongoing pandemic we try and eat out 1-2x a week to support local businesses, even when money is tight. To be honest I literally live 2 blocks from the Woodhaven store. I specifically drive to the Cottman store because their food is usually better. I know their not affiliated with each other and to me the sauce is different. In a good way. My first issue was the wait time. I know it was busy, I know your probably short staffed but, waiting in the rain for 25 minutes after my quoted time was no fun. I ordered before I left, hopped on i95 (20 min ride). Arrived and waited, and waited, and waited. Normally I wouldn't mind. But as soon as she handed me the pizza. Ice cold! I didn't say anything because i was outside in the rain and the staff seemed a bit overwhelmed as it was. Opened the bag and took a bite of the mozzarella sticks while driving home, ice cold and not fully cooked. The fries also cold. The wings were the only food that were hot. Such a bummer! We spent $55 and got cold food which is a huge let down and frankly wasn't worth the drive. I understand things happen but please Keep the pizza and other food warm while waiting. There is nothing worse then having to reheat a pizza when you just got it. All the apps went in the trash.
I gotta start out by saying. sometimes its really good pie, had a few soggy ones lately, but the only thing that stops me from ordering on a regular basis is its really pricey.

prices are getting too high. consistency is dropping. some days the dough is great, others its downright stale, and others its been burnt..also had a meatball sandwich...it was so dry it was a disgrace. we threw it out!!! your wings are really really good but not for that money. i lived around the corner from the "O" street spot as a kid. we loved it... cmon guys dont drop the bar. hope you think about this--but sad to say the price "aint" right anymore. you guys have a lot of competition in mayfair you would prob get all of their business if people could afford it and you made sure the pies were consistent

I've always ordered from this place. However the last three orders have been a mess. Mozz sticks were wet and soggy and sauce spilled all over inside container. Asked for blu cheese got ranch. Asked for sauce on side they put it on the item. Next order, asked for blue cheese got nothing, asked for sauce on the side they put it on it. Asked for extra sauce on Buffalo flatbread doesn't seem like they put any Buffalo sauce on it at all. Buffalo chicken pizza has zero Buffalo sauce on it. Every order is either missing stuff or made wrong. For the price of a takeout order from Santucci's they should really be on top of getting them right. Again three orders and each one was a mess. No more

I frequently get take out pizza from here and it's usually delicious. I love sauce, so I love having the sauce on top of the cheese as they do at Santucci's. The workers are usually pretty friendly. Delivery is also fairly quick. The only complaint is that sometimes when I order extra sauce it's saturated with too much sauce; other times it's perfect. Also, when we order one with light sauce and one with extra sauce, a few times they have both been covered in sauce.

Google and Yelp says open until 7pm on Saturday's. I drove over and got there at 6.25pm to be told it's closed?? Wasted my time. Thanks. Please update your listings or be open at the times you are supposed to be open

Wow wow wow one of the easiest 5 star reviews I've given out. This is some real deal vegan food y'all. As we all know, vegan food can be iffy: it's either you can obviously tell it's not the real thing or has a weird texture that makes you wonder "Am I eating styrofoam??" Not here. I went with their scrambled tofu burrito, which has a "cheezy tofu scramble", red onion, pickled onion, tomato, lettuce, and cucumber. The tofu scramble was literally a vegan egg substitute and I don't think I would've been able to tell a difference if you did a side by side comparison with real eggs. If you're looking for a healthy breakfast/lunch substitute or if you're a vegan/vegetarian looking for new places to visit, and miss the taste of the food carby, cheesy stuff, you have to try out Falcon Coffee Bar. It's as close as you can get to being identical to the real thing

I love this place I tried the Cuban sandwich and had to do a double take it tasted like real meat and cheese also the back patio is super cute overall love the atmosphere and can not wait to try more food

The owners of this place are awful. In summer of 2020 they fired employees for participating in protests, posting about Black Lives Matter on their personal social medias, etc. Do not give these people your money

I've been to this spot twice this week and both times I have been impressed by the quality of the food & service. I tried the pesto toast & the flax 'toast' it's served on is wonderfully crunchy, delicious & gluten-free! The toppings are pretty perfect: crunchy, creamy, flavorful.... and the parsley oil!!! I admit I got the same thing twice!! I'm not local so I wasn't sure when I'd have it again I also tried the turmeric latte with cashew milk as the barista suggested. The latte was creamy and delicious and had a bit of lime zest on top which brought a unique flavor to your run of the mill turmeric latte. The baristas are all very friendly and laid back. Definitely give this place a try if you're in the neighborhood! I can't wait to come back!

Love this coffee place! They make their own in house cashew milk and all their vegan food is to die for. The chop chop salad is probably my favorite but don't forget about the empanadas too. The vibe is great for a date or getting some work done.
A-MAZING!!! The Bodega Sandwich was incredible and after only trying it once I am now craving it daily. I also had the Eldorado latte (turmeric) and it was de-lighful! I can not wait to return!

Loved this spot! This plant-based coffee bar (which turns into a cocktail bar at night in the back) has a super interesting, eclectic vibe. There are some unique drinks (like the raspberry macchiato with coconut cream that I ordered). The service was super friendly and there is good WiFi and plentiful seating. I recommend visiting their outdoor patio in the back. Sitting in the sun and working or catching up with a friend? Sign me up any day. The food also looked delicious. Definitely hope to return soon!

Nice little spot! Love the decor. Very modern/rustic and comforting with lots of greenery. That's my favorite part! Avo toast and empanada presentation was extremely tasteful and had an upscale feeling. The flavor, even better. Avo toast was one of my favorites so far. If you're hungry, get one of each and you'll be just fine. Mocha latte was very good along with great latte art. Staff was very welcoming. I really felt at home and comfortable there. Plenty of outlets to plug in at the bar if you need to work. The establishment is 2-in-1 with a cocktail bar in the back that opens in the evening. The coffee house also offers come cocktails and mixed coffee drinks if you care to indulge. Would for sure be back! Update... went back for lunch. It was totally my fault that I forgot the chicken on the salad was not chicken and instead was plant based and had a weird taste. I ordered the chop salad. It was drenched in dressing which I did not like the taste of. The whole salad seemed to be overwhelmed with the dressing taste which seems to maybe have some tumeric or something in it. I am not vegan so I did not like the plant based chicken at all. Disappointed but it was more or less my fault for my mix up. I still loved the coffee and my previous post with the toast so I'll be back for those!

Caught this cool new space after whiskey tasting at close-by Corsair. Same block as Bastion restaurant. Terrific cold brew coffee, friendly atmosphere. Covering the no plastic straw movement with stainless steel or paper straws. Vegan food offerings and cocktails look enticing for another visit. Good luck to the new endeavor!

Falcon Coffee bar is a great place to go and catch up with a friend. The inside is a little sad because it's all dark and the coffee is all natural so it can taste a little bitter but other than that it's a pretty good place. Their chorizo empanadas are amazing

THE BEST STUDY/WORK VIBES. I love the aesthetic. It's bright and open- but also cozy. They usually have vegan/gluten free snacks which is much appreciated. Street parking can be busy- but the coffee and environment are worth it

If tasty food is all it takes to make a place great, the Falcon Coffee Bar has it in the bag. The empanadas are very tasty and the bodega sandwich is delicious. I look forward to trying more! The atmosphere is trying to grasp onto feng shui but dying plants have it just out of reach, but hey, minor detail. The only thing holding me back from giving this eclectic plant based cafe 5 stars is the service. There was no greeting when we walked in. We sat at the bar and perhaps it was our own fault to not be aware that you can not order from there. Eventually we had to interrupt the conversation of the employees to ask where we order... just 3 feet away. We will definitely return for the tasty food with high hopes of better service and perhaps an extra star.

Awesome vegan spot in wedgewood-Houston! Their brunch is not to be missed, the bodega sandwich is 10/10! The pastelito was inexplicably flaky especially being made without butter- delicious!! Their to go cocktails are also a must try! Definitely check them Out for a great vegan breakfast spot!

One of the few open cafes we could find on Thanksgiving Day and I'm so glad we came! It's a lovely and warm cafe with lots of beautiful green plants giving the whole place a shabby-chic eco vibe that we Loved! We got the Bodega sandwich and Tofu burrito. The Bodega was delish! The tofu burrito was nice but could have used a bit more flavor and the large onion chunks were a little too sharp. We also got a cashew mylk mocha and dirty chai lattes which were DREAMY!
Bodega sandwich is so good. Love the atmosphere here and all the succulent plants around and their style overall

Falcon is amazing!! Such kind employees and delicious food! I could not recommend the iced lavender latte MORE ITS SO GOOD!!! also the buffalo chxn burrito is incredible, and such a great atmosphere. definitely worth a visit!

Great spot! We had heard a lot about this place from our friends in the area. My wife and I had the avocado toast and iced vanilla latte with oat milk. Both were unique and enjoyable. The vibe is unbelievable too.

Can't speak much for the cocktail side, but the coffee bar is absolutely amazing and is filled with wonderful workers. To be fair, I go during the early evenings (5PM-ish), missing the crowd so the quiet and calm environment is quite enjoyable. My go-to drink is a nice cold brew, macchiato, or espresso shot, which have all been amazing. Music is lovely and is at the perfect balance between loud enough to hear yet quiet enough to hold a conversation without having to yell into someone's ear. The most convenient thing about Flamingo is the parking and opening hours. I love morning coffee but sometimes a girl just needs her after work coffee or wine. Did I mention they have wine at the coffee bar? Well, they have some selection of wine. Get you some wine and coffee.

The Wedgewood Houston neighborhood had a cafe for a short while in years past, but it was unfortunately a short stay. However, the neighborhood has received a magnificent addition to the cafe culture of Nashville with Falcon. While the cocktail lounge side, Flamingo, is still in the works (though almost ready to go), Falcon dishes out local coffee from the local Osa Coffee Roasters, a small tea selection from local tea shop High Garden, a small but wonderful cocktail and wine selection, and a menu of toast, empanada, and sandwich selections that don't feature animals, but do taste amazing. Maybe I am biased because I have a cafe that is walking distance from my home, but this place has been a welcome surprise. Falcon currently makes my favorite cortado and avocado toast, the atmosphere is trendy and comfortable, and the staff has been friendly and caring. I don't have bad words to say. I'm excited about a great cafe opening in the neighborhood, and I highly recommend it.

I was charged extra for vegan cheese when they told me that my sandwich didn't come with any vegan cheese. They served me a sandwich with the vegan cheese I am allergic to as well as the cheese they charged me $2 extra for, didn't apologize, and didn't offer a refund. This is the second time they could have made me sick if I wasn't so vigilant. I am not sure why they mention being allergen friendly on their menu, because they honestly do not care. Massively disappointing. I will not be returning. I was sick for 3 days after I ate here for the first time.

Yes yes and yes. Do you like going to church? No, ok great then what about a coffee church? This place is a legit reconverted church that is now a third wave coffee shop and (I swear it's not that weird) they have great vegan food and coffee options + nice staff.

This is a neat plant based coffee bar tucked in the booming Wedgewood Houston area. I'm not really a coffee drinker like that but have had the avocado toast, tofu scramble burrito and the "chixin" wings which they don't have on the menu but they are the BOOOOMMMBBB! As of now they only have them on Saturdays. These are the only faux wings that I've had that actually have e texture of a wing and a bone in it for the effect...it is so tasty...the tofu burrito is so filling and seasoned just right. They also sell some kind of coconut brownie (I think it's coconut) but it is BOMB as well! Staff are friendly and I haven't had any issues with parking...you have to park on the streets.
Really cool atmosphere, great vegan friendly food! I got to eat a breakfast burrito that was delicious and such a treat.

A cute little coffee place in Nashville! Great ambiance and the employees are super nice. Nice chill music playing in the back, so I could definitely see people studying here. Got their Andy Palmer (lemonade + cold brew). I had never had one before but it was surprisingly good. Definitely helps that their coffee is super delicious I would definitely recommend this to anyone visiting in the area! There are a lot of cool places nearby that seem worth checking out

Wedgewood Houston just keeps pumping out the amazing small businesses. Case in point, Falcon Coffee Bar. This is a coffee bar by day and a cocktail bar/lounge by night. The vibe here is amazing, friendly staff and the music played throughout the venue is awesome. For coffee and breakfast, you have to order via an outdoor window and if your staying to hang out, they give you a numbered card to place at your table. You can sit inside in the front coffee bar, the back cocktail lounge area, or the outdoor patio, it's all open. I chose the lounge because it offers the most space and large comfy couches. My veggie breakfast burrito was delicious and the cold brew that accompanied it hit the spot. BTW- They have oat milk! I for sure need to make my way back here to sample of some their cocktails and fully experience the lounge, minus the sunlight. Party on!

THIS IS MY MOST FAVORITE RESTAURANT IN THE WORLD. You have to come here seriously it might just change your life. Amazing prices, incredible food, the best vegan food ever, very clean. Vegan or not you have to try it. The French dip and breakfast wrap was amazing. Kale salad as a side was 10/10. Changed my life lol. You can taste the love in every bite. I made a trip around the country this past summer and it completely blows every place we've been to out of the water.

I can always count on Falcon to make me feel welcome and at ease. The coffee is amazing, and the food menu is bomb as well. I love to see plant-based businesses making cruelty free eating the norm! My fave are the empanadas (specifically, soyrizo), but I recently tried the Philly cheezesteak and loved that, too!

I got an iced mocha and toast with jam and my husband got an espresso and avocado toast. Everything was great, and I really appreciated that they didn't pile on a ton of jam on my toast that I would have just scraped off (like almost every other place we've been to)! The bread was so good! My coffee snob husband gave the espresso a B. The one thing that would make this place even better, would be to add some tables to their benches outside!

I had heard a LOT about Falcon prior to coming here--and all great things too! I found myself finally going in order to get my hands on the Yellow & Lavender goodies that they carry, but I was so glad to finally stop by! The look of the place itself is stunning.. small and well decorated without being too dark; tons of plans. The service was okay, I just got my treat and a cappuccino to go so it was quick. My cappuccino itself was fantastic until the last few sips, not really sure why! I'll definitely be back to try it all again, I know how off days go! Also, their cocktail lounge is calling my name!

Nice little spot! Love the decor. Very modern/rustic and comforting with lots of greenery. That's my favorite part! Avo toast and empanada presentation was extremely tasteful and had an upscale feeling. The flavor, even better. Avo toast was one of my favorites so far. If you're hungry, get one of each and you'll be just fine. Mocha latte was very good along with great latte art. Staff was very welcoming. I really felt at home and comfortable there. Plenty of outlets to plug in at the bar if you need to work. The establishment is 2-in-1 with a cocktail bar in the back that opens in the evening. The coffee house also offers come cocktails and mixed coffee drinks if you care to indulge. Would for sure be back!
This place has such amazing local art on the inside!! I am blown away by the amount of small businesses in Asheville who support their artists! Great Vietnamese coffee too.

Love that this spot is vegan- hard to find a large selection of those in fried chicken city. I had the bodega sandwich based on others' reviews and I was a little nervous because the description didn't line up with what I'd normally order, but holy shit I'm glad I did! So good! It oddly reminds me of McDonald's in the best and most nostalgic way. It's the bun, and the tang in the aioli. Highly recommend. I also got a cinnamon roll which was delicious. Coffee was meh. Definitely worth checking out. They have Flamingo in the back opened up for seating now, too which is awesome.

This is a really neat plant based coffee shop. We were hoping to get breakfast and coffee but were told they don't start serving breakfast until 9 am. They did have empanadas ready and doughnuts from Morsel. Both were fantastic! I would love to try their other food. For coffee, I got the El Dorado (turmeric latte) off the seasonal menu with their house cashew milk. It was good - an interesting mix of flavors. I tasted turmeric, cayenne? And it also had lime rind. My sister got the macchiato which was really good. I saw a lot of reviews that said the cold brew was good and saw a lot of people order that while we were there, so I think I would try that next time. Overall it's a really nice coffee and breakfast spot.

Super cute coffee shop located in Wedgewood Houston Visited this coffee shop today for the first time with my coworker and was very impressed. It is located over on Houston Street and is attached to the Flamingo Cocktail Bar. I ordered a large iced coffee with caramel syrup and it was very good! I'll have to come back and get one of their doughnuts Pros: + yummy iced coffee syrups (caramel, lavender, mocha) + awesome customer service! The barista was very personal + ample seating and cute decor + street side parking + food options + gorgeously decorated pastries
The Lavender Cashew Milk Latte is literally the best coffee I've ever had in my life! And the food is amazing! My favorite spot in Nashville!!
Service was decent but ham and cheese croissant thing tasted like it was sitting for a few days and the avocado toast took 30min to make, would not recommend

A HIDDEN GEM FOR SURE!! I met my friend here for coffee and I was blown away. the lattes are yummy. The food was good. Staff is really friendly! the atmosphere is laid back and whoever makes the playlist has amazing taste in music. a cool hidden hangout with some yummy treats.

This place is the bomb diggity. I've been hanging out here so often the baristas know my name. The owner of The Falcon, Andy, is great! He's always slinging beans behind the bar. Alex is another one of my favorite baristas. Everyone else I've met is awesome too. Always friendly and great customer service every time. The coffee is delicious. The cold brew is out of this world! Some of the best I've had in Nashville. They use beans roasted locally at OSA Coffee in Edgehill! The food menu is entirely plant based. Everything is so good. Try the BLT with a side of potato salad and thank me later. The empanadas are tasty too if you want a small snack. Rad vibes all around. Great music, lots of plants and cool atmosphere. They are very intentional here and aim to be as environmentally friendly as possible, only using biodegradable and compostable materials. If you aren't aware, The Falcon is the coffee shop (black building) in the front and it connects to The Flamingo (pink building) which is a cocktail bar behind it. I haven't been there yet but word on the street is that it's gnarly. Whether you're craving coffee or a cocktail, you can't go wrong here! Check it out.

The vibe and atmosphere of Falcon bar are amazing! There is plenty of seating both indoors and outdoors. The staff is super friendly and patient. This is our first time here it took us a bit to order. The drinks are good! The only thing I didn't like was the chocolate croissant it was not good at all! I get it's vegan but the chocolate and the texture it wasn't for me. Also, I feel like the price point is a little high compared to other shops. I wouldn't mind having cocktail drinks with friends here after work. The vibe is so chill I can see myself grabbing coffee and working here in the morning. I'll come back.

I really disliked the outside area of this location. Super urban and lots of construction going on. Inside is very nice though: cute decor, great music, lots of indoor and outdoor seating, fairly quiet with lots of people working on laptops. Cashier was nice and gave great service. The barista was very helpful and on top it it. She let me try a one ounce pour of the Andy Palmer ( mix of cold brew and lemonade). Delicious and refreshing but not something I'd like to drink a whole glass of. That helped me choose the blueberry Americano with coconut milk. It was light without being too light, a little coffee and a little fruit. Love that they have a vegan menu! Had the Bodega sandwich. Was super tasty and presented well. It is small, but not too costly so I was ok with it. At 5 pm, the coffeeshop closes and the back turns into a bar called the flamingo. In sum, great vegan coffee spot with good food and coffee to work on your laptop. It's small, intimate, and quiet. Feels like a neighborhood haunt more than other touristy coffee shops in Nashville. Bummed I'd already tried a donut earlier in the day, cause they had yummy looking vegan ones here from Yellow & Lavender that were done in the croissant-ty style. So know that if you have a sweet tooth, they have options here.
This place is great! Empanadas are delicious, especially the chorizo empanada. Good coffee and free refills! Great vibe, good music and bar is cool too!
What a cute place - I will tell my friends! Nice quiet place with coffee, hot tea and a few cocktails plus vegan food ( have not tried the food yet)

I LOVE the vibe so much. Plants everywhere! Good music :) great spot for people with good allergies or specific food lifestyles. The people were very friendly and helpful. Hannah, my barista, was a gem. She made me feel welcomed and valued. :)
Found this amazing coffee shop while visiting town. Open first day of the year before 9am and I had an amazing cup of coffee with to die for empanada. Absolutely love this place .

Yup, still 5-stars as usual. Gotta say: their new Banh Mi sandwich is PHENOMENAL and my new favorite menu item. This better be a permanent menu item and not a seasonal thing!! Idk what they did to make the miso beef inside so tasty, and it's so hard to believe it's all plant based!!!

Super cute coffee shop! Indoor and outdoor seating. Variety of drinks and eats. I got the iced tumeric latte with a shot of espresso... came out super good. Not too sweet at all. I got my drink for there and took it out to the back patio which had a lot of open seating. Walking towards the back I noticed a full bar and seating area .. turned out it's a club as well. The club doesn't close until 3am, and every last Saturday they have a 70s themed party and dress up. Pretty cool if you ask me. Super cute and classy. Had my drink while I FaceTimed with my sexy man and simply enjoyed the vibe. Will be bringing him there when I visit again... hopefully at night to the club so I can grind on him. It's just a sexy vibe (the club section) I WILL BE BACK.

I love this place! We went to the Falcon (the coffee shop). It's great--good music, premium tea from High Garden (can't wait to go back for coffee), beautiful earthy decor, and super friendly service. Our barista, Natalie, was awesome--so friendly and gentile. We can't wait to go back!!

Literally. Amazing. The employee with the Taurus tattoo on her finger, if I could kiss her I would. That's how amazing everything was. I asked her which drink she recommended, food and sweets. I got the iced vanilla latte, French dip, rose or lavender pistachio donut and the cinnamon roll. And when I tell you each item slapped I'm saying they SLAPPPPPPPED. I already was looking at the French dip because that used to be my jam back before I went vegan so her recommending it just made my soul sing lol and it was everything I wanted and more. The aju was insane. Out of this world. Also she recommended potato salad for my side and that was amazing as well. Always look to a female Taurus for food suggestions. We know good food! 10 out of 10 recommend this spot. Will be back.

The building caught my eye when I was heading to a hair appointment nearby, and I asked my stylist if she'd ever been. She said she'd had a great vegan BLT here, so I decided to stop by for a drink after getting my hair done. The ambiance inside is sparse and casual, and the menu is small. My Traditional Cuban caught my eye because it was my drink of choice when I was barista. The one I had was excellent; the espresso managed to be bold and earthy but still mellow and smooth. When I ordered, the barista confirmed with me first what was in it--just espresso and sugar--which I appreciated as a general practice since so many people use common names for different drinks. I'll definitely go back with a book or some work sometime soon!
I found this little amazing place for breakfast. I had the avocado toast. Highly recommend!!! Great find!!!
Was visiting from California and always like hunting down a good cup of coffee. Excellent craft brew. Great vibes and merch too.

The outside of this coffee shop is stunning, and the inside is perfectly modern and cozy. The cold brew is wonderful and their all plant based menu is delicious. On top of it all, the staff is extremely kind and welcoming. Definitely recommend this place.

Review for Falcon Coffee Bar - Currently chilling here on a Sunday afternoon, getting some work done and enjoying some flavorful coffee and empanadas. Not sure what I enjoy more, the positive customer service, the dope playlist or the plant based menu. I definitely see myself coming here more in the future.
By far the kindest baristas in town. Also amazing food and coffee obviously I go there almost everyday! High my recommend the chop chop burrito and Irish coffee
Love this place! Amazing vegan food, great spot for working and staff are nice. Plus it is a really cool area and easy street parking.
So good. Flavor is in every bite. Food is beyond delicious and service is amazing. This hands down is some of the best food in West County.

Dined here with friends at the beginning of the snow storm on super bowl weekend. It's a wonderful little restaurant with nice atmosphere even though it's in a shopping center. The food was excellent. The service was friendly and attentive. It was a really good experience.
