Decent fast food at reasonable prices. It's definitely a cut above McD's or BK. The burgers and fries aren't inspiring, but they have a good selection. Their onion rings tend to be a better choice if you like that sort of thing. What makes Culver's stand out is the shakes! Their custard chocolate malt is to die for. So happy to get my fix again.

though i visibly saw 3 culver's team members inspect my order, i was missing two items: two chocolate milks w/the kid's meals. this happened before, at the park blvd/pinellas park culver's (on that visit a side order of a basket of fries). so i decided to avoid that location altogether and patronize the park blvd/seminole location. it seems that errors occur frequently with large family orders. a shame really, because overall i have been very pleased with both the value and taste of the food offered. this will definitely play a role in which fast food establishments to do business with, especially now that a new zaxby's opened up on park blvd and belcher rd., which is closer to my residence than the aforementioned culver's locations. i will reproduce this review on social media and other websites as part of overall customer awareness.

This was our 2nd and final experience at Culver's on Park Blvd. Sunday evening so we thought we would stop for milkshakes and onion rings. The young girl taking the order was incompetent. We waited more than a reasonable time for two shakes and an onion ring in the drive through. We ordered one small shake and one large shake. The menu board lists the "small" as 2.99 the only other size "regular" as 3.89. When i paid at the window I was charged 5.29 for the large shake and told there was nothing they could do. I questioned the charge but paid hoping for an amazing shake and no luck. Culver's will never see my family or another dollar from us. Which is their loss, I sure that I would be in their ideal demo and frequent the pdq, chic filet and dq and other restaurants in the area. The manager and window gal's apathy will likely run off many potential customers.
4 visits in 2 months. 3 out of 4 times our orders were incorrect which resulted in additional trips back to get corrected, not to mention expired cole slaw. Horrible. Will not be going back.

I've enjoyed everything I've had here. The burgers are the best of all the fast food chains. Their fish is delicious, way better than Long John Silvers. The restaurant is always clean and the staff is always very friendly. As an added bonus, they give a discount to veterans. I've eaten here 5 times in one week, it's that good. Hopefully they don't follow the path to rapid expansion and then suckage, like so many new places have.

It's a little pricey but he atmosphere is what you are their for. From their abundant selection of thick ice creams to their made to order burgers. Not too busy most days. Entrance is a little tricky as Park Blvd and the light to get into Home Depot intersect.
I'm not sure what it is about this particular location. The ice cream/ custard always has ice in it. Perhaps it is a cost saving measure or a bad machine but like I said it's only this location.
Great Chicken! I'm not a big fan of butter fried burgers but others seem to love it. Good fries and good service!
Absolutely terrible service and the food was cold. The manager did not care about my complaint. The drive-thru is ridiculously slow also.
Stopped in for the first time today. Glad I did. Good fast food, clean facility and friendly folks. Easy in and out on a busy road. Glad I live close by so I will return.

Maybe it was an off day but this visit was such I do not ever plan on returning to any Culver to eat. I generously bumped the rating 1 star because the staff that helped me was good. My burger was so overcooked that I didn't have meat as much as a crunchy patty something. Other burger though was okay though drowned in Mayo and had to scrape it off.. Meat wasn't seasoned based on taste so had to use a lot of pepper and salt. Crinkle fries were best part of the meal though they are my least favorite fry. Finished meal up with a sundae that wasn't memorable- so all in all a disappointing visit.

If you like Culver's you'll like this place. Standard interior, clean and well maintained. Food, like all Culver's. Either you love it, or you don't. 5 stars for the friendly, helpful staff who went out of their way to make our order right.

Okay, where do I start ? Well, I had been here a couple times by Drive Thru, where service was somewhat slow, but acceptable for a made to order burger. The frozen custard is actually delish, and a few times I just got that. Burger from Drive Thru was tasty, but pretty darned greasy. Decided to go inside for a burger recently. What a mistake ! When you first come in - it's a Cluster%&^k ! Can't tell where the line is or where exactly to order. The kids they have working are too busy talking to each other to wait on anyone, and only when I asked - are you working or what ?- did I get any service. Since they put too much "butter" on the previous burger buns, I asked for "no butter" on my single burger (bun). Of course, that put them into a tailspin, (guess no one's ever asked for that before), and I knew I was in for it. They give you a number, and you sit down to wait for the food. Okay, 5, 10, then 15 mins goes by. I ask about my burger, to be told "Well the drive thru's backed up and we're shorthanded. We serve the drive thru first." Okay, good to know. "serve the drive thru first"? Really ? So why bother ever coming inside ? Another 5 mins goes by. At this point I was quite irritated and asked to speak to the manager. "We're shorthanded. He's working the grill right now and can't come out to talk". At this point I'd waited close to 25 mins for my burger, and was ready to demand my money back and leave, but then the kid gives me a coupon for a free meal and a "yours is coming right out", so I waited again. Sat back down, and after a few more mins., finally they bring out my burger. (waited about 30 mins total), and guess what ?!! Not only did the bun have TONS OF BUTTER, I also received a "Double", not the single I ordered ! So all the waiting for what I had assumed was for "no Butter", I still got Butter on the wrong size burger. GGGRRR.. At this point, I sopped up as much grease as I could with a napkin, and ate about half of a bigger burger that I didn't want. I complained to the kid who seemed to be the only crew member that actually cared, and he apologized. I told him they really need to get their act together, and he just kept saying "we're understaffed, and people called in sick". My advice - Avoid this place except maybe for going thru the drive thru for a delicious frozen custard. The hamburger meat itself tasted good, but it's really pretty greasy with the buttered bun. Don't go inside because as I said before, it's a Cluster%&^k in there.

This used to be my favorite fast food burger joint. I would eat here at least once a week, usually twice. Sadly, like most places, the quality of food has decreased significantly. The last few times I've been, I've been very disappointed. VERY disappointed. The customer service is pretty bad too. The people are friendly enough, but they're frequently slow and/or incompetent. Today I went in for a burger and fries. It literally took them 20 minutes to deliver lukewarm food. They also forgot the mayonnaise I requested. Because of COVID, they're not allowed (?) to have condiments available for customers to help themselves (although customers can help themselves to drinks), so they need extra vigilant when customers request them. They aren't. I didn't want to wait in line again so I ate my lukewarm fries without salt, pepper, or mayonnaise, which is how I like them. Oh well, on the bright side, I'll save $80 per month and lots of calories by not eating here.

Third strike. Although people rave about their desserts, they are not on my diet. Two burgers prior and grilled chicken today and while it wasn't awful, none of it is delicious, and the cost took away a star, so it's a one. I could have had a meal at the local Chic-fil-A for the price of a grilled chicken with no bun, condiments or anything. That's a no brainer for me. You struck out Culvers!

Decided to give this location a chance after the east bay one became a disaster. This was no better. Terrible service. The kid packing the food actually wiped his nose with his gloved hand and then proceeded to keep using it. He also grabbed pens, used the register and other nasty stuff. The manager was leaning on the counter and didn't even have his shirt tucked in. What an example... They had no fried chicken at one in the afternoon or they just didn't feel like making it. Why have it on the menu then? Case has no flavor of the day.

Better than McD's for the burgers but if you like flame grilled stick to B.K. The prices are good, food fresh, servers are knowledgable and friendly. It's nice to order, take a table and have the food delivered hot and correct. However the custard is amazing. Malt's, shakes, sundaes etc. and all outstanding. Worth the trip just for dessert.

The best burgers 100% fresh. The Garden Fresco with Grilled Chicken Salad with the Sesame Ginger Dressing is my healthy yummy choice super fresh. The staff is so friendly. True concept of family owned. Love it.
All I can say is "Is was so greased couldn't eat the special fish dinner". Oil from the frying covered the bottom of the dish . Looked like a boat sank. If you want somee super food, read Yelp!!

Curt is a very nasty employee. My family goes in all the time with large groups. Sometimes we use coupons we receive from emails and he gets nasty when we use them. Most of the others are nice, but Curt is a whole a**.

The cashier was very helpful and friendly the first time I came in and helped me decide what to pick out as the menu is huge. Can't judge on the food, as I've only had custard here on two different occasions, which is absolutely amazing. From the other reviews it doesn't sound like the food is good so I'll stick with the desserts.

So sad that the one fast food restaurant I thought I could count on for great food and great service is slowly sliding into the lake it is next to. I have ordered that same thing for ages-single butter burger and a soda ( or strawberry mango smoothie). Burger always came with lettuce and lots of good sauce dripping off of it. What a disappointment when I bought lunch for the techs fixing my computer. 3 single burgers, 2 fries, 2 sodas and a smoothie. The burgers consisted of bun, cheese, meat. OMG are you serious? I called to ask and the young man who answered the phone laughed as he apologized and said the person on his end should of asked what kind of burger I wanted. I can't take my receipt and complain because I didn't get on. Isn't that special. One more chance then I go back to PDQ

The burgers were delish, very juicy and tasty. Love the char broiled flavor. The fries and onion rings were very good as well. I had a chocolate malt, best I ever had. I had never eaten at a Culvers, there aren't any in the Northeast were I live. We love 5 guys burgers, but this was just as good.
The manager Jim Jaeger is a pervert and touches underaged employees inappropriately, but somehow still has his job because it is somehow classified as "nonsexual".
Why in the world would you give us our frozen custard first and then have us wait 15 min for our meals? Maybe they should hire more responsible staff that actually care about their job.
Food is horrible. 2 times now I've been here and the food is overcooked and cold. How is that even possible?
First time there and the cod fish dinner was good . The French Fries were hot the fish was fresh and excellent. I am in love with this place. Thank you!

This is one of the greasiest and skinniest burgers I've ever had. Not a place to come if you have any dietary health concerns. If I come back it would be to try the chicken but as far as semi fast good burgers, I'll stick to Five Guys.

Best burger I've had in quite awhile. Only had fries and burgers. Only complaint I could find was the precut bagged lettuce or as I call it chemical lettuce. Hit the drive thru so no peek inside. Clean outside but it's a pretty new location. I'll return.
Burnt burgers...not rude but not friendly service..ni need for us to return.... May be bad night but others have said the same...its a shame I was looking forward to good new restaurant..to bad

It's fast food burgers, fries, onion rings but if you want amazing ice cream go here. I've eaten the burgers quite a few times and they're good similar to other fast food places like S&S but I swear they have THE best ice cream. The peanut butter cup concrete mixer is a go to.
The food is always great, I'm from Wisconsin I have been eating at Culvers for the last 20 years and the Culvers here is just as great as the Culvers food in Wisconsin!

Two Wisconsinites meet up in Seminole, Florida... and naturally they go for lunch at a Culver's! This location lived up to all its Wisconsin counterparts. The grilled cheese, fries, cheese curds, and custard we ordered were the perfect comfort foods after a day out water skiing on Lake Seminole. The location even offers a beautiful view of the lake!

Just went there literally an hour ago, and half of the food wasn't up to anybody standards. Some rude employee rolling his eyes when the food was delivered to the table, male bathroom was dirty beyond belief. Occasionally we buy our dinner there, but lately we have noticed the fries quality,taste and freshness isn't there anymore not sure if it's a certain group of people not doing their work right or just the lack of the managers on tasting samples before giving the OK to server to customers. Their drive thru makes constantly mistakes on handing orders, more than once i've gone thru it and have found that i ordered a double cheese and only to find a single cheese burger/half of the fries on the bag they come in.

Went in today for a burger and fries. Usually good, with good service. Took a couple bites and realized it was a plain cheeseburger with no lettuce, tomato, etc. Told the kid working and he said he would get me another burger. I asked if he wanted the other, he said he would throw it away for me. A few minutes later, a lady came to my table with a french fry container loaded with lettuce, tomato, etc. Unbelievable. Not looking for anything for free, but come on!! I expressed my dismay, but they didn't;t seem too concerned with losing a customer.

I don't get this place. The entry sequence and ordering process is quite a cluster$&@$. There is no queuing line with people coming in from 2 sides so nobody knows where to stand. The ordering area is really shallow too. It is just a really poor restaurant design with respect to customer flow. The food is similar to Steak and Shake. While the burgers are ok the crinkle cut fries are nothing special and quite bland (think store bought frozen fries). The decor is really odd too - if their concept is farm fresh family style it doesn't show. I might go back to try their ice cream but not for lunch or dinner.

The ice cream is their inky saving grace, because their food and customer service lack. Ordered a spicy chicken sandwich and the meat was dry because it was overcooked and there was no condiment sauce, which made the sandwich even more dry. I didn't even eat the bread, tomato, lettuce and 1 pickle. Fries were also overcooked, but the family ate the burgers. Teenagers working the register and soda machine need training. Had to ask for ketchup 3-times before we finally got a little pack and the soda girl could not understand Diet Pepsi, as she asked us 6-times if we wanted a Diet Root Beer. Shaking my head!
Great taste BUT super thin patties. Way OVERPRICED Kids meal $6. 2 small tenders. Tiny fries NOT WORTH IT

Burgers are thin and greasy but tasty. We had a coupon so it made it a good value. I wouldn't eat here again without a coupon. Overpriced for portion size. They gave me the wrong burger but since it was the same price as what I ordered I went ahead and ate it. Nothing special IMO. Steak and Shake has comparable food on their $5 menu. Custard is good.

Nice double cheeseburger--hot, tasty, crispy edges, with very good toppings. French fries were so hot I had to hold off for a few minutes so they were cool enough to eat--they were good but not spectacular. Wife had chicken strips that were hot, tender and spicy. Very clean restaurant, very nice staff. With a senior citizen's discount (10%), we had dinner for about $16, including our drinks, and had a good meal. Cleaner, nicer than the other fast food places, and better fare. We'll be back.

First time ordering at Culver's. Was very disappointed with the result. The onion rings and sweet potato fries were delicious, hot and tasted freshly made. The sandwiches were another matter entirely. The chicken sandwich was like warm. The bun was soggy like it had been sitting around for awhile. The harvest burger was absolutely disgusting, a luke warm soggy mess, one bite the entire thing slopped to the plate in a sodden blob. It was tasteless and despite specifically requested no cheese,had cheese on it. The slip listed "no cheese" on the order. It all went in the trash.Needless to say will not be ordering from Culver's again.

My kids are fans of Culver's and this was my child's request for his lunch at school on his birthday. I was running late to deliver his Culver's lunch so I called ahead to place an order. They said that since they just opened they were not taking call ahead orders for another 2 weeks. I explained how I was late for my son's lunch and they said they'd be more than happy to help me out. They took my order and when I arrived at the new location on Park they had the order ready. It shaved 10 minutes off my time and I was so grateful that they accommodated my request and helped me out in a pinch. Two thumbs up for customer service and the kids love the root beer!

We have been there a few times and every time was as good as the first.we love the butter burgers and everything we have tried.went there and ate today was great.we also picked up some gift cards ,buy a 25.00 and get a free deluxe basket,how can you beet that.
Burgers and customer service are always great at culvers. The burgers, fries, and cheese curls are amazing.Having a great time with the family. Thanks, Culver's for a fresh delicious dinner

There Food is So much better than the usual drive thru Food! Made to Order! Hamburgers are awesome! Fries are always hot & Not greasy! Cheese curds of course great, from Wisconsin! Custard is very good, and is a Wisconsin thing too (use to live in WI) if not familiar it's more creamy than ice cream. Always had very good customer service too!

Terrible experience at this restaurant tonight. 32 minutes in drive thru (10 of which was after we got up to the window.). There were only 8 cars in front of me. When they asked me to park (after handing me our ice cream), I asked her to bring me fresh when they bring the food because I didn't want it melted. Girl at window rolled her eyes and asked if I really needed them to put it in the freezer. I told her that if the 20 minutes to crank out 8 cars was any indication then I probably did. It took another 12 minutes to bring 2 burgers and 1 order of fries to the car. Horrible. This restaurant manager needs to take notice. I'll be looking for ways to lodge a complaint.

Piece of advice to the owners and upper management of this location, when you leave somebody in the store in a management position please give them the ability to handle customer concerns. In addition make sure the people behind the counter understand the importance of customer service and know when to keep their mouth shut and not argue with customers. I can assure you after my experience this evening I will never step foot in this location ever again.

3:30pm Sunday feb28, 2016... I go to the drive thru ask, for a flavor of the day, turtle, and politely ask if they can make the ice cream look like the picture (because I've been here many times before and the flavor of the day is always lacking its pizzazz and hype that the picture and flavor forecasts create). Yeah I have the app and check this stuff out each week because I love ice cream! So, please don't disappoint me and give a a little vanilla ice cream with 2 pieces of pecan and a squirt of caramel and forget the chocolate! Will ya??!! DO IT RIGHT! Ppplllleeeaaasssseeeeee. Just once. So, I asked if they would give me a cup of turtle that looked like the pic, and you know what? THEY DID. Congrats! I would give you 3 stars instead of 2 if the little BRAT at the drive thru didn't hand me my cup of ice cream, say 'have a nice day' and then SLAM the window in my face! What a B. But hey! Thanks for the follow through! I know the labor pool is chalk full of bright eyes but the manger needs to handle his inconsistency. Do your freakin' job.

I've read some poor reviews about the service at this location, but the service is what prompted me to write this review. They must have stepped it up because the service tonight was impeccable. Everything came out lightening fast and the staff were very polite and kind. The dining room was also incredibly clean. And the food, as always was amazing.
This place is great for what it is. Custard is awesome. Burgers are good. Chicken tenders are good. Love the fried cheese curds.

(ALL ABOUT CHEESE CURDS) I had dinner at another Culver's location last night, and liked it enough to want to try it again today. This is fast food, but with a few different options and, uh, it's "upscale fast food." I wasn't that hungry, and it was still pretty early (10:30 am) so I decided to try the custard on a future trip, and just picked up an order of cheese curds in the drive through. I paid and was given a plastic table tent with a number and asked to pull forward in line...there was no one else there, and I had no idea what to do with the tent (put in the roof of my car maybe?). A few minutes later my cheese curds came out. Folks, these are mozzarella sticks, reshaped and given a fancy new name. Taste just like mozzarella sticks.

Good sandwich. Beef pot roast but I ordered their desert which they called flavor of the day. When it came it was about one table spoon of frozen custard a drizzle if I guess what they called caramel and no chocolate or nuts. A complaint to management got a response of I'll make sure they add it all in the future. No compensation or apology for what I paid full price and got a very small portion of basically plain custard.

I have been here a few times and this is what happens. The burgers are extremely greasy and lack luster. The fried chicken is dry if they even have any, and the service is what you would expect if 12 year Olds were running the show. The last time we went, they forgot our banana split. When we went back, they acted like it was my fault, gave me an overflowing container in the drive thru and when we went to eat it, there was an extremely green banana at the bottom. Do you know what happens when you eat green bananas? I didn't, but I do now. Lots of nauseating GAS. My husband passed gas all night long. I had to sleep in another room. Even my bulldogs were like WTF, Dad. Needless to say, I was surrounded by 5 furry animals trying to escape the assault of dad's butt. My husband said he had the worst belly ache and couldn't stop passing gas. Even the next day at work, his boss almost sent him home. Be careful what you put in your stomach from this place.

First time in. Went because neighbors said it was the best fast food burger around. Total disappointment. Overcooked burger, burnt bacon, cheese not melted. Fries tasted like the frozen ones from grocery store - not crispy and not hot. I took my food home but I only live a half mile away. Should not have got cold that quickly. They claim to cook fresh when ordered. Doubt that. Guy at service counter was awesome. Great attitude and friendly smile (no mask but that's a different issue) He even called outfit someone in back to give this order TLC as first time customer. Too bad that I'm now also last time customer. It's back to the whopper for me.

Horrible customer service. This was my first time trying out Culver's and it's safe to say I will not be returning. The workers were very rude and rolled her eyes when I placed my order. I'll stick to Chick-fil-A.

The moment I walked in I was greeted by such warm humans. Everyone was very friendly and smiling, which made me realize I am obviously not in New York City anymore lol because you would never get that service there. I ordered a regular cheeseburger with a chocolate shake. Both were excellent. Shake was perfection and the burger was smashed beef technique and a perfect bun. Not too salty or buttery. Everything was just right. Wish they had one of these places in NYC!!
What overpriced place is this? The food is just bad. The ice cream is ok but Jesus , it's expensive. No thanks, two times was enough of this place.

I was kind of happy that Culvers was coming to my neighborhood because we had them in MN and I liked them. I thought that since their parking lot was often crowded it was a good sign...but no. This one is awful. Burger was tiny and burnt. Tomato was way under-ripe. I mean it was just gross. I made a special trip there too. Never again!

Amazing food. Burgers are EXCELLENT Cheese curds are excellent too . The custard is to die for! I have also had the blue cranberry chicken salad and loved it. They are new as of right now, so it is busy. Stay for the dessert...it is well worth it. This place will be a big hit for Seminole. Drive thru is available too.

2nd time here. Same lousy food. First time the Burgers. They wrre really Greasy & fries over cooked. This time, Rueben Melt / Cod Fish Sandwich / Cheese Curds. Rueben I could of re-soled my sneakers the meat was so *tough*. Cod Fish sandwich had a non toasted bun that actually engulfed the small piece. These Curds were so over done in the fryerlator we didn't finish them . We had split the two. No, didn't order shakes, or the *custard*. Thank God. $16 just for this crap was enough. Never again. Guy at the window was very pleasant and only reason for 2-Stars ...

Terrible. Burger had no flavor. I think kinda pricey..they delivered my food to my car and forgot to take the tag off my door. Good thing I did not have to drive far before I found it. If it scratched my car they would be paying to get it repainted. First and last time I'll go here.

Two times in about 5 visits to the drive through I was not given my correct order. Shorted a sandwich both times. They may be fresh to order but if it's not in the bag than that doesn't matter. I will not be going back there, hopefully they open another one in this area!
The buffalo chicken fingers are good, I am not a big fan of the burgers but the place is clean and has friendly servers!

I had no complaints about the food but the staff on the other hand was terrible. I arrived at the drive thru at 8:21 and had to wait about 15 minutes to order and that was only 3 cars ahead of mine. When I finally got to the ordering menu it took the lady a solid 5 minutes to start taking my order. I only order a single chicken sandwich and two concrete mixers. Then from there it took another 5 minutes to get to the pay window. When I pulled up to the window the young lady at the window was on the phone and didn't open the window for several minutes. When she finally opened the window she was very rude and had an attitude with me since I ordered my food. I just brushed it over my shoulder and paid. I noticed that my order was on the drive thru screen for 17 minutes and she deleted my order so the time limit would get recorded. My wife noticed this because she used to work at Chick fil a in the past. When I pulled my car forward I waited another 20 minutes for my chicken sandwich (only a sandwich, not including fries or anything extra). I had 2 cars behind me receive there order before mine. Then an employee came up and gave me a coupon for a free meal and apologized. I explained to him that the lady was extremely rude and I know why my order was "missing" and he told me that the young lady was removed from the drive thru and she was a new employee. But that was a lie because the young lady was still taking orders. She even came outside to talk to her friends in the car outside. An hour for one chicken sandwich and two ice creams seems completely unreasonable. Very upset with this service.
We did the drive though so I can only speak on the food. The burger is very good and affordable. The fries are good also. I would say it's better ham Steak and shake all the way around.
Great food and friendly place to eat. Very clean and staff is extremely welcoming. Concrete Mixers are amazing!!!!

Burgers are scrumptious, juicy & flavorful. We went to drive through. I got the swiss & mushroom burger (single patty but standardly has two) & my daughter got "cheese fries" and ice cream. Positive: The ice cream was really creamy & good. She thought the cookies would be swirled in, but they were just on top. No big deal, just wanted to mention. Negative: I asked if they had cheese fries. The girl said yes. I then asked if the cheese was on top or was it just served on the side. She said it's on the top, so we got them. The fries were hot, crinkle cut but a small container of cheese was provided. She had to dip the fries into the cheese sauce. That was a little disappointing. Finally, we had to pull to the side to wait for our food which was okay because it came out hot and fresh. But the order wasn't complete. They gave me just my burger and the ice cream and forgot about the fries. So I had to call the girl back and ask for those.

We pulled through the drive through for a quick burger. We didn't want lunch from one of the chain stores on every corner. We hadn't been to a Culver's but were willing to be adventurous. We are sooo glad we did! We had the Reuben and the Swiss and mushroom burger. Both were so fresh and yummy. The burger had fresh mushrooms- not from a can. The bun was so soft They had the crinkle cut fries that were hot and perfect. The kids had burgers and corn dogs. Everyone loved it and we even went back the next day! Yay for Culver's. Wish we had one in out town.
Awesome friendly service, fast hot food, yummy custard! So glad to have quality food from Wisconsin!!

I guess they dont lie when they call it a "butter burger." If you like really greasy food, this is the place to go! My burger was dripping with grease and was not very good. I'll try it again based on menu selections, but won't hurry back.
We loved Culver's! It was a nice break from all the local seafood on vacation! The burgers and grilled chicken were both awesome and the ice cream was the best!! We will be back!!

It's not Burgermonger or Burger 21, but I kinda like Culver's. The decor has a homey feel , there's carpet,and the tables are clean. I've only had burgers and shakes but they were good. The shakes are creamy and delicious, especially in Florida in July. The girl behind the counter at lunch is so friendly. I've had better and worse burgers, but for the money it's great. They also hand you a number if you stay or have take out, so you can sit and wait for your food to be delivered. Most places people just Mill about by the counter. Do yourself a favor and swing by for a Butter burger and a chocolate shake.
The fresh frozen custard is delicious either in a "concrete mixer" or a milk shake. Butter burgers are too greasy.

We came in late for dinner. We did not expect much since the restaurant is very small. The owner was very nice to cook for us for our order. We ordered pepper steak and yum yum chicken. They are very delicious. The beef is so tender and fresh. We wanted a little spicy on the pepper steak. The food came right into the flavor that we wanted. Unfortunately, we are so far from this restaurant. The people live nearby are lucky to have such a good restaurant. We hope to come back again.

A true Gem. Family owned. The owner obviously is very proud about the food he makes and it shows in the quality of his food and that he remembers return customers. Unique in that everything is made to order with fresh ingredients and fantastic flavors that have completely changed my opinions about Chinese food (i did not really like it before eating here). I have had the Fragrant Chicken, Chicken with Broccoli, and the Spicy Tofu with Vegetables. The dishes all have flavors that are much more complex than normally are present in your everyday run of the mill Chinese restaurant. Prices are very fair and the portions will not dissapoint. 1 warning - "spicy" means spicy! The owner makes any visit worthwhile, singing or humming along to Elvis or Sinatra. I have been here several times and plan on returning several times.
I paid $55 for three orders, the portions were very small for what i paid for and for been Chinese food. This is the most expensive Chinese restaurant i ever been. The food is not the best either.
Frank Sinatra music. Delicious chicken and broccoli, egg rolls, Wonton soup and niece of previous owner was very nice.

This is a fabulous Chinese restaurant. Family owned with the owner preparing all the food. Has take out and sit down services, so its kind of between a take out and a sit down place. It is not a buffet type place but more of a little restaurant where the owner will remember you the next time you come in. He also takes your order and prepares your dinner. The owner loves Frank Sinatra and has Sinatra posters up and Sinatra songs playing amid the Chinese decorations, but that is not the only surprise! The food is excellent, and many dishes have the owner's special sauces, one of which, the "fragrant sauce" is addictive. It is both spicy and lightly sweet and a perfect complement to chicken or shrimp. I usually don't like Chinese dishes with beef, but the beef here--which the owner special orders--is extremely tender and full of flavor. The owner prides himself in selecting only the finest ingredients, so you are getting dishes made with superior ingredients and that shows in the taste. The shrimp he uses are huge! Really, this is just a dazzling place on the Northwest side, Lafayette Rd., not far from the 56th St. entrance to Eagle Creek, and it is a hidden gem. If you love Chinese dishes do yourself a favor and stop in.

Many years ago I lived in San Francisco. My FAVORITE restaurant food was Ma Po Tofu. I found a couple restaurants that offed the dish. For many years now I have tried and tried to find anything close to what I had. I lived in different cities and never found anything close. UNTIL NOW! I noticed the International Market Place Coalition would be going to the Imperial Palace. I thought I would give it a try on my own. I asked if they offered Ma Po Tofu and they agreed to prepare it for me. It's perfect. It has the perfect balance of meat and tofu but more importantly the correct amount of ginger and toasted sesame oil. After years of searching I finally found my favorite dish. Thank you Imperial Palace.

So I had been to this restaurant before, and I thought the food was pretty good. It is not the closest and my favorite place nearby, but my favorite place, the owners were on vacation. So to get my food fix, I called in a carryout order here on a Saturday night at about 6:45pm. The gentleman who answered, said that he was pretty busy, and that my order would be ready in 35-45 minutes. At 7:30, I arrived with my 3 year old to pick up our order. I was reminded of the peculiar atmosphere with all the plants and Sinatra music. I noticed there was only one elderly couple eating together in the restaurant. The gentleman greeted me and told me to have a seat as it would be 10-15 minutes. I waited with my toddler who was growing impatient. I noticed that he bent over and picked a couple containers, maybe spices or leaves off the floor 10 minutes later I realized he was still reaching in to the refrigerated cooler to grab food to cook for my order. I began to lose my patience. All this time, there were no other orders, I questioned how busy he actually was, as he stated on the phone. I took my daughter to the restroom, which definitely could use a good thorough cleaning and then back. I wanted to show her some of the decorations around the place and it caught my eye as he dropped a piece of chicken or crab rangoon (uncooked) on the floor. Speaking of floor, I was floored, when he reached down, nonchalantly, and picked it up, placing it back on the prep table with the rest of my food. Unbelievable. I immediately picked up my daughter and walked out the door, unnoticed by him. Hungry and waiting, I went to an Italian chain drive through, at about 8:10, nearly one hour and half later, I got a voice mail stating that my order was ready to be picked up. Needless to say, I will never be back and I have also notified the local health department to investigate.

The server who answered the phone was very cordial. When we arrived to pick up our food, he was already standing at the register ready to greet and help us. We ordered carry-out for the Yum-Yum chicken, and when we got home... It's was excellent. The order was on-time, hot, and very flavorful compared to Chinese food I've had in the past. It did seem kind of expensive for take-out, but my husband and I shared 1 dinner order of the yum-yum chicken (with fried rice & two little broccoli for garnish), and it was plenty enough. By the looks of it, the restaurant was super small, but clean and well-maintained. I'll definitely make this my go-to Chinese food restaurant in the area.

I absolutely love their food. I have been going here for at least 15 years. I usually order the Chicken Fried Rice and add cashews and then get an order of Crab Rangoons (big as a baby's head!) But everything our family has tried has been great. When my beloved Bobby retired I thought for sure the place would go downhill or go away altogether but his family has kept up the exact same standards and it's possibly even more delicious. PS: Check out the decor and music - lots of Sinatra, Rat Pack and Marilyn Monroe!

Very nice people..obviously a loyal following based on the congenial familiarity of owner and patron. Food was quite good...fresh and high quality ingredients...reasonably authentic...would have liked more vegetables and less beef...but...I did not mention that, and should have. Perhaps the server could have paid a bit more attention to the dining room..but..it was obvious they were getting a large take away order ready. Even though I go to BJava quite frequently...never noticed this place..and were it not for recent yelp reviews...would not have discovered it. Why don't these places promote each other in the same strip mall ??? Very reasonably priced...and an excellent overall value.

I'm really glad to have discovered this place. I've only driven by, oh, 500 times but have somehow never noticed it. I asked Bobby the owner how long they've been open and he said 9 years...! Food was excellent. It is a one man show so it can take awhile if there are several orders in front of you, but the food was worth the wait. For reference, I ordered General Tso's Chicken which was sweet and spicy and my husband ordered Chicken and Broccoli and was excellent. Everything tasted very fresh and I enjoyed the way Bobby interacted with the customers. We will go back for sure!

This is the most amazing Chinese I've ever had. Normally when you ask for General Tso's Chicken extra spicy it has a little bit of a kick to it and that's all. I ask for it extra spicy and they asked on a scale of 1-10, I decided to be mindful and went with an 8. This was blow my mind perfect spiciness for General Tso's. I also bought an order of Crab Rangoon with my meal, it comes with 4 of them that are the size of a child's fist! It amazed me when I opened them up! I was only able to eat half of my General Tso's and 2 of the Crab Rangoon before I was stuffed. I am definitely coming back to this place and thrilled I live only 10 minutes away!

It's not bad but it's also not that good either. We order $51 worth of food which was surprisingly not a lot at all. The won ton soup tasted off, the won tons were cold and tasted more like they had been reheated a few times. The generals chicken was pretty good, the sauce was more on the light/mild side of spicy but had really good flavor. The orange chicken was pretty good as well. The teriyaki beef I sadly didn't even get to try because it had mushrooms in it (which weren't listed on the menu). The egg rolls were a little cold just like the won tons. The containers of food were all very small and you didn't have a size option. We were trying to feed a few friends who had helped us move and said they wanted Chinese for dinner. I will say the fried rice was pretty good and the way they packaged the food everyone basically got their own container. For the price and the quality and the size I don't think I will be back.
Great food and fast service. Very friendly staff. Good lunch menu. Great place for lunch.

The food here is great and the service is friendly and fast. We started with crab Rangoon (huge and delicious) and spring rolls. For our entree we shared and order of chicken with broccoli and steamed rice. Their is plenty of food to share in the entrees. This made our early dinner very affordable and we were stuffed! We will be back soon!

Great food here and service, kinda a one man show at least it was the other night, I go to the Starbucks next door all the time and was hungry so figured would try out the Imperial Palace fats prompt service here I walked in and the owner took my order then he went back to Finnish the order he was working on and mine also, they both came out at almost the same time I got the Chicken Low Mien (sp) it was very tasty and made me want more but as I had gotten it to go and was eating it on the road that wasn't a option, but I will b back to try some more dishes for dinner

Bobby rocks! We live near his restaurant (an awesome treasure in a strip mall off of Lafayette Road and 56th Street). When you walk in, you feel like you are in a jungle of beautiful plants and pictures of Marilyn Monroe while Frank Sinatra plays in the background. Bobby is basically a one-man show who usually works as server, cashier, phone order taker, and chef. The wait (usually not long) is worth it! Most people do takeout, there is definitely space to eat in there and enjoy the vibe. We come so often he knows me by name, and I love that kind of customer service. Hubs and I almost always order egg rolls and house fried rice (the shrimp are huge!). My favorite dish is Mongolian beef that is slightly sweet with stir fried green veggies and mushrooms. Hubs was having a hard time finding a dish that he truly loved at Imperial. One time when we were in the restaurant, he noticed there was an orange shrimp dish but not an orange chicken. He asked Bobby if he could make orange chicken, and Bobby said, "Of course!" Now Hubs gets it every time. Bobby will personalize your dish if you want it to be spicy (he'll usually ask you to rate what you want on a scale of 1-10). This is my favorite Asian restaurant in Indianapolis. Go. Go right now to see Bobby.

As you can see from the reviews, this is a one-man show. If you've eaten here a few times you get to know Bobby and his wonderful food. We eat here often, it is hands-down the best Chinese food in town. Eaten take-out from here nearly a dozen times, it has been excellent quality good every time.

This is a hole-in-the-wall kind of place. I think this is a good thing because it allows the owner to really interact with the patrons. The owner really cares about customer service. I had the Yum Yum chicken from the list of lunch specials. It was very tasty. I would go back to try other things from the menu if I come back to the area.

Our 1st time ordering from here & ITS AWESOME! So close to our home & the quality of the food will definitely have us ordering more often! The rangoons are HUGE, the beef & broccoli is real beef (not chewy pieces parts) and the YumYum Chicken is off the chain!! Highly suggest Imperial Palace!
The best Asian food I've ever had. Bobby uses fresh ingredients and everything is made to order. Be sure to call ahead because fresh takes time.

My family has been going to Bobby's (I honestly never remember the actual name of the place- it's even in my phone as "Bobby's") for years. My first job was at the Starbucks in the same strip as Imperial Palace, and during my lunch break I'd run over there and stuff my face with fried rice and dread going back to that evil Coffee Siren. When my nice manager was working, we'd bring over free coffee for Bobby, and he'd be thrilled. Once I quit the 'Bucks and went to college, I didn't see Bobby for years. One day, probably 5 years later, I was craving Chinese, real Chinese, not PF Chang's crap- I live downtown but my boyfriend was willing to drive. When we picked up the food, Bobby recognized me, name and everything, asked how I was, how my sister is, my family, etc. And it isn't just me- he knows all his customers. He's the only man in the place, and he's not young, but he's a natural people-person and an amazing cook. He has conversations with every person who walks in (Bobby picked my boyfriend out for a vegetarian after he ordered a veggie plate- told him he'd make my boy some special tofu next time). You're gonna wait for your food, but Bobby will tell you to sit, and you'll listen to Frank Sinatra and see Marilyn Monroe on the walls. Then you'll get your food, and you'll eat it (there or home), and it'll be GOOD. Big hunks of fresh chicken and veggies. Nice hot, steamy rice. I have leftovers at home. I gotta get them now.

It's hard to choose Chinese takeout when all of their menus look the same... but we went with Imperial Palace due to the ratings on Yelp and they did not disappoint! They took our carry out order within 30 minutes of closing and had our food ready by the time we drove there to pick it up. We ordered Cashew Chicken, Orange Chicken, and Crab Rangoon. It tasted hot and made to order with 3 fortune cookies! My husband was upset the cashews were whole and not pieces but it tasted good to me. The crab Rangoon was primarily filled with cream cheese instead of crab... but that didn't stop me from eating multiple. :)
Small seating area only five or six tables. Very clean excellent food quality. Large portions. I would recommend for sure. We did carry out

I have been coming here for lunch for years, since I work close by. I've never called in my order - I always walk in between 11 and 11:30 and I've never had to wait more than a few minutes for my food after I order. Bobby, when he was around, was excellent, and so is the new management (nephew I think). I've had all of their fried rice variations, fragrant chicken, tso's, etc. and they are all great! Their spring rolls are great. Wantons are giant. And the prices are EXTREMELY reasonable! Great place. I love it here. Don't ever change a thing, guys! I'll be coming back for years to come!
This is the best Chinese restaurant in Indy! We were greeted immediately and served by a kind man! The food is amazing! Plus the place is clean! Highly recommend to anyone craving lo mein!

We went for lunch because how do you say no to $6 lunch specials?! Amazing. They make it super spicy if you ask them to so that was a huge plus for me. Best of all, their chicken and beef is from the halal section in restaurant depot-yes it's halal!!!

Pretty typical small Chinese restaurant in so far as the food goes. What I really appreciate about the Imperial palace is the friendly (and clear) service. Bonus they have a pretty nice interior design with middle of the line chairs and tables- Not the cheapo typical I wonder if this will fall apart/covered in sticky substances or the full on fancy booth style- but a comfortable sitting area where I don't feel totally out of place as a nonasian female. I loved the lunch portion for it's great price! $6.19 with a mini spring roll- Yes Please! They even added some veggies to the Sweet and Sour Chicken! The food itself (including the steamed dumplings) was very average. Nothing mouth watering or unique but still good. I have heard great things about the yum yum chicken- which I am definitely tempted to try on the next round. It took a tad longer than I was expecting to get our food- 20-30 minutes or so, making the lunch hour pretty tight. Though my fortune cookie was kinda lame ("Wish You Happiness") my overall experience was great!

Pretty good! Small little quaint place. Ordered over the phone, however they have online ordering option as well. The manager/owner was extremely nice and very friendly. We ordered the yum yum chicken (YUM, seriously, so yummy you won't regret it!), the orange shrimp (again very tasty however was a tad warm and i would have preferred if it were hotter), spring rolls (can't go wrong with these) and beef lo mein (good!). These entres came with an order of white steamed rice on the side. The price wasn't too bad compared to all the food we received. I always feel like takeout can sometimes be very expensive but this one was normally priced. Not too cheap, not too expensive. Was satisfied with the service as well as the food. Will definitely be coming back if I'm in the area!

This is definitely a place worth checking out if you're in Indy and are sick of fast food and/or meals over 2000 calories. I come from the east coast, and the food won't be revolutionary compared to what you might find in New York or Chicago. You won't find dishes drastically different from what you might be familiar with. But the service and quality are both excellent and almost guarantee a great eating experience. The place is run by the owner and his daughter, but only he was there when my group of five ate there. The restaurant is in a strip mall (as I've found much of the best Chinese food is), and has 6 four-tops and pictures of Marilyn Monroe on the walls. We walked in at 5:30 and it was empty, with one couple dining and two people waiting for carry out when we left. When we arrived the owner/chef/maitre-d/waiter came out to greet us and was very friendly. Its good the place doesn't seem to get incredibly busy, because the owner took our order very personally, asking us about spice level on a scale of 1-10 (with advice) and even engineering our meal a little bit, taking one of our dishes and recommending it as an appetizer, which turned out to be the exact right amount of food. He also made all the food fresh, most of which could be witnessed fairly easily from the dining room to the kitchen. As an appetizer we order the Yum-Yum chicken (I don't think there's a proper translation from Mandarin) which was "their specialty" (and not on the menu), a very good crispy chicken dish with what tasted like a light hoisin sauce, similar to what's put on Peking duck but not as thick. One of the people in my group ordered a wonton soup, which was also surprisingly good (as in, better than that which I get from my local take out place that I love). For dinner, we had Spicy Tofu with Vegetables (one of two vegetarian options on the menu, although I'm sure the owner could work with vegetarians to come up with more options), Singapore style Meefun noodles, Singapore style Beef, and General Tso's chicken (for one of my less adventurous friends). All the food was very high quality. A review on the wall explained that the owner can order especially good meat and maintain low prices because of the non-existant labor costs. The Meefun was definitely the best dish of the night, having a more mild but very flavorful taste and full of chicken and shrimp. The Singapore chicken was also great, which was slightly sweet. The tofu was the spiciest thing we ordered (we told him an 8 out of ten for that) and didn't disappoint. I didn't get a chance to try the General Tao's chicken, but it was finished very quickly. All in all, we had a great eating experience, leaving a big tip. If you're looking for any food in Indianapolis that isn't thoroughly unhealthy or thoroughly North American in origin, I would definitely come here for a change of pace.
Slow service but best fast Chinese food I've ever had. A tad pricier as well but worth it!

Went here based on other Yelp reviews... yep, they were right! The food is very fresh and Bobby takes pride in ordering good-quality ingredients. The fried rice is the best I have ever had. The yum-yum chicken is delicious... there is a light seasoned coating that gives it a slightly crispy bite, and not greasy in the slightest bit. A lot of care and passion goes into every dish... my suggestion: if you want carry-out, call ahead - Bobby will tell you exactly when it will be ready. I would highly recommend this place for a whimsical date... red and white checkered table cloths, pictures of Marilyn Monroe and Sinatra on the walls, and Amy Winehouse music coming from the stereo. Bobby is a natural host, and his food is delicious.

Ok...everyone was right! The Yumyum chicken was fantastic. The only thing that would have made it better would be if it was chicken breast but it's still awesome. The potstickers were very good and the crab ragoons are out of this WORLD. The homemade chili paste was great. I would have given it 3 stars alone on the guy who took the order...this guy is a gem of customer service. Extremely genuine. The cook was even saying hi to me when I walked in here. I live in Chicago but when I get back down here I will definitely try some more!

This is my go-to place for Chinese food. Everything is cooked to order, not sitting under a heat lamp. The yum yum chicken is my favorite, and they have the best crab Rangoon I've ever had. Also, the people are super nice and very Covid safe.

The best Chinese food in Indy. Started by Bobby, his nephew Ben runs the place. The portions for dinner options are huge (my wife and I can split a General Tso's) and the Yum Yum Chicken is a crowd pleaser. It might take a little while to get the food during peak hours, but if you call in carry out a little before or after a rush, you can pick up the food 15 minutes after you call. Whenever I want Chinese, I make the extra effort to get out to 56th and Lafayette for Imperial Palace.

The only place worth going for Chinese food in town. The high quality ingredients make the food taste fresh and fantastic, but Bobby is the real selling point here. he runs the place alone with his daughter. I walked in, and it was just him, puttering around in the kitchen like it was his home, singing along to Frank Sinatra. He greeted me by name (I'd ordered over the phone) and took the time to really talk to me. He knew it was my first time in, and asked what I thought. He was incredibly friendly, his food was delicious, and it was very reasonably priced. Don't waste your time going anywhere else. I'll be going back to check his more signature dishes, but his General Tsos and Vegetable LoMein were fantastic, with all the vegetables retaining their individual flavors and not being boiled away into oblivion. I've never had better.

Imperial Palace has great Chinese food! Bobby makes sure to tell you he's cooking your order/meal fresh. I've been to IP several times and it's a joy to watch Bobby do his thing on the wok! It's also kinda pleasing to hear him sing a little Frank Sinatra while he's cooking. Reasonably priced and generous portions, this is a fantastic place to eat. My favorite is the Yum Yum Chicken!

I just wanted to be one of the many people who are singing the praises of this place. Imperial Palace is an unassuming Chinese joints in the middle of a strip mall, just like a million other Chinese joints across America. Give it a chance though and you will be very impressed with the quality. Imperial Palace is a one man show, at least from what I can tell. The owner, Bobby is a really nice guy that a lot of passion for what he does. He makes an effort to get to know his customers and will remember your name if you're a regular. Even if it's you're first time there, he treats you like a long time customer, great guy. The food is wonderful. Aside from that time I had food in Chinatown in Chicago, I have never had high quality Chinese food. For the most part, it's your old standbys, but the quality of the food is a few notches above what you'd typically find in a restaurant like this. Everything just tastes so FRESH and is all cooked to order. That being said, I would recommend you call ahead. An order on a busy night can take 45 minutes to an hour Keep in mind that Bobby is the only one working. Even with the wait though, the food is WELL worth the wait. If you're unsure of what to get, I'd recommend you start with the Yum Yum chicken.
My dumplings were warmed up in the microwave. Sesame chicken tasted old. Will never eat here again.

I ordered take out and got sweet and sour chicken, hot and sour soup, and crab rangoon. Everything was great. I think the hot and sour soup was my favorite, which could have been because it was the perfect thing on a cold night. I was having kind of a "blah" day, but there's something about a tasty, hot meal that can really turn your mood around.

This is the Hot & Sour soup that I have been craving. A thick, transparent broth with not full of black pepper. The tofu in small enough pieces to eat without cutting them with a knife and the mushroom slivers firm. You don't get the heat in the first couple spoonfuls but as the soup coats your mouth you can feel it. Not annoyingly hot, just enough to wake up the taste buds. And it is only $2 for a bowl. The famous yum-yum chicken is very good if you like crispy chicken with a mildly sweet sauce. The lunch portion is very large with 2 chicken thighs made into the yum-yum, rice and a spring roll for $6 and change. Other offerings are fairly standard Americanized Chinese with Bobby's twist but he is proud of his yum-yum chicken. The vegetables on the dishes that I have had have always been fresh and not overcooked. The fried rice may throw some people. It isn't the oil and soy sauce laden fried rice like other Chinese restaurants. It is lightly sauced with a few vegetables. The rice is still fairly light and fluffy. The restaurant itself is small and has about 5 tables so it can fill up quickly. If you eat in, you will be listening to Frank Sinatra music and you will be surrounded by plants. I've only seen Bobby and another cook in the kitchen so I am assuming that things could backup a little when they are busy as they make everything fresh, but I have never had to wait long for lunch. I would not classify it as a destination restaurant but if your craving some quality American Chinese food, it's worth a try.

This is your typical Chinese American food place. I am part Chinese and know real Chinese food. There is a few real Chinese dishes you can get but they are not on the menu and if you know the owner they will make it for you. The service is always excellent though and the owner is friendly and usually knows your order when you come in. Very clean as well. The other thing is most Chinese places have their own recipes and this one does have a special general tsos tofu that is excellent.

Omg this place is so good!! Don't think I will be ordering from our old Chinese restaurant now that we tried Imperial Palace. We ordered crab rangoon, dried chili chicken, and orange shrimp. The rangoon were gigantic, as big as my hand. Nice, crunchy, and creamy. The dried chili chicken was the star of the show though. It has lots of vegetables and good quality chicken. Much better than your typical Chinese restaurant. Can't wait to try more things on the menu!!

Had dinner here with two other people on Saturday 6/20. First - the ambience is pretty low-end even for a strip mall. And they don't do free refills on drinks which I find obnoxious in our area. The food was kind of a mixed bag - the moo shu pork, yum yum chicken and potstickers were all great. The fried rice and crab rangoons were on the lower side of meh - the rangoons were about 97% cream cheese which is disappointing. However, the hot and sour soup was gross - and I mean inedible. So....I probably won't go back...but it was nice to try a new place.
Great food. Ben is very friendly. And, I love the Sinatra while I wait. My favorite Chinese carry out!

Yup, Yup! I may change my review to five stars after I've had a chance to visit again. I ordered carryout on new years day (night). We ordered the double cooked pork, beef lo mein and spring rolls. All were delicious. I had to wait a while for my order when I got there as (others have mentioned) there is only one gentleman working. Worth the wait though. He was very kind to both me and my young son...offering him a fortune cookie while we waited. The menu is small and is more traditional tasting than a strip mall Chinese spot. I will be back for seconds. As of now, it's my second favorite Chinese in Indy

Old school Chinese food and the owner cooks it himself, incredibly rare thing in the state of Indiana due to the lack of Asian population. He is extremely friendly and the only thing I can knock is the wonton soup, most places don't get it right and unfortunately this is one of them. Otherwise everything else is solid, you really can't go wrong checking this place out.
Best Chinese food on west side of Indy!! Large succulent shrimp! Always use fresh ingredients! Everything is always perfect!! We go back again and again! Never tire of it!
Small place and kind of a hole in the wall, but great food. Be ready to wait a while since he's a one man show, but worth the wait.

I have checked out this place a few times because it's so close to home. I REALLY wanted to give them raving reviews because everyone needs their go-to Chinese take out place. Sadly, this will not be mine. I've ordered different things each time I've visited Imperial palace. My son loves General Tso's chicken, so that's a given, but this didn't even pass the kid test. It was soggy, over sweetened, with two little pieces of broccoli. On another occasion, I ordered shrimp fried rice. It was literally just rice and shrimp, with some weird coating on the shrimp. On top of, let's say, average food, the price was NOT right. For a meal that would normally be $15, I paid $25. This isn't one of those instances where you get what you pay for.

Ordered togo. Called and asked about a few menu items, the man that answered the phone was very polite and informative. I ordered the hot and spicy beef, fried rice and crab rangoon. Everything was delicious! It's very close to my house, so I will be visiting often.

As the previous reviews great food. Quick service. Small seating area but very nice place. Had the sesame chicken very large portion. Very friendly staff. Definitely will stop again on my way thru Indiana.

First time here, placed a take out order at 5:30 and arrived to pick it up at 6:15 and it still wasn't ready. So if you expect fast food like most Chinese take aways do, don't go here. It really is a one man show. A group of four game in for a sit down meal and he told them it would be 1 hour and 20 mins before he could serve them. The food was good but I've had just as good made in 15 minutes. Definitely a man who takes pride in his work.

The best Chinese restaurant I've ever experienced.I am vacation here.The local food for me is really reluctant.I was missing the food from my own country very much.I asked Bobby to make special dishes for me.The food is very tasty.His skill is so amazing and he is very nice.Sorry my English is not good enough to express my thank to Bobby.

What a fun place! It's a small family-run restaurant that has incredibly endearing decor and ambiance. There are Marilyn Monroe posters on the walls, an indoor "forest" of live plants (that they always seem to be watering while I'm in there :)), and an old stereo that plays classics in the background. Last time I went was with a friend for lunch. Reasonable prices and fast service. I got the yum yum chicken, which is my usual, and it was good! Probably the best part of our experience that day was the service and kindness of the wait staff. A tucked-away gem!

We keep trying different Chinese delivery places to see if we can find anything better than our current favorite. From the reviews posted here, we thought we'd found the one. Meh... Not so much. We won't be switching from Wonder Wu though. The fried rice was better, but the General Tso's chicken was far to sweet and wangy and didn't have enough spice. Also, the chicken didn't hold up - meaning after soaking in all that sauce, it just got soggy. Soggy General Tso = Sad panda.... and hungry Amber. I mean, it was ok. The driver was very friendly and prices were competitive, but we'll be sticking with old faithful.

Every time I've gone to Bobby's (my friends and I don't know it by "Imperial Palace"), I've had to wait... but the food has always been WELL worth it! Bobby runs the show himself - waiting tables, getting drinks, cooking food, busing... he does it all! That said, you will wait, but the results are always exquisite! I once asked Bobby what the best dish on the menu was. He told me that the Yum Yum Chicken was his own unique recipe; the others were his versions of American Chinese classics. From that day on, I've always ordered it - it's wonderful: a beautiful umami flavor coupled with a mild sweetness! NOT to be missed! I've since moved from the area and don't get there as often as I'd like. Still, when I'm nearby, I try to pop in for another taste of glory...

Stopped here for lunch and had a pleasant experience. Their lunch specials are nicely priced at $6.99 which includes a spring roll. After seeing the deep, rick color of their wonton soup, I had to get a bowl to try. I felt there was a heavy sesame flavor that over powered the soup but for only $2 I am not that bothered I tried it. My lunch dish was tasty with a great level of spice - I ordered the medium. There was nothing wrong nor was there anything really great about this place for me. Perhaps I will give it another try and it will change my feelings.

Legit... Chinese invented BBQ and Fried Chicken when Anglo and Saxons were running around Europe in animal skins. Cooking in china is an apprenticeship often where a cook specializes in single dish like Peking Duck or Lions Head or Shenzhen Spare Ribs... I have a feeling the owner of this little place was trained in the east. I happened across this why meeting someone. I will return. I got the YUM YUM Chicken which reminds me of a Peking Duck version of Chicken. The skin flash fried on a roasted chicken meat that was cut and prearranged (see picture). The accompanied spring roll was never frozen. This Roll and the flaky roll was expertly completed and finished around fresh vegetable filling. The meal was surprisingly good, fresh and well presented. Gong Xie !

Wonderful food! Miss Bobby Lee the owner! His relatives are running the restaurant now! You must try yum yum chicken! Only Chinese restaurant in town that serves this! Also frequent shrimp is a must try dish also!
This place is amazing! The food is great and the service is always pleasant. I always love going here!

Love this family owned place. They remember our names, our orders and our tastes. So friendly and always chatty, even when busy, they take the time to ask about family. They buy locally and prepare (prep) daily. Very clean and always attentive to detail. Glad we found them and now we refuse to eat anywhere else!

This place is a gem. I was driving through Indy, looking for a snack, and wanted Chinese. Picked this spot for convenient location and strong yelp reviews. I got the yum yum chicken, which was obviously made to order with care, and it was a garlicky, crispy, rich and flavorful treat. The fried rice served with it was well balanced and not an afterthought. Also, the worker guy was extremely pleasant. Way beyond my expectations. Really great find!

Bobby was great and so was the food! The place is not much to look at, but Bobby and the food make up for it! Would definitely go here again. Only real disappointment was a stale fortune cookie, but I didn't have the heart to tell Bobbie!

Let me preface this review by saying most of the others have this place pegged perfectly: it's an American Chinese restaurant with good food and ASTOUNDINGLY GOOD customer service. Highlighting the latter is the sole reason for this review, but I'll throw some compliments at the food as well. I walked in with a friend from out of town, we were both feeling ravenous after a few hours of climbing. Alas, it was approaching 10PM on a weeknight - not exactly the best time to find decent grub. Imperial Palace (better called "Bobby's") was one of the few places open 'till 10, and we got there literally 5 'til. (For the record, normally avoid coming in near closing time - in this case, glad I didn't!) The parking lot was deserted, the restaurant devoid of customers and, to our chagrin, the door locked. "Better luck next time" we thought while walking away. But no! Bobby, the owner, quickly unlocked the door and let us in, explaining that he keeps it locked late at night in the interest of safety. Instead of being miffed at us for walking in so late, Bobby was both friendly and patient. We spent a few minutes eyeballing the menu and settled on a rather large order for two people: General Tso's Chicken, Shrimp Fried Rice, Sweet & Sour Chicken, Spring Rolls. After ringing us up -- but before charging my card -- Bobby said "This will be about 20 minutes - is that okay?" This floored me, not only was the guy willing to let us in almost at close, he was actually concerned about making us wait! At this point there was no question we were willing to, but our throats were a bit parched and a drink seemed in order. He suggested we walk next door to some sort of hybrid bar/restaurant, then swing by whenever we were finished with the drink. Unfortunately, the place was closed, so we returned to SG. Bobby asked what brought us back so quickly, we mentioned the closing and asked if it was okay for us to sit & chat. What happened next ranks among the best customer service I have ever received (and most certainly for anything under $$$$): while my friend & I were chatting, Bobby brought us two empty cups then set a bottle of "grape juice" next to us. "Please," he said, "Enjoy." The three of us toasted, chatted for a few minutes, then Bobby went back to making the food. It was done almost exactly 20 minutes after the time printed on my receipt. It took about as long to get back to my house, and the food was still piping hot. Everything was quite good, and a special shout-out for the spring rolls - absolutely awesome! For the service alone, this is easily my favorite Chinese place in Indianapolis. That the food is also among the best is icing on the cake.

Bobby made my day. He is great, as he is mentioned in many other reviews- I can validate he's the real deal. The food was great he cooked it fresh in front of me. The place itself is a little small but clean and decorated well. Not what I expected in a good way!
We travelled by this city and find this place. It's a small restaurant but it's delicious and size is really good for for hungers.

Just wonderful, wonderful, wonderful. I have eaten there several times. I have always enjoyed the great food I love talking with Bobby about old times in Taipei. On Friday night my GF & I went for dinner and had a great time not only was the meal wonderful but we had time to meat and talk with Bobby's nephew Ben and his wife Alice about times and places in the south of China. Just wonderful, wonderful, wonderful.

Very Americanized, not authentic at all. Good for what it is, but not as great as other alternatives around the city. If you want authentic Chinese food, avoid this place. If you are satisfied with regular General tsos chicken and sweet and sour chicken, etc, you will probably enjoy this place more than I did. Nice owner. Not that busy inside, only a couple of other customers the couple times I went.

The food was really good here! I'm really appreciative that they serve halal chicken and beef! Everything tasted amazing- especially the Kung Puo Beef! Service was also great, will definitely be coming back

The prior reviews are spot on. Well worth the extra wait for the food. Definitely our new favorite Chinese spot in Indy. Plan ahead as the wait was over an hour today for pickup (which I was told was not normal).

My first time here, went based on very favorable Yelp feedback. When we arrived at 6:00 on a Monday evening, we were the only dine-in patrons, there was one person waiting for carry-out. The owner (Bobby) was the only worker in the store, serving as cook, waiter, and everything else. I know his daughter sometimes works with him, but that may only be on busier nights. It took a while for bobby to come and take our order, as he was busy cooking a couple of take-out orders, but we were prepared for the leisurely service so no matter. We ordered a Pot Sticker appetizer, 6 large Pork based filled dumplings, and they were obviously freshly made right then - a great mix of flavors in with the pork filling. For the main courses we had Spicy Tofu with vegetables and Double Cooked Pork. Both were again excellent, with the sauces clearly very different from one another, all very fresh ingredients, and Bobby's carefully marinated and twice cooked pork in the incredibly flavorful Double Cooked Pork. If you are not concerned about fast service (but it is very friendly), and don't care about no alcohol, just want the best Chinese dishes that I have found in the Indy area, this is the place.

Ben Will meet you at the counter. He is such a truly nice guy. I order from them once a week happily. They make your order on the spot. It is always Wonderful Go try it please You won't regret it Customer as long as they are still open Tell Ben Julie says hi

This ranks as some of the best Chinese food I've ever eaten...and that's saying a mouthful! I stopped because I was hungry and it was there. Frankly, after seeing the obligatory backlit posters of food you seem to see at every Chinese take-out joint, I wasn't expecting anything other than to get full. I figured the chicken and cashews would likely be a safe bet, and got an order to go. It was outstanding, No, REALLY outstanding. I also ordered an egg roll, which was one of the worst egg rolls, outside of a Chinese buffet that I have ever had. Too much cabbage, and no peanut butter. It just tasted bitter and bland. I took off 1 star for that. Other than that mis-step, I heartily recommend this place!
Definitely going back! Food had great flavor xx especially the yum yum chicken . Also the crab Rangoon are the best I ever had.

AMAZING! Great experience. It is pricy but the portions are huge. The service was phenomenal which is unusual for a takeout Chinese restaurant. The Crab Rangoon are HUGE and delicious. The best takeout I've had.
Bobby and his family were super kind and hospitable. I arrived 15 minutes before they closed but still enjoyed my dinner. Great food and great people!

Excellent Chinese restaurant. Many of the Chinese restaurants serve similar, if not identical, menus. What makes this place different? The service! Ben is an amazing owner and takes care of each customer who walks through his door. The dishes are prepared when you order so you know you're getting the freshest food. Spice levels are excellent as well. I'm so happy that I chose to eat here and look forward to coming back soon!

I recently started working on the west side again. I've now made this stop part of my weekly lunch rotation. The owner, Ben is so kind and the food is awesome! They will be getting my business for sure!!
Yum yum chicken is amazing. The crab Rangoons are the best I've ever had. This is just flat out good food made with good ingredients. Been coming here for over 10 years. Solid every time.

Nice place for a good filling American Chinese fusion lunch. We ordered spice level of 6 (on a scale of 1-10). I would say the spice was reasonable and we could have actually asked for 8. The highlight was Garlic Chicken, possibly due to my Asian roots - packed a punch with garlic, sauce and veggies. The garlic and orange chicken come with a side of steamed or plain fried rice. Hot and sour soup had a unique flavor - which was neither too spicy nor too warm - just the right touch. All in all good good at a very reasonable price - definitely recommend. They do serve halal - chicken and beef only.

Decided to give this place a try for lunch today since it's not far from where I work. I got the Yum Yum Chicken based on other reviews, and I was not disappointed! Some of the best chicken I've had! I'm not sure what the sauce is with it, but it was delicious, and the chicken was nice and crispy on the outside & juicy inside. I enjoyed the fried rice mixed with the leftover sauce. The spring roll was also surprisingly good, since I'm used to the very "blah" ones from other Chinese places. Delicious and also nice & crispy on the outside. I will definitely be back!
Had lunch today...yum yum chicken. Tasty! Very friendly staff and reasonable lunch prices.

We went for lunch because how do you say no to $6 lunch specials?! Amazing!They make it super spicy if you ask them to so that was a huge plus for me. Best of all, their chicken and beef is from the halal section in restaurant depot-yes it's halal!!!

I went to Imperial Palace based on its rating. Numerous people said nothing but good things about the restaurant, so I had to see what they hype was about. I ordered Yum Yum Chicken and it was all that and more - delicious. My friend got general tso's chicken and was not impressed, however. Their food is good - but nothing that I haven't seen before at any other chinese restaurant in the area.
If it's Chinese we're craving, Imperial Palace is where it's at! One of our favorites is the peppered steak. They make everything fresh daily, and the service is fantastic.

We came here for dinner at the invitation of a friend who is a lifelong fan, and I can certainly appreciate the charm of this place. The famous Bobby apparently still owns the restaurant, but it is managed by another family member who is very friendly and helpful. The food was excellent, especially the General Tso's chicken and hot and sour soup. We did not like the Mongolian beef as much, but really appreciated being able to choose your own spice level. The fried and steamed rice were both great, and the spring rolls were solid. The service was wonderful, although I understand they do a brisk carry out business as well. All in all, we really enjoyed our visit here and recommend this place to anyone looking for good American Chinese food.

Imperial Palace is available for delivery to us through DoorDash. We stumbled upon it when we were discontent with previous delivery options. We found this to be a cut above your typical small-scale Chinese restaurant cuisine. The ingredients are fresher, the fishes more flavorful, and the options a bit more unique. The Yum-Yum chicken more than lives up to its name, and I find myself craving more than I should. Their egg rolls are meaty and taste like they are made by someone who is proud of their food. This has become our go-to place for quick/delivery Chinese food and I'm confident it will be for you too.
