The wife and I have been coming here for years. I have to say the most consistent sushi experience I've ever been to. Killer shrimp, Arizona and Mexican rolls are a must!! A little expensive but for what you get it is well worth it. Owners are so nice, British guy up front rocks. This is truly a hidden gem of conshohocken!!! Quality, good music, booths for seating what else do you need??
Conshohocken DESPERATELY needs a good sushi restaurant. This place is way overpriced and not very tasty.

This is one of my go-to sushi place. I wouldn't necessarily recommend dining in because it appears to be more of a take-out place which I actually prefer. I love the variety they have but I must say my favorite is the tornado out of the special rolls and spicy tuna from the regular roll menu.

Not that many Sushi places in Conshy that I would trust...Actually I only know of 2 and one is kinda sketchy. So guess how pleased I was when Happy Maki kicked out some stupid school of dance and decided to serve their delicious Bento boxes. I do get that it is a little pricey but would you really eat "cheap" sushi? The inside is very well done for primarily a take out place, and the staff is very friendly. If you have more than 3 people I really wouldn't suggest eating in but thats up to you... The Bento box is the best bang for your buck and my go to. Like Alexandra said its probably not an 2-3 times a week thing, but definitely 2-3 times a month when you get the craving for some sushi thing.
Fresh sushi and always tasty! Very nice place for a quick lunch or a small get together. The decor is cozy an inviting. Don't forget to check out the special of the day!

Happy maki is one of the best sushi places nearby. The service is always nice. And Gi, the cook, is the nicest guy ever, he always makes conversation. They treat regulars really nice here. I always feel at home and comfortable. It's more of a cafe place, so you go up and pay before you sit down and the food is served. There's rarely a wait for dine in as it is more of a take out kind of place. There are special rolls each day that are 2 dollars off. My favorites include the rose roll, the flaming (great for spicy-food lovers), and the tiger. Their spicy chicken teriyaki rice bowl is amazing too. I believe if you go during lunch hours, there are lunch sushi specials that include a cooked and fresh roll for 10$.

I love this place. Conshy is lacking in sushi spots but I've always been happy with happy maki :) Favs include the sushi pizza, Flaming roll, green dragon roll, tiger roll - although they are all great. I usually get two special rolls and while it is pricey it's so good. I have found that other sushi in the area (the general, guppies, kabuki, wild rice, even nectar) offer sub par special rolls. They cost more and aren't as interesting. Happy maki has a ton of options and they don't skip on ingredients or portions. The only comparable place is Woojung, but Happy Maki is much more convenient. It's always been fresh and quick. I think this place has a lot of haters - maybe it's because it's in a strip mall, but don't be fooled, it's great sushi!!

The food is absolutely outstanding! There rice bowls are made to perfection with a flavor that reminds from first bite to last. If you are not sure what to get, the staff is very helpful with there recommendations. Lunch or dinner, just can't beat it.

Basics: tofu salad a bit watery. Crispy tempura Roll was lean, very very very stingy w/ the wasaby & Ginger. The nigiri was good. The $ 34.00 price tag was out of control. Trying to order more food @ 1 minute to 9 ended in them telling me they had already closed. Next time I'll drive the 11 miles to bonjung and not have regrets.

Good times! My wife found this place and I will say that if you're looking for a high end sushi place this is not it. If you're looking for something to grab on the way home and don't want to break the bank it's perfect!

The sushi is alright but the prices are crazy high. The food is very fresh but the rolls are very small. I can't say I would go back. So many other options with reasonable prices. It's kinda a fast food place because you order at the counter. No idea why they charge so much.

Happy Maki is an oasis in a desert of boring suburban food offerings. As far as quality and taste of rolls go, they are right up there with even the nicest sit-down sushi restaurants in Philadelphia. With quick service and no waiters, it's an interesting way of doing sushi, however, don't be fooled by the laid back ambiance. I suggest the Hiyashi roll and TNT. As a regular at Happy Maki, I really noticed how the sauces on some of the appetizers and rolls simply can't be found anywhere in Philly, let alone the east coast. Many of the rolls and appetizers seem to be totally unique to Happy Maki. The Korean/Japanese hot food is really tasty too. Overall, the fast service, authentic ambiance, and most importantly the quality food gets a five-star from me!

I came here to grab a dinner to take with me on the road, and, as implied by the name, was definitely expecting some happiness when I opened the bag during a rest stop on I-95. For what I paid (~$13) for a California roll and an eel roll (8 pieces each), I was waiting for something beyond the average supermarket sushi. That failed to materialize and I had to resign myself to the fact that I had overpaid for some mediocre sushi. Truly, you are better off getting sushi next door at Genuardi's for approximately 2/3 of the cost (and almost 1.5 times the portion). Not that the sushi isn't decently edible, but it was not worth the price.

The staff at this store are the absolute opposite of what you should expect to find at an all-organic market. While sitting in my car waiting for the store to open I watched the employees as they arrived to work. One extremely unkempt looking guy smoked his cigarette all the way up to the door and then threw the still-smoking butt on the sidewalk. Then came a girl smoking her vape as she entered the store. Inside, I found the store to have a bizarre smell and a weird vibe. The employees seem miserable and so does this store.

All the produce is organic which is enough to get a 5 star review from me and not true of other health food stores (whole foods). If you are looking for something specific outside of produce (beyond meat for example) you may have to look elsewhere but this place is really a gem

Stopped in quick to pick up a few things for supper. I have not been in this store for over a year. I was Shocked to see the fresh collard greens, 5 wilted stakes in each bunch, and the price $$$. Then to the salad counter, a young man looked right at me, "do you need help" I replied yes, and he never returned. The staff is far from friendly, produce and salad bar, I rate a 1 Star. I'm sorry I stopped in, what a waste of time. I will continue to go to "Rollin Oats Weekly" where customer service is 5 Stars, produce is Fresh and not wilted, salads crisp and fresh.
Expensive. Supposed to be a health food store, but most food sold contains PUFA Canola or Sunflower oil. Where can real, non-GMO, unprocessed food be found these days?

Everytime I go here something I've selected "rings up incorrectly" I would shop here all the time if I could afford it but there prices are so high compared to over health food stores organic variety I've even seen the price doubled. I bought an organic cran juice here $12 Publix same thing $6. Disappointing and therefore I'm really cautious when I go here and make sure the items I pick up get correctly scanned and aren't price gauged.
I always love to check out the food here. I always wind up leaving with a few scrumptious meals worth.

I was looking for a little treat and decided on some gummies in the bulk section which were pretty good but when I went to finish my snack A DAY later a maggot or worm of some type was inside the bag crawling out of a gummy...? Also the bag was closed so I don't think it crawled in? I don't think maggots usually breed in one day (unless of course they do?) so that was kinda gross to see. I think perhaps they need to monitor their bulk section freshness more carefully. However besides that incident I would go back again but maybe just not to the bulk section.

The customer service at Earth Origin's is amazing! Everyone is so friendly and helpful. If you need something, they really go the extra mile. I also love that they offer so much organic produce that is not wrapped in plastic. This is a great place to go grocery shopping.

For a specialty grocer and deli, it's rather dirty. The deli section in the back with the trays of salads is filthy. Maybe all delis are, but maybe better at keeping it hidden. Not here. Yikes! Much of what makes a specialty organic store unique (and essential) is its offering of select products you just can't find anywhere else. Nature's Finest could put all those things it offers uniquely in one or two aisles. The majority of the store is stuff (surrounding the unique items) you'd find at the Publix...only here you'll just pay more.

The location of this store and the visibility of the signage from Central Avenue is excellent, in addition the organization of the vitamins (easy to find) and general store layout is well organized. There are interesting magazines. They have a delicious turtle bar. That is all I am going to say that is positive. The staff needs help. There is a Save Away near my house, a very interesting discount grocery...the staff at Save Away can teach Earth Origins people customer service, accuracy and kindness. The staff at Earth Origins seem highly distracted and not involved in their job. I have had one sales staff look annoyed because I have asked for a location of a product. The deli counter is a snail council. The men who work there who have hair down to their waist should tie it back, there is a salad bar and the food is exposed. Product selection all around can be improved. The prices are similar to Manhattan high end organic store, but it is the staff that is the problem. They need to appreciate their jobs, make eye contact, smile, know their product and move with energy. I am going to Rollin' Oats from now on, Earth Origins has enough of my money and after the terrible service I received today I am not returning.

Every time I'm in St. Petersburg this is one of the stores I frequent. They have a great selection of foods that I enjoy. They carry vegan products as well, in addition to bakery vegan items. They also have prepared foods and a salad and hot food bar. I will continue to shop here when in the area.

Earth Origins has a wonderful selection of natural and organic foods. What I want to know is why the employees, especially the cashiers, are always so sullen and rude? No matter what time of day I go into the store, they carry on their conversations with each other rather than ringing up customers standing at their registers. Most cashiers at other stores ask if you found things you wanted to buy, or have some other greeting; these employees just ring your items in and expect you to know when they finish and look at the screen to see how much you owe. EO is the closest grocery store to my home and has the cleanest selection. I really want to go here to do my shopping, but the entire experience is offputting. I don't know the source of their apparent unhappiness. Are they generally unhappy people? Or is the working environment such that they just don't like their jobs? Either way, I won't go to EO unless I am strapped for an item I can't find somewhere else or need in a timely manner.

Update: Their customer friendliness has improved substantially, thank you. You're now acknowledged, greeted, smiled at, etc. The Juice bar area, while improving from more options/Acai bowls, etc, is still painfully slow, painfully. Additionally when (2) employees are in the area (5'x5') there is not sufficient counter space for 2 people to prep the product, so the customers again experience further delay. I like the ocassional sales/discounts I've seen at the deli counter. Keep up the improvements, we appreciate it. I've upped 2 stars to 3.

Visited today for first time and was not impressed. I could not find anyone to help me and when I asked a cashier to assist me a tall guy came out of back very disheveled. He asked me what I was looking for and when I told he he said it would be on a particular isle. After I stated I couldn't find it he stated " if it's not there we don't have it" really?? I left the store with items left in cart.
They offer great vegetarian dishes/salads.
Nice healthy market! Great options and variety! Ordered from the deli a creamy penne shrimp pasta. It was amazing!

Excellent lunch at Earth Origins today! I ate instead the store while running errands! Such a kind staff all the time and delicious food made right in front of you :) I would highly recommend this to friends for a local store and food on the go!

If you've been to Natures Food Patch in Clearwater, this is a near (smaller) duplicate of it, however Earth Origins is severely lacking in 3 important areas: 1. Customer service: Not friendly (no smiles, no hellos, no nothing), not knowledgeable, not accessible (10 minutes to find someone who knows where something is), and the Deli/Juice bar service is painfully slow, I've had hundreds of fresh juices made in my lifetime- nowhere else does it take as long as it does here. Numerous times myself and other customers have given plenty of "eye signals" to each other over the obscene amount of time accruing while we waited for our orders to be filled. 2. Hot/Cold Bar: The food is literally like a school caffeteria's, in the respect that there is no flavor on anything I've tried, and I've sampled the whole bar. For the prices charged, step it up guys. Also, how about NO CANOLA OIL.. for the premium you charge- try to an oil that doesn't double as insect repentant. 3. Pricing: Yeah, we get it: Organic/Natural comes at a premium, but even in comparison to Natures Food Patch, and Whole Foods, this place is over priced. You'd literally think that there is no management in this place, because if there was, it would be very evident that this whole establishment misses the mark on many levels, and I'd presume management would address this. This is very fixable, but please, fix it. Before we give up on you.

Employees were very friendly.Tried & purchased a few deli items that were yummy, but wish they had a larger selection. Closest thing I've found to a Whole Foods or Central Market in this area so far. A bit pricey on most items. Will shop there again.

Earth Origins is a great little neighborhood organic market. I really appreciate the quality of their produce and the wide range of raw nuts they carry. Each time I visit, I always stop at the juice bar and get fresh veggie juice. They put apple, beets, ginger (hold the garlic), and a number of green veggies into it. It tastes so good, I sometimes just go there to get the juice. I think their prices are a little high for the vitamins, but in a pinch, I can always find what I need. The salad bar is also nice and the new cafe offers a place to sit and eat your lunch. The proximity of the store to the Pinellas Trail is convenient for a quick healthy food stop while you are out riding during the day. ABC Bikes is right next door so you can also stop and get some new gadgets for your bike while you're there.

Went in for lunch after school around noon. I've eaten here many times from their hot-bar and cold-bar (prepared foods section), but today was too out of this world not to mention. I brought home their blackened salmon and also a small cup of eggplant lasagna, and I feel like both were so excellent that it's not fair to the rest of my life! And together was only $7.. Also walked out with a Justin's dark chocolate organic peanut butter cup! :) (wayy better than Reese's cups might I add)

My wife and I shop here occasionally and today while shopping we heard and then saw someone COUGHING 3 separate times into the open air (not trying to cover his mouth)within about a minute. We looked to see who it was so we could stay away and we found out it was a STORE EMPLOYEE next to the prepared food counter who was NOT WEARING A MASK or face shield! I told the manager and she went to talk to him and I heard him start yelling "who told you. Point them out to me" I was a couple aisles over and he came up to my wife and I now wearing a FACE SHIELD (still no mask). He was very confrontational with us trying to explain he ate a cookie and was chocking on a nut that was in it. We didn't see him eating anything and we were there for a while. He was scanning products on a cart and was standing near the back of the store which he could have easily exited to cough. He kept following us down the aisle yelling. He told us he is the healthiest person on planet and takes 60 pills a day and he is not sick. We finally went back to the manager who pointed us out to him and she just said sorry. She handled the situation very poorly by allowing him to confront us. She kept saying she will talk to him. We won't be coming back. There are many other health food stores that take COVID19 seriously where we feel much safer. We never write reviews unless they are positive but this was absolutely not okay during a global pandemic!

I frequent the store for lunch. The prices are higher than in other health stores,but they have good deals every week, when you can get really good deals. Also, every Wednesday is 10% off on everything. I like the hot bar and the smoothies they make. Chocolate delight smoothie is really good They usually have a smoothie of the month for a lower price!

I'll give a more in-depth review later, but I saw the average 3-star rating and had to respond. This is a 4 & 1/2 star (I don't give 5 stars on anything) or I don't know organic food stores. I have eaten exclusively organic since about 1980! Great little store that has virtually everything. Clean and the beautiful produce section. (Okay, so never mind on the produce section. Maybe I caught them on a bad day. My recollections were from a couple of visits in early 2018. Went today. The fruits and vegetables are bruised and a little beyond their shelf life). Everything else is still great.

The staff here is argumentative, unhelpful, and arrogant. I live less than two miles from this store and have stopped going there as the staff is so unfriendly. I like to go where people are happy to help me spend my money. What is the problem here? Why are you all so unhappy?

I have been going to Earth Origins for 15 years. One of the main reasons I go there is because of the supplements manager, Jeff. I've been thriving post osteosarcoma for 24 years and live a very organic, alternative/holistic life in regards to caring for myself. Jeff's knowledge of the supplement industry is excellent, stellar, professional and on point in every facet. I have lots of questions because I'm so diligent about how I support my health and Jeff ALWAYS gives me a thorough education to every question I have. There have been times where he has painstakingly done individual research for me making sure I'm receiving the correct information to make an informed decision. He has also gone above and beyond to complete special orders for me to get certain products in so that I have it at my convenience. I've watched him with other customers and his staff as he treats each individual with respect and professionalism. He is a hard working concerned manager as are the terrific knowledgeable staff he supervises. I highly recommend this store for the wealth of knowledge in the supplements department.

This is a very nice health food market with a good food bar (including shrimp and chicken dishes). The hot foot area was mostly picked over when I was there, so maybe it's really good too? They have a nice dining area section. They have some good offerings including Brown Cow yogurt and other specialty brands that are worth discovering. There is a surfboard shop, bicycle store next door (and across the street), and the Kraft Cafe is opening up next door so this is a cool spot to be sporty, eat well, and live well. :)

Becky made the best Vegetarian Parmesan Chicken I have ever had!!! The veggies were excellent also. They had a special of $6.99 for a main dish and two sides. Nice portions also, you can't get a healthy meal like this for that price anywhere, ready to go for when you are on the run. Highly recommend Earth Origins and their cook Becky!!!
Ordered two smoothies here... were good, but a little pricy. I do enjoy this store and if it is an independent market, more power to them.

I stop in almost everyday to grab a lunch plate out of the hot case. The selection is always diverse and healthy! The staff is great and the food is even better!! I recommend this place to anyone interested in a fresh and healthy option when in the South Pasadena area. - Ben

This is where I grocery shop if I'm trying to feel like a real fancy lady. I'll usually wear my 1 piece of Lilly Pulitzer clothing, and desperately try to keep my sunglasses on for the full shopping excursion. It's always a fun little shop. It's not like this grocery store is anything over the top it's just classic. It's been around forever. Like before health food was mainstream enough to be in a 7/11. Their produce is amazing, to die for, gorgeous. The hot bar is stocked with cool foods! And their sushi? Woah boy, it's a good time. All this ~amazing-ness~ does come with a price tag. It is certainly a more expensive grocery haul. For example I recently purchased maple syrup...it cost $17.00 :-) LOL (so yes, it was the pure stuff, the stuff Ina Garten swears by, but still). The store is small and incredibly curated. They do have a rewards system. So if you shop here regularly you can probably expect to earn a few bucks off each trip.
a natural paradox, (opposite of what you would expect) great product selection but no safety measures being followed consistently in the deli!!!

Listen, I love Earth Origins for the product selection and fairly priced smoothies! With some better cleaning procedures and employees that aren't so off putting this would easily be a 5 star review. I come here 2+ times a week. 1. It's dirty!!! The spot behind the counter where they make their smoothies and juices is always FILTHY. Once my friend found a flying bug in their salad. I don't care too much about these things. It happens and a little grime and a bug isn't gonna kill anyone. It wasn't until I am visiting the bathroom 7 months pregnant and I pull the changing table down out of curiosity and it's dirty as heck!!! 2. they changed their pasta salad and chicken salad. WHYYYY!!! It was the main reason I shopped here. 3. The staff are comically rude and sullen! Like it's literally comical at this point. Why are they so unhappy?? It's been like this for years.

I was so excited to see Earth Origins market when we first moved to this area and soooo disappointed when I actually shopped there. I've been there twice now. Like every other produce department in TB they think nothing of presenting ROTTEN produce for sale all prettied up in styrofoam and plastic wrap. I just don't get it. I would shop here for pantry items ONLY and bring your checkbook 'cause it's gonna cost ya! Back to Publix for reliable GMO produce that at least is not rotten and still has some nutritional value. Next year, I put in a garden! I guess I compare every FL organic market to Native Sun in Jacksonville and this ain't it!
Love the Hot Bar-- Chef Ms. Betty is the best. Only problem is deciding what to have! Bison Burger today, Meat Loaf tomorrow. Fish is always excellent!! Love the Tuna Fish too...
A face shield is not a mask. How are people thinking this is okay? Shocked that they think it's totally okay for an employee to walk around with just a face shield.

As soon as you walk in, any person use to the aroma most organic stores/markets has will feel the nostalgia and satisfaction that this is a legit place. They have great choices in food. Very well in stocked. They have a lot of items you won't find at Trader Joes, Whole foods, Henry's, or etc. But it's the same for the latter as well. I enjoyed their unique selections of food and very friendly staff.
I threw out every piece of overpriced fruit I bought here. Fruit rotted before it ripened. Will never shop here again.

Earth Origins has a pretty good salad bar and prepared foods section. They have a lot of organic produce, and vegan options such as vegan cheese, vegan sour cream, and many meat substitutes. While Earth Origins does have a lot of options, they are extremely expensive and I have seen a few things that they also have at the regular supermarket almost double the price. I usually go here if I need one or two specialty items, or I wanna grab some vegan potato salad or use their salad bar, however, I wouldn't recommend doing some serious grocery shopping unless you have lots and lots of money to spend on groceries.

Stopped in tonight to check the place out. We were quite surprised to see how large the place was and to see how large the selection was. They had just about everything you could ask for from a health food store. The produce looked quite fresh and was almost all organic. They had a hot line, deli line, as well as a small salad bar. It also had a decent sized market with health oriented offerings. You really couldn't ask for much more.

I love this place. Good or bad, I cannot add anything that someone else has already said but this: the reviews would IMPROVE to hire a complete staff of people who are the same kind of people who would actually shop there themselves. My theory regarding the rudeness that is reported in some reviews is these are staff who don't get the importance or the value of this store and therefore couldn't give a shite regarding the store's customers, their needs, or the reason the store should exist other than to provide them a paycheck, however meager that might be as a grocery clerk. Earth Origins management - PLEASE for the sake of the store, its mission, and its customers, stop hiring people who would never shop there and who would far sooner go to Wally World for their groceries. This store needs to be staffed ENTIRELY by people who care about its mission. If the management does not fit this profile either, well there you go. The owner(s) of the store need to pay a little more and hire people who truly care in the same way that the die-hard regular customers here care about this store, its mission, and its offerings.

I was absolutely excited to find a local store that sold all of my fave items until I actually shopped here. Customer Service the worst I've experienced in St. Pete area overall! No one spoke, they all looked at me as if I shouldn't be shopping there, and the finale at the register was when the cashier tuned out to watch the television behind me in the cafe area. She noticed my irritation, giggled, apologized, yet continued to watch it. No Way will I support it.
This is a well stocked, organic neighborhood market. Hey also have a takeout department. Try a smoothie yum. Please support our local businesses. This one definitely deserves our support.

Recently new to shopping at whole food stores and have found Earth Origins to be a very great place to shop. The staff is very friendly and quick to offer their assistance, even the customers offer their recommendations and assistance. The variety of products for purchase is outstanding. Like most healthy eating shops or products, the price are somewhat high which forces you to be mindful when shopping. Weekly deals or specials help curb this a little. Overall, a very nice store with a wide variety of products to choose from with a very friendly staff.

Nature's Finest is an organic grocery store that also has a deli counter inside where you can get sandwiches to go. I've never really been a huge organic food eater, but this place is where you'd go if you were. They even sell organic pet food, which I find a little funny. They have lots of products I've never even heard of from hemp soaps to fancy oatmeals. Everything your average grocery store would carry but in organic form. They also have a salad bar where you can prepare a salad in the store and take it out to go style. It's a neat place to spend a few hours of your afternoon if you've never seen lots of organic products together. The staff is generally helpful and appear like "earth-biscuits'' themselves (a nickname one of my english professor's used)- long hair and dreads mostly.

If you want a pretty wide selection of organic produce, ranging from onions, potatoes, and squash to leafy greens such as kale, spinach, and dandelion, this place beats the others in this county. They even have sunflower sprouts and other hard to find items that can really provide a new and interesting twist on your organic meal.

I have been here many times over the years but since it's a bit further than other healthy grocers, I don't go as often. With that said, I went recently and I think it's better than it was in the past. The vegetable and fruit department has definitely taken a step in the better direction. Everything was beautiful, organic, priced well and super clean. I think they have overhauled the place a bit and cleaned it up and it shows. Kudos for that. They have 3 aisles of every natural homeopathic herb and pill you can imagine. They have a very clean and nice looking salad bar which was consistently cleaned and added to when I was there. They have a wonderful juice bar with a very helpful hipster cutie. He was very knowledgeable made me want to hang out and do shots with him. Wheat grass shots, that is. They have a fantastic frozen foods section and even a very large pet section which was nice. I am always whining and complaining that we don't have a Trader Joe's here. This is pretty close (NOT PRICE WISE BUT PRODUCT WISE). I would recommend them more now than I would have in the past and it's nice to see a store get better than get worse over the years.

Stay healthy better quality of life, this is a place to be. Even I not that conscious about the choice of material or ingredients of food, I shop at this place some time. The Earth Origins Market sound correctly and earthy for the product they have carry. From the organic produce to organic raise meat selections, provide variety of value food. It has all natural cookies- Mmmm yum. It has selection of salad bar if you just has one person portion for a night. The hot deli has good choice if you decide not to cook. For ice cream- ice cream? It has the talent I gelato. Not many place sell this this ice cream. The place is not packed in the morning and easy to shop. It almost like has the whole place for yourself. The fresh produce is great, the organic powder for cooking is better. It close to the beach and good for the vacationers stay at the hotel with kitchen want to cook themselves.
Awesome grocery store with you know, food & stuff. I would visit more often if I repaired that starter on my car. It's a bit far to walk here from beach apt.

I had an amazing experience the other day while shopping here. The cashier greeted me upon enterin Earth Origins and as I shopped it was non-stressful and non crowded (for once). The shelves were organized nicely and the fridge stocked again with my fav beverages. The salads were prepared in nice takeaway boxes and were affordably priced. When I was checking out, Grace who was my cashier was so very nice and happy! It made a huge difference in the typical check out process. It's great to see people making the best out of their day, enjoying their job and making people smile!

I visit this place at least once a month. When I'm here I head to the hot and salad bar. The food is always fresh and good. You have to be extremely careful of how much you put on your plate because it adds up. I love their vegan cookies. I also like $5.00 sushi on Friday's.

If I had to make a comparison, this is the Winn-Dixie of health food stores. You're glad it's there, the lights are on, there's customer service and samples...it works! The prices aren't as sky-high as I've seen, there is a very decent-sized by-the-pound dry food section and herb section, a large frozen food section, a good amount of produce packed into a small section, a salad bar, and a deli with lots of options. Hey - it even tastes pretty good! There's a little dining area crammed off to the side of the cash registers with a flat screen TV where you can eat your vegan ice cream in relative peace.

Love the natural and organic food selections - and the available meat/deli ones too (those can sometimes be hard to find). Prices are not as competitive as Rollin Oats or TJ's but they are still comprable when you think of the gas you spend to drive to either. I'm not sure how I didn't realize how close I was. Wish they pushed reusable bags/recycling a little more too.
Very polite and professional staff. Food is always good. And a big plus, staff wore masks. The coffee is delicious and they have a great salad bar and deli.

I really like this health food store. They have good selection of already made healthy food and it's good. I really like there chicken curry salad.They also have good desserts. The flourless chocolate cake is on point. They have veg juice at a reasonable price. They have a wide selection of herbs and vitamins. The staff is very knowledgeable. The prices are average and there is aways enough parking. You can get in and out fast.

found this great store thru Groupon, can't believe never went here before. Large store with HUGE inventory of vitamins, love their bulk foods section,fresh veggies were so so in my opinion, bought items from their deli, enjoyed that very much, staff very helpful n know their stuff. go there on a regular basis now n is next door to O's Bistro which is a spiffy dining destination as well, well worth the time to shop here

is there anything harder to write a review of than a grocery store? i mean seriously, what do you say? they have produce, they have groceries, you check out etc. that being said, nature's finest is my grocery store in st pete. it's a pretty small store and the selection is limited for sure, but for people with special diets, especially vegan or vegetarian diets the place is a godsend. the frozen section has more "fake meat" style comfort food than you can shake a stick at. this alone gets it 4 stars. the grocery section is small but most of it contains a lot of vegan friendly foods. expect to pay though. almost everything is organic and branded so nothing is really cheap. also, if you are into vitamins and supplements at least 1/4 of the store is give over to those so there is no shortage of stuff to check out there (i buy all of my plant protein powder here.) the produce is really nothing special, and i suspect you could do matter at the saturday market, even though i have never been so in a nutshell....looking for organics and lots of them or vegan type food, go here. not looking for that....go to publix and save $$

The cashier with long gray hair and long denim skirt is such an unhelpful mean person. Corporate really needs to be aware how rude this older woman is to their customers. I will not ever shop here again because of her.
Had lunch at the prepared foods bar, Chef Becky helped me out with the many choices they had there. The food was awesome!!

Great Natural Food store and Deli in St. Pete. Good prices, amazing food and salad bar. Favorite salad is veggie crunch. Wouldn't go anywhere else in town for supplements--this place is way lower than Rolling Oats and even comes close to online prices, and you have them in your hands right away.

Retail Indifference. Employees are reflective of management or visa versa. This store/restaurant has health food and a restaurant but it's the employees who make the experience unpleasant. There is no greeting. No thank you. It has all the health store bells and whistles except for the people thing. Save your money and schelp across town to Rolling Oats. Now your talking about a great experience.

The place has improved it's physical space but Rcustomer service is totally unprofessional and at times just plain rude. I shop here because it is close. They need an attitude improvement. They may need to take a lesson from Rolling Oats.

Maybe my expectations were too high, but I wasn't all that impressed with this market. Before I talk about what I don't like, I will first say that the people working there are very helpful and friendly. There is a great selection of organic nuts and grains and ethnic food you will not find in regular supermarkets. The problem I have is mainly the prices. Not the prices for specialty items, but the items you can find at your local Publix but for two or three dollars more on average. That's not a good look... The produce didn't look all that fresh and the prices were again high. No reason to pay these prices when you can get better quality fruits and veggies elsewhere much cheaper. Will I ever come here again? Maybe, but I certainly won't go out of my way when there are better options in the area. It's a shame because it is Very close to where I live.

I've been craving Synergy Kombucha (Guava Goddess) for months. I was so excited to find a health store close by which carried it so I bought a case of the stuff. I'm in heaven now. Nature's Finest is fine. Great staff, wonderful selection of products and a kick-ass deli. I had the Hot Deli combo with a wonderfully tender BBQ chicken thigh, black beans and a Spinach/Rice casserole. They have a decent bulk section and a raw food section. AND they have my favorite Greek Yougurt. It was like seeing old friends again. I'll be coming back here often!

I've shopped here for many years before the name change. I don't go as often as I would like since a distance from my house. Everyone that works here has always been friedly and helpful. They have good salads in the cold cases and a great salad bar. The produce is also very good. My one complaint is that it is pretty dirty. I bought items from the bulk food bins and it was filthy. Like it has not been wiped down and anything washed in a very long time. In addition the scale and the floor were also very dirty. I went over to the cold case and there was a dead fly laying on top of the hunmus. There needs to be some serious cleaning going on in this store. The cleanliness is my only issue.
Fun place, big selection of high quality products. The size of the store is perfect, we went in found all we in for plus some all done in 10 minutes. Friendly helpful staff , clean organized store.
You just get a bad vibe when you go in.Some staff members are helpful some are really not.That's if you can find someone.I only go there if I really have to.
My favorite grocery store to go to. The employees are very kind. They have a great selection of fruits and vegetables.
Good selection of healthy and organic foods...not too bad in price on some items. More convenient location than whole foods. Will visit here often.

I would give this a much higher rating if it weren't for one thing - You really have to pay attention at the cash register. Far too many times incorrect prices comes up. Or if things are on sale - sometimes the sale price doesn't come up. Also the prices marked on shelves/frozen food cases are not always accurate. I have spoken to them numerous times about this - but always get the same story about how this is a problem with corporate and they really can't do anything about it. I literally have to watch every item as it is rung up. This is not just an occasional thing. It happens far too often. I have resigned myself to the fact that I have to pay close attention to what I'm being charged. It does get frustrating some times. But the store is convenient and they have great promotions. So if you have the patience to make sure you are not being overcharged then I recommend it.

This grocery store has some great stuff; It offers great, different deals every month, plus 10% off every Wednesday. Get the reward card and they will send you discount via email up to 15% off , and sometime 10$ coupons. This place has almost all the produce organic. It can be pricey if you don't plan your grocery list at home.

This is your run of the mill organic, hippie earth-muffin grocer. If I recall correctly, it's part of a small chain, so I can't exactly call it independent. I've been in twice now - once for lunch via the salad bar and a rotisserie chicken, and once for some produce that I couldn't find at Publix. The chicken was generic and the salad bar had a lot of fresh offerings to pick and choose from. It's definitely a bit more pricy than regular grocers, but if you're dead-set on organic and you're on that side of town, it makes sense. The little dining area was clean and simple. I wouldn't want to really hang out there, but it works for grabbing a bite while on the go. It was a little iffy for service in trying to pin someone down to help with a decision on powder supplements for my friend. The woman working that area was really engrossed with talking to a couple and it was futile getting anyone else to really get an answer. Basically, it's fine for me if I'm in the area and want that sort of thing, but I'm not going out of my way.

This place has been around since the 90s. I watched it go from KashNKarry to Nature's Finest Foods and now Earth Origins. To be honest, it's always been a dirty craphole. Lately though, not only is it as dirty as an off brand 7/11, the people who work there are nasty. I'm just curious if rolling your eyes at customers is standard for this place? I simply said excuse me to one tall, long haired gal and she rolled her eyes at me and sighed loudly... Like my very presence was causing her agony. Seriously, get a grip. You get paid to work, so try not to be a See You Next Tuesday. Being nice to your customers isn't hard. In fact, I was actually standing 3 feet away from the product I needed (and had to find myself) so it would have taken her about 2 seconds to show me. On to the checkout, where one lane for a bunch of people buying a weeks worth of groceries were checking out... And I guess I just have crappy luck, because someone didn't come relieve the solitary cashier until I had already put my stuff down. So the customers behind me rushed the new lane and nothing was said.
Love this store. Great selection of organic fruits and veggies. Incredible vegan food choices. Everything is fresh. Even have amazing vegan dessert choices. The staff is friendly and helpful.
complete health food store I can find everything here I want/need. Good selection of just about everything.

This place is a dump. Don't waste your time. Maybe I'm spoiled with Natures Food Patch in north county (lovely) but I doubt it. Dirty, grimy and overall icky vibe. I was waiting for roaches to show up everywhere I looked. The staff was friendly and knowledgeable but that isn't enough to win me over. I will never return and I can't understand how anyone spends money there.
Great variety of products, terrible customer service. I asked about a food product and got a shoulder shrug and was told to look in grocery.
Fresh extracted juice from the juice bar is amazing. I love the açaí bowls too. It's pretty difficult to get fresh fast food in this part of town so Earth Origins is my go to.

Tom, the owner of Advanced Countertops, was recommended to me by several different people when it came time to install our pre-fab granite countertops in our newly constructed home. I'm so glad we ended up working with Tom, as the level of care and attention we received was truly outstanding. We were in a tight situation with scheduling, and Tom and his crew turned themselves inside out to accommodate us and make everything work the way it had to. The cost of the work was very fair, and the quality of what they did was superb. I felt like I was being taken care of by highly knowledgeable and experienced people who genuinely cared about my project. I couldn't think more highly of Tom, the way he runs his business, and the work that he and his very polite crew do. Top notch, across the board. He has lots of cool, well-priced remnants in his shop, too, so if you need just a piece or two for a project, check them out before spending a ton of money elsewhere.
The countertop material is gorgeous, but the way they matched the edges leaves a lot to be desired. In some places it was matched perfectly, in others, not sure what they were thinking.

We went in to purchase a piece of laminate and the lady at the desk was very nice and helpful! They had in stock what we needed and it was VERY inexpensive! Will utilize their services again in the future!

Had two projects and will go to Lowe's in the future. Do not do business with their laminate department. The young woman in charge is not honest and will misrepresent the facts. I was told Advanced Countertops was a reputable company - perhaps with their stone/granite sales - however, stay clear from the laminate sales, unless you have lots of time to waste.

This is a great company. I needed assistance with some laminate. I contacted them by e-mail and received a prompt response and quick solution to my problem. That's the kind of customer service I like. I will use them in the future. You should, too.

I have used Advanced Countertop numerous times. Most recently in January 2013. I find their work to be top-notch. If you are going to use them, call and set up an appointment. Otherwise they may be too busy to see you if you just walk in.

In praise of Doug Driver at ACD, responsive, professional, knows his business. I had my heart set on a Corian countertop in Burled Beach. Come to find out it's not a well marketed color by Corian, 6-8 week lead time. Many emails with Doug, who was always quick to respond & precise. Ultimately (and a bit sadly because I looked forward to working with him) I selected another company with a product like Corian but at a much lesser price. The almighty $ rules.

Beginning to end, Advanced Countertop Design was great to work with. Doug answered my millions of questions by phone and email -- he was very prompt and helpful. The scheduling went as smooth as can be. The installation team was great, and the finished product looks great. It's super sturdy, the fit and finish are great -- the seams and corners are all very high quality. I've tried a different Reno company for Corian counters, for a previous cabin, and it was the exact opposite experience. So refreshing to work with a well-run company and I recommend them to anyone.

We recently hired this company to install a Corian countertop in our master bath. Due to the size of the counter, they would have had to order a full slab, bringing the price to a prohibitive level. Marie suggested using a remnant that they had in stock and found one that was perfect color and saved me about $700. The workmanship was excellent, customer service was impeccable. I would not hesitate to use them again and again.

We recently remodeled our kitchen and used Advanced to do our counters. I can attest to the fact that this company is top-notch all the way around. The ladies in the office were very patient with our endless requests for samples and our design modifications. The quote was fair and reasonable....the materials high quality....the fabrication precise and quick. The installation was done perfectly by the owner and was done with amazing speed and efficiency. I love my beautiful new countertops, and I'm very pleased we chose Advanced to do the job.
Carlos did a wonderful job installing my new countertop. And when he and Marcos had to come back to recaulk a small area, they responded in a timely manner and did a great job.

We engaged this company to fabricate and install new Corian countertops in our kitchen several years ago and they did a great job. We recently remodeled our kitchen and couldn't believe the price they quoted for a slight modification to one countertop and fabrication of a new 24-inch wide countertop; more than $1,000. We were told that most of the cost was labor. Okay, but when we asked for a bid to just provide just the materials, no labor, the price was only about $250 lower, and it included a substitute color instead of the color included in the original bid. It is clear to us that they they must have more business than they can handle if they think they can treat past customers this way. We would rate this company just one star except that they did do a great job for us on the original project.

Precision totally ripped us off regarding our garage door repair. We had them out twice, to the total of almost $1800. Then, it malfunctioned again. On the recommendation of a neighbor I called a local company. Fixed it for $129. Have to admit, I did not call Precision about a refund or anything, but I highly doubt they would have been interested in talking with me. Just wanted to get my garage door working. For what they have charged me, I could have gotten a completely new door.

My garage spring decided it didn't want to work the 2 Saturdays ago. I tried to do the responsible thing and contact 3 garage door opener repair companies for estimates and NONE of them called me back. When I was at work, I just happened to open a ValPak envelope and lo and behold, it had a coupon. I called them that day and they were able to set up an appointment for me for the following Saturday morning between 8-11. Well, Tod, came to my house at 8:45 a.m., and explained to me the problem and provided three different estimates of the repair job. In addition, I asked him if he could put in a new lightbulb and he did. All in all, he was finished by 9:15 a.m. You should definitely contact them!! They have several different timeframes available so you don't have to take time off work. They are open on weekends and won't charge you extra! I would definitely call them again!!!

Called the main number for Davidson county and asked Jasmine if they could copy a gate remote for domestic use. Jasmine said this would not be a problem. I confirmed the address with her. Drove 25 minutes to the 7200 Westbelt address to find an office complex and a locked door. Called again, and Julia (who was very nice) informed me that they do not do retail work or sales out of this address. Incredibly frustrated and disappointed with this company. I understand that training your people about what you do is an investment of time and capital resources, but it is also how you acquire and maintain customers.

I spend three days installing our new garage door opener, but could never figure out why the floor sensors would not stop blinking, resulting in the garage door not closing. Shane Follis, after some trail and error, solved the problem. Eventually, it turned out to be clip in the overhead which was lose resulting in unsecured wire connection. Shane's professionalism, friendliness, and troubleshooting steps were amazing! 5 stars!

No stars! BEWARE this company's idea of "service" because what they really mean is "sales". Made my appt, stated the model garage that I have and the problem is door won't stay down. Austin comes and immediately tries to frighten me about exposed wiring that could cause a fire and burn up my cars. Oh ok. Then he goes into units are built to last 10 to 15 years and mine is old. Oh ok. Then whoever put my door up did a really bad job. Oh ok. Since he wasn't doing ANYTHING to DIAGNOSE the problem, I began telling him about youtube videos I'd watched and what people were doing to fix the SAME problem. I may as well have talked to a plant. He couldn't even articulate any method of diagnosing a problem, nothing remotely close to first we'll VERIFY the sensors are working properly then check this or check that. NOPE NOPE NOPE. Got on his ipad and presented me with three packages I could purchase, the cheapest being $174, the next over $500, all were about replacing and there's been no attempt at diagnosing the problem- he even said the $174 pkg was not a guarantee it would fix the problem. DO NOT CALL THIS PLACE IF YOU'RE LOOKING FOR A REPAIRMAN!

Our spring on our garage broke this morning. The only company open on Sunday was Precision. William came out and repaired the spring. He was very friendly and knowledgeable. He answered all our questions and we felt the price was not out of line. He did not try to sell us anything we didn't want as previous reviews had mentioned. We would recommend and us them again. Bob Hinman

Be careful with this company. Their prices are astronomical and they constantly try to upsell you instead of just doing the job they were asked. After a quote of almost $1000 for a motor replacement, I called the company that originally installed it 20 years ago and they replaced it with a brand new unit for $300. I wouldn't call it a scam, just a business model with high pressure sales and prices.

We have used Precision Door twice now once for the operator and once for the door. They did not install the door nor did they decide to strike to operator by lightening, so the reason for the calls were not to fix work originally done by them. I really appreciated their great customer service they have an answering service who answers nights and weekends. The last phone call took place on Easter morning. They were able to have a technician out the next day at a time that worked for us. They sent a great confirmation email telling you and showing a picture of who would be at your house. I truly appreciated that part. Both times the technicians were friendly, gave options and explained things fully. We have been fortunate enough to work with Brandon and Thomas and highly recommend both!

Problem with our garage door was with the manufacturer so we were not charged for even the Service Call; the unit was quickly replaced with the guarantee that the unit will be replaced with a Lift Master if any problems occur in the future.They have become exceedingly pro-active by calling on all customers whose unit was installed around the time as ours and replacing their units, too.

I would not recommend Precision Door Service. Our garage door was not closing when using our garage door openers. Precision sent out a Tech (& trainee?) the next day. The Tech entered the garage, looked around, and instantly said we needed to replace several parts. When we said what the problem was, he reset the release cord to the opener & track (I released it originally to close the door manually). The door was now closing properly but the CAUSE of the original problem was never addressed. I ultimately agreed to the $700 package for the "needed" new parts (although thinking this was outrageously high ). Nonetheless, the garage door was now operating properly---a "fix"which lasted only a few days!! When the original problem returned, I called Precision the next morning & was told the manager would review the file and call me back. When he didn't call back that day, I called again the next morning (always politely) and my wife called again the end of the day. The person taking her call said that they would put "urgent" on their note to the manager. When another day passed & still no return call from Precision, I called another garage door company. The Tech immediately questioned the need for all these new parts & tried to FIND THE CAUSE of our recurring problem. He thought he found it & made the repair for a total charge of under $100.

I used them for the first time yesterday, and the tech was very friendly and knowledgeable, will definitely refer them to others. I only needed a tune up and he didn't try to sell me repairs I didn't need.

SCAM ARTISTS! Tech showed up and immediately said the motor was shot and I needed to replace everything. Quoted me $700! Even told me the machine was "old", i bought the house new 18 months ago. I was able to get someone from the manufacturer on the line and he was able to fix the problem in 3 minutes over the phone! Precision Garage Door Nashville has no idea what they're doing, just after your money!
Courteous, professional and explained everything easily to understand. Arrived as discussed. Pleasant to deal with.

I am currently a resident at this establishment. I have been here for a little less than a year. Although I did decide to reside here it was not for lack of issues. The issues started before I even moved in but because of how "nice" the inside of the apartments looked I let it slide (more on that later). My boyfriend and I first toured a lovely 2 bedroom 2 bath at the price point of $1500 we were told that it would be held for us because the place was closing. When we called back the next day to schedule to actually close on the apartment we were ignored, for not only one day but for 3 days and they were open we checked. It took us actually driving there TWICE for them to even see us and when we sat down they had no recollection of us even being there even though we sat down and had a tour. Turns out they rented the apartment they said they we could the next day (WHILE WE WERE CALLING AND TRYING TO GET IT). Nevertheless we had to settle for a much smaller 1 bedroom 1 bath at the exact same price because in the span of 3 DAYS the rent went us $300. And all of our other prospects were gone because we thought we had the apartment. Boy were we dumb.

THINK TWICE BEFORE LEASING AN APT HERE! The noise is absurd. Constant first thing in the morning even on weekends all you hear is constant stomps and noise from neighbors upstairs. There has been a massive increase in younger tenants in the early 20s who have no respect for other residents. The music is very loud and people are constantly double parking on the weekends due to the lack of parking spots! Very overpriced for the type of environment you subject yourself too! Cannot wait for my lease to be up!

All of the Google reviews from the start of COVID to the end of October 2020 have been removed. This place is despicable on so many levels. Go research the robbery in July 2020 and the active shooter a few weeks later. So many better places to spend your money. They do not give a crap once you are moved in. There goes the neighborhood!

Lease at your own risk. Pro's: The clerk that provides the mail is prompt and courteous and always knows exactly where my package(s) are located. Con's: 1. Imagine you've just had a long work day and are hurrying in from the cold outside and you go to enter your building and your key fob isn't working. You try and try to open the door but the fob/door is malfunctioning and now you've got to walk around the entire building in hopes that one of the doors respond to your fob. Not cool. 2. Pool regulations are not enforced. - On 2 occasions I witness a resident giving a life guard beer to drink which is beyond irresponsible. - Residents frequently bringing in more than the allotted amount of guest. - The umbrellas are always out of service. On one occasion a resident was trying to open the umbrella and it fell over on him and he ended up getting injured. - The pool is generally not clean. 3. Parking is an absolute nightmare. Here's a concept if you build x amount of apartments make sure you have x amount of parking spaces. 4. The buildings are poorly made. My bedroom windows were unable to lock. On a ground floor apartment that made for a few uneasy nights. 5. If you are not sidestepping dog poop you are side steeping duck poop. 6. Maintenance has a bad habit of entering without knocking. 7. Fire alarms are frequent and for the most part go off for no apparent reason. 8. The most frustrating on the list is ... trying to leave in the morning. Clearly a light needs to be installed. You spend on average 7 minutes trying to make a left turn during rush hour. There have been several accidents and the staff have made it clear that it is up to the residents to figure out how to get a traffic light installed.

I would never rent here again and I would get out of my lease early if it wouldn't cost me an absurd amount of money. The facilities are nice and the maintenance is taken care of promptly, however, the management team has very little concern for renters' issues. Of the multiple complaints I could list, the most pressing for my family is that our apartment constantly smells of cigarette and other types of smoke due to tenants smoking in their apartments and we were told there's nothing to be done. Every closet, bathroom, and bedroom in my apartment is subjected to this smell at all hours of the day. It's disgusting.

This apartment complex is luxury in name only. The staff (mainly the front desk girl and the manager) are rude, unhelpful, and dismissive of resident concerns. There is one cart per building that goes missing for hours to days at a time, making carrying in groceries very difficult. The walls and floors are very thin, and every step of your neighbors can be heard. Depending on your building, you will frequently hear the rumble strips from the 476, 276 interchange. Smog occurs rarely when accidents occur on the Turnpike and when the winds blow the smoke from the near by trash incinerator power plant making the air oppressive. The gym is over crowded and the business center is often filled with teens watching loud videos and making phone calls. On the plus side, it is close to the turnpike and 476 onramps. Overall, I recommend against living here, as better options are available nearby.

Worst apartment I have ever lived in. Firstly, parking is terrible. There are very few spots near the apartment complexes. There are additional lots, but they are quite a walk from where the main apartment complexes are. My wife always points out the irony that this place is called "parc" but parking is terrible. Secondly, the noise is UNBEARABLE. There is noise pollution from plymouth road, butler pike, and the Pennsylvania turnpike. If you live here you will quickly become acquainted with the sound of cars driving over rumble strips as they approach PA turnpike toll station at exit 333. These sounds are constant, even throughout the night. Then there is also the mechanical humming, clanking, and vibrations we hear from nearby garage doors opening and closing. Trying to enjoy the sunset or starry sky from our spacious balcony is impossible as these sounds are a continuous clamorous intrusion. Lastly, and most disturbing of all, is the noise from our upstairs neighbors. There is a near constant banging and thudding coming from our upstairs neighbors--likely from a combination of running and jumping. This noise is nearly constant throughout the day and continues well into the weekend. Occasional lazy Saturdays or Sundays are no longer possible as we are woken up by the noise at around 7AM, almost like clockwork. In the afternoon, it is not possible to sit by a good book and enjoy it because of the constant noise. I believe this is due in part to noisy upstairs neighbors and in part to the poor construction of the building. Earplug do not help when we try to sleep nor do headphones when we are awake and trying to relax, as we feel the vibrations undamped. It is like feeling the constant beating of a bass drum against your head, though not nearly as melodious. Lastly, management is TERRIBLE. They are very selective in enforcing the rules of the community. For instance, my car was parked without a parking hangtag and was towed, as this was a violation of the community rules. However, when we initially complained to management about the unbearable noise coming from upstairs (also a violation of community rules) we were basically told-- sorry that's apartment living. My wife and I have been living in apartments for nearly a decade and the noise we heard coming from upstairs was well beyond the limits of normal. We pressed the issue with management because it got to the point where we could not relax in our own home. They told us they spoke to our neighbors and there is nothing more that our neighbors could do and nothing further that management could do for us. There is a written rule that neighbors shall not be disorderly and shall not disturb the peace of other tenants. They very easily could have pressed the issue further, tried to mediate the problem, and/or issued penalties for continually disturbing the peace. They did not Interestingly, this is not the first time that management has taken a hands-off approach to disturbing neighbors (as revealed by a quick google search). In conclusion, I strongly discourage anyone from living here. Between limited parking, noise pollution, unreliable management, and the significantly high rent, you are better off taking your money elsewhere.

Apartments are OK. My work timings are little messy i leave in afternoon and come back home around 10 and never find the parking near the building.when i first came in, the parking spaces were available and now its the time that there is not a single space left in all the buildings. Apartment people want you to park your car a mile away from where your building is. if you are by yourself its hard to grab your heavy groceries and walk all the way that far.Parking is first come first serve which is stupid i guess. They have to do something for the parking but management just says park here or park there they do not bother to take out any solution.if its cold , raining or snowing whatever the emergency it is you have to park far it don't matter to them.They know that there is a problem but they do not want to get more space and fix parking issues . they hear complaint from one ear and let go from another. The whole apartment buildings are built extremely poor and unplanned .They have this website for residents where residents can discuss things and if the post is against them, like their community complaints or resident issues they deny your request to post on that resident wall . That is a shame because you hide the truth.

I am writing from my experience - having been and experienced both ends of the spectrum. Pros: Very well maintained apartment complex. The maintenance is prompt and the apartments are new and nice. Slightly overpriced - if you have a 2nd car, be prepared to shell out an additional $600/year. Valet trash is prompt and costs an additional $180/year. This is a great feature if you are a professional on the go. Also conveniently located near amenities and the mall. If you commute up 476 or 276, this apartment is ideal since it is located off the highway. Friendly community. Cons: They have a flawed car towing system in place that doesn't check a paying residents car plates before towing cars away. The towing company employed has a complete monopoly in the region and employ questionable practices to enforce non-existent lease language. They look for hang tags that that can be easily duplicated and are not always visible under all weather conditions. Management is willing to listen but won't necessarily help you if you find your car towed away. The apartments are located off the highway, so if you are someone who doesn't like noise or lights, it may not be the best for for you. All in, if you haven't experienced both ends of the spectrum like I do, you ll either love it or hate it. I did not like my experience in dealing with the management with regard to dealing with the crisis, but the leasing agents themselves are friendly and helpful, so it is completely individual dependent.

We are just moving in but the staff has been great, professional, and very helpful. The apartments are beautiful and very well appointed. They did not cheap out as so many others have. The facilities and services are first rate. Brand new complex and it is nice to be the first one in the apartment. We could not be happier.

The apartments and facilities are nice but parking is a major issue at this complex. First, residents are charged for parking and there aren't enough convenient parking spaces to accommodate the residents near their buildings. Please note that this place is in the middle of the suburbs. Secondly, there are only 6 guest parking spaces for 400 apartments, and residents have been advised that management recently partnered up with a towing company to tow anyone that does not have a parking permit on the lot. In addition you pay a trash maintenance fee to have someone come and get your trash since there are no trash-shoots. This is not a big deal however the little fees are annoying. I would be very hesitant to recommend this place.

We moved in a few days ago and are enjoying our experience here so far. The guest parking issues mentioned in another review (only 6 spots) seem to have been rectified since we moved, but the additional parking seems further away from most buildings. Building 7000 seems to be the best for folks hosting guests frequently. The apartments are reasonably sound proof (you can hear footsteps when neighbors wear heels/shoes or neighbors that walk with heavy feet), trash collection happens outside your door each night between 6 and 8pm, and the build quality of the units is relatively good. We have a few small things not working currently (e.g. a small number of outlets), but we're the first people to live in our unit and maintenance is expected to come shortly to fix.

I lived at Parc for two years before I relocated to another city for work. The apartment complex is new, luxury and clean. The staff was excellent to work with - extremely helpful, responsive and courteous (thanks Joanna, Justina, Nicole)! I highly recommend this complex if you're looking for something new and luxury.

Driving down the freeway going 70 ... see a senske truck slowly drifting out of his lane. I drive up next to him and he is TEXTING with headphones in. I honked at the guy to get his attention and he didn't even flinch. Not sure how they would feel about that

Today I got a text from Senske saying I am scheduled for lawn service this week. This is the second time this year they have scheduled me in the middle of Winter. I called them last time and told them that fertilizing a lawn in the middle of January was not a good idea and to make it for the end of March or beginning of April. I guess they think that this is March. Well I have now told them they are FIRED and do Not recommend them at all!

Ok, So I guess I messed up. I usually do my research before I hire or buy anything, But because the guy came to my door and he started talking his game I never really looked them up until after I was dissatisfied with their service and saw all the negative reviews. Frankly, I can do a better job at getting rid of my weeds. I pay $50 a visit for literally 5 mins work. Ive paid for 3 visits and I have weeds all over my yard. Either the stuff they use is not good or the guy spraying it is not doing a good job (probably both). I really have no experience in any of their other products. They have always been nice but when I called to cancel they never asked why. To me that's sort of a red flag as well, If your good company then you'd try to save the customer or at least see what the problem was.

They were responsive and helpful when scheduling a consultant to come out to give me a quote for tree trimming in mid-August. They then requested a 50% down payment before even scheduling the work. This should have been a warning and I should have backed out. I paid the 50% ($300) and then did not hear from a scheduling consultant until more than a month later. I called close to five the day before to ask if I could expect them at a specific time or time frame, since I do have to work and they could not. They did not arrive at my property until 3p and proceeded to remove a tree that was not on my list of work and did not trim back one of the trees that was on the initial list because the neighbor was not home, but they are still charging me full price. I will be asking for a discount considering all of the work on the initial invoice was not completed. I would not recommend them for tree trimming. No one should have to pay a 50% down payment before the work is even scheduled.

Like everyone else so far who has reviewed this company, the customer service is terrible. The technicians don't know much at all about what they are applying, they are just dragging hoses and spraying. They know nothing about lawn issues or what to do to fix them. They schedule times but they are more suggestions than actual appointments. Calling into their office to discuss anything is nearly useless, the people are unfriendly and gruff, hardly who I'd want working for my company. In fact in all the times I dealt with them the only person who was friendly was the woman I spoke to and cancelled my service. When she asked why I was cancelling she wrote a note about why and I said I'm not sure why I'm bothering I doubt anyone is reading any of this anyway and she said "I can't disagree with that." That pretty much sums up the attitude of this company. If you hire them, don't expect anything special and do expect that you'll fire them sooner or later. Go to Zamzows or any place else and save yourself a bunch of headache and grief.

Pre paid for many lawn and tree services last fall. All items are related 'App' (applications) numbers and are not planned for with dates. Also, terms they use when you call and their billing statements are different than the written contract. When I call for questions the rep does not have access to the contract to discuss being 'double billed' on pre paid items. Asked to speak with a supervisor but one was not there and it'd be '2-3 days' for one to call me back. I've never received an update on what specific services have been completed and what services are remaining on the pre-paid contract. I suppose part of the reason is nobody, amazingly, in the office seems to have a copy or manages outstanding contracts. I've received service text 1-2 days before an application but it never says for what specific 'application' and never with a general timeframe. I've asked for both and it's never happened yet. Last service the persons arrived unannounced while we had other landscaping going on and they had to reschedule. I was told it was my fault I was removed from the service text notification. Bookkeeping is extremely poor. Would not recommend long term, prepaid, multi-service contract with Senske in the Meridian Idaho area unless the above issues are resolved.

We have been using senske pest services for several years now. Mario, our pest technician, is the best one out there. Always shows up, always calls or texts to make sure the schedule is correct, and always follows up with us the next day. He goes above and beyond to make sure our home is pest free! Highly recommend.

Very disappointed. Excepted a bid of $1000 for a full day of pruning and thinning. Paid $500 upfront. They guys showed up unannounced at 10am, as I was leaving. When I got home at 1pm they were gone and left a bill for $500 on the door. I called the Co 3 times that day, but didn't get a call back for a couple days. After 3 months it is not resolved. They are willing to change the bid to $625 for a half day. I don't consider 3 hours a half day and feel like they don't care if they did a good job, they just want to collect the money.

I was scheduled today to have my lawn aerated and overseeded. After staying home all day to be available when they arrived to clarify details of the job, etc...they never came. I called just before 5:00pm to see if they were still coming and they said I was rescheduled for next month...without communicating anything to me. Sadly, all the negative reviews are true about this business. Avoid them

I always request Mario for my bug service. He is very thorough and always so nice and professional. I have used Senske for years and their products work. Even though they are guaranteed, I almost never have had to call them back for a re-service. If my memory serves well, I have never called them back for add'l bug service b/c of Mario's thoroughness. And only once have I had to call them back for my lawn and that was in the beginning when I bought this home where the yard was one of the worst lawns in the universe-- turned around to one of the best b/c of Senske. I've had neighbors state they assumed I would have to completely resod my yard and have asked what I did to help it. I tell them about Senske's bug service at the same time.

Watch out for this one. I had scheduled aeration service with Senske in April, which they repeatedly cancelled and rescheduled. Eventually they stopped calling entirely. This was both strange and frustrating but I was just going to let it go considering the COVID situation. Come August and I receive a bill in the mail for the aeration in June, which had never been done. Either their techs cannot read an address and they served the wrong place, or, and I hate to think this, their techs lied about providing service. I suppose it is also possible their automated system puts together bills based on schedule and not on actual verified work. In any case, if I had signed up for a service that wouldn't have been as obvious as aeration, such as spraying for weeds or bugs, I wouldn't have known about this problem and would have paid for nothing. I will not be attempting to hire Senske again for any future service, nor would I recommend others to do so.

I wish I could give them no stars but Yelp won't let me do that. Last summer a different company operated Senske but they recently got bought out and there are now TERRIBLE, DON'T WASTE YOUR TIME & $! 1. The automated call service said they were coming multiple times and they did not show up. We called the office and the woman on the phone was very unprofessional and had no idea what was going on. 2. Eventually after several calls they came out.... but did a terrible job! They didn't even touch our side yard or get an even application throughout the yard. 3. We tried to make it right soooo many times but all they cared about was their bottom line. DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY, I give them an F-

I gave them $ 700. On July 29th to remove a tree on September 11. They called me at 1:30 pm the day before and said they have to reschedule because of staff shortages. They didn't even give me 24 hours notice. I emailed customer service and they replied, they sent an email to the supervisor get work done on Saturday sept 11 or refund money ASAP. They didn't come. They came back a few days later and said the person they sent to bid the job messed up. It was unsafe to climb, they need a lift. My animals were out and I was not home. 4 days later I emailed customer service asked , where are we in the process? Where is my $700. They said it would take 14 business days to give me my money they have had since July 29! I would not recommend this company at all. I asked if they were going to give me interest on my $ 700. They had since July 29th. They said no. Thumbs down!

I called them up and asked if I lived in their service area and was told over the phone that I was, so I scheduled a consultation visit with one of their 'Account Executives'. The appointment was very timely, and the gentleman who looked over my trees was very professional and personable. He didn't believe it was a problem where I lived and he told me that he would consult with his tree expert for the best course of action to assist some distressed trees, and spray all of the others on a periodic basis for good health. He actually came out to my house a second time to take pictures and look over my trees again.
