He said that he would talk to his experts the next day, and would get back to me regarding remedial treatment, but said that the office will be contacting me to get me on a recurring spraying maintenance schedule for what I thought was a reasonable price. About 2 weeks later after I didn't hear from the Account Executive, I emailed him to ask about the status, and the next day I called the office and asked my question to a very nice lady who passed my message on to the Account Executive. He called me later that day and left me a message that Senske would be unable to provide service because of my location. Really? Now, I'm 3 weeks delayed from maybe getting another service to help with our trees. I'm not sure when the Account Executive was going to call me to tell me that, if at all if I hadn't inquired into the status. You know, bad news seldom gets better with time. In summary, Senske does a good job on the sales part, but I'm not sure their development strategy is synced up with the Branch leadership. They could have looked at my address to see where I lived to determine if I was indeed in their service area before they even came out to waste the salesman's time, or mine. In addition, I think its short sided for the Boise branch to not service my location. I live no further than 25 minutes from BOI and 15 minutes from Warm Springs Avenue. My neighborhood is expanding with more new homes being built, and one of the best advertisements for any service company to have is their service trucks routinely in the area along with neighbor testimonies for quality of service. I'm sorry I can't attest to any level of service other than sales as we didn't get that far in the process. P.S. Since I first the above review, another Senske salesman called me up a couple of days ago to get me on a regular service schedule. When I told him that I was earlier told that I lived out of their service area, he was confused, and then he put me on hold and searched for our address and I think he asked someone else in the office, and then came back and told me that he apologized, but yes, I did live out of our service area. Once again, the company is not really communicating within themselves. Actually, I'm glad I do live out of their service area.

It's as though this company applies plain water instead of a weed and feed formula, and I am paying a ton of money to them to take care of my lawn all summer. Each time they come and service my yard, I get a bill for over $100. This is supposed to take care of fertilizing and preventing weeds on my lawn as well as spraying my shrubs and trees. After paying them over $300 for three applications so far this summer, I would expect better results. When I called and talked to them about it, and they said they would not do anything for me because I didn't buy "the full program", Which works out to be well over $500. My neighbors who have been dissatisfied with Senske as well recommend Summer Lawns. Please don't waste any money on Senske services.

They actually sent me a bill for $70 for services not rendered, my pipes freezing, and needing to hire someone else to come and finish the job their technician screwed up? I suggest everyone who has a bad experience to report to Consumer Fraud, the BBB, Rip-off Reports, and every possible reporting agency. That is what I'm going to do if they don't clear up this bill.

Marco is always super friendly and we are satisfied with the service they do. Many of our neighbors and friends have chosen senske as well and appear to be satisfied. We've looked into other places to save money but senske is the most reliable and efficent company which keeps us loyal customers.

A 40-foot pine tree blew over in a windstorm - pulled the roots right out of the ground. I trimmed off all the limbs and put them in a pile, then called Senske. A guy came by and gave me a quote which included taking away the pulled-out stump. Then they called and wanted a pre-payment. That should have been my warning. When the guys came to do the work, they just put all the limbs I had already cut off into a shredder, then cut up the trunk and packed up. I asked them about the stump and they said to call the company. I called, and they said that they wanted more money to do the stump - even though it was already out of the ground. And the original quote has written on it "Remove stump"! I would NOT recommend this company for anything!

Their getting 1 star because 0 stars isn't available. I contracted with 4 Seasons pest control and pre-paid for 5 services. I discovered 4 Seasons was acquired by this company. I emailed them stating I had only (to this date) received 2 of the 5 services. I asked for an immediate service and a refund on the 2 missed services. NO RESPONSE. Yesterday, without a courtesy call, a person was at my home and he was lucky that my Doberman guard dog was in the house. I only know the person was here as I found a packet on my front door stating he had sprayed. Do not use this company under any circumstances....

What a terrible experience. I went with this company because they had some good reviews and I had a blowout that wasn't done correctly last year, so I didn't mind paying twice the going rate to get good service. I had a great conversation with the owner/manager (?) and he assured me the guy would walk me through everything and explain things. I was happy to pay extra to get real service and know that I was in good hands. Or so I thought. I waited home all day and finally got a call that the guy was coming in 10 minutes. I looked out the window on my way to the bathroom- no truck. I was in the bathroom for a few minutes and saw a guy getting back into a truck. He drove away before I could get out to him. I get my phone and call him but he won't come back out to show me he's done the job. I told him there were more valves in back. He told me he hopped the locked fence! (And he damaged it. The gate is no longer even. It's sagging on one side and I'm pissed.) I asked him why he didn't ask me for the key. He asks me if I was even home, like he didn't see my car parked right in front of the gate he damaged! I asked him why he didn't just knock. He just gets evasive and I tell him to have the manager call me. I call up the company and I tell the receptionist how upset I am at this experience. She says she will have the manager call me. That was 3 days ago and apparently they don't feel a situation like this is worth responding to because I've had no contact from anyone in the company. Last night my pipes froze and I had no water in my bathroom this morning, because the skirting is still off, waiting for this company to come back out. Since I didn't know if the job was done, I had to hire someone else to come out. It's a good thing I did. He did say the water was mostly blown out, even though we did get a good amount of water coming out when he blew it. But he also found that the tech didn't fully open the valve or the other bleeder screw (?) on the backflow. And since it is brass, he said it would likely have cracked with build up. That would have caused an even bigger problem between me and this company. I really wanted to find a great company I could rely on year after year, to do my winter blow-outs and spring start ups. But when a company gives you such terrible service, can't even knock on your door so they don't have to damage your property, and won't be bothered to call you back to discuss a very obvious issue- what is there to say? UPDATE: 11/12/18 I just received a call from Chris. He was very apologetic and seemed horrified and upset that his tech damaged my property, gave such poor service, and only did half the job. At least there is some care given in this company. They need to respond to customers right away, instead of a week later. But at least he wanted to make this right for me.

Worst customer service ever!! Called for a quote to remove a large tree in our yard. They gave a bid and we left on vacation. Came back and called them to schedule the removal. They came out again to look at the tree and said he was unsure if he could do it for the same price but would have his guy come by and look at it later that day and then we could schedule. 9 class to them no return call then we physically went to the office, they we very sorry for the delay, signed up for pest control and someone would be by later today to look at the tree. Well no call and no one showed up. Today, Saturday get a call from the original guy and he was very nasty and short and said they could do the tree but it was going to triple cost of the original price. Told them to take a hike. No way would I have this company remove a tree let alone spray for bugs!! DONT USE THEM!!!

4-12-19: We are very unhappy with your employee who left one of your flyers on our door. We have a prominent sign, with bright RED lettering, next to our front door that states: STOP NO SOLICITING DO NOT LEAVE ANYTHING on the PORCH, the DOOR, or ANYWHERE on our Property!!!!! NO ADVERTISING, NO CARDS, NO FLYERS, NO BROCHURES... NOTHING!! We put this sign up because we travel frequently and, for the security of our home, DO NOT want anything left on/near our door that would advertise the fact that WE ARE NOT HOME! There was nothing positive about my experience with Reno Rental Finders. They were unprofessional, unorganized, and misinforming. To set up a viewing, in addition to your name and phone number, they also ask for your driver's license and/or license plate number. I scheduled the first available viewing just a few minutes after the listing was posted, and was informed that this was the first viewing they were holding for the space. When I arrived to the space 5 minutes early, other viewers were already walking out of the space. Just after I got there, 3 other people came in to take a look as well, meaning that this was not personal viewing appointment as they informed me (after giving them all of my information and setting the "appointment" time) - it was an open house. The agent then told me that after viewing, I can fill out an application online, and that I would receive a refund if the application did not go through. I immediately left the property to quickly submit an application. Upon following-up a couple of days after, the office informed me that the applicants who viewed the house before me were approved. My application was useless, and I did not receive a refund. Alternatively, the agent told me on the phone that they had "similar properties" available that I could use my application for. I applied for a 1bd/1br for $600/mo. The properties she suggested were 2bd/1br for $1200+/mo. In summary: - I set an appointment for a personal viewing - Was informed that I would be receiving the first viewing - Other viewers came before and at the same time as me - Application did not receive a refund - Staff does not know what they are doing The only situation I would suggest Reno Rental Finders is if you're willing to wait at the property every day, in case there were public viewing times they did not list for you, and if you're still willing to take a gamble and pay for an application you won't receive a refund for.

Yes and that's not considering what the outcome will be.

Very rude and disrespectful owner. This isn't a business, this place is a joke. I feel sorry for his employees and customers. I'm not surprised about so many bad reviews about the owner and this place. I felt very mistreated and disrespected and never ever will go back, good news I'm taking my money elsewhere. Something needs to be done about businesses like this, where customer service really sucks. Please spread the word around.

It's no wonder this poor excuse of a business has a two and a half star rating on Yelp. I've done business with them since 2009 on multiple properties I own. If you look at prior reviews you'll see other people have had the displeasure of dealing with the ignorant rude woman behind the counter as well. This place is pure trash.

Sod was down exactly 5 weeks and was either dead or weed clumps. Called to ask for someone to come out and tell me what to do. Sent out a young gal who said "this is not right." She got on the speaker phone with Annette who kept yelling that the warrantee was 4 weeks, and I did not use "her guy" to maintain it. Five weeks and dead and all weeds?? Never, ever use them.

My husband purchased a palatte of sod after being to nearly every local place in the area. They provided him with all the information needed to install a gorgeous lawn. We were very happy with the service they provided him with and we now have an amazing lawn!!..H. Grosse

Great company to order sod from. I called on a Tuesday afternoon around 3pm. I ordered a pallet of sod for the next morning, the receptionist phoned me back and stated if I would like they can deliver that night. The sod arrived around 6pm and was ready to be laid down. I didn't have them lay it for me, I did it all myself but I'm sure if I asked them to do it it would have turned out fabulous. The sod had no dead spots and no bugs. In addition to the sod they also have a HUGE garden center that my wife and I plan to use when the time comes. The owner is helpful and so is the rest of the staff. No games, no gimmicks, great customer service. The only thing I noticed was their prices were a tad more than the other guys. The other guys are rude and not helpful and make you feel like you're bothering them but not Gladiator. In a world where customer service is key to business success, Gladiator does it.

I purchased 4 pallets of Bahia sod from this company on the proviso that is was a hardy grass and grows anywhere.. The 2000 square feet area was prepared and sod laid.. It looked good for a few months then started to die.. I visited the company personally and was told , your probably cutting to short and it will come back.. That was not the truth but got me out of the door. I even changed my Lawn service in desperation to save the ailing lawn. We have a sprinkler system and a lawn fertilizer company who have done everything they can to save the lawn. I called and spoke to the owner who fluffed me off with remarks of, probably to much water, too much shade, the way it was laid, she had a stock answer for everything and well versed with her excuses. No offer to come out to look or even replace a couple of pallets to appease a disgruntled customer! I placed odd pieces of the sod in other areas of my lawn and that also died! It was obviously a bad batch of Bahia that was supplied to me, but it looks like I'm stuck with the dead grass and can only say to the public in general, buyer beware!!

We ordered and paid for almost $400 in sod to be delivered on 2/27. My husband called on 2/23 to see if their was a chance on getting the sod earlier, he was told no it had rained the day before so they wouldn't be able to deliver it until Sat as originally planned. He called again on 2/26 to confirm the delivery for the next day and was told that they couldn't deliver it until sometime the following week, when he asked why no one had called him he was told "their customer's just know, they don't have to tell them" He told them he was a new customer and did not know this. He asked to speak with a manager because the person who answered was so rude. Annette got on the phone and was also very rude, she then passed the phone to a man who got on the phone and cussed my husband out, he told him "I know where you live, I have your address." It was beyond unprofessional and disgusting that a business owner would allow an employee to THREATEN a customer. Before doing business with this company be sure to do a search on them, you will see the many reviews about their rudeness and disgusting way they treat customers.
We had a fantastic job and also got all of our plants from the location next door. Annette and other staff was super helpful we me designing the layout. Lawn still looks amazing a year later!!!

Go with any company other than Gladiator sod. I do landscaping work on the side and I needed 2 pallets delivered on a specific date and time (I ordered well in advance). The day the sod was suppose to arrive I got a call from Gladiator saying that they couldn't give me what I had already paid for. I got screwed and had to reschedule topsoil delivery that was already on it's way and I had to tell my customer that I couldn't do it that same day! As I was on the phone with their "manager" I kept my cool but simply asked questions as trying to get at them for doing business so poorly. She was extremely rude and not apologetic throughout the duration of the phone call. They simply do not have any respect for their customers.

My husband carefully measured our back yard to determine how much sod to order and have delivered. It appears this company delivered at least 100 feet less than what we had ordered and paid for. When hubby went back to complain the person he spoke to stated that the right amount was delivered. We disagree and Gladiator refused to make the order right. Do not purchase sod from this company.

We had them install St Augustine on one side of our front lawn last year. The lawn had so many weeds. Eventually the lawn was more brown than green. Without thinking, he called them again and replaced the same side with Zoysia. I've attached a photo. We haven't needed to mow it yet, but hopefully you can see how polluted this is with nutsedge. For the last few days after work (after getting up at 5:30am), I've been stooping over pulling the stupid things out. Not the thing I expected to do after getting a new lawn. To be fair, they did show up on time.

DO NOT BUY SOD FROM THIS COMPANY!!! I have never experienced such horrible customer service in my life! My company ordered sod for a property we are flipping and completely dead crunchy grass was delivered. When we reached out to the company their response was that it's too bad, we already paid in order to ensure delivery and there is nothing they will do since they already have our money. They went so far as to tell us we were stupid for not knowing what we were doing. I literally cannot believe that a company would be such outright crooks! JUST GO TO ANYONE ELSE!!!!

I Asked for a 1pm delivery and my product wasn't delivered until 5pm. I should of learned the first time when they were also late by two hours . Luckily for me I was able to find another company that offers the same product for a bit more. But it is worth the extra cost to have your purchase delivered on time .

We would not recommend Gladiator Sod. Annette was unprofessional and took no responsibility for the poor quality of sod in the backyard. From the time it was put down we could tell it was far inferior to the front yard. It was laid on a Friday,we asked her to come Monday. They came multiple times and still took no responsibility. They had a pest control company come, that was a joke. Gladiator left a bag of soil telling us to fill in the cracks.We asked them to replace the back or a partial refund. They refused and stopped all communication. I think it's no coincidence that the good sod that everyone can see is in the front. DO NOT FALL FOR THEIR SALES PITCH

Originally called Gladiator Sod and left a message. Never received a call back. Called company again and was given name of Annette to call. Called Annette and she said she would try and come by today which was a Friday. Received a call later in day from Annette saying she could not make it but she would come by my home on Monday. Monday came and went and never heard from her or company again. I had been warned to stay away from this company from my neighbors and I should have listened.
It appears that they have moved and have not updated their website. Tried calling as it says they open at 10am but no answer. A total bummer when you want to go see what they have.

Nice specialty store. I don't do a lot of woodworking, but they look like they have it all and know what they are doing. I needed some hide glue to repair a crack in my Ukulele. Home Depot and Lowes don't even have it on their website, and when I called them, they acted like I was talking in foreign language. It was so nice to find a store that knows their stuff.

Over the last 5 years I got into woodworking and have gone to several of the local suppliers over that time. For the last 3 years I have I have mostly gone to the Woodworking source. They have a bright clean store with a great selection of tools, woodworking supplies and a real good selection of the higher end woods. I have also taken several classes at there shop that made my life a lot easier around my shop. What I like most is the staff. They are always helpful with lots of suggestions on how to do it, what to buy and how to save money. Ralph is the owner and stands behind his products and services. If you havent been there you should stop by if your into woodworking

Lance helped me cut this wood for the bar cart. The cuts were absolutely perfect. Made an amazing gift for Xmas. Lance is super professional, friendly and I will be going back and telling all my friends. A+ work.

When I first walked in the lights were off so I wasn't sure I was in the right place. I moved more and lights came up. I visited this place before Mastercraft because it is closer to work. When the lights came up a man came into the showroom. He was so nice. He actually looked at the project directions I had and listened to me saying why I was there. I wish they had more stock! They keep very little wood for building shelves. Maybe I will go back and see if they still have that large walnut piece. I appreciate him taking the time to talk to me and help me the best he could.

This store has moved around the corner so call for directions! They still sell great tools and materials but the real magic about this place is the workshop! Their WOODWORKING CLASSES are now all running again in an even bigger shop! The equipment they have us work on is AweSome. The instructors are excellent. At home I've always been the shop helper and not the tool operator. Our shop is at the cabin. Not accessible all winter. What to do? I wanted to get over my fear of the big tools...especially the table-saw so for kicks and giggles I got my husband to take classes with me. The table-saw in the store workshop is the type that CANNOT cut off fingers! So that completely put me at ease. I will no longer need to get my husband to make a cut for me! First we took the pen turning class and today we just completed the breadboard class. I got to make table-saw cuts, play with glue, learn how to scrape off dried glue, use the planer, jointer, and router before sanding and oiling my breadboard! I'm very happy with both our pens and our breadboards! Perhaps next winter we will take the BOWL making class! If you find this review useful please vote!

Shopped here numerous times, the staff (Ralph especially) are always very helpful in finding you the right product. Yes, you pay retail price (they do often send out coupons and promotions though), but it is worth it for the friendly and helpful service.

Incredibly helpful and supportive staff. WIde range of tools for the professional or hobbyist. I bought a direct drive variable speed lathe for large projects at this store because of a great discount and tremendous assistance I got from the staff. Ralph - the owner - is extremely knowledgeable and has provided ongoing advice as I've begun doing larger and more interesting projects. The other staff members also know what they are doing and spend time with me each time I come in. There are a wide range of classes at what appear to be fair prices.

I love that every time I walk into this shop, I always feel welcomed and the staff is always willing to solve any problem I have. Lance provided a service that I couldn't do on my own and is greatly appreciated.

This is a wonderful source for woodworkers. Today was our first rather major purchase...an awesome router to mount in our table and all its accessories. We've come to the store for years mostly to dream about setting up our shop and pick up incidentals. We brought our old router plate in to get a router to mount to it but after seeing a new system that allows it to be raised and lowered without getting underneath, we decided we're worth it! If you are lucky enough to arrive when RALPH is in, he can really explain a lot about how to make life easier, especially for beginners. The woodworking LESSONS at his shop in the store sound absolutely awesome. I think next winter we need to get serious about l

Have recently discovered The Woodworking Source and am very pleased with the vast amount of materials and tools they carry. Everyone there is so knowledgeable and helpful, they go out of there way to make sure you find everything you need and offer great advice to help you with your projects. Haven't taken any classes, but it's looks like a great place to learn a new hobby.

I went to the Woodworking Source today to inquire about creating/designing bookshelves from some wood with "character" and not simply using generic materials from a big chain store. There were two men working this afternoon, and I was the only customer in the store. It was quickly apparent however that they were more interested in checking inventory than helping an actual customer. The store does have a nice selection of different wood and cuts/finishes, but when I asked the man working the back room about some of the options, pricing, and their services I was only given one-word replies, if any at all, with no inclination that that either worker cared that I was shopping there. I likely would have placed a handsome order for 60+ feet of custom work, but apparently you have to catch the workers during a more convenient time than "open hours" to do so.

The people who work here go above and beyond to answer my questions and teach me new things about the woodworking hobby. Whether I've participated in a class, gone in to buy new equipment, or if I'm just dropping by to see what is new, the employees always treat me with the utmost respect. I appreciate the Woodworking Source because they are an old-fashioned small business that cares about its customers; they give customer service that I rarely get anywhere else (that is hard to find these days).

I've been to this store twice and had two completely different experiences. During the first visit I was met by a very knowledgeable lady who teaches the pen turning classes. She was very attentive and showed me the different parts of the store and the shop in the back. I was simply visiting for the first time and I was interested in learning about the store. I bought a push stick and some penetrating oil. Two measly little items and I was treated like royalty. FIVE STARTS During my second visit I was looking for a silicon bristle glue brush. When I asked for help, a very tall gentlemen was extremely rude about the entire question, responding, "That's a Rockler item and we don't sell that stuff here! Besides, it doesn't work and you would be better off with this product," pointing to a glue spatula. Such a shame that some employee would give me such a bad impression of their store. It will take a lot for me to return to their store. I guess Rockler will get more of my business rather than Woodworking Source.

I stopped in today to load up on supplies and use my Birthday coupon they sent me. Gary was the only sales person there today. The owner had a family emergency and the other sales person was at the doctor. I put my pile of supplies on the counter and Gary warned me that he was a little slow on the register. Not his regular task. The coupon was a challenge but he made it work out and then an error on the receipt also was a challenge. Every thing worked out fine in the end. Ralph, you should give Gary a big pat on the back for taking on the challenge and filling in for everyone in a truly professional manner. I have always had a good experience when shopping here. Thanks!!

I came here to buy a gift for my fiancé as woodworking is a new hobby he picked up. I myself know next to nothing about woodworking. The people working were incredibly helpful! They spent hours with me picking out woods for certain projects, helping me buy the right lengths for certain kits I was buying and projects he would use the woods for. They gave me tons of tips and my fiancé was blown away with his present in the end. So not only was the customer service amazing but the store itself is a crafters dream. They have everything you could want for woodworking, kits, tools, specialty woods, classes, resins, etc.

A few years back I decided to get into woodworking, so I stopped by to check this place out. Since I was still new to everything I asked a lot of questions and spent quite a bit of time there without actually purchasing anything. Everyone there was great. They're all very knowledgeable and they never made me feel stupid. They took the time to answer my questions and never rushed me or pressures me to make a purchase. Fast forward a few years and I'm still impressed with this place. It's well organized and they have a large variety of specialty tools. The staff is still friendly and this is now my first stop when buying any thing wood related.

I'd driven by this place several times with the intentions of checking the place out, but never seemed to have the time. Anyway, my wife finally forced me to stop. Wished I'd stopped much earlier. This place is great. Awesome people and a great selection of wood and wood working tools. I was really excited when I found out they have a workshop area where they put on classes. I'd always wanted to try turning with a Lathe and found out they had several turning classes with different skill levels. I signed up for a beginning turning class and have been hooked since. I turned around 30 pens and wine bottle toppers for Christmas presents and spent a lot of time at the Woodworking Source. I've gotten to know the staff really well. They are all great people and very helpful. Since taking my first class, I've taken several other classes. The classes are fun and educational. I'm making fancy pens with veneer inserts and Celtic knots and I learned the skills in the classes I took. Great Place.

Very nice building with lots of amenities but unfortunately weak security presence (One aged rent a cop up the block) and right next to an alley teeming with dumpsters and unfortunate but aggressive homeless folks that many have to walk past to get to their cars. For the NYC price I would expect much more attention to the surrounding areas.

My boyfriend and I moved in the Ludlow a couple of month's ago and it has been great! The staff has been super helpful with anything we need and I love love love the finishes in the apartments. They make it actually feel like a home. You can't be the location either. The gym was very important to us and the one we have here saves us time and money going to an outside gym. Highly recommend.

I've waited a long time to write this review...I've lived here since April of 2019 and kept hoping things would get better so I could give this place a better rating as there are lots of things I love about this place. Alas, as one other review stated its death my a million paper cuts...and for me one especially big problem that has never been resolved. We'll start off with the good. Its a brand new construction. Location can't be beat. Easy access to MFL, Regional Rail, 5 blocks from PATCO, 1/2 a block from Reading market and Jefferson. CVS, Moms, Target, the fashion district, China Town all a stones throw away. I really like the kitchen. Massive fridge. GAS Stove is fantastic! Large amenity space with nice gas grills to use as well. And its quite protected from the noise of Market street which is nice. Great view from my apartment. t Now the bad/irritating/absurd. Remember this place was built from scratch to be an apartment complex. Not a converted cigar factory or anything. ~ The HVAC unit is ABSURDLY LOUD. Worst yet it blows directly into the bedroom and the mechanical part of it is also in the bedroom. This has been a never ending struggle for me. Its loud enough that I have to turn up the TV, it is audible in phone calls, and constantly wakes me up. Maintenance has been nice and tried several things to make it quiet but long story short...its still ridiculously loud. Again...why would you build something like this? Did no one test it out before? I used a decibel meter and found it to be between 50-70 decibels! Also doesn't reach kitchen or bathroom. ~ I have 1 drawer and two cupboards that I still can't open because they're too close to the stove. Why was it built like this? ~ They have three grills in the patio...but one has never had a gas connection to it...why? ~ They have a nice gas fireplace inside in the amenity space...again no gas connection? Why? ~ Kitchen counter tops and sink are white and stain permanently VERY easily and are impossible to keep clean. ~ Washer & Drier are surprisingly not that modern and a quite loud ~ I live in a corner apartment facing east. Beautiful view don't get me wrong, but the blinds are terrible and do nothing to block the sun. Had to install my own blackout blinds but because of tall windows, hard to find ones that fit. There are also two blinds near my pillar that are basically impossible to reach/use. ~ Gym water (or lack thereof) - They first had those large 5 gallon jugs to get water from. Basically they were never full. Brought this up with management several times and they kept saying that their supplier was unreliable but they never found a solution. For one week they used water bottles which obviously didn't work. Now there just isn't water in the gym. Why not build a gym with a water fountain? ~ There is a window that has been boarded up in the gym for at least 8 months now. Apparently its to put in a dog park but they never told us that until I complained so far all I knew someone broke the window and never fixed it. ~ Speaking of dogs, there is no green space, and there is also a vet next door, so there is always dog urine all over the cobblestones outside the apartment ~ The front entrance door gets stuck and won't close. The maintenance and leasing folks literally walk through this every day and no one thinks to fix it. I've had to put in two maintenance requests to get it fixed ~ Speaking of maintenance, they came to fix this incessant clicking in my bathroom (which admittedly they did fix) but now I smell whatever my neighbor is cooking (thankfully they seem to be an excellent cook). I put in a request to fix this 2 weeks ago and never got a response or a repair ~ Speaking of no responses, I again messaged the property manager and leasing office about addressing my HVAC and haven't heard back in 2 weeks ~ Speaking of communication, as was eluded to by someone else, the fire alarm goes off quite frequently. Communication about what the evacuation plan and the cause of the fire alarms has been abysmal. Admittedly it improved a bit after I complained but why did it take me saying something to do the right thing? ~ They have some social events which is nice but often times they literally tell you an hour or two before they start. ~ One other big and major annoyance. I live on the 17th floor and about 8 months ago we were notified they are turning the 17th and 18th floors into Lyric rooms (short term furnished rentals). I don't think when anyone moves into an apartment they expect to be living next to train of random tenants coming and going frequently. ~ Revolving door of leasing agents and front desk people. Also, one leasing agent told me that he was overworked and this is why responses were so slow. Sorry for long review. Excellent location and generally nice apartments, but terrible management, poorly though out building construction, and doesn't live up to its "Luxury Apartment" claims at all. I wouldn't recommend it.

Very nice building with lots of amenities but unfortunately weak security presence (One aged rent a cop up the block) and right next to an alley teeming with dumpsters and unfortunate but aggressive homeless folks that many have to walk past to get to their cars. For the NYC price I would expect much more attention to the surrounding areas.

I moved in during the COVID-19 pandemic and found it to be a seamless experience. Chris, the leasing manager, was extremely helpful with all of our questions despite being unable to physically see the building (we moved from out of the area). The FaceTime tour was helpful and would recommend it. I saw in the past there was a hiccup with security, but after being here during the looting surrounding George Floyd's death, I felt completely safe and you could see security guards (yup, more than one!) patrolling the area throughout the night, and often warding people away from the area. Outside of that situation, I've seen them doing rounds throughout the building as well as being posted outside regularly in all types of weather. This is definitely a safe area especially with this kind of security presence. I can say that walking my dog at 2am feels perfectly okay despite being downtown. Overall, I'm having a great experience and highly recommend Chris. I've had some pushy sales people in the past, but I found Chris to be the ideal leasing manager. Not pushy, informational, caring; overall great guy.

Renters Beware! I'd like to share my experience thus far with The Ludlow. In August 2018 my mother wanted to move to Philly. I lined up some apartments in Center City for her, one of them was The Ludlow. The staff, building and location seemed good enough for her, so she placed a deposit for an apartment. Shortly after, my mother developed a medical condition which prevented her from moving. September, I contacted the sales staff and requested a refund of the deposit which they agreed. Several months passed and no refund. I contacted The Ludlow to check on the status of the refund. They stated that a check had been sent. I advised them no check was received. The staff at The Ludlow/Greystar has been, in my opinion, dragging their feet since at least November. I have been a renter for quite a while and I have seen good and bad property management companies. The Ludlow/Greystar appears on the surface to be courteous and professional, but this experience has shown their dark side. They are quick to take your money but will string you along when it's time to return it. I have begun filling papers for a small claim suit due to The Ludlow/Greystar inability to refund my mother's deposit in a timely fashion. I suggest, if you're considering The Ludlow that you take a close look at how they conduct business.

I've lived here for about two months. The building is brand new, clean, and beautiful with great amenities and space/floor plans. It's located in a prime location just walking distance from Jefferson Station. Before moving in, one of my biggest concerns was the noise level since I'm a very light sleeper. However, the apartments are quiet and I've had no issues. The staff/management is also very friendly and accommodating, and reply to any questions or service requests within less than 24 hours. Definitely a great place to live especially for young professionals.

The Ludlow is an amazing property and I'm so fortunate to live in the new, safe East Market neighborhood. My Agent was Christopher Llanes showed me different layouts and he effectively helped me choose the right unit for me. I love living in this neighborhood and the Resident parties and raffles thrown by Brianna Cheli are always so much fun. I highly recommend this area to move to and Chris's expertise and Brianna's event planing skills are great!

I have sent 8 emails to the property manager and received no response. My lawyer has sent a certified letter to the property manager and received no response. I am out of ideas. DO NOT MOVE HERE. I am breaking my lease and getting out. I have complained about the noise from fitness classes in the plaza since July 15. The noise continues today. https://streamable.com/m6zo4e
All front desk and leasing staff are kind and helpful. Brand new building, nice common space with pool table. Perfect location.
Great place if you love to take cold showers. If not, then probably stay away.
Everything at the ludlow is great. The management, the amenities, the maintenance, and the security! I would highly recommend this building.

Not happy. After spending 1 1/2 hours trying to fix a problem with my daughters new iphone from Verizon, we were told to call Apple tech support. Her phone is only a week old, in my view it would have been easier and less time consuming just to give her a new phone. I think it my be time to switch carriers rather than putting up with this BS.

This store is a joke I've been here 25 minutes after the girl told me she would have to find me In the system, the manager is to busy with another issue and I'm still waiting on the girl that has seen 3 other people that walked in thru the doors. No Custumer service and all I wanted was my 2 month old otter box replaced. I spent $1400.00 on two I phones and accessories but can't be found in the system. Smh I miss AT&T ....

Met with Daniel twice over a glitch on my phone. Tried to get me to purchase new phone. I told him to stop insulting me, that I wasn't going to buy a new phone, and he told me to get out of his store, and don't let the door hit me in the ass on the way out. And I have witnesses

Worst customer service ever. Just bought a new iPad, asked for help with the new protective glass and to use device dollars, which I've earned, towards my new iPad Was given a flat no, I guess they forget that they're actually supposed to be customer service representatives. Then the girl had the audacity to tell another rep my situation with the tone, apparently she thought I couldn't hear her.

So I love Verizon and have been an Altell customer many years ago? Verizon is awesome for me? I love the Tech Coaches if you have an issue, as a senior I use those Tech Coaches and they are patient and wonderful, Verizon does provide the best service, I could switch but I won't? Really good customer support? That means more to me

I have had excellent, and very importantly, patient help from RJ at this store. He has helped with both phone purchase and ferreting out the best plan for my husband and me. Sometimes the wait is long, but patience deserves patience. (Plus, they don't have a problem with me bringing in my dog, who is also patient and good natured.) I agree with Tammy that it is best to go to a corporate store vs. an authorized dealer.

Salesman?? Couldn't tell you his name .. didn't bother himself with an introduction. Told him I wanted to add another line and change my existing plan . Told me he only sells phones and I'd have to call customer care.. the entire time leaning on the sales podium . I was going to buy a phone, accessories etc but just grabbed the phone and left . Oh and the salesman wasn't going to set it up either but I insisted I could go on about this but what's the point.. my lesson.. I called customer care they bent over backwards to help and sent accessories with next day shipping! (Free )can see why I was the only customer in the store

The store is very well laid out. Lots of room to move about and browse. They have seating available as well. Was greeted quickly and offered assistance immediately by the staff. The staff were friendly and very efficient.

Kevin was super helpful when we purchased a phone, but didn't help us set the phone up. Returned for some set-up help within minutes and Riki had pretty horrible customer service. Snotty and condescending. "I'm not Apple." Highly disappointing considering we'd spent over $1000.00.
Staff to include management especially Doug were rude and unprofessional. The store has bad customer service and I don't recommend anyone to buy there.

I went to the Verizon on us19 in palm harbor and I explained to the guy that worked there that my iphn8+ wasn't charging and I explained that I had tried 3 different brand new iPhone chargers and still wouldn't charge. So when I explained this he plugged my cell in and it worked and then he was like well it's charging now so I don't know what to tell you......!!! So of course I get home and plug it in and it won't charge. I had some other issues so I went to the gulf to bay location in Clearwater and that's where I actually bought the phone and as soon as I walk in I was greeted with a very nice gentleman and I explained what was going on and before I could blink he had a new phone ordered for me. He wasn't trying to get rid of me and he truly was a very nice person. I would never go with any other service! I have excellent service with Verizon!!!

This is a real Verizon Corporate store and will know your account best. I got all sorts of bad phones and run-around with the Verizon-authorized stores and will only go to corporate stores from now on. Mr. Nate was VERY COMPETENT AND GOOD with customer care when I visited the store for a Droid Maxx upgrade to my Account. He went out of his way to ensure I had the right phone and that it worked on my account. He realized what a terrible experience I had with Cellular Sales Verizon-authorized store earlier and helped me immensely. I only wish that all Verizon sales representatives are this helpful in person.

I love Verizon & especially this location. I've been with a lot of other wireless carriers and never had the same coverage...I believe that you get what you pay for and I'm never without service even in "dead zones" for many of my friends. This location is usually fully staffed with a knowledgeable workforce that is ready to assist as soon as you walk in the door. Even if all of their associates are busy, someone will at least greet you and let you know that it won't be long. My last visit was excellent. We walked in wanting to inquire about their BOGO iPhone special.
