We have answered the phone and told them we are not interested many times but still they call.

Worst experience ever! Our salesman completely misled us on the cost of the windows, the good ole bait and switch. We received a bill from the finance company in mid-December, saying we had a payment due in January! Not only were we told that payments would not start until 30 days after installation, the windows aren't scheduled to be installed for 2 more weeks! We were billed for windows that aren't even in our home. This company billed the finance company the day after we signed, they didn't even wait the 3 day period they promised to ensure that we weren't going to cancel! After receiving the bill my husband reached out to the company - he called 4 times. Each time being promised that a manager would call him back. Had he not persisted, I am quite sure we would never have received a call from anyone. We even considered paying the cancellation fee, despite their shady business practices, and they refused to budge! Go somewhere else, once you sign on the bottom line, this company jumps ship! I have filed a complaint with the BBB and am awaiting follow-up from the organization.

Purchased a replacement window for our screen door. It was not ordered correctly and Anderson windows will not refund me my money. They do not give out shipping labels it would have cost me over $300 to return this window and I only paid $135 for the replacement. I will never buy Anderson Windows again their policy is not on their website for their returns. They were willing to not charge me a 20% restocking fee for me to return the window but written give me a shipping label to ship back the window. This is poor customer service as far as I'm concerned the customer is always right whether we ordered the wrong window or the right one we should be able to return the product. And receive a shipping label for the return not have to pay over $300 for a return for a window that cost only $135. I do not recommend Anderson Windows for anything. Just wanted to add the manager I spoke to was Tyler he was no help at all.

(5) ~ Excellent Job From Start -to- Finish for Replacing Windows and Patio Doors. Recommend scheduling a pre-visit(sales) to understand what options are available and to get the best deals. The deals offered from the sales person were better than the ones offered in their online & mailing advertising;)

Best window replacement company in the industry! Turnkey operation from start to finish. Sales rep was great and the installers did an amazing job. I will definitely recommend them to all my friends and family.

I purchased a double sliding patio door from Renewal by Andersen, King of Prussia. It was installed on Jan 10, 2020 and we have had several issues since installation. First and most important being the door does not lock, the installer put a piece of wood over the lock and said a part needed to be ordered, leaving our home totally unsecure. The next issue was that we noticed a large gap and draft coming from one side of the door. We called service again, they came out a week later. The service tech had to remove and reposition the door, this issue was corrected but it was stated that "the door was not installed properly and should never have been left like this". Next, we notice that the handles on the door when opened hit the fixed door and are causing dents in the frame of the fixed door. We noticed that one of the "stoppers" on the bottom of the door corners is missing, this part has been ordered with a 6-8 week timeline. This however will not correct the door handles from hitting as they hit on both sides and continue to cause dents in the door frames. Yesterday, we finally had a service tech come to fix the lock, he could not get it to work and found that is was the wrong side lock that had been placed on our door. He also mentioned that we were never given the foot locks to secure the door at the bottom. Again the parts need to be ordered leaving our home unsecure. This has resulted in us having to cancel a vacation as to not leave the home with an unlockable entry as well as several missed days from work to be available for the service techs. Issue after issue and with each call and complaint all I hear are excuses and how great the company is. As one reviewer stated "the company is comical" their customer service is a joke. How they feel that leaving the homeowner unsecure for several weeks is acceptable.... is beyond belief. Please beware and do your research before you sign....I am sorry I listened to the sales pitch and did not do my research. As I am left with a $13,000.00 improperly installed, damaged, unlockable door.

We received a quote and did not get approved for full financing which is fine. However, we were told we were responsible for a 25% cancellation charge. We didn't sign anything and were never left with a copy of a contract. We were not told about the cancellation fee prior to applying for financing. Now we are being harrased.

I called this company for a quote to have one (possibly two) front window replaced and was asked all sorts of questions about my house and the age of my windows. I made it perfectly clear that I was only looking for the replacement of ONE window due to the style of the window not the efficiency of the window. The representative told me I might as well change THREE windows because that is what I would be charged. The minimum # of windows to replace is three, even if I only need one window replaced. I promptly told them I didn't need the discount advertised, I just needed one window replaced. The rep said it did not matter, the price would be the same. I told the rep I obviously called the wrong company and not to call my number in the future.

I had some trouble at first but they went over and above to work it out. The windows are beautiful and the detail of instillation is one of the reasons for the price. It is worth it. Great Job and good people to deal with.
Workers went above and beyond. Clean, effecient and even did extra work at no cost
No star. I requested a quote and declined to go further (sales rep was incompetent moron). They are now calling me all the time and won't leave me alone.

Recently made an appointment for an in-house consultation. Contractor never showed up. When I called to confirm if the appointment was still set, I was told that someone on my end had called to cancel (which was not true); this was followed by an apology and a promise that the person I spoke with would get right on the phone with a contractor and have someone out to me shortly with a callback to confirm. Well, that never happened either. If this is a measure of the service I could have expected, I'm glad I found out sooner rather than later...

Revised DO NOT USE RENEWAL BY ANDERSON WINDOWS. BUYER BEWARE. I want to start by saying that I went with this company thinking that it would be worth the money for what is advertised as a higher quality product from a company that maintains they pay great attention to detail and provide excellent customer service. Unfortunately none of that has proved to be true. Nearly one year later they still have not installed the correct window as ordered due to numerous mistakes by the manufacturer, the installers and overall beyond poor communication. I used Renewal by Andersen in the greater Philadelphia area to install windows on 1/24/2021. The installation team came out and installed the windows and the simulated window sashes were placed in the incorrect location in the window during the manufacturing process. The technicians were made aware of the issue during the installation and advised me they would contact the manufacturer and have new window sashes built. The new sashes were built and the service department scheduled a new date for technicians to come back and install the new window sashes. When the 2nd set of window sashes were delivered, one window was broken which was discovered when they opened the box so they couldn't complete the job. The technicians advised me they would order a 3rd set of window sashes. The service department contacted and scheduled the 3rd service. When the techs came out to install the new sashes they had a lot of difficulty getting them into place properly, but eventually got the job done. After they left, I looked at the windows from the outside and noticed the tech had broken the window and damaged the medal facia on the outside window. I called my representative and he informed me that a service tech would be calling me to set up an appointment to check out the damage. The service tech came out at a later date and confirmed the damage and ordered new window sashes. He also advised me the medal trim work would be replaced on the outside window because it was damaged during the installation. He also assured me he would be the one to come out to replace the window sashes because he is one of the lead installers. The new window sashes were ordered and they put me on the schedule for installation. The day of installation, 20 minutes before the tech arrived I received a phone call advising me the window was not delivered to their warehouse and a tech was on his way to caulk the outside window because I noticed water intrusion approximately one month after installation of the wrong window they installed. Fast forward to December 11th. The technicians came out Saturday to install the new replacement sash. Long story short, the window sash was in the incorrect location in the window. The techs advised they will have order the new sash again. I am very disappointed with the way this process has gone. A one day job has led to me taking off 6 working days and the window isn't fixed yet. I am hoping on the 7th visit they get it right. Unfortunately I don't live at the residences where the work is being done. It's not my primary residence. Each time they have scheduled a new date I had to take off from work and drive over 75 miles one way to find out the window was either the incorrect window, damaged during transportation from the manufacturer or damaged during installation. As of now, I am still waiting for the new window sash to arrive and a new date for the installation. Almost 1 year since placing my order, the window isn't right. I purchased Renewal by Andersen based on the quality of the product and the reputation of the company with an expectation of a superior product. I could have used another manufacturer but chose this company because I heard a lot of positive things. I also recommended you guys to another customer and they used you as well but everything went smooth during there installation. As of now, I am very disappointed with the overall experience.

Installers were pleasant, professional, clean and the vinyl capping is flawless. We have definitely noticed a difference in the temperature of the rooms we switched out the original windows to the Anderson Replacements.

Fraud!!! Buyers beware... I recently became aware that the terms I agreed to were not accurately reported on my credit report. I reached out to the finance company to receive a copy of the contract they have on file. The contract they sent me, to my surprise and distress, IS NOT the one I signed nor the terms I agreed to (17.99%, 120 payments of $137.93, totaling $16,551.00). My contract was for $7674, no interest for 12 months via auto payment. The person who completed the entire fraudulent contract used his own handwriting including printing and signing my name. The signature line where I would have to sign is not even close. Moreover, I personally would never sign up for such a financially destructive deal! As of June 2021 my credit report says I owe the finance company $6900 on windows I purchased for $7654 on 10/20/18! The company representative will not returns my calls.

We just finished paying off our windows since the price tag was so HUGE! If you are looking for customer service go elsewhere. We had a salesman come in and give us the sales pitch and showing us previous work done and demoing the window. While telling us about previous work, he told us he would follow up with us post install and continue to follow up with us throughout the process and continue to follow up to see how we like our windows! We did NOT see him after the sales pitch. Terrible customer service and very unprofessional!

Everything goes like clockwork with Renewal by Andersen. The salesman showed up precisely on time. He was thorough, knowledgeable and pleasant. The cost seemed high, but in the end we felt we had gotten a good value because the level of service was so high. The installers did a good job. And the company followed up with us several times to be certain we were satisfied. Overall, we were very impressed with how this company conducted themselves with us. And they earned this 5 star rating from me.

NO STARS!!!!!!!!!!!!! I am writing this as a warning to anyone considering buying windows from Renewal by Anderson. We did, and it has been the worst consumer experience I have ever had, And with a hefty price tag. The windows failed to live up to the promises made by an over-eager salesman, who also failed to live up to his promises to us. When we considered replacing our windows in the back part of our home, it was mainly for improved heating, with esthetics and update a side benefit. We still require a heater - even pre-winter. And the appearance is fair - not much better than what we had, except we have replaced a wood exterior frame requiring paint. Little change in appearance. But change in $$ - for very little accomplishment. We listened to all the hype the salesman spewed and believed it. So we bought in. And used the finance company Renewal used. We trusted them. That was our big mistake. The finance com and we got stuck having to work things out with them. The company has never sent an invoice, or e-mail on a monthly basis. Despite trying our hardest to rectify this, spending days on the phone with the company, we still have not received an accurate monthly billl reflecting the amount they want us to pay. We received NO satisfactory intervention by Renewal, despite the fact that THEY selected the finance company, not us. We have not had an e-mail change nor a residential change. It has been UNBELIEVABLY difficult -- a time-waster (we are both busy, an incredible waste of our time trying to deal with this finance company,which we did not select.) When contacted, the salesman insists that WE must take care of it despite the fact that RENEWAL is their client, we are merely an end user in this arrangement. There has been so satisfactory intervention, the pricey windows have failed to live up to any promises made to us by the salesman and the company's glossy propaganda brochure. WE ARE STUCK!!!!! I wish I NEVER heard of Renewal by Anderson. These expensive windows did not live up to promises, have a very pricey tag (and, by the way, there are several prices available, some that are advertised and some that are offered to you. When we agreed to buy them, I saw a TV commercial offering them for LESS). These windows have caused us hours of struggle trying to resolve a very simple matter: receiving a monthly invoice. And the pain of throwing away thousands of dollars that did not accomplish anything for us. I am SOOOO sorry we bought these windows. I am writing this to spare anyone reading this from having this same horrible experience, with little returns from the actual installation. Just problems!!!

The windows are great, but whoever designed the screen removal and installation should be fired. The absolute worst system I have ever had to deal with. If you don't mind having to feel your way around to install a screen and if you'd like to open your window without completely removing your screen, than Andersen is for you. I wouldn't again. John G Philadelphia

I don't know where to begin. Hopefully this helps others in the future. The salesman comes and give us an estimate on the windows for our house, the price was $20k for only the bottom half of the house. We told the salesman that we would have to think about it, he the proceeded to say that we had to make a decision right then and there or we wouldn't get that discount and the state/nationwide discount, that it was only for today. So we sign. They give 72 hours to change your mind to cancel. My husband and I talked over some more after the salesman left weighing pros and cons, we then made a decision to cancel. We call the salesmen repeatedly within the 72 hours and he doesn't answer. We continue calling throughout the week. The salesman finally answers by then which is Thursday after the 72 hour window. He says it's too late and the the windows already shipped out. Ha! So basically having a custom windows being made to fit your windows is a total lie. The salesman came out on a Thursday, the 72 hour window ended on a Monday, he finally picked up the phone that following Thursday. The windows are done and shipped out?! Yeah right, this company is out to steal your hard earned money. Now they're trying to stick us with a bill of $10k for windows we don't even have. Don't waste your time people, they'll pressure you into signing on the line and and never picking up the phone when you're trying to cancel.

I had a renewal by anderson salesman here today. After nearly 2 hours of my 1-hour consultation I still did not have a quote. Finally received a quote for replacing all of my windows and a quote for just replacing my downstairs 3 front windows. I looked at all the pictures, I looked at all the types of windows the salesman did not recommend, and finally got a quote of $11,000 for my townhome. When I did not sign on the dotted line today he walked out in disgust. I told him I wanted to get a second quote by another company. He asked if it was Pella and I said yes. He told me Pella's windows are inferior and will fail in a couple years. Well, I don't have to worry. I called Pella and today, Monday, and left messages. Never heard back from Pella.

Updated review!! Keeps getting more comical with this company. Just had a door to door salesman walk up to our house asking if we were thinking about replacing our windows anytime soon and that they have done other houses in the neighborhood! I had to break it to the sales guy that the renewal in fact did mine too! Customer service is not a strong suit here! We just finished paying off our windows since the price tag was so HUGE! If you are looking for customer service go elsewhere. We had a salesman come in and give us the sales pitch and showing us previous work done and demoing the window. While telling us about previous work, he told us he would follow up with us post install and continue to follow up with us throughout the process and continue to follow up to see how we like our windows! We did NOT see him after the sales pitch. Terrible customer service and very unprofessional!

I have to agree 100% with David A.'s post. I also have a small budget and had Renewal by Anderson give me a price quote (they don't like to call them estimates) and choked when I saw the original price. For 10 windows it would be around $22k. Guy was nice but during the sales pitch he didn't want to let up. I said this is very expensive and I need to give it some thought. Each time he said "so let's get started" I said no. He whittled the price down to $6900 for 5 windows and said that price leaves with him. I said then take it with you because I am not doing it. He also said I could not get a bay window because I didn't have enough clearance underneath the soffit. When I got another estimate from a different company I asked about the bay window and he said of course we can put one in! I was amazed. Anderson wanted to charge 3x more than the company I am going with and that $22k didn't even include a bay window!

I requested a quote from this distributor, they called me the next day and informed me they only quote for 3 window minimum. I have a very large window that needs replaced that probably will cost more than 3 standard windows. When asked for the minimum dollar value, I was told it was a 3 window minimum. Obviously they don't need the business, must be nice in this economy to have more work than you need. Interesting that one of the reviews was negative due to salesmen going door to door. The fact that they need salesmen is indicative of the need for business. I am tempted to contact Anderson and take away their local distributorship.

Unprofessional and Overpriced! We were asked to allow 90 minutes for a presentation, so we scheduled appointments with competitors 2 hours apart. As the long-winded sales pitch approached the 90-minute mark, we informed the salesman that he needed to wrap it up. He insisted that he couldn't possibly be done by then. He would arrange to stay in the area and return immediately after our next appointment. This turned out to be a ploy to bash the competitor instead of focusing on our project options with Renewal. Once he realized we were not going to be making a decision then and there, the salesman became absolutely rude. I'm familiar with high pressure sales, but insulting your customers seems like a bad idea especially if you're so desperate to make a sale. I can't imagine that these tactics work on anyone. At that point, we felt like hostages in our own home, and their possibility of making a sale went from a "Maybe" to a "Never." After reading about so many similar experiences here, we have vowed never to invite a salesperson or service provider into our home again without consulting Yelp first!

Buying new windows is a huge investment, especially if you want good windows like Andersen. We'd heard so many horror stories about other window installation and home renovation jobs (both on the news and from friends), that we decided to contact Renewal by Andersen in King of Prussia on the recommendation from friends with a super-nice house on the Main Line who had just had a ton of custom-sized windows installed and been thrilled with the end result. The sales guy was very knowledgeable and low-pressure and really seemed to want us to both understand everything from materials and measurements to financing. When it came time for installation, the guys (Jason and Dave, though not sure which was which) showed up on time (wow! - our plumber could take some tips from these guys) and were very polite. They were careful to keep everything clean in our bedroom. The windows themselves are beautiful, and the draft that we felt all winter long was immediately gone. We discovered that there had barely been any insulation around our old windows. The Andersen windows are really easy to clean as well, which I love about them. In the end I was actually glad we didn't go with the quick/cheap fix like the previous owners of our house had, even though we will have to save up to get new windows for the other rooms! It was our first big project (yay - congratulatory self-pat on back), and I think it was totally a worthwhile investment.

After catching the salesman in a lie (shocking, I know), and lack of confidence in their contractor who came to my home smelling like whiskey, I was actually sent an email where the owner Mike Watson at Renewal by Andersen of Greater Philadelphia insulted me personally. Nice business you got going there.

First of all. You should offer zero stars! My husband and I called Andersen to replace 4 of the standard double hung windows in our home During their "buy one get one free" campaign. Of course, we made appointments with two other companies as well. The salesman gave a very good presentation about the quality of the windows, the lifetime service guarantee and the company reputation. Then he gave us a quote. Over six thousand dollars for 4 windows. That was the BUY ONE GET ONE FREE deal!! So, without the "deal" the 4 windows would have cost twice that?! When my husband said we have to interview one other window company, the guy told us that the lifetime warranty would go away if we didn't sign up before he walked out the door! I literally almost laughed out loud! In a "small talk- I'm just a regular guy" conversation he told us about a used Lexus that he got for a bargain and how he wanted to get a new Lexus! He won't be buying it with my money! Later snake oil sales guy! We purchased beautiful windows from a very reputable competitor for less than half the price of Andersen.

FOLKS, stop bitching about the price of these windows. They are premium windows! You're not going down to Home Depot to procure some windows just for some schlub from your neighborhood to install them. All these windows are custom-made and the parts and labor are covered for life. I also was a little shocked at the cost for 3 basement windows, but Phil explained - in detail - why they cost so much compared to some other options, and it was a no-brainer to go with Renewal. By buying windows with a discount/promotion from Phil, we have secured that same percentage discount for any future windows we need replaced. We also went with the financing option because of the additional 5% discount and no interest for a year. The installation of our windows went smoothly and I couldn't be happier. Mario and his colleague cleaned up after themselves and worked quickly and quietly - with their masks on!! The windows are pretty, strong, easy to use, safe, and will keep our basement from being drafty now. For what it's worth, my mother also outfitted her house with Renewal by Anderson windows. She's had to make use of the warranty before for a broken part here and there and she has nothing but stellar things to say about their commitment to maintaining their products. I am docking a star only for the corporate-ness of this company. The satisfaction surveys are numerous, and the screener phone call to get someone out to my house for a quote was sickeningly long and unnecessary. I felt like my social security card and a pelvic exam were going to be necessary in order to schedule the appointment, but thankfully it didn't go that far.
No better windows, no better service. Expensive, but we got good value for the money. So refreshing to be treated as an important customer in this day and age!

Dear Boise Guest House (and Eve-Marie), Your rooms are so charming that we decided to stay on our way passing through Boise to Zion and also on our way back from Zion to Seattle. Different room each time, the first time was the Treetop Suite with a small little balcony and a really cozy living room with adorable red chairs and pillows. The only issue was that the shower head was really low and I am tall, so I had to bend down to wash my hair. That is typically the case with old homes though, I think, as I have ran into this issue in other older places. The second time was a two-bedroom suite...The Traveler's Suite (a bit too big for us but it was the only thing available) . Wow! It was like I was playing house, and I absolutely loved it!!! My fantasy of having a poster bed finally came true! My FAVORITE part(s) of the place is (are) the free coffee/tea/hot cocoa in every room, the brownie bites upon check-in, self-check-in, alphabet magnets and vintage typewriters! I know there is also free wi-fi, but when there is the option of reading one of the many magazines or books that are stacked about on the shelves or playing a board game in front of a (tv screen) fireplace, why would you ever want to be online!?! XXO, Liana

We rented the Hyde Park Bungalow and everything was perfect. So clean. Plenty of space to accommodate our family. Loved everything. Honestly I didn't want to write a review because I wanted to keep this secret gem to myself! Thank you Eve and Loise.
what a great place to spend a Boise weekend! comfortable lodging with all the amenities and walking distance to everywhere I want to be!

Amazing 1 night experience. The Travel Suite and backyard of this B&B was absolutely darling. The owner must be a decorator as everything was so darn cute. Extremely clean with ALL the amenities. The owner was very accommodating, as I had a change in travel plans. In fact, I called her about 6x with all my questions and changes after the initial booking.

Not only was the kitchen well stocked, but there was a private little patio where we sat outside with my cousins and ate and laughed in the evening. There was a little porch with chairs at the front door of the Nest (the name of the suite we had) and we enjoyed our coffee out there, looking at the plants and the neighborhood. We walked to the Co-op and found the location ideal - quiet residential close to shopping and meeting points. Clean, quiet, comfortable: hard to beat that.

Really great. Location is key because it's just outside of downtown and in the edge of the neighborhood. Clean and mostly quiet. Great back yard area although we spent much of our time on the front porch. We love Boise!

This place is amazing! We stayed 5 days, and really enjoyed this beautiful historic home with an amazing location. It is very close to all restaurants and beautiful downtown Boise area. You have the option to rent a bike, so you don't have to drive around. The guest home is very clean and has a full kitchen with everything you could possibly need to cook a wonderful meal. You also have access to private parking and laundry area. Everything is beautifully decorated and cozy...It feels like home.

Absolutely fantastic lodging experience in Boise. We stay in a variety of rentals, hotels and cabins and this place is one of our favorite anywhere - and easily in Boise! You will not trade comfort for intrigue here, either. While the rooms are artfully decorated and there is a playful quirkiness to the style, it is amazingly fresh, comfortable and up to date while being in a beautiful early century home. I recommend this place to anyone!

Most of our family lives in Boise, so we've stayed in a lot of hotels in Boise over the years with very mixed results. I'm so sad that it was only recently that we discovered the Boise Guest House. It is now absolutely my go-to Boise hotel. As soon as I learn that a family member has something coming, I hop on their website to book a room. We've come to think of it as a home away from home (You have a band concert that weekend? Great, we'll be at the guest house). The rooms are beautiful and clean, it's very close to downtown, and the stay is very peaceful. There is a kitchen and a bathroom that are fairly small, yes, but you won't find anything bigger or cuter in a cookie cutter, beige hotel. I can't recommend this place enough!

My "official" rating for the Boise Guest House pertains more to the particular room that we stayed in rather than the house as a whole. We booked Suite #4 for primarily two reasons: the bathtub and the larger kitchen. From the pictures on the website, I thought the tub looked big enough for two people, but, alas, it was not. The kitchen had enough utensils and such to prepare simple meals like breakfast. My biggest complaint with our stay here was the lack of AC. When we tried to turn on the AC, the heater turned on. This suite has one window which could have been better protected and privatized. Instead of using the AC, we had to open the window for cool down the room which my husband was reluctant to do because the window was exposed to anyone walking along the street at night. Also, the window faced the parking area which really took away from the privacy of the suite. With the lack of privacy, I felt like we couldn't be ourselves in the room as we always had to make sure that we had enough clothes to be "presentable" so to speak. These problems could have been easily avoided if only the fence was extended a few extra feet. As for the house as a whole, it is super cute, and is about a 10 minute walk from downtown Boise. Although we would probably stay here again, we would be sure to book an up-stairs suite because of the safety and the privacy concerns we had with Suite #4.

Definitely one of the best hotels I've stayed at for an unbelievably affordable price. The rooms are decorated very nicely and provide a very soothing, peaceful atmosphere. All the necessities are included and then some (great non-Folgers ground coffee, all the basic seasonings needed for cooking in, options for hot chocolate and tea in the mornings, and every option of dish and silverware if needed). I came into town for a surgery, so getting to stay at such a relaxing place was extremely helpful for my healing process. Free access to the laundry facilities is also a plus. It's nothing fancy, but an amazing feature you don't get at many hotels. Only area of improvement would be their outdoor hang out area. It is also very cute and cozy, but with a little extra, like a fire place or even a little extra decor, I would have been out there a lot more often. But this is just nitpicking really. This hotel was flawless and I would recommend it to anyone looking for a great and reasonably priced place to stay in Boise. 100 times nicer than any chain hotel and less the price.

This is one of those reviews you hesitate to give for fear you'll never get a reservation again as it's such an outstanding experience. Super cute rooms with full kitchens, walking & cycling distance super easy to Boise Coop, restaurants, green belt, the Boise Guest House is in the heart of it all! Eve Marie could not be nicer and knows Boise well along with a passion for sharing the Treasure Valley. Take a days drive up to Stanley on Hwy 75 We don't recommend the loop heading up 21, super twisty and the beautiful views are along 75. Go a bit past Stanley and when it gets twisty turn around. Stanley Bakery = Best sandwich's , but be careful only open seasonally.

We only stayed one night in Boise and decided we'd rather stay in a trendy local area then the traditional hotel stay. Lois helped us book our reservation over the phone and made the entire process simple. The location was great, as we were only about .4 miles from most of the restaurants and bars downtown. The walk was scenic and enjoyable. We had everything we needed, plus some inside the guest house. There were so many cute little details that you don't normally get when staying in a big hotel - for example: homemade treats upon arrival, fresh coffee, a cute back patio, yoga mat inside the closet, small notes around the house that explained each area and even told the history of the house, and more. The house was also very quiet, even with other guests staying in all the other rooms adjacent to us. Parking was also very convenient and included in the total cost (no extra surprises). Check out was just as easy as check-in. We enjoyed everything about this cute guest house and will definitely come back if we are ever in Boise again!

My husband and I stayed here on a 3 night visit to Boise. The location was perfect and we enjoyed walking downtown for coffee every morning and then again for dinner in the evenings. The accommodations were very comfortable. The porch was also a great place to sit and unwind after a long day. I highly recommend Boise Guest House on your next visit!
Charming, cute and well appointed room in a location that is walking distance to downtown. Check in was straightforward and easy. Biggest downside was the extra guest in the bed.

We stayed in the Attic Suite. The spaces were very inviting, clean and comfortable. Although the kitchen and bathroom were small, we had everything we needed for a very enjoyable stay. We will definitely stay again when in the area!

"As good as it gets" 5 stars, because it had me at Boi.....aaah, but seriously, I really loved staying here. I come to Boise at least once a year and usually stay at The Modern, however, I really wanted a change. Plus, I'm noise sensitive and thought this might be a promising alternative, it was! I booked the TREE TOP suite for my visit in January. It was COLD! The drive up took me through negative temps, so let me tell you how much I appreciated arriving to a nice warm room with a fake TV fire. It's the little things, you know? The room itself is like a small adorable apartment with a full kitchen, a little breakfast nook, a separate bedroom with bath and an outside patio. I can't tell you how nice it is to have the option to cook. That night I slept great. The bed was squeaky, but very cozy. In the morning I made a hand drip coffee from little mason jars of freshly packed grounds that they provided....again, the little things. I never heard or saw anyone on my stay, but that was more then likely due to it being the off season. I will most definitely be staying here from now on. As an added bonus, they are dog friendly, 5 more stars for you!

Stress-free 4 day trip to Boise unraveled when our confirmed stay was cancelled just hours before check-in. We received instructions for accessing our Front Porch Annex at 9:20 am for our reservation booked 8/30/18 for our 10/6-10/10 stay. At 11:41 we received a call saying there was some kind of mistake and that there was already someone booked into that accommodation. Since it was Parent's Week at Boise State, they didn't have any other vacancies and other properties they work with were also completely booked. They offered to let us stay at the owners house for a night..."trying to help accommodate us". We weren't looking to be "accommodated", we just wanted to check into a place we had carefully selected based on the amenities and location advertised. This place had received really high ratings and the people we conversed with while trying to find somewhere to stay for the night we're surprised to learn of our experience. We spent 4 hours in the middle of our first day of vacation trying to find an acceptable resolution. It was stressful, frustrating and a terrible way to spend 1 of our 4 brief days. For our troubles, we were offered a refund of the money we paid 5 weeks ago for a stay they confirmed twice but couldn't provide.

I stayed here for 3 weeks and it was fantastic. Clean, cozy, great location. The staff was welcoming and friendly and there were even home-baked cookies. I stayed in three different rooms during my stay and each room was unique. My favorite room was the one on the second floor with the porch, but all of the rooms are nicely decorated and clean. Also, there is a nice backyard with lots of picnic tables and a huge front porch on the first foor, so be sure to spend some time outside. No complaints at all.

I needed a home away from home and this was perfect for our needs. Something cozy, convenient and quiet. The kitchen was fully stocked with all that we needed and the staff is friendly and helpful. I appreciated the large living space to hang out with friends and family.

We stayed for three nights in Suite #4 and we'd definitely stay again. The room was charmingly furnished; pretty without being twee and incidentals that you might want but not want to buy (like sugar, tea, olive oil) were supplied. The bath mat was so thick and luxurious; I loved it. The clawfoot tub was nicely deep but it's a bit on the short side; fine for my 5'5" frame but it would likely be less comfortable for particularly tall people. The location of the guest house could not be better--right downtown but away from loud bars: it's about a five-minute walk to Flying M Coffee (best coffee in Boise), Cafe de Paris (lovely croissants), and the Boise Co-op (excellent everything). As others have said, the backyard garden was quite fine. We sat out with cocktails one night and had a leisurely breakfast (those croissants!) another morning, enjoying the antics of the red squirrels and watching sparrows gather grass for nests and get drinks of water from the nicely tranquil water feature.

We are so happy we found this place! It's a very charming historic guest house with many special touches. We stayed in the Nature Suite and the decor is so cute and perfectly appointed. The owner emailed us before we arrived with information on the check-in process and what to expect. Our room included almost anything we could possibly need during our 3 night stay. The location is within walking distance to downtown Boise. We even had our friends drop by for a glass of wine on the back patio before we took a 10 min walk to dinner. The patio has various sitting/conversation areas and nice lighting for an evening gathering. The only drawback are guests who do not respect the quiet time. The first night we were awakened at 11pm by guests who were very noisy when they came in. I still highly recommend the Boise Guest House...a home away from home!

The best bad hotel experience I've ever had. Apparently, either Expedia didn't tell them I had a dog, or I somehow failed to tell Expedia. So I wound up in a no-pet room. As soon as I realized the mistake, I called the proprietor, who was very apologetic about the fact that, at that time, they had no pet room available for me -- I would have to find accomodations elsewhere. So my 3-day stay turned into a 2-day one. But they were so nice about it, so patient and accomodating (no pun intended) that they turned a bad experience into an OK one. They went the extra mile in difficult circumstances. But as for the room? Quirky as advertised, very comfortable. Like a small Bohemian apartment, really. Tiny but serviceable kitchen, complete with spices. Interesting decorations. Small but very usable bathroom and shower. The most interesting thing is the "no human contact" system -- you just get a door lock code for the front, and pick up your key inside. Privacy is their strong suit. Fine location just a couple blocks from the heart of Boise, I say this place is a winner even though I lost out here.

I have been traveling to Bosie for Work and Leisure for more years than I care to share. I recently found out about the Boise Guest House from a friend and I am happy I did. The location is great, the rooms are clean and roomy, there is wireless internet and the rate is more than competitive. I will not be staying at a nearby hotel in the future, I will be staying here. It has everything I need. Thank you.

What a little sanctuary! We had the best time staying here. We were on a roadtrip in the northwest and had never been to Boise. Figured, why not? We decided to treat ourselves to a B&B instead of the standard chain and found BGH on TripAdvisor. Also needed to stay somewhere pet-friendly -- we have a 10lb Jack Russell -- and Eve-Marie was so accommodating. She told us that the only 'room' she had available was a two-bedroom little apartment in the back of the house. We went for it and were just blown away. Talk about a great value! We arrived late -- around 10PM -- and Eve-Marie met us and helped us get settled in. We immediately felt at home. Full kitchen, cozy living room, a nice bathroom, and two bedrooms (this would be perfect for families: one bedroom with two twins, the other with a four-poster full or queen size bed. So comfortable! The whole apartment had been redesigned with lots of modern touches -- it was just adorable! Originally, we had only planned to stay one night, but we liked the downtown area and BGH so much, we opted for a second one! Boise was such a nice surprise. We'll be back!

My husband and I stopped in Boise on our way home from a roadtrip headed back to Seattle. This place was so charming, and the room was absolutely beautiful. Extremely clean, super comfortable bed, cute bookshelves and canisters of hot cocoa mix...we loved it. The only thing I can anticipate being problematic (which didn't end up being a problem for us because we had quiet neighbors) was that since it's an old house, you can hear other people in the house. But it's an authentic old house that is in immaculate condition. Stay here. Better than any high end hotel and the nicest bnb I've ever stayed in!

I want to update my 5 star review to a 3 star. We have stayed at BGH several times. This is our third time. We usually love staying here. However, this last time, we booked a 4 night stay with booking.com. When we arrived, we received an invoice from BGH for only 3 nights. We checked with booking.com and confirmed that we had prepaid 4 nights, so we called the manager at BGH. She had to move us to a different room on the fourth night. This was very inconvenient for us. Check out was scheduled for 11:00 AM. We had pack our bags, etc. And we would not have access to our new room until 3:00 PM. We were dealing with the inconvenience, but my husband noticed that they charged our credit card for the extra night, so I was pretty disappointed. It was their mistake and an inconvenience for us. Also, the extra night cost is more than the original booking.com price.

I hesitate to tell you how nice this place is because then it'll be booked next time I'm in Boise. Responsive, helpful and super nice owners plus fully ready apartments. I won't tell you my favorite apartment so maybe I can book it next time.

This was our 4th time staying at the Boise Guest House Suites. Each visit has been in a different room. The rooms are always comfortable and perfectly clean. There is a ton of charm to each room. Last night we stayed in the Attic Suite. The air conditioning is perfect and we never saw or heard another guest. We love the opportunity to celebrate our Staycations at the Boise Guest House and look forward to our next stay!
I loved my stay here. It is super cute and a great downtown location. Great backyard and front porch.

Fantastic location and accommodations! I travel a lot for work and it was so refreshing to stay at a place with kitchen and all the little touches that make this place comfortable and relaxing. Highly recommend!

We love the Boise Guest House and have stayed there previously. It's a great location in the historic part of old Boise that I love. Having grown up there, I'm pretty familiar with the area. This trip we stayed in the Animal Trophy Suite and it was just perfect! Check in is efficient, everything we needed was in the room, and parking was readily available off street. The only negative is that the bed in that suite sags somewhat in the middle. After 4 nights there, my lower back was causing a lot of pain. It took several days back home in our firmer bed for the pain to go away. Other than that, it's our favorite spot to stay when in Boise and we plan to return (hopefully with a better mattress waiting for us).

As a native Boisean, I know "Boise Charm" when I see it, and Boise Guest House embodies it perfectly. The old house has been restored beautifully, maintaining so much of its original craftsman charm, but with modern updates. I've stayed in both the Treetop and Travel suites and was never disappointed in the comfort, the decor or the amenities. Upon arrival in the Treetop suite on a cold December night, the "fire" (on the flat screen tv) was crackling and the room was dimly lit and perfectly cozy. I recommend BGH to anyone coming into town or just needing a staycation--especially those with special dietary needs (there's a fully functioning kitchen in all the suites and the Boise Co-op or Whole Foods a quick bike ride away). The outdoor spaces are wonderful too--really feels like a home away from home--relaxing, comfortable, beautiful and mellow.

Went back to see about exchanging tank because it said you could on the tank they sold me a year back. This time they made a call to approve. Only problem is they had any. Due to burning man. I'm going to have to come back in a week when the tanks are returned. Good thing I have three tanks.

Too bad I have to give even one star. We moved over 3 weeks ago, and while the morning crew was very pleasant and helpful, the rest of our experience was terrible. We were charged with using moving pads ($5) and dolly ($5). I called immediately after I received email (5 minutes after returning truck). I said we never used those, so please refund the $10. It's not much, the $10, just principal. I have called a total of 3 times and emailed once, and still have not received the refund. I will be making another call soon, maybe to BBB. Makes me wonder how many people they are charging this minuscule amount and maybe the customers aren't noticing. Terrible experience. Won't be using any U-Haul company ever again. Hope the higher ups read this.
Everyone was really helpful and I would always recommend using UHAUL for your moving needs. This is a larger location, and they always seem to have plenty of equipment.

I'm about to embark on my first big move and I needed boxes and moving supplies. I went to this UHaul for my needs and I left pretty disappointed. I waited in line for about ten minutes while one person helped one customer and the rest of the employees were scrambling about doing other things. When I got to the counter, the employee was very short with me and not helpful. I explained it would be my first big move and if she could give me some advice on how many boxes/what other people usually do/etc., and she just gave me a blank look that basically said "Figure it out for yourself". Then she couldn't even tell me if the refills of tape would fit the tape rollers they had in stock. It was just very not helpful. The organization of the staff was very chaotic and crazy. I just wish they would have had things more under control and an employee more willing to help.

I had a reservation to get a hitch put on at 7 am this morning, I was about 10 minutes late. I am ridiculously sleep deprived also at this point The guy at the front (black framed glasses and missing teeth--not trying to be rude just for reference) tells me my hitch isn't even here and if they didn't call me for a reservation then I wasn't suppose to come in-- except I did have a reservation and I'm supposed to be here. He calls the parts place to get a time frame after 10 minutes he hands me a print out and asks me to sign. So I ask if my hitch is actually here, he says it is!!! Ooookay... He then asks if I am going to wait for the installation, I said I would, they initially to me on the phone it would take about 1 hour, I gave myself 2 hours, I was willing to wait around for 2 hours!!!! I leave the store to go to Walgreens and then to 7-11 to get a drink and a snack and still no one has even moved my vehicle. An hour and a half after my reservation time after no one has touched my car still I asked the same guy how long it was going to take and this is when he proceeds to tell it would take 2-3 hours as he is the only one able to install it and he has to run the counter. WHAT. THE. FUCK. Why did you not tell me that when you asked if I was going to wait for the installation. Ri-fucking-diculous. *****so after waiting for my car, the dude that did the install (his name is David) did what he can to make it up to me, I needed wiring too... why didn't we know this before I have no idea, he is doing that next week and waiving the labor. That saves me a pretty penny**** he gets dibs for effort

If you're in need of a moving truck, storage unit or rental service and considering using the Double Diamond U-Haul on S.Virgina street in Reno, I'd strongly advise you take a step back and reconsider your options. I had rented a moving truck from this location when moving to a new home. Shortly after loading the truck, a family emergency had come up and I had to fly back to New York, leaving me no time to unload it. So, I left the truck locked & parked at a local Walmart, still within time frame I paid to rent it out. My trip ended up taking 2 days longer then my contract allowed, so needless to say they repossessed the truck with all of my belongings still inside. I never once received a phone call inquiring about the status of the truck let alone to inform me that they had intended on picking it up. So I return to Nevada and go to Walmart expecting the truck to be there and to my surprise it was gone. Now, I understand that it was my obligation to return the truck on the date agreed upon and since that didn't happen, they repossessed it and unloaded all my stuff into one of their storage units. I paid off my balance on the storage unit and still owed some money towards the bill on the truck, and had worked out a payment schedule with uhaul to get the remaining debt paid off. I needed some clothing and a few other living items from storage so I went in to office and asked if it would be alright if I grabbed a few things and the guy working got the okay from his manager and opened the unit for me... I was stunned to see how the employees had handled my belongings. All my furniture was literally just thrown in there along with everything else. My two month old bed frame was broken, my brand new couch was broken, my iPhone and accessories were stolen, my paint markers and magic cards were all gone as well. Everything was ransacked and picked through then tossed carelessly before closing the door. A few days later I returned to the storage unit to grab the title to my car since the registration was up, thinking it would be no problem. WRONG. The manager on duty was a total dick with very little concern for anyone but himself. I explained to him the situation and that I had been allowed to retrieve some items a few days prior and before I could finish speaking, he cut me off and demanded I provide the name of the employee who allowed me into my storage unit so he could fire them. I continued to basically beg this man to please walk me back to the storage unit as I really needed the title to my car. He laughed at me and said since I had broken my contract with u-haul I was not allowed to touch any of my belongings until every cent was paid back to them. So, to sum things up... The employees at the Double Diamond U-haul not only stole a large amount of valuables from me, they carelessly threw everything I owned into a storage unit, breaking damn near all my brand new furniture in the process, and to top it all off laughed in my face and denied me access to what was left of my stuff until I paid off the remaining balance I owed to uhaul.

When I picked up the truck I informed the employee at the counter I would need the truck for about 28 hours not just 24 hours. I was informed that this would not be an issue. I received a call at the end of the 24 hours from a local U-Haul number, employee name Bennett, who was rude, snarky, and beyond unprofessional. He told me he did not care what the employee behind the counter the day before told me, I was delaying other people from getting their truck and it was my fault. When I went in to return truck, within 28 hours I agreed to the day before, Bennett continued his verbal attacks by not providing manager name or contact info. He then said he was going to make it easy and not charge me but now that I asked for manager information he wasn't going to help me. Does he behave this way with all customers or is it because I am female? He also appeared under the influence. And then the day before there was the check in to get the truck debacle. We waited almost an hour to pick up a truck I had already rented online. And the Uhaul application is useless.

Jury is still out on this one... Rating Could go higher or lower depending on how they handle this pending situation. We picked up a truck and were very satisfied with how quickly we were served, our reservation was all set with no problems, (in the past our group has had problems with reservations being cancelled and trucks not being available. Several people at our hotel in Reno complained that uhaul screwed them and cancelled a reservation ) and we even picked up some overpriced yet convenient propane while there as well. The fun started when we went to fill our gas, and noticed the gas line was CUT, and UHaul said they had no other truck, and if we wanted it repaired we could do so, and they would give us a free day later.... We shall see

I don't usually write bad reviews but my experience was terrible. I recently called Uhaul to schedule an appointment to get a hitch installed on my SUV. The location near my house I called did not have the parts so they schedule me a couple days out somewhere that did. I went there on my day off and spent several hours waiting between IHOP, dollar store and sitting outside waiting for my install. Several hours later I get called that they are done with the hitch but have the wrong wires so cannot finish the job. They will overnight the parts and I will have to come in the next day. The next day arrives and I get a voicemail since I couldn't answer the phone, that the parts have not arrived and they won't be arriving for another 3 days more. When I try to call back to make the appointment it rolls over to the Uhaul call center who says they will leave a message for the technician to call me back to make appointment. This was on a Sunday. I receive no call back so I call again on Tuesday, and again get rolled over to call center and they leave a message for the store to call back. Wednesday comes along and I have no response so I stop at the store on my way home since this location is nowhere near my house, the technician is gone home for the day so no one can tell me anything but they assure me they will have him call me back. Now comes Thursday, the day I'm supposed to be picking up my trailer, so I drive again back to Uhaul because shockingly I wasn't called back. I ask to speak to the manager this time. Magically they are able to fit me in later that afternoon so I have to drive back there again. I leave pretty irritated, but excited that's it's done. I was wrong, the wires installed do not work for RVs so I cannot hookup trailer with functioning lights. Not to mention the wires they installed are just hanging, no harness nothing. Needless to say I've cut my losses and decided to go elsewhere to get the proper hookup installed on my car. Between the Uhaul call center issues, the lack of communication at the store, and the fact that I basically spent $270 for nothing to have the wrong thing installed. My recommendation is to not use Uhaul at all for this service. Either go to the dealer, you will pay more but it will look nicer and be the right wires or go to one of the yelp rated places in town that has a high star rating for hitch install. If I trusted Yelp I would have saved myself the trouble by looking at their 2 star rating.

awful awful awful. line out the door. alllll kinds of glitches in the system for every customer. one customer was being charged 300.00 for a fridge dolly. nobody knew what they were doing except latrice. horrible horrible customer service i will never use this uhaul again. never.

We rented an auto transport trailer for a cross country trip and have nothing but great things to say. We originally rented a dolly until we learned that it wouldn't work with an all wheel drive vehicle. We spoke with a lady who then offered us a free upgrade to the full auto trailer due to the fact that the dolly incompatibility was not communicated to us. On our road trip we got a large nail in one of the tires of the trailer and had to pull off the road in the middle of nowhere Wyoming. The women we spoke with for road side assistance was extremely helpful. She got our exact location and called us back to update when someone would arrive. The nicest gentleman arrived right on time and changed the tire so quickly. They even followed up with multiple calls to make sure we were ok and taken care of. We were truly grateful.for such great service in a not so great situation. That's what customer service is all about. Thank you!
Absolutely appalling customer service. The sales rep we had the unfortunate luck to deal with at this location had NO IDEA what they were doing. Not worth the hassle. Go elsewhere!!!!
I made an appointment and they ready when I arrived. Very professional and very quick. I loved their service and they did a great job installing my new hitch. Thank you.

I purchased 5 small wardrobe boxes one quiet Tuesday morning with 3 employees helping me and they all agreed that the large crossbar was the one that should go with the small wardrobe box despite my questioning them. Today I am packing and it is a Saturday and I am 13 miles away from the store and I have the wrong crossbars. This seems like a basic piece of knowledge for a U-Haul employee to know and in case you run across one who doesn't you need the small crossbars for the small wardrobe box. Epic fail! Second only to the time I rented a U-Haul truck from this same crew, drove it to my condo and the battery died 30 minutes later.

Every time you call, someone will answer and say "can I put you on hold for a minute?" And then hours later you're still on hold. I left my phone go for 2hours and 20 minutes before just driving over. Literally nobody was even in the office. They say they do trailer hitch installs on the website, but when I called in and finally spoke to someone on the phone he said they do not do trailer hitch installs at this location. When I drove over, there is an install bay and they are working. Tried to fill my propane tanks. Was told to wait by the pump and someone would be right out. After 45 minutes of waiting and standing in the sun... I left. Worst business I have ever dealt with. DO NOT USE THIS UHAUL LOCATION!!! UHaul in Reno is a laughable farce of an operation.

Nice people, awful service. I had an appointment at 1pm to have a hitch installed. When I walked in a very nice man greeted me and said he would find out when the installer would be ready to work on my car. He never returned. 20 minutes later another very nice man checked with the installer for me. Said he was finishing up and they would bring my car in soon. It is now 3pm, I'm still waiting for my car to be worked on, no word on when that might be.

If I could leave 0 stars, I absolutely would. They are not waiving late fees if you are struggling to pay your rent due to Covid-19. Also, after 10 days, they double your late fees and start Pre-Lein proceedings. Storage facilities are not required to file in court to sell your belongings. However, you, as a tenant, must file in court to stop them. Good luck with that since all State and Federal buildings are closed.

Not sure these people are qualified for their jobs. Came 5 times to have our van wired and have a hitch mounted. Couldn't seem to figure out how to wire it. On the fourth try gave us back the van WITHOUT our hitch. On the fifth try they wired it but not having the trailer with me I couldn't test it, after an hour drive home the wires don't even work. Never coming to this place again! The manager said he'd do it himself but had some kid do it. Save your time and money and go somewhere where they actually know what they are doing.

Made an online reservation. Trucks available on the lot. David said the national U-Haul reservation system was down and he could not give me a truck. The 1-800 number for customer service told me there were no systems down. This is the second time I was unable to get the truck rental. Plus you rent a wreck at this location. U-Haul sucks. I recommend Penske, they are easy to work with and the rental trucks are better.

I spoke with a representative and she was very courteous on Tuesday. She said I had an appointment for Saturday and that their technician would call me back to confirm the work needed done for lighting harness and trailer light installation. No call back at all over the next couple days on Saturday when I called the local lady at the shop who answers the phone was fairly rude. That was about 935 940 this morning.

Everyone that works at this location is worthless. I just wasted so much of my time trying to get a hitch installed on my car after 3 weeks later scheduling an appointment they tell me they don't have all the wiring and parts they need to do the installation so I drop off to just get the hitch installed. To then only receive a phone call an hour later about how they couldn't do it because they didn't know how. Again wasting more of my time everybody was hiding when I got there I received no explanation or apologies. This is by far the worst experience I have ever gone through at a business in this area they should be ashamed of their self and close the doors.

I had a reservation for a trailer for my son to haul some furniture to the Bay Area for me, and the trailer was ready when we arrived. The nice guy who hooked up the trailer realized that the brake lights weren't working - so we tried another trailer. Same issue, which meant that the problem was with our wiring harness. He and my son did some troubleshooting, and determined that this was indeed the issue. They had a wiring harness kit in stock and had our truck fixed in just over an hour. Very courteous, nice guys all around, and the price for the repair was cheaper than if we had tried to do it ourselves. I can't remember all the employees we dealt with today, but there was Dakota, Nick, Joe (maybe!) and the manager who's name started with an A ...I wish I had written all their names down to thank them personally. Thanks for a good transaction!

DO NOT GO HERE to get a trailer hitch installed. They screwed up all the wiring on my jeep. No brake lights or running lights. There were 2 other Jeep's at the jeep dealer that were also ruined by trying to get a trailer hitch installed here.

Horrible customer service! Needed to get some propane tanks filled and couldn't get anybody to help me. Tried pushing the customer service button several times but nobody ever responded. Tried going to the front desk inside and stood in line for 20 minutes but the line moved nowhere. The customers ahead of me kept asking questions to which the people behind the counter could not give good answers. There were several employees walking around the yard aimlessly - didn't look like they had anything to do. Not one of them bother to walk up and say "do you need any help?" By the number of one star ratings in yelp I can guess they just really don't want to fix this problem either. Save yourself some frustration and go take your business elsewhere in Reno.

We returned our truck and trailer here to this location within the one way time we had. Ended up receiving a call from U Haul saying we never returned the trailer, tried contacting people at this store and was told phones are transferred and they never answer them. Had to go round and round with corporate and store to get the trailer logged in. Even after receiving paperwork showing it was returned was still charged a fee and had to dispute. The guys here never informed the manager of our issues, and they really could care less about there job. Save the hassle rent a truck from Ryder or Penske.

Laconically, U-Haul has decent service offerings, but this location has terrible service. If you value good service, then choose another location. --- Customer Service: Poor Explanation of Bill: Exceedingly Poor Politeness of staff: Poor Maturity of Staff: Very Poor Condition of Vehicle: Very Good Cleanliness of vehicle upon pick-up: Windshield and dash were dirty Gas Mileage of Vehicle: Good
Make a reservation 3 weeks before our move and get told two days before they don't have truck. They are a joke. I will never use haul again. No discount or find a answer to the problem.

We called the call service center ahead of time and reserved a storage room. Once getting there they said it wasn't available and that we are only a number to the call center and that we should have called this specific storage center to reserve instead. We drove all our belongings to this U-HAUL and were very frustrated to arrive and not have it available. The front desk gentleman was very nice and offered to let us keep our U-Haul truck for longer so we could figure out what to do and give us multiple smaller rooms. He was very accommodating. This is clearly a problem with the overall company rather than this individual branch.

I stored my stuff here for about 7ish months. The location is great and the U-haul system is amazing. Free to use carts and bed movers. Very secure, felt safe. Upon moving out I rented a truck from them. Dispatch tried to give me a truck that was 40 miles away which was dumb. I called this local and they worked with me and gave me a good deal on a truck. I returned it after hours and my bill was as expected. Easy peasy. Made moving a lot easier than it could have been.

I ordered a UBox for delivery on 8-29-19 with moving help from Tetris Movers of Uhaul's website. The mover confirmed pick up and drop off for 9:30am. By 10:30 am I called mover, no answer. I called Uhaul, they had to call mover and get back to me. After 2 hours I called back and Uhaul had to find an alt# for mover and was told they didn't deliver Uboxes any longer. So I had to reserve a pickup truck to tow box myself and I assumed to load myself. At the Uhaul location both the district ngr and local mgr were helpful in getting me alt moving help and not charging the pickup to me. I returned the pickup and box by 6:23pm on 8-29-19 according to the emailed receipt from Uhaul. On 9-5-19 I got an email from Uhaul stating equipment wasn't returned. I was in transit and called from hotel. They said they had the truck receipt, but not the box. Well the box was attached to your truck I said. So they needed to call the local Uhaul and would have them call me. 4 hours later I called back and was patched thru to Nathaniel at local Uhaul in Reno. He says they found the box and they were getting shipped asap. I asked if it was still going to arrive in Orlando, FL on 9-15-19 and he said yes. Later I checked my Uhaul account and it said arrival 9-24-19. By this time I decided Orlando was not feasible, and changed my destination to Cottonwood, AZ. So I called Uhaul back and spoke with the Ubox dept so they could change destination to AZ. Change was made and it reduced the charge by over 1100.00 at least, but they weren't going to do anything for the error and the Ubox guy was rather rude about it. So I went to check my Uhaul account a little later and it said drop off was Glendale, AZ not Cottonwood, AZ. So I called back. Apparently, Cottonwood Uhaul doesn't accept Uboxes. Wow, I am glad the U-Haul location has power and authority to right by customers - I can't wait to explain this situation to corporate and express my extreme dissatisfaction and disappointment. Lowe's is terrific for outright purchases. They have a wonderful selection of good looking and well-priced merchandise. Lowe's installation program seems to be quite a different thing. I found beautiful shower doors there & chose to have them install it. The first indication this might be problematic was the four trips there just to find someone knowledgeable enough to take my order & arrange the installation of these bypass shower doors. The installation took place Oct 23. The track at the base of these doors is installed entirely in a bed of silicone. The track or doors (don't know which is the problem) seems to not have been installed properly because it is crooked & consequently shortly after the install (one month) the silicone started to erode causing water to begin to seep under the track. I called Lowe's in Nov & was told the installer will call me & come back out. In Dec I called again. Later in Dec I was in the store & again requested help. Finally in January, when not only was the silicone almost completely gone, the plate on the bottom that is supposed to be secure would slide back & forth every time the door was opened AND there was as much water outside the shower as inside. I called again - forth time, this time angry. Mid January the installer finally calls, we have an appointment for Friday. He doesn't show up! I call yet again & indicate I want either a different installer or I someone to come out, inspect this, and give me a full refund for the installation & I would have someone else reinstall. Apparently there is no other installer for this procedure, the company Lowe's subs this work to is the only one Lowe's uses. They offer me a reinstall, with the same company, plus a 50% refund of install charges. I don't find this an acceptable solution - I would not choose to repeat this experience again with someone I already do not feel comfortable with. Lowe's finally agrees to a complete refund. Lowe's procedure is to charge a fee of $35 if their install services are requested, to have someone come out, measure & assess the installation - which I pay. If the customer chooses to go ahead with the installation, the $35 is applied towards the total installation price, in this case - $234 leaving a balance of $199 which is paid, along with the price of the door, when the installer completes the assessment & indicates what the installation charge will be. Lowe's credits my card for only $199, plus tax, because the install dept manager (whom I have been dealing with) says "you were credited the $35.00. Our basic labor for a bypass shower door is $234.00, when you subtract $35.00 it is $199.00, that is what the receipt is showing you paid." Not only is there a basic installation problem, apparently there is a basic math problem as well. Lowe's is either unable or unwilling to understand this basic numbers issue either. This experience with Lowe's has been a huge disappointment, not only was the actual install a dreadful experience, ultimately Lowe's really does not chose to 'make it right'.

Absolutely will not recommend this company!
