311 days of anguish and torture In August 18, 2017 I contracted New South Windows to install windows and doors in my residence. The contract stated that would complete the project between 12 and 14 weeks. We paid 1/3 of the project cost with the order. 14 weeks and three days later New South shows up to install and collect my second installment. A couple days after that is when I realized "Houston there's a problem". Everything went belly up! New South informed that they really didn't have all the windows and doors and that they were still in backorder. However partially installed windows were exposed for month without sealing or fixing the stucco around them. Now it's past Thanksgiving and the Holyday season. I had to wait again until New South hired a sub-contractor to do the stucco job. The contractor showed up sporadically to work on my windows even in Holydays. He destroyed parts of my lawn, plants and grounds. He even had the audacity to make stupid remark to my neighbor who called him out for the mess on his property not cleaning. Then something happened and he blew up one of my new picture windows. It's now a NEW YEAR, 20 weeks and 5 days and still the job is not complete. NSW project manager shows up in my house after multiple calls and we both produce a 9 item punch list. 1. Picture window with 8/8 grids Mulled 1/2 half-moon window over front door. 2. Windows 4 & 6 missing grids top and bottom 3. Stucco around loft windows need to be removed from shingles 4. Picture window 9 cracked, needs re glaze. 5. Master BR (wrong tint) 6. Master bath #19 cracked re-glaze 7. Caulk windows 25 & 26 inside and outside (screens missing) 8. Window #28 needs grids top and bottom. These are just examples of us going back and forth discovering new things and them coming sporadically to fix others. By this time, I have involved New South Windows top management including the President, CEO, VP and operations manager. Top management of this Company seems not to have power or influence through their organization. Their emails and request to employees (which I have) went nowhere. It's now April 3rd or 32 weeks and 3 days after signing the contract with New South Windows. Although the punch list is NOT complete, NSW schedules for inspection. Needless to say New South Windows did NOT pass inspection. The inspector found at least 54 missing anchor bolts throughout the entire house. A few days later NSW shows up and installs 56 anchor bolts that were missing. (these are supposed to be hurricane proof installations) don't know how with 56 missing anchor bolts. On April 18 they successfully passed inspection. That doesn't mean that they have completed the job. No, no no... new and old punch list items were still pending. We continued to go back and forth until June 25, 2018 or 311, 44 weeks and three days since we signed the contract I paid New South Windows the final payment. I will NOT recommend this company to anyone. This has been the most frustrating and cumbersome home project I have ever had.

We used this company before to replace five windows in our home. They did such a great job we hired them again when it was time to replace a couple more. This time we ordered two windows and the price came out to more than a thousand a window which is completely ridiculous considering the size of said windows. They did such a great job the first time we decided to hire them again regardless of the price. They quoted us 12-14 weeks for completion and we had install complete at about 20 weeks. Not only did we wait over a month past the completion window but they ordered and installed the wrong glass. One window was for the bathroom which was to be obscured, instead clear glass was installed exposing the bathroom view to three surrounding neighbors. Not worth the time or irritation. We have three long windows and three double sliders that will need to be replaced and we will be taking our business elsewhere.

They broke one new window and did not tell me until they left. They did not clean up, they left shards of glass and other materials all over my patio and yard. The Salesman, Install Manager, and Service Rep never called back about what happened, despite being "very upset and wanting to make it right". Took 5 weeks to get a replacement window for the window they broke, and I had to call them to schedule it. I have 33 other windows in my house and 3 glass sliders, I will be hiring someone else to finish the rest of the house.

Initially we met with 3 windows companies including Home Depot. The NewSouth sales guy was by far the most "salesman" ish of the 3 but he was just old school. The simple fact was their windows, at least the display they brought, was by far better quality than the others we looked at. Home Depot's best windows weren't even close to being as nice. But of course, price is important. He started his price high and we were able to negotiate with him. I love this because none of the others would negotiate. We ended up getting him down to a price below the others (and their quality of windows was clearly better). So once we settled on price and windows, I looked at the online reviews. My wife and I freaked out when we saw BBB reviews and Yelp reviews like "Sherri G's". We were very nervous. Fortunately, we had zero problems. The windows have been in for about 2 months (from this review) and they are everything we had hoped; our first electric bill was $92 down from $150, I don't hear my neighbors AC at night anymore and our house feels much more comfortable. The inspection went flawlessly; the city inspector even commented that these were "really nice" windows. We are very happy we made this investment. The only thing I'll mention is that I think we were supposed to tip the installers; I did buy them lunch one day (handed him a $20 bill) but I think I should have given him like $50 after the install was complete which I did not. They did a good job and worked very hard and were very respectful of my home and privacy so deserved to have a tip.

They have a great product. With that being said, their customer service is the worst. You'll never hear from your salesperson again. We signed a contract April 2018. Made it clear that we needed them no later than August 6 due to plans to leave town for a month. After many phone calls (got to know the wonderful secretaries), they came on August 8. We had to delay our departure. An incorrectly measured window had been delivered. Got home in September and called again numerous times. Finally came with the window at the end of the month. Inspection went well. Caps were installed on all windows and doors. Within 48 hours the door locks were not working on one of the doors and one of the caps was broken. We have probably called them over a dozen times. The majority of the time the person we wanted to speak to was out and never called back. So if the secretary tells you someone will return your call, don't hold your breath. It is now November and the problems have not been rectified. Update: Customer service has greatly improved. We are extremely happy with our windows. Keep in mind, Rome wasn't built in a day and neither are the windows:). You will be very happy with the quality of the windows. It will be worth the wait.

Salesmen never called for a follow-up to see if everything was going well or if I was happy. Patt H.

I want to caution anyone considering this company to go elsewhere. I had my windows installed in 2017 and although they were not the lowest priced estimate, I selected them due to the features of their windows as well as their lifetime warranty that covered both the window and the installation. Unfortunately in November of 2020 I discovered that 2 windows in my northeast bedroom were leaking into the wall. New South representatives inspected the areas and claimed the windows where not the cause. I hired a "mystery" leak detection company who identified that the leak was due to improper installation. Due to moisture penetration, mold formed within the walls and required complete mold remediation. During this process my emails and phone calls to NS representatives requesting repair and compensation went unanswered. NS sent representatives on several occasions to caulk the windows at the fasteners within the sill. During those visits I also verbally told the crews I was expecting compensation for my costs of the property damage. There was never any follow up from NS. It required a letter from my attorney requesting a warranty claim to initiate NS to contact me. NS stance is that it's my fault for not "contacting" them to do the wall and remediation work, although I have email and phone records showing otherwise. They are refusing to reimburse me for the total costs for the associated damages caused from the leaks. The remediation and property repairs exceeded $10,000. The representative has never apologized and shows no willingness to fairly compensate me for the repair costs. I anticipate legal action is necessary to hold them accountable. Do not waste your money or time on this company, your problems may not be evident until years after the installation!

Finally, on Tuesday, March 27, 2018, a NewSouth Window Solution technician came and replaced the cracked window. I believe in paying for quality and seeing the quality of the windows compared with others was the deciding factor. Unfortunately, I have come to regret my decision. I was thoroughly briefed that the New South factory was behind and would be about 4-6 months from order to installation which I was fine with. I started the process in December. They came to install in early June and it was immediately discovered by the install team that six windows out of a total of 21 were misordered. Later another window was wrong but installed anyway. Another window was installed with a cracked plastic frame. Another window was installed where the center of the window was not aligned with the two windows on each side, which looks rediculous. This noticeably uneven window is directly in the front of my house! There were issues with nine out of a total of 21 windows! I made call after call to Todd, the project manager, only to be ignored. I wanted to know what the plan was to correct everything. After seven phone calls, I was scheduled to meet with Todd who no-showed and no-called. I called the General Manager, Steve Lambert, who was somewhat responsive but again deferred me to Todd for a solution. I again attempted to contact Steve after Todd was non-responsive and the fact I still had scaffolding on the side of my house two weeks after they finished installing the windows while Hurricane Elsa was on her way. I had to physically show up at New South's office to receive any acknowledgment of my issues. I spoke to Steve about my experience with the company and the fact that nearly half the total order was wrong and he proceeded to tell me about his manning issues. There was no discussion of how the company was to "make it right" other than scheduling a meeting at my home to see the totality of the mismanaged project. Steve and Todd walked around my house and saw the issues described - nearly four weeks after the initial installation. Steve advised there was nothing they could do about the uneven window in front of my home that didn't match the ones immediately next to them. Nothing. I asked how could every other home in the neighborhood have windows that match but New South can't manufacture a window the matches others right next to it. Steve replied that he had no idea how they did it. It was obvious at that point no one was going to fix this and we moved on to the other issues. Finally, a week after that a couple guys from New South came not to take the scaffolding away but only to strap it down next to my house because their truck wasn't big enough. Keep in mind the scaffolding was no longer needed. It took an additional week for them to remove the scaffolding - after the hurricane. Let's not forget that the window stickers can't be removed until the inspection is complete but the inspection can't happen until all the windows are installed which will be in September/October at the earliest ... so a minimum of 10 months. Also, I can't get the stucco around one of the windows painted because it's just going to be torn out again and replaced. My home also had built in shutter hardware that New South removed and now I no longer have an option to install shutters on the second floor. The main reason I'm frustrated is the fact that there was no attempt to rectify any issue other than to simply submit another routine order for replacement windows. In short, based on the numerous mistakes combined with the lack of follow-up I can not in good conscience recommend New South Windows to anyone for any project.

After a long drawn out process to fix an official document which was improperly notarized by their office manager, this company has threatened me with lawsuits, denied any wrong doing, and has accused me of harassing them. They insist that I am only out for a discount which would have made sense if I had asked for a discount when they sent me the wrong doors, mismeasured two of my windows,acted unprofessionally or any other reason that I would have had to ask for a discount BEFORE the install. Just check out the BBB complaint response I received to see for yourself what they have said. I have also filed reports with the Department of Business Regulation, the City of Orlando, the State's Attorney's Office, Police Department, the Office of the Governor, and various other agencies if you'd like to look into those as well before you make a decision. They even have a letter from the government stating that their practices are not in accordance with the law and they still refuse to fix the document. They say that if I want it fixed then they will send me a blank one and I can fill it out and get it notarized and send it back to them. Also, I have a defective window, stucco damage and drywall damage and my install was over a month ago. I had to fix the drywall so we could hang the blinds back up. I still have not had inspection because the document in question is holding up the City of Orlando. They have finally offered to fix my window and stucco, but they are sending out the contractor I specifically asked them not to send out due to his unprofessional behavior during my second install. I have spoken to all the "presidents" of this company-- Garrett Jones, Earl Rahn, Dan O., and unfortunately the only advice I can give you is to take your business anywhere else.

Horrible. They installed a broken window six months ago and JUST now replaced it. (In May) Four months after they installed the windows initially, we called and asked when they were coming to put the new window in and they claimed they had no knowledge of a broken window. They gave us the run around for months! They did nothing to remedy the situation. And nobody in charge was ever there. It was a nightmare dealing with this company. Months later and still not getting the piece we are missing for the window. No returned calls and no returned emails. This place continues to be a shit show. The WORST customer service I have ever experienced.

They have a great product. With that being said, their customer service is the worst. You'll never hear from your salesperson again. We signed a contract April 2018. Made it clear that we needed them no later than August 6 due to plans to leave town for a month. After many phone calls (got to know the wonderful secretaries), they came on August 8. We had to delay our departure. An incorrectly measured window had been delivered. Got home in September and called again numerous times. Finally came with the window at the end of the month. Inspection went well. Caps were installed on all windows and doors. Within 48 hours the door locks were not working on one of the doors and one of the caps was broken. We have probably called them over a dozen times. The majority of the time the person we wanted to speak to was out and never called back. So if the secretary tells you someone will return your call, don't hold your breath. It is now November and the problems have not been rectified.

I have been dealing with issues for months and no one has been responsive. I ordered my windows October 2018 and waited the 16 weeks for install. We ordered from them because they demo a wonderful product and sell you on the fact that they don't use contractors to install and will leave your home looking just like it was before they arrived. We were replacing a whole two story home with new windows. We were quoted a 1-2 day install which did not make sense but we went with it. The installers were third party contractors who did not bring their own cleaning equipment and who caused extensive drywall and stucco damage. The work was so poor that New South cut ties with them. One of the men showed up to our home two months later threatening a lien on our property if New South didn't pay him. After 3 days of installation we were left with the windows "as-is". We were sold on a complete job and were now being told that we had to paint and fix some areas of damage. A few of the windows were installed slight off and have to be slammed and others were broken. We have been waiting since February for this to be resolved. We haven't even been able to get our windows inspected. The stickers that must remain on have already faded from the sun and weather. Our new back door is still an unpainted sloppy job that we have to explain whenever we have guests. At no point has this inconvenience been addressed. We overpaid for windows with the expectation that the service and product would be worth it. I am wishing I had saved the money and not been sold on the company name and marketing. Don't be fooled by their salesmen!

My saga began in June 2019 and did not end until the middle of January 2020. These folks may have a good product, but they are certainly not worth the pain and heartache it takes to work with them. The windows were ordered in June and I understand that they are all custom manufactured. The installation was finally set for September 3. One window was made incorrectly, so filler was added to secure it for while. Finally, on Nov 29, the replacement window was scheduled for installation and, of course, it was also the wrong size. Strangely enough, after waiting 2 1/2 months for the first correction, it was just a few days until they brought another one that finally fit. We could finally make an appointment with the county for inspection. Our home was disrupted for 4 months and at the end of all of this (I have spared you some additional details), we received a somewhat vague "apology" of sorts and a $50 gift card. My advise......run, don't walk away from this company and for heavens sake...don't pay in full until EVERYTHING is finished to your satisfaction.

We met with several window companies to get quotes on window replacement. They were in and out within an hour. New South was there for almost 90 minutes with the longest sales pitch. When it was time for the estimate, the sales man wrote a number on a piece of paper and asked what I thought. I asked him for a break down of the quote. How much is each window, how much for installation, how much for just a slider, etc. He told me they "don't do that." Every other company gave me an itemized quote. Their piece of paper price was consistent with the other companies and they do have really great windows. I just didn't like the shady sales tactics. Why couldn't I get an itemized quote?

If I could leave a negative number review I would. Terrible customer service. Overpriced. Installers ruined our siding. No return calls, terrible. I would NEVER recommend this outfit. My next calls will be to a attorney and TV station help.

I originally placed my order for ~$30K worth of sliding doors and windows back at the end of September (9/24/2015) and provided an initial deposit of $10,500. The Sales person verbally indicated 6-8 weeks, but the contract clearly stated 7-9 weeks. As it turns out, I would have been very happy with 7-9 weeks. It's now 18 weeks and counting. I called the Sarasota office in early November and was informed that order was not thru production yet. Several follow-up calls and several weeks later, I was promised an install date just before Christmas - never happened. I received a call on 1/4 from Steve L. that the windows were ready to be installed and the doors would be available to be installed the week of 1/11. I was travelling on business both of those weeks, so we agreed to do the complete installation the week of 1/18. Windows were installed on 1/18. The sliding doors "couldn't be found" for delivery. On Monday, 1/25, I spoke with Steve and was told that the doors were found and we scheduled the installation for 1/29. Today (1/29), the crew didn't show up. Didn't call. Not even a call from Steve. After another round of follow-up calls with Steve, I now have yet another promise that the job will be done next week. They say they have the doors, but it was a crew availability problem that caused them to miss today's date. I no longer believe anything they say. I'll believe it when I see it. How can you treat your customers so poorly?

Never do business with this company. They do not make windows here. You can wait and wait for them to contact you until you finally have to call them,. Make sure you check with the BBB website before choosing a window company. The best "show display" may not be exactly true. They do not have extra windows and dont have to call sales manager for a better price. This is a ploy tactic to make you think you are getting a good deal.

I signed a contract Sep, 23, 2000 for Hurricane Impact windows. Waited 4/12 months for installation! When they finally arrived I was excited to have them installed. OMG! I have to wonder about the quality of these windows, there is caulk left on windows and frames from the manufacturer. The exterior side of the sliding door is a JOKE! They made a make shift frame out of wood, yea wood not metal or vinyl, but wood. The seams don't line up and there are large amounts of caulk covering them, gouges one side of the frame primed over. Not even painted, only primed. When you open windows, you flip up locks slide open, when you shut it self locks. They look to be plastic and cheaply made, wondering how long before I will have issues. The installation, only one person on the crew spoke broken English. What a mess from start to finish. Caulk everywhere inside and out. They broke one windowsill, took a small piece they had on their truck an installed it, 36inches to short, assured me they can find another half? ARE YOU KIDDING ME, how are you going to match up an old piece of marble? All the bottom ledges of windows look like they have been cut, should go from side to side or have some kind of end caps, the cuts on each end inconsistent. 2 1/2 on one side 2 1/4 on the other. Another windowsill after they installed window now goes from 2 1/2 inches on one end down to 1 1/2 inches on the other. I cant believe I used this company. HUGE DISSAPOINTMENT. I'm sick to my stomach what I paid for these windows. What's really funny is they called the next day and asked me if I was ready to set up the inspections. FUNNY! When I explained to the rep at New South Windows, the lack of quality, installation nightmare. The fact I'm still missing half a windowsill she asked me to send photos and she would pass this along to a supervisor, someone would be getting back with me. I guess I should have asked, next week, next month, next year?????

I will edit later. Meanwhile, DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY. Within two minutes of Mike entering my Home, he insulted my neighbors who just spent at least $25,000 on windows with this company. He told me they bought windows and "cheaped out" on the sliders. Then, after the windows were installed, they wanted the sliders done. After he gave them his price, they told him he was ripping them off and priced too high. What salesman starts off his sales Call by insulting your neighbors !?!? I will continue this review over The Weekend when I have time.

It has been months since New South Window installed my windows and they have provided nothing but very poor customer service. They continue to threaten me with court, liens, and lawsuits-- including a slander charge for what I posted on yelp. However, everything I have said is true and I can prove it. I believe that other consumer should know what they are like before they decide to purchase from them. Go to my website to see pictures and read more about how they are trying to foreclose on my house!! http://www.overthrowmartha.com/2014/03/eco-friendly-contractors-what-can-happen.html AND look out for the news articles coming out!! {wink} All I want is my defective windows fixed, my stucco fixed, and compensation for the time and money I have spent trying to show that it is against the law that the Notice of Commencement was improperly signed by a notary outside of my presence (which they admit they do commonly). They state that it is their policy to not discount for any reason so they are still requiring me to full payment even though I have spent approx $2k in fees, missing work, postal cost, etc A WEEK AND A HALF after they placed my windows they placed a lien on my property. I never received notice, but it was attached to my online file. So sweet. And now they have served me to foreclose on my house. This isn't right! So, please, do yourself a favor and stay away. If you're in Orlando try Collis Roofing and Windows because they placed my doors (which NewSouth Window fudged big time) and they were wonderful. UPDATE: The lien was removed, but TWO YEARS later, they go behind my back and SUE ME! They win only because I didn't even know I was being sued so I never showed up! Sneaky, sneaky. Are these the people you want to deal with?

After last Hurricane Season, my wife and I decided to make a good investment and to purchase Hurricane resistant windows. It was a huge investment so we did a lot of research and we heard that New South was the best. Their salesman, Joe, came to our home and was very thorough and answered all of our questions and really showed the value that this purchase would bring to us. When he left, we realized we were making a good decision. When it came time for installation, a crew of hard workers came to our home, worked very hard and by nightfall we had Storm proof windows. The follow up and assistance we received from New South truly shows they stand by their product and thus far we are beyond pleased. Our house is much more quiet and secure. It is lowering our energy bill and we have peace of mind come Storm season later this year. We would recommend New South to anyone considering Hurricane Proof windows. They have an excellent product backed up by a solid support team and infrastructure. Thank you New South on a job well done.

Before consumers do business with this merchant, i strongly advise they review the BBB files. In my adult life, I have NEVER seen a company with this many poor reviews. Glad I cancelled my in home estimate with New South Windows.

I installed 6 windows and one sliding door in my Seminole, Florida home back in January 2018. The total cost was about $13,000. You would think one would get a good product and excellent after sales service with this high amount? Think again! One window glass came cracked and was discovered by the company's final inspection staff. He promised the company would replace the cracked glass within 4 weeks. No body called or contacted me despite my calling their office in Tampa several times asking them to honor their warranty and replace the cracked glass. They keep giving me the run-around answer, somebody will contact you as soon as possible and I have been doing this since February 2nd! Be ware and do your home work to get the best after sales service and do not fall for some one who takes your money but never returns your call when you need them!

This company cannot honor their claims. They told me they made their own windows in Florida for the South, but could not give me an address of the factory. They claim they make their own glass with nine layers of solar and hurricane protection but the sample they showed me was exactly the same as the other windows we looked at. They claim buy two windows, get a third one free, but at over a $1000 per window they are just hiking up the price. We looked at a few window companies. The average price was about $700 a window installed for a white vinyl window with enhanced solar protection. After all the companies did their two hour dog and pony show we just looked at the bottom line and their reviews. This company has had over a dozen complaints on the BBB since last year. I noticed they opened and closed their Altamonte Springs office. I'd be terrified to see my window company go out of business after spending $10,000 on new windows! http://www.bbb.org/west-florida/business-reviews/window-companies/newsouth-window-solutions-in-tampa-fl-90094094# Needless to say we didn't buy from New South Windows. Do your own research. Get three quotes and read the reviews like we did. Although we had to wait a month to get new windows in our house in Florida, we are very happy we made the decision and saw a huge drop in our utilities.

We were sold on the salesmans demonstration of the lack of heat transfer into the house with his heat lamp. After having these windows installed we found the heat being transferred into the house by the sun was at times over 95 degrees with the interior temperature set at 78 degrees.. After asking for an inspection we were told " sometimes when the sun hits just right we will still get heat into the house" . I feel this is false advertising and should have been told the demonstration only works with a heat lamp. A classic case of misrepresentation of their product. Be wary of a purchase from this company.

I ordered windows from New South Window way back on Jan. 10, 2017, Still don't have an install date! I decide to call the New South Window everyday till they give me a date. They told me it will take about 12 weeks. Now Is May 2, 2017 at 12.30pm I still have to called them everyday to checked on my the window. Almost 4 months now. I will update my review when they give me a date...

Last window finally fixed. All windows are in properly. It is truly a shame that a company starts out so well and just totally collapses with follow up service. New South needs to learn or they will go the way of the dodo bird and disappear.
Salesman lied to my face and told me that if I didn't replace all the windows of my house I wouldn't get approved by the county inspector. Very rude also. I'll stay away from this company.

First I just want to say that the manager responded to my first comment and said that NSW tried to call me that day. They did not. My husband and I sat in the garage for over four hours with phones in hand and never recv'd a call until I called and said the windows delivered were incorrect. I imagine someone told him they tried to call but must have misdialed. The frustration from New South Windows continues. I feel as if this will never end. The correct windows were delivered(the second time) and installed. One of the windows was difficult to close and I demonstrated to the installer. I was told that I was closing it wrong. I needed to put down my cane and should use two hands to firmly close the window. Of course the installer closed it that time. The county inspector was supposed to come again, (the first time the windows were wrong) soon. NSW called to schedule the inspection and I explained to the young lady that the window had become extremely difficult to close and I wanted someone to look at it. She put me on hold and came back and said, "after it passes inspection someone will come out". Inspector came (third time) and failed the one window because it's REALLY hard to move. He sent an email to NSW while in my driveway and explained why the window was failed. Inspector said that NSW had been notified and I assumed NSW would contact me. Inspector will have to come back for a fourth time. Nothing heard from NSW and now I can't close my window at all, it got down to 45 in my bedroom. After five days(Tuesday) I called and spoke to lovely Loretta. I tell her my window won't close , it's 45 degrees and window failed inspection. Of all the things I said she only heard the window failed inspection. I had to beg her to please have someone from repairs/service or whatever it's called to please call me. It's now 6 p.m. on Thursday. I have not heard a word from NSW. Every single time I've had something that I NEEDED to talk to someone at NSW about I have to deal with Loretta. Every time I've had to deal with Loretta NOTHING is ever resolved. The ONLY time I've gotten a response and spoken to anyone except Loretta is thru social media. Loretta is starting to remind me of the troll that guards the bridge and refuses access to all travelers. Its like a border crossing and I don't have the correct passport. Sorry, not sorry, she's following her job description. Petty employees are just a side perk of NSW. I have to wonder if I'm the only person she hates or if she's just the wrong person for that job and is related to someone at NSW. Florida has another cold front coming in. I have my pretty, brand new, paid for window that DOESN'T work and an employee that is always ugly to me when I call. I am mentally weary and trying to just get this entire experience over with. I truly wish that I never, ever heard of this company. All I'm asking for is someone, anyone from NSW to do their job. Everyone blames another department when something goes wrong and then I have to go thru the belligerent Loretta hoping that she will actually send along my message. Btw belligerent Loretta is the nicest thing I've said about her. Would someone other than Loretta please call?

I wish I had read the Yelp reviews prior to contracting with New South Window Solutions, at 10741 Crossroads Commerce Blvd., Tampa, FL 33610, for the installation of ten windows in my home last year. The installation of the windows began in early August 2018, almost seven months later the installation of all ten windows is still not complete. There were some problems with the quality of the glass initially and New South Window agreed to reorder glass and come back to replace panels in some of the windows. For one window, a standard window, the first delivery came with a crack in the internal glass panels, hence the window needed to be remade at the factory, when the remade window arrived many weeks later it did not fit in the window frame and yet the first window did fit, but due to the internal crack was not acceptable. In November when the third remade window arrived for installation it also did not fit, so once again an order was placed for a new window which we are still waiting to have installed. We are also still waiting for two glass panels to be replaced, they were ordered in the beginning of November 2018, four months ago. Weeks go by, I send an email, call and leave a message, and no one returns emails or contacts me until I copy a territory manager on my email request for service to complete the job. Communication with New South Window has been very difficult, I rarely speak to the same person twice, there appears to be a high turnover of employees. I find it ironic that New South Window is doing extensive advertising for new customers and yet they cannot complete the work for existing customers; I am glad I withheld final payment. There is something to be said for companies who provide quality products, dependable service and respectful customer service, this has not been my experience with New South Windows.

Truly not your average window company. With so many window companies out there, it was nice to hire a company that manufactured a green window, very energy efficient and professionally installed the window also. Made in Florida, by Florida workers, for Florida homes. We ordered new windows for our 20 year old home and couldn't be happier with the windows, and service. Great job NewSouth! I will definitely recommend you. My neighbors already have theirs on order. Pete.

So I called Cody as per the "owners" suggestion from my original review. He stated that the windows were done and ready to be installed. Never addressed our issues of selling the home just wanted to immediately schedule the installation. Well they came to do the install and 2 of the patio doors were incorrect (one could not even be installed at all because it was completely wrong) two of them were suppose to open and they installed stationary windows. Unfortunately they do not put the trim and molding on the windows until after the inspection and the inspection cannot be done until the install is complete. So I have pieces and parts on my patios, on my floor, and I cannot replace the blinds because they are custom and would need to be removed again and the cost is quite prohibitive, I also cannot open my main patio door because they didn't put the screen in. Merry Christmas to us - uggghhh. Bit wait - there's more - so we paid $14000 down and financed the rest and I receive a call from Cody stating that since they completed most of the work he would need me to sign a document stating they could release an additional $19000 of the financing, meaning we would have to start paying instead of what was agreed, additional payments start after completion of the project. I told Cody to do what he needs to do and I would do the same. The financing company called and I explained the situation. They agreed that the job needs to be complete. In the meantime I have gotten dozens of emails, phone calls, notes on my door and voice mails from the company. The last Voice Mail from Cody stated that since I did not return the calls or sign the document my job was on hold. Wait a minute pal, your company effed up the job - not me - fix it and fix it NOW! I phoned the company today at 9:30 and explained the situation and said I needed to speak with the GM or someone in charge, I was told they were all in a meeting but Dave would be calling me. Well here it is almost 5pm and nothing. They are very aware that we are traveling to Moffitt Cancer Center in Tampa regularly and do not need this additional stress. At this point it is abundantly clear that New South puts their own profits and needs above that of the customer and they are NOT a company of integrity or their word. You lied and said my windows were complete, obviously they were not, you are now blowing up my phone calling between 4 and 6 times in a row in rapid succession, you are leaving threatening messages but amazingly you are NOT trying to complete my job. What is wrong with you people? I will tell everyone I know to RUN from any New South representative. Talk about horrible people.

Improper install. After waiting 23 weeks for my product to be installed, 3 of my 10 windows (adjacent double hungs) were installed such that each window is cockeyed with the adjoining one. Looking at the window from several feet away you can easily see a broken horizontal line across the center of the window opening. The installer and "production manager" argued with me that the windows were hung straight, but my opening wasnt square and level. When asked why they did not square and level it before install, the hem and haw answer was it would not fit (they said they did not have enough room to shim it up - I pointed out they were the ones to make all measurements before windows were built) Not Happy

Horrible first point of contact! That says alot about a business! Called to get a representative out to the house. Spoke with Peter. After giving him my information and setting up and appointment her called me back and stated that he sees that we had spoken to someone in 2018 and the process had doubled. He stated that they only do PVC now and no longer doing aluminum. I asked if he could see what we were quoted before he said he didn't have that information. Well how could he say the prices had doubled? He said he didn't want to waste thier time or mine and again that the prices had doubled. If he can't tell me what we were quoted before then how are the prices doubled. I got so angry I told him F!@# you! Wrong on my part but he got so argumentative and loud. I called the Tampa Bay location to get the supervisor's name and she transferred me to Peter. Who started screaming at me he had written an email to his supervisor about me. Which is great but he refused to give me a name. I find that odd. We were new home owners in 2018 and are now ready to redo our windows but off the top they have doubled in price according to a appointment taker who is no allowed to talk about pricing. Overall a bad experience from the first phone call. Let's see if a supervisor does call. What a joke!!

We couldn't be happier with the service we received from New South Windows. The salesman was courteous and knowledgeable, gave us a great product presentation and left us with a thorough, no-pressure quote that covered all our options. The installation crew showed up on time and did an excellent job. The windows were installed perfectly and look fantastic! After installing each window, they thoroughly cleaned it and the surrounding area. There was no mess. They really treated my home as if it was their own and we really appreciate it. I'd heartily recommend New South if you're in the market for windows!

We signed a contract with New South Windows October 2020. Seven (7) months later, well after their agreed upon time frame of 14-26 weeks of completion, the windows and the slider doors first day of installation began. The installers were friendly yet did not 100% follow their own installation protocols. There was a thunderstorm the first two days of installation and only one window had a drop cloth. They left dirty shoe prints on new tile, new flooring, dirty walls from handling. Upon completion of the first day of installation, we first and foremost noticed the noise in addition to the mess left in the house. We inquired with the installer and he stated that he did still hear noise as well and was not sure why. We contacted the New South Windows office and spoke with Anthony, a part of the production team, and he said as well that we should not hear noise. We also alerted Julian, the salesperson that we heard noise. Julian also reiterated that we should not hear noise and that he would be upset and would want this corrected to 100% satisfaction. The installers returned the following day and at least mostly wore shoe covers and put down two drop cloths. With the remainder of the windows and the two slider doors installed, there was more damage to the house - new drywall broken, window frames broken, new bathroom tile broken, broken glass on new window, two broken screens, and an inferior slider door with additional drilled holes, as well as additional muddy shoe prints and dirty walls. There was also still noise to be clearly heard from all windows and slider doors. There was also shoddy workmanship of the product itself with multiple excessive caulking and mess with the windows and doors. The installer again stated that he did not understand why he could still hear noise and could not clean all the mess off because it was too much. They used Great Stuff sealant, a cheap product around the windows and slider doors. We alerted New South Windows again that same day we were still not satisfied with their products and materials. The company sent Cody from the production team two weeks after installation to discuss issues and after an inspection, acknowledged all the issues and just asked for payment. He said that the job was finished, and that payment was needed. The job is not finished and there are still all the issues first brought to New South Windows attention at inception. Cody said that he would speak with his boss and get back to us the next day. Cody stated that customers have held $500 and $10k from a job until completed to their satisfaction yet was not willing to take half payment from us until completed to our 100% satisfaction. Under duress, we wrote a check because Cody promised he would be in touch the next day and we would move forward. After a week, we had not heard anything, and we put a stop payment on the forced check due to non-existent communication and shoddy product. Cody only called after the check was stopped and did not relay any information as to what was being done to correct the issues and move the job along. Cody just said that he would put the job on hold because of stop payment instead of even trying to get answers and work on correcting all the issues. That was a month ago as of this review. New South Windows stated that they had a superior product and that is not what was received. They decided to just drop the ball and not handle their responsibility to their customers nor back their own products and complete a job to 100% satisfaction.

When I move to Florida I will definitely use NSW for all of my window needs! We had New South Windows on two separate occasions even though they are a little pricey. The first experience was fine but the second one is totally disappointing. I REALLY did not want to do this, but here we go. I bought 5 windows from New South Window company, the sales rep was timely, professional and very knowledgeable about his product. I bought it. He made me aware of the 4 month time frame on the installation, not a problem at all. Communication was great up until the installation time came. Installers came, went room to room pointing out the windows. I had been working from home to ensure everything was alright. And this is where things begin to get messy... 1) Installer #1 had been chopping away at the wrong window frame on my home. Once I had figured out that he was going at the wrong window, I immediately notified him. He quit working and went the correct location. The incorrect window was never inspected or nor was I notified that nothing had been seriously damaged. 2) Installer #2 began to work on another window in the back, big 5x5 single piece. Installer #1 walks up and they begin dismantling the window. Adding suction cups to the sides of the glass, they walk through my home into the foyer where BOOOOM. The glass had dropped and exploded. Not a big deal, accidents happen. Half ass clean up job is done and they continue on the other windows. Their cleaning left shards, pieces (size of a mans finger) throughout the foyer, office and dining area. I found out pieces were left because I stepped on a nice size piece of glass while on my way to my office. 3) Fast forward after the windows have been installed, the installers have left the job site and I am walking through and around my home to inspect everything. At EVERY SINGLE spot where the windows had been replaced was an immense amount of broken glass from the former windows that had been there. At this point I am annoyed, but whatever. I am picking up the glass and putting it in a beach bucket when I hear my DOG screaming on the pool deck. I run back to the pool area. My dog is still crying gnawing at his bloody paw. I instantly knew what had happened. I pulled the class out of my dogs paw. Collected the rest of what I believed to be the remains of the old windows and called the store. I asked for the store manager, Randy. Who I had told about what had been left behind. It didn't seem to phase him. His exact response was "I can get a tech out there to look at it". Look at what? the glass that was left behind? My dogs paw? My foot? What can your tech look at. After all of this, the windows have to be inspected by the city. The city approved them. New South is SUPPOSED to call and set up a time for the techs to come back out and finish the windows (plastic caps they put on the sides). As I write this, it has been 2 months since my windows were installed and finally got someone to say "oh wow, the caps for the windows haven't been put on yet?" Needless to say, I have called numerous times to get this justified or even have this heard. My wife has called numerous times. Unfortunately nobody believed it was a good idea to call back or even say "Listen, we are sorry for the mess that was created. It is not our intentions to have our customers unsatisfied. What would you recommend we do next time?" Maybe they can take that phrase and use it during training's. There is an upside to this. There is a young lady at the front, her name is Keyanna (I do hope that is spelled correctly). She is extremely nice, helpful and is more than willing to ensure you are being taken care of.

Still waiting for final inspection to be done by city Faulty wrong glass replaced two weeks ago Still waiting. ......... Why couldn't the inspection be done the day after faulty window replaced?? We have had to put up with having stickers on the windows to look st instead of blinds. See what else is wrong when inspection done.

So back in May we ordered windows and doors doe our home. Although they were extremely pricey we felt that since this company is also a manufacturer and they are owned by a larger manufacturer we would be in good hands. We were told that they had no major delays, just the normal manufacturing stuff but no supply chain issues, etc. so we were given a date of September, October at the very latest. Fast forward to beginning of September and my partner has some additional health issues (on top of recovering from a stroke) and his doctor said that it would be in his best interest to move into a ground floor home, as even with the chair lift, his mobility is very unstable. Given the fact that we had been given some very impressive offers on our home we decided to sell. So I phoned this company and asked what the ETA is - no ETA from the warehouse. So I asked if they'd even begun making them, I was told they weren't sure. I explained that we would probably be moving and the cost of the windows would not give us an ROI - in fact we would loose money. I asked if since the windows are not even made if we could just get a refund of our $14000 and I was told my "sales rep" would give me a call. Never heard from him. I get a call today and the same girl I spoke with before gives me an "update" that the windows are not done. I ask her for an ETA and she says 2-4 weeks. I asked her why no one has gotten back to me and she just kind of stuttered over her words but gave no real answer. So basically, they just keep lying to me so that they don't have to give us back our 14k and they stick us with windows that cost so much we can honestly never move if we want to move into something comparable. Too bad businesses today care so little for the customer and so much for the almighty dollar. I would NOT recommend working with these folks. Lies end up hurting a business in the long run, so just stop now!

Our project was just completed, all went very well during the installation process. And while I thought it would be hard to get excited about new doors and windows, turns out the difference is startling. First, our home is flooded in a good way with light now that the old/original sliders and some windows have been replaced. They were tinted with old style film and over time obscured the view in addition to blocking too much of the daylight. The quality of the glass is so much better that everything looks so clearly - kind of like going from low def to high definition TV. We already have a good inkling the energy savings will be substantial. Since the installation was complete we have not had to turn on the heat despite the chilly for Tampa weather. I can only imagine what this will do for our AC bills. The installation crew led by Breno Regis was outstanding. They clearly understood they were working in our home and went to great effort to minimize the disruption. And they were meticulous about cleaning up as they went and every evening when they were done. Keep in mind removing old windows and especially sliders is a big task and involves lots of cutting, drilling and in our case cutting concrete in one room and pouring in another. Realistically there is dust and noise. I don't see how they could have done better given the task at hand. The sales process was just that, a process where you have to sit through a lot of their presentation. While I understand it, could have done with less. Our sales person Jacob worked with us to make the cost competitive and the NewSouth product clearly is a step above many others. I suppose the ultimate recommendation is the fact they we will be back for a few more windows and maybe even a door or two. We will call Jacob and ask for Breno.

Lowe's is very hit or miss. We recently went to them to have our flooring done in our entire home. That process went extremely well. The flooring guy was great, and the contractors were on time and did good work. My house looks wonderful. And the price was excellent for it all. On the other hand, shopping in the store for general items can be frustrating, even if you know exactly what you're looking for. There have been three occasions in the last four months of shopping at this Lowe's where the item I needed was in stock, but the inventory was high up and out of reach in the overflow stock. We did the normal paging via buttons in the aisle. No one responds. We ask people in other departments for help, they refuse and just issue another page, or flat out tell you to go back and do the page yourself. I've asked employees at the register, who also page, and yet no one shows up to help. Each time, I've gotten so frustrated that I walked the entire store until I finally found a manager. Who has never been apologetic for wasting 30-40 minutes of my time for a simple request, but has fetched the items for me. When I know what I'm coming into Lowe's for, and it's in stock, I shouldn't have to be waiting for soooo long for simple help. I'm doing a project, I don't have time for delays. When a customer asks for help, you need to help them, Lowe's. On to more good for Lowe's: their return process is very simple. Even if you don't have the receipt, they can find your order if you paid by credit card. They have never hassled us with any return, and with our flooring order, we had a ton of extras that needed to go back. It was very easy. The order online and pick up is also simple, as long as someone is at the desk at the entrance. I've had to wait 15-20 mins, after paging someone there, for help picking up an order at least twice recently. I don't mind waiting, but some waits here seem excessive. I'll continue shopping at Lowe's, it's good enough for now, but I hope they add some employees so that customers can get a little better service in the future.

I had terrible experience with delivery and installation department. I will continue to go through Home Depot from now on.

Two years ago I purchased a Whirlpool refrigerator with extended warranty at Lowe's. It's now having major issues and when I called I cannot get thru. The first time I held for 58 minutes without getting anyone. Today I have been on a hold for a good 40 minutes. I finally got someone and they transferred me to the satisfaction survey. I called a local Lowe's and guess what, she transferred to some place where all the phone did is ring. To say I'm pissed is putting it mildly. As far as I'm concern Lowe's worthless when it comes to getting service and I will never do business with them again.

I was looking for a grill for Father's Day. Prior to purchasing the grill online, I specifically asked customer service if they would be able to deliver it the next day, which happened to be Father's Day. The customer service replied yes, as long as the item is available at the store. Sounded too good to be true and it was. The next day, I called to inquire about delivery. The customer service person told me that the prior person who I talked to told me the wrong information. Okay, I get it, these things happen but I was very irked because I asked and I was given the wrong info and then secondly, it was supposed to be a special day gift. This second customer service person attempted to appease my irritation by telling me that I could come to the store and just bring it home. This would have been fine except they were supposed to put it together and deliver it. I said no, I will wait until they deliver. I asked when my delivery would be. This CSR stated they would contact me the day before delivery and let me know details. He also told me he discussed my situation with the manager at the Speedway location and told me there was a possibility that they could assemble it earlier. When I called later to talk to the manager, I could not get in touch with the manager to find out if assembly was possible. I waited on the phone on hold and after a long wait, I just decided to hang up. Now it is Wednesday and I called to follow up on my delivery. This worker told me that someone would call me tomorrow before they deliver. I'm so fed up with getting wrong information, condescending apologies, and attitude from workers. I should have just stuck with my initial thought and went to Home Depot. I won't be shopping here again. I don't expect things to run perfect all the time but I do expect workers to know what is going on and not misinforming buyers. Customer service definitely needs improvement.

The hubby and I went to lowes to look for a specific color of paint for our living room. We looked around at other paint colors then walked up to the paint counter. We were helped immediatly by the associate. She was very friendly and helpful as to deciding what finish we wanted and how much we were going to need. It was our first time buying paint so she was very helpful. The paint color and finish look great on our wall. We will definietly come back if we need anything for future DIYs.

I wanted to start hanging stuff up properly, I was tired of nails falling out of walls or bending. I decided I wanted a power drill, a stud finder, and some sturdy screws. Any time I asked someone if they weren't busy they would reluctantly help by saying yes to all of my questions to get rid of me as soon as possible. If you don't have time for me, please just tell me next time. I didn't want to burden anyone. If you're inexperienced and you want help, try going to Ace or a smaller hardware store.

First, the sales people at the store were fantastic, even the delivery guy went out of his way to insure our satisfaction. Where the deal went haywire was a misunderstanding of the term "complete installation including moving furniture". This was for $1500 worth of floor tile plus another $1500 to install. In fairness, the installers did a fantastic job installing the tile (we had already moved the furniture for them). Then on the third day, they grouted, leaving all the tile covered with dust and we assumed they would be back the next day to clean up after the grout dried and put the furniture back in place. Well, on their way out the door, they give us instructions about how to clean all the tile with vinegar and water to get rid of the grout left behind on all the tile surfaces. I thought complete installation meant the job would be finished and not by my wife and I on our hands and knees cleaning 600sft of new tile. Plus, returning the furniture to the appropriate rooms would have truly finished the job. When I called Lowe's to question this, they didn't have an answer for me and called the installer. The installer of course said they leave that to the customer and so when the Lowe's employee called back, it was to say that it's standard procedure for the customer to clean up and move the furniture back. The other quote we got from a small independent store was basically the same price and they went out of their way to say that they stay with the job from moving the first piece of furniture out to moving it back in. Lowe's just shrugged their shoulders and went with the installers comments rather than checking into what their actual agreement with that contractor might state. So, we'll get it clean, move the furniture back in and enjoy our new tile. What we won't do is use Lowe's contractors in the future without a complete, written explanation of exactly what they do. I feel like I paid a premium price for installation and got less than a premium job in return.

Went to Lowe's New Year's day due to a hot water heater going out. Purchased a AO Smith 50 gallon tank, took it home and installed it only to have it not produce hot water even after 24 hours of installation. Next day we called out a plumber to make sure we made no mistakes installing the unit, only to be told we did install the unit correctly per the instructions and recieved a written report. Called the store and spoke to Ryan (from Lowes) and he mentioned we would have to contact the company AO Smith to get a Return Authorization number, contacted AO Smith customer service which btw is only open M-F 0700-0700 CT so had to wait the next morning so now going on 2 days without any hot water, only to get Customer Service from Jason who was extremely rude, would not bother with the report from the plumber as he had left off the resistance readings from the Thermostat and elements even though the reports stated the Thermostat was not working and the Element was bad even though the unit was getting power. Jason refused to give a RA number and basically stated they would do nothing until we get those numbers despite it's winter and refused to allow us to return it to the store. Returned to Lowes again, an elderly salesman on the floor in Lowes (who was a very nice and caring gentleman) again tried to assist us with AO Smith on the phone and they again refused to help us, finally after approx 2hrs in the store with and AO Smith on the phone they very reluctantly agreed to pay for another plumbing company to come out and inspect the unit BUT NOT UNTIL 2 FEB. expecting us to wait a month without hot water just because they refuse to allow the unit to be returned. Which forced us to purchase another AO Smith unit as that is the only product Lowe's carry's. That works fine and was installed the same way the first one was done. We got ahold of the original plumber we used the first time who helped us out and did a courtsey call and returned again at no charge to us and redid the resistant numbers and it turns out the upper element had no reading, the 2 theromstates and lower element had good reading, he then pulled out the upper element to inspect it, and it had no visable damage indicating it was a bad element. My partner and the plumber attempted to contacted AO Smith for over an hour as AO Smith requested to be contacted while the plumber was at the house Jason was on another call and and the person at AO Smith handling the call became rude when my boyfriend and the plumber after another half hour told her he could not wait any longer and needed to go and attempted to give her the report that the unit was still bad and was hung up on them. This plumber also mentioned 2 other plumbing companies he knew had dropped AO Smith due to problems with this company trying to get warranty repairs completed. Bottom line my boyfriend who is a 100% veteran has spent over $70K on jobs and has used Lowes for several years including installing water heaters in the past and now we are now stuck with an other additional water heater that does not work and are of the cost of that unit of over $430.00 because Lowes' won't let us return it due to a lack of a RA number from AO Smith, and AO Smith refuses to gives one stating there is nothing wrong with it and has no compasion for the winter time and poor customer service and refusal to accept the fact that this unit is defective. Long time Lowe's customer but very upset. Donna W./Charles E.

Busy Sunday warm afternoon . Disappointed with the sales " service" asked associate about sale item ? He didn't know?" I asked do you have the flyer w info he said " no " final said after long pause I'll go get one , slow return still couldn't answer ? Other guy when asked to borrow a tape measure said " ten cents a minute " ha ha I also was shopping the garden center where I've bought golden barrel cacti before. They were very small and marked up to 7.98 $ each more than I've ever paid & poor small skimpy quality. I think Home Depot nursery is better quality & price than this e Speedway location. Shop & compare ??

We bought a washing machine from Lowe's on Aug 6, 2021. We should have been wary when I knew more about the washers we were looking at then the representative in appliances. They set up delivery for the next day, in the afternoon. They use a third party company to deliver. They driver called me about 9am on Saturday and said he was on the way. When I said I was scheduled for 1-4, he said he had morning. So I let him deliver. We payed $30 for him to take away the washer, but he said there wasn't enough room on his truck and he'd have to come back (yes, I should have said, "you took a washer off, you can put one on", but it was very rushed and I didn't think of it). He was in a hurry (B/c he had too many deliveries), and the whole delivery and set-up of the new washer was stressful. He never came back to get the old washer, and after repeated phone calls the next day (Sunday), we received a call late Sunday saying there were truck problems and they'd have to come Tuesday. No room Monday. Very angry, we called the manager Monday morning, and he did handle it and had one of his drivers come pick it up that afternoon. That driver worked for the store, and he was much more knowledgeable. He fixed something that the previous driver had messed up (our washer was leaking). Lowes should get rid of their current contractor for deliveries! On top of all that, when we were buying the washer, the salesman helped us buy a washer that qualified for the $200 rebate from the water company. However, when I tried to fill out the rebate paperwork just now, I found out you need the model and serial number of the old washer to get the rebate. So now we are out $200. Needless to say, we are frustrated that the salesman did not make sure we knew that. I would have left this comment on Lowes' website, but I could find no place to give feedback. There are lots of things we like about Lowes. Especially their military discount. But we will not use them to buy a major appliance again. We will probably go to Christies or another appliance store. Yes, they are more expensive, but you get knowledgeable salesmen and delivery/set-up.

The best thing about this Lowes Store is the location. If you want customer service, go to Home Depot.. I need a steam mop for my floor and the guy i finally caught to help me said i probably didnt want one because it happened to be on the top shelf where he would have to get a ladder.. He was so rude about it I just left.. i will drive farther to go to HD or pay more at Ace where the customer service is always excellent.., Screw these lazy employees..

Well , after a lot of shopping , comparing , looking at consumers mag. We came back to Lowe's First , best and widest assortment of appliances. At fair prices. We wanted certain features , and not others. In the end , we chose all Frigidaire and a mid line Bosch dishwasher. No print stainless , counter depth, ease of controls . And today we met Carolina, who went above and beyond to make sure our price was right. And she threw in a 100.00 coupon and veterans discount. USN. Free delivery, no set up. Still waiting on changes to the kitchen. So no hurry. Nice to have this part done. Update Things went so well with the kitchen, we came back for the replacement of two sliding patio doors. Install in ten days or less, Pella doors in vinyl with the best features. And in stock. I called Pella yo confirm the features. $2 k Sale.

Terrible customer service. Completely shocked by our experience after switching from THD. Complete waste of our time and energy. Opened a new card account and ordered a big purchase for our new home to take advantage of discount. Went to pick it up and after waiting an hour for them to find it, they tried to give it to us destroyed /broken. They sent it back and reordered. Only thing we have done is follow their instructions and sink over 3 hours into the pickup. Unbelievable they let us leave without making this right. Our time obviously means nothing to the manager at this Lowe's, so neither will our money.

Went in tonight to buy a last minute Christmas tree. "Tom" found us wandering around, in search of the tree department, and pointed us in the right direction. Tom was immensely helpful, knowledgeable, and super friendly! We left very happy with our purchase- thank you Tom!!

Lowe's is having a Bath savings event. They have one person working in the department! This poor guy is working his ass off as he's being pulled in a million directions. I have been waiting 30 minutes and no one else around can help. Way to go Lowes. If you're going to have a big sales event, staff properly.

Been in and out here several times over the past years for misc home improvement needs. They have a super friendly staff, and a pretty broad inventory. Generally their prices on tools are competitive. I think their big box competitor (which the staff refers to as "the orange box") may beat some prices for some materials, but I notice Lowe's will have more variety for things like molding and trim. This location is pretty close to where I am though, so sometimes the price difference for small items just isn't worth the time and gas unless its on the way to something. All around a great store with a great staff though. Thanks for being the neighborhood hardware store "blue house"!

I was looking for a very specific item for a project I'm working on. I saw the item on lowes.com and got the part number down. I went to this store which is the closest one to my home and I instantly felt lost when I walked inside. I have no idea where to locate anything in a hardware store. I walked around aimlessly for a couple minutes before being helped by an employee. I told him what I was looking for and he directed me to the right aisle. I found the aisle and searched for the exact part I needed, but it wasn't there. I then went to customer service and was helped out by a really nice girl. She was able to locate the item on the computer, but they just didn't carry it in store. She did, however allow me to order it from their computer straight to my house and there was no shipping cost! She was really helpful and I felt she put in extra effort to make sure I got exactly what I wanted. Overall, even though I didn't walk out with the item I wanted, a couple extra days is no big deal.. but this store does get two thumbs up for me for their customer service!

My go to for "home improvement" (more like repair!), pinterest projects, and shopping excursions to prove to my husband I'm not ALL "girly" (pssh who am I kidding). My biggest qualm with these home improvement type stores is 1.) inadequate staffing in departments so you are left to wander far too long than people who come to these stores want to, 2.) The staff you can find and wait for (after of course the 2-3 other customers who found them first) acts like they know what you are talking about but actually sends you to the wrong aisle or gives faulty advice. Lowes has thus far exceeded my low set expectations! I have had staff APPROACH ME to see if I needed help, been actually very helpful with suggestions or tips for the projects I was doing (often teaching me something new) or found someone who could assist very quickly. My husband and I have even entered the store during their team meeting typed thing where they chant about having a good day and high five and it was rather cool to see :) I must admit I am a sucker for proximity so given that this place is within 5 mins of home, I am inclined to shop here. BUT home depot on Broadway is probably 3.5 mins from home and I avoid that place like a kmart on black friday. That being said we replaced a major appliance in our home this year and after much price comparison, found lowes offered the best deal and free delivery. We once bought a cheap weed wacker/ edger to handle our tiny square of grass with occasional weeds (much to small to warrant a real mower. Seriously. The edger just couldnt handle the task at hand and we returned it, out of box, for a full and easy refund. Woo hoo. I also started doing summer refinishing projects and Lowes has had the biggest selections of stains. I am very nitpicky so this is good for me. While I am a huge ace fan, if you need lots of things or more industrial things such as lumber, trees, etc (yes I have had these needs as well), then Lowe's is your go to. Hey Military, you get a discount here! See you in the pinterest fails but trying again aisle?

Don't ever buy an appliance from Lowes with an extended warranty. Bought a whirlpool diswasher on 2/28/2018 with 5 year warranty. Called Lowes on 8/10/2020 and asked for service. Service came out in 1 and 1/2 weeks on 19 August. Found needed "mother board" and not available until end of September. Then got call from Lowes saying the parts cost more than dishwasher and they were exercising their right to deny repair and they would pay the cost of my dishwasher. Called today the 25th to inquire about check. Jessica said it was just approved today the 25th and I would get a Lowes credit card in 2 weeks. Not acceptable send check. Then quoted extended warranty folder that said Lowes owed me $50 since product could not be repaired in 10 days. Jessica said since I had taken the buyout I did not qualify for the $50. I had no choice, Lowes told me that they would not repair the dishwasher and I would be paid the costs. Used to really like Lowes but no longer. They do not abide by their warranties. DON'T BUY APPLIANCES OR EXTENDED WARRANTIES FROM THIS COMPANY

Good prices, nice staff but VERY POOR DELIVERY. My wife bought a new fridge in June and was promised delivery in two weeks. Going on three and half weeks now and they're totally jerking us around. They never call to report delays even though they said they would. Totaly unrelaible and hostile when pressed. Would only buy things in the store. Never will buy something that needs to be delivered.
