I am really dissapointed as a customer , not with the store here, but the corporation. As a veteran my 10% discount made me a loyal customer. Until I went to buy a dryer and they said it was not good on that as their prices are so low that they cannot afford to do that. At that time my dryer that i wanted was not on sale, and the price was $200 more than other stores but would be down in three days to other stores prices., and they would adjust that on that date. Then one salesman said and the store is cutting the discount to 5%on non sale items . Another one said no that's not true. Lets get the story straight. I have liked this store a lot but I will no longer trust the appliance dept on prices. So be forewarned . Also they need more employees. Again all of this is corporate caused problems. I especially like a manager names Jacob. He is one in a million but has no power over Corp. nor does anyone else working there.But I have power , i cancelled my order.

Sometimes you have some good luck and run into a salesperson on the floor. If you're extra lucky, they know at least a little but about what they sell. Wander around there for an hour and you'll probably know as much as the average random employee you'd ask for help. A tiny few in the staff, at least on weekends and evenings, actually know and care about what they sell. But this is really not the place to go if you need help or advice, only if you already know what you're looking for and know how to find it in the store. They have a large selection of almost everything and it's relatively cheap. If you actually need help and/or advice, go to Ace Hardware (any of them, really, but the one on Tanque Verde and Sabino Canyon is nearest).
Your clerk in training Juan was a real condescending jerk. Real funny guy. I will not be back as if Lowe's really cared for customers. Bye bye. Hello Home Depot.

i have always received excellent service with the east side lowes in tucson az until recently. i was looking for a replacement ge electic cooktop to replace one that was cracked. lowes recommended that i pay a $35 fee to have lowes come out and check the dimensions before we purchased the new cooktop. i paid them $35 on 11/3/21 and they came out on the 5th of november. they told me they would call me with the dimensions. the following week i called the appliance section every day and no one answered. very frustrated i called for a manager. he tried to read me the dimensions but they were confusing. he said come in and we will give to you. i went in and the clerk pulled up a chart with the dimesions. i asked for a copy. he said i cannot give them to you since they are owned by the company we sent out to do the measurements. i said i paid you for the work not another contrator. i left and went and found a manager. he also refused to give the information that i had paid for. don't use the appliance section of lowes for anything. i will now go to other home centers to do my shopping.

2 Blinds installed for one low install rate. Both windows were the same size but we had them come and measure anyway. Today they are back to install a retractable screen door for the front door. This will allow the breeze without the bugs. I have had one before so we know what to expect. Lowe's has a ten percent military veteran discount. HD Does not. Simplified shopping.

Went to Lowes on Speedway road to order 700 bricks for a 90 foot long retaining wall and set up delivery and also get new bathroom fixtures for my bath remodel. They had everything in stock so I went to customer service to pay for everything on 12 and set up delivery of the pallets of bricks. The first rep asked if I had the model number for the bricks. I had taken a picture of the shelf label and while I was getting it the rep said "I have to take these people that have returns" and turned away on me! My wife's mouth dropped open! After awhile a guy came up and started to ring me up. Home Depot has 10% bulk pricing on brick quantities over 200 so while I was being rung up I asked if Lowes had bulk discount pricing on the bricks. The guy said I had to buy 800 bricks so my 700 quantity didn't qualify. I thought they price matched Home Depot but I guess not. I asked if the delivery fee could be waved for compensation on no price match and he said "Nope, we NEVER waive fees. Between the bricks, delivery fees, and the bathroom fixtures the bill was over $2500! I told him to delete the brick order from the register and I would take just bathroom fixtures. When I asked how much the total was he said "Oh, I just deleted the transaction so I guess I will have to start over again". I had already spent an hour on this transaction and my wife was really ticked off at him. She said "Forget it. Let's go to Home Depot" and left.

This location is doing absolutely nothing to enforce mask requirements. They claim they require staff to wear masks but I watched as an employee took off her bandana (not a mask) multiple times to blow her nose/wipe her face, then went right back without washing her hands. I spoke to the manager and he said they are unwilling to do anything about customers who refuse to wear masks. Companies like this are complicit in our pandemic getting worse.

Don't plan on asking for help if you come here. All we needed was for someone...anyone on staff, to tell us the vicinity of an item we had been searching for. We passed a member of management pulling some items on a cart and asked for directions. We were told immediately to "wait until later, I'm busy".

Hello. My family was in the store today. We spent about 20 minutes walking around looking for items, we passed more than 15 employees and not one said hello or offered to help. All that to say, it's disappointing that I feel as though I have money and have arrived to purchase something and not one person offers to help me find anything. Not one. Not one hello, not a single word from anyone. I will probably not be visiting your store again. Considering no one said hello at all I expect no response from you.

The store is now closing at 7. Not 9 like yelp says. the store doesn't care enough about its customers to go through the immensely difficult task of updating yelp. But if you trust the 9pm closing time listed on here, you will end up wasting time and gas. The note on the door says they have been closing at 7pm since 4/3. Also, don't even bother trying to get them to answer the phone

Not happy with their customer service at all. Terrible. We've spent 800 bucks on window coverings. The window covering (custom) were delivered here to my house by the manufacturer as promised. I've contacted Lowes to please call the installer that we paid for ahead of time to come over for the install. They claimed they notified the installer, and that I should hear from the installer within 48 business hours. I didn't. Called Lowes again. Same story. Didn't hear from the installer. Called Lowes again (a week later now, with my window coverings waiting on my bedroom floor). The manager said she would personally make sure to contact the installer and that I should hear from them. She said she would also call me back in the afternoon to make sure the installer called me. I didn't hear from the Lowes manager or the installer. I called Lowes again. This time, the Lowes employee said she would email the installer, because that usually works better. The installer called me an hour later to schedule the actual installation A WHOLE WEEK OUT, and they claimed they weren't notified by Lowes until they received the email. SOMEONE is lying. Either way, I'm not happy, and I will not buy anything that I can't install myself from Lowes again. Too much of a hassle.

Love this store! The workers are always helpful, especially Patrick and the other men in flooring. The lady at the checkout, I believe her name is Marilyn is an asset to the store. I live seconds from Home Depot but drive the extra distance to visit this lowes. Marilyn makes every customer feel important. Every customer that leaves her cash register has a huge smile. Seeing her always puts me in a good mood!

Huge store with everything you could ever want or need to upgrade your home and more. Employees are proactive and knowledgeable. One cited from memory the aisle and row for two obscure items I was seeking. Also, the public bathrooms are very clean.

The store was clean and well organized. It was a little hard to find help when looking for certain items. Check out staff was courteous and expedient. Unfortunately most things are out of stock. Looking forward to returning once merchandise is available.

And I thought Home Depot was bad at answering the phone. Lowes is proud to let the phone ring endlessly. They don't care about getting any more business. Find a local hardware store that actually cares and wants to help you, or go try to find what you need at Lowes on your own.

I love Lowe's! Mainly because I am sick and tired of standing in Home Depot for hours without help or with, and let's be generous, inferior help. I have NEVER had problems at Lowe's, people are friendly, no problems returning stuff and I have a feeling that I would be able to talk to a manager not like stupid Home Depot where nobody ever takes responsibilty. Lowe's allows dogs and they are soooo much better than Home Depot on Broadway. Lowe's is the place to go. I am so sorry I spent a cent at unworthy Home Depot instead of Lowe's I will always buy from Lowe's from now on and also make sure that our company uses Lowe's!

We usually shop here and get great customer service, but I would never use Lowe's for flooring installation. They charge significantly more than other businesses in town, and the customer service I received (with Lowe's being a middle man to foothills flooring) in getting an estimate was subpar. The Lowe's employee I was working with told me he would call foothills to get more information about why the estimate was as much as it was, and I never received a phone call from him with an answer. I also never got an estimate emailed after talking with them on the phone, I had to call back and request one so I could actually see it myself. And at that they don't itemize the estimate so you know exactly what you're paying for. So communication was severely lacking. Very poor experience. The only reason why I'm giving 2 stars instead of 1 is because they are reimbursing the $35 estimate fee.

Edit/Update: After speaking with a manger, I was refunded for the issues below. The manager was very polite. Do you love being treated as if your time is not valuable, and hate keeping your hard earned money? Do you enjoy waiting all day for contractors to show up to put in an hour worth of work or less. Then look no further, this is the place for you! Purchased materials and scheduled a very small shower remodel, a project that was supposed to take 2 weeks. Of course they wanted payment upfront. Materials arrived to the store and I was never notified. My shower was torn out and just left in a demolished state until the contractors could work me into their busy schedules. 6 weeks later, its not complete despite being expected to be home during their installation windows at their contractor's beck and call. Twice at least I was given a time window to expect workers only to have them never show. The original fixtures did not fit properly, so the contractor met me to assist finding ones that do fit only to have them also not fit, and the remodel was not even completed as per the contracts specification. I've brought these issues up once and although the manager I spoke with was sympathetic, it didn't change anything. I've requested another meeting with management, and will update depending on how that goes but as of right now my family will never shop at Lowes again.

i always find something in this place that hones my inner craftsmanship (although i'm always acting on impulse). This place is our life saver especially when we used to be homeowners and wanted to diy everything. This is our go to place for almost everything we need for our place.

Sunday at 4:30 pm was not the best time to look for assistance in the lumber dept. My 90 yrs old mom was screaming help help and no on came to assist us for more than 30 minutes. There were several other customers back there doing self sever as well without assistance. Patrick finally assisted us even though it was not his department. Wayne was helpful with the LED 3 way bulbs.

If you want to spend your entire day away from home maybe when your in laws are visiting or something go to Lowe's. This place is the absolutely perfect store to wait while staff look you in the eye and as you ask them for help instantly become deaf and walk by you to help someone else who's just walked in. This seems to happen every time I need assistance in Lowe's. 35 minutes was the last wait and I mean the last time I ever went into that place. Also the whole register your military discount if you want the 10%. Sure I have all day to do that. You're welcome for my service but yours is atrocious

A few days ago an envelope from Pure came in the mail. It had the $35 Visa card in it, but it also came with a handwritten note from Bryce, who I assume is a regional manager for the area. The note was personalized to my experience (pictured) and mentioned the specific feedback I shared about the overly confident salesperson. Most importantly though, the letter acknowledged that the experience I had was not up to their standards, and that the feedback I provided was going to be used to improve their process so future customers won't have the same happen to them. In the letter Bryce candidly addressed the fact that there's a fine line between confident and cocky, and that the sales organization should always remember that the customers have afforded the company the privilege of coming into their homes to quote. I'm changing my overall rating to four stars because of these acknowledgments. The original review reflects my actual experience with one salesperson, and it was shared in holes the feedback would prove helpful to the business. Knowing the feedback was received tells me that this company actually does care about their customer's experience, and I value that a whole heck of a lot. Coincidentally a few days before this note arrived I'd gotten a call from a community friend who had recently started working for them looking to earn my business. I haven't made any moves on the new system yet, and I'd happily chat with Chris Lombardo if he called again, especially if he could be more competitive on the pricing.

I've been coming to this store since I moved to Reno in 2005. Service has been hit-or-miss over the years, but mostly hit and gradually improving. If I were writing this review based on service in the 00's, it would be a zero star review (including a nasty experience in 2006), but the last few times I've been in, service has improved tremendously. That's why I am discounting the early years. My wife and I went in there with the specific intent to upgrade our phones. We checked in and looked around, helped less than 10 minutes later. By this time, we had both decided on our phones, we told the kid "we want this phone, and this one" and that's what we got. No hard sell or anything else. I didn't want the accessory pack he offered (I know he has to, it's his job), and he said OK, didn't try to push us any more. Even when my wife decided to hold off on her upgrade for now, there was no pressure for her to buy something. We walked out of the store well less than an hour after we walked in, with my new phone activated and data ported. There are two negatives to this store, one of which is not the store's fault at all: Access sucks. Only one easy way in from Virginia St., and if you miss it, you get a free ride up onto the onramp of the I-580 motorway to circle back and try again. And you can't go out the same way you get in--you have to drive around the car park past other shops and exit onto McCarran. The strip mall was just designed that way, and has likely been that way since long before the store was there, so I don't fault the store for this. Just beware. The other negative is that there is no printed literature of any kind to look at, describing each phone, the plans, etc. Up until a few years ago, those were easy to find at Verizon stores, and even some box stores like Best Buy and Target. Not sure what happened to them, but it would be useful to have printed matter to look at as well as the display phones. Hence, the docking of a star. On the whole, we enjoy our experience here once every two years, and look forward to our next visit in May 2017. Hopefully they will have addressed the printed material issue by then and earned back their star.

If I could give this Verizon store 0 stars I absolutely would! Like many other reviewers, I agree that the store itself is nice enough, clean and looks good. However it's a shame because the second you walk through the door you will be greeted (if you are actually every greeted by their so called 'greeter') with nothing but shady sales techniques, uneducated and unfocused sales reps. They also have a poor selection of accessories. I was forced to port over to Verizon because I live in an area with that has limited service from my previously provider (AT&T). Because I shared the account with a family member, she came with me to see if it would be worth her switching over as well. Before the visit was over, we had decided to switch over both of our wireless lines, as well as 2 land lines and 2 home internet accounts to Verizon to take advantage of the business discount available given our particular situation. All in all, it took us almost 8 hours to make this transaction (yes...that's right, 8 hours, to set up a few wireless lines, a few land lines and a few internet accounts). In addition to that, we experienced multiple issues during this visit: (1) the sales rep put together and rang up our equipment before explaining to us what he was giving us. As it turns out, he included multiple devices and accessories (phone cases, screen covers, 4Square devices, etc.) that we had not asked for, discussed or approved for purchase. He charged our credit card for these prior to asking us about them, thus resulting in us having to return these items at a later date when we realized what he had done. In addition, he sold me an iPhone 4S and my family member a tablet that were incompatible with the service we were trying to take advantage of (for me, I wanted an iPhone but specified to the rep that I wanted to ensure it worked with the 4G network - which the iPhone 4S does not) and my family member requested a tablet that was compatible with the 4Square ap/credit card purchasing system (which the tablet he sold us was not). In both cases we were assured there would be no issues. He also lied to me about Verizon's international voice/data options. When I told him that I traveled internationally occasionally for work he explained that there was a $10.00 a month charge for a limited Canada/Mexico data & voice plan. In reality, the cost is $15.00 a month for voice and $25.00 for data for the Canada/Mexico option. Then on a subsequent visit to discuss a billing and online account access issue, another sales rep "assisted me". I put that in quotes because after waiting 45 minutes (for what i was told would be a 10 minute wait), I was assisted by someone who, within the first 5 minutes of greeting me, interrupted me when I was telling him why I was in the store to ask me if I streamed music on my phone (i.e. like from Pandora). I assumed he was just trying to make small talk so I responded that I did occasionally. He then proceeded to begin streaming music from his phone at the loudest possible volume and carrying it around whereever we went in the store. I spent the next 10 minutes shouting over the music because he would not turn it off after being asked more than once. After trying to explain my issues to him (during which time he never even got on the computer to look at my account), he eventually just told me to call the *611 customer service line and that they should be able to help me (and that he couldn't call them from the store). So after spending almost 2 hours in the store, I spent the next hour sitting in my car talking to a customer service rep on the phone right outside the store. I've also had countless issues with their *611 customer service reps (being lied to about the costs & coverage of available features, reps not activating features when they said they would - thus resulting in hundreds of dollars of international roaming fee's being incurred (and eventually removed but only after hours of dealing with different reps.), etc.). All in all, in the 2 months I have been a customer, my family member and I have spent over 100 hours dealing with issues that are directly related to their poor quality sales and customer service, in particular related to our experiences at this store. If I had another choice for a wireless carrier in the area I live, I would happily incur the early termination fee just to be rid of this carrier.

Of course they will always try to sell you on options (like screen protector, phone case, etc), but again they are not pushy and will respect your wishes if you say you are not interested. Don't believe anything Verizon tells you... there are always ALWAYS hidden fees or "termination charges." I bought a JetPack hot spot... guy says $50. Did he lie??? Maybe not, but he didn't tell me about the two year "contract." He didn't tell me that when I cancel all Verizon services because I got a way better deal at Consumer Cellular, that Verizon is the blood sucking company that keeps on charging. BEWARE. They "forgot" to cancel my voice charges even though I cancelled all phone service. BEWARE.

Leaving the big V because of coverage issues. I believe my decision is showing even wiser as they don't make it easy to review pay the final bill. Corporate games, bigger is not always better. Beware of 5G if you care about a healthy life for your children and beyond. A tin-foiled suit will be appropriate.

Not worth buying anything here. Employees are standing around and texting, not helping. Plus, if you ever have to return anything, get ready to wait for an hour. Returns get shot to the end of the line, and skipped in preference for new Verizon sign ups.

I have been a verizon customer since 2007 carrying 4 lines. Literally spent $10,000 in this time frame. I ask if I can close one of the lines 14 days before its renewal date, and they wouldnt even consider the notion! The gal that helped me is in bad need of a makeup tutorial, that right there made my confidence in her plummet. not sure why i even gave her or verizon a chance to win me back. She was well rehearsed in her speaking points regarding cancellations/upgrades etc. But didnt care at all when I asked her how much it would cost to close all 4 lines. Obviously did not care to retain longtime, loyal customers. it is worth every sent, paying the cancellation fees to get out of the grips of verizon. so done with them!

Terrible customer service nobody has any idea of what to tell you or any waiting periods on processing applications for sign up. Everything is said to be done online so going to the store will do you absolutely nothing. They will not inform you on the correct waiting times of any application or the proper documentation you will need for sign up. You can not pay with cash or a card they won't even let you in the store for due to the virus. The hours have been cut as well as employees and none of it is posted online so if it's after 4PM don't waste your time.
Had service. Rude. It's sad. I have been buying phones from the same place for years. Never going back.

I went in to get a sim card, which I technically got, so two stars instead of one. The greeter (Hector) said I had to check-in to get service and the wait would be 10 minutes. He continued to stand in the same spot for 5-10 minutes doing nothing, then came over and said "I'll be helping you today." He took my new phone (which he asked me to bring in to the store) out of the box and roughly dropped it on the counter. I told him I did not need it activated in the store - I just need the sim card. He ignored me and continued the activation process anyway. He powered the phone on and skipped through the setup so that we could make a "test call". I ended up factory resetting the phone so that I could properly step through the setup without digging through all the settings screens. He was arrogant and obviously thought he was performing a service I couldn't have done on my own. For most people getting a new phone is exciting and personal. He obviously does this stuff all day, so new phones are no big deal for him. He took what should have been an exciting experience and bludgeoned it. And all I wanted was a sim card.

Still haven't received an email back after I've tried twice. This is seriously the fucking worst company ever!! I've talked to MULTIPLE representatives who have all promised the same shit and nothing has been updated on my bill!!!! I don't even know what to do at this point, this is ridiculous. I'm extremely unsatisfied

My sister and I went into Verizon today with the intention of upgrading my phone. Jarrad helped us and was very friendly and nice. He helped me with upgrading my phone and also sold my sister on an Apple Watch. Overall, great service and the employees were very helpful and knowledgeable.

I was in and out in under 15 minutes with a new hotspot. I was greeted immediately and put in the queu. I barely had time to browse when my customer service rep found me. Gwen rocked my socks with her amaze balls customer service! Super stoked on a speedy, pleasant transaction.

This store has the worst customer service in the industry. Evan, I think his name is, needs a lesson in customer service or needs to pick a different profession. Just go to AT&T and be treated like a customer, instead of a inconvenience. We WERE going to leave AT&T after over 15 years of service, after the way we were treated I will stay with AT&T. Thanks Verizon for showing me in advance what you think of your customers.

Worst customer service ever. I'm sorry I troubled "Cody" by daring to ask him if he could help me with my phone. I will never step foot in that store again. Verizon please refresh your employee in proper customer service techniques.

I went to Verizon twice within a month because I needed help with some of the things in my phone; I am not very good at this new technology stuff. I was helped by Branden Garcia both times, he is friendly, patient, very helpful and knowledgeable. He solved my issues right away and also gave me some advice on what to do so I will not have the same problems again. if I ever need any help again I am going to ask for Branden. Thank you Verizon and Branden for great customer service.

Had a stellar customer service experience with Daniel. We were having a little trouble with our new gas grill, brought it in and immediately Daniel helped us fix the problem and more, while also being incredibly friendly and understanding. Definitely keeps us coming back to Home Depot.

Do NOT!!!! I repeat DO NOT buy your appliances from here. It has been a disaster!! 4 days with no fridge as their 3rd party installers took out the old one but couldn't install the new one. Their 3rd party installers installed a damaged microwave and are refusing to replace it. I have spent 8 hours off work over 3 days to get these appliances installed and the managers do not keep their word! Go anywhere else!!!!

Went in looking for paint colors, ended up leaving super dissatisfied. One gentleman and two very young girls working the paint area and not one of them said hello or even made eye contact. For twenty minutes we browsed and still nothing except for hearing the girls drop the F-bomb multiple times. Went to walk around the store and noted that no one asked if we were okay and overheard very unprofessional conversation. I get it, I'm young. But there was no professionalism with the younger crowd. When we finally got help, the man was super nice and apologetic for his coworkers. We do not remember his name, but he was new and used to work at Harris for f&b. He gave us directions, then saw us still lost a few minutes later and walked us to the correct area. We would like to thank him for salvaging part of our experience at Home Depot today.

If I could give a negative number I would . Dont say you haven't been warned..worst appliance nightmare ever. Purchased a built in oven microwave combo and a stove hood... omg.. 2 abandoned install attempts. Multiple phone calls with the scheduler and then the install people and then Lenny the sales person and back and forth..no one wants to own anything. Unbelievable. They had the territory manger of XPO the install company in attendance at the first install and they needed to do a build up which they were unprepared to do.. charges us an extra 250.00 .. ok fine.. send another guy out and he said he has no idea what they were talking about as it really wasn't needed... he also didn't know why the stove hood had to be rescheduled as the adjustment was super common and not a big deal .. Would never ever use them again.. won't even go i the store to but a light bulb... they need a six sigma person to fix this problem. Not that complicated ... will go to Ferguson's if Best Buy or to Cysz 's in Reno. Have heard much better things after our experience . They hire outside installers but all the communicating is handled in store unlike HD.

Lowes and Home Depot - compare and contrast. Both have more hardware than you'll ever need in your lifetime. Both have some of the best self checkout operations in the retail industry. Both have very friendly and useful staff that go out of their way to help you. Lowes typically has exactly what I need and their merchandise tends to work better for me. Home Depots tend to be in more convenient locations. Home Depot has an easy and fast returns counter. Both have hot dog stands. Both allow you to get a lot of exercise when you're walking through their huge stores.

We went to Home Depot on a Mission. We had been all over town looking for a specific mirror and had struck out. We live in Sparks but ended up in South Reno. Not only did this store have my mirror, it came with a Super Knowledgeable employee named Karrie. She helped me find just the right hardware fir the mirror. She gave me choices and helped me find things on my list cutting my shopping time in half. It was late so it was Very Much Appreciated. I live down the street from the Sparks Home Depot and have always had to try and find someone to help me and they usually point and walk away. Thank you again for your Excellent Care Karrie. This Home Depot Rocks!

I feel like there are certain things that I like about HD that make me occasionally stop in here as opposed to Lowe's. 1) The employees seem to get a bigger kick out of the fact that I bring my dog with me. One cashier walked over, squatted next to Katie, and petted her for what seemed like an eternity. She looked at me and said, "Man, I really needed this today." 2) The employees seem to have more experience. Yes, they still hire college kids who wouldn't know a Phillips from a Standard, but those folks tend to be cashiers and not the people wandering around to answer questions. I understand you're nice, but that does me no good if I need to talk about how to go about re-plumbing a sink. At Lowe's, those folks are in the wild and you have to be careful who you take advice from. 3) Paint sales! I'm sure Lowe's has them too, but HD advertises them better. and finally, 4) It's right across the street from Target. Once I've ripped off the spending-money Band-aid, it's a free for all! Who knows what I might buy?!

Very Solid Store. Nothing that is going to WOW you or blow you away, but I don't have anything bad to say about this place. I have never received stellar customer service, and no one has gone above and beyond to show their commitment to their job, but at the same time they do their job really well. Keep up the excellent work. We all need that solid, dependable store where you know what you are getting when you walk through their door.

Unfortunately today I left feeling disrespected with my experience at this location by a manger named Holly. It was a simple trip to buy a few things and one in particular that I needed. I chose this place since I am a card holder. I needed help finding something and luckily Holly passed by me. She mentioned that it was sold out, since we both didn't see it in the isles it'd normally be in. She must have been busy with a task at hand since she was holding a clipboard and briefly after she acknowledged that it had been sold out she rushed off and I saw her checking in with other associates and making notations on this clipboard. As a manager myself I understand that we have tasks and deadlines on a day to day. And it's easy to forget to put ourselves in our customers shoes. Had she taken a moment to offer to do an inventory check or any other alternative to order it online. A suggestion of any kind, my experience would have been different. As I'm walking to self checkout I notice the item I had been searching for is on a wall display by the entrance. Since she was in eye sight I walked over to her and said just so that you're aware you do have said item and it's right by your entrance. Her response was rude, "I'm glad that you walked around and could find it". If I was a manager on duty I'd be more appreciative, it was out of curiosity. Being that it's a popular product hence why it's at the entrance of your lease line. I thought you should know for your next customer. I hope another member of Mangement reads this and addresses that sometimes our responses can come across as apathetic.

As much as I love Carter Brothers Ace Hardware in Midtown (and I do), this particular Home Depot location happens to be a lot closer to me and offers several advantages. First up, they're open until 10pm. That may not sound terribly important, but being able to scoot over there in the late evening has saved me mid-project more than once. Second, their return policy is among the best of any retail chain. I make use of a Home Depot store credit account, which means even if I've forgotten/lost a receipt, I can still return any item and have it easily and quickly credited back to my account with no fuss. Third, you can actually shop using the website and then just drop by the store and pick up your order from the customer service counter. Don't have time to wander the aisles? This option is perfect if you're in a hurry! Now, nothing is perfect, and Home Depot certainly has some flaws. On occasion I've encountered staffers who either ignore me or who are ill-equipped to assist with a given query. Not often, but it has happened a couple times. Another interesting flaw is that, despite the size of these "Big Box" stores, they don't actually have EVERYTHING I might be looking for. Seriously, I've gone to that store trying to find a very specific part/tool/supply on more than one occasion, only to find they don't carry it. Whenever this has happened, I've almost always been able to find that odd item at Carter Brothers, so that's when I make the drive and give them a visit. Plus, I've never had anything but outstanding, friendly service at that Midtown shop. One last note: on a couple occasions I've purchased appliances from Home Depot and had nothing but great service. Their appliance sales staff don't get paid commission, so there's no high pressure sales pitch AND they actually seem interested in making sure you're getting the unit you really want/need. But the best part is the delivery staff. Those guys are really efficient, with great attention to detail during delivery and install. Can't say enough good things about this aspect of shopping at Home Depot; it's now the first place I check when considering a new appliance or other home improvement project.
Nobody in this place could tell me where the concrete cleaner is. Can you say "retraining ". Going to their competition before I come back here. Useless.

I went to the Home Depot on Virginia Street yesterday and I was pleasantly surprise to see a lot more employees around to answer questions or help you find something. I notice most of the employees are now walking up to the customers and asking them if they need help finding something; in the past you had to walk all over the store to find somebody to help you, I am happy to say that seems to be no longer the case. There is a gentleman named: Michael Good, ( I asked him for his name ) He stands out, he is very friendly, you don't have to approach him, he approaches you and I notice he was giving a couple of ladies some tips on how to make the job easier or telling them what not to do so they will not ruin the project they were going to do. I did not need any help finding something, but I was very impress with the way Michael Good was taking care of the other customers, I had to get his name. Thank you Home Depot management for making this a much better place to shop at; and thank you Michael, for giving customers a pleasant shopping experience.

Had a set of keys cut at Home Depot that did not work. When I returned the next day, the staff was apologetic and very helpful. Ron worked with me to assure that I was 100% satisfied. He went above and beyond my expectations for customer service. Kudos to the staff at Home Depot for making even a trivial problem into a win!
Bad aisle signage. Bad bulk wood product signage. Stock levels inaccurate between application and in-store. Surly, unhelpful wood employees.

Home Depot has stuff. I will give them that. Just about anything you'd ever want to improve your home, they have. Checkout is quick, the employees are all friendly. But just try finding one when you need one. Either they are grossly understaffed or every time I'm in there everybody's called in sick. The place is huge, so you have to wander around forever before you find what you're looking for. On the other hand, on more than one occasion I've found something I didn't know I needed when I'm searching for something I do need. Hey, maybe that's their strategy!
This Home Depot is out of the way and the parking lot is pourly designed. I was frustrated before I even walked into the door.

Johanna in Customer Service has ruined my Home Depot experience where I spend thousands of dollars. I've had 3 recent dealings with her and she is extremely rude...not even a "thank you" after a $300 purchase. Another time she was combative when had a return- legitimate. Put her somewhere else and put friendly people who don't hate their jobs behind the customer service counter.

I purchased a refrigerator here and had a problem with the appliance 2 hours after delivery. I called Home Depot and they insisted that they were unable to help me and that I would need to call Maytag. I even spoke to associates at the store who also had the same opinion, but seemed bothered to having to speak to me; the associate was assisting someone in person at the same time at the store and I got to listen her talking to someone who didn't want an water and ice dispenser in the door. She told me she would call back; she did later noting that her manager instructed her to call me back and that the delivery company would call the following day to assist me. No one ever called me back. They are more than happy to take your money, but if you need customer service, it is best to look somewhere else.
Karrie in paint is great. Very helpful and mixed our paint perfect on first try. If you need paint go see Karrie.

Rude rude rude. We needed a new window and had to order it. We ordered it on August 27th and was told that it wouldn't be in until sept 24th. Sept 24th rolls around and still no window. I called the store and they said, " didn't anyone call you?" No, nobody called me. What did they need to call me about? The staff member I spoke to said that the window was delayed 2 more weeks. So, on Oct 10th I call the store and ask if it's in. They tell me no and to call back tomorrow. Oct 11th I call and it's in but they want me to wait till the next day to get it. I expressed to him that I would like to get it that day because I don't have a window in my house. He tells me he'll call back in a half hour. Tick tick tick tick and hour and a half goes by and no call. I haven't had no window for a month and a half and it's starting to get chilly at night. So, Husband and I load up the kiddos and go to Reno because I'm not leaving without my window. We get there and they tell us to go to pick up and it will be there, just to give them a few minutes to pull it. We shop around for about 20 minutes and then went to the pick up desk. No window!!! Ugh. So after several calls the pick up desk employee says I'll just go get it myself. When he brought it out, I was shocked to see that it wasn't wrapped or protected in any way. He gave us some cardboard and wrap so we could wrap it ourselves. In the meantime I'm noticing all the flaws from damage done during shipping. Bent fins ... the vinyl is scratched beyond repair etc. in desperation I just take the window. We get home and start to notice the craftsmanship is sub-standard. Really, we wait almost 2 months and nothing is aligned or cut right. I'll take the Carson Home Depot's over this one any day.
Hands down my favorite Dept store. The team is always friendly and willing to help. The store manager is quick to step in and resolve any concerns . Great store, great people.

We came in to buy a new faucet for the kitchen. Didn't feel like it was going to be too much of a hassle. The selection was large! My wife and I stood in the faucet isle for at least 30 minutes, going back and forth about what we should get. We had several employees ask to come and give some advice. We took some suggestions, but overall we had to just make a decision. The employees tried to guide us in the right direction as to what would work with how many holes we had in the sink. Once we got home, I discovered that we could not use the faucet that we bought due to the fact that we had a dishwasher vent. I called and talked to two different people on the phone about this problem. Neither were able to help me. Frustrated, we headed back to the home depot. We found two different people to help us this time. Picking their brains about what we could do diifferent. One guy suggested that we could re-route the dishwasher vent, while another man told my wife there was no way of doing that. Instead of making a big deal, we just returned the faucet we bought, and picked another that would work with the dishwasher vent. Good service the first time, pretty good service the second time. We always seem to have to go back more than once. I would suggest this home depot. They did what they could to help us. They do have a pretty large selection of whatever it is to choose from.

I am far from the "handy-girl" type - though I can hang a picture, shelf and have figured out those dang anchored ceiling hooks! And I find all the neat little "nuts and bolts" I need for basic repairing around my house..... however that's not why I'm Yelping about this Home Depo. I'm Yelping this place because last year I decided to get in touch with my horticultural side and bring out my inner green thumb, and I found amazing plants, flowers, seeds, bulbs, watering cans, and awesome unique flower pots at this location. Believe it or not I actually grew some of said seeds, and bulbs, and some of the live plants I bought ARE STILL ALIVE!!!!!! This is either I've grown in my endeavors or this spot sells awesome DIE HARD plants because normally I kill all plants not made of silk! (kids, cat, fish, and dog are safe) So if you're into gardening check out the green house section at this Home Depo the prices are great and as far as I can tell everything is high quality. And - if you are feeling especially adventurous, be sure and get one of those cheap mystery meat hot dogs on your way out the door!! 5 stars for the hot dog!
Would be nice if i could actually find someone to make my keys. Instead, two employees at the self check out complaining about co-workers. Nice work, ladies

We paid for our floors in June 2021 (new LVP for all living spaces and carpet for the bedrooms) and it is now Nov. 3 and the company they use has canceled on us 3 times- twice day of. The day Romanoff Renovation was supposed to show up between 8-11 both in October and today, after we have completely followed the preparation instructions on our end making our house unlivable, they have canceled AFTER the 11 deadline. Is being pushed back AGAIN. This has been an AWFUL experience. Do not use them for floor install - EVER! Update: Nancy at Home Depot says they can't do anything to help us and is blaming this all on our President of the U.S.A......talk about not taking responsibility for your company's own faults. This is the WORST!! Here is a picture of what an area of my home currently looks like with everything out of my children's rooms.... until "Nov. 18"...you know, the 4th date the floors have been scheduled to be done.

Meh. Service is sub par, most employee's don't seem to know much about home improvement. Nothing is worse than standing in line while employee's have fun conversations with each other that waste my damn time. I went to rent their truck, which happens to be incredibly affordable and useful. While standing there waiting for the employee to process my order, he's chatting and laughing with another employee about God knows what. How rude. Yeah buddy, all I want to do is sit here and wait while you have a blast NOT processing my order. I hope you get fired.

This place is a dream come true for a can't sit still, youtube project loving girl like me. They have everything you need for all of your projects and helpful staff. It really seems like the floor staff really enjoy their jobs. They are seriously always ready to help out and talk about whatever you're working on.

After buying expensive doors from doordestination.com also known as BGW Doors that arrived with manufacturing defects & then encountering company management that neither cares about customer service nor honoring its warranties, I decided to give Home Depot the kudos it deserves for its return policy. Thank you, Home Depot, for making it easy to return products! I seriously regret not buying doors from you.

warning veterans... the home depot's in reno and carson city pick and choose what products they will give the veterans discount. do not shop there unless you have no other choice. it appears it is only hd in nevada dont give the discounts, all hd in california give veterans discounts. let''s show them our sacrafic won't allow them to line their pockets. don't shop at home depot.

After a very long relationship with Home Depot I will not ever go back. Lowes has all my business. I had lots of work done in my home we bought all supplies from Home Depot as I have done for many years. Today I went to return 6 pcs of base board it was bought in a 10 pkg but I know they sell it individually. "Joe" at the return desk who has absolutely no authority measured each one to make sure they are the same length. Gave Joe my receipt he then called his manager who told him they don't take broken pkg. I told him they sell base board individually, he had no answers. I told him you really going to lose a customer over a few dollars, he had no answer. I told him they could keep the base board put back into stock and resale as they must need the money more than me. I also told him to tell his manger to read my Yelp review. I know they don't need my business but I was a good loyal customer. This may be petty but it's about exceeding customer expectations and good Customer service, we have choice and I will alway be loyal to business that offers great customer service. Good-by Home Depot & return service employee Joe, Hello Lowes & social media with very poor reviews for Home Depot.

Yea, I know. I am inside a Home Depot. What the H? In any case, you can find your last minute needs here before heading towards Gerlach. Headlamp (absolutely essential). Check. Traveling mug. Check. Plugs, adapters. Check. Very, helpful friendly staff here. Fast and easy check-out.

I went and someone helped me right away. A few minuets later I asked if they could check if another store had my item and they called right away. Overall, I was very impressed and can see why significant other loves this place.

Home Depot Reno location is great. This is one of the few Home Depot left where there is still some customer service being provided, and quality good customer service which makes it even better. Called asking for a stock check and the clerk on the phone was super nice, checked the computer and then asked me if I would like to hold for an actual physics stock check, I was hesitant because I knew I was going to be left on hold for 30 minutes best case scenario, she was back in less than 2 and confirmed it was in stock. Showed up to the store and there it was. We were offered assistance a couple of times as well which really doesn't happen at other Home Depot nowadays. Very happy with this location. Keep it up !!

I came here to pick up last minute Burning Man supplies. The store is HUGE, so I'm glad there were plenty of staff around to point me in the right direction or else I would have killed 3 hours just wandering around uselessly. I needed 10 foot PVC pipes cut down to 7 feet, and they were able to do that in a few minutes. Prices were fair too, considering you could just grab so many different items in one location. They have a section set up just for people looking for Burning Man supplies, and although I already had what they had in stock in this section, I know it will be helpful for others. They even had an international map set up and asked you to put a pin in your hometown location. Nice idea!
The paint and carpet department are very helpful. Beware of new interest policies with their credit card.
DIY peeps! If your planning to do some wood work. Don't go to this Home Depot! They charge extra to cut your wood. WTH. Go to the Steamboat location.

When you go into the tool section there are the most annoying beeping security screens that beep every time you move. I am an extremely patient and tolerant person and these beepers make me want to punch someone in the face....with that being said, it is home depot and they have almost everything you could need.

Seems like they have upped their customer service game. Every one was very polite, professional and helpful and there was plenty of staff to ask for help. The reason for only 4 stars is because they have WAY to much stuff crammed into aisles. You can't even pass someone else in that same aisle. The aisles in front of the checkouts are so full 1 person can barely get through. There is also to much stuff outside. Can't drive thru without the possibility of hitting someone. There also aren't enough wood carrying carts. We found everything we needed so they seem to be well stocked.

Just had a horrible customer service experience with this Reno HD store. Yesterday I called one of the Carson HD stores to see if they had a particular product. I didn't have the SKU but I did have the exact HD product description. The guy at the Carson store found them in his system and then went to the shelf to be sure that they were there. I bought all of them that they had, and was very happy with their customer service. Well, my experience with this Reno store couldn't have been any different. I called the Reno store earlier today to confirm that they had the product in stock. First, he told me that he couldn't look up anything without an SKU, which I didn't know. He was completely unwilling to even try to look up the product based on HD's website description. I told him that the day before an associate in the Carson store actually went to the shelves to make sure that they had the product, and that the guy in Reno wasn't even willing to look up the product based on its description. After a ridiculous minute-long back in forth over whether he should even try to look up the product, he relented and started typing in the website's description. Of course, after 3 seconds of typing he found it, and just as quickly told me that they didn't have any. At this point I knew the guy was FOS, so I went to the store anyway. It didn't surprise me at all when there were over a dozen of the product on the shelves.
Had an amazing experience this morning at South Virginia Home Depot. Thank you Corey for all your help!! Corey was fun and very, very Helpful!

Do not use the Pro Services contractor program; if you do, you will regret it. Short version: 7 months for a small kitchen remodel for new cabinets and countertops. No ownership of the project at the HD level; they take your money (100%) up front and you don't hear from them again. You have no leverage with the installers and no contract with them. Three cancellations for the countertop install by Accent Countertops (out of Salt Lake) with promises to "make it right for you". Nothing ever done. Demolition of the existing countertops resulted in heavy dust throughout the house, even upstairs. No dust containment used. Charry Sieng, store manager, gave us a minimal discount when we complained the first time. When the project was finally done, we wrote a letter to HD CEO, Craig Menear, and that resulted in a $1000 refund. Not sure how they came up with that number but we were tired of dealing with the problem. Had to sign an "agreement and release" form, which tells me they deal with this type of problem often enough to even need a form. Had similar issue two years ago with a house-full of carpet. Installer never showed up, even though I had taken two days off from work to be here to help move furniture. I'll buy nuts and bolts from HD but never use their Pro Services or contractor program again. Everyone I've talked to who did so, had the same experience. One star rating is too high... CAVEAT EMPTOR!

I purchased vinyl flooring, the transition strips from Home Depot and paid them for the installation. When the installers finished there was ON transition from vinyl to carpet just a rough edge of carpet. When I talked to Home Depot about it they said they will not repair it because I was verbally abusive to the installers, and the store manager after they mess up the job. If I were you I'd buy from a flooring store with there installers not like home depot which sublets to installers. I will never set foot in home depot again.

This is the Home Depot where I (and pretty much every other burner I know) stop for supplies on the way to Burning Man. Maybe there's more than one, but this one is mine. It's big. It's crowded. The staff is clueless. But where else do you find (for example) a hot chick who's had way too much caffeine and been on the road for two days, in skimpy clothes in blue hair and excessive facial piercings buying two carts worth of PVC (but you know she's not doing any plumbing), and a giant pile of rebar (but no concrete), piles of rope, a bunch of flourescent stuff, water containers... and there's a dozen more people in the store with similar loads. Four stars just for the entertainment value. This review only valid the third week in August.

This Home Depot is FAR better than the Home Depot across town! The staff was helpful, the selection good and we found what we were looking for. We bought patio furniture and 5 people ended up helping us find everything we needed and load it into the car.

This place is awful! They charged my card without my consent. Someone used a fake name a fake address and placed a phone order. I went down there in person to see what happened they stated that it was a phone order. Even though the item had not been given to the person who stole my identity they still will not reverse the charges. Now I'm out $600 and I can't afford rent for the month. Worst of all even though I told him that this was a fraudulent charge they still gave the customer that stole my identity the item that they ordered over the phone. Horrible service rude staff I will never go back. If you like having your credit card information stolen then this is the place for you!! Shame on you Home Depot for encouraging theft by giving a person a order that you know for a fact was a fraudulent charge prior to you giving out the order!!! #greed #moneyhungry #theftpromoter #recklessdisregard #corporateamerica #1%

Stopped by waiting for the hubby. I found perfect shrubs and a tree for the back plus it was 25% off! I always have good luck finding what I want here. The load was too heavy for me to load plus it wouldn't fit in the Suv! That's where the 4Runner comes in handy! I can't believe how much we saved compared to out other nursery we have been buying from.

Least favorite HD in town. Damonte Ranch, Northtowne and Spanish Springs are all worth the drive to avoid this one. It's cluttered, not as clean, and the staff is way less friendly than anywhere else in town. Asked for help finding a patio door handle and both associates couldn't be bothered to assist, simply pointing at the area they thought it was in. And it wasn't there as those were storm door handles. Anyway, I'll stick to the others.

The girl working in the door department is a complete moron. Thanks for wasting two hours of my life because you have no clue what you are doing. She sent me to Double Diamond Home Depot store after checking stock on closet doors. And guess what? She ran the wrong skew. No stock- I'm returning these doors I bought since there is no match and buying online or in store at Lowe's.

This store usually has what I am looking for and always someone asks if they can help. Although I like the feel of the Lowes not far from here better, it still is a decent store and offers all that one needs for home and garden, usually ;-{)

Went here to purchase a BBQ grill. All associates were kind and helpful but the store was in disarray. All of the grills were assembled and posted outside. The one we chose was not in a box and all of their stock was totally assembled.. this made it extremely difficult to fit in our midsize SUV. Also, the kiosk for the propane tank was broken and we patiently waited for an associate to assist us and 2 other customers waiting for propane. I'm also not too sure if having all of the grills preassembled during the pandemic is a good idea... I understand sometimes it's a convenience to already have something set up, but not when you have a little car.. I'm thankful to the associates and strangers that tried to help cuz we were looking all sorts of frustrated. We're home now and hopefully it works when we make dinner tonite and doesn't crumble due to the fact that we had to really stuff the thing into our vehicle.. wish me luck!

Mad props to home depot today in their management of covid era shopping. I was skeptical about same day pick up and curbside pickup based on my experiences with other stores. Home depot really made it smooth and seamless. My order was ready less than an hour after I placed it. An appropriately masked employee approached my car as soon as I parked in the curbside pickup area to collect my order number. He told me there were two people ahead of me but that my order would be out shortly (good communication). The whole process was simple and what all shopping experiences should be.

Need stuff to fix your house? Need stuff to fix your yard? Need stuff to eradicate an infestation of some sort? Just want to buy something gas-powered that can rip apart solid steel? Go to Home Depot, then! I have never been disappointed here and will continue to go to this store as long as the customer service, selection, and prices stay what they are now (see my tips for specifics). Good job HD crew! You have made a customer for life out of me!

I witnessed a very disturbing situation. I was near self-checkout when I witnessed David, a supervisor, yelling at an employee of this store. He said "When I ask you to do something you do it! And so on." He got the attention of other customers and employees in the area and we all felt sorry for this woman. I haven't seen this style of management since basic training Does this Home Depot store allow supervisors to treat all its employees this way? He could have easily talked to this lady in private and not the way he did it in in front of all customers and co-workers. At least she kept her composure and stayed calm and professional while supervisor David went completely out of control. Lowe's is only a few minutes away and will be the store I will shop from now on.

I'm just like my Dad - I judge a home improvement project's complexity on the number of Home Depot trips you had to make to finish it. One trip = easy, peasy. 4+ trips = difficult. I've had a handful of projects of all difficulties and to say I frequent Home Depot is an understatement. I usually find what I need fairly quickly, but on the chance that I don't know where something is, someone can usually point you in the right direction or find someone that does know. I also like that it's super close to my house which is great when that difficult project keeps increasing the number of Home Depot trips. Also, I love that they allow dogs (this might be all Home Depots). I like to bring my dog places just to get him out and about and not just on his normal walk. All the employees light up when they see a dog walking through. I've had a couple of gripes with Home Depot though: 1) The time we just wanted a gallon of paint. We waited at the paint desk for about 5 minutes, but no one was around or came up to help us. We had customer service call for the person who was working paint. Another 5 minutes, no one showed up. Customer Service called gain. 5 more minutes and still no one. Finally, someone who hardly ever works paint came to help us and was very apologetic about the wait and that whoever was supposed to be working the desk never showed up. This guy was so friendly and even gave us a 10% discount on our purchase. This is the only time we've ever had an issue with paint - there is normally somebody there ready to help you out. 2) They make keys, but don't expect anything fancy. We have a U-Haul brand padlock on our side fence and I wanted to get a key made for parents and brother. But they didn't have the key to match. 3) Sprinkler parts are kind of lacking. It seems like they have a lot, but there's always some joint or head that we need that they don't have.

I'll give this store a two star just cause there is one guy named Larry there in plumbing that knows what he's talking about ! I'm very upset I wasted my time and now my money seeing how I trusted a guy there when he told me the insulated flexible ducking would with stand the heat well it didn't and started burning the insulation and filled my house with the worse smell ever !!!!!!! And now I'm told I can not return the product cause they can't sel it again well it would have never happen if the (( pros )) told me the correct info I'd say if you need something done and advice contact lowes or google it your self save the time and the money !!!!!!!

Every Home Depot are the same. (Love the self checkout by the way. ) What makes it different is the customer service. My experience with this store is only ok, meaning there's no wow, no boo. I frequent this store fairly often because every time my plants die I come here to get a new one, and they always die on me within 2 months..... lol There were several time I have question about some hardwares and want to ask for help but there is none..... after several encounters like this I've learned that if u need help right away, stop looking around for employees, just walk to the little office in the back and wave at them. I wish someone can answer my questions about plants, cuz they always die on me even the toughest plants.

The self check out staff is incredibly rude. I've been there twice now with the same group of little brats. I spend $1000s of dollars a month minimum at Home Depot for my parents local businesses. Today I asked where signs were and they told me they didn't have any. I then asked where cleaning supplies would be and I was told you guys didn't have any well little did they know I walked out with about $100 worth of cleaning supplies which is a normal amount for my parents company and 6 signs in tow. Little do those brats know that the customer is always right. They are lucky to have jobs in a time like now.

I come from Oakland, and let's just say that the Oakland Home Depot experience requires a lot of doing it on your own. I went down to Reno with Dad and stopped at the Reno H.D. The people there were nice, clean, smart, friendly....I was hit up every 50 feet by someone asking if I needed help. Everyone I asked was genuinely friendly, AND, know what they were talking about.

The Home Depot in Spanish Springs has been excellent however this Home Depot in south Reno is a different story. Only employee in the paint department, A young girl, did not know how to mix paint. And did not offer to get someone who did know how. I would have given it one star except I ran into an employee as I was leaving that did know how to mix paint and did so. Not all Home Depot's are the same.

Based on the popularity of my last FACT formatted review, I present to you Home Depot. FACT: Words like "handy" and "craftsman" will never be used in a sentence describing me. FACT: I need supervision to follow IKEA style instructions. FACT: I will inevitably make a mistake when following basic instructions! FACT: I'd never operated a power saw until a month ago. FACT: The only power tool I owned until that point was a $20 drill from Walmart. FACT: Since owning a home I've realized the need for high quality tools. FACT: I now own a miter saw and am in the market for a circular saw. FACT: RIGID brand tools from Home Depot carry an impressive lifetime warranty. FACT: All tools aren't expensive, meaning you can develop a collection pretty quickly! FACT: Home Depot has tools to fit any budget! All that said, Home Depot has become a regular stop for me, helping me learn the wide array of tools, hardware, and home improvement fixes available to the DIYer or, like me, the guy who wants to call himself that. Now it's appropriate to laugh at me. Hopefully when I write the update I'll still have all my fingers!

George in the garden department could not have been any more annoyed I was asking for help with arborvaties. He tried to make it better at the end but failed miserably. He really should not be in a customer service position.

Home Depots are home depots. they have the usual stuff, and the same lay out as every other store. But seeing as I live right in between the two Home Depots in Reno, I always choose this one. They generally have more knowledgable staff, we had to order a custom door, and it arrived perfectly with no errors. It is also usually a bit less crowded than the west reno location, always a plus! And its near a bunch of other stores, so if you need to run other errands, its a convenient location. I am not a fan of their garden collection though, the west reno location has better landscaping supplies.

Stopped in today for some hardware to string up a triangle patio shade. Employees were few and far between, even overheard an employee telling another customer some call-ins caused the staff shortage. I didn't need any help on this visit so that wasn't an issue for me. I was able to find all of the necessary hardware on my own and even stumbled on a cool 'carabiner' type attachment for those of us that don't know how to tie an assortment of knots. It enables us non boy scout folk to string up anything without having to tie a knot! Cool stuff. Prices were reasonable and stock was plentiful, I could have hung 10 of them if I needed to. They are nearly right up the street from me so convenience couldn't be better. They will always be at the top of my list for home improvement products.

Ordered a carpet runner online. Was easy to pick up and easy to order online. Courteous sales person and no hassle with no waiting in line. Shopping off hours is my favorite thing to do, especially in the Holiday Season with traffic and crazy drivers everywhere. Home Depot 5 Stars today.
Karrie in paint is great. Very helpful and mixed our paint perfect on first try. If you need paint go see Karrie. Denise is great also. Great paint ladies.

Great experience with Nancy making our flooring project go well. Lora was amazing on the sales end as well. Definitely look for these 2 ladies if you are doing floors. Store is also very clean, and has anything you would need at the great price. Great job at the service desk as well.
Had an extra digit in my zip code and had extreme trouble getting them to understand the problem. This is the second time we've had issues with zip codes and this store.. not super impressed.

If you pay for something with cash and do not have the receipt they will not take it back. I was returning a $4.50 bag of sand and they wouldn't take it. Bad thing is I've been digging holes to put in a new fence which I was going to order from them. I'm going to Lowe's. I suggest you do too. This company has really gone downhill in the last few years. They lost a multi thousand dollar a year customer over a $4.50 bag of sand.

Well everyone is so familiar with Home Depot it probably doesn't seem necessary to do a review. However sometimes someone is so helpful that something needs to be said. First, this Home Depot has a nice happy feel just walking in. Lots of hustle! We went directly to the nursery and met up with Joey who was really HELPFUL! I learned more in a few minutes than I did researching on the internet! Turns out Joey has been in THIS Home Depot Nursery for 20 years! He really knows his business. He tells it like it is. He says Home Depot REALLY does honor the guarantee on the plants they sell so be sure to save your receipt if that's important to you! I know the next time I need plants I'm coming back here even though it is not the closest Home Depot to my house! It's hard to find people who KNOW plants! I also needed help in the paint department. Denise was another AweSome employee in this store. SIDE NOTE...After leaving HD we needed to look at something only Lowes sells. We rarely shop at Lowe's because we're just Home Depot People I guess. What a huge difference. The Lowes felt dead. Nobody in there. Took 20 minutes to get help with questions about an item they supposedly had but didn't. The guy in Lowes Plumbing said he'd be right back...15 minutes later I saw him head down an isle away from me and I hollered...he turned around and yelling...not politely...said YEAH I'LL GET THERE. Several more minutes later he showed up. Unfortunately he didn't know much about what we wanted! Pretty much a waste of time. I have never received rude treatment from anyone at any Home Depot in decades of shopping. Joey and Denise are just two who impressed me yesterday. But there were actually a couple more smiling faces that added to the pleasantness of shopping here! If you find this review useful please vote!
I've shopped here quite a few times. THIS Home Depot has much more merchandise than the location at the south end near me. Great customer service EVERY time!!

Home Depot: Internet purchase folly. I needed several items for my home including 3 toilets. I did not want/or couldn't shop in store, so I went online- of course, simple right? Well not exactly, I did find what I wanted, 3 toilets. Then I tried to find "toilet installations" (as Home Depot advertises how easy it is to get things installed), here things got complicated. First thing I see on the installation page is another phone number (a telephone "tree"!) to call, and which sent me to another number which began to get me totally frustrated and ended up being the local store. I was told that since I had purchased the toilets "on the Internet" and sent the toilets to the store, they would charge me $25.00 each for my installers to pick up the toilets which floored me. So their $79.00 installation fee per toilet would cost me $75.00 more! I could not believe this on top of buying near or over $1,000.00 in merchandise that day. We picked up the toilets. Then one of my new toilets sprouted a leak and the plumber who installed it came twice to figure out what was going on and fix it. He finally told me it may be a defect. It was leaking when he left. We were already upset that HD would have charged us a $25.00 handling charge? So I did not want to deal with them over this, but I believed I had no choice, I called and talked to the service department- and was told- since I had made the purchased "ONLINE", the options were to bring in the toilet and purchase one "in stock" (and repay for it to be installed by my plumber or them)! When I questioned a fair trade for a defective toilet and a new one off the floor, the service person said that the Internet purchase "people/real entity???" MAY give me a Percentage of my purchase! Again- disbelief! I felt I was really getting the royal runaround! What about the policy of merchantability being blatantly ignored? When I called the "internet people" I tried to go as far as I could go, I received the same kind of talk about a "partial/possible/percentage reimbursement. At that point I asked for the corporate offices number. I was exhausted, frustrated and mad. I had spent hours trying to get this store to say, ok, bring in the defective toilet and we will give you a replacement - we stand by our products! No such words were ever uttered to me, a longtime and "valued customer" who has spent at lot money at their stores- I never did. By some luck or good karma after a week or so my toilet stopped leaking on its own. Oh thank goodness I don't have to deal with HD. I'm going to Lowe's or maybe better, my neighborhood hardware store.

Waited 15 minutes in the blind section. Employee helping Someone else. Didn't acknowledge me, didn't offer to get help. A simple hi be with you in 20 minutes etc. would have been appropriate. Found another employee who couldn't help. He tried to find someone. No luck. 20 minutes later no help. Well guess Lowes might want my business.

Was told dishwasher and washing machine would be delivered between 7am and ll am at my son's house. Waited four hours. Truck arrived late around 11:30 wasting four hours of my time. But there is more-- the paperwork was screwed up, ie. not coded for installation--sure, that is what people do, buy household appliances without installation. The delivery guys would only install the washer--so the dishwasher awaits attention in the garage. Home Depot hires independent contractors and must not be paying much--the delivery service is seriously deficient. Not on time and aggravatingly incomplete. Someone in house obviously incompetently screwed up the paperwork. The delivery guys will only do what is on the invoice. Either they are not paid for anything not on invoice or just have very little initiative. In any event the customer is abused. Now I will be wasting more time getting the dishwasher installed. So my respectful suggestion is if you are in the market for household appliances that require delivery and installation go elsewhere. Well, unless you want a similar experience so you can write an irate review and tell all the people you know what a bad experience it is, shopping for household appliances at Home Depot. Those lousy reviews are true.
Dylan and John (Pony) are great people they help me with my tool box and helped me load it in my vehicle. Very nice people and great store to shop at!

If you can try to go to another Home Depot I say do it I don't go to Home Depot at all terrible I'll repeat terrible customer service I had a problem with an order they never got back to me I finally called back to talk to the manager and he transfer me to somebody else in another department that had no clue so frustrating don't try to call the customer service phone because you' will hear about four other workers behind the person that you're calling talking over them you can never understand what they're saying

Horrible customer service. We were looking for something very specific so we asked an employee for help. He told us where to go, once there we could not find the item. Asked another employee where it was and he proceeded to again point out where we need to go. After explaining that we had already looked there per another employees directions I asked for him to take us and show us where it was. He continued to point and tell us where it was and would not take us to it. A very lazy employee. Went to Lowe's and immediately was greeted by someone who walked us directly to the location of the item we needed.

The Home Depot is a good place for your home improvement needs! Now if you mess up the project that's on you haha. But I have never had any issues here. Every time I have come in the store is well kept and clean. Everything is relatively easy to find and if I need help I'll ask. The staff is very helpful and accommodating as well. I have always like the selection of items they have here. I have somewhat of a green thumb and they have everything I need there for my garden needs. Just a random fact they sell chicken coops too. Also they sell tiny house on their online store for a fair price. Which I am interested in. There is always ample parking when I go here. I love the hours they have. I remember coming here around 8pm thinking they would be closed but they done close till 9pm. I was super happy about that. Also, Every time I have asked for the discount I have never had any issues or any employee a weird remark about it. I had an issue once at Lowe's about getting the veteran discount and I never returned there. Just fyi if you ask a veteran to show proper ID for the discount we are more than willing to do so. We now have ways to prove that when a veteran says they are a veteran they can prove it. I get it i have hear about those people trying to take advantage of the discount. I am sure the staff at Home Depot is well informed. If they are not they should be. I was not happy about what happened at Lowe's, so hence inform your staff about the proper way to handle the situation. Thanks for reading my review.

I've been shopping Home Depot at the Virginia Street, Reno NV, location and spent thousands of dollars there over the years. Best kept secret is their consumer credit card. Get it. It extends your returns to one full year! Never had a problem at any of their locations really. Their website has better deals than other online stores. Plus, you still get their same great online guarantee, and you can return the items you buy online at any Home Depot store.
Asked 3 different people to unlock a packout box I was trying to purchase waited 45minutes and nobody unlocked it purchased it online from another store

5 stars for service! I was looking for some dahlias to plant at my boyfriend's. The only 2 plants that I liked were both semi-sad/ dead/ crunchy. Dylan offered a discount because I really wanted dahlias. He literally looked at the sadness and told me to take them. OMG I was shocked!! I'll definitely come back for the quality of service!

This is actually a review for the carpet installers Home Depot assigned to us.
