The overall carpet buying experience was mixed, with a little confusion on their side (information not being logged properly with our order), but overall friendly and helpful. The install on the other hand was a nightmare. We were doing it on a second property, and I was not on site. Right off the bat the guy said he wouldn't start unless someone was there to sign off when he was done. We had contractors I trust going in and out, so I assured him someone would be there, but it still took a lot of arm twisting for him to get going. In the end I asked him what sort of assurance he needed (the contractor had been there on time to let him in already) and he couldn't say, so he finally started the job -- not a great start. We did get his job signed off, but unfortunately my contractor went home sick and sent a replacement who signed as asked. Had it been me or my contractor we would not have signed off. The installation itself was okay, but they kind of trashed the place. It was newly painted and scuff marks on the base boards was somewhat expected, but the extent of the damage to the paint seemed excessive, and wasn't limited to the baseboards. There was several hundred dollars worth of paneling (not much, but VERY expensive redwood that you just can't get anymore) that was just dumped out front in the snow. Doors were removed in the closets and were not rehung. I would never trust these guys in my home again without constant supervision.

This is the worst moving company I have ever encountered. We booked them to move our small row home and were told we would be the second or third move of the day. They confirmed with us the Friday before and then again when the mover himself called Saturday morning to let us know he would be around in the afternoon. Throughout the day I called and left multiple messages for both the company and mover himself when the time began to tick on. No response and so at 6pm we rented a uhaul and moved ourselves. They never contacted us that whole day or showed up. Sunday came and still no follow up about why they didn't show or have the decency to call. Finally, on Monday when I called back I got in touch with a supervisor who finally agreed to refund my deposit after telling me the whole situation was my fault and that he didn't need to listen to me badger him for 10mins! By far the worst company with even worse custom service! NEVER BOOK WITH THEM!!

Hired this company on Tuesday for a move Saturday (1 Bed room apartment). I was told I would be the second job of the day , so naturally I thought 3-4 o'clock latest. At 3 o'clock I had not heard from them and decided to give them a call. Rang a few times and went to voicemail and went about my day. AN HOUR AND 30 MINUTES later they said they were on their 3rd job of the day. I stated that I was told I was the second move for the day , the person on the phone stated they had no idea what I was talking about , he's only handed paper work for each day. It's now 7:21 and I just cancelled my credit card deposit , my things are not out my old place and I have work 6 days a week Sunday-Friday. So in short , I wasted my only day off on a very unprofessional company whom couldn't get a quit simple job accomplished because of lack of communication.

My wife and I were trying to figure whether or not to hire a moving company or do it ourselves. We needed to move a couch and a dining room set across town. My wife did quite a bit of research and found that SVJ was the most economical. When my wife contacted their salesperson my wife made it clear that we do not hire anyone without a quote. The woman on the phone was nice and said she emailed it. We never got it. To ensure it did not get caught in the spam filters we gave her two other emails addresses. Again never got anything. Finally, my wife told her to fax it to us. Yup, you guessed it, we never received it. My wife called the salesperson at SVJ and she said don't worry about it we'll take care of you, (essentially saying "trust us"). At that point, I decided to check the reviews on Yelp and as I suspected where there is smoke there is a dumpster fire.... Needless to say, we moved the items ourselves and looks like we saved ourselves a major headache and a bit of money.... **17 Mar 17 UPDATE** Okay, shame on me. I forgot put paper in my fax machine. Their fax printed today and it was dated four days before my actual move date. None the less, I still saved $150 by doing it myself....

The worst move of all ten -- including overseas and then back -- in the past twenty years! I told Mr. Jamieson that I had the equivalent of a three bedroom house to pack and move between 9AM and 5PM. Most of the goods to go to the new home and some to go to a storage facility. I told him he would need a truck and a half to move everything: I know that because I've moved all of it on multiple occasions before -- many places in the US and overseas and back -- and it will not fit into one standard panel truck! He didn't listen. Four guys showed up at about 11AM. They didn't know they had to begin at nine and end at 5PM. I got charged by the property owner for not being out on time. Lo and behold! The men could not load everything timely in the remaining hours and they could not load it in one truck! And by the time they were done loading, it was already 7PM and they had not moved the truck to the new place! By the time they moved the truck to the new place and unloaded it, the storage facility was closed! We had to leave property behind at the old place because it would not fit in the truck. I was told they would come back the following day to pick that up and move it to the new place and the storage facility. I paid with a bank check on Day One and, because what I had said before the move was ignored entirely, when the movers came back the next day, they demanded nearly half again -- over $500 -- for a second trip, driving time, fuel etc. I had to give them my credit card in order to get my goods off their truck at the new place and the storage facility. Yesterday I looked at my bank account: besides getting paid about $1,300 in the deposit and the bank check, they attempted to charge another $1,000 on my credit card! I've been hit with a bank charge because they attempted to charge funds which put my account over my credit limit. The men came without sufficient packing materials, shipped most of the pictures without boxes, shipped the lamps without boxes, used a piece of plastic as a rod in the clothing box (it bent and broke so everything was at the bottom) and lost the AC cord to the TV. That's what I've found thus far in the unpacking. Things are broken / damaged because they were not packed as one would expect of professional movers. I can't put too much blame on the men: they were inadequately advised as to the requirements of available time and packing requirements. If they had arrived on time -- on or before 9AM -- with a larger truck or two trucks and one more man and sufficient packing materials, they would have been done and home in time for dinner with their families in one working day. As it turned out, I was the additional labor force on Day One and a second trip the following day was necessary. This is not right that I am charged with almost 50% move than the estimate because the company didn't listen! Worst move out of all 10 over the last twenty years! Whether Mr. Jamieson believes it or not, some customers actually know as much as professional movers do about moving their own households!

I want the afternoon service and they gave the the "afternoon/evening". If you want to move in the evening where rubbery would happened, just choose them. They are very good at playing words. Be careful about their words. You can not believe even a single letter from they speaking because they will refuse everything you have been told. I am very regret booking the reservation here but it is an expensive lesson to learn someone's attitude will change immediately if you pay the deposit.

WARNING!!! DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY!!! I reserved them three weeks in advance, they were to come and pack the day before, when they arrived to pack, the lead guy told me he had to leave early to go to court for child support but promised every thing would be packed. When he left the other two guys left, and less than 50% of the house was packed. On move day they were to arrive at 9:00, showed up at 10:45, and had to pack the rest of the house which took them 4 hours, meanwhile I missed my move in time at my new place. The lead guy bought at 4th person that reeked of alcohol and hold me I would have to pay, which I said NO! The move was to be 3.5 hours it took them 8, they were totally unprofessional, they turned on my wireless speaker and blast music while they packed. They ran out of material and asked me to go buy tape, they did not have enough boxes so they brought in used ragged boxes they found in their truck. They did not properly wrap my beige suede furniture and left it with marks. I have an expensive vase that missing which was either stolen or broken. The company did not take responsibility for it and when I reported it never followed up. The packed 45 boxes to rack up extra charges and just threw my items into them. These are NOT professional movers. I have moved several times across the country and never experienced an horrific experience like this. They took their time to rack up overtime charges these guys as well as the management is dishonest. The lead guy even told me that when they get mad at a customer they just throw their items into the new place and leave. I ended up paying $300.00 more than my estimate due to their lateness, not completing the packing the day prior and taking their time, and using more materials than necessary. The lead guy had the nerve to ask me for a tip. I wish I had read the reviews about this company before I hired them if you want the worst moving experience of your life use this company. By the way they insisted they had to write my credit card and expiration number on the receipt, which I refused to do, the lead guy Aaron, insisted it was the only way they could process the payment, I said you processed the deposit over the phone, you will do this the same way, when they realized I would not budge they processed the payment. Final warning!!! DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY!!!

We've used SVJ two times in the last 5 years to move. We've recommended them to friends and family as well who love them. They are fast, efficient and affordable. They are the perfect movers for someone moving apartments or houses and wants to save some money and have the move over quickly. During each of our moves, there was nothing broken or chipped. We had movers who took a lot longer and ended up breaking things. I found it impressive that they could move things so fast without any damage. The movers were always professional and went above an beyond during each move. Highly recommend.

TERRIBLE experience. Showed up several hours late. No one at the office answered the phone when I called to see where the movers were. When the movers did show up they had no idea what they were doing. Didn't bring tools, borrowed mine and never returned them. Took frequent breaks. Damaged the walls and said the damage was pre-existing. Re-assembled the furniture incorrectly. The list could go on. The men were nice enough but obviously just didn't have the correct training. I should have know that their cheap quote was too good to be true. Spend a little extra and hire a more professional moving company!

SVJ made our packing & moving experience so much better and not to mention, less stressful! Amy was very pleasant and booking was so easy. Juan and his team arrived exactly on time and were so very friendly and worked around the clock for us! Packed every fragile item very carefully and literally had the entire house packed within 2-3 hours! This team rarely took breaks and never complained once even amongst one another and we had a lot to pack. A lot! Their positive attitudes & easy going nature made me feel very comfortable with them handling and moving our belongings. I was impressed with their teamwork in handing off, carefully moving things and doing it with a smile! I would definitely use this service again and recommend them to others. SVJ should be very lucky to have such trustworthy, hardworking men representing them! Thanks again guys!

This was a local but complicated move. It was also the first time I used professional movers. My experience with this company could not have been better. The owners Steve and Valerie took the time to listen to exactly what I needed. The crew that moved my 2 households of furniture could not have been nicer. Nothing was broken in the move which I thought unthinkable. I was really nervous about the move and stressed. The young men who came to do the move worked as a team to ensure items were packed properly for transport. If you have a local move and can afford to do so, I would recommend giving SVJ moving a call. Thank you for making a difficult process much easier.

SCJ Moving was the perfect choice, thanks to their professionalism, timeliness, and thoroughness from the beginning of the booking process until the end. The movers were extremely friendly and efficient in their moving. I would definitely use this company again and recommend them to others!

Employees of this company are rude, obnoxious, inconsiderate, sloppy and have no respect for other peoples property. I do not recommend this moving company to anyone! From the damages to my ceilings and doors to the unplugged chest freezer full of meat to the cigarette butts all over the driveway I would recommend finding another company! After emailing this company pictures and receipts of this damage and having NO ONE contact me back all I get is "we will call you back" here we are 2 weeks later and I have heard nothing! Poor example of a business! If there was an option for a negative review I would have done that option!8 l

Stay away with SVJ! I was referred by my friend to this moving company, and thought it would be fine and never checked any reviews. But in the end had very similar experience with all those 1 star reviews. They were late, and one more guy showed up than the quote. The lead guy kept saying that they wouldn't charge me extra and I just need to "take care of them" (meaning paying them more cash rather than paying through company). They were super unprofessional. Charge phone at my place without asking. Used shower without asking. Once they arrived at my new place, they asked for $170 more in cash, and refused to unload the truck before I agreed so. And worst of it all. They damaged my new TV!

Broke a valuable piece of art and refused to reimburse me. After much going back and forth about company policy (a policy that should be explained at the onset of business (poor business etiquette btw)), there was no result other than the reiteration of said policy. Professionalism and business ethics are non-existent. To anyone seeking a reputable moving company -- this is not it. DO NOT HIRE THIS COMPANY! KEEP LOOKING!!

This was the worst moving experience I have ever had. The six gansters that showed up to move us were just that. They didn't speak to us, they constantly asked for food and drinks. They slammed furniture into doors, walls, and ceilings. We were responsible for keeping all the screws to beds and other furniture. They lost some screws, rebuild furniture poorly, and couldn't remember where anything went. They literally put boxes anywhere they could, trying to rush out of the house. One mover apparently was on crack and lived in a dumpster, validated by his co-workers and his lack of short term memory. I was horrified to have this group touch my things. I would never use this company again.

We had a very fast move, due to job relocation, and this company was fabulous! They were kind to a crazy mom who was trying to help her daughters. They had to find a new home plan a move & come up with all the funds in 17 days........From the customer service reps to the movers they were professional, patient, respectful and incredibly kind.The 3 gentleman who came and helped with the move were fun(at that point was so needed) professional, organized and helpful. We are so pleased we choose, after reviewing four companies and proposals, this company. We would absolutely recommend their service, and use again if necessary, to anybody. Our experience was top-notch 100% satisfied.

First let me say, we were supposed to have 4 guys for our move, only 3 showed up. When I asked about that they said oh well. Their attitudes were arrogant. They left large items behind ie. LADDERS! Arriving at our new home, we ordered pizza for the guys, I thought that was a nice gesture since it was over lunch. Boxes are all over the house in no particular order and the ones marked very fragile are at the bottom of 2 more boxes. The one guy was laughing as he screwed our kitchen table back on the base, handing me an extra screw he didn't need. WTF! After they left we realized we couldn't open the table to put a leaf in because the ass wipe screwed our table together! Now my husband has to buy a special screwdriver to undo what the ass wipe did! Also, we tipped each of them $25. and the comment my husband heard was "big tipper". I WILL NEVER RECOMMEND THESE GUYS TO ANYONE. EVER. They created a nightmare for us.

Aaron and Hector moved some of my furniture into storage during a home renovation. They arrived on time, were courteous and professional, took time to carefully examine all the pieces they were moving to check for existing damage, then wrapped everything in shrink wrap (bubble wrap on the glass front of a dining room cabinet), got it carefully onto the truck, unloaded it carefully, and were finished in just about 2 hours. This was my first move in almost 30 years, so I was anxious, but these two guys worked well together and handled my furniture as if it were their own. I plan to hire SVJ again to bring my stuff back to the house after the renovation. Ruby at the office was super helpful and efficient in getting the whole move organized in record time. Highly recommend!

SVJ Platinum Moving Company is extremely unprofessional. -I received an email today at 9:17am its contents were "We can come out this afternoon/evening but you would have to give us a call as soon possible. " -I called at 11:38am and spoke to Tonee Labell. She told me that was impossible but that there was an opening tomorrow. She said that there was two moves ahead of me and that it would arrive from 3-8pm. She said she had to give me another quote despite sending me one herself. I told her it was fine, but that I needed that slot. She assured me that she would call me back ASAP. -2:29pm I called back because I was getting worried. I spoke to another representative who refused to give me her name. She told me the spot was taken. I told her that Tonee saved it for me. This lady told me that they get many calls every day and that was it. She was very rude. I asked to speak to Tonee, and she said they would get back to me. She would not put me on hold and told me they only do call backs. I have phone records of the phone call times and emails to prove all the quote and given estimate if anyone wishes to see it. Update: 3:20pm I received a call back from the same lady who I spoke to at 2:29pm. She provided her name to me. She said that they now had an opening for tomorrow morning from 9am-12pm. I told them no because I spent the past 40 minutes calling every delivery company possible to get a mover for today/tomorrow. I managed to already get another company for tomorrow 8am. I did not want to screw over my new moving company so I declined the offer. I honestly believe I only got this offer because I complained on social media

We got prices for over 15 companies in the area. SVJ was not the cheapest but the only one that said they would send 4 guys. My thoughts were the more guys the faster things will get done. Everyone was great up until the day of the move. I was told many times that the movers will arrive tween 9am and 11 am. At 11:01 I call the company. I spoke with a woman who said she was the manager. I asked were the movers were. She said that the time frail was an estiment time and that they can show up whenever. She also said that they already have our business so she can treat me however she wanted. It's not like I could get another company out there today to move us. I was told that the truck was having problems. I said thats fine but a phone call would be nice. She then said that their phones were not working. I asked 4 guys and not one phone working? She then told me that they will get there when they get there. The movers showed up at 12:20pm. There were 3 and not 4. The men were great. Very nice and friendly. They worked very hard and fast and took great care of our stuff. The one thing they did that I didn't like was they charged their phones without asking. Our moved was on two different days. When they arrived at our new home the following day they arrived at 9:20 am. We have 3 guys once aegean. Two were new. One of the guys had a bad back and was working very slow. I don't feel that I should have paid for him at all. My husband and I ended up doing the work that we were paying him to do. At 11ish all three of their phones were blowing up. It turns out they had another move that day. I learned that they tell everyone the 9-11 am pickup and drop off time. They do the drop off first then go and pack up. It would have been nice if they told me that they would pick up in the afternoon so that my husband and I could have made trips ourself during the AM. We learned after they left that they broke my daughters fool house, a bookshelf and our grill. Because we singed the paperwork they won't reimburse us for these items.

In short: Stay Away from SVJ. We had them scheduled to arrive at 2. The day of the move they called and said the truck will arrive by noon. So we adjust our plans accordingly and then they don't even show until 2 anyway. They arrive in a truck way too small for what we requested. So we were only able to get 60% of our stuff. Not to mention, they had to repack the truck twice. During the move they wanted to make a stop for some drinks at Wawa. However, they took longer than 45 minutes. Further delaying. We were scheduled for 3 people, they show with 4. However neither of them were particularly experienced or even very good. Our brand new house was decimated. Holes, scrapes, marks galore. Minor damage to our furniture and primarily in not very noticeable locations. Not a huge deal. However, my top of the line 64" HDTV? Destroyed. So I make a claim with them and was met with considerable hostility and some BS line that they only cover $0.60 on the pound. So after a month and 4 days of putting me off they offer me $62. Fair market value is $3200 and replacement value is around $4500. So I tell them that is not enough and that they need to cover much more. Two weeks go by and finally I get an email they are sending me a check but fail to mention the amount. I get the check, for $62 with in them memo in big letters "Payment in full for damage to TV. Claim closed". The gall alone was astonishing. Arrogant and insulting. Needless to say, I'm going after them. But as a warning to the rest of you. Stay away.

They were hired to move my mother to her new place 5/26/2020 and they arrived an hour late. They didn't move everything as they were supposed to and to make matters worse, they were booked to move the remaining stuff to my house the next day. Unfortunately they forgot to book it into their system leaving me to find a new course of action. Never again would I use them.

DO NOT USE THESE MOVERS. We hired SJV movers for a short distance move within Philadelphia. Three movers were hired for four hours. Four movers arrived though only three were requested. Only three consistently helped with the move, yet all four demanded a tip before they would leave the premises. This was after they did not follow repeatedly communicated (3 times) instructions for where the moving truck should be driven to (the loading dock, not the front door) which added significant transit time and in addition to frequent breaks. These seemingly intentional delays resulted in an hour and a half of overtime being charged, which they demanded in cash before leaving. Even after several boxes of dishes were broken, they also refused to leave until they felt the tip was adequate. Things they kept repeating "It's my birthday, and I came to help you move on my birthday." "I help you, you help me." As a mother with a small child present, this felt threatening and highly inappropriate. Please do not use this moving company!

I am so disappointed in this company. I used them before and had two great experiences. This time I call to hire them and the level of customer service is horrendous. They were trying to over charge me bsaed off of a list and would not listen to me when I said if I used you before and what I had then is what I have now, why would I need an additional man and an extra hour. I then decided to contact the owner/manger due to my issue and I NEVER HEARD BACK! I would also tell people to use them and now I recommend people to never use them again. DON't USE!

As you can see I wrote I had two great experiences and then this experience happen which I was very disappointed with. I sent you an email in December 2013 and never received a response until now, April 2014. Five months for a response is pretty pathetic. I appreciate that you just recently responsed to my email agreeing that they should had taken pervious moves into account, but sending me an email saying sorry and then writing your comment on here trying to disacknowledge my complaint is not the way you should treat your customers.

After the impeccable service we received the first time we used SVJ, choosing them the second time for our big move out of state was a no brainer. What a difference. We were promised that once packed, our belongings would not be transferred to another container until it landed at our destination only to find that it had indeed been transferred at least twice. No blankets were used despite our contract specifying that they would. Some furniture were only shrink-wrapped in plastic. As a result, EVERY SINGLE piece of our furniture was scratched and dinged. Some pieces were completely destroyed. Nearly all the 50 boxes were damaged...some were burst open. The standard insurance provided cover at $0.60 per pound and that claim was processed without issue. I'm thankful for that despite that level of cover being woefully inadequate.

Wish I would have done my research before deciding to go with SVJ for my move from Philly to NYC. What a terrible overall experience. I will start off by saying this is not a professional company, they don't even have their own trucks. Three guys showed up in a rented Ryder truck. After they left, I quickly realized my coffee table didn't make it. Called the guys and no one picked up. Called SVJ directly and they admitted to leaving the coffee table outside on the loading dock at my old building. Their suggestion to fix the situation was that "they make trips to and from NYC all the time, and it would come on the next trip". The issue was that they left it on the loading dock next to the dumpster so it was thrown away. They had zero sympathy for the expensive coffee table that was now gone and told me my only recourse was to make a claim with them. Made the claim and their policy only covers 60 cents per pound, netting me nowhere near close to the full value of the table. They wouldn't budge and give me more and basically made me feel lucky for even getting that. For anyone looking into them, just know that no matter what happens or how expensive your property is, if it is lost or damaged, they only pay 60 cents per pound. Let's say its a $1,000 TV that they break. Let's say it weighs 100 pounds (which is doubtful), you are only getting a MAXIMUM of $60. There is a reason they have the cheapest rates in town, buyer beware. Pay a little extra for a proven, professional company.
Great moving company. Helped us move kind of short notice on a weekend. Price was very fair. Crew of 4 people came. All very professional and quick. Great service, would recommend to everyone.

DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY.. They were late, and did not bring their own tools to break down the furniture. They cracked my wooden bed frame. Scratched and dented the drawers under my bed and my husband's armoire. They had barely any drapes or coverings for the furniture. They didn't fill the truck and complained they couldn't get all of our stuff in so WE had to make multiple trips. I was extremely disappointed in their service. They said they would have someone come out and to "touch up" to our furniture and took cell pictures on the damage. I've emailed them and reached out and they have not called me back or responded to my emails. I know I won't hear from this company again.

My move was scheduled for 2/3. The morning of 2/2 I received a call from Valerie wanting to reschedule because of the forecasted snowstorm on 2/3. Knowing Manayunk and the mess that would remain in the wake of the storm, I asked if we could get the move done the same day. Valerie was able to pull a team together and get them to me within 3 hours!! And 3 hours later, we were moved!! Terrence, KJ and LJ were phenomenal! They were fast and efficient but took care not to damage any of our things. I was hesitant to use SVJ because of the bad reviews on Yelp but I am so glad I chatted with Valerie and went with them

Do not use this company if you have a small job. Do not use this company if you have a time constraint. They came 10 hours late worked 51 minutes and charged me their minimum rate: 3 men three hours.!!!! Since the moving men would have been penalized if i didnt complete the transaction, I paid in full and called the office in the morning to voice my complaint. I was given a "sorry but that's the moving business these days" answer. No apology or offering a small refund was offered to ease my frustration. Really?? I was not informed that my 12 NOON arrival time was NOT an arrival time at all but a "window" that meant any time after NOON. They arrived at 10pm!! Lesson: Make sure you are the first scheduled appt. of the day or you will regret it. Find a company that is straight forward. I am a military wife and have moved over 16 times. This one was a logistic nightmare.

Pick up was never completed. I was given a morning window of 9am to 12pm. Nobody came during that time and no update regarding status was provided. I called the office 3 times between the hours of 12pm-1pm and was told the office could not get in touch with the movers. When questioned how many moves were ahead of me I was told just one. I inquired what time that move began and was told they did not know. After another hour of waiting, I tried the office again multiple times around the 2pm hour, including left a detailed voicemail. Nobody returned my call; the office closed for the day despite knowing I was out of the loop. Nobody called to check in to see if the movers had contacted me. By 3pm, I finally got a call from the movers who said they had been double booked. I asked that they have the manager call me to discuss a discount for my time wasted and for the office's mistake for double booking and failing to inform me. I have not yet received that call despite calling the office on Sunday and Monday following the missed move. For them to think it is acceptable to show up over 3 hours late for a move presumed to be first thing in the morning is unacceptable (even more, I received no notice or update of the status of my movers throughout the entire morning and early afternoon, despite numerous attempts on behalf of myself to make contact). To be told that I shouldn't have anything else to do that day or that my time isn't valuable is atrocious. To not be offered a reasonable accommodation or discount for my time wasted is horrible. To be told a manager will call me Sunday morning and to still be waiting 48 hours after my move was supposed to take place, ridiculous. Then to be told the man I spoke to on the phone on Saturday who claimed to be my mover and is named Jerry (who was the only calm and professional one I dealt with) doesn't work for the company, frightening. How then did he get my phone number if them claim he doesn't work for SVJ? Or why would he find it appropriate to use a fake name? I tried to support a local company. My move was stressful enough and I believed you all would help relieve some of the burden. They did anything but that. Save you time. Find another moving company.

My husband and I had the pleasure of using SVJ Moving for the second time on August 30, 2015. We had Mike, Anthony, Gordon and Cloud who worked quickly and tirelessly through the heat with no complaints. They showed up on time and in great spirits. They made sure our precious items were wrapped appropriately before they took anything out of our apartment, even though we didn't ask for this extra precaution. Our move was completed in less than three hours, so we did not incur any additional fees or charges. They proved to be true professionals. I would recommend SVJ again and again especially these four amazing movers. I'm pretty sure whatever they are getting paid is not enough to reflect how they impact people's moves. We truly could not have done it without them. I am nine months pregnant and my husband has a few ailments, and no one ever likes to burden friends with the task of a move. This however felt like old friends or family, helping us out efficiently. Oh, and let's not forget, their prices are right on point. SVJ Movers can easily compete with the best of them, and I'd pick SVJ every time!
Wonderful movers! Hardworking, polite young men. Got the job done in about 2 hours. We'd certainly recommend them to anyone planning a move.

This company was GREAT. The guys they sent out to help me and my family do our move was wonderful. They were very professional and courteous. SVJ made our move a very easy transition. I would definitely recommend this company to everyone to use for their moving experience. Everything was padded up and well takne care of. Also, the move was done in a very timely manner. They were done in no time. The peron that was in charge of the crew really made sure everything was completed before I signed anything. He did a walk through with me at the old place to make sure they had moved all what I wanted moved. And another walk through to make sure it was all put in place where I wanted it at the new house. They aslo breakdown and set back up any furniture that needed it. For example my king size bedroom set was huge and they broke it down and set it back up at the new place. I was very satisfied with the job these guys performed. As I read other people's comments, its no way they could have had the same crew I had because these guys were friendly with me and my family and they were on time and I it was done so fast, I didn't see any breaks being taken. So I really don't know what they are talking about. Maybe it was a different crew..all I know is, the crew that handled our move, were totally Awesome. Thank you so much SVJ.

This is my second time using svj movers, and I have nothing but geat things to say. They are definitely the most affordable movers that I have found, they were prompt, and got the job done without any issues. Girl, Dashan, and Daniel were great today, super fast and nice guys! I would definitely recommend them and will use them again in the future if I move again.

I reserved two trucks and five men almost two months ahead of time before my move. On the day of my move only one truck showed up with five men, they said there was truck trouble and they would move my 7 bedroom house with one truck and make additional trips if needed. This meant they would have to take more time trying to fit everything in one truck squeezing things together, it was basically like a gigantic jigsaw puzzle five men were attempting to do in a good amount of time that is if they were attempting to do it in a good amount of time (they take way too many breaks) I did not stop I continue to work and work and work it was pretty ridiculous actually that they came with one truck and didnt hustle to make uo for it. Thats half of my issue the other half is that they do not have the proper moving equipment that movers should have like waist straps harness to jointly lift heavy items like refrigerators. Half of my house was still left un moved. They also did not have proper tools, when you pay people by their time it would make sense for them to have the proper tools to use to make their time efficient instead of a screwdriver or drill instead of using an allen key the right bit on your drill will speed up the process it should not take 1 hour to take four legs off a table it should take 5 minutes if I didn't already have most of my items disassembled I don't think they would have moved a quarter of my house they were that slow. One positive thing I can say is that the people are nice and respectful I see that they are just employees and the people they work for are terrible at management if I was there boss/ owner I would properly equip every one of my employees with the proper tools to make the jobs get done efficiently and easily my employee should not be breaking their backs lifting up items like that they should have proper harnesses to lift them in ratchet strap them and jointly walk with them elevated not scratching floors not scratching walls it's pretty ridiculous that they're doing things unprofessionally. They say that they disassemble and reassemble everything but they do not do this. I have little faith in movers since this experience. I really hope they step game up and help people more because moving is very stressful and i didnt need to do all this myself i thought I was paying a legitimate experienced company for white glove service. Not the case. Could have rented a uhaul and had a few day laborers do the same job for way less. I didnt bargain and i dont like to fight i paid what they told me to but I was not happy at all!

Me and my family moved to the far NE and I used these guys for the move, everything went smooth from booking to the finish. I was told 3 guys were coming and four showed up ready to work and they packed the whole truck. I had more stuff then I thought and they were Okay with that I was still boxing as they were moving. Great company!!!!

The movers did arrive between the quoted time of 9-11 AM. They did move fast and got things in and out quickly. However, they did not take the appropriate time to inventory the amount of items that I had. According to the main mover, I "had more stuff than what was on the list" which required a fourth mover. This of course would result into paying more money and I could hear the other movers telling him to charge me more. Everything that was on the inventory list was in the apartment for the move. Additionally, the fourth mover was the truck driver who did not assist much with larger items. I wouldn't suggest this company to anyone who is moving, especially any single women.

DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCES!!!!!! We had to put a lot of our furniture in storage for a few months after a tree fell on our house. It was something that needed to be done immediately and this was the only company that could do it the same day. We just recently had our furniture returned since the house has now been rebuilt and there were several items that did not come back. My husband took pictures of everything they took out and we had $3,170 worth of items that were not returned. Some of the stuff even came back so stained and filthy it now gives me the heebie jeebies. We did not get back some of the pieces of glass to put our dining room table back together which they did pay to have a glass company make for us although they were not able to make one of the pieces beveled which the one that was lost was beveled. How does that even happen??? Did someone break those pieces of glass??? We had pillows that were not returned, although some did come back. The 2 that did not come back were the same and the other 8 that came back were different. I guess someone liked those 2 and stole them. We also had 2 pictures, 2 metal wall hangings and a large antique brass mirror that were not returned. I wonder whose wall those items are now hanging on???? I sent them pictures of everything that was not returned and they claim they found one of the pictures but I haven't seen it yet. They also said they would send me out a claim form which I haven't seen yet either. I think their insurance covers 60 cents per pound. I'm sure I will not get anywhere near the $3,170 value of the items we didn't get back! When our furniture was returned, they tried to return a couple of bar stools and a chandelier that was not ours. Someone from the company called my husband when the furniture was in storage and asked about buying some of our items. I thought that was very strange and wondered if the employees just wandered around looking at things that were in storage and just helped themselves to what they wanted. Furniture would be more difficult but I guess pictures and wall hangings are much easier to just walk off. I was also charged for 3 hours of time to unload the furniture plus 1 hour travel time. The men were here barely 30 minutes! THIS COMPANY DOES NOT DESERVE TO BE IN BUSINESS - DON'T USE, EVER!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! YOU WILL BE SO SORRY!

They are by far the worst moving company in the world. One I reserved 3 guys for 11am on a Sunday. When 11am hit and I did not receive a call from the company saying that the guys were here, I thought maybe I should call them. I then call them and they say "well I don't know what time they are going to get there I well tell them to call you when they are on their way." Ok so I give them another hour, then two, then three then five. It is now 4pm and I call back and the rude women on the phone tells me that they are on their way. At 6pm when they had not shown up yet I gave up all hope, I then call them to cancel my move...of course by this time they are closed. At 8pm the movers tell me that they are outside my home. They seamed like nice people so I went with it, 15 min. into the move I noticed that they had no tools or anything to help them with the move. They pack up all of my things, nothing was wrapped we get to my new location. And they say well you know we bought an extra guy so we are not going to charge you extra if you just "look out" for us....look out means pay them extra. They then get to my new place, and say "well this is more walking than we expected." Note if they had a dolly they would not be complaining. They they ask me with a straight face to pay them 40 dollars extra a person, $160 to walk my items into my apartment and when I told them no they said they they would take longer and this would just be added to my invoice if I don't give them the money off the books. Needless to say I told them to kiss my ***. I hate that I was put in this position. I hated everything about SVJ.

I'll start with the one big negative. We signed up for the "second move" of the day. What we THOUGHT that meant was we would be the second move of the day. What it meant was we were ONE OF THE ADDITIONAL MOVES for that day. Turns out, we were actually the 4th move of the day. We would have appreciated a more honest story. If we knew we could be 4th, the frustration with waiting 41/2 hours beyond when we thought the movers would show up would have been lessened. And it took us 3 calls to the company before we actually found out when we thought they would show up. That said, we were desperate to get a mover since my daughter found out about her move date only 4 days prior to the move. We worked with Gil at the office to get a last second slot. It was a relatively easy move from a 1BR Apt to another 1 BR Apt in center city Philly. Once they did show up, the move went well, easily stayed within the 2 hour minimum timing and the movers were polite and worked hard - on a very hot day. As another person noted, they did stress the "need to tip" more than once. So, I give them a 2 for the communication with us, a 2 for the tip pushiness, but a 4 for their flexibility to give us a slot and a 4 for the actual move. That lands them somewhere around 3 stars. I would use them again, as long as I knew for sure when they were going to show up.

Very, Very disappointing. I have moved a few times, and have had several experiences with various moving companies, all of which have been positive. I've never in my life posted a negative review. SVJ is the sad exception. Their movers will purposely neglect and damage your property, shake you down for a giant tip at the end and guilt trip you into paying it. When you're forced to speak to their management about the damage they will cause to your property, they will dismiss you, ignore you, even mock you, and then hang up on you. The SVJ movers removed a plastic cover that was protecting my mattress without asking, and caused it to become completely dirty. After this, the movers demanded I pay a 40% tip!!! They actually refused a standard 20% tip offer, and so drove the cost of the move up significantly. When I called the management to request help in paying for the damages to my property, they constantly brushed me off and gave me a run-around. I called at least a dozen times, and each time they had their canned response, saying they needed to speak to their manager, and that he was out of the office. After a few calls they began to openly mock me on the phone. There are a lot of movers, some cheaper than others. But any cost saving you may think you will have with this company will be completely offset once experience their movers bullying you into paying an exorbitant tip, and once you see the damage they will cause your property.

I wish I could give them 0-star. The quote I had with them was for 3 men for 3 hours, but a 4th person showed up that morning. It looked like they just randomly hired someone on the street. The lead then tried hard to ask me to hire the 4th person by paying some extra. He kept saying that it would take 3 of them more than 3 hours and adding the 4th person would lower the cost. I didn't want to confront him because the lead had a bad manner and did want them to treat my stuff well so I OK'd the 4th person. I told them all stuff in the apartments needed to go, but would like them to save them vacuum for the last since I needed to vacuum the carpet after all stuff was gone. I explicitly told them I needed them to take the vacuum with the truck since my own car was already full of other things. However, just as I was vacuuming the carpet, they departed without even letting me know! Then I had to spend extra time to rearrange the stuff in my own car to fit the vacuum in. But shouldn't they at least have checked with me if I had more stuff before they left? They don't take good care of my stuff. They were throwing my furniture and boxes around and made my mattress dirty during the move! Because I have a few items made of compressed board, so I had to stay around them to let them know they need to pay special attention to some items so that they don't break them. But even that, they broke my 2-year-old desk at the destination! They also tore the cloth (more than 1-foot long of tear) on my sofa and broke several other things. For all the damages, the movers didn't show their sorry at all, and they were only acting like "the insurance will pay you anyways"... And speaking of their insurance? They only cover $0.65 per pound per item... Concerned that I will not get enough compensation for my loss and frustrated about how they handle my stuff, I was angry asking them how they were going to do with the desk. A guy then claims that he was going to buy me a new desk using his own paycheck! And they took the broken desk with them because they "don't want to pay for it while letting me keep it." However, later when I called the office making all the complaints, they office staff told me "that's not gonna happen" what the guy told me about my desk! I then argued quoting the mover's words, but the office staff insisted that I signed the insurance agreement, and they wouldn't get me a new desk. But the movers took my broken desk promising to get me a new one! Those guys just lied to my face! At the destination before they unload my stuff, they asked me to pay the remaining balance, which I assumed reasonable. But the lead came up with a number that's $150 more than I expected (he tried to make me pay more than I should!). I then asked him to show me his calculation and insisted I shouldn't be paying the number he had. And then he impatiently "fixed" the numbers, which still proved to be more than I should've paid (and the office refunded me later). Frustrated enough, I called the office to make a complaint, only to find that the office staff didn't feel sorry and showed no patience listening to my complaints. She kept claiming that how good they are and how many good reviews they received, but none of that mattered to me! And I also mentioned some additional damages I found after the movers left, but she refused to admit them simply because those damages were not reported at delivery and thus were not included in the final bill! But the guys made me to claim any damage at delivery when I didn't have time to go through every item, simply because they were in a hurry to leave! The above are just a few highlights about my horrible moving experience with the company, and there are many other issues I don't even feel like spending the time on.

Steve came out to our home to access what needed to be moved from Bala Cynwyd, PA to Frederica, DE. He assured us a competent crew would be sent with 10 men and 4 trucks. Included in that was to be a "furniture expert" who would carefully dismantle and reassemble furniture. Moving blankets would be used to protect the furniture, etc. Also advised they were fully insured. 11 men arrived with the one individual telling us we owed another $160 for the extra man. Then we were told we needed to purchase additional insurance. The crew sent was sub-par, at best. Some smelled of alcohol at 9:00am. There was a great deal of turmoil amongst the crew with them openly arguing frequently and often. One of the men actually shoved the only person who was working to the ground. The "furniture expert" was never sent and we had to dismantle the furniture ourselves with borrowed tools from the neighbor. No moving blankets were on the trucks. Walls were damaged and we had to repair them that evening, as settlement was the next day. When they arrived to the newly built house, they put a hole in the wall, destroyed a door, stained the carpeting and left cigarette butts in the driveway. Packages marked fragile were destroyed. All the while, multiple calls were placed to Steve and he still has not contacted us.

These guys were fast, funny and cheap! Emptied all the big stuff outta my 4br house and into a two car garage in less than 4 hours. We couldn't move into our new house until the next day. Had one minor incident with a chunk of wall but it was an easy fix! I wish I knew the four guys names but I will use these guys if I need to move again and highly recommend them to anyone!

I want to proceed this comment with saying I never, ever complain about service. That being said; This is the worst experience we could have possibly had. We were completing a local move so were paying an hourly rate that was agreed upon for 4 movers and a 22 foot truck; estimated time of arrival 9am-12pm. At 2:40 pm 3 unprofessional guys show up with a 12 foot truck. They start to load the truck and get to a point and begin complaining about how much stuff there was to move. Then the leader of the pack says he's going to have to charge more because the move is going to take longer than estimated and that instead of the original amount of $740 it will be $1400 and they want payment before they make the trip to the destination. My husband disputes this because they are minus one guy plus have 1/2 the size vehicle they were originally supposed to have so of course the move is going to take longer but that is the movers problem not ours. They come to agreement to finish this trip and make one more trip for $150 in addition meanwhile the guy in charge is cursing my husband out saying the "F" word a million times. The second trip the guys fill the truck up 3/4 and want to close the truck so my husband tells him to finish loading the truck we still have more items. The guy proceeds to tell him he doesn't give a "F" we are done and he will F-ing punch my husband in the face. Long story short they finished the second trip and we are stuck with completing the move ourselves. A company like this should use accountable, professional people when they are dealing with others belongings ; not people who are under house arrest (yes the main guy was wearing an ankle tag) and have no regard for proper human interaction.

I am giving this company three stars due to a mix-up in the time slot for my move. I was advised to sign up for the early time slot (9am - noon pickup) since my move was long distance (a 2 hour drive). After multiple calls at 10:30 AM, 12:30 PM, and 1:30 PM, I finally got a call back with an ETA. The crew didn't arrive til just after 5PM. This was reportedly due to a mix-up on the paperwork from the office. However, the guys on the crew were great despite working long hours that day. My furniture arrived safe at my new home at 9PM that night.

I would give them negative stars if I could. I contracted them for a day. They call and cancel that day. And they still refused to refund my security deposit. I think honestly they maybe be a fraudulent company. I would stay as far away from them as possible. Another time I used two men and truck so if you're looking for another company that's really good I definitely recommend them over these guys. I hired two men and a truck another time and their work couldn't have been better, very fast and efficient, friendly and trustworthy. I did get my deposit back finally. But I'm still not totally convinced that they might not be semi fraudulent. I think might have given them so much trouble they decided keeping my deposit wasn't worth it to them. Many many phone calls and an email. They are very rude also on top of being undependable. Particularly the guy who books The appointments. I still would recommend choosing another company. I ended up hiring Chris w Karma cleanouts and moving. Super personable, efficient, on time, strong and trustworthy. There price was about the same as two men and a truck. either company I'd recommend over this one. Especially if you need to get moved on the day you're planning.

The entire situation working with this company was messed up. I felt strong armed by the company into accepting more men than I knew I needed for my household move. I only wanted two guys and a truck, and was told I had to have three guys for a three hour minimum. When 6 guys showed up, I was surprised! They said "I would only be charged for three guys" (which is more than I had wanted anyways) Then, during the move, half the guys sat around shooting the shit and smoking cigarettes WHILE ON THE CLOCK. When they moved one full truck load in 1.5 hours, and I asked them to keep working for the remaining 1.5 hours, they got all snarky at me and made me feel stupid about it. Again, especially the team leader. Finally, I was appalled to find out I was charged for 5 hours!!! When I called SVJ, the best they were able to do was reduce it to four hours of charged time, even though the guys had left in less than three hours. I not only would never go to this con-artist operation again. At the end of the day, I ended up being charged an extra $100 from what we agreed upon, didn't get any extra time with the movers other than the 3 hour minimum, and had the movers make me feel crappy about asking them to work the full 3 hours that I was paying for. The only positive thing they did in this entire experience was to send me an email asking for a review, which reminded me how awful they were and reminded me to post on yelp.

The movers were late without calling. We had an arrival window of 9am-11am. I had to call at 11:10 am to find out when they would be there. I was quoted for 3 movers- 4 came and they tried to get more money for that. At any given time there was at least one of the movers just sitting around. They took multiple smoke breaks while stuff had to be done. The driver hit and knocked over a stop sign on the corner of our old street. The driver hit a parked car on the street as we arrived and said he would leave a note and later we realized he did not. Part of one of the beds that was moved was displaced and it took them 40 minutes to build one bed between three people because they did not know where they put the piece. The team of movers were overall OK with the exception of the apparent boss/leader of them. He kept trying to get more money out of us for multiple different things. He was the driver who hit multiple things. They arrived at 11:25. I was under the impression they would do a walk through first and then he would "start the clock" as to when we would pay/they would begin moving things. He wrote the start time as 11:25 am and then we did the walk through. We only had one truck load of things and were only going one mile to the new house so it seemed to take much longer than it should have. The last hour they were there they were going extremely slow, lingering and took two smoke breaks in a 50 minute period- I was unaware we were paying $95/hour for them to smoke. They finished up actually moving things just after 3pm but lingered and "cleaned up" for another 20 minutes while we kept asking if they were done (mind you they charge by the quarter hour). They charged us for 4 hours (3:25 end time) but wrote down 3:00pm as the end time- seems like they took our cash for that extra time and added it to their already too large tip. Overall not a very good experience, not recommended.

My wife arranged a local move of about a half dozen pieces of furniture with additional moving of considerable number of pieces of furniture from one room to another with some going out to the curb. We were somewhat concerned when we looked at some of the poor reviews on this site. However, our experience was very positive. They came with 4 men instead of the three for which we were billed. Even though they had an extra man we paid exactly what we were quoted. They worked efficiently and did everything that we wanted or needed them to do. My wife wanted me to mention that they were very professional in moving our grandfathers clock - knowing how to properly protect it during the move. We would use them again. Revised 9/26/17: I spoke too soon. I just discovered that they put the grandfathers clock back together - they had taken some parts out for the move - they apparently put it back together wrong and it doesn't work - and they didn't tell me it didn't work. I would not use them again at this point

This company is horrible! Extremely unprofessional...over priced and are poor communicators. They clearly hire anybody off the street to move your belongings! One of the movers during my move....which is paid for by the hour....told me that he was going to take his time and that it's going to take too long. They took 3.5-4 hours to move a 1bdr apartment. (With EVERYTHING already disassembled and lined up). An apartment I moved all the things into in less than 2 hours. There was some silver lining. The manager on duty was great! Very diligent, calming, and FAST. It sucks he had to work with a bunch of sorry trifalin bozos!

If you want to save yourself headache and stressful situation DO NOT HIRE THIS COMPANY!!! You'll thank me later. First hand experience. The worse experience my family and I have had. We hire these guys for our move for the day of our settlement. We hire 4 guys because it was a big move. They were supposed to show up at 3pm as we spoke to the manager Ron prior to the event. The guys never showed up, we called them 3.30 no one answered, called again and again finally they told us some of the guys didn't show up for work!!! And wanted us to reschedule!! Are you kidding me, we had to move out of that house that same day. Long story short after many calls back and forth the driver himself shows up at 6pm and ask for $600 extra for him to call one of his buddy to help with this move. They put us in extremely stressful scenario. We were on a timeline and we had no other way to move our stuff. We had to on the spot pay extra money and another guy shows up 5 minutes later (this whole thing looked very suspicious*) they brought our stuff to the new place, made scratches on the walls. My dresser was damaged. When I spoke to the driver he was super rude Like he did nothing. They were loud and fouled mouth. I couldn't stand it. I just wanted this thing to be over and thinking about filing changes against this company. They absolutely ripped us off. We should've known after reading bad reviews on them. Management is rigged, they want money in advance. Pure ripoff. Save yourself from this company. This company is 0 star I had to pick at least one star to write a review.

They stole a painting from me. I had thought that they did a good job - they were polite, fast, and efficient. But I noticed after the move that the only piece of art they moved for me is missing. It is a gray painting of Peter Pan facing a pirate ship that my sister made for me a few years ago and is completely irreplaceable. It was in my son's room and one of the crew specifically asked me if I wanted them to put it on the truck, which I agreed to. I looked everywhere for it in every location it could be, and it is not a small painting at about 18x20. The office says they looked everywhere for it and that they would check with the crew, but clearly it never made it off of the truck. The crew disappeared for an hour between leaving my first location to dropping off items at the second location, even though the locations are only 20 minutes apart, so go figure. I cannot replace the painting. I just want it returned, but there's nothing I can do but warn future customers. If it's returned to me, I'll delete my reviews.

DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY!!! Our move took longer than expected. Their attitude was horrible. They were extremely unprofessional. A lot of our things were damaged, they were just throwing things, including furniture, around. I'm sure I will get no restitution for the damage incurred or the stress involved. If this post helps even one person avoid this company, it will be worth it. If I could give them negative stars, I would!

DO NOT HIRE THIS COMPANY, WORST EXPERIENCE I HAVE EVER HAD. This was the worst moving experience I have ever had. I was planning on moving two 1b apartments into 1 apartment. I made this very clear when I was scheduling the movers. When the movers showed up they said they were not aware of the second pick up and that they would require me to pay more. Once arriving at the drop off location the foreman would not unload the truck unless I paid him $225 cash upfront, on top of the agreed upon quote. He held my belonging hostage for over 2 hours until I was forced to pay him. Once they started to unload the truck I noticed that they did not wrap any of the furniture, or properly secure anything within the truck. They damaged multiple pieces of furniture and damaged my new apartment while moving items in. I was a return customer but they have lost my business for life.

While getting my items reassembled from them, they got very rude and unprofessional. I was quoted for 2.5 hours labor charges and the work got finished in less than 1.5 hour, still they were behaving as if I am eating up their time and were doing the reassembling in just an unprofessional way. Some of the screws, I had to tighten up later, few screws which were supposed to be fit in the bed were just left. When asked for reassembling the sofa, the guy said he has never done it, were highly reluctant to do the reassembling work. I had cardboard boxes specifically for my bed and sofa size, they just destroyed it even after my request. Got scratches on my furniture also. Positive: They were on time and didn't ask extra charges, although my stuffs were also very less.

I recently used SVJ for two moves and have several issues with the business practices, of both, the movers and the administrative staff. The first move went well, with the exception of them not refunding my deposit. I was told the movers would bring it with them on the second move. That never happened. Quite the contrary, the movers told me what they thought they should receive as a tip. They said that the going rate for a tip was between $65 and $120 PER PERSON, because the company does not compensate them well enough. Then halfway through loading up the truck, I was told by the movers that they required my credit card number written on the receipt after the move was completed. Mind you, the company already had the cc number on file. There was no way I was going to give the movers the cc number. After packing up and leaving for the new location, the driver said that his GPS took them the wrong way, and took them over 2 hours to arrive at 2nd location (aprox 40 miles). It took me 1 hour. The furniture was reassembled and placed haphazardly (wobbly tables, missing couch legs, among other items). Meanwhile, the movers complained about the weight of some of the totes and the distance they had to walk with them. Lastly, the initial move was over 2 months ago and we have yet to receive our deposit. There have been several calls made, and now all I get is an angry guy named Gil telling me he has no further information, other than the check is in the mail. Pay the extra money for another company.

I pretty much helped the entire time that they moved me (which included their cigarette breaks). On top of that, they lost two sides to my bed. When I emailed about it, the woman told me that they would reimburse. I originally found a bed on craigslist, but it ended up being the wrong size. No other beds were available, so I had to buy a new one from Ikea, and they refused to pay me more than the $85 that they agreed to pay for the craigslist bed. I had company hired movers that moved my things to DC, and they were INCREDIBLE. It really proved to me how awful this company really is.
They were on time and finished my move in under three hours. They charged me the price quoted and didn't add on any additional fees. Professional and punctual. Great service!

We had a wonderful experience with this moving company. They were on time. Everything was moved in and out quickly. 4 guys for 3.75 hours was cheaper here than anywhere else with less men. Very impressed!

Let me start by saying that I've moved several times and I have never had such a horrible experience. I also never post complaints, but I feel the need for others to know how bad this experience was. If I can convince one person not to use them, then this post will have been well worth my time. Three gentlemen arrived to move me, as agreed. Then a fourth gentleman pops up and I am told that he will be helping as well. The lead mover was emphatic about letting me know how much they usually get tipped. The subject of tipping was brought up 3 times. Very unprofessional, to say the least. We all left the first location at the same time. It took the movers close to an hour to arrive at the next location, which was 7 miles away. This extended their time and my bill.(I believe that I paid an additional $120.00 for their extended time). Upon completion of the move, I was asked to sign a bill of lading indicating that all items were received in good condition. I signed the bill of lading without knowledge of any damaged or missing items. I don't know that anyone has the time to hunt through 40+ boxes, bags, inspect all furniture, etc. Over the next 48 hours I unpacked most of my things. I noticed that 2 items were missing. An 18" X 18" metal sign that was handmade ($77.00) and a large round wall mirror ($32.80). (I'm assuming that these items were damaged and/or broken). Additionally, my brand new bedroom furniture and some other wooden pieces of furniture had deep, noticeable scratches. I contacted SVJ first thing Monday morning and they explained that they would mail me a claims form. Two weeks later I called and asked if they could send another form, as I had not received the first. I completed the form and sent it back the day I received it. I had omitted the "weight" of the items that were "lost" as I was unsure what their weights were. I thought the receipts, prices and descriptions would suffice. I sent the form back, only to receive it again 2 weeks later. They attached a form that stated: "Per our terms of agreement you are protected up to but not exceeding $.60 per pound, per article if you sustain a loss or damage to your goods." They also indicated that they would reimburse me, even though I signed off on the bill of lading. So, if my $77.00 sign weighs 5lbs., that's 5 X $.60 = $3.00. I have already replaced the sign and the mirror... my cost $150.00 as I could not find the originals at the price that I'd paid. I would ask anyone considering SVJ to CHOOSE ANOTHER MOVING COMPANY.

These guys were well on time. Instead of 3 guys, 2 showed up which was little disappointing Both the guys were slow and they were taking their sweet time. Since my apartment was on 5th floor i had to stay in the house and i was waiting for them to pick up the stuff from there but they were taking lot of time for making each trip from house to truck and back forth. Whenever i went down to the truck to find the reason these guys were taking break having cigarette or chatting which was unprofessional. Seeing this i had to call my friends to help in moving. More over even they requested me if they could stop by at wawa on the way to the new place to pick up cigarette and i agreed on that. Unloading was fast but they were over 30mins than the allotted time. If you are lucky in getting professional guys (which i did not) then its a good company to do business with.
Great group of people! They were on time, friendly and efficient. They were happy to help make the move easier on us. I would highly recommend them to anyone moving!

I also would like to give a 0 for rating. I understand the difficulties in the moving industry but can assure anyone looking for anything even resembling professionalism and respect , STAY AWAY. Everything from being late to not honoring the contract to smashing there truck into my tree to ruining my children's furniture. All after I handed out $80.00 in tips. When they showed up with a truck with no lift gate , no furniture dollies and no appliance hand truck I knew I was in trouble. Pictures are included.

Definitely needs better people working for them. 2 of the guys who came to move were great but 2 were horrible. They didn't use any protection on the furniture while moving out or into the house. Had a rip on my sectional, damaged my table.

The men they sent arrived 4 hours late. They charged me 3 hours moving and 1 hour and 45 min to move. They arrived at 3:04 and finished at 5:36. It should have taken 1 hour to get to my new place. The extra 45 minutes was so They could go through my things. They broke things and stole over $3000. Dan, Tone and Day Shawn were what the men called themselves. When they arrived the one called Day kept getting in my face. He was always within 2 feet of my face. So I couldn't see what was coming in. He wanted me to give them 50 a piece for a tip. He was looking for 150 for a tip. The company has yet to return my calls or emails.DO NOT HIRE THIS COMPANY.

My experience with this company was both good and bad, hence the three stars. This is my second time using this company for a move in the last 12 months. My issue with both of the moves resides in their lateness to arrive. On my first move, they were scheduled to arrive between 8Am -12PM. They reached out to me about being late and did not arrive until 1. They provided an additional mover at no cost for the lateness. On my second move, they were scheduled again for arrival at 8AM -12PM. With no heads up about being late, they did not arrive until 3PM. To me, that is unacceptable. My father had a very similar experience when he used them just a few days ago. For some reason, the scheduling for the movers is horrible on the company's end. I will say that the movers came in and performed their work as expected and timely within the window that I hired them for. Possibly will not use this company in the future, unfortunately.

Please take my advice and never use this service ! The managers are rude , unprofessional and do not perform the work as promise . They will trash your house during the move . Please be warned do not use this company .

This was my first time using a moving company. I will definitely use them again. They came with an extra guy which worked out great. They worked fast. They didn't play around with getting my things out and on the truck. They kept asking what else, needs to go. They even tightened loose screws on my dining room table and other furniture. When we arrived at the new location, I stayed out their way and told them where I wanted things to go and that was that. Nothing was broke, nothing was damaged. They were just hard working guys making a living. I also want to mention that the price was right. They were a lot reasonable than ALL the other moving companies I received quotes from.
A difficult experience. Movers were unfriendly. Took frequent long breaks. were not that careful with the furniture.
Employees don't have answers as easy as the load weight of the appliance dollies they rent. Won't even give me recommendations. Good thing I found another rental place with knowledgeable employees.
Best customer service! We needed to tow a car home to L.A. They set us up fast and got us going.

We reserved an auto transport 2 weeks ago. When we show up today the line was all the way to the back of the store. The staff moved s-l-o-w-l-y and we waited for approximately 45 minutes. We finely reach the front and confirm they have our reservation to be told they do not have an auto transport...no solution to this problem which for us, starting on a coast to coast relocation is a big problem. Unhelpful people coupled with complete incompetence is always a recipe for disaster. Thanks U-Haul!

Very easy to rent (was here to help a friend move some things) and drop off. Joshua was very efficient and friendly. Got us in and out of there in no time. Van was new and clean. Would not hesitate to recommend this place. Only recommendation to corporate - give Joshua a raise - that guy is a star AND hire more like him. Location was slightly short staffed so no one was at counter when we arrived (there was already a queue of people). But when we were helped, it was very good.

Traveling up from Southern California to the Northwest we encountered a short in our trailer wiring... The general manager here Scott H , after a 12 hour shift stayed to personally handle and reinstalled properly our wiring , as it had almost caught fire due to it been improperly installed in Southern California. We had gone to two of the U-Haul's here in the Reno area and he was the only person that was able to handle our situation and extremely professional young man, I highly recommend this facility .

No bueno. Got a one way auto transport trailer in Boise, for whatever reason they wrote S Virginia for drop off location. So I called this one to see if it was possible to bring it there since is way closer to our place. When I called, the lady on the phone just said "you're gonna have to hold, I have three costumers in front of you and I'm the only one here" I didn't have a chance to say a thing. After 50 minutes on the phone, I just decided to drive there. When I arrived and ask the yard guy, which by the way looks like he's high or drunk, he just said "no, you can't drop it here, they'll charge up to $200." All fine until I asked why she didn't just tell me that on the phone in stead of making me wait for 50 minutes and drive there, his response was "we are the smallest yard and do more business than any other yard in the area, we are busy", I then said "but you have really bad reviews", that's when it got even worse because he said: "well, who cares, you either like us or not" and walked away. They've been rude before, but this was the worse. Definitely not going there again ever.

Worst customer service I've ever received. If it could go wrong it went wrong. Website is useless when trying to rent a vehicle. Pushed back our pick up time 8 hours in advance. Checked in the night before as told to do and the next morning there was no registration. Arrived on time for pick up truck was not even checked in or ready. Don't waste your time with this company.

I cannot say enough bad things about this uhaul. This is easily the WORST UHUAL IN TOWN (maybe even the world). Every single experience I've had here has been incredibly horrible and the customer service is the worst customer service I have ever dealt with. Let me tell you about my most recent visit (which is very similar to all the other visits I have had) I scheduled a uhaul ONE WEEK IN ADVANCE for my business. I specifically chose the uhaul on rock blvd so I could stay away from the oddie location. The day before I was set to pick up my uhaul, I got a message saying they were having trouble covering it. So I called and the person on the phone was very nice. She fixed the problem for me and said they located a truck for me but it would be at oddie instead (great). She also told me the first 30 miles would be free, and gave me an extra free day for the trouble that I was put through. That was pretty cool. She asked what time I could pick up, I told her we were pretty busy but sometime after 12pm. She said that's fine, any time after 12 is fine. Awesome! We show up at about 1:45pm, wait in the longest line ever (typical of this uhaul, be ready to spend a ton of time waiting) and I'm not kidding you. Do not deal with this U-Haul dealer when it comes to install something. Made a reservation in 1 week advance. They call you day before and change everything. Warning to everyone again who deals with this U-Haul location.

The worst service ever! Delayed my departure date for moving out of the state. Too bad I can't review this place lower. The manager, Jim, is a complete dirtbag. He doesn't know how to to treat or talk to people. This was an incredibly inefficient waste of my time there was people out the door and one of the workers outside clearly saw me move it and couldn't pull in because of how many people were outside so I parked near the trucks and he said can you back out and I could not do a nicer gentleman helped me move the truck. GO TO ANOTHER U-HAUL! AVOID AT ALL COSTS! This terrible place is a form of purgatory for those desiring to move.
