I spoke with movers and neighbors and they were all familiar with this location, saying "NEVER go to Oddie U-Haul. It's terrible". I can confirm this. STAY AWAY!

Big cooperate enterprise that feels like a mom and pop shop. I had a hitch install scheduled a week in advance at the Uhaul location most south in Reno, showed up the day of the install and turned out the hitch installer was a no call no show (wump wump wwuummpp). South Reno location called the Oddie location to see if they could do it for me the next day, Oddie could do it but did not have the part # available. I'm appreciative of this U-Haul location and I recommend seeing these guys, they definitely have my business for as long as that staff remains the same. Shout out to Manuel, the hitch installer and the kind miss (who had her phone stolen the same day) for stoking me out. I hope to see them all the next time I come through!

We Love our local U Haul center. Vehicles in all Shapes and Sizes. Was So Simple. Wow!!! Instead of paying a Junk Dealer a small fortune for carting off our old furniture, we hauled it off ourselves. The rental process took a while, but the drop off was handled by Miguel. He is a Class Act. Thank You U Haul. You Rock!!! Reserve yourself a truck today!!!

I will echo others - there is something wrong with management here. I went elsewhere and suggest everyone do the same.

He had it completely installed in about 30 minutes and I was on my way. The next day we came back to do the other vehicle and once again Angel exceeded expectations of service and really helped us out. Thank you Angel and the U-Haul team, we appreciate you guys.

I'm gonna be short. Dont go. Go to the other in in town. Avoid this one. They tried to RIP me off. Waited in line 30 minutes to be talked to. The workers are completely unprofessional and incredibly rude to their customers. This U-Haul is horrible! Went in to rent a trailer. There was only 1 person in front of me and it took 15 minutes to be helped. I would give a zero if I could. I reserved a 12' enclosed trailer on September 14. Reservation number 25768657. What a joke this place is! I am moving and made a reservation for 2:30. Went to pick up my truck and it wasnt there. The people were late returning it. no stars deserved at this place first they tried to give me a truck that had already left the parking lot 30 minutes ago then they tried to rent me a passenger van for the same price as the 15 foot truck i was supposed to get and when i told them my reservation was for a 15 foot truck they acted like they hadn't just tried to text me a truck they had already been rented avoid this place at all costs!

Over the top excellent service. Fast, easy and superbly professional. Made the moving process way less stressful. Jim, the GM was highly communicative. He's a real pro. HORRIBLE. was told to come in at 7 am by a Michael and when I got there they didn't have anything I need. I have 2 kids I had to get a babysitter for so they could waste my time. DO NOT RECOMMEND,horrible service that doesn't know what they're doing.

Only reason I gave 3 stars is they were not willing to fill my RV with propane. The employees were friendly and did their best. I guess the manager feels they don't need the 60 bucks it cost to supply propane to RV travelers.

Had a great experience getting my U-Haul at Oddie Blvd with Stephanie's excellent customer service! She was very helpful as it was my first time renting a u-haul. This has been the third time I come in the last month and realizing it's my last time. Everytime I come I have troubles. The first time you can tell they didn't want to help me. The only location that had a pick-up to rent. Service was fast and friendly. Everyone works super hard to get you in and out. When I called on was on hold for awhile. I just wrote this out on google reviews so I took a snapshot of it. DON'T USE THIS UHAUL or any Uhaul it seems, scammers!

Most ridiculous experience I've ever dealt with right before a stressful move. DO NOT GO HERE. if you reserve with uhaul confirm your vehicle every hour for a week until you need it. Thankfully after constant attitude back and fourth with these employees at this location Miguel reluctantly called over to the Moana location and Anna over there was extremely helpful and kind. DO NOT GO HERE. You will only be "helped" by rude, incompetent people who hate being there more than you. I have never been to an establishment with such terrible customer service. Save yourself the trouble and don't give them business they don't deserve!

This one guy just sits on the phone all day and makes the line get larger and larger. People are waiting to be rung up and now isn't the time to dilly dally. I expect better service and one where every employee is not chatting on the phone all day long.

U-HAUL OF ODDIE SAVED MY MOVE! HERE IS MY STORY...: Originally, after a google search to find U-hauls near my home, I called the closest location, FIVE STAR MOVING & STORAGE (located at 800 Stillwell Ave in Reno, Nevada 89512), and they took my reservation and credit card number for a rental that was supposed to take place on Saturday 7/17. When I arrived at the very scary/shady warehouse location in the 'hood of Reno around 8:30am on 7/17, the doors were locked. I tried the 'after hours' phone number on the door and it went straight to the voice mail of an unidentified female. I left several messages on both the Five Star main phone and the after hours phone. After knocking loudly on the back door, some sort of mechanic (seemingly methed-out and missing several teeth) appeared and informed us that Five Star was not open on Sundays (mind you, it was Saturday and the hours 8am-12pm were clearly posted on the front door...when I'd made the reservation the woman on the phone told me that they opened at 7am on Saturdays...) I was completely dumbfounded and suddenly found myself in the situation of a crew of friends waiting to assist me with my move and NO U-haul. I frantically called the nearest U-haul and thankfully found U-HAUL OF ODDIE (1790 Silverada Boulevard, Reno, NV 89512). The man that answered the phone told me he had one 17' truck left and I made my way over to his store. U-Haul of Oddie got me in and out within minutes I was on my way. My move then went very smoothly. I promised myself I would write a yelp review to provide other customers with information on the negligence of Five Star and to praise the good work of U-Haul of Oddie. U-Haul of Oddie saved my move and my sanity that morning! Five Star now has my credit card number and still have not returned my Saturday morning phone calls even though it is after 3pm the following Monday, 7/19. I've also contacted U-Haul Corporate to inform them of the negligence on the part of Five Star. I recommend U-Haul of Oddie to anyone in the Reno area and remind EVERYONE to be sure to do more research than a google search when planning an expensive task such as a move!

Note: please see update below. Absolutely one of the worst experiences I've had at a business. There is ONE person working the counter and EIGHT people in line. It wouldn't be so bad if it didn't take at least ten minutes per person. I have been in line for 17 minutes and one person has been processed through the line. There's a SECOND line for waiting for trucks because there is one guy grabbing trucks. Truthfully, this is one of the most frustrating experiences in any line I've ever had. I would excuse this as a fluke or maybe they're short staffed, but I came here last year to buy boxes and I waited in like for 30 minutes...to buy a box. Management, you ABSOLUTELY need more than one person working the counter. This is ABSURD. Your business process is broken. Hire someone to fix it; it's obvious you're incapable of doing so. UPDATE: While the initial review is still true, taking the truck back was 100x easier and the staff were very courteous. They didn't charge me for the dolly since they didn't initially put it on my contract when I requested it. It's only fair to give them a much better review. The guys are nice, the truck ran well, and the price was good. All-in-all, aside from the insane wait this morning, everything was very good.

We were dropping by on our way through for a simple fill up of propane. The attendant came out, saw how little we needed, and gave it to us for free! Bonus bathrooms that were actually really clean and you've got a better experience than I would have guessed for a random uhaul rental. Nice!

Love this uhaul. Always clean, always professional. Yeah it's busy but that's because they are the best. The facility is clean with all the merch in site. Byron is outstanding. He handles his responsibilities well and still maintains the friendly demeanor that uhaul customers want during this transitory period in their lives. I would recommend making your reservation way in advanced like a week or two. You can call 1-800-GO-UHAUL to schedule the reservation or you can call the office.
Wish we could give 0 stars. Don't even bother. You make a "reservation" which means absolutely nothing. We drove 40 minutes to pickup a truck that didn't exist. Absolute bull.

Horribly slow customer service. Rented my 20ft uhaul there. Return it 6 hours later, after waiting a half hour they tried to tell me i have to return it to double diamond!!! Fuck you, im returning it where i rented it from. Not gonna pay me for my time, you deal with it!!!!

I reserved a 17 foot truck and had movers scheduled to help me pack up to move out of state TODAY! Would give 0 stars if I can. Made a reservation IN STATE to LAS VEGAS and was told by a rude customer service rep at this location that we could not drive OUT OF STATE when clearly Las Vegas is in state! No call. No information prior to pick up. Will never recommend UHaul again!

These guys are amazing. I rented a trailer. When I arrived, we discovered that the trailer wiring in my car was damaged from the hitch bottoming out and scraping the wiring. My fault for damaging it. Absolutely horrible customer service. If you enjoy being overcharged. If you enjoy being lied to. If you enjoy employees interrupting you and not allowing you to speak. Beach city is an apartment complex that gives many mixed emotions. To start off I will say--location is amazing, it's a 2 minute walk from the beach, direct walk to SBCC campus, 1 mile from state street, its really easy to meet new people and make friends, and most apartments get an ocean view. However, there are some fundamental issues with the how they run this place. For starters, there are about 50 parking spots at Beach City that aren't allowed to be occupied. There's parking spots in the garages under the apartments, behind the yellow building, and even around 15 in the green street. With a waiting list of over 100 people wanting a parking spot, you'd think they'd fill these spots. However, around 10 of these spots are occupied by the owners luxury cars--why does he store these in a college apartment complex and not his own house? Couldn't tell ya. It's times like these where my roommates without a spot have to walk 7 minutes down Cliff drive in the dark coming home from work when you really think "gee, I know that walk is a threat to your safety, you could get harassed by the homeless or strange men again tonight, but hey, at least Mr. Beach City gets to take up 10 spaces to show off his Porsche and vintage cars! What a great use of space:)". We are here to go to college, find jobs, and support ourselves. We need to be able to park our cars on the property!!! As well, maintenance is a joke. My neighbors have had a hole in their ceiling with pipes exposed above their sink for 3.5 months, no fixing planned any time soon. When my apartment had an ant problem, some guy in a wife beater and jeans walked in with a can of $3 Raid, sprayed our windows, and called it a day. You'd think with all the money they collect by charging $50 fines for hanging a wetsuit to dry on your balcony could cover some decent maintenance. Beach city also does not hesitate to fine it's residents. My roommate for instance left her bike on our balcony for 30 minutes while she was out getting a bike lock. During this time each of us received a $50 fine for storage issues... that's a $250 total fee for leaving a bike out for 30 minutes. As well, they've racked up some big money changing each individual of the apartments $50+ because of people having other things on their balconies like "too big" PLANTS, tables, and even surf boards. These fees, the parking, and the reliability to get things fixed here are horrible. Do with this review as you will.

I love beach city, the employees are nice and reasonable. They help when it is necessary, I don't have any complaints about the management and the places are very nice to live in especially for students who are brand new to Santa barbara. The location is amazing and I love being able to walk to class in 5 minutes not worrying about finding a parking spot or anything. Beach city is beautiful but also holds you to a standard that any apartment complex would, be respectful of neighbors and those you live with and follow the rules and you will love it.

What can I say besides...DONT LIVE HERE! Like honestly this is the worst place ive ever lived at, for one watch out for what they promise you will be in your apartment (new kitchen appliances, decent bathroom, speakers for your apartment) because they most likely aren't there. Beach city is THE worst place to live on in all of Santa Barbara. DO NOT LIVE HERE !!! if I could give this a -5 star rating I would. DO NOT LIVE HERE. This has been the worst and most disappointing living arrangement I've ever been it. The rooms have countless amount of issues. My son is starting his second year staying in this complex, moving in today as a matter of fact. Personally, I was suspect when he first wanted to move in here a year ago for last school year, based on the reviews. But looking back, I thought it was fine and supported him choosing a second year. Yes, there is partying happening, expected for a complex full of young college students. Nothing outrageous during my visits, as I expected to see much worse to be quite honest. When I have visited on evenings and weekends, I observed an active security patrol everytime which is a good thing in my opinion. I particularly base my high rating on the service from the front office staff, particularly Ava, but everyone else was just as good. Every single phone call and email was always answered very promptly, with ful courtesy and always with complete and accurate information. This rates high in my book as a concerned, paying parent. The only negative I have had about the experience, is that they have zero guest parking on-site, which is a bit frustrating when visiting as the paying parent. But I can see how guest parking could be abused by residents and their friends. All in all, I have been happy and re-upped for the second year.

I currently live here in Beach City or should I say Beach Sh*tty? These are the worst living situations I have ever dealt with. HORRIBLE management Shame on you beach city The only hard workers here are the construction guys working on random stuff around the complex.

Never live here. The managment staff is terrible and all they want to do is steal your money. ATTENTION: Do Not Listen to ANY of the "good" reviews! They are all fake! Beach City doesn't even deserve one star. I wish parents would read their Yelp reviews before making the mistake of letting their kids live there. If you are considering sending your child here - Don't do it. I would give it zero stars if I could. Between the partying, lack of control, "repair" fees for things that were broken before you moved in, parking issues, and more and more... It was not a great experience for my son. Terrible terrible management and service there. Front desk workers, always had such an attitude and never cared or wanted to help. If I could put 0 stars I would.

This place is terrible. From the RA's to the management to the rules. I had mice and bed bugs for the first month i lived here and nothing was offered besides "go buy mouse traps" and "flip your mattress over". They want nothing but money and scam you over and over again throughout the months of your lease. From ava to adam to brett to the St George management they are hungry for taking money out of your pocket and nothing else. We were told we would have free cleaning provided and never recieved it unless a new roommate was moving and beach city wanted it to look appealing for the tour. The only thing good about this place is the location. I got barely any of my deposit money back after I cleaned the whole apartment.. They made up things and charged my roommates and I with different fees.. This place is way over priced for what it is..

Read the other reviews. It's pretty self explanatory. Also do a quick search of the owner, Ed St George on the internet and you'll realize quite a few articles in which the city of Santa Barbara has issues with him. Other than that they will come into your room and throw your things away, they will charge you for damage that was done before you moved in, all around a big scam and a terrible place to live and try to study and sleep. They throw out your things and have 0 respect what so ever. Save yourself the time, the money, and your own well being and live somewhere else!!!

I love this place so much. I was very skeptical coming here at first reading all the reviews but DON'T listen to the bad reviews, because I will tell you this is the best place to live going to Santa Barbara City college. There are other places to live at in Santa Barbara but they are all so expensive, utilities not included, WiFi not included, and probably a long walk to school. Beach city on the other hand, utilities included, free WiFi, study room, vending machines, gym, pool, laundry rooms and so much more for a very reasonable price... not to mention the 4 min walk to classes. DONT HAVE TO WORRY ABOUT 30 min bus from IV!--- forget it!! No excuse to ever miss class cause you can roll out of bed and be in class before you even know it. You meet the coolest people living here too, the management is SOO good and there are people working on maintenance making sure everything looks great every day. Thursdays become our favorite nights all together.. you'll see ;) There are little events beach city host to get us all together such as movie nights, pool BBQ's, ice skating, bowling, and toco/pizza dinners. From someone that has lived here for only a year and a half, This is the best of the best. Living here next year... I can't wait!!

Our home is infested with bugs and flies and our kitchen is so run down that our cabinets don't even shut all the way, the dishwasher is broken, the sink is broken, the blinds are broken, the lights are broke. I never write online reviews but I've made an exception due to the fact that Beach City is a corrupt and obscene place for anyone trying to get a collegiate education. First I will address the noise. My roommate told me that one of the water damage areas occurred 6 months ago, meaning that they will deduct the cost of fixing it and not do the repairs. That being said that is just the beginning. The real security doesn't do anything and it's a private company. The management team, short of Sheri who is the executive director, is nothing more than a bunch of crooks. When I got a lawyer to remove myself from the community he told me that St. George has a reputation amongst the entire legal community as being the worst among the worst. Just look at other student housing and try to find 32 one star reviews anywhere else on yelp. Let's also not forget the amount of blow dealers and stuff going on, which happens everywhere but not with such open solicitation for complete strangers. If anybody needs a lawyer I personally had a great experience with Mike Brelje, but don't expect to get out of your lease easily or cheaply, and without some boarder line illegal intimidation So here's a few tips for the folks that are stuck their waiting for repairs. For starters if they don't fix something in 14 days properly you have the right to hire someone of your own choosing and they have to pay it. Another thing is that they have a whole bunch of code violations (I.E broken glass on the fire extinguishers, improperly built carports, and a whole bunch of little stuff that st George will have pay and if you consistently report it to the city they will get fined and that's how I was able to get them to let me out easier than expected. Just contact a lawyer because they will charge you full rent and lie about putting you on a waiting list. However I will say the location is killer and most of the people are genuinely nice. If your not going to school and want to party and you don't mind being in a shitty apartment this is the place. Don't be fooled by the nice location and the outside because the appliances, plumbing, management, and general atmosphere could not be further from the aesthetics that indicate class and quality. Also if you own a bike and don't keep it inside it will be vandalized, guaranteed. Oh and I forgot I know at least four apartments, mine included, with broken heaters.

I am a college student who lived at Beach City last year and I can confidently say that was the worst decision I have ever made. DO NOT LIVE HERE!!!! My apartment was already a dump when I moved in, everything was broken and in bad shape. When I reached out to management to fix this issue, no one responded. Management is essentially nonexistent at this facility. Ava is the worst property manager I have ever met, she is rude, unresponsive, and at the end of the day does not give a shit about anyone's wellbeing at Beach City. There was also a dead skunk in the pool that was left there for days. I could go on and on about how horrible this place please do not live here you will regret it. In addition, at the end of my lease I not only did not get my deposit back but I got charged an extra $100 for absolutely no reason. I fully regret not listening to others about how tragic this facility is, do not ignore the bad reviews!!!

Pretty simple review here. -Easy to get in and our, Glendale is never too busy and as long as you exit out the back its simple. -Staff is usually very helpful, sometimes they are a little understaffed and you may have to hit a call button and wait. -Most items are in stock but on occasion you'll have to wait for a restock. -Great customer service at the Pro Center! -Convenient location for midtown people. its a lot better than driving way West/East/North -Tons of Parking

When I first moved into my new house it seemed like I basically lived at Lowe's. I became very familiar with their employees and location of items. The employees were always very helpful at answering any questions I had, and if they didn't know the answer they would get someone who did. The store itself is always clean and always packed! I love that they have self check out as well. It makes my shopping experience that much more pleasant because you can be in and out in no time. Whatever I would be looking for, they always had in stock. They also make returns very easy... I'd either buy the wrong item or too much of something and I was always at ease knowing the return process was so easy. They know people make mistakes lol They're human too. I even had a wire rack cut in store and when I got home it was too short, either I measured wrong or I told them the wrong measurement and they still let me return it and get a new rack that was cut at the right length. I love that they allow you to bring your pets in as well. This just seems like the perfect place to shop for all your home improvement needs. The reason for 4 stars is due to the gentleman who works in the locks department. I was having all of my exterior door handles replaced and wanted to get them keyed two different ways (one way for front door, and one way for back door). I was told my someone else that if I bought the locks/handles there that I wouldn't have to pay a re keying fee. I did buy from there but ordered online because they didn't have what I wanted in stock at that location. When I brought them in he said I would be paying a rekeying fee due to them not being purchased that day. Get this.... is $5 a lock to re key and I had 4-6 locks that needed re keyed. I wasn't very happy with this but he said that was their policy. I still don't agree it should have been handled that way. I ended up taking them to Home Depot where I told them the situation and they re keyed them all for me at no charge.

Terrible. I came to get a simple 2x4 only needed 1 foot. They said they only sold larger lengths but can cut it for me. I waited 40 mins in line to get it cut watched them help the three customers in front of me. Then when it's my turn the worker says he cant cut anymore at this time on his machine and that they cant cut it by hand. After ubering here and back home Lowes not only did not help me but they cost me time and money.

I come to this Lowe's about once a week, either for personal projects or job materials for my construction company. The location is GREAT! That has to be my favorite thing about this Lowes. Just off of Keystone Ave (with a secret back entrance off of Rural Street), this place is my Go-To! I give it three stars simply because the employees can be hit-or-miss sometimes. If you catch someone of a bad day... YIKES! But generally things are okay. Lowes has a decent lumber selection and a GREAT stain selection (for wood projects). I love this place though mainly because of the convenience. The other reason I'm giving this Lowes only three stars is because they don't offer any weekly rebates like how Menards does. If they did off those rebates, HOLY COW- I'd be there all. the. time. The facility is HUGE, with lots of selections, and it's very well kept. I love their outdoor landscaping options as well. Another huge plus about this Lowes is they allow you to bring your dog into the store! Which is great considering our pup is sometimes 'high maintenance' and kept be left at home all the time!

The worst business I've ever worked with. Ever. Im so disappointed with Lowe's. Do not, I repeat do not buy appliances from there and get delivered. No matter how good the deal is. You will go through the most frustrating process of no one knowing what to do and they won't even have the product in stock. When they sold it to you and said it was. They will give you a delivery date and time and it would've never gone out for delivery and you'll never get a call. I will never, ever buy here and discontinuing my business' account and making sure I let everyone I know how utterly terrible this business is. They have been thriving through the pandemic and can't even be honest with customers. I wish I could give them a -100 stars.

There are times I pop in here for something I need quickly and I"m in the area. And, every time I do, I'm reminded why I do my best to always go somewhere else. Yes, it's big, and they have a lot of stuff. That said, this particular is more than lacking in customer service. I'll clarify, if you can find someone to help, they're typically happy to help. But I've had a pretty hard time finding someone to assist me at this particular location. Last time we went, we went to the service counter because we couldn't find what we were looking for, and waited and waited while the folks behind the counter took phone calls then disappeared (It appeared to be they were filling phone orders), and they'd occasionally look at us standing there waiting for service, then go back to what they were doing. Again, they usually have what I need, but the lack of customer service doesn't make it worth my time to go there.

Horrible customer service. I don't know what happened to this place but when a cashier has her hand on her chin and her elbow on the register, and another says "I'm glad I get self checkout because I don't need to talk to anyone," you should probably reassess your hiring practices. This used to be my go to store because I live in broad ripple, but I've hired the folks in the Michigan street store to remodel my kitchen and bathroom, because customer service still matters to the employees in that Lowes.

Wow! I can't believe I'm even taking the time to write a Lowe's review, but we just had the best customer service (possibly ever). Tom is a gem and deserves an award. We are fixing up an old house and had questions about everything you could imagine: windows, water heaters, doors, fixtures. Tom walked us everywhere and explained everything with incredible knowledge...knowledge that you would expect from a home inspector or contractor. We left with everything we needed and a free home improvement education. Do yourself a favor...go to this specific location and ask for Tom. "Clem" I think was his name, was also extremely attentive and kept checking on us. Such a helpful and productive trip. We will be back!

I'm new to the area and I am loving Indy for the friendliness factor. This Lowe's is no exception-- since we have a new house, I come here almost every other day (it seems) and everyone is so helpful and kind in answering questions for all my home projects. Employees are even so wonderful to provide GREAT recommendations when Lowe's does not have the items/services I request. Also, I should note that the selection of items is really pretty great! There was just one little thing that I was a bit surprised that they did not carry- interior auto cleaning supplies- but the employee was kind to apologize and refer me to AutoZone. Not a deal breaker at all, since Lowe's is a home improvement store, not an auto improvement store. Why four stars, you ask? Derrick in the paint section needs a serious attitude adjustment. I asked him if they carried an item, which I specifically named and he just looked at me with a total stink face and said "I don't even know what you are talking about." He continued with the 'tude as I re-named the item and rephrased that I was wondering if Lowe's carried it. Poor Derrick seems to have missed the excellent service training that the other countless employees have received. Keep it up, Lowe's! And Derrick, take a few clues from your co-workers :)

Tonight in hardware ,needing help was totally invisible to the employee who knew I was there. Walking within 4 ft of him and silently waiting he turned slightly away. Went and had my keys made by a machine. And laid down the locks I was going to purchase

This company many many mistakes and out right lied about the delivery of my major appliance delivery. An item to be delivered on Friday was not delivered until Monday! This was totally messed up by Lowes and JB Hunt without either being truthful or accepting blame.

Just really awful service. Went in to buy a push mower. Late in the season, so they were all out of the mower I wanted. Fair enough. Was told by the gentleman on the floor in the section that they wouldn't be getting anymore so I would need to call the manufacturer. I literally walked out to my car and ordered it off the Lowe's website from my phone. Why even have a store if this is the help you're giving out?

Lowe's could honestly be called Amazinglyfanastic Place of Awesomeness and Do it Yourself Excitement store. I went here with my baby brother to look for torch fuel, the citronella kind. I was blown away by the green house alone! Beautiful plants and flowers were in abundance, and I felt like I was in a beautiful garden of heaven! Everyone here was superbly helpful. The store associates know where their products are located in the store. As well as, what product would best suit your needs. Excellent for cost efficiency. My baby bro and I also got a great deal price matching at the check out! How cool is that for a hardware store I say check this place out. You may never want to leave!! Endless projects, endless possibilities...thank you Lowes!

Let it be known that I love shopping in hardware stores and buying plants until it's a part time job keeping them all alive. ...I've been growing veggies since middle school, ya'll. Thank you, 4H, FFA and farm parents. All this to say, this particular Lowe's is working it hard to raise prices and fool the city kids into paying more than they should to grow a garden and raise a houseplant. In fact, once I was fooled and purchased a Christmas tree here, a live one, for $80/$90 and then found the exact same tree at another Lowe's on the south side of Indy for half the price. Needless to say, I returned a live Christmas tree. It was both comical and sad how the prices vary between the two locations and demographics. I will give them credit for keeping this store is very clean and tidy and that the staff has always been helpful.

I strongly prefer a different home improvement store and my latest visit to this Lowe's reconfirmed my hunch to drive the extra 15 minutes for the superior customer service offered by their competition. On this particular visit, all I went in for was a drill bit and proceeded to spend 45 minutes there speaking with three different staff members and getting varied opinions on how to do my DIY bike rack. While I appreciate the opinions and support, I left feeling more confused than before and pretty frustrated. I want to commend Annie in the tool section for being extra helpful and trying very hard to offer me what I needed. All that being said, this is a good option for big-box prices in the Broad Ripple area. Their nursery is pretty fantastic and one of the bright spots of the entire chain. However, my predilection for the Clemson-colored rival continues.

They do not enforce the local mask rules. And if you say anything to the employees they don't do anything. I asked a guy to please put his mask on as I was in line behind him, he turned around and showed me his gun. No kidding.. He threatened me. Then he left and I complained to the managers. They said he had a right to have a gun and they were not going to get involved. They simply do not care. I called the next day to ask for a manager, nobody called me back. Very sad way to run a business.
I've been to this one...that's what I do go to Lowe's seasonally. Although is some distance its worth the burn in gas. Only been here twice but the folks here seem to have a clue.
Costumer service at the return counter was awful. The lady we had was rude and closed off and did not listen. Ended up not being able to return but we were able to replace our paint.

This review is for the garden section. I live in Fishers, and so usually shop the Lowes or HD near me for home improvement stuff. I do, however, pass this location often when driving home from work. The garden center a destination for me as it always has the best selection of perennials of any big box store. You can also find a great section of basic shrubs and some unique items too on occasion. There is no other Lowes like this. Someone clearly cares, and even in the care and upkeep of the plants, this is by far the best. And prices are among the best in the city!!!

This is a pretty good location, if you go during the day during regular business hours you can usually get pretty good help. It depends on how busy they are and how much is going on in the store, but the staff is pretty knowledgeable and helpful. I special ordered a high end vigio bathroom door. They price matched to Minard's and beat it by 10%! Now that's savings.

I love Lowes. I love great big box hardware stores. Lucky I'm not a rich man, I would waste most of my money in these places. Funny how I go here to get a package of incandescent light bulbs, and leave with a new vanity top and boxes of screws. I always look down the main isle in the back of the store, they always have scratch and dent stuff, and clearance items I really don't need. Oh look, a box of switch plate covers for $5.00, I really shouldn't, it's in my cart.

Being new in town...heck being new to the state of Indiana...I needed a bunch of stuff, namely a trash can since the City does not provide one. So...fortunately there is a Lowe's less than a mile from my house and I went there yesterday morning when they first opened. That is the ONLY time I'll go to one of these warehouse type of stores. I came in for the trash can...and came out with everything BUT the trash can. It completely slipped my mind as I was picking up pretty flowers for my front yard...gardening tools...a silly and unnecessary decorative flag...etc. Then I forgot to use the $10 coupon that I got when I moved in. The cashier...a sort of surly individual...said I would need to go to customer service. Uhhhh...not wanting my newly purchased posies to wilt, I decided to deal with the coupon another day. Because of said forgotten trash can, I returned this morning...again right after they opened at 6:30 a.m. and spoke to a very pleasant young man at customer service. He suggested that I shop for what I needed and then he could take the $10 off my current purchase. Task accomplished and new trash can secured. I'm sure I'll be back...I have my eyes open for patio furniture and maybe a BBQ :-) But can someone suggest a less mob-inspiring place to have some keys made??

I do remodeling and small construction projects on the side and this store is right in my neighborhood. It is not a big Lowe's and some items are not carried here, but the staff is great and most times the materials I need are in stock.

Dude. It's a Lowe's. Like every other Lowe's everywhere. They have hardware stuff and painting stuff. Seems a smidge classier than a Home Depot. Staff is helpful. That's all I've got/ all I need when it comes to this sort of store.

This store is horribly managed. Been there many times because it is close. But I am done. Last month to look at appliances - no associates to help and the manager was too "busy" overseeing the dock to assist. Now trying to special order a storm door - again, no associate staffed to help, no callbacks, nobody answers the phone. A complete cluster.

I'm usually attacked as soon as I walk in the door because people who work at Lowe's must think that since I'm a younger woman walking in a place like this, I must have no idea what I'm looking for. And I don't know, then I'm not comfortable enough to ask one of the several employees I can see when I do a 360 in spot. So no matter what, I have to walk in looking very sure of myself, head held high because I really just want to look at stuff on my own without being hassled- Because most of the time, I do know why I wandered into a Lowe's. It wasn't on accident. So, I came in for a kitchen faucet (because I'm replacing my sink, so why not replace the faucet while I'm at it?)- And of course I thought of a whole cart-full of other necessities while I was at it. As I was looking at faucets, of course the employee asked me if I needed help, which I didn't. I really was just looking. They were all placed really high, and there was a whole wall- Everything spread out, not necessarily by price or brand. So it took me awhile to really look through everything. After I told the associate that I was fine, I'm just looking at all of it, he somehow had a ton of stock to put away, adjust or whatever right next to where I was looking. He kept asking me questions about what I was looking for- Really, looking to just look at some freaking faucets in peace- so I can focus on what I want rather than you pressuring me, dude. If you are serious about receiving the appliances you purchase, then you should never order from Lowe's. We ordered a washing machine. We have been waiting for days, after being given various delivery "windows." These windows come and go without any concern for the customer's time or schedule. Having dealt with this business, I am actually a little surprised that they can remain in business. This has been an abysmal experience. As I write this on the Saturday of Memorial Day weekend, I have been given a new delivery window of 7 am to 9 pm.

I placed an online order for pickup. I was hoping for curbside pickup, but that was not an option even though it was advertised. After a day, I received an email which stated that my order was ready. Upon arrival I parked in the area marked for curbside pickup hoping that was still a possibility. I went inside to let them know I was there. Once they identified my order, someone at the store was directed to gather my order. It was apparent that my order was not ready as stated in the email. I had to wait inside the store for about 15 minutes while they gathered my items - something I wanted to avoid by ordering online. I could have gotten my own items quicker if I had shopped myself. Once my items had been gathered, there was no offer to help me load my items in my car even though they were fairly heavy items. Online ordering at this store is not as advertised and curbside pickup appears to be non-existent. I will shop elsewhere during this crisis.

I am so disappointed. We went to that spcific store because online it said they had what we needed. The great thing about lowes is that they have better overall service than Home Depot. The drive through is amazing and they are great in loading the heavy bags of mulch into the car. The return lines move quickly enough and there is no wait for cashiers.

Never go here. There are plenty of local places within 1 mile of here that are more helpful, better service, better prices and actually care about helping you. The employees at this store are rotting from the head down. - I hope you read this and it ruins your next managers meeting. Your customer service...well...whatever rhymes with 'Lowes'.

This location is extremely convenient, and I have used it to purchase paint, tools, building materials, winter insulation materials, plants, and moving boxes. The prices are typically comparable to Home Depot, and the variety of goods is much more extensive than let's say Sullivan's Hardware, which is more seasonally based.

The people at this particular Lowe's are outstanding. They are always willing to help and returns are quick and easy. Having just moved here in the last year, we spend a lot of time trying to figure out the "right thing" to fix up our older home. We've bought a lot and taken a lot back and we're always helped with smiles and helpful insights. Great job!

Lowe's usually has what I need when I am looking to improve or fix my house. Nothing seems to be overpriced like at Ace or Sullivan's and every once in a while you can find good deals on sale or clearance items. It is also very acceptable to negotiate or barter on clearance items, especially if it is a display or non-stock item. After living here for nearly four years now, most of the regular employees know me and are generally very friendly. I have purchased Lowe's brand - Kobalt tools before and they have held up. I am also a big fan of the distressed plants and mis-mixed paint section where you can find that almost perfect color for $5/gallon. Lowe's also has a 1-year guarantee on all plants including distressed. Just save all of your receipts and take the plant back if it dies.

I visited this Lowe's location daily for a bit, while settling into my new home and running back n' forth for the umpteenth, millionth item that I inevitably had forgotten. OK, now that I can write about a Lowe's in Indianapolis, I can tell you that this place is clean and has one of the better garden centers in the inner part of Indianapolis with a very good selection of shrubs and trees. This is a store in a neighborhood of established homes and mature trees, so young trees are not in high demand and there are not good conditions for young trees unless they are replacement trees. So if you're looking for trees or shrubs, this place has a lot of them. The prices seem to be better here on some things than on others. The fertilizer was very expensive, but the mulch was cheaper. The sprinkler selection was especially better and cheaper than most other Lowe's, but then again, Broad Ripple and Meridian Kessler have established lawns and many of them have sprinkler systems, so it may be lack of demand. Service here is good and prompt. They also have a pretty good selection of products made here in the USA! That is definitely one thing I have not given Lowe's props for is their sheer number of American made goods from mom and pop manufacturers. I try my best to choose those products if I have a choice.

Fast forward from my last update almost 6 months...a lot has changed in 6 months...WHAT is this white stuff on the ground?! Oh yeah, I moved from California (no snow) to Indianapolis (snow) :-) While I really do prefer to shop at the smaller, independent hardware stores, I was told that I needed to get driveway salt...and fast! Lowe's opens very early and I was able to swing right on in after my workout across the street at LA Fitness. As I got there at 7:00 a.m., there must have been about 20 employees milling about...then I realized they were having what appeared to be their daily rah-rah session :-) One very polite young man asked me if I needed any help (maybe he didn't want to attend the rah-rah session). I told him that I was new to dealing with the white stuff and asked him to suggest a product to use since I was getting conflicting information -- ice melt...or salt? He asked me some questions as to the type of surface that I was trying to clear (new or decorative cement, etc.) and explained that some products stain, and so forth. We discussed a few things and he directed me to the Prestone Driveway Heat. I looked at the huge bag with dismay and he suggested that I buy both the large bag and a smaller container and refill it as necessary. He also told me that between the 2, I should have enough for the entire winter. As I was checking out, he asked me if I needed anything else and suggested a few items. I then remembered that my daughter borrowed my ice scraper and said I needed a new one...he ran back to that section of the store and ran back with 2 options...the Cadillac of scrapers or the Kia of scrapers...since I usually park in the garage, the Kia would do :-) I still prefer the neighborhood independent hardware store, but I appreciate the convenience of the large warehouse store on occasion too.

Little did we know we'd be discovering a true gem. The lovely proprietor, Yanti, who greeted and served us, recommended the rendang - said it was their signature dish. Knowing the complexity of this dish, it's the "mark of authenticity" in Indo cuisine. We ordered it along with a noodle dish, mie goreng and were literally blown-away while the lovely Yanti sat and chatted with us. Bali restaurant has the potential to put Indonesian food on the map in American culture, like Mexican and Chinese cuisine in the 1960s & 70s, Japanese and Thai cuisine in the 1980s, and Vietnamese cuisine in the 1990's. Don't be fooled by the rather "strip-mallish" looking exterior or the relatively plain interior decor. The food and hospitality are definitely "5 star." My late father always told me that the bathroom was a good indication of a restaurant (or home's) cleanliness. I can say for certain that he would have approved of Bali Restaurant based solely on this fact. Although born in SoCal, I spent considerable time in the beautiful country of Indonesia as a young adult, including the island of Bali. I have always longed to go back. After experiencing 'Bali' in Upland, CA, it's no wonder I also long to go back...

This restaurant located in Newport Beach's Eastbluff Village Center along Upper Newport Bay has a great atmosphere. The chic rustic modern decor along with an organic wall garden in the patio has a lot of charm. We came in for Sunday brunch and it was not busy but the patio dining area was almost filled up leaving the indoor spacious. As for the food, the steak was seasoned nicely however, it was not medium rare as requested. The poached eggs were perfect. The chilaquiles had good flavor but it lacked crispy crunch as the tortilla came out soggy. This dish must have crunch to even everything out. I recommend asking for tortillas on the side. The house made sangria was absent of fruitiness and the mimosa was on the bitter side. Service was generally good. It's tucked away in a corner of a small, understated shopping center in Newport Beach by the bluffs. By design, It doesn't look like much from the outside. Upon entering, I felt like I was walking into mon pere's lakehouse. The atmosphere could be best described as changing of the seasons. A bit rustic, but polished. Think woodsy, breezy... The dining room is surrounded by a patio on two sides accessed by accordion patio doors. We had a fixed menu and everything was served family style. The first course was salad. My favorite was the Heirloom Tomato Salad with burrata, rainbow beets, purple onions, herbs honey, and a balsamic dressing. Simply amazing! I worked to get every ingredient in one bite. The tomatoes were perfect and why I've never thought to use honey and burrata simultaneously is beyond me! It was truly satisfying. I would have been happy with that as a meal. There was also a Garden Lettuce salad with Red Verjus Vinaigrette. The next course was fish and included Wild Sand Dabs served lemon-piccata style. They came with artichoke and zucchini risotto, heirloom spinach and lemon beurre blanc. I wasn't familiar with sand dabs. I had to google them. They're a flatfish. The preparation was excellent. Even with serving that many people at once the fillets had a nice crisp bite. The risotto was very good. Creamy, with a hint of herbs. The meat course was Boneless Short Ribs served Osso Buco style with roasted potatoes and mixed vegetables. This was the star of the night. The beef was so tender! The potatoes were a great compliment, but it doesn't appear they did anything with the vegetables except toss them in some oil. The service was excellent. No wine nor martini glass went unfilled the whole night. Provenance is now permanently on my go-to list for Newport Beach. I'll be back soon!

What to say about my favorite butchers, cheesemongers and all around genuinely nice folks here at Fosters? They have always been so personable and friendly; I’ve been coming here for years and love supporting them because while their price point can be high, that’s quality you’re paying for (and the spectrum of what’s available price-wise is incredible reasonable). Want to know how that duck grew up? Awesome, Pete will tell you! Want to know about the small batch, off-the-grid woman from Vermont making this amazing cheese? Clair has you covered! Feel like chatting about the origins of Lambrusco? Foster would love to tell you. Over the years they’ve become much more than staff, they’re trusted sources of info, friendly faces and tbh one of very few destinations I’m willing to risk visiting in this pandemic and it’s ALWAYS the highlight of my day/ week to walk through the doors. They care what I’m making and how it turned out and always work with me to get whatever product I need for a client or job, as well as for myself. Might there be a line outside? There may be...but that line is because they are BUSY and they have been working exceptionally hard since March to make the shop as safe as possible not only for customers, but also for staff and that means that they limit the number of people shopping at a time. Do I miss the hustle and bustle of elbowing my way to the butcher counter in The Before? I sure do, and I look forward to that again. But given the present circumstances, if you’re not down for a wait on the sidewalk on a Saturday or on Christmas Eve, or the day before thanksgiving then maybe come by when you have more time to devote to this very real treasure in Bushwick, because it’s worth it.

From about a half block away, Foster Sundry stands out against the back drop of the surrounding buildings on Knickerbocker Ave. With its full glass front and inviting lighting within, one is encouraged to venture inside to discover this wonderfully unique addition to the Bushwick neighborhood. From the decadent lattè to the generously offered cheese samplings and the beautifully presented meat display, Foster Sundry is a well-timed addition to this neighborhood and will most certainly compliment the existing businesses. As we consumers grow ever more conscious of where our food comes from and the manner in which it is prepared for our purchase and ultimate consumption, Foster's offering of a whole-animal butcher fulfills this desire. Upon my visit, the proprietor Aaron Foster was present and couldn't have been more welcoming or gracious. The same can be said for the barista, cheese monger and butchers. I look forward to watching Foster Sundry grow and become an integral part of this area of Brooklyn. Best of luck Foster!

reviews.title: A Hidden Gem
reviews.text: Tucked back in a little traveled part of town, this B and B is a real treasure. The proprietors, Donna and Jeff, have lovingly restored this home to reflect its former glory. The rooms are spacious and well appointed, with an ample amount of toiletries and convenience items provided for guests. Donna loves the kitchen, and bakes warm cookies each evening, as well as an amazing 3 course breakfast each morning. Although not within walking distance to any area attractions, there is ample parking provided. The neighborhood was quiet during our visit, and the bed was comfortable. The room we had was on the ground floor with its own entrance. Other rooms are up one or two flights of fairly steep stairs. We were able to see these rooms during our visit and all were nicely appointed. Improvements to consider: Our room was dimly lit, so a stronger reading light would have been a plus, as well as a multi-port outlet for charging electronics.

reviews.title: Wonderful stay
reviews.text: I so enjoyed a stay at this Muskogee B & B. The hospitality was beyond gracious, and the breakfast was delicious. Highly recommend! The location is in a quiet neighborhood where the homes have Muskogee history........and the Graham-Carroll is certainly full of history and beauty.

reviews.title: A must stay bed and breakfast.
reviews.text: We just spent the weekend as guests at the Graham-Carroll bed and breakfast. It was a wonderful weekend. This bed and breakfast is under new ownership and has been completely renovated and redecorated. There are 5 guest rooms. The one on the first floor is handicap accessible. It has a huge roll in shower and its own entry to the outside. There are 2 guest rooms on the second floor. We stayed in the honeymoon suite on that floor. It was our own little paradise. The bathroom had both a jetted tub and a stand alone shower. The bed was heavenly. Soft but firm at the same time. The 3rd floor also has 2 rooms. Each with their own bathroom. From the 3rd floor there is access to a rooftop deck. The weather was perfect this weekend for sitting on the deck both Saturday night and Sunday morning. Breakfast was delicious and was served in the sunny conservatory. Donna and Jeff did an amazing job of restoring this historical home and are excellent hosts. If you are in Muskogee this bed and breakfast is a must stay.

reviews.title: Making Memories
reviews.text: Jeff and Donna helped to make our anniversary unforgettable. The house is gorgeous, the grounds relaxing, and the breakfast....spectacular! My husband is a "normal eggs and bacon" kinda guy, not an adventurous foodie at all. Donna's multi-course breakfast wowed him!!! Beautifully plated, the soufflé was perfect, the "weird French toast" (hubby's words) with some sort of magical strawberry concoction was unique and delish! Thank you for a special night and morning! Looking forward to a return visit :-)

reviews.title: Beautiful Restoration with Wonderful Hosts
reviews.text: Had a wonderful time celebrating our 25th wedding anniversary. The home is breathtaking, calm, and relaxing. We stayed in a beautiful honeymoon suite that you don't want to miss. We also enjoyed a tour of this historic home which only increased this beautiful experience. It was truly an amazing step back in history. Very restful with a great breakfast.

reviews.title: Restful and stress free getaway
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of staying at the Graham-Caroll House Bed and Breakfast and found it to be a delightfully restful and stress free experience. The house has been beautifully restored with a variety of wonderfully decorated rooms to select from. The breakfast served is far above expectations and includes multiple courses to ensure the guests enjoy a relaxing dining experience. This Bed and Breakfast is by far the best I've stayed at. I am already checking my calendar to make a return visit.

reviews.title: Comfy bed, gracious hosts, outstanding breakfasts!
reviews.text: Stayed here for college football opening weekend and Cherokee National holiday festivities. We stayed in the Aspen room and were overwhelmed by the elegant beauty of this grand historic inn. I especially enjoyed the beautifully landscaped garden. Jeff and Donna were wonderful hosts and provided the most excellent 3-course breakfasts. The King's Eggs and Donna's delicious blueberry compote, banana bread french toast were absolutely delicious! We let Donna know that we were looking to watch our favorite team's opening game Saturday night and upon our return from our travels, we found and extra chair in our room to enjoy the game. I can't say enough to describe how much we appreciated our hosts' friendliness, hospitality and kindness. We would return here in a heartbeat and highly recommend this gorgeous inn.

reviews.title: Beautiful place to stay
reviews.text: We were driving through and found this gem. The food and hospitality were great, and it was so fresh and clean! My husband likes a big breakfast that keeps him going while on the road, and this met that need. I like coffee in the morning and it was waiting for me when I got up!

reviews.title: Delightful Stay!
reviews.text: This place is the perfect place for a weekend getaway, retreat, or vacation. Jeff and Donna were so hospitable and went out of their way to make our stay enjoyable and special. The three course breakfast was outstanding and was cooked to perfection. Thank you!

reviews.title: Very nice people great friendly impression really felt comfortable.
reviews.text: The room was very clean and well laid out loved the large tub to relax . The bed felt like i was on vacation. The breakfast was wonderful and brought out in several courses. Enjoyed the historical house along with nice lighting and very friendly owners.

reviews.title: Describe Better Than Perfect
reviews.text: Best Experience in 30 years….celebrating our 30th wedding anniversary at Graham-Carroll House B&B rewarded us with wonderful memories. And that made possible by owners Donna and Jeff, whose passion and love infused into this home couldn’t help but touch our hearts. Couldn’t have picked a better place to celebrate. Donna guided is on a tour through the house upon arrival as its charm and hospitality unveiled from room to room. Thoughtful, warm and inviting, every step through the house brought a special moment into view. From the peacock themed décor to Donna’s special touches, every room we explored was so inviting. We could imagine couples sharing vows in the special arch, others experiencing the elegant 3 course breakfast we enjoyed, quiet time reading in the living room, playing the piano.And the walk-in bath with overhead and wall shower heads will spoil you. Donna baked and served warm cookies our first night ( to die for) The Garden room had a very comfortable bed and large bathroom, A ramp and private entrance, large doors and ramp into the shower stall may make this acceptable for someone with mobility issues. Security cameras and very good lighting outside are reassuring for travelers. 5 years of love in restoring this house to its glory and the passion of their care for their guests was evident as we spent time engaging with them. The house was only half the experience. Time with Donna and Jeff was a treasure to our time spent there. Looking for a special place to stay on a 3 day road trip, this was the highlight. Go early enough to enjoy the ambiance and some time with the owners and then more time in the morning. This world is always in such a rush, this is the perfect place to slow down the pace and enjoy life. How do you describe better than perfect?

reviews.title: 5 Star Royal Serenity
reviews.text: Wonderful B&B! My room was perfect, the breakfast was exceptional, the hosts are warm and welcoming. They were also very knowledgeable of the home and the area and offered many wonderful suggestions on activities. I felt like royalty being served my 3 course breakfast, which I enjoyed overlooking the beautiful garden. I also relaxed by sitting on the deck during the evening, very peaceful and right outside my door. My favorite B&B ever!

reviews.title: Wonderful experience and beautiful B&B!!!!!!
reviews.text: Wonderful romantic get away at the Graham-Carroll House B&B. The house has been totally remodeled and is spectacular. Beautiful décor, peaceful atmosphere, manicured gardens. Our room was spacious, beautifully decorated with a HUGE shower with multiple spray heads. Breakfast was the best I've ever had at a B&B. The owners were extremely nice and helpful. We'll definitely be going back.

reviews.title: A great place to stay in Muskogee
reviews.text: The Graham-Caroll House Bed and Breakfast in Muskogee just recently reopened after new owners spent almost two years refurbishing and redecorating the historic property. All previous reviews of this property here on TripAdvisor were for previous owners and not the current state of the property. My wife and I recently had the pleasure of being one of the initial guests of the home after its reopening and we were truly impressed by all facets of the property and the great hospitality and attention to detail by the current owners. The historic home is lovely and quiet and there is a room for almost anyone in the home. The whole home is well furnished and decorated and full of many unique chandeliers. Breakfast and deserts were top notch and the owners are friendly and accommodating. We were able to stay I the "Honeymoon Suite" which was open at the time and it was top quality and well decorated. The owners gave us a great tour of the home during our stay and were accommodating to all of our needs. If you are in Muskogee and want to stay somewhere to be pampered with top quality accommodations, you can't go wrong here. We plan to return very soon.

reviews.title: This is the place to stay in Muskogee
reviews.text: My daughter and I had a sweet Mother-Daughter weekend here. Donna welcomed us on a chilly autumn evening with hot cocoa and cookies. The Garden Room was cozy, warm, and as beautiful as the rest of the home. The breakfast was A-mazing! Jeff and Donna were so flexible and accommodating with our needs and were constantly looking out for our comfort. The time with my daughter was precious, and I cannot thank them enough for making that possible. I can't wait to return with my husband sometime!

reviews.title: WONDERFUL
reviews.text: If you are looking for r&r look no more. Breakfast for a king, you will not leave hungry. We had french toast with fresh peaches, yummmmm. The garden suite had its own entrance which made coming and going a cinch. And the oversized rain shower, heavenly. The owers are very accommodating and super nice. If ever in the area again we will be back.

reviews.title: Best Indian holiday
reviews.text: I was booked here through someone who promised me a scenic location and a luxurious stay and it indeed was true but the best part about this property was the staff and the owners who made it feel like I was at home. They paid attention to every detail to ensure a comfortable stay. My requests if any were made sure to be accommodated without delay. My 5 year old has had an amazing time and wants to go back again.the location is spectacular, the service was excellent and d people extraordinary..I'm going back for sure:)

reviews.title: If paradise was on Earth
reviews.text: This property is in an apple orchard, has walnut, cheery trees. It is just a kilometer from solang Valley where you can indulge in adventure sports. I found it far more conveniently located for trips to Rohtang, leh , spiti . I avoided the mad traffic jams. The food is great The service was good and so we're the rooms.

reviews.title: Perfect place to hibernate
reviews.text: I am a solo traveller abd just by chance tumbled across this hidden gem.. My God.. The views will leave you gasping ...I was lost for words when I entered this heavenly place.. Apple orchards, snow capped peaks and some wild horses in a distance.. I was hooked... This is the second place of One Hotels that I stayed in after Rishikes and I have become an ardent fan of this chain.. Sumptuous food, extrmely polite staff and clean rooms ( especially washrooms) , they know the need of the travellers.. Just go there for the sheer beauty of nature and you will not regret.. Cheers!!!

reviews.title: Just Fantastic
reviews.text: Just awesome is how I will describe this hotel. Located away from the crowd of the mall road this is an upscale property. Luckily when we visited the entire property was filled with fresh snow and that too almost 4 feet..it was so gorgeous that we extended our stay from 1 to three days. The property has almost 400 Apple trees and I am sure September would be a lovely sight of Apple laden trees. Words cannot describe the beauty of this hotel. You have to be there to experience the beauty of this place. Good polite staff, great food and its an awesome place to unwind if you like snow and the cold weather

reviews.title: Beautiful scenery.
reviews.text: Stayed there in Feb. Amazing views ,Great location and good food! Highly recommended for people in search for Serene and peaceful getaway in lap of beautiful nature. The place gets more beautiful in Winters and snowfall adds to the charm. The manager and staff took lot of care .

reviews.title: Paradise on earth !
reviews.text: This hotel is situated in the solang valley surrounding by the mountain pick's river n apple orchard.All staff members are very cooperative, always ready to help each and every single guest.Another assets of the hotel is General manger Mr.Das who is personally interacted to me and my five years old son Mehul to know my needs for my cozy stay . Food was delicious, I can say it's out of the world. My special thanks to Chef Pradeep n house keeping boy Tamal. Room was very clean n every rooms have a special mountain view.simply I felt in love with this hotel and the surrounding nature.

reviews.title: Wonderful....
reviews.text: Great location, amazing view, tasty food, nice staff, 360' view of snow covered mountains and surrounded by lush green apple, cherry and walnut trees. Suggest to try luxury Swiss tents to stay. Great experience. Next visit with my friends.

reviews.title: A pure bliss
reviews.text: Surrounded by heavenly snow clad Himalayas this place gives you the best of the views that Solang / Manali has to offer. They have luxury tents as well as proper hotel rooms with a balcony each and amazing views. Built amongst an apple orchard this is the place to be, we are glad we chose this hotel although a pretty newly built property it is very well managed and the staff is very courteous, specially Mr. Virender who made our stay even more memorable with excellent food and prompt service. Will definitely visit again

reviews.title: On road less travelled
reviews.text: An excellent cottage property tucked in apple orchard, facing white mountains on two sides. Its a piece of heaven providing much needed solace and serenity. We were awewd by the views from balcony, priceless moments in the dining area with breath taking views and above all getting cozy at the bonfire. Will certainly visit again and highly recommend all to experience true hospitality in the virgin wilderness. 5 stars for service, food, quality of stay and monumental memories of this pictursce location. Will try the swiss tents on my next visit.

reviews.title: Walking in the Himalayas
reviews.text: It was an amazing experience living right between the mountains. Waking up to the sun rising from behind the mountains is one of my best experiences, walking distance from Solang valley it gave us access to all the adventure activities the heart desired from paragliding to zip lining. The staff was helpful and polite and the food top class. Would highly recommend it.

reviews.title: Amazing location, very nice staff
reviews.text: We stayed at Sky One in March 2018 and found it in a perfect blend to spend an unwinding holiday in Manali. Located right in the Solang valley near the hub of various activities like paragliding, atv rides, skiing etc. Nice rooms, good food, cooperative staff and to top it all the option to stay in luxury tents.

reviews.title: Heavenly holiday
reviews.text: Spent a week at this amazing property.. don't have words to describe..Apple orchards, Himalayan views and delicious food...on top of it what a staff..everything was perfect.. thanks a lot One Hotels for an amazing experience..For sure I will be back again in January for skiing and snow boarding..

reviews.title: Good Service - Could be better; Pet Friendly
reviews.text: We stayed with them for 2 nights with our 2 dogs. The Tent was comfortable. Food is good. Plenty of open garden space for the pets to roam around. There were minor irritants though - like no electricity for 5-6 hours on our first night. I understand it was not their fault, but alternate arrangements should have been ready. One other irritant was that the staff lit up a bonfire in the garden area just outside our tent - We thought it was for the guests (us). But the entire staff (about 4-5 men) sat around the bonfire and enjoyed. Me and my wife just stayed inside the tent because there was no space for the guests to sit around the bonfire.

reviews.title: Wilderness Redifined
reviews.text: True experience of nature's wilderness right in the midst of Solang Valley. Definitely not in Manali and that what makes it special. Away from the city life and close to beauty of nature is the peculiarity of this property. Icing on the cake is the marvellous hospitality, spellbinding service and exotic food. A complete value for money for all categories of travellers. Will be surely visiting it again. Thanks

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: It was a good break and things fell into perfect rhythm when stay was comfortable and food delectable enough to keep your exploring spirit awake. The hotel is located scenic,nature is always calling out waiting to be explored.

reviews.title: Awesome Location and Great Hospitality
reviews.text: Had a Royal Feeling when welcomed on reaching the Resort. Its a beautiful Location and easily approachable. Resort surrounded by Apple Orchid, pluck and eat hihihih. Enjoyed Paragliding and Sking located just 2 Kms from the Resort. Rooms has got the wooden charm from Inside and 360 Degree view from the Resort, WOW. It was snow all around and the Resort had good arrangements to keep us warm. Chef had its taste, delicious breakfast and Trout Preparation was smashinggg. Resort was having Camping facilities as well,,,,making the stay more adventures as what Manali is meant for. Overall i will be bouncing back again for the Smashing 'Trout'.

reviews.title: Wonderful Hospitality
reviews.text: Excellent service, very good cooperation and local guidance from staff, resorts situated on the way to solang vally in with nice mountain view and apple tries, choosing this resort's is good and best option

reviews.title: Hidden Jewel in Manali
reviews.text: I stayed in this newly opened property over the New Year. What an amazing experience!!! The views to the snow clad mountain are superb and reminded me of my visit to Switzerland. Amazing rooms with top of the line facilities... I would love to experience this superb property again.. Kudos to the Manager for making our stay absolutely wonderful.

reviews.title: Awsome hotel in the of heart mountain !
reviews.text: The location where sky one ski Resort is located is their a big advantage. This resort is located in apple orchard sourrended by the mountain and river as mentioned in their website. Rooms are very cleaned with Very specious washrooms attached with rooms. staff members are customer friendly . Receptionist Mr. Virender , GM Mr. Hemant is always at service to make my memorable honeymoon . They offered cake! Food was delicious. All staffs members are alyays smling and very traind to caters in gentile manners. Me and my wife love to back soon.

reviews.title: Fabulous location! Courteou, amazing staff!
reviews.text: We are a family of four from Australia and thoroughly enjoyed this very homely resort. Its located only ~200 metres away from the Solang Valley cable car and snow sports center. We have had a perfect ski and snow sports holiday without having to battle the traffic to and from the Manali town center. Thanks to the amazing staff, who despite having to battle the very low temperatures, went out of their way to make our stay a very comfortable one! The food prepared by the chef was very delicious! Thank you Sky one Solang valley, we will definitely be back!

reviews.title: Average Hotel for a shorter stay.
reviews.text: This Hotel is on the main road of Nainital. You have to walk through few meter stairs to reach at the Hotel. Walk-able distance from Parking, Naina Temple as well lake. Not much sophisticated compared to Price, but considering the location its good for a short stay. Rooms are having small balcony. Geyser in rooms. Average cleaning will be visible.

reviews.title: Nice location
reviews.text: Hotel is really good but a little pricy.since I have my old parents with me and it was very late so I decided to stay here. The manager was really nice and polite and he was asking if we need any help. The plus point is , they have food . We need to order and it comes fresh in your room. The server we got was really nice .

reviews.title: good "budget" option in Nainital
reviews.text: The himtrek hotel – Nainital – India On the centre of the mall in Nainital you will find hotel himtrek. Writen about in the lonely planet 2009. One of the rare “budget” hotels in Nainital. For as far as you can speak about budget hotel or guesthouses in Nainital. A triple room in high season is more then 2000 rs. In low season we bring that down to 1000 rs incl tax. Still more then double or even triple the price we paid elsewhere in India. But it must be said that hotel himtrek offer a good stay for that money in this area. Take the rooms on the second floor with a view on the lake. They are the best value. (Avoid the rooms in the back.) There is a nice little terrace in front of these rooms with a nice view over the lake. Clean and spacious rooms. Bedsheets and pillows are not that clean. There is no airco in the room but al rooms have a fan. Tv in the rooms.The hotel is a little bit away from the mainstreet so you just have not to much sound from the street. We had a good sleep for 9 nights in this hotel. Clean, spacious bathroom with hot water from 07:00 am to 11:00 am. We did not take any food from the hotel. Just because there are more then enough options in town. Strange rule is that you can not wash any clothes in your room. But when we get our clothes back from there laundry it was full of stains and mud. An expensive shirt was ruined. So I did my laundry myself next time.

reviews.title: Good stay, safe for women travellers
reviews.text: I and my 4 other freinds stayed for 4 nights and 5 days at Hotel Himtrek, which is loacted right at the mall road near to the boat house club and main shopping area of Nainital. The rooms are spacious and beautiful and the staff is very hospitable. We did not have any sort of problem in terms of security or safety(being an all girl traveller group). The view from second floor is good. We ordered dinner at night and experience was good. There is no air conditioner but the rooms have fans.I would recommend Hotel Himtrek to female travellers as the place offers good safety and security with a pleasant and peaceful stay.

reviews.title: Good Budget hotel with nice service
reviews.text: I stayed here for two days on 9th and 13th April, 2016. The location of the hotel is next to the Mall road. It is a few minutes walk to the Naina devi temple and the Tibetian Market from the hotel. The rooms are airy and spacious and the staff is very hospitable. The hotel manager Mr. Ganesh is a very nice person. He arranged all our car rentals and tour plans during our stay here. The lake view from second floor is good specially from the room no. 221 where we stayed.We took breakfast and dinner here and it was tasty.

reviews.title: Very good
reviews.text: I loved the way they have decorated the hotel. It is very neat and clean. The rooms are well furnished and its a good hotel for family and couples. Women safety is there in the hotel.The staff is very helful and kind and service is very good. Food is also very good and the people who will choose to stay here i would reccomend this hotel for everybody.

reviews.title: Nice Hotel at an excellent location
reviews.text: The Hotel is ideally located on The Mall and immediately opposite to the Lake. The rooms are clean and cool. The beds are comfortable. Hot and cold water is available in the Bathrooms. The staff is courteous and helpful. However, the room service can be improved a little bit. Overall a good hotel to stay at.

reviews.title: A sneak out for overnight
reviews.text: Visited this place for a night sneak out. Checked out hotel's on trip advisor but showed all full. I reached there and roads were jam packed turned around but on my way back met a hotel manager of another hotel and he booked it over a phone a family room for 6500/ Rs, too high for a type of hotel. Clean hotel right on mall road, walkable distance from parking but linen and blankets offered were not hygiene. Staff was good and helpful.

reviews.title: Poor service
reviews.text: Stayed in the hotel for 3 nights. At first glance, the rooms looked OK. By second day the rooms started to smell musty. Probably that was why the windows were open when we first saw the rooms. Had two 3 bedded rooms but each room had only two towels. On requesting another, we were informed that only two are provided per room irrespective of number of beds/number of occupants and we would have to manage. We had to call room service thrice over an hour to get drinking water. There was no water in bath one day. Worst part:on our last night at hotel, there was continuous loud siren like noise. On inquiry staff informed that it was from the adjacent hotel and they could not do anything, not even contacting the other hotel about the noise. The staff was indifferent and unprofessional.

reviews.title: Big room with nice service hotel
reviews.text: This hotel location is very best. This is just next to mall road. The room size was very big. Room were neat and clean. There was very nice view of mountain from the room. The front office staff was very much supportive. They can arrange local taxi for sigh seeing at very reasonable price. There are lots of shopping places around this hotel. This place is safe with families. There were many families that were stayed in this hotel.
