The rate was good, the room was pleasant and the manager was very friendly and gave us great tips. We recommend this motel.

reviews.title: quiet, clean
reviews.text: this motel is a bit removed from central ellsworth and is a bit further from acadia, but the location is quiet and the cottages are cute and clean. the cottages are decorated with a few knick knacks which gives them a bit of a bed and breakfast feel. it's also really hard to find reasonably priced hotels in the area around acadia, especially during peak summer season, so this place was a good find. not sure how well the wifi works because I didn't use it. friendly staff, no issues. would stay again.

reviews.title: Different Experience
reviews.text: This was very different than conventional hotel stays. One bed cottage, very clean, quaint. No check in desk,you are given your cottage number and the key is in the cottage. We had the last cottage that was extremely close to the road but surprisingly it was very quiet. Had microwave and refrigerator. Great hassle free stay. Wifi was spotty but was an inexpensive stay to visit Bar Harbor.

reviews.title: There was a Pink one and a Purple one and an Orange one
reviews.text: We booked this room cause we thought Acadia area would be booked this time of year. It really was a row of different color cottages. We had the Orange one. They really tried to make you comfortable. Coffee pot , microwave, refrigerator and all these little kind of tricky tacky but unique decorations. It not really my cup of tea but a unique experience.

reviews.title: Nice place, need some improvments
reviews.text: We stayed 3 nights. Nice place the owner was very helpful in way to do were to eat. He came right away to solve problem with toilet and was very friendly. Comfort bed not far from town .good price per night. The first cabin from the road (no. 6, the pink one), could be very cold even if you open up the heat. We couldn't find a way to heat the bathroom. No Wi-Fi connection at cabin (it takes a couple of hundreds to add some repeaters to the place. That can improve visitors stay and reviews).

reviews.title: Cute, Comfortable & Cozy
reviews.text: It’s not the Ritz, but clean, comfortable and provides a nice gateway to Acadia and the area. Rooms hold the bed and a chair, not much else. Good selection of cable on the TV. Internet was spotty- mostly off. We stayed in yellow with two rooms. The AC in the front room didn’t cool the back room well - an open window did just fine. Great value and was comfortable for us.

reviews.title: Roadside Relaxation
reviews.text: From the period preceding World War II you capture the wonderful image of roadside motels. Either drive by for a visual glimpse of the past or an enjoyable stay in a rather tight setting. To some of you it will bring back surprising memories!

reviews.title: A delightful surprise!
reviews.text: This place is so cute, and also clean and well appointed. I had everything I needed in my cute little cottage. I would go back on another trip to Maine -- the management was friendly and accommodating.

reviews.title: Our Acadia Vac
reviews.text: On the Fourth of July we arrived at the Sunset Motel,Ellsworth,Me. For a great three night stay with Roland and Dee,our single cottage was a wonderful place for our stay. Roland was very helpful and kind.We couldn't have asked for more. And it being pet friendly made it even better, having our Bella with us really made our Vac- ation complete,we wouldn't think of traveling without her.

reviews.title: Grandma's guest room
reviews.text: This cute clean cabin, is an out of the way spot for a good rest. I thought I was saving money by staying here and I did but if I had gone closer to Bar Harbor our bill would have been even cheaper. The decor is very dated and the TV can not be seen from the bed. The bed is in the hard side and the pillows are thin. There is plenty of soap but no shampoo or conditioner and the water never got hot. I think it was cute but dated.

reviews.title: Owner Knows His Stuff
reviews.text: We were greeted with, "Saved the big cottage for you,"... and yes, he did. We really enjoyed our one night stay here in the two bedroom white cottage way off the main highway. Huge bathroom,nice linens, good beds, decent AC and lots of good info from the owner himself.( I bet he has some stories to tell!) We would surely go back again.

reviews.title: Not bad for the price
reviews.text: This place is right on the main road and so somewhat noisy. It is cheap though and the bed was reasonable. Bathroom again reasonable and it was quite nice having your own Private chalet. The soap selection was somewhat amusing with half bottles of other peoples shampoo et cetera. The coffee was nice but the milk had separated and was therefore disgusting. Have a look behind the chalets in the undergrowth for fireflies at night – really amazing!

reviews.title: Vacations
reviews.text: The view offered is really nice but property is not maintained professionally. You need to have your own transport. Prices of the rooms is really exorbitant comparing with other nearby resorts. Rooms offer bare minimum facilities.

reviews.title: excellent find
reviews.text: Having not expected much from this simple and cheap old tea plantation house and bugalows, it turned out to be excellent. Beautiful setting with views of 5.5km peaks and down to the plantation. Very peaceful place and lovely people - the food just appeared when you sat down and was always very good. All the staff were very helpful and the manager Shidu was a great host and a wealth of information. We caught sight of some pretty large animal in the garden one night - the place was alive with wildlife - Shidu informed me that it was probably the leopard but not to worry because it ignores humans!!! I would recommend this place to anyone who fancies something different and memorable. Only down side was the mobile phone masts obscuring some of the amazing view. Nigel Feetham Nottingham UK

reviews.title: most 3rd class estate, and most 3rd class management.
reviews.text: dont ever stay, management is bad. cant even eat food of our choice even after paying rs 600.00 per person. u hv to eat what your other guest room has ordered. very very bad. not at all worth their charge.

reviews.title: Outcast quite place
reviews.text: the cottages are built separate from the main hotel building surrounded by lush green trees. You would love it if you like the lonely peace and quite. Frankly we felt kind of stranded as we were the only ones in the whole hotel ground with the staff. Vast open spaces, amazing breath taking views and the best chicken kadai we've ever eaten as the chef cooks just for you. A little problem of insects bcoz of the forest surrounding. the hotel is hard to find as its located a little off the road. Room was average, with ok ok interiors though.

reviews.title: Hotel with great views
reviews.text: Hotel is located in a very peaceful place with very beautiful views surrounded by greenry all around. Hotel is in quaint style which gives you feeling like palace . Room service facility is also good and rooms are spacious with all the facilities. Food is also delicious.

reviews.title: Wow!!!
reviews.text: Stupendous Views + Friendly Owner + Courteous Staff= White Haven Estate It is in an isolated part of the city, making it more beautiful and serene. The surroundings are calm and silent. TIP: Ask the owner for a visit to the nearby Kangra Tea Estate.

reviews.title: No other place like White Haven Palace Estate
reviews.text: Location is a bit hard to find but once you reach, you sure will not be disappointed. This is not like any other ordinary or luxury hotels. This Estate seems like some King's palace with vantage views of the whole city! The Breakfast and the food here is superb. Staff is very helpful and will guide you. I am craving to go here once again!

reviews.title: Great spot, but terrible service for the price
reviews.text: I stayed at White Haven two years ago and this week. It's a wonderful spot, amazing views and a lovely house and gardens. Views are superb. However we did feel a bit like we were in the way of the staff who seem to be running the place for their convenience. Even trying to get all the residents to have exactly the same foods and being very frugal about starting a real fire on cold nights (I asked if there was a fire ration because they kept saying "only one hour of fire"). Unfortunately the enthusiastic manager Mr Sidhu seems to have lost heart and is hardly every there; because he was a great font of information and lovely hand drawn maps. The place could be brilliant with a few small tweaks; a bit more cleaning, much better food (even some tea from its own tea estate would be cute) and staff who don't seem like you are getting in the way. But staying all that nothing can fault the quiet gardens and cute views.

reviews.title: Excellent property, great food..
reviews.text: We stayed at white haven for 4 days last year and it was a wonderful experience for us...the food was as tasty as home made good and the staff was extremely cordial and helpful....but the best part of this estate was the breath taking view of the dhauladhar range.....its just mesmerzing....u will want to stay there for days... So if u are looking for a holiday in a quiet place away from the town hustle bustle then this is the perfect place...even the approach to this estate is thru a thick forest....although its little too deep so finding it at night is a bit difficult...but overall it was a very pleasant stay....would love to go back again...

reviews.title: Good and silent place
reviews.text: Went here in December and this was one of the best experience I had while staying in a hotel. Nice and beautiful surroundings around the property. Nice and helpful staff. Food was nice and scrumptious.

reviews.title: Do Not Visit This Property
reviews.text: Recently (June 2 to 5th) we had been in Dharamshala and booked this hotel through their delhi office for three days with 50% advance payment. On reaching Dharamshala ( Temperature of around 34 -35 that day) we found that the hotel does not have air conditioner or fan. Pedastal Fan, they provide on request .We thought not checking into this hotel and asked for the refund. The Manager told us he shall retain nearly 50% of the booking amount, to which we thought that it was a better idea of staying back for one day and take the balance refunded the next day. Our idea of staying back did not prove good, food was pathetic, Service was horrendous, no power, no fan (They do not put on the generator when there is no power) , uncourteous manager and when checking out we asked for settlement and refund of the balance amount, we were ill treated and never given a refund. We go for holidays atleast 2-3 times an year.This was my most unsatisfactory stay in any hotel till today.

reviews.title: More a guest house than a hotel
reviews.text: White Haven Estate is more like a guest house than a hotel. With only 8 rooms and a small staff, it is a curious little place. It is well out of town, so you can't just wander into town for a look around. After checking in around mid afternoon, we had a knock at the door to ask what we wanted for dinner, because they had to go to the markets to buy the ingredients. In late February, it was also cold. The room had very little in the way of heating, and no electric blankets on the single beds. Bay windows opened out on to a fantastic view of the Himalayas which on the last day with fresh snow on the peaks, made all the other limitations worth it!

reviews.title: Great location, bathrooms need upgrading
reviews.text: We stayed at this location as part of a wonderful 17 day private tour organised by Mr V P Singh of the Indian based company 'Legends and Palaces '. The location is delightful. The bedrooms are large with wonderful views but the bedding could do with some upgrading. The same could be said of the bathrooms. The restaurant meals were satisfactory. The log fires in the evening were a real treat.

reviews.title: great place for a quiet getaway
reviews.text: White Haven Estate is located away from the hustle and bustle of the main Dharamshala or Mc Leodganj crowd. Its nesteled in a tea estate and has a wonderful view of snow clad mountains from most of the rooms. It is not a luxury resort, so dont expect much, but it is clean and comfortable for a good stay. Also, the the food is great as it is like home made cooked in the estate kitchen and if you are the only guests, you can decide your own menu!! Good staff and pretty satisfactory service. A walk around the tea estate is a must as it gives an excellent view and feeling of walking among all greenery. The rooms are quite spacious and the ones in the main building, on the ground floor also gives you a verandah to sit out and enjoy the day! Overall an excellent quiet getaway...perfect for family and children !

reviews.title: just perfect
reviews.text: One of the best hotel in the area which is very peaceful and provides a quality stay. A quaint style hotel totally gives you a royal feeling. Rooms are spacious and enough cozy even in the chilly weather. A bit far from the main city area, so it can cost you some bucks to roam around and sight seeings.

reviews.title: Very Peaceful Hotel with Stunning Views
reviews.text: We spent an unscheduled night at the hotel having left the Chonor House due to the dreadful night's sleep we had had due to noise. Sidhu the manager is a delight, a true gentleman and could not be more helpful. This hotel could be absolutely amazing, as the location and views are stunning, and it is incredibly peaceful, but it does need a good clean, and staff who can run it in Sidhu's absence. My husband was unfortunately not at all well that day, so literally spent all the time there in bed, and Sidhu did everything he could to make sure we were ok, but the problems start when he goes home. The rest of the staff struggle to understand English so I had major problems in making myself understood and ended up speaking to Sidhu at home on several occassions.

reviews.title: Beautiful location bad experience
reviews.text: A group of us (10 people) stayed at this place and were delighted with the look and feel of this house. Unfortunately we discovered that $1000 of cash was missing from one of our suitcases and there were several questionable points of entry that would have allowed this to occur. When we discussed this matter with the manager and told him that we will pay the rest of our deposit once this matter is resolved he physically threatened us along with verbally abusing us. While this was going on a family member called the hotel 3 times to find out our whereabouts and the staff told them that they have not seen us...very scary experience. Criminal charges have been filed and the manager is under investigation from the Police and tourisim boards. A beautiful location and pristine setting was spoiled by our experience at this hotel...buyer beware.

reviews.title: Excellent Resort
reviews.text: I have stayed at White Haven few times in last few years, it is the best place in Dharamshala, beautiful view, home away from home and very friendly staff...... what more could u ever ask for... they have very large rooms and beautiful lawn from which u can have the best view of the mountains....... i recommend to everyone going to Dharamshala to stay here only...

reviews.title: Brush with Royalty
reviews.text: Great place to rejuvenate Excellent homely food. Ideally located in the midst of a tea estate on a hilltop. Mr Sidhu the estate manager was a great host, ensuring the best for us on a lazy, laid back holiday.

reviews.title: Beautiful surroundings but very badly maintained
reviews.text: Large Spacious Rooms with good lighting but bathrooms are small without even basic facilities - no jets /sprinklers in WC. Bathroom doors dont close, had lot of insects, Hot water is available but it took time(half a day) for hotel staff to figure out how to start hot water. Worst -the quilts had lices. Menu did not have too many options. Food quality below average.The staff insisted on 5-7 hr notice to provide food(unless you have opted for expensive Rs400 per person per meal "food included" option). Staff was helpful but untrained. The property library was not easily accessible. Lighting on common areas was never there - You have to push the staff to keep the lights on in library or dining area or lobby or verandah. it felt like staying in a good nice tent because there is tea garden and mountains around but because there is no light or activity in the rest of the property. You can walk down the tea garden but you have noplace to sit or even stand to enjoy the tea estate. The tea factory by owners is available for a visit where you can buy some expensive export quality tea - there is nothing on the house -Tea factory staff was polite enough to guide you through the factory but showed no courtesy to offer a cup of tea or a glass of water . No discounts on tea even for guests in white haven.

reviews.title: Amazing stay with heavenly beds and fluffy pillows
reviews.text: Stayed on two separate occasions in this lovely hotel and was really impressed with the property and its welcoming staff especially the front desk team. The price is affordable considering its top notch location (in between Ayala Centrio and SM Downtown), having heavenly beds with comfortable bedding and fluffy pillows complete with other amenities. The fried chicken and pancakes being offered for breakfast are yummy too. PS: Huge THANK YOU for the complimentary upgrade - highly appreciated:) Kudos 1A Express team and kitakits soon!

reviews.title: Just Good
reviews.text: Was impressed the first time my husband and I checked-in here last 2016. This year’s travel, we decided to stay here again for the night before we head back to Surigao the following day. I commend the staff for being great and nice. They were very approachable and helpful but my disappointment came when my kid, a 4 year old (who likes to walk in barefoot when he’s inside a bedroom) went up to the bed and to our surprise, his feet were all covered in black. SHAME 😓 So I took off my slippers and felt the floor myself and found out that it wasn’t even mopped or swept. tsk. I think RS (Room Supervisors) should double check the room before releasing it to FO’s and guests. I would still love to check in here again soon because aside from their location is just walking distance from malls, their room are all nice, spacious and beds are big and I did also mention that the staffs are super duper great. I just hope that next time, we won’t be dealing the same problem again. To the management, please please please solve this issue.

reviews.title: Had an excellent stay!
reviews.text: Booked 2 nights with the family for the weekend and we loved it! The breakfast was awesome, the hotel staff very hospitable, the housekeeping are outstanding. The room itself is very comfortable - specially the pillows! I love the fact that there's a 24/7 laundry and a convenience store at the ground floor for stuff I forgot to pack. lol Ran out of diapers in the middle of the night and they had it. Malls are just 2-3mins walk away. There's a newly opened SPA in the second floor. They also got a salon! Got nothing but good review for this hotel. I highly recommend this to my business friends especially coming from outside the Philippines.

reviews.title: Accessible Comfort within the City of Golden Friendship
reviews.text: My family stayed here for two nights. All I can say is that if you are looking for a place to stay and sleep after a busy day roaming around Cagayan de Oro City, I suggest you book a room in this place. Aside from the fact that it's located within the city wherein the major malls and food establishments are just a stone throw away from the hotel, the beds are luxuriously awesome! You can comfortably sleep with their awesome beds and pillows. We booked the Family Room Deluxe. It was spacious, comfortable, and clean. Not to mention, they have a fast internet connection. If you are here for business, you won't get disappointed. You can work all day and rest comfortably all night without the worries of a backache in the morning. They have warm and friendly hotel staff. A convenience store and a laundry shop are located at the ground floor. Both are open 24/7.

reviews.title: Perfect for Everyone
reviews.text: First of all, I love just how understated the place is. The interior just shows what kind of a hotel 1A Express is: simple, straightforward, convenient. The colorful artwork across the halls provide contrast and color to their minimalist interiors. Also, the staff are very courteous and knowledgeable; they let you feel that you are welcome. The rooms are spacious, well-organized, and well-designed. AC works perfectly. The bed feels like heaven and their WIFI is decently fast. What's good about this hotel is the location. It's just a touching distance from a local mall. If you're a Catholic then a church is just across. Plenty of mode of transportation pass by (since it's situated along a highway) but the guard would help you hail a cab if you need one. I recommend this place highly.

reviews.title: Perfect Staycation For Honeymooners
reviews.text: One thing that's vital in a hotel isn't just its interior & cleanliness but the attitude of the staff. Expect that in One Avenue, they'll make you feel number one. Didn't regret to have our staycation as a newly wed couple in this hotel! Convenient location & parking. Walking distance to malls! Parking isn't a problem. An express hotel but not a budget hotel. You get what you pay for from the room amenities down to the luxurious details & exceptional customer service from the staff! Breakfast is served at One Avenue restaurant located at the top floor. Laundry service is 24/7!! What a blessing!! Love that their wifi pw is personalized, internet is fast too! Got our new fave hotel right here. Will surely go back whenever in town!

reviews.title: Home away from home
reviews.text: As ALWAYS, 1A Hotel will always be my first choice of Hotel whenever I am in CDO. With its comfort, it seems like you are just at home. I've always love to say here. I was surprised because the food now is in buffet already. The last time I have visited kasi eh plated pa and it goes to show lang that the hotel is really good at madaming mga tao ang preferred mag stay dito. I hope the hotel will be able to maintain everything they have.

reviews.title: 1A Express Hotel
reviews.text: I had a nice stay at 1A Express Hotel. The rooms are great, AC okay, and staff are friendly. Breakfast was also good. The bidet though was a bit “aggressive”. I hope they would change it. Overall, I enjoyed my experience. 💚 #LetsDoThis

reviews.title: Awesome Overall Experience and Best Place to Stay at 1A Express Hotel!
reviews.text: Recently, my kids and I stayed at this hotel and it was an awesome experience! I love the minimalist and modern style of the room. The earth colors are cool to my eyes. I love the bed and pillows, it's so soft and comfortable. They also have a hot shower that can relax you from the tiring day you had. Another thing that I really, really love about the room we stayed in (we got the superior deluxe room) is the work desk and the chair. It is perfect for business people or travelers that need to work during their travel. The internet connection is astoundingly fast! Plus, a convenience store is on the ground floor of the hotel. If you need your clothes to be washed, a laundry shop is available and it's affordable compared to other shops. Centrio Ayala Mall, Gaisano Mall and SM Premier CDO (soon to open) are just a few minutes walk. There's a Korean restaurant beside the hotel, a Catholic church nearby and food establishments too. The hotel staffs are friendly, polite and responded immediately to the things that you need. I'm really satisfied with their customer service. My kids really enjoyed their stay at the hotel for 2 nights. They don't want to leave the room and my youngest daughter even wants to stay there for a year (lol!). When you need a place situated at the heart of the city, 1A Express Hotel is the place to stay.

reviews.title: Comfortable stay...
reviews.text: Our room was quite it has good sound proofing. Clean and neat hotel. Breakfast food was alright. Staffs were friendly and accommodating. Walking distance to big malls. I was impressed for the 50 pesos per piece ironing service.

reviews.title: very accessible
reviews.text: We stayed here last Dec 30-Jan 1, 2018. The place was great and very accessible. Walking distance to Ayala, Gaisano and Sm. Going to Limketkai is just 1 ride away. And it’s only 3.5km away from Seven Seas. There’s convenience store, parlor and laundry shop. The staff are very accommodating and they’ll extend their services just to meet customer’s satisfaction. But the main problem is that, it only has 5 parking space to be shared by the all of the stores mentioned above.

reviews.title: Awesome Place!
reviews.text: Got the chance to stay here for two nights and I have to say it was a pleasant experience. The hotel staff were very friendly and accommodating. The room that I got to stay in was so spacious. I love the beds!! Slept like a baby during my entire stay :)

reviews.title: Nice hotel in Cagayan de Oro - Recommended
reviews.text: Very nice hotel, neatly situated between the SM and the Centrio malls, Staff very friendly and helpfull....very nice first impression given by the front office. The rooms are nice ans delicate and very clean. Kudos for strong internet signals. I will come back and I recommend this hotel to others.

reviews.title: Worth every cent!
reviews.text: Central location just between the newly open SM Downtown and Centrio Mall and just one ride away from Limketkai. Along C.M Recto avenue and LAX shuttle service can pick up and drop off to and from airport. By far one of the most accommodating hotel I have been. Staffs are nice and always ready to assist and answer inquiry. Super Comfy beds. Tidy room. Relaxing room ambiance and lightning. Clean and neat bathroom with great water pressure and temp. Simple but hearty breakfast. For massage lovers there is a spa on the second floor in the same building great staff and service as well. Will be definitely going back again here again on November

reviews.title: Satisfied Walk In Guest
reviews.text: Front Desk staff is very accommodating..when we checked in they offered the promo rate which is very good affordable for 4pax and 1kid. Rooms are clean and beds are big. They have 24hr store located within the building and laundry shop. It is just a minute walk from sm downtown..very convenient 😊

reviews.title: A Perfect Mix of Comfort and Convenience
reviews.text: Our staycation at 1A Express Hotel was a match made in heaven. We didn't know there was a hotel at the heart of our city which was a perfect haven for couples. It was the right destination that we were looking for in a staycation. Their staff was respectful, friendly and accommodation. The facilities are clean and well-maintained. When we got inside our Superior Room, everything was just delightful! The cotton pillows were so soft and the bed was so comfortable, I could sleep there all day. Their restaurant serves huge portions for breakfast, we especially loved their chicken. 1A is very instagrammable as well since there are several spots where one can take great pictures. It gives great value for money and we can't wait to check-in again soon!

reviews.title: Great Hotel Experience!
reviews.text: I have been used on passing by CM Recto Avenue while riding a cab for work. And while scanning, this neat, all-white building is a refresher to my eyes. I admired its loop design and at first I thought it is the new in CDO. Never did I realized that it is an express hotel. The 1A Express Hotel. My curiosity enticed me to spend a staycation in this hotel (Aside from its room rates are 50% OFF in this summer season!) When I entered, the front desk officers greeted me happily. Everyone expressed hospitality, and are quick to serve its customers. The rooms are spacious and luxurious which I did not expect initially for the outside shows simplicity and coziness. The beds are big and comfortable. The comfort room is super clean (and I so enjoyed my fave hot shower!). During my stay, I always look forward for their complimentary breakfast – tasty and healthy. Thank you so much 1A Express Hotel for being a home to me during my stay. Surely, I will be coming back soon for another rest and recreation! 🙂

reviews.title: Awesome Hotel Experience
reviews.text: My family stayed here for two nights, so timely for the Holy Week Holiday. I find my stay awesome as it gives me and my family the opportunity to rest, pray and reflect during the Holy week season. Clean room, comfortable bed, peaceful environment, fast internet, delicious complimentary breakfast (especially the pancakes), convenient location and courteous hotel staff are the things I like in this hotel. My mom who's recovering from stroke also enjoyed her stay at the PWD room. The room was designed for all PWDs to have easy access to the hotel facilities...and i find this truly awesome. Thank you 1A for the awesome experience! Till my next staycation 😊

reviews.title: A positively memorable experience
reviews.text: I was invited to speak before the aspiring models of Model Central (MC) and MC booked my stay at 1A Express Hotel. While the hotel is relatively new (there were still on-going construction upon my check-in) but the staff made sure that my stay is positively memorable. During my second day, I went down late in the evening (actually wee hours early, around 2:00AM) to look for a place to eat because I was famished, and the staff were warm and accommodating and offered to call restaurants so I can avoid the hassle of leaving the hotel. Those gestures, may look simple, but it means a lot to a customer like me who puts a premium on excellent customer service. I wish I was able to ask for the names of the front office staff on duty during that time so I can thank them through this review. The location of the hotel was nothing short but strategic. It is practically a stone's throw away from Ayala Centrio Mall and Lim Ket Kai. It is also near CDO's watering holes like The Lifestyle District, etc. The room where I got accommodated was comfortable, clean, and the space was enough for me to move. I suffer from vertigo and migraine if my head is not well rested, and I use a special kind of pillow back at home, and the pillows in my room didn't cause any stress and fatigue on my neck and head. I had a good rest in short. If I can make a recommendation, it would have been better if the clothes hanger are not built-in. It was a bit of a struggle adjusting the hangers because it has a metallic head. Overall, 1A Express Hotel will be my hotel of choice when I'm in CDO - may it be business or non-business trips. See you soon!

reviews.title: Clean, sleek, and value for money hotel1
reviews.text: I decided to stay at 1A Express Hotel being one of the newest hotels to open at Cagayan de Oro. It is located at the busy and accessible C.M. Recto Avenue, Cagayan de Oro City. You can easily spot it right after Ayala Centrio Mall if you're coming from the airport. I stayed at Superior Room with a standard size double bed in a spacious room. The room has a minimalist design sticking only to white, grey, and brown in the colours used. You will find burst of blue in accessories which I find charming as it sticks the hotels identity. The toilet with bidet is of good size, and would suit even those tall people. I must say the shower and its constant water pressure, and temperature is worth a mention. The staff were very accommodating and made sure my needs were met, and my questions answered. Breakfast was served at the Breakfast/Function Hall at the top floor. Recommended meal is the Breakfast Special Chicken, and also Longganisa. Within the 1A Express building, you will also find 1A Laundry Express, and and a Convenience Store at the ground floor that is available and open 24-hours/day. For those who plan to stay longer, and also do the laundry by themselves they can find a high-end but reasonably priced laundry area, a parlor and spa for people needing pampering. Overall I would say that 1A Express is one of the accommodations at CDO worth a return stay or recommendation.

reviews.title: Soft opening , HARD landing..
reviews.text: It is quite understandable when there is a new business and staff in any situation. Yet when they cannot get anything correct, this becomes an issue. On arrival in CDO there was a huge convention, so most hotels in the city were fully booked, making it quite hostile to find a hotel to put it lightly. 1A Express is so new they are still til now under the construction phase in the entry area. Unfortunately the hallways of the hotel are open air at the front of the hotel so you get the noise of the construction. I did ask the staff once I checked in if this would be an issue and they replied with don't worry sir this is only an issue during working hours. I was kept awake off and on throughout the night AND EARLY MORNING HOURS(7pm-6am) of construction noise..ALL NITE! When I went downstairs to complain the front desk apologized and on used their radio to tell the construction crew to please try to keep their banging to a minimum LOL...seriously..during sleeping hours, while you told me in the beginning this would not be the case. Regardless, after this construction phase is over with, the open faced front of the building will be a continued NOISE hazard throughout its history. If you enjoy a quiet nite sleep, please be aware. This was not the only issue. That one night stay was the only night available, so I had to search online first thing in the morning for another vacancy. I called to the front desk and asked the staff if I could use the phone in the room to make local calls to land lines, as this is STANDARD PROTOCOL in hotels where you pay premium prices such as 1A Express. They declined and informed me that local calls are not allowed. It was vital to contact these hotels around the city quick due to the lack of availability , so the staff said they would help me find another hotel to stay at. All is well right?! They did line me up with a place...They gave me the location and mentioned that 'check in time' was 2 pm..just as any other hotel on the face of this Earth. When I arrived at the new hotel late afternoon approximately 4 pm, I was informed that my room had been given to another customer. They mentioned that the 1A Express staff was to inform me that if I did not arrive at the 2 pm check in time that they would give the room away. Thank you very much 1A Express staff! You made my stay in CDO for two days A COMPLETE AND UTTER NIGHTMARE. All they could say was, sorry sir I hope we can do better next time... I give them 5 stars for BIG SMILES BUT NO PROPER ACTION! What do they teach in Phils schools? They are missing listening skills and common sense 101 classes.. The prices they are charging are certainly not worth the soft opening prices outside of their horrid service. When their normal prices come into fruition, it will be grossly over priced. Perhaps the owner is smelling too much of the glue smell that is lingering in the lobby. CDO hotel prices should not match the Global invoices of top rated urban cities. Get real

reviews.title: The place to stay in Cagayan de Oro
reviews.text: I highly recommend this hotel if you're staying in Cagayan de Oro. It's affordable, without compromising comfort and quality. It was my first time to stay in a hotel alone, and I'm so glad it was at 1A Express Hotel. The hotel is very clean, safe, and trendy. The staff are genuinely nice and accommodating. I truly felt at home. What sets 1A Express Hotel apart from other hotels in the city? First is the location, it's accessible and close to a lot of malls and lifestyle destinations in Cagayan de Oro. Second is, guests are allowed to bring food bought outside into the hotel room with no charge. I was really able to relax and unwind thanks to 1A Express Hotel. I had a blissful stay here, and I can't wait to come back! ♡

reviews.title: Comfortable stay right in central downtown
reviews.text: Stayed in a room in the 3rd floor with the family. Room is clean and well-maintained. Its modern, minimal design is refreshing to the eyes. Room size is adequate, toilet and bath area is relatively large. Hot and cold shower is available. Reception and cleaning staff are courteous, warm and well-trained. They are quick to respond to our requests. WiFi is available. Its greatest advantage is its location. It's a short walk to Centrio Ayala Mall and SM Premier Downtown Mall for your shopping and dining needs. It is also easily accessible via public and private transport.

reviews.title: BEST STAYCATION EVER!
reviews.text: Had so much fun staying here with my friends for two nights. The interiors and paintings are super lit and instagram-worthy! Perfect for our IG feeds. I must say the wifi connection is extra fast. But more than that, the people who work there are super nice and friendly, it really shows why Cagayan de Oro is known as the City of Golden Friendship. It's also just a walk away from Centrio Mall and the rising SM CDO Premiere Mall, like they're literally just across the block. Would definitely go back here. :)

reviews.title: A fun and clean place to be!
reviews.text: I love how minimal and clean the hotel is. And if we talk about location, this hotel is very near Centrio Ayala and SM Dowtown Premier. The staff and front desk officers were also very kind and accomodating. Plus, they serve really good pancakes so thats a huge thumbs up for me.

reviews.title: Quality Service like no other
reviews.text: Cagayan de Oro City has always been known to be the City of Golden Friendship and 1A Express Hotel exceeded our expectation. From room accommodation to laundry service to convenience store to cafe to hotel reception, all of their services were superb. My family had a great stay and would definitely recommend them to tourists and locals alike. And oh, you may also book your reservations thru StreetBy. :)

reviews.title: Best hotel in Cagayan de Oro
reviews.text: I had a very good time staying in this hotel everything was perfect from the luxurious bedroom to the very helpful employed who inform and booked nice activity for me (like rafting). I was not able to find a better hotel for this price in Cagayan de Oro! Just on the side of Ayala Mall it is also the best location with a large selection of good restaurants, supermarket, stores, playground for children .... the hotel have 24hours laundry service you can do yourself or they can do it for you. If you like to exercise there is a gym on the cross street for few pesos a day, also a sport center 5 minutes walk from the hotel with a nice swimming pool. The tourist information on the side of the sport center. I had a great time, thank you

reviews.title: 1A Express Hotel - It's all worth it!
reviews.text: 1A Express Hotel really impressed me a lot with so many things. First of all, I really appreciate the friendliness of the staff of the hotel. They were very helpful and made you that things are going well. I also like the relaxing ambiance. They are not very fuzzy with colors. They stick to white and other pastel colors making it a warm and calm. The rooms are spacious, tasteful and fresh looking. I like the modern look of each of the rooms and all the essentials that you need can be found in your room. The beds were so soft and pillow was perfectly firm. The water pressure in the shower was excellent. I really had a great shower and the soaps and shampoos smelled very nice. Breakfast was also nice, I had the bangus and fried rice which was delicious. They also have a balcony outside the restaurant if you wish to have a glimpse of the city. I am very very satisfied that I chose this hotel during my visit to Cagayan De Oro City! It's all worth it!

reviews.title: An Exceptionally Comfortable & Convenient Hotel in CDO
reviews.text: My family and I had an awesome stay at this hotel. You would feel that "home away from home" experience as it offers comfort and convenience at the same time. I love their modern room design and minimalist furnishings. Their beds are cool & comfortable as well. It is comparable to a 5-star hotel. What I also love about this hotel is the service that they give to their guests. The hotel staff are very warm & friendly. One of the best thing about 1A Express Hotel is its convenient location since it is just a few minutes away from the popular shopping malls in CDO. It is situated at the heart of the city so it's easy & accessible for your needs. And speaking of needs, you don't have to go too far to look for a convenient store, a beauty salon or even a laundry shop because they also have it. They truly provide an excellent "express" service for busy people like us. It is indeed an exceptionally comfortable & convenient hotel to stay in CDO!

reviews.title: Awesome Hotel
reviews.text: Newly Opened. Love the scent of new stuff... The mall is near the mall. I had a good night sleep 😴 i love their pillows so much, wish i could take those pillows home, I've been wondering where did they buy those 😭

reviews.title: Skiing in the Aosta Valley
reviews.text: Le Rocher is a family home and delightful in every way. Nothing you ask for is too much trouble and everyone is cheerful and chilled! Chilled in a relaxed way - not cold!! The hotel is warm and cosy, clean and well laid out with several sitting areas to read or chat with fellow guests. The food is authentic with fresh produce and it will be impossible for anyone to be hungry! With a spa and boot room and lift to the ski lifts there is nothing more needed. Enjoy!

reviews.title: Fantastic hotel
reviews.text: Really homely yet stylish. Copious food and helpful chef when 12 year olds get fussy. Whirlpool,sauna and soothing showers in the spar perfect pares ski. 5 min walk to gondola and centre of town. Hire skis from skiset next to ticket office then leave them there at end of day. Loved this hotel.

reviews.title: On the button
reviews.text: Well appointed hotel with a very friendly family feel. Rooms all you expect and a decent spa facility in the basement. Food really what differentiates the hotel. Not only great, but the generosity is clear. Thumbs up to ski2 who organised for us.

reviews.title: Friendly Hotel
reviews.text: Stayed here for lads trip, 4 days skiing. A great wee resort, pistes were very quiet and no queues. Hotel is about 1 km from town. We received a warm welcome from the owners and staff were all friendly and helpful. Rooms are clean but basic. Single beds are quite small but comfortable. Half board was good value. Large continental breakfast selection with bacon, sausage and scrabbled eggs. Dinner offered a good variety. Hotel has free wifi, and a good spa area with jacuzzi, sauna and steam room.

reviews.title: Very good experience!
reviews.text: We stayed there for six days beginning of February and enjoyed every minute! This hotell has the most friendly and service minded owners and staff you can think of. Their attitude made us feel welcome already from the first minute we entered the hotell. The skiing was fantastic, good and well-kept pists, well functioning lifts and luckely perfect snow. At the end of the week the sun was there for us as well. Although the hotell is not placed in the village or close to the ski lifts, this was not a problem. The owners and staff was ready to give you a ride to either of the two main lifts and got you back when the day was over. In case you wanted to visite Champoluc, a short stroll of 5-10 minutes through a beautiful forrest with lights and wooden sculptures took you there. BTW We had lunch one day at the really fine restaurant Osteria Balivo, do that if you visite here! We had chosen half board and did not regret this. Generous breakfast, far away from the continental ones. Dinner gave you the typical Italian setup with anti pasti, primo and secondi piatti, cheese and dolce. Multiple choices for first and second courses. All very well cooked and served. Oh, the wine list was generous as wellyed with the Aosta valley ones and enjoyed this. Yes, one more thing - Le Rocher is known in the are for the good deserts :-). Every evening we used the spa which was included in the price. Turkish and Swedish saunas, Italian bubble bath and a good relax area. Woao! It was also a nice place to meet an talk to fellow guests. If anything, the weekest part probably are the rooms. They are maybe not the biggest, the beds are somewhat hard and you can hear noice though the walls and from the corridor. It is however kept very tidy every day, doing the beds etc. Towels, soap etc was replace at least ones or when needed. So - All-in-all - If visiting Champoluc - Stay at Le Rocher!

reviews.title: Best Hotel in Val d ‘ Ayas
reviews.text: Another wonderful stay at welcoming and fabulous Le Rocher Staff and food excellent. Relaxation area superb after a hard day skiing. It is a delight to ski back from Frachey through the woods and be welcomed by Lotta, Giulio, Stella and team. We will be back soon ..........

reviews.title: Stellar stay with Stella the Dog
reviews.text: We stayed mid-week off season and were the only guests. We were warmly welcomed by the host and Stella the Dog, who patiently taught us how to play fetch properly. Nicely appointed clean room, great recommendation from the host to drive all the way to Mont Blanc and take cable car which was highlight of entire trip. He also put out a splendid breakfast spread for the two us. In ski season this place will be hopping. Champeluc is a lovely town, quiet and picturesque below the mountains.

reviews.title: Return Vist
reviews.text: Nine years ago we had a fabulous week in this hotel and on our return to the resort on a cheaper package deal we decided to book the Wednesday "kitchens night off" meal at Le Rocher to see if it was as we remembered. We booked on line and were asked what time we would like a table. We requested 8 pm It is a 15 minute walk from the centre of the village ( where the first lift is) . The path away from the road is reasonably lit and there are wood carving statues/ art along the way. We were slightly disorientated by the new buildings in the darkness ( well it was 9 years since our last visit) but there was no obvious sign from the path and as it turned out over shot. Fortunately google maps quickly clarified our mistake and we arrived a little early as we had intended for an aperitif. We were immediately told our table wouldn't be ready til 830, ok fair enough if a little disappointing. We eventually sat down at 9 after having to draw their attention to us which was the only part of the evening which didn't meet our high expectation. The food was still fabulous ,great value for money and good quality. The bottle of wine was not charged for in recompense for the long wait ( or being forgotten about?). I wish this hotel well for the future and if we ever return for a third visit to Champoluc we hope to call in again.

reviews.title: perfect escape
reviews.text: We had our fifth stay at this hotel this February. Le Rocher is a relaxed, quiet hotel with lovely owners Giulio and Lotta. The rooms are clean and comfortable and the shower rooms are sparklingly clean! The staff are pleasant and quiet and thorough. Dinner is great with a buffet of starters followed by two courses ordered in the morning at breakfast. The buffet means that hungry kids can graze from their arrival. Really lovely wine list too. Pudding is something gorgeous like a tiramisu or nuts and fruit and cheese. The restau was particularly good during our visit and there was a really nice St Valentine's dinner with wonderful flowers and decorations. Staff are really fab about food probs as I have to avoid some food groups and this can be a pain. Although dinner is included, you can arrange to go elsewhere if you give advance notice. There is a bar with woodburning stove, perfect for relaxing. There is a nearby tv where you can play dvds and various games and packs of cards. I have watched my sons sitting playing cards with friends met over dinner. The hotel attracts really nice guests, Italians and Swedes to mirror the owners nationalities but is also used by companies like ski 2 and one of my favourite things about staying there is that I have met really nice and interesting people. You can get a lift to the slopes but there is a short but scenic walk through the woods past some wonderful wood carvings. G&L make the stay very simple and can arrange pick up from the airport, ski hire and advise about ski passes. They are so lovely and make you feel very welcome. There is a spa but I'm not a spa person so not a clue! I love the skiing, the views and the mountainside restaus. I love that people in the village always remember you too. Very laid back and charming, I love it and so do my kids and my husband.

reviews.title: Total Chill Out!
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed this March 2014 in the Le Rocher for a weeks skiing . I cannot recommend it enough for a totally relaxing experience with superb food and great hosts and staff who were all so friendly and where nothing was too much trouble. Fantastic 'wellness' centre with sauna, stream room and jacuzzi to eae away the sore muscles! Champoluc is a great place to ski if you want quiet pistes and great, good value, coffee stops at half the price of French resorts! We cannot wait to visit again.

reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.text: Yes food is good. Rooms are clean. All the " normal " things you want from a hotel are at least as good as you can expect from a good hotel. What really makes this Place so nice is that the staff and specially the owners makes you feel at home. It's a friendly and relaxed place. It's a Place you like to return to

reviews.title: NOTHING TO SAY: JUST WONDERFUL
reviews.text: The staff: Amazing The food: Can not be better The owner: Friendly The room: Adequate Thank you so much for such a nice experience. You showed the real hospitality. Everybody is smiling always. The food was delicious! I will never forget the taste of the food I had! :)

reviews.title: Family friendly hotel
reviews.text: Very nice family run hotel. Giulio and Otta are excellent hosts. Family friendly. Genuine food. Excellent quite location, away from the busy village centre. Excellent both winter and summer time. My kids love Le Rocher.

reviews.title: Perfect location
reviews.text: We stayed for the second time with our children during the Christmas holidays at the Le Rocher and we had a lovely time. The family room is rather big and comfortable. The hotel is in a lovely location hidden in the woods but still very close to the gondola/ski lift. Food is very good and hosts and staff are very kind and friendly. The hotel is definitely very family friendly and would definitely recommend it.

reviews.title: Hotel with potential - but bad service and many small irritations
reviews.text: The first impressions were really good. Hotel looks really good and new, rooms are quite small (italian standard I think) but very clean and each room as their own balcony, the spa with hamam and jaccuzzi is really nice and the owner was nice. There is a free garage for parking. The location is beautiful with a nice view but a bit more off than you get the impression of from the website. It is located outside Champoluc (it takes 10-20 minutes to walk into Champoluc either through a walkway through the forrest, which took longer due to the amount of wet snow there, or along a dark road). We had a rental car but sometimes wanted to enjoy good wine so did not take the car. There is a shuttle bus one hour in the morning and an hour in the afternoon to the ski lifts, which we did not use. However, soon the lack of many small things (each one of them could have been acceptable if it had been the only flaw) made our stay a less good one. Most of these things should be possible to fix quite easily, so this hotel definitely has potential: There is no real hairdryer even to borrow (only the worst possible kind they have in some hotels, which takes an hour for you hair to dry), there was no iron or ironing board to borrow, we did not receive any more soap or schampoo after the first day when it was finished (we stayed for more than a week), there were almost never any towels in the spa (when asked for some, we were told to get our towels from the room...), towels did not dry in our room due to some problems with heating in our bathroom, you could not get anything at all (no sandwiches, snacks) to eat after you got back from skiing, you were not allowed to choose a table in the restaurant for breakfast even though most of the tables were free, and there were no chairs on the room balcony to enjoy the afternoon sun and the nice view. It is also very noisy: The wooden floors in the corridors are really nice, but without some kind of mats, we heard every single person in our corridor and above us going to and from their rooms (we are not early birds and are not the first ones in the slopes in the mornings...) We also heard chairs being moved from the restaurant two floors below us. The service we received was really bad. You get the impression that some of the employees really did not want to do what they were there for (but rather go skiing themselves.) You felt you were bothering them by asking for something. On our last day, we slept in and arrived at breakfast at 09.40 am (breakfast is supposed to be served until 10 am) and found that the breakfast buffet had been completely removed and when we asked, the waiter asked us what time it was. When we told him he got some of the food for us but was apparently annoyed. We also tried out the hotel restaurant one night, and event though the price was ok, we were not very impressed. There are several resataurants in the area that can offer considerably better food, service and ambience.

reviews.title: Very quiet and relaxing
reviews.text: This is a lovely hotel, very friendly staff and feels like you are staying in family home. We booked with Ski2 and so had daily transport to and from the hotel which is a few minutes drive from the lifts in Champuloc or Frachey. Nice walk into town too along a well lit path also. It was very quiet when we went as it was Xmas week and Italians tend to holiday the week after Xmas, which was very busy when we left on 29 December. The food is very good with several starters, salad bar, meats and cheeses, first course, main and dessert. Servings are smaller but the overall meal is very filling. The a la carte menu is quite limited although there are daily specials. The wine selection is very good. The rooms are lovely, quite small but more than adequate for a week's holiday. Good television service which is very unusual but on a rainy afternoon was very useful. Ski and boot room was very good and spacious although the flight of stairs was a challenge with tired legs. We enjoyed the spa which although small was very well equipped with foot spa, Jacuzzi, steam room, sauna and couple of different treatment showers. Very relaxing. Loved having the dogs around especially Stella the Jack Russell who needed regular pieces of ice throwing for her. Really enjoyed our stay and the skiing wasn't bad either.

reviews.title: Cosy Friendly Family Hotel
reviews.text: We stayed at Le Rocher over New Year with our family and had a wonderful time. Swedish Lotta and Italian Giulio plus their 3 children, dog and cat make this a very welcoming hotel. There was a good mix of ages at the hotel so it was equally suitable for couples or families of all ages. Lovely food especially the spaghetti carbonara and great local wine. All in all perfect base for a family ski holiday.

reviews.title: Lovely hotel with great service
reviews.text: Stayed at Le Rocher for the 6th time and always lovely to come back. The dinner and breakfast is super, the cosy bar with a fireplace is perfect after a long day in the pists. The spa is not a big one but just what you need. The rooms are typically Italian, with a bed and bathroom. The service is excellent.

reviews.title: A little gem
reviews.text: Le Rocher is a little gem. The owners Lotta and Gullio go that extra mile to make sure your stay is extra special and Fulvia on reception is exceptional. Fabulous location, great food and good size rooms. Lovely sitting areas by the fire with rustic bar. Sauna and steam rooms, heated boot room and free wifi. Champoluc is a hidden gem for skiers, plenty of runs for all levels. Free mini bus to the ski lifts. A lovely walk to the village, especially pretty at night as the path is lit by ground level lights all the way, magical.

reviews.title: Tasteful architecture in glorious setting. Nice rooms and facilities
reviews.text: Stayed there for a couple of days and got a very good rate before ski season started in earnest. Our room was a decent size, spotlessly clean, with a good bathroom. Beds were good and room very well heated. Service was excellent with prompt check in. Breakfast was good (typical continental fare so don't expect eggs bacon). Great croissants, coffee a bit sludgy but does the job in the morning. Hotel is located about a ten minute walk from town centre. I walked back in my ski boots from ski lift no problem but they do offer drop-off and pick-up morning and evening. Building is in the local grey stone and timber, located in a scenic setting. Warm and inviting relaxation areas, slightly spoilt by piped rap music. More discrete music would better suit the place IMHO. Spa, steam room and sauna were all very clean and welcome after a day skiing. Due to lots of timber construction noise can carry. This is typical of the alpine areas and wasn't a problem when we were there as they were not busy and our fellow guests were well behaved but it might be a problem should there be rowdy people near you. Champoluc and the Monterosa are amazing and the skiing was out of this world.

reviews.title: Good location, very kind staff
reviews.text: Just came back from a long weekend in Champoluc with my colleagues. We stayer 4 nights at Le Rocher and it was excellent. We arrived 10 pm and some of us were hungry and there were sandwiches and fruits in our room. Very nice! The room and the bathroom was clean also there were bath robes and slippers. The breakfast had nice selections of breads, yogurts, fruits, corn freaks, ham, cheese and boiled egg. I especially liked their croissant. They had normal croissant and also chocolate croissant. The dinner is very nice too. At the breakfast, you can make a selection for the first and second course. There are three dishes to choose from. The dishes were tasty and we were very full every evening. The dinner starts with a very nice buffet of antipasti. I think there were about 20 different kinds of antipasti on the buffet table. The staff at the reception and at the restaurant were very kind and attentive. The hotel is located not so far away from the slope but the hotel provides a lift close to the gondola station. We usually went by a hotel mini bus in the morning and walked back after skiing. There is a nice walking path in the woods from the gondola station/town to the hotel and it takes just 10-15 minutes to walk. The spa at the basement is very nice too. It's not so big but there are steam sauna, sauna, jacuzzi and aroma shower. You can go down with the bath robe that is provided at the room. If I have a chance to go back to Champoluc, I will definitely stay there.

reviews.title: Perfect relaxation
reviews.text: We stayed here for a week in February. Wonderful welcome from Guilio and Lotta and all of the staff. Arrived in perfect time to have delicious and relaxing dinner in the lovely dining room. Bar is convivial and friendly with lots of corners for chats, games of cards and a bigger space for important football screening! We stayed in one of the suites this time; It was really comfortable and spacious with beautiful views. As ever, it was very clean and well cared for. Big TV with Sky in main room and DVD player in second room. Food really good, big table with lots of interesting starters then primi piatti and secondi piatti that you choose at breakfast. Everything was really delicious! A beautiful cake or other dolce laid out every day or fresh fruit, delicious cheeses, nuts, fruit pickles to nibble before retiring to the bar. We had the added bonus of the annual San Valentino Dinner with not only a spectacular dinner but even more flowers and extra present! Breakfast is a spread of croissants, rolls, cereals, eggs, cheese, ham fruit juices and also hot bacon, sausage, scrambled egg. You get so well looked after here. ALL of the staff are lovely and Fulvia is so excellent at making sure that no details are over looked. It also seems to attract really nice guests. She organised transport to and from Milan! I love it and have returned on many occasions. The skiing is great, miles of quiet slopes and wonderful views.

reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: Visited here between Xmas and New Year on a ski trip. The hotel staff are helpful, friendly and excellent. Stayed on half board. Good selection of cold breakfast buffet for breakfast with super fresh coffee and fresh croissants. You order dinner at breakfast. Dinner is traditional Italian hearty food which we really enjoyed. There is a spread of anti pasti to get you started as soon as you go in. Sweet consisted of home made baking cakes etc. The hotel is in a very quiet part of the valley. It is 10 minutes walk to the town though there is a mini bus to the ski lifts in the morning and ski deposit at the uplift. The hotel itself is new and very clean. Good Wellness Centre as well.

reviews.title: Not the best value for money
reviews.text: Stayed for 3 nights at new years'eve. Hotel is very good looking, new, cosy, in quiet location. Outside of Champoluc, distance to city almost 1 km, but we liked that because Champoluc was too busy and noisy in this time period (there are really big traffic jams in the morning and in the evening, specially over the weekend, as this place attracts many people from Milan and Turin who come just for one day). Hotel service (checking, cleaning, shuttle service) was excellent. This hotel has a little, but very good spa area, just right size for this type of hotel, Food could be better and you can for sure get a nicer dinner outside the hotel, in restaurants. What we didn't like at this hotel was: - cold inside the rooms (radiators cold for most of the day and night, temperature in the room dropped below 20C many times, you can't dry your stuff which got wet during skiing) - hairdryer is useless (no power, just does not do the job) - noisy rooms during the day if you stay in rooms above restaurant (you can here chairs moving...a lot).

reviews.title: Great place to come back to after a hard day of skiing
reviews.text: We had a long weekend here just before Christmas. The service was warm and friendly. The room was small with a loft area that had a single bed which was perfect for our daughter to sleep in. There was free wifi which we made good use of in the evenings while we sat in front of the fireplace and had a pre dinner drink. The hotel was also super quick to respond when I got in touch with them after we returned home as I thought I had lost the charger for my headphones. Would definitely go stay there again. The location was perfect, just a little ways out of town, it was still walking distance. On the Sunday afternoon, my daughter and I enjoyed a day I will remember for a long time, we decided to call it quits skiing at around 2pm and then walked back from the ski slopes at Frachey to La Rocher through the forest and alongside the river, the scenery was just spectacular and we had a ball making snow angels, throwing snowballs and as we trekked through the snow back to our hotel.

reviews.title: Amazing - we would definately go back
reviews.text: We spent an amazing 5 days at Le Rocher Hotel in Champoluc, in April 2011. The hotel itself is beautiful, nicely decorated, the bar area was very cosy with a fire going every evening and the decor didnt feel at all tired or old. Our room was nice, our balcony overlooked the mountains which was an amazing view. There was a spa in the hotel which was available for use from 4pm everyday which was very welcomed after a days skiing! The location of Le Rocher was good - there were buses running to the ski lifts, but we didn't use these once as the walk is only 10 minutes and through a very pretty forest. The food in the hotel was absolutely amazing! We were on half-board, and i have never had such good half board food on any other holiday. We were given a menu at breakfast for what we would like that evening - which a choice of three dishes for each of three courses. The food was delicious and every night we were completely stuff! The staff at the hotel are very friendly and spoke great English. They helped in anyway they could, even finding me a blackberry charger when I ran out of phone battery! On our last day our taxi collected us at 6am (too early for the restaurant to be open), so the owner of the hotel left us a breakfast in the bar area which included pastries, cereals and flasks of tea and coffee. It was the best service i have had in a hotel for a long time. The only slight downside is that the hotel was quiet (one night we were the only people there!) however we went at the VERY end of the ski season (while lifts were closing) and I have no doubt that in peak season this would be heaving with people. We are both 26 so like a nice lively place! This has not put us off at all, and would like to return next year (maybe a bit earlier in the year).

reviews.title: Comfortable base for skiing in Champoluc
reviews.text: A clean and comfortable hotel, about a 10 minute walk from the central lift and slightly further away from the Frachey lift which is the quickest route to the second valley via Bettaforca. The walk is along a reasonably lit path, although it was very icy during our visit. The owner will transport you in his minibus if you ask, we only asked once as it was snowing, but handy if you have to carry your ski gear.The room was clean but quite small, but not a great deal of storage space for all of those skiing clothes. We felt adding some more shelves in the wardrobe would help, but if you have space take some hangers as this would help. There were only 10 in the wardrobe. Food is the highlight, excellent quality and probably the best I have experienced in a ski resort hotel. Whilst quality is good, choice is limited, but ok for a weeks trip. The communal area is rustic with nice comfortable chill out areas, great for playing games or having a quiet drink. Owners are lovely and engaging and have two friendly dogs, the first is an old rescue dog that they have taken in who is very friendly but not so energetic. The other is into everything, always wants to play and runs around continually. If dogs are your thing, you will love it as it gives it a homely feel. My biggest criticism is the bar bill, we went with friends, and asked to keep separate accounts, but you are never asked to sign for anything, so when we came to pay the final bill we got a real shock. When queried, the system was very manual, and you couldn’t identify what days or drinks had been ordered. It’s not something you want to be doing on holiday but keep a close eye on what you are drinking, particularly if you are with close friends as it was very embarrassing at the end of the trip, even though we realised that we had paid more of the bill than we should have. I recommend that you keep a record of what you are buying and the cost, so that there is no ‘confusion’ at the end of the week, as it wasn’t a great way to end a holiday. Perhaps pay as you go, then there will be no problem. Overall a great base, but could be excellent with a little more thought.

reviews.title: Very nice restaurant, spa and service!
reviews.text: Many things seemed to have changed when I compare with a review from 2009! The rooms have hairdryers, no lack of towels, we got new soaps etc. A very nice spa with 2 sorts of sauna, a bubble pool and comfortable chairs where you could relax. Every dinner started with a delicious buffet with antipasti and then there were several choices for first and second courses. The only complaints were that the beds are a little bit hard and you have to be aware that the hotel is located outside Champoluc but it is only about a 10 minutes walk to town. The advantage is that it is very quiet in the night. The staff drives you every morning to the ski lift and when you call in the afternoon they turned up after a few minutes to pick you up and drive you back to the hotel! A very nice bar with an open fire at the hotel.

reviews.title: Comfortable family run chalet style hotel
reviews.text: I'm just back from my sixth visit to Champoluc and third stay in this hotel. It's definitely my favourite place to stay in the village. Clean, comfortable, family run but professional. The staff are charming and helpful and the Swedish/Italian owners delightful. Food excellent, rooms comfortable, spa filled and food delicious. Underground parking, shuttle morning and evening to the lifts at Champoluc and Frachay, ski storage and boot drier. Nice walk if you chose to use the Champoluc ski storage and soon to open pool and spa on the way. If I could have taught the kitchen how to make tea it would be completely perfect!

reviews.title: Avoid at all costs!!
reviews.text: This is a beautiful 2 bedroom chambre d'hote (bed and breakfast) just north of St Remy. The rooms are superb, the garden immaculate, the pool gorgeous, and Mme Landrin friendly and welcoming. However, her husband is apalling. He is extremely precious regarding the family silver (heirlooms) and - consequently - extraordinarily pedantic over security. We were never comfortable about when we should and shouldn't lock the front door (the property itself is secure behind high walls and locked gates), and were constantly walking on egg shells. One evening my wife and I left my elderly mother-in-law to dine in St Remy (we were celbrating our anniversary), and she accidently locked herself out of her room. When she politely asked if there was a spare key, the owner flew into a rage and abused her for daring to lock her door. He complained that he trusted us with his precious silver, and that to lock her door was an afront to his honesty. She was left to wait in our room until our return, and was in a terrible state when we arrived. She never recieved an apology, and he acted as if nothing had happened the next morning. Unfortunately their website is a private one and they do not appear to be working under a sponsor. The best I can do is warn prospective visitors! I do not believe this was an isolated incident, and that his behaviour was an example of his atrociously bad temper. I hope this proves helpful to someone.

reviews.title: Charming, 2 storey old house (built 1644) and gardens, only 1km from St Remy
reviews.text: We stayed 4 nights at this Mas (= French farm house) and found it very hard to find, mainly because the street address given on Booking.com is wrong; it is NOT 12 Quartier des Jardins but 12 Rue Petit des Jardins (which is off the D5 road); our GPS could not locate the property and we had to stop and ask 2 strangers for directions!! The elderly woman (Madeleine) who runs the place speaks no English, which we found quite difficult at first, as the room we were shown was not the one we thought we had booked (we requested the only one of 4 with a separate walk in shower cubicle); her husband speaks reasonable English, however it’s his wife who looks after the rooms/bookings! None the less, everything turned out fine and we ended up staying in the room we wanted because the other booking they had for it was cancelled. This room was large and had a large rough tile walk-in shower plus small dressing room. No information in our room explaining anything about the property or Wi-Fi; we were given a map of St Remy- that’s all. Fortunately there were some other French/English speakers there at the time of our visit who helped us with some of our questions. The bedroom and separate bathroom/WC are a generous size, with a small flat screen TV and air con. There’s a busy road nearby but the room has double window glazing. Very tasteful paintings on the walls and antique furniture, tiled floors with rugs, nice wall and ceiling lights, quite “charming”. Breakfasts served in the dining room were adequate – tea or coffee, croissants, jams/bread, fresh fruit and yoghurt. Free Wi-Fi is only available in the lounge/dining room which guests can use, it works well but would have liked it in our bedroom also. They have a large kitchen and terrace area out the back of the house which guests can use in the evenings plus a fridge to store your food/drinks in which we found great. It’s also possible to use this kitchen for cooking meals. We found our elderly hosts to be very friendly (contrary to some comments on Trip Advisor), and Madeleine who runs the rooms is very kind and thoughtful (even offering to do our laundry for us at no charge!), despite the fact that she does not speak English. Recommended, 95 euros/night incl breakfast. This is great value in my opinion.

reviews.title: Underwhelmed
reviews.text: We stayed here for 2 nights and I wouldn't stay here again. It wasn't bad, but it just wasn't for me. The price was great, but the following things bugged me: Madeleine's lack of English was a problem for us. There is a noisy road close by; some people might not even hear the noise, but I am sensitive to noise, so it was a problem. The room was lovely, clean and spacious, but the windows were very small, so there isn't much of a view. The breakfast was fantastic. The property grounds are nice, but there is an area that looks like a working yard, and there is an old broken trampoline, that is an eyesore. Also, it is definitely not walking distance to town. It is on a busy road which is very dark at night.

reviews.title: Wonderful Inn
reviews.text: We had the pleasure of spending 8 nights in this quaint Inn in St Remy and enjoyed it immensely. The room was very large and comfortable with a nicely renovated bathroom. Breakfast were crossaints, yogurt, fresh fruit, juice, coffee and wonderful homemade jams. And there is a guest kitchen where you can prepare meals or snacks for yourself! Perhaps the best part was Madeleine who owns and manages the Mas. She was so helpful with directions, bus schedules, restaurants and even picked us up at the train station once. I can not say enough about how large a part she played in making sure our stay was enjoyable. We had planned on walking or using the bus to all areas in the vicinity. Bad idea! Only 2 bus routes which go to Avignon or Arles so a car makes it far easier to visit the many sites in the area. Walking into town is easy, about a half mile but after 2 days you have exhausted all the sites so either plan a short stay or get the car!

reviews.title: Beautiful and welcoming oasis in a charming area of Provence
reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay at Mas Lou Figoulon for 4 nights. Our room was great. Well appointed with a mix of antique and contemporary furnishings, venetian mirrors, and morano chandelier. The bed was very comfortable. We also had a walking closet with a dressing table and wall safe. The bathroom was recently renovated with a large walk-in shower and a view of the garden. The room also over look the garden with french windows. Our breakfast was laden with yummy baked good, fresh jams, fruits, yogurt, fresh coffee and juice. And breakfast is included in the rent. We could also use a full size frig to store our wine and fruits that we bought in town. There is also a large kitchen that we can use. We could also use more than one eating areas to relax and drink our wine. Madeleine and her husband were more than hospitable to us. They were open to our questions and made recommendations on restaurants in town. They were not intrusive at all. They would go about their chores during the morning and we hardly saw them in the evenings. Madeleine really went out of her way to make our trip comfortable! Keep in mind, my french is horrible and her English is not great, but we were able to communicate on email and in person with no problem. They were very sweet! I don't want to forget to mention the lovely garden with flowers, almond trees, and the pool. We had a perfectly relaxing vacation at Mas Lou Figoulon.

reviews.title: Old world charm in Provence
reviews.text: Mas Figoulon is a beautiful guest house originally a farm built in 1662. The garden is lovely with a pool and guest kitchen with fridge and in or outside eating areas. Certainly the lack of English was not a problem, Madame seemed to know what we needed and was extremely helpful. Our room and bathroom were big with comfortable bed, air con and tempermental wifi, but could do with a bit of an update. The breakfast table was a picture with best china, lots of fresh fruit and home made preserves. Even the family silver is on display. It was nice to relax away from the noise of the town which is close enough for the fit to walk but a short drive for us not so fit with parking in the main square. A supermarket just down the road for picnic provisions. Lots to see and do around this area so Mas Figoulon was an excellent base for 4 nights.

reviews.title: Taste of Chateau Living
reviews.text: Madeliene does not speak English. Her husband does. Not to worry! She is a very welcoming hostess insisting on helping us with our luggage. The next morning, the beakfast was extraordinary...fine china, fresh flowers, really wonderful fresh fruit and pasteries to compliment the entrees. Close enough to St. Remy to walk and far enough to feel like you are at the chateau in the country. The building is a real old chateau beautifully landscaped with a pool and good parking. The rooms are VERY French and true to period chateau. Everything was delightful in the room...Louis the XIV should have had it so good! The experience was well worth the 95 Euros. Our only regret is that we only had one night.

reviews.title: A lovely stay in St Remy de Provence
reviews.text: My husband and I and our two teenage sons had a wonderful stay at Mas Lou Figoulon for four nights and five days. St Remy is the best town in Provence in our view and a great central location from which to explore the region. We had two bedrooms and a shared bathroom and they were large, comfortable and decorated with glorious antiques. Madeleine was a delight despite our language barrier. She is a great host as is her husband. The breakfast was so lovely. Different complete setting of lovely French crockery everyday, croissants, coffee, fresh juice and fruit. Outside the garden is lovely as are the grounds and the river that runs through the property. I doubt my sons will ever forget the gorgeous pool which was such a welcome relief from the heat and her lovely cats especially the grey grumpy face one :-) would definitely stay again and recommend. Thanks Madame!!

reviews.title: Relaxing in St. Remy
