reviews.text: My aunt and I had such a wonderful stay at Mas Figoulon. It's a small, quaint bed & breakfast with the a relaxing environment. Madeline and her husband were polite and helpful (despite the language barriers - their limited English and our limited French). Would definitely stay here again if I visited St. Remy in the future.

reviews.title: Quiet haven with country feel.
reviews.text: Mas Figoulon is an old farmhouse which has been in Madam's family for four generations. Our room was spacious with a dressing room, very handy for suitcases, and an updated, large shower room. Masses of antiques everywhere. Breakfast was fruit and croissants, more than enough for me. The pool, in large grounds, is beautifully kept and wonderful after a day sight seeing. Well placed for Arles and Nimes. St Remy is a lovely town, my favourite now! Good local restaurants.

reviews.title: Beautiful and quiet B&B just outside St. Remy
reviews.text: We spent 3 nights here and enjoyed our stay very much. Pros: Very nice owners, good breakfast, comfortable room, beautiful garden, quiet and peaceful atmosphere. Cons: Owner's English is very limited (I know a little bit of French so we managed), our room could not be locked with a key (the room was at the top floor and the key we got was to the house's main door), returning at night from city center by foot is not so pleasant as it requires walking several hundred meters on the side of an unlit road.

reviews.title: Lovely French B and B
reviews.text: We spent 3 nights at this B and B within walking distance of St. Remy. We paid 80 E a night for a large room with a bath tub, no shower. Yes, Madeline does not speak English, but don't let this deter you. The bed was comfortable, the room quiet. The room had AC but we did not need it. Breakfast is included with the room, something that seems to be more and more uncommon. The breakfast was croissants, yogurt, fruit, juice and coffee or tea. The grounds of the mas are very pretty. There is a nice place to sit ouside with your wine and cheese. For a true French experience I would recommend staying here. We found Madeleine and her husband to be very gracious host and hostess. It was about a 10 minute walk to the town center.

reviews.title: A delightful place to stay
reviews.text: We stayed for 3 nights. The house and hosts were charming and the room was delightful. Comfy bed, dressing room, spacious bathroom and beautifully styled rooms. Lovely things all around. The room overlooked the gorgeous garden which was lovely to sit and and have the dog run around. The house is conveniently close to town but still quiet. Unfortunately Madeleine didn't speak any English (which was surprising as the site we booked through suggested that 'we speak your language' and we (being English) traditionally speak no French. But she was very hospitable none the less. The choice at breakfast was a little disappointment being mainly bread products but nice none the less. The Wifi was good and didn't require fiddly passwords. We will definitely return again if in the area.

reviews.title: I'm Dreaming of Another Visit!!!!
reviews.text: My husband and I had the absolute pleasure of staying with Madame Madeleine and her husband at this outstanding inn for seven unforgettable nights. I can't say enough about this wonderful couple and their gorgeous home. We had an absolutely beautiful room that was spacious with a large in-suite bathroom. The room, as well as the inn was furnished with impeccable antiques. Every morning the dining room table was dressed in beautiful French tablecloths and dishes - there was not a repeat of anything the entire time we were there! Our breakfasts were wonderful with fresh breads, croissants, homemade jams and fruit so beautiful, it looked like a picture. Madame Madeleine takes utmost pride in her inn and making her guests feel special. There was a wonderful guest kitchen at the back of the inn in which we could have snacks etc. on our own, as well as tables and chairs set up in the front of the inn for al fresco eating and lounging. A beautiful in-ground pool was also available. While Madame's English was as limited as our French, we still were able to communicate and she was kind enough to even do some laundry for us. Even though our holiday ended three months ago, I'm still living in that wonderful home and it's on the top of our list for a return visit.

reviews.title: Loved the place.
reviews.text: Stayed for 7 nights. Old farm house, well kept (house and wow gardens) beautiful furniture, very comfortable bed / mattress, modern bathroom and shower, gracious host, clean, great location (need a car - about 3 min drive from town center). Gorgeous gardens. Definitely recommend. They have 4 rooms. Wifi in all except one room! Nice though basic breakfast (fresh bakery, her home made jams, good coffee). No eggs and such. We asked if we can bring own cheese and started getting a great cheese plate at breakfast. Everything with great taste- different dishes every morning. Loved it!!!

reviews.title: A peaceful and tranquil haven
reviews.text: The Mas is only a short distance from St Remy and it was with relief that we drove into this peaceful place, and felt miles away from the hustle and bustle that was in St Remy the day we arrived. Our room was huge, comfortable and clean. Madeleine and her husband were lovely and welcoming. Although she could not speak English, and my French is terrible, we made ourselves understood with some gesturing and pointing. The only slightly odd thing is that there was no soap provided (I was expecting the usual little cake you get in a hotel or B&B to wash your hands with after using the bathroom). I am not sure if it was an oversight, or not usually provided. As I wasnt sure how to ask in French,and we had our own shower gel and could use that, it was a minor issue and we didn't worry about it. We were asked what time we wished to have breakfast, and when we came down at the arranged time, we were greeted with a lovely spread of coffee, orange juice, bread, croissants, pain au chocolate, fruit (strawberries were in season) and yoghurt. We had booked through a Provence Emotion (a holiday rental agency), and paid 90Euros a night for the largest room, it appears to be less (70-80 euros) if you book directly with them. Regardless, I felt it was very good value, and would definitely stay here again if we returned to the area and chose to stay in a B&B.

reviews.title: we'll definately be back!
reviews.text: Our first trip to Honduras was a bliss! Andre was extremely helpful with putting our trip together and Alejandro took a great care of us at Trujillo Beach Eco Resort as our tour guide! We stayed in the villa and were pleasantly surprised by all the amenities. Pool was very nice and we soaked there every evening, but ocean and the beach took our breath away! There were no people on the beach, just us! Sand was nice and the ocean floor smooth and tide pull was not strong. The food from the restaurant was excellent. We also did some grocery shopping in the town of Trujillo [since villas have fully equipped kitchen] and were very impressed by the history of the place. Our guardian angel Alejandro took us there and showed us around. Can't wait when our condo is finished! Irina and Serguei

reviews.title: A great experience with amazing service
reviews.text: Beautiful area with beautiful beaches. We got to enjoy horseback and dune buggies all within the resort. We ended up contacting Monika Small at Recap Investments to purchase one of the condos being built. We're so excited to use next winter season. Highly recommend this place. Andre and Alejandro were out if this world.

reviews.title: The website is very missleading
reviews.text: This would be a wonderful place to write a novel, or just hang out if you want to be secluded from everything. Only 3 other people in the entire place, and it's not like you can take a stroll into town. This resort is way out in the boonies, a long ways off the pavement on a terrible road. About a 30 minute drive to town. There was no clubhouse, no eco-garden in use. (it was there, growing a lovely, meter high crop of eco-weeds). The beach is quite a hike from the resort, and not that nice. Lots of garbage from the cruise ships, and the water was too choppy and rough to swim in any time we went. The restaurant was limited to very few choices of food, and even less for drinks. All that being said, the cabanas are beautiful, and so are the pools. The staff was super friendly, and went out of their way to try and make us comfortable. The kitchen is a little short on cookware, but has the basics. If this resort was close to town, on a nicer beach, it would be incredible. I have to think that many of the positive reviews are coming from people who were sucked into investing in property here without seeing what they were getting first. We met several during our month in Trujillo, who were very disappointed when they actually came and saw where their money went, the location being the biggest downfall. I would only stay here again if I was trying to hide from the rest of the world. We were booked for 3 weeks, and left after 3 days. The wi-fi was terrible also.

reviews.title: Home Sweet Home
reviews.text: We where at the Resort property from Dec 24/14 to Jan 8/15. We own a house on the property so we did stay in it. We have stayed in the villa's in the past and they are very nice clean and comfortable units. The pools are very nice and the landscape work in the pool areas have come a long way and are growing nicely. The beach condo's are coming along nice and should be ready soon. The restaurant was closed when we where there for some remodeling but when it is open the food is great The food at the restaurants in the town of Trujillo are also very good. Just wish I didn't have to leave but now have to start working on plans for our next visit.

reviews.title: Great place to stay!
reviews.text: I just stayed in one of the villas at TBED. They are very nicely finished and perfectly clean. The pool and grounds area are lovely. It is a very peaceful place to relax. My tour guide was Alejandro and he is fantastic. He went out of his way to make sure I was comfortable and was always willing to plan activities as well. He is a great asset to the resort. The food from the restaurant was all excellent and most of it is grown right at Trujillo Beach Eco Development.

reviews.title: Excellent if you like tranquility
reviews.text: Here is my upfront and honest review: If you want a tranquil, off beat setting where you can wake up every morning listening to the sounds of tropical birds, go for walks on the beach without meeting one single other person and see monkeys and iguanas in their natural setting, then this place is for you. Truly do not come here if you are looking for restaurants, night clubs and people selling you jewellery and offering to braid your hair. This is as far from a tourist trap as you will get.......and I loved it. Grab a bike, go for a walk, swim in the ocean or chat with the few other people on this 600 acres who decided to vacation here. The staff are wonderful and friendly. You will be made to feel like part of the crew/ family. It's not for everyone but it certainly is for me. WIFI was good unless you were trying to stream movies. A variety of DVD's are available. Restaurant food was excellent but yes selection is limited.The villas are roomy and self sufficient with full kitchens and laundry. If you are missing anything, just ask. The pool areas were spotless and a great place to socialize. The road in is an adventure but once you arrive you may not ever want to leave. You do need a car to access this location. Thank you Polo, Julio, Nora, Alejandro & Kimberley for your Honduran hospitality.

reviews.title: Trip to Trujillo Beach
reviews.text: As soon as we arrived in Roatan I knew I had made the right decision and as soon as we arrived on the mainland after our ferry ride I knew I was stepping into paradise. The rain forest so lush and colorful, the kind faces welcoming us to their country, the car ride made me feel like a child again I was so excited to see all the new things. When we arrived in Trujillo Beach I couldn't get over how green it was and big and the ocean so beautiful, the waves so calm. We checked into our one bedroom villa which was really clean and we loved the extra touch of flower pedals on the bed which was super comfy. The fridge was stalked with water which is really important to me especially after the travel. We met with Andre the tour operator who toured us around showing different sites and throughout the week we did some zip lining, white water rafting and horseback riding right at the development. It was a great experience. I have to admit I was pretty nervous travelling to Honduras with all the media hype but after speaking with a rep from Recap Investments they had assured me it was a safe area and they were right. We can't wait to get back and have some more tequilas with the staff and friends we met.

reviews.title: Daniel G
reviews.text: We just got back from our first trip to Trujillo Eco Reach Resort. The place is out of the ordinary, it is a real eco center. We rented a villa for one week but next time it will be for 2 weeks, just to relax and enjoy nature. The staff is very helpful always ready to serve, everyone goes out of the way to keep you happy and content. We fully recommend Trujillo Eco Resort to people who want a different type of vacation

reviews.title: Great Staff
reviews.text: We had a wonderful two-night stay. Of the many positives, the best is the personal attention by the entire staff. We had a great time identifying all the different birds and mammals we saw on the property.

reviews.title: Wish we were longer!
reviews.text: This was our first trip as a family to Trujillo Beach Resort. We own a house which we rent out on the property thur Eco Venture Tours. We were in port on the Norwegian Jewel on Jan 28th/2015, with other cruise ships arriving on and off in port. It was a great opportunity. The weather was sunny. The surroundings were very different. Our tour guide Alejandro picked us up and showed us our house and condos which are rented out from Eco Venture Tours. He bought our lunch in a little restaurant which was really sweet. We got internet and emailed home. The lunch was made for us and served right to us. Try the Banana Juice! Good. The beach with the waves rolling in took my breath away. How it was so beautiful. Seen lots of birds and iguanas. Definitely want to see Trujillo Eco Beach Resort again so we can stay longer. Would not hesitate to go again. The Edwards Family

reviews.title: Andre is fantastic...
reviews.text: We came to Honduras to check some land that we had purchased and Andre was an amazing tour guide. He showed us some great sites, took us to a great restaurant and was very hospitable during our stay at the Eco Resort. I would highly recommend him.

reviews.title: Great place to escape from the city and enjoy nature
reviews.text: Great, spacious villas and condo's in a lovely setting. Access to beach and nature within walking distance. Within driving distance to hot springs and the historical city of Trujillo. Rooms are comfortable, fully equipped and clean. Service was very friendly and wifi was great. I was sorry I had to leave. Will be back soon!

reviews.title: Good but too far from anything!
reviews.text: Very nice venue, professional staff, beautiful scenery. The only downside is the location. Too far and remote from Trujillo that I would recommend that you stay closer unless you plan on staying in this venue the empire time.

reviews.title: Family vacations
reviews.text: As we arrived to a beautiful Trujillo Beach Eco Resort we were stunned how beautiful and natural place we come. We had a party of 5 adult and 1 teenage boy with us and we stay at beach front condos we have 2 units and we loved it. We stay there for one week and we enjoyed every single day with swimming, hiking, walking on the beach and watching the wild life. We also rent a car so we can explore the surrounding around the resort and go to town and visit some other attractions that Honduras can offer. We also ordered some food from the restaurant and have it delivered to our place and I can say that my teenage son is very picky with food so I was a bit afraid he won’t eat but the big surprise came when he eat his food and ask for more. Food is excellent 👏 the staff at the resort is very nice and polite. I will go back again and we will also recommend this place 100% thank you for everything the guys did for us😀

reviews.title: Best hotel experience in the north coast of Honduras
reviews.text: My family and I stayed here for 3 days. Albeit short we fully enjoyed our stay and was definitely the best part of our Easter holidays in the north coast of Honduras! The staff was very friendly, professional and went out of their way to help us out (we arrived late) and always made us feel at home! Food options although not extensive were very good! We enjoyed some local specialties including "sopa marinera" which is prepared from fresh fish and seafood, "desayuno tipico' etc Every day at night during our stay the hotel staff surprised us with an activity (egg hunting, piñata party, etc) which we all, including our daughter, very much enjoyed! We would definitely recommend this place and be back!

reviews.title: The staff of Beach eco resort, especially Polo Pavon, was amazing!!!
reviews.text: The resort is located far away from anything, to relax and get away from it all. The staff there, Polo Pavon, Alejandro and Bessy were incredible. They went the extra mile in everything they did. I wish all hotels and resorts had people like this. The condo was pristine with all the amenities. The food offered by the restaurant was excellent quality. The down part, was the road getting there, and the lack of cell service, internet and cable tv. Otherwise we really enjoyed our time there. I would recommend this place for those who don't care about the technology and want really great service.

reviews.title: Nice place, quiet and far from the noise of Trujillo city, excellent service included
reviews.text: After 11 km. or about 25 minutes driving from the main road you arrive to the facilities, which include 2 sets of house and 2 condo buildings near the beach. Houses are fully equipped for small to medium families. Breakfast is included and service is excellent. From here it takes about 1 hour driving to Trujillo city so you can enjoy all the beauty of its beaches and other tourist attractions, while enjoying a nice and quiet stay in the hotel.

reviews.title: A Place to go to see but once is enough
reviews.text: So to be fair it had been raining before we got there and there was a lot of mud but there is very little to see and we did not need long there. I hope the place develops because the people were lovely. We visited the town Centre as well and this was small and friendly but nothing exciting. Nothing else to say at this time

reviews.title: A great getaway to a palce few know anyhing about
reviews.text: We visited Trujillo Eco-beach over the Christmas holidays and were surprised at how lush and wildlife filled it was. We stayed in the condos and had a private 5 km. beach all to ourselves. This is a new resort complex and is comprised of several ocean front condos, some villas and several private homes. Bikes are free for use and the trails are varied and easy to use. Nearby lush wetlands ensure plenty of wildlife. Onsite staff were amazingly helpful. We rented condo unit A5 which is right on the beach, and has a walk-out directly to the pool. The unit was completely furnished with all appliances including washer and dryer. I highly recommend this unit for those that want a private and quiet beach experience in an eco-setting. Two onsite restaurants (one under construction) serve excellent meals if you don't want to cook yourself in the unit.

reviews.title: Quiet retreat
reviews.text: We stayed on the resort for a few weeks in June. We were the only guests and super quiet. We enjoyed long walks along the beach and swims. The available staff was did everything to make us feel at home. We enjoyed the food in the restaurant and the pleasant weather.

reviews.title: excellent place
reviews.text: Very quiet place if you want to be out of everything including tech. we enjoyed a wonderful vacation , very good and friendly ppl at the hotel. The rooms are really nice, also the pool , the restaurant and recepcion still need work but, since you can make your own food at the cabin you dont use the restaurant to much bring your repelent you need tons of it.

reviews.title: Hondurain Hospitality
reviews.text: We had a great experience, good service and really enjoyed the restaurant. Found the resort to be a perfect location for a wonderful and quiet retreat. The resort has 600 acres of land and 4.5 kilometers of beach. The views of nature, plants and wildlife at the Resort were outstanding. We hiked and biked enjoying the trails, viewing monkeys, a vast array of birds, etc, all within their natural environment. Every day we loved those long walks along the long safe secluded beach. The sea has a nice sand bottom that goes out for a long ways without much of a current that was perfect for us to play in the waves. Our pool was very nice and was the luxury fully equipped accommodations. We also had many opportunities to be shuttled into the town of Trujillo for some grocery shopping and for strolling around. Absolutely wonderful vacation!

reviews.title: Quiet place on gulf blvd.
reviews.text: Siesta motel was a nice surprise from the beginning. The rates were fantastic and the room was very clean! They have a full kitchen and wireless internet. The owner Mike is awesome! He is very attentive to the property and it shows. If you are looking for a quiet place to relax without all the trash you see at most motels, then Siesta Motel is for you. Thank you Mike for a great stay!

reviews.title: Responsibility priced great motel.
reviews.text: We stayed here on vacation. We really enjoyed our stay here. It is a clean and comfortable mom & pop motel. All rooms have kitchenettes which are great. Great location, with easy walking to beach, restraunts, bars, etc. Maria, the lady who helped manage motel, quickly became our friend. Very sweet and friendly lady. Loved the fact that this motel makes accommodations still affordable in this area!!

reviews.title: Weekend get away
reviews.text: Very convenient to the Beach, walking distance to a great "mom and pop" place to eat that was not only reasonable in price but great in taste. First and foremost, this is a MOTEL, not a hotel, so arriving there my expectations were NOT very high. However, I must say, both persons greeted us and were pleasant. We called to make therm aware that our arrival would be late (11pm) they were very accommodating. Room was small but we were surprised with the small kitchenette with a full size fridge? We spent most of our time on the beach and out and about. We only returned to the room to sleep. Upon checkout our cash monies were returned with no difficulties. The placed is differently aged and could benefit from renovations, or at least some new and fresh linen. Well, it is what it is, for a Beach MOTEL.

reviews.title: DO NOT STAY HERE!!
reviews.text: My daughter n I reserved a room for 1 week. Our first day was awful! My mother n her friend picked us up at Tampa airport. She lives almost 2 hrs from there but was kind enough to get us to our room by the beach. After we checked n they took us to the grocery. We returned to our room n was unloading the car when Maria came screaming n yelling at us saying we owed her $22.50 each for my mother n her friend. I tried to explain to her they were leaving that they just helped us carry n our grocerys! She said we broke the rules n had to leave. Mike called a few min.later saying the same thing...we had to b out by 10am the next morning n would b refunded the full amount plus deposit that I paid n cash. The one night we did stay would remain on my card which was fine w/me. At check out the next morning it did not happen that way. I did not get my deposit back n they say they refunded my card(not showing yet) n I was to pay cash for the night. Which was higher than quoted. Room was cleaner when we left then when we got there. I made sure of that! This place could b very nice if the right people were running it! But the only place they r running it is n the ground. After talking to some locals this place has a reputation that proceeds them. Only hope is new management n No hourly (if ya know what i mean)rate!

reviews.title: Very nice quiet mom and pop place.
reviews.text: While the exterior made me a little nervous, the interior and inn keeper more then made up for it. First off, I had a problem with my reservation (my fault) and the owner was so kind and helpful getting us our room despite my mistake. The rooms were very nicely remodeled and extremely clean. There is no pool and it's not beach front. But the beach is just a short walk down the block. And it's a short beach unlike other areas where it's a half mile of sand before you reach the beach. They do have a few rules but it's meant to keep the place calm and quiet so if that's what your after I highly recommend. We will definitely be back.

reviews.title: Not brilliant
reviews.text: The room we rented for one night was classed as an efficiency and we were desperate for somewhere to stay. I would not stay in this place again. Why it was an efficiency I do not why. There were no crockery, cutlery saucepans or anything to even make a hot drink. There was a full cooker microwave and fridge freezer. I got the impression that they expected their clients to travel with all their own equipment. The manager kept asking if we had children or animals. Having said no once she then asked the question at least twice more. Also having paid for the room we then had to hand over $10 by way of a key deposit. Never had to do this once in the 27 years we have been travelling to the USA. Also I was told that in March the rate would be double what I was paying. I thought I was mad to pay what we did but I certainly would not pay any more. I don't know how this place keeps going well perhaps I do people like me to are so tired and just want a place to rest. We had one thin tired towel between us, no soap or any basics whatsoever. Fortunately we had brought our own towels. Could not wait to get out of the room and get my $10 back.

reviews.title: Scary owner with angry woman sidekick
reviews.text: These people are the worst. 1st he took $30 cash for keys. Overcharged my lil sis 30 from the cost online. When i went to ask y they ganged up on me said i could only stay 1 night now and locked me in the office. I was seriously scared. It was my birthday. They accused me of being on drugs, and i told them ill go somewhere else. Which we did after he refunded my sis card but kept the 30cash! :( ! the Malibu resort is great with a Pool and kind ppl. RUN!!!

reviews.title: Worst staff/ Management Ever
reviews.text: It's right on the beach, has a kitchenette, and it's super inexpensive. That's all that is good. The management treated us like criminals. Asked for a $20 cash deposit even though room was paid for on a Credit Card...who does that? Inspected the room before we checked out before they would return the deposit. Wash cloths and towels were ratty and they gave us a large dish towel to use as a bath mat. The man who runs the place milled around the motel and seemed to watch our every move as if we were untrustworthy. It was creepy. I felt more like a prisoner than a guest. The vibe was aggressive and unhappy and the woman manager was incredibly rude. I would never go back.

reviews.title: They called us lairs!!!!
reviews.text: Run don't walk....where do I begin!!! We had a third person join us at the last minute so we asked if they had a rollaway we could pay for...well they didn't but said it would be $23.00 a night....but we had to pay in cash. That right there was a red flag...they also asked for $20.00 in cash for the return of the key! We never received a receipt for anything...not even for our 3 night stay! The room was ok...nothing special.... The owners were rude. Not even a good morning when they walked passed us! My friend and I smoke...but we smoked outside as anyone would do. Well.....when we were leaving....they told us we burned the sheets.....WHAT? Really....I have pictures of the sheet....I saw the rip in the sheets the first night we stayed there...didn't think of anything...as the sheets were thin and old. Well now they tell us we burned the sheets. They also told us that we drank every night maybe we forgot that we walked into the room with a cigarette! What...now we are drunks and liars! I wouldn't stay here again...and hoping that people read this and stay somewhere else. Ohhhh we did give them their key back but never got our $20 back. They ruined our morning...as we had miles to go before are next wonderful hotel! Run don't walk.....

reviews.title: Quaint old Florida motel
reviews.text: One block from beach. A couple decent cocktail joints across Gulf Blvd. Motel is old but clean. owner/mgr. thinks she has to show you EVERYTHING...even how to use the TV remote. Coffee is outside portioned. PIA... Overall ok for the money. Would stay again if necessary.

reviews.title: Horrible Night of NO AIR CONDITIONING IN FLORIDA
reviews.text: Bad motel, manager-owner grumpy and not nice, room was yuck - shower only big enough to turn around, bed for 2 people a twin, stinks like old old motel, BIGGEST issue was the A/C did not blow cold air...sweating while trying to get ready for dinner date, unable to sleep due to HOT ROOM - ended up staying down on beach just to be comfortable-manager-owner brought to room - did NOTHING to fix problem and lame offer of $10 off room-what an insult. Did not offer another room or any fix at all. Left as soon as sun came up and to boot, check out at a beach motel is 10am...really? Saturday morning 10am?? Money paid was wasted. DONT STAY HERE UNLESS YOU LOVE STINK, GRUMPY PEOPLE and TO SWEAT ):

reviews.title: Very close to the beach!
reviews.text: This place was the absolute cheapest I could find that was close to the beach (about a 3 minute walk.) We were nervous due to reading some negative reviews. First of all, there was a mix up with my reservation. I think this made the owners leery of me and my daughter upon check-in. They asked us several times what day we had arrived in Florida, if anyone else would be joining us, and what we were visiting for. It was odd and uncomfortable. After the initial check in process, things improved a little. We liked our room and utilized the kitchenette. The air worked great and beds were nice and comfortable. The beach is basically in the backyard. The owners were friendly for the rest of our stay and the lady greeted us a few times and even gave us some tips on nearby local restaurants. There are several restaurants within walking distance. We had no issues at check out and our cash deposit for the key was returned. The hotel is not in a bad part of town but I would say the owners have dealt with a lot of difficult people which makes them less than friendly at times. If we would be able to get the same very low room rate we would consider returning.

reviews.title: Paranoid
reviews.text: Great prices prompted me to stay, but upon arrival I was subjected to paying a deposit immediately and interrogated that I wouldn't have any visitors at all! No matter what? Check out time was 10am and they were pounding on door at 9:30 to remind me! She actually inspected my unit before checking me out in case I had damaged anything? All my clothes smelled like Patchouli oil, I wouldn't stay again for free! Pay the extra, have your friends over and relax! Somewhere other than here.

reviews.title: great short stay
reviews.text: The location is great, really close to the beach in walking distance. The staff is very friendly, helpful and caring. The room we had was spacious and comfortable for a short stay. We would have loved to stay an extra night but it was fully booked.

reviews.title: NOT the Place to stay
reviews.text: I usually enjoy retro Fl hotels but this was awful. Booked for two nights and was charged almost the room rate ($68) for my service dog even though the web-page said $20 per night. Mike and Maria were constantly engaged in verbal battles and were down-right creepy. Roaches in the room capped it off. Not to mention that there are no beaches in Redington Shores that allow pets even though we were assured so when I called. That meant that my dog had to stay in the room except for periodic walks. Pay a little more and stay somewhere else

reviews.title: Just OK
reviews.text: This place would not be my usual choice, but it was just fitting the occasion. Price is average, rooms were clean, breakfast acceptable and sometimes that's all you need. The place does not have a "bar" in the classic sense, but just outside there are some nice restaurants and services.

reviews.title: Very good value
reviews.text: Far better than the usual Japanese business hotel with fairly large room, friendly staff and a hot spring. Clean and modern. For the price a very good deal. Free wifi. A short walk from the main railway station.

reviews.title: excellent location,spa, breakfast buffet
reviews.text: I enjoyed staying at this hotel. Very reasonable rate and good service. Free Wi-Fi, natural hot spring spa available, wonderful breakfast buffet. I will stay again if I have another chance to visit Kagoshima. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Onsen /Massage
reviews.text: We came to Kagoshima via Cruise and decided to go to an Onsen. When we arrive it was closed until 12:00. We went across the street for lunch then came back. The Onsen is 1300¥ which includes a towel. There were lots of choices on shampoo, conditioner, and body wash. There were 3 Onsens varying in temperatures. The one outside is for one individual. After the Onsen I asked about a massage. By far thebest massage I have ever had. No oils are used . It was 6500¥ for 65 minutes. Wow I feel awesome the relation rooms are nice as well. Thumbs up

reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: My wife ask me particularly to write a review for the hotel to show our appreciation for the good service provided by the reception. Specifically, this is to the old uncle, presumably the manager who show his caring attitude to us. We book a single room only for 2 adults and 2 children. The room can accommodate all 4 of us as the twin beds are big enough. We were being told that we had to pay extra for 4 however, the manager in seeing that my elder son was a special child, told his staff to waive off any extras. His kind gesture really touches us even told the extras we were suppose to pay is a mere $50. Also, each time I pass by the reception, I will be greeted. This is really great service. Not to forget, the room is also comfortable even though we house 4. The hot spring is good too. If something that has already been done for you, Arigatou gozaimashita ありがとうございました, thank you Silk Inn Kagoshima

reviews.title: Clean and modern business hotel
reviews.text: Rooms not large, but well planned and a reasonable window. It was about 10 mins walk from the station so not as well located as some. We had a rental car for a while and the parking was on site and below our window which was great. Staff pleasant and helpful for our first experience of an onsen. Only drawback was the washing machine which took ages and cost a lot and 3 hours later we still had damp washing. No problems with noise. Wifi was good

reviews.title: Hotel & SPA
reviews.text: Located 5 minutes walk from the railway station, good sized room, quiet aircon, comfortable beds and reasonably sized bathroom. Good value and clean. The spa ( onsen ) was the highlight. Spacious and a choice of hot or boiling - just fantastic after a day's walking around the sights. In-house restaurant very good but a great cheaper option on the road back to the station. Car rental place almost opposite hotel.

reviews.title: Fantastic hotel and spa!
reviews.text: I can't recommend the Silk Inn in Kagoshima highly enough. From the warm greeting we received in English upon our arrival to the delicious breakfast buffet we enjoyed right before we left, this hotel was an absolute find. As a Japanese American who speaks very little Japanese it is often difficult to find hotels in smaller Japanese cities and villages that welcomes me so wholeheartedly and with such genuine kindness. Perhaps the greatest testament to this was the fact that once we arrived at the property, we didn't leave again until we checked out. This is almost unheard of for us, as we usually like to explore the cities till late at night, eating at small, local establishments. However, when we arrived at the Silk Inn Kagoshima, with its kind staff, warm interiors and spotlessly clean rooms, we truly didn't want to leave. The spa, as other people have stated, is fantastic. Tastefully decorated, clean and completely relaxing. The woman's side had three baths, and all were hotter than than what I had become used to in Japan. We also chose to eat in the hotel's well-priced restaurant. While the menu selection is not huge, it covers the bases perfectly: Sashimi, sushi, shabu shabu, black pork tonkatsu. The emphasis in the fish/seafood dishes is on the local catch around Kagoshima, and the sashimi was simply out of this world. Our room was decently sized and immaculately clean. Once we closed the door we heard no noise from the hall and we both had a wonderful rest (perhaps aided by the trips to the spa and the excellent dinner). Although the hotel was completely full, it never felt crowded or noisy. Breakfast was equally delicious, with many local dishes to try, including a selection that focused on specialities made of the local black sugar that Kagoshima is famous for. Perhaps the most surprising thing about the whole experience was the cost. At the height of the Japanese high-season, our room at the Silk Inn cost less than other rooms of lower quality in out of the way towns in Kyushu. We were truly surprised and delighted by this hotel and did not want to leave. I strongly recommend this hotel to locals and foreigners alike. I especially think that this is a wonderful place for foreigners to go and feel truly at home. Thank you very much for an excellent stay. I would especially like to commend your wonderful staff who made every effort to speak to us in English and strived to make us feel welcome.

reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.text: Great location a couple of blocks from the main train station. Easy to get to after a very long day of train travel from Tokyo. Very friendly front desk staff. Their English is limited but Google Translate helped when needed. Being close to the station gives easy access to the city tram and the local trains (as well as taxis and busses), so the various things to do in Kagoshima are easy to get to. The spa on the 2nd floor is very nice. Didn't try the on site restaurant, but even non-guests were eating there.

reviews.title: Surprised by the noise
reviews.text: I had only a brief stay, and overall, the hotel had plenty to offer. The availability of a late night restaurant is nice, the staff were welcoming, and the facilities were clean (though nothing special... Some things were outdated and heavily worn). The room rate was very reasonable, and the location, close to the bus stop, is highly convenient. However, I was very surprised at how noisy the hotel was, especially considering how this did not show up in many other reviews. The rooms were not sound proofed at all, so all evening I could hear other customers calling through the hallways, people moving around in the room above and adjacent rooms, cars and street noise, and even people talking outside on the streets. The windows to the outside don't seem to shut properly even when "closed". As I said, not a bad choice, but if I had it to do over again, I would have paid a little more for a better sleep elsewhere.

reviews.title: Perfect location, close to JR Kagoshima Chuo Station, airport bus terminal and AEON supermarket
reviews.text: Stayed at this hotel for 1 night with a kid. The location is excellent in Kagoshima city centre. Just next to airport bus terminal, JR Kagoshima Chuo Station, city tram terminal , AMU Plaza and AEON Supermarket. It is easily accessible to all parts of Kagoshima. A 24-hour convenient store at the corner of the main road. The hotel is clean and the room is standard in size (Japanese standard), not big but not too small. There is a air purifier in the room which is great. Everything is clean and decent in the hotel. The free onsen in the hotel is a bonus. The onsen is indoor. Hotel guest can go to onsen with your room key card anytime during the opening hours! There are massage services available at the onsen but didn’t tried this time. You could just ask the staff to reserve massage service if needed. The service of the staff is very kind and they can speak good English. I enjoyed the Hotpot dinner (Shabu shabu) at the hotel restaurant. The Kagoshima pork is super tasty and the sushi is fresh and nice! The dinning experience is great at the hotel restaurant. The hotel also has laundry room (washer and dryer in 1) so that you could wash your laundry by the coin operated machine. Very easy to use! Overall, this hotel is great and I would stay here again when I travel to Kagoshima in the future! Highly recommend to family or couple travelers!

reviews.title: Excellent location, service and onsen
reviews.text: This hotel is a few minutes walk from the Kagoshima Chuo station. It has nice onsen facility and offers great breakfast, featuring many local dishes. It has free WiFi and air purifier. Onsen has two tubs for the men's side, one with lower temperature and another one with higher temperature. The single room is compact size but it is fine for resting in bed and sleeping. I highly recommend this hotel in Kagoshima.

reviews.title: Great hot spring, great service!
reviews.text: Very nice reception service, we've been given a lot of advise for transportation, room was clean, hot spring was very great, very good location as well, just less than 5 mins walk from airport bus terminal and close to every sight-seeing places. we enjoyed the stay, thank you! Arigato!

reviews.title: Oh Yea !
reviews.text: Great choice to stay here. It has a Japanese onsen ( natural thermal water bath), spa with great massage, quality rooms, great location close to main train station. Room was very good, comfortable bed.

reviews.title: Clean, large and chic hotel room with onsen
reviews.text: The location is bit far from JR station but near the airport bus station. I stayed here two nights in premium twin room. The room is on the 7/F which is the highest. The room is really large with a massage sofa. The toilet and bathroom are separate. There is an onsen on 2/F and we visited every morning and night. Also, we tried the in room message which really made us relax and great in value. I will definitely stay here again when visit Kagoshima.

reviews.title: Convenient hotel with onsen
reviews.text: Hotel close to airport bus station, staff can speak English with smile and very good service. Bedroom size space good enough with big window allow a lot of sunshine, speed wifi, sufficient daily essential inside room, hotel area clean and tidy. bedding size is big and comfortable. Onsen facilities are good for relaxation. But room to room divider and corridor sound noisy and flushing system is strong but loudness. Breakfast is in Japanese style with not much choice but tasty. Receive a small gift when check in and out. Hotel close to market, restaurant, shopping center and central JR station.

reviews.title: Nice Hotel
reviews.text: Room is good. Reception staff is good. Nice osen in the city. Just 10 minutes to the JR station and the kagomma furusato YATAIMURA. There is a local super market near the hotel where u could buy cheap and nice ingredients.

reviews.title: Great Service, Location
reviews.text: Stayed at this hotel for only one night, but was pleasantly surprised by the nice service. Even though I do speak Japanese, I was greeted by great English service. Also received a free drink at check-in and check-out. Only about 5 minutes walk from Kagoshima-chuo. I didn't try the baths, but they looked nice, and the room was small but comfortable. The restaurant was also very good. Would definitely stay there again.

reviews.title: Decent hotel, Location near train station
reviews.text: Quite standard amenities for a Japanese hotel. However do take note if you are intending to wash your clothes. The washing machine is based on program settling and once you set it, there is not way to off it until the whole cycle is completed. If your clothes are not able to withstand hot dryer, please do not use the laundry service.

reviews.title: Great value, lovely place to stay
reviews.text: We stayed for two nights at Longo Vezo. Everything was well arranged: the owner had arranged someone to pick us up at the Tulear airport, and then take us to the ferry with a zebu cart through the shallow water. Very efficient! We were a little disappointed that we did not get the bungalow we had booked (closer to the sea), but we got it the second day. The location is superb: wonderful spacious beaches and lots of activities: make sure you check out the wonderful deserted island Nosy Ve, which was one of the highlights of our Madagascar trip. Also, the excursion to Tsimanampetsotsa N.P. was amazing and well worth the price (which admittedly is quite high). Nice place to socialize with other hosts. We had some great conversations with people from all over the world. The food and cocktails are also good; and value for money is excellent.

reviews.title: Poor clarity of pricing made for a bitter end to a great trip
reviews.text: I just recently returned from a stay here at the end of my 2 weeks in Madagascar. I have to report they were not at all transparent with the costs of both the room and the excursion we did. I booked via a local guide who handled all the logistics. My guide had contacted them months prior and asked them to book me a room. He asked if I could get a beach front chalet. He was originally told that was fine and at no cost change. But they then reneged on this and charged extra for the room, apparently telling him only when the bill was presented on check out. Also we planned to do the trip to Lac Tsimanampetsotsa and my guide was originally quoted at 100 euros, by Longo Vezo when he made enquiries to book. But then when we arrived, it changed to 100 euro plus fuel, plus the cost of the picnic lunch, which the latter again was only presented as part of the bill at the end of our stay. This lunch was 80,000 ariary (about £23) and all we got was a single bread roll containing a plain omlette and tomato and some mineral water! For comparison, a main meal is usually around 13000 to 16000. The time of the trip also changed and I wasn't told so I got up hours earlier than I needed to. Very disappointed that we missed getting to Nosy Ve because the only boat they were willing to use was one of the local sailing boats and there was a strong head wind. It would have been great if an alternative motor boat could have been offered, as we only had two full days there (there was one moored up but they refused to use it). I need to mention that this place does not have any plumbing. Apparently it is the same for nearly all the hotels in this small resort, so you can't really fault them for this, but be aware! You get buckets of sea water to wash with and flush toilets with. It was otherwise comfortable, nice beds, food variable, some nice, some just average, some (the picnic, pretty basic). Also avoid the cocktails in the village bars, they will mess you up big time! I have had a really bad upset stomach since staying there too. So all in all not a great end to an otherwise amazing trip. My room was not attended to during my stay of 3 nights, not that I was too bothered. It's quite a walk to the local village but bottled water is about half the price as at Longo Vezo so worth stocking up.

reviews.title: Really nice place, but the owner is a jerk. Oh and I got bed bugs.
reviews.text: Let's see, Anakao was great and the people there were awesome. Longo Vezo would have gotten much better reviews except this happened.... One day I woke up with some 40-50 bed bug bites all along my upper back. So when I requested to switch rooms, the owner, Eric, accused me of causing trouble and blamed it on the fact that I was American. He said, "oh you americans always cause problems." He basically called me a liar despite the fact my back was littered with bites. Of course, he later apologized and gave me the room free for the week that I was there. However, anyone who has been to Anakao knows how small and intimate the place is, especially at Longo Vezo where you all eat dinner together. So needless to say it was a bit awkward after the incident with Eric. Other than that, I loved Anakao and I found the place to be awesome. The diving was decent too.

reviews.title: Amazing Madagascar paradise, simple but fantastic location
reviews.text: We visited for two days foremost to bird watch on Nosy Ve (red-tailed tropic birds etc) and the place is a unique paradise. Calm (mostly sailing ships and no motor sounds!), serene, great food, vast beaches and good snorkling (at Nosy Ve). Very good service and nice people running it! The menu was changed every day, with good oppurtunities to eat fresh fruit de mar etc. If on Madgascar, go there!

reviews.title: Perfectly off the grid & absolutely amazing
reviews.text: What an amazing place to stay. Off the grid by all means. One can easily accept bucket showers as a little comfort to pay for this unforgettable experience. Totally lonely beaches, very quiet and as close to nature as it gets. Eric & Carole welcome you warmly, and the kitchen is cooking fresh and tasty. We have done our CMAS whilst we were here and Eric is the calmest & easiest dive master you can imagine. Credits to the great staff as well!

reviews.title: Good bungalows but average food...
reviews.text: Bungalows are nice and clean (even if we had always some bugs coming to visit us) even if a bit expensive. View is nice. Meals are sometimes tasty and flawless and sometimes not really good.... Dessert and starter are on the other hand very expensive. Breakfast is also a steal (12000Ar).... it cost as much as a meal for a bread (good home made bread) and jam.... Better to go next door at Lalandaka to eat where food is spectacular and very good value. Eric and Carole also offers a lot of activities like diving, quad, etc.... We didnt do it as their prices (and probably services) are much higher than to work with fishermen.

reviews.title: Amazing remote getaway
reviews.text: We spent 4 nights at Longo Vezo and had a wonderful time. Easily the friendliest and most welcoming place we encountered on our travels in Madagascar. All guests eat meals together and it was fantastic to be embraced even though we didn't speak French. Thanks Longo Vezo for a fun and relaxing few days. They were about to start running adventure watersports which I have no doubt will be great so look out for it.

reviews.title: Wild beaches and amazing food
reviews.text: Anakao is like a paradise of Madagascar and this place is also amazing :) we came here during rainy season and we were the only tourists not only in this hotel, but also in this beach :) it was raining and only once during five days :) Seafood in this hotel is so amazing :) we actually got anything we asked a day before lunch or dinner. All food is very fresh and for good price. Communication with owners was very quick and helpful. Communication was in English and that was really good, because I don't speak French :) Bungalow was in front of the sea and really clean :) Really great quality and service!

reviews.title: Great experience!
reviews.text: I have spent three nights at Longo Vezo and wished I could have stayed there longer. Bungalows are simple but comfortable and the price is great. The ones right in front of the beach are heaven. I loved the location of this accommodation as you can ready get away from it all if you want to. Food changes every day as it depends on daily catch so you know it is fresh and cooked with skill. Drinks selection was lovely. All staff are friendly and accommodating and the owner is great. He can organise trips and scuba diving and will look after you very well. Overall, perfect stay and exactly what we wanted from Anakao.

reviews.title: Perfect end of a very intensive trip
reviews.text: Carole and Eric are great guests. They create a very familiar atmosphere between the guest. You feel home. The bungalows are well located in the dunes far from everyhing. Spacius, great terrace with hammac and shares. They organise diving activities or excursions as well. We did the sailing to Nosy Ve, a small island with a lot of birds and nice snorkeling spots. The sailing was a top experiance: with a traditional boat over a wild sea. A must done. The foos was very nice and at a very fair price. We will come back.

reviews.title: Helpful, charming, and passionate owners offer great staying, food, and experiences
reviews.text: The best thing with Longo Vezo is probably the charming, passionate, and very service minded owners, who are two cool, relaxed, and professional french 'hippies'. They passionately offer great food, mostly freshly caught fish and seafood from the ocean right outside. They also offer and organise diving (which was great!), surfing, whale watching and some excursions in the area. I loved the whole experience and would highly recommend Longo Vezo!!! Stayed for 5 nights. The partially ecological place is secluded by nice vegetation and set right above the beach with a beautiful view overlooking the Mozambique Channel and the island Nosy Ve. The beach shacks, or huts if you like, are comfortable, spacious, cosy, and clean, with a feeling of privacy. With a few more comfortabilities I would definitely rate it as a 5, but that could probably take away the charm as well! I guess its a matter of taste and preferences. wifi is free during one hour after dinner, some huts have bucket showers, and a shared toilet.

reviews.title: Excellent service and exceptional dive sites
reviews.text: The best way to get to Anakao is by boat using the Anakao Express boat shuttle that leaves Tulear about twice a day during the high season. The lodge staff from the moment we left Tulear to Anakao and back were punctual and professional. The boat ride in and of itself is magical. The boat also drops you off right in front of your hotel or lodge. The staff at Longo Vezo are extremely sweet and accommodating, the food is exceptional - simple, always fresh and well seasoned, expect to meet new and interesting people too - the collective lunch and dining experience makes for great and interesting conversation with people from all over the world and don't miss the rum based cocktails and amazing deserts! The owner was very helpful in advising which activities to do, the excursions were very well organized. We went scuba diving twice, the center is an approved CMAS diving center, a legitimate and serious center, dive sites were breathtaking with majestic coral reefs...a must see! The accommodation was simple with all the basic amenities provided (something the website makes very clear, so no surprises there), expect quietness around the lodge, expect to be fully relaxed and momentarily disconnected from the world, listen to the waves crashing and star gaze. I will definitely come back.

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: I traveled to Anakao to surf , dive , enjoy nature and relax . Longo Vezo delivered in a highly professional manner all within the most wonderful atmosphere . The diving was world class , Eric is a master-diver with highest respect for your personal safety , enjoyment and care of the environment . The surfing was also world class , with a number of spots easily accessed . All the staff were very friendly and most helpful . Food was good and rooms clean and comfortable . Great views . safe swimming on quite quite relaxing beach . Loved my stay and will be back

reviews.title: AWESOME
reviews.text: I hadn't booked or informed in advanced and was originally only going to stay a few days. I ended up staying 7 nights, untill I had to return to Tana to catch my flight home. There are no palmtrees, not the luxery of a resort, but this is place is like paradise all right. They are the hotel the most distant from the village (15m walk), which means the beach in front of this hotel (or even right up to your bungalow) is usually quite abandonned and all yours. I enjoyed the accomodation/food (special needs, and they met them without problem) and hospitality of Eric, Carole and the staff a lot. My experience there is definitely in my personal top 10 best places to visit.

reviews.title: short break
reviews.text: Lovely welcome, very clean comfortable accommodation easy on street parking, very nice breakfast. Ann and Joe are great hosts and could not do enough for us. Would recommend and stay with them again. NICOLA & STEWART DAVISON

reviews.title: Heartful place
reviews.text: The owners Anne and Joe took so much care of their guests; something you don't experience so often... you feel like a special guest! the room was small but very nicely decorated and very very clean! the breakfast was made with lots of care and special consideraton; definitively a place to recommend and to go back again

reviews.title: A very nice place to stay.
reviews.text: My family and I spend 1 week of our holiday in Torquay in july 2013. And we really enjoyed that week. The guest house is really a nice place to stay. Very clean and cosy rooms, great breakfast, a bus stop right outside and last but not least the hosts. Anne and Joe are very pleasant, helpfull in any way always with a smile and a funny remark. We really will recommend this guest house and area as a place worth visiting. There are som many things to see and places to go, and staying at Whitburn is worth a try. Bente Jensen and family, Denmark.

reviews.title: Last minute weekend break
reviews.text: We booked here as a last minute thing as we couldnt get into our usual B&B. We were welcomed by a lovely, friendly couple, joe and anne. As the other reviews said the rooms are spotlessly clean and comfortable but not modern. CLeanliness is more important to us. The en-suite was small but practical and again spotless with a good shower. Anne provided fresh milk for the tea and coffee which is better than the usual UHT pots. There was a tv on the wall and free wi-fi was available. Breakfast was adaquate but we were disappointed at the lack of choice. We are used to fresh fruit salad, a choice of breakfast, and a choice of how you want your eggs cooked ie. poached, scrambled or fried. Here the cooked breakfast was just served with a fried egg. There was a small choice of cereals, some yoghurts and some pieces of fruit available. Toast was issued as standard with tea or coffee. The hotel is only a short walk from the town centre. Parking is available on the street outside. The guest house is at the top of a rather big hill so the walk back up is rather tiring. You can take the steps from the harbour but there are 121 steps that are very steep. Lovely views from here though!! Overall this is a very clean, cosy guest house, with hosts that are very friendly and nothing is too much trouble for them. We usually spend the same money elsewhere and feel we receive the little extras that make it special ie. toiletries, choice at breakfast, choice of drinks on complimentary drinks tray and little biscuits. If you want a clean comfortable guest house this will be fine.

reviews.title: Friendly and welcoming guest house
reviews.text: We stayed two nights and felt well provided for. For the price the room was well equiped with en-suite, digital TV + dvd player that we made use of and fresh milk for drinks. 10 minutes downhill walk into town if you find the cut-through footpaths, but we used taxies to get back. It's a short journey but incredibly steep so the taxi was cheap but well worth it. Lovely breakfast although 8am is quite a bit earlier than some other B&Bs I've stayed at... we did consider skipping it but in the end did have it as we'd paid for it. Check-out is early at 9:30am too. The owners seem very friendly and flexible though so if you wanted a slightly later check-out or something, I bet they'd be okay about it. Would stay again except now I know how mountainous Torquay is and not having a car, I might be tempted to look for somewhere with less of a climb to get back from the town centre - not a reflection of the excellent service though.

reviews.title: Home from home
reviews.text: Welcomed warmly by Joe and Anne who were great hosts with loads of knowledge and info of the area and what's going on. Breakfast was lovely and set us up nicely for the day. Great location and felt so relaxed and comfortable in our family room, would recommend to anyone and was surprisingly reasonably priced considering the time of year! Thanks Joe and Anne.

reviews.title: Friendly hosts
reviews.text: As a one night stop over the Whitburn was great and good value for money.Although the interior decor is a little busy the rooms were better than adequate and the English breakfast served set us up for the day. Joe and Anne were extremely welcoming and we had a great chat with Joe after breakfast and his local knowledge was outstanding .We'll be back!

reviews.title: good guest house
reviews.text: Great stay the hosts couldn't have been more brilliant, for the money this was fantastic, the furniture was very warming and the rooms were clean. Joe and Ann were very friendly and the breakfasts were delicious. The man in our family doesn't eat beans or tomato's but Joe put double everything on so he had more than plenty. It was quiet so you had a great nights sleep and a plus is there's a bus stop right outside! If you want the Ritz you pay for it! Brilliant Value, Brilliant Stay, Brilliant Hosts!

reviews.title: Will definately go back
reviews.text: Really nice place to stay, decor bit dated, but Anne and Joe made us feel very welcome, this is the only place we have stayed (and we have stayed in a lot of B & B's) that provide fresh milk and not those silly little cartons. Breakfast was excellent,. Next time we go to Torquay we will stay here. Anne was lovely and Joes eggs are the best. If you can get in here, stay here.

reviews.title: Whitburn Guest House
reviews.text: A great welcome when you arrive, lovely clean rooms and a full breakfast to start the day for you. What more can you ask for. Joe and Anne are there to help and advise you on anything you need to know about Torquay lovely people and the best of Irish.Will certainly stay there again. Kevin and Linda Murphy from Nottingham

reviews.title: Would recommend staying at Whitburn Guest House
reviews.text: Owners, Jo and Anne, made you feel very welcome, nothing too much trouble. Accomodation was exceptionally clean, beds made each morning, milk provided each evening for tea/coffee in room. Breakfast couldn't have asked for any more, juice, cereal, cooked breakfast toast and tea and coffee. Would say it took us 10 minutes to walk into town centre. Would definitely stay there again.

reviews.title: lovely hosts
reviews.text: We went to Torquay to see a show and stayed for one night at The Whitburn. en-route we were held up in traffic and were very late in arriving in Torquay we rang Ann and Joe to say we could'nt checkin untill after the show due to the holdup. Ann could not have been more understanding and wished us a nice evening when we arrived much later Ann and Joe were there to welcome us. We had a great nights sleep and had a lovely breakfast in the morning Ann was very attentive without being intrusive and had a lovely chat with her and Joe. This is a very reasonable B&B clean and welcoming if you want the Ritz pay for it. We'll be back thanks again to Ann & Joe

reviews.title: Recommend Whitburn
reviews.text: This guest house was very welcoming and comfortable. Joe and Anne made us feel at home as soon as we arrived. The beds were exceptionally comfortable and breakfast well cooked. In all, this was a very nice location and very good value for money. Quite near to the activities in Torquay but up a hill. Would stay there again and pass on to family and friends.

reviews.title: Brilliant and friendly place to stay
reviews.text: We were warmly welcomed by Jo and Ann. The room was spotless and was cleaned everyday. My mum is coeliac and her dietary requirements were meet without any problems. Fantastic place to stay and cant wait to go back.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: My Colombian family and I recently had a chance to stay at this guest house and we were thoroughly impressed by service offered by Joe and Ann. The rooms were very clean and the beds were quite comfortable. It is in a nice location and it was a short distance to the center of town. Torquay is a nice place and due to the wide knowledge of Joe and Ann, we knew where to go and what to do. The breakfast served was not only plentiful, but of good quality. They were very happy to offer extra food if we asked for it and we enjoyed it. We would definitely return and/or recommend this guest house to all who plan to visit Torquay.

reviews.title: south coast motorcycle trip
reviews.text: Arrived very tired after long trip. What a fantastic warm and friendly welcome we received, Joe and Anne made our stay one we will never forget. What a great couple, nothing was too much trouble. Room great, food excellent

reviews.title: "Friendly"
reviews.text: We stayed for three nights at the Whitburn which is a very friendly and well run business. Joe and Ann made us feel very welcome and their local knowledge regarding attractions and places to go is first class. They could not have been more welcoming or more helpful! The food is excellent (slightly limited choice but very tasty) and the rooms are basic but very clean and tidy. You are close to various places of interest/activities e.g cinema, ten pin bowling, restaurants, amusements, the town centre, museum and a fantastic marina. And if you're not good with hills (like us!) there is a regular cheap bus service or taxi ride (it cost us £5.25 to get from the town centre back the to B&B, which was very reasonable of an evening), or even a lift in a nearby carpark which cuts out most of the incline for you! We have been twice and will go back again!!!

reviews.title: great little place
reviews.text: we stayed here for 1 night , we were greeted by a very cheery lady who couldn't be more helpful, also the breakfast was very good . the rooms are a tad dated, BUT they were very clean and comfortable (which is more important to us than being shiny and new)especially for the price!!, the owners even put fresh milk in the rooms which is way better than the dingy little plastic uht rubbish. great location lovely people very reasonably priced...would definitely stay again

reviews.title: Old-fashioned!!! Very poor!!
reviews.text: In desperate need of a refurb!! The whole place was old fashioned and very dated!! Room a good size but very noisy. Don't expect a good nights sleep, because you won't get one!! Room seemed clean enough but on closer inspection we found a pair of dirty socks under the bed from a previous guest!! Nice!! Location was dreadful. Certainly needed a car!! Was not within walking distance of anything(unless you liked hills!). Would not recommend.

reviews.title: Amazing friendly place to stay
reviews.text: From the moment we arrived at Whitburn guest house, joe and Anne made us feel so welcome. They are so friendly and would go above and beyond for anyone. They made our little boy feel at home too. Joe went out of his way to write down all the aeroplanes that were taking part in Torbay air show on our first morning there and told us the best place to see them in Torquay, what a fantastic day that was. We will defiantly be returning and will certainly recommend them to any wishing to stay. Can't wait to return in the autumn.

reviews.title: Great friendly place
reviews.text: Anne and Joe took great care of us after we were double booked somewhere else. Joe went out of his way to find a room for us and they took care of everything. Anne and Joe made us very welcome, breakfast was great, rooms were really clean. We will be going back. Thank you for helping to make our weekend special.(our first weekend away in 2 years) Kim and Jeff

reviews.title: Small, friendly place to stay
reviews.text: Background to us staying at this guest house...At the start of July I had been ill and 3 days before we were due to fly out to turkey I was advised to cancel the holiday on doctors orders (not good idea to be in foreign country ill, I needed the nhs services). In order to try and rectify the abandoned holiday and try to appease our 14 year old who was bitterly disappointed as were we, we found this pleasant guest house online. I decided to ring them as wanted to speak to them direct and get a vibe on the place. I spoke with both Anne and joe who are a lovely friendly couple, we booked for a week and asked if we could extend by a further day or two if funds allowed. They confirmed if they had space then it would not be a problem just let them know in good time of our plans. If they were full and we definitely wanted an extra day then they would be prepared to assist in finding another guest house. In the end we did not have any additional days due to funds unfortunately. Upon paying for the holiday we received a confirmation email for the payment that evening. The following day we received paperwork in the post. Upon arrival in Torquay at the accommodation we were given a lovely welcome by both Anne and joe. We were shown to our room and our private bathroom (unfortunately not en-suite), I was worried but needn't have been. They offered us fresh milk on arrival to make hot drinks in the room, it was a lovely touch. They replenish the tea, coffee and sugar every day, they leave a chocolate biscuit also. They provide fresh milk on an afternoon and evening. They even accommodated my odd request of having a bucket in the room in case I was taken ill, (luckily it was not needed). They were very informative on the local area, attractions etc. We had a lovely holiday and went on a lot of trips. Breakfast was lovely and cooked by joe. There were fruit, cereals, yogurt, toast and a cooked breakfast if wanted, all in the price of the accommodation. Will definitely return in the future.

reviews.title: Family holiday
reviews.text: Joe & Anne welcome you into their home with open arms, and provide good clean accommodation with a good breakfast in the morning. Our daughter settled in instantly and was sad when we had to tell her we had to leave to go back home, but that is the effect Joe, Anne & Torquay has on you. Thanks Anne and Joe for making us very welcome and making it a great stay hope to see you again soon :-) Russell, Dawn & Peyton

reviews.title: Very nice stay!
reviews.text: First visit to Torquay enjoyed every moment and was very pleasant stay at Whitburn Guest House. Cannot fault our stay for the money. would recommend to anyone ! great breakfast and the room was really nice and clean. Only 10minute walk to the town center. joe and anne are great hosts and care to any request.

reviews.title: Very friendly and very welcoming
reviews.text: Ann and Jim were very welcoming and it was a very enjoyable stay. We stayed in the October half term holiday and they made sure that our ensuite room was warm and cosy.lovely stay lovely people and they couldn't do enough for us.

reviews.title: Loved it here
reviews.text: What a fab place to stay. We were warmly welcomed like old friends. Nothing was to much trouble. Breakfast was really good and hot. The fresh milk being supplied in a jug was a lovely touch, such a refreshing change. Room was huge in comparison to many places I've stayed, spotlessly clean with more than adequate toiletries and beverages. Will definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: A warm friendly welcome
reviews.text: Stayed for two nights. The room was spacious and comfortable, there was a good selection at breakfast and it was tasty, and the service was very attentive. The B&B is in close proximity to the town centre, as long as you're ready for a lot of steps down the hillside! We would definitely recommend the Whitburn and will likely be returning ourselves.

reviews.title: carol.dave
reviews.text: Stayed for 2 nights 27/28 June 2013.Very clean & tidy, excellent breakfasts, great value for money. Owners were very friendly & jovial, Another good point is a bus stop right outside. It was our first visit to Torquay & if we go again we will definitely stay at the Whitburn.********

reviews.title: Poor quality guest house
reviews.text: We stayed here with several members of my family with their kids etc and was really unimpressed with this place. The breakfast was very cheaply done and the vegetarian in our family was only offered beans, egg and tomatoe and that was it. No extra egg or bread or anything so her plate looked a joke. The rooms were very cheap and the whole place looked like they hadnt spent a penny on it in years. All members of our family agreed we would never stay here again but will definately visit Torquay as its a lovely place. Find a better quality guest house as theres tons around the area.

reviews.title: Excellent would highly recommend
reviews.text: Stayed here for 2 nights and was very impressed with the accommodation, location and service. The room was excellently presented and was quiet and peaceful. The hosts were happy to share local knowledge. It was very convenient for walking to town as it only took me 5 minutes to the main shops. My partner had to be up early every morning so they put out extra milk in the room and served him breakfast on the Sunday early. The breakfast is that good I didn't need to eat anything for lunch as I was still full! We would highly recommend this accommodation.

reviews.title: nice friendly staff
reviews.text: stayed there 3 nights with my 2 sons very friendly staff clean and tidy would recommend it to any one nice place within walking distance of town centre nice breakfast tv in every room tea and coffee and a choice of serials for breakfast or a full English breakfast whitch was very nice

reviews.title: Friendly Staff
reviews.text: Friendly staff with good english spoken, very clean toilet block, good pool,pizza and bar area .Good stop over point gates are locked at night and do not open till 8am. It is near the main road but that was not a problem for us.

reviews.title: Good site, but could be even better ...
reviews.text: There is no better centre from which to visit the wonderful towns of Rapallo, Santa Margherita, Camogli and, of course, Portofino. Camping Miraflores is, literally, right on the motorway junction, and it’s so simple to jump off the autostrada and tap into this wonderful part of Liguria. The campsite owners are very friendly & helpful and there were quite a few motorhomes on site, even in April. The pitches are generous & level, and all have electricity & water. In season, there is a minimart, a restaurant, a small swimming pool and a children’s play area. It’s not the cheapest campsite we’ve found, but it does have advantages. Some five minutes from the campsite is a bus stop with frequent buses covering the 2km into Rapallo itself. Buy your tickets at ‘Isterika’ Bar for €1.80 per person per journey. From Rapallo train station, it’s a short walk to the boat that shuttles back & forth to Portofino … a must-do trip. There was most of what we needed on the campsite, including free WiFi, but there was not enough hot water - what a shame! If you’re a man, and you want a wet shave, you have to do it in cold water or under a warm shower. I’m not sure why this omission exists, but it is a bit of a problem. At Italian prices, you do expect to get the full package, and that includes soap, toilet paper and some way to dry your hands.

reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text: A lovely place to stay with all amenities,friendly staff and spotlessly clean. Rapallo is nearby,but not dog friendly on the beach. The buildings are pretty though and there is plenty of lovely buildings to look at

reviews.title: Good camping and excellent restaurant
reviews.text: Stopped off here for one night the 15 June. After riding for 2 days in rain through France it was good to pull off the autostrada and camp in dry conditions. The pitch was sheltered and although the site is next to the autostrada there was no problem with traffic noise. The restaurant had an excellent range of pizzas as well as other foods. I selected the pizza miraflores which was spiced with chillies I also had a carafe of the house dry white wine. Total bill 7 euros. The pizza was excellent and would have made a meal for 2 people I struggled to get through 75% of it, there was so much. The free WiFi worked well in the restaurant but was patchy elsewhere on the site. A good campsite that is well worth a stay, I was travelling south to a motorcycle rally otherwise I might have stopped for several days.

reviews.title: Very dirty
reviews.text: We stay there one night only fortunately ( 21/07/17-22/07/17) ! The owner ( one old man with the withe hair) is very rude person ( could be the reason the "ligure" people have this fame) . We stay there with our friends with a tent .Space wasn't big but this for Liguria place is normal ,bathroom is only one big near to the swimming pool and is not clean,other very small ,are not clean and very poor quality. Place is located near to the height way and in the night is a lot of noise. Swimming pool is very small and not clean! I don't advice this place !

reviews.title: Great Site for exploring the area.
reviews.text: Spotless facilities. Tasty pizzas and snacks. Refreshing pool. Fast wifi. Small shop with essentials (beer, wine, water, toilet roll and more) Brilliant and helpful staff. Close to toll plaza, but plenty of trees to silence traffic. Only a light sleeper would be annoyed. It is just over 1km to Rapallo town but an easy walk or cycle. Coop supermarket 10min walk. Toilet roll not supplied, neither is hand soap so take your own. Reception and bar closes for lunch.

reviews.title: A great friendly campsite, though traffic noise can be high.
reviews.text: This is a good campsite, average prices for a campsite. It has showers, toilets, camping car facilities, electricity, a great-very clean swimming pool, a bar and pizzeria. The owners are very hard working and helpful,speak to the lady for English. Its positioned near the toll gates of the a12, easy to find, but can be noisy with traffic on the autostrada, but is a good location to explore liguria and the cinque Terre. So overall a good experience.

reviews.title: A little gem
reviews.text: Situated at exit 12 of the autostrada, this campsite should not be dismissed because of its proximity to the motorway exit.
