The "common areas" like the hallway and the poolarea, can be a bit odd. When entering the hallway there is an old refrigerator next to the door and litter lying around the property. It seemed like they really tried to clean and maintain the pool. The locationwas very good - 1 minute walk from Clifton Hill and 10 - 15 minutes walk from the falls. My point is: if you are on a budget and wants to stay centrally located, this is a good option. But if you are used to staying on Hilton, this might seem like a very bad place to spend a night. We would stay here again.

reviews.title: Great, affordable & close to everything
reviews.text: Clean, close to everything & quiet. The owner was very curious and helpful. I'd go back. If you want a 200 dollar plus room, then get one and pay there 20 dollar breakfasts too. This is a great place. Room had air, cable, fridge, and was very clean. Not too sure what that other person is talking about... there was a window in the room and all the rest of them did too...

reviews.title: Where's the Pool?
reviews.text: The website says there is a pool, but there is none. Small room, dingy hallway leading up to rooms. Parking is an extra $10 per day; need to walk across the street. Didn't go to restaurant in basement - stairway did not look inviting. The bed was ok. The window looked out to a wall of another building 6 feet away. The main reason we chose this place was because it was within a mile or so of the falls. But at nearly $200 for one night, it's way overpriced!

reviews.title: BED BUGS
reviews.text: This hotel is outwardly quite dilapidated. However, this would not have been a problem if we hadn't woken up the following morning with horrible bed bug bites. We have not been reimbursed and the proprietors have largely ignored our calls - I doubt that we are the only guests to have been affected by bed bugs. I hope that others will come forward. FOUL.

reviews.title: Dumpiest hotel I've stayed in
reviews.text: I don't know where to start. When we entered the room the tub was full of undrained leaking water. They didn't give us any towels. Nothing in that room could have been newer than 1950, including the refrigerator. We couldn't access the Wi-Fi, and it was limited to 30 minutes even though it was advertised as free. The chain on the door was broken off, so we had no means of securing the door at night. The whole place had a funny smell. To contact the front desk to check in/out/get information we needed to call the manager's cell phone, which costs a small fortune in roaming fees with our American cell phone plan. We tried to check out a day early from our two day stay, but the manager would not refund our money.

reviews.title: would not recommend for sure
reviews.text: Stains on towels. No fridge No microwave inside. People smoking right outside the entrance to hallway. Smells in hallway. Shower temperature would not stay stable. Carried from warm to hot to cold..also too dirty.will never back a gain to this place “parking not included. Room was very small and bedsheets were dirty, Very poor customer,the staff was so rude in the office. 눇

reviews.title: Good value great location
reviews.text: The room was very clean with three queen size beds. It was close to everything the staff did everything they could for you. I would recomend to anyone with a family. Will go back this summer you really can't get a better deal for a large group

reviews.title: Perfect Hotel for a cheap break away
reviews.text: Myself and my partner stayed here for one night on the 13th of August. Honestly, we were both a little apprehensive as this hotel gets a bad rap online. On check in we were greeted by a lovely young lady, we then went to our room which was basic but clean! It had AC and a very comfortable and super clean bed. The only downfall of the room was it had no window which wasn't really a deal breaker for us. The location of this hotel is perfect a 5/10 minute walk to the falls and a 3/5 minute walk to the attractions on Clifton Hill! Great Hotel needs more credit! Definitely good value for the low price!

reviews.title: Discusting
reviews.text: 1 night stay and I was glad to get out of there stains all over one of the beds everywhere just felt dirty. no one there to check us in or out. It's cheap but you can get nicer places for the same amount.

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: The staff was great, very friendly. Very close to everything it was so close walked most every where. This place was easy to find. The rooms were a little small but clean. Would most likely stay again in the near future.

reviews.title: Fine
reviews.text: It was fine, not too good, but not bad either. Rooms were a bit cramped, but price and location are good. It is located not far from Clifton hill and there is a small alleyway providing quick access to the street behind.

reviews.title: Better than where we had escaped from ......
reviews.text: Bit of a story behind how we ended up staying the night at The Falls (see review of Susan's Villa), but let's just say the family were happier staying here than where we were supposed to be. We arrived late and pretty fed up; the man in reception was very helpful and overall we got what we paid for. If you are expecting lots for your money, then you'll be disappointed. This is a cheap motel worthy of a single night stay.

reviews.title: It is what it is
reviews.text: Very cheap hotel (we got a room for 68$CAN). However with that comes very basic amenities, rooms were a little old smelling but, they give you a clean place to sleep in and a place to clean up, and that's all we were looking for. Not great if you want a place with WIFI but we were basically only there to sleep so it was fine for what we needed. If you're looking for something fancy and more modern, not the place for you. All in all, for the price, it could be much worse. Location is the main selling point here, close to pretty much everything.

reviews.title: Would return - Not overly impressed
reviews.text: This was the 1st time EVER in going to a motel that I went to check in at 2pm and they said "Check in isn't until 3pm". So we drove around this little town for an hour with nothing else to do, wife had a migraine and just wanted to lay down. Went back to motel at 3pm and they said room isn't ready yet, will be another 30 minutes. Front Desk apologized numerous times. Room was clean. No extra bedding for our extra bed. Shower didn't have a lot of pressure. They are renovating, but the place was still very clean even for the remodeling happening. Was impressed by that, but not the check-in service.

reviews.title: Business trip
reviews.text: The rooms were clean. The staff were very nice and friendly. The breakfast food was good and the staff were their to check if you needed anything. The internet was very poor. I had better use of the internet with my smart phone than my computer. My computer never did connect to the internet.

reviews.title: Average but one of best hotels in Huron
reviews.text: This is an attractive hotel. My room is large and bed is comfortable. The walls are very thin as I can hear everything in the hallway. I woke up during the night because it sounded like someone was in my room. The front desk staff could use customer service coaching. Yesterday morning I left the hotel early and politely asked if my room could be one of the earlier ones cleaned as I planned to come back at 2 pm for a couple hours before my evening meeting. She stared at me for a moment clearly irritated before finally responding "I will ask." I honestly was surprised that it was cleaned when I returned.

reviews.title: A great place to stay
reviews.text: Hotel is great! Nice and clean room was very clean. Housekeepers were very friendly and helpful. Two ladies at front desk in morning were wonderful and very friendly. The young dark haired lady working evenings was very rude. Too busy smoking,talking on her phone and watching movies. Breakfast had a great selection. Would stay here again.

reviews.title: Nice Place
reviews.text: We stayed one night on a hockey trip and there really wasn't anything wrong with this property. The staff was pleasant and the place was clean. The breakfast was normal for this type of property and there was quite a bit of space to sit. The only real drawbacks that we had were that the staff (almost all of which have dozens of tattoos and/or piercings) doesn't sit at the front desk so you always have to ring a doorbell to get service and that the rooms aren't very big. Based on other experiences in Huron this is one of the better places to stay.

reviews.title: Quality little gym
reviews.text: Kudos on this Hotel keep their little gym well maintained! It’s a rarity. Cable and machines all worked. No rust. Plenty of towels and a good multi-station machine. Staff and breakfast were above average. Rooms were clean but the carpets and couch and chairs in my Queen Suite were badly stained. Upstairs smelled musty but bed was nice. I would certainly stay here again just because of their fitness center.

reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: I was surprised at the negative rooms. I am pretty picky and was quite happy with this hotel. Room was very clean and comfortable. Staff friendly. Breakfast room large. Excellent choice. Husband loved the biscuits and gravy. Plenty of parking. Safe feeling location. I would go again for sure if I am ever in Huron again.

reviews.title: Nice nice and comfortable
reviews.text: Had to visit for a funeral visitation and the we found this hotel to be very nice. Beds were quite comfortable, breakfast was very good and the shower had excellent water pressure. We would stay here again. Thanks for a nice stay.

reviews.title: Good place to stay
reviews.text: I have stayed a several Quality Inns and this one in Huron SD was nice. The breakfasts were okay. Got food, different types of meats each day. The room had large jacuzzi, extra seating area and extra area to prepare food on. Very nice. The hotel is old and my room had two ac/heating units and only one work. Been nice to have known only one work. Management should place a sign stating not working. The extra heat would have been nice during the week I was there. Temperatures were below zero each day. Room was comfortable enough. The fitness center was nice but the ac/heating unit did not work. Management needs to have it fixed, or sign stating it is not working. The sauna in the fitness room did not work, did not look like it worked. Would be nice if it did work. It looked like it was in disrepair. If management does not want to have it in the fitness center either remove it, place a sign on it stating not working. The staff was friendly and helpful. I would recommend this hotel and I would stay here again. BigIsh

reviews.title: Grand son baptisim
reviews.text: Very comfortable, clean room. The only down fall. They put my X-Husband and I in a handicap room. He's 6 ft tall, he checked us in, I'm sure the clerk saw this. The shower is set up for short people, and wheel chairs. I'm not sure if they were full and couldn't put us in a different room or not. The breakfast wasn't hot. I had eggs, sausage, biscuit, and the gravy. Had a strange taste and Luke warm. I booked this room through here, so not sure why we were put in the handicap room, I didn't request it.

reviews.title: Good stay
reviews.text: I stayed at the Quality Inn in early summer. Check in was fast and staff was very friendly. I loved the drive up room on the back of the Hotel. 3 steps from car to room door.... wonderful. I want to go back to Huron during the state fair if my time allows and I will stay at the Quality Inn.

reviews.title: Good enough
reviews.text: Very friendly staff. Breakfast was standard, but well presented and fresh. The property is showing some age, but yet good value for the money. Rooms are quiet and the windows open for fresh air. Room was clean.

reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: Pretty average hotel. When we walked in it smells very bad. But the rest of the hotel was okay. Our room was fine nothing special the bed was extremely comfortable. There was a fridge and a microwave. They had some vending machines. We had a group that was working and medical event in town and they put breakfast out early for us. The staff was friendly.

reviews.title: Bad lighting
reviews.text: Friendly staff at check in. Half the lights in my room were burnt out on check in and were replaced the second day. The room was pretty still pretty dark Even with all the lights working especially the bathroom. Beds were comfortable enough. Fridge and microwave in room. Hot selection for breakfast included waffles, sausage, scrambled eggs. Yogurts, cereals, toast, bagels, fruit, coffee. Wifi connections worked well. No elevator. I would stay again.

reviews.title: Pretty Good Overall
reviews.text: This is better than some of the other options in Huron. Very clean and quiet, with nice comfortable beds. Breakfast was good, not exceptional, but probably at least as good as most in this category. The workspace was small, which is kind of a pain when you're a business traveller.

reviews.title: Much better than first impression
reviews.text: This is an older hotel. So it did not look to glamorous on the outside. The parking lot and the outside of the hotel could use some sprucing up to make it more presentable. Upon entering the small lobby there was nobody there. But we found the desk clerk outside. She apologised for not being at her post. But we seemed to be the first (early) guests for that evening, and the weather was nice and sunny outside. So we did not blame her. She was very friendly and expedient with the check in. Being an older hotel, the hallways and rooms were a bit on the narrow side too. But here end the negative comments. The hallways and rooms were squeaky clean, and the beds very comfortable. Plenty of towels and toiletries too. And very quiet! We were at the ground floor, facing the parking lot and the road. Later that evening a whole group of motorcyclists drove on the parking lot, but we could barely hear it. So we had a very good night's sleep. The next morning we had a very good continental breakfast in a bright and clean breakfast area. Everything was good tasting, and they had a wide variety of food items available. In closing: We definitely will be back when our travels bring us back to the area. (Note: We were visiting the "Laura Ingals Wilder museum in "De Smet".)

reviews.title: Not bad, except for some details
reviews.text: I thought the room was good...nice bed and bedding. The meeting room was fine for a hot/cold breakfast each morning, and worked well for a family get -together. I would have liked to use the in room safe, but the door was broken. The heating system was kind of noisy, but worked when the temperature dropped.

reviews.title: The best place in town but..........
reviews.text: I've stayed here a number of times for business reasons. Not many choices in Huron. The place is clean, well maintained. The water pressure is adequate. Cable channels are as good as most. The staff is polite and helpful. It has 2 floors and no elevator, so if you have a few bags, when you make your reservation request first floor. The coffee is awful, and the breakfast is below average. I'll stay here again, because it is the best place in town. (that means few choices available).

reviews.title: National Junior High Rodeo
reviews.text: Hotels being able to charge you for a night that you didn’t even stay is ridiculous! Claiming they called and left voicemails and lying to a guest is totally uncalled for. It seems they say they called so they can pocket the money since Choice allows them to make up their own rules. It’s a shame! Never again will we waste our time with Choice Hotels and their sketchy ways. We will be sharing with the better business bureau about our situation and how money was taken from us. Rodeo friends beware!!

reviews.title: only complaints were in the details
reviews.text: Lobby and room were beautiful, clean feeling, spacious. LOVED the room that opened to my car! Complaints: The microwave was unplugged and I had asked for the room opening to the car due to being in recovery. Having to bend over/squeeze between the furniture in order to plug it in was NOT appreciated! Also, one of the clerks did not get the memo about parking outside the door of my room. I'm sure they were new and I know for a fact that they are now educated because I explained to them myself that the reason I needed to be instructed to park on a certain side of the hotel is because that is where my room opened to. I did NOT appreciate having to carry my stuff through the hotel after I had paid extra to have a room that opened to the outside on the ground floor when afterward I discovered that there was a parking spot directly in front of the door of my room! But the clerk now knows... Also, being in recovery, it was very irksome to have all three of the bath products I put in the shower slide one by one onto the floor. Slanted shower shelves?? Why!?? But for the average traveler, it was a nice, clean room, with few problems. AND if you are careful to find out the RIGHT place to park, it's worth a few dollars to some of us to park directly in front of our room! The day staff was super nice, I will add.

reviews.title: Bad bad customer service
reviews.text: We were in town for a funeral wanted to get a bereavment rate (grandmas funeral) she said they could not do that because hunting season. Really dead animals are more important then family. How sad. We did locate another hotel in town that was very accommodating. I would never recommend. Customer service is so so important.

reviews.title: One night stay passing through.
reviews.text: I stayed one night traveling by motorcycle. The room was very nice and I had a pleasant night's sleep. There is a great little steakhouse across the street. My only complaint was that the desk clerk seemed annoyed to have to check me in. Not friendly at all, and almost dismissive.

reviews.title: Low End of Average
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed here for a weekend while we participated in an event that was taking place in Huron. To start, the man that checked us in was quite interesting. Not many words to say, but got us checked in and pointed in the general direction of our room. Once we got to the room, it wasn't what we expected. It was a bit musty smelling. It just wasn't great... At least the beds were comfortable. I'm not too sure what else to say about it other than, unless you're a Quality Inn die-hard fan, stay across the street at the Best Western. I wish we did.

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: I come to huron to see family and I stayed at the quality inn and it was the best stay ever. Rooms are nice and clean beds are good sleep like a baby the staff is friendly and the gm heather is supper helpful and really friendly and the grounds are very well keep would stay there any time... andthanks aagain heather for your help

reviews.title: Good Property
reviews.text: This is a nice property. The pool is very clean and nice. Rooms are clean. Price is good for what you get. Quiet at night and location in proximity to good restaurants is a definite plus. Would stay again if I was in the area.

reviews.title: Other rooms are probably better.
reviews.text: The loose back of the refrigerator cabinet vibrated with a roar when the refrigerator ran. The nearby ice machine racket was a disturbance, too. Add in a noisy exhaust fan in the bathroom. I also knock a point off for any motel with the sink in the bedroom instead of the bath. What motel executive ever thought that was a good idea? Don't forget to take the shampoo from the bedroom sink into the bathroom shower. My wife ran water through the coffee maker for tea, the water came out brown. Other than that the room was standard US motel. Two queen beds, flat screen TV with cable, ironing equipment, dresser, clock, small table with chairs, larger refrigerator, hair dryer, coffee maker, lots of pillows and a microwave. A big placard touts their adjustable shower head, but there was not enough water volume or pressure for some of the settings. Lighting was dim, the ceiling light especially, with nothing lighting the table. Breakfast offerings were Fruit Loops, Raising Bran, bagels, waffles, apples, orange juice, apple juice, yogurt and probably a few other items. I hope others have better luck with their room than we did. I have had much better rooms in bigger cities for less than the $71 ($79 with tax) we paid for this room.

reviews.title: Very friendly professional and helpful housekeepers.
reviews.text: Enjoyed our stay here. Amanda the young woman who cleaned our room was very nice polite and had a pleasant attitude. They need more staff just like her. Thanks to Amanda our stay was enjoyable. We plan to stay again due to her. As she changed our minds after being treated badly by the lady at the front desk.

reviews.title: Whish internet worked
reviews.text: Friendly staff, and very helpful. Free popcorn all you can eat. Room was fine. but internet was so slow it took over an hour to get to a site, and then slower yet. Do not stay if you need internet. ASKED FOR MANAGER TO CALL ME ABOUT INTERNET, BEEN ALL DAY NO CALL.

reviews.title: Great Staff and Service
reviews.text: A very large group of sports fans stayed here recently and we got nothing but the best service and they accommodated everything we asked for. Clean rooms. Great hotel with friendly staff!! LOVED this hotel!

reviews.title: Good Sleep
reviews.text: We just needed a place to sleep and this worked out. The interior was being remodeled and painted so handrails on steps were missing. However there was no paint smell. The breakfast was about average. The location was right across the road from a restaurant we wanted to try so that was good. We all got a good night's sleep.

reviews.title: If you are looking for comfort and quality
reviews.text: Thee only hotel to stay in Huron. Beds are comfortable for this tough sleeper. Staff is friendly and accommodating. Breakfast is awesome. Waffles biscuits and gravy eggs sausage cereals. All rooms have been remodeled and all have fridges and microwaves. Fresh Popcorn all day.

reviews.title: Quality Stay
reviews.text: Was a nice clean room. The breakfast was good the kids enjoyed the waffles each morning. We have stayed at other hotels in Huron and prefer this one over the other properties. The staff was friendly and showed us the various room types when asked.

reviews.title: Won't Stay Again
reviews.text: Have stayed here before when Pheasant hunting. Hotel needs updating for price. After totally unpacking for a few days stay we found we had a HUGE FLY PROBLEM in our room, lot's of fly's were coming out of ceiling fixture after killing 30 they just kept coming, and this was in November with cold temps outside. Desk clerk was pleasant and honest, explaining they thought they fixed that problem and found us another room. Coffee was the morning joke with guest in the breakfast area, light brown water, everyone said who ever makes it doesn't drink it. Ended up at Mickey D's for breakfast.

reviews.title: Our one and only stay at a Quality Inn
reviews.text: When we arrived the person at the front desk didn't seem too happy to see us. She gave us a room on the second floor (no elevator), which had a funky smell to it. We asked to be moved, so she gave us a larger room on the first floor. It was adequate, but nothing more. We won't be staying at Quality Inns anymore.

reviews.title: Very Clean, reasonable price great staff.
reviews.text: A wonderful customer guest rep meets you signs you in and directs you to your room. It is clean well appointed and comfortable. Not a large room but just a good comfortable size. The bathroom a bit small but it is very clean and the towels are decent.

reviews.title: Best hotel in Huron
reviews.text: I recently stayed at the Quality Inn, in Huron,SD. I was welcomed with a warm smile and hello, The staff was very friendly and helpful. The hotel was very clean and that is rare anymore. The rooms were very nice and the beds were comfortable. The grounds were well kept, and breakfast was very pleasing. Overall we had a wonderful stay at this hotel and will be coming back when we are in the area.

reviews.title: Great location, huge room and friendly service.
reviews.text: We had a very friendly welcome to IMA. We were given a free room upgrade to a room with a double bed, a comfy sofa style bed, a kitchen and dining table. The apartment was very big and had great views out towards central Berlin. IMA is located less than 5 mins walk to the underground station and is right next to the bus line that heads past check point CHARLIE. It was a great base for exploring Berlin. It is also really close to Oranienstrasse, a street with lots of cool bars and places to eat. We were given free wifi access in the room and there is a nice cafe in the hotel reception. The staff gave us lots of help with the public transport and recommending places for our first time in Berlin. IMA is within an old factory and also houses lots of art studios. It is a lively, alternative area of Berlin and we felt safe even when wandering back late at night. Was a bit worried after reading some reviews on here but our fears quickly disappeared when we had such a warm welcome. Would definately stay again and recommend to friends.

reviews.title: Fun people, Fun city, Fun place!
reviews.text: For those of you who's coming to Berlin and not only for the tourist parts, but to the clubs and the alternative lovely Kreuzberg, THAT IS THE PLACE. Ima is an apartments-hotel, that makes the place perfect . On the one hand you get a big loft-apartment with kitchen, leaving space, bath, we had an apartment with a good city view (If you coming a group of people that's even very cheep..). On the other hand there is no lobby,it's not hotel, but there is a great IMA cafe down with a great great food, warm friendly, young and trendy atmosphere. I'm counting my days to my next weekend in Berlin (in May!), I will not go to any other hotels but Ima. Thank you for making this new years eve so so so...!

reviews.title: Very nice !
reviews.text: We had lots of fun there, location is very good, many things to do in the area, urban vibe, very nice rooms with good decoration. We were almost every night in the coffee located down stairs, all in all excellent value for money.

reviews.title: Pros and Cons
reviews.text: To confirm what a lot of reviewers are saying: The lofts are situated in an old warehouse. The location is ideal who wants to stay in Berlin, but not there where al the tourist go. It is situated in Kreuzberg, a very lively, alternative neighborhood. Near Clubs and Bars if you are into that and close to two metro stations (Moritzplatz and Kotbusser Tor. There are mini lofts and large lofts. Furntiture is IKEA style - need to be a bit fit to get up the bed next to low roof. Showers and Faciltities okay, free Wifi. NIce attentive staff who showed us the room and set-up the extra bed for us! Small breakfast for E5, you are better going down the road to the cafe/doner and other eateries. Quite original place to stay...but A bit overpriced for E85 per night for a mini loft - ok for 2 or 3 people, expensive for 1.

reviews.title: Way too noisy
reviews.text: The apartment was a good size and reasonably clean and comfy. The staff at check-in were very friendly. However, the noise from the construction site literally yards from our door woke us up early each morning, which would have been ok if we hadn't already been awake all night listening to the rowdy drunks in the courtyard. The lack of sleep really spoiled what should have been an enjoyable break in a fantastic city.

reviews.title: Very good apartment
reviews.text: The staff were very helpful, we didn't arrive until 9pm and the lady came from home to give us our key and showed us around. There is a lovely courtyard outside the building and the lift to the rooms was a scary novelty at 2am! The lofts are spacious and modern contrasting the outside factory look. Quick and free WiFi. Wasn't hard to get into the center of berlin by walking or public transport. The surrounding road didn't look to safe, but had no trouble over our 3 days so no real negatives from my experience.

reviews.title: owners unreliable
reviews.text: do not rely on owners transfer to / from the airport ... they are totally unreliable. We have had a very bad experience, we risked losing the return flight. cleaning is not the best, and when it's hot it suffers a little.

reviews.title: Great place in interesting area
reviews.text: My son and I stayed here in May for about a week in a mini loft. We really loved the area which was handy to central Berlin and was lively and interesting. We also loved staying at IMA Loft apartments, which were extremely handy to a great street with restaurants, bars and cafes (Orienstrasse), and to three U-bahn stations. We had no reservations about the attractiveness or otherwise of the area - in fact we liked this and felt safe. We stayed in a mini loft which was comfortable, secure and had everything we needed. The staff are very welcoming, helpful and friendly and were willing to extend themselves at times when we needed extra assistance. The mini loft is perfect for two people, however be aware that the platform where the bed is has a very low roof and steep stairs so if you are less than reasonably fit or have a bad back or need to get up often in the night, then consider another style of apartment. We had no problems with this however, and it was quite comfortable. In any case there is comfortable bedding provided downstairs as well. I would rate this place as excellent but feel I need to take one point off for a slight problem, which was an odour under the kitchen sink that I believe is due to slow drainage, however it was not intrusive and was, I think, an unavoidable feature of an old building. There was construction going while we were there and we did hear the workmen a couple of times, but again whilst this was not aesthetically pleasing (think scaffolding everywhere), it was not intrusive. I would highly recommend the loft apartments.

reviews.title: I like it!
reviews.text: This is not just a hotel, it is something more than a hotel. Large apartments with a kitchenette. If you want to save money on eating out you can even cook there - there are all you need for this tool, and even spices such as salt and pepper. IMA is particularly suitable for those who like to party, because Kreuzberg awake at night. Despite this, it's very quiet.

reviews.title: Excellent stay. Was perfect for us.
reviews.text: Two mates and I stayed in an apartment which was in the renovated factory-type building. The room was pleasantly decorated in a nice style and contained mini kitchen (with cutlery and condiments), fridge, table and chairs, sofas, television, comfy beds, towels, and the bathroom had sink, shower and toilet. Everything we could have needed. The building was quiet, safe and the staff, especially Yvonne the boss, were extremely helpful, flexible and caring. Its situated in the wonderfully artsy Kreuzberg district and is within easy walking distance to anywhere in Berlin (in any case there is the fantastic German public transport). Excellent stay. Berlin is the greatest city.

reviews.title: Great apartments in a convenient location
reviews.text: We had a great stay in these apartments, it was brilliant to have your own independent space in the middle of Berlin. Our apartment had great views across the city towards the TV Tower. The location was excellent, between Moritzplatz and Kottbusser Tor U-Bhan stations, so easy access yo anywhere in Berlin. Also close to the bars and restaurants of Kreuzburg. Some have said that the street these apartments are located on is a bit undesirable, and whilst i'd agree that the area around Kottbusser Tor station has a few odd characters, we all felt completely safe in this area both during the day and very late at night. These are apartments and very much for those looking for an independent stay, i think we only talked to staff when we checked in and left, so don't stay here if you're looking for a hotel style service. I'd highly recommend the IMA lofts for anyone looking for a great value, independent accommodation option and an excellent location. Two thumbs up from me.

reviews.title: Huge open plan apartment.
reviews.text: Stayed here for 3 nights in December. The open plan studio was large with a dining table and a sofa for relaxing. I didn't end up cooking so I don't know how good the kitchen was but it seemed to be well equipped. The room was clean and the location was good. Only a short walk from multiple stations.

reviews.title: Tragedy
reviews.text: Failed to maintain even a quarter of what we were told in advance. The place is dirty, clean is terrible in the cafe. We got an apartment with used kitchen, no one washed there. We opened the holiday with 2 hours of cleaning and it didn't continue better.

reviews.title: Cancellation at the last minute without alernative
reviews.text: I had reserved 3 nights from 29.06.2013 to 02.07.2013 at this place through booking.com and they have cancelled it today (18.06) because it is closed for some refurbishments. ccording to Booking.com they should have advised them and they should have provided us with an alternative at the same price. Which they DID NOT do. This is very unprofessionnal from their part and I would never recommend them.

reviews.title: Best place to experience Berlin
reviews.text: We went there for my birthday and we actually booked a miniloft, but as they were out of them they gave us a big one instead. Great concept, very clean, friendly staff, great location, good value for money. It was actually one of the most roomy places I ever stayed in. It's probably not for everyone though. The streets in Kreuzberg might look a bit scary and dim at night, but we did not have any problems.

reviews.title: Peace & quiet
reviews.text: The loft apartments are a good place for people who love old industrial buildings. The inner court yard, which is well away from the main street, offers a peaceful stay; the lofts are small and basic, but modern and clean; linen and basic kitchen ware are provided. The café offers a very varied buffet breakfast for only 5 EUR, and for those who need it, there is free Wifi all over the place. The small studio loft requires a good physical condition, since you need to climb in bed under the ceiling on the mezzanine, but is very cosy. The only downsides were that the fridge in the room didn't work (apart from the built-in freezer), so it was hard to cool drinks; the fact that the loud sounds of late-night party people ricochets off the walls of the inner court yard and wake you up, and that it is a bit off-centre if you want to go back for a rest during the day. The kitchenette only has a microwave (which we didn't use), but the place is located close to two metro stations (Moritzplatz and Kotbusser Tor), with a lot of bars, cafés and restaurants for all kinds of budgets in the surrounding streets. Definitely an original place to stay, if you don't care too much for luxury.

reviews.title: THE place to stay in Berlin!
reviews.text: IMA loft apartments is the place to stay in Berlin! It's located in a very young and trendy area with lots of nice cafes, shops, bars and clubs. all within walking distance! The lofts are spacious and designed beautifully. Staff at the IMA café downstairs is very welcoming and always happy to give recommendations for local places to go. The food at the IMA café is also very good! IMA is HIGHLY recommended, I will definitely go back myself!

reviews.title: Good for the price
reviews.text: My family of 4 stayed 4 nights in June. We stayed on 4th floor unit but it was more like 6th floor hike due to not counting ground floor as 1st floor and some between floor levels. Elevator never worked but I think they are working on it to fix it. Shower you have to be careful or you will have wet floor and they provided more towers when we asked for more. It is little noisy due to police station near by I think. Lots windows that works well and it has simple set up with IKEA type furniture. Hot water works well. Location is under 10 minutes walk from bus stops and subways. 15 to 20 min walk to good food. Neighborhood is safe for walking around. Staff is friendly and nice.

reviews.title: Loft apartments with an artsy, energetic vibe
reviews.text: We have stayed at the IMA twice now, each time for a week and we will stay there again. It's very affordable, fairly clean, and they allow pets. The factory that houses the lofts is quite something, though I don't know anything about its history, I'm sure it's got one. The IMA staff of three girls are very helpful and kind, always willing to cooperate and be accommodating. The noise at night is a bit much at times, but since the IMA lofts are located in the middle of Kreuzberg, there is no way around noisy intervals and noisy people. The elevator is kind of weird, so I prefer to take the stairs, although during both visits there was no lighting on the either the ground or first floors on the stairwell. That should really be taken care of. Other than that, it's a great place for the price, plenty of shops and stores nearby, and Potsdamer Platz is only 30 minutes away on foot. Heartily recommended!

reviews.title: Disgusting and right in the ghetto
reviews.text: Booked a 2 room loft and went there in may 2011. Since the building is located in a real ghetto, it was shock after shock when walking from the metro to Ima Loft. Passing by drunks, junks and more. When arrived at the right address, we could nog believe this was the place. It some kind of filty industrial building (the Mitsubishi logo is still on the main gate). Electrical wiring is all over the walls, hanging loose. The lobby is some kind of home made desk, almost falling apart, with a laptop on it. All of the furniture in the so called lobby are falling apart. The chairs where broken, the sofa was too filty to sit on..... One of the reasons we booked, was the fact they offered breakfast. After seeing a puppy dog walking around the kitchen, we never ate there. Now the elevator. It is located about 200 meters from to lobby, outside. After you walk into some kind of dark alley, you need to open the elevator with your key and hope that it is working. It is the most unsafe elevator i've ever seen in my life. The smell of dried up urine did not help either. We went there with 2 couples, which one of them had booked a so called luxery Loft (and paid offcourse a lot more for it). It is advertised with having a seperate bedroom. The normal room and the other room where exactly the same!!! the only difference the expensive room is 1 meters wider, they're both not having a seperate bedroom either, just one big room. After discussing some time with one of the workers, she stormed away anrgy saying that the manager will contact us. Offcourse he never did. we never did see one other co worker the entire weekend either. The room is filled with old and broken Ikea furniture. One of the seats were broken, the sofa was not safe to sit on, there where yellow spots on the bed, the floor was disgusting, the kitchen was extremely disgusting, the freezer had still food in it from past visitors, the pillows smelled like sweat, the front door would not shut correctly, there's no presure in the shower,................................. After cleaning the entire room ourselfs, we did manage to have a good time in Berlin. But Ima Loft is by far the baddest hotel/motel/appartment we ever stayed in, and this is included places in Afrika and eastern Europe. I do not recommend this to anybody, even not my biggest enemies!!!

reviews.title: Live the Berlin loft lifestyle
reviews.text: Ignore comments on here about safety and the snobish attitude to the IKEA furniture. Some Tripadvisors either don't do their research before they go, go with false expectations of what somewhere is going to be like or think everywhere should resemble a 5* hotel chain. This place is great. Lovely spacious loft spaces set in an old warehouse with everything you need for a stay in Berlin. CD player, clean bathrooms, fridge, comfy beds. The staff are very laid back, which can come across as not really caring about your stay, but if you don't expect the red carpet treatment then you'll be fine. Ten mins by cab to Berghain, 5 mins walk to Kreuzberg's bars and cafes and 2 min walk to a U-Bahn. If you want to stay in an area that feels like Berlin proper, thenn this is it.

reviews.title: �� Best way to explore the real Berlin.
reviews.text: Great location (old factory building) with nice people running it. Supermarket (open 'til 22 pm) around the corner. Also check pubs (Bateau Ivre), clubs (legendary So36) and restaurants (too many to mention) nearby Oranienstrasse and Skalitzerstrasse. This is Berlin how I ❤ it.

reviews.title: Great location for exploring Berlin & Kreuzberg area
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I were recommended these apartments by someone who has previously lived in Berlin and we were not disappointed - a great base for U-bahn access for exploring the rest of the city and exactly what we needed for a long weekend. The apartments were spacious with an arty feel and we did not feel intimidated by the surrounding area, in fact, we enjoyed the bars and restaurants in Kreuzberg and would recommend for young people wishing to see a different, more quirky side of Berlin (but acknowledge that the area will not be to everyone's tastes). We ate out most of the time so did not make great use of the kitchen facilities but they appeared adequate, as was the bathroom. (Although a plug near a mirror would have made it easier for me to blowdry my hair, vain I know!). We also had two delicious breakfasts in the cafe attached to the apartments and made use of the free wifi. Berlin on the whole was great value and would definitely return to the city and to IMA.

reviews.title: Do Not Stay Here - unsafe area, hotel does not help
reviews.text: I stayed here for the 2010 Berlin Marathon and I was forced to move hotels on my last night for my own safety (see later). The hotel is located in quite a poor part of Berlin, on the border of Kreuzberg and Mitte which is notorious for petty crime (at bottom of the street is the notorious Kottbusser Tor U-Bahn station). My main gripes are with the reception support and with the safety of the hotel. First, I arrived and was not able to pay the remainder of my balance using credit cards as their machine was not working. They could not be bothered to get it fixed so I was forced to withrdraw cash using my credit card. The 'free internet' was not working and they refused to fix it so I could only use internet in the reception until it closed at 8 (or 6 on the Saturday and 2 on the Sunday, just because it suited them). The staff were either ignorant or useless and some (like the Brazilian guy) never even spoke German. The hotel manager, Dann, was more like a stoned Basil Fawlty. The rooms never had a TV so evening entertainment was a struggle. Regarding the safety, the lofts are in a former warehouse and the staff do not always remember to turn on the lights. This means guests sometimes have to negotiate dark alleyways for about 300m until you reach an equally uniniviting street, where there was an assualt between the Friday and the Saturday, with police guard and cordon. AVOID!

reviews.title: Berlin Break
reviews.text: Lovely big apartment that comfortably slept 5 of us. Very comfy beds and well equiped. As previously said it's not the most beautiful part of town but the area is lively andf well located. The staff at reception were very helpful and helped us with maps, resterauntas etc. Many thanks for a great trip.

reviews.title: Great location and practically sound proof
reviews.text: After struggling to find an apartment to suit 11 of my friends and I we found and settled on IMA lofts. We were divided into 3 rooms, they were quite well furnished and enough space (whilst not being too big or too small) but the highlight of these lofts was that we often would have the 11 of us in one room having pre drinks or post-clubbing drinks and not one single person complained about noise. We couldn't even hear each other from next door. Overall this was a great place to stay. Although they only have one key for the room, so if you plan on doing things separately throughout the day... Don't bother because whoever doesn't have the key will be locked out!

reviews.title: My stay at IMA Loft apartments
reviews.text: Room was spacious for a singe stay, well equipped, area is calm, near city center you can walk till Alexander Platz or use the underground for 4 stations, helpful staff. In brief excellent in terms of value for money only one point to raise, the reception needs to be open for more hours

reviews.title: Nice but isolated (and noisy on weekend)
reviews.text: Stayed for 2 nights in July 2012. The room we had was quite spacious (much better than a subsequent apartment at the circus hostel) but the lofts aren't really that near any hustle and bustle. As we stayed on the weekend, the built in cafe wasn't actually open so in contrast to places like the circus or die fabrik, you need to walk some distance to get a coffee or a bit of grub. On the Saturday night one of the ground floor art spaces was used for a function which sent echoey beats around the courtyard until about 1am - bit irritating for anyone wanting to sleep. Staff are really friendly and helpful but if I wanted budget accom in kreuzberg again I'd go for die fabrik or michelberger.

reviews.title: Definitely pick it!
reviews.text: For those who like to stay in hostels, but look for an alternative in Berlin. It's in a great position if you want to see the otheriside of Berlin: Kreuzberg! Other locations in Berlin are also accessible by the subway. Two stations are close to the "hotel". Clean, big, modern, alternative and great value for money!

reviews.title: Acceptable
reviews.text: I loved that the lofts are surrounded by cafes, artists' studios, a dance studio, and close to plenty of good restaurants. Makes for a great atmosphere even if it isn't the prettiest part of town. We hired bicycles for two days and found Berlin very easy to get around. We had a 3-person apartment (2 upstairs, 1 downstairs on a sofa bed) and I have to say the sofa bed was VERY uncomfortable. The kitchen was reasonably equipped. We hardly spent any time in the apartment anyway, and as we were on a low budget, the price suited us perfectly.

reviews.title: Fair hotel, interesting set-up, nice atmosphere
reviews.text: Plus: relaxed staff, industrial elevator, lofty set-up, artsy features, clean room, beautiful courtyard, good atmosphere, good location Minus: too relaxed staff, no breakfast incl, all furniture from IKEA Bottom line: I would possibly go again. Try it out!

reviews.title: Ima loft : another way to visit Berlin
reviews.text: The lofts are situated in an old warehouse. The location is ideal who wants to stay in Berlin, but not there where al the tourist go. It is situated in Kreuzberg, a very lively, alternative neighborhood. There are mini lofts and large lofts. We've ordered a miniloft, and received an upgrade (free) to a larger loft. At time of checkout, we heard another couple that received an upgrade (free) because the lady was a bit older, and the manager was concerned that she would have problems to get in the bed at the mini lofts (2 meter from the floor, reachable by ladder). Downstairs is a cafe, were you can enjoy breakfast for 5 euro (may 2012). The staff was helpful when you asked something, otherwise they leave you alone. My next visit to Berlin, i will stay again at Ima Lofts!

reviews.title: Do not stay here!
reviews.text: This hotel may look cool, but actually it is a seriously overpriced dump with no regard at all for the hotel guests. We were woken up every morning to the sound of drilling at 7am! The rooms look good on photos but actually are just full of cheap Ikea furniture. The staff are much more interested in hanging out looking cool than actually doing anything, otherwise the location is central. There are so many other great, friendly, quiet and cheaper hotels in Berlin, in nicer locations, dont waste your money!

reviews.title: nice, bright and light.
reviews.text: really nice apartment with the bed upstairs overlooking the lounge and kitchen area. nice, bright and clean. in the complex are a few shops with a good coffee place. close by to metro but also nice to wander around. we were a group of four and found it comfortable. we booked through agoda.

reviews.title: Great Sleep
reviews.text: Nice little hotel ran by a very warm family. The rooms are spacious, modern and nice with hot water. The breakfast is super with lots of choices. Everything you want to see is right around the corner. Luang Prabang as a city is absolutely incredible so plan to stay a while. We would definetely stay at this little place again!

reviews.title: Cosy stay
reviews.text: We had a great stay for my birthday, we actually received the room that was the same as the photos! Which was a first, the bed was really comfy, and everything was clean. I would stay here again, the breakfast is included which is great and sometimes when you come back to the room you get fruit and juice on arrival which is a nice touch. The location is good too walking distance and price for Luang Prabang is good.

reviews.title: The only choice in LuangPrabang
reviews.text: To be honest to say this is a charming little hotel in Luang Prabang with very attentive and kindly staff . The hotel is near busy streets, but it was no bother to us at all. So easy to access to any famous places . The staff were so friendly and helpful.They are exceptionally helpful under the attentive eye of manager, they clearly do her utmost to make this hotel a gem. Our room was comfortable with a big window . Love is ! We stayed 5 nights and wished we had stayed longer, sad to leave. We will be back very soon .

reviews.title: Great hotel to stay in luang prabang
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel . Located away from mian streets , 5 minute walk to the night market, room are nice and clean ,AC work well . The staff very friend and helpful . I and my friend was enjoy my trip in luang prabang .even only 5nigth in your hotel .we would stay here again for sure . Highly recommended to everybody . Thanks

reviews.title: Friendly Hotel
reviews.text: Nice hotel. Rooms clean with good Wifi, Aircon and Tv. Reasonably priced. Food very good and nicely presented. Staff very friendly and assisted with booking for onward travel. Will go again next time in Luang Prabang.

reviews.title: Outstandingly friendly staff at this traditional constructed hotel.
reviews.text: On arrival the polite and friendly staff greet you with a drink and fresh fruit. This certainly set the tone of my stay at this semi traditional/ wooden hotel. The rooms were large and everything was superbly clean. There needs a little upgrading in the bathroom area but this did not detract from the excellent stay. The breakfast was adequate and there was always coffee and tea on hand whenever you wanted it. Equally after a day out you were greeted with a fresh cold drink on your return. Breakfast was ordered and served outside on the balcony. Very much service with a smile from the two young people at front of house, you were excellent.

reviews.title: Fantastic valie
reviews.text: I stayed here for four nights with my sister and a friend and am so glad we did. The triple room was fantastic value for money - the breakfast was great, and we got fresh towels and a complimentary water bottle each every day. The staff were very polite and friendly and helped order us tuk-tuks and advised us on what the rates should be (useful when you never really know whether you're being scammed). My only complaint is that the wifi was very poor - to have any hope of a connection in our room we had to be standing right by the door. Overall, a fantastic stay and I would recommend this place to anyone.

reviews.title: Greet Hotel
reviews.text: Rendezvous boutique hotel is the best in luang pra bang . The room was large, clean and comfortable. The staff were really accommodating letting us check in early. The breakfast was really good. It was nice and quiet and the aircon worked well. Wifi is amazing. The location is perfect to explore the town and markets. Would stay here again. Highly recommended to everybody. Thanks .

reviews.title: Great stay! Would come back
reviews.text: I would highly recommend this hotel. The staff were really friendly and welcoming. The room was clean and got cleaned every day with fresh towels. The breakfast was really good. It is an ideal location, close to the town centre but not in a loud area. Would happily stay again! Highly recommend.

reviews.title: GREAT HOTEL AND LOVELY STAFF
reviews.text: beautiful hotel....They have an outstanding staff. I cannot express how patient, helpful, and courteous they were. The room was comfortable and clean ,I and my friend was enjoy my trip in LUANG PRABANG even only 3 night in your hotel,we definitely come back and recommend your hotel to all of my friend. Thank again...!

reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: I really ẹnoyed my 7 night stay at the Rendezvous Hotel. There seems to be a young crew running the show and they do a fantastic job. All staff were friendly and helpful. My room was lovely and quiet with full equipment, air conditioners,fans, coffee and tee free at room. Beautiful bathroom. The room was cleaned and made up every day. The breafkast menu had a number of choices, with banana pancake a clear winner. Only 5 minute walk to center. The hotel was well located and an easy walk to all land marks. They can arrenge reasonable trasport to the waterfall and airport. The place is a winner, 10 out of 10 from me.i will comeback Rendezvous hotel.

reviews.title: Amazing hotel
reviews.text: I booked for 3nights and i liked so much i stayed for 3 more nights. Luang prabang is amazing. So much to see and do.... Even has a good nightlife. The location is perfect, right in the center of the city. The hotel staff was helpful and friendly, room was nice and clean. There were 10 choices for the FREE BREAKFAST and the coffee was to die for!! I should have stayed longer. I would recommend this place for any and all travelers.

reviews.title: Beautiful hotel
reviews.text: The room was very large with a comfy bed. We had a fridge, tea & coffee making facilities. The room was cleaned daily & toiletries were re- stocked. There are little turtles or terrapins in the fountain in the lobby which is pretty cool. The breakfast buffet was very good, a varied choice & eggs made fresh. All the staff were friendly and helpful. Would stay here again. Highly recommended anybody travel to luang prabang.

reviews.title: Friendly staff and well situated
reviews.text: The young staff were always very helpful, the lady who did most of the paperwork spoke very good English if you allowed her some time and spoke clearly. Our room was a good size, we found the beds and pillows the most comfortable we have had in SEA, there was a fridge and tea and coffee available, you got the boiling water from the foyer. After being out and on our return we were regularly greeted with a fresh, chilled fruit smoothie and a bottle of water. Breakfast is included, my favourite was banana pancake, we were also given a small bowl of fresh fruits at breakfast. One of the days we were there my husband was unwell and I went on the trip we had booked, the staff checked on my husband several times and asked if they could get anything for him, on my return he fancied trying a banana and they were happy to give us a couple to save me going out. Rendezvous has lost the 5th star because whilst we always had hot water the plumbing was idiosyncratic, it's position is great to access most attractions but there is some background noise but this stops about 8pm.

reviews.title: Lovely boutique hotel, enjoyed it!
reviews.text: We really enjoyed staying here for 3 nights. Staff were friendly and helpful, we got welcome drinks during our stay and cold water when we arrived back each day. Room was clean and practical, only complaint was the bed was hard. It has a nice feel with all of the wood. Breakfast was nice and good choice. It was nice sitting outside your room eating breakfast but it lacked a common area. Great location and hotel was happy to arrange trips and reasonable prices. It is pricey but there is a lot worse value for money in LB than here! Would recommend!

reviews.title: Nice atmosphere
reviews.text: We stayed 3 nights and cannot complain about anything. Place is very nice, very clean, decorated with a good taste and very well situated. Staff is friendly and helpful to organize pick ups, motorbikes or laundry. They made our stay very convenient. It's no luxury, but it has a very nice atmosphere, big clean bathroom with hot shower and western toilet. Breakfast is included you have a nice choice of fresh juices, banana pancake, omelet, cereals etc. ,and you can enjoy it directly at the terrace in front of your room. Very good value for money.

reviews.title: Fantastic stay!
reviews.text: Luang Prabang is one of the best cities in the world, so why not stay in one of the most beautiful hotels while you're at it? Wonderful, helpful staff were very accommodating and made us feel very welcome. They had great recommendations on local food and great non touristic attractions. I would tot ally recommend to anyone travelling through Laos to pay them a visit.

reviews.title: lovely boutique hotel
reviews.text: I've stayed here for 3 nights, my room was great it was clean and had all I needed for a relaxing stay. I found the staff to be really friendly and helpful throughout my stay! The hotel is in a handy location just 3 minutes from the night market and the mekhong river, I would highly recomend a stay here during your time in luang prabang.

reviews.title: Great place!
reviews.text: We stayed here for one night. Great atmosphere, very friendly people and clean rooms. Welcomed with fresh fruit and drinks. Nice and quite rooms. Good location, just 5-10 min walk to the centre. Highly recommend it!

reviews.title: excellent boutique hotel
reviews.text: We stay in 3 night all clean and comfortable and cool. Excellent breakfasts. Great location. Great people working here. Nothing to much trouble for them. Felt like home. Highly recommend this hotel. Thanks guys for all your help.

reviews.title: great hotel
reviews.text: the hotel is lovely location , close to centre everything , to the night maket . I stay in the hotel for 3 nigth , the room is very nice and big , clean , great wifi , breakfast is included really good options . the staff is amazing friendly and helpful . l would definitely stay again . highly recommended .

reviews.title: Not too bad!
reviews.text: Pros: The hotel is located very close to the centre of Luang Prabang with most things being reachable in a 5-10 minute walk. Breakfast is included and you have a choice of around 10 different options that they'll cook and bring to your room. They also offer a laundry service (we used it and it was reliable)and you can hire motorbikes from them if you want to travel further out of the city. The rooms have TVs and air-con. The staff were helpful and friendly. Cons: the bed was uncomfortable and the walls are very thin so you can hear everything! There were a few noisy guests while we were staying and this kept us awake. Also, the breakfast was just ok - I was a bit disappointed with most of the options that I tried. (My boyfriend enjoyed the breakfast and didn't find the bed too bad, so maybe it is just me!) In summary, for the money it is good value but there are a few things that dampened our experience!

reviews.title: excellent hotel and great staff
reviews.text: We stayed in rendezvous boutique Hotel for 5 nights and had a really lovely stay. The rooms are spacious, clean and the hotel staff were very friendly and helpful. . Foods are great too. Hope to come back again. Will recommend this hotel.

reviews.title: All round, just okay.
reviews.text: Located away from the main streets, price was 1000bhat a night which was quite expensive having been used to better rooms for half the price. Best thing - the shower. Room clean, huge double bed and HBO HD in English on the TV! Worst thing, the lack of communication with the owners. Hardly anyone is Laos can speak a word of English which makes things quite difficult at times and bartering doesn't seem that accepted here.

reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.text: I really love my stay in rendezvous boutique hotel , I really love is the room very nice and clean , great wifi. great location, staff very friendly and helpful. Would Stay here again .highly recomended hotel to evrybody. Thanks too all staff in the hotel.

reviews.title: Good service = good stay
reviews.text: Nice customer service, always friendly and ready to help us with arrangement of drivers and tours, daily complimentary drinks etc. Hotel facilities are ok for Laos standards, but the great service made up for it! Good range of breakfast items to choose from :) Some mosquitoes outside the room :/

reviews.title: Cute hotel with fantastic hospitality!
reviews.text: As soon as I arrived until the moment I left, the owners of this hotel went over and above to make my stay a great one...and it was. They greeted me with a refreshing drink and fresh cut fruits, not just the first time I arrived but everytime I came back to the hotel! They helped me with travel arrangements and although they offered their own rates for buses they didn't force me to use their services and we're just willing to help me as much as they could. They even called the tour company I had arranged a trip with to double check that they had the correct address for my pick up the following day. Also I wanted to take a short trip up north to Nong Khiaw and I was able to leave my luggage with them for a few days no problem. Accommodation: The rooms were very spacious and well kept, with a large wardrobe, firm beds...also had desk, chair, fridge and a safe. The AC worked well but also had a fan just in case! Although the bathroom was large it was on the basic side and at times it was difficult to regulate the temperature of the water. The wifi connection was really good. Facilities: on each floor they had a water dispenser, with cups, coffee, tea and sugar so you could make a cuppa, whenever you needed. You could also buy a selection of drinks from them in reception. Breakfast: this was included in the stay and served on the table and chairs they had outside each room every morning. Good selection and made to order. All in all a charming place to stay with the nicest of people looking after it.

reviews.title: Amazing and great staffs
reviews.text: We stayed here threes nights, we are impressive with staffs, they very helpful. Rooms very nice and cleaned bathroom. Manage so cool, he give me fruit juice everyday after a day visiting in the city! Strong wifi and good breakfast with banana pancakes. Highly recommend!!

reviews.title: Excellent services and good location
reviews.text: The services is excellent, the front desk staffs very kind and helpful. They booked me for various type of tour in LP, good prices and only 5 mnt walk to city centre/night market etc. Room is spacious, warm and clean with good quality of wooden floor. good WiFi and quite street, which is perfect. would love to come back.

reviews.title: great hotel
reviews.text: Lovely place a few minutes walk from the centre. Nice little touches for a hotel of this type like a different juice brought to your room every afternoon. Really sweet lady that runs it. For the price, outstanding. highly recommended . thanks

reviews.title: Where Calm and Rest Meet
reviews.text: The rooms are clean and basics, with minimalist decoration. The bathroom is simple but clean and everything in the bathroom works. The owners and workers are very kind. They provided us with a lemon juice and a selection of fruit which we were pleasantly surprised by. The workers and owners are quite, respectful and helpful (Not uncommon for Laos). The food options are mostly western which can be an issue for those seeking an authentic Lao experience. However, they do provide a noodle and vegetables option for breakfast for those who want it. The overall hotel is relaxing and has a cosy feel. It's advisable to get a room on the second floor as the ground floor doesn't have a balcony which isolates you from the street below.

reviews.title: Best hotel in Laos
reviews.text: The service at this hotel was beyond amazing. Honestly, the staff went out of their way to make our stay as pleasant as possible. We had welcome drinks on the house at check in and after each day upon our return. Rooms are really clean and comfortable. Really, I loved this place.

reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text: Really enjoyed our stay with the very kind and helpful staff at this hotel. Sen speaks very good english and was very helpful during our four night stay. The room was spacious with beautiful wooden ceilings and floors. The shower had great pressure with super hot water. The AC was cold. The bed is hard as are most beds in Laos. We really liked the cold juice that was brought to our room upon our return from the days activities. The breakfast was good with several choices available. A fresh fruit plate was also served each morning. One Note: A downstairs guest's room was burgularized during the last night of our stay. Make sure you secure all belongings before going to sleep at night.

reviews.title: Beautiful hotel
reviews.text: Great place to stay in Luang Prabang , lovely location, attentive staff ! Breakfast is very good and the rooms are clean A/C so good , because in the day very hot. I love it close to the night market and all that there is to see in this amazing city. The staff very nice welcoming like your home . Highly recommended. Would stay here again when I come back to Luang Prabang .

reviews.title: Experience at this property
reviews.text: I checked in here on 23 November early evening. I consumed a meal on Bangkok Airways on route to Luang Prabang from Bangkok. Later that evening I was extremely ill, vomiting all night through until the mid morning of the next day, couldn't eat breakfast and spent all that day in bed. The young person who appears to be in charge of the front desk did enquire if I needed to go to the hospital. I asked her on that day if my bathroom could be cleaned, she replied that it would not be cleaned until the next day which was the Saturday. Never in all my life have I experienced this bad service. On the Saturday I was feeling better, so went on a boat trip on the Mekong. On my return to the hotel there was no toilet paper and no water in my room, so had to ask for it.My room was 10 which was ok, but no natural light to read etc, When I could eat,breakfast it .was just ok. The staff here are very young, not a lot of English going on. Position of the property is okay. This is NOT a boutique hotel, which sucked me in. This is a guesthouse. To sum up, I would NOT stay here again. It killed me to hand over $250 USD as this place was not worth that sort of money! Better places to stay!

reviews.title: Great staff
reviews.text: Lovely stay ,we stay is 5nights is amazing hotel very nice and the rooms big and clean , breakfast is really good in the morning ,great location,staff here very helpful and friendly, we will come back here stay again , and high recommend to everyone . Thanks

reviews.title: Feels like coming home!
reviews.text: We stayed in Rendez Vous a couple of times within a period of 2 weeks. We returned there after our 2-day trekking (which we booked at the hotel) and after our trip to Nong Khiaw and Muang Noi. Every time we returned it felt as coming home. The staff is incredibly friendly and helpful. Every day they brought a fresh juice to our room. The rooms are nice and comfortable, location is perfect. I would certainly recommend this hotel!

reviews.title: Book it now!
reviews.text: Our favorite hotel! Really nice hotel and rooms, with a shared (kind-of) balcony where you have a little table in front of each room, where you get breakfast. Breakfast is really nice. When we arrived to the hotel the really nice staff brought us a welcome drink and a plate with fruits (!!!) and during our stay of two nights they brought us different drinks and a plate with fruits every once in a while (in total three or four times) for example when we got home after walking around, looking exhausted. The rooms were really nice, clean, comfortable beds, good wifi, good air-conditioning, everything perfect. The shower was even better then ours at home. Perfect location, the market is 2 minutes away. In conclusion: It's a really great hotel and we would always go there in Luang Prabang! We really recommend it!

reviews.title: Friendly staff, perfect location
reviews.text: We stayed at Rendezvous Boutique Hotel recently with my girlfriend and it was fantastic. The rooms are basic but considering the price and the fact that your in the city they were great! They were serviced every day with new towels sheets etc. Breakfast every morning is yum and the cook always remembers how you like your omelette or what sort of sauce you want. The staff looked after us and made sure our stay was comfortable. One of the best place we have stayed in Asia as far as value for money and customer service was concerned. Within walking distance to most tourist sites. Hotel is close to near night market We highly recommend this hotel

reviews.title: Fable staffs, marvelous stay!!!
reviews.text: The room was spacious with lots of natural light. The bed was spotless and sooooo comfortable. I was welcomed with fresh drinks upon arrival and whenever I come back to the hotel. Even though the staffs weren't numerous, they all did their best. Bonus: thumbs-up to the banana pancakes.

reviews.title: Great choice in LPB
reviews.text: We spend wonderful 4days in this hotel. It was beautiful wooden house with impressive two big mango trees. The room was big and keep clean during our stay. Also has comfortable bed, large window with nice view. Breakfast was great too. We could choose fresh juice and main dishes and there were all excellent. Staff was so welcoming and helpfull. They provide us welcome drink and citymap also helped us to booking slowboat, tuktuk and minivan to go to Vangvieng. Thanks to hotel for having wonderful memory in Luangprabang

reviews.title: Good room, noisy area
reviews.text: Nice, clean, big room with a king size bed and a single bed. Big washroom, AC, hot water, a safe, laundry service, breakfast (delicious but limited choices) and some of the nicest staff we've ever encountered. However, earplugs are necessary. A rooster next door starts singing daily from 3:30AM to about 8:30AM. Also, a little girl next door screams her head off from early morning to late night every... single... day. Not sure if it's terrible twos or if she was sick or whatnot. Regardless, we stayed there 10 days and enjoyed our stay nontheless.

reviews.title: best placeto stay in luang prabang
reviews.text: Great hotel to stay in luang prabang . The hotel is very nice and rooms are big clean and lovely balcony. The breakfast is amazing many options... Eggs cereal pancakes a really large selection. The staff in the hotel really helpful. Would stay here again for sure. Highly recommended. thanks

reviews.title: Wonderful, must stay!
reviews.text: This is a lovely little guest house just on the outskirts of Luang Prabang old town. Such a little gem. The staff couldn't do enough for you, so friendly. Breakfast was nice, a choice of 10 items, and they do fruit shakes too. Room was lovely, very big and clean, everything is decorated in the traditional wooden style with white walls. Aircon worked great. You can also book onward tranvel here as well. Barely a 5 minute walk to the old town and less than 10 mons to the backpacker area of town. Location is perfect. The street is VERY quiet even though there are other guest houses on the road. No through traffic. Literally can't rate it highly enough, would give it 6/5.

reviews.title: Top notch service!
reviews.text: After staying in this hotel I realized that you don't have to pay a lot of money to receive an incredible service. Smooth check-in, with a welcome drink and fruits. The room was big and had air-con, a ceiling fan, a mini-refrigerator, a safety box (big enough for computers), a TV, free coffee and tea, an spacious bathroom with a Spanish style shower with hot and cold water. Everyday the room was cleaned, and I was welcomed back with a natural fruit juice. The building of the hotel is also impressive, with a traditional wooden style. Breakfast is included and the banana pancakes are incredible!!! The location is pretty good as well, in a quiet neighborhood but very close to the night market and street food, this hotel has become one of my favorite!

reviews.title: Lovely hotel
reviews.text: Great hotel to stay in Luang Prabang.room is very nice and clean. Very nice staff, everything perfect. Room is clean and cofortable. They try hard to make your best vacation Excellent breakfast. Would stay here again. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Excellent boutique hotel
reviews.text: Really nice hotel, the staff were very friendly and new the area well. The place was very very clean and felt like home. Heading to Luang I would a absolutely recommend this place and will return again soon!!

reviews.title: Treat you like family - lovely hosta
reviews.text: I am so grateful for the owners of this hotel. They went so far out of their way to help me, when my spouse got into a pretty bad situation. I am really unsure what I would have done without them. Lovely hosts, cute rooms on a quiet street right around the corner from the night market. Thank you again so much for your hospitality - I am beyond grateful for your kindness.

reviews.title: Travelling
reviews.text: Really good hotel, it was clean and the staff were really friendly. Air conditioning was very good and kept us nice and cool which was needed as it was really really really humid and hot over here. Bring bug spray with you as the mosquitos are everywhere!

reviews.title: amazing hotel
reviews.text: great hotel stay in my trip.The staff was very friendly! We got a welcome drink and a fruit platter to each breakfast. Breakfast was a really good choice. The room is nice and clean very comfortable. I would highly recommend this hotel!

reviews.title: Phenomenal service
reviews.text: Great location, spacious rooms and very friendly staff who go the extra mile for all guests. We went on a two day hike and upon our return we were surprised to find that our luggage was already placed in our new room and a welcome drink was waiting for us outside our room! Definitely recommend staying at this hotel.

reviews.title: Good value for money
reviews.text: This hotel is very conveniently situated only a 5 minute walk from the night market, Mount Phousi and plenty of bars and restaurants. The staff are so lovely and friendly and helped us to book a cycling tour to Tad Se Waterfalls and arranged a tuk tuk to take us to Kuang Si Waterfalls. The rooms are a good size and, although basic, they were clean, the bed was comfortable and the shower always had hot water. It was a nice bonus to have a fridge too. The breakfast menu was fairly extensive with eggs lots of ways, banana pancake, noodle soup and fresh fruit, a menu that we have found is very common in SEA. If we came back to the hotel during the day the staff brought us some fresh juice which was a nice touch. The only down side to this hotel is that the walls are paper thin and we did have some very noisy neighbours. We would recommend this hotel as a great, value for money, well-located place to stay.

reviews.title: Very friendly and attentive to guests
reviews.text: Stayed for 2 nights here. Great location just minutes from the main market Street. Nice big, clean room with good air con. Throughout the stay we were brought fresh juice and fruit which was a really nice touch. Very helpful in helping us book transport. Nice breakfast which was brought to your room. Each room had its own table and chairs outside on the decking. Would highly recommend if you do not want a pool.

reviews.title: Fantastic value!
reviews.text: We stayed here for 4 nights and were very impressed. The room and bathroom were exceedingly clean. The breakfast was good. Every day you get a free bottle of water each and when you return each day you're met with a refreshing glass of lemonade. The woman running the place was very kind and helpful. I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Simple, great location, clean room
reviews.text: Big room with wooden floor which made me to choose to stay in there. The location is quite close to the night market and many attraction. The banana pancake is the best in the breakfast. The hot water difficult to adjust and the room can hear each other. The rest are good enough to stay. The service of the owner is really appreciated.

reviews.title: Beautiful hotel
reviews.text: Amazing hotel to stay at in Luang Prabang, the room is so romantic!! Great wifi . Great breakfast, The staff was very helpful and friendly with everything. I would definitely stay again. Highly recommended. Thanks rendezvous boutique hotel .

reviews.title: This charming hotel is worth every penny
reviews.text: A gorgeous home, always worried about you. Perfect welcome! Neat and clean rooms Walking distance from downtown (5 minutes a night market) place very highly recommended then enjoyed this hotel Always there to help and most importantly always smiling

reviews.title: One of the worst hotels
reviews.text: This was one of the worst hotels I was staying at in SOA. - no room service AT ALL - staff is hardly understandable - really dirty bedsheets (that didn't get changed, ever) - the gate was locked at 11 and I couldn't get in, no one ever warned me about this - there was a waterleak in the room above the bathroom, so there was water dripping from the ceiling all the time

reviews.title: GREAT HOTEL AND LOVELY STAFF
reviews.text: Lovely hotel, very nice room and clean ,Comfortable rooms, extremely friendly and helpfull staff! They gave us a fruitshake and cafe everyday when we got back in the hotel! Felt like coming home.Perfect location. would stay in here agian , highly recemmemded to everyeverybody..

reviews.title: Small Hotel with a Big Heart!
reviews.text: Mid-June 2016 I stayed six days at Rendezvous Boutique Hotel in Luang Prabang. Near the Post Office, the eateries, the day and night markets, and the money changers, it's a charming little hotel in a quiet neighborhood. It's run by a staff of three -- the front desk guy who speaks English, the chambermaid, and the waiter. But what a great job they do! My double room with a view was cleaned daily, fresh towels and mineral water provided. Cascades of shower water, both hot and cold! If that air-con isn't cool enough for you, there's a rotating electric fan overhead. Breakfast you choose from a menu is served at your private table just outside your door.
