You get a refreshing welcome drink when you check in and one every day thereafter. Have any questions about the sights? The English-speaking guy is only too happy to help you. You, too, will check out satisfied you got your money's worth!.

reviews.title: “Great choice in Luang Prabang”
reviews.text: My friend and I stayed here for 3 days. We had a wonderful stay. The staff was so informative, helpful, and kind. The room was big and clean. The breakfast is an experience by itself. You can order as much as like. Leaving breakfast hungry is impossible .The area is great, too. Will definitely stay here again!!!

reviews.title: Excellent Customer Service
reviews.text: Stayed here for two nights. Room was spacious and clean. Air con was good. Shower was excellent. The room had all the commodities that was needed. The best thing about this hotel is the staff and customer service; they go above and beyond to make sure your stay is as enjoyable as possible. We also rented two scooters from the hotel and had no problems. This hotel is in an excellent location and well worth a stay.

reviews.title: Cheaper Price - Nice
reviews.text: We (two couples) stayed here in April 2011. We are in our early 40s. We stayed in condo 108 I believe. We were on the intercoastal side, which actually faces the parking lot. However, this condo was a few hundred cheaper than others and I thought that was worth it. The beach behind the condo is beautiful and nice pool/patio area. There are sevearl good restaurants within walking distance which was a major plus. I also liked the jogging path that went for miles. A big downside is the slamming doors from other condo's and the exit that starts around 7:30am each morning. SUPER LOUD! That was really my only complaint. This condo is basic, but seemed clean and comfortable. The check-in staff ladies were nice and we used the washer/dryer down the hall and that was just fine. Recommended!

reviews.title: Right by the beach!!!
reviews.text: This was our first stay at this condo bldg (Unit 114), we were on the ground floor with a patio directly beside the pool and steps from the beautiful Gulf of Mexico. The evening sunsets were breathtaking, the constant waves pounding on the shore so soothing . We were able to walk to a couple of local restaurants (also a drug store very close by), and take long leisurely strolls on the beach. Our one bedroom was very clean, well kept and nicely decorated. We were there during the olympics so the big screen tv (46" perhaps?) was great for all of those hockey games - watched them from the patio! The staff are very friendly, they are always cleaning or fixing something! We also met a lot of very nice people, they seem to return every year, they were very welcoming and invited us to join their group - we had a great time!

reviews.title: Right on the beach
reviews.text: We stayed in a two bedroom unit on the ground floor, facing the Gulf. The view was fantastic! The unit was very clean with comfortable living room and dining room seating. The bathroom we used (nearest the kitchen) was spacious. The unit is decorated with a beach theme which looks really nice. The bed in the guest bedroom was too soft for my comfort level.

reviews.title: Great Place to Stay and Relax
reviews.text: Stayed in unit 112 this time. The unit is very outdated. It felt like we stepped into a 1980's time warp. The room was also not the cleanest. Could have been dusted and wiped down better. THAT BEING SAID....Everything else is amazing at this place. The beach is nice soft sand and is kept clean. The pool is nice, it's kept warm. We were on a ground floor unit so you literally walk out onto the pool deck, then out onto the beach, then into the warm water. The beach is never that busy (not like clearwater or st. petes). There are many great places to eat in the surrounding area, including PJ's if you like seafood (PJ's is the best), Los Mexicanos for some amazing mexican food, Slyce for some great fresh pizza and a nice bar.

reviews.title: Unit 303
reviews.text: my mom and I have stayed in 303 for 4 or 5 years and found it to be very clean. we have never seen a bug there. the air conditioning vent can be adjusted so it does not blow on your face. the owners are very accommodating to please renters. it is a beautifuuly decorated unit and it has been updated almost every time we have been in that unit. if you have any problems the owners or office staff will help. it is like our home away from home when we go. we always enjoy our time there in the unit and on the beach. love watching dolphins and boats from the balcony. we also saw jupiter from balcony. the sunsets are great from the beach. we always have a great experience there and looking forward to staying in unit 303 again this fall. Julie Babiak

reviews.title: Perfect location
reviews.text: Unit 108 was beautiful and everything you could want in a condo. Fully stocked and super cozy! The pool was refreshing but always filled with little kids who didn't follow any of the pool rules and the parents didn't pay attention. Wish they'd make it smoke free. Too many people smoking out by the pool. Especially cigars which made me sick. The beach was perfect. The water was warm but not too warm. It was a nice private location. The sunsets are not to be missed. The girls in the office were super friendly. Can't wait to go back.

reviews.title: Much needed getaway
reviews.text: Our family stayed at unit #312 for a week. I must say from the outside and along the hallways at first I thought this place was a dump. All the way up to the door entering the condo, I thought we would be checking out the same day. Once the door opened I was really surprised. The two bedroom, two bath condo had really been updated and felt like a newer unit. Usually we spend the beach vacation in Destin, Florida. The condo was well stock and had an excellent view of the gulf. Our beach time each day was enjoyed with very few crowds. The water was perfect. Amazing restaurants are close by. One downside to this rental is there is no beach chair service on the beach. Headed to the cvs down the street for cheap seats for the beach and umbrellas. One other down note is there is no laundry facilities inside your condo. They are on each hallway for $2.00 per load/ per wash and per dry. We could not have asked for better living arrangements. It's clean and a good place to shower and sleep. Plus for us is the crowds on the beach and heading out for dinner is so much less than places like Clearwater and Destin. Downside - luxuries like beach chairs, umbrellas, and in condo washer/dryer. If you can live without those, this is the place for you.

reviews.title: Great beach, condo needed substantial update
reviews.text: Stayed with my wife for the month of January 2017 in Fifty Gulfside Condos. We had stayed there a couple of times before with very good results. However, this time we were very disappointed. Several issues. When we booked (February 2016) well in advance. We asked for a ground floor unit and were told we could have unit 116. Soon after booking we received an email saying that we could not have that unit and were moved to second floor. The second-floor unit was in desperate need of upgrading, bad stains in the carpet, stains on the ceiling tiles in the bathrooms, sliding glass doors were not working properly (could only go through one of them), TV's were old, small and out of date, stains in bathroom areas, out of date medicine cabinets, furniture with stains, and other smaller miscellaneous issues. During our stay, we asked to see other units for possible future stays. A couple were very nicely updated so we know many of the owners tried to do a better job. We were told no discount regardless of the condition so we were stuck (paid in advance – no offer to refund). We were told all units of similar size (two bedrooms in our case) were the same price regardless of the condition. After three weeks, no deposit returned and I called during business hours (recording said call would be returned after completing call). I left a voice mail and did not hear from them until I called three days later and finally after 6 weeks the deposit (partial was returned).

reviews.title: Mr
reviews.text: The unit that we stayed in was fine the problem is you have this late night the rules don't apply to us so we can just stay up an keep the other vacationers up they need to put a stop to this. Also they need to put Cameras in the halls so that way these that ride their bikes they can put a stop to it. So I don't know if I'll will return here again or not.

reviews.title: Great view and beautiful beach.
reviews.text: I stayed here in October and had a great time. The beach is beautiful and the pool was very convenient for the family. There are many good places to eat and drink.

reviews.title: I love 50 Gulfside!!!!!
reviews.text: I just returned from vacation at 50 Gulfside in Indian Rocks beach. The units are beautiful. Very spacious, clean and comfortable. It is directly on the beach. You can either have a beach view or a view of the intercoastal. You have a water view w/all units. I have stayed here every August for the last 10 years. I have stayed in one, two, and three bedroom units (depending on how many family members joined me). The beach is amazing. There is a pool on the deck on the beach. Lounge chairs, tables, & barbecues on the deck. Plenty of room. I never felt crowded. Great location. There are a few stores & restaurants that you can even walk to. I highly recommend staying here. You will be impressed with everything about this place. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact me.

reviews.title: unit 210
reviews.text: The complex itself is in a great location both close to the beach and in biking distance of restaurants. This unit is gulf side and has wonderful views of the ocean and sunset. building is older and there are not enough chairs on the deck to accommodate all guests. The "chair wars" as they call them begin early in the AM when people rush down to "claim" chairs by hanging beach towels over them as soon as management cleans them. This to me is rude and annoying as many of the chairs sat vacant for hours so no one else could use them. We booked late this year and almost couldn't find a condo anywhere in IRB and this was the last available so we snatched it up. Based on the pictures we new it was older, but after staying there I would not return. The bedding was very old and uncomfortable...I had to fold up a blanket and comforter under the fitted sheet to stop my back and hips from hurting at night. The main bathroom off the kitchen was dirty and there were 2 dirty washcloths hanging in the shower and hair on the back wall. Kitchen was minimally appointed, all furniture looked and felt like it was original from when the place was built in the 70's. small TV and no stereo of any kind. We listened to music on our laptop. I don't see how an owner can expect return renters when the place is so outdated and uncomfortable. the only draw really is the location. Perhaps other units are nicer, but overall they are very small square footage.

reviews.title: Great long weekend
reviews.text: We stayed in room #305, which was right in the middle and faced the intercoastal. We would have preferred being on the beach side but this was all that was available for a last minute booking. The unit itself was the best equipped we have ever stayed in. An up to date kitchen with relatively new appliances. The table and chairs were perfect for our group of 5. Free wifi was sketchy but that was just a complaint from the younger members. Elevator was painfully slow at times and the stairs are a bit of a muddle if your hands are full. Biggest complaint were the bathrooms. Really small and much in need of an overhaul but would be tough with the space available. The fact that you could exit the building, walk 10 yards across the pool deck and be on the beach, was awesome. Would consider a return trip.

reviews.title: Baseball heaven
reviews.text: Room 211 was outstanding, the owner updated her condo before we arrived in March. We booked the condo in January and were absolutely ecstatic the size of TV's and furniture. TOP OF THE LINE. The condo was spotless with endless towels for us to use. The supervisor and ladies in office were very accommodating. We are hoping to rent the same unit again in March.

reviews.title: Unit 315
reviews.text: The GOOD: This is a very nicely appointed condo with an *amazing* ocean view. Kitchen had everything we needed, and the living/dining area was perfect for 2 people. The bed was very comfortable. Best of all is that the beach is literally only steps away! The condo had beach chairs, mats, and an umbrella available for us, which I really appreciated. The beach is far less crowded than it is down by Clearwater, and we were lucky to have fantastic weather during our stay. My only real complaint about Unit 315 is that it is directly situated above the swimming pool, which was consistently packed with noisy kids. They were having a great time-- this is a PERFECT place to come if you want to bring your family!-- but if you are looking for a quieter condo I'd choose something on the intercoastal side of the building. The NOT-SO-GOOD: As a word of warning to the smoke-sensitive, this condo is listed as non-smoking, but there was someone in a unit below us who smoked on his deck regularly and it came right up and into our unit...gross. I could also smell smoke in the hallways several times. We stayed over the 4th of July holiday, and there was a security guard sporadically on-site from July 3-5. I saw the guard sitting in his car in the parking lot multiple times. Fifty Gulfside charged a week-long premium for a guard, even though he was around for most of that time...since the place was full, I have a hard time believing they didn't make a profit off this. :/ OVERALL, we'd definitely go back, and would recommend it to our friends. Next time we hope to bring our kids along, as it really is a good place for families.

reviews.title: Family fun
reviews.text: We spent 2 weeks at Fifty Gulfside, two of our children and their families joined us for one week. We had separate condos, all beachfront. The view is breathtaking, the sunsets are unbelievable. Each condo is individually owned. The kids condos were beautiful and very tastefully decorated! Ours (#115) not so much but our view was awesome! The pool is huge and right outside the patio door! The office staff, Marie, Gerry and Mary are sweethearts and do all they can to accommodate the guests. The only negative I found is the wifi is spotty and that was so important to us due to jobs and school. God willing, We will return!

reviews.title: Excellent place to stay
reviews.text: We all loved our stay at 50 Gulfside. Our room was clean and beautifully decorated. The condos are situated within walking distance of several excellent restaurants such as Crabby Bills and Jake's Cantina. Only took a couple of minutes to walk from our room on the 3rd floor and into the water. Would definitely want to stay here again in the future.

reviews.title: The Unit Makes a Difference
reviews.text: We have been here a number of times and if you don't mind taking the stairs, choose a corner unit on the third floor. The light and view make it an excellent choice. We also like that we can rent here for times not restricted to one week at a time. Also we love the area because it's still "old Florida."

reviews.title: Relaxing Vacation!
reviews.text: My family stayed in condo 317 for the week of New Years and loved it! The condo was clean, updated and had great Gulf views! We loved how Indian Rocks Beach was laid back and quiet. It was close to Clearwater Beach for a more crowded scene. We have 2 little kids, so when we went to the beach it was nice only having to go a short distance to drag everything out on the sand. Only thing I would recommend was that the owners replace the mattresses on the beds and get rid of the egg crates. Other than that, we couldn't have had a more enjoyable stay. We will definitely be back this summer!

reviews.title: Relaxation at it's finest
reviews.text: I've stayed here several times. This spring break we stayed in unit 211, which could use an update, there's no doubt. But it was clean and we have everything we needed. I will say though, that if you are trying to determine which unit to stay in, my sister stayed in unit 212 and it was far nicer than 211. However, 211 had a smart TV so I was able to get into our Netflix account for the kiddos to watch movies at night. That was a great perk! The deck area is quiet, the pool is clean, the beach is perfect and the facility is well maintained. It is a very cute area, with plenty of places to eat. However, we just run to the grocery when we get there and cook in the condo every night. There are two grills on the deck for use, and I know from watching, they are cleaned by staff every day. This was the most relaxing vacation I have ever had. We swam at the pool and in the ocean everyday. John's Pass is near and don't forget to give some love to the Sea Bird Sanctuary near by. It is very low key and quiet, away from the hustle and bustle. It was exactly what we needed.

reviews.title: Unit 211 Needs Updating
reviews.text: We booked at the last minute so choices were limited. This unit was clean but dingy. The furniture needed updating or maybe a good cleaning. The kitchen cabinet doors were all open and wouldn't stay closed. The bathrooms, especially the master, were really in need of an update. We saw condos in the area for the same price that were all updated for the same price. We just waited too long to book. The really great thing about this unit was the balcony. The view was awesome and I stayed out there as much as possible. The furniture on the deck looked fairly new. The complex itself was fine. Not luxury but they were always cleaning. Location was convenient. I would stay in the complex again but would rent a different unit.

reviews.title: Great Spot On The Beach!
reviews.text: Room 215. Loved the kitchen and bathroom. The TV was tricky and we had to get the maintenance man to tell us how to turn it on and off. The bed was too hard. Two nights I slept on the loveseat. I would not reserve this room again because of that. I wished it had a full size couch also. The balcony is on the beach side; however, you are directly above the pool. We had no issues with that. You could have a blind cover the sliding doors at night. We like our assigned parking and it was easy access to our room. We took the stairs and elevator both. The elevator was very close to our room. The beach does not have chair and umbrella service so we bought an umbrella and the office gave us chairs to use. They had grills to use, but we did not use them. I like the towel racks on the balcony to hang the wet towels. It's close to all the restaurants in Indian Rocks Beach. The place was clean and I noticed the maintenance people cleaning every day. The beach was not crowded at all. We saw dolphins. The water was great! Would stay here again, but not this room because of the bed (personal preference).

reviews.title: Great location bad condominium
reviews.text: Gulfside location is perfect. Only steps to the beach. However the condominiums are not up to par. Our tub was dirty with soap scum. The tub would not drain properly. We saw rats running around the outside. My guess is it because the garbage dumpsters sit in the parking lot with no protection from animals. We saw roaches inside the building. There were not enough cleaning supplies for the week. The worst part was the pool area allowed smoking. I do not like having my children around smoke. One group of people took over half of the pool area from 8 am till midnight. They were loud and nothing was ever done. Our parking spot was taken 2 times with no way of getting in touch with anyone to have the car removed. We will definitely never use this property again.

reviews.title: Always fun! Indian Shores Florida
reviews.text: We have stayed at the Fifty Gulfside property 3 times now. No complaints. This is a fun relaxing place. No frills just nice clean condos with all the amenities you need to stay on the beach, eat some food, keep your beer cold, hang out and relax. Staff doesn't bother, guests/owners are all really nice. Your 20ft away from the beach, calm water, gorgeous sunsets. Will be back!

reviews.title: Peg's Place has it all
reviews.text: This unit is on the highway on the beach side. The unit is fully equipped with everything you need. I'm loving the paper plates. The beach cart and all the chair and umbrellas, such a deal (plus boogie boards and assorted toys). We load up, go around the corner of the building, and are on the beach. Perfect. Tom was very attentive when we arrived, the office staff very friendly. Can't ask for more.

reviews.title: Great little condo complex!
reviews.text: We recently stayed in 215 with our 4 year old. Each condo is individually owned, and 215 was really nice. Everything was new, including all the appliances. The view of the ocean was great, and we were right above the pool. That could get a little loud after 9 when we were sitting out on the balcony, but usually by 10 everything was quiet. I liked this condo as you really couldn't hear your neighbors on the inside. The washer and dryer worked great, and they even gave us some dishwasher soap, and hand soap to use. Overall, this was a great place to stay.

reviews.title: Felt like home!
reviews.text: While we have stayed at this 52 unit complex for the last three years, this unit #306 is by far the place we felt most at home. The decor is truly fabulous. You felt like someone was letting you stay in their home rather than a rental. Anything you could possible need in the kitchen was included. A lot of rentals have mismatched pots and pans, silverware, dishes and glasses for the tenants. Not this unit. Top quality dishes, wine glasses, silverware and cooking utensils are all there for your use. The leather couch was strewn with Ralph Lauren pillows. The beds were comfortable, and the bedding was beautiful. The flooring, cupboards, walk in glass shower (no tub) and everything else was first class. The unit does face the intercoastal waterway and not the beach, but the view from the balacony is still spectacular. We would request this unit again.

reviews.title: Our best vacation ever
reviews.text: My husband and I rented condo # 108 which faced the gulf and the beach right out the back door right after we retired in 2012. The condo itself was lovely with all the comforts of home. Two bedrooms, two baths open floor plan living room, dining room and kitchen. Kitchen totally equipped with everything you could possibly need. We stayed 3 weeks and had spoken directly with Tom the owner before we arrived. He gave us lots of information on the area. They even provided us with an extra parking space for when family who lives in the area visited.

reviews.title: Amazing, Best Vacation ever!
reviews.text: We rented unit 317 for 5 days during 9/21/2015 thru 9/25/2015. Our stay was fabulous. The view was great. The management was awesome. we had a small problem and it was address right away. The condo was clean, the beach was wonderful and on two different days the dolphin swam right up to where we were in the surf! We also saw sting rays. And shells everywhere. not just broken pieces..whole shells. I would stay here again in a heartbeat. Can't wait to go again.

reviews.title: Great Views
reviews.text: We stayed here a couple of times. Great location. We stopped going here when we got our Siamese cat. He travels with us everywhere and this condo does not allow pets. Other than that, the staff are helpful and friendly. It's been a couple of years since we stayed there but wanted people to know that we enjoyed our stay and had they allowed pets, we'd probably still be staying there,

reviews.title: Shady management will rip you off
reviews.text: Stayed there July 2015 with parents and kid for 10 days in room 116. The room itself was OK but appliances were borderline broken. The microwave fan did not work and it was hard to cook anything on the stove without setting off the fire alarm. The dishwasher was really old and 1/2 of the time would not start. The double door facing the pool was very hard to lock and even locked could be opened with a strong push. We were worried someone could get into our room at night. After the stay the complex management refused to return our cleaning deposit stating numerous issues like "bad mell out of the kitchen sink" or "dirty dishes in the dishwasher". We left the room clean and put everything the way it was where we found it. In addition they said they had to replace a bed sheet (thin one). I asked them to provide a receipt on how much the replacement one was but they said it was not their policy to do anything like that. So for a "bad smell" and one bed sheet they decided to take $150 without any need to give us further information. When I tried talking to them on the phone they just said they had no policy to discuss these issues with the customers and that's that. One more thing to add in general -- if you stay there I would try to avoid staying at the bottom level condos near the pool area. Reason for this is that during our stay at least there people sitting on the chars next to the pool pretty much from 8am to 3am the next day drinking beer. If you have small kids I am sure they will gain a new vocabulary from these drunks. Also if you have small kids the pool supposedly closes at 10 however people were swimming there until 1 or 2 am. Just FYI in case your kids or yourself have hard time falling asleep with lots of noise coming from the outside.

reviews.title: Best spot in IRB!
reviews.text: This was my third time visiting 50 Gulfside, and have stayed in a different unit each time. The building has units that accomodate families of all sizes, and are clean and nicely furnished. I love the fact that the beach is just steps away, and depending on which side of the building you stay, you can watch the sunrise or sunset everyday. (Sunrise on the intercoastal side and sunset on the gulfside, both of which are absolutely beautiful.) I especially enjoyed watching on the pool deck, that has plently of loung chairs and tables, and a beautiful, clean pool. Each time I arrived, the units were prepared with fresh sheets and towels, and were overall very clean. The beds were very comfortable, and every night I stayed here I got the best night's sleep I have gotten in awhile. Each unit is decorated and equipped in such a way that made visitors feel as though they are home. Since I did not rent a car, I had to walk to get to where I was going which was a breeze, since there was a CVS and plently of nearby restaurants that had a variety of food including Italian, Mexican, and of course amazing, fresh seafood. Definitely recommend staying here, you will enjoy your staty from the moment you book to the day you check out!

reviews.title: Not as nice as previous visit
reviews.text: Nice location, our condo was very nice and clean. However, the smoking around the pool was annoying, and several parties were very loud. Pool area is full of kids- (free babysitter) - while their parents drink beer and ignore them. Looks like they could take the kids out for a while and let others enjoy the pool. Non existent WIFI , and slow response from front office about a minor problem. Seems to have gone downhill a little bit.

reviews.title: unit 206
reviews.text: Loved this location ! Very close to several restaurants, etc. The unit is fairly nice with new bedding and new mattresses. Lots of cooking items and dishes. No long distance package. We spend two weeks in November and one week in January. Looking forward to going back in November but to unit 209!

reviews.title: Great family beach value escape unit 312
reviews.text: Unit 312 is a well appointed 2 bedroom condo overlooking the beach. From the balcony you can survey the gulf, beach and pool. The weekly rate is very reasonable and the condo has been updated in the past 3 years. Brian, the superintendent of this 1972 45 unit condo property, manages it as though it were his own. He does a great job keeping the place clean and properly running. Set reasonable expectations for you and your family, this isn't a hotel with a staff but a condo that you need to keep clean like it were your home. Everyone we met at the property was friendly and the pool is clean and the BBQ grills work well. I would recommend this unit and property to any friend.

reviews.title: Below the Radar Find
reviews.text: Originally booked a gulf view 1 BR apt. but management switched us to a corner 2 BR gulf front unit (218) after the south side of the building underwent repairs starting in Aug. 2016. The gulf front view is magnificent--the large pool is heated with ample chaises provided overlooking a beautiful beach which is not crowded. However, there were some areas of concern including non-functioning elevators for most of the week and smoking permitted at the pool. The biggest issue we had was the poor Wi-Fi we experienced with only spotty reception in one BR as the only area in the apt .which had internet access. Overall, we had an enjoyable week and hope to return in the future!

reviews.title: Great Location in IRB
reviews.text: We especially enjoy the location of this condominium building. Our apartment was comfortable and well furnished including kitchen accessories. The entire building, however, could use a bit of a facelift. The pool overlooks the beach which is a real plus and the management supplies two gas grills for guests to use which is handy. What is really nice is that we could walk to the stores to shop and to restaurants for dinner.

reviews.title: Loved it here.
reviews.text: This is our 4th visit to Indian Rocks Beach and our first time here. We have stayed in smaller units previously. While this is an older complex, the property is well-maintained and the pool and patio area have been updated. The noise level is good for a larger complex. Our condo unit on the 3rd floor had a very spacious living area with a modern kitchen and plenty of utensils for cooking our own meals. The only thing I would change would be not to cram so much bedroom furniture into the bedrooms. It made it very difficult to manuever. Indian Rocks is a great vacation spot. The beaches are not crowded. There is plenty to do, and some excellent restaruants nearby

reviews.title: Great place for family
reviews.text: These condos back on to a gorgeous beach. Loads of sand and shells to find. There is a pool- tons of kids when we were there. Not a great place for a couples getaway. Easy walk to great restaurants. Condo was typical but well-appointed wouldn't hesitate to recommend. Great stay!!!

reviews.title: Fraud
reviews.text: We booked a beach condo at 50 Gulfside on Aug. 1, 2018 for our May, 2019 family trip. They have a 30 day cancellation policy. 16 days before we are set to check in we get an email that the pool will be under construction starting May 6, the day we move in, for about 2 weeks. Not only would we not have a pool for our beach vacation, but would have to deal with the noise of construction the whole time. Our condo was on the pool deck so we wouldn't be able to avoid it. They offered a 15% discount on our stay. The original email did not state they would adjust the cancellation policy to accommodate the new information, but I thought for sure there wouldn't be an issue. What is the point of a beach condo without a pool? We have 4 kids ages 5 and under. They can handle the beach and heat for maybe 30 minutes before getting ready to cool off in the pool. We could stay here for free and it wouldn't be worth my husbands 1 week off. Time is the most valuable thing to us right now. They did not respond to my emails trying to cancel. When I called this morning and spoke with the manager, Fred. He said that it was within 30 days and they offered a 15% discount on our stay. Just repeating what was already in the email. He kept saying that it wasn't their fault when it was scheduled. I understand that. But its not my fault either and we shouldn't be punished for it. I'm bummed that I have to re plan my vacation with only 2 weeks to spare, most places are already booked up. But I can not stay at a beach condo without a pool. My kids would be completely miserable, making my husband and I miserable. If we wanted to book a beach place without a pool (do those even exist?) we'd be able to get one for a lot cheaper than the 15% discount they are offering us. I booked a condo with a pool. If that is not what I'm getting I need the opportunity to get my money back. I don't want to spend my whole week dealing with construction and having workers walking/talking/smoking around the pool all day ruining our view. They need to adjust the cancellation policy since they are the ones that told us only 16 days before our trip that we would not be getting what we booked. They are stealing our fun family vacation from us and the manager on the phone literally laughed at me while I was complaining about it. He said it was up to the condo board and the best they are willing to do is give us a 15% discount on our stay. We will not be staying here. I'm currently in the process of going through my credit card company to get my money back for this fraud. I have never been so disappointed and shocked by a company before.

reviews.title: Home away from Home!
reviews.text: We could not have been more pleased with our stay at Gulfside 50. The rooms were immaculate , stocked, and the staff was over the top with service, smiles and overall readiness for anything we may have needed, which was really nothing. The pool was perfectly set on a relaxing temperature, the beach was clean, and the sunsets were beautiful. My entire family and I stayed I unit 210, and it was perfect for all of us. Spacious, and a u it filled with everyone we could have needed and then some. If I needed anything I asked he staff and they were in it within minutes! Wanda Nealy especially was as handout for us. She loves her job and you can tell by the way she carries herself and has her hands on passionate attitude towards everyone she seemed to meet,including my family. This will be a definite place we will want to return to and sooner than later. Thanks to everyone at Gulfside, and we look forward to seeing you all again soon!

reviews.title: Great Condo
reviews.text: We had a lovely stay at this vacation home rented by owner condo. Clean and cute. It was a bit dated but had great rates. Right on the beautiful beach and across the road from the intercoastal waterway.

reviews.title: excellent for families!
reviews.text: We just returned from 50 gulf after a family trip with 5 adults and one 3 year old and a 1 year old. We chose this unit because it was a 3 bedroom 2 bath directly on the beach. This is an older complex but very well maintained. Beautiful beach front pool and beach is very close to the condo - good for little legs. So much fun to chase after them as they explored the beach! The unit has a wrap around balcony with those incredible views. All units are individually owned and maintained, so look at the website to see each one. We stayed in 318. It is a bit tired and could use some updating but was absolutely fine for us - it also is available to rent for 5 nights which is what we needed and at an excellent price! Loved the area - very casual, outstanding seafood places, less crowded beaches.

reviews.title: 20 Years and still coming back...
reviews.text: I've been coming to this same block, to the same apartment (118) for 20 years now. The rooms are always clean, spacious and homely without fault. I visit the area once or twice a year to visit family and to have a little vacation for myself. The owners of the apartment I use are a lovely English couple and I have had the pleasure of meeting them a few times, they are always adding new things to the condo, iPod dock here, new TV there... It feels like home. Love it, Love it, Love it Go there

reviews.title: Great place to vacation
reviews.text: We just returned in Feb 2017 from aa two week stay at 50Gu great places to eatlfside50 and it was as we remembered it from our stay in 2012. Had a 1st.floor ocean front condo and just out our patio door we 20 feet to the pool and about 50geet to the beach. Staff was great and the whole complex was very clean. Condo was a little dated but very nice. Lots of bars and great places to eat. Happy hour starts when they open and is over at six, plenty of time for us. Most places had really great music. Easy drive from the Tampa Airport. Already booked for next year and looking forward to it. Forgot to mention we met some really nice people staying there who made our sta really good.

reviews.title: Heavenly Vacation
reviews.text: Our stay at Unit 118 was wonderful! The rate is competitive with other condos in the area and worth every dollar. The condo was spotless, with very comfortable beds and furniture. Both bedrooms were cheerfully decorated. Both bathrooms had a shower, which is always a plus for us. The kitchen appliances along with the cooking and dining supplies were very adequate and the view from the condo was wonderful. We were right on the beach with nothing obstructing our view of the vast open skies and magnificent sunsets....The large deck area, right off our very large private deck was also wonderful, with a barbeque and several chairs and tables. There were always plenty of lounge and sunbathing chairs on the deck for our use. The pool, which is also very close to the condo was very clean and the water was always a perfect temperature. The entire property, both inside and outside is beautifully maintained. We stayed at this condo two times in 2014 and look forward to our next vacation in this Unit.

reviews.title: Condo rental
reviews.text: Enjoyed each visit . Decor somewhat dated but cleanliness excellent. Great location and Value! Short drive to many tourist attractions not far from I 75, and Tampa Airport secure parking. Short drive to shopping areas as well.

reviews.title: Unit 216
reviews.text: This gulf front unit was clean and spacious with what appeared to be new carpet and furniture. There was one MAJOR problem. The beds in both bedrooms are VERY old and make a tremendous amount of noise (squeaking,creaking) anytime you move at all or roll over. Made it very difficult to sleep, even forcing me to sleep on the couch several nights. Other than that the unit is very nice, situated overlooking the pool, which can get loud at times. The building itself is an old building which could be maintained a little better...saw a crust of bread in the elevator for 3 days before it was finally picked up. Location is good with a nice deck, grills and pool. There were quite a few people smoking poolside which should not be allowed at a family place with many kids in the pool etc. Overall, the close proximity to the beach was the best feature. Before you book ask about your particular unit and the last time it was updated.

reviews.title: Excellent, Excellent, Great Stay!!
reviews.text: This will be our 9th year at this condo. The building situated is in the lower end of IRB and is just perfect. No worries here. We stay in the same room but have been in several others and everyone that we have seen as well as the one we always stay in are clean, spacious and very comfortable. Besides who really cares about the room, I am here for the BEACH. LOL. This building is situated right on the beach with one step of the deck on your on the white sanded beach. The pool is always kept clean as well as the deck. Staff is always friendly and on hand during daylight hours. Shower and sand clean off hose is available at the gate to the beach. Grills available and clean. We rent a second floor unit that is perfect for us as some of the first floor units exit right at the pool so if your planning ahead be sure to take that into consideration. Plenty of eatery's and stores within walking distance. Intercostal waterway is across the street and there is a nice gazebo with swing there to relax. I could go on and on.......

reviews.title: Location is everything!
reviews.text: This small condo comples of 51 units is directly on the Gulf of Mexico. The beach is top notch and the complex is immaculate. We have stayed here previously, and noticed that the unit conditions and equipment varies.All unites are individually owned and thus taken care of and updated according to the owners wishes. This visit was in unit #113 which was updated and well equiped. I would stay away from unit #115 which is not updated and has poor quality beds. Wonderful front desk and the patrons were all terrific. We are coming back in December and can't wait.

reviews.title: Great location, great vacation!
reviews.text: This rental building houses about 50 or so units. We stayed in a one bedroom gulf view unit and it was just awesome. The views were outstanding and the beach was not crowded at all. Everyone seemed to have plenty of room. The building also has a nice pool and deck area which was nice for taking a break from the beach. Our unit was on the second floor and was very quiet. Indian Rocks Beach was one of the nicer towns up and down the coast. It is much lower key than Clearwater, which we liked. We would definitely stay here again!

reviews.title: Unit needs a little work, but overall a GREAT vacation!
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed in unit 303 in the last 3 months. This is our second time at this condo complex and we like it because: 1. it is a little bit cheaper than some of the others 2. nice pool 3. the ocean beach isn't crowded at all 4. the sand on the beach is nice 5. good bbq facilities 6. nice office staff 7. donut shop within 10 minutes walk 8. cvs within 10 minutes walk 9. jogging and biking track outside the condo 10. los mexicano's restaurant 10 minutes walk 11. Crabby Bills restaurant 10 minutes walk. The unit we stayed in could use some maintenance and upkeep, however. Super anoying was the air conditioning vent that would blow directly on your face/bed in the 2nd bedroom. They needed to install a plastic defuser thing to blow the air away and you'd be fine. Also, the unit itself really needed a deep cleaning in a bad way! And, while the kitchen looked recently upgraded with stainless steel and nice cabinets, some other areas in the condo needed to be upgraded. For example, replace the bathroom vanity instead of spray painting over it (which was chipping!). Also, I hate to say this, but there were a few too many bugs of various sizes in the condo for my liking. The guess the condo sprays once a month. ugh! Liked the furniture on the patio and patio cushions and table. This unit seemed very quiet - not a lot of traffic up on the 3rd floor or kids running around or slamming doors. Of course, loved watching the sunsets every night! We love Indian Rocks Beach. We would pick this condo complex again, but probably not 303. The owners need to spend a little more TLC on it for me to give it a better rating. Thanks!

reviews.title: No heat
reviews.text: Well checked in ...and front desk didn't even tell us ..btw no heat...so long story short no heat for fourth day in a row...did get a few blankets and a two inch space heater which is worthless...did get fireplace on but it's more for looks ..won't heat a room pass sixty degrees...no offer of moving us...by the looks of lint in fins of baseboard heaters...hasn't worked in sometime...so rooms are basically 60 degrees......the not tub i n middle of complex is basically a glorified bathtub..guest services don't call you back or answer phone....pool spa no jets....the Wi-Fi for streaming forget it...even when I paid extra movies kept bufferimg...so if you got kids with games or a firestick forget it...the good does have a big tv.. Wouldn't rec ommemd..

reviews.title: Beautiful views great rooms
reviews.text: My husband and I spent a week here in a one bedroom suite. I had read many bad reviews of the place and some great ones so I was apprehensive It was off season so our check in process was fairly quick I've heard in the busy season it could be bad. The guy at the front desk was not super friendly just kinda rushed through and sent us to the concierge desk when we were done to pick up our maps of the resort. The lady who was there was very friendly did offer us a hundred dollars if we wanted to sit through the time share spiel but was not pushy and they didn't call us everyday to ask like most time shares do I found this very pleasant. Our suite was huge right on the edge of the cliff with a beautiful view of the valley. Huge bathtub with double headed showers seriously want to redo my bathroom and get one of those. The kitchen was stocked with everything we needed . Big bedroom with sleep number beds (which I now own because I've never slept better in my life so helpful for my arthritic hips.) The Jacuzzi on the upper flower had a great view and it was nice to sit out there. There were some maintenance issues outside the Jacuzzi area could use some care chipped concrete on the walls and a new coat of paint. We did not try the restaurant because we really loved our suites kitchen. SO we really enjoyed ourselves and other then the front desk all the other staff was friendly and I would definitely come back for a relaxing retreat it's a bit of a drive into town though so if you really want a lake Tahoe experience I'd probably stay near to town

reviews.title: Resort at the Top
reviews.text: Resort situated 7,648 feet above Sea Level by the vicinity dividing the state of Nevada and California by the Lake Tahoe Area. If you enjoy height, this is the place to be. Famous destination for the ski lovers. A nice place for Summer Vacation too, mountain biking, hiking, mountain climbing are just a few among other activities offered at the Resort. You will enjoy to see the Washoe Valley on top of your unit facing east.

reviews.title: At it's heart it's a Time-Share, the Resort is just the side show
reviews.text: RUN or SKI AWAY! Got roped into a high pressure travel pitch at a local home-show. They sold us two nights in Tahoe at a bargain rate "because we just know you're gonna love The Ridge". We took the bait, after paying for it they then mentioned the 90 minute sales presentation requirement. The date was left open for our adventure. I called and confirmed for a Sunday arrival, and were told we would be staying at the Lake Tahoe Hotel Resort at Stateline, CA. (a rundown former Embassy Suites), there is some sort of connection between the two properties, Example: the concierge/activity desk at Tahoe Resort is in fact a time-share sales prop and their service vehicles drive about at The Ridge.(whole other review on Tahoe Resort). We attended the sales tour and they do have a prime location for skiers, a great view of the Carson Valley, and an average property. The dining and bar have limited hour and the pool and facilities seem dated.. We told just how stupid we thought it was to try and sell us a timeshare but not even have us stay there to "try it on" ! It's October, between season, and a Monday the place was empty. They offered to "make it up to us" by offering us a stay at $250 a night. WOW! Trip Advisor can get you a stay here at about $90 per night. Look on any of the timeshare resale sites if you really want to buy here and save thousands. Or just stay in one of hundreds of other accommodations in Lake Tahoe..

reviews.title: Conflicted......read this review
reviews.text: Well 1st I was a solo traveler. I stayed here for 5 days/nights. This "resort" have beautiful views, decent rooms, fairly comfortable beds, but that's about it. If you need or want more than that I wouldn't stay here. The restaurant and spa doesn't open til 730a and restaurant closes at 8p spa takes its last service at 330p. The concierge is good at check in as they want to sell you time share but NEVER answer the phone and no one is hardly around property if you want or need something. Sooooo meh. For me it was fine because I was out all day slept and repeat but had I known it was this lacking with service I would have stayed somewhere cheaper to get a lil more for the money esp paying for the so called resort fee.

reviews.title: Wedding Party
reviews.text: Stayed at the Ridge for a wedding in their main convention center. Food was amazing at the reception...some of the best I've had at a wedding! Ha! Tough for parking. Rooms varied per building that you were in. Value was fantastic for being slope side.

reviews.title: Kitchen Amenities
reviews.text: The kitchen was well stocked and the suite was clean so for a family vacation it worked well - nothing fancy but a good value. The wind howling through the hallways was tough to take until we figured out that by putting beach towels under the doorway we negated the sound. The drive down to the lake was fine but coming in from Reno we drove up from the valley on the Kingsbury Grade which was a bit too steep for my liking so will drive out of Tahoe via Rt 50. Staff has been very courteous and helpful

reviews.title: Beautiful views ~ NO air conditioning
reviews.text: I have no "real" complaints but this is not the Marriott Timbers. No air conditioning. New to this property-- it is a ways up the mountain which is ideal for ski season. Having visited in August, a bit out of the way of SLT Blvd. and all the conveniences of eateries, shopping & entertainment. The resort does provide shuttle service to town, complimentary newspaper at your door & free small coffee in the market place. If you enjoy being outside the hustle bustle and don't mind the steep climbs, both on foot & car, you will find the property a welcome during cooler months.

reviews.title: What A Bummer
reviews.text: Our family was so looking forward to this vacation. We were actually looking at purchasing another timeshare at this location. We had called a week earlier for early checkin and a lady named Milly said we would not have a problem. We drove all night to arrive at 10am. We were greeted by a very unpleasant lady named Debbie. She asked for our last name and she explained to us that we did not have a reservation at this resort and we needed to provide a res # or she couldn't help us. We booked through Interval so weird that they would not have our res#. Finally after 20 minutes we were able to find it with them spelling our name wrong. When we asked for early checkin, she stated we would not get it. We asked how long it would be and she stated there were other pressing owner relations issues due to their internet being out. Long story short on checkin, we waited till 4pm and when I was so frustrated I went down to ask why we had not received a phone call for our rm being ready the specialist said it had been ready for 2 hrs but our friend Debbie did not call us. Ok now to the resort, I will be brief. Elevator has been out of service for months per staff and will not be in service for weeks. When I had asked our friend Debbie about a rm close to our vehicle she told me "oh yes it's on the first floor", little did I know first floor was 3.5 floors below. When we got into our rm am issues, remotes do not work had to get housekeeping to bring two new ones, light bulbs oos, internet after paying for it does not work in rms and hot tub was cold. This is only our first night staying in the crest and I will update but hard to believe the ridge can make a comeback. So bummed we get one vacation a year.

reviews.title: Relax with a Hot Stone Massage and their Steam room.
reviews.text: I always enjoy my stays more, if there is an on-site Spa. The Ridge Tahoe has such a Spa. I enjoyed a European Facial one Day and a Hot Stone massage upon arrival to relax my body and put my worries aside. If i were to mention one minus, it would be the adjoining pool which was full of squealing children playing. That took away the relaxing feel afterwards, so I might suggest they have one pool designated more for adults, like they do at my home resort in Palm Desert at the Marriott Villas ll. There are three pools, one called the "Quiet Pool". The JW Marriott in Palm Desert also features an excellent Spa and their pool is separate from the Main Hotel pool, and is for the exclusive use of it's Spa Attendees.

reviews.title: Enjoyable experience with the family
reviews.text: Just spent a week at this resort and had a nice time. Our room had 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, full kitchen with laundry, living room with fireplace, dining room and large patio with natural gas bbq. The bathrooms were clean with pleanty of towels. Parking was on level 5 with an elevator to our floor. Very easy to get in and out. Only concern with the room was all the dim lighting in the common areas ie. dining room. The public areas (pools, jacuzzis and Game room) were generally nice but showed signs of wear. The resaurant at the clubhouse offered nice quality healthy food choices and the staff was so friendly and helpful. The resort also has a gift shop/convenience shop, Spa, putting green, indoor tennis/basketball, outdoor tennis and hiking trails starting steps from our building. A very comfortable experience. Note: This was not ski season but I did notice a monorail-type express lift to the ski lift.

reviews.title: A great getaway
reviews.text: My husband and I used our timeshare and stayed at The Ridge Resorts in July, 2016. The Resort is located high in the Sierra mountains and has a campus of several buildings. Not every building has balconies. Unfortunately we were not able to get a 2 bedroom unit with a balcony. Their owners have first choice. Even so I called several times prior to our arrival, to request a room with a balcony. When checking in, we were told that instead of asking for reservation, we should have ask for the front desk. Out of 6 of our requests, the front desk only received one request. The front desk was very helpful and we lucked out. They put us in the Plaza building with an end unit. No balcony but great views. First floor....which is not ground level. As higher you go, the view is even better but it is much hotter . The unit was very tastefully decorated with a great kitchen. Bring your own coffee, cream and sugar. Each room had a king size Posturepedic number bed. Never had a number bed before. Loved it. Each room has its own safe. I highly recommend to put all your valuables in the safe because housekeeping can come in any time to check on the room. House keeping comes once a week to do a brief cleaning and bring you fresh towels. Buy your groceries in town. It cost less than buying groceries at their Marketplace which is located in their club house. Our unit had a washer and dryer. Bring your own washing detergent. The dining room table is big enough to seat 6 people. The second bedroom is more like a hotel room but with its own coffee maker, a fridge and a microwave. Our master suite shower had two showerheads. It felt good to take a shower. All units do not have air conditioning. Even if the outside temperature was about 85 during the day and 45-50 degrees during the night, it can get a little toasty. We figured out to leave all windows a little open, We closed the curtains when the sun hit the windows and opened then when we got shade. The fans helped a little bit. There is a lot to do on the property. A hiking trail right by, tennis courts, pools, saunas, a big workout room, a restaurant ( The hungry Bear ) with good food, massages (I got one of the best deep massage by Carole Buehler). They have daily activities for children of all ages. They can make different art pieces and experience rock climbing (real rocks, not a wall) or play putt, putt golf. You get daily updates as a message on your phone. It will tell you the temperature of the day, activities and food specials. If you don't know how to retrieve your messages, call the front desk and they give you the number and if needed, connect you with the concierge. Driving up to the property, can be a little scary. Especially at night. Very winding, one lane roads. A shuttle bus on the property will take you at no cost, into town, or anywhere you want to go. The property is : no smoking". We could smoke in the garage and some designated areas. Behind the Harrah's casino / hotel in town a gondola will take you for about $45.00 to the very top and you'll see an incredible view of the lake and the surroundings. I read some terrible reports but found if I am nice to the people, they are very nice to you and will try to accommodate you. One more thing, hang a little provided newspaper door hanger on your door and you will get a newspaper delivered to your room for free. Enjoy, H. Hisle

reviews.title: $350 a night for a room I wouldn't pay $50 for
reviews.text: It was advertised as three days, two nights. I was more like two nights, one day. Check in is after 4pm so there is no first day and check out is 10am so there is no third day. You just really have the middle day as a day to do things. The room was only half made up, i.e. beds and linens were done but the room wasn't cleaned. And no shampoo or lotion. Leftover food in the refrigerator. The couch and chairs were so dirty that we put towels and sheets on them before sitting down. Kinda grossed us out.

reviews.title: Great spot beside the lift
reviews.text: A great spot beside a Heavenly lift. Nice size rooms, plenty of underground parking (very important during ski season), and very friendly staff. I'm glad we chose this place. Close to town as well. Be sure to enjoy the rooftop hot tub after a day on the slopes. Easy to get to and the staff ensure you have a pleasant stay.

reviews.title: The Ridge Resort
reviews.text: Beautiful vistas, excellent accommodations and nice people. Only minutes from the California line. Lots of shopping and water activities also nearby. Excellent locale for the family vaction we took. Casinos on the Nevada side only but right at the state line. Majority of hotels and resorts for both states are at the state line. Carson City, NV 30 minutes and Reno, NV 45-60 minutes away. Sacramento, CA two hours away.

reviews.title: Nice one bedroom near Stagecoach lift
reviews.text: Booked last minute so nice to find this one-bedroom condo with a pull out sofa. Kitchen is quite small, fits one person but has everything. King size sleep number bed. Plenty of towels provided. Has a fireplace. Not quite walking distance to the stagecoach lift unless you trek down the hillside of the lodge and shuttle service available. We did not realize this Ridge lodge is located away from the main lodge. It’s one of the lodges on the left as you start to drive the one way road. It was nice and met our needs. Would stay again if looking to stay near Stagecoach on the Nevada side.

reviews.title: Poor Service
reviews.text: We were notified at check-in that our room (3405) wasn't ready, but that we could wait by the room. The receptionist said, "I would comp you, but we are too busy!" I had to ask her to at least give us a late check out, which she did. When we got up to the room housekeeping wasn't even working on our room, didn't know we were checking in, and was down the hall cleaning another room. We had to convey to the cleaning woman, who didn't speak English, that we were checking in. Once she understood she quickly and graciously moved to clean our room. Our check-in was delayed by 2 1/2 hours so we say with our luggage and food outside on the 4th floor terrace. Once in the room we discovered there was only one coffee mug and one drinking glass so we quickly called and requested one of each. Later that evening we still hadn't received either so we called again. we were told that dispatch would bring them ASAP, and that dispatch would call us right back to give us an estimated time of arrival. They never called during our stay and we never got our other mug and glass. The room amenities list includes free high speed internet but the speed was actually 512kb and was useless. Higher speed would have required payment. The small cafe with counter service had no available menus, and when there was one available the man working the counter gave it to the guy behind us in line! We instead went to the bar to order food, and the bartender said it would take awhile so we say and had a drink. He was wonderful and the food was good, but again the service at the counter cafe was really lacking. There is no air conditioning in our room, which is probably not normally problematic, but with the high temperatures and nearby fires and smoke we couldn't leave windows open. We didn't really use the mandatory $19 a day resort fee, so keep that in mind when considering the cost of the room. We assume this would allow use of tennis, rackets and putt-putt. The hot tub was right by our room, and it was nice, so that was a plus. The Tahoe Rim Trail is just outside the resort for hiking/biking, so that is another plus.

reviews.title: High Above Lake Tahoe (Pant Pant)
reviews.text: Stateline Nevada offers casinos, shopping and tourist traps aplenty, but a 15-minute drive up the surrounding mountains takes you to The Ridge Resorts, a large time-share/hotel complex practically at the top. At nearly 8,000 feet the views are spectacular both into the valley and towards the lake, but the air is this and it takes a few days to acclimate to the altitude. The resort offers hotel rooms, single and two-bedroom apartments and — in the usual manner of time-shares, full kitchens and plenty of room for families to hang out. The two bedroom unit we had (Naegle 11) was on the top floor. It had two nearly equally equipped master suites and a large living area in between. Being the top floor, the unit had cathedral ceilings and there were skylights in one bedroom. These units also have a large patio with table, chairs,chaises and its own gas grill. Sitting on the patio nursing a cup of coffee in the early morning is a special luxury most hotel rooms lack. An extra amenity in our building was a hot tub in the center atrium. We snooped in rooms in other buildings and each has its own perks. Be sure to ask for a lake or valley view when you book. Like most time-share units, the kitchen is well stocked with cheap appliances, dishware, and cooking stuff. We managed to eat-in every night but one, in spite of the dull knives, rickety pots and pans and lack of prep utensils. I don't really think you are expected to actually use the kitchen for more than an occasional quick meal, but they put on a show of providing everything you might need. The major appliances — stove, oven, microwave and fridge were all fine, although a bit worse for wear, but it is always a challenge cooking in a strange kitchen without staples. Really, one wonders why places like this don't offer an inexpensive pack of kitchen necessities such as aluminum foil, oil, sugar, condiments and other things that you have to buy and ultimately leave behind. The Ridge offers plenty to do all year, although it looks like the winter months draw more crowds and have more things open. Their sit-down restaurant was open only on Saturday, but the casual restaurant adjacent to a nice bar and lounge offered a limited but satisfying day-long menu. There is shuttle service throughout the Resort and down to the hubbub in Stateline, but a car is really a necessity. We drove all around the lake, taking Route 50 as it paralelled the shoreline. The lake itself is still pretty pristine, and many places required a bit of a hike to reach the beaches which were thin strips of coarse sand at the waters edge. The Ridge was built in the mid-80's to offer a luxurious home-away from home vacation week for owners and the units are full of granite countertops, Many have gas fireplaces, and the furnishings are comfortable and sturdy. But it has been thirty years and except for an upgrade to large flat-screen TVs, it looks like things haven't been updated much at all, and — at least in our unit — showed the kind of wear that three decades of use leave behind. But for the most part our experience with three grown children along for the week was a happy comfortable trip and we wouldn't have a problem returning in the future.

reviews.title: Request a valley view
reviews.text: The first room assigned to us was 3413 in the Terrace building. It was on the ground floor and had a terrible view of only a parking lot. Luckily we were able to get a new room on the third floor of the Tower building, which had a lovely view of the valley. I definitely recommend being proactive about requesting a good view. There's no reason to stay at the top of the mountain if your view is of a parking lot. I found it pretty disappointing that they gave us such a bad room even though it was off-season (early October) and they had plenty of availability. Two other things that were disappointing - for some reason the on-site mini-golf course was closed on the day we wanted to use it. They didn't give us a reason. The weather was fine and they didn't seem to be doing any maintenance that would affect it. The other problem was the hot tub for the Tower building. We used it one night and it was pretty warm - I would have preferred hotter but it was still okay. But the next morning we used it and it was only lukewarm. Not even as hot as a bathtub. I didn't use it very long since I got kind of cold. I thought I'd warm up in the sauna but it was turned off, even though we were there during the posted 'operating hours'. The resort is at the very top of the mountain - higher than any of the other resorts. I had a really bad bloody nose the first night and a headache the second night because of the altitude. If I were to go to Lake Tahoe again, I might prefer to stay further down the mountain or in town so that it would be a lower elevation and more convenient to drive to other attractions. Otherwise, the resort seemed nice and well-maintained. The rooms were decorated nicely and were spacious. The kitchen had nice granite counter-tops. The resort staff was friendly. And we appreciated the free shuttle to downtown.

reviews.title: Using up timeshare points
reviews.text: We had a bunch of points we needed to use so decided to come to Lake Tahoe. The Ridge Resorts are comprised of several different buildings with different types of accommodations. We stayed in a 1 bedroom suite in the Cascade building. It was spacious and had everything you need. The units are a bit dated but overall very well maintained and comfortable. We also stayed in the Tower building for 1 night. It was a basic studio hotel room. Again, well maintained but a bit on the small side. There was 1 elevator which took forever to get to the floor. There are 2 elevators in the Cascade building and they are fast! The grounds are nice and the little restaurant in the club house is actually very good!

reviews.title: Wedding party
reviews.text: Didn’t have my wedding here but had our rehursal dinner had our family stay here be because of all the amenities. Very convenient and operates like a vacation rental so you can accommodate all group sizes. Best part is the shuttle into downtown. Just no AC so plan for that in the summer time. I’d say that and your room didn’t get cleaned regularly were the only things that people complained about. Made getting ready for a wedding a little hard as the swamp coolers provided are muggy. Would love to go back and this time get to enjoy all the parts of the hotel. The spa was great! Had one of the best massages ever!

reviews.title: Snow day
reviews.text: The room was amazing, king size bed. Pull out couch and love seat and great fireplace. Had I know there was a small kitchen, I would have prepared better. Would definitely book here for our next trip.

reviews.title: Beautiful views in a spacious room
reviews.text: We stayed at the Ridge over Memorial Day weekend and we're thrilled. There was plenty of room for the 5 of us and we cooked in the room with the full kitchen. We also enjoyed the pool and as we were in the Plaza, the hot tub just on the top floor. Everyone was so nice and the shuttle into town or around the resort was a plus. We would recommend this resort to anyone!

reviews.title: Great Rooms, Incredible Views!
reviews.text: This is by far the best place to stay in the Stateline area. The rooms are super clean, sleep number beds, in room spa. Daily service if you’d like. There’s a restaurant on the property. Activities for the kids during the week. Washers and dryers available on your floor.

reviews.title: Convenience on the slopes
reviews.text: The Ridge Resorts are a complex of about 10 separate buildings, each with a different name. We stayed at The Ridge Crest. They are all on a 3-4 mile circular one-way road that is serviced by a regular shuttle that stops at the Stagecoach chairlift at Heavenly Valley ski resort. This is about the most convenient way to go from hotel to slope at any resort. The Ridge Crest is old style, which means that the rooms are large. Management is quick to fix maintenance issues. One issue: the on-site ski rental shop is expensive. I paid $60 per day for top of the line equipment. I am used to $40 per day in other places.

reviews.title: High Above the Clouds
reviews.text: The resort is above 7000 feet elevation so a different experience to be sure. The information given out explains that you may feel some effects of the altitude and how to deal with them.The road in is windy but a not uncomfortable drive. The suite we had was well stocked in both kitchen & bathroom and had a Kind-sized sleep # bed - very nice. The decor was somewhat dated but certainly clean and functional. The bar/bistro in the main building is small but good. In fact, Michael, the first bartender we had was a great guy with a sense of humor and very knowledgeable about the area. The use of laundry equipment is free was which was great as we'd been on the road for a few days. It is not a place where you can just go out the door and hike as it is so high but by driving down the hill or using the shuttle you can access the town, the beach, many hiking trails.

reviews.title: Watch your credit cards
reviews.text: Hard to believe. We have been owners for 15 years at the Ridge Tahoe and have enjoyed our stays but on our recent trip, we left thinking that we will never come back. Owners are aware that there is 1 cleaning day sometime in the middle of their week stay. The day is told to you at check in. What is not told to you at check in is that housekeeping often comes in to the rooms unannounced and for no logical reason. This happened to me when I came out of the shower and came in the living room area to find a housekeeper inside the room with no supplies and when confronted she quickly left. This was after our designated cleaning day. We called the manager and they told us that housekeeping should not be entering the rooms unless it is the designated cleaning day and they sent security to the room to find out how many times the room had been entered and which key card was used. They also told us they would be in contact with us later to go over what the findings were. We got back to the room about 8 hours later and there was no message, so my husband called the manager with no response. I called again about an hour later and did not get a response. In fact from the the time that we had reported this incident on Thursday morning to the time that we checked out Friday at 10:00 A.M., a resort manager has never contacted us. After getting irritated with the situation, we went to the front desk telling anybody who would listen, until finally the head of security came and spoke to us and what he said is shocking. He told us that the Ridge's policy is that housekeeping can enter your room at anytime to look around without your knowledge and even if you say that you don't want the housekeeping services on the specified day, they can still come in saying they are doing an "Occupancy Check". The only way to keep them out is to hang a do not disturb sign which they do not provide in the Naegle buildings where we stay. We found out from security that housekeeping had been in our room on multiple occasions besides our designated cleaning day. We are alarmed by this because the day before the incident, we learned that our business checking account had been compromised from someone duplicating our debit card number. This is a card that is rarely used and had not been used the entire time we were in Tahoe. When speaking with our bank, they told us that the common places that card numbers are stolen are restaurants and hotels. All someone has to do is take a picture of your card and a hacker can make a duplicate card with that number on it. The Ridge management could have easily cleared this up by comparing the times that the housekeeping had entered our room and the times that we were at the pool, which would be the only times that my husband's wallet would have been left in the room. The Management instead chose to ignore us, and regardless where our account was hacked, their behavior is unprofessional and really left us feeling like they were hiding something. When speaking with a person at the Resorts West sales office (owner of the Ridge Resort), which the Head of Security passed us off to, he told us, "you should put all your valuables, including purses, in the safe when you go to the pool". We said, "the safe is the size of a small microwave oven. Wouldn't it make more sense to keep hotel staff out of our room when we are not expecting them to be in there?" He said " It's their property and they could do what they want, when they want". We asked him why they do not call their guests to check on them instead of entering the rooms. He said "That would take too much time ". We told him that makes absolutely no sense. The only way that we can see ourselves going back there is if they change this policy. We were quoted so many conflicting policy procedures that we don't know what to believe.

reviews.title: Great views but room too hot!
reviews.text: We booked our room through Vail Resorts. Our building, The Plaza, was nice - underground parking and spa on the roof with a spectacular view of Lake Tahoe. Although located right next door to Heavenly Stagecoach Lodge, we had to take the shuttle around the loop due to the one way street. Our room was nice - we had a studio and it included a microwave, fridge and coffee maker. It was newly remodeled. The only odd thing is it was so hot. And we were there in the middle of winter. We kept window open but had to open the room door to get any kind of breeze. I guess the ice machine air conditioner in the room was a clue the room is hot!

reviews.title: Conveniently located to Heavenly
reviews.text: Nice place to stay although a little dated. Was disappointed in the hot tub in the plaza building. More like a warm bath tub. The view from the outside hot tub is awesome on the 8th floor of Lake Tahoe. The club house is a bit of a walk but not bad. This is not true ski in ski out but the shuttle will pick you right up at your building and take you to heavenly stage coach lodge which gives you great access to the mountain. If you want to get to town I would recommend a car. The bus is an option but not really Convenient although free. The market in the clubhouse is fully stocked if you forgot something however there is a Safeway only 20 minutes by car. The restaurants and bar are limited and close really early. If you have a car plenty of amazing local food choices nearby. I would recommend Sonneys BBQ, Primo Italian, Chart House, Base Camp Pizza, Creative Crêpes.

reviews.title: Gorgeous view from private balcony
reviews.text: My accommodations in late spring of 2016 were excellent. My only negative comment is that I had zero interaction with the hotel staff other than via the telephone. To check in you use a house phone and are directed to some lock boxes and you are told the combination. Inside is your key and welcoming paperwork. To check out you just leave the key on the kitchen counter and walk away.

reviews.title: Great location for slopes, needs a little maintenance.
reviews.text: First - if you stay here, it’s got an excellent little lift which gets you to the stagecoach lift, which is a great way to start. The plaza building we were in isn’t too bad, but the heating is ballistic, the clever inflatable beds are a bit worn out and we didn’t have hot water for 2 mornings. The hot tub on the roof REALLY needed cleaning! Overall - ok.

reviews.title: Wonderful stay at Lake Tahoe even with 62 inches + of snow
reviews.text: My husband arrived on Monday just at the beginning of a huge snowstorm. We got 62 inches from Monday through Wednesday. The resort provided shuttle transportation around the resort area and into town which was great as I was not about to drive. Our condo was in the Pointe and it was fabulous, fireplace, jacuzzi and full kitchen - no one can ask for more. There is a hot tub in the building and a small gym. Bed is very comfortable with sleep number beds. Have not tried the restaurants yet, probably will tomorrow. Everyone was great. Debbie let us finish the check in process early so that we could park and I was very grateful. Would definitely come back.

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Great place clean friendly staff and positive vibes. Good size rooms and awesome views of the valley below Clean many things to do and see Good place to eat and chillout. Wonderful relaxing spa treatments and get very pampered and spend the time just enjoying being in a beautiful place e

reviews.title: Isolated from all services
reviews.text: The Ridge Pointe is not safe and the layout of these resorts is very inconvenient. The map online is not to scale, so did not realize how isolated we would be from all the services (bar, pool, etc.). I tried to enjoy the outdoor hot tub, but the power went out due to a high wind. I had to gather my items in the freezing, cold, dark only to find out that the key card reader for the front door did not work because of the power outage. HUGE DESIGN FLAW! I thought I was going to freeze to death, I had to sneak out the side and go around to the front of the building. I will not stay here ever again, I thought that this was a RESORT, but it felt more like a motel.

reviews.title: A Great Family Tradition -HIghly Recommend The Ridge
reviews.text: My family has been coming to The Ridge for years - it has become our annual family tradition-we love it. It is a well designed resort, comfortable & luxurious & convenient. So many activities to do & gorgeous views from our room. I am avid hiker and The Tahoe Rim Trail goes right by it. Do not miss The Van Sickle Connector Trail that starts right at the resort and goes down to the casinos in a few hours of absolutely breath taking views (why pay $40 for the gondola?!), then take the shuttle back up to the resort. I highly recommend The Ridge & continue to many more years of coming back.

reviews.title: Very Good Hotel Facility
reviews.text: Just got home from a week visit to South Lake Tahoe and stay at The Tower at The Ridge Resort. We had a two bedroom unit – plenty of space and very clean. Was impressed with the size of the rooms and the appointments.
