The first morning we woke up and the room was chilly even though the heater was turned on – after talking with the staff, I was advised that The Town had radiant heat, not forced heat – as such the rooms would never be really warm. Within an hour though the hotel delivered 4 small space heaters, as well as several additional blankets to our unit. The cleaning staff was very friendly and accommodating, they were always asking if there was anything they could do or provide. The concierge was helpful with snowmobiling and restaurant suggestions. The “new” ski-in / ski-out gondola that takes you down to Stagecoach was very handy and made skiing less taking not having to deal with buses or drive down. Though one day the gondola wasn’t; working because a guest had broken off their key in the switch. We did lose electricity a couple of times – though don’t think it was the hotel’s fault. Service was restored within an hour or so.

reviews.title: Nice resort and amenities
reviews.text: The rooms were nice, albeit a bit hot. I am not used to no a/c, but they do not have any But the size was big enough and we slept fine . The pool area and other playground and kids areas were nice enough for my kids to play on and they loved the hot tubs on the roof of our building. I'm not sure if we would come back but we really enjoyed out visit here!

reviews.title: Gone Down Hill...still a bargain
reviews.text: We’ve been vacationing with our kids (now late teens) to The Ridge Resorts for 10 yrs. We initially picked it for its various summer activities (tennis, swimming, hiking, yoga, racquetball, wallyball, spa, kids art classes, movie theater, etc etc.) It’s a timeshare resort. However...we didn’t buy a timeshare so been booking through GetARoom.com. The price is always less expensive than a hotel room. We’ve stayed in the 2 bd/2 ba (HUGE bathrooms) condos. Also in a King hotel room and another condo offsite (DO not stay offsite. You have to drive to Resort everyday to get to amenities! Hassle. Live and learn.) This Resort has served us well in the past. However...it’s definitely gone downhill. Our recent trip to the hotel portion the curtains in room were thick with dust at top; it fell on you as you opened the curtains! The room itself, 2nd floor in Plaza, was warm and stuffy. We had to leave the ceiling fan on 24/7...wh/ is annoying and loud. The bathroom wasn’t cleaned well (ugh). When we called housekeeping to ask for extra TP, shampoo, pillows, it took them - on 3 diff occasions -nearly 6-8 hrs! Really? The place needs updated decor and to be gone over thoroughly (broken outlets and old microwave). Better and consistent amenities offered (they cancel any activities if less than 2 ppl show). The registration desk staff was new and messed up our Rez 2 different times (lots of turnover in last yrs. Means inconsistent customer service). In the future, we’ll try one of resorts in So Tahoe. A place with better customer service, consistent amenities and updated rooms and property. Plus save our car driving up and down the hill everyday.

reviews.title: Great place for Hiking--and many other activities.
reviews.text: We were there as guest of friends in June. They have stayed there before. It is a really nice resort with all kinds of activities available--tennis courts, racquetball courts, saunas, spas. The concierge was very helpful helping me find hiking trails, many of which start fight from the property. There was still a little bit of snow on the slopes and the views of the valley and the lake were awesome.

reviews.title: Beautiful Mountain Retreat
reviews.text: The resort is nestled near the top of Heavenly Mountain on the South Shore of Lake Tahoe. It is a complex of several buildings, all with mountain views. It can be a self-contained resort with its bar and bistro open seven days a week, and a full service restaurant open two nights a week. The food is quite good. There are many indoor and outdoor activities available for adults and children. With the spectacular Lake Tahoe a short drive away, do drive down the mountain. At the base of the mountain there are several good restaurants, clubs, grocery store and a movie theater. The accommodations at the resort are quite nice and comfortable. The two bedroom suite we had was furnished in mountain chic decor--wood, stone, warm and earthy tones--and very spacious. A fully furnished kitchen with appliances, pots, pans, utensils, tableware, plates and glasses. There were three televisions and two full baths in the suite. The loading port of the Stagecoach lift of the Heavenly Ski Resort is at the resort, connected by a short express monorail from the Ridge Resort.Overall, this is a good value in any season. The Lake is nearby, as are Carson City and Reno, Nevada and all those cities and state offer in the way of entertainment and gambling.

reviews.title: Fantastic Resort
reviews.text: If you are looking for a great resort, in a great location this is it. This resorts offers lots to do winter or summer. The resort also has some good restaurants on property and near by. Great for singles, or couples or even families. They even offer sleep number beds for great comfort.

reviews.title: Disappointing Interval International (II) Trade
reviews.text: We traded our Breckenridge 2 bedroom Grand Timber Lodge Resort, a premier resort, for an equitable, "premier" resort as classified by II. We chose this property, or I should say the property chose us as we had limited trade options, as a) it was advertised as ski in/ski out and b) it did appear to be a "premier" resort. We checked in satisfactorily and assigned a 2 bedroom unit in the Cascade lodge. Upon arriving we were disappointed with the Cascade as the building looked dated, lacked a deck and really did not have a good view like several of the other buildings in the complex. Our condo were rooms 4107 & 4108, first floor rooms. As for the condo itself, we both were impressed as to how spacious the unit was; ~1,400 square feet. The lockout unit was the largest we have and it had all the same bathroom amenities as the master unit. From there it went downhill and I question how well managed the place is overall. The dishwasher, though surprisingly it worked well, was not mounted to the cabinet. Overtime you loaded a dish, the unit would almost fall out of the cabinet fitting. Flushing the toilets was an adventure. The first flush the toilet acted as if it was backed up and if you mustered the courage to flush again it actually flushed correctly. Sometimes you would have to repeat the process 3 times. That could be a little scary. The shower head in the master was mounted too low and the pressure was okay. The shower in the lockout was fine. All the furniture was old and uncomfortable. The beds were all sleep number and were quite comfortable and the sheets were soft, so we were pleased with the sleep quality. My biggest complaint was the ski in/ski out. At GTL, we truly have ski in/ski out. Not so at the Ridge. For ski in/ski out I never walked so much in my life. First you had to take a shuttle, then call a 8 person "train" which took 3 minutes to the stagecoach lift. After getting off the train, you then had to climb down at least 20 steps and then walk 50 years to the lift. It was even more "fun " going back, especially after skiing hard all day...The rental shop at the resort is great and I highly recommend getting your skis there. We did not try the restaurant or the bar. The restaurant is only open Thursday - Saturday. But the bistro was available. We did like the location and town access was simple. Overall, there were many things to like about Ridge Resorts. Armed with the knowledge I have now, before arriving I would definitely want to understand where I'm staying. We were there the first week of February and by and large it was quiet.

reviews.title: The Ridge View
reviews.text: Nice place. Clean, but far away from state line strip. We are in room 1833 that is on the street level. Very noisy from the street. They happen to be sealing the asphalt this week ! All the amenities are located about 2 miles away at the top of the mountain. There is a transportation bus that will take you to the top, and one that will take you to the casinos and bring you back.

reviews.title: Spring Break 2nd Annual Family Road Trip Review
reviews.text: 3 adults and two teenagers, including myself lodged at the Lake Tahoe Ridge Resort. Our 2 bedroom accommodations were excellent: the kitchen, bathrooms, living room areas were clean. Our washing machine was not working, engineering was contacted multiple times. This was quite an inconvenience, however, we finally after a day received a washing machine that actually worked. I must report however, that an engineer arrived each time we called to report the machine. Finally, I walked into the lodge and reported this incident to the person at the desk and within minutes the supervisor of maintenance arrived with others to solve the problem. All kitchen appliances were clean and working well. We were able to cook and have meals as a family. We kept housekeeping very busy with our requests. Each time a member of the team arrived with a smile and with extra towels and blankets particularly. I don't have any complaints with regard to this resort. It snowed, the staff cleaned the snow quickly about the property including the snow that collected at our front door. I appreciated the fact that we had a doorbell that actually worked. Overall, I would recommend this resort to anyone who wants to have an amazing vacation and with teens who appreciate their privacy, easy access to activities about the property (swimming, a game room, indoor/outdoor swimming pool, basketball, etc.). and who appreciated the stay. In their words, we love it and it's better than our resort (Westgate Flamingo Bay in Vegas) during our 2015 Road Trip. The accommodations were extremely comfortable for the girls. If you prefer lower elevations, this is not the place for you. It takes an hour to travel into town.

reviews.title: Way way past its prime
reviews.text: We went here on time share exchange-so we knew could be chancy. We were therefore prepared for subpar facilities- but this resort is in desperate need of overhaul. Where to start- we were here for a week (we are leaving early and fortunately drove so we can do it), and our 1BR full kitchen exchange got us a small room with bath, coffee maker, microwave and a couple of cups, spoons, forks and two glasses, and small fridge. But there was supposed to be two restaurants on site- however one is a small pool area snack bar and the other one is closed for renovation. So eating for a week was a lot of meals in town. Inconvenient and expensive. Also "sleep number" beds - could never get setting past 40-like sleeping on a brick! The "multiple" amenities include weirdly spaced out (we're talking spread out across different buildings and multiple different levels) poor signage- (even in elevators), run down 1980s style offerings. Everything we tried (pool, hot tub, sauna, mini golf, bar (a table set up in lobby), snack bar, "market" etc was substandard and in very bad need of updating, fixing, esthetic improvement and functionality. Here's a good example- gym has stained broken ceiling tiles peeling down on flooring, TVs connected to very old school equipment that are so far from equipment that headset won't reach! What's up with that? Ladies changing room was closed for renovation- slightly inconvenient to not have even a bathroom anywhere near gym or pool. Pool was not clean looking, spa had only two working jets and no timer or thermostat- water was tepid. Sauna smelled like old socks. On the plus side, staff was friendly and helpful. The taco bar was tasty and fellow who prepared ingredients deserves praise - nice! Lake Tahoe is beautiful (though it was chilly here, last night it went down to 29 degrees) (photo attached) and maybe if you are here simply for skiing in Winter then it might be ok- but for summertime- I would recommend a newer nicer hotel- there are others nearby.

reviews.title: Pleasantly Surprised
reviews.text: My family of 4 stayed here for Christmas week 2017. We stayed in a 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom unit in the Plaza Building. We loved our room, which had an amazing view of Carson valley and the mountain side - which had a light dusting of snow. The key features of our room that we loved were the master bathroom shower - had 2 shower heads on either side of the shower which kept you nice and warm! We also loved the sleep number beds. It was a nice size unit in which we never felt crowded. The fake fireplace works well and quickly heats the place up - sometimes a bit too much. The resort offers easy access to Heavenly Ski Resort- great if you intend to ski! The resort also has shuttles within the resort and a shuttle into town. It's very convenient. We only tried the Bistro for eating on property - it was Okay. It was certainly convenient, which is why we went. We didn't try the bar or fancy restaurant. We made reservations at the Chart House for Christmas Dinner - which is a short drive halfway down the mountain. It has an amazing view of the lake - and we went early to enjoy the sunset. It was spectacular! Another attraction we loved was the Bleu Wave Cruise to Emerald Island. There are 3 different companies with a similar offering. Blue Wave offers an online discount and includes a cold cut lunch and cookies with 2 drink tickets for each adult. Yes, that includes alcohol! It was a 5 star experience. The crew went above and beyond - we thoroughly loved that day and such a great experience. It was about a 30 minute drive to the dock from the resort. We would not hesitate to stay here again!

reviews.title: Stay Away
reviews.text: I had the unfortunate experience of visiting the Ridge Tahoe recently and will never go there again! The front desk is terrible we waited in line for what seemed like hours finely some big sweaty man came out offering free breakfast we didn't want free breakfast we wanted to check in. We were told by several people that this always happens because the front desk is a "mess". When we finally got into our room it was so hot it was ridiculous (no air conditioning) and all the windows were closed to make it worse. to top it off someone else came into our room and said it was their room too. Turns out the brain trust at the front desk had given our already occupied room to another party. We were told this happens all of the time at the resort which is amazing. Needless to say we will never ever go back.

reviews.title: Great property w/spectacular views - close to Lake Tahoe
reviews.text: A friend got married at The Ridge & reserved a block of rooms for the guests. My wife & I had never been to The Ridge, so we were excited to get to check it out. We travel quite a bit & have our own timeshare, so we've had many experiences in a variety of properties. Overall, the Ridge was pretty incredible. First, the location - its pretty tough to beat the views & the proximity to Lake Tahoe (I'd guess its about 10 minutes to the casinos). Second - the property was (almost) immaculate - It seemed like the condo/wing we stayed in was relatively new... The wing where we stayed could be modified to a multi-bedroom unit with full kitchen simply by opening the 'connecting doors' within our 1 bedroom unit. Pretty cool. Third - we didn't have any major issues with The Ridge, Ridge staff, etc... except for one incident. When we were packing up preparing to leave, we found a leaking black leather bag under the bed. Upon further review, we discovered a collection of sex toys... Made me wonder: if the cleaning team missed this, what else did they miss? Other than that, it was a great stay - & we'd probably do it again... & this time we'd check under the bed before occupying the room. :)

reviews.title: Good location but staff need to be trained on the art of customer service.
reviews.text: My wife and I are "Owners" at The Ridge and have been for a few years. We stayed here at the beginning of July 2016 (our first visit during summer) and were surprised to find that there is no airconditioning in the Cascade building. Fortunately temps drop drastically at night and we put fans in all the windows to suck in the cooler air. Which was just bearable for sleeping. We had another trip planned for the end of July with the kids so we asked if we there was air conditioning in the Nagle building where we would be staying. We were told "No it's not needed in Tahoe because it is so cool at night". Then we were instructed that we could ask for a portable aircondtioner for our next visit, but they only had a limited number of them so be sure to get one early. we asked to reserve one for our trip in 2 weeks and were told that they don't reserve them it's first in first served. Then we were instructed to ask as soon as we check in on our next stay. Fast forward 2 weeks. We are checking in for our stay at the Nagle 12 building and ask for an airconditioner to be sent to the room. the person at the front desk says that we need to call housekeeping when we get to the room and they will bring one to us. we get to the room, open the door and are greeted by humid hot stuffy air as we enter the unit. We call housekeeping (approx 4.30pm) and are told that they don't do the air conditioners and that we need to contact maintenance. We call maintenance and get a voicemail saying that they are not there, closed for the day and call back in the morning. We call Housekeeping and are instructed that there is nothing that they can do and they tell us to call maintenance in the morning. Meanwhile we are stuck in a hot, humid unpleasant room. In the morning we call maintenance at 8am and leave a message. Never hear back from anybody. We call the front desk and they could not care less, tell us to call housekeeping ETC ETC ETC. We never got an air conditioner and never got contacted by any staff member about availability of one. Seems that they could have just said "I am sorry, we don't have one available" that would have been disappointing but no where near as frustrating or time consuming. On every occasion that we have stayed at The Ridge we have left filled out comment cards for the management. Sometimes good comments, sometimes bad. We have never ever heard anything back from management.

reviews.title: Ok at Best
reviews.text: The place is just ok for the price, never stayed in the area so not sure what to expect. We had to catch an early flight to get there in the shortest amount of time. We thought we would be able to check in at least 2:00 pm get some rest before heading out to our first family event. Nope not the case, they stick to the 4 pm if you are lucky!! We get to the room and it is hot!! Then we call the front desk only to find out that there is not air conditioning on all of the property!! During the night with the windows open the room got cooler but during the day it was warm. The spa was/is being renovated so there was lots of construction noise at the main lobby. On the plus side there is a great hike at the top of the hill!! We did it on Saturday and Sunday. Lake Tahoe is beautiful and very large.

reviews.title: This is for the Ridge Pointe only.
reviews.text: This a part of a three complexes property and there are NO activities at this location, so if you are skiing I guess t would be a good place to stay. Otherwise it is rather boring and not for kids, EVEN THOUGH THE PICTURES SHOW OTHERWISE. The activities for kids like swimming, kids arcade kids activities sessions are all located at the main complex called THE RIDGE TAHOE and you have to drive it. All the food and drinks are also at the Tahoe complex. The room..two bedroom suite..was outstanding and roomy! No valets or valet parking.

reviews.title: Nice rooms but service could be better
reviews.text: We only stayed at The Ridge for one night as we were visiting relatives in the area. I booked this hotel as it had a good price for a two bedroom unit, compared to two rooms elsewhere. We arrived at 9:00pm and the check in was fairly easy. We found our assigned building and rooms. With a 2 bedroom, they connect a single hotel room to a one bedroom unit. It turns out, they didn't unlock the connecting door between the two units. We had to call down to the front desk to get them to send someone to unlock the connector. In the mean time, we discovered that there were no sheets for the pullout sofa, so another call to housekeeping for the set of sheets. 45 minutes later, the housekeeping staff arrived with the sheets and unlocked the connector. The room was extremely warm when we arrived, but there is no central air conditioner system, so opened up every window in the unit. Seems like the entire building had their windows all open as far as they would go. If I were here for more than one night, that would have been a problem. The rooms themselves were nicely decorated and the sleep number bed was interesting.

reviews.title: Very Enjoyable
reviews.text: Our family has been coming to The Ridge (Tower) since the 1980s. It's always a highlight of the family get together. Overall It is well managed and designed, and especially the Tower and Naegle buildings, are, comfortable & luxurious. The valley view from the Tower is to die for. My only concern is that the check in time is crowded and crazy. Management should be able to do something creative about this I recommend The Ridge as a full destination resort although there is much to do in the area as well.

reviews.title: Beautiful location and very cozy suites!
reviews.text: We stayed here during our family winter holiday and it was fantastic! The resort is located up-top the mountain and has a wonderful view of Carson Valley. There's something for everyone - whether you want to enjoy the fitness facilities, go out and ski at Heavenly, or enjoy the casinos and restaurants. The rooms are super cozy, and a perfect mix of cabin/suite/condo style accommodations. We'll definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: A nice resort with everything you need.
reviews.text: The Ridge Resort was located next to all the ski and winter fun activities providing a good home base. The resort was as clean as you could expect with tons of snow everywhere with a strange building layout touting a jacuzzi located in the center of the building's rooms open to the sky. Kind of a 70's type of vib. They do a really nice job with snow removal so you can get around and do the things you want to do without worrying you'll be snowed in. The clubhouse is really nice with great food and bar, spa, owner's lounge and friendly people to help. The housekeeping department came every day to check on us and to ask if we needed anything. Felt really pampered by them. The not so good: The suite was beautifully remodeled but already showing wear and tear. The insulation is not good on cold days and you had to keep the water at a drip so the pipes wouldn't freeze. The 2 bedroom suite was freezing except for the master bedroom that was always too hot. The jacuzzi in our building was out of order the entire week we were there. The building dry sauna was perfect though. The steam sauna was nice in the clubhouse but not hot enough so the swimming pool temperature was not set to counter the not so hot steam sauna. The swimming pool was too cold and the Roman hot tub was as well because the steam sauna wasn't hot enough. The showers were excellent and had lockers. Just need a little adjustment with the temperatures and it will be perfect. Loved the Eucalyptus in the steam sauna. The front desk manager, Nina, tried to do everything to make us happy when we wanted to move because our building jacuzzi was broken but communication with housekeeping seemed to be lacking with her department when we decided to stay put because moving would have been a huge hassle. Housekeeping came everyday to ask if we were checking out by instructions of the front desk. Then half way through the week the front desk called and asked what was going on like we were squatters or something. Strange. Why they put us in a building with broken facilities is wrong but understandable since they were receiving record snowfalls and a power outage blew out the jacuzzi. We could have used the facilities in any of the buildings, though, but it was cold and difficult to navigate that idea. The view in our suite's common area was obstructed by a wall of snow and a roof but we could still see the gorgeous landscape of the mountain with effort. This place has great potential. Overall, we enjoyed our stay because of the location and the very friendly staff. If winter activities is your thing then this is a really good place to stay. Things can always be worse in my opinion and our stay was fun and the suite was acceptable and we enjoyed our stay.

reviews.title: Enjoyable Vacation
reviews.text: The Ridge Resort is about a 5 minute drive above the hussle and bussle of South Lake Tahoe. Great in the winter for skiing as right next to the lift and it actually has it's own gondola to carry you to the lift. Summer is great as it has three swimming pools, tennis courts, and many outside activities to keep you and the kids busy.

reviews.title: Fantastische Backpackers!
reviews.text: This backpackers / lodge is fabulous! Words can not describe how kind and helpful the people are who work in the hostel. Not only with everyday questions in and around the hostel but also helping out planning my trip and getting back my phone that I forgot in the hostel where we stayed previously, I got it send to Blue Sky Mining but it didn't come in on time. When the parcel came in Blue Sky Mining they helped me out big time by sending the parcel right away to Cape Town! Thanx a million to Romy for arranging that and a lot of respect+love for all the other staff as well for making my stay so pleasant (6 days).

reviews.title: Nice stop off if your passing through Durban
reviews.text: This was a very clean, very relaxed and accommodating hostel, my only problem was that it was a bit far away from anything that you didnt really feel the need to leave the hostel, the rooms were great and the bathrooms were perfect, the set up and environment inside was very cosy and exclusive and you could find plenty to do inside but it was to far away from everything, if you go with a few people it might be easier to organise trips from there into Durban or down to the beach but as a solo traveller i found myself staying in. Its a luxury stop off in my eyes and a very comfortable one at that!

reviews.title: worst backpackers
reviews.text: ok the rooms are clean, and the accomodation is good, but that's not why people anjoy backpacking, it should be a b&b and not a backpackers, service is pathetic,staff are unfriendly, the bar and kitchen close at 10. there is no sense of freedom or warmth that you would usually get at a backpackers lodge, blue skymining diggs for money from the backpacking community, i would not visit blue sky mining again. not as a backpacker..hpe this helps

reviews.title: lovely location pity about management
reviews.text: I spent 3 weeks here on a visit from the UK to see my family, I had booked 2 deluxe units for the 4 of us and can honestly say only one unit could be described as deluxe therefore most of our time was spent in 1 unit, management refused to allow us to stay together even though we did not ask for any money back, there was no laundry service on site, the safe was not operable for 5 days and we were never asked if everything was to our satisfaction. Returning in 2 years and this place can forget about a repeat booking, there are many places wanting our business.

reviews.title: Road trip
reviews.text: I always enjoy staying here and find it good value for money, however it has changed a lot and it’s become bigger and caters for the real backpacker. Great views and very friendly helpful service. Try the daily drink and meal specials too

reviews.title: Ugly vibe, unfriendly unpleasant owner, manager, staff
reviews.text: I've stayed at hostels and backpacker places all over the world, and this place has to be near the bottome of the list. Unwelcoming unfriendly cold manager and owner...There are signs everywhere demanding deposits, forbidding this or that. Get a sense of the spirit of the place by checking their website: There's a 40% forfeiture of deposit money for those who cancel 8 to 30 days prior to arrival! The owner and manager are hellbent on making money--they seem to be succeeding at that--but follow the rules and regulations. Pay for wi-fi. Be sure to pay in advance if you want to extend your stay there for some odd reason...and to be fair, the grounds and two small pools are beautiful; the view is great. And...I witnessed a worker spraying poison around the base of the main building...I suggested that he wear gloves and a mask; he replied there weren't any! Just thinking about those people upsets me. Find an alternative place to stay.

reviews.title: Great Backpackers
reviews.text: This is an awesome backpackers, friendly staff,clean rooms,friendly on the pocket and well organized. This is definitely a place that will leave you with good memories. There are also a lot of great guests to enjoy the experience together. Fun times... Jay

reviews.title: A really good clean place to stay
reviews.text: We stayed here for 3 nights. Very close to the sea. Great affordable food and drinks. My only gripe is the lack of comfy furniture and couches to just chill out and lay back in. All the seating was upright restaurant style or hard benches. I will still be back though.

reviews.title: Beautiful Relaxing place to be....
reviews.text: Most amazing place to be no matter what time of year. Units : Black Marlin and Great White are beautiful units to stay. We then stayed with the family in the dormitory Dorado (sleeps 8) own bathroom/shower/toilet basin. Fantastic stay and ALL staff are excellent and always very helpful. The food at restaurant is very tasty, especially the specials of the day. Relaxingand beautiful environment and staff. If you look for 'Luxurious 5 star accommodaton' book in at the Hilton hotel. View is breathtaking, wifi very fast, swimming pools are amazing.

reviews.title: I stayed here unexpectedly with friends over a weekend and got to stay in a dorm and a tent around back.
reviews.text: I stayed in a dorm style room and a tent over the course of a long weekend. The lodge offers two great pools, a bar and restaurant, and plenty of lovely space for lounging. We enjoyed the location; it's walking distance from a fabulous stretch of beach, but the market and bars nearby left something to be desired. We even got to try the brai here, and it was well worth it.

reviews.title: Lovely place
reviews.text: Lovely helpful staff, very nice rooms, very clean. Views of the beach from decking area. Nice restaurant. There was a Zulu cooking lesson going on the night we stayed and it seemed they always had something planned to entertain there guests. Shared kitchen for guests. Swimming pool. Baz bus stop!! Would recommend!!

reviews.title: Great Backpackers
reviews.text: Came here for 4 days looking to relax and it was perfect. Great view of the ocean from the property. 2 pools in a big backyard. Quick walk to the beach. Great staff and great curry. If you are looking for big night life, this area isnt the spot.

reviews.title: Unbelievable value for money
reviews.text: Loved this place which is across the road from Warner Beach. Went with out 3 & 1 year old and they loved the place didn't want to leave . Food was good and staff very friendly. A place well looked after on a daily basis and many returning guests who have nothing but good things to say. This plZce should be called a resort not a back packers

reviews.title: Great place, lovely staff, awesome food
reviews.text: We stayed for four nights at the Blue Sky Mining Hostel and we loved it. The location is absolutely beautiful, the staff super friendly and we got a lot of great advice, what to do in the area. We would totally recommend it and would be happy to go there again. The rooms were clean and the food in the restaurant is absolutely amazing. We had a great time!

reviews.title: Perfect stay
reviews.text: Perfect location for durban visitors.train Station & beach 5 mins away. Hostel has 2 brilliant pools Sun deck with nice ocean view.staff were more than nice. Parking space and supermarket are also nearby. Hostel is really clean also

reviews.title: Horrible,stinky place to stay.
reviews.text: Yes,it's a backpacker but there's no reason for it not to be hygienic.We were allocated a stinking room,not to talk about the shower.....oh my word it was so filthy.The water was cold because they forgot to switch the geyser back on when we arrived.They should invest in cleaners and industrial cleaning material.

reviews.title: Superb!!!!
reviews.text: We've only stayed here for one night but we were VERY sad to go! Blue Sky Mining is an unbelievable backpackers. Friendly staff, a great restaurant and well stocked bar - at very reasonable prices! The rooms are very well maintained and from our side, really not one complaint! You REALLY have to go out of your way to find something wrong. The atmosphere and the view goes hand on hand - unbelievable. We can really recommend Blue Sky Mining. But please don't make the same mistake we did - you cannot stay for only 1 night...stay as long as possible, you really will not regret it! Well done guys - we'll never forget it. Jaenie and Gerda

reviews.title: Rad
reviews.text: Stayed here while doing a month long internship in Amanzimtoti. This best is one of the coolest backpackers lodges in South Africa. Location is beautiful and the staff are super welcoming, friendly, and helpful. Definitely worth coming back in the future.

reviews.title: Nice place
reviews.text: Stayed here for a couple of nights camping. Food is great and the views and proximity to the beach are amazing (even saw whales one evening from bar/dining area). Staff all friendly and helpful. Makes a very nice relaxing stop along your trip, with the area feeling very safe. The camping spots however are quite small which is alright as long as you don't have a large tent. The only problem I can think of is that it is advertised as having free WiFi (Coast2Coast I think it was), which it doesn't you have to pay a small fee (think was R30) which isn't much but after expecting free does miff you off a tad.

reviews.title: Weekend getaway
reviews.text: We spent our long weekend at Blue Sky and it was the best in a very long time. Excellent service. Excellent staff. Excellent view. Definitely the place to be. Thank you Blue Sky for making our getaway so unforgettable.

reviews.title: Awesome (if you have a car or stay far away from Durban
reviews.text: If you have a car or just want to stay in a nice place in Durban, this is the right place to stay... Really confortable and awesome rooms with good shower, bed and nice views from the swimming pool (they have 2 awesome swimming pool) and is just 3 min walking to the shops and beach. The staff is really helpfull.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: A secret little heaven along the coast. Thank you Fiona for excellent service and all the staff were friendly and helpful. The view was spectacular and bunny chow was very tasteful. Very clean rooms and good security. You will see us again.

reviews.title: Five stars!
reviews.text: We loved it here! Great food, awesome pools, beautiful view and interior. We were upgraded from a dorm to a private room while it was quiet which was great. The staff are really friendly and helpful, would definitely come here again!

reviews.title: Stunning Stay in Durban
reviews.text: We stayed here for a week during August, when we first arrived we were welcomed by the very helpful staff, they showed us round and explained where everything was, the meal plans at the restaurant and the parking area as we were driving. We always felt welcome when we were there, the staff always asked us how our day was when we came back and were well informed in all the activities we were doing and excited about our videos we showed them. The food was great, they have specials every night which you can try, the curry was very hot so if you do stay here just a heads up, I like a good hot curry and this one did not disappoint. We were scuba diving while we were in Durban and the staff offered us advice on where to dive and the best spots around Durban. We were hoping we could learn how to surf while we were there but unfortunately the weather didn’t allow this as we were unlucky with size of the waves but the guys at the hostel were always happy to check the next day for us. The room was clean everyday while we were there, the bathrooms and showers were spotless, just one recommendation was that they put up a blind or curtain in the main toilet/shower as you can look straight through the window into the room. Overall we thoroughly enjoyed out time at the hostel and would highly recommend it to anyone looking to stay in Durban but not in the city centre and have a car to travel in .

reviews.title: Awesome place
reviews.text: Entire experience was super cool. The rooms are very nice and cheap and the residence in general was awesome. The staf were really nice and helpful with suggesting things to experience and in our case to locate the best surfing spots in the area. Great food as well. You could drive south with a lot of surf spots or in to the city of Durban. But the best spot was just down at the beach a five minute walk from the hostel. A super nice beach break with good waves. Every morning-surf a group of dolphins joined us and we got to experience them literally swimming around our surfboard. Amazing experience! Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Beautiful grounds, view, and nice staff!
reviews.text: We stayed there twice! We found the staff very nice, friendly, and helpful with trip planning etc. The place is very clean and well organized. There are signs but within reason as we were told some people get out of hand and the signs help prevent that. The atmosphere is very relaxed, it's close to the beach and the food is delicious. We would recommend BSM. Only suggestion is that WIFI be free of charge, it's a pay once and then unlimited.

reviews.title: Good place to stay
reviews.text: Honestly, I would like to give them 3,5 stars, but rounding it up as the staff is very lovely and helpful. We stayed a week in the self-catering cottage. Our first impression was that it has a lovely view and well maintained. It had a lovely balcony to sit on and enjoy the view (but the chairs could be a bit more comfortable, especially since my butt is a bit larger than average and only just fit in the chair). It was equipped with most things we needed, although we were surprised matches weren't provided while it is a gas cooker and the fridge wasn't turn on before we arrived. However the bed is quite uncomfortable (very hard mattress with soft pillows). Although it probably is based on previous experience of what people did, it was kind of annoying to find notes everywhere what you were not allowed to do. Maybe put them together in one welcome folder with house rules and explanations as well as some ideas of things to do in the area? Personally I found it a nuisance that you can't turn of the tv (because of the moisture). The reason might be very valid, but not having a tv at home as I like the peace and quiet and even though the sound was off your attention keeps on getting drawn to the screen. Apart from those minor things we had a lovely stay. The place offers great views, two baie lekker pools and a lovely atmosphere. The food they offer in their restaurant is of great quality. The staff is very friendly and helpful (and a special mention to Reena who was very nice and always smiling and chatting with us and even brought the ordered food to our cottage twice!). An idea is to maybe let your staff do some of the activities you offer, so they can tell more about it (the companies should offer it to them at no cost so they will be sold). I spoke to two people and they couldn't really answer questions, but were helpful enough to phone the place and ask them. Selling activities works much better if you know what you are selling :).

reviews.title: Wonderfull view horrible staff
reviews.text: On arrival already did not receive a warm welcome. Rooms as expected, clean and maintained. For a backpackers the vibe was terrible, not because of the guests but staff were unacommadating. The view is wonderfull, what a shame about the service. Wont see me again.

reviews.title: Clean, vibey and great service!
reviews.text: This is def one of the better lodges/backpackers I have ever stayed at. 7-10min walking distance from the beach is totally worth it considering the view. It has its own delicious restaurant, great activities/facilities, 2 pools and the staff are really great. Dont be mislead by the entrance, this property is very big and very well run. All rooms are super comfy and clean. We stayed at a self catering that was perfect for 3 with an amazing view of the ocean even had a jacuzzi tub Highly recommended. Warner beach/Amazimtoti is not the best areas in the south but its totally worth visiting.

reviews.title: Great Time
reviews.text: Loved the self catering unit, clean with beautiful ocean views as well as tons of privacy. Staff were exceptionally helpful, besides for a cold shower one morning due to no hot water, the rest of our stay was phenomenal. Real value for money.

reviews.title: If you have a car and enjoy sleeping it's a great place to stay
reviews.text: Blue sky is just a few minutes walk from the beach and about 15-20 minutes by car to the city centre. Also, has perhaps the best kept gardens of any backpackers (with views of the ocean) - the staff are nice and friendly and that makes this a nice place to chill out. If you are looking to go partying until 2 a.m. then this is not the place for you - stay downtown somewhere. Internet is a bit more expensive than average though.

reviews.title: What a wonderful place
reviews.text: Have been there three times is wonderful very clean and staff are out of this world, food is also lovely always go back there when we go to south africa highly recommend them.Is close to a lovely beach and Warner Beach is a lovely area and people so friendly

reviews.title: Just go there!
reviews.text: We found this hostel by chance and it became the favourite place we stayed during our south africa trip. For little money you get lots of service, nice views, clean rooms and much more. Quite close to the beach you also find relaxing spots in the big garden with two pools. You can either buy meals or cook it yourself in a big kitchen and eat in on an amazingly big deck with direct sea view. We will definitively go there again and so should you!

reviews.title: Should be a hotel
reviews.text: I spent one night at Blue Sky Mining backpackers and it really was a little piece of paradise. It has 2 heavenly swimming pools, a little shop where you can buy necklaces for as little as R20, a few minutes walk to the beach and local shops, and the rooms were very well decorated. I really enjoyed my night here and was very dissapointed that we could only stay for one night. Definitely make this a stop on your Durban adventure!

reviews.title: Very professional, well set up
reviews.text: We originally planned on staying a day or two, but kept extending our stay. They were busy, so every time we extended we had to change rooms, but that wasn't a problem. It meant we were able to experience different parts of Blue Sky mining. They have lots of ideas/knowledge about activities in Kwazulu Natal. They helped up book diving at the Aliwal Shoal, where we did a shark dive which was amazing. They have two separate houses, each with their own communal kitchen and pools! There is a nice roof terrace and a fire pit. The drinks are cheap! Only downside was that the bar closes at 10pm, but is understandable, as there are some dorms and privates near the bar and they do this to allow guests to have a good night's sleep. This was the best backpackers we stayed at in all of Natal province. They also have plenty of parking available, free of charge.

reviews.title: Service that went beyond my expectations
reviews.text: This is the second time I stayed at the Blue Sky Mining. First time a friend advised me to stay there, the second time it was my place to re-organise during my year of travelling in Africa. With Romy as the hostess she advised me on transport (to and from the airport), the Baz Bus, things in the neighbourhood and more. It made my life much easier. Although it is a backpackers hostel, it has a relaxing atmosphere where you can chill out. The rooms and communal area were clean and tidy. Overall a very nice place to stay for a couple of days.

reviews.title: Very nice backpackers
reviews.text: This is one of my favourite backpackers. The rooms and the staff are very nice. They serve good food for a good price. Between the houses lays a beautiful garden with two pools. The decoration of the house is unique.

reviews.title: Sensational !
reviews.text: My husband and I spent one week in this beautiful and well-run place. The rooms are super clean and serviced on a daily basis. The food, especially the Indian bunny chows are superb. We were greeted by Fiona an amazing employee who we believe was the supervisor/manager as she looked after us during the entire stay. Both the rock pools were kept super clean and the lounge and kitchen areas were in top notch condition. The grounds are very safe and the ocean views are simply beautiful. My only negative or semi-negative comment was that unlike most other backpackers, Blue Sky does not offer a book exchange/library for those who want to real during their stay. They did however sell old paperbacks etc...at relatively high prices. Other than that this place is great. Durban is less than 30 minutes away so no hassles and it was nice to get out of the city. Truly a very very well run establishment. Romy, I am sorry that we didn't meet although your communications by email for friendly..

reviews.title: Friendly staff and great views
reviews.text: We stayed in the Great White Self Catering cottage at BSM and it was good value for money. We were given a warm welcome on arrival, checked in and shown around by a very friendly and chatty lady. Our self catering cottage was basic (wooden floors/walls etc) but clean and well kept. The only real problem we had with it was ants - there are a few places where the walls don't quite meet so a few little things get in! Other than that very good although the bed not that comfortable. The kitchenette was sufficient, an oven, hob and microwave as well as fridge freezer. We ordered food and beers from the restaurant, their bunny chows are great but not for the faint hearted! They serve a decent selection of food which was perfect as we were happy chilling by the pool. They even brought our dinner to our cottage! The real star of our cottage was the balcony with gorgeous sea views. Only improvement would be to get some decent chairs, we just had plastic lawn chairs. The one issue we did have which is out of the owners hands is the neighbouring dogs (in the garden just below the balcony) seem to yap-yap almost constantly! During the day when you're trying to read and chill out and during the night too. All in all, good value for money and a great place to stop for a couple of days.

reviews.title: The most amazing views!
reviews.text: We stayed in the Seahorse room, and even though it was secluded, the wifi was fast, the view was incredible and the breakfast is great! The entire place is stunning- pools, a rooftop view, ocean view, things to buy and many activities. The only concern is it's a bit far from central Durban, but the view makes up for it!

reviews.title: Excellent as usual
reviews.text: Brilliant stay a year later at the slef catering unit with my family. staff always very polite and helpful.Very convenient to the beach with many sites to choose from. Food was good and recommend restaurants in the area were perfect.will make this a yearly tradition. Brie from the slef catering unit is awesome to say the least. Very nearly keet grounds and units

reviews.title: Spotless and comfortable
reviews.text: Our room was a lovely front double bedroom. Large high ceilings and plenty of room. The whole place was spotless. Owner was very friendly and welcoming. Breakfast was delicious. Location very good just a short stroll to centre - we took our bikes. Parking on street outside hotel.

reviews.title: nice and friendly guest house
reviews.text: Stayed there 3 nights, the rooms were very comfortable and immaculate. the owner very friendly, breakfast good with nice fresh cofffee. Easy walking distance to the city centre 20 max. would definately stay there again.

reviews.title: Do not trust booking confirmation - Do not give full credit card det
reviews.text: I made a reservation by e-mail once month ago and I was asked for my credit card details, I gave the card number and exp date. When I was asked for the 3 digits at the back, I refused because with all those details, they can charge anything they want anytime they want. I offer instead to pay through a secured web site. One Nancy answered me saying it was ok and confirmed the booking. Two days ago (one week before living for Scotland) I received an e-mail telling me that since I didn't give the three digits my booking was cancelled. The owner pretended that in Scotland, they couldn't do anything with those details. I answered that it wasn't fair to let me down just one week before my stay and that she should have said no one month ago. She never answered. Just to be clear : 1 - I booked my entire stay in Scotland 10 days in 10 different B&B's by e-mail and except for Alcorn, I was never asked to give credit card details. They all want cash payment 2 - If you can buy anything from the internet with a credit card number, exp date and three digits at the back, so can anyone you give this information to! Fortunately, I immediately booked another room in a cheaper and nicer place

reviews.title: Ideal - just what I was looking for
reviews.text: Stayed here in march for a night ... The B&B is very clean, rooms are bright, spacious and modern. Staff were very friendly and helpful. Perfect location - quiet area but close enough to all amenities. Will definitely stay there again.

reviews.title: Alcorn Guest House- Best in Dundee
reviews.text: I had 15 day experience as a guest in this B & B. The place is rated five stars because I found it peaceful, the rooms and wash were clean, food was good and the hospitality was excellent. Mrs Lalitha, the owner is a very friendly lady and she does her best to keep you comfortable. I will definitely opt the same place another time.

reviews.title: A Great Place to Stay
reviews.text: I stayed at the Alcorn Guest House for 3 nights last week while on business in Dundee. Having stayed at a similarly priced bed and breakfast in Dundee the previous week, which left a lot to be desired, I was pleasantly surprised when I arrived at the Alcorn. The room was a good size, clean and warm with good storage space. Complimentary tea and coffee were available in my room and the room was serviced daily. The breakfast was very good with a range of cereals and full cooked breakfast available with plenty of tea, coffee and orange juice. There was no dog when I stayed last week as the Guest House is under new management. The guest house is walking distance from the city centre but a 2 minute walk takes you to the nearest bus stop which is serviced by regular buses which head into the city centre. The Alcorn is a very reasonably priced B&B and I would be more than happy to stay here in the future.

reviews.title: A very pleasant place to stay
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I had a very large and well-appointed double room (en-suite) at Alcorn Guest House. The staff was friendly and flexible about check in, breakfast, etc. The beds were very comfortable and noise from other rooms was minimal. We would definitely stay there again if we need to be in Dundee.

reviews.title: Ideal B & B at West End of Dundee
reviews.text: Close to local amenities and without any parking problems (street parking at front door) this is a very comfortable B & B. The proprietor is a lovely lady who gives a warm welcome to all her guests, many of whom visit regularly and have become friends. The rooms are spacious and very clean, wifi is available throughout the building. Shops of all descriptions are within a few minutes walk include, antique shops, restaurants, pubs, hairdressers, charity shops, cafe's, chemists, banks, etc. Breakfast is served in the small dining room and is excellent. This is a non-smoking B & B however for those who still use 'the weed' there are gardens to the front and rear of the property where they can sit in peace. "An enjoyable stay"

reviews.title: Ideal B and B
reviews.text: Stayed here in between my shifts at Perth Royal and Ninewells . Host even waited for late checkin at 1045pm. Room was ideal and bed was very comfortable. Friendly host and I will definetly use again. Was a shared bathroom but shower was welcoming.

reviews.title: Good value
reviews.text: I stayed here for 2 nights. You need to be careful to go to Hyndford Street and not Hyndford Place! Room was good value (£25 per night for a single in March 2006, including full English breakfast), fairly small, with TV and basin in room, but no soap or shampoo. Tea and coffee making facilities were included in the room. I had to use a shared bathroom and I had to go through the breakfast room to get there, which was a bit embarrassing if you didn't want to dress properly to get to the shower in the morning. Not all rooms will be like that! Breakfast was fantastic - full English breakfast with as much coffee and orange juice as you liked, plus, if you wanted it, cereal and fresh fruit. Staff were very friendly. They have a dog, so if you don't like dogs, be warned. It probably takes about 20 mins to walk to the centre of Dundee, but you pass shops etc well before that. I would recommend it.

reviews.title: Annual golfing stop over
reviews.text: Stopped at this guest house for the last four years, for the location is ideal for our annual charity golf event at ST. Michaels golf club 20 minutes away by car. Rooms are very good and clean. The hostess Lalitha is fantastic, bubblely, very welcoming and great to converse with. Breakfast extra for a small fee but not to be missed. definately return next year or when next in Dundee. Alan W and the golf buddies.

reviews.title: Weekend Stay
reviews.text: Nice and clean guest house , clean room, good bed ,quiet location, lovely bathroom. The landlady is a real character and will stay there again when in Dundee.

reviews.title: A nice B&B
reviews.text: when i visited the place for a one night stay, i was happy with the warm welcome from the owner as she gave us the room keys and the wifi password, the wifi speed was very good and the room was good and nice, i loved that everything seemed nice and new, although it was not, but that didn't make a difference. it was still nice and comfort. enjoyed my one night stay there and was hoping it would have been longer. for a B&B option, i recommend Alcorn.

reviews.title: Great 2 Nights
reviews.text: the cleanest place i've ever stayed anywhere and its run by a lovely lady who provides a very tasty fried breakfast. I have stayed here multiple times now, 4 times I think. It has been a few years and the place is as well kept as it always was. Would always recomend.

reviews.title: Could do better
reviews.text: We arrived in Dundee without a forward booking and tried to find a place to stay. We stumbled upon Alcorn Guesthouse and didn't start with good impressions due to all the Hindu and Buddhist idols on display in reception. Lalitha asked us our budget, knocked 20 pounds off our top price and then added 3 pounds each for breakfast. Extraordinary! The room was large, with a double and single bed and very clean. She gave us the WiFi key and we looked up the place for tripadvisor reviews. That's when we saw we had paid about 5 pounds more than average. The room was comfortable, with a large flat screen tv and we slept well. Breakfast was adequate but not overgenorous with portions. Our negative comments were to with the electrics as there are daisy-chained plug points on both sides of the room, and the bathroom has no towel rail. All in all the room does not encourage more than one night's stay. We would not return.

reviews.title: Best value in Dundee
reviews.text: Stayed for two nights in January. I stumbled upon it walking around and could not be happier. The lady who owns it as incredibly nice and made a phenomenal breakfast. I will definitely stay there again if I return to Dundee.

reviews.title: No thank you
reviews.text: Stayed here for a couple of nights and i was not impressed, they toilet was dirty and there were hair in the shower. The breakfast was not all to be desired, as the sausages were so burnt i could break the walls... would not go back there!

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Fab stay owner was very friendly and room had every thing you would need! Would definatley stay here again. Large TV in our room and fresh towels every morning which made a very comfortable stay.Hopefully see you again soon.

reviews.title: Comfortable Guest House with Helpful LandLady - good value too!
reviews.text: We stayed here on an overnight trip to St Andrews (a golf tournament was on, so more convenient accomodation was not available). The room was comfortable - not luxurious. The breakfast was plentiful - not top notch. The land lady/owner was extremely friendly and helpful - and that, for me, is a real big plus.

reviews.title: Very friendly host
reviews.text: Nice B&B, in an old nice house located near the town center. Rooms are not really modern, but overall they are comfortable. The big plus is the friendly host. She will look after you and with a small price difference, she will setup a really nice breakfast in the morning.

reviews.title: Alcorn Guest House
reviews.text: Had a lovely overnight stay on Friday, good clean comfortable room. The owner was so helpful and very caring. A must to go back to.

reviews.title: A great place
reviews.text: A terrific, Spotless Guest house and a great welcome --- thanks Front bedroom was a great size, one double bed and a single bed, En-suite was also a good size and all spotlessly clean. Breakfast was good -- and at a time to suit you. we would highly recommend.

reviews.title: Quiet location, but that is it
reviews.text: I am going to be honest, even though the owner was lovely, we rely on this site when booking accommodation. The B and B is in a quiet street, which is a real advantage. However we are paying good money for this. The double bed was saggy, thankfully there was a single in the room also, so glad there was another bed to choose from. We do like real coffee, so when we saw the cafetieres in the cupboards, we thought, yes real coffee, but disappointingly we received instant coffee, even though the place was quiet. Breakfast could have been better quality, the sausage really was not good. Beans were poured over the bacon, rather then kept separate. The two goods things about this B and B are that it is very clean and the owner a really nice person. But quality really needs to be improved.

reviews.title: warn and freindly
reviews.text: i have syayed at the alcorn for about eleven weeks mon to fri. it now feels like home from home .it is a very warm and welcomming place to stay. the rooms are good sized and very clean. breakfast very good . very close to city but set in a quiet location. great value well recommended

reviews.title: A nice little guest house.
reviews.text: My partner and I stayed here for one night while at a wedding in Dundee. Having never stayed at guest house before I was pleasantly surprised by the warm welcome we recieved. The manager was very friendly and efficient. Our room was large and had all the facilities needed. We were also provided with a lovely cooked breakfast next morning which was very reasonably priced. Would use this guest house next time we are back in Dundee.

reviews.title: AMAZING EXPERIENCE
reviews.text: The Owner of the Hotel made our experience so wonderful, not only was she friendly and accommodating but because we didn't have allot of time she drove us around Dundee and showed us all the highlights, she was great and her guest house was clean and very nice, I loved it there and would go back every time I had the chance

reviews.title: Excellent place to stay in Dundee
reviews.text: Stayed here for 3 nights plus 3 friends. We all agree it was a great place to stay as the land lady couldn't have been more friendly, kind and helpful. All rooms clean, comfortable. Breakfast was delicious too! Would definitely stay here again. Thank you.

reviews.title: Dire - STAY AWAY!
reviews.text: All i can and will say about this place is that despite requesting a double room we were given a converted stairwell with two single beds in it. Not only this. Inside this 'room' (i use the term loosely!) were two doors which could not be locked...the other side of these doors? Stairs to other rooms through one, and an actual other room through the other, leaving us with no option but to push the beds up to the doors in order to make the room safe and secure. As for the bathroom. More like walk in cupboard full of rust. Dire. Horrible. Dank. Rubbish food. Horrible staff. Dundee as a city can be summed up by this one horrific B&B.

reviews.title: If you are in the area, stay here!
reviews.text: My friend and I stayed at the B&B for 2 nights in October 2010 and we loved our time here. It's outside of the main part of Dundee in a cute and quite area. The rooms were clean and comfortable, breakfast was good, and the host was extremely nice and sweet! She worked very hard to make sure we were comfortable and happy! It's only taken me so long to write this review because I forgot to write the name of the B&B down but finally found it online. I would highly recommend staying at The Alcorn Guest house if in the area, it's a very cozy and quite place.

reviews.title: quiet place
reviews.text: The owner was nice but she was strict in terms of noises.I think it was an old house and they just re-decorate it to beautify the inside.Floors inside our room was making noises everytime we walk.The food was not that delicious.The bacon was always smelly.She was not helpful in giving us information about the basic information within the places of dundee.

reviews.title: Very comfortable family accommodation
reviews.text: It is not easy to find accommodation for a family 5 at a reasonable price, and we were so glad to have found Alcorn Guest House. The Alcorn is a charming house that is easy to find in Dundee and walking distance to the sea wall, parks, shops and restaurants. We had the family room that consists of 5 single beds in 3 adjoining rooms. Our host offered us suggestions to walk around Dundee and find supper. She served us a delicious hot breakfast with generous portions in the morning.

reviews.title: Nice stay, roomy bedrooms, fair price and very friendly host.
reviews.text: It was the only open B&B in the street at that time of the year (!) Very convenient host, she didn't charge us for the continental breakfast. The rooms are massive and the bathroom is clean, but the sheets are a bit too short for the beds.

reviews.title: Well run guest house, delightful owner who is welcoming and diligent
reviews.text: Good value guest house. Friendly owner who works hard to make your stay enjoyable. some rooms are not en suite. Full breakfast if you wish. Fairly centrally placed about half mile from centre. Parking easy and free in residential street outside.

reviews.title: holiday
reviews.text: stayed 3 nights at this delightfull guest house. which is within walking distance into the centre of dundee... the lady of the house was so friendley and couldent do enough to make our stay welcome.. breakfast was any thing you wanted.. full hearty breakfast for us. would certainly recomend.. clean & value for money...

reviews.title: Cute and friendly
reviews.text: Nice little place adjacent to the (few) restaurants in the area. Very friendly owner, who went so far as to go out and buy vegetarian sausages for us. The rooms are small but clean and convenient for groups of more than two people (semi-separate accommodations within mini-apartments). However, no soap or shampoo for the shower, and the curtains did not block light completely (which in Scotland during the summer is a problem).

reviews.title: Night out in Dundee
reviews.text: First impressions - taxi driving into the street, noticing it's a residential area. The guest house from the outside, looked a bit dated, but clean. The owner, a very friendly lady, could do anything for us, even four loud young girls. Even the next day, she was saying she was listening out for us, "wondering where the girls are", and we didn't break the rule of making too much noise. Which was quite hard for us ha! The room was cheap and cheerful, even though two of us was sleeping in the bedroom and the other two were in the attic, we found it funny. You pay what you get for. I would stay here again, even though it's a bit away from the city centre, we were about 7-8 pound for a taxi. Was a lovely wee guest house.

reviews.title: Charming B&B in central location
reviews.text: We stayed tonight at this lovely place. Very nice host, she served a very good breakfast and was very helpful and friendly. The room and bath has eben clean and in a good condition. Hostel is located very central, only 15minutes to walk to the center. I can recomend this B&B without any doubts.

reviews.title: Great Value Stay for Carnoustie Visit
reviews.text: One night very comfy stay in a spacious triple room for three adults with ensuite. Amazing value compared to other accommodation in the area whilst the Golf Open is on. Lalitha is a lovely host that takes pride in her guest house and takes care of her guests. She cooked us a very generous serving of full English breakfast which was delicious and only £5 a head and served it at 7am so that we could get an early start to golf. We spoke to other guests at breakfast who have been returning for years so this must be a testimony to Lalitha's hosting. Thank you for looking after us.

reviews.title: Where to actually start?!?!
reviews.text: I placed a booking at this guest house via laterooms this afternoon. Literally 2 hours after the laterooms adviser had phoned through my booking, re-confirmed the room price and my reason for staying, do I get a phone call from the guest house informing me that my booking is in fact, now invalid unless i agree to a close to a 50% increase in room price... I agreed verbally over the phone as i was a little stunned at the excuse they tried to peddle at me. I advised they were in breach of trading standards, to which she responded "Yes.". I have now cancelled the room and booked a nicer, and now cheaper hotel than this guest house were trying to charge me for. Why would I pay money to a business that has no integrity?! Book at your own peril. Now I have the panic of wondering what they will do with my credit card and personal details.

reviews.title: Ideal guest house
reviews.text: Stayed here again for a couple of days. Really good location and lovely guest house. Comfortable and clean room. As usual Lalitha gives you a warm welcome and takes a keen interest in her guests. Looking foreward to my next stay at the Alcorn whilst in Dundee.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: We stayed here in October of 2006 and just wished to say we would readily recommend these apartments to anyone travelling to Naxos. The apartments themselves are well located for people like us who do not wish to be located in the centre of Naxos (which for the younger party type is just a short bus trip away) but wish to either explore the island on maybe a quad bike or simply laze on the beautiful beach just a few minutes walk away. For those who do not wish to laze in the sun by sea there is a pristine pool area to enjoy. The apartments themselves are very clean and user friendly. There are rooms with or without a kitchenette. If you choose one without a kitchenette you will find a traditional family owned restaurant if you turn left on the main promenade facing the beach (with a table and two chairs virtually sitting on a platform above the beach). We ate there 3 times and I wish I could recall the name of it to promote it. There were other restaurants but this one is our top pick. The arrival pick up and departure drop off service was so very welcomed and makes travelling to and from the apartments so very simple. Additionally, the pricing was completely fair and value for money. Michaella, the manager, was very accommodating, friendly and helpful. It was very clear upon arrival that if we needed anything to simply ask and the one time we did ask she was true to her word and more. We would stay there again if we returned to Naxos.

reviews.title: Mostly good
reviews.text: Nice location, about 3 minutes from a great beach, very quiet in September. Pool area was nice and relaxing Room a bit of a let down, 2 light sockets missing, a bit dated and bathroom very tight staff were friendly and was great value

reviews.title: Home away from home
reviews.text: I have just returned from a fabulous break at the Anna Studios in beautiful Naxos. The studios are wonderfully located, immaculately kept and just a relaxing and peaceful place to be. Mixalia and her family could not do enough for you and make your stay extra special. From the pick up from the Port to the wonderful cake on arrival to the warm and friendly hospitality its no wonder people come back year after year - I met one couple who have visited the family for 26 years in a row. The rooms are comfortable and some like our room did not have a kitchenette but Mixalia will provide cutlery and bowls and plates if you ask for them. However it did not hinder us making tea and coffee and storing food in the fridge. The room was serviced every day but the lovely Tanya and towels and sheets were frequently changed. The pool area was also immaculate with ample sunbeds and again spotlessly clean. The pool was beautifully positioned and even has jacuzzi jets. Its minutes from the main beach and about 10 mins to Agia Anna. The restaurants and supermarkets are in each reach. This made for a relaxing and peaceful stay away from the hustle and bustle of the main strip. I can’t recommend these studios highly enough, Mixalia offers a lovely breakfast for 5 euros and there is plenty on offer. I can praise her homemade cakes enough (Nostimo) and her father’s Raki. You can by drinks on site and the family are always available to help. I cannot wait to visit again. Efharisto Mixalia x

reviews.title: Girlie break
reviews.text: Fabulous simple rooms great pool room 2 overlooks the fields nice and quiet Could not ask for better 1 minute to beach and 2 minutes to supermarket and restaurants perfect The staff are lovely arriving at port get a ticket for the bus 1.80 and stops 1 minute away Just so lovely

reviews.title: Perfect Location, Atmosphere, and Hospitality!
reviews.text: My girlfriend and I stayed at Anna Studios right in the middle of August during the high season on Naxos, but staying here was very low key and relaxing. The room was everything we needed, the pool was more relaxing than any others we had been to during our stay, and it was centrally located in Agios Prokopios. Anna and the rest of the staff were so helpful and so inviting. If I am ever back on Naxos again, this is the first place I will be looking to stay! Thank you for such a wonderful part of our trip!

reviews.title: Super!!!
reviews.text: Perfect stay with super friendly family. From the first contact you feel the hospitality. Clean and cozy appartment with nice terrace. Center of village less then 100 mtrs away but complex situated in very calm settings.

reviews.title: Absolutely outstanding!!
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed for 6 nights, our stay was absolutely amazing. From the awesome homemade breakfasts that we had every morning to the friendly can never do enough service from Michaela and her family. Anna Studios is always spotless, our studio room had a veranda that overlooked a good size swimming pool which like the rest of the place, is always super clean. The air conditioned room had a mini kitchen that has all the necessary goodies including a stove and a small fridge. The place is always peaceful and quiet and the location is perfect, a few meters from the beach, shops, restaurants or bus service. Michaela’s dad fetched us from the harbour and drop us off the day we left, this service included in the price which we thought was very competitive. We are extremely happy that we chose Anna Studios and should we return to Naxos we will most definitely be staying there again. By the way, if you ever stay at Anna studios you have to taste amongst the rest of the of the excellent breakfast, the cheesecake that Michaela makes!!! It is finger eating good :)

reviews.title: Vassilis-Athens
reviews.text: The rooms are very clean and big . The sea was only 70 m. far. You can find everythik in a distance of 200 m. The people werw very frendly. Me and my wife enjoy it.

reviews.title: Still my favorite hotel in Naxos
reviews.text: I just love this hotel. We always stay at this hotel when we go to Naxos. Why: It is near the great beach of Agios Prokopios, it is clean, it has great roms for reasonable prices and it has a good little polearea where you can relax on nice sunbeds. Michaela and her family who runs the hotel are just lovely people,always there to help you. Michaelas father pick you up from the harbour and drive you there again. In the morning you can enjoy free coffee that the family makes for you. We stayed there in july 2012 and where happy to see that they have now have new and nice bathrooms in the hotelrooms. Clean, modern and delicate. On our next trip to Naxos, this is where we will stay again :-)

reviews.title: Excellent value for money, great service
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I spent 5 nights here at the end of August and really enjoyed our stay. Michaela is a wonderful hostess and is always there to answer any questions or give advice about where to eat/what to do around the area. Even when she wasn't at the reception, we could just ask the other members of her family and it was no trouble at all. Our room was at the back (number 8) and had a small kitchenette which was very practical. The room was nice and overall good value for money, especially since breakfast was included. The breakfast was insane, so much bread and cakes! I tried to make the most of it and eat it all every morning but failed miserably lol. The pool was nice and quiet, and well maintained, The location was great - just 5 mins to the beach and the bars/tavernas in Agios Prokopios, and easy access to the bus which takes you to Naxos town. Overall we had a really nice stay at Anna Studios, it was very pleasant and excellent value for money..one or two negatives however were the noise of the fridge and the cock that crows all bloody night long as mentioned by another reviewer...and for some reason every night an awful smell came from the drain in the bathroom. It didn't hugely affect my stay but without it I would have otherwise rated the hotel as excellent. I would definitly stay here again as the type of hospitality and kindness offered by Michaela and her family was fantastic and is quite hard to come by in this price range, I would highly recommend spending a few days here if you are thinking of visiting Naxos.

reviews.title: Great place to stay in Agios Prokopios
reviews.text: In July/August 2006 I travelled with my family - wife and 4 children (6, 10, 12 and 16 yrs) to Agios Prokopios, Naxos. We found the Anna Beach Studios hotel on the internet, and we communicated with Michaella (person in change of running the hotel) via email. Michaella gave quick and detailed responses to our emails, and managed to find suitable rooms for us, including a room with a fully functional kitchenette. When arriving in Naxos Michaella's father met us at Chora harbour, and drove us to Agios Prokopios, appx. 10 minutes drive. Anna Beach Studios hotel is a family run hotel involving the whole family. The hotel is clean, the rooms have good qualities, and the location of the hotel in Agios Prokopios town, is great. The hotel is placed close to the fantastic beaches of Agios Prokopios, but still in calm surroundings - a perfect place for a relaxing holiday. It is also definitely worth mentioning that the hotel has a new and excellent swimming pool facility. The pool is a great place to stay if you choose not to go to the beach, in addition to afternoon relaxation enjoying the sunset. The children loved staying in and around the pool. The rooms are fairly priced, and are good value for money. We will definitely travel back to wonderful Agios Prokopios sometime soon, and Anna Beach Studios-Hotel will be our certain choice of hotel. I highly recommend this hotel and its surroundings - it is simply a great place to stay.

reviews.title: Overall a very good stay
reviews.text: We stayed at Anna's studios for 3 nights and were very happy with our choice. The room was quaint but had its own terrace and a very practical mini kitchen that has all of the essentials. The location is absolutely perfect, just a few metres away from Agios Prokopios beach, and the swimming pool at Anna's studios is very well kept as well. The couple who runs these rooms is extremely nice and attentive, she left us some delicious rice pudding in our room on the first day and he drove us to the port (they offer transfers to/from the port free of charge). They live right next door and it looked like they kept a small farm behind their house with a few goats and hens - it really adds to the scenery! Unfortunately there is a cock in a nearby farm that crows endlessly from about 5am until 12pm so if you are a light sleeper it might wake you up (but that wasn't so much the hotel's fault and all nearby houses suffered equally to us). Just two things to take into consideration: the internet connection in the room was very poor, and the fridge from the mini kitchen quite loud at night (we unplugged it and everything stayed fresh overnight). Overall considering the fair price per night (57€) we were very satisfied with Anna Studios and can highly recommend it!

reviews.title: Very good studio 150m from the beach.
reviews.text: We stayed 6 nights in the studio located South-East on 1st floor. It's very pleasant to take the breakfast in the morning on the balcony. The studio is located 150m from the beach. And the host is extremely nice. If we visit Naxos again, we will stay there again. Thank you for everything.

reviews.title: Plesant Stay at Annita
reviews.text: I started with the same problem as many other people wishing to stay in Agia Anna when booking through Kosmar... Annita or Antoninna Studios ?? In the end we were happy with our choice and did not mind that they were 5 - 7 mins walk away from the beach and restaurants.
