This is up a very small incline and would not suggest people with walking difficulties stay here. They are basic but very clean and our room (no 12) had the best views from the beach to one side with Naxos town on the other ( we also had the biggest balcony) do not be put off at all that it is quite close to the airport as their is 1 maybe 2 propeller planes that take off once a day and are more entertaining than disturbing. There is a small pool bar that they will open for you if you would like an alcoholic beverage and it does seem that they are expanding the studios so would be a good bet for next year. The staff are very polite, although we found the pool a bit cold and small. Other than that we were very happy and would happily return.

reviews.title: Good basic - family run hotel
reviews.text: We had a couple of nights at this hotel, where the atmosphere is so relaxed and nice. The family really know the meaning of customer care. They are there for you. The hotel has a quiet atmosphere and a nice and clean and well-maintained pool area. And the location of the hotel is just five minutes’ walk away from the beach and the tavernas. Our room was very basic, and spartan equipped. The kitchen could need an upgrade. But the cleanliness was perfect, and the Wi-Fi well functioned.

reviews.title: The perfect place to enjoy your stay in Naxos
reviews.text: We stayed at Anna Studios for a bit more than 2 weeks and really enjoyed it. The place is located in Agios Prokopios, the beach village south of the main town (10 min drive). It's a good stop to be based at the visit the island or just discover the different beaches. the is a bus link between the main town and the beaches (stop is 2min walk from Anna Studios). Let's talk about the pension. Pictures are totally accurate. The rooms and the whole place are very clean. not many rooms so it is very enjoyable. The pool is very good with sunbeams for all. We were in a studio on the first floor with mountain view and loved it - room 13 it is! The pension is just 3 minutes aways from the beach. dont forget to try Plaka Beach and Agia Ana which are really good too. Supermarkets and many restaurants are 2 minutes away and the pension is really well located as far from the main road. Finally I really want to highlight the kindness of the host. Michaela is so nice, helpful and speaks excellent English (most people speak good English on the island). She really manages the place perfectly. We met couples who come every year, no wonder why. If we had to come again to Naxos I wouldn't look for another place!

reviews.title: Wonderful studios in Agios Prokopios
reviews.text: This is a perfect base for a holiday on Naxos. The studios are very close to the lovely beach, there is a lovely good-sized pool, and the apartments are good-sized and kept spotlessly clean. Mikhala is the perfect host and you get personal attention from her and her family. We have stayed on many Greek islands before, I would say that Anna Studios offer the best location and value for money that we have found. Thoroughly recommended!

reviews.title: the only place to stay on naxos
reviews.text: I have been staying at studios Anna for many years. They keep improving their place all the time. Recently they put in a great pool. You are also walking distance to the beautiful beaches of agias prokopios. You are also just a quick bus ride to the main town called naxos town. But you are still far enough away so that agias prokipios is quiet and very good for bringing children. Michaella, the daughter of the owner runs the place so smoothly. Mike gertner..point pleasant, nj usa

reviews.title: Great family run lodge
reviews.text: Anna Studios is a very cozy, very well located lodge in Agios Prokopios run by the very friendly and energetic Mixalia and her parents. She is extremely helpful, always being there when you need her, all you need to do is ask. The rooms are basic but fully functional including a fridge, safe, wi-fi and a small bathroom with good water pressure. Cleanliness was perfect and we always had fresh towels to come back to as well as a nice snack after a long day. The pool is small but quaint. We didn't eat here so can't comment on food. Overall, we were very satisfied and comfortable here and felt like we got good value for our money. If you want to spend most of your time out and about, as we did, Anna Studios is an ideal place to stay for its location and friendly energy.

reviews.title: Very nice personnel, not comfortable hotel
reviews.text: Pros Nice people Great breakfast Lovely pool Very clean Cons The bed- we had a double bed and the springs kept poking my back, it was very difficult to sleep on it. The shower- we used 2 different ones because we asked to move(we wanted a double bed instead of 2 singles together and the safe codes didn't work) so we had one shower that was on the side floor with a curtain and even though it was on a lower level the whole room got wet. The other was a cubicle but it had not curtains so the entire bathroom was flooded too. Besides that, I ran out of hot water twice and there were no towel racks near the shower-just little one by the sink. the soap rack in one room wasn't leveled and stuff kept falling in one room when it tipped. Wifi -weak connection if your far from the reception If you are looking for comfort, some luxury or romance I wouldn't recommend this hotel.

reviews.title: Perfect for the beach
reviews.text: We arrived in Naxos on the ferry where the owner was waiting to collect us for free. (We had called the apartment from our previous accommodation to arrange this). We were made to feel very welcome and the transfer from the port was only about 10-15 minutes. Our room was nice, decor perhaps a little 80's, but nice and clean. The pool was beautiful and due to the beach being so close it was hardly used by any of the other guests, so it was like having a private pool! There are plenty of sun lounges and umbrellas etc. Breakfast items coffee, cake and melon etc were included in the prices which was nice. The beach was literally 2-3minute walk down the drive and was a large 2km beach lined with some bars/cafes/restaurants so the location of the accommodation was brilliant. The area was fairly quiet, but just what we were looking for. I would go back and I would recommend to friends as it is great value for money.

reviews.title: Family run quiet and friendly
reviews.text: Just a stones throw from the beautiful beach of Agios Prokopis is the warm friendly Anna Studios with a well kept pool and well maintained apartments. Our family room had a double room leading to a twin via an archway this had an open plan area onto the kitchenette. There is a separate well equipped and modern bathroom bedding and sheets of good quality and changed frequently.

reviews.title: Loved Anna Studios and the owners!
reviews.text: We had an amazing stay on Naxos and Anna Studios was great. It's a bit of a drive from the port but the man who owns it picked us up from the port and drove us back when we were leaving. We were able to check in around 10am and get settled. It's a really short walk to the beach and Anna Beach is beautiful. If you feel like adventuring and exploring the other beaches, it doesn't actually take too long to walk along the others. We were able to spend time at a few different beaches while we stayed at Anna. The rooms are a bit old but they were really clean and the pool and flowers outside were immaculate. The daughter Michaella was extremely helpful. She helped us with directions, how to get around, what was worth seeing, what wasn't worth seeing, and where to eat. There are little markets close by and the room had a kitchenette so we were able to buy food to keep...it was nice not eating at a restaurant for every meal. They had free wireless internet too. On the day we had to leave, our ferry didn't leave until 8pm but they needed the room earlier in the day. We were able to store our bags in the lobby area, go to the beach all day, come back to the hotel and take a shower in the extra showers by the pool. It was great to be able to get ready even though we had already checked out of our room. Anna Studios was great and I definitely recommend it to anyone going to Naxos!

reviews.title: strawberry cheese cake
reviews.text: Recently arrived back in the U.K. after our 3rd visit to anna studios . Any body considering Naxos for a holiday would be hard pressed to find better accommodation in a better location . Whilst prokopiuos beach is only 2 minutes away the studios are far enough away from any possible traffic noise .Michaella and her family are genuinely concerned in providing a 1st class service . The rooms are spotlessly clean and towels and sheets are changed regularly . The pool area is immaculate . The showers rooms have been ,or are in the process of being , refitted with high quality fittings .Never have had to have a cold shower . Water pressure excellent . Transport to and from port is provided free .A regular bus service is available nearby into Naxos town .If your`re lucky you may find some of Michaella`s strawberry cheese cake ,nicely chilling in your fridge after returning from a hard day on the beach (her mum`s rice pudd`s not so bad either ) .Never found anywhere to match this place for value for money .

reviews.title: Within easy walking distance to Agios Prokopios beach
reviews.text: Spent 4 days here during late May and found that the Agios Prokopios / Anna area was very quiet - l guess it wasn't the tourist season yet and most shops & restaurants were closed or just getting ready for the busy season. Anna Studio is located within approx 20 metres walk to the Agios Prokopios beach which is very long stretch of calm & beautiful beach. The studios were decently spacious (we had a quadruple room) and the kitchenette & bathroom were simple but adequate & clean. We stayed on the top floor and enjoyed sitting on the balcony overlooking nearby houses. We thoroughly enjoyed the swimming pool & lazing about on their nice lounge chairs - you need to be mindful not to make too much noise btw 2-6pm when other locals could be having their seista's and the pool closes at around 7pm for cleaning. TV in the room had some CNN Business type channels. Michaella (daughter of the owner) was extremely friendly and spoke good English - the owners live in the small house at the back of the studios. Transfer to/from the port is free and there are plenty of local shops/restaurants around. Definitely recommended and great value for money.

reviews.title: Echte aanrader
reviews.text: Anna-studios is an hotel where the guests enjoy much individual attention. The family is friendly and takes care for the pleasure of the guests. Transfer from and to the port/airport is free and always possible. The location is perfect, little traffic and only some minutes from beach, restaurants and minimarkets. Conclusion: An adress to go, to go and to go!

reviews.title: Expensive for the level of service
reviews.text: Clean room, nice pool, but a service level average for the price paid. It's close to the beach and to the village of agios prokopios, it's fair but not amazing. The staff is welcoming, at the level of a guesthouse (which it is)... but it's a hotel price.

reviews.title: Friendly, nice and clean
reviews.text: A nice calm place, great rooms, clean and very friendly and nice family who makes the stay so special. Short walk to the best beach. Quiet place. Naxos is beautiful, and Ag. Prokopios is beautiful place , safe and friendly. We loved the pool area, for relaxation after beach, and in the morning. Michaela offers coffee and juice and cake for free , for breakfast. They offers to pick you up when you arrive, and take you to the harbor when you leave, for free. We will come back next year.

reviews.title: A perfect stay in an idyllic location
reviews.text: Another wonderful stay at the beautiful Anna studios. My partner and I returned to stay at Anna Studios, which is perfectly located just minutes from the idyllic beaches of Agios Prokopios and the lively centre of the village. I've been staying with Michaela and her family for many years and their apartments never disappoint. Spotlessly clean, spacious and with all the amenities you could ever need, the Studios are a peaceful oasis to return to after a long day in the sun and the stunning swimming pool is a peaceful place to unwind. This is very much a family run business and this is evident from all the personal touches they provide, from collecting you from the port to leaving sweet treats in the fridge and offering excellent recommendations of places to eat, drink and visit. I cannot recommend it enough.

reviews.title: Quiet, friendly and wonderful location
reviews.text: A great family run hotel, 2 mins from beautiful sandy beach. The location great, very quiet. 3 minute walk to shops, beach and restaurants. Very clean and Michaella very welcoming and helpful. Perfect.

reviews.title: Very pleasant stay in Agios Prokopios, Naxos
reviews.text: We stayed in Anna Studios for 3 nights and we really enjoy this place very much. Michaella is very friendly host, open to tourists needs. She serves very good fresh breakfast. Some of the products are from her own farm (we had a chance to try tasty organic eggs and cucambers). The swimming pool is clean and very good also for children. Water is fresh and clear. The beach is very close and also the bus connection to Naxos town is very convenient. Whole family was very friendly, open and helpful to the guests. We have been pick up from the ferry and had free transfer both ways, which was very much appreciated! We also got some extras, like free morning coffee and some home made omellet as well :) we would surely recommend this place!

reviews.title: feeling home
reviews.text: our favourite place in Naxos for some years now!ideal location a good 200 steps from the beach and the bus/taxi staton to Hora (6km),a family run facility where you feel home from the first moment you're there;successive revamping actions of the facility (last winter the comprehensive renewal of the bathrooms with state of the art material and equipment), very nice swimmingpool,airco and sat tv,has kept this facilty up to excellent service standards.The family resides on the site and never fails to help making your stay an experience in greek hospitality. transport to/from airport/port on request.

reviews.title: Really good choice to stay in Agios Prokopios,reasonable prices!
reviews.text: We stayed in Anna studios for 4 days!Our room cost 45 € per day so we had second thoughts about booking it but then we read the reviews here and we gave it a shot and we were really satisfied with our choice after all.The location is great just 1 minute from Agios Prokopios beach but it is not noisy.Our room was cleaned every day as well as the swimming pool.The swimming pool is a really nice place to hang out if you don't prefer the beach its clean and with nice comfortable sunbeds.The owner is really friendly and kind and she is there to solve any problem that comes up.Every morning the owner offered free coffee or juice.The center was not so far away and the bus station was 1 minute walk.Buses are frequent until 2 p.m so no need to use a taxi . A disadvantage was that the bathroom was not equipped with soap. I highly recommend people to stay in Anna Studios!

reviews.title: A perfect vacation
reviews.text: We really lives our stay at Anna Studio’s. A clean room, not expensive and everybody is So kind. It is like coming on a family visit. My boyfriend lost his Wallet the Second day and they helped us so good. They mayed the necesarry calls and gave us all the info we needed. They even called to the restaurant nearby to help looking. The studio is very close to the beach and Agios Prokopios is to me the most beautiful place of Naxos. Good restaurants and also very close to Xora. I Love Naxos and Will go back to Anna Studio’s. I already miss it there

reviews.title: Amazing!!
reviews.text: Just got back from a 4 days on Naxos. Anna Studios is a must stay place on the island! It was very clean and in an awesome location super close to market, restaurants and literally a 2 min walk to the most lovely sandy beach. It was about a 7 euro cab ride from Anna Studios into Naxos town. They do offer free port pickup/drop off. Michaella is so lovely! She brought us coffee and home baked coffee cake one morning and she is so helpful, such a treat! If/when I return to Naxos I will be sure to stay at Anna Studios!!! Thanks Michaella:)

reviews.title: Perfection !!!
reviews.text: Very good place! The room was BIG! There is also a Uge balcony... the swiming pool was very calm... Superb service with a smile and good (and cheap) breakfast! Very close from the Naxos port (there is a bus every 30 minutes and it take 15/20 minutes both ways)

reviews.title: great location, clean, wonderful management
reviews.text: We only stayed 2 nights but it was wonderful. We were upstairs with balcony overlooking the pool. We were served a delicious breakfast both mornings on the balcony. We were poolside and could here the waves and not the rooster.. Michaella and family were very helpful plus offered free pick up and drop off from the ferry. Our room was super clean, quiet refrigerator, stove. Good WiFi. Very close to beach, restaurants, and grocery store. We rented a little car and enjoyed touring the entire island. Most placed were closed up for the winter which was nice, slow quiet season with good weather. We hope to return one day. Loved it all

reviews.title: Loved it!!
reviews.text: Brilliantly positioned apartments. Convenient for Agia Anna Beach and also Agios Prokopios Beach. Peaceful at night. Children loved the large pool. Family very helpful and gave little added exras which were a lovely touch. Not the most modern of apartments but perfectly ok and the position more than made-up for this.

reviews.title: Best hotel in Naxos
reviews.text: We have been staying here many times. Last time for a week in juli 2018. Michaela is a wonderfull host and the rooms are nice and clean. The pool is excellent and the hotel is only a few steps from the beach. We will be back, we had the best holiday staying at Anna Studios.

reviews.title: My favorite hotel in Naxos!
reviews.text: We have been staying at Anna Studios several times, and it has always been great! Nice apartments, clean, great swimmingpool and excellent service. Michaella, Anna and the rest their family makes us feel so welcome and they are so sweet. The hotel is in a quiet area and not fare away from the great beach. If you want to head into Naxos city, it is only 6 km away. For us this is THE place to stay in Naxos :-)

reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: We stayed in Anna Studios for 3 nights and we really enjoy it. Michaella is so nice host, the free trasnfer from/to the port, the welcome with orange juice and cake, the breakfast everyday was great, some of the products from her own farm. The swimming pool area is very nice, and the wonderful Prokopios beach is so close, you are not at the first line of the beach but just 2 minutes walking, what for us is better, avoiding the noise of cars etc. Supermarket, restaurants and the bus stop is 2 minutes walking as well. We really enjoyed the stay, we absolutely recomend it, if we ever come back to Naxos we will stay at Anna studios!

reviews.title: Perfect stay! Nice Greek family
reviews.text: We stayed 5 nights on Naxos with Anna Studio's. When you're off the ferry, you'll get a free transfer to and from the hotel. The hotel is runner by a nice and warm Greef family and is very cozy and well organised. Arriving at the hotel is very nice, the owner's hospitality is great and always willing to help you.We had room nr 5, wat is on the ground floor with pool view, easy to grab your drinks, just hopping over the wall of our balcony. ;-) We had a small but full kitchen available, so you're able to make your own breakfast. The rooms will be cleaned every day. Also the pool is rather big and will be cleaned every day.The locatie of the hotel is perfect, 100m from the beach, but at night you'll get privacy and quit sleeps. If you're Looking for a small cozy hotel with many privacy on a good location, you just found it! We had a perfect stay! Thank you very much Anna Studios!

reviews.title: Perfect hotel, friendly staff lovely place
reviews.text: We are so happy to be spending our vacation at Anna Studios, the place is so clean, pool is wonderful, Owner and her family are so lovely you feel lime home! We will definelly come back! They are aweosome! And they are PET FRIENDLY!!❤️❤️❤️❤️

reviews.title: Very good place to stay !
reviews.text: Great place 2min from the beach. Clean neat and serviced. Free wifi, pickup and drop from port or airport. Michaella offers free coffee, cake and juice in the morning. Lovely pool. Cleaning 7 days a week. Restaurants, supermarkets , laundry close by. Will be back for sure. Highly recommended place in Agios Prokopios.

reviews.title: A Great find - right near the beach
reviews.text: We stayed at Anna Studios for a week in August with our 11 year old daughter. The location is perfect, just a five minute walk to the main street, beach and restaurants. The rooms are of a good size ours had two sets of French doors with shutters opening on to a long terrace with seating. Our room was cleaned to a high standard ever day and sheets changed The pool area is spotlessly clean. As an extra you can pay for breakfast to be brought to your room each morning. Or you can have free coffee, cakes and fruit juice which is set out each morning downstairs in the seating area by the pool. Anna Studios were a great find and we will return.

reviews.title: Perfect stay with an amazing staff!
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I did a last minute booking and we still got picked up at the ferryport for free (and back). We loved this place so much that we extended our stay! Michaela is doing an excellent job and she bakes cakes for all guests everyday. When we got home from the beach the fridge in our room always had two pieces of cake and it was the best!! Location: We liked staying in Agia Prokopios a lot, because the beach is spaceous compared to St. George and Anna Studios is 1 minute away from the beach. 5 minutes to Agia Anna and 2 minutes to the bus stop that will take you to Naxos town every 30 minutes for 1,80 euros. Room: Rooms are clean and lots of space. Beds are good compared to the other ones we have had in Greece so far. Shower a bit small and you have to hold the showerhead the whole time while showering. Fridge and nice balcony where you can dry your clothes. Pool: Pool is really nice and clean with lots of sunbeds for all the guests. Only negative part was that the pool closed at 8 in the evening. We really wanted to swim after dinner, but its getting cleaned at that time. Service: Again, Michaela is a perfect host and helped us with arranging laundry services, transport to and from the ferry, makes amazing CAKES!!, and was available the whole day. (During the night theres an emergency number you can use to reach her). Improvements: You can hear all your neighbors during the day and night, especially if they shower or flush the toilet. We were a bit scared to wake everyone up if we showered during the night. The Wifi was also not especially good. Thank you so much for having us, we will come again!

reviews.title: Loved Anna Studios
reviews.text: In Ag. Prokopios, Naxos, I stayed at Anna Studios. What their website promises is what you get. It's family run. The studios are well equipped and well kept clean, what I appreciate. That feels good. Anna Studios is located in a really beautiful, quiet environment and only a minute walk from the beach. Supermarkets, nice taverna's etc., it's all close by. If you're planning to go to Naxos' Ag. Prokopios / Ag. Anna I can recommend Anna Studios. I enjoyed my stay very much!

reviews.title: Outstanding
reviews.text: My family and I stayed at Anna studios for 3 days! We had 2 rooms! Well what can I say! apart from this place was amazing, so peaceful and quiet and so clean too. This place is minutes from all the amenities i.e. supermarket, beach, restaurant, public transport and taxis stand. It's a lovely place, Michaella the owner is so friendly, very helpful nothing is ever too much for her! the minute you call her she is there even if she is cleaning or doing other stuff. Adonis Michealla' s nephew was a nice young man always cleaning the pool area, always helpful too, the whole family are so lovely and made us feel so welcome. Will definitely go back to Anna studio as and when we decide to visit Naxos in the future and will definitely recommend to all our friends and family. Love it, love it, love it......... Pam

reviews.title: EXCELLENT !!!!
reviews.text: Stayed for 3 nights and was blown away by the lovely setting and even lovelier Michaela and her family that own and run the place ! The rooms were spotlessly clean and the good sized swimming pool great for a cool dip in the scorching Naxos heat. Our room at the back had a view of the field where Michaela keeps her chickens, goats and donkey, with the hills beyond - beautiful ! I would strongly recommend Anna Studios for great value for money and a relaxing, comfortable place to stay - next time I visit Naxos I will be going back without hesitation - well recommended !!

reviews.title: A cozy stay
reviews.text: I enjoyed my stay at the Montpellier Hotel with my boyfriend. We were in dire need of a warm and relaxing stay after a cold and exhausting hike. We booked a room for the two of us just hours before arrival. As we arrived, we were upgraded to a suite for the same price and were given everything we required- this includes inquiry about our breakfast preference, which was delicious and to my delight- vegetarian friendly. We enjoyed our short stay and I would revisit in the future as well as recommend.

reviews.title: Montpellier Hotel Llandrindod Wells
reviews.text: All I can say that was good about this hotel is the room was comfortable. We had four rooms booked for Saturday night, we asked if we could have breakfast at 8am on the Sunday as we had a competition starting at 9am and were told no problem. When we got up Sunday there was a heavy smell of cannabis in the hallways, we got down stairs there were boxes of cereal but nothing else at all. Eventually at 8:25 the 1st two "cooked"!! breakfasts arrived then a further 10 minutes passed before the other four arrived and all were cold. Still no tea, coffee, milk or anything else. I went to use the toilet down in the cellar & found out where the potent smell was coming from, the smell of cannabis down there was that strong you could have easily thought you were stood in the middle of a crop of plants. When a friend made a complaint to the "Chef"!! about the food the reply was "you can eat it or leave it". This time last year this hotel was a really nice place to stay, now its nothing more than a doss house.

reviews.title: Staff were excellent
reviews.text: The hotel is tired and worn - wallpaper is peeling, carpets are old. Not disabled friendly - lots of stairs, no lift! There was a mistake with booking.com who didn’t inform the hotel that we’d be bringing a child with us (my mother and I). Staff immediately upgraded us to two bedrooms, a twin and a double at no extra charge. Fallen over themselves to be helpful and accommodating! I would stay here again!

reviews.title: A Perfect Retreat
reviews.text: If you're looking to stay in a quiet, secluded hotel in a sleepy villiage then this is the place is for you my friend! To start with the rooms are huge, and after setting up the Xbox and the projector, whipping out the board games and getting comfy on the sofa we had our own little sanctuary. Run a hot bubble bath in the ensuite bathroom and we had no reason to leave the room for the rest of the day. I mean if you want the honest truth the place needs a lick of paint and a little revamp but when I really thought about it the reason we've been back three times is because it is the run down, quiet hotel in the middle of knowhere that I've come to love. But to end this review and not mention the staff would be a insult! We first met the sweetest smile from the most welcoming woman you could ever meet, making it clear that the hotel was a family run afair. She showed us to our room (which has now been our regular for these getaways now) and could not be anymore helpful and freindly. We opted for the breakfast which was worth its weight in gold after some late night drinking and online games, brought to us by the same woman, we came to the conclusion she must have clones to be doing all the work she was doing. So to sum up... if you wanna make your own little sanctuary in the middle of nowhere then this is the place for you!

reviews.title: Shocking Place
reviews.text: Outdated and in need of a major refurbishment. Turn-down Service was appalling, used items not replaced, had to ask for toilet roll for our bathroom and the floors did not even get vacumed. Tiles missing off the bathroom wall, carpet on stairs threadbare, tiles missing from the entrance way and the sign at the rear of the property is missing. Room was ok but old windows and could hear all road noise. Breakfast was served fast but not enough to survive on until lunch. Had to butter my toast on the table as no side plate. Worrying that had to pay cash for the room as no card machine. Wouldn't stay here again

reviews.title: OK
reviews.text: Large, comfortable, clean room and bed. No shower but bath with shower head which soaks the bathroom carpet if you're not careful! Warm welcome and friendly staff. Didn't use the restaurant but breakfast was ok - cooked to order - BUT instant coffee made by the waitress at the table! Good value for money compared to other local hotels.

reviews.title: Disappointing breakfast
reviews.text: The room was lovely.. lovely size... few quirks which weren’t deal breakers but would of improved...shower in the bathroom not just a bath... we had a small child with us and while the decoration was lovely for a child it’s just a play ground... so things had to go on the top of the wardrobe and the kettle was on a very low table... perfect grabbing height!!! Breakfast though was beyond disappointing we waited half an hour before anyone even appeared... nothing was out ready and half way through breakfast service .. four people had “cooked breakfast “ when the waitress said said no one could have breakfast as the chef wasn’t cooking anymore!! Absolutely crazy and way past disappointing...we had booked to stay as we were having a party locally for my daughters 18th... she also stayed and had booked breakfast for half 9 the day before but she didn’t even get hers!!

reviews.title: Very clean friendly hotel
reviews.text: The hotel owners and all the staff were very friendly. The room was very spacious and very clean. The breakfast was plentyful and cooked lovely. The price we paid was amazing for a room, free parking and breakfast. Would definitely stay again. Lovely lake nearby and a few pubs especially enjoyed the ale house.

reviews.title: Pleasant overnight stay
reviews.text: Stayed here for one night short notice whilst working in Wales. The evening meal and breakfast were good. The room was spacious and I had a good nights sleep. The hotel has recently reopened and can only improve with guests staying. The host was really friendly and hospitable.

reviews.title: Let down by lack of maintenance
reviews.text: Located a short walk away from the shopping centre with its own car park at the rear. Our suite showed signs of lapsed maintenance. Most of the light bulbs did not work but enough did to see well enough. There was a power point that was hanging off the skirting board, but was re-secured during our stay. The curtain track in the bay window had come adrift on one side so that that half of the curtain stayed in the closed position, the other half opened and gave enough natural light. Door locks usually have 2 screws holding the internal part in place, ours only had 1. Whilst the lock was loose, it did close and lock. All these points are so easily fixed one can only ponder as to why the maintenance had been allowed to lapse – a great pity. Our suite had 2 spacious rooms as well as an en-suite and was clean with a comfy bed. The Full English Breakfast was excellent and you can customise it to your needs. However the breakfast room was a bit on the cold draughty side. The staff were very pleasant and communicative. If the maintenance is kept up to date then this Hotel would be a joy to stay at.

reviews.title: Great Weekend Bowling
reviews.text: Just a short stay whilst competing in the Radnorshire Indoor Bowling Centre - just round the corner from the hotel, gret size roomsa and had all the necessary equipment in the rooms. Nicely decorated hotel and great service. Nice breakfast in the morning with plenty of tea and coffee going. Lovely warm and cosy rooms. Highly recommend the "Montpellier Hotel" for people staying in Llandrindod or in the vacinity.

reviews.title: A bed for the night and reasonable food, but that is all.
reviews.text: So, after a 4 hour drive across from Dorset on the south coast, I was very pleased to see my sat nav say that I have arrived. I was staying here with 7 friends as part or a motorsport event that was happening nearby. We had a warm welcome by the manager and after a little discussion, were all directed to our rooms. I was sharing a twin room with a friend and it was pleasant, clean and spacious. However, that's where the positive list for this trip ends. We met in the dining area for dinner and were greeted by a very tasty set menu that we had pre booked. We asked for drinks and were told we could have Fosters, Coke or a select few others, despite seeing a 'full' bar around the corner. Once we had our SMALL drinks and can of Fosters, we asked for another Coke. We were told that they had run out. Strange given that we were a some of only a few guests staying that night. The manager went to the shop and returned with one bottle of Coke for the table. Given the issues to this point, we decided to settle the bill, before retiring to our rooms, so that we could get away on time in the morning. When the team owner went to pay a total of over £500 for our rooms, food and drinks, we were told that we weren't able to make a card payment. A Hotel, that will not take a card payment for £500 ....? I'l let that sink in for a moment. Avoid loose tiled floor trip hazard on entrance ramp, walk to town, two people withdraw their full limit from an ATM, return to hotel, pay in CASH.... CASH.... Time for bed. A reasonable nights sleep, so cannot fault that. Despite my friend falling out of his narrow, single bed onto the floor besides me, oh how we laughed! It was a cold room, (no radiator) so had to borrow from a friend. Quick coffee and shower before breakfast to set us up for the day. Err, maybe not. Being an old, large hotel, I set the shower running to get the hot water through. Made an instant coffee by plugging the kettle into the socket and placing it on the floor as it wouldn't reach from the desk that it was precariously parched on. Pour hot water, stir, add sugar, add mi... oh wait, no milk. Forget it, i'll shower and have one at breakfast. Strip off in the carpeted bathroom, hop into the shower and " OH MY ... " !!! The water was so cold that it felt like it was being pumped straight from the mountains just a few degrees above freezing. Return to bedroom, boil kettle on floor again, fill basin with 1 part hot water, 1 part mountain spring water. Tepid face wash complete, time for breakfast. No real dramas here, so i'll start to wrap up this review. In summary: If you are looking for a bed for the night and the rest of the hotels in the surrounding area are fully booked, this place will suffice. For all other occasions, I would strongly advise staying elsewhere.

reviews.title: Very Enjoyable Stay
reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel over the August Bank Holiday for 4 nights. The room was accommodating, very clean with crisp white bedding. The cooked breakfast was a feast! Abraham, his lovely young family and staff were so friendly and helpful - nothing was too much trouble. The location is perfect if you are a biker and wish to explore the Welsh roads. We hope to return next year! Many thanks for a lovely stay.

reviews.title: Lovely place
reviews.text: The Montpellier is a lovely hotel with some real old world charm. It's in a beautiful Victorian building and the recent refurbishment has aimed to keep with the age of the building. Really lovely to stay somewhere that doesn't feel clinical and same-y like a lot of chain hotels. The manager was very friendly and great to chat too. The rooms are large and spacious. Breakfast was huge and delicious. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and will happily book again when we next head to Llandod!

reviews.title: Stay clear
reviews.text: This is not a boutique hotel, run down and shabby yes. We always try to give balanced feedback on hotel stays but this keeps getting worse by the day. Can’t believe you have to state exactly what you want for breakfast and the exact time you want it the night before, a German lady in front of us was gobsmacked how hotel is run around staff not guests. I know there are plenty of comment about breakfast but really .......two selections of cereal, one slice of toast and only enough butter for a quarter slice! Today because we didn’t know we had to tell them last night what time we wanted breakfast we were sent back to our room as nothing was ready. I could go on about state of place but you get the idea, would say like faulty towers but that was funny and this is real.

reviews.title: Me, my wfe, my mom & my Aunt
reviews.text: We had a really nice 2 night weekend stay to visit my Aunt & Uncle who live in town. Yes the hotel is dated & yes it is a work in progress, however the rooms we had (a double & a twin) were spotlessly clean, really spacious & comfortable. Breakfast was good & freshly cooked. What really made our stay though was the staff, well Hannah actually. She was on reception, front of house, serving breakfast & I understand she even cleans the rooms! She so friendly & welcoming, nothing is too much trouble has she always has a smile for everyone, she is a real credit to the hotel & tge reason we are looking firward to a return trip when tge works are completed. Tje hotel is full if old world period charm & I hope this is retained by the owners as wirk progresses. Thanks aga8n Hannah & good luck with your studies

reviews.title: 2 day visit
reviews.text: the hotel a bit dated but is under going refurbishment very close to town short 3 minute walk the room we had was good and large bed very comfortable nice reclining armchair and settee manageress very helpful breakfast exellent good value for money would go again.

reviews.title: Avoid at all costs
reviews.text: OMG please don’t go, my husband booked a 2 night stay at the Montpelier as a 60th birthday surprise after spending the day at the Royal Welsh Show. On approach to the hotel we could see it was run down but hey let’s not judge a book by it cover!!! The entrance hall was grubby and badly decorated, we should have turned tail and headed for the hills at that point, the reception area was even worse, “The Hotel Inspector” would have had a field day, I don’t think it had been cleaned or tidied in a long time. My husband handed over his credit card, I know, we should have asked to see the room first, hindsight is a wonderful thing! We were shown into a “suite” I wouldn’t have left the dog there and I don’t have a dog. What was wrong you may ask? The plug in the bedroom was hanging off the wall with all the wires exposed and a bedside lamp was plugged into it, a breach of Health and Safety and fire regulations The carpet was badly stained The sofa was badly stained, I didn’t feel comfortable perching on the edge of it Lamp shades were missing Lamp shades were not fitted correctly The curtains, the plemets were hanging off, and hooks were missing, the curtain that divided the room in half was hanging off We complained to the receptionist, then the manager and then finally to the “owner” as primarily it was unsafe as well as the list above. Safety of ones guests should be the greatest priority, we were offered a £60 total refund on a £130 per night stay, which was later withdrawn, we asked for a refund as was told that wasn’t possible. The hotel was so bad we left anyway. Please, in our opinion, don’t waste your money or most importantly risk your life, there are plenty of other lovely hotels/B and B’s in this lovely part of Wales.

reviews.title: Not Impressed
reviews.text: We had plans to stay here, however having emailed them in advance we got no response after the intitial acknowledgement! When we were in the area we looked around and decided to stay somewhere else. Not impressed with their lack of communication!!

reviews.title: Clean & Value for money
reviews.text: It was ok. The shower worked. The loo worked. We had clean beds for the night. We were warm enough and fed enough. We had an appointment time for breakfast, but we had breakfast and it was fine. Basically the basics, for a basic rate.

reviews.title: Convenient location
reviews.text: We stayed here for one night only. On arrival we were told that the management had just changed and hence no bar/restaurant! This was a little disappointing, given the great reviews the restaurant had on Trip Advisor. The staff are friendly and the room was comfortable, if a little in need of updating. The whole building looks like it needs a re vamp. However for a short stay it was absolutely fine. Tea/coffee making in the room with biscuits, a decent TV and toiletries in bathroom. Fresh white linen and very clean. The breakfast was not a buffet and we had to choose just one option. But the full English was tasty and filling. Overall our stay has been pleasant and we would stay again, hopefully it will be upgraded decor wise some time soon.

reviews.title: Reasonable hotel
reviews.text: Stayed here for 2 nights in July I had a good sized room for a single with a reasonable bathroom, the only problem with the bathroom being no blind or curtain at the window, nowhere to hang towels and no shower curtain so you had to fight with the shower so as not to drench the carpeted floor. Breakfast was substantial being cooked to order and was a good start to the day. The hotel is a bit tired but clean and perfectly adequate for a few nights stay. The cost of a single room with breakfast was very reasonable at £55. Didnt have evening meals here but its only a short walk to bars and restaurants. There is a large free car park to the rear of the hotel. Strong free wifi in the room I stayed in.

reviews.title: The True Horror of Montpelier Hotel
reviews.text: Please don't stay at this decrepit building, the photos you see are so old they are not a true reflection of the very poor state of the building. Dangerous doesn't begin to cover it, bear wires, damp everywhere, windows open to let the smell out. No food available on a Saturday evening and our arrival time was 6pm. It stuck in the 50/60's with coloured bathroom suits if that truly what you can call them. Black mould around the windows if you are lucky to have one as my friends only had a fire exit door leading to a fire escape which looked sooooo rusty you hoped you didn't need to trust it in case of a fire. The breakfast was very poor with your eggs being cooked with carpets on the bottom, one small square of butter had to keep asking for more, one slice of toast ect ect, asked for my half of tomato to be well cooked NO looked the same as everyone else. They charge my friend twice for same room now he has to get his money back. They over charge for qualities on everything, no bar as advertised on a Saturday night????? The ten pound charge for the dog I was more concerned we would all catch something tbh. Staff, (useless) as we had to eat out and they didn't have a glue where to send us that was dog friendly, we found our own lovey pud Laughing Dog great ffod and lovely people shame they don't do B&B. Dangerous electrics inside and out, obviously being used as a Hostel. Please don't stay there its a fire trap in my opinion I couldn't believe what I was looking at as we puled up. It wants reporting or pulling down. Forgot to say about the cigarette burns in the sticky carpets.

reviews.title: Very disappointing definitely not a Boutique Hotel
reviews.text: When we got to our room the curtain was closed so we opened it and the whole rail fell down, it had already snapped and had just been placed back together hence the closed curtain. This was fixed next day but badly. We were told we had to give a specific time for breakfast i.e 8am or 8.30am etc even though the welcome guide in the room said it was between 7.30 and 9.00. When we went down at 8am our full English was brought out immediately...how long had it been made and waiting? There were two coffee machines sat empty and a kettle was brought out for us to make a drink. One morning we arrived for breakfast and no one came, I asked and they said because we hadn’t told them the night before no breakfast was ready for us. We were told to go back to our room for 15 minutes and they would get it ready. There was nowhere to hang a wet towel other than across the wall heater or over the door. Fire doors were propped open with fire extinguishers and the tiles on he floor in the entrance hall were cracked and loose, causing a trip hazard. Very, very disappointed, this hotel has a lot to offer, if only the staff worked for be guests and not for themselves

reviews.title: Taster day
reviews.text: Have to pay to get into room at a reasonable time,rooms small as we upgraded but still room small.Food very good and did note have to wait too long check for offers and special days as they are good value would recommend this hotel"

reviews.title: Great if you like drum n bass at a 1000 decibels
reviews.text: I'll try to be as objective as possible here. The receptionist was lovely. Very welcoming and friendly. She informed us on arrival that there'd be live music until 1am that evening. I wasn't thrilled as I'd have preferred to have been informed before I booked as we have 2 children and it's important for us for them to have a good night's sleep but thought, ok we can deal with it. Our suite was huge and absolutely lovely. The carpet was brand new and the room was very clean with very nice decor. The music started at 9pm and when you're told "live music" you expect a local band/Ed Sheeranesque type bloke with a guitar. What we got instead was full on drum n bass music which was so loud that it shook the entire building. And it's a big building! Our room literally vibrated. We have an audio recording which is actually shocking. Just wish I could upload it here. The music was held in a basement area which was populated by locals. Even the offer of a free pint from the staff couldn't tempt me to participate. I'm middle aged! Why on earth would I want to go to a drum n bass party??? God only knows what the rest of your guests thought. The restaurant area looked nicely appointed and modern but I doubt the corridors had seen the attention of a decorator since the 1970s. Peeling paint and wallpaper with an overall dingy and unloved look. Hopefully the owner will update these to look as lovely as the rooms. My advice for anyone who wishes to stay here is to check that there will not be a drum n bass party held during your stay - unless drum and bass is your thing. And my advice to the owner is to have the courtesy to let your guests know before they book so they at least have the choice of enduring an extremely loud rave or not. Also, choose between being a hotel or a nightclub because you can't be both!

reviews.title: Rave Night
reviews.text: Arrived here after a five and a half hour drive.welcomed by a friendly member of staff who took us up to our room.nice and clean with fresh bed linen.It was a bit fresh it there but soon warmed up with a heater that was supplied. Breakfast was great with a choice of full English or cereal .teas-coffee or juice which sets you up for the day. SECOND NIGHT.RAVE!!!!!Well music started about nine pm.got louder and louder,the sash windows were vibrating with everything else in the room.There was no way I was going to sleep with all that noise.shouting coming from outside the street didn't help.Thinking it will stop soon I was watching the clock and it finally went quiet at 2.45am.All I wanted to do was get out there. Breakfast next day was strange atmosphere.A young member of staff was asked by the owner to get feedback from the previous night. Before we left for the day we was approached by the owner who did apologise for the noise and offered us a drink.he oviously didnt think it was too loud.funny when the hotel shook.NO CHANCE AS I WAS KEPT UP ALL NIGHT AND WASNT HAPPY . staff were very nice and very helpful and couldnt do enough.The Hotel is under new management and run by a family and hopefully the owner will put his guests first before the loud music keeps them all awake. I think once it's has some tlc it will be a great family run hotel.

reviews.title: Nightmare hotel
reviews.text: We were booked in for 2 nights. We could not wait to get out after first night. No night porter so left alone all night. No bar or restaurant so had to eat out. Manager got aggressive when we complained (Gary). We did not even stay for breakfast. In need of a major update. Fire safety needs updating. Our room had a shower in a bath, but no shower curtain and only was chest height. Will never go back and supprised it's even on booking.com.

reviews.title: Comfortable Stay
reviews.text: We had a two night stay here in a suite for my husband, myself and our son. The hotel is in need of decoration. Only one bar area open and was ok. The restaurant wasn't open for food on the Friday when we arrived. The staff were super friendly and helpful. Room was clean and comfortable with a portable heater (we got one for the bathroom too as it was a little chilly) The stay was good for the price. Breakfast was excellent.

reviews.title: A pleasant short stay
reviews.text: Stayed here for 2 nights and looking at previous reviews was not expecting very much at all. When we arrived the Manager Gary was on his break but checked us in. The room we were shown first was not the one I looked at/booked. We were then given the correct room - I cannot be sure if this was an error or not. The room was large and needs updating but it is an old hotel and was clean and comfortable. The only downside was the fact that there was carpet in the bathroom which was v.old and no shower curtain or screen, so as per other reviews, the carpet became soaked after a shower. Apparently, this issue is in hand. Fortunately, there was minimal noise from other patrons which, in my experience, can be a massive problem in smaller establishments. Breakfast was ok but you couldn't help feeling that everything you ate was being watched. It was not a buffet affair. Other reviews said there was no-one there overnight but there was - a friendly polite young man who always had a smile and a 'how are you?'. All in all value for money.

reviews.title: Very Disappointing
reviews.text: We stayed here for one night at the beginning of August as we were attending a wedding in Llandridnod Wells. In the weeks leading up to the wedding I called and emailed the hotel many times and received no response or answer, they have 3 different phone numbers and none were answering me. I was trying to contact them to request an early check in so was getting very stressed out when I was getting nowhere. FINALLY, 2 days before we were set to arrive I received an email back stating we were able to check in early. When we arrived at the hotel there was nobody at the reception area and there was a piece of paper with a number to ring for assistance. When I called this number a man answered and really rudely told me that check in wasn’t until 3pm, I explained that I had spoken with someone who said I was able to check in early, to that he responded very sarcastically “really?”. I was getting more and more frustrated by this point as time was ticking on and we had a wedding to get to, someone arrived TWENTY minutes later to check us in, the service was so so slow considering we had explained we were in a rush and had a wedding to get to. We were asked what we wanted for breakfast the next morning but we weren’t aware of the options, so when I asked what we could have the lady replied “well.... a full English?” really sarcastically. Sorry, don’t ask me what I would like for breakfast if there is only one option and make me feel stupid in doing so. The rooms were SO dated, there was tea, coffee and a kettle in the room but no mugs??? Very bizzare. This hotel is not worth £70 per night at all and I’m disgusted that I paid this for the service I received.

reviews.title: Trying hard
reviews.text: The staff were pleasant and were trying hard to please. The room was large and clean but there needs to have some serious money spend to bring everything up to date. The continental breakfast was very basic but the cooked breakfast looked OK. Not sure we would return.

reviews.title: Worse than Fawlty Towers
reviews.text: When we arrived we were told there was no bar restaurant as they were under renavation and were advised to go to a restaurant down the road, On returning and letting our selves in to the darkened hotel at around 11pm we went to our room which to be fair was ok and went to sleep around 12am at 1am I was woken by an alarm sound after wandering the hotel I found it was an alarm clock (I think) in room 1 which was directly below ours. We had been told there was a member of staff in room 8 I went to room 8 and knocked on the door I repeated this 3 times and banging harder but no responce so we packed our bags and left finding a Mc Donalds open about 40 minutes away we stayed there and would recomend you did too,

reviews.title: Stay Well Clear of this Hotel
reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel back in Jan 2017 and the hotel was lovely at that time hence the reason of going back, but all has changed now since we stayed here in Feb 2018. When we first of all arrived at the hotel there was nobody to greet us – once we found the Reception the lady in the reception was lovely. We asked for the Breakfast be served at 8am on the Sunday Morning due to us having a bowls competition that started at 9 just round the corner in the indoor bowling centre , the lady mentioned it would not be a problem at all. There was 6 of us in our group and we all had a good night sleep, comfortable beds, rooms nice and warm but it ends there. In the morning we opened the door of our hotel room to a heavy smell of Cannabis throughout the building – smell getting worse when we were going downstairs to the eating area. A friend of mine went down to use the toilet by the eating area and he found out where the potent smell was coming from, the smell of cannabis down there was that strong that you felt like passing out. When in the eating area there was no coffee, tea or any drinks in the area. There was a few cereal boxes but no bowls or spoons to eat them with. There was two empty coffee filters that didn’t look like they had been cleaned for a long time, we tried to look everywhere for members of staff, but nobody to be seen anywhere. We sat down and waited 25 minutes for the first two plates of “Cooked Food” to come out and a further 10 mins for the other two plates to come out – they were all cold and the Harsh Browns was still frozen. Some toast did arrive after the plates, these were also cold. Eventually after we asked the Chef if we could possibly have some drinks then he brought out a jug of Orange and water, no glasses or cups to be seen. Again after asking we eventually got a few cups but not enough for us all. We complained to the Chef that the food was cold, the reply we had was “Either Eat it or Leave It” We had to purchase our Breakfast in the bowling centre as we were all starving!! Even though the breakfast is all included in the hotel room price. I would not recommend this hotel to anyone. I will not be staying at this hotel again.

reviews.title: not what advertised
reviews.text: arrived no bar; no restaurant, only one member of staff room was clean, however if I was an inch shorter i would not have been able to turn the bath room light on the cord was so short, were told that there would be a night porter but when we had a problem the room we couldn't find anyone I thought this was a danger in a hotel this size if there had been a fire I don't what would have happened

reviews.title: Is this the same hotel?
reviews.text: I booked this hotel based on previous reviews but wish I hadn't, the building needs some tlc and we were greeted with a large, dirty ashtray at the entrance; a young woman was waiting for us and showed us to our room, we were told the restaurant was closed and also the bar so no evening meal available. We were given keys and told to lock the outer door on our way out as there were no staff in the hotel at night! Our room was large, clean and had good bedding and towels but the beds need new mattresses and the shower head over the bath soaked the carpet as there was no shower curtain. Breakfast, where do I start and worth bearing in mind I paid £180 for a two night stay; no menu, we were asked what we would like to eat....do you have any fruit or yoghurt..no, we had scrambled egg on toast, no butter on the toast, we asked for it and were brought some type of spread, coffee was help yourself to water out of an urn and a coffee sachet, orange juice was in lager glasses; the second day I asked for toast and marmalade but there was no marmalade! Plus points are pleasant staff, though it appears no one is in charge and fast internet, we also had excellent food up the road at Fabians but you could do much better than this hotel locally and for less money

reviews.title: Family stay for wedding
reviews.text: We had an extremely nice stay. The staff were very Friendly. Lovely large room with ensuite and a sofa bed in the room. We also had a twin room also with ensuite. Both rooms had period features as well as furniture. We had a nice breakfast and also vegetarian breakfast. Fluently of tea coffee. And cereals. The staff were very friendly and helpful. Nothing was any trouble.

reviews.title: Overnight stay
reviews.text: When we arrived an elderly lady was hoovering ....very friendly ..she said manager wasn't there he would be back later she showed us two rooms to choose from one was huge quite clean the smaller one we chose as it smelt of fresh paint and was better suited to us ...we went out for tea and on arrival back there was a lady with two children who asked us to check in upstairs at reception ...man was very friendly he said the manager he had there had left so him and his wife were running it till they got another one ...had a good night's sleep .....went down for breakfast....all laid out but no bowls for cereal so we just sat and waited and waited ..then the lady appeared with two cooked breakfasts put them down and we never saw her again ...not very nice either all tasted cheap ........when we left didn't see anyone either....wont be going back there .......

reviews.title: Great place to visit/camp
reviews.text: Spent two nights here last week. Didn't really know what to expect, just found it online and decided to go. Not too far from Denver, which was nice. It's half forest, part Jurassic park. Tons of aspens, lots of foresty trees. Not too many trees in the actual campground though, which doesn't make for too much privacy, but we didn't mind too much. Bathrooms, showers (coin on), dog friendly, lots of families with kiddos, but not a huge campground and we liked that. You can fish, canoe, hike, no swimming, paddle board. Sites have fire pits, tent pads and picnic table. Recycling! Yay! 20$ a night we thought was pricey. 7$ a day, if you don't have a CO park pass (we don't, just moved here) then 5$ for firewood. 74$? To camp for 2-2 1/2 days, guess it's not so bad. Beautiful nice hike around lake.

reviews.title: Nice State Park
reviews.text: We spent an afternoon here. The visitor center is very nice and the staff are knowledge le and helpful. The lake is nice, as is the walking trail around it. There's really no shade, and at this high altitude, the sun can be scorching, so either bring your own shade, or plenty of sunscreen and water.

reviews.title: Off the beaten path
reviews.text: We found this park while planing a trip out west from the Chicago area. Was the only park on I-70 we could find reservations for at the time. We only needed a place to sleep for the night so our requirements were few. Was quite a drive from I-70 some in town some on asphalt but most on a gravel road. The campground was in a valley surrounded by mountains with a meadow feel, nice tent pads and plenty of room for our popup. Bathroom was new very clean with flush toilets and pay showers bring flashlight at night due to solar powered lighting. Overall was a great park tho far off the main road . Happy Camping !

reviews.title: A nice hike around an alpine lake
reviews.text: We enjoyed an easy hike around the lake, it was a good beginning to our hiking adventures. We tried to complete the pass above the lake but it was still closed due to weather. Once we hiked it I got my mountain bike and repeated the trail on that. Although not challenging it was nice to get my feet wet.

reviews.title: Cabin Camping at Sylvan Lake
reviews.text: I stayed in a camping cabin at Sylvan Lake State Park. The cabin is 2 rooms (some are a single room) with the front room having a table and chairs, propane heater, chairs, and some shelves for storage. The other room is a bedroom, with three single beds and a double bed. The cabins (except cabin #1) do not have bathrooms or kitchens and there is not running water. There is limited solar lighting, which I found a bit dim and supplemented with lanterns. I stayed in early May before the flush toilets and the showers were open. The second morning I woke up to a blanket of snow everywhere, but the cabin was snug and warm. It was very nice to have a heated cabin when it was chilly - the family was able to go into the cabin and play games in a heated space. There were nearby vault toilets and a hydrant for drinking water. I would recommend this campground and the cabins to anyone who wants a camping experience without sleeping in a tent. The visitor center sells firewood and ice.

reviews.title: Surrounded by Mountains
reviews.text: When we were there we camped in the middle of a grass field surrounded by mountains. It was beautiful. A nice lake to fish and hiking trails. Had water spigots to fill your jugs but no electricity. No place to charge phones (not even the outlet at the bathroom). Quarter showers that were nice and warm.

reviews.title: Great day trip for hiking and fishing near Avon
reviews.text: It's an hour drive from Avon on mostly paved road, with only the last 5 miles being well maintained dirt, to this lovely mountain lake. The 1.5 mile hike around the lake is scenic, about half in the sun and half in the trees. There are picnic tables right next to the parking, but they are not shaded. Some folks brought a portable awning for their own shade. Along the right hand side of the lake are some shaded tables if you don't mind carrying your supplies for a 10 minute walk. I caught three nice trout in an hour's fishing on dry flies. Fun! Don't forget your camera and bug spray. Scenery is magnificent. Bugs are not vicious but a bit of a nuisance at the upper end of the lake. A great day trip from Edwards, Avon, Beaver Creek or Vail!

reviews.title: Hit the fall colors perfectly in this nice, short drive
reviews.text: Nice drive to this lake south of Eagle, Colorado. Very scenic and saw some old cabin ruins on the way that made for beautiful, early autumn pictures. The road that continues beyond the lake looked rougher and we didn't have time to explore it but it looked scenic as well. If you actually drive down to lake, you will have to pay. We turned around as we were able to get the pretty pictures we wanted from the road.

reviews.title: A Fun Adventure
reviews.text: On the first day of fall, my girlfriend and I spent a night camping at Sylvan Lake. When we arrived (a 3 hour journey from Colorado Springs), we were greeted by an amazing scene. Storm clouds surrounded the park and the aspens were just starting to turn. Our trip was marred by a steady down pour and a cold night that brought the seasons first snow. I still had a great time though. 1) Location: Outside of Eagle, CO, the park is a pleasant 30 minute drive from town. The White River National Forest is really pretty. The aspens will look amazing on the hill sides. The proximity to the park to town makes it easy to buy supplies and eat. The lake itself is a pretty area with mountains surrounding the canyon. 2) The campground: the spots by the lake are super close together. We went during a storm, so we had the area to ourselves. During peak camping season, I would suggest campers who want to be alone to find a different place to go. The facilities are nice, well kept, and close to the camping sites. 3) Cost: Ugggh... $18 fee for camping and $7 extra for day use fee. Overall, it's a nice place for a trip. A very unique ecosystem with historical sites mixed in. A good spot for families but a poor spot for romantic couples. If there is a meteor shower, the dark skies at this park would be amazing. The cabins on site look great and there are paddle boats for rent. The lake had fish jumping but we didn't see fishermen.

reviews.title: Campground on beautiful alpine lake (gorgeous fall color)
reviews.text: We've stayed in Sylvan Lake twice, the first time in a tent site, the second in cabin #8--which we loved, and highly recommend. It's private, comfortable, and right by an aspen covered hillside. And it has access to the Sneeve Gulch hiking trail, which we found to be a short and relatively easy climb on a packed dirt trail to a spectacular overview of the lake and the surrounding mountains. We just stayed one night, on our last visit. Next time we hope to stay longer and explore the area, as Sylvan Lake is surrounded by the White Rive National Forest, and there are many hiking opportunities. We found the staff in the visitors center to be very helpful and informative. Very highly recommended/

reviews.title: Something for everyone
reviews.text: First, my rating is based on my actual experience at Sylvan Lake. If I would visit again, I would probably have a more pleasant experience. So I'll try to give you information that will make your experience more than average because I do believe Sylvan Lake has potential. Campsites: There are four different experiences available. 1. "Fisherman's Paradise" - I must not be a fisherman, because this is NOT what I consider paradise. The sites are about 20' x 50' and your neighbors' 20' starts immediately with no trees, not even a painted line to separate you from your neighbor. It is a flat rectangle of grass that I suppose it is considered fisherman's paradise because it is the closest to the lake. 2. Elk Run Campground - if fisherman's paradise doesn't sound like a camping experience you would like, this would probably be a much better choice. The sites are spaced out quite a bit, there are trees, bushes and some privacy. This area allows for campers also with some sites being pull through and some being back in. 3. Cabins - not much to say here...they looked nice and of varying sizes. 4. Yurts - not much to say...except they are ~10 miles away from the lake on a mountain dirt road. Facilities: They have vault toilets that are improperly made (at least the one by Fisherman's paradise is). There is also a shower house with free hot showers (they have flush toilet's in this shower house). Visitor's center: Very nice with ice, firewood, a small gift shop, fishing license purchase and very nice staff and free wi-fi. By the way there is NO cell signal at Sylvan Lake. Location: ~20 minutes from Eagle, CO, a very nice town right off of I-70

reviews.title: I love Colorado
reviews.text: Just went on a trip from June 7 - 14 and it was great. There were 14 of us that went and we rented cabins 6, 7, & 8. I'm so glad we got these because the one by the lake had so many mosquitos you could be eaten alive lol. Up on the hill where we were there really wasn't any. I didn't end up reading that binder that's in the cabin until the last day. Big mistake. Read the binder. It had all kinds of tips in there. Really enjoyed our vacation and will look forward to coming back. Thought we would need firewood for our cabin, we didn't need it since they have a propane heater that makes it nice and toasty and also can work well for heating up water to do the dishes.

reviews.title: Great views but, not a lot to do
reviews.text: The only thing to do here was fish and some small hikes. We stayed two nights and our kids got bored after the first day. They do have canoes you can rent but, the lake is small so you can navigate the entire lake pretty quickly. The campsites are nice although if you are tent camping you will need to check the sites as some are only suitable for RV's even though they say they can accomodate tents.

reviews.title: Wrong time!
reviews.text: We came at the wrong time of the year! It was right after a snow storm, and we did not come with snowshoes and proper snow-apparel! So, we were able to walk across the frozen water a little bit, but there wasn't much else for us to do due to the snow. We basically drove the road of the park and got some beautiful photos. We did not stay at the cabins on site or campground, we were just visiting the park for the day. Even though we didn't really get to experience the park, it was still beautiful!

reviews.title: Quiet and secluded
reviews.text: This was a great place to stay for quiet and beauty. There's a five mile diet road to get back there but the whole ride is beautiful and will get you in the mood. While they don't have rv hookups they do have water spigots to get water at and there is a dump station. Generators can be used from 6am to 10pm. Camp sites aren't on to of each other though there are few trees in the campground area. At first i thougjt i wouldn't like that, since i want tree shade, but it wad overall such a good stay that didn't matter. They also have showers and toilets. The walk around the lake is beautiful and not strenuous. Is live to go back and stay for longer, since we were only there for three days. If youre looking for all the modern amenities, don't go there. If you're looking to get away from the hustle and bustle and into absolute beauty, this is the place for you!

reviews.title: breathtaking
reviews.text: I've been to sylvan lake state park last july. The campground is pretty good, but the view is the best! I still regret that I didn't took enough pictures. You should really take your time at this lake... And hike!

reviews.title: We come to the cabins every summer
reviews.text: This has been a family tradition every summer for years since we found it. The lake is great fun for the kids taking out the rental paddle boats or canoe. We attempt to fish, have never caught anything. The hiking is wonderful one of our favorite spots in Colorado.

reviews.title: Wonderful Lake and Campground
reviews.text: We spent a day here and would love to rent a cabin in the future. The lake is beautiful and peaceful. The area was not overcrowded at all which is hard to come by these days. The lake was easy to walk around and has several picnic tables and benches spaced around the path. There were a mixture of day visitors from Denver and from the Eagle area as well as lots of folks camping overnight in cabins, tents and campers. The cabins are rustic and you need to bring your own bedding and cooking gear. There are fire pits next to each cabin and they have bunk beds with mattresses- just no bedding materials. The lake was perfect for canoes, kayaks and paddle boards and there is a boat ramp. Lots of fishermen, both fly fishing and spin fishing. The lake is stocked with trout periodically. I went into the wash room and there are toilets and showers as well as outhouse type bathrooms. The washhouse showers are coin operated. I believed it was $1.00 for 4 minutes. They had a change machine for fives and dollars. The sign said they charged for the showers to conserve water. The washhouse was located near the camper area and the outhouses were near the cabins. There is a visitor center at the entrance where you can buy fishing licenses. You will need a State of Colorado Park pass that you can also buy there. If you just want one for the day they were $7.00. Cabin reservations can be made 6 months in advance. All the weekends were booked into October for the cabins when I looked in June. I think there were plenty of open tent sites. We loved our stop here and will definitely be back!

reviews.title: Nice campground
reviews.text: The campground is very clean and quite. The campsites are well spaced out so that you are not over hearing your neighbors conversations. The toilets are very well maintained as well. The campground is right next to the lake which itself is beautiful. The campground is almost 15 miles (including almost 5 miles of unpaved road) from the closest convenient store. So, make sure you have everything you need before you camp there for a few days. There are lots of activities to do in/around the lake. Gorgeous hiking trails, biking, non-motorized boating, fishing etc. I had a lot of luck with catching some rainbow trouts (powerbait worked best for me). Definitely a hidden gem. There is no cellphone signal at the campground. The closest cell phone signal I found was about 13 miles from the campground towards the town of Eagle.

reviews.title: Great park to just take a hike aroudn the lake
reviews.text: Did nto stay in the campground just went to hike and they had many trails to choose from with all different levels of difficulty.

reviews.title: Camping & ATV Trails at Sylvan Lake
reviews.text: We camped at Sylvan Lake last fall in an RV, and had 2 ATVs with us. The views are beautiful and you can ride your ATV from your campsite to miles and miles of ATV trails. It was a great weekend! Should probably keep it a secret, though!

reviews.title: Fun in the Rockies
reviews.text: First time to this state park. My wife and I enjoyed it very much. Beautiful area & well kept/maintained camping spots. The bathrooms are amazing regular bathrooms with water. Very peaceful & away from the masses, nicely tucked up in the mountains. We would love to recommend this to anybody wants to get away for a little while. Lake was wonderful nice Trail all the way around it people are fishing and canoeing having a great time. The park ranger was very friendly and very helpful we thank him very much :-)

reviews.title: Amazing quite place
reviews.text: Beautiful place to take the family short hikes and perfect views a lot of cabins and there is a place to have a good picnic with your family and friends very good prices to enter to the lake stop by the shop and get some suevenirs and enjoy museum before you go to lake

reviews.title: Not great for tent camping and bacteria in lake
reviews.text: Sylvan lake is absolutely beautiful. Unfortunately when we were there in July, there were signs all over the lake saying no swimming/boating due to bacteria in the lake. That was a huge bummer even though we're are grateful that they are doing those tests and informing visitors. The campground had a few decent tent spots set back from the road but for the most part there is no privacy at all and tent sites are mixed together with RV sites and are right on the road. They put us right in between two RVs that had their generators running all night and everyone walked by our tent to use the restrooms. We got up early and left. We also never saw the campground host the whole time we were there. We were hoping to ask if we could move sites. We would not go back or recommend.

reviews.title: refreshing
reviews.text: beautiful scenery, a lake full of fish, wonderful programs for the kids and a friendly staff makes for a great place to stay. if you like the outdoors you'll love sylvan lake

reviews.title: Beautiful day walking the lake and off-roading
reviews.text: Friendly staff at visitors center, plenty of picnic tables for day use, and a wide range of campsites. Take bug spray if walking around lake or fishing. Roads were maintained but I'd be hesitant to take a car beyond Sylvan Lake. Couldn't get beyond Basalt today because of large snow drift, but it was incredible scenery. $7 for day use in state park. In better weather, you can take the pass over to aspen.

reviews.title: Beautiful Mountain Lake. Great flat hike all around the lake.
reviews.text: There were lots of kayaks and paddle boards on the water. The trail was wide, with great views all around the lake. Many people were successful with fishing. The 1.5 mile trail was perfect for us after 17 hours of driving and getting acclimated to the elevation.

reviews.title: Beautiful Place
reviews.text: What a view! We had a tent spot at Fisherman's Paradise for a few nights. Very close to neighbors, but great view of lake. Little rodents near tents were cool, kids loved them. Fire pit was nice. No electric or water, but water pump, toilets, and showers very close walk and clean. Facilities are well maintained by staff. Rented canoe, $25 for 1/2 day. Beautiful way to quietly see lake. Paddle boards also available. Nice hiking trails all around. I can only imagine how beautiful this spot is in September. Nights were quite cold and days quite hot at end of June. Only complaints: we didn't catch a single fish (others claimed they caught their limit, we hardly saw any caught) and a large and loud group took over the campsite next to us all day with no reservation. There is a "day use" location down the road they should have gone to. We were expecting peaceful mountain solitude but instead got non stop yelling until dusk. I'm sure the rangers would have addressed it had we asked. Ranger Erin gave a great presentation on insect life in the lake. Don't expect phone service. Awesome visitor center.

reviews.title: Family Fun Time
reviews.text: All the reviews are pretty much correct above. This campground has a lot of pros: nice lake, bike / hiking trails around lake, secluded location. BUT What none of the reviews above mention is that this is an extremely family oriented place. After reading the reviews the boyfriend and I came here to escape and relax. We were super excited to get a lakefront campsite - until we got to the campground. 1. We were one of the only tent only campers at the lake. Everyone else had popups, RV's, Huge SUV's and a couple play in tents for the kids. 2. The lake campsites are tiny. We were so close to each other we could hear the family next door's portable DVD player sing Disney songs and the family 3 sites down playing campfire games. No one was yelling or being obnoxiously loud we were just too close. 3. The place was filled with families with small children. They were everywhere.
