We heard kids cry thoughout the night and couldn't even find a fishing spot without being swarmend by them. This seems like a great place for families but not for a couple looking for some peace.

reviews.title: Day trip for a hike
reviews.text: This is a beautiful lake with a 1-1/2 mile trail around it for an easy hike. People were camping nearby and fishing. It was quite peaceful. You cannot swim in this lake and only non-motorized small boats or kayaks can be used on this lake.

reviews.title: stayed in Yurt 2
reviews.text: I took my family including a 3 year old to stay one night in the yurt in Sylvan lake. We have stayed in Yurts before that this was a great experience for us. The yurt is basic with two futons (making two full side beds) and a set of bunk beds, the 5 of us fit perfectly. There is a fire ring with an adjustable grill surface. I did ask if there was a grill feture and was told no, so that was a nice surprise. They are remote, on the other side of the park, a good 9 mile drive of unpaved roads. There was plenty of wild life to be seen, we saw plenty of marmot and a couple of mule deer. The moose and bear did not make an appearance. This site is on our to do list for our next CO trip.

reviews.title: Rv overnight stay awesome!
reviews.text: We stayed last minute on an overnight on way from Denver to grand junction a beautiful place!! The only reason I didn't rate it excellent is because there aren't any hookups and the road coming in is not paved and rough. We took hike around lake it's just wonderful

reviews.title: A hidden jewel!!
reviews.text: Sylvan Lake is, in my humble opinion, one of the best kept secrets in Colorado. My family decided to take a weekend camping trip out there, without knowing much about it other than that we found it on a list of state parks, it looked like reasonable drive, and seemed relatively low-key. This lake is so serene, pristine, and the park is so empty!! This is probably one of the best camping trips we've ever had. The privacy and untouched beauty of this little state park is what makes the experience special; I don't know if this is always the case, or if my family just really lucked out. It really felt like we had the entire place to ourselves, a magnificent back yard. There were maybe 2 other families camping there at the same time, but we rarely, if ever, ran into anyone. There are several short and medium distance trails around the park, mostly well shaded and well maintained, all beautiful. My family used the campgrounds when we visited in the summer, so this isn't a review for the yurts or the cabins. The campgrounds are generous, and facilities are close by and clean. The only downside is that you do have to drive some distance on an unpaved road to get to the park. It's a bumpy ride, but if you're the camping type it's nothing to be fazed about. All in all, I highly recommend this place, but I don't want to say too much at risk of making it too popular!

reviews.title: Loved the Yurt
reviews.text: We stayed only 2 nights in Yurt. Wish it had been all week! Comfortable twin beds, roomy, great quiet location. Perfect for star gazing at night. Old cabins on site. Vault toilet kept very clean. Lake is beautiful and while tent sites are not shaded, there are cabins on the lake to rent. Can't wait to go back.

reviews.title: The Yurts at Sylvan Lake State Park are Awesome
reviews.text: We stayed in one of the three yurts that are not adjacent to the lake. They are really nice- better than the cabins we have stayed in the state parks in Colorado. I really liked that they had coin operated showers in the bathrooms at the lake in this park. We were a family of six and we were very comfortable in the yurts- they had a bunk bed and two fold out futon sleepers. The yurts were very clean and well lit with a skylight. The hiking here was really nice- absolutely picturesque. Close to Eagle for supplies, but hidden away so you didn't feel like you were near the highway or town. There was a game trail about 300 feet from the yurts that was neat to watch for animals. The rangers here were really nice and knowledgeable. Also we received a park pass for the month of August for our son who is a Navy vet.

reviews.title: Nice view
reviews.text: We got there almost at sunset when we found that someone stole our campsite. The rangers went to deal with it and their solution was for us to switch. It was a little irritating that I was being punished for others selfishness. We discussed and they seemed that was the only way until I told them I would write a review and they started scrambling to fix it, but in the end we just moved. Showers were a bit scary and dark. The views were amazing! Lots of things to do.

reviews.title: Pretty area, but campsites aren't very private feeling
reviews.text: The lake is so pretty, but most of the campsites can't see it. The fishermans paradise area is more like camping in a parking lot. There are no utilities in the sites. The bathrooms are clean as well as the showers. The Rangers were very friendly.

reviews.title: Beautiful location, a few things to prepare for!
reviews.text: Fairly easy to get to (about 25 minutes from I70), there is a dirt road for the last 5 miles so keep that in mind. Beautiful location - the lake is pretty and there are groomed trails around the lake and near the campground. We just went for the afternoon, brought a picnic lunch (there are several picnic benches) and then hiked around. It was a Monday so fairly quiet. We noticed the cabins which would be great fun to stay a night or two! There are also a number of campgrounds for tents and/or RV's. There are BUGS (hitchhikers) around the lake that like to cling to your shirt. They don't bite (thankfully) but they are a nuisance so be prepared. There is apparently wildlife there but we didn't see any. Dog friendly but keep on a leash! I would go back for sure but spend more time and maybe even rent a cabin and stay overnight. there are bathrooms - there is no plumbing however they are VERY clean. PS - there is NO cell service : )

reviews.title: Amazing and relaxing
reviews.text: Amazing place for a hike. You can't swim at the lake, but you can bring your kayak or a floating boat like we did! There are some cabins and I saw some camping tents too. Lots of picnic tables around. Watch your step for the hundreds of holes on the ground. They are the houses of cute little ground squirrels. :)

reviews.title: Inconsiderate people!
reviews.text: Booked a stay at Fisherman's Paradise sight 35. Most people are considerate about using there generators. Others, not so much. Our neighbors started there generator at 6:30 to 7:00 every morning and ran it continuously. The policy at Sylvan is 6:00 in the morning until 10:00 at night. Give me break! If you don't want peace and quiet, stay home. We had reservations for Labor Day. Cancelled. The staff is very nice. But they could not do anything about generator noise.

reviews.title: A little rugged, but always refreshing
reviews.text: The views are breathtaking, although there aren't many trees. We tent camp there several times a year and rent a cabin over Fall Break. Stargazing, especially in mid- late August and October during the week prior to and after meteor showers are UNREAL. I guarantee you haven't seen anything like it, unless you've stargazed showers in the desert. There is no light for many miles and you can see the milky way clear as day. Tent camping is great. Those of you tent campers with tender skin, as we have, bring lots of sunscreen and a portable canopy; bugs can be rough in June, so bring the off and the smokers. There is always fresh water available, the vault toilets are kept very clean. The main restroom has flush toilets and warm showers for $1 per 4 minutes of water. After three days of roughing it, that felt really nice! Because its primitive style camping, i.e. no electricity, while there is competition for campsites year round (except late Fall and Winter), many campers are in RVs which means the restrooms and shower facilities almost never have people waiting to use them, which is nice :-) Cabins - we rented the standard bare bones cabins thinking we'd need to bring our portable heater, to pre-heat before bed and lots of layers to keep warm. I was pleasantly surprised when I found the cabins have bunks with mattresses, a gas pot-belly style heater that kept the cabin very toasty, and basic solar lighting, so we didn't need the lanterns and layers to see and keep warm. It also has lots of shelving to store food and wares inside, so limited the need for back and forths to the car. Each has a dining table inside and out, and a porch which came in handy for the snow showers we got throughout the weekend. Fishing is decent (brown, rainbow and brook trout), but if you plan fish for every meal, if you don't have a boat, it won't happen; pack accordingly. Because its in a box canyon, the sun rises late and sets early, so plan day time activities and meals accordingly; daylight fades fast even in summer after about 5PM, earlier in the Fall. The ranchers run cows up and down the mountains when they move them, so in the Fall, you may have a wayward bull wander into your campsite. It's a little disconcerting, just let the rangers know and they will come and get them. There is a little fox that makes his rounds several times a day - well, he isn't really little. He is brazen and while he isn't interested in the kids much, he will take your things if left outside - welding gloves for the fire, anything soft or food smelling, even if its not food (i.e. dish soap, potholder, paper plates that weren't used). He is not really afraid of people, and will come close, but will shoo away if you raise your voice at him. At night he will prowl just outside the campfire light, so don't panic if you see eyes. He is just hoping you'll go to bed and leave something for him. Just keep everything packed away when you go to bed.

reviews.title: Great place in Tuol Kork
reviews.text: I recently stayed at Star King to recuperate after an illness-I live in Phnom Penh. The rooms are great with an excellent breakfast included. The pool is gross so don't pick this hotel for the pool-its a block from a very nice health club. Staff are very kind. Stay here if you need a great place in Tuol Kork area of Phnom Penh.

reviews.title: Absolute Divine Hotel
reviews.text: We booked the Star King after having a rough part of our trip for a little R & R and were more than happy with our experience. The service was impeccable, every single staff member was outstanding. The spa and rooftop pool are a real plus, along with the happy hour and in house cocktails. The Friday Night Buffet/BBQ is a 5 star and a must if you are there, the chef is amazing and it is definitely underpriced at $10. The only negative thing is that is not in the center of the city, but we had no issues getting around to all the main attractions, and were more than delighted to entertain ourselves with the amenities at the Star King in the evenings. Highest Recommendations.

reviews.title: Up and coming Hotel
reviews.text: Staff was exceedingly friendly and helpful at every turn, they made our stay! Pick-up at the airport made check in very smooth. The on site restaurant served great food and reasonably priced drinks. The rooms were large and clean. Location was a quiet 15 minutes away from center city--good for family's. Breakfast was very good, but opening time was a big challenge. The hours posted said 6:00 a.m. opening, but twice we had to find people to open up when we tried to eat at 6:15/6:30. A little frustrating if you have early morning plans like we did. Second issue was the room furniture -- it was stylish, but extremely uncomfortable to sit on. When these issues are fixed, the StarKing will be an outstanding location in Phnom Penh.

reviews.title: Beautiful new hotel, great service
reviews.text: Had a wonderful stay at this hotel after stumbling across it after our room fell through at a hotel nearby. Rooms were lovely and spacious, great shower and big comfy beds. Loved the rocking cot bed provided for our baby! Wonderful Staff and great breakfast the next morning. Would stay again

reviews.title: Decent stay
reviews.text: Ok the previous reviews are pretty spot on for this hotel. Now I could give this hotel a higher rating IF you know what you're in for. As previous posts suggest, this hotel is situated out of the riverfront, about a 10-15 minute tuk tuk ride ($4). So it's not as simple as walking out your hotel to all the amenities in town. The hotel is also VERY quiet with not too many guests. However this may suit you like it did for us after having experienced so many hotels where you have noisy neighbours this was a nice peaceful retreat. So if you like peace and quiet and don't mind getting a tuk tuk to town and back this is a great hotel. The rooms are enormous and very clean. There is a pool on the top but we didn't use it. The restaurant is also enormous which seemed strange as we had breakfast twice and dinner once there and we were the only ones in it. This was a bit strange as our first day the restaurant wasn't open for dinner and the following morning we couldn't get a full breakfast as the cook wasn't in. This was at 7am event though they state breakfast starts at 6am. The other mornings breakfast was great. Our dinner there was also very nice. The staff here certainly don't speak much English. This can cause some issues but we managed to get by OK. Overall if you don't mind being out of town and enjoy the peace and quiet, this is a great hotel. However if you need to rely on the hotel for things and like being close to everything, look elsewhere. We enjoyed our stay as we like the peace and quiet and didn't mind getting tuk tuks to the city. Each to their own

reviews.title: Service was prompt, staff was attentive! Rooms we had was very spacious!!!
reviews.text: We booked for two superior rooms but was upgraded to two Junior Suite with no additional charge. The only low down was that it was a new hotel- about six months and the road was unfamiliar with all the tuktuk drivers we had. Other than that, it was very satisfying, we had free lunch though we arrived earlier than check-in time

reviews.title: Couldn't Even Get a Cold Beer!!!
reviews.text: Do not stay here. The hotel itself is fine, but the location is awful, the pool is green, there is dust everywhere, the air con is rubbish and they don't even have cold beer at the bar! You're a 20 minute dusty, smelly, bumpy tuk tuk ride from the main centre of town and there is literally NOTHING near the hotel that you would want to go to! It's been built in the "up and coming" part of town, but right now there is nothing here and I don't think there will be for a very long time! Really, really terrible way to end our holiday.

reviews.title: Highly recommended hotel
reviews.text: Very Friendly staff and helpful. They greed you with a welcome drink which taste wonder. Very clean thought out the hotel I had a wonderful night with good view at the top floor. 5 star quality at affordable price highly recommend.

reviews.title: Unforgettable hotel
reviews.text: The hotel offers an excellent variety of recreational facilities, including fitness center, sky pool, spa, massage and good view sky bar in the centre of city. Superb facilities and an excellent location make the Star King Hotel, Phnom Penh the perfect base from which to enjoy my stay in this city.

reviews.title: Beautiful rooms but certain advertised amenities poor and not in a good location
reviews.text: This was the last of 6 hotels we stayed at over the course of a 2 week trip to Vietnam and Cambodia. While the hotel is very impressive and finished to a high standard we were disappointed with it's isolated location well away from downtown Phnom Penh and the lack of any bars or restaurants in the immediate vicinity. Furthermore the pool was green and murky and we definitely did not wish to swim in it, which was a great shame as Phnom Penh is very hot and dusty. The staff were friendly and obliging but lacking in English and trying to get a beer at the poolside bar was impossible; I don't think I would stay here again.

reviews.title: Very nice hotel in Phnom Penh
reviews.text: Star king It was a very nice hotel.. Staff so helpful n friendly.. There's nice sky view bar.. For the room is big and clean. The price is affordable.. I like the swimming pool and sky bar, the view is nice and i really enjoy to stay there. When you visit Phnom Penh don't forget to stay at star king hotel. :)

reviews.title: Wonderful and comfortable place to stay
reviews.text: It a really nice hotel, rooms are big and spacious especially very comfortable to stay, the lobby is spacious with wood furniture. We have taken a great Espresso at the Russey Keo Lounge next to reception counter. We had a wonderful time here! The staff is friendly and efficient. Lovely swimming pool with a poolside bar! They have served us a lovely breakfast spread with traditional Khmer cuisine. It's not quite far from the center. They provide free shuttles to the airport but you must book it in advance. Completely worth the money. Loved this hotel and would highly recommend it!

reviews.title: Simply awesome. Highly recommended.
reviews.text: Stayed there for 4 nights and had to go back for more. Staff was polite and awesome. Place is clean and very good value for money. Food was terrific. Amenities are complete and wonderful. Pool perfect. Laundry and airport pick up FREE!!! everything was great great great!

reviews.title: OK Hotel still being built. Staff good.
reviews.text: The rooms are good and well appointed but I don't expect a 4 star hotel to have building work going on all day whilst staying. The management was happy to stop the noise at our request (which we only asked once) but it's not ideal. The hot water was on and off and the pool was a bit green and murky. We were assured it was clean and swam with no problems but a green, murky pool is not very inviting. The staff are very helpful and friendly. The family room was a good size and the available services good as long as you are willing to pay the hotel premium, which is standard in this kind of establishment. Perhaps once the hotel is finished it will be worthy of 4 stars, but not yet.

reviews.title: The facilities are nice, but the staff are absolutely inept.
reviews.text: I found this hotel on TripAdvisor and the pictures of the rooms sold me on it (along with the price). They also offer a free pick-up at the airport (which is at least 35 minutes away by car). According to other reviews, the hotel is only one year old. I knew things were not going well as soon as we got picked up at the airport by our hotel driver. He tried to start conversation with us by asking where we were from. When I told him we were from the U.S. he went into a long lecture on how the U.S. was not Cambodia’s friend, because we allowed the Khmer Rouge to take over in 1975. I just sat back and let him rant. I was not going to change his opinion, but this is the first time I’ve had a hotel driver give unwanted political opinions. When we arrived I saw the entrance was on the second floor, at the top of a staircase. We received no help from the hotel staff carrying our luggage up the stairs. When we went to the reception desk I found the staff member spoke with such a thick accent that it was hard to understand her attempt at English. When we got to our room we found it clean and large. The furniture is thick wood and our bed was very large. It was comfortable to sleep on. There are lots of international (110/220 Volt) outlets in the room. There is a safe and a good amount of English language TV channels. The air conditioning worked quite well in our room. The bathroom had a good amount of amenities and had a very nice rain shower-style shower head. In our room there was a lot of seating area and places to put our luggage, including a long bench at the foot of the bed. We were happy with our room. We stepped out to explore the rest of the hotel and found they do not turn on the air conditioning anywhere else than in the guest bedrooms. We only found one other couple who were staying in this big hotel. Obviously the hotel management was trying to save money, as most hallways were only dimly lit. We had to turn on more lights as we went. We got to the rooftop pool and bar. It was completely blacked out except for one bartender who was sitting under a small light behind the bar. He walked around turning on the lights so we could see the facilities. We found the pool had a layer of dust on it, as this hotel is in a dusty industrial area. He showed us the large message area but said that if we wanted one he would have to call in a masseuse. The engraved art work and the stone craftsmanship of the bar, sauna, and entrance way were very nice, though. Too bad it was hidden in the dark. Down in the restaurant we found no one except one staff member. The air conditioning and most of the lights were turned off there as well. Since there was nowhere safe to walk to for dinner, we ordered room service. We had to repeat ourselves a few times slowly, because his English was broken. Later, when our meal was delivered to our room it was a good portion and tasted really good. We ordered Cambodian dishes but ensured it was not made too spicy. I called down to the desk for something later in the night. I found the night receptionist was by himself and he barely spoke English. He had to get our dining room waiter to translate. I think that’s a pretty serious safety issue if you have an emergency in the night and the reception desk staff does not speak English. Essentially, that evening we felt trapped in our room, because it was the only place in the hotel where we found the air conditioning on. The city has a hot, humid tropical climate. Furthermore, the area around the hotel is poorly lit and there are few places open to walk to at night. In the morning, we went down to the restaurant for breakfast at 8:30 a.m. We found only other couple there. Again, the waitress had poor English skills and mixed up our order as a result. I was also haunted by a fly that kept landing on my coffee and plate. When I pointed it out to the waitress she just laughed like it was joke. To top it off, the coffee tasted horrible. When we wanted to book a specific dinner cruise that I found on TripAdvisor the day receptionist tried to badger us into to taking another one they had a pamphlet displayed on their desk for. No doubt they get a commission for booking that one. I insisted on my choice and she reluctantly booked it. We booked this hotel for 2 nights at a great rate of $40 a night. That must be a “loss leader” to get guests, because they charge much higher for other services. For example, to hire a driver and vehicle for the day it was $60 (more than a night’s stay). That’s a pretty high price for one of the poorest countries in Southeast Asia. We also found the ride back to the airport was not free. That cost $15 as well. A simple dinner for two at the hotel was about $24. In summary, if you visit Phnom Penh I do NOT recommend staying at this hotel. Find a place more central to all the tourist sites where you can walk outside the hotel, and where the staff speaks English. Don’t be deceived by the nice photos, like I was.

reviews.title: My Home Away from Home
reviews.text: Great food, great staff, and great service have made this a wonderful experience for me while staying in the capital. Since my arrival at the airport, everyone here has gone out of their way time and again to make sure my stay is a pleasant one. Currently, I'm staying in the apartments and they come equipped with all the necessities of daily life. And if I need something, all I have to do is ask and with no time at all that item will usually be waiting for me just outside my room. I can not say enough about this place. I highly recommend it for anyone looking for a long term stay in Phnom Penh.

reviews.title: My Go To Hotel in Phnom Penh
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of staying here prior to the official opening. From the reception staff through to the restaurant, front office managers and room attendants, the friendliness and attentiveness was an absolute joy. The rooms are sparkling clean, roomy and with all facilities. There's a breezy bar and roof top pool and fitness centre. A 5 minute tuk-tuk ride to the markets and riverside cafes makes this a great location. With the Phnom Penh City Centre development just next door this will be THE place to stay. Will definitely be back.

reviews.title: Must stay at Phnom Penh!!
reviews.text: Large rooms, top notch facilities with rooftop bar and friendly / helpful staffs... Must stay at Phnom Penh whether leisure or business trip!!! Facilities include jacuzzi, sauna and swimming pool!! Rooms are large and nicely decorated with class, fit for all groups of travelers..

reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: We loved our room, the rooftop pool and the services. The room we had was a two bedroom apartment which was a highlight for our family of four that had been sleeping in the same room for our whole trip. Everything was clean and new and the shower was the best we'd had the whole trip. They had free airport shuttle. We had happy hour drinks and snacks at the beautiful rooftop bar and hung out in the HOT jacuzzi both nights we stayed. The only down side for this hotel was location. It is not close to anything and you need to take a car or tuk tuk to everything.

reviews.title: Sadly disappointing
reviews.text: In six weeks in Asia this was my only letdown. There were no bars or restaurants available for use. The pool was dirty and cleaning didn't seem a priority. The hotel is quite new and comfortable and the staff friendly but that doesn't overcome its lack of amenities The area it is located in is basically a building site, with construction surrounding the hotel. If you go for a walk the area is completely dominated by automotive shops or repairers. There is a limited market and a small number of food stalls near. But the hours are restricted It is situated a long way from the area of the city people wish to see. In 2 or 3 years it may be a the place to stay but not now and is definitely not family friendly.

reviews.title: Warm Friendly Hotel that treats you like an old friend
reviews.text: This is my second stay at the Star King and I felt as I was an old friend returning "home". The staff are remarkable - quick to help and nothing is a problem. The rooms are spacious and mine had a view to sunset over PP. The rooftop is a little "goldmine", sipping a beer or cocktail as the suns sets over the city is such a great experience. The breakfast is limited but all presented beautifully. During my stay is was basically "what would you like". While the hotel is a bit further out than some of the other hotels it a short tuk tuk ride to the central markets or the riverside. i didn't get there but there's also a very good supermarket nearby. As the staff for directions

reviews.title: Very Strange
reviews.text: This is a nice building with tons of potential, but it seems like it's half abandoned. Rooftop pool area could be extremely nice, but it's dirty, some of the equipment isn't working (no wifi either), and the bar is unstaffed and vacant. Room was okish although the bidet was leaking water onto the floor, and there wasn't any soap for the bathroom sink. Wifi went out for half a day during a two day stay. Location is a bit far from everything although I didn't mind too much since the price was right.

reviews.title: New upcoming beautiful hotel!
reviews.text: Amazing big room, TV, airco, sitting area, little balcony, clean bathroom with toilet & a big shower. We received a welcome drink in the lobby and in the room we got water & a bottle of red wine as complimentary. Hotel is only 1 month old but everybody did their very very best! It is beautiful: lots of wood, artistic wall creatures like in Angkor Wat,... Breakfast will be a buffet and there will be a spa. (Soon) There is a rooftop jacuzzi/pool, tuktuk service available (not free), transfer to bus was free. The food of the restaurant is very very good! Hope they will be more famous soon! They deserve it! Go for it! You won't be disappointed.

reviews.title: Supurb hotel very friendly staff.
reviews.text: My family and I arrived at Phnom Penh international airport on my birthday after a long flight and layover in Singapore from Perth Western Australia to be greated by friendly hotel staff holding a clearly printed sign with our name on it who escorted us to a near by transfer mini bus, the air conditioned mini bus was a welcome sight as the high humidity hit us very fast. When arriving at Star King the check in was very efficient and the welcome drink & cold towel were just what we needed. The kids enjoyed their very beautiful reception area. We were then escorted up to our room by the hotel manager. We were shown around our room and I was told that in this room is your master suite, when I opened the door I was greated by six staff members singing happy birthday standing behind a cake and a circle of candles. This was a great way to start our stay. While staying at Star King we were treated like the only guests in the whole place and nothing was too much trouble, from organising transport (tuktuks, private charter cars and airport transfers) to also helping plan a stay in Siem Reap so we could visit Angkor Wat & of course the tomb raider temple(Ta Prohm) nothing was too much. The food in the restaurant was very good and vairied this also helped my children (7 & 12) try something different to our normal home cuisine. There is a roof top pool, 2 x spas, male & female saunas and of course the rooftop bar, which provided a lot of entertainment for our two kids and us adults alike. While there we also celebrated our twelth wedding anniversary and the management and staff set up a romantic candle lit dinner on the roof top for the four of us giving us more memories to take home. I would like to thank all of the staff and management of Star King Hotel and Apartments for making our stay so special and would like to recommend the hotel to anyone who is looking for great a home away from home while in Cambodia.

reviews.title: Awesome Stayed
reviews.text: the hotel was amazing The property is clearly well managed, immaculately clean and very comfortable i love the lobby,The staff was great, very helpful and nice people, Rooms were a very good value and i would stay there again

reviews.title: A very welcoming Hotel
reviews.text: I concur regarding the level service at Star King Hotel and Apartment. It is outstanding. We were greeted by driver at the bus station and brought us to the hotel. The hotel is well appointed with good internet, good air-conditioning. Large Room, bathroom amenities excellent. Breakfast is wonderful, staff are great and always smile, small pool on rooftop to chill out, hot tub, steam and fitness center. If I return to Phnom Penh I would definitely return to this property, it is great, and comfortable.

reviews.title: Do not stay here
reviews.text: Nice room and foyer but that is all. Bed was so hard it would be softer sleeping on the floor. Went to restaurant for breakfast to find it empty with no staff. Eventually the receptionist asked if we could wait 20 minutes. When we asked for a taxi we were told "why didn't you book last night" to which we replied why didn't you book the kitchen staff for breakfast last night. We had booked for 5 guests and they still wanted to charge $20 for a roll out bed. Terrible location. Wouldn't think of getting into the slimy looking pool. Stay away.

reviews.title: Amazing Hotel
reviews.text: Our stay in the star king hotel was wonderful. from the second we entered we felt so welcome. the staff is really friendly,polite and helpful. we got a welcoming drink as we arrived that was a nice surprise after a long hot day of travelling. the room is very spacious and clean with a small balcony. the hotel facilities were very good. the breakfast had a lot of variety and was good quality. they also have a pool on the 8th floor, on the roof of the building allowing you to look over the vibrant city . the location of the hotel is a bit out, but its nice to see also the less touristy areas of phnom penh. the royal palace is about 15min by tuk tuk. its a definite must stay hotel if you come to phnom penh, they made us feel right at home.

reviews.title: Best Place for MICE Venues
reviews.text: - Newly opened accommodation with full services. Staff are well and professionally trained. - The room is quite big and clean with qualified amenities. - The property is located in the easy access area of the city equipped with latest technology facilities. - Affordable rates.

reviews.title: Good service
reviews.text: I stayed for a night, the price was affordable. Surprisingly room service was excellent and I felt like I was in a 5 stars Hotel, the bed was very comfortable and toilet was very clean. I am very critical when come to food and beverage and I love it. Overall I am stratified with what I am paying. It's always a good deal for low price and make me feel like I am in paradise.

reviews.title: Very nice and comfortable hotel
reviews.text: Star King hotel is very nice and comfortable to stay. The hotel room is clean and spacious.The stuffs here are friendly and helpful. I will definitely come back to this hotel if I visit Phom Penh again.

reviews.title: DO NOT STAY HERE
reviews.text: Worst customer service and hotel! Alarm bells should have gone off when our tuk tuk driver couldn't even fi d the place Hotel is 20 mins from. City centre and there is NOTHING around the hotel it is located in the industrial area, there is no where to eat outside the hotel without getting a taxi into city centre. My husband and I had a booking for 2 nights and we only stayed 1. We were the only guests at the hotel and they had to open the restaurant for dinner so we could eat, there was not even a breakfast service for us. Hotel is around 9 months old and the room was very large and the ensuite was large and nice however that is where everything good about the hotel stops. Being rather hot we decided to use the pool on the roof top - feral see pics and hotel advised us that it was ok to use - you be the judge To be real honest I did not feel safe staying here maybe because we were the only guests just felt very eerry. We moved over to another hotel in the city centre for the 2nd night and when we checked out the staff management did not even care.... Air con worked better when we opened the air con cover otherwise the room was very hot. Do not waste your time or money staying here worst experience ever

reviews.title: Awesome Hotel and Services
reviews.text: I stayed at Star King Hotel for a couple night. I do Enjoyed roof top bar, pool, hot and cold water facilities. Star King Hotel staff are very friendly and they are performing 5***** star customer service, I am Highly recommended the best Hotel.

reviews.title: Would be better if the hotel was closer to the commercial areas
reviews.text: Hotel looks new with nice accomodations but the hotel occupancy must have been really low since they closed the restaurant for lunch and dinner, and only had a breakfast buffet. So without a restaurant and bar, you had to go out. Unfortunately, there is nothing within walking distance so you had to take a tuk-tuk which made for a very unpleasant ride. The staff seemed short handed but at least they tried to help as much as they could. The negative is this hotel seems isolated from the tourist areas.

reviews.title: Short stay
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed at the Star King Hotel for 3 nights from 16-18 Feb 2016. It is a newly built hotel finished to a very high standard. The staff are fantastic and nothing is too much trouble. We only stayed for B&B so cannot comment on other meals but the breakfasts were brilliant, if you wanted something that was not on display, just ask, and if they can they will do it for you. Highly recommended. However there is a drawback. The hotel is about a 20 minute Tuktuk ride away from downtown Phnom Penh, and downtown is where it all happens, from the night life to the Royal Palace and various markets. If that's not an issue for you, then it's a good place to stay, we would certainly go back. A word of warning. Some of the Tuktuk drivers are ripoff merchants, negotiate a price and stick to it, with a small tip if you wish. We actually found taxis were cheaper than Tuktuks.

reviews.title: Would recommend
reviews.text: I was accommodated at this apartment, due to its close proximity to my work place. The rooms are large and clean. Staff are friendly. The reception has the aircon turned off and subsequently is suffocating. The pool area on the roof just needs to be cleaned. The restaurant and bars are closed. Generally it's a nice hotel, but it's not near any infrastructure. For convenience of work I would stay again.

reviews.title: Enjoyed the Hotel so much--have moved into the apartments for a month
reviews.text: I booked the Star King Hotel for 4 days upon arrival in Cambodia while I was looking for an apartment. I enjoyed the front desk hospitality, the pool and small gym so much, I decided to stay for a month in the hotel apartments while I searched for a suitable apartment. The hotel is new so everything is fresh and the staff could not be more helpful. It is not located in the tourist zone of the city, but it is a tuk-tuk ride away and well worth the commute to that area when needed.

reviews.title: Gracious Host
reviews.text: I did not stay at Don Carlos' casa, but I did go to a roof top fiesta pig roast there. It was a great party with music and dancing, pork, rice, beans, plantains and more. There was also a bar set up with mixed drinks. I look forward to going back there in January!

reviews.title: Great place and great hostess
reviews.text: Great casa and Great Family!. We stayed for 3 nights in Casa Don Carlos. We had an excellent time there. We are missing our breakfast in the terrace every morning and our dinners looking the stars, great food!. The terrace is a fantastic place to chill out after the frenetic live in Santiago streets. We were travelling with our two daughters, and they have a superb time. Carlos and his family always walked the extra mile to make us feel at home, and when we had a problem with our transfer at 6 am, Don Carlos was there to help us to find another taxi to go to the airport, and with the breakfast for our daughters. We stayed on the first floor room, We will definitely go back to this house. It is very well place in Heredia Street, close to the main squares.

reviews.title: Excellent casa
reviews.text: Great location in Santiago. Very easy walking distance of the main attractions. Delicious meal. Very clean and comfortable room. Attеntive hospitable hosts. We had everything we needed. Carlos is the best host we have ever met - kind, responsive, with a great sense of humor. We would stay at this casa again. Definitely recommend this casa. We really enjoyed staying at Casa "Don Carlos". Nastya and Andrey

reviews.title: Not what we expected
reviews.text: We arrived with high expectations as we had been booked into another casa for 9 nights but on arrival there was no room there. We had to be let in by another guest as the owner was upstairs. She showed us round and we were able to choose a room see photo. This was the best of the few available but was very crowded with not much room for storage of clothing. The AC was directly above the bed and was extremely noisy. The bed was not very comfortable and the sheets were polyester which in the heat of Cuba are not the best choice over cotton.There was hot and cold water available and the shower was good. There are two schools directly across the narrow road so be warned there is a lot of noise during the day time.Another thing to be aware of is that smoking is allowed in the casa and the cigar/cigarette smoke can drift into the rooms from the courtyard.There is a rooftop terrace which gets ver hot during the day and is accessed by a quite dangerous spiral staircase, this is where the food is served. The food served at the gas is of a good standard and not too expensive. The owner of the car and his wife were very kind and obviously trying there best. I would not recommend this was for a stay of more than a few nights.A good place to eat is The Grande Hotel opposite the cathedral good music at The Bar Bohemia half a block up from Casa De La Trova monday to fridays there is a brilliant house band starts at 2100.

reviews.title: The great beginning
reviews.text: My travel around Santiago de Cuba was started from Casa Don Carlos, and this is was great beginning, at first thanks to Carlos, he was very very friendly, he speaks in a lot of kind of languages and he helped me a lot with trip around town. Casa located very close to beautiful panoramic views, monuments, beautiful for photo shoot streets, and two great ice cream cafes with great prices located in few minutes of walk. Highly recommend this Casa. P.s from the roof of the casa you can get a nice view too old town

reviews.title: My second home.....
reviews.text: I stayed in Casa Don Carlos, for two weeks (august 2013) and had a wonderful time . . An always helping host named Carlos and Isabel and I was threated like a family member.The breakfast always fresh fruit and dinner was delicious, I even had lobster on the menu.... The price for this location included food is perfect . The location is perfect in the middle of the centre between plaza Martes and Parc Cespedes, so there is enough to do and if you like dancing like me you find a lot of salsa places where you can dance for example : casa de la Trova, Casa de Tradiciones, salon de son.and casa de la musica ..you can walk or if you take a taxi it will not cost more than 3 Cuc for a ride...And if you like swimming you can go to Hotel las americas and buy a swimmingcard at the reception for the whole day for only 10 Cuc For 10 cuc you have 8 cuc for spending food and drinks at the swimmingpool the other 2 cuc is the entrance..) Also important is that the owner carlos speaks english perfect... The rooms are clean and every 3 days they clean the bed...and they also wash your dirty clothes in the laundry for a cheap price.. if you want..So I am very satisfield and I am really recommend casa Don carlos for everyone who wants to visit Santiago de Cuba for one or even more weeks...Thanks Carlos and Isabel for the hospitality...

reviews.title: Book at your own risk!
reviews.text: I must say this was the worst experience I've ever had booking this kind of accommodation. Although I booked the room a couple of weeks in advance, and got the confirmation from "Don Carlos", when I arrived there the room was booked to other people! The owner received us with a smile in his face and saying this the way business works in Cuba. I could not disagree more, since I booked a lot of houses in Cuba and this is the only one that failed. Although I cannot rate the room, as I didn't stay there, I got the impression that this guy could do exactly the same again to other people, so... book it at your own risk!

reviews.title: Awesome stay and service. Highly recommended centered location.
reviews.text: If you want to stay in the center of Santiago de Cuba, and be part of all its folklore and history, enjoy beautiful sunrises and the good Cuban coffee, you would not find any better place than Casa Don Carlos. Conveniently located one a few blocks from all the main cultural main spots, e.g. Plaza de Martes, Parque Cespedes, Enramadas, Plaza Dolores, etc., I was able to go back and forth, catch a quick a shower and be back in the action in no time. Carlos was the best host I could ever asks for. His beautiful family received us for the week we stayed in December and we felt we were part of his family too. Best breakfast in town, a 3rd floor terrace like no other, with a magnificent view, perfect to relax and enjoy Santiago’s weather. Clean rooms with air conditioning, good service, WIFI, access to private taxis, and independent door entrance; just the perfect setting for us! I highly recommend this place. I would definitely come back again!

reviews.title: casa perfecta)
reviews.text: I recommend Casa Don Carlos with great pleasure, i had a vacation about two weeks and i compared accomodations. This is the best i`ve seen))) Carlos is friendly and open-heart person_) Nice food and fresh juice) We left a car in garage near by accomodation. Thank you Carlos and your family)

reviews.title: La casa Don Carlos : Allez-y! Just go there!
reviews.text: La casa Don Carlos https://www.facebook.com/casadoncarloscuba Very nice, calm, clean, comfortable house with 4 nicely furnished rooms with hot water, air conditioning and fan, some rooms with tv. No fridge in my room but two were at the guests' disposal right in front of my door. Nice patio + rooftop terrace overlooking Santiago. Perfectly situated in the main artery of Santiago. Quality/price ratio is unbeatable, even for someone travelling on your own like I did. Carlos is a very cultivated man who speaks very well French and English and puts a lot of energy towards his guests' comfort. He will answer emails VERY quickly, will come pick you up and drop you off upon arrival and departure with a bonus spoken little tour of the city. Anything you ask, he will try to answer or accomodate, especially food preferences. You won't get such a professional welcome anywhere else, therefore I warmly recommend this casa especially for long stays. Thank you again Carlos! The lobster-afficionado French girl ;)

reviews.title: Don't let 1 bad review put you off - Casa Don Carlos is great!!
reviews.text: I stayed in Casa Don Carlos for five nights in Dec 2013, and would happily go back tomorrow for at least another five! Carlos and his wonderful family are so friendly and welcoming, their Casa really was my Santiago home, and will be again when I hopefully return. The house itself is beautiful, lots of space, with a fantastic, and unexpected, roof terrace with views over the whole city. There is a lovely courtyard sitting area for guests to relax, where you are likely to be offered a glass of rum, or whatever else is going! My room (the middle one I believe) was spacious, bright, clean and comfortable, plenty of hot water, AC and a fan. I was lucky enough to be invited to share Christmas dinner with the family, which was lovely, and also helped celebrate a birthday during my stay. Carlos was so welcoming to me, and my friends, he collected me from the bus, helped with my onward flight to Havana (which had been cancelled - always check!) and brought me to the airport. Finally, you simply cannot beat the location of the Casa - it is so centrally located, minutes from the main park, and reasonably easy to find. I would be amazed if there is a better Casa than this in Santiago, and like the many many other reviewers, recommend it with pleasure. Thanks to Isabel, Carlos, Marte & all the family & all at Casa Don Carlos for your kindness, hospitality and for a wonderful Christmas. Best wishes from Dublin x

reviews.title: One of the best casa's on our trip in Cuba
reviews.text: Together with one casa in Baracoa our stay with Carlos was the best during a 3 week trip in Cuba. Carlos is a friendly, helpful and intelligent man who cares for his guest. Evening dinners were marvellous and they offered the best vegetarian meal we had in Cuba. Clean rooms with airconditioning, helpful staff, possibility of laundry and good location of the house.

reviews.title: Best Location and services
reviews.text: Nicely located, relatively comfortable, clean rooms with bathroom. Breakfast is good, typical for what you should expect in Cuba - eggs, fried according to your wish, bread, fruits, honey, coffee and fruit juices. The Family is very friendly and helpful. They will take care of you and make sure that your stay will be as comfortable as possible. The Don Carlos Rooms are nice. A wonderful place to stay. Carlos speaks excellent English and is very helpful all time Just Take ask For the most famous beer in Cuba Cristal and my buddy Carlos all time has some of them ready for you the first two free Lol......is not bad Stayed July 2014, traveled with friends

reviews.title: Great Casa
reviews.text: We stayed with Carlos and family in December 2013 for two nights. We were made very welcome, provided with lots of information about the city (and help with arranging a tour) and spoiled with loads of amazing food. The breakfasts were the best we had in Cuba - a massive spread of delicious local food. The location is fantastic. Heredia is one of the most interesting streets in the city with lots going on (we saw a 50 piece band playing!). But Don Carlos' is located 5 minutes walk from the centre (and the busy part of Heredia) so had the advantage of being really close to all the sights, while being quiet at night. Our room had two beds, air con and an en suite bathroom with shower. It was spotlessly clean. Carlos arranged transport for us from Guardalavaca which was also excellent. We would definitely go back and I can't recommend this Casa highly enough. If you stay with Carlos I would recommend having at least one dinner at the Casa as the food was top notch.

reviews.title: Great casa in the heart of the city
reviews.text: I chose Casa Don Carlos for the location and was not disappointed. A few hundred meters from the centre on a quiet street . Carlos arranged for an airport pick up and was quick to find us a driver for any of our tours. The beds were comfortable and the water was hot. The rooftop patio is great place to enjoy morning coffee and breakfast or to catch an evening breeze and enjoy a cold drink that Carlos always has on hand . Both Carlos and his beautiful wife speak excellent english and are very nice hosts, and their kids are the cutest . I have stayed at many private casas in Cuba and this is the best. Santiago has much to offer and is a great treasure to anyone wanting to see the less travelled Cuba.

reviews.title: A very helpful host in great surroundings
reviews.text: We (group of 4) stayed here at the end of June 2016 for 1 night. Carlos, the owner, was extremely helpful, accommodating and gave useful advice about where to visit. Rooms were fairly standard for Cuba (+nice bathroom) and breakfast was good. Close to all the sites to visit in Santiago.

reviews.title: Casa Don Carlos residence
reviews.text: I stayed at Casa don Carlos for 6 weeks during the summer of 2012 and I couldn't have hoped for a better experience. The ease of booking with them, communicating and finding them was outstanding. The clients speak perfect English and French which made my time their far more enjoyable. Moreover as a 4th year medical Student the medical background of the grandfather and the mother made living with them very interesting. I thoroughly appreciated the meals they provided, top quality breakfast, midday snack and dinner, with a great variety of Cuban dishes for a fraction of the price you would find elsewhere in Cuba, especially in restaurants. The interior decor was lovely and local, very spacious with areas to sit out in the sun. The location also was great, close enough to town to see all the sights (the Bacardi museums, Heredria house) but also to the hospital and a Hotel for swimming. Even the airport was close making travelling very easy and the family gave a good price for expenses. The family were more than willing to facilitate all aspects of our stay including travel (in my case to and from the hospital and for leisure trips), laundry, Internet, and other entertainments (such as Ice cream!!). And they involved me in their family gatherings, the local festivals and other trips. An unbelievable generous and welcoming family, I would recommend anyone to stay with them if you thinking of going to Cuba!

reviews.title: Superb Casa with Muli-Lingual hosts
reviews.text: Don Carlos is an exuberant host who enjoys speaking many languages and who attempts to deliver a high standard of accommodation and service which is hard to maintain in Cuba. He succeeds but he works much too hard. His wife, Isabel, is a doctor who has taken time from work to bring up their baby and can also speak fluent English. They are superb hosts. The casa attracts an interesting range of guests who we met over breakfast. The rooms have bathrooms "en suite" and everything works. There are also air con and fans which were scarcely needed at the beginning of February. A good breakfast with juice, fruit, eggs, ham, cheese, honey coffee or tea @ 4 CUC is served on the roof terrace. As promised, there was a driver with a fine old car waiting to pick us up at the airport @ 12 CUC. Isabel's mother provides a laundry service and also sewed a tear in one of my shirts. When, at short notice, we wanted a car to take us to La Gran Piedra Don Carlos was able to arrange a car within 30 minutes. The cost was 60 CUC within the range which guide books lead us to expect but the quality of the car and the driver, who spoke some English, was far higher than we would have expected - it was excellent value. The Casa is 2 minutes walk from Plaza de Dolores and 4 minutes from Plaza de Marte which has Wifi. A few minutes in the other direction is Parque Cespedes. It is at a perfect location. I have some knee problems from arthritis and I thought the short steep hill from Parque Cespedes might give me problems but on the hill is a massage centre. For 7 CUC I had a massage for my left leg and knee which was giving me problems and for my right leg too. I was sceptical about what was being done to me but when I left the shop and started up with hill I was so impressed with the benefit that I immediately returned to get some treatment for my neck and shoulders. Isabel was able to arrange for a physio to visit me at the Casa the next day which further eased my leg problems. I had high expectations for Santiago which were exceeded by the reality. I cannot recommend the Casa Don Carlos strongly enough. Enjoy!

reviews.title: Great hosts, great location
reviews.text: Carlos and his family are the best thing about this casa, and they were great hosts. It was very helpful to be able to talk with Cubans with such good English, as our Spanish was rudimentary. They were very sociable which made eating in good fun. Our room gave onto the communal courtyard [others onto the living areas] as they do in all these older town houses, but it makes these rooms a touch gloomy and if other guests are noisy, then it can be hard to sleep. The roof terrace and courtyard are very inviting. The view is splendid. I went up the spiral stairs with caution, with my artificial knees, until Grandmother insisted that I use the stairs through her apartment, which was lovely of her. Carlos was very helpful in what we might do in Santiago and can arrange transport etc.

reviews.title: Family house in Down town santiago
reviews.text: We drove from Santiago to this house to do a gentle trek in to the mountains ,Casa Don Carlos was a great place to stay in Santiago. We recently stayed 3 nights with carlos and His family and it was excellent. The casa is in a great location, close to the main square, we stayed in the top room which was huge, clean and had a nice view form top terraces to chill out on after a hard days sightseeing. The food was brilliant - interesting sauces, amazing banana chips and even homemade desserts. Nivia was excellent in making us feel welcome and highly recommend her case. This place was recommned by our friend Oney and Katy . thanks Carlos Thanks for the two free small bottles of water.

reviews.title: one of the best casas in all Cuba
reviews.text: We've been travelling in Cuba for almost one month and visited many different casas. And this one, oh God, was superb. The main advantage of the casa is its host - senor Carlos. Always open-hearted, wih smile on his face, he makes every efforts to turn your stay to the perfect and careless holiday. It is very important - at this casa you can speak with the host not only Spanish, but also English. One more advantage of the casa - food. Here you can eat not only eggs for breakfast (you know, for us it was a great problem to ask something else at other casas, because many hosts can offer you eggs or nothing instead of it). The biggest lobsters we've ever eaten in Cuba were at Don Carlos casa (and the tastiest). Here we also had a chance to try the local beer =) There are many other reasons to stay at this casa - convenient location, always hot water, air conditioning etc. We highly recommend this casa to stay. If you stay here you'll never regret.

reviews.title: Excellent house!
reviews.text: We stayed at the house of Don Carlos in January 2017 and had a good experience! Carlos is a very helpful and nice person! His wife is also very kind. The house has a beautiful terrace where it is possible to eat a great breakfast. The location is perfect, extremely central. It's possible to do everything on foot. On my birthday, Carlos made me a beautiful surprise and presented me with flowers and a delicious cake!

reviews.title: Great casa with an extremely helpful host
reviews.text: Very central location - just a few blocks to the main square. Nice and very clean rooms - breakfast is served on a large roof terrace. Carlos is very knowledgable about Santiago and is happy to share his knowledge. He was extremely helpful when we had forgotten a camera in a casa in Cienfuegos. He went there, picked it up and had it sent to us. Thank you so much - we would go back any time.

reviews.title: Pleasant stay and nice to be able to speak English
reviews.text: We had a good time at Carlos' place and learned a lot about Cuba, since Carlos and his wife speak English (and French, too!). During the night the place was quiet, quite exceptional for it's central location. Breakfast can also be served at 5:45, just in time to catch the morning flight to Havana. Much appreciated, thank you Carlos!

reviews.title: Carlos the star!
reviews.text: My stay in Casa "Don Carlos" was memorable enough for me to want to write this review first! I was first welcomed to the city by an eager Carlos at the bus station, and even pointed out the important sights en route to the casa while in the taxi. He and his lovely wife Isabella speaks perfect English and it was such a relief on my rather-overworked brain to not to have think and translate into Spanish for 3 days. :-) The room was perfectly adequate with air conditioning, a private-ish clean bathroom with hot water (quite unnecessary in the hottest city in Cuba by the way) and a small TV which does not really work (just white noise but it's OK as i won't be able to understand much anyway!). The beds and pillows were actually the most comfortable of all the casas i've stayed in Cuba. Thankfully, no lumpy pillows at Casa Don Carlos, which are unfortunately, all too common! Then again, this is Cuba, so one shouldn't expect the same as one would of a 5-star hotel, as this is a private Cuban home, and lovingly furnished, if spartan. However, the highlight of the stay was the wonderful company the hospitable couple provided, and gave us a valuable insight into the Cuban's everyday life, and the food! The service is definitely 5*. A very fantastic local experience no impersonal hotel will be able to offer. You'll be sure to be very well-fed (maybe too well?!) as I often struggle to finish the gargantuan portions! Carlos will always encourage you to save room for helado (ice-cream) so be sure to! He's generously offered complimentary use of his dial-up internet but never got to use it. His house has a small roof terrace which is perfect for a cuba libre or mojito in the cooler evenings! Even though my departure was in the evening, for an overnight bus to Trinidad, Carlos allowed me the use of his room and bathroom for freshening up before leaving! The location is also fantastic, on the main Heredia, but blissfully away from the touts, and just a block away from Plaza Dolores. A taxi each-way from the bus station costs 5 CUC. I would go back to Santiago de Cuba just to stay with Carlos and family again.

reviews.title: Excellent care in Casa Don Carlos
reviews.text: Among other 6 casas we stayed in Cuba, this was the best. This is not superb colonial house, but excellency is by Carlos approach. His English is very good, he is really helpful to organize everything and give you advices about places of interest even in advance by email. Room was clean, nice, spacy, with attached bathroom, and quite quiet for good sleep if you count that you are directly on Heredia which is busiest party street in the night. Carlos prepared best breakfast we had in Cuba. Overnight car parking was possible on Plaza Dolores 100m away.

reviews.title: Carlos is the best!
reviews.text: A wonderful place to stay. Carlos speaks excellent English and is very helpful. The food is very good and the casa is centrally located. The only thing - I wouldn't pick the single bed in the first room, the springs there are really hard to sleep on. I would also bring my own towels as the ones there are not the best at soaking water... Other than that - don't think twice - go for it! Carlos took us from the airport at midnight and prepared a wonderful meal. We have only good things to say about him.

reviews.title: Friendly peoples
reviews.text: We had two fantastic stays at the Casa Don Carlos Everything was fine starting with the friendlyness, the support with transfers to and from the airport at really weird times (pick-up at 4 am), the service, the cleanliness, the food, the drinks and the location in the city center of santiago de cuba Last but not least we were surprised by a beautiful decorated room because of our engagement. Thank you very much carlos and His wife and dauther for three fantastic nights in your house!!! Lisa and Andi Only thing like tip Breafast need more,salchichas any jamon en lascas ,other thing was great Thanks

reviews.title: Fantastic casa - one of the best (!)
reviews.text: We have been in cuba for 5 weeks, but "Don Carlos" was the first place that we slept in Cuba, because we have started our trip in Santiago de Cuba (for the festival). Carlos is a very warm and friendly person, speaks fluent english, also very "tourism oriented" - he has a laptop, internet connection and of course an email account (most of the cubans did not have), so we managed to get in contact with him and coordinate this stay + pickup before the trip. . He came to pick us from the bus station with his car, as part of the service with no extra cost. His "casa" in nice, clean and the food they made us for dinner was delicious (!) It was a really good start for a great Canadian experience.

reviews.title: A Wonderful Experience
reviews.text: Isabel, Carlos and even their little daughter Marte couldn't have made this American feel more welcome and at ease on his 1st trip to this exciting city. Recommend Casa Don Carlos for anyone looking for ease (including English!), convenience (very well located) and affordability!

reviews.title: Fantastic location
reviews.text: Thank you Isabel and Carlos for looking after us when we stayed with you. The casa is in an ideal location and we felt very safe knowing that we only had a short walk from the central tourist spots. Having such great English was an enormous help also and we were very glad of your help and advice as regards taxis and places to go. Thank you for helping to make this a memorable holiday.

reviews.title: Carlos rocks!
reviews.text: I spent several days at Casa Don Carlos in July 2013, backpacking through Cuba with a friend of mine. I can just say that Carlos is a great host, always there to help you. He arranged a private ride for us back up north because all the buses were booked because of the local festival. And even if he doesn't have a free room for you in his house, he can find you another casa particular where you can stay. So, on the way back from Baracoa he arranged for us to stay in a very nice casa in a very upscale part of Santiago (the owner was a former doctor). Carlos is also an amazing cook, oh, and most importantly, his English is EXCELLENT! I'd say Carlo's phone number is a must if you're staying in Santiago because he can practically arrange anything for you!

reviews.title: The most and best House in santiago de cuba
reviews.text: We stayed at casa Don Carlos during our trip to Cuba 2014 The casa is in excellent condition, the furniture all looks antique & is very tasteful. We walked in through the front door for the first time We can feel like part of the family The room we had couldn't be described as spacious but it was cheaper than the others and we really didn't need more space as we spent so little time in there. More importantly it was clean, with air conditioning and a stocked fridge. You're able to have your laundry done there if needed. The house has a roof terrace that offers some interesting views of the rooftops of Santiago and is a great place to enjoy a few beers/rum while deciding what to do for the evening. We had breakfast there every morning, there was plenty of it and it was very nice, typical of a breakfast you come to expect in a casa. Carlos and His Wife are always on hand if you need anything.this is a reliable person don't forget to ask for the two free welcome beer .Lol..... Super nice guy I recommend this house if do you have small Kids this the right place to be . Thanks again carlos for sending me the papers by regular mail at you own expense ..

reviews.title: A great place to stay
reviews.text: We stayed at casa "Don Carlos" for 3 nights and had a very pleasant stay. After arriving to Viazul station, a friend of Carlos` picked us up even though it was 7 am and took us to the casa. Carlos was very helpful in telling us where to go and what to see. Also, he prepared very good breakfast every morning for a very good price. In addition, Carlos organized taxi rides for us to visit different beaches close to Santiago and always had a good advice for us. His wife is also very nice and helpful. After a night at the beach I had some thorns stuck in my foot and she got them out, almost painless :) We were amazed when she told us that she is a doctor with two specializations having in mind that she is very young. The atmosphere in the house is very relaxed, and although you are sharing the house with other members of the family, you still have your privacy. We really had an amazing time there and if we were to come back, we will definitely stay at his place again :)

reviews.title: A pearl in the middle of the city
reviews.text: The room was large and clean and the Casa comes with an amazing roofterrace which has been beautifully arranged by Carlos and his Family. Carlos really made our stay in Santiago worthwile by supporting activities, making awesome mojitos and generally being extremely friendly, he even surprised my girlfriend with a birthday cake! If we ever go back to Santiago we will be sure to book with Carlos again

reviews.title: Stay with Carlos and his nice family!
reviews.text: After 3-week round trip in Cuba and 8 casas, I must say, Carlos was one of the best hosts to stay with! He is very helpful and one can finally ask all the questions about Cuba in ENGLISH! It is indeed a very relaxing atmosphere at his house among his family (he and his wife Isabel both are well-educated and very easy to communicate with). Carlos came to the airport to pick us up, when the taxi failed him. 2 times actually - our flight from Havana had a 2h delay. He gave us a lot of useful information and let us leave the luggage after our short stay in Siboney before taking a night bus to Trinidad. The room is spacious, with a private bathroom. The breakfasts are big and tasty. We liked the location a lot - very close to the main square and all the life : ) Thank you Carlos&Family!

reviews.title: Best casa in Santiago!
reviews.text: Booking with Carlos is probably anyone's best bet when staying in Santiago! Do not get discouraged by any negative reviews! We spent couple of nights at Casa Don Carlos when travelling around Cuba and Carlos was by far the most helpful host we've met! We arrived very late at night and there was no problem for him to cook dinner for us at midnight (and even fetch water from somewhere in town at that time!). Don Carlos casa is probably in the best location in Santiago, in a very famous and entertaining Heredia Street, city centre location! We've had there most amazing food (like merlin) and breakfasts were great as well! Carlos speaks excellent English, which may be quite unusual among casa owners, but is extremely helpful, particularly when trying to teach a bunch of tourists how to play domino properly! He explained us domino rules and played with us one evening which was great fun! Carlos was also trying to help us arrange transport to our next destination after it'd turned out the buses were full! Our stay in Santiago was extremely memorable and this was to a big extend thanks to hospitality of Carlos and Isabel!

reviews.title: My staying in Casa "Don Carlos"
reviews.text: This winter I had a trip to Cuba, I stayed at many places and tried different casas. And the most comortable and friendly was Casa "Don Carlos". Wonderful location, nice and cosy apartments, made my journey and exploring Santiago de Cuba unforgettable! Carlos - the owner - the Man and good friend. Always opened to conversation if you want to speak Spanish or English or even French!! If you don't know where to go or where to stay at the next point of your travel around the Cuba - no problem, ask Carlos! So if you are planing a trip to Santago de Cuba (this is awesome place, by the way!!) do not hesitate to stay at "Don Carlos" Enjoy your trip, Pavel from Russia!

reviews.title: Safe and comfortable with great hosts!
reviews.text: Don Carlos picked me up from the airport, (twice really, since my flight was delayed 12 hours and I had no way to let me know). Perfect location, delicious food, super comfortable and kind hosts. Made me feel right at home!

reviews.title: Uncomfortable and unprofessional
reviews.text: We stayed at Don Carlos casa for 2 nights, and found the casa to be a poor choice in Santiago de Cuba. Negatives: 1. Don Carlos offered to do washing for us for a price. We gave him a bag then 2 hours later it was folded and back in our room. We couldn't understand how it could be washed and dried so quickly, and it didn't smell clean. We had to re-wash it later. 2. Don Carlos initially offered us use of the internet, however when we asked if we could email our casa in Trinidad to reconfirm our booking, he insisted on writing the email himself when we were not around. Later he said that the casa had called for us and put us on the phone with someone who gave us a message that due to some vague "plumbing problems" we would have to stay at an alternative casa. Not convinced we contacted the original Trinidad casa directly, who informed us that this was not them calling us, and that there were no plumbing problems, and our booking was fine. 3. Don Carlos offered to buy us a bus ticket, but returned saying that there were none available for the day we wanted. The next day we went to the bus station and were able to buy tickets in about 5 minutes. 4. We found the mattress to be particularly uncomfortable. 5. The bathroom was dirty. 6. The windows had no glass, and opened to the common area, so the room was noisy throughout the day. Positives: Don Carlos wife is very friendly, and the casa could be a good place to stay if it were run more professionally.

reviews.title: Highly recommended
reviews.text: Nice home, very convenient location. An interesting, English speaking host who could not be more helpful. Isabel and Carlos make you feel right at home. They helped us find good restaurants and great music. We will be returning again this fall.

reviews.title: ok but i expected more
reviews.text: Good location. Near to the centre but the room was to close to the kitchen and in the two days i've spent there, i've been woke up respectively at 7.30AM and 8.30AM. Anyhow Carlos is a friendly person tough. Ready to help you in any circumstances giving you advices about location and so on..

reviews.title: Great casa and great family
reviews.text: We spent 2 nights in the Casa Don Carlos in August 2014. The casa is centrally located so that we could walk everywhere. Carlos speaks perfectly English and is very friendly and helpful. He picked us up from the Viazul bus station and on the day of our departure, as we didn´t have any time for breakfast, Carlos prepared us coffee and packed some sandwiches for free. His wife is an amazing cook. We would stay here again.

reviews.title: In the casa particular with 4 guest rooms of Carlos and his wife Isabel
reviews.text: "We felt very much at home during two weeks, March 2015. Spoiled with delicious meals; daily fresh-cut fruit and smoothies, eggs as you wish, bread, cheese and meats, we could ask Carlos what we wanted even more, yogurt for example, he immediately went shopping! A very sweet old lady cooked every evening fish, meat and vegetarian meals. As you can expect downtown it is a bit noisy, even indoors.. cars that pass by, the bell of the fruit vendor in the street, television, salsa music, rattling pots and pans from the kitchen, talking housemates in the living room, you get used to it! The casa has a nice and sunny patio where you can sit, talk or read. A lovely place. Already missing it! The casa is situated in the centre of Santiago, which means you are in the middle of where it all happens: Parque Cespedes and Casa de la Trova are only a two minutes-walk, so are the nice shops, hotel Casa Grande and lots of other facilities that have attracted you to come to Santiago de Cuba. Carlos turned out to be a nice and service minded host: he was flexible and always willing to adapt dinnertime to our wishes, even in the last minute. If we needed something he was doing his utmost to accomplish our wish. So Carlos en all your staff: Thank you!!

reviews.title: Satiago de Cuba, muy caliente
reviews.text: First of all, if you are traveling around Cuba, you must visit Santiago de Cuba. It is second largest city, after Habana, and it is the city of high importance. Castro proclaimed the victory of the Cuban Revolution from a balcony on Santiago de Cuba's city hall which is located in a very nice square in the city center. Nearby, there is also Balcony of Diego Velázquez, Spanish conquistador who founded Santiago de Cuba. To continue, staying with Don Carlos and his family is a must. The owners Carlos and Isabel are very nice people. Always helpful with tips and recommendations. Carlos also helped us find the taxi to drive us to different beaches, Castillo del Morro, and the last day, he even offered to take us to the Viazul, the bus station, himself. As for the accommodation, the house is situated in Heredia Street, which is one of the main streets in Santiago. The most lively street in Santiago, situated in the center of the city and just 2 min away from all the attractions. This is the place where street music never stops. The house is very spacious and it has 4 rooms for rent, which is great for bigger groups, as we were. (5 of us in total). Rooms are comfortable, although our bathroom was pretty small, the most important thing is that it was super clean. The house offers big outdoor area were we could relax and hang out all together in the evenings. Also, there is a beautiful roof top, perfect for having your first coffee in the morning. I highly recommend having a breakfast in Casa de don Carlos. It is perfect and it brings you back to life after crazy party nights in Santiago. People here are amazing, very cheerful, ongoing and friendly like in no other city of Cuba. All in all, I highly recommend Casa De Carlos during your stay in Santiago.

reviews.title: Everytime again
reviews.text: We have stayed at Don Carlos for three times and we always feel at home there...wonderful roof terrace, good cooking, working showers... and not to forget the friendly and helpful family !! We come back ...for sure!

reviews.title: Second home :)
reviews.text: I stayed in place of Carlos twice, in 2011 and in 2013. It's just great! You feel like at home and you are treated like a family member. Breakfasts are gorgeous, also transfer to any place around Santiago can be arranged at market price on even cheaper. Location is right in the center, everything is close (Casa de la Trova is one block away, Casa de la Musica is around 4 blocks away). Rooms are clean and well maintained, hot water 24.7бб laundry is provided. Thanks a lot to the owner for giving the great experience of the true Cuban hospitality.

reviews.title: Thanks Don Carlos for a lovely stay!
reviews.text: We really had a wonderful time at Carlos' place right in the center of Santiago. The room was clean, spacious and included an AC. Carlos himself speaks perfect (!!!) English and was extremely helpful in both sorting out our travel arrangements as well as explaining the Cuban way of life :-) The best feature of his Casa is the amazing roof top terrace, which was a great place to just hang out, take a break and enjoy the sun. Carlos even invited us to drop by 4 days later on our way back from Baracoa to Havana to spend our 5-6 hours stopover in Santiago on his roof top! Thanks so much for everything, Carlos! We will back soon! :-) Jonas & Christian

reviews.title: Amazing casa and hosts!!!
reviews.text: My friend, Patrick and myself were touring Santiago de Cuba in the spirit of Patrick's 70th birthday and stayed at Don Carlos for 3 days. Excellent casa. Very helpful that Carlos spoke several languages (my Spanish is limited, at best) and he was able to make recommendations throughout the town for restaurants, etc. The best part was the the rooftop patio where we spend every evening in the wee hours drinking Cuban rum and replaying the days events. Many thanks Carlos for opening your home to us!! Stephen (and Patrick)

reviews.title: Casa you cannot miss!
reviews.text: If you going to visit Santiago de Cuba you have to stay with Don Carlos. The host is the best, the most helpful and the funniest one off all. Most important speaks English which was a great asset for me, as my Spanish was just basics. I spent 2 nights there but wished I stayed more. Food they prepare was amazing (first time had Merlin and it was first class), also breakfasts were very good. The whole family of Carlos (Isabel and little Marta) were super kind and we had lots of laughter together. Carlos helped us finding out all information we needed to get to next destination, called our next casa for us and helped with arranging transport. The stay was the most entertaining of all- we learned how to play domino's proper rules, which started being much of interesting than just matching the dots! Our room was quite cozy, one bed was cool, the other a bit uneven - still sleep was very good and we had separate bathroom for us, which was clean and nice. House was quite cool, had stairs for roof top, which we did not have time to use due to rain, but looked amazing and would definitely be an asset during sunny day.
