Anyway house has plenty of space in the leaving room- which is big and has plenty of chairs to rest, sofas and dining part for lovely meals. Go and stay with Casa don Carlos! you won't regret it

reviews.title: Super friendly, but not too comfy
reviews.text: After we discovered that another casa that had been recommended to us was underwhelming, my girlfriend and I checked Tripadvisor and went for a top-rated casa that turned out to be full, but nextdoor to Don Carlos. We stayed for two nights and paid a mere 20 CUC/night without breakfast. We can confirm that the casa is located perfectly for discovering Santiago als well as for exploring the Salsa/Son music scene and that Carlos is indeed an exceptionally friendly and helpful host. Our room featured 2 fairly large beds with decent mattrasses, a large fridge, a (really bad) TV, a fan and a wall-mounted AC unit. That unit is one of the two reasons that keeps me from giving full marks. It was loud as a jet engine and had no settings, just on/off. A better AC seems like asking (too) much for 20 bucks. However, if you have ever been to Santiago in June, you may agree that a functioning AC is essential and that not being able to let it run at night kinda defeats the whole purpose. That and the fact that we were a bit out of luck to have the room underneath the terrace, i.e. the one in which you fall out of bed every time somebody moves a chair on the (beautiful) terrace above, prohibits star number 5. If it were only about friendliness and hospitality, I'd actually give 6 stars.

reviews.title: Idyllic calm away from the crowds!! Five stars for an amazing host.
reviews.text: I chose this spot for our first couples getaway. When we arrived, our flight had been delayed, and we were very exhausted. Due to the lack of lighting in the area, and the fact Google Maps didn’t recognise the maze of streets and waterways, it was hard to find. We called the B&B, and a lovely woman answered the phone. Despite there being a slight language barrier, she came out to meet us where we described and she took us to the b&b. Without that intervention, we would have been lost outside for longer. She did mention that Google Maps doesn’t pick up their location, but it’s understandable considering Venice is a historic maze. Once settled, and the city tax was paid without any issue, she gave us a map with some key instructions on and where the best places would be in the area. She also helped us get a grasp of our keys, and the instructions for the b&b. The next day, after a lovely nights sleep in a very warm room (that we were very thankful for), we met Andrea in the breakfast room. We were the only people staying so we’re served by him with a delightful continental breakfast which we didn’t expect (even though it is a b&b, we had never experienced this kind of hospitality). He gladly made us coffee, and suggested wonderful restaurants that if we had the funds we would have gone to. However, his heart was in the right place. He told us about the history of the b&b, and how it used to be his family home where he grew up and it is charming and reflects that. The b&b is out of the way, but it is fun to get lost in the maze if you have time to spare. I would suggest utilising Andrea’s knowledge of the area as he had good tips for paying less for Gondala rides (€2 instead of €80) and how to get to certain parts of Venice. St. Marks Square is 13 minutes walk, and the Rialto Bridge that is centre to most of the tourist attention is around 15 minutes to 20 minutes walk. You WILL be thankful you’re staying away from that crowd, because you’ll soon tire of it and it’s lack of authenticity. You’ll crave the normal nature of the b&b and acting like you’re living there rather than on holiday. Go in early spring, it’s less busy and cooler. Take advantage of Italy’s excellent train service across the country. We went to Verona and thoroughly enjoyed it as a day out. Five stars!!

reviews.title: Living Like a Venetian
reviews.text: We were lucky enough to find Allo Squero through Trip Advisor and once again, we were not mislead. Allo Squero made our first trip to beautiful Venice one we will never forget. We found ourselves "outside" of the major tourist area (Rialto Bridge, St. Mark's, etc.) but very near (about 4 vaporetto stops) from all of the major attractions. We loved being in more of a "neighborhood" and were able to walk along the canal, window shop and just allow ourselves to feel like Venetians. Our Innkeeper, Andrea, and his wife, Mia, were charming and we thoroughly enjoyed meeting them and staying in their lovely B&B. We had a canal just outside our bedroom window and watched gondolas go by frequently. Needless to say, if we're ever lucky enough to return, we'll definitely return to Allo Squero.

reviews.title: Stay at the Garden B&B
reviews.text: Andrea our host was most helpful with our booking and how to find the B&B. He also advised us about prebooking some tours. Once we arrived he helped us with recommendations for places to eat and transport. However he spoilt our stay by being quite rude to our relatives who had entered the grounds of the B&B in order for us to then go out together. He was quite humiliating the way he told them to leave immediately saying something about not being allowed by the tourism authority to have extra people on his property. He did not explain the situation at all and we still do not understand his behaviour.

reviews.title: Very comfortable B&B in quiet location
reviews.text: A lovely B&B that was a pleasure to stay in. The room was quite large and the bathroom was spotless with excellent fittings. We also loved the comfortable bed. Breakfast in the garden was a lovely way to start the day. Our host was delightful, very welcoming and could speak a number of languages. The B&B was relatively easy to find with the excellent directions provided but you do need to look for the little sign near the door. It was an easy walk to all the major sights with a number of typical restaurants nearby, while still being in a very quiet location. We thoroughly enjoyed our 3 night stay and would highly recommend it.

reviews.title: Highly recommend!
reviews.text: Stayed here 2 nights in May and loved it! Andrea made us very welcome and, seeing our box of tea bags, he sorted out a kettle for our room. He also sorted out a firmer pillow for me which was much appreciated. Breakfast was so relaxing as served in the pretty garden. We had hoped to stay 3 nights but Allo Squero were full so we were directed to a local hotel at the end of the street. The hotel was good but we much preferred the B & B as it was so clean and comfortable. Can't wait to go back!

reviews.title: Allo Squero
reviews.text: We spent four nights at this lovely gem of a B&B in Venice. Andrea, our host, was great. He offered suggestions and directions. Breakfast was served, when the weather permitted, in his backyard garden. Our room had a canal view and a new bathroom. Everything was spotlessly clean. It was very quiet at night. Another reviewer said that it is hard to find. That would be true to say of anything in Venice if it is your first day there. Andrea gave us directions from the "Ca d'Oro" vaporetto stop that worked perfectly. We found the location was convenient and an added plus is that it is also a short walk to the boat that goes to Murano and Burano which leave from the north lagoon side of Venice Island. I look forward to my next trip and will certainly stay at Andrea's place again.

reviews.title: Pleasant location away from the crowds.
reviews.text: This is an old family home that is in the process of being tastefully renovated. We liked the location because we could walk easily to both the major sights and also the less-frequented parts of the island. Our bedroom windows opened onto a side canal and it was nice to have the garden with cat even though it was a little cool to eat outside. Our host was helpful and the breakfasts were good. We were a bit put off by the crowded carnival atmosphere of Venice near all of the famous sights - if we come again we will stay far away from St. Mark's and the grand canal and enjoy the beauties of the quieter areas and outlying islands, or else come in the off season.

reviews.title: Quite a find!
reviews.text: Very conveniently located, at a walking distance of major attractions but yet in a quiet area of the Cannareggio sestiere. Very good restaurants a few minutes away. A very helpful owner suggested wonderful places to eat close by, attractions, transport, etc. Would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Lovely little B & B in the heart of Venice
reviews.text: We stayed in this B&B for a long weekend in Venice and it was perfect for us in every way. The location is superb within a short work of the Rialto bridge but just out the way of the tourist hub so it feels quiet and secluded. The rooms are decorated very nicely and the window looks straight out onto the canal which is a great feature. You can lie in bed at night and listen to the Venetians along the canals - perfect! The breakfast is good and is served in the garden which was the old shipping yard - really adds to the character. We loved the time we spent there and would definitely recommend it to anyone visiting Venice.

reviews.title: Quiet location with pleasant rooms
reviews.text: Allo Squero is a very pleasant B&B in the Cannaregio district near San Marco. The location is tucked away from busy streets and is nice and quite, located on a small canal. It can be a little hard to find (as are most places in Venice), but Andreas gives very helpful directions, and the location is only a short walk to San Marco or the Grand Canal. Andreas greeted us with a glass of local wine upon arrival! The rooms are new and modern, the accommodations are quite nice. The bathrooms are new and clean and have a nice full tub for a warm soak. Breakfast is tasty and simple, with yogurt, fruit, and fresh bread with jams. Andreas also makes fresh cappuccino for each guest. The B&B is also located near some very good local dining options away from the overpriced tourist places of San Marco. Andreas provided a few suggestions for local Venetian tapas bars, which offered excellent food and wine at affordable prices. Overall, Allo Squero is a great location stay in Venice for easy access to the sights and a quiet neighborhood feel.

reviews.title: Oasis in Venice
reviews.text: My expectations were high for Allo Squero because it's owner Andreas had been extremely helpful during the booking process. He answered all my questions and provided invaluable advice about transport from the airport. Not disappointed! You are welcomed into a lovely wisteria-filled garden and shown to bright, spacious and well-appointed rooms and modern bathrooms. Allo Squero offers three rooms, two ensuite. The third uses bathroom down a short hallway. We were a group of five and had Allo Squero to ourselves. The location in the cosy neighborhood of Cannaregio is convenient to the sights, restaurants and shopping. Breakfast is more than adequate with coffee, tea, juice, fruit, bread, cheese. Charming breakfast room. We stayed in mid April, which was chilly in morning. In warmer weather, breakfasting in garden would be delightful. Andreas also offered laundry service for a very reasonable cost. He provided recommendations for eating and sightseeing. Definitely shortlist Allo Squero.

reviews.title: Lovely little place in the heart of Venice
reviews.text: Andrea was very friendly and an excellent host. He prepared breakfast every morning which we had in the garden. There are plenty of shops around the area, Andrea will give you great recommendations for places to eat as well. We would recommended the place 100% and would always go back!

reviews.title: A little piece of heaven
reviews.text: Situated in quiet neighborhood, this b&b is a quiet spot to rest after exploring the hustle and bustle of Venice. Clean, wonderful breakfast, beautiful garden, prompt and efficient service. A true gem.

reviews.title: Comfortable
reviews.text: This is a lovely B&B in a quiet area of Venice but just a short walk from the square at St Apostoli church. Considering the age of the buildings in Venice,we had a surprisingly modern room with an en-suite bathroom. The room was a good size with a view over the canal ( I was thrilled when a gondola floated by outside our window). The bed was really comfortable and there was plenty of wardrobe space. The bathroom had modern fittings and shower ( no bath) and toiletries were supplied. On good days breakfast was served in the garden consisting of yogurt, fruit and toast with jam. Unfortunately we had some rain so had to have breakfast inside one morning. It was lovely to sit in the garden after a hard days sightseeing. Although there were no tea or coffee making facilities you could put food and cold drinks in the fridge in the kitchen. The owner and his wife were very welcoming and gave great directions and recommendations for restaurants nearby. We felt very secure during our stay as there is a main door from the street into the property, a locked garden gate and then the door into the B&B itself ( also locked). Free WiFi is always a plus. We would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Faulty Towers
reviews.text: Myself and my wife have always used TripAdvisor weather it be booking a restaurant a hotel or researching a holiday and it has never been far wrong. We booked this accommodation based solely on other travelers experiences ... on this occasion how wrong were we. Our flight unfortunately was delayed for nearly two hours so this meant we didn’t arrive in Venice til after 10pm . The owner said to give him a call if we were having any difficulty in finding the place he didn’t answer when we needed him instead it was his daughter who didn’t speak any English so couldn’t assist us. Eventually after wondering around for all most 2 hours we found the place, good luck to those of you who have difficulty in reading maps it’s in the back alleys of beyond. Upon arrival we were greeted by a young Asian Lady who didn’t speak very good English at all , anything we would ask her regarding the property she would refer to a map of Venice, however she did know how to ask for €18 tax that we owed I explained that we hadn’t had a chance to withdraw any cash, we just wanted to have a good nights sleep after a long day traveling. The next morning we woke and were excited to explore Venice my wife tried to turn on the lights but they wouldn’t work so we got dressed and went up for breakfast to be told by the Asian lady there was no electric she shrugged her shoulders then asked us AGAIN could we pay our bloody visitors tax no explanation what so ever as to why there was no electric, we couldn’t shower and we couldn’t charge our phones no WiFi , we had planned to meet friends for lunch I felt horrible all day you are quite far from the Venice attractions here so you couldn’t nt just pop back and fourth. Breakfast consisted of lukewarm coffee orange juice and bread in a basket, you had this around a small table thank goodness the other guests had been and gone already as 6 people around one table would have been very cramped. We arrived back to the accommodation quite late at night you have to go through a door then a gate then another door the place was in darkness it was so hard to get the key in the door never mind see where we were going. Next morning we met the owner he didn’t ask how our trip was going nor how we were getting on , did we need anything ... no just for the €18 travel tax I wasn’t going to flee the country with 18€ for goodness sake, this really annoyed us ..what about an apology for not been able to wash etc etc We skipped breakfast for the rest of the trip and didn’t spend a lot of time in the property after that just to sleep. The bed was comfy and the place was warm that’s about all good I have to say. There are 100s of hotels in Venice I’d say it would definitely be worth paying a little extra to ensure you have electric can shower and charge your phones. This place put a dampener on our trip to Venice, the area is also very very quiet and hard to find, think twice folks.

reviews.title: Quiet and comfortable
reviews.text: Allo Squero is located in a quiet, non-touristy neighborhood. It was fun to stay in an area that had of a more authentic neighborhood feel. At first, we were worried about how safe it would to walk around at night with how tucked away it is, but we ended up feeling more than safe. And, as for the actually B&B, there were three secure doors you had to go through to get in side. Very safe. The rooms were bare bones, but definitely met our needs (especially for the price we paid). The bathrooms were amazing - the largest ones we saw during our entire 11 day trip all over Italy. Andrea and his wife were very welcoming and gave us great ideas for "local" places to eat. The location was also within walking distance to several "main sites".

reviews.title: Hospitality 5-star
reviews.text: Andrea and Hiroko are really nice and hospitable people. They picked us up by boat at the train station (for a fee that was well worth it). I wouldn't say that the B&B in particular is hard to find, in fact, everything is hard to find in Venice. We got lost many times in the 2 days. The B&B is clean, simple, the room at the canal was not very quiet but it was worth it just to experience the canal right outside your window and a gondola floating by. The wifi signal was strong and good. Andrea even helped me print out my train tickets. And he helped us to the vaporetto stop when we left, which I am so grateful for.

reviews.title: This place made us fall a little bit more in love with Venice. Genuine and caring hosts will make your stay personal.
reviews.text: Andrea & Hiroko are wonderful hosts, their charming B&B is well located off the touristic track but still close to everything you want to see. Surrounded by some excellent restaurants that they are happy to make reservations at - go to Trattoria de Bepi... awesome seafood. Breakfast is served in the homely garden - fresh fruit, yogurt, breads, tea/coffee. Andrea organised a Gondola to pick us up from the garden one afternoon - a perfect personalised experience away from the touting tourist traps. The rooms are clean, spacious, and simply decorated, the bathrooms are recently renovated and great. Highly recommended for a homely option with genuine and caring hosts. We will be back. Thank you!

reviews.title: Charming B&B with incredibly friendly service
reviews.text: My husband and I booked this hotel for New Year's Eve 2013 on hostelworld and it looked like the best option for our budget that still had an opening, but we weren't expecting much. We were very pleasantly surprised to find the place was charming (only 3 rooms total, plus a cute garden), in a good location (very central to Rialto Bridge and San Marco, yet far enough away from the main roads that it was a peaceful escape from the tourist crowds), and the service was excellent and friendly. Our train was a little late getting in but the host, Fabio, stayed to meet us, and when we ended up getting a little lost (Venice side streets are quite complicated) and called the office line, he ran out to meet us in the main square nearby which was very helpful. They make free breakfast every morning for the guests of the 3 rooms, and Fabio even made it to the B&B early on the morning of New Year's Day just to cook us breakfast, after getting very little sleep the night before because his own NYE celebrations and the commute back to the main island! That's what I call great service.

reviews.title: A lovely, friendly, well situated bed and breakfast.
reviews.text: Excellent B and B in a quiet neighbourhood, but not far from the Rialto and handy for the fondamente nove water bus stop. Lovely garden where breakfast is served when its warm!

reviews.title: The BEST place to stay in Venice!
reviews.text: The best B&B i've been to! Great value for price! SUPER clean, GREAT hosts, GREAT location, GREAT rooms, and VERY modern. i would strongly recommend it to anyone visiting Venice.

reviews.title: comfortable & clean!
reviews.text: The owner is very polite and helpful. His wife speaks Japanese so it can be a plus for Japanese travelers. It was fun to watch the gondola guys passing by from the room with canal view. Located in the quiet residential area but not far from attractions. Also, there is a grocery store nearby. Landry is available upon request.

reviews.title: Great Find
reviews.text: This B&B is wonderful - was a bit sceptical after viewing it on Google street view, but its in a lovely, safe and quiet spot in the residential area of Venice. Andrea is very helpful, really welcoming and shows you where all the best spots to eat are (everything we ate was really tasty and really reasonably priced). Breakfast is typically Italian - simple, with amazing coffee and we were even treated to fresh figs from the tree in the garden one morning. The garden really is a great spot for breakfast, calm and peaceful and you can watch the birds flying overhead. The rooms are simple and clean, beds were very comfy and the bathrooms are pretty amazing. Location is great, about a five minute walk from the Rialto bridge, but very quiet and away from the crowds and within easy walking distance from the Fondamenta Nova Alilaguna stop from the airport. Also about 15 minutes walk from the train station. Will definitley go back.

reviews.title: Great location, great experience.
reviews.text: Pros: Great location for airport water taxi. Quiet and good size room. Breakfast was really good. Fresh fruit, good toast and jam, and coffee and juice. Felt like an oasis in the middle of a city. Cons: Wasn't really a con but we had the room that has its own bathroom but it is down the hall. We didn't mind and we were aware upon booking.

reviews.title: A secret garden
reviews.text: Wonderful! What more can one say? Tucked away in an unprepossessing back street on the corner of two canals, this is one of the great places to stay. The hosts are welcoming and friendly with great advice on where to eat, the room was spacious and overlooked the canal, the en suite glistened, and breakfast was the perfect start to each day. The location cannot be bettered as you are away from the tourist hordes but within easy walking distance of the main attractions, whilst many local back-streets invite exploration. There are many restaurants within 3 minutes walk, and a good pizzeria. The garden is a bonus, an oasis of quiet and calm and a good place to retreat and relax after a day of pavement-pounding. One of the joys of Venice is walking in the areas where people live and Cannareggio offers lots of possibilities. We look forward to returning to Venice and will not even think of staying anywhere other than Allo Squero.

reviews.title: Lovely room, but hard to find
reviews.text: We stayed here for two nights in October. It was in a nice neighborhood a little off the beaten path, but still within walking distance of the Rialto and other sights. Only downside was it was nearly impossible to find! Don't try google maps to find this place...you will get lost! Make sure you contact the b&b directly for some better directions before you get to a venice. But once you get there it is a lovely room, and a friendly staff.

reviews.title: Family weekend in Venice
reviews.text: We flew into Venice on the way to the Dolomites and spent 2 nights at Allo Squero. We rode the Blue Line from the airport and then had a 10 minute walk to the B&B. It was not at all hard to find - just difficult to tell that you have found it. (minimal signage see photos). Easy return to the airport. The small garden was relaxing. The location was a short walk to San Marco and the Grand Canal but was in residential Venice without tourist activity. The rooms were clean and quiet - with some gondola traffic early in the evening. We will not look for a different place to stay in Venice.

reviews.title: Cute place in a quiet neighborhood
reviews.text: We were very happy to find this lovely b&b in a quiet part of Cannaregio. Andre, the owner, was very helpful and friendly, and served a very nice breakfast. The main drag is only a minute away, and San Marco and the train station just another 15-20 minutes. There are a few nice little restaurants tucked away in the neighborhood, which Andre pointed us to. We had a lovely stay, and I imagine you will as well!

reviews.title: Great Location and Value, and a Charming Host
reviews.text: Allo Squero can be challenging to find/get to, but then most places in Venice are, and this place is definitely worth the effort. My GPS was very helpful in getting us to the right location. Our room looked out onto the canal and it was very enjoyable saying "Ciao" to the occasional passing gondolier or boater (shutters available for privacy). The room and bathroom were large and well-appointed. Andrea is doing a wonderful job in restoring the house. There are still some areas 'in progress' but this only added to the charm. The garden area provided a peaceful backdrop for breakfast and Andrea was a charming host. Breakfast was simple but sufficient. Location is very good with all attractions within walking distance and very good restaurants nearby. We will definitely stay here again on our next visit to Venice.

reviews.title: Quiet, homely and friendly
reviews.text: Venice can be a bit much if you don't love hoards of people queuing, selling stuff and taking photos so finding a place a bit out of the way was perfect. It had a relaxing little garden and our room overlooked a canal. Breakfast was plentiful and we even got a packed one for an early departure. The room was lovely and felt very private and homely, my only complaint was that there were no toiletries but other than that it was perfect. Thanks

reviews.title: Excellent secluded accomodation yet within easy reach of all attractions
reviews.text: We took the water ferry straight from the airport to Fondamenta Nove and then it was a 5 min walk to Allo Squero. The room was so peaceful and quiet after the hustle and bustle of travel and the crowds of tourists. Andrea was waiting for us and gave us excellent recommendations to local restaurants which we would never have known otherwise. Breakfast was very good with wonderful special touches and a pleasant conversation with Andrea who is very knowledgeable of the local area.

reviews.title: Andrea is such a wonderful peson that its hard not to give the top rating
reviews.text: First, the positives: This B&B is convenient to everything you want to see, yet its far enough from the rushing crowds to be quiet and relaxing. Our room overlooked a small canal, which was a great treat. The room was clean, the bed reasonably comfortable, and the garden a very pleasant retreat. Andrea is extremely helpful. His restaurant suggestions were terrific. So, our complaints may just be spoiled Americans. Three days are a long time for towels when you are traveling. The quantities of soap are small, and there is nowhere to put them in the shower. And I know you can't expect much in a European breakfast, but hardtack is still disappointing. These may seem like petty complaints, and there is a lot to recommend this location, but I just can't give it my top score

reviews.title: Enjoyable place to stay
reviews.text: We have just spent 3 nights at this B&B. We thoroughly enjoyed the experience. The room was clean and quite large. Very quaint garden to eat breakfast and enjoy the quietness. The wifi was excellent, breakfast was sufficient and enjoyable less then 5 minute walk from Ca d'ora bus station. Would recommend it to those that are sick of big sterile hotels.

reviews.title: Spacious room, lovely view
reviews.text: We really loved our stay here--wish it were for longer! Andrea was a very nice, helpful host. We enjoyed his breakfast and appreciated the map and restaurant recommendations (they were delicious!). We loved our room with a canal view--such a lovely site! The room was pretty big, too, as was the shower. We would definitely recommend our friends and family here.

reviews.title: Perfect Venezia Lodging
reviews.text: Of all the places my husband and I stayed during our two week vacation in northern Italy, Allo Squero was our hands-down favorite. We had a bright, spotlessly clean room overlooking a canal. The bed was very comfortable. Breakfast, which we enjoyed outside by the garden, included fresh fruit, yogurt, cookies, juice and coffee, of course. Andrea and his nephew Nicola were the perfect hosts. Complimenti! Highly recommended!

reviews.title: Perfect Location
reviews.text: We just finished a 3 night stay with Andrea. We absolutely loved the accommodations and location. We were continually surprised at how completely quiet Venice became, just walking the couple of blocks off of the heavy traffic areas to this charming B&B. The room was of good size, clean, and we enjoyed the large private bath. Wrapping up our 11 day vacation here was ideal. Andrea provides essentially free reign of the home to his guests. We were able to store a bit to drink and eat in his fridge, had access to dishes, and loved the outdoor patio. Seeing green grass, trees, and shrub in Venice is a perfect way to end your busy day of sightseeing. Andrea was a great host, provided a modest but welcoming breakfast to start the day. His recommendations for authentic, ‘local’ eateries and pubs were spot-on. His knowledge of the metro waterways was also very handy in exploring neighboring island and getting to the airport upon our departure.

reviews.title: Beautiful tranquil place - away from the madding crowds
reviews.text: This is a beautifully renovated boat house 5 mins from the ferry terminal with direct access to the airport. A lovely peaceful place to relax away from the crowds. The host, Andrea, is an absolute gentleman. and lovely breakfasts. Great recommendations from the host for local places to eat. A great place.

reviews.title: Pleasant stay, fab location
reviews.text: Lovely B&B representing great value for money in what is an extremely expensive place to visit. Room clean and comfortable bed/decent night's sleep; though found shower luke warm at best. Bring ear plugs if noise bothers you at all as it's rather loud from early morning. Being able to breakfast in the garden was definitely a bonus; breakfast is very basic (toast, fruit, yogurt) but adequate. Excellent location; 20 minutes to the train station, about 5 to the Vaporetto. Everything is walkable from here though so no real need for the boats. The host's recommendations for restaurants were much appreciated and enjoyed. A great welcome !

reviews.title: A gem
reviews.text: I can't recommend it highly enough. The property has a lovely feel about it, probably because there are only three rooms available, it's been beautifully restored and it feels like the family home it is. For little over 100 Euro we got: - a well proportioned, tastefully decorated, comfortable room with a modern en-suite; - a glass of prosecco on arrival as the owners sorted out the paperwork; - great tips for enjoying the one night we had in Venice e.g. the best place to eat in the neighbourhood, the best place for a glass of house wine for 50 cents and meatballs at the counter and taking a gondola trip across the canal for 50 cents each; - a seat in the best place to eat in the neighbourhood thanks to mention of the owners name!; - breakfast in the garden - happily provided even at the ungodly hour of 7am on a Sunday before we left to catch our flight; - hosts who gave us the right balance of taking time with us and leaving us to our own devices.

reviews.title: Cosy, family run bed and breakfast.
reviews.text: My girlfriend and I stayed here for two nights and found it was everything we needed. Owners are lovely and they went out of their way to help us; we arrived at night and they came to meet us at the water taxi. Rooms were spotless and the bathroom was cleaned each day. Breakfast was basic but sufficient. We asked where to go for dinner and they recommended a couple of great reasonably priced places. The garden was a lovely touch.The only criticism we would have is that there are no tea and coffee facilities in the room.

reviews.title: A Little Oasis
reviews.text: Allo Squero was all we could have wished for. After spending 2 nights at the end of a cruise in the large and impersonal Hilton, this was definitely a refreshing and pleasurable experience. Our room overlooked a small canal from which we could watch passing craft including Gondolas with the Gondolier at eye level! The B & B is charming and so lovely to sit in a garden with trees, birds and grass when so much of Venice is hard surfaces (apart from the water!). The room was simple, but perfectly adequate and breakfast likewise. Andrea made us very welcome and was just so helpful with suggestions of great eating places, directions to the local shops, sights, wine refill place ( (take your empty water bottle!). Perfectly located in quiet, residential area yet only 2 minutes from the bustle of Strada Nuova. Andrea also provided excellent instructions for getting to the B & B which in Venice is essential!

reviews.title: Clean, quiet, and friendly
reviews.text: We stayed 4 nights at Allo Squero in April. From our room overlooking a quiet canal, we enjoyed a sublimely peaceful retreat in Venice. Andrea and his wife were welcoming, helpful, and extremely professional. The room was spacious and the bathroom was well-appointed. It felt homey, safe, and was a great value! We would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Comfortable, friendly and great location!
reviews.text: This little B&B is a hidden gem. Andrea is a wonderful host, willing to provide information, maps, or just chat. We stayed in 2 of his rooms (4 nights in the room with separate bath and 3 in the en suite on the canal). Both were very nice, a roll away bed was added for our son. The en suite room is very spacious and has a large closet. Our breakfasts were very good and we met people from all over the world! The location for vaporettos and walking is excellent - just be prepared for Venice - you're going to get lost!! Andrea has a service where he will pick you up at Piazza Roma for 20 euros, we took advantage of this. We did walk to Fond. Nuova for the airport water taxi at the end of our stay.

reviews.title: Great little spot in Venezia
reviews.text: We arrived late in Venice to thigh deep floods and snow, but Andrea made us feel warm, cozy and at home in Venezia. And we awoke to sunshine, Carnivale and a beautiful winter's day! Andrea was always very helpful and provided great local restaurant recommendations that were off the usual tourist route. We particularly liked the chinchetti place and Ai Promessi Espose.

reviews.title: May 2014 Stay
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed 2 nights in Allo Squero and loved it. Our room was nice sized and had a spacious bathroom and was very clean. Our breakfast was served on the porch overlooking the garden and was a great way to start our day! Andrea was great to give us recommendations, and he was very friendly and helpful. This area of Venice wasn't quite as touristy which was really nice. We would definitely recommend staying here.

reviews.title: Wonderful Venetian B & B
reviews.text: My son and I stayed at this lovely B & B at the start of June and had a perfect four night visit. Following Andrea's instructions we had no difficulty finding Allo Squero after alighting at Fondamente Nove and just that first walk was delightful. As others have said, it is in a perfect location - a quiet, 'real' neighbourhood yet within walking distance of all the wonders of Venice. Sitting in the garden after a simple but delicious breakfast, hearing birdsong and just glimpsing the canal through the garden gate before setting out to explore this fantastic city really was heavenly. Similarly at the end of an exhilarating but exhausting day, it is a welcomingly cool and peaceful spot to return to. Andrea is so hospitable and helpful, but also gives you complete freedom to come and go as you please. We particularly appreciated his advice on places to eat locally - all delicious. The house is charming and accommodation spotless and comfortable - the rates for such a lovely place very reasonable. We are determined to return one day and have already highly recommended Allo Squero to family and friends. Thank you Andrea.

reviews.title: Wonderful!
reviews.text: This b&b was one of favorites on our 9 week trip around Europe. From the moment we arrived they were so welcoming and helpful. The room was lovely with a canal view and the bathroom was very clean and brand new! The breakfast was our favourite part as the coffee was amazing! The b&b is perfect as it is central but not too close to the tourist crowds. It made us experience the real Venice and it made our trip 100 times better! Thank you very much for a lovely stay. Francesca and chris From Australia

reviews.title: Highly Recommend
reviews.text: We spent one night at Allo Squero and wished we had more time to stay longer. Location is terrific - in the heart of Venice. Room was spotless and property had lots of character. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.title: Gem of a B&B
reviews.text: Our second visit to this charming B&B which was every bit as good as the first. If you are looking for spotlessly clean accommodation within easy reach of all the tourist attractions (about 10-20 mins walk away) and yet far enough away from the noise and hustle and bustle of central Venice, then Allo Squero offers it to you. The B&B is within a quiet and safe residential area and is ideally located for the Fondamente Nove waterbus stop. Our en-suite room overlooked the small courtyard to the rear which is very peaceful offering you a wonderful night’s sleep. The room also comes with a hairdryer and some basic toiletries. Breakfasts, although simple, are very good and you have the added bonus of being able to enjoy them outside in the garden area, weather permitting of course! Andrea is a wonderful host and very helpful, particularly on where to eat locally. I would highly recommend this little gem of a B&B. Thank you Andrea.

reviews.title: Went above and beyond to make our short stay unforgettable ! :)
reviews.text: We booked 2 nights in this hotel, we got the suite which was spacious, clean, very modern, equipped with everything you may need, breakfast was superb as well. but what really sealed the deal was the amazing hotel staff, as soon as they found out we're celebrating a birthday they surprised us with a cake delivered to the room and had all the staff singing happy birthday when the cake arrived. would definitely be coming back. so worth it.

reviews.title: Amazing Boutique Hotel in Vouliagmeni
reviews.text: We stayed at the Somewhere Hotel for 3 nights while we were in the area for a wedding. From the moment we arrived, the staff was extremely friendly and helpful, and it got better from there! Beautiful rooms (we had one with a view of the gulf), great breakfast and a relaxing and gorgeous pool area. My girlfriend and I both said multiple times while at the hotel that it was the nicest hotel in which we've ever stayed. The hotel is in a good location - close to everything in Glyfada and Voula, and very accessible to Athens and the airport. It was great to escape the city at the end of a day of sightseeing to relax near the beach. Also, a note to show how great the staff was. Our friends were also in the hotel and we all had flights to Santorini the morning after the wedding. Greek weddings go until 6 or 7am and they arranged a car service and made boxed breakfasts for all of us to take to the airport at 5am. Couldn't have been happier with their service!

reviews.title: Finally
reviews.text: Finally a great hotel in Athens. Excellent rooms great service and breakfast. Easy to walk to the beach clubs and some nice restaurants. 20min to reach downtown and the airport. A must stay ün Athens for all purposes.

reviews.title: Above expectations
reviews.text: We had a perfect 3 nights stay at this small boutique hotel, we were in a stylish room with a beautifull view tot he beach. Staff is outstanding, and there is a relaxed atmosphere. The location is perfect, it’s a small walk to Astir Beach and the Lake. We definitely will come back!

reviews.title: Kindness to strangers
reviews.text: I think our experience at Somewhere is significant. We were not guests. We were damp and a bit lost. We were made most welcome, our luggage secured, enjoyed a great breakfast and several fine coffees and throughout treated with kind professional warm hospitality. Our experience means we will consider Somewhere with affection if we come back to Athens and we would like to share our experience with Tripadvisor.

reviews.title: Delightful boutique hotel
reviews.text: This is a delightful boutique hotel right in the heart of Vouliagmeni. My wife and I stated here for four nights while looking for a place to rent in the area. It is very conveniently located. You do have to cross the main road to get to the waterside, but if the traffic’s heavy, there’s a (well lit) underpass. The hotel ambience is “modern, chic”. Our room was a good size, with a balcony to enjoy the evening sun. The staff are exceptionally friendly, helpful and efficient.

reviews.title: Absolutely stellar!
reviews.text: This is an exceptional boutique hotel located in the most beautiful area of the Athens riviera, Vouliagmeni. A 2 minute walk away to a strip of bakeries, cafes and restaurants and a 5 minute walk away to beautiful little beach inlets. The design of the hotel is classic and elegant with a modern feel. With hues of blue, light grey and beige, you instantly feel at ease and peaceful. The rooms are spacious and fitted with the most up-to-date technology - touch-pad light fittings, a nose sound system, Nespresso coffee machines ... It indeed would have to be THE best designed hotel we have stayed in - well done to the architect and interior designer! The Molton Brown amenities are the best quality! And the face wash and mouthwash left at evening turndown is so thoughtful! The pool and dining area is also most wonderful! The lounges and chairs are comfortable and make lazing a day around the pool most enjoyable! And every time you sit, the staff arrives with a cold refreshing glass of water The breakfast is unique and wholesome. Everything is made with love and good ingredients as opposed to the massed-produce American style breakfasts at some hotels. My favourite was the thick yoghurt with goji berries, cranberries, walnuts and honey. But what makes this hotel truly exceptional is the wonderful staff. Each and every one is attentive, conversational and will go absolutely out of their way to make your stay comfortable and easy. I loved them all and wish I could take them home with me! Thank you to all at Somewhere for the most wonderful, relaxing stay!

reviews.title: There is always "Somewhere" exquisite to go to
reviews.text: Somewhere is a gorgeous boutique hotel situated on the Athenian Riviera in Vouliagmeni! I have been to very few boutique hotels but Somewhere tops my list of hotels in general! From the moment I came walking in to the front desk I felt like home! The staff are just out of this world! They go above and beyond to please you in the most kind and gracious way! The hotel is modern but also gives you a sense of cosiness at the same time! The whole premises is spic and span! Rooms are cleaned twice a day! The food is scrumptious at the very least! The whole menu is a 5 star one! All in all, at the end of the day its value for money is excellent! So, with profound gratitude I would like to take the chance and THANK team Vouliagmeni for making us feel like royalty! We will always treasure our moments with you and will be definitely coming back before summer is out! I highly recommend this hotel!

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Excellent all around. We stayed with our 10 month old son and the entire staff went over and above to accommodate us. Courteous, polite and informative service, awesome breakfast and great drinks by the pool will definitely bring us back.

reviews.title: Great small hotel close to Athens
reviews.text: What a wonderful hotel ! Somewhere Vouliagmeni is a small hotel, all brand new and with a great service. We stayed for 4 nights for a trip to Athens. The hotel has only a limited number of rooms, so the service is always very personal, from arrival, breakfast, service at the pool or room service. Everything you ask is possible and done efficiently. The rooms are very nice and comfortable. We stayed in the penthouse suite, with a large terrace and jacuzzi, with spectacular views over the sea. Highly recommended for a special occasion! Breakfast buffet is super with everything you wish, including sliced fresh fruit, fresh juices, espresso, etc. Breakfast on the terrace or close to the pool on sunny days is pure luxury. The restaurant is also very good for lunch or dinner, and is very close to many other restaurants. The only negative point is that you have to cross a busy road to get to the beach. This hotel is highly recommended when you visit Athens: it is only 25 min. drive to Athens (about 20 Euro by taxi) and it is much nicer than staying in the busy streets of Athens. We will for sure go back!

reviews.title: Hidden Gem
reviews.text: Had 5 days in Athens Greece and I chose to get out of Athens and book in an area that is considered the "Riviera of Athens". The best decision! Somewhere is a SMALL boutique hotel..literally 11 rooms!! We had a view of the bay which was literally across the street! Everything about Somewhere was top notch from the "car service" that picked us up in Athens(and took us to the airport) to the AMAZING hospitality from Elina to Stratos to the nice touches in the rooms to the well kept intimate grounds... The spacious rooms are very "tech influenced"...lots of touch pads to control lights and window shades etc Molton Brown ammenities...I could go on and on! Do yourself a favor, get out of Athens (dirty and unkept) and book at Somewhere..you won't be disappointed

reviews.title: Exceptional Service
reviews.text: From the moment I was picked up by the driver at the airport to the moment I left, the service and special attention I was given at this hotel was amazing. The assistant manager who checked me in was incredible and answered all of my questions and took care of every little detail. The room was the perfect size for a solo traveler and classy, with all of the high-end amenities you would expect including a comfy bed. On departure, they had even made sure a vegetarian food box was packed for me since I was leaving at 3:30am. Location is directly across from beaches and lots of restaurants in area. Only downside was it was very noisy at night due to the main road out front and lots of light crept in through the shades making it difficult to sleep.

reviews.title: Somewhere hotel / Perfect hotel
reviews.text: Staying at Somewhere was the best hotel experience. Amazing Hotel, spacious rooms, amazing location, lovely staff, perfect service. All the hotel facilities are perfectly designed to offer a relaxed and enjoyable stay as we had! The location is perfect, the room was perfect, with an amazing view of the sea and the nature, the bed was very comfortable too, we also enjoyed swimming and relaxing by the pool, enjoying the hotel’s perfect location, and got impressed from the super tasty breakfast. Exceptional service! Lovely bathroom. Great outdoor spaces to relax and eat. Food was very high quality. Breakfasts, lunches and dinners were all exceptional.

reviews.title: Positively surprised
reviews.text: The hotel looks smaller than on photos but it is 100% boutique hotel. Comfortable, friendly, perfectly located. The best place we stayed in Athens. Walking distance to the beach and many restaurants. Very smart design.

reviews.title: fantastic
reviews.text: wonderful boutique hotel! wonderful facilities..wonderful pool.. most important wonderful staff and service. Staff so friendly ,caring and always willing to help and give advice and extra care. so glad we decided to stay here (for 5 nights! ) rather than inside Athens. great pool. lovely beach across the road. great restaurant around the corner... *Take into account regular rooms are surprisingly small!..the suites are a fabulous comfortable room

reviews.title: A beautiful hotel on the Athenian Riviera
reviews.text: We stayed at the “Somewhere Boutique Hotel Vouliagmeni Athens” for 2 nights. The ‘Somewhere’ hotel is beautifully situated in the heart of Vouliagmeni, aka Athens’ “Riviera”, just across from the shore and beaches. The professionalism and courtesy of the staff and the clean, top notch facilities are just beautiful, and it has been a joy to stay here at this five-star boutique hotel. The outdoor dining and pool areas were relaxing and truly wonderful. Rooms have nice HDTV and fast WiFi and USB and wireless charging ports. The hotel’s food is amazingly fresh, tasty and beautifully presented and our breakfasts were included; a great choice. Complimentary fruit, wine and water on arrival were a really nice and appreciated touch.There is convenient parking at the front of the hotel. We drove to the spectacular Temple of Poseidon from here. I have attached a few photos of the Hotel’s outdoor areas where we really enjoyed unwinding after a great trip across most of spectacular Southern Greece. We’ll look forward to our return and stay here.

reviews.title: Very boutique, Very small
reviews.text: I was pleasantly surprised at the service at this hotel, and the overall aesthetic. However for the high price it is not worth it, due to the size of the room and the hotel. The rooms are extremely small, no view, and I was shocked about that for the price of $300 per night (not including taxes) The pool is also very small and if there are children there (which there were) it’s really not enough room to swim. Also it’s right on main road so you get traffic noise. The food is very good but too expensive for what it is. Thankfully the service from the very friendly staff was top notch, and one perk is they offer free car service to/from airport. But this isn’t enough to justify the high price for such a small room & hotel premises.

reviews.title: Impressed
reviews.text: t's hard to impress me but the guys here made it: place is fantastically located, staff all very professional and gentle, rooms (regardless they are a bit tiny) are completely sound-proof and very comfy. From here you can walk or tram/bus everywhere in Vouliagmeni. The front desk/concierge was super helpful and responsive. They are English friendly and in general some of the best front desk people I've ever dealt with. Very nice and cosy the bistro restaurant with in the hotel I'd recommend the hotel as a relatively good value.

reviews.title: Our wedding - The groom’s headquarter
reviews.text: We have chosen the hotel for our wedding as the groom’s headquarters. All his family, 16 of us stayed at Somewhere for 3 days during the wedding celebrations. The service was excellent, the ambiance excellent. Everyone was happy and willing to help. The groom felt like he was at his own home when getting ready for the wedding and all the family was happy and relaxed because of the perfect standard of service and professionalism of the Somewhere staff. The day after the wedding we welcomed all of our friends for a brunch by the pool which was organised in detail by the chefs and Ms Gatsinou. Special thanks to Stratos, Miranda, Elina, Dimitris, Despina, Mpampis and Yvonni and all the staff. Thank you guys you really made us feel home. Excellent choice for everyone visiting Athens, Vouliagmeni.

reviews.title: Silent moments of Delightful Treat
reviews.text: Couple vacation retreat from Texas- highlights: Very clean atmosphere, new facility, well designed with ambiance, quiet, serene, absolute delicious breakfast buffet, very polite/ serving staff, ordered in room service one night that was well worth the price better than restaurants in city, away from city noise/traffic, hot showers, nice view from balcony, very tiny hotel w less people very intimate experience!

reviews.title: Exquisite
reviews.text: Stayed here for a long weekend. Wonderful place with excellent food and delightful room. The staff were exceptional; we were made to feel special all weekend. Simply exquisite! 35sqm room with a all the facilities and s balcony near a beach in a sheltered horseshoe bay

reviews.title: Elegant escape
reviews.text: Super located small, elegant and cosy! Modern design, which I'm a big fan of. It was a great place for weekend gateway for me and my husband i." "What a chic surprise!" The design of the room is definitely modern, and while that's to my taste! Everything was terrific. Lots of effort goes into the little things that make you say "wow," Super breakfast and great bistro for dinning.

reviews.title: wonderful stay at Somewhere Boutique Vouliagmeni
reviews.text: I had a wonderful stay at Somewhere Boutique Vouliagmeni Hotel.It was the absolute comfort! exactly what i needed two weeks before my wedding! Joanna was very helpful and knew exactly how to help me with everything i addressed to her! very professional and friendly.

reviews.title: 11 rooms of perfection
reviews.text: Stylish and charming. The hotel is so small in size that it in some way facilitates the designer to make every inch of it as exquisite as it can be. The service on the other hand is without a doubt perfect as well. I arrived at around 0 o'clock in the evening and the reception was waiting outside the hotel expecting me. He was super polite, dressed smart and became very chatty when I told him that I just got back to Athens from the prestigious Greek Island Santorini. He introduced to me a wedding scene in a Chinese movie shot on Santorini which attracted tons of Chinese tourists to that island. They prepared a plate of fruit in your room accompanied by a bottle of liquor, free of charge.

reviews.title: An early winter break
reviews.text: An excellent hotel for visiting Athens and the surrounding areas but being away from the noise of a busy city. The hotel is perfect for relaxing, surrounded by beautiful beaches and lots of lovely restaurants to suit all budgets. We were given a lovely room at the hotel with a balcony for enjoying the sunny November days and watching beautiful sunsets. The staff were helpful and courteous, going out of their way to ensure our stay was perfect.

reviews.title: Waw waw waw excellent people.
reviews.text: This place exceeded all my expectations. It is a new and stylish establishment. It is very comfortable and it's rooms are well decorated and furnished with impeccable taste and styling. The staff ... My gooddess they are dedicated team who serve with a smile. To be honest this is a seven start establishment. It is well located about 20 klm from Athens but it is worth the stay there. We enjoyed our few days and wished we could stay longer. It might be a bit on the expensive side... but believe me it is worth every euro. Well done to the team and management.

reviews.title: Perfect spot
reviews.text: Having to travel quite often on business I prefer small and lux hotels than the impersonal big ones. Somewhere in Vouliagmeni meets the qualifications to the point! Small, private, lux with very helpfull and polite staff was the perfect choice. Breakfast is a total expirience and the stylish bistro Lutetia offers elegant plates and wine choices. A very elegant outdoor temperature controlled pool and a fitness center helps you to relax and enjoy your stay.

reviews.title: Amazing food
reviews.text: Very nice atmosphere. The food was first class!!!! And first class service!!!! And amazing cocktails...a nice place to enjoy your stay at the the South of Athens by the sea. Easy access to the sea and to the ancient part of the city and its night life.

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: What a fantastic hotel we were very impressed. We have been staying here for 11 days whilst in Athens on part business and part holiday. A lovely comfortable room with good wifi and air conditioning. Staff are lovely very friendly and welcoming. Pool are is clean and iced water is topped up frequently by the lovely team. Breakfast is delicious with an extensive buffet and eggs cooked to order. I recommend the Benedict eggs which were delicious. Thank you for a wonderful stay we will definitely return!

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Somewhere boutique hotel Vouliagmeni was a very nice surprise. Got upgraded to the Riviera suit, which was a very nice suit with a large balcony. Very nice and comfortable bed. The staff is very serviceminded and friendly and will help you with whatever you need. Your room is cleaned twice a day. Breakfast was delicious and the drinks from the bistro was very good. The location is also good: close to restaurants, about 10 minutes walking distance from Astir beach and 20 min to the airport. If you are looking for a great and friendly hotel at a great location in Vouliagmeni; Somewhere is the place for you. We travel a lot and have stayed at a lot of great 5 star hotels, but I have to say Somewhere Boutique hotel is one of the best hotels we have stayed at this far. Highly recommended and we will definately stay here again on our next visit in Vouliagmeni.

reviews.title: Long Weekend Break
reviews.text: Our first visit to Athens (for a friends wedding), we stayed for 4 nights choosing Beachfront over City Centre - good decision. Small but beautiful and luxurious, well equipped boutique hotel and well positioned. Staff were always attentive, friendly and helpful. Clean spacious rooms with exceptionally comfortable furnishings (we booked Deluxe Riviera). We only booked bed and breakfast but after such great breakfasts we ended up having two evening meals in their restaurant - superb. Transfers to and from the airport were included - all in all very much a 5* service.

reviews.title: Wonderful oasis
reviews.text: What a great find this boutique hotel was, it was a recommendation and it really is true to its word! Homely feel with great attentive staff, complimentary wine and fruit in a clean fresh room minutes away from the beach. This is really a gem of you want to be well looked after away from the bustle.

reviews.title: Amazing quality and first class service
reviews.text: For our last day of vacation in Greece we've chosen Somewhere Vouliagmeni hotel as we wanted to stay by the beach but not in one of those huge resorts in Vouliagmeni. Our stay was amazing. We loved the hotel design as well as the top quality of the furniture and all the equipments of this brand new hotel. We've been to several hotels of this category but never such a high standard and extreme attention to detail. The service is also exceptional. The personnel is very pleasant, qualified, extremely attentive. Thank you! We would definitely stay again at Somewhere!

reviews.title: Best boutique ever!
reviews.text: Somewhere is definitely the place to be. An ideal location, near the lake, across from the beachfront, minutes to Glyfada, and away from the Athens hustle. What separates this hotel is apart is the attention to detail in all regards and the anongst the best service level I have ever encountered in any hotel in the world.

reviews.title: Fantastic!! Everything we hope for and more!
reviews.text: After a difficult arrival with the airline losing our luggage we couldn't have arrived anywhere better! The hotel has been fantastic and has helped in every way possible to retrieve our luggage and help us to enjoy our stay more comfortably! The hotel is beautiful inside and out and has surpassed all our expectations (which were high to begin with!) We are celebrating our wedding anniversary and very very happy to be spending it here!

reviews.title: amazing service
reviews.text: went there for a couple of days for a wedding in athens- we had the penthouse suite which was a great size, with a beautiful and spacious balcony. The service was excellent, location is amazing and the view is simply stunning!

reviews.title: Total perfection!
reviews.text: Am seldom completely blown away by a hotel - but Somewhere did it! From the first contact with the fabulous Despina in the front desk to my departure everyone I met was friendly, courteous, considerate and attentive. The room was great - all the gadgets you could wish for, spacious balcony with day bed and comfortable bed. Breakfast was delicious - great menu of dishes cooked to order as well as the buffet. Small but well equipped gym and outdoor terrace with small pool completed perfection. I’ll be back!

reviews.title: Best staff ever
reviews.text: Visiting Greece for the first time, I really can say I had the luck to book at somewhere in Vouliagmeni, first of all the staff is veryyyyyy friendly always smiling and always helpful, if only for the staff this hotel would be with the visit. The hotel per say is very nice, the room was spacious and very comfortable and a walking distance to the beaches. To all the staff at somewhere thank you for making our stay so pleasant, will definitely come back.

reviews.title: Excellent hotel!!
reviews.text: The staff at this hotel are amazing from the minuet you check in till you they, they are so attentive and friendly!! We had dinner at the hotel, the steak was superb!!! A great selections of wines also!! The swimming pool was at a great temperature and was so refreshing. Breakfast is different as it's not your typical choice, we loved the options that they had!! I would defiantly recommend this hotel to anyone heading to Athens for either one night or for a holiday!! I just wished we could have stayed longer.

reviews.title: Fantastic!
reviews.text: The difference between a good hotel and a great hotel? The small details. The little touches which take it beyond a pretty, modern and well decorated hotel. This is a small hotel with a real attention to detail. Staff are first class and attentive without being imposing. The rooms are well appointed with excellent chamber maid service. A lovely cosy bar with impressive cocktails and a very pleasant breakfast experience. My only regret is not trying the restaurant, but there are plenty around and I like to get out to explore. Next time. The surrounding area is beautiful with beaches and a quiet peninsula nearby. I visited for business for just 2 nights, but would be happy to bring the family. Only 20 mins from Athens city centre and the Airport, the location is great.

reviews.title: Great Value for Money Hotel in Amritsar
reviews.text: We stayed in this hotel during our Golden Temple - Wagha Border trip. Location : The hotel is located near Cooper Road, in a sub-road beneath the starting point of cooper road bridge. The location is not very appealing, but the hotel is an exceptional value for money one. And this property is situated very near to the Golden Temple & Jalianwalabag Room & Service : Their rooms are very reasonably priced and very very spacious!!. The amenities includes a king-sized bed,a small tea table with 2 chairs, a dressing table, wardrobe, bathing tub etc.... Really worth the money we spent and may be more than that. The receptionists and the hotel staff were helping, well mannered and polite. However, the room service is available up to 11:30 PM only. Food : The hotel serves authentic Punjabi and North Indian foods from their kitchen. The food was reasonably priced and was really a gastronomic heaven. We enjoyed their Butter Chicken, Tandoori stuff and Roti. Tip : Order only one side dish per two person, since the food portion is really large. In & Around : Golden Temple and Jalianwalabag is very near. Visit these places during early morning so that you get sufficient time to go to Waga Border ( Indo- Pak border ) and see the parade. Overall : A very nice stay .

reviews.title: chief and besy.
reviews.text: chief and best...excellent experience....Waiter Kuldeep is very friendly....impossible to serve this type quality in such a low rate... maneger receptionist directors are very helpfull....all can trust

reviews.title: A Heart of city Hotel
reviews.text: This Hotel cannot be missed for the sheer location of the same. Its a great hotel to stay at. It has few shops within the premises to shop for the best local products to buy which also caters to North India memorabilia.

reviews.title: Overall Value for the money.
reviews.text: Hi, I stayed for 2days & 2 Nights in Room No.109 of this Hotel, booking done from makemytrip website, it gave me 30% discount on existing Tariff. Overall its True Value for money considering Budget Hotel if Ur searching for its close proximity to stn & Road so that U get Rickshaw or Taxi are its Benefits. The hotel is also close to The Golden Temple and Jalianwala baagh by Rickshaw it takes 15mins and walk from Hotel takes half hour strolling through the market & shops. The Rooms & Toilets are spacious with Big Mirrors on Rooms & Bathrooms. Lots of space to keep Luggage with Cupboard, Writing Table, Chair. 2 more comfortable chairs with Small Dinning Table. 24hrs Water Supply. Staff was co-operative, polite and helpful. Food was slightly expensive but tasty.Compromise to be done in terms of electical switches, as just 1 switch in a spacious room. Another occupied by a TV which was Dumb as had No Sound at all. Picture too was flickering and getting switched off every 5mins. I couldn't watch IPL 2013 Matches. Toilet was a bit unclean with stains. Fans were slow & AC was old but gave the desired cooling.Overall Value for the money I paid. What else one can expect at Rs 820/- inclusive of taxes.

reviews.title: Good reasonable Priced Hotel in Amritsar
reviews.text: Airlines Hotel Cooper Road Amritsar Good budget priced hotel in Amritsar. Quiet location.Rooms spacious. Towels and Bedlinens changed daily if required. Room Service good. Clean rooms and even has a Swing for 2 people. Needs some decorating to Bedrooms and bathrooms. AC good and power backup in summer was a treat. Overall Suite Room Rate of Rupees 1200 was good value.

reviews.title: Good one.
reviews.text: Hotel check in time was at 12:00 PM and we reached there at 07:30 hours in the morning, they handed over rooms without any extra charges. Rooms were spacious and maintained. Over all was good experience.

reviews.title: NICE HOTEL
reviews.text: On 19.07.2013 to 21.07.2013 we visit Amritsar & booked int hote. Hotel rooms are big & well equipped the small refrigerator was not working but the AC working. there is slightly maintenance problem but staff are good its near about 5 min away from railway station. They prepare food but its is costlier that opposite side restaurant.

reviews.title: A good place for the price
reviews.text: The place is well situated. Its very close to the station and the golden temple is a 20 minute walk away. The rooms are very spacious and there is ample room for everything. The Toilet and Bathroom was not very clean though. The hotel is located close to they highway so there is a lot of traffic noise.

reviews.title: Affordable Hotel with good service!
reviews.text: The Room was spacious & clean. The amenities they provided were really worth the money paid. The hotel serves delicious North-Indian food in reasonable price. You have television and internet access in the rooms and the staff is very helpful. The place is safe and worth the value for money. I can recommend this hotel for people who look for a budget hotel as I had a good experience.

reviews.title: excellent service, value for your money
reviews.text: Owner and staff are very helpful and friendly, service is good. Rooms are ample, have all the basics you need for a few days stay. Beds have the typical Indian mattresses (hard for me) but the staff solved that by putting a thick soft blanket over them so I slept very well. A/C works fine. No internet connection on my floor (3th) but it is excellent in the lobby. Food served by restaurant is good and very tasty. Around the hotel you will find variuos local food stores, restaurants, etc. The Golden Temple is about 20 minutes walking from the hotel, a must do. Will recommend this hotel to whomever plans to visit Amritsar.

reviews.title: Below Average..lacks maintenance..
reviews.text: This Hotel has very big rooms but lacks maintenance. Dirty rooms, we had to get the sheets changed when we reached. A cat was all over the hotel and would sneak into the room. Some construction work was going on when we stayed in this Hotel and it seemed they got all the room service work done by the labors who was working there. He was poorly dressed and looked dirty. The washrooms did not work properly. We were not too sure of the kitchen quality so ate outside only (you have plenty of options). Location wise also its located under a busy flyover and crossing the road took us 10 minutes. The good thing was service was good and help was readily rendered. It would have been a nice hotel years back, but now it needs serious overhauling. I wont recommend it.

reviews.title: Nightmarish experience for couple of days
reviews.text: Old rooms, old fans, Lift not working for both the days, Looting of money excess than the supposed payment. Supplied water which when consumed resulted in loose motions, Taps coming off when turned in the bathrooms, TV not working, Presence of torn condoms beneath the beds. Worst hospitality making the two days stay a nightmarish experience. We checked in at midnight 11 50 pm and vacated at 11 PM after almost 2 days but we were made to pay for 2 1/2 days . Since we were 3 adults, they supplied an extra cot which costs around 100-150/- with a blanket and pillow for which they charged Rs.500/- extra . When questioned, he said that we cannot check out without paying . Window AC also broken . Very poor and outdated infrastructure. My mother had to struggle a lot due to non working of Lift for 2 days as she has kneejoint pains. Worst attitude, Looting of money , Spoiling of holiday mood . No Wifi facility as presented in the website.

reviews.title: Super Dirty Hotel
reviews.text: Recently traveled Amritsar and stayed in this Hotel "Hotel Airlines", giving you the quick review based on my Experience : Bad Things first: 1. Hotel location is bad, there is no transport from the front of hotel if you want to travel any location in Amritsar like Golden Temple, Durgyana Temple etc. 2. Hotel is very old and its super duper dirty, when you go on the above floor its badly stinking with toilet smell 3. Rooms are in very bad shape and looks not maintained from ages, they are so dirty that you dont feel to stay in 4. Bathrooms are extremely dirty and stinky 5. I am getting this hotel in 650/- on Make my trip but since I tool it direct from the hotel they charged 1000 Rs/- which is not at all worth for this dirty / stinky hotel Gud Things: 1. There is a restaurant INDERPURI in front of this hotel which is very good when it comes to food 2. There are many daily utility shops near to this hotel which is add-on 3. Staff of hotel is good and prompt, specially a guy called Ravi. Took tea in Hotel and it was good. Overall I will not recommend this hotel to anyone , unless you have super low budget or you getting in 50 Rs for PNB employees.

reviews.title: Poorest of the poor - product & services
reviews.text: I had choosen this hotel for our trip to amritsar last year I am sorry for posting it alomst after a year. I had booked this hotel through makemytrip after reading the reviews and proximity with the main attraction and railway station. The moment we entered in the hotel, there was some work going on, the rooms were old paints peeling off, fused lights, ceiling crack, TV not working, torn & faded sofa. When we called up the reception and told about all these there was no one to hear this from the hotel next we called up makemytrip and informed about the hotel status this also took 15 mins for someone to come and listen to us. we did not had any other option but to stay as we had already paid for it. The only good thing about this hotel was the close proximity from the gollden temple and railway station.

reviews.title: Bad location. Average service
reviews.text: The most striking thing about this hotel is its bad location. It is loccated by the side of one of the crowdiest most parts of the city besides a bridge. Needless to say that this place is no very quiet. The rooms are average., just about OK for the price charged. Would not strongly recommend to people.

reviews.title: Bad Experience
reviews.text: Hotel has got good location but badly maintained. At 4 o'clock in the evening, the room was not ready. Lot of water leakage in the bathroom. Water was not coming. Geyser is not working. No food menu. First extra bed was told at Rs. 300/-, but later on charged Rs. 350/- Not value for money. Other good hotels at this rate re available.

reviews.title: good hotel, complete value for money
reviews.text: i booked this hotel through one of the websites, the experience was good. we went to haridwar by train. this station is situated very near the railway station. golden temple is a 5 min journey by auto from here. staffs are warm and good natured. we ordered food through room service. food was also good. overall a complete value for money.

reviews.title: Very comfortable stay!
reviews.text: It was a very comfortable stay. The best attraction was the swings (jhula) in the bedrooms. My parents stayed there and found the stay very nice. The location is quite reachable for Golden Temple and Wagah border.

reviews.title: Good Service and location
reviews.text: Service and location were good. Food was average.Rooms were big enough but not so clean.It is an old hotel so do not expect too much from it.But one can get good food and drinks in about 1 kn diameter. All I would say is it is cheap and good.

reviews.title: V. V Good
reviews.text: At this rate rooms are simply outstanding ,gentle behaviour and courteous hospitality.if you are planning to stay in amritsar I think they are good enough to.stay and try once food of.crystal restaurant it's bit expensive but awasome. It's close to Station and simply good👍👌👏

reviews.title: Hotel Airlines Amritsar
reviews.text: Good to Stay..!! Nice Staff. Well I recommend people to Stay there. Nice Place to Stay in Amritsar. Though Light/power had gone twice in my 1 nite Stay But over all a good experience... XXXXXXXXXXXXXX

reviews.title: Cold rooms but quiet
reviews.text: The rooms have been quiet. The windows had big gaps. On request they provided a small electrical heater (for free) which wasn't strong enough to heat the room to a normal temperature. It was still very cold (January). The room had a real shower with hot water and a very old bath tube. As the bathroom was terrible cold taking a shower was no fun. There was a small extra room with a desk, light switch for this room was broken. The small table with the television looked to be broken for a very long time. The overall condition of the room was old/ bad. The bed was uncompfortable. Television had no english channels. Internet access is available, but only with a very old computer and slow modem (no chance to connect a laptop). The staff was friendly and helpful, sometimes a bit nerving (first hour after checkin they came to my room 10 times!). The golden temple is around 15 minutes distance with a rikscha. Mainroad is direct in front of the hotel, therefore no problem. There was no safe/ locker available in the room or at reception. I left my laptop in the room, nobody touched something even the staff knew about the laptop. I can recommend this hotel for people who look for a budget hotel - don't expect too much.

reviews.title: Looks like a haunted place to me
reviews.text: I was astonished to see the size of the room, however after exploring it a bit I was taken back. Bathrooms are just equivalent to government toilets. Bed was dirty with all hairs in the blanket kept there. Heater is of no use, rates of food are like those in Hyatt. Just avoid staying.

reviews.title: Very Very Poor
reviews.text: Hi... I have just been to this hotel & stayed there for 2 nights. I must say that it is, till date, the worst hotel I've ever stayed in. Rooms have a very unhygenic feel, dirty bedsheets, stinking towels, leaking taps, exposed wiring, dusty windows, torn blankets, ... it has all d characteristics of a "no GO" place. It is not worth even if someone gives u a room to stay free of cost... ! Not recommended

reviews.title: Good hotel
reviews.text: A nice hotel with clean rooms, quick servicing, modern rooms. Food was quite good and tasty. A nice hotel in the centre of city. Prices are quite reasonable and facilities provided was average. Overall a nice hotel

reviews.title: Budget
reviews.text: The rooms are extremely spacious and sort of old school. The air conditioned rooms even have a swing but it makes noise due to rust. The location is not too bad. We frequented inderpuri (which is a very good place to eat and is a stone's throw away) while staying here. Cleanliness can slip below average at times. I sort of have mixed feelings about this place cos while the rooms or even the hotel in general is past it's days of glory. The owner and the family are nice and pretty informative. They might have to step up with the service staff and overall upkeep of the place. Hot weather or not, the non Ac rooms due to lack of ventilation get pretty stuffy. For now with the facilities and state of things, it is a budget option, may be not pleasant for everyone but will save u some money if travelling with friends or okay with average standards for stay. There is a good wifi connection at the reception. Several places worth visiting are walkable too.

reviews.title: Cheap Stay
reviews.text: stayed there for a night. The rooms are available at a cheap price . i would recommend visiting the room first before taking the keys. positive recommendation for a night stay, although the location is pretty great being in the center of the city .

reviews.title: Adequate
reviews.text: The hotel is run down and dirty. Badly maintained. Beds are as hard as the road and linen should not be inspected too closely. The noise from the road is loud and nearly constant. Staff are fairly pleasant and helpful. Would I stay here again? No!

reviews.title: Five Star attitude, great people, gorgeous building, rock bottom prices
reviews.text: I have travelled extensively through India and I have stayed in a huge variety of paid accommodation, from back packer places in Chennai, to Haveli in Udaipur, to five star hotels in Mumbai and Delhi. I have stayed in places in Bhopal, Kanyakumari, Kovalam, Ernakulam, Mangalore, Bangalore, Kolkata, Pune, Goa, Varanasi, Jaipur, Agra, I could go on. I have slept on rock hard beds, seen dirty overpriced hellholes and the most charming gems. Reactions to my often solo travel have ranged from indifference, shock, bemusement, amusement and curiosity but usually professional friendliness. I have learned that you don’t always get what you pay for, and that quality comes with different star ratings and sometimes surprisingly inexpensively. Staying at Sachin’s was one of the best experiences that I have had as a guest. The hotel has the feel of a classic Haveli, with lots of terraces and open space.
