I was greeted by both husband and wife, we had tea, they gave me lots of good advice and made me feel very welcome. I was then shown to my huge room that felt like a suite, with lots of light, a nice seating area with a small couch, chair and table, a big comfy bed, the brightest cleanest 5 star crisp fresh sheets, 2 bath towels, 2 bars of soap, toilet paper, 2 fans, AC and a heater, a separate dressing room and large bathroom with hot water via a geyser that you controlled yourself. The room even had a swing and a working phone to reception. There is lift (elevator) and the people who work there are very helpful. I am assuming that the 2 star rating might have something to do with the fact that the place is a bit run down, but you are also paying rock bottom prices for a 5 star attitude. There is a difference between clean and worn. This place is very clean, and for the price, it is an astonishing good deal, and such beautiful architecture. Yes, there is mildly leaky plumbing and peeling paint, but I have paid a lot more for such things at other hotels. These are also details that the owners are well aware of, and are working on. There were small power outages and brief gaps in the good signal free wifi, again, this can happen everywhere and often does. The attention I was shown, the time my hosts spent with me, the concern and care above and beyond what anyone would expect and the delicious breakfasts included in the price made up for the slightly shabby bits, things that are easy to overlook especially in context. Clean, quiet, elegant, beautiful, safe and well located with the outstanding Surjit's Food Plaza just minutes away as well as great shops all along the street! Sachin and his wife and staff are the kind of people who genuinely like other people, who really care about their guests. I wish more hoteliers were like them! Overall one of my best most pleasant stays ever, thank you! I will be back!

reviews.title: Poor
reviews.text: No parking Poor room service smelling toilets Tea and food was good but expensive non-cooperating staff bad location ventilation problem plugs were not in working condition web of electric cables Big and unclean rooms

reviews.title: Okay hotel
reviews.text: I visited with family and was only in Amritsar for two days. The room was massive but dirty and was not cleaned on a regualr basis. Plus we didn't realize it was going to be SUPER hot during the month that we visited (aka beginning of July), so we almost died trying to get some sleep. Food was good and was provided till 10pm and reasonably priced for Amritsar. The cooler was practically nonfuntional and filling it with water using a hose was a messy job that they didn't accomplish very well either. I wouldn't stay here again, but if you're on a tight budget and no place else to go, its an okay room to crash in. Also, no wifi code was provided. But the location was quite good, in that, we were only about 10-12 mins from the Golden Temple and about the same distance from Alpha One and Trilium malls (both super nice and heaven for when its burning hot outdoors)!

reviews.title: Spacious, conveniently located, old aged rooms
reviews.text: UPS : 1. Conveniently located near to Golden Temple 2. Close to Railway Station 3. Spacious Room with ample space in the room 4. Flexibility in check out timing 5. Grocery, medical shops, restaurants etc are in stone throw walking distance DOWNS : 1. Located just down the bridge lane and hotel entrance is completely overshadowed. 2. Located at the busy intersection road points. Huge traffic witnessed in day and night time. Honking all around. 3. Rooms are very old aged and inadequately lighted VERDICT : Value for money, spacious room, conveniently located to important tourist locations across Amritsar.

reviews.title: Large room, Cleaning required
reviews.text: Room was good. Large rooms. But it is not that clean. It feel like you are in Bachelor's House. It is budget hotel, I payed 1K with breakfast. It is in between Golden temple and Railway station. In Amritsar you need to pay 50 rs to go anywhere(fix rate, don't know why). But overall budget ok ok hotel.

reviews.title: disappointing
reviews.text: this hotel is a real rundown place does not have a clean feeling. Rooms have a poor look. just not a welcoming and relaxing place. food below average.

reviews.title: Cheap Hotel, Good service but bad bedsheets
reviews.text: Worth spending the money. Staff is very helpful. Even the owners are available in the hotel to guide and help you up. There is a swing in the room, which is very exciting and relaxing. But be careful about the bedsheets. They are usually dirty. Better to carry your own.

reviews.title: Nice choice!
reviews.text: The hotel is very good! Rooms are nice & spacious.although it's litte far from railway station, if u want a clean & romantic rooms, it is a good choice.we also suggest this hotel to some of our relatives.

reviews.title: Good location ,amazing comfort
reviews.text: The location of the hotel is awesome.I had booked it for my 60 plus parents and they had a very good stay.The hotel manager/owner was very cooperative with them and even allowed them early check -in. Everything was at a walking distance be it railway stations ,market or Ranjeet Singh Garden.Definitely recommended for a budget and clean stay.

reviews.title: Rock bottom price
reviews.text: Great Value for Money Hotel in Amritsar We stayed in this hotel during our Golden Temple - Wagha Border trip. Location: The hotel is located near Cooper Road, in a sub-road beneath the starting point of cooper road bridge. The location is not very appealing, but the hotel is an exceptional value for money one. And this property is situated very near to the Golden Temple & Jalianwalabag Room & Service: Their rooms are very reasonably priced and very very spacious!!. The amenities include a king-sized bed, a small tea table with 2 chairs, a dressing table, wardrobe, bathing tub etc.... Really worth the money we spent and may be more than that. The receptionists and the hotel staff were helping, well mannered and polite. However, the room service is available up to 11:30 PM only. Food: The hotel serves authentic Punjabi and North Indian foods from their kitchen. The food was reasonably priced and was really a gastronomic heaven. We enjoyed their Butter Chicken, Tandoori stuff and Roti. Tip: Order only one side dish per two-person, since the food portion is really large. In & Around: Golden Temple and Jalianwalabag are very near. Visit these places during early morning so that you get sufficient time to go to Waga Border ( Indo- Pak border ) and see the parade. Overall: A very nice stay.

reviews.title: Good and spacious
reviews.text: The hotel is really accessible from railway station and bus stand. Also its cheap. The rooms and room service are great. Also the home cooked type food is available on demand. The best part was the chapatis as they were tawa rotis available. Simply loved the stay

reviews.title: Never ever stay in this hotel
reviews.text: I have been there in this hotel in the month on March . I must tell you , there was nothing that was right in that room . Choking pipes , filthy smell in the room , no hot water , phone not working . One of the worst hotel i have ever stayed in . The only good part was the tea that i ordered . My advice is not to stay in that hotel .

reviews.title: Good one
reviews.text: We reacjed the hotel late at night. There were not enough man power to attend us. the manager was in a white suite, tall, and stout body appear ed in the scenario in the dark after some time making the situation more scary, we all have an eerie feeling at that time. But in the next morning the situation complete ly changed, the location was good , just 1km frm amritsar station. The staff was very friendly and the romms were cozy, clean and equipped with room heater as well. It was a nice experience. Only they can put some more man power during the late night, so tjat they can at least make the situation easyy for the tourists.

reviews.title: Horrible Room..NOT RECOMMENDED
reviews.text: I had booked 2 room(NAC),when rooms are allotted, toilet flush not working in both room,some bad odour coming from room, also lights are so dim. After quarrel with Manager, he ready to give AC room but with extra charge.Its too late in night so we have to give them extra money for stay. Even we are ready to checkout & told them give us NAC room for just keep luggage they ask 900/- for just luggage for half day..VERY VERY BAD EXPERIENCE..

reviews.title: Cathedral in the desert
reviews.text: They told us it was near the Golden Temple but it isn't, it's under a jammed overpass. No chance to park even a rickshaw to get your luggage out. Big rooms, big beds but such a terrible depressing place, a dusty and dirty cathedral in the desert. Nobody else was there apart from us. They were very proud of a big swing in the bedroom, we were afraid to hit into it at night time. The structure must have been nice and good ages ago. We stayed there one night and we fled away next morning.

reviews.title: Damn cheap Hotel
reviews.text: Its a very cheap and low grade hotel in amritsar. Rooms are very untidy and not even mailntained. Washrooms are also very dirty. Hotel staff is also not good and co operative. Food is also not hygenic of this place.

reviews.title: Average Property and the oldest one !
reviews.text: decent place with closest access to railway station, markets are close by, transportation is best by cycle rickshaw and economical, rooms are quite spacious, amenities are good, food quantity is a lot too much, location is besides bhandari bridge...

reviews.title: Below Avrage
reviews.text: Please check noise of Air Conditioner and Flush before check in. I have face the problem even after changing the room. Most interesting thing. Hotel has no mannu but they served as per your order very funny.

reviews.title: we got out early!
reviews.text: Very cramped and noisy. Shared toilet and shower in the same room, so if someone was having a shower you couldn't go to the loo. The decoration wasn't particularly nice and the walls were very thin. My daughter and I had enough and we got out early. The price of it is definitively not worth it. I think, the worst thing of this "hotel" is the shared shower and toilet!

reviews.title: The Ebury House: Nice Hotel and Great Location
reviews.text: We stayed at the Ebury House Hotel at the end of March 2004 for five nights. We had a triple room en suite and had a very pleasureable experience. The hotel is situated in a perfect location close to the Underground and in a very safe neighborhood. The room, as in most European b&bs, was small but very accommodating for our needs (a double bed with a set of bunk beds). A hair dryer was provided, which was nice that we did not have to use electrical adapters. The breakfast was satisfactory. The hotel staff was very courteous and hospitable. We will most definitely stay at the Ebury House again on our next visit.

reviews.title: London trip
reviews.text: This hotel was booked by my friend. Its in a Lovley English type Street. Easy to find as near Victoria station. The bedrooms are compact.especially the ensuite.no hand towels provided. But extra bath towels available on request.no phone in room or hairdryer. Room I was in was 21 on top floor in there other buildings nxt door..too many stairs.plus with small window and very warm.no fan or air con.it was very clean. This area was very noisy in morning.even on Sunday. With builders. As alot of homes getting work done.location is what this hotel is ideal for.would stay again because of this reason.plus lots of restaurants and pubs around this area plus discount coupons provided for local restaurants.

reviews.title: Not a good choice.
reviews.text: This house is now being managed, along with several other houses on Ebury Street, under Belgravia rooms. I posted a review under Collin House on this website that would be applicable to Ebury House, as they are now both managed by the same people. In summary - you don't want to stay here.

reviews.title: Budget but great location
reviews.text: Hotel is cheap (for London), location of the hotel is great & the street quiet. Management is not particulary friendly but they're polite and try to meet your needs. We stayed in a twin ensuite room - the room was budget but OK. Some niggles - like a broken lamp half hanging from the wall, paper thin walls next to the stairs, the toilet had cracks in the rim which had gone green and the tiny plastic ensuite only has enough warm water for one shower. If you can, ask for a double room as I think these are in better condition. The breakfast room is nice but the English breakfast is vegetarian. Overall just be aware this is a budget hotel - you get what you pay for and no more.

reviews.title: Great friendly clean place
reviews.text: We stayed at the Ebury House Hotel in June 2005. I booked the B&B via internet, but also phoned them, and had a chat with the person in charge. She was very kind, and we looked forward to our stay. Upon arriving we had to wait 10 min. till our room was ready, but we where perhaps a bit early, so it was ok. The staff was very kind and normal, Im writing normal, because I have read many times in this forum, that sometimes people who work at hotels, seem strange and unwilling, and unable to understand anything :-) Our room was up quite a lot of steps, that was a bit narrow. But thats how most b&bs are in London, so that was expected. It can be difficult to drag all your luggage up, so its not for the less able. Though there also is a room on the ground floor. Anyway the room was nice and clean. The bedding a bit on the old side, which I mainly gathered from the colours of them, that was fashionable a long time ago. But it was all very clean. And so was the rest of the B&B by the way, the hall and the breakfast room. We got fresh towels every day, and a cleaning of the room. The bathroom in our room, was very small. It had zink, toilet and shower. It was all contained in one big plastic room, that had been fitted into the room. Difficult to explain. It was small, but clean and it worked fine. The room had a small tv on the wall, and view out to the street, which was very quiet, even though there is only aprox. 5 min. walk to the Victoria Station. A very safe neighborhood. They will hold your luggage for a few pounds. In the breakfast room there was 5-6 tables. All very clean, and quick service. The breakfast was cerials and eggs, beans, toast, juice, coffee and tea. You could basically get all what you could eat. It was no problem to order extra toast :-) We payed 75 pounds a night for a twin ensuite. But know that you can get it for 65 pounds in the Feb. So maybe the prices vary through the season. So all in all a great experience!

reviews.title: Very good location
reviews.text: We booked a twin room on the lower ground floor and it was very spacious. Very clean too. Great tea and coffee making facilities too - believe me you don't always get these at some London hotels. 3 minute walk to Victoria station and coach station. Staff friendly and helpful.

reviews.title: Never going back there again.
reviews.text: Being a young traveller from Asia, it was my first trip to London with a friend. I had a tight budget so I opted to stay here. As soon as I got in the hotel, I immediately regretted my decision. The receptionist, who greeted us arrogantly was least helpful to us because we checked in before the usual check in time, because we were travelled all night from Scotland via National Express bus, and had no where else to go to freshen up. We were not let in to our rooms, acceptable but the behavior we received from him was horrendous. However, he did let us keep our luggages at the reception. Coming to the room, I was placed on the top floor of the hotel where climbing the narrow, small stairs were simply hectic. the room had two single beds, as we requested and was very small.. Acceptable for a hotel within this rate, but the bathroom was a joke. They were so small, that even airplanes have bigger toilets! The bathroom door also had no lock. I plan to visit London once again, and this time I'm staying at the Premier Inn, where I should have gone in the first place.

reviews.title: No thrill no fuss hotel
reviews.text: I've got the cheapest room for one night. Didn't expect much but a bit more cleanliness especially the walls will do wonders with the place. Shared bathroom clean but only one on the first floor and a toilet on the ground floor, not impressed. Top points for location, 15min away from Victoria Tube Station, not bad.

reviews.title: Would try elsewhere
reviews.text: Just needed a 1 night stay - good location in London. However, staff provided terrible service. While waiting over 25 mins for someone to arrive at reception, staff very unfriendly/arrogant when arrived. No apology offered for the wait. Very unreliable service as other guests had bags locked in reception and had a train to catch. Room very very small. TV did not work.

reviews.title: Should have gone to the Premier Inn!
reviews.text: Sleepless night on very uncomfortable and stained bed, broken bedside lights and spotlights. Corner portable toilet/wet room was smelly and dirty. Dust and cobwebs all over including around the mouse trap! Room only deal no breakfast facilities at the hotel. Need we say more! If we hadn't arrived so late and needed to get up so early in the morning we would have tried to find somewhere else.

reviews.title: Do Not Choose Unless You Prefer Location!
reviews.text: It situated in Belgravia, just 10/15 minutes walk from Victoria. Big Ben can be reached on foot in 20-30 minutes and 10 minutes by transport. The location is very catchy but the hotel is very terrible. The Asian receptionist (Probably Pakistani or Indian) is such an ill-mannered, imprudent and moron person and does not have any idea about how to talk to people.

reviews.title: Good Value
reviews.text: This is not the Ritz but it is extremely convenient. being very near Victoria Station and an easy walk to Buckingham Palace. Breakfast is not included but there are lots of places to choose from close by and 2 of those offer discounts for guests of the hotel. The staff was friendly and helpful. Our room was recently renovated with fresh paint and a new laminate floor. Definitely an excellent value for basic accomodation.

reviews.title: Great location!!
reviews.text: We had a 4 night stay. Very small room with a double bed and bunk bed. Bunk bed needing to be replaced, the wood is splitting and it has been taped up. Mattress on double bed in need of replacing as well. The location made up for the beds. Very close to bus and train station and great breakfast cafes.

reviews.title: very bad experience
reviews.text: We stayed 4 nights and we had a very bad experience. All the management staff of this hotel should be fired immediately, they do not have any experience and no desire to be in this business. Their business licence should be immediately cancelled and this hotel requires to be closed immediately. It's total rip off. Stay away from this hotel, surprised to see that local government is allowing these kind of crooks to be in the business.

reviews.title: Good budget place
reviews.text: Came accross this place on booking.com. Got it at a great price. It was pretty basic, but had everything I needed and it was clean. Which is very important to me. The room and bathroom was really small, however for that price, I thought it was good value for money. It's one street over from Victoria Station, and close to a bus stop, so I didn't have to walk to the station with all my luggage. There are restaurants and a Sainsbury local on the adjacent street, so you can get food quite easily.

reviews.title: Airplanes have bigger bathrooms
reviews.text: was it the heavy cigarette smoke aroma that permeated the room - including the bed linens or the Barbie House of Dreams-sized bathroom. Entrance to the bathroom was barred partically by the protrusion of the sink so to get to the toilet, it required a deep knee bend and some fancy pivoting. Said toilet was postioned mid way into the shower which only dispensed a trickling of icy water. No phones in bedroom. cot like beds; I am 5'5" and my ankles protruded over the end. Depressing basement dining for Breakfast only. Dreadful egg accompanied by two heapings cold canned baked beans and canned stewed tomatoes. they should rate it as a hostel, not a hotel.

reviews.title: Nice little place
reviews.text: I stayed at Ebury House years ago. It looks by the pictures that they have updated it. It was small, but clean and comfortable and close to everything. The bed was comfortable, the breakfast was good. I didn't notice any issues other than my toast being a bit burnt in the morning. Was a lovely little place with an interesting history, would stay there again.

reviews.title: Good Location
reviews.text: Great location, walking distance to Victoria station. The room was very small, but it was clean, as was the washroom. The wifi was not included and cost £10 a day. There is no elevator, and so I had to carry my very heavy suitcase up several flights of stairs. Upon checkout, if you wish to leave your suitcase at the hotel, you must pay for that as well (£10).

reviews.title: great location, but otherwise poor
reviews.text: our room was very small and not the cleanest. the first room we checked into had a plumbing problem (waste water from toilet coming up into shower) and so we had to change rooms. Seems plumbing is a problem in this hotel and some rooms have saniflow. on a positive note - staff were fairly friendly, low prices and great location for Victoria coach and bus station.

reviews.title: Comfortable...and cheap
reviews.text: I stayed here on a recent business trip to London because everywhere else seemed to be so expensive. I saw some places charging £500 for a night but this 'hotel' was only £129. However, for that you only get the basics. The room was OK - in the basement of a building just round the corner from Victoria Coach Station - so quite central for everything although further than I had hoped from the river. I kind of expected a proper hotel but this is a selection of rooms in a number of different building. The room had a double bed with duvet - not much to write home about - and a sink/cupboards. It was a shared bathroom which I found to be a bit disquieting but the bathroom was just down the corridor and in the end I think I was the only one using it. The view out of the window was pretty basic - the janitor's office/cupboard at the bottom of the stairs from the street where they stored all the rubbish. I wish I spoke Russian since the janitor seemed to take a lot of phone calls in Russian while I had the window open! It was quite warm in central London that day. There was no breakfast but the hotel had arranged for a 10% discount at two local cafes. Victoria Station, Victoria Place and the surrounding streets had plenty of places for food and drink to be bought. Good place especially if you don't want to pay exorbitant prices during Wimbledon fortnight!

reviews.title: Disgusting - AVOID
reviews.text: Checked for one night stay having found a discounted rate online. Check in desk did not seem very professional, staff not welcoming. Room was on top floor, bathroom 7 floors away! Room was small which I did expect, however the room was dirty, stains on bed and walls, door flimsy and did not feel secure. Pictures online are misleading. I got the impression this hotel is more used to having patrons who stay for less than one night. I did not stay as I did not feel safe. Upon getting a refund I checked into a nearby quality hotel. Overall experience was disgusting. Only positive was the ease with which I was given a refund.

reviews.title: Good for the price and last minute
reviews.text: We requested a double with en suite, but got a room with a double, a bunk bed and another single. The bathroom was outside of the room down a private corridor. The corridor smelt and the the floors aren't clean enough to tempt you to walking barefoot. For the price I can't knock it, it is usually the cheapest and being in a decent location, it is fine.

reviews.title: worst hotel ever do not stay
reviews.text: Very small series of rooms. Had single on the ground floor. Bed was ancient and lumpy. The pillows weighed a ton - due to all the dust mites and their faeces that will have accumulated there because the hotel is dirty. I had to make a pillow from a towel as the pillows made me feel sick. Stained bed cover, smallest mouldy bathroom, TV only worked on 2 channels. it was noisy with kids running around till midnight and a computer room.cupboard situated outside the door, so noisy i could hear keys being typed at 11.50pm and some stupid person reading tourists leaflets word for word, including the small print. i also had bites on my torso from what i presume are bed bugs or fleas. All for the sum of £99. i've stayed in better hostels in india for £5 a night! Call the authorities!

reviews.title: Ok for the money
reviews.text: I have just returned from a stay here, myself and 2 children. For £70 for all of us I can't complain and I try to be fair with criticism... In my opinion they've tried to fit too much in, the bathroom is shockingly small - I have honestly never seen anything like it, my face was over the sink whilst using the toilet! The sink was surely out of a dolls house. The 'kitchen' had a sink but no area to put clean dishes and had only 3 mugs in the cupboard and no small spoons at all?? Beds are uncomfortable and you can feel the springs through. On the upside it's central London for £15 pp - if you want luxury pay but I still think you can find better, it was also advertised as having a hairdryer and there wasn't one. No I didn't ask I couldn't be bothered. Nice reception staff tho!

reviews.title: Clean. Modern. Perfect Location near Victoria Station in London!
reviews.text: My family and I booked a quadruple room in the Ebury House for our London trip last June 2012. We were given our own keys for our rooms. NO elevator fro this building. The rooms were clean and equipped with all the basics. The ensuite bathroom is clean, although very limited in space. Upon check-in we paid our complete bookings and the receptionist was fairly kind as well. There's a sink, a microwave oven and mini refrigerator. The victoria station is very near where you can buy basics like water, food, etc, so you won;t go hungry in this area. Victoria station is very near which is why almost all the attractions in London can be easily reached. Almost all the hop-on hop-off tour bus stops stops there too. Ebury House is suitable for all kinds of tourists. Simple inn but equipped with all the basics a traveler needs. I might even try this place out again on my next stay.

reviews.title: Put me off staying in London
reviews.text: I thought that Pimlico would offer high quality accommodation for the price I paid, £129, and that the room (for 4 people) would be comfortable and spacious. But the room was small, with a tiny shower room attached. The bed was not comfortable and I skipped the Breakfast, which was DIY. For the same money I could definitely have found many better options.

reviews.title: Skip the Ebury House
reviews.text: Ebury House, London Review: We reserved the family room as we were three senior ladies. One of the bunk beds was so bad that all the spare pillows in the room had to be placed on the mattress in order that it was possible to sleep. They did put blankets under the sheets to protect us from the springs on the other two beds. Sleeping on top of the comfortor was an improvement. The wardrobe had one door missing. The night table had a drawer missing and one of the remaining ones front was falling off making it hazardous. When we pointed this out, they did nail it back on. The headboard on the double bed was disgusting--with holes and tears in it--it had been nougahide at one time--a long time ago. The shower door was an accordian type that was coming apart in several places. The toilet roll holder was on by one nail, which kept falling out all the time. We were also not thrilled with the breakfast. Although their ad says eggs plural fried or scrambled. We were only offered one fried egg along with tinned beans, a tinned stewed tomato, tinned mushrooms and a frozen potato something or other that went in the toaster. I notice they mention hot chocolate, but that was never offered either. There was juice, coffee, tea and toast. We did let the management know that we were very disappointed and they did reduce our rate from 95 pounds to 85 per night. The location is great. We did not want to spend our holiday moving around, so stayed on. We did try a b & b one block further on and found they had lovely accommodation for 70 pounds and a full english breakfast. We will keep them in mind if we return.

reviews.title: Good for budget
reviews.text: I booked this hotel/hostel for 3 people through booking.com it was £55 for one night. So it was good for the price of central London. It was 5 minutes from Victoria coach station, located in a housing location which is identical for a couple of streets. The receptionist changed every couple of hours. Our room wasn't ready at the time so we got another one for 5 people. A single, double and bunk beds which was fine by ourselves. There was a table, kettle when you came in. A small sink, fridge and cupboard on the other side (really small though). Then the bathroom was a small toilet and then shower like a closet. The windows were small but the area was quiet until at night where there was shouting and police sirens, didn't really sleep. The location was a walk away from Oxford street the main flagship stores of high street clothing (top shop, Zara, new look etc). As well as Burberry, Prada, etc. The main tourist areas Buckingham palace, Big Ben, river Thames, London eye, House of Parliament, tower bridge easily walkable from the hotel. You need an Oyster card/ or can travel with a day pass on the buses and underground around zone 1 where everything worth seeing is. Loads of restaurants of all cuisines around as well McDonald's, subway, Pizza Hut etc dotted around. Good price as all we wanted is somewhere to put our stuff and sleep when we got back.

reviews.title: Ok but wouldn't return!
reviews.text: Very good location which lured me in. Ensuite was very small not practical at all.Beds uncomfortable. I feel charging £5 per person for wifi is ridiculous also to save bags £2 per person seem alot. Seems as though ever little extra is encuring a charge me and my family will not return as for the price it is not at the standaed we would expect.

reviews.title: Good location but shame about hotel
reviews.text: Booked in for one night after finding a good deal online. On arrival not warmest, was booked in and given 3rd floor room in their next door section of hotel 102 Ebury Street. Entered room to find guests in their and room had been double booked. Went back to reception at 104 Ebury Street given alternative room this time in same building. It was a twin room that would have been better as a single given the size. No wardrobe, chest of drawers, bedside table or desk/dressing table. Just coat hooks on back of door and two hangers. The en-suite was a step of approx 12 inches and extremely tiny space. Shower cubicle door not fitted properly, shower took ages to get warm at best and did not function as you would expect. Window open looked like propped open with timber batton! Curtains didn't close fully and wooden floor meant you could hear guests in room upstairs which is not what you want late at night. Given the location about 5 mins walk to Victoria station and coach station the location is excellent but won't be staying there again.

reviews.title: A place to avoid
reviews.text: I just spent 4 nights at Ebury House. Horrible place. The staff at the reception is extremely arrogant, either ignoring you or being directly unfriendly. The room was ridiculously tiny even by London standards. The shower/toilet in the room, 10cm from the bed, was so small that we ended up using the common bathroom outside. We could hear every single noise from the neighbours in the whole house. And finally the hotel charges for eveything : wifi (5 pounds/day), adaptor (7 pounds) and even to store your luggage a few hours on departure day (2 pounds per luggage). All in all a hotel that I would NEVER recommend to anyone incl. people on low budget - it is simply not the money worth!

reviews.title: Wouldn't go back
reviews.text: This place is really basic and not kept up. It wasn't clean. The beds were old and uncomfortable. The breakfast was horrible even within the context of a British hotel breakfast. We tried it once and skipped it the other days. There are plenty of coffee shops around. The location is good (near Victoria Station) and the neighborhood is great. The Ebury Street Wine Bar across the street is really good for dinner.

reviews.title: Really good for families!
reviews.text: I stayed here with my mum two daughters and niece. We stayed in one of the large family rooms in the basement. It has a double bed and 2 sets of bunkbeds a bathroom with shower and a small equipped kitchen. This hotel was perfect for a hectic break in London, reasonably priced and only a 5 min walk to Victoria underground. It was spacious and cleaned daily. Thank you we will be returning!!

reviews.title: Sweetest owners ever.. loved our stay
reviews.text: I stayed with 3 other girls in the 4 person en suite bedroom on the first floor. We stayed a total of 7 nights.. and we loved it there. Of course it was a transition from our huge hotel/motel rooms in america.. but we were prepared for how the lodging is in London. I found the room to be super cute.. thebreakfast was filling and in a super cute dining room. What was the biggest highlight I suppose.. was the man and woman who ran the place. They were the sweetest people ever.. helping us with everything we came to them with.. and we came to them with quite a few things.. asking if we could change our reservation from one night to the next.. asking for an alarm clock.. asking him to keep a lookout for my luggage that would be arriving from the airport the next day as it didnt make my connecting flight. So many things we asked.. and they were friendly and accomodating.. very lovely people. I loved the location.. there were two cute places to eat a block away.. the travelers tavern and the Belgravia. The bus station and train station were right down the road.. we got a week long tube pass.. and never had to pay for a taxi or anything... If you visit london.. I would definately recommend staying here :)

reviews.title: Maybe not the worwst hotel I've been in, but pretty close
reviews.text: When I booked our twin ensuite room, I spoke on the phone with a very lovely young lady. I had seen the hotel in a guidebook which is usually very reliable, and the price was very good for London. We chose the hotel for the proximity to Victoria Station as we needed to be on the Gatwick Express early in the morning. Neighborhood was lovely (Belgravia) and safe. Short walk (15-20 minutes) to Parliment, London Eye, Westminster. Our problems started when we got to the front door. There was a sign indicating we were to check in next door at the Collin House. I went in to the reception area, where a young man told me I would have to wait as there was someone in front of me. Not a problem. However, I stood for quite some time and he did not acknowledge me again (except to introduce his mother when she came in). He was working on the computer, so I assumed he was checking rooms. I finally asked if I was in the right place to check in. He assumed I was wating to use the guest computer, why I'm not sure. After finally completing the check in process, i mentioned I was looking forward to speaking with the woman who had booked my stay. I was then told the reason we were checking in at the Collin House is that they have bought the Ebury House. We have stayed in London several times, so we are aware of smaller hotels, but this was the worst experience we have had. Beds were terrible, linens scratchy. Entire bathroom was a stall stuck in the corner of the room. You could barely turn around in it. Toilet paper holder broken, so tp sat on shelf behind toilet...almost unreachable. No soap in the sink. No hand towels. Curtains didn't close. Tv didn't work. Air freshener (Glade solid) was empty. Did I mention there was no heat? No way to turn the radiator up/on. I would not recommend this hotel.

reviews.title: One night is one night too many
reviews.text: This was not a hotel, but a building with rooms. My basement room was big enough for an elf. It was supposedly a double room, so that would have been for 2 elves. The cord from the hairdryer wasn't long enough to reach the mirror in the cupboard that was the bathroom, (yes that's right - a cupboard with a sliding door!) It was in the basement, so no view although the neighbouring garden could see in as they were higher, but the curtains wouldn't meet in the middle, so I had to improvise with a hair grip. You have to pay £2 if you want to leave your bags. I could go on . . .

reviews.title: Just great! Will look here again!
reviews.text: I can't say anything bad about my stay. First I got a special offer of 31 pounds for one night. They put me in a family room: very large, massive TV, nice en suite bathroom and kitchenette (microwave, cutlery and crockery, kettle with tea and coffee, sink etc.). The heating worked really well and could be controlled in the room. Also the room was very clean. Good quality bedding. Location is great just minutes away from Victoria. The street itself is really pretty (well it's Belgravia). Staff were friendly and helpful. There is also a free internet terminal downstairs. There is a charge for leaving luggage but it's way cheaper than leaving it at Victoria. I will stay here again if I can get another offer like this one!

reviews.title: Amazing location
reviews.text: Recently stayed here with my family as love to stay in Belgravia, The hotel is perfect for an overnight stay , clean and comfortable and very good value. My son loved it as our room had bunk beds and thought he was on an adventure.parking is also free from 1 pm on Saturday and all day on Sunday which is a big saving .

reviews.title: Youth hostel experience-good enough
reviews.text: I was amused at the reviews I have seen on this hotel. There seemed to be mixed reactions. I felt it was nice enough for the type of hotel that it is - namely, a youth hostel type. I found out about it on the youth hostel website. I did think the rates listed were slightly misleading - it listed its cheapest rate as 25 pounds, when I got there they said the only room available was one for three people which cost 48 pounds. Plus there was a 1 pound plus charge for using my checkcard. It was on the 5th floor or a tiny row-house type building so I had to walk up 4 flights of steps. Neverthless it looked nice enough. It apparently is under new management and has been renovated recently - looked like it had a new paint job. For my purposes I think I am just as happy to walk up since I can do it and I feel more secure that way. They had a bathroom on each floor and there were three small rooms on my floor. The other two rooms filled up - I think one of them may have had their own bathroom. The people I saw seemed very nice. The bathroom was small but adequate. However when I took a shower the water was only lukewarm. The great advantage to this is its location - it is on the next block from Victoria Coach Station and a couple of blocks from Victoria Rail Station. As I understand that London is very pricey I suppose it is a good buy considering. All I wanted was a place to spend the night as I was leaving early next morning and for that purpose it was adequate. They did not include breakfast but Victoria Coach station has lots of fast-food type places inside the station-I especially recommend the ham and cheese pasty for 1pound35. Also there is a small grocery store beside the station. If I go to London again I probably will try something else but it is good to keep in mind in case I need an inexpensive place to stay next to the station.

reviews.title: comfortable stay, close to victoria station
reviews.text: this hotel was pretty good, stayed in a studio room. modern and basic. the bathroom was clean and up todate. i like the big mirror in there. the shower was okish. wished the water pressure was abit stronger and hot water wasnt a problem. one glitch, all the lights went out as a fuse blew but wasnt a problem was fixed in an instant and my other problem was the heating wished you were allowed to turn up the heat but you couldnt as it was set to a certain power level.

reviews.title: To Misquote Arnie"I will NOT be back"
reviews.text: This should not be called an hotel rather a series of rooms. Was on 4th floor - no lift and very narrow stairs and difficult to manage even with a small case. Met a disabled man and his wife trying to get up to 3rd floor and they said they had specifically asked for ground floor! The room was attic shaped and barely room to move around bad small bed. The TV was angled so not really visible unless you stood leaning against the wall! WIndow wouldn't shut but luckily it was a warm night. The bathroom!! It was terrible-toilet needed to be flushed when I arrived. Taps were loose and had unmatched tops . Only ONE towel slightly bigger than a hand towel. No Bath Mat but was not tempted to have a shower. Light cover in bathroom missing so bare bulb. Soap was a bottle on sink. I think this was once part of a bigger room as when someone walked in the room in front on 4th floor I really thought they were right beside me! No breakfast but cost was high for what I got 119 sterling.

reviews.title: A Great Place to Stay
reviews.text: Just returned from a week in London and stayed at the Ebury House. This is a nice, budget B&B in a fantastic area of London and on a residential street, so it's fairly quiet at night. We stayed in two different rooms: the first was a twin (2 twins) and the second a double. Both rooms were very small by American standards and the bathrooms were hysterically tiny! (We looked into another room on the second floor that overlooked the back garden, and it was larger as was its bathroom.) But we knew all this before we went and were not surprised. Also, we didn't visit London to sit in our room! We found the beds to be comfortable enough. The breakfast is decidedly NOT gourmet, but it is satisfying: warm and filling. The tea was wonderful. The management is very friendly and helpful. We received a really warm welcome. They try very hard to make everyone's stay as nice as possible. We stayed for seven nights and paid 60 pounds a night, a fabulous price for London! Please remember that this is a small, budget hotel. For the price, it is an exceptional value: decent breakfast, ensuite bathrooms (in some rooms), marvelous location in a quiet area, clean towels and bed made each morning, and a caring and friendly staff. What more could you ask? Overall, we were really pleased and would most definitely stay there again.

reviews.title: Okay..
reviews.text: It was fine for a weekend in London. Nothing special. They had comfortable beds and a clean room. The room was tho on the first floor and really badly isolated. So you could hear through the walls to the reception pretty clearly. The bathroom was shared, but not occupied that often. Close to the Victoria station, so easy to get to the underground. I think they changed name tho..

reviews.title: Value - But get the downstairs room for 4 people
reviews.text: Pretty sure this is the hotel we stayed at... But when booking if you book directly on their website you can get a room for about 15-20 pounds which is a steal! This isn't a hostel you get your own room, I believe unless they changed it. I last stayed here 2 years ago. When my sister and I stayed, we lucked out because they were over booked they gave us a downstairs room which had 4 beds in it. 2 bunk beds and then a queen in the middle. It did get a little noisy in the morning when people were picking up trash but we didn't have to share a bathroom. At the upstairs floors you do. If you want to stay at a hotel in london, there a bunch in Belgravia - I like the premier inn in Victoria - Its central and safe, but if you like a deal then these places are better. I mean who goes to london to stay in their room? Your out all day sight seeing then you nap - Then club all night! This spot is great for if you want to be central and get a bus to picadilly circus or someplace else. I'd stay here again - But I would pay the extra money for the larger room. The room is also walking distance to Victoria Coach Station. If you book your trip right get your flight the LHR, Stansted, or Luton and then get on a coach get off at victoria coach station and stay at this hotel! Hotel staff was also really nice and helped me and my sister with our bags - They also let us store our bags while we went to ireland for a few days for free! I think they normally charge 2 pound a day for this!

reviews.title: Anywhere but London this would be terrible
reviews.text: The staff were friendly and helpful but the room - on the fourth floor (no lift) - was tiny and airless. Located just under the roof, the room was very hot and, with no ventilation, rest was not an option. There are essentially no amenities here but the hotel is well placed near shops, bars and restaurants. There must be some kind of 'please smoke as much as you like' policy, as you are aware of cigarette smoke all the time. The TV had an odd and very limited selection of channels and the bathroom offered a prime example of the dreadful shower technology so prevalent in the UK. I was glad I was only staying one night and it did seem very expensive for what it was but with most central London hotels charging criminal room rates, this is an OK option. The only real advantage is its location and, at that price, I'm not sure there a great many alternatives.

reviews.title: Small price, small room, Great location
reviews.text: If you are looking for a very good location in London, 5 minutes from the Victoria bus and railways station and tube/subway, and you want to go cheap with breakfast, this is a good option. Rooms are small but with LCD tv. Bathrooms are those plastic pre-built ones. Do you mind? I just had a quick shower, breakfast and ...gone to enjoy London!

reviews.title: It is what it is, for the price
reviews.text: I had two nights here for £64, a decent price for that location. Anyone expecting a hotel/hostel will be disappointed, it is more like a BB. The street is pretty and the rooms are typical of London apartments in that area, though quite small. I would have put a 4 stars had the shared bathroom not thrown me off. There was no toilet tissue and it looked like having not been cleaned for ages. What a waste, if cleaned properly the bathroom would be actually quite large and lovely. Also the walls are very thin so you can clearly hear water flowing inside (all the time), and people walking in the corridor. Light sleepers really shouldn't choose this hotel.

reviews.title: OK for a one night stay
reviews.text: Staying in London for one night to go to a tennis match. This hotels best selling point is its location. It is round the corner from the Victoria bus station and less than 10 minutes walk to the train station. Plenty of cafes and restaurants in the area. We had a room on the fround floor with 2 single beds and a bunk bed squeezed in. It also had its own shower room. Both were clean, beds were comfortable. Room needed some TLC, half the lightbulbs were out. Door missing off the cupboard. Receptionist on arrival was helpful and friendly but the other 2 we saw the next day could have made more of an effort. You can leave your bags here for the rest of the day on checkout day, handy if your bus/train departs later in the day. Charge is £2 per bag. Bags are left on shelves opposite reception and no receipts are given so anyone could come in, say they had left a bag and take whichever they fancied. If you want cheap, clean accomodation for a night or two this would be fine, just dont expect too much and you wont be disappointed.

reviews.title: friendly management, good location, smallest water closet on earth
reviews.text: Give the prices of London hotels and the horrible exchange rate, this was the best deal we could find in town. The location is excellent, close to victoria station and major buses are all about an 8 minute walk away. The street is very typical London architecture and is in a very safe area. We were able to walk to some major sights in about 20 minutes. The manager was very nice, let us use the phone and helped book tours. The breakfast was good, they'll substitute and are willing to accomadate your tastes. One tip though: if you are over 100 lbs. and you are staying in a room with a private bathroom or water closet, you will have trouble fitting into the bathroom. It is literally about 4ft. x 4ft., when you sit on the toilet your face will be up against the door. Everytime you turn around, you will knock something over. Bottom line, if you can't afford anything better, this is a good deal!

reviews.title: Not fit for Hobbits or Dwarfs
reviews.text: We did not have the room we reserved. but were put in a 5th floor room with a bathroom that was so small that you could not shut the door. The head board, door lock curtain rail and loo flush were broken. We were told on Saturday that there was a 25% discount in a nearby cafe as they did not do breakfast but the cafe was not open on Sunday. Good location and clean sheets, but very expensive for the facilities.

reviews.title: Modern and comfy but minimal frills
reviews.text: The room was spacious and comfortable and for once they had a modern TV which was really good. Walls a bit thin. The little extras were spartan to say the least. Ultra cheap soap and shampoo. Not even a wine glass. Front desk service is minimalist but they did give me a refund when I had to check out a day early, so brownie points for that. Worked quite well for my needs and budget.

reviews.title: We'll stay again
reviews.text: Great price, clean room and well located for town. As it was winter, we didn't get to make use of the pool, but the kids were rapt to be there. Town wasn't far up the road. And it's near to Kids Town, too. There's a MacDonald's next door and a Subway about 100m away. It's walking distance from the large park that's adjacent to the town centre.

reviews.title: Challenge Shepparton competitor
reviews.text: We opted for the budget room. It was clean and very close to the event that we went there for I have rebooked for next year to stay again. Very friendly staff and close to all the eating places. Thanks

reviews.title: The small things matter
reviews.text: If you read my reviews you'll see that I'm not all that hard to please. This seemed promising; location ideal for the purpose of our visit, refurbished rooms, photos looked good. So? On first glance, all was good. Room nice, bed comfortable, heating efficient and quiet, spa bath clean. Then I started to notice the problems. I don't know who did the grouting around the bath, but it was appalling; most of it had fallen out. There was nowhere in the bathroom to hang towels, though you could see where there once had been. There was, however, a flat screen TV in the bathroom...it didn't work. It seems as if, when they refurbished, they went for the flashy stuff (huge flat screen TV in the room) and just hoped like hell you wouldn't notice the corners that had been cut elsewhere. So, would I advise people not to stay here? No. On balance the place is ok. It is not expensive, it's quiet, the location is pretty good. Just remember, you can't always go by the photos in the brochures.

reviews.title: Nice place, not a king size bed
reviews.text: Lovely people, nice place. We had an apartment with a kitchenette. Decent sized bathroom and good shower ( we had no hot water but this was addressed quickly and professionally by the manager). "King" size bed was two singles put together with a big hump in the middle. Very uncomfortable beds. Unfortunately won't be back due to the bed situation. We were booked for two nights but checked out after one, couldn't have slept in the beds for another night.

reviews.title: Not bad
reviews.text: A nice cosy place with amineties to suit rooms are nice aircon heatpump and kitchenette with good appliances. Laundry facilities are good just did not find washing line tumble dryer is modern and works well. BBQ facilities around the pool are nice well kept lawns and garden. Only set back is the servicing of the rooms been here a week and room not done or sheets and towels changed. All in all not bad close to shopping and other facilities. Pricing is reasoable

reviews.title: could be better
reviews.text: Modern room , good bathroom tv and bed however the air conditioner leaked all night. When raised with reception the next day they were indifferent about it which was disappointing - and there’s no one there overnight.

reviews.title: Southgate Motor Inn
reviews.text: The hotel was easy to find being on a Main Street in Shepparton. It was a short wayboit of the center of town but within easy drive to eating places. Hotel is next door to MacDonalds restaurant which was great for a quick meal. Room was clean and new looking. It was all ground floor accommodation with a sliding door that opened up to a grassy courtyard area with a pool. Tables and chairs were available outside for use. There was tea, coffee, milk, biscuits and a fridge. TV , hairdryer at the office , heating and cooling. All in all it was a very restful place for our 4 night stay. Easy parking outside the room.

reviews.title: A chorus of fire alarms
reviews.text: Nicely appointed with a hint of deco the room size is very generous and the bed huge & comfy. Heater worked as did the water pressure and the towels a tad stiff. Reception nice and assisted with directions to near by Coles (10 min walk) also close by an Allens lolly outlet. The lake is nice for a morning stroll and has a cafe that trumps the included breakfast that you've no choice in I lucked out with coco pops & pineapple juice but companion scored cornflakes & tomatoe juice. Both our toast set of the fire alarms and noted some others did too. The rooms share a front & rear walkway so can be noisy. But with a neighbouring 24hr maccas (breakfast was taken here) it's fine for a one night business stop.

reviews.title: changed its name to Southgate Motor Inn
reviews.text: stayed for 2 nights, thought it was a bit expensive before getting there but there was a lot on that weekend so put it down to that, plus we were a travelling party of 2 adults and 3 young children. stay was decent enough until we went to pack up prior to leaving and found someone else's clothes in a drawer, along with prescription medication including a bottle of methadone. Told the receptionist who looked on the computer and found out the person who had stayed there, she told the owner who said they would call me 2 days later (still waiting the call!!). The manager rang after a message had been left for him, he had conflicting stories from the receptionist as to who stayed there and in which room!! He was apologetic but it seemed a forced apology and with little empathy for the situation given young children were in a room that had not been cleaned properly, and contained drugs that were dangerous to children. He offered me a free nights stay, but I stated I would not stay there again given the treatment we had received and the contents we had found in the room, when I mentioned I felt the treatment did not reflect the price we had paid he got angry and said this is what it is about money, he then hung up. The matter has gone to further authorities!!

reviews.title: Not equipped for cold winter nights
reviews.text: The rooms are nice and clean but there is only a thin blanket on the bed and no electric blanket. The only option is to keep the heater running which is directly over the bed making it noisy and uncomfortable with warm air blowing in your face. If this place at least had electric blankets I would have rated it a 4 or 5.

reviews.title: Quite Impressed
reviews.text: This was a quick overnight stay whilst on a road trip and we booked on-line prior to arriving at Shepparton. Initially I was a little concerned with the 3.5 star rating as in past experience have found the accommodation standards really seems to vary greatly at this rating and can be very 'hit & miss'. I can honestly say that South Gate Motor Inn was a pleasant experience. Obviously the place has undergone a major renovation and everything was quite new. The room/bathroom all modern, very clean and well presented. The rear of the room had a sliding door opening to a central yard around the pool - lovely! I thought it was very well priced (but we did book through an online accommodation site so not sure of discount %). If visiting again, we would be more than happy to stay again.

reviews.title: Good for an overnight stay
reviews.text: We had two twin share rooms at the SouthGate. The rooms were of a good size & we liked the way you could open the back sliding door to get to the pool area. If you have kids there is a McDonalds right next door.

reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.text: Quiet and very tidy facilities.would stay here again if we need to stop in Shepparton. The room / apartment was very well appointed and the housekeepers are to be commended on how clean the rooms were.

reviews.title: Great, spacious accom
reviews.text: My husband, 9 month old daughter and I stayed here on a two night stay in Shepparton. The 1 bedroom apartment room was larger than we thought it would be. We were easily able to set up a portacot in the living area and still have space to walk around. The walls had a few stains that hadn't been cleaned up but they were very, very minor. The kitchenette had great items for cooking. The bed was comfy, the location was a 10-15min walk to the lake. It's a great place to stay with a family and there's an enclosed outdoor area per room which is large. Supermarket/ Macdonalds can be walked to. The pool was empty which was a bit disappointing and we weren't notified upon booking that it was unavailable. I would definitely stay here on our next visit to Shepparton.

reviews.title: Drive past !
reviews.text: We had a shocking night here, you can hear every noise from the rooms next door and in the morning the staff are so NOISY they wake you up. Unfriendly service, not welcoming, we are here now and can't wait to leave. Will NEVER be back !!!

reviews.title: You can't judge this book by its cover
reviews.text: I stayed overnight in Shepparton, and found myself here as part of a "mystery hotel" deal. At first blush, the one-bedroom apartment seemed to live up to its 4-star rating. It looked modern, well-appointed and sparkling clean, and I began to doubt the bona fides of the Tripadvisor ratings I had read and shuddered at upon learning and researching the "mystery hotel's" name. However, soon the disillusionment began. So many corners had been cut for economy's sake - very poor quality shampoo/tissues, hardly any milk, no hairdryer (even though advertised as "4 star" hotel), phone broken, dirty bin under kitchen sink. A pity really, as it could have been so much better with more competent management.

reviews.title: Very comfortable place to stay
reviews.text: Overnight stay in this motel & I was very satisfied. The rooms are very spacious and have recently been refurbished which were done very tastefully. The A/C worked well on a very hot day. The continental breakfast was also very good value for money. There is a pool on site & the whole outside area was great, not that I had time to use it. Overall I was very happy with my overnight stay & will stay there when next going to Shepparton.

reviews.title: Convenient with comfortable beds and efficient air conditioning
reviews.text: The twin room we occupied was clean and comfortable. Beds were good with little traffic noise. The air conditioning coped well with the outside 44 degree temperature. The only drawback was the one chair [table & four chairs provided outside but weather too hot] and a cupboard door which had not been repaired.

reviews.title: Lovely Stay
reviews.text: Clean room, new facilities, complimentary breakfast, nice court yard, comfy bed, excellent service. I arrived on a cold raining night, reception was opened late till 10pm, stepped in to a warm (aircon & light was on) & clean room; complimentary breakfast for the next morning (toast, oats, cereal, milk, juice), jumped on the large comfy king size bed; all my stress was gone. The front door parking gave additional comfort. After bantering out in town the next day, I came back to a serviced room: new/re-made bed, breakfast for the next day, new (or newly folded) towels. Serious value for your money. I will be back for seconds and thirds for sure. Highly recommended. Thanks Southgate.

reviews.title: Lovely room - would stay again.
reviews.text: Lovely modern room, some little imperfections if you look closely but overall a nice place to stay. No do not disturb signs, so if you are dead to the world after a long trek beware housekeeping will open your door when doing their rounds. That said they do a great job in maintaining cleanliness. Watch out with kids in the pool area it gets slippery on the slate flooring. They were very good in providing a late night check in, for which I am most grateful for. Overall great room for price, pool area and shared patio that you can smoke on. Would stay again. Next door to 24hr McDonald's, short 10min easy walk to Kialla shopping centre, Coles, liquor land etc

reviews.title: Great For A One Night Stop Over
reviews.text: Lovely lay out and the room was clean and tidy. It was a public holiday so the manager left my key out for me, which I very much appreciated. Lack of electrical plugs for my work computer and slow internet were the only drawbacks.

reviews.title: Don't recommend for large groups
reviews.text: Management timed sprinklers in the BBQ area to be switched on around 6:39-7pm, dinner time. People hanging around grass got soaked. The gentleman preparing BBQ was being soaked, unacceptable. We had 6 rooms booked, one of the rooms had bed bugs and our friends were transferred to an apartment but that's not acceptable. Not recommended for large group stays even though the outdoor area is a great set out where you can all hang out together. We were warned at 6:00pm to keep noise levels low, even though it was New Years Eve because they had elderly people & young kids staying. Management should not have accepted our large group booking for New Years Eve. If it were not New Years Eve, we would have left.

reviews.title: Family
reviews.text: This room is absolutely gorgeous a double bed each all amenities at hand, staff very helpful and friendly. Spotless.Just out side of Sheparton township. Nice and quiet. Pool, spa the list goes on. Highly recommend this Motel.

reviews.title: Perfectly adequate for a one night business trip visit
reviews.text: This property is very easy to find and next door to Maccas (easy for breakfast!) and a km from the large shopping centre where there are supermarkets and food outlets. Being newly renovated it fees like new and had a well appointed kitchenette, courtyard and nice bathroom. Bed was comfortable and parking was at the door. Good value for money.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Have to say this was a hidden gem of a place. The rooms were clean and magnificently appointed. There was a separate living area and little kitchenette that allowed us to have an area to sit and relax. Highly recommended

reviews.title: Good service
reviews.text: We went to McDonalds to have a cup of coffee with raisin bread. Coffee was served extra hot as requested and raisin bread was hot when served. Wait period was very short and we had an enjoyable experience

reviews.title: Great Surprise
reviews.text: I booked a Mystrey Hotel on a Web site and scored this place. When I did my initial search on Trip Advisor and read teh reviews I was very worried that my wife wouldn't like it. Well when we turned up it was a newly renovated Hotel and when I saw the room, it was like a 1 bedroom partment with a seperate lounge and bedroom. So it was better than I expected. The only down side is the TV sorts of sits in wall cavity that seperates the room and so the sound travels from the lounge to the bedroom. it has a really nice outdoor seating area as well and then really nice green grass out to the pool. The renovation looks ok. Just a few minor things where they look like they have done it in a hurry. So for a one night stay it was great.

reviews.title: Could be excellent if.......
reviews.text: While a little bit away from town this tastefully renovated motel tries hard and I expect that people could get a great stay. But we had problems with a blocked sink. They quickly and politely changed us rooms. The next room however had a foul smelling bathroom which we put up with for 2 days. On the positive, its good value and they provide an acceptable continental breakfast and its well located to McDonalds and Subway and the highway. Good sheets and towels, a pleasant change from most small motels. Get the plumbing fixed and you will be on the right track. Look forward to seeing this next time we stay.

reviews.title: Lovely modern motel
reviews.text: Enjoyed our one night visit. Clean and fresh. Only couple and 11yr old stayed, would be great for groups as rooms backed onto lovely pool and BBQ area. Nice comfortable king size bed. Recommended gor all travellers. Good price too☺

reviews.title: Best and Quietest in the West.....
reviews.text: Our 2nd visit, and still very impressed with the friendly welcome service, the totally refurbished large room with King-size bed, spare settee and flatscreen tv also a spotless bathroom with largesize shower, Yes there was milk for the complimentry tea and coffee's.....plus .an outside nice clean swimming pool with bbq facilities, as well as a guest laundry. We liked the manicured garden area's and the wide "front-door parking. We received a "past-guest discount" and found the cost reasonable. With McDonalds just conveniently "next -door" and the centre ot town a few minutes away, we again enjoyed our stay- and will be back. Thank you, greg and jill {sydney-nsw}

reviews.title: Oasis
reviews.text: The internal pool space is a fantastic oasis and is a reL asset in summer. The rooms were all very modern and a comfortable stay. Breakfast is an odd affAir but does the job. The location is convenient to town and nearby to several restaurants.

reviews.title: Great price and great stay
reviews.text: First of all it was the price and the picture of the clean room attracted us to this accommodation. $125 per night for an immaculate room with two double beds is brilliant. The room looked over the garden towards the pool. We arrived an hour before check in, as we needed to freshen up before going to a funeral and it was no problem getting early access to the room. Every staff member I encountered was friendly, helpful and professional. My only two criticisms are the bottom half of the tv was blurry (I didn't mention it to them, so they had no chance to fix it) and that outside the rooms are tables and chairs and there were smokers two rooms down and the smoke flowed into our room. Not pleasant at all. However overall it was a great experience and as we have family in Shepparton we will be staying there again and encouraging others too as well. Oh and the best thing was that even though it was on a major road there was no road noise.

reviews.title: Not too bad
reviews.text: Stay here a fair bit as have family in shep-vegas can either be very quiet and peaceful or very loud it kinda feels like some rooms have thicker walls than others..keep in mind maccas is right next door and kids like to rev there engines and hoon about a bit.. Ok but could be better.

reviews.title: Only let down was reception's welcome or not so welcome
reviews.text: This was my second stay at this place... My first was roughly 3 years ago. The room is what you would expect for the money you pay... reasonable rates and reasonable room. Clean and tidy enough. The location is decent. We stayed in a Twin double room, two double beds enough for two adults and a child. We stayed 2 nights on a weekend and everything was fine. The visit started with check in staff. A blonde, unfriendly almost rude woman met me at reception, no smile or small chat, no welcome or even a chance for questions. Handed the key, swiped my credit card and told me to just drop off my keys in the letter box out front before 10am on check out day. When I got to my room I needed wifi, couldn't find anything in the draws so I randomly dialed 0 as no reception no. or stored no's listed on phone. The same woman I would say answered and sounded annoyed by my question of wifi password. Getting info from her was like pulling out teeth. I managed to get there and b4 I had a chance to even say thank you she had slammed the phone in my ear. All this aside, if you don't mind bad customer service/rudeness (my pet hate) then the place is otherwise decent. The pool was the highlight. My son and I had a great swim... perfect for the heat of Shepparton. Other staff dark hair woman with Tatts doing the room service/cleaning seemed nicer.... I would stay again, hopefully someone speaks to management (although rumour has it she's the owners wife) about customer service improvements...

reviews.title: Overnight stay
reviews.text: Good standard for the price. Room was nice and clean and well presented. Good facilities for those staying longer. No one from management on site overnight though which was a little odd. Only downside would be what seemed like really small bath towels.

reviews.title: Beautiful ! Didn't want to leave.
reviews.text: What a gorgeous motel.! Spotlessly clean ,such a comfortable bed , a roomy shower with lots of pressure . Very private location with sensible parking for all residents . Friendly helpful staff which was a pleasant welcome .. Fresh and clean in every aspect. Look forward to visiting shepperton again and without a doubt will stay at southgate .

reviews.title: Nothing special
reviews.text: I stayed here for 1 night. The room was clean and comfortable and new or refurbished feeling. The location was a bit noisy. Breakfast was included in the price, however it was quite ordinary with cereal, juice and white bread for toasting delivered the night before. Wifi was not included which was disappointing.

reviews.title: Available for bookings but closed!
reviews.text: Coming through Shepparton at 10:30pm. Had a look what was available on Wotif. This place was, so I called in. When I got there it was closed. Pressed the contact button and spoke to someone who said no after hours bookings! Very glad I didn't book through the web!Annoyed to make the trek across town for no reason. Get your info consistent and accurate!

reviews.title: Clean & very well appointed room, friendly team.
reviews.text: I have now stayed at this motel several times & keep going back, friendly team, love the country feel, clean, very comfortable beds, being able to see out the room over the pool, able to sit outside & very good pricing. Whilst no restaurant, there are many eating place in Shepparton or McDonalds & Subway beside. They do cook a very nice breakfast.

reviews.title: Quality Stay
reviews.text: Stayed here for 4 nights on a recent work trip to Shepparton. Almost hidden behind a row of shops and a few km’s outside the CBD. I found this to be a very clean, comfortable and reasonable stay. Will definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Clean and comfortable Bargain
reviews.text: My partner and I stayed here for just one night on a Mystery deal while visiting Shepparton. We both found the place to be very nice and presented well. It is a new modern apartment. The position of the TV was a good idea, where it can be switched between the bedroom and the lounge area, which was handy. The bed was comfortable and we had a good nights sleep and we did not hear any street noise. There are adequate kitchen utensils for 4 people with it all tucked away in the cupboards. A bit of salt and pepper in the shakers provided would have been nice though. You will need to take oil if planning to use the fry pan as we did. The room we had opened out onto a private courtyard which is enclosed for security, this is great if you have small children. Beyond the gate is the BBQ area, grassed lawns and a fully enclosed pool and kiddy pool. Overall we were happy with this facility. But ask if you can have a room separating you and the next room as the walls are very thin and you can hear the voices in the next room very well.

reviews.title: Impressed
reviews.text: This motel I cant rate high enough not many motels are not children friendly this one is. The staff so efficient and helpful feels like my second home I have stayed at 4 motels in Shepparton this one is simply the cleanest the beds so comfortable room for kids to play special thanks to Linda for making me feel welcome everytime I stay with you Kind regards Debbie MC Comb

reviews.title: Something not quite right
reviews.text: We booked this accommodation to break up our trip home. The room appeared nice as we walked in. But we just were not getting very good vibes about the place. It didn't seem finished. The bathroom had some random panel just stuck on the tiles, it was as if there wasn't enough space for it so they went stuff it, we will just stick it on here - no one would notice. The shower screen was also fastened with sticky tape. I always like to do a 'bed check' before I get into a bed, wow this was terrible. I don't believe the sheets were clean they were really soft/warn in - not 'crisp' like other hotels. The area of the hotel is NOT quiet - it is beside a 24hr McDonalds so everyone likes to go there at ridiculous times to get a burger and do burn outs. The person in the room beside us was running her own business with so many knocks on the door during the night. We got out really early the next day - I didn't sleep. It was a terrible stay, and we have learned our lesson!

reviews.title: Simply the Best in Shepparton at right price!
reviews.text: Gorgeous reception staffs! Well designed and furnished rooms. Good linens and bathroom amenities. Most important and cosy thing about this hotel is every room opens to lush green lawn equipped with BBQ facility and well designed pool. It's really sets apart from other Motel. You can sit out, relax, enjoy your drinks and meals!

reviews.title: Quiet, clean and comfortable room
reviews.text: We had a 3 night stay in a standard room. Very impressed with the quality of service and exceptional cleanliness of our room. The central pool is clean and has a pleasant atmosphere. It is a popular motel for families. Additional powerpoints in the room would be a good improvement.

reviews.title: Renovated, but still tired
reviews.text: Motel appears to have been recently renovated, however cleaning has not kept up to the renovations. Room looked okay at a quick glance, but the noticed things like coffee cup rings on the bedside table, dust and cobwebs in the corners. Outside in the courtyard, communal ashtrays had not been emptied for several days and sachets of coffee & sugar littered the pathway. Main bed was okay, though my son said the sofa bed was very uncomfortable. Could hear the next door McDonalds drive though speaker from the room and could also hear what was going on in the room next door.

reviews.title: Good for a nights stay.
reviews.text: Clean, quiet, only a few minutes drive from the city centre. Continental breakfast provided, cereal, sliced bread and raisin bread to toast, milk and two bottles of juice - very filling. Had dinner at RSL and it was well priced, huge portions. Would stay here again if passing through.

reviews.title: Clean well appointed Motel
reviews.text: This is a comfortable, clean well appointed & well priced Motel, which is close to town facilities. Whilst it does not have a restaurant there is many eating places near by. The door into a courtyard makes it a pleasant place to sit & relax. Nice breakfasts. Stayed here several times on business & will return.

reviews.title: Bad position
reviews.text: Had a booking here once I found it no way was i staying there was to far from anywhere and built in with other businesses on a wet night the only place you could eat is McDonald's wasted my money but found a great place the courtyard motel

reviews.title: Not too bad
reviews.text: The bed was comfortable and the pillows were too. Not walking distance from town but right next to Maccas if you like that stuff. Better to book online as the lady told me they were out of standard rooms so I booked online and there were plenty. Wifi was very very average and was hard to get onto your phone. Had to download an app. But still didn't reach the end rooms and ended up on 4G. No goodies in the bar fridge either. Ok stay, but just the norm.

reviews.title: New is not always a guarantee of quality.....
reviews.text: Booked on last minute.com. If sleep is not important to you then you may find this accommodation acceptable. We could hear EVERY noise from the room next to us.....from periods of "intimacy" then to listening to them each showering, to moving furniture around to their plans for the following day. I came for relaxation, but I would have been better saving my money and staying at home. Very disappointing. Will share my experience with my travel clients.

reviews.title: Lousy Customer Service
reviews.text: I also had problems with the Blonde woman on reception and had the same problems, very abrupt and doesn't seem to have an interest in the customers needs. Price for 2 nights was $220 and I asked if any discounts for pensioners or RACV Members, told bluntly no that's it. She accepted payment by debit card and handed me the key, told to put the key in outside box when leaving by 10AM. No mention of breakfast or any other facilities. I went to the room and found it smelt of smoke and the vinyl on the couch was peeling off. I had to get the water for a coffee from the ensuite which didn't really impress me, and the light room was very dark. I decided not to stay that night and put the key in the outside box and then rang the next morning to cancel my stay, and was told seeing I hadn't given them 24 hours notice I would lose the $220 I had paid. I would strongly recommend that people find another Motel in Shepparton where they care about customer service, DEFINATELY NOT A PLACE I WOULD RECOMMEND FOR PENSIONERS.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I stayed at this Motel last week and was very disappointed. My booking could not be found when I arrived, I was given no instructions on how to pre order breakfast and the lady at reception seemed very disinterested. I felt like I needed to apologise for disturbing her. The accommodation itself is basic but clean enough.
