My booking included breakfast however, by 8 am when reception was still not answering the phone I left. In the end the breakfast part of the package was not eaten.

reviews.title: Good location and facilities. Recommend for families.
reviews.text: Stayed for four nights in a Delux Suite. Large double bed and roomy bathroom. All rooms back onto a large grassed courtyard with a very inviting fenced swimming pool. Sofa bed was handy for my grand daughter who stayed one night with me. Good quality linen along with good pillows and extra towels. Only criticism, the water pressure was poor and no microwave.

reviews.title: 2 Night stay
reviews.text: This is a great motel . The room was very clean and had a decent size tv and king bed. The grounds and swimming pool area are extremely well maintained and the reception staff are excellent and very helpful. Will definately be staying again when we are down that way.

reviews.title: was intrigued with the bad reports after iv just stayed there for three weeks
reviews.text: where can i start. i had an apartment witch i also like to do the bed check and i found to be a new matress and my sheets where all new cause i noticed that the gouge truck was bringing them in and i asked the cleaner how they do there sheats.. so they must of clearly up dated there services sinces 2012. i didn,t think it was over priced cause i used my golden chain card witch alot of travelers have these days. the staff where if fact nice to me and would aid to my service if needed. i didn,t hear any crazy nose on the streets at all and after doing a drive around at night in the town. i found shepparton to be quite after 10 pm. the breakfast that was cooked for me in the morning was on time and the way i like it. the wash room was fitted with a new washing and dryind machine. and i had plenty of cupboard space with a fresh smell every day after i came back to my room after it had been made up.. iv enjoyed my stay. if it was summer time i would of most likely had a swim to. but that will have to wait to i go back down to shepparton in the summer time.... definately will stay there again

reviews.title: Standard hotel room
reviews.text: This hotel is advertised as being new. The room we stayed in must have been "new" a few years ago I think. I had booked online & was to get continental breakfast included, but didn't receive anything. As a previous reviewer has said it is nothing special, but it was clean and comfortable for a one night stay. We found it to be quiet so it must depend how close your room is to the road.

reviews.title: Long stay in Time Flies B&B
reviews.text: I really love the Time Flies B&B and the landlord. I planned to stay there only one month, but I decided to stay almost four months. From the beginning of November 2017 till mid-February 2018. The house is modern, very well furnished and located in a quiet area close to the promenade, the sea, the bus stop, markets, and restaurants. It's very clean and tidy. My aunt and my cousin came to visit me and they stayed in the room Time to Breath for some nights. They were surprised and happy for everything. I suggest to everybody to sleep in this beautiful B&B. If I return in Malta, I'll return there for sure.

reviews.title: Excellent bed and breakfast
reviews.text: We chose this bed and breakfast for my parents' 70th birthday trip. All I can say is that they loved it. They raved about the location, the beauty of Malta, the brilliant bus service (6.50 EUR for a week) but most of all they loved Time Flies. Their hosts couldn't have made them more welcome and even gave them a leaving gift. My communication with the establishment was brilliant and I was assured their trip would go smoothly. Highly recommended

reviews.title: Good in some aspects, poor in others.
reviews.text: My partner and I stayed for 5 nights at the end of a two week trip of Malta and Gozo. Of all the places we stayed, I'm afraid this was the weakest. A real shame as it does some things so well. However, it also did some things poorly (hence the average rating). The positives: the rooms, corridors and communal areas are immaculately clean. The interior design is bright and fresh too. The breakfast offered is also tasty (Roberto makes good fresh coffee). Lastly, Roberto gives beach towels for you to use (a nice touch I thought). The negatives: on arrival, Roberto told us that breakfast was €8 per day per person. This would have cost an additional €80 (a fee we didn't expect). When we showed our paperwork proving that breakfast was included (also, I'm sure a B&B means bed and breakfast!) he became a little confrontational and kept saying something to do with terms and conditions. I calmed the situation and asked if he could show me the terms later in the day (once we've both looked at them). He then didn't get back to us and we had to approach him regarding it. When he did get back to us, he said it was included. I'm afraid my partner and I both felt unwelcome by this situation. I think he is an opportunist and was trying to get extra money from us (even though we'd already paid €100 per night for a double room with a shared bathroom - not cheap). I still don't understand the confusion and how it wasn't included and then suddenly it was (he was just trying it is think). Also, the safe didn't work and it took 2 days for him to fix (a concern when you have passports, IPads etc). Lastly, we found him unpredictable in his mood. Sometimes friendly, other times unapproachable. To summarise a good, clean place with nice touches. However, it's missing some basic things (unclear on breakfast, poor customer service). It was relatively expensive too. My advice, stay elsewhere if you have the option to. Time Flies B&B - a good last resort place.

reviews.title: Our First Experience Of Malta
reviews.text: My wife and I decided to book "Time Flies" through Trip Advisor for a week in late October 2015. The B&B was immaculate, having just been throughly renovated/decorated18 months ago. Our beautiful room overlooked a small roof garden and had air conditioning and a daily maid service that made the bed, tidied up and changed the towels. There was free wifi, sometimes in the evening a little slow. The B&B is on the second floor of a complex but there is a lift should you need it. Breakfast was continental but the choice was extensive, various cereals, breakfast cake, croissants, selection of cheeses and meats, yogurt, and bread. There was teas available and small biscuits any time and a shared fridge should you need. We found the location perfect for us, the place was quiet but not to far from some very nice bars, restaurants etc. We bought a bus pass 21euro each on our first day and explored most of the island using this. Busses are frequent but often very packed. We were both pleased we chose a B&B particularly Time Flies on reflection as Roberto and Rosanna were friendly hosts that you could not get from a hotel. A lovely place.

reviews.title: Gorgeous place, gorgeous hosts
reviews.text: Time Flies is such a lovely B&B. Set in a quiet back street, you wouldn't know you were so near to quick bus routes to Valetta, and only a short walk to St Julians or Sliema. Rosanna and Roberto are very friendly hosts, and are quick to recommend places to see off the beaten track - great if you're on a budget and want to avoid the tour buses. And the breakfasts.... yum! If Roberto has made a cake, make sure you get some! I would recommend Time Flies to anyone, at ay time of the year, it's that good!

reviews.title: Time to breathe
reviews.text: Very nice B&B! We had some difficulties to find it at first, there was no sign at the outside. But the location was very central and near a bus-stop. Good breakfast and with very comfortable beds. The rooms was very nice and personally decorated. Beware of the dog - it bites!

reviews.title: Great little B&B!!
reviews.text: I just don't do reviews, but felt the need to comment on our 9 night stay (returned 11.04 .17) at Time Flies. Roberto and Rosanna made us feel so welcome from the moment we arrived. The B&B is in a quiet location close to buses and Roberto will arrange taxi transfers for you from/to the airport. The rooms are super, spotlessly clean and Roberto's breakfasts are not to be missed. If we were to go to Malta again we would not stay anywhere else. Best local restaurant we found was "Fresco's" which was 5 minutes walk away. Marilyn, Allan, Lin & Michael

reviews.title: CERTAINLY FLEW FOR ME
reviews.text: Located in a side road just off Tower Street at the St Julian’s Bay end of Sliema, this querky B&B is ideally placed for the Sliema waterfront, St Julian’s Bay, the buses into Valletta and the Sliema Ferry or indeed elsewhere on the island. Whilst the outside of the building is certainly not that special, inside you will find an immaculately looked after premises with a comfortable bed and a reasonable breakfast. As part of your booking ,the owner can arrange airport transfers @ E20 each way. The excellent TA reviews are completely justified.

reviews.title: Best B&B ever!!!!
reviews.text: I went to Malta for a wedding and stayed at time flies Malta. I booked an airport shuttle and even my flight arrived before schedule, the driver was already waiting for me. He brought me safe to the B&B where the owners (Rosanna & Roberto) welcomed me. They showed me everything. My room was really sweet and cosy and I had a hair dryer, a beach towel and a little back sack that I could use. They also have a little tea time area where you can have a cold water, tea or coffee and little biscuits all day long. Everything is VERY CLEAN and lovely decorated. The breakfast is wonderful! Apart from the usual "stuff" which is all fresh and nice presented, you also get Cappuccino, fresh orange juice and eggs, if you like. While Roberto was preparing the eggs etc. Rosanna and I talked about the wedding, Malta, how they got there etc. It was like having breakfast with friends. One day I woke up late and missed the breakfast, but even it was already 11 am, Roberto offered me to prepare a Cappuccino. That was really sweet! Thanx again! I would always stay there again, if I'd go back to Malta for holidays! It's such a lovely place and Rosanna & Roberto made me feel at home! Thanx for having me and for the great time we had!!! Hope to see you again!

reviews.title: Time Flies
reviews.text: Very nice B&B at a good and quiet location in Sliema run by a friendly family. The rooms are good and the breakfast is excellent. Roberto made fresh orange juice and baked some cakes daily for breakfast.

reviews.title: cozy stay in sliema
reviews.text: I stayed 2nights in single room. room was not so big, but quite clean and the interior was very very cute.I really liked it. The location is near bus stop. so for me this is valuable. Host family is friendly and they offered heartwarming breakfast. I recommend this Place to person who loves B&B

reviews.title: Now my home in malta. Reccomandable.
reviews.text: I spent 3 nights with my wife in this nice and small bnb just in the middle of sliema and near the bus stop , bus 12 - 13 , we were the first guests ever and the owners roberto ans rosanna were so friendly with us. The flat is modern and confortable. For sure is the place where i will back to sleep in malta. Bye from nicola and chiara

reviews.title: Time flies when you feel good!
reviews.text: I spent several days at ‘Time Flies’ with some friends, and really enjoyed my holiday and my accommodations. The B&B is situated in a quiet street near the coastal road, close to the main bus lines. The rooms are comfortable, bright, and relaxing. There’s a large common area including a sitting and breakfast room. Rosanna and Roberto, the owners, have made their B&B very charming. They are very kind and helpful people. Feel free to ask them all kinds of information about Malta- where to go, what to do, names of restaurants, shopping best places, museums, etc. This is also a good starting point to visit the other islands: Comino (with its ‘Blue Lagoon’), and Gozo. You’ll love your holiday here. I’m sure of it!

reviews.title: Great attention to detail
reviews.text: Had a lovely stay here. The polished modern presentation and unique clock decorations don't feel like a traditional B&B but the spirit is actually the same. Great room, bed and facilities, good and very personal breakfast. Fun, innovative presentation. Great location :-) I definately recommend.

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: My husband and I have just returned from a week's stay at this lovely B & B. The accommodation is immaculate and everything is like new. Every morning we got up to a beautifully prepared breakfast and a quick chat about our plans for the day. Although close to the buses, seafront and restaurants it was a peaceful haven to return to after a busy day sightseeing. Nothing was too much trouble and we would have no hesitation in recommending the B & B. Thank you!

reviews.title: Best night in a hotel ever!
reviews.text: Everything was perfect. From the friendly welcome from our hosts to how beautiful and spacious the room was. We usually stay in an apartment as don't like how impersonal and stuffy even the most pricey hotels are, but this is a brilliant example of how renting just a room can work out well. It's a quiet street but close to plenty of bars and restaurants and a 10 min walk from the ferry to Valetta. The room is as good as it looks in the picture and immaculately clean. Thank you so much for making us feel so welcome!

reviews.title: "Time to be forever young"
reviews.text: It was gorgeous holidays in Time Flies in Malta! Highly recommend this B&B for accommodation when visiting Malta. Grazie mile to Rosanna, Roberto, Alessia and Shaki :) for warm reception! Miss my cute room and Roberto's pancakes for breakfast :) Hope will be back soon!

reviews.title: Location
reviews.text: Feels like coming home, best breakefast was excellent. Near buss stop , and best servic . Many restaurangs nearby , the host has many tips. You just Love this place. If I go to Malta agin this is the place to stay .

reviews.title: A great B&B
reviews.text: We stayed for 9 days at the Time Flies. Thr rooms were very clean and Roberto was very nice and forthcoming. He even got up early to prepare out breakfast before official breakfast time when we went diving. We had a great time in Malta!

reviews.title: Almost Perfect
reviews.text: We planned a trip to Malta. No one we knew had ever been there, so we had no "word of mouth" about what to do or where to stay. We found Timeflies B&B on Trip Advisor. The place turned out to be exactly as described. A small, perfectly located, spotless hideaway. Roberto sent a car to meet us at the airport. And it's a good thing he did because when the driver stopped and said, "we are here", I said where? The entrance is a non descript doorway on a bland street. But once you take the somewhat compact elevator to the 2nd floor, you walk into a clean and friendly room. Roberto and Rosanna greet you and give an old-fashioned key (not electronic) to your room. Our room was SMILE. Decorated in bright white and yellow, with odd clocks throughout, the room clean, good-sized and overlooked a small garden. The bed was quite comfortable and the bathroom was spacious, albeit with a unique shower stall. One small criticism - there were no tissues, no toiletries and towels had to be re-used for several days. And there were no bath wash clothes. The breakfast was fine everyone morning, including cereals, fruit, great bread and freshly squeezed orange juice. Roberto would make cappuccino or espresso or plain American coffer, as ordered. Personally, I wish breakfast varied a bit, but it was good and only a block away there are a dozen restaurants. Oh, and I need to mentioned the giant chocolate croissants - incredible, even if they were probably 100 grams of fat each. I would heartily recommend Timefiles B&B. It is in Sliema - not Valetta. But the bus system is easy to use and several stop 50 meters from the B&B.

reviews.title: Full Service in low Season
reviews.text: We spent 3 nights in this beautiful bed & breakfast. The service was AAA. The rooms, the breakfast area, the entrance, the hallway.....everything has a modern design and nicely follows the "Time concept". We were very happy with our room "Time to Smile". There are only a few things missing, e.g. an electrical Outlet in the bathroom, hygienic pouches for women maybe.....but this does not narrow the overall positive impression. Very important for us: erverything was very clean. We even got a wonderful breakfast, almost leaving no wishes open, although being the only guests during our stay. The b&b is located very convenient, with a public Bus station just around the corner. So what can we say, a perfect stay!!! We would like to thank Rosanna and Roberto for their warm hospitality.

reviews.title: Cozy Stay
reviews.text: We spent 3 nights in Time Flies B&B. Roberto and his family are lovely hosts. Shakira is a great host too. Our pick up and drop from the airport was amooth. Room was clean and i loved the decor. The breakfast is also good with fresh orange juice. Roberto was so kind to get up early one morning on request as we had an early cruise to catch. Very centrally located. Overall would definitely recommend it. If we are back in Malta we would love to stay here again.

reviews.title: Almost Perfect
reviews.text: We stayed at this B&B for 4 nights in May 2016. It is a modern and fresh acommodation, centrally located in beautiful Sliema. The room that we had called Time to Breath. It is a nice and spacious room with unique decoration, and it has a balcony! The bed was clean and comfortable. The owners were very friendly and informative. They can provide you with any information about your visit in Malta. The breakfast was great, prepared by the owner. However during our visit there was a problem with the internet connection, so it was slow, and on our second day the TV stopped working, until the end of our stay.

reviews.title: Immaculate property with wonderful hosts
reviews.text: We loved every minute of our 5 day stay at Time Flies. We were warmly greeted by Roberto upon arrival and were very well looked after throughout our stay. He even went out of his way to leave us some breakfast after official breakfast hours when we slept in. He also promptly offered us a firmer pillow when we enquired if he had any.This lovely little b&b is only a few minutes away from the harbour and there are many places to eat nearby. We also loved Roberto's little treats; biscotti, coconut sweets etc that he left out for guests to enjoy. We would strongly recommend visitors to stay at Time Flies to experience Roberto's wonderful hospitality.

reviews.title: The most perfect B&B I have ever stayed
reviews.text: I stayed at Time Flies B&B for 4 nights, and I could say that this is the most perfect B&B I have ever stayed! First of all, the location is very good. It takes you only 2 mins to the beach and bus stops heading to Valletta, and there are a lot of restaurants nearby. Because I was a solo traveler, I stayed at a room called Time To Be Forever Young which is totally comfortable, clean, and tidy with minimalist style which I totally like it every much. Their buffet continental breakfast was literally good and in high quality. There was a wide range of food you could choose; from just normal bread to homemade cake. Also, there is a tea corner with some biscuits available for you as well in case you are hungry at night. The owner (Rosanna & Roberto) are helpful, friendly and very nice; therefore, I felt like I was staying with my friends' house. I would recommend Time Flies B&B to anyone who plan to visit Malta, because everything's so perfect and you are not going to regret to stay here. I have had the best stay ever and will surely stay here again in my next return trip to Malta. Thank you so much Rosanna and Roberto :) <3

reviews.title: quirky
reviews.text: 3½/5 - very clean/freshly refurbished (perhaps twee/quirky to some), arranged pickup from/to airport, great breakfast, shower in bath needs grab rail, rooms stuffy/limited ventilation, some might find "remote" shared bathroom difficult to co-ordinate (because of "distance")

reviews.title: Weekend in Sliema, Malta
reviews.text: We spent 4 days at Time Flies B&B in Malta. Outstanding service, very nice rooms, at a good price! The breakfast, which was included , was also very nice, and included homemade treats, such as crepes and cakes. Nice interior, and very clean!

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: One of the best places I have stayed. Lovely and clean room, good location, free wifi, quiet but still easy access to main street with public transport, tourist info leaflets/map in room, cute dog Shakira, excellent and welcoming host, very good breakfast (including vegetarian choices and vegan cake!), Roberto even made cute small cakes for me to take when I left :)

reviews.title: Fantastic hosts that make your stay special
reviews.text: We stayed for 5 nights. The whole place is immaculately clean. Bedding crisp and white. The breakfast offers good quality foods. Lovely and quiet. Very convenient for bus service. A gem of a place. I was unfortunately unable to download the photographs I took of Time Flies but everything is beautiful.

reviews.title: The Best B&B
reviews.text: Thank you Roberto for a wonderful stay in your beautiful home You have really thought of everything that people need when they are on holiday The room was impeccable and could not be faulted in any way. The whole place gleams and shines and is such a pleasure to spend time in. We loved the tiny back pack with the blankets for the beach, the breakfast with your delicious cake was a treat each day, and your help with local knowledge was so greatly appreciated We could not have asked for more and were delighted with our choice of accommodation. Set just one minute from the sea front Time Flies offers a quiet, restful haven away from the main traffic an noise of the town of Sliema

reviews.title: Lovely stay
reviews.text: Stayed at the hotel for one day, but wish I could have stayed longer. It has most things you need, like WIFI and complementary water. Highly recommend, great design and location at a reasonable price. Being pet friendly is an added plus.

reviews.title: Just great !!!!!!!
reviews.text: We were 7 women and spent a whole week at Time Flies... superbe !!! We had the whole place (4 rooms) for ourselves. Rooms were very clean, nicely decorated, quite, spacious. Breakfast was all you need included fresh fruitsalad each day as well as a glass of fresh orange juice. Every day we came home from a long day visiting Malta, Roberto prepared us a can of fresh munt tea and some fresh baked coockies, nice suprise.... A lot of cosy restaurants in the neighbourhood... I would go back to Time Flies if I ever visit Malta again... Thanks Roberto and Rosanna for the wonderfull stay !!! Maybe check the Wifi, sometimes unusable

reviews.title: Beautiful Little Oasis
reviews.text: I stayed in Malta for a week in the Time to Breathe room. Roberto and Rosanna were such lovely hosts, and the space is really wonderful. Breakfast was fantastic, the room is spacious and comfortable, and the location is convenient for getting around the island (and I met a woman whom I know will be a lifelong friend, so what a nice bonus!). I enjoyed being on the water in Malta more than I enjoyed being on land, but when I was on land and at the Time Flies, I was content! Thank you!

reviews.title: Very refreshing!
reviews.text: This is a wonderful B&B. First of all, the location is very convenient whilst being on a quiet side street. Also, rarely have I stayed somewhere that immediately feels so homely. The owners are very friendly and were able to offer advice about places to visit and how to get there. The interior was clean, with plenty of personal touches that add to the character. There was a wide choice on offer for breakfast, including both tasty and healthy options. I would not hesitate to return!

reviews.title: A++++
reviews.text: This bed and breakfast is one of the best I have stayed in from all over Europe. Everything in the B&B is brand new and under 1 year old. The family was so, so nice and did everything they could to ensure I had a fantastic trip to Malta. Also, the freshly made breakfast every morning was perfect. I wish all bed and breakfasts were like Time Flies B&B! I will be back for sure. Highly, highly recommend Time Flies B&B!

reviews.title: Rafal & Dorota
reviews.text: We spent in Time Flies 14 nights on holiday. It is fantastic place. I recommended Time Flies B&B to everyone who like comfort quiet and excellent breakfast. The place is very clean (5star hotels can learn from them how to clean the rooms). From Time Flies everywhere is close . There is very good communications to Valetta Gozo or every part of Malta. It was great holiday unfortunately to short (only 15 days). We definitely will came back to Malta and Time Flies B&B. Thank you Roberto and Rosana Rafal I Dorota ,Liverpool

reviews.title: excellent accomodation!!!
reviews.text: this bnb is just amazing! we stayed there for a weekend trip in room "time to be yourself". there has been put a lot of love for details in the decoration and it feels like coming home, every time you enter the bnb... not at all the hotel/hostel atmosphere, just comfy and makes you feel relaxed from the minute you arrive... even though bathroom is shared you feel like being alone in the apartment. room was super nice, very comfortable bed and lovely decoration, with balcony shared with another room. bathroom as well beautiful and always clean. breakfast simply delicious, roberto is making the best espressi :)... location: perfect, 1min to the ocean, right around the corner are bus stations and tourist info spots, as well as sliema itself is super nice with lots of restaurants and bars if you don't want to move around one evening... additionally the airport transport was perfectly organized. resumée: perfect location for a trip and we'll definitely come back!! roberto and rosanna are excellent hosts and it was a pleasure to stay there!

reviews.title: Air B n B style intimacy
reviews.text: Thanks to Roberto, Roseanna and Shakira for making this a memorable experience. Although the room was not en-suite, I only shared the bathroom for a portion of the stay; and there was never any queue for me to get to it. The rooms were all individualized with their own particular theme - mine being youth. A lot of time and effort has been put into making all aspects of the apartment and rooms both welcoming and ambient. Although the establishment does not describe itself as a boutique hotel, it has many of the hallmarks that would define one. Often Roberto, the domestic 'god', would spend time baking and would serve up these tasty oeuvres at breakfast or during the day. One of the pleasant things I liked about the stay, other than the coziness of the surroundings, was just how much trouble Roberto went to to correct any anticipated issues, including answering questions and making suggestions for possible itineraries. I enjoyed spending time both with Roberto and family as much as some of the guests that frequented the guest house. In many ways this place incorporated the care and intimacy that has all but abandoned most traditional tourism accommodation, more closely associated with P 2 P booking services like Air B n B. I hope to return again.

reviews.title: Time Flies when you are at home
reviews.text: I travel a lot for work and I love to explore new places to stay. I am always trying to find a place with a soul, which is different than all other boring hotels. So when I was looking for a place to stay for my "solo" holidays, after quite some search Time Flies got my heart from the very begining and when I saw the sign on the wall "BE YOURSELF - EVERYONE ELSE IS ALREADY TAKEN" I was sold! In 10 minutes I had my room booked and plane ticket bought - Malta here I come. "Time Flies" exceeded my expectations in every way. Firstly it is not just B&B it was designed with absolute perfection, attention to details, love and in a way to make you feel at home. It simply has very unique vibe. The ambience created by amazing owners Rosanna & Roberto which made my solo stay amazing! THANK YOU! It has everything and more than you may want: perfect location, great rooms, fantastic breakfasts and something other places do not have SOUL! If you solo, couple, family, or u travel for any reason - there is not other place to chose. I am definitely coming back!

reviews.title: Maltese Magic!
reviews.text: We spent five nights in this spotlessly clean, immaculately presented B&B just a minute's walk from the seafront and bus stop (buses are fantastic value at 6.50Euro for 7 days). Be sure to try some of Roberto's cake (Malta's answer to Mary Berry!) At our request our hosts kindly organised taxis for collection/return to the airport - much appreciated. Thanks for a great stay - would recommend.

reviews.title: Simply perfect
reviews.text: This is how a holiday should be. Roberto and Rosanna are wonderful hosts, and made us feel very welcome in their B&B. The room is very high quality, much better than the local hotels we have been to before in Malta. You can immediately see how serious they take things and how much attention to detail they have, from the care taken on the room, to the drinks available at any time and the great breakfast. The place could not be cleaner. Thank you Roberto and Rosanna for making our stay very enjoyable. We'll be back.

reviews.title: Wonderful, wonderful.
reviews.text: Recently returned from a 4 night stay at Time Flies, what a wonderful relaxing time we had there. Roberto & Rosanna are excellent hosts with a little help from Shakira, their cute chihuahua. Very close to the sea front and plenty of restaurants. The property is beautifully decorated and so clean, bright and new. Lovely continental breakfast served with a good choice of breads, meats and cheeses. Roberto's croissants were beautiful, all homemade. Lovely, lovely stay and hope to return one day, will definitely recommend Time Flies to friends and family if looking to visit Malta. Thank you to you both.

reviews.title: The best place in Malta to stay!
reviews.text: Everything is great about this small b&b. Location is great,close to everything,restaurants, bus stop, very clean and cosy, Roberto is excellent and so helpfull, he really made us feel that we were guests in their home! I would deffinetelly return here, if I would visit Malta again!

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: Me and my boyfriend stayed here at the end of July for one week and both enjoyed it very much! We stayed in "Time to be yourself" room which was great, veeery clean and comfortable and the air conditioner worked perfectly. The service was very nice, and we loved the choices we had for breakfast. The location was great as well. Close to a main street, 2 min from the bus station, close to the beach (well, not the sandy beach you might dream of, but if you wish for large sandy beaches Malta is not the place, or at least not this area). Anyways, there is place for sunbathing and the water was nice and warm. All in all, we strongly recommend this B&B and we are looking forward to go there again!!

reviews.title: Feeling at home in Malta!
reviews.text: What else to say? Rosanna and Roberto take care of you like you're a member of their family! They give you a lovely place to stay, they feed you with homemade pies like (better than!) your mother does... They even listen to you at the end of an intense tourist day in Malta! And if you get acquainted with Shakira,the little princess dog, if she will be generous with you...you'll certainly cry when you have to leave this loving place! I hope I'll be back soon... PS I REALLY LOVE THE QUOTES WRITTEN EVERYWHERE!!

reviews.title: Fantastic B&B in a great location
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of staying with Roberto and Rosanna for four nights earlier this month, in their "Time to Breathe" room. Their attention to detail made my stay very comfortable, from the backpacks with a beach towel to the soothing decor to the awesome breakfast every morning. The breakfast spread was great - lots of variety (cheese, meats and fresh fruit, as well as cereal, pastries and yogurt) and Roberto squeezes fresh orange juice for you while you chat about your plans for the day. Roberto is also an incredible baker. You must try whatever kind of cake he puts out. Quite frankly, that was my favourite part of breakfast :) On top of the comfort of the B&B it's also in a great location. Easy access to buses to Valletta, the airport and other sites (such as a direct bus to Mdina, which is stunning) and its less than five minutes to the waterfront and some great restaurants. Also, it is a very safe area (really, Malta in general is very safe), which is important to me as a solo female traveler. The Sliema neighborhood is very relaxing and low key but is within easy walking distance of neighbourhoods like Saint Julian's. Thank you so much for hospitality - I hope to see you again soon!

reviews.title: Lovely Airbnb in the heart of Malta
reviews.text: A very cosy Airbnb. Lovely decor, with love to detail! Homly atmosphere, great breakfast selection, super nice hosts. The perfect location in Baluta Bay (between Sliema and St. Julians). A MUST when in Malta :)

reviews.title: Shhh, keep it entre nous !!!
reviews.text: In sliema Malta there is a haven of peace and tranquility called Timeflies B and B. Should you be lucky enough to find a vacancy you will not be disappointed. It is for the person who is particular, about cleanliness, good manners, excellent service, fresh orange juice, a welcome smile, in other words it is for the one who yearns for the "good old days". Roberto , Roseanna and shakira are on a sure winner, much power to their efforts. I shall rebook as soon as I get home.

reviews.title: Couldn't imagine it gets better in Malta
reviews.text: Easily one of the nicest stays we've ever had, and for sure the nicest stay in Malta. Difficult to tell by map, but this B&B is just over a minutes walk from St. Julians seafront, restaurants, and shops. Our room looked as if we were the first to ever stay. Immaculately clean with fresh sheets, pillows, and towels. It's obvious Roberto took a great deal of time in designing and creating the mood that flows through the entire place. The breakfasts are also amazing, with fresh crepes and fresh coffee on the request. If you're on the fence about where to stay, I couldn't recommend this place more highly. My wife and I had an incredible time and will surely stay here again during any return trip to Malta. Thanks Roberto and crew!!

reviews.title: Fantastic B&B
reviews.text: I had a long journey up to the Highlands so I decided to book with Allan Bank as a half way point. It was incredibly comfortable and I was made to feel at home. I felt very welcome and I loved it so much that I'm booking again to stay as I regularly travel to the Highlands. I had a lovely packed lunch to take with me on the road as I had an early start. I can't think of a better place to stay. Thank you so much for a lovely, comfortable room on a cold, rainy night! Looking forward to seeing you and staying at your B&B again!

reviews.title: Wonderful place
reviews.text: Allan Bank is a lovely place to stay in Eyemouth. The hosts are very friendly and informative about the local area. The accommodation was faultless; spotlessly clean and very comfortable. The breakfasts were fabulous with lots of choice and perfectly cooked and served. We would highly recommend Allan Bank.

reviews.title: A perfect stay!
reviews.text: Very nice and clean B&B. We absolutely enjoyed our stay here. The hosts were very friendly and welcoming, the room was beautiful, the bed comfy and the bathroom very clean. We had a sunny breakfast for two in a very cosy room with a large window facing the lovely garden. Breakfast was traditional and very good: I had fresh fruit with yoghurt and smoked salmon with scrambled eggs. I can definitely recommand this B&B.

reviews.title: A most enjoyable stay
reviews.text: Allan Bank is a lovely place to stay with parking on the door. It is an easy short walk into town with a choice of places to eat in the evening. The accommodation is superb and so is the food.Marilyn and Archie make you feel very welcome and nothing is too much trouble.

reviews.title: Very welcoming, clean and comfortable
reviews.text: We stayed for two nights whilst visiting the British Open Golf Championship at Muirfield. Marilyn and Archie were very welcoming and helpful with providing local information. The accomodation was comfortable and very clean - a beautiful traditional house. Fantastic breakfast served on both mornings and nothing was too much trouble. Would highly recommend this B & B.

reviews.title: Incredibly good value and the most friendly service.
reviews.text: I needed a place to hole up when attending a friends' wedding and I has happy to discover that Allan Bank had a specially designed Scottish breakfast for vegetarians! Even though finding the house wasn't so easy (it's surrounded by lush foliage) Archie was very helpful on my arrival and made sure I felt very welcome. Certainly being treated to a traditional feeling double room (including window shutters) with a very modern en-suite bathroom helped to make me feel I was in the lap of luxury. And happily the next few mornings exceeded my expectations, there was so much on offer that it felt criminal to not make the most of Marilyn & Archie's hospitality! Overall, a very satisfying trip and definitely a B&B worth revisiting.

reviews.title: Wonderful hosts
reviews.text: Marilyn and Archie treated our family as if we were Royalty. We were coming from Toronto Canada to bring our two daughters to Eyemouth to visit their grandfather's and great-grandparent's hometown. Our recommendation is that if you are coming for a stay in Eyemouth, Allan Bank B&B is the "only" place to stay. Cheers, John, Diane, Lindsay and Jaclyn Cormack

reviews.title: "Great Hosts"
reviews.text: This is a lovely B&B. Fantastic spacious Bathroom and a Lovely light and airy room. Very comfy beds, so woke up rested. Marilyn and Archie are such a lovely couple and make you feel so welcome. Delicious breakfasts, cooked to perfection. Archie brought us tea and biscuits when we were relaxing in the sitting room (just go that extra mile) Can't recommend Allan Bank enough.!!

reviews.title: Absolutely wonderful!
reviews.text: The owners of Allan Bank B&B were warm and inviting. Our room was clean, comfortable, and perfect for relaxing. My aunt and I enjoyed the cheery atmosphere of the hosts, other guests, and the town. We had a modern bathroom attached to our room and every amenity we might have needed was provided. They had a range of options for breakfast that were all equally delicious. I hope I have more excuses to go to Eyemouth in the future so that I can stay here again!

reviews.title: Great weekend
reviews.text: Very helpful and friendly couple who run Allan Bank bed and breakfast. We would recomend it to anybody who are looking for a weekend stay in the Borders and Eyemouth has a great Golf Course with a fine seafood restaurant.

reviews.title: Amazing Stay
reviews.text: Cannot recommend this B&B highly enough! We stayed to attend a wedding and having arrived a little later than planned, instead of calling us a taxi, Archie very kindly offered to take us, both Marilyn and himself really went out of there way to provide an excellent service! Room was lovely, en suite spotless. The whole B&B itself just has a nice homely feel to it. Breakfast was awesome and helped prevent what could have been a rather nasty post wedding hangover!! Thank you so much and we will definitely be back.

reviews.title: Fresh
reviews.text: This is a lovely little B & B. The bedroom was on the small side but we had access to a lounge/dining room which can be used for such as take away meals if required. Breakfast was a wide choice specially recommend the fresh fruit salad with Greek yoghurt.

reviews.title: Lovely place
reviews.text: We had a great stay at Allan Bank B&B. The owners were professional and friendly from the moment we booked, through to the morning we left. The room was very comfortable, with a large bathroom, and the guest lounge had a fridge and Scrabble board, both of which we used! The building is beautiful and close to the town centre, and the owners looked after our bikes and were brilliant with dietary requirements (coeliac), including a cake to take home! Wouldn't hesitate to come back and thoroughly recommend to others.

reviews.title: Warm, comfortable & friendly
reviews.text: We staid here for one night and despite the wet n cold welcome the Eyemouth weather offered this B &B couldn't have been better. The couple who run this beautiful property go out of their way to create an atmosphere that offset the worst the Scottish weather can chuck at you. Our room wasnt enormous but it was carefully set out and decorated to the highest standard. WiFi in the room was strong enough to stream Netflix and the bed was comfortable. Breakfast was delicious and plentiful so overall a great stay. We would stay here again without a second thought.

reviews.title: Very Warm and Friendly B&B
reviews.text: Arrived after 10pm and we were all made very welcome after our long journey from Inverness. The tea and home baking was very much appreciated at such a late hour. Our rooms were very comfortable and spacious and had everything we needed, including the bottle of wine! The choice of breakfast was fantastic and we all thoroughly enjoyed what we had to eat. Allan Banks is a B&B I would recommend to anyone who is visiting Eyemouth. I cannot thank Archie and Marilyn enough for their warm and friendly welcome. Looking forward to a return visit.

reviews.title: A great find!
reviews.text: Excellent B & B. Owners are warm and welcoming. Archie was extreemly helpful and shared local information and suggested places to visit. The house is spotlessly clean and the bedrooms are very comfortable. In fact the bed was so comfortable it was difficult to get up in the morning! Breakfast consisted of good quality food and there was a varied menu. Very good value for the money. I would definately recommend this B & B.

reviews.title: Everything was fantastic!
reviews.text: It isn't often that I can say I wouldn't change a thing but AllanBank has quite simply done everything right. The staff were lovely, the room was incredibly comfortable and the breakfasts were great. What a treasure.

reviews.title: A fine welcome
reviews.text: Spotless, comfortable and welcoming; also easy to find. The Allan Bank is well located for many fine attractions and beautiful places on both sides of the border. The breakfasts were plentiful and the ingredients of high quality though the distance between the kitchen and the dining room could be detected in the cooked eggs. The room and shower-room were spotless and well equipped but for a couple with suitcases, back-packs and camera bags, not spacious - the towel rail was too small for the number of towels provided and while the bed-side lampshades looked good, being dark grey they did not let through enough light to read by. Nonetheless we enjoyed our stay and our hosts were delightful, welcoming and helpful.

reviews.title: First-class guest house
reviews.text: A wonderful guest house with friendly, informative and welcoming hosts, and comfortable, clean, well-appointed ensuite bedrooms. We were offered a wide choice of breakfasts and tried many during our stay, all appetising and excellent. Top marks!

reviews.title: Couldn't ask for nicer hosts
reviews.text: We were welcomed by Marilyn and Archie, the hosts, and given the tour of our room and breakfast area. Hard to imagine two more welcoming and pleasant people. The room was quiet and large enough, though not huge. The bed was comfortable and, because the house is on a relatively quiet street in a quiet town, we slept well. This would be a nice setting to spend a longer time, just sitting on the grass outside reading and drinking coffee. Speaking of coffee, Archie was something of a coffee connisseur, which pleased me a lot. I'm an early riser, as he is apparently. I was up at 5:30 where I found him quietly preparing the dining room. He brought me a fresh French Press of excellent coffee just the way I like it. I roast my own coffee and his was (almost) as good as mine. There was more coffee and the breakfast was complete and delicious. It is a short and interesting walk along the wharf to the town and supermarket and beach. When we return to Scotland, we'll go out of our way to stay here.

reviews.title: Field survey in the Borders
reviews.text: Very nice B&B and location. Archie and Marylin have prepared very good breakfasts during my stay. Their B&B is a nice place to work. The room in which I slept was well equipped and quite comfortable. Highly recommended! Anthony Bour (French linguist and PhD student in Freiburg-im-Breisgau, Germany)

reviews.title: Leaves not much to desire
reviews.text: The B&B is in a beautiful old building. The bedrooms are a little bit tiny but one has a large bathroom with a very nice bathtub. There is a large and cosy lounge and Marilyn and Archie are happy to set the table if one wished to eat takeaway food. The breakfast is excellent.

reviews.title: Eye opener in Eyemouth
reviews.text: Having never visited Eyemouth before, the only thing that could rival the outstanding coastline was the hospitality and accommodation of Allan Bank. Marilyn and Archie have to be congratulated on making our 2 night stay a very memorable and enjoyable experience. We stayed in the super king room with fabulous ensuite facilities. Breakfast was perfect as were the hosting skills of the proprietors. I would recommend Allan Bank to anyone lucky enough to be in the Eyemouth area.

reviews.title: Fantastic rooms, hospitality, breakfast and they take dogs too!
reviews.text: My partner and I and my parents spent a lovely if chilly weekend staying at Allan Bank B&B. We had our two dogs with us who were made as welcome as we were by Archie and Marilyn. The rooms are excellent with lovely ensuite bathrooms. We were doing some diving in St Abbs and they also helped us to dry our gear in their garage. Breakfasts were delicious and I cannot recommend them enough to anyone staying in the area. You can walk into Eyemouth in 5 minutes.

reviews.title: Wonderful welcome
reviews.text: Having never stayed in Eyemouth before it was a hit or a miss where we chose for our two nights stay in the Scottish Borders town, but we reckon we struck it lucky as we must have found one of the best guest houses in the area! Archie warmly welcomed us at the door and we immediately felt that his and Marilyn’s guests’ comfort was top of their list of priorities. The first thing to hit us was how clean, cosy and well maintained everywhere was and that continued into our comfortable, warm and spacious room, the large bathroom has to be one of the nicest we’ve seen in a guest house or hotel, it had a big roll-top bath with an over-bath shower, perfect for a relaxing soak in bubbles, the bathroom not only had a large radiator but a hot towel rail at the end of the bath. The central heating came on early in the morning so no chilly showers or baths for their guests. Our room had plenty of storage space, a good TV and a comfortable bucket chair, my hubby borrowed another chair from the dining room next door! The beds were extremely comfortable with spotlessly clean soft linen, and there was a well stocked hospitality tray. The bedroom had good lighting and a nice touch was the bedroom and bathroom windows had shutters which afforded complete privacy whilst keeping all the heat in the rooms. The breakfast room also doubles as a pleasant lounge. The guest rooms are on the first floor with the breakfast room on that floor too, handy for me as I am not great with stairs so it meant I only had to use the stairs on entering or leaving the house. A good idea is that guests are asked to fill in a breakfast request form in the evening giving the time they want to eat and also their breakfast choice....well... there were so many choices on offer it was difficult to choose! The well presented delicious food cooked by Marilyn and served by Archie was superb and Marilyn’s cooking is worthy of another mention! The guest house sits in a nice quiet area of the town but is not too far from restaurants and bars, and has ample on-street parking. If you are visiting Eyemouth and you want to experience great hospitality you can look no further than the Allanbank, my husband and I thoroughly recommend it.

reviews.title: Lovely place to stay
reviews.text: We recently stated here for two night when attending a friends wedding at guns green house. The owners were lovely and couldn't do enough for us, even offering to run us back to the wedding venue the next day to collect our car as we had bags and a kilt to carry! The B&B was only a short walking distance from the shops, pubs, restaurants and harbour. The room was clean, modern with en suite shower room. Bed was really comfy. Breakfast was lovely too. The whole house was maintained to a high standard. We would definitely stay again and recommend to others.

reviews.title: Great B&B
reviews.text: This is a very warm and friendly B&B in a beautiful 19th century house just a 5-minute walk from the high street in Eyemouth. Marilyn and Archie were very welcoming from the outset (they accommodated an evening arrival) and gave us space to relax as well as being very attentive, especially at breakfast. The room was very comfortable and the double bed was huge and so cosy that we struggled to get up in the mornings. The bathroom was nicely decorated and spacious although as a taller gent I struggled a little in the shower with the shower head being too low. The breakfast really set us up for a day of walking with a full Scottish on offer alongside cereal, toast, porridge and fruit. There were other options such as smoked salmon and scrambled eggs and everything we had was very tasty. Lactose-free milk and yoghurt was specially purchased by Marilyn & Archie for my wife and they even went to the trouble to bake lactose-free biscuits for the room which was a lovely touch. Walking guides were provided and we used one of these on our walk from Eyemouth to St. Abbs (a little treacherous in wet weather!). As part of our package M&A prepared us a packed lunch on each of the two days we were there, which came in handy on the walks. A special B&B this - welcoming and friendly and very much recommended.

reviews.title: Perfect last minute stay
reviews.text: Excellent b & b, run by very friendly couple who went out of their way to make us feel very welcome. Room was very clean and tidy, en-suite first class. Breakfast was a good selection of cereals and cooked food. B & B well located with short walk into Eyemouth, overall very happy with our stay.

reviews.title: Simply the Best!
reviews.text: This was the second time we have stayed at Allan Bank and in our opinion it is the best B&B we have had the pleasure to stay at. Thank you Archie and Marilyn for making our stay so comfortable, we will miss your fabulous breakfast's.

reviews.title: SIMPLY THE BEST
reviews.text: My husband and I have just returned from a 2 day break at Allan Bank, If staying in eyemouth this B&B is a must. Owners Maryln and Archie, were the perfect hosts, always had time for a wee chat,and nothing a problem. The accomadation was spotless, and we had a shower and a roll top bath in our en-suite, pure heaven, not to mention the delicious breakfast. Ample on street parking outside property.

reviews.title: Best B&B in Scotland in charming area
reviews.text: My wife and I started in Carlisle and ended up in Edinburgh over a 3 week period; staying mostly in B&Bs. This was the best B&B. Its a large vintage home completely redone, with attention to detail and bathrooms better than my home and large bedrooms. Eyemouth is a small working fishing village with at least one great restaurant and close to unique places (isolated cove accessed by a tunnel, standing circle of stones,Holy Island,etc.) to visit, some of which are off the tourist route. In addition to the home and location, the best was Archie and his wife Marilyn. Absolutely charming people. If you are visiting the Borders, this B&B and Eyemouth are worth driving out of you way for a visit. Dell Elliott Santa Cruz, California

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: The Allan Bank Bed and Breakfast, Eyemouth is run by Marilyn and Archie who are a lovely friendly couple who can not do enough to make your stay pleasant and restful. Archie is always there when you need him and Marilyn's breakfasts are delightful. We stayed for two nights whilst diving at St Abbs and as a result we needed an earlier than usual breakfast the second day. No problem. The room was a nice size with a comfy bed and tasteful decor, which was a credit to Marilyn. Allan Bank is easy to find being on the main harbour road but it is not noisy or busy and is a short walk from the harbour with its numerous restaurants. All in all a wonderful place to stay with a friendly homely feel and delightful hosts. We will be back!

reviews.title: Better than an Hotel
reviews.text: We looked at reviews for this B&B and I am pleased to say they persauded us to book and they were true to their word. From the moment we arrived we were made very welcome, nothing was too much trouble for Marilyn or Archie. The rooms were very modern, clean and excellently equipped, all the guests accomodation was on the first floor and we were given a free run, including use of lounge when returning in the evening. The breakfasts were excellent, with a very varied choice, including a fantastic full Scottish breakfast always cooked to perfection. An ideal location for touring the border country. We would highly recommend this accomodation.

reviews.title: great place to stay
reviews.text: We stayed at Allan Bank for 2 nights in June and were very pleasantly surprised. Archie and Marilyn gave us a warm welcome and after showing us our room, which was spotlessly clean and very comfortable, Archie brought us a pot of tea and biscuits. Very welcome after a long journey. We really enjoyed our stay here and breakfast was amazing, cooked perfectly and good quality food. Archie and Marilyn work very hard to ensure guests enjoy their stay, which we certainly did. We hope to return and would recommend to anybody.

reviews.title: Last minute booking but good choice.
reviews.text: We had booked another hotel for this weekend but were let down we we arrived in Scotland. We managed to get a room in Allen Bank and we were more than happy with our lovely, clean room. We were greeted warmly and offered a cup of tea within minutes of arriving. All in all nice place and because of out early start we took the packed lunch option and it was great. Would stay again.

reviews.title: Lovely b n b
reviews.text: This was our second stay at Allan Bank and we enjoyed it once again. Marilyn and Archie were very welcoming and remembered our first stay with them. Room very modern, decoration nice and it was lovely, clean and warm. We had breakfast both mornings and can recommend the fruit salad and the full english. Will stay again.

reviews.title: A delicious breakfast.
reviews.text: Allan Bank is the most lovely old building, which unfortunately has a sad and out of control garden surrounding it. Our room was comfortable and the bathroom both spacious and modern. I was, however, surprised to see only net curtains at the window, particularly as there's a street light just outside. Our breakfast was delicious, with good strong coffee, a fresh fruit salad and a choice of mains. We paid £75 for two, and this was the most expensive place we'd staying in two weeks of B and B. So, I feel that some proper curtains should have been included.

reviews.title: Exceptionally high standards
reviews.text: Marilyn & Archie have established a top class B&B. From the relaxing and homely environment, comfortable clean rooms to the hearty breakfast which sets up up nicely for the day to explore the beautiful coastline walks. We also sampled the towns restaurants and award winning fish & chips all within a few minutes walk. We would have no hesitation in recommending Allan Bank to anybody who is looking to stay in Eyemouth. David R

reviews.title: Wedding Week
reviews.text: Stopped off here for two nights on our way back south after a family wedding in Aberdeenshire. Very clean, welcoming and nicely situated. Archie and Marilyn were very friendly and made you feel quite at home. The breakfast had a wide choice and was tasty and plentiful. Rooms light and clean with exceptional en-suite. Bed really comfortable so we were refreshed next morning. Would highly recommend.

reviews.title: Brilliant B&B
reviews.text: Wonderful two day break at this B&B. Location very convenient for walking into town. Room extremely comfortable with spacious bathroom. Excellent breakfast with extensive selection. Very helpful with special request re parking and with additional assistance on a very wet arrival. Would recommend to anyone wishing to combine a really high standard with very welcoming and friendly hosts. Gordon and Leslie

reviews.title: great place to stay in Eyemouth
reviews.text: Very good value for money.Archie and Marilyn made us feel very welcome. Rooms spotlessly clean and lovely decor. Breakfast choice was excellent. Hope to stay again before too long. When we inadvertently left a pair of jeans in the wardrobe on departure Archie and Marilyn promptly packaged item and posted to us. A service you would not expect to receive in some establishments.

reviews.title: Thankyou marilyn and archie
reviews.text: Just returned from a nights stay at the allan bank b&b what a fantastic place. home from home with fantastic hosts. the decor is beautiful. the rooms are well equipped and spacious. information of local areas provided or gladly given from the hosts.the breakfast was fresh and plentiful my husband had two(Archie i think john made the order mistake on purpose)we have stayed at many places around this area up to a five star hotel and i can honestly say this place wins hands down. we will not hesitate on booking again when up that way. Marilyn & Archie you are lovely people and have a business to match well done.

reviews.title: great stay
reviews.text: The hosts were very friendly and helpful from giving advice about the area to making tea and coffee for us on arrival. The room although small was extremely clean with a comfortable bed and contained all facilities needed for a nights stay.The breakfast was plentiful and tasty . Thank you for a lovely stay!

reviews.title: Fantastic stopover en-route to Gleneagles (Sunday 14th July 2013)
reviews.text: A last minute selection for me ....to break up a long journey for me and my wife travelling further up into Scotland and what a gem of a find it was! Eyemouth was at it's best when we arrived (brilliant sunshine) set the scene. As many have said Archie and Marilyn are extremely welcoming. Their service was a very personal one. Their advice on places to eat down at the harbour 'ticked the boxes' for us for our evening meal. Interesting little place and a working port was lovely to see. Allan Bank accommodation is the 'tops' spotlessly clean and with a lovely comfortable bed for a goodnight's sleep: set us up for the onward part of our journey the following day. The whole feel of our room and layout of the upper part of the house (breakfast room) is very homely. Would have no hesitation in recommending this as a place to stay. In fact tried to book on our return journey back to Essex (but alas 'no vacancies')....not really surprised! Allan Bank and Eyemouth is a marked spot for returning too. DF

reviews.title: Val and Mark Derbyshire
reviews.text: Having seen the reviews Allan Bank received on Tripadvisor we booked a weekend break there. The reviews were right. The house was beautiful and very clean. The room was immaculate and the bed was very comfortable.. Breakfasts were amazing with loads of choice. Marilyn and Archie were very pleasant and willing to make our stay as nice as possible..I would not hesitate in recommending Allan Bank to any of my friends, family.or anyone wanting to stay in that area.

reviews.title: Friendly, relaxed and comfortable
reviews.text: This was a lovely place to stay, friendly, comfortable and the owners were very flexible, allowing us to arrive early in order to get changed before a wedding, and come and go at all hours (quietly). The room was comfortable and the bathroom was excellent.

reviews.title: Excellent B & B
reviews.text: Spent 5 days touring the area based at this fantastic B & B. On arrival we were welcomed with home made melt in the mouth shortbread, fruitcake and tea. This set the tone for the high quality breakfasts which kept us going ALL day. Loved your decor and the delicate touch with the wee posy of fresh flowers in our room and on the breakfast table. Archie and Marilyn are excellent hosts, happy to provide info re various places and made our stay very relaxed and comfortable. Paul and Kay

reviews.title: Fantastic Hosts!
reviews.text: We stayed for one evening at the Allan Bank Bed and Breakfast on our way back from Aberdeen and it was lovely. The house has been lovingly restored and a lot of the old features kept, the decor is fabulous and the owners are very pleasant. The two rooms we occupied were immaculately clean and the beds were so comfortable, both had en suite bathrooms with walk-in showers. Breakfast was excellent with a good choice of food, which was locally sourced using organic pigs for the sausages...yummy!! We arrived at night time and nearly missed the house due to overgrown trees and the sign not lit up. At first we were slightly disappointed because the photograph looks better than when you first drive up. Because of the trees covering the house you don't see on first impact the beauty of this lovely house. However, on entering the house and welcomed very warmly by Archie and Marilyn we quickly became very comfortable. We had an 85 year old with us and he did struggle up and down the stairs to the bedroom so this should be depicted at the booking stage. Overall a very good experience in a beautiful house.

reviews.title: Would recommend to everyone. Beatuful place.
reviews.text: Absolutely perfect. Stayed there on our wedding night. The building itself is decorated In style of the of the building with all the modern amenities. The rooms are spacious and lovely, all with there own bathrooms and the breakfast was delicious and the owners of the B&B Archie and Marilyn are really helpful and friendly. If you go to Eyemouth and are after abit of luxury there is no where else worth going when you compare it to this place!

reviews.title: Great attention to detail
reviews.text: Stayed for one night while travelling Scotland on motorbikes. Excellent and faultless stay. Exceptionally clean and well appointed. Very amiable hosts. Would have no hesitation staying here again if passing.

reviews.title: Excellent stay at Alanbank
reviews.text: We've just had an excellent four night stay with friends at Allanbank. Marilyn and Archie were the perfect hosts. The accommodation was first class and the Scottish cooked breakfast was the perfect start to the day. Highly recommended. Kind regards Paul and Christine

reviews.title: Excellent B&B
reviews.text: Lovely rooms. Excellent breakfasts. Great hosts. Would definitely return. Near to very good eating establishments, centre of Eyemouth and, of course, the picturesque harbour with it's combination of working boats and pleasure crafts. We must, of course, not forget the first class Golf Course with it's excellent restaurant!!

reviews.title: Warm Welcome
reviews.text: Stayed here in May this year, What a really nice place to stay, clean and a brill breakfast, very nice couple who ran it, I would recomend it to everybody.

reviews.title: Cute place on the coast of scotland
reviews.text: Just came back from Eyemouth where we we stay in this very beautiful B&B just 5 min walk from coast and town center. We got some tea and homemade cake on arrival. Room spacious, clean and fully equipped. I was so happy when i have found hairdryer in the drawer. And what was the most important for me dog friendly. Highly recommended!

reviews.title: Lovely people excellent food and service
reviews.text: Just returned from spending 2 nights at this B&B. It was lovely. Marilyn & Archie were lovely couldn't do enough for their guests. Lovely rooms, very high standard. Food was the best. Would go back in a minute. Was a lovely break and all the people were so friendly and helpful everywhere we went. Go give Eyemouth and surrounding area a visit and dont forget to go to Allan Banks. Lynn & Ron

reviews.title: Can't fault Allan Bank
reviews.text: Allan Bank is a lovely place to stay in Eyemouth, situated just a few minutes walk from the town centre. From the moment we arrived owners Marylin and Archie were very welcoming, friendly and helpful, making our 4 night stay with them very enjoyable. Our room was very comfortable and the breakfasts were delicious. We would certainly stay there again and thoroughly recommend it to others. Jenny and David

reviews.title: Perfection in the bed and breakfast formula
reviews.text: Impeccable reception by the owners who take a lot of pride in attention to detail for their guests. The double twin on the first floor, with comfortable on suite, was a fine place to relax after visiting the borders sites. This establishment is worth a visit when you are anywhere in the area!

reviews.title: Warm and welcoming
reviews.text: A beautiful place to relax. We arrived after a hard day's cycling and were welcomed with tea and cake. A small gesture but it meant a lot. Our room was clean and comfortable. The breakfast was delicious. Thank you Marylin and Archie for your warm hospitality.

reviews.title: Exceptional Everything
reviews.text: Visited Eyemouth recently for the first time in a long, long time. Beautiful little coastline village near the border on the east coast of Scotland. Reminiscent of Coullioure in France. Lots of little back streets to explore; breath-taking views of the North Sea from the bay, and coastal path walks which are invigorating. The sun was shining in the sky....there wasn't a cloud in sight ... Stayed at Allan Bank with Marilyn and Archie...lovely hosts who did everything to make my stay memorable. Lovely traditional home of character. Immaculate bedroom and bathroom with shutters on the windows and a roll top bath. Lots of attention to detail. Delicious breakfast in the morning using the best of locally sourced produce. Perfectly cooked poached eggs, crispy bacon and a few grilled cherry tomatoes on the vine. Portion size was ideal for me...taste over quantity. Lovingly cooked with attention to detail and sensitively served. All in all...exceptional quality.

reviews.title: Excellent bed and breakfast
reviews.text: We stayed at Allanbank last Saturday night when my husband needed to work in this area. We had a warm welcome from Marilyn and Archie. Our room was spotless, a good size, with a lovely bathroom. The attractive shutters excluded all light at night. The breakfast was delicious and Archie and Marilyn did everything they could to make our stay comfortable. The house is a short walk from the centre of Eyemouth so within easy reach of museum, restaurants etc. We will certainly be back when we are in the area again.

reviews.title: yorkshire couple
reviews.text: We found Allen Bank very comfortable, the rooms were very well kept, and breakfast was second to none, a wonderful choice well cooked and served in relaxing surroundings. The house its self was easy to find and within easy walking distant to the town. Would definitely recommend it to anyone. will definitely go back.

reviews.title: Excellent Accommodation and Hosts
reviews.text: The hosts are extremely friendly and helpful. The accommodation is very nice, clean and well looked after. The breakfast was brilliant with lots of choice. Overall thoroughly recommended. Eyemouth itself is a lovely place to visit.

reviews.title: Charm and Charisma
reviews.text: A delightful B & B. Great hosts. Lovely rooms, well appointed. Excellent breakfast. We received a cuppa upon arrival. Near to restaurants/hotels. Parking is on the street however has a 100% safety record v break ins, car damages.

reviews.title: Perfect stay in Eyemouth
reviews.text: At first we drove past the B&B and turned somewhere in the town centre. Taking a closer look we finally found the sign in front of the house. Archie was very welcoming and offered help wherever it could have been useful, e.g. carrying bags. The room was very comfortable and breakfast was delicious after walking our dog at the beach which can be reached within 5mins. Unfortunately we did not get to know Marylin as she was visiting family members. We hope to catch up on that one day as we'd love to be back there again.

reviews.title: The perfect stay
reviews.text: I spent four nights at Allan Bank and there is definitely nothing to complain about. Marylin and Archie are very attentive and helpful hosts and they have a really good sense of humour. Breakfast plenty and very good. Room very comfortable. And the place is ideal for people like me travelling only by bus. I highly recommend this place. anita

reviews.title: Lovely B&B
reviews.text: We travelled here for a peaceful evening in Eyemouth, and weren't disappointed. The rooms were well appointed and immaculately kept, and Marilyn even allowed us to choose which room we would like as we arrived slightly early. The breakfast was outstanding and set us up nicely for the day ahead. Thank you for a lovely stay !

reviews.title: Very comfortable and welcoming
reviews.text: This old victorian home was a beautiful b&b. The owners have done a wonderful job of restoring and modernising it with comfortable beds and updated bathrooms. Marilyn & Archie made us feel so welcome. Marilyn went out of her way to purchase Almond Milk (I am dairy alllergic) for me to have with our breakfast. It is close enough to walk to the main town for eating.

reviews.title: Beautiful Large Period House, Superb large en-suite rooms, Excellent breakfasts.
reviews.text: My wife and I stopped 3 days here, Archie and Marilyn really made us feel welcome.We had the Super King sized room with a very large en-suite bathroom which has a roll top bath and shower. The breakfasts are really super. Archie gave us some good advice on local travel and restaurants. Possibly the best guest house we have stayed in. Highly recommended. Many thanks Andy and Hils Manchester.

reviews.title: "More than just a B&B!"
reviews.text: My daughter and I recently visited Eyemouth staying at the Allan Bank. We could not have had a better place to stay......all down to Marilyn and Archie. They are very friendly, very helpful and very knowledgeable about their town and the surrounding area. The room we had was very tastefully furnished,comfy and well equipped. The breakfast was delicious with a good amount of choices. Nothing was too much trouble for Marilyn! Thank you both. When we are doing more walking in the area we'll be back!

reviews.title: "An excellent B&B"
reviews.text: We have just spent eight very comfortable nights at Allan Bank all thanks to the hospitality of Archie and Marilyn. Our room (no 1) was clean,warm,and cosy with a really comfortable bed and a modern ensuite shower room. A great choice for breakfast is served each morning, also if needed there is a choice of a packed lunch if you have an early start on your departure. This is a great place to stay because of the warm,friendly service from both Archie and Marilyn. Hopefully we will see you again,thanks for everything. Highly Recommended!

reviews.title: amazing stay - wonderful find
reviews.text: the owners gave such a friendly warm welcome and their kindness continued throughout our stay - the room was spotless and comfortable,(an amazing night sleep with no noise from the quiet street outside) and decorated in lovely fresh colours - large, spacious with all the supplies you could ever want/need. the breakfasts were delicious and really set you up for the day. in the breakfast room, the view was lovely and I felt that I was in the middle of the country - yet only a few minutes walk to the harbour. thank you for a lovely break

reviews.title: Relaxing Getaway
reviews.text: It reminds me of the movie Dirty Dancing. Log cabins. Lake view. Just a peaceful getaway when you want to get back in touch with nature. The staff is welcoming and very accommodating. This is a place for the laid back. What better way to spend a hot summer evening than sitting on the porch drinking a cold beer and checking out the millions of stars that you don't get to see when back home. Can't wait to go back!!!

reviews.title: Perfect family vacation destination
reviews.text: We vacationed the week of the Fourth of July this year. We stayed with two other families. The other families had stayed here in previous years, and this was out first year. It could not have been better. I highly recommend this as a family vacation destination. The owners were very pleasant, and the resort was awesome. Please understand, this is a cabin resort, so if you're expecting the Hilton, you will be disappointed. This place was exactly what I expected. The room we stayed in had a room with two double beds, a full kitchen, bathroom, and a separate bedroom for the wife, and myself. The pool was clean, the view was gorgeous, and it's very close to shopping, and dining.

reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: My wife and I enjoyed our stay at Alpine. Facilities were very nice, and the view of Lake George from the deck was spectacular. Ernie and Ms. Lillian were very accomadating throughout our stay. Ernie helped me getting to and from the Launch site which was a few miles away so I could dock the boat at the Village Alpine dock. Everything was enjoyed and our stay very comfortable. Thank you Ernie and Ms. Lillian........

reviews.title: Just what I wanted
reviews.text: This was my first time staying at the Alpine Village Resort, and I must say I had an excellent time. The man who owns it is extremely friendly and chatty and is very helpful with questions and concerns. The cabin we stayed in was just what we wanted. The cabin was very rustic; I enjoyed seeing no vacation-like photos hanging on the walls, no advertisements for the place laying on the table, and no phone. ...it made it feel like we were out in the woods and away from civilization. There were cobwebs, but it only added to the rustic feel. The only problem we had was with the owners wife who is rude and doesn't show any appreciation for anyone or anything. Thankfully, we only dealt with her once. According to her husband, she doesn't do much around the place to help out, but his friendliness makes up for her attitude. If you love the feeling of relaxing in a rustic cabin surrounded by nature, I suggest you go here. If you've been pampered and taken care of your whole life ...then go check in to one of the many luxury hotels and enjoy your vacation with all of the other tourists who can't stand the thought of living in a cabin for a few days.

reviews.title: Great place to stay when in Lake George
reviews.text: After reading the reviews I was hesitant to stay here. I feel that sometimes places are judged poorly though. We went, not expecting the Plaza, but a rustic cabin. Something we wanted. The cabin was well constructed and we had a stunning view of the lake. The property was beautiful and well maintained. The beach and pool were well kept and clean. The owners were very nice and welcoming. I read many negative things about them but they seemed very nice. The breakfast at the restaurant was good and inexpensive. The only negative thing I have to say about the place was that our room was dirty. Not "in the woods camping" dirty but just never cleaned dirty. Our refrigerator was dirty when we arrived and the TV and surfaces had like an inch of dust. The floor was dirty and under the beds were just gross. All the room really needed was a good vacuuming, and a dusting. Other than that we felt the resort was very nice and we had a great time. The place was packed with families and from what I heard everyone was enjoying the place with no complaints. I would return to Alpine Village again. I think the price is fair for a lake view cabin and we really enjoyed ourselves. I just hope the rooms get cleaned up a bit.

reviews.title: VERY RUSTIC..PRICED GREAT...GREAT MOUNTAIN GETAWAY
reviews.text: We reserved 4 days at the GoldenSands Resort first and when we arrived we realized the owner(BOB) mislead us about the accomodations. We were stranded in the mountains with three small children an 18 ft boat and nowhere to go. WE stumbled down the mountain to Alpine Village and thank god we did. It was just what a relaxing time in the mountain should be. Thank you to the Staff at ALPINE VILLAGE for helping us save our almost ruined vacation.

reviews.title: 31 years and still going!
reviews.text: I have been going to Alpine Village for 31 years and we are still going. We have watched all the changes thorugh the years. The owners are like family. If there is a problem Ernie will fix it quickly. Lillian takes the time to make vistors welcome. I read some of the negative reveiws. Don't go to the moutains if you want to be so picky. These are cabins. My children grown married adults still go to Alpine Village, and they enjoy it there as much as a week at the Polyenisian Resort in Disneyworld. These are two different types of vacations. We will be back again and everyone we have sent has also continued to return. don't always listen to the negative. The grounds, the beach, the water are better than ever. The pool is kept spotless and Ernie checks the chemical levels regularly. Skip over the negative reveiws and you might make some new friends. We will be there in June, and so will my sister and husband, and both my children and their families. My son even comes if his wife has to work and returns again with his friends and families at a later date. He is 31 and has been there since he was 3. Enjoy and relax. The Flanders, N.J. gang

reviews.title: Breakfast
reviews.text: Stopped in for breakfast thanks to a recomondation from the manager at the lake George inn. Glad we took his advice .food was delicious ,hot and plenty of it.especially for the low prices .service was excellent. Breakfast on the deck, beautiful views what a nice way to start the day.

reviews.title: Unreliable
reviews.text: When I called to make a reservation they said they were full - but there was a vacancy sign when I drove by. They told me I'd have trouble getting a room because there was a big event in a nearby town, but every single motel had vacancy signs. Not good business!

reviews.title: great place for anniversary
