Then, a day before my prepaid stay was over, her henpecked husband barged into the room, while we were dressing, without even knocking, demanding we leave as he thought we were suppose to be out. He was mistaken and hadn't even checked befor entering, in addition to being extemely rude. The woman owner was vain ( for an Old ---) and nasty, and not at all sorry for ruining our vacation. I was very specific about wanting a lakefront cabin in my reservation, and had driven a long way. Also, the beach was dirty as was the pool, so swimming wasn't an option. These people should understand that vacations are something people look forward to, go to great expense for, and should be treated as the patrons that they are. If they're tired of their work, then stop doing it.

reviews.title: Authentic 1920's Log Cabin Resort
reviews.text: Absolutely perfect place for an authentic old timey family get-together. We celebrated our daughter's wedding on the beach, with a pig bbq dinner in a big rented tent, and dancing in the cute little gazabo. All our guests stayed in the 30 or so little cabins surrounding the main lodge and loved it. This is not a fancy HIlton; but, it was so much better because of the laid back, cozy ambiance. And, the owner, Ernie and his staff were all very amenable helping in any way they could. So many of our family and friends told us it was the best and coolest wedding they had ever been to,

reviews.title: Time worp
reviews.text: I worked at Alpine in the summers of 69&70 so when I needed a place to stay in the area I went back. I couldnot believe how the place looked the same. In a very GOOD way. Super clean and updated. There was no pool back in the day but its a nice touch now. The raft is gone but ok. the Pub in the basement area is no morebut standing in the empty sapce i could hear the ghosts of a bygone era. I could still hear the "Doors" coming from the juke box thats gone also. I liked it very much and will return again this may while there on assignments. Owners not as friendly as the Langes were but nice enough. No meals served either but again that is in the past.

reviews.title: cozy cabin...
reviews.text: this comfy cozy cabin was a good 3.5 hr drive from NYC. we rented this place for 3 days. my taller half arranged to stay here for it's amenaties. the best was waking up to sunrise from the lakeside view... the rooms were a bit out dated, but that how it was years ago. not that many people appreciate old school resorts like this. coming to a place like this, reminds me of when i was a kid, and my family had road tirps. places like this brings people together, to have a tighter bond. today, people expect free made-to-order breakfast, free WiFi, free parking, free dinner, free...free......free... and that's where places like this lose out on business. don't get me wrong, on the reviews of ALL or the neighboring resorts, including this one says, "the room smells modly." well, heads up, this is an old town, with old cabins. i would choose this place over any chained hotel. the staff was very helpful and accomidating. the rooms have air conditioners. well kept and maintained since 1946! i'm coming back to this resort, once a year.... to attend the Adirondack Hot Air Balloon Festival. just one mile away, there's plenty of restaurants and shops. there's also a steamboat that takes you around lake george. the classic mini-ha-ha will take you for a 32 mile trip up and down lake george... and there's a steam calliope concert in between each cruise!

reviews.title: Bed bugs and spiders
reviews.text: Stayed here towards the end of August with a group of people. First off, the location and restaurant are great and I have absolutely no qualms about either. The room we had was disgusting, and filled with very large spiders, but as it was a log cabin I dealt with it. What I wasn't expecting was to have to deal with bed bugs acquired from staying here. Do yourself a favor and either stay elsewhere in Lake George or check your mattresses before sleeping in them. Not worth the bed bugs!

reviews.title: Nice place but dated
reviews.text: Very nice place to stay we rented the bigest lake front cabin they had but didn't realize cabins have no living rooms so you get bedrooms and a kitchen the view is great the beach is nice the pool was nice if you want to BBQ it is a hike to go from your place to the BBQ the recreation area was very dated and musty smelling but the main lodge was beautiful and the porch on the main lodge was awsome

reviews.title: Great Place to Stay With the Family
reviews.text: I can't say enough great things about this place. My wife and 3 and 1/2 year old spent 1 full week at the Alpine Village Resort...Great Location-So Much To Do...So much Fun! Let's start with Alpine Village-Ernie is a great host. Breakfast is inexpensive but delicious. The waitress Marie was very sweet. Free use of pool, boats, canoes, safety vests, ping pong tables, volley ball, and beach. Place is very clean and well maintained. 3 grills with covered picnic benches right be the beach is very convenient. Enjoyed using the fireplace in the cabin. I travel a great deal on business throughout the country and stay at some of the top hotels. This place was perfect for me. It is very unique and it is refreshing not to stay in a cookie cutter hotel room. The place is rustic. I mean, we stayed in a real authentic log cabin!!! I think that is great. If you are expecting the Ritz Carlton...stay at the Ritz Carlton. If you want to stay in an authentic log cabin right on the beach of Lake George with great hosts and great company, stay at the Alpine Village Resort. We have already booked our trip back for 2015. It happens to be located in one of the greatest areas in New York state. Close enough to Vermont and there is so much to do in the Lake George, Albany, Saratoga, and other upstate locations. We have been to Lake George twice and there is still so much that we have to do!!!

reviews.title: Alpine Cabins
reviews.text: Myself, my girlfriend and her daughter made the trip from Baltimore to get away from the city. We were absolutely blown away by this place..... Its beautiful, all the way around. The people are great and treat you like family, and do their best to help you however they can. As for the few negatives I have read about this place, let me tell you if you are the type that needs your shoes tied for you by a butler and need all the luxury this is not for you, however,....... If you just want to relax and enjoy every last second of your vacation in a refreshing getaway at a very good rate, I would suggest this place over and over again.

reviews.title: Horrible Experience - Not So "Ernest"
reviews.text: Our family had booked a two night stay a few weeks prior to our vacation date and when we arrived the owners claimed they had never heard of us nor did they have a reservation on their books (slips of disorganized papers). My mother explained to the owner that she and him had talked about things to do in the area, that his name was Ernest and that he and his wife Lillian would take good care of us etc. He took my mother's credit card information but never "booked" our reservation. When my mother questioned the owner he became rude and defensive and it was VERY CLEAR that he was backtracking to cover up the fact that he had messed up our reservation and was now lying about it. She even mentioned that she received a confirmation email from his website to which he replied "I don't do email" and "I dont do computers" which is odd since I can see that he replies to the other bad reviews he gets on this website. Anyway, my family and I immediately wanted leave after talking to Ernest for just 5 mins....we left and drove down the street where we found a lovely little place to stay called Mt. Knoll. The owners there were kind and accomodating...we recommend staying there and NOT at the Alpine Village.

reviews.title: Direct access to Lake George on a little beach
reviews.text: I usually stay with family when I am in the Lake George area but my cousins and I were looking for a cheap place to stay on the lake and close to the village for the weekend. This place was adorable, the main lodge has a beautiful wrap around porch that I sat and ate breakfast on every morning while I was there. They do offer breakfast at the lodge it is between $5-8, I never ate there since we brought small snacks for breakfast. The owner is super nice and easy going, our cabin was ready when we arrived. We were at the top of the hill, closer to the road. The cabin room was small, it had one double bed that my cousin and I shared. It was somewhat clean, dust bunnies in the windows and in the corners but its a cabin.. you can't expect the Hampton Inn. The bathroom was small but it was fine for what we needed. I absolutely loved the beach! They had these gigantic adirondack chairs, we tanned all day and used the canoe that the owner provides. They also have a small pool. It was very close to the village, I will be coming back to this place, made you feel like you were in the mountains.

reviews.title: Great time
reviews.text: My husband and I took our kids to Alpine Village for a weekend get away. The outside was very clean with rustic look cabins. The rooms are clean with a lot of space. The only problem was the wifi in the room, but outside had good wifi. The breakfast was good, but I didnt like the pancakes. They have a couple of grills on the property with picnic tables. The resort includes kayak, row boat a mini park. I wish they had an arcade. Can't wait to go back next year with the whole family.

reviews.title: BRING YOUR OWN LINENS
reviews.text: July2015 Had a room with 2 bedrooms and kitchen. Checked In at 5:30 my room was not ready at 4. The place has no help. I seen 2 women cleaning rooms and cabins. They have 40+ rooms and cabins? How clean could it be? I don't see how they could possibly clean the proper way.(VERY SAD) The owners are all about the CASH at check IN. Only 100$ on credit card. Made my friend go to ATM for cash 2TIMES. Cabins have no SMOKE ALARMS? It is a hike down to Lake and very wet. Best thing in place is the shower. I did have hot water. Beware of very small towels. NO garbage cans on promises. Pool area BBQ area,and Porch. The place could be nice if you put back money in place. They have plastic chairs at pool with wood and screws on leg for support. Please go buy a new $8.00 chair. 4PM is dumpster diving by owners for empty cans.

reviews.title: Don't waste your money or time.
reviews.text: What a dump. Place smells musty. Beds are uncomfortable and small. I'm 5'11" and my feet were hanging off the end. Pool is very small. Lake view is nice but you can get that from the hotel next door which had so much more happening. We winded up going to a different hotel and leaving a day early. It's funny they have a sign that says no refund for early departure, probably because many people leave as soon as they get there. If the person in the next room decides to take an early morning or late night shower the walls shake and vibrate when water is running. Rooms are small and old. Owners are very old school and a bit rude. If your going with family find a different hotel pay a little more and be more comfortable. Parking lot is extremely small. As far as good things go breakfast was nice and reasonably priced. I say AVOID this place like the plague!!

reviews.title: Will return next year
reviews.text: My family loved it. A good time had by all. Alpine Village has actual log cabins - very clean and maintained; well manicured property. Kids played and enjoyed w/ other children. Lakeside lodging very resonable. We would definitely return next year again - we found a gem in Lake George.

reviews.title: Very impressed! I can't wait to bring the whole family.
reviews.text: This place was so great I almost want to keep it a secret. My husband and I rented a cabin as a walk in. The owner was more than accommodating, immediately felt like family. The cabin was rustic, but the crisp sheets and new bath were very nice,along with a comfy bed and quiet ac, made my trip. It was lake side, with free kayaks and row boats. There was just enough wifi to do what I needed to do, without being strong enough for a child to spend all day with their technology. The tvs are small( your kids won't be tempted to sit in front of it all day) Not so large a place that you feel you are sharing with every family in the neighborhood. I relaxed on the dock one evening and had the whole place to myself. I would love to have a small family reunion here and just enjoy the immenities of the property. My adult children camped nearby, and left their campsite a day early to stay at Alpine Resort for a night. Breakfast was good, and quick service, they did not open until 8:30 am, which is a bit late for me. The one problem we had was an overflowing toilet, which was fixed immediately. TY Ernie. This is what Lake George should be all about.

reviews.title: Relaxing Getaway at Beautiful Lake George!
reviews.text: We just got back from staying at Lake George for several days. We stayed at the Alpine Lodge. This was our second year in a row staying at the same place and the same room! We stayed in the lodge. Here are some details: The room: We had a room upstairs in the lodge. It has two adjoining rooms and two separate baths. The rooms were spacious enough. One room had a double bed. The other room had two singles. We also had two closets, two TVs, and a refrigerator. The room has window air conditioners. The room was clean enough for a rustic log cabin. Met my expecations fine. The beds were slightly uncomfortable due to the cheap grade matresses. The pillows were also flimsy - bring your own! The windows did not offer much of a view. The bathrooms were small and cramped. The master bath door does not close shut, which was a problem last year too. There is no lock on that door. The lodge - Very nice, roomy, old lodge! Stuffed animals are all over the walls. Nice, huge fireplace in the middle of the room. Nice, cozy sofas and arm chairs inside to relax in while waiting for the wife. Big, wooden tables to sit at to do crafts, write letters, etc. The nicest part of the indoors! Views - My favorite spot for a great view is sitting on the front porch in one of the Airondack chairs. I put my feet up on the huge log rail and just relax! A close second is at the hotel's small, private beach. Perfect view for Thursday's fireworks show! Beach - A nice, small beach. Great place for the children to play in the sand for hours on end. Completely safe. Great access to the lake. Hotel allows use of their row boats, canoe, and kyak (deposit required). Swimming in the lake is utopia! Beautiful! And, safer than other beaches. Pool - A great pool for the kiddies to splash around in. Water is only 4 feet deep, but that is fine. Solar heated. Nice fenced in pool area to mingle with other guests and rest on the lounge chairs. Hotel staff - This is a family owned and run hotel. Ernie and Lillian run the hotel with their son. They are all generally nice people, but seem to be overly concerned about money. Whenever I spoke to them about something, money always came up: "Can I sign out the row boat?" "There is a $20 deposit required." "Do you serve breakfast here?" "We sure do! One of the best values in Lake George. Cheaper than most of the other places." "If I rent a boat, can I dock it here?" "There is a $25 fee per night" Ernie always seems to be willing to get into a conversation. Lillian seems to be more stricktly business. Also, my wife and I discussed making plans to come back in the fall. She asked Ernie about the rates for a certain week in Oct. and he quoted $59/night. The next day, I asked Lillian and she quoted me $79 for the same room! (We quickly changed our minds about coming in the autumn). I think they should post a rate schedule and stick to it.... The waitresses are very nice and so are the cleaning people and the owner's son, Kevin. Amenities - The hotel met my expectations here! Lots of fun things to do - ping pong, pool tables, volleyball, bad minton, boating, basketball, video games. They do have wireless internet. They have a laundry room in the basement. They charge $0.25 for a bucket of ice. There is a large enough parking lot, but sometimes you have to hunt down a spot. Cleanliness - It is certainly clean enough. There were not any bugs or layers of dust on anything. Everything looked neat and tidy. No smell or odors. The grounds are always impeccable!

reviews.title: Nice getaway
reviews.text: Lovely rustic hotel. We stayed in a log cabin type room in main building. It has a B&B feel. Kitchen and 2 bedrooms. Very nice family has owned the hotel for over 30 years. Inexpensive breakfast in main building that was great. Lake swimming and pool available. (It was too cool for me) If you want a modern hotel, this is not for you. I preferred it to the many high-rise hotels in the area.

reviews.title: Ok
reviews.text: The place was ok. The property is nice but the room smelled moldy. The ac was not working well so my husband had to fix it. Thank God it's what he does for a living! The had a great breakfast in the dinning room for a cheap rate. Not sure if we would stay there again but we would definitely go back to eat breakfast.

reviews.title: Old, unclean and unkept.
reviews.text: We stayed at this Alpine Village this summer for a second week in July 2013. The pros are as follows: 1) There is a breakfast restaurant there and a good view of the lake from the deck. 2) It is on lake george in good vicinity to the village 3) Towels changed daily Cons: 1) While the resort states that they accept credit cards, they only take $100 in credit card payment, and the rest you must settle in cash or travelers check. 2) The rooms are dirty. The bathroom ceiling and plaster walls were sticky from old dirt. 3) The old air conditioners in the rooms are super noisy, it is like sleeping next to the old gas lawn mower. 4) There are no gas grills, there exactly 2 bbq stations which are coals only, and tend to get fully booked each evening. 5) The lake beach is so ingrown with weeds, that it renders it practically unswimmable. 6) The owners are rude and rather uncaring, but that is my subjective opinion. Surely, people differ. Mainly, this resort did not do its job keeping the grounds. My kids could not swim there, because of the water weed problem and that spoiled the whole vacation. The grounds are large. I would definetely caution against staying there any other family whose main priority is lake/beach vacation. But hey, I hear their pancakes are good, so if you don't care about the lake - breakfast is served daily.

reviews.title: The epitome of a "diamond in the rough"
reviews.text: Stayed in a cabin here with some friends who've been coming here for many years. I was told not to expect the "luxury suite" so as to not be disappointed but that it was wonderful for the price. Turns out, it really was a very nice clean place. Definitely the "rustic cabin" feel with plenty of room for a family of 4 (including 2 teenage boys). The pool is very nice and although the beach is a little on the small side, you can't knock the fact that you are right on the lake with gorgeous views. Now for that important question: does this place have internet? It does although it is hit-or-miss WIFI. Expect to disconnect for a real vacation or wait until you get access to public WIFI areas. My boys weren't thrilled - especially with the recent release of Pokemon Go - but they survived. There were TV's with cable. And here I was thinking I'd never see my kids watch another episode of Sponge Bob again. ;) There was also a ping pong and a pool table which kept them amused while us parents sat on our private porch in our adirondack chairs enjoying a lovely afternoon drink. Which reminds me, small kitchenettes with a full size fridge, coffee maker (although you must bring your own filters and coffee) and a microwave. And yes, there are A/C window units to keep the cabins cool. And last but not least, a great cheap breakfast. Just a hop, skip, and a jump away. Less than 5 minute drive into downtown Lake George, it's a lovely little gem providing some peace and quiet for everyone. Will definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: The go to rustic place
reviews.text: We stay at this place every year, and if we don't, it's because they're booked ! That's how relaxing this place is. Private beach where there are usually ducks and their babies sitting by you :) Great view when eating breakfast on the balcony of restaurant. Has decent size pool. Can do your own BBQ. Has boat dock to bring your own boat. Use of kayaks and row boats. Rooms have fireplaces for the chillier months. So romantic and peaceful.

reviews.title: Great Stay!!
reviews.text: My husband and I came up to Lake George from NYC, but are from Houston, Texas. We did not have any plans previously booked in Lake George and decided to wing it. We are so glad that we did! We found the Alpine Village close enough to town, but off the beaten path. Wonderful and relaxing and my work a holic hubby had no choice but take it easy! He actually enjoyed himself. We loved the coziness of the cabins which were nice and clean and more modern then one would have thought. The Lake George area has always been my favorite peaceful area and the great folks at Alpine helped to feed more wonderful memories.

reviews.title: Sin Ventura Hotel and Antigua, Guatemala
reviews.text: In Antigua, Guatemala, if you are staying at the Sin Ventura Hotel , you have made a wise choice. Economically it is a bargain that is a clean, well-run hotel with no frills but no short cuts either. The staff is knowledgeable, helpful, and exceptionally friendly. As to location, you are a very short distance from the Central Park, which is the heart of Antigua. The park is framed on every side by historic municipal buildings and colonial neighborhoods converted into beautiful shops and restaurants.The cathedral is on the east side and the whole scene is overlooked by Volcan Agua from the south, which shadows your every movement so you are never lost. A full mix of Antiguans and visitors enjoy the park for the live marimba music, relaxation and social contact. One of the most popular discos in town is located at the Sin Ventura, along with a sidewalk coffee and beverage kiosk. Shuttles to the airport are also arranged through the front desk for $10. Sin Ventura i a wise choice.

reviews.title: Central hostal for a good price in the beautiful town of Antigua
reviews.text: La Sin Ventura I booked on another website due to good ratings. I was not disappointed - the right thing for my weekend stay. The rooms are adequate large, clean, equipped with all necessary things. There is a laundry service, too for 12 quetzales. The atmosphere of the old building is cozy. The staff very friendly and helpfull. WiFi is available at the reception or with some luck from the neighbored restaurant MonoLoco. I had a sinlge room (but with a 1,4m bed) without TV. For two persons they are supposed to have TV. Important to know: there is a bar/disco in the basement and yes - you can also hear it in the night. But due to local laws they have to close around 1 so that approx at 2 it is calm then. For me it was not a problem - I was out in the numberless bars and clubs around. The hostel is located close to the central park. You can find lots of historical buildings, restaurants, shops and agencies to plan trips. All in all it was a nice stay and totally the right thing for my purpose!

reviews.title: Good Place for the money
reviews.text: At $18 US the price was right for this place. The rooms are tiny but clean and have a private bathroom. The shower was strong and hot and clean. Bring ear plugs as the noise will drive you crazy especially on the weekends when the bars are in full swing. The location is excellent and the staff is great. The wifi works very well. There is no TV. You will pay about triple the price for a more comfortable room but for me it was not worth it.

reviews.title: Cheap and noisy
reviews.text: If you like to be in the middle of a noisy, teenager party instead to have a nice sleeping night, go ahead: La Sin Ventura is your place. But if you are a boy or a girl in your twenties, you will find this small, cheap hotel very enjoyable.

reviews.title: Great Location, Solid rooms - can be loud!
reviews.text: We thought the place was great. I'm a heavy sleeper, so the noise was not a real problem for me. But, I could see how it would be. Friday and Saturday nights, they have a club going right underneath, which is actually quite loud. The clubs and bars all close promptly at 1am, so it could be worse.

reviews.title: Stayed while on a medical mission
reviews.text: This was surprisingly a very enjoyable place to stay. It's not the usual place I would pick on a vacation but since the majority of our team was staying here it was convenient. Of course for the price you know you won't be staying in a lavish environment so keep that in mind. This is a no frills, minimalist type of approach. Staff was very pleasant, laundry can be done daily for a small fee. The rooms are clean. The bathrooms are small but there was hot water the majority of the time. One of the major drawbacks was the noise at night but it wasn't horrible. I would advise ear plugs just in case. This place definitely exceeded my expectations. The location is great, close to the center of town and easy walking distance to restaurants,stores. I wouldn't pick this for small children because the space is limited. But if you're looking for something inexpensive, clean, simple and conveniently located this is a good choice. There was actually something very appealing with the simplicity.

reviews.title: Central a location, colonial elements
reviews.text: Friendly staff, central location. WiFi reception in room at the end of the 1st floor hallway was a bit bad. Room was very large and tidy. Even though there was a salsa club below, little noise or disturbance of any kind.

reviews.title: Great position for a great place!
reviews.text: Main square close by, very nice and clean place, lovely terrace on the roof volcano view. Big rooms with big bathroom. Free wifi. Great value for money. At the second floor there's no noise from the club below. At the reception you can book trips they're always very kind. The perfect place in Antigua!

reviews.title: So beautiful and lovely staff
reviews.text: I have been very happy of my stay in this hotel not only for the best location in town and the unbeatable price also for the room style which was small but had everything I needed. The stuff is super nice and helpful. On top of all this the building with a very beautiful colonial architecture there is a terrance from where you can see all Antigua!

reviews.title: This hotel has one huge drawback
reviews.text: The location at only half a block from the main square is perfect, the rooms are attractively furnished and comfortable, the water for the shower is hot and has good pressure, the staff is polite and helpful and the price is reasonable. However, there is loud, booming music Tuesdays, Thursdays, Fridays and Saturdays from the disco on the ground floor. I was surprised to learn that this was owned by the hotel's owners, who seemed not to care about offering chances for peaceful sleep to guests these nights. The commotion stops at 1:00 A.M. and is less heard in one of the rooms deeper in the back.

reviews.title: Decent Hotel But Not For Light Sleeper
reviews.text: Located in the heart of Antigua, Sin La Ventura is an affordable, clean and safe hotel with a very friendly front desk staff. However, the rooms located along an open corridor do not offer much insulation from outside noise. There is nightclub downstairs nightclub that on some days can go into the early morning hours. If you plan on being out during the late evening then this is a manageable situation. I really enjoyed the location of Sin La Ventura and taking in almost decent views of the city from its balcony area. A few members of the front desk staff speak English well enough to provide good local information and were helpful in planning trips around the city. My room although basic was comfortable and the free Wi-Fi worked pretty well. I would definitely stay here again even if I have to fall asleep to the sounds of Antigua nightlife.

reviews.title: Good location, good value!
reviews.text: The location and the value are great. The rooms are spacious and the hot water pressure an absolute treat (best shower in Guatemala so far!). The wifi on the second floor wasn't working and the staff was in no hurry to fix it. There is a nightclub in the same building and the music could be heard at night. Having said that, it was a distant bass sound and monotonous enough to ignore. It kind of lulled me to sleep! I would definitely stay again in this place.

reviews.title: two discos downstairs - loud until 3am
reviews.text: There is one disco downstairs in the front and one next store. both are open and playing very loud music until 3am. we were not told about the disco when we checked in. Only when we arrived after dinner at 10pm, we heard the thumping music. it reverberates throughout the whole building. If you like to party all night it would be a great place to land and crash after drinking too much and dancing your tail off. I had a 14 year old daughter. so when in Rome, do as the romans do, dance all night long. otherwise hotel was clean, rooms nice, tile in hallway pretty. wireless in the lobby. polite staff.

reviews.title: Simple, clean, and great location
reviews.text: I stayed here for eight nights this summer. I had originally looked at four other hotels and hostels, and came back to La Sin Ventura. I booked two nights, thinking I might find another place cheaper, but every couple days I paid for more nights until my whole stay was here. It was super convenient to be just off Parque Central, so anytime I got a bit lost, I could ask how to get back, and everyone knows how to get to Parque Central. The room was quite small, but I only needed a place to sleep and shower, so that was fine. I paid USD18 per night. Yes, the nightclub downstairs was lively, but as a woman traveling alone, it was far less creepy to have a bit of a soundtrack in the background than dead silence. The WiFi was a bit unpredictable, sometimes limited to reception and sometimes available in my room. Rooftop access was locked :( though I'm told it's an amazing view.

reviews.title: Issues with noise from the bar and wifi
reviews.text: I arrived late on my first night (10:30 pm) and did not know about the bar on the ground floor. For the second night, I moved to another room supposedly away from the bar and should be quieter. Another issue - no wifi connection on this next room and has same loud bar noise. The cost per night per person is about 20 US$. The rooms on the second floor are for 2 persons or more; represented to be quieter. Good Points: very near the Central Park and other attractions of Antigua. Restaurants, shops and grocery stores are near by. Hotel staff can make shuttle arrangements. Newish bathrooms Tips: Use earplugs to help you get sleep. Choose rooms near the Reception/Front Desk for faster Wifi connection.

reviews.title: Fun when you are young, but...
reviews.text: When you are young and you are there to party and don't have to sleep, it's fine. It's in a fantastic location. Next to Mono Loco. The bar downstairs is fun, loud, and with stiff drinks. There are bathrooms with the room. The cons: loud, no a/c and there are windows that open into the hallway let in all the noise. And it is VERY noisy here because of the location between 2 very loud bars. A few of us got a rash from the sheets (maybe bedbugs?). The showers are kind of dirty. I would still recommend it for young travelers, but not if you want to sleep at night.

reviews.title: Decent value, friendly, noisy
reviews.text: For Q320 a night it's good value. It's a hotel, not a hostel. No dorm rooms. All private bathroom rooms, which are dated but perfectly fine and clean. Location is great in the middle of town and the bars /restaurants. Reception were very friendly and helpful. We extended our stay we were happy with the service. No breakfast on offer, but no real problem. The biggest problem was the noise. The rooms have a window onto the corridor. Very strange. But it is slated glass so cant really be fully closed. It meant that you could hear everything when people chatted whilst walking passed. You could also hear the neighbouring rooms easily. There is a large bar downstairs from the hotel (reception is on 1st floor) which can be heard from the rooms. I wont complain too much. It's a decent hotel for the price.

reviews.title: not for sleep
reviews.text: Spent two nights in La Sin Venturas. First night was a nightmare, music from the disco and people walking noisily on the corridors, shutting doors, etc. up to 3a.m. (I had to go to the reception and ask for help to stop my neighbour from a long and loud chat at 3a.m!). Following day I got another room and it was much better. Positive: very friendly stuff, excellent position, very nice roof and very cheap price. But do not go there if you wanna rest ;-)

reviews.title: Not posh, but a good budget option
reviews.text: I stayed at the La Sin Ventura for 2 nights after a medical mission in Guatemala. Our entire group stayed at this hotel so I’m not sure how much the rooms were per night. The sign out front said that you could stay for as little as $18 per night. If that’s true, it’s a good deal, but this is far from the nicest place in Antigua. It is reasonable, though if you want to be close to the center of town and are on a budget. The Hotel is located a block from the main plaza, so the location is great. While most of the hotels in Antigua are hidden behind walls with pretty courtyards, this one is open to the street. The street level is a nightclub which is incredibly loud most evenings and you can pretty much hear everything as the walls are paper thin. It didn’t look like there were many people at the club, but the music blared until after 1AM. Make sure you bring earplugs! There is no elevator, and the rooms are all on the second and third floor, so be prepared to haul your stuff upstairs. The check-in lobby is on the second floor and that is the only place you can ensure that you have internet access. There was patchy internet access on the third floor in our room, but you really cannot count on it. The rooms are pretty sparse, but clean. My room had three double beds which were clean but not terribly comfortable. There is an old CRT TV which did get cable and several American channels. There is no air conditioning and the room has glass windows that open to a corridor (where everything can be heard). Some rooms got extremely hot at night and there is no fan in the room. The lights were bare bulbs and the bathroom was pretty small. Still, the shower was outstanding with hot water and great water pressure. Good location with clean and bare bones accommodations. If you are on a budget, this would be a good choice. There are some really nice hotels in Antigua that are much nicer and more expensive, but this is a decent option.

reviews.title: Great value for money
reviews.text: Perfect location just 1 minute walking from the PARQUE central. Very spacious and clean room and bathroom. Confortable beds. We stayed there two nights and we could rest perfectly. We were there Sunday and Monday nights and we didn't hear any noise (I don't know in weekends). The staff was very nice and very helpful. The only negative point was that there was not wifi in the room, only in the reception. All in all, very good hotel. I would stay there again.

reviews.title: Charming Hotel, Charming Town, A Wonderful Few Days!!
reviews.text: Coming from Tikal, we spent a few days in Antigua before heading to Lake Atitlan. We stayed at the Hotel La Sin Ventura. Arriving at about 6:30 in the morning, it wasn't a problem to check in and get settled. The room was ready and they were happy to have us. We headed out pretty quickly to find a lovely place for breakfast just off of the town center. The hotel, is very close to some wonderful places to eat. Right next door is a great Korean place and downstairs is a nice place to grab coffee and a muffin for a quick breakfast. Antigua is a small village so the hotel is very close to everything you'd like to see as well as several tour organizers and ATMs. The staff was very nice, and accommodating. We had a very large, comfortable room with hot water and private bath for a very good price! We would stay there again on another visit!

reviews.title: Great staff, central location, kinda noisy
reviews.text: I stayed at this hotel for over two weeks during a medical mission trip, and they really made it feel like home. The staff is extremely helpful and friendly. The rooms are clean and homey, if a little small. It's centrally located. They have a rooftop patio with a great view of the city and the mountains. All of this outweighs the cons - really small bathrooms, and somewhat noisy (the adjoining disco, your neighbor's alarm clock, a squeaky roof vent, etc.). I'm a heavy sleeper, so the noise wasn't that bothersome.

reviews.title: Location, location, location
reviews.text: La Sin Ventura is a relatively inexpensive hotel located within a half block of Antigua's central park. It is squarely in the tourist zone and is surrounded by restaurants and several points of interest. The rooms are sparse but clean and well decorated, the bathrooms bright and the water pressure in the shower is a delight. The best part about this hotel is the staff; they always have a pleasant word to say and they go out of their way to please. As others have already noted, this hotel is directly above a discoteca that opened for business well after the hotel started. The hallways are tile and do an exellent job at carrying the sound into the rooms. So if you are a early bird and not a sound sleeper, then this may not be an ideal choice for you. The music did end promptly at 1am each night though and once people filtered back in from their night out, it was quite as a mouse.

reviews.title: Very mixed
reviews.text: Excellent location and friendly staff, but with several major drawbacks; The noise level is rather insane if you want a good night's sleep. Not only do you get a lot of hallroom noise, you can also hear your neighbours as well as the nightclub next to the hotel. I had no WifI in my room as it was at the end of the hallway. Recommended if you want to go to bed late and get up early for activities. if you want to get decent shut eye, steer clear!

reviews.title: Wonderful Customer Service!
reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel for a few nights and were delighted by the wonderful customer service! The front desk and cleaning staff were both accomdating and friendly. The rooms were nice and clean, and the location excellent. It did get loud on the first floor when the club downstairs was having a big night, but I imagine the noise doesn't carry through to the upper floors.

reviews.title: Best staff!
reviews.text: La Sin is a budget hotel with a super staff! The desk personnel are super friendly and speak English. We had the best cleaning staff who treated us like family and took excellent care of us! The location is next to the main Plaza so it was super easy to get around. Some evenings the music was very loud, however, it quits at midnight-so we could overlook the slight inconvience. Would definately stay here again!

reviews.title: Great location - not the most comfortable
reviews.text: This hotel was conveniently located near the central square in Antigua, as well as a movie theater, outdoor coffee stand, etc. The rooms were small but OK - no fans or outdoor windows if you stay on the first floor, so there isn't much air flow. It is located above a bar that is especially loud on Tuesdays (Ladies' Night), so you might not get much sleep if you stay here. Check out some other options if you can.

reviews.title: Bar review
reviews.text: While I did not stay at this property, I did have drinks at the bar. The location is really great as it is close to the square. Friday night was ladies night and they had rum and cokes for 3 Quetzales. The only downside was that at the level of volume they kept their music, one could only spend a limited time in there.

reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.text: We stayed at the hotel four nights. It is located in the main park area. Close walk to almost every attraction. The rooms were clean and the staff helpful. Saturday night the disco down stairs was loud. We found the value and price incredible.

reviews.title: Perfect location, friendly staff, beautiful building!!!
reviews.text: Located right in the middle of everything. Really nice staff, different size rooms for whatever your preference. Rooms in the back away from the club are quiet, but don't have great wifi. Rooms close to reception have great wifi, but it's noisy from the club. Would absolutely stay again!!! I originally booked 1 night and ended up staying for 4.

reviews.title: Would stay again!
reviews.text: Great location for access to everything! Clean rooms! Staff is very friendly, yet professional. Booking was easy. Check in/check out was a breeze. Free wifi in the lobby. Feels like a hotel, not a hostel. Great price! All the necessities, clean, safe, affordable. I would certainly stay again.

reviews.title: Great location! Good experience!
reviews.text: I really enjoyed la sin Ventura. We did not have an issue with noise but you could hear music from the club at night. The wifi did not work in our room, but I could use it in the public corridor. The location could not be any better! It is right off the main square. Our room was clean and comfortable. Staff was friendly and helped up book a shuttle to panajachel. I would stay here again!

reviews.title: Best location at the best rate
reviews.text: The location of the Sin Ventura is unbeatable, just few meters from the Parque Central and walking distance to all places around in Antigua. I have read that there is noise from the bar downstairs, our room was on the 3rd floor and was not affected at all. The staf is very kind and friendly, the rooms spacious (we got a triple room for 2 persons) and clean.

reviews.title: Value and Location
reviews.text: I stay at the Hotel Sin Ventura once a year when traveling from San Lucas, Toliman to Guatemala City. The price and location of this hotel are unbeatable. It is right next to the Parque Central, good restaurants, coffee shops, and other touristy Antigua attractions. The staff are super friendly and helpful. The rooms themselves are minimalist, definitely not fancy, but a place to sleep. There is a lot of noise at night since there is a bar under the hotel and the hallways echo. But, again, the price and location make the stay here worth it! The front desk sells bottled water for about 5Q (2/28/18) which is half the price that surrounding shops sell it for. They can also help arrange a shuttle to the airport, my group paid $10/person (USD on 2/28/18).

reviews.title: Honest, helpful staff
reviews.text: I would have to agree with some of the cons; a little noisy at night, no window to the outside, small rooms, but none of that is uncommon, esp. in this price range. We left the wife'scell phone and charger iin the room when we left for Panajachel. We emailed the hotel desk and the manager said they would hold it for us,as we were coming back to Antigua before we flew out of Guatemala. So we spent another night at the hotel, received our 3AM wake up call. It is a well run and clean hotel with an excellent location and staff.And the roof top sitting area has a great 360 degree view if the city and surrounding volcanos.

reviews.title: This is the place I come back to
reviews.text: La Sin Ventura is 75 yards from the central plaza of Antigua. Rooms are simple, neat, clean and offer hot showers. There is an attached cinema and cafe. On the ground floor is a disco. The disco is quiet after 10 PM. In the morning, the disco staff serve a continental breakfast. I have found the reception staff to be very accommodating. They provide shuttle service to and from Aurora, the international airport. Everything I need is a short walk from La Sin Ventura, and I have stayed there every year for the last five years.

reviews.title: Good overall, but may isolate noise better.
reviews.text: Good location and room conditions, but very noisy (I could hear next roommates all night long). My advise is to isolate noise better, maybe using PVC on windows. Room conditions were good, it was clean.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: The location is amazing, the water in my private bathroom was hot (a rarity in Guatemala) and the rooms were clean and comfortable. It can get a bit loud, but I didn't really have an issue with the noise. The staff are okay, but they aren't very helpful due to their limited English. Definitely recommended for the price, location, hot water and working wifi.

reviews.title: Great Location and Value
reviews.text: Clean hotel with basic necessities for a good price. Location could not be better. Staff was friendly and building is safe. I would recommend this hotel for couples or traveling solo. Antigua is a gem itself. There is not a more charming place!

reviews.title: Great value, great location
reviews.text: For a budget traveler who isnt concerned about nightclub noise, this is the place. The staff is amazing, the price is super cheap, the rooms are clean and the location is the best in Antigua. The downside is that its right next to a bunch of nightclubs, so it can be noisy. I am here at least 10 times a year and love it.

reviews.title: Can't believe this is a hotel or that anyone would stay here.
reviews.text: This place is just a noisy spot. When you walk by it the noise is just blaring! And it is a hotel? It has always been a spot for bars and mediocre restaurants. And no i did not stay here all you have to do is go by it and you would never want to enter much less spend the night. Loud bars/discos and hotels don't go nicely together.

reviews.title: Location great! Noise a problem..
reviews.text: There is a discotheque in the ground floor of this building, which we could hear all the way to the 3rd floor. Loudly. I am a light sleeper and had a hard time falling asleep. My girlfriend slept through it like a baby. Price is very good and the location can't be beaten! Would recommend to people not having trouble sleeping :-) Staff was friendly as well. They also offer laundry service and transportation to the airport.

reviews.title: Clean, safe and very very noisy accommodation.
reviews.text: I was hesitating before giving a 5-star review. But the I got from this hotel everything that I expected. It is right in the middle of town - walking distance to ALL the attractions, so there are always people or police around and I never felt unsafe. It is very clean, Martha is excellent and pleasant - keeps the hotel and rooms impeccable. I always had enough clean towels, hot water, and access to safe in the reception. My room was large with a small window that looked in the back of the property. Because the hotel has a bar or a club downstairs, it is very very noisy at night. If you are a light sleeper, bring ear plugs. The front desk staff is very helpful and accommodating.

reviews.title: Excellent location, great prices
reviews.text: Staff here is very friendly and accommodating. Cannot beat the location- it is only 1/2 block from the main plaza with many great restaurants/bars close by. My room was simple and clean and came with a private bath. Rooftop terrace for viewing the city available. I highly recommend this place and would stay here again. *note: there is a bar downstairs that can be a bit noisy- but it stops by midnight or so and I only noticed it on Sat night.

reviews.title: Great value for money
reviews.text: When we arrived late on a Saturday night, our first impression was boy what's going on here! There's a bar downstairs and of course on a Saturday it was busy but then we went up the stairs to the hotel reception and it was extremely charming. The rooms are basic but clean and the staff is great. The location is perfect, just a block away from the main square. Loved Antigua and loved La Sin Ventura.

reviews.title: Great location, good basic rooms
reviews.text: We stayed for 3 nights - bargain price and great location would definitely recommend. Staff are lovely. Nice terrace on the roof with views of Antigua and mountains. Laundry service was efficient and good.

reviews.title: Great located hotel
reviews.text: This hotel is in the center of Antigua Guatemala, really well located!!! close to everything... the service is good. The only bad thing is the reception of Internet in the rooms, it is so slow!!!... the have 24hrs service, so the hotel is always open (some hotels in Antigua have close time, FYI) sometimes can be a bit noisy since other guest are having fun in the rooms, LOL... the price is $18, so not that bad. It is clean and they have hot water as well

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: We've chosen the Hotel by accident, but it was great! The location great! Very clean, very nice and helpfull stuff, hot water, free WiFi. We've slept pretty well, we heard some loud music only once, because there are no real windows. I would stay there definately again. We stayed in the evening on the terrace.

reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text: It was a great experience, we didn't mind about the bar in the ground floor as we were in the 4th story. The room was comfy, clean and warm. The only thing I would complain is that there was only one sachet of shampoo and a tiny soap for both of us to share, everything else was awesome, the attention and location.

reviews.title: Great location, friendly staff
reviews.text: I stayed here for 4 nights during my very first trip outside Europe. Had a wonderful time the staff is so nice, the room is small but clean and it is so central. I had a good time dancing in the bar and on a next trip in the future i will definitely stay here again. Gracias a Alex y todo el personal!

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: The hotel is in a great location. It is a block from the city square and an easy walk to every restaurant. There are multiple clubs around and the loudest is on the ground floor of the hotel. It was worth it for the low price.

reviews.title: No Frills - Good Location
reviews.text: La Sin Ventura is really a hostel more than it is a Hotel. That being said, it's very good. The location is great, just steps from Antigua's central park. Everything was very clean and neat. Wifi is available in the lobby, but doesn't work too well in the room. The rooms are small, but the beds are clean and comfortable. Private bathroom was also clean and had everything you would need, including hot water! This hotel is perfect for the traveler who just needs a clean, secure place to stow their luggage, sleep, and shower. The staff was very friendly, though you may have some difficulties if you don't speak any Spanish. Check out was a breeze - just leave your key in the cabinet. For the price, everything you need is here.

reviews.title: Excellent location and value
reviews.text: It's a go to for me in Antigua. The rooms are small but clean, the location unbeatable. The wifi is weak and it's quite loud until 1am, but I am usually out and about until then anyhoo.... For 20USD it's a good value. Nice staff.

reviews.title: Great place for young people
reviews.text: The hotel is on top of a bar so at night there is loud music I could hear from my room (even with the windows closed). Nevertheless, this was a great place. I was within minutes (less than 5 minutes) from the central park. It is right next to Monoloco which is very convenient and even having a bar downstairs is great. I really liked the staff's attention. They were very helpful when I needed to know something from the city and its activities. I walked at night and felt extremely safe. Would definitely come back.

reviews.title: the noisest place to owernight
reviews.text: we stayed only one night in this hotel. its disco and cinema next wall. so, till 3am your bed like inside disco and in movie. no possibility to sleep. window in room enter to long public terrace.

reviews.title: Nice but Noisy
reviews.text: Good location, simple clean, nice rooms, and excellent wifi. But is right beside a bar with only an awning between it and the rooms which have essentially no sound proofing. If you noise doesn't interrupt your sleep, go for it... otherwise be sure to have good earplugs. Also, ask for a room far away from the stairwell. Even just people walking/talking is they are going to their rooms is quite loud.

reviews.title: cheap, decent option in a great location
reviews.text: We booked this room online extremely last minute. We chose it because it was so cheap (40USD for a double room) and because it's located just off the plaza. The location is perfect. The check-in process was easy and the people there were friendly. We must have gotten the last room for the night, because we were all the way at the back of the building. The good thing is that meant we were a little farther from the very noisy bar and club that takes up the whole bottom floor of the building. The room was small, but suited our purpose since we were only there for 1 night. It had a couple tiny windows but was otherwise pretty dark. Because we had booked so last minute, I think they didn't have time to finish cleaning the room. The sheets seemed clean, but the wastebasket was full of garbage and there were half-empty water bottles on the dresser. The bathroom was decent and the shower had good pressure and constant hot water. Just bring earplugs if you're a light sleeper, because you can definitely hear the club music from your room. We were there on a Saturday, so I'm not sure if it's noisy like that every night. For the location and price, I would definitely stay there again.

reviews.title: Simple hotel in the city center
reviews.text: The hostel has simple rooms but very good location in the city center. So its close to many attractions, restaurants, market. The only problem is when you have a car, because there is no place to park it near the hotel. There are parking places in the nearests streets, but remember to park in the right place because the police will give you a ticket.

reviews.title: Great location!
reviews.text: Strategically located next to central park, churches and restaurants. Internet does no work in all areas. There is a restaurant and bar on the first floor. Tip: they don't have iron service, so iron your clothes at home.

reviews.title: Good location and clean rooms
reviews.text: I stayed there two nights at the end of May 2013. If you are a traveling couple, I would advice to stay in the rooms with two double beds. The cost is the same as for a room with only one king/queen size bed. The major difference is that the rooms with one bed are on the "first" floor, which for Americans that means the second floor, and at night the music coming from two different bars might be too much. Another problem I found was the shower head was too high and the shower curtain too low. This led to water spilling all over the bathroom once done showering. I will also recommend not booking any of your tours or shuttles through the hotel. You're better off going to any of the many travel agencies and make sure you negotiate the price. The hotel's location is perfect. It's half a block away from the central park which makes it close to everything else. Also, there is someone on the front desk all 24 hours a day in case you need anything. My favorite perk of the hotel was the terrace they have. Maybe buy yourself some beer/wine and take it up there while you enjoy a 360 view of the entire town. In the end the hotel is not horrible but there is definitely some room for improvements.

reviews.title: Hotel stay
reviews.text: Nice rooms, affordable for budget traveller. Located in the heart of Antigua and on the main street that connects to almost all parts of this beautiful town. So easy to find. Free wifi. Free breakfast.

reviews.title: Centrally located
reviews.text: Location was great centrally located; walking distance from El Parque Central & El Arco. Hostel is on top of a restaurant/bar so late at night there is live latin music; for those looking for a quite place to stay this will not be your first pick. Personnel was friendly & super helpful. Cleanness was great, hot water available & free wifi.

reviews.title: Perfect hotel for (female) backpackers
reviews.text: After 4 weeks of traveling without warmwater showers, staying in Sin Ventura was a bliss. Their shower was great, and I felt finally clean... Furthermore if your traveling alone it is not save to walk the streets alone at night, since Sin Ventura is just around the corner of the Central Park and close to the bars you don´t have to worry to get back to your hotel. Surrounded by bars it can get quite noisy though, but if your (like me) go out yourself there is no problem...

reviews.title: Great and well located choice.
reviews.text: I stayed here recently for one night and for a second time. Great location just off the main square. Small but very comfortable room with terrific shower. Very helpful lady at check in. Free WiFi. There is a nice coffee shop downstairs. I will stay here again.

reviews.title: I was really happy with my stay here!
reviews.text: My husband and I live in Canada with our 5 and 4 year olds. We go to Guatemala at least once every two years and we just love it there. All of my husband's family is Canadian so when they hear how much fun we always have in Guatemala they always want to come with us. Now my husband and I are adventurers at heart! We do not care about comfort or anything at all, not even when we bring our children. We want them to be OK being uncomfortable as long as they are safe travelling and learning about different cultures. I always get nervous about my husband's family though, especially when I reserved these hotel rooms for a really cheap price. I was really happy to see what the hotel looked like, the rooms were super clean, great location, great view. Simple yet perfect for what the purpose was. I totally recommend this hotel. Staff was super nice too.

reviews.title: Nice location but avoid the weekends due to disco downstairs
reviews.text: This place gets my own rating of 1 or 2 on Friday and Saturday and a 4 any other day. The price goes up on the weekend too; if anything it should be half price. I stayed at this hotel on 3 visits to Antigua and the last visit (on a Friday and Saturday) I finally convinced myself not to return if I am visiting on the weekend. Ear plugs and Ambien will barely overcome the noise of the disco. Other than that, the descriptions outlined here are correct. The location could not be any better. It is a clean place, there is about 1” of space between your knees and the wall when sitting on the toilet, the shower is nice, forceful and hot and the single beds are for the most part comfortable. The sole louvered windows into the hall seem to provide adequate ventilation but one often wonders if fellow tourists with their clickity clack rolling suitcases and yells down the hall at late hours to get the attention of family members entering or exiting the hotel are worse than the traffic noise when windows face the street. (At least street noise dies down late at night, while most tourists believe if they awaken at 5AM, you should too). The rates run about $20 US P/P. There appears to be ample parking, and just 2 doors down from the hotel entrance in the strangest location I have ever parked, an old movie theater with the seats removed. It’s almost worth a stay in the hotel for the fun of parking in the indoor theater. Of course you stand to lose a little paint or a mirror if you are not skilled with driving through such a narrow opening, but if you have been driving in Guatemala a few weeks dodging people, dogs, carts, cars and busses, then driving in off the sidewalke into an indoor theater should be a breeze. Note the guy running the booth just outside the hotel that sells mixed drinks, soft drinks, juices, beer, gourmet cappuccino and your free breakfast has a key to the parking garage and can let you in any time to remove or replace any items in you auto. In my initial day’s search on my first visit to Antigua, I found plenty of on-the-grounds hotel parking if you pay a high price for the hotel. According to the tourist office there are only 3 budget hotels that they were aware of with parking. There are of course a few city lots but I always try to find a hotel where I can at least walk to the car at night if I discover I need something I left there, and one typically doesn’t bring everything into the hotel each night.

reviews.title: Good location, wifi improved
reviews.text: We stayed here our first night in Antigua because I knew it would be a reliable choice in a location I knew well. It is far from the cheapest at $18/pp regardless of how many are in a room, but it is clean, comfortable, and very near Parque Central. Last year I found the wifi a bit spotty once I left the lobby, but there is a router at the end of the third floor now, so we had good access. I have never had a problem with bar noise, either on the second or third floor, but I also find hotels that are too quiet feel creepy to me, especially if I'm alone, so it's an individual preference thing.

reviews.title: Good cheap hotel, super location
reviews.text: The location is the biggest selling point of this hotel. It is very close to Parque Central so it is easy to get everywhere & safer as a solo female traveller. I had a room on the first floor. It was rather small & dark, however it was clean, the bathroom & shower were good & perfect for my needs. I had no problems with noise at all. The staff closed all the main doors to reduce noise levels from the bar next door in the evenings. The staff were very friendly & helpful.

reviews.title: Awful, unprofessional staff
reviews.text: My boyfriend stayed for 2 nights without issue. I met with him the 3rd night. He checked the price for 2 people via booking.com, which showed the same price for a single room. He notified the front desk there would be a second person arriving. They charged us for a double room-twice the amount-even though we were in a single room. There is an error on booking.com where it shows the price for a single room when searching for 2 adults. At no point were we offered to move to the larger room, which was what we were paying for. The staff acknowledged the error on booking.com, while blaming us for not "asking for the larger room," suggesting that we should have had the understanding that it was an option. We were not reimbursed money, and they still refuse to take responsibility for their staff's error in not offering a larger room. If that had happened, we would have had an understanding that something was awry. Never again will I stay here, and I would not recommend it for anyone else.

reviews.title: really nice hotel for the price
reviews.text: We stayed in a triple room on the third floor. It was really clean and quiet on our stay. The staff was really nice. The only disappointment was the included continental breakfast, but there are many other great places to get inexpensive food in Antigua.

reviews.title: Great location, no character
reviews.text: La Sin Ventura has a great location on the Parque Central, but I do not recommend staying their. It is located directly above Mono Loco, a cheesy tourist hot spot that blasts music until all hours of the night, every night right into hotel guests' rooms. Our room had no window, was very stuffy, was teeny tiny, and lacked any character or charm. For the same price there are many hotels with lush garden courtyards and more spacious rooms. And, I imagine, there are many without the constant blare of disco music pumping into your room until the wee hours of the morning.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Stayed here for two nights on the tail end of a Gecko tour – therefore not sure of the price factor. Fantastic location and set in a gorgeous old building. The rooms were basic but nice, not huge but still full functional and with ensuites. Given the setup of the hotel (long corridors with tiles) it was sometimes noisy, particularly at night as there is a bar downstairs and next door. Staff were friendly and helpful, rooms were kept clean and the bar downstairs was great. Overall the location is the best feature of the hotel, just a stone’s throw from the markets, square and main strip. Would probably stay here again.

reviews.title: Best Bed and Breakfast on Lake Erie
reviews.text: We have stayed here repeatedly since discovering this gem early last summer. Phil Laurien has created the perfect lake house retreat with an emphasis on style and comfort. This B+B was just awarded the best of Lake Erie award for 2014 by Lake Erie Living magazine. Even when all 3 units are full, you will find privacy and quiet both inside and out. With all the modern conveniences such as flat screen tv and wifi, we were very comfortable. We relaxed all day and dined at great restaurants (Chez Francois and the Wine Vault) each night. Upon checking in we were given vouchers for breakfast or lunch each day at a nearby restaurant which was quite nice. Vermilion is a lovely little town to explore -with great shopping , beach and lovely lake views. You can walk anywhere unless, like me, you wear 4 inch heels to dinner! Do not limit your visits to summer. This inn has ample heating for cold fall and winter nights. I love the lake in the winter, and there is always a good restaurant nearby. We are so glad to arrive here and then sad to say goodbye to Phil and Roxie ( the wonder dog!). Until our next visit...

reviews.title: Private Cottage Retreat on Wedding night
reviews.text: My husband and I were kidnapped and taken to the private cottage on our wedding night as a wedding gift from family! Very nice and clean place...the owner, Phil was very pleasant and welcoming. The cottage is highly recommended and beautifully decorated.

reviews.title: Clean and comfortable, but not remarkable. Should not really be billed as a 'Bed and Breakfast'
reviews.text: We stayed in the Cottage on a recent Saturday evening. The InnKeeper Phil gave us a lovely tour of the main house and we stayed in the Cottage which was comfortable and clean but not remarkable. When we stay at a Bed & Breakfast, we are looking for a nice breakfast as part of the experience. We received coupons for Granny Joe's down the street. The coupons did not quite cover the cost of the cheapest breakfast and the coffee was pretty bad.

reviews.title: Perfect!
reviews.text: We stayed at this lovely B&B enjoying Vermilion's third Thursday celebration. The place is spotlessly clean, beautifully decorated and spacious. It's perfectly located, within a short walk to shops, restaurants and Lake Erie. My husband and I stayed in the Sunshine Room. Our friends enjoyed the very spacious Captain's Quarters. We both were thrilled with our accommodations. Phil, the owner, is gracious and friendly. He provided baked goods from a local bakery at 7 am and we were given a coupon to a local place for a hot breakfast (the breakfast was just okay). Phil only takes cash or check. He lives upstairs in the home. He does have a dog that goes within him throughout parts of the the house. There was no evidence that the dog had been in our room - everything was extremely clean. Loved this place!!

reviews.title: Away from It All
reviews.text: We wanted to get away from it all, especially schedules. The Captain Bell House and all of Vermilion was an excellent place to relax. The house is within walking distance to almost everything we wanted to do. We like that there was no fixed time for breakfast as the vouchers could be used at any time during the day at Granny Joe's. Phil was helpful with local information - good recommendation to check out the Wine Vault. Room was comfortable and quiet. We are already planning some time in Vermilion next fall and will stay at the Captain Bell House if it's available.

reviews.title: Perfect Anniversary Celebration
reviews.text: You know you're in a special place when the proprietor spends 30 minutes walking you through every inch of his B&B's restoration. Staying at the Captain Bell House is a beautiful combination with a dinner at Chez Françoise, which is a 5 minute walk down the street. Stay in The Cottage (very romantic).

reviews.title: Beautiful and Comfortable Weekend Retreat
reviews.text: We decided to stay for a full weekend in Vermilion for our anniversary and were so pleased to have found Captain Bell House as our base. We stayed in the Eagles Nest Suite on the upper level and were wowed by how beautiful and spacious it was. The bed was especially comfortable and I really appreciated having a full kitchen, Keurig coffeemaker and real half and half in the fridge. Top notch amenities included breakfast certificates to Granny Jos for a full hot breakfast. Great location where we could walk to just about everything. Thank you Phil for restoring this beautiful home and providing every comfort we needed for a lovely weekend.

reviews.title: Exceeded Our Expectations
reviews.text: We spent the night in the cottage. It was wonderful,very clean with nice furniture and first class fixtures. Phill and his lovely daughter spared no expense in the remodeling of this old house! He also was kind enough to give us a complete tour and biography of the house. He is one entertaining and interesting host,we liked him. We will be back to spend more time and share this lovely place with our friends and relatives.

reviews.title: Perfect Place!
reviews.text: We made last minute reservations and got the Sunshine Room which is on the ground floor with a private entrance and next to the full kitchen with Kuerig coffee, fridge and stove. The room and bath were delightful and clean. The bed was very comfortable. The owner, Phil, and his dog, Roxie, were gracious and accomadating. We walked to dinner at Chez Francois which is fabulous! Instead of the typical breakfast with other guest we were given $6.00 vouchers to Granny Joe's one block away which worked out beautifully since we like to sleep in later than most. We definitely will be back.

reviews.title: Best B&B in town
reviews.text: Our stay at the Captain Bell B&B was outstanding. The accommodations were well appointed and the place was spotless. Phil, the innkeeper, was very gracious and accomidating. He went above and beyond to make sure our stay was very special. We also appreciated that the stores and restaurants (as well as the beach) were all within walking distance. We came here as honeymooners and will look forward to spending future annversary's here!

reviews.title: Wedding NIght Get-Away
reviews.text: We decided to stay at the Captain Bell House after our wedding in Vermilion. Although we could only stay for one night, we were thoroughly impressed by everything we saw and enjoyed ourselves immensely. We stayed in the Captain's Quarters, which is almost like an apartment attached to the building - we had our own bathroom, kitchen, sitting room, and bedroom, not to mention plenty of closet space. Everything was quaint, charming, very clean, and very thoughtful. The owner was very courteous and obviously very proud of the establishment, and rightfully so. We highly recommend a stay here to anyone vacationing here from out of town or for anyone who simply wants a little weekend getaway. We will most certainly be back ourselves.

reviews.title: Warm and Cozy
reviews.text: We only stayed one night, and the accommodations were wonderful. We stayed in the Captain's Quarters which has it's own living area and kitchen. It was quite private, we actually felt like we were staying in a separate property. This would be a great spot for a mid-to-long term stay. The location is perfect, with a quick walk to the beach and downtown Vermilion. Phil and his dog Roxie were very welcoming. I would highly recommend staying here, and look forward to returning for a visit next year.

reviews.title: Not typically a fan of bed & breakfast's
reviews.text: What a treat, all new interior and well appointed...comfy thruout ,including the bed and towels.. The owner Phil and his sweet dog Roxy are a great way to be introduced to this wonderful bed-and-breakfast.. We plan to go back soon for a French wine tasting dinner at the incredible Chez Francois restaurant..

reviews.title: Two night stay
reviews.text: We just spent two nights in the cottage and can't say enough nice things about the cottage and our host. We loved the decor and the cottage was super clean and well appointed. I Would recommend this to anyone looking for a family or romantic getaway.

reviews.title: Best In Vermilion
reviews.text: I visit Vermilion annually and have tried several hotels and B&Bs -- this is the best one! Stayed in the Captain Quarters and found it exceeded expectations. Comfortable beds -even the fold out couch and nicely appointed rooms. Fluffy Towels and all the extras like gourmet coffee, snacks, waters and breakfast at one of the best spots in town included! Location is great for walking to all the restaurants, lake and lagoons. Owner is very helpful and personable but not intrusive. Will be back next year!

reviews.title: What a great place!
reviews.text: We came for one night. It was a mom and three grown daughters. We had a wonderful time. Phil is a fabulous owner. He made everything so comfortable and well appointed. It was clean and done well throughout. Phil thought of everything. He even brought pastries in the morning. He gave us a tour of the house and was so knowledgeable of his house and the local area. We have been coming to Vermilion for 50+ years and I would highly recommend staying at the Captain Bell House.

reviews.title: Best place in Vermilion!
reviews.text: This is an extraordinary B&B! Phil was a gracious host and knew how to be invisible yet there when we needed him. Kept the charm of the house but added central air along with Amazing renovations; top notch appliances, high quality bed linens, tons of bath towels( fresh every day!) Provided 3 cruiser bikes AND took the time to help me hitch our bike trailer. Gracious with my in laws, switched out a chair in their suite to accommodate her wheelchair... Quiet!!! Beautiful, can’t wait to stay again. Even had spring water and ginger snaps in both suites. Absolutely Love this place!

reviews.title: Outstanding!
reviews.text: We were traveling home and on a whim stopped here. Phil restored this historic home himself, with a real eye for detail. The Sunshine Room (suite) was huge and very well appointed, comfortable, with a spacious bathroom. Follow his recommendations for dinner. The voucher for breakfast was a real plus. Everything within walking distance. Outstanding!

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: The owner shows a lot of hospitality! I stayed at the cottage with my dog and the place is very clean and had everything I needed. I have stayed here twice and hope to stay again. A perfect place to relax!

reviews.title: Anniversary
reviews.text: We live near Cleveland, an hour from Vermillion. So when we decided to celebrate our 45th anniversary with dinner at Chez Francois, we thought it would be nice to stay at a B and B in Vermillion rather than make the longish drive home. We stayed in the cottage at Captain Bell's. Everything about it was lovely - the accomodations were first class -good coffee in the room with real half and half. And organic maple syrup (!) for our short trek to Grandma Joe's for breakfast (a $6.00 voucher per person goes towards that. Very comfortable bed. We parked our car there and walked everywhere. Just perfect. Phil and his daughter have created a very welcoming and comfortable escape for visitors to Vermillion. We will return!

reviews.title: Welcoming, Friendly, Clean, Cozy
reviews.text: My husband and I made reservations for dinner and a night's stay in Vermilion in September. We reserved the Sunshine Suite at the Captain Bell House B&B. We received a warm welcome from the proprietor and his sweet dog Roxy. We had a wonderful stay in this charming historical B&B. In the morning, we had a nice cup of coffee in the B&B's kitchen, then walked a short distance to enjoy our breakfast.

reviews.title: Top notch, dog- and people-friendly
reviews.text: We stayed in the beautifully renovated cottage. Sparkling clean with a comfortable seating area and small but important details like good lighting. Great location just down the street from good restaurants and the public beach. Our host was very welcoming to both us and our dog. He hopes to sell it and I hope he finds an owner-operator who takes as good care of it - and his guests- as he does.

reviews.title: best kept secret in Vermillion
reviews.text: Spent a great weekend in Vermillion. Phil is a great host. Recommendation for dinner at the WineVault was spot on. Great get away weekend place - even in the winter --- Fun weekend with the Ice Sculptures in town and Chocolate Library fund raiser. Look forward to coming back in the spring with our bicycle's.

reviews.title: A great birthday weekend gift
reviews.text: My daughter and her family took my husband and me to Vermillion for my birthday. While we travel a lot, this was my first experience at a Bed and Breakfast and I couldn't be more pleased. My husband and I stayed in the Sunshine Room and my daughter and her family in the Captain's Quarters. The rooms were lovely, the beds very comfortable and the host, Phil, was very gracious and informative. We all enjoyed the Keurig in the kitchen with tea, coffee, hot chocolate and cider as well as the yummy ginger snap cookies. Lake Erie is a short walk away as are the restaurants and shops downtown. I highly recommend The Captain Bell House and hope to visit again.

reviews.title: The Best Place to Stay, EVER !!
reviews.text: My cousin and I stayed here for 2 weeks in the Captain's Quarters. We LOVED it here !! The proprietor, Phil, is a gracious host with an amazing attention to detail and cleanliness. I highly recommend this B & B !! Luxurious towels and sheets !! This is truly an amazing and wonderful place to stay, but you better hurry to book a suite, as this place books quickly !! 5 stars !!

reviews.title: Vermilion retreat
reviews.text: Had a wonderful time in Vermilion and enjoyed my stay at Captain Bell House. It was super clean, very quiet and had wonderful amenities. Phil was very helpful and accommodating. Definitely would stay here again.

reviews.title: Excellent choice in Vermilion
reviews.text: I have never been to a better B&B. We stayed in the seperate cottage which was perfect for us. It was immaculate and the towels luxurious. The owner, Phil, is very accommodating. He gave us restaurant, sight seeing and other local information. His advice was spot on every time. He allowed us free use of 2 bikes and told us a great spot to ride to so we could watch the sun set over Lake Erie. Phil attends to every detail, such as bottled water, a Keurig with a huge selection of coffee, tea and cider and even a jar of ginger snaps.
