He delivers fresh locally made pasteries for breakfast and you also receive a voucher for a local restaurant for breakfast or any meal. The kitchenette (with fridge and microwave) in the cottage is well stocked with table and silverware, and there is even a selection of DVD movies to watch. Phil took the time to pump up the tires and clean the bikes daily, and it is clear he puts in a huge amount of work here. What a deal! THE Captain Bell House cottage truly was a home away from home for us. We will definitely visit again.

reviews.title: Loved It!!!
reviews.text: Went to Captin Bell's on Feb 3, had a great time in Vermillion, Ohio with Ice-Afair. We stayed in the Sunshine room, and enjoyed every minute of it. Phil (the owner) was very gracious and accomidating. This is a great place to stay if you are visiting Vermilion, Ohio. With in walking distance of downtown. We had a great time.

reviews.title: Cute and Cozy!
reviews.text: We have stayed at this b&b a few times and have had a wonderful experience each time. This place is new, clean, and so cozy! It's our favorite place to stay in Vermilion. Phil was extremely accommodating and keeps a great place. Highly recommended!

reviews.title: Really enjoyable stay- thanks Phil
reviews.text: Excellent room, renovation, and host...the Bell house is our new favorite place to stay when dining in Vermilion. Breakfast vouchers for local restaurant Grandpa Joe's is a great idea. Short, scenic walk to town.

reviews.title: Last minute stop
reviews.text: Captain Phil was extremely accommodating and had a very clean perfect space for me to spend the evening! I highly recommend this as well as just going to Vermilion. Captain Phil even suggested a wonderful restaurant. I travel every week for work and almost never stay in a traditional hotel anymore. This was the exact experience I was looking for and will definitely use Captain Phil again when I return to Vermilion Ohio.

reviews.title: A family gathering
reviews.text: My husband and I wanted to treat our family to our favorite restaurant and we called this beautiful manor on a wime. Coincidentally, he had a cancellation and we had the absolute pleasure of staying in a very spacious suite for one night. I have stayed in several B&B's and have never come across someone who rents by the day. It was absolutely perfect for our schedule (we had to work the next day), however, we also enjoyed a relaxing night in this sweet, adorable town. The suite had a full sized kitchen along with a huge pull away couch bed (which I ended up using d/t a snoring spouse!). A delightful double bed with huge closets. My favorite surprise about the place, FULL size washer and dryer!! We didn't have to use them but what a forethought for travelers who do!! The nautical decor was perfect!! Definitely coming back!!

reviews.title: Cottage was Very Nice and Quaint!!
reviews.text: We stayed one night at the cottage at Captain Bell;s B and B. We were very pleased with the nautical decor. The bed was comfortable and the room very clean. There is just one bed so perfect for a couple.You receive a voucher for breakfast at Granny Jo's, a nice small restaurant a few blocks away. This B & B is close to Chez Francois the excellent French restaurant on the river. The owner Phil was pleasant and made sure the stay was to our satisfaction. I would highly recommend Captain Bell;s.

reviews.title: Good place
reviews.text: This B&B is a "good place". We stayed there on an impulse and it worked out fine. The house has been renovated expensively and it has been a labor of love. A most enjoyable visit with Phil and Roxie. Worth the stop.

reviews.title: Excellent get-away!
reviews.text: I've stayed at the Captain Bell House twice, and as a Clevelander, it is the perfect get-away! Each room or suite is very different, so you can tailor your trip to your needs. But whichever one you choose, your host Phil will greet you kindly, explain all you need to know, and give you good tips on your Vermilion stay. It's in the center of town, so you can walk everywhere. It's spotless, homey, inviting, and spacious. I highly recommend!

reviews.title: We'll be back!
reviews.text: My sister and I grew up near Vermilion but now both live elsewhere. Headed back to Ohio for a wedding this summer, I was looking for a place that both our families (4 adults, 4 children ages 4-14) could stay and have plenty of room to spread out and hang out together. Captain Bell House was perfect! We rented all three rooms (each much more than just a room!). The Captain's Quarters is your own little apartment. Super spacious, with a full kitchen. The Sunshine room has a huge bathroom and the Cottage is adorable and also very spacious. The entire property is newly renovated and very clean. Both my sister and I agreed that the pictures posted don't do this B&B justice. Our expectations were far exceeded! The innkeeper is friendly, accommodating, and always available to make your stay just right. The location couldn't be better, just on the edge of town walking distance to the beach, shops, restaurants, etc... My family and I will surely be back to Captain Bell House when we visit Ohio again!

reviews.title: Inadvertent Pleasure
reviews.text: My fiance and I were traveling to Hickory Corners, MI in our 1968 Lincoln to participate the opening of the Lincoln Museum at Hickory Corners and decided to travel the coast of Lake Erie. We stopped to ask about the B&B and Phil was up on a ladder painting. His hospitality is like visiting your favorite brother who is the nicest person on the planet. Don't miss Phil's suggestions on restaurants on good routes on which to travel. Thanks Phil, we will be back! Kim and Carter

reviews.title: Phil Thought of everything when Refurbishing & Decorating this stunning home!!
reviews.text: My Husband & I received an over nite at Captain Bell house as a Christmas gift from our girls ( along w/ dinner in town) We had a wonderful stay & Really enjoyed chatting w/ Phil the owner. Great guy w/ Terrific stories, very pleasant & easy going. He has a sweet dog named Miley. The home is Beautiful,very cozy & super clean. He has coffee tea & water available along w/ a jar of ginger snaps,kitchen utensils, large umbrella in case it rains but you still want to walk around the cute town, blow dryer, Bikes etc ... he thought of everything!! We would not hesitate to go back!! Thanks Phil for a memorable weekend

reviews.title: Quiet Inn with Character and Comfort
reviews.text: As with many who visit Chez Francois in Vermilion a place to stay is important. We discovered the Captain Bell House B & B for the first time this past weekend. It is furnished very simply but very comfortably. The common area is spotless and equipped with a Keurig with all types of beverage options and a big glass jar of wonderfully crisp gingersnap cookies. The innkeeper, Phil Laurien, pointed out the milk in the fridge for dunking. Our room and private bathroom were called the Sunshine Room and is decorated accordingly. The bed was very comfy and the lighting was excellent. The breakfast voucher to a breakfast spot a two minute walk away allowed us to enjoy exactly what we want to eat and it was a nice touch. Phil did have fresh pastries for us from a local bakery to enjoy as well. This was a very nice spot for a anniversary celebration and will be on our radar next time we come up for dinner.

reviews.title: Wanted a different kind of vacation!!!
reviews.text: Well we got it. Captain Bell house B&B was nothing but amazing! Phil the proprietor was so warm and welcoming and attended to all our needs. We stayed in the Captains quarters and it felt like home! Clean towels everyday, washer and dryer so we didn't go home with dirty cloths. Nautical theme. A coffee bar in the main house with any coffee or tea you wanted at any time day or night. Phil would leave blueberry muffins or cookies in the morning at the coffee station. Beautiful old home totally redone by Phil with hardwood flooring and all modern flair with a cozy fireplace. Located right near Lake Erie! The town is walking distance with charming shops. Thank you Phil for making our anniversary vacation one to remember. Also Phil is very knowledgeable of the history of the town.

reviews.title: More than 5 Stars!
reviews.text: If you are going to Vermilion, this is the place to stay! It was our first time there and we will definitely be back and will be staying once again at this AWESOME B & B. The owner, Phil, is wonderful! And you wake up every morning to yummy treats from an awesome bakery. The place is immaculate and incredibly comfortable. We had such an enjoyable time and "Captain" Phil and his sweet dog Roxie are the best! We didn't want to leave!

reviews.title: Captain Bell Bed And Breakfast
reviews.text: Best Bed and Breakfast. First time staying at one and will go back again. We had a girls weekend and had a wonderful time. Walking distance to shops and beach. Well maintain,beautiful rooms,friendly inn keeper.

reviews.title: Location, location, location
reviews.text: My brother and wife stayed one night in the main house and my wife and I stayed in the cottage next door. The owner Phil was very cordial and informative. We were on a lakefront housing search and hoping to move to the Vermilion area. He arranged an introduction to an area realtor and drew us a map to a home we might consider that he knew about first hand. The nearby restaurants/taverns are a very short walk away. We will return without question regardless of finding our dream home. The home is quite old but restored perfectly and very quiet as was the cottage.

reviews.title: Excellent; we will come back!
reviews.text: This is a very good B&B. Everything we look for. Genuine hospitality. Captain's Quarters is on the ground floor; generously large with full kitchen; like an apartment; exquisitely decorated with antiques and art; everything you need is there. Comfortable bed; GREAT shower; gushy towels; good wifi; reasonable rates. Easy parking, all about a block from the lake and good restaurants nearby. We will be back. Two things to know: No credit cards, cash or check only. Breakfast is provided by certificates to a great breakfast place a block away, very good. That said, the B&B has a great coffee maker, plenty of cookies, and our very attentive host brought fresh muffins in each morning. Highly recommend. Paul and Jean Amundsen

reviews.title: Great stay!!!
reviews.text: This was our first time at a bed and breakfast and it was a great experience. We had the sunshine suite which was very private and had its own entrance from the outside. The room was very clean and the bed was very comfortable. The best part of our experience at Captain Bells was our host Phil and his adorable dog Roxy. Phil was extremely accommodating and made us feel real comfortable. He gave us bikes to use and made great suggestions of places to go in the area. Thanks Phil for making our anniversary special! We will be back!

reviews.title: Beautiful restoration, very clean, convenient
reviews.text: We stayed only one night. We were in Vermilion for a wonderful wine dinner at Chez Francois, just a few blocks away, within walking distance in good weather. This is a small B & B with just 2 guest rooms on the first floor of the house, both having their own outside entrance. Additionally, there is a separate small cottage next door. Unlike some B & B's, there is no communal gathering at the dining table in the morning. Rather, Phil gives a $-off coupon for you to eat at a very nearby ice-cream parlor/restaurant that serves a basic breakfast. He also had fresh Danish/cinnamon rolls available for us in the Capt Bell kitchen by 7:00 AM, along with an instant coffee machine and special pods for pretty darn good coffee. Eating elsewhere was not a problem for us. In fact it allowed us to just grab a quick morning meal and be on our way. So if you relish the multi-course gourmet breakfast and chatting with other guests, (typical of some B & B's) this is not the place to find that. What you WILL find is a very knowledgeable innkeeper, a lovingly restored 1850's house on the main street running through Vermilion, your own clean modern bathroom, and a comfortable bed. You won't find cabbage rose wallpaper, musty doilies, and fussy tassels. Our room was freshly painted, clean, cheery, air-conditioned, and a welcome change from the dark dusty mode of some other inns in historic buildings. Phil has a wealth of knowledge about the house and what it took for him bring it up to guesthouse standards. He is a renovation hobbyist and knows a great deal about housing. He gave us a great tour of Captain Bell, almost worth the price of our stay. We will most certainly return for future visits.

reviews.title: Perfect Vacation Stay
reviews.text: We made a last-minute decision to stay overnight in Vermilion after visiting the islands. We were so lucky there was space available at the Captain Bell House! The Captain's Quarters suite was just perfect. Phil's attention to detail showed through every inch of the property. Far exceeded anything we had hoped for - extremely clean, lovely decor, fully updated but retaining the original old world charm. We left feeling very pampered and looking forward to our next stay at the Captain Bell House.

reviews.title: Perfect getaway
reviews.text: We heard great things about this B&B and had also wanted to try Chez Francois, so we found a weekend where we could do both (book early!). The Sunshine Room was perfect for us (but if you do not want to hear any "house sounds" (footsteps on creaky floors or don't want anyone to hear you, you might want another room! Everything was very comfortable and fully updated. As stated in many other reviews, this B&B is only a couple of blocks away from the beach and downtown Vermillion. Wished we could stay a little longer!

reviews.title: Our home away from home....
reviews.text: This was our second stay at The Captain Bell House...Such a wonderful Bed and Breakfast..with an amazing host Phil...He stays on top of all our needs and is very informative about the area...He restored this charming old sea captains home to its former glory. It is so well appointed and clean.We just loved staying here in our little cottage away from home...Fresh brewed coffee every morning in our room and then off to the wonderful breakfast place just a block away for a delicious breakfast. If you are ever in Vermilion and looking for a place to stay I would strongly suggest that you check out this "JEWEL" of a bed and breakfast! You will be so glad you did...We will be going back to stay again in the fall. Lake Erie is just a few blocks away and there is a little park to watch the sunset over the lake in the afternoons...Just so Beautiful..I highly recommend it....Thanks Phil for our wonderful vacation spot...we just love everything The Captain Bell House has given us...A Home away from Home!

reviews.title: Fantastic overnight getaway spot
reviews.text: Stayed in Cottage for a birthday getaway evening to include the amazing Chez Francois. Captain Phil is fantastic and the Cottage is cute and immaculate. An easy walk to Chez and other Vermilion attractions.

reviews.title: Great weekend on the lake
reviews.text: The Captain Bell House was great. We used the provided bikes (could have used some helmets) to cruise around downtown Vermilion and to Paper Moon Winery. It was an easy walk to the beach, to Chez Francois, and to the Wine Vault. We were in town for the Wooley Bear festival which was.......an experience. I would highly recommend the Captain Bell House.

reviews.title: Great choice
reviews.text: We stayed here last weekend and were welcomed by Phil. He was very accommodating even as we made our last minute reservation. We found the Captain Quarters to be very clean and well appointed. It has a lot of room and a full kitchen. It is very quiet here and we were comfortable. The location is excellent for walking to Lake Erie or downtown shops and restaurants. We would love to return sometime!

reviews.title: Excellent accomodations
reviews.text: We stayed at Captain Bell House Bed & Breakfast in Vermilion for our 32nd anniversary getaway. Phil is very gracious, attentive and hospitable. He gave us a tour of the facilities, we were very impressed with his handiwork. We had the pleasure of meeting Roxie, "The Friendliest Dog in the World." Our room was comfortable and every square inch was clean and polished. We had a great time shopping in the quaint stores, having dinner at Chez Francois and lunch at Granny Joe's -- all within walking distance. If you're visiting Vermilion, put Captain Bell House Bed & Breakfast on top of your list!

reviews.title: Great service, nice cottage
reviews.text: We stayed at Captain Bell's for a business trip. I chose the cottage as there are no stairs and had a walk in shower, and a kitchenette. The room was great. I did not go into the full house to know what it was like but the establishment is up for sale so it may change. The current owner went way beyond the call of the duty to make our stay pleasant. I highly recommend it. One BnB in the area only served breakfast at 9. Since I was on a business trip I had to leave by 8. Most places would give you a "go bag" but that place just said no food.

reviews.title: Biking Adventure and Captain Bell's
reviews.text: My friend and I stayed at Captain Bell's while bike-riding on the Backroads and Beaches Trail. Phil was a wonderful host, providing us a tour of his B&B. His restoration work is amazing and truly a labor of love. We stayed in the cottage next door. It had a shed so our bikes could be safely stored for the night. The cottage was spotless and had so many thoughtful amenities. When the weather turned stomy, Phil offered to drive us to our car. Luckily, it wasn't necesssary, but it was very kind of him to offer. He also helped us plot out our evening, telling us the best spots in town for appetizers, dinner, and dessert. We were provided gift certificates for breakfast at a local restaurant, which we both really enjoyed. I wish Phil the best of luck as he moves toward retirement and ending his B&B career. The new innkeepers will learn from the best!

reviews.title: Very Pleasant
reviews.text: Great little Bed & Breakfast within walking distance of the lake and all of Vermilions downtown shops and restaurants. Phil was very nice and friendly. We enjoyed the concept of being given gift certificates to use at the restaurant a block away but found $6.00 per person to be inadequate. For $175 per night we should have at least been given $10 a piece to get all the things you would normally get in a breakfast. Other than that the place was very nice but a little noisy with the other people staying there.

reviews.title: Highly recommended!
reviews.text: My husband and I were traveling on St. Rt. 6 with no set destination. We are so happy that we stumbled upon this fantastic bed and breakfast. We could not have ask for a friendlier atmosphere or better accommodations than offered by Captain Bell House - comfortable, clean and relaxing.

reviews.title: Really Nice!
reviews.text: We stayed in the Sunshine Room. Everything was very clean. The room sizes were large and we were very comfortable. We slept great in the bed too. They also had a full kitchen, but we chose to eat out at the many different venues in town! The owners were very nice and helpful. We couldn't have had a better time! I would highly recommend a stay here.

reviews.title: Accessible for people with mobility problem.
reviews.text: Comfortable, bright and clean room. Enough room for a walker. Kitchen was convenient, very clean and well stocked. The Innkeeper, Phil, was very pleasant, helpful and accommodating. Parking and accessing our room were very good for my husband, who has a mobility problem.

reviews.title: Great stay at a top notch B&B
reviews.text: We spent 2 nights in the Captain's Quarters and it was great. The apartment is very roomy. The sleeper sofa was very comfortable as was the bed. Breakfasts were provided at Granny joes and were very good. Phil provided lots of info about the restoration of the house. We all enjoyed his kuerig including hot apple cider for my son. It was an awesome visit to Vermilion. So glad we chose to stay here.

reviews.title: Lovely evening, quiet night and excellent breakfast!
reviews.text: We stumbled onto this B&B while we were cruising down the coast of Lake Erie and were welcomed by Philip into his beautiful manor. I can advise it to anyone looking for excellent ambiance at an excellent location run by a gentleman.

reviews.title: I wish I could have stayed longer.
reviews.text: We stayed in the Sunnyside room on the first floor. It was more of an apartment. The sitting room was huge with a sleeper sofa and electric fireplace. Bedroom was also spacious with a gorgeous pocket door separating it from the sitting room. Bathroom, again, was very large and could be accessed from the bedroom or the sitting room. Nice kitchen with everything necessary, a jar of ginger snaps with milk in the fridge, and loads of coffee choices. The room also had a private entrance. All of the rooms were beautifully appointed and comfortable. The location is convenient to the beach and town. Captain Phil and his faithful canine companion Miley were gracious hosts and very accommodating. I would highly recommend staying here and look forward to visiting again.

reviews.title: Fantastic overnight experience
reviews.text: We came to attend special dinner at Chez Francois, Captain Bell's very well located within walking distance of everything. Cottage was spacious, very clean, and well appointed. Phil was very gracious and welcoming. We definitely will visit again! Joan A.

reviews.title: Fantastic Stay in the Captain's Quarters
reviews.text: My husband and I and 2 boys stayed in the Captain's Quarters this past Wednesday night and had a great time!! My husband and I stayed in the Cozy Cottage in April for a night and wanted to bring our boys back to see why we enjoyed Vermillion so much. When we checked in we were warmly greeted by Phil again. We enjoyed the Keurig in the kitchen with tea, coffee, hot chocolate and cider and the boys loved the ginger snap cookies. Phil gave us a tour of the home and the Captains Quarter's was perfect for our family. It had everything we needed and was very spacious. We've never stayed at a bed and breakfast before, but we loved this place because it's updated and everything is immaculate. After we checked in we walked to Main Street to visit a few shops, got some dinner, had ice cream, went to a park and watched the sunset over the lake. While I was tucking my son in that night, he said "this place is awesome". When we tell people about Vermillion, not many people have heard of it, but we would suggest staying at Captain Bell House to anyone. Phil really takes great pride in making sure people are happy when they stay here. We'll be back again, hopefully in the Fall or Winter!!

reviews.title: Lovely, restful.
reviews.text: A two-night break from work in the city - we loved the spacious suite, equipped with every comfort we might want. Clean, fluffy towels. Floors sparkle. Parking at the door. Gourmet coffees and teas. So pretty! So quiet! So close to the public beach! You must go!

reviews.title: Always a Good Night
reviews.text: We have stayed at Captain Bell House several times and this was the first night in the separate cottage. There is not one detail left undone. It is spotless and well cared for and this room was like a small apartment. The coffee maker is ready to go and the special treat of ginger snaps and milk in the small refrigerator made for a tasty late night snack. Phil is the best as innkeeper. Making sure that his guests know about all the remotes and controls in the room, it is evident that he wants you to be completely at home in his inn.

reviews.title: Great place to stay in Vermilion
reviews.text: Decided to check out the Captain Bell House, and delighted that the Cottage was available. Very nice accommodations, private, and quiet. Phil is a great proprietor and we would go back in a heartbeat.

reviews.title: Clean Room, Friendly owner
reviews.text: Stayed here on my cross country trip on Rt. 66.....Great experience for an overnight, near the lake! Breakfast voucher for up the road, 2 blocks...worth it! REALLY nice puppy dog....I was unsure if they were biker friendly...alot of places are weary of that sort of thing...the owner was pleased to help out and made me feel comfortable...

reviews.title: THE Place to stay in Vermillion, Ohio
reviews.text: We stayed in this beautiful B and B for a couple of nights for a friend's wedding. We could not have found a better place! It was walking distance to the venue (Vermillion Boat Club), main downtown, parks, shopping area, restaurants, and of course the beach! Phil, the owner is a very nice and meticulous, and keeps the property very clean and well maintained (including a recent major renovation). You get some sort of a voucher for breakfast in a nearby cafe, but he also stocks the small kitchen with coffee, tea, bottled water and snacks (including nice pastries from a local bakery). Now, we have a go to place in Vermillion when we visit our friends in the future (including our new friends Phil and Roxie).

reviews.title: Best place to stay in Vermillion
reviews.text: My wife and I recently spent a night away in the Sunshine room. Phil and his dog Roxie were wonderful hosts. The inn was beautiful. Everything about our stay was top notch. Downtown Vermillion is only a few blocks away. We will be booking another getaway here soon.

reviews.title: The best stay in Vermilion
reviews.text: A great personality in both the B&B and the Innkeeper, Phil. Beautifully restored and comfortable in every way. The cleanest B&B I have ever stayed in. Phil is very knowlegable of the local events, businesses and people as well as Vermilion history. Vermilion is my home town and now I know a great place to stay when in town. I look forward to bringing Roxie a biscuit too!

reviews.title: Fantastic Cottage
reviews.text: We just spent 3 days in this cottage and wish we could stay forever. The location is great and the cottage feels just like home. From fresh towels delivered every day, coffee breakfast and pastries every morning and the most comfortabke bed ever!!!! Our host, Phil is full of information on everything in the area. Extremely friendly without being obtrusive Phil is wonderful and knows exactly what you need for a relaxing vacation. We highly reconmend a visit here...you wont want to leave.

reviews.title: Shelter from the storm
reviews.text: We arrived in Vermilion just before a huge lake effect snow and lucked into this beautiful B&B with its welcoming proprietor and friendly resident rescue dog. There's a small charming bedroom, and a huge suite, but I claimed the separate cottage all by myself - what a treat! Huge TV (with cable), comfy bed with quilt, Keurig coffee/hot drink maker. The house and cottage are lovingly and expertly restored, with eye-pleasing color schemes, and the place is spotless. Free wi-fi to boot. For breakfast you get a voucher to almost-next door Granny Joe's (the breakfast was excellent and I'd like to go back and check out the "ice creamatorium" portion). Vermilion itself is a charming Lake Erie town, with great antique shops and restaurants. I don't see how you could go wrong staying here.

reviews.title: Quaint town. Accomodations relaxing.
reviews.text: Well kept, neat, clean with everything we needed to make our stay a welcoming experience. Ralph, the owner, was very helpful and accomodating. One could sense the B&B was his passion. We enjoyed the hometown atmosphere of the city.

reviews.title: Wonderful place for a getaway!
reviews.text: We stayed at Captain Bell House for one night after having dinner at Chez Francois and wished we'd stayed longer! Phil and his trusty sidekick Roxie the dog are wonderful hosts. He has painstakingly renovated the old house from top to bottom and it's lovely. He is so friendly and welcoming and will do anything to make you feel at home. The location is quiet but very close to the town and the beach. We will definitely go back!

reviews.title: Great accommodation for a 3 sisters' weekend together!
reviews.text: My sisters and I had a great time here in March when we came for a nearby baby shower. Beautifully modern and updated, fantastic service and walking distance to cute places to eat and shop. Recently remodeled throughout but keeps the character of the historic house. Lots of space, great kitchen, cool views, close to the water...Mr. Laurien made sure we had everything we needed. Would stay there again in a heartbeat.

reviews.title: Great overnight visit in The Cottage
reviews.text: We stayed one night in their private cottage next to the main house. It's very spacious with a King bed, seating area and mini kitchen area. We found the cottage a great option as it gives you complete privacy. Would definitely stay in the cottage next time we are staying in Vermilion. Owner was friendly and suite was very clean.

reviews.title: Wonderful Hospitality!
reviews.text: This was our second visit at Captain Bell's and the rooms were immaculate and comfortable. Phil is a host who is accommodating and not intrusive. His attention to detail shows from the lakeshore decor in The Captain's Quarters, our spacious room, to the abundance of fluffy towels and crisp ginger snaps for late night snacks. A must for a dinner stop at Chez Francois. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Excellent, beautiful house and great service
reviews.text: I've already booked a return visit, so that should speak volumes. The house is so beautiful, decorated by his daughter, the linens are soft and luxurious, rooms super clean with not a trace of previous occupants, and Captain Phil made me an excellent hot toddy to boot, which I drank by the soapstone fireplace in the homey, pretty living room. We took a nice walk down to the water, walked to several great restaurants -- it was a perfect location.

reviews.title: Great spot on Lake Erie
reviews.text: Very comfortable room. Bed was excellent. Very clean and well appointed. Bathroom towels were luxurious. Not a B&B in the truest sense, as there is no "breakfast" at the location, but guests are provided a voucher for a great breakfast at a diner in a converted house that is just a short walk away. Would not hesitate to stay here again. Captain Phil is a gracious host.

reviews.title: Lovely place to stay and walk to Chez
reviews.text: We enjoy having dinner at Chez Francois but not having to drive home afterwards. By chance, we found Captain Bell and booked it for an evening. What a lovely place! Phil, the owner, is extremely nice and thoughtful. We stayed in the cottage. The room is nicely decorated and comfortable. Captain Bell House is a short walk to downtown and the beach. We received breakfast certificates for Granny's: a walk of less than 2 blocks. We actually preferred this as we could go when we wanted and select our breakfast. We are looking forward to our next stay. We will know to book our stay early as I predict this will become a very popular place to stay.

reviews.title: Five star service
reviews.text: I stayed in two occasions and the quality of service from all the staff was five stars. Everybody is efficient, courteous and very helpful. The location is very convenient and the buffet breakfast is excellent.

reviews.title: A little expensive but with a nice service
reviews.text: The employees are very helpful.There's a guy who works in the breakfast who treated the guests with a special attention his name's Miguel.The maids deserve a little tips they are very helpful.The only problem is the noise that comes from the others pipes in the bathroom.But close the bathroom door and you can sleep well.

reviews.title: Not bad
reviews.text: The hotel is pretty well located. You are a few blocks from Florida street and plaza san Martín qnd Retiro. The staff is friendly. It is not very “baby friendly”. The baby seats are quite dangerous, you have to hold the baby in them. Otherwise everything else was ok.

reviews.title: Hotel Dolmen --- far from impressed
reviews.text: I am writing this review from the lobby of the hotel (while waiting for the shuttle bus to take my wife and I back to the airport) while my experience of this place is still fresh in my mind. We stayed 2 nights at the Dolmen Hotel and booked our stay via a travel agent from Australia. When we arrived at the airport, we were told that someone would be waiting for us with a sign with our names on it. Surprise! No one was there for us. We managed to find the office of the transport company and finally got on our way to the hotel after 1.5 hours of running around and waiting for a shuttle bus to be ready. Once arrived to the hotel, we were greeted by two obnoxious and rude ladies at the desk who told us our room wasnt ready and to go get a coffee or something at the bar. Of course , no one was attending the bar, so we just sat there. After 30 mins , we went back to the front desk to ask what is happening , and one of the ladies muttered something in spanish to the other one who then burst out laughing. She told us to wait another 30 minutes. Which we did. Once arrived in the room, we were not impressed by the poor quality of the furnishings, the tiny bathroom and overall cleanliness of the bath and carpets (sorry to sound like I' m nagging, but we've stayed in many many cheaper priced places with much better overall quality). To top it off , there were no towels and had to wait about 25 mins to get some delivered. In the morning , the buffet was ok but nothing to write home about. We had a lovely day sightseeing and walking about and once we came back late in the afternoon, the room was half cleaned and of course no towels were supplied , again! In short, we would love to come back to wonderful Buenos Aires but we WILL NOT stay again at the Dolmen. Hell no. Regards, K and K Ngoviky, Brisbane Australia

reviews.title: Unexpected quality service
reviews.text: This was a great surprise. The hotel has a special offer, with buffet with champagne for breakfast and a dinner included for 2 nights stay. Room was comfortable, swimming pool was nicely warm, not the jacuzzi. I do want to comment on the wonderful quality attention provided for all the staff. From the Valet Parking to the excellent lady that was our waiter on the complimenatry dinner on Saturday night on April the 12th. The staff at the breakfast service was 5 stars. This hotel needs an uplift look, just keep the attention given by the team workers.

reviews.title: Outrageous service!
reviews.text: Very nice and clean hotel, with ok location, however what really made me give the excellent rating was the service. The staff was extremely helpful, friendly and fast in every single thing that we needed them. Breakfast was concise but very good with different fruits and fruit juices, a good assortment of typical Argentinian pastry (especially the medialunas), dulce de leche, scramble eggs with bacon, nice cold cuts, etc. It was very reasonable. I know that some other reviews mentioned problems with noise, but fortunately it was not my case. I would definitely return to this hotel.

reviews.title: What's not to love?
reviews.text: We are budget travelers but stayed there when our in-laws were in BA at the start of an organized tour. It is a wonderful hotel in an ideal location to Calle Florida and other walking tours of the city. The staff is super helpful -- they will score you tickets to a Boca Juniors futbol game or tell you how to do it yourself for far less money. The top-floor pool and hot tub are pristine and afford wonderful views. The complimentary breakfast bar is obscenely delicious, and the WiFi signals are strong. Our room was huge, with light-obscuring heavy curtains and down duvets, as well as an anteroom with a desk so someone can be working or surfing the web while the other sleeps in peace. There's really nothing not to like about this place, particularly if you want something other than the multinational chains that increasingly are taking over upscale hotelling in BA.

reviews.title: Good hotel
reviews.text: A good 4 star hotel in a fairly central position. Well furnished rooms, good breakfast - all at a very reasonable price. Would certainly stay there again.

reviews.title: A very pleasant surprise in a hotel
reviews.text: It is very well located with easy access to all forms of transportation.A very friendly and accomodating staff.Good size rooms with unusual quality linen and spa products.An excellent breaksfast with a wide variety of fruits and local sweets and cheeses and overall an excellent relation price/quality

reviews.title: Do not leave your stuff unlocked in room
reviews.text: After staying for 4 days I left the hotel on sunday 29th may. When I arrived home I missed my watch and 2 tshirts that I had left at the bathroom. I called the hotel and they said there was nothing left. But I am sure it was there. Do not stay there if you want to relax about your stuff

reviews.title: could be good but it was not gor us
reviews.text: The hotel looked clean and nice, hover electricity was not working on our room, so no lights. We made the staff aware of this problem immediately but they did nothing to fix it. The hotel did not seem full, so i guess other room were available as well. Bottom line we had to use a flash light in the bathroom and during the evning, not big deal for 1 night but certainly not optimal. Outside this the place was good and the staff available

reviews.title: On a quiet street, convenient location
reviews.text: I stayed here two nights. Easy check in and at a good price. Within walking distance of Florida Street, the main harbour and St Martin Park. Room was quiet and clean. It met my expectations in all aspects. Would comfortably be able to recommend.

reviews.title: Wi-Fi frustrating - otherwise good
reviews.text: We stayed in 10 different places during our recent trip to Chile and Argentina. This was the most expensive - which is reasonable as it was a high standard hotel in the centre of Buenos Aires, and you would expect the other cities we visited to be cheaper. Things were mostly as they should be. Handy location, small pool, well-used, could do with more sunbeds, but there may not be room for them. Turn down service, not something we needed, but as we were in the room, we each collected a little chocolate. Excellent breakfast. The Buenos Aires Herald (English language newspaper) was at our door on one of the three mornings. The snag was the internet. I see it was criticised before. The problem is not with the networks. There is one network per floor - and I detected floors 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7 as being possible. We never actually managed to connect to 5, but, at various times connected to all the others. I suspect the password was different on 5. The password supplied was a particularly complex combination of letters and numbers. The difficulty was that, although we could connect to the hotel network, they were often not connected to the internet. Sometimes they did, but after an arbitrary period of time, it dropped me, and I had to re-log on. Sometimes it worked, sometimes I managed to work my way through the different networks (awkward password every time), and found one that had connectivity to the internet. We resorted to using the lobby computers (there were only 2) at times. It was all very frustrating as there was something we had to sort out. Previous comments suggested that customers could not log on in their rooms to the network. That has obviously been solved. However whomever is managing the networks has done a poor job in setting up the router link to the ISP, and in creating the monitoring processes to ensure service is restored when there is a problem. Internet connectivity is important to us, and out of the 10 places we stayed, this was number 8 or 9. The others were all cheaper. This is not the standard that I should expect from a hotel of this standard, and is the reason that I would not stay here again, or recommend it. If internet connection is unimportant to you, it would be OK. As the management have addressed the networking problem, maybe they will address the connectivity problem. So you can ignore the negative aspects of this review if you find that subsequent reviewers praise the Wi-Fi service. We ate in the restaurant once. The good steak came overcooked (we had ordered a punto), but we started eating it, and showed it to the waiter. They brought us replacement meals, with the steak cooked correctly, but we were not sure that was going to happen (language difficulties). The waiter had left us the original meals which we continued to eat, with the result we did not have the capacity for the second one. He should have taken the first away when the decision was made to do them again.

reviews.title: Great *Average* Hotel
reviews.text: If you're not a fussy traveler, like me, this hotel is more than adequate. The rooms were clean and being in the back part of the hotel we didn't have much noise. Yes, the maid service was inconsistent with replacing towels and bath mats but a phone call fixed it. The location makes it easy to walk or take a taxi to a number of popular tourist attractions and is central to bars and clubs (if that's your thing). The staff is friendly and helpful. The continental breakfast is just that...nothing special but more than adequate to get your day started. Yes, the wi-fi is horrible. Plenty of people have commented on it so I won't. But if Internet is that important while you're on vacation there are reliable computers in the lobby and plenty of Internet cafes in the area. The area is seedy very late at night (it was normal for us to get back from dinner and drinks at 2 a.m.) so definitely use all common sense precautions as a tourist. And the pictures of the pool and gym are misleading. The "hot tub" was cold. I'd avoid the whole rooftop area altogether. Our party of three was forced to get two rooms when we would have been perfectly comfortable in one room. But I blame that on the travel agent. And since we were split up I can tell you firsthand that some rooms are nicer than others. So if you think your room seems old and you're unhappy, request one of the remodeled ones. I enjoyed my stay at the Dolmen and would stay here again.

reviews.title: Great hotel in all respects.
reviews.text: We stayed in the Dolmen for four nights before our cruise. A friend recommended it and we were not disapointed. The room was quiet, comfortable, and immaculate. The buffet breakfast was extensive and delicious. But the most outstanding feature was the staff, helpful and friendly. We arrived early after an overnight flight and were quickly installed in our room. My husband had an infected toe and needed treatment. We asked about a clinic and Nestor Guzonatto, the Assistant Manager, called a traveling doctor who came to our room quickly with an assistant and Mr. Guzonatto to translate. She prescribed an antibiotic which was sent for by Mr. Guzonatto and delivered to us. The charge? Only the reasonable cost of the prescription. A fine experience!

reviews.title: Horrible experience, will never go back
reviews.text: It was the only hotel available at the time because of an event held in Buenos Aires. The lobby of the hotel was very nice, but little did we know, we were fooled but its outer appearance. The service was not good at all, we had booked 3 rooms (2 rooms for 3 people and one room for 2), and they only had 2 rooms available. We had already paid for the rooms and the system showed that we did order 3 rooms. Although they said that they will fix it (which they did) it was unpleasant to have to arrive to a hotel and have to deal with something like this. As soon as we stepped into the hotel room, we were hit with a blast of hot air. We turned the AC on and unpacked. Everything felt old and dirty. After an hour, the room didn't feel any cooler, we asked for some one to help fix the AC because it was blistering hot. We spent 3 days at the Dolmen, and our AC was never fixed during our stay, so we had to keep out windows open (and listen to the traffic outside) to sleep. Also, the hair dryer didn't work at all. The next morning, we went down for breakfast, the food was mediocre and the staff members were immensely rude to us, they gave us an attitude and it was an unpleasant way to start the day. Our towels in our rooms were never replaced as well, the old towels were taken and new ones were never bothered to be put back. When we were about to check out, they alerted us that we had to pay a fee because some one had charged something to our room. We asked for a receipt which they didn't have, and then we asked for the time and date of the purchase, which turned out to be during New Years Eve, and we were all out partying so it was impossible for us to be at the hotel. They insisted and insisted, so we decided to pay because we were about to be late for out flight. It was an overall disaster, the only good thing was the free internet access in back of the lobby.

reviews.title: Excellent location and very nice Hotel
reviews.text: I was there with my wife and also one of ours sons an his wife too. We spend outstanding vacation thanks to the excellent attention of all the Hotel's personnel

reviews.title: Super fantastic hotel, great location
reviews.text: Once again i come back to that lovely place. Kind personal super service lovely faces friendly service clean and quiet! I love the place, the gym and the 35 degree pool. The rooms are wonderful.thank you for this great opportunity Safe location Super central Love it

reviews.title: Good location!
reviews.text: Very well located! Close to Aeroparque Airport. One block away from Avenue 09 de Julio. Also a few blocks away from Florida Street and Porto Madero region, where there are several typical Argentinian Restaurants. The hotel offers a good value for the price. It is a old fashioned hotel, but it is good for short stays. The Internet is free, but very slow. Breakfast is okay.

reviews.title: Noisy and terrible staff
reviews.text: Unglad to say that this Hotel was not OK for me. Specially when travelling for business when I ask for more. The staff from reception was not friendly at all and it seems that if you ask for something they do it as an special favour not as a real and genuine service. Besides you wont be able to sleep OK because it is too noisy. Not recommended at all.

reviews.title: Best 4 star in town
reviews.text: Stayed for 5 nights and had a wonderful time. Big, clean, modern guest rooms. Very professional personnel. Good Continental Breakfast. But the best of all is the price and the location, just some blocks away from 9 de julio avenue and Recoleta. Nice neighborhood.

reviews.title: Excelente hotel and staff
reviews.text: Located in a nice part of Retiro, the staff specialy the manager Nestor Guzonato are very professional, of help and effective. I had a really huge trouble with Hotels and they helped me with that. All customers must take care with Hotels, they on purpose do not write the currency. I lost lots of money with that, but by the other side I found some correct people in this world

reviews.title: Completely unremarkable
reviews.text: I stayed at Hotel Dolmen twice in April, both times in a room that had two beds. I would characterize both experiences as entirely average. The staff was friendly and helpful. The neighborhood felt safe. My room was comfortable and sufficiently clean. The bathroom was quite small and water leaked from the shower onto the floor, not a big deal, but slightly annoying nonetheless. The wifi worked fine, and the buffet breakfast was good. I have not stayed elsewhere in Buenos Aires and as such I cannot compare it to other hotels in the area. I will be back in the city later this year and I might see what else is around, but I won't rule this one out.

reviews.title: OVER RATED
reviews.text: Two things give this hotel a rating. One is its location and two the front-of-house staff. They gave me a very early check-in. The room, if one could call it that was dark and pokey, the curtains filthy, and the decor tired. No carpet on the floor. The bathroom was so so and the towels warn. Not what one expects for the money paid. The breakfast selection was mainly sweet breads. The fruit salad contained canned fruit and the eggs! Scrambled half burnt and half runny .. go figure. Definitely not worth the TripAdvisor branding.

reviews.title: Good hotel, great location
reviews.text: Good hotel, very good food and atractives, near forida street, but the beds are very unconfortable, the pool is very small but the bar is great

reviews.title: Very friendly and a great location
reviews.text: The hotel is just one block from Avenida Nuevo de Julio with close access to lots do restaurants and shopping. The theater district is pretty close as well. The staff is friendly and helpful with any kind of local info one needs. The breakfast buffet is a nice spread. This is the third time I've stayed here - always nice.

reviews.title: Excelent location and service
reviews.text: Please, ask in the reception for Vicente, the best recepcionist ever! He will try to do everything to please the guest. Besites, the hotel has really nice rooms, a nice swimmingpool and sauna and breakfast has a lot of varieties. I recommend!

reviews.title: Great location but rooms need refurbishing
reviews.text: The hotel is in the centre of town and you can walk to the Obelisk easily. Lots of restaurants and shopping areas within a stone's throw including the famous Gallery Pacifico. The lobby looks fine and modern (it opens on to a pedestrian street) but the rooms are horribly dated and need refurbishing. I was in room 508 and the bathroom door wouldn't shut properly, so when I took a shower, the steam escaped and made the whole room feel like a sauna. Fortunately you can open the windows but that brings in mosquitoes. Wifi is included in the room tariff but on some floors, the signal is not very strong and keeps dropping. Breakfast is strictly okay - I wish they had more variety for hot items. The hotel however happily booked us a table at the jazz club and all the staff were very friendly and helpful.

reviews.title: Dolmen hotel
reviews.text: Hotel is very central. It's room and breakfast not bad. But there is a problem about hotel design. The room doors are looking at the open hole, and there is too much door noisy. (Like a bomb) İf you want rest and good sleep... You can't. My opinion; I am sorry..this hotel not comfortible..

reviews.title: Beware of Checkout
reviews.text: My wife and I spent two nights in the Hotel Dolmen before taking our cruise. The location was good (just a few blocks from Florida) and the room well appointed although it had just had a fresh coat of paint so the fumes were heavy. Our room also happened to be next to an open stairwell so we got the noise from other floors as well as people using the stairs, which was very irritating. The buffet was ample and good. However, at checkout, using my Amex card, I saw that I was going to be charged in Pesos so I showed the girl my reservation I had booked at their website and the guarantee in U.S. dollars but she insisted that I would be billed in Pesos. And, when I get my Amex bill, as I suspected, I was billed for more than the guarantee. Not a good experience!

reviews.title: Great and Attentive Hotel Staff
reviews.text: We stayed at the Dolmen for 4 days through New Years Eve and the hotel staff was amazing. Our travel agent misspelled our names completely for our reservations and the hotel staff was very prompt in working to resolve the problem quickly. The airline also lost my luggage and the staff members were very helpful in assisting me by making phone calls to the airport/local airline staff to retrieve my bags. Our rooms were clean and just what we needed to come back to after a long day of sight seeing and a night of great food/wine. We had no problems with noise...if anything between the two hotels that we stayed at in BA it was some of the best sleep of the trip but we were at the end of the hall on the back side. So if you're a light sleeper you might want to ask for one of those rooms. They were also great in giving us suggestions for restaurants, places to go and places to avoid to maximize our time while being safe. I will say that there pictures of the pool are completely not realistic. The pool/gym does not look anything like the pics and the bar consist of beer in a bucket. That was a real dissapointment but the hotel bar downstairs made up for it w/ great conversation and coffee drinks w/real whipped cream. (Side note--if you ask for real cream in the US you're getting whipped cream out of a can so this was a nice little perk for us). Also, the free internet access is priceless!

reviews.title: First Latin American Country
reviews.text: This hotel is in fantastic location in the middle of the downtown area, with lots of other hotels on the street, restaurants, shops and within walking distance to mayor attractions. Very quick check in poses. The front desk and bellmen very friendly and pleasant. We got to our room, a very outdated and old looking one. First thing we encounter after flying overnight, the air conditioner did not work. I have do called the front desk, and wait for the maintenance staff, 30 minutes in our room working to fix the problem. Instead of moving us we had to wait. I asked for the cost of an upgrade, 60 dollars per night, that was too much for 7 nights. Breakfast in the morning was adequate, with lots of sweet items if you are into those foods in the morning you will love it. Staff was also very pleasant. I asked for an iron and ironing board, was told they don't have any available. Pressing was available for the equivalent of 6 dollars each item, I pay 2.50 dollars back home for shirts. A 4-star hotel does not have ironing boards,very disappointing. One day after getting back form been our all day, we encounter a bed pillowcase with blood stains and a towel in the bathroom with the same issue. Took pictures on my phone showed them at the front desk agent; she said nothing back to me. I asked for the room redone while out to dinner. Again no apologies. On Friday after been out all day, we sat in the room for a glass of wine. The lights went out in our room, seems it was an electrical problem in the fuse box. Staff was not able to fix the problem. We had to move to another room, and ones again in an old room, again no apologies from anyone. The pool area is very old and unkempt, with dead plants around, the outside pool was dirty, nobody was there. Second pool under the atrium was fine. The pictures on hotel website, are from a long time ago or well staged. The area does not like what is on the site. This hotel cold be a great with some upgrades and better customer service.

reviews.title: Perfect location, good standard, friendly staff.
reviews.text: Lots to chose from in BA. We chose this mainly because of the location. In the Centro there is walking distance to all major sights downtown. Also good selection of restaurants and also the major shopping streets.Rooms are good standard and the breakfast buffé has a big and good selection. Staff is friendly and helpful. We used their car service for pick-up from the harbor (arrived with boat from Montevideo) and also for leaving from the city airport to Patagonia. Good, reliable, convenient and value for money. Use it. Went up one evening to check the pool-area. Looked like a lot of fun for the families with children who occupied it :) Would definitely stay at Dolmen again - also the word Dolmen has a hilarious meaning in the Swedish language. That was also an extra for us =)

reviews.title: Location a good one - right in the heart of the city
reviews.text: My room was on the 8th floor at the back, quiet and a good size (room 805). Check in was quick and efficient - even though I arrived very early in the morning. I pre-booked a privat-car transfer from the airport; all done by email - and the driver was waiting for me and quickly got me to the hotel with no fuss. Wifi can be poor, but it is free to use and operates at a reasonable speed - the signal has dropped out several times though, but it has been working OK for the past few days. The hotel location is great, right in the center of the city and lots of good places to eat nearby. I was at a meeting and the hotel is a good venue for an international meeting. The staff are very efficient and service is good. I like it, other reviews comment that the hotel looks a bit dated, but I found it OK and I am happy to recommend it. A decent price and a safe place - like the fact that the room has a large safe - big enough to lock away my laptop etc. Most of the city sights are within walking distance. Nice solid place to stay. Bring a travel kettle if you are addicted to tea. Also there is a shop a few doors away that is open 25 hours a day (sic). Enjoy.

reviews.title: Great location and nice breakfast
reviews.text: We liked: The location The pool The staff The breakfast The price We could check in early We didn't like: The gym and pool first opened at 11 The door to the bathroom couldn't close The room was small

reviews.title: So wonderful
reviews.text: This Hotel and The Charme of Its Location is facinating. But not only this, The staff and their politness with the service they offer. Friendly and happy beautiful Faxes welcome you. The swimming pool and terrace is very comfortable! I loved this place. 2 steps from Santa Fe ! Fantastic Thank you for the cleaness and super friendly Attitude.

reviews.title: Very good location
reviews.text: It´s a well located hotel, close to Calle Florida and Corrientes. It serves an excellent breakfast. The service is above average. Vicente, the receptionist is just great! Very helpful and receptive! The rooms are nice; bathrooms deserve some remodeling and new towels.

reviews.title: Great location, nice stay in B.A>
reviews.text: Dolmen is greatly located, downtown, nearby calles Florida and Lavalle, as well as Nueve de Julio avenue, and short distance to Puerto Madero and Recoleta, the places to go for a great night. The room was okay, not spectacular or spacious, I have to say, but confortable and clean. It lacked a blanket, that´s true, but I requested and they provided it. There´s safe, minibar, cable TV, all the things expected in a hotel room. Dolmen also provides free internet but there are only two computers and I had to wait my turn a few times. Breakfast was good too. Have seen betters, have seen worses. No problems with the staff, quite the contrary, they were helpful. All in all, a nice stay. I recommend it.

reviews.title: really nice place to stay
reviews.text: excellent service, even late at night! fair prices, huge breakfast buffet, good location Only the bathrooms and the swimming-pool on the top of the building were not as good as the other aspects of this hotel anyway we enjoyed our stay there and we definitely will come back!

reviews.title: Old fashioned yet very friendly!!!
reviews.text: The Dolmen seems popular among the locals, with good old friendly service to compensate for the old, and in need of renovation, facilities. Preferred also because it has a garage, which is convenient; and also because its centrally located, the dolmen seems like a no brainer. The rooms are spacious and clean, but mattresses are bland and shabby, the bathroom's tub shows heavy signs of use, yet water pressure is outstanding. Breakfast was less impressive than I expected it to be, due the fact that booking said it was great. It had a variety of fruit and cereal, but eggs were inedible, which is an Argentinian problem I think. Location was excellent, very easily accessible via public transport. Front desk staff extremely helpful, which is a rare find in Buenos Aires. I'd recommend this hotel if you have a car and don't want to waste time wandering around micro centro looking for a parking lot, or if you need front desk assistance often, or if you like soft mattresses, or if a little corrosion on the bathtub is of no importance, or if you don't need the egg's protein in the morning. Price was fair.

reviews.title: Great location. But tired and in need of a makeover
reviews.text: We stayed for 5 days at the beginning of November before going onto other countries in South America. We then came back for 3 nights before flying home at the beginning of December. The first stay was memorable for the crammed breakfast room and the waiters ( about 2) who walked round slowly not really understanding about serving people. Not brilliant food. Room 411 was adequate. Second stay was not good. We were put in a box room 1304, with a shower that didn't work. The noise of the hotel air conditioning unit situated somewhere on the 14th floor was intolerable. In fairness, we were moved when we complained. In fairness, the hotel staff were excellent when they recovered some property for me left behind from the first stay.

reviews.title: Central, but that's it
reviews.text: It is very centrally located in BA, but that has drawbacks. Step outside and your in the world of exhaust fumes. My room was on the 2nd floor at the back. No view, just concrete, but must be more quiet as a street room. Room, not like in the pictures, at all. I would describe it as adequate but vey dated. Build in maybe the 60's and never touched since. Wifi is poor, a freebie that was in the air worked a lot better People are friendly, but hotel needs updating. Woul I stay again? If I had a choice not, it's that my boss picks up the tap. So, not bad but not good either, if you come with an open mind you will be allright.

reviews.title: Underwhelming experience & noisy
reviews.text: I have generally been pretty happy with most hotels I have stayed in (check my other reviews), including past experiences in Buenos Aires. The Dolmen, while not a disaster, has a number of shortcomings that would have made me reconsider, had I known. 1. Noise - this is my #1 complaint. The hallways are tiled, with no sound absorbency. The doors to the rooms are extremely lightweight. *Any* sound from the hallway is transmitted including people walking, children, the cleaners, the lift, telephones... So far, this hasn't kept me awake, but it goes all the way up to bedtime and from about 6:30 am- so don't expect to sleep in. 2. More noise - I'm on level 14. Stay away from this floor. It is right under the pool pumps, and there is a constant drone. I've found it soothing, because it is constant, but others may not. Additionally, when they clean the water, it's intolerable. When I went to front desk 4 times to say it had to stop, they just shrugged (politely) and said it had to be done. 3. Food - breakfast is a generally below average affair- the scrambled eggs were warm and a bit grey. The rest of the food was adequate, but I decided to venture out this morning and for the rest of my stay to have something more enticing. 4. Standard of the room - the room is tidy and I imagine fairly hygienic. Having said that, the carpet is stained, and there was no plug in the bath. Bed is comfortable. TV is modern LCD. Wifi is actually pretty good. 5. Gym/pool- on the 16th floor, with great views of the district. However, 2/3 pools were not functioning. There was a small gym typical of most hotels (i.e., not really worth using). I'd steer clear, as others have. 6. Staff- friendly, polite. 7. Area- there are better parts of BA, but it' walkable to Recoleta, and there's a tube station nearby (if you haven't used the tube here, it's actually pretty easy and very cheap). Overall, I'd be willing to accept everything else if the noise wasn't such a problem. That's really a major flaw in a hotel, and I really can't stress how annoying it is to hear *everything*. If you're a light sleeper, or value some relaxation in your room sometimes, I would advise you choose somewhere else.

reviews.title: Great service and location
reviews.text: Loved our stay at Dolmen Hotel! Prices are reasonable and service is warm and personalized. We were treated to a very good FREE three course dinner --delicious-- and our waiter , Hugo, was efficient and kind. Mariano and others at the reception desk were very attentive. There are marble floors, mirrors and brass accents throughout. Our triple bedroom was large and clean, our beds were opened and chocolates placed on our pillows every night. An excellent breakfast is included with a variety of fruit and pastry, bacon and eggs, juices etc. You can walk to Florida, Recoleta, Puerto Madero , Gale rias Pacifico and upscale Santa Fe shops. Excellent value ! Photos to be included shortly.

reviews.title: Just barely OK but nothing more...
reviews.text: I do not understand why this hotel has such a good rating on Trip Advisor. I spent a week there (from Christmas Day to New Year day) and to me everything about this hotel was 'just barely OK' but nothing more. Clearness. The carpet is dirty. The bathroom needs some renovation, too. Everything else is OK. Service. Mostly good altough I did not use much of it. They serviced the room twice a day, the second time making a bed. One day when changing the towels they gave just one towel instead of two and did not give a floor mat but the other days everything was OK. The shampoo and soap are of a cheap kind. They charged my room with something that I did not use from the mini-bar but when I told I did not use they reversed the charge, so that was OK. Breakfast. Not tasty at all. Choice is small. The same stuff every morning. But it is eatable, not too many people, so it was OK. Room. Everything is OK except the air conditioner. The day I checked in was really hot, +36..37C (100F) so I thought it was because of that. But the other days the temperature was lower, around +31C (88F) and it still was not sufficient. I always kept it on the maximum level and the only time it was comfortable was after the middle of the night and the early morning. Other times, it was just liveable but not comfortable. Internet. Every floor has its own WiFi point. When I managed to connect to my floor point it was OK but maybe 1 time out of 3 I could not and I had to connect to a different floor in which case it was sooo sloooow... Location. Yes, it is close to the subway (subte) station (few blocks) and it is in the safe area. That is good. The bad thing is that Retiro is not a good place for tourists. It is close to a few attracions but not to many of them so most of the times I ended up taking a subway or taxi (and taxi is really not expensive in BsAs so I used them a lot). The problem is that the traffic in this part of the city on weekdays is really, really bad. Few times I was late because I did not expect it would take 10 minutes to pass a few blocks. The city itself is not very pleasant place around the hotel, the sidewalks are narrow, lots of traffic, lots of people, etc. As a tourist I really wished that I stayed in Recoleta, Palermo or maybe Puerto Madero or San Telmo, so again, the location was barely OK for me but definitely not excellent or good.

reviews.title: Nice clean place for business and/or pleasure
reviews.text: Hotel Dolmen is a nice clean small hotel. Rooms are a tight fit but what isn't in Bs. As. unless you pay out the nose! It is withing walking distance of the shopping district and large parks and of course the big ole dolmen in the center of the avenue in the city. I enjoyed my stay. Food was good. Buenos Aires is a great place to visit. Pity the exchange rate is crazy.

reviews.title: Fantastic breakfast, great service, near everything
reviews.text: The Dolmen has nice comfortable rooms, an indoor pool on the roof. A lot of workers providing great service including many that spoke pretty good English, and where patient with my Spanish. The breakfast buffet covers 3 long tables with everything you can think of. There is a basic fitness center on the roof level, but they referred me to a world class gymnasium around the corner. The location is perfect. It is walking distance to the Subte (subway) which goes all over town, it is surrounded by travel agent offices that sell tours, cafes, and antique shops. It is short walk to a main shopping street. Not too far to Retiro train station in case you take 1-day trips. Also a park where you can jog after dinner. Very safe area. I went 18 months after the 2002 currency collapse when 1/3 of people lost their job. Being from San Francisco and used to big cities, I was amazed to find almost no homeless in the area, the streets were cleaned nightly, it was an incredible find.

reviews.title: Bad emergency facilities
reviews.text: We were stucked in the elevator for 12 minutes which felt like hours. The loudspeaker inside the elevator hardly worked . The hotell has absolutely no "normal" stairway. If you insist walking the staiways you can only use the emergenscy exit. They are very narrow and a trolley blocked a part of it. If you wanted to go to the diningroom via the stairways, you had to go trough the kitchen. The service, rooms and breakfeast were average.

reviews.title: Very friendly staff, average hotel
reviews.text: The hotel was adequate for an overnight stay. The room was small, but clean. The furnishing were okay, but old. The breakfast was good, but the dining areas was very crowded. Certainly not one of the best hotels in Buenos Aires.

reviews.title: Room Without a View
reviews.text: Friendly enough staff, hotel clean and well located. Breakfast was an extensive choice both continental and cooked. Unfortunately my room looked directly at a blank wall, 6 feet away. No natural light could enter the room.

reviews.title: A very nice stay.
reviews.text: Stayed at Dolmen Hotel for 6 nights and enjoyed it very much. Modern ans spacious rooms, efficient and helpful staff, good breakfast and an english newspaper every morning. Very good location (several minutes walking to San Martin square and the main central streets). Definitely recommended.

reviews.title: Good hotel, excellent price
reviews.text: This was my first time at this hotel. I made the reservation on Internet and did not know what I was going to find. The room was clean, hot water was perfect and breakfast was very good. But the best, in my personal opinion, is the location, close to Retiro and downtown and the price, very convenient for such a quality hotel.

reviews.title: loved the Dolmen so much.. i am coming back 7 months later
reviews.text: i came to Argentina with my sister-in-law march 2007, we were greeted warmly and had our room in no time.. the staff was superb..we enjoyed our week long stay and our breakfast each day was fresh and good with more than enough to chose from. our room was all that we needed , CLEAN AND AIR CONDITIONED.... we had internet service and the staff helped us with our walking tours and shopping excursions..(OH BOY) i am returning with my husband, my two sons, my daughter and our son in law..i have informed the hotel that i am returning to celebrate our daughter's 1st. wedding anniversary and her 31st. birthday..i am confident they will all feel as i did..Stay tuned for more reviews..we are leaving in 6 days.. I LOVE THE DOLMEN HOTEL

reviews.title: Nice Hotel,Good Service, Good Location
reviews.text: I usually tend to sleep in the well known international chains but colleagues of mine recommended this hotel and it was not disappointing. I was upgraded to a better room and it was huge, had 2 bathrooms, jacuzzi and a living room. I don't know how the other rooms are but mine was great. Breakfast is pretty good although I personally prefer the healthier stuff ( e.g Boiled eggs rather than Fried omelettes, vegetables- which I did not find in any of the 3 hotels I stayed in Argentina). The bell boys were very helpful and friendly. Oh, and the price was not bad either.

reviews.title: Gym opens at 11am...not good...
reviews.text: I am currently staying at Dolmen Hotel in Buenos Ayres. The purpose of my visit is business. Before going to work today, I planned to exercise at the gym of the hotel. To my surprise, the gym opens only at 11am!? I could not believe the hotel holds a gym facility but allows guests to use only from 11am until 09pm...Also, during breakfast this morning, there were only a few tables taken but the others could not be used since there were still plates from previous guests to be removed. Staff was busy doing something else and did not care for it. My perception is, the hotel is also understaffed.

reviews.title: Wonderful Staff
reviews.text: I was travelling with my baby. And we had to store his food. The hotel staff has offered us the freezer and they installed a microwave on our room. It was wonderful. The breakfast is great and a very good localization. The room is very big and clean.

reviews.title: Central Locationj
reviews.text: We arrived at the hotel around 12 noon and were told that the check-in time is 3 PM. We did not get our room key well after 5 pm. The reception counter seemed a bit chaotic with many people waiting in line. So our first impression of the service was bad. The room keys often stopped working during our stay with no good reason and we had to go to the reception to get a new key. The service staff was ok. The hotel is central and the breakfast is very good.

reviews.title: Bad hotel with bad attitude...
reviews.text: Our worst hotel experience in a long time.... Found this place on booking.com, it looked ok and the reviews were quite good. But according to our opinion this was far from the truth: 1. On arrival the staff gave us a room on the 11th floor and in this room there was this loud strange sound from machines coming back repeteadly every 5 mins. When we called the staff they said it was from the pool machinery and it would go off at 21.00. When we came back from,dinner shortly after midnight and wanted to get some sleep, then there was still this loud noise. We tried to sleep, but it was impossible. At 03.00 we gave up and called the staf, that gave us a room on the 8th floor. It was ok... 2. Pool area looks wonderful on the website, but in reality its awful. Its run down, dirty and has glass walls and glass roof. Do we need to say its gets hot??? We chose never to visit it again 3. Cleaning leaves a lot to desire. Hair, dust etc was easy to find and not worthy a so called 4-star hotel... 4.The biggest of Dolmen is the staff. Their attitude was extremely disturbing and the management really needs to give them proper training and understanding of how to deal with customers. We are experienced travellers and visit at least 15 different hotels per year and have never met staff that treated guests like something the cat has brought into the house... A friend of ours stayed at Dolmen during the same time and was even more disturbed by the conditions at Dolmen and wrote a very critical revied on Dolmen. However, Tripadivos chose not to publish it. Lets see if this one gets published...

reviews.title: Great location but that's about it
reviews.text: Foyer and room smelt of mould. Not this first thing you want to experience when you walk into a hotel. This is a very tired hotel and desperately needs to be revamped. There's dodgy patching of the ceilings everywhere, lights with cheap fluorescent bulbs, stains on the carpet, etc. Back in the day I'm sure it would've been lovely but now it's looks and feels very run down. The hotel is located in a great location but so are many other hotels that offer far better value for money.

reviews.title: Decent, but beware of the hydromassage in the bathtubs!
reviews.text: The hotel itself was fairly decent, if a little overpriced considering other nearby options. But the location is good, being right in the middle of the microcentro and close to Plaza San Martín and many of the sights that tourists will want to visit. However, after a very long day of work I decided to use the hydromassage in the bath. After a couple of seconds, the water that was churned out of the jets was decidely brown and unpleasant looking and I realised that the system probably hadn't been cleaned for a long long time. Disgusting, but I thought getting out of the water and showering and soaping myself vigourously would be best. Nevertheless, after boarding my plane the next day I arrived home with a fungal infection - later to be diagnosed as roundworm to be precise. If I lived in Argentina I would've attempted to sue quite honestly.

reviews.title: A nightmare always!
reviews.text: Been there already twice. First time, got a room on the first floor right beside their office. Awful bedroom, no space to barely walk inside the bedroom. Mold, old carpet, lousy bed and linen. Bathroom is so tinny, and the shower is inside this awfully small bath tub with those disgusting curtains. Nowhere to run to. Breakfast is regular. Location is good. Not worth it. Second time even worse. I know they have rooms without carpet but they are still old...

reviews.title: Good Location, average 3 star hotel
reviews.text: The location is excellent, you can walk around and get easy subway to other destinations. The staff is excellent! We have been there for 4 nights in the room (junior suite). Its large with 2 double beds and a sofa bed, but it has carpet (old) and the bahroom needs an upgrade. It could have a microwave for families with small child. I had to bring a But I would recomend the hotel, its fine!

reviews.title: So Noisy!
reviews.text: My husband and I just returned from Buenos Aires and the Hotel Dolmen. The big warning we give is watch out- this place is NOISY! It is constructed in 12 floors with an open floor plan and lots of marble, so you can hear every door open and close all night...and it sounds like the doors are slamming. We stayed on the 6th floor before a trip to Patagonia and were in a room that connected to another room, and the walls were paper-thin. We didn't get a wink of sleep AND we could hear the breakfast service set-up six floors down! That's seriously how loud it was. Also the windows are not thick, so you will hear every bus and honking car, too, if your room faces the street. On the plus side...the hotel is in a good location near Florida Street. Our sixth floor room was generously big and spotless. Breakfast was excellent with eggs, bacon, variety of cereals, sweets, breads, and great coffee and juices. We also thought the service was very good. The hotel held our bags while we went to Patagonia at no charge. We stayed one night upon our return from Patagonia and we were upgraded to a suite on the 12th floor. Beautiful room with 2 bathrooms and a balcony. While we didn't have the connecting room noise, even on the 12th floor, we had an amazing amount of traffic noise. Our advice is keep looking....or bring heavy-duty earplugs if you want a good night's sleep at the Hotel Dolmen.

reviews.title: Good value in good location
reviews.text: I stayed 4 nights at the Dolmen while in Buenos Aires to attend a wedding. My company's office in Argentina made the booking for me, which seemed to help a lot with the rate as it seems bookings made within Argentina are done at a lower price than bookings made otherwise. I arrived on an AM flight from the US and my room was available for an early check-in without any problems.
