The room itself, while not up to 5 star standards, was completely fine and since it was on the back of the hotel, there was absolutely no traffic noise at all. Breakfast was included and the buffet, while nothing great, was fine. The hotel is located within easy walking distance of Florida Street and Puerto Madera is not too far either. Taxi's seemed be very easy to catch right in front of the hotel also. My only complaints were that I requested 2 extra hours for an extended check-out and was happily told yes, for 50% of the nightly rate. 50% for 2 hours?? Most hotels would not even charge. Also, I made a 10 minute or so call to the USA and was charge 106 pesos (US$34). I would certainly stay there again, but not make any international calls.

reviews.title: Location good. Hotel average
reviews.text: Cant knock how handy it is to everything, but it's a tired old hotel. My room had a weird smell and bad stains on old carpet. My friends staying here also commented on the smell so it wasn't just me. For the money, you can do better. Their service in the restaurant is appauling. Locals get served faster and quicker than tourists.

reviews.title: Nice and Comfy Good Location
reviews.text: We stayed with two young children for 3 nights The Dolmen is nice modern hotel with good location a few blocks from the Obelisco and the shopping streets and Pacifico shopping ctr and in the other direction a not too far walk to Recoletta. Staff: Friendly and helpful Good english Room: cream coloured carpet maybe not the best choice for a busy hotel so it was a bit grubby but apart from that the room was immaculate and v comfortable beds Noise: We were on the sixth floor on roadside of hotel with building works hardly heard anything, but marble floors inside did mean quite a bit of hallway noise but nothing crazy and usually only in the am around breakfast time Pool: Lovely location on 16 floor with panoramic city views small but good with indoor outdoor pools, jacuzzi and saunas and small gym Breakfast: very nice good range of food Bacon eggs, cereals,fruit, baked goods juices n tea and coffee. Overall a very enjoyable stay

reviews.title: Great bargain and wonderful service
reviews.text: This hotel is an unsung treasure. The staff was wonderful and so very helpful. Our room was great. It was the standard room.When it was booked, I was led to believe by the write up that it was a small room. Not so. It was a large sunny, very quiet room complete with a refrigerator and a jacuzzi. Every night, at least twice, the staff would come by with fresh towels and a basket of chocolates. Turn down service was automatic. the room was clean and service to a clogged drain occured within ten minutes of the call. We were swamped with toiletry handouts and anything extra we wanted. When I got a spanish language newspaper outside the door, the staffer ran down the street and returned with an english paper. Thereafter, there was an english language paper outside my door for the rest of the week. The staff was surprised and grateful when they were tipped. The doormen would hail the cab and then walk over to the driver and explain fully any instructions we might have. In one case, it meant explaining two other stops and a pickup before our destination. The hotel is ideally located. the restaurant in the hotel has a nice affordable menu and stays open until late. When we didn't like the room service menu, I went down to the restaurant and ordered what we wanted. the waiter insisted on the full room service cart delivery but didn't charge a room service fee. Frankly the rest of our party was envious. they stayed at a famous hotel that cost them a thousand dollars more than ours and their stay was not as luxurious or comfortable as ours. My only complaint is the scope of breakfast offerings. They had lots of fresh fruit and juice, pastries, scrambled eggs and bacon, two kinds of ham and cheese and yogurt in their buffet but after a while, the same thing got old. Everything, however, that they offered was fresh and delicious.

reviews.title: A must try.
reviews.text: Have stayed here quite a few times. Generally very good service, stylish design, and very good value. Good location too, not far away from the international airport.Sometimes can be a bit noisy when other guests arrive late to their rooms though.

reviews.title: Well located hotel in Buenos Aires
reviews.text: Dolmen Hotel is a good four stars hotel very well located in Buenos Aires. It´s close to the metro station, Florida Street, Recoleta, Retiro and downtown area. The service is very good and they have a parking service inside which is not common in Buenos Aires downtown.

reviews.title: The perfect place to stay for a perfect holiday
reviews.text: A Hotel under the category of Luxury rooms (no Hotel stars), very new, designed and built with high standards, large room and bathroom, good acoustic sound proof, excellent location, everything is functional, reception guys very friendly with good recommendations, rooftop place for breakfast and drinks with a magnificent view of the Acropolis. Totally recommended.

reviews.title: Great hotel in a great location
reviews.text: This hotel is located across from the acropolis. Staff is very friendly, hotel is clean. We had a very enjoyable stay. Breakfast is on the sixth floor with a view of the Acropolis. Hotel is near the Acropolis metro terminal. Easy walk to many sites around the city. If you wish for a change from Greek cuisine, there is a wonderful Italian restaurant just a few doors down from the hotel. Great stay!

reviews.title: Actually 4.5 stars...
reviews.text: The location and staff were top notch. Very clean room. TV included BBC World News for us news junkies. Mini fridge. Fancy shower nozzle. Amazing breakfast on the 6th floor area with a lovely view of the Parthenon (don't forget to visit up there after dark). The only negatives- the smoke alarm kept going off due to someone smoking in their room. And we couldn't adjust the room temperature . On our second morning there, we had to depart before breakfast was served, so the staff made up breakfast boxes for us with ham & cheese sandwiches, bananas and cookies. So thoughtful (and appreciated).

reviews.title: Perfect!
reviews.text: We stayed in this hotel four nights altogether, on our way to and from the islands. When we arrived, they had just opened a week before. We were immediately impressed by the location, the quality of service and the size of the room. The bed is top quality and sound proof well done. Breakfast was good, and you can enjoy the view on the Acropolis! We want to express our sincere appreciation to the staff for their warmth and professionalism. We will definitely go back there.

reviews.title: Perfect hotel, perfect location
reviews.text: We had a fantastic stay here. The location could not have been better. A stone throw away from the metro and a short walk to the Acropolis and Plaka. Reception were extremely welcoming and friendly. Rooms were really clean and the pillows were very comfortable. Breakfast on the terrace was really good. Great selection of an authentic Greek breakfast with view of the Parthenon. We had to leave early on our last morning and reception booked us a taxi to the port and gave us a pack up breakfast for the road - a lovely touch. Would highly recommend!

reviews.title: Great location - well appointed rooms
reviews.text: The location of the hotel is unbeatable, right across the Acropolis Metro station, meaning with easy access to most parts of Athens. Most of the places of touristic interest, e.g. Acropolis, Acropolis museum, Plaka district, Thisseio etc, are withing walking distance from the hotel. The rooms are brand new, our bed was very comfortable and the bathroom clean and well appointed. The front desk personnel were friendly, helpful and kind enough to offer us an upgrade to a more spacious room. The breakfast is served at the rooftop cafe, which has an incredible view of Acropolis, but the service is rather indifferent, or I might say it was completely absent. My only objection is for the type of breakfast offered. As a Greek I can assure you that some of the items served do not belong to the Greek breakfast menu, e.g. I don't know many greeks that eat "dolmadakia" (stuffed wine leaves), "siglino", "strapatsada" or "siropiasta sweets" for breakfast. "Feta" is indeed a typical Greek type of cheese, but it is not the most appropriate cheese for breakfast and also orange juice is not a tasteless yellow-colored sweet liquid.

reviews.title: Great location and super modern hotel and amenities
reviews.text: Just steps from the Acropolis and Plaka with treat restaurants and cafes nearby and tons to choose from. Super modern hotel and room was very comfy and quite. All of the staff were very nice and helpful with great recommendations. Rooftop deck, wine/bar, and breakfast were fabululous overlooking the Acropolis. Would definitely come back would highly recommend!!!!

reviews.title: Perfect small hotel in ideal location with great staff and facilities.
reviews.text: The hotel is opposite the Acropolis museum . It is on the edge of the Plaka district, central for shops, nightlife, restaurants and within walking distance to almost all the the top sights. Very quiet and the staff are brilliant- very helpful and welcoming, and knowledgable about Athens. Getting to the airport on the metro was very easy as the stop is virtually across the road. The rooms are very well appointed and clean. There is a rooftop bar and breakfast area which looks up at the Acopolis. The entrance lobby could be embellished a little with more seating, magazines and tables to make it even more welcoming.

reviews.title: Fabulous boutique hotel in Athens
reviews.text: We have just stayed 7 nights in this fabulous hotel, so close to many historical sights and pleasant regions and restaurants, The junior suite was quiet, very clean, roomy and had a wonderful bed! The staff make this place so special! Every duty manager was only too happy to suggest spots for us to see and how to do so. They all genuinely cared for our welfare. I use trip advisor to book hotel suggestions - this hotel is one not to be missed! An amazing view of the acropolis from the rooftop bar/breakfast room just topped off a perfect stay.

reviews.title: Gr8 view
reviews.text: Jet lagged, just arrived in Athens from oz, walked past called into their rooftop bar 1899 -what a spot - amazing view of acropolis gr8 Chardonnay worth a visit! Gr8 way to start a trip to Greece 👍didn’t stay in hotel but looked amazing

reviews.title: An awesome place to stay in Athens.
reviews.text: The hotel location is excellent. We believe that the overall experience in Athens is molded by the zone where you stay over the night. And this hotel is in the best zone possible, beneath the famous Acropolis and a few meters from the awesome Plaka neighborhood. The Acropolis metro station was just 10 meters from the hotel`s front door. From the breakfast roof top you can enjoy a beautiful view to the Acropolis while eating a very good breakfast. The rooms were spacious, modern and very clean. Congratulations to the staff , they were always very helpful and kind.

reviews.title: Highly Recommended
reviews.text: I had a 36 hour stopover and choose this hotel for the location. I took the metro from the airport which was 18 euros round trip and was an easy way to get there since the metro stop is so close. They were able to check me in early. Staff friendly and helpful. Rooms small but clean and modern with a comfortable bed. I found a hop on/hop off bus close to hotel. Breakfast was amazing and the view spectacular. They held my bags after checkout. I also purchased a local sim from the airport for 22 euros and 10 gbs data.

reviews.title: Highly recommend!
reviews.text: We booked this hotel the night before we came back into Athens after traveling to different area of Greece on a whim. We had previously stayed at a different hotel down the street but wanted to try something new and we were so glad we did! First of all the hotel is so close to the Acropolis station that we kept walking around in circles because it was just that close that it just wasn't believable LOL We arrived 2 hours earlier than check in & it was so great that they could already provide us with a room since we just wanted to rest before starting our adventure in Athens again. The staff is just amazing at this hotel always willing to help & give recommendations! OMG one of the best things about this place is the rooftop terrace/bar!!! We enjoyed breakfast up there & also a night of drinks overlooking the great view of the Acropolis. There are also a lot of other great bars all around the hotel but with such a great view & service why go anywhere else!

reviews.title: Athens hotel with great location and very friendly staff
reviews.text: We spent three nights at this new hotel in Athens that is just down the street from the Akropoli Metro stop and around the corner from the New Acropolis Museum. We could not have picked a better location. Although the room and bathroom were small, they were clean and fine for the little time we spent in the room. Breakfast was delicious and all of the staff were very personable and accommodating of all of our requests.

reviews.title: wonderful in every sense
reviews.text: Having stayed in Athens several times, i had quite a precise idea about what hotel I would like, and accidentally stumbled upon this little gem, which had it all. It has the most perfect location near the main walking street that windles around several historic sites and is close to the Plaka and other lovely streets with a magical atmosphere to hang out in. Metro is practically on the doorstep as well. Also, the hotel and its room are beyond stylish. In spite of the area the hotel is quiet and offers great sleep and relaxation not even mentioning the wonderful breakfast on the rooftop terrace overlooking - what else - the Acropolis. Rooms are clean, and staff is just amazing. Friendly, professional, and with a great knoweldge not only of Athens, but somehow also of what to recommend you personally.

reviews.title: Great Little Hotel!
reviews.text: First, it’s location is perfect: right next to a metro stop and across the street from the Acropolis museum plus in the shadow of the Acropolis itself. You can’t get closer to the action than this!! The hotel itself is perfect. It’s a family owned boutique hotel with an extremely friendly and helpful staff. Our room was large, modern and clean. The free wifi worked beautifully. Breakfast was extremely Greek, delicious, and served on the rooftop with a beautiful view of the Acropolis.

reviews.title: Pricey but Incredible location. Great staff.
reviews.text: Had a great stay would recommend to anyone passsing through if staying some nights. Could 't possible find a nicer and more accommodating staff. Rooms are chic sharp, nicely equipped and very clean. You also couldn't really get any closer to the Acropolis or the metro. Definitely give it a try.

reviews.title: We loved it
reviews.text: We had a great stay. The staff were all very nice and helpful. It’s just outside the Akropoli metro station and a stone’s throw away from the Acropolis museum and the south entrance to the Acropolis. Breakfast and drinks at the rooftop were great too with views of the Acropolis hill while you dine or have a drink. The rooms are clean and new. In addition, there’s a nice cafe called Froots next door and also a great Italian restaurant nearby.

reviews.title: Excellent location and incredible staffs.
reviews.text: We are so glad that we chose to stay at AD Athens Luxury Rooms and Suites for our last stop after spending 3 weeks holidays in Spain & Greece. We stayed 3 nights at the hotel. The room was spacious, new and clean. We asked for a quiet room as we’re light sleepers when we booked the room few months back. We’re very satisfied with the room allocated. The location is perfect. Most of the attractions are just a stone throw away. The metro station is just right next to the hotel (although we didn’t take any rides). We are impressed with the team working at the hotel. On the day we arrived, we received warm welcome from Panos at the front desk. He was very polite and friendly. A big thanks to Angelo at the front desk too. He was extremely patience and helpful with all our questions. He even printed a schedule with informations for our reference. When we ask him the place to buy a special wine cooler to take home, he immediately helped us to find online. When he found out that a store near where he lives has it. Angelo offered to get it for us and delivered it to the hotel the next day which was his off day! It’s really a nice touch and we’re very grateful to him. Panos, Angelo, Aris, the Cafe staffs and the chambermaids have made our last stop of our trip a memorable one. A big THANKS to everyone!

reviews.title: Good value, great location modern room
reviews.text: We booked the most basic room, which was small but very clean and had everything we needed. Chosen for its close proximity to the new Acropolis Museum. Great air conditioning, and good shower. Bed was perfect. Best of all, roof top bar for breakfast and drinks. Here's the view...

reviews.title: Friendly, accommodating and comfortable with great view and amazing breakfast
reviews.text: A fantastic location on the edge of 'Tourist Central' Makigrianni. Acropolis museum is no more than a 5 minute walk and you have fantastic access to the Acropolis itself and other historic monuments. The location, on one of Athens' many side streets, is characteristically a little more 'tired' than the main tourist thoroughfares but this is generally true of Athens and presented no problems. The hotel itself was definitely not tired!! The rooms were recently decorated and were clean and comfortable with fresh linen after two days and fresh towels daily. There is a bar and terrace on the top floor of the building with fantastic views of the Acropolis and reasonable prices when compared with bars in the area, which was ideal for a quiet evening drink. Breakfast is worthy of a particular mention. This was a fantastic buffet spread served in the roof terrace area. There was a huge selection of cold meats, cheese, savoury pastries and breads as well as yoghurt, honey, fruit compotes, and a massive array of sweet pastries and cakes. The check-in staff couldn't have been more helpful and provided us with superb information about the city; it's sights, where to eat and drink and what to avoid. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this place!

reviews.title: Excellent, wonderful gem
reviews.text: I found this hotel online. And I do not regret it at all. It is an excellent hotel. New, clean and very welcoming. The staff are amazing and helpful. They speak English, French, of course Greek and even Japanese!!!!! The rooms are comfortable and spacious. The bathrooms too are very clean and have toiletries of quality. The breakfast is delicious. It is in the terrace on the sixth floor. The terrace has this spectacular view of the acropolis so it is really splendid having breakfast there. The metro station is hardly 100 meters away and there are lots of restaurants, souvenir shops and bars near the hotel. The acropolis and plaka district are all walking distance. The next time i am in Greece, I am definitely staying at Ad Athens luxury rooms and suits hotel.

reviews.title: Perfect hotel in the heart of Athens!!!!
reviews.text: What an absolute hidden gem in the middle of Athens. The hotel is very clean and modern and so convenient to everything. Steps away from Plaka and the rooftop bar has the most amazing view of the Acropolis. The staff was so friendly, the breakfast was great, we could not have made a better choice. Anyone visiting Athens, I recommend a stay here.

reviews.title: Best service and quality rooms
reviews.text: Traveled from South Africa, Johannesburg and the concierge service was great, accommodation is affordable and the views are excellent. Very close to the acropolis and in front of acropolis museum. Rooms clean and large. Luxurious bathroom. Staff very friendly

reviews.title: Perfect location to Plaka and Acropolis
reviews.text: Stayed here one night. Super clean room, nice toiletries offered and good shower. The patio where breakfast is served was really nice and came with a spectacular view from the rooftop- also serves as a nice place for a late night drink as it doubles as the bar at nighttime. Staff on arrival and departure were SUPER helpful, which is why I give this place 5 stars. We went to dinner not far from the hotel in the Plaka area- highly recommend this area. This hotel is super walkable to anything you could need. We took taxis to and from the airport, which was the flat rate of 38 Euros (an Athens rule). The drivers will try to up the price when you go to the airport from the city centrer, so be sure to confirm the price before you get in the taxi! For all travelers to Greece, be aware, Greece has unique plumbing and does not allow you to flush toilet paper. Yup, do not flush any toilet paper or else you may back up the plumbing system. This is Greece wide and really not a big deal (same goes for places in Africa) but just be ready for it :) We visited a few Greek islands and it is the same there too. Be respectful and just go with it. Enjoy Greece!

reviews.title: Perfect location, Awesome staff
reviews.text: Hotel room was clean as were the bathroom and shower. Water pressure was temperature was so good I didn't want to get out! Staff was so helpful with recommendations and super friendly. Breakfast is included and was served on their roof top with a nice selection of pastries, jams, yogurt and bread. They had drip coffee available, and when my husband asked for a latte they happily accommodated. Best part about the hotel is it is literally 20 feet from the metro entrance. We got off at the Acropolis stop, went up the escalator towards "Athanasiou Diakou" and walked right up to the hotel. So convenient. Would definintely stay here again!

reviews.title: Good location, Excellent service!
reviews.text: Location: Few steps away from the underground station and literally next to the Acropolis and Plaka. Quiet neighbourhood at night. Plenty of food outlets nearby. Accommodation: Newly opened, clean, sleep comfortably. Laminated flooring in room which is GREAT! Good wifi throughout. 6th floor serves breakfast and bar at night which has the best view towards the Temple of Rome. Staff: English speaking staff are profesional, very helpful and kind. Highly recommended and definitely will return to stay!

reviews.title: Great Hotel, Amazing Service and location
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed at AD Athens twice during our trip to Greece for a total of 3 days. We can not say enough about the quality of service and level of hospitality all of the staff showed us during our time at the hotel. We have to make a special mention of the concierge, Angelo; he was so helpful and went out of his way to make sure we enjoyed our stay in Athens. Breakfast was great and the rooms were very clean. Honestly, we couldn’t ask for more. The hotel is located right next to the metro and a few steps from the Acropolis and Plaka. We found that it was extremely easy to get to all the major attractions from this location.

reviews.title: A new place in the oldest and most central part of the city
reviews.text: The room was amazing and really clean with no exaggerations in the decoration. Beautiful colours made our stay relaxing after our demanding days at work. We also had a big, modern, spotless bathroom. We enjoyed our traditional Greek breakfast with the most wonderful view of the Parthenon. Will definitely be back.

reviews.title: Excellen!!
reviews.text: Wonderful small hotel with cozy rooms and amazing views to the Acropolis. The staff is helpful, nice and extremely nice. Two minutes walk to Acropolis, a perfect bar on the rooftop and excellent breakfast.

reviews.title: A warm and modern boutique in the heart of Athens
reviews.text: Just like most other reviewers, we had a great stay at AD Athens. I chose the hotel because of it's ratings and it still exceeded my expectations. The room was large, modern, clean, beautifully appointed. The bed was very comfortable. The breakfast room / bar on the top floor has a stunning direct view of the Parthenon. The staff are absolutely lovely. A special thank you to Panos for warm and friendly hospitality and excellent food recommendations. And, lastly, the hotel is at an unbeatable location, a 3 min walk from the Acropolis Museum and entrance to the Acropolis itself, Temple of Zeus, Plaka district, the Acropolis subway station, and a whole street of restaurants. And even though the hotel is so centrally located, it is quiet and tranquil. A great place to stay!

reviews.title: Amazing discovery in an amazing city
reviews.text: Athens, is a most special place to me. I lived there for three years and need the Athens 'injection' every year. It is my home away from home and has just incredible history, culture, people and food. And it continually reinvents itself. All front desk staff were amazing, so helpful and so friendly. The location is great, right next door to the Akropoli station and major bus routes. Wonderful to walk around the city and to smell and feel Athens. The room (which was an upgrade for me) was just wonderful, clean and well kept. House keeping was terrific and very prompt. The breakfast room at the top had so much food and great service - very welcoming. To sit there and have an incredible view of the magical Parthenon/Akropolis was inspiring. It was too cold for the bar to be used at night but I am sure in the summer months - it is a wonderful place to have a drink before going out. The only thing I could find to comment on was that the lobby did not reflect the modernity of the rooms. Lots of wasted space and could be used and modernized much better. Create a coffee or rest area with some nice lounge music perhaps... But certainly nothing to fault! AD was just great! Well done to the owners and team for creating an awesome atmosphere. As long as the rooms are maintained to that standard and the staff remain, then certainly I will stay on my annual visits and for sure will recommend to all my friends.

reviews.title: Perfect place to stay
reviews.text: We spent two nights here and they were perfect. Great location, just a few hundred yards to the Acropolis Museum and Acropolis Metro station. Awesome food just feet away. Hotel was super clean, comfy beds, FANTASTIC SHOWER and super cool rooftop bar/food area. Front desk people were super nice and helpful. Just loved the place. Only negative was that their breakfast spread didn't really have much on it I want to eat for breakfast. It looked more like a lunch or snack spread. BUT, downstairs next door there is a bakery place that had the most amazing breakfast sandwich type thing that I loved so problem was solved!

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Excellent 4 star-hotel with perfect location. Acropolis and the museum is just around the corner and there are a lot of restaurants to choose from in the area. The metro is right outside the hotel. Nice breakfast with view of Acropolis. Very comfortable beds and the rooms looks just like the pictures: very modern and fresh. A little thin-walled so you can hear people in the corridor but that didn't bother us much. Angelos in the reception is very nice and helpful, he speaks 6-7 different languages so you get all the information you need before and during your stay (we called before arrival to ask the taxiprices as a lot of taxidrivers, specially from the airport, tries to charge tourists a lot extra and pretend you didn't pay enough as the quickly change your 50 euro-bill into a smaller change when you loose concentration for a second to check on your bags etc). We highly recommend this hotel!

reviews.title: Superb hotel in a great location with lovely staff
reviews.text: The location of the hotel was perfect, we walked everywhere. The metro to the airport takes 40 mins with one easy change. The roof top terrace for breakfast was very special. The staff were the hotel's greatest asset-they were knowledgable, welcoming & genuine. Shout out to Angelos who gave us a great introduction during check-in, showed us all the places of interest on a map & always greeted us with a smile. The bed was super comfortable & the shower jets were nice & powerful. Check-out at 12pm is very generous. Wi-fi worked well.

reviews.title: Fantastic location
reviews.text: Fantastic central location. The young man at Reception went out of his way to help us. He was incredibly friendly with a wealth of knowledge about everything. Very clean rooms and beautiful view of the Acropolis from the rooftop restaurant

reviews.title: Fantastic location and awesome service!
reviews.text: New Hotel that is located at the foot of the Acropolis. The key historic sites are within walking distance. Angelos provided information prior to our arrival that saved us money and made the experience awesome. His recommendations were also great so our tours, shopping and eating were all great. Make sure you take time for the breakfast and night view from the 6th floor roof deck. The Sight of the Acropolis lit up at night is majestic.

reviews.title: Clean, modern..centrally located, we walked almost everywhere
reviews.text: This hotel has apparently recently refurbished. The rooms & bathroom were clean and modern, the guy that welcomed us at reception spoke English, Spanish and even French.. Excellent breakfast, plenty of choices & overlooking the Parthenon... It is that centrally located that we didn't need to use public transport at all, all the important sites are within walking distance Definitely great value for money.

reviews.title: Perfect location in Athens
reviews.text: This small boutique hotel is in the PERFECT location for seeing the major sites. All are within walking distance and the metro station is steps away. Also right in the middle of many good restaurants and shopping. Welcoming staff with good rooftop breakfast. We stayed in the suite with a wraparound balcony and stunning view of the acropolis. Well worth it.

reviews.title: V new 4* Hotel at the feet of Acropolis
reviews.text: GOOD THINGS: - Recently renovated, quite good shape - The breakfast is comprehensive, with quite some local products - It has a roof terrace where breakfast is served, gorgeous views to the Acropolis - V good quality-price ratio - V silent, despite being at the heart of touristy area Absolutely recommendable!

reviews.title: Great place, location and staff
reviews.text: Newly renovated. Great location, 5 minutes from Acropilis entrance and a few steps away from subway station. Staff was very helpful. Very nice breakfast with traditional greek yoghurt at rooftop terrace, with a view of Acropolis.

reviews.title: Prime location
reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel on the two legs of our Greece vacation in and out of Athens and were happy with the location and service provided. The front desk staff was incredibly helpful, giving us a list of information of what to see and do in the city along with a lot of personal attention to our trip details. On the first part of our stay our room was spacious however the second time we stayed the room was smaller and the shower a bit dirtier than we expected. However the roof top is fantastic for view of the Acropolis!

reviews.title: Perfect location, great staffs!
reviews.text: Definitely the place to stay when I come back to Athens again. Perfect location and very friendly, helpful staffs ~ especially Angelo. Clean room, comfortable bed. Thank you AD Athens to make us feel like home during our stay😊

reviews.title: Absolutely amazing!!! Excellent customer service!
reviews.text: We have visited many places and stayed in many hotels. This hotel was the “best of the best” for customer service. We notified the hotel at booking that my daughter could not eat gluten. Not only did they have gluten-free bread for her to enjoy at breakfast, they also had many other gluten-free products for her, including cookies. The entire breakfast buffet for guests was delicious and contained several Greek specialities. The rooms were beautiful, and the view at breakfast was amazing as there is a fantastic view of the Acropolis. Make sure to see the view in the evening, also. The rooms were very comfortable, clean, and modern-looking. I appreciated the safe in the room, as well as the elevator. Our room did have small steps inside so be careful when you enter (see photo). The location of the hotel was great for visiting sites and there is also a grocery store nearby. I am so glad we stayed at this hotel. The staff was amazing (even letting us enjoy breakfast and check-in very early as we arrived via an overnight ferry from Crete). It is my understanding that the hotel is only a year old. It was remodeled into a hotel from a building next to the new Acropolis museum. I highly recommend this hotel when visiting Athens. This hotel’s staff will make you feel very welcome and comfortable. I wish I could give this hotel more than an excellent rating. It truly is one of our favorite hotels.

reviews.title: Sightseeing
reviews.text: Fantastic location!!, right next to the metro exit. Theres also a grocery store 30 meters away for water and softdrinks. Rooms are a bit small and cramped. Thats why its rated a 4. And also the internet was slow. All in all if i go back i would request a room on the 5th floor for a better view

reviews.title: Wonderful experience
reviews.text: The rooms are clean and comfortable, the staff is very cordial, and the location is ideal. This hotel, though fairly small, offered us everything to make our stay in Athens wonderful. There are many nice restaurants within walking distance.

reviews.title: Angello made me like the place
reviews.text: Angello at the reception is very friendly and extremely helpful. Besides that the hotel was in a very good location. The breakfast was nothing special, and the building is renovated so it still retains characters. Id stay there again if i was ever in Athens. Good value. Bit I would give it 3 stars if it wasnt for Angello, he was super helpful.

reviews.title: Wonderful staff, great location!
reviews.text: First, I must say that the front desk staff is the most welcoming and genuinely pleased to see you of any hotel I've been in for quite a while! So helpful and pleasant and eager to share their city with visitors! That leaves a great first impression! The location is so convenient and perfectly close to the Plaka district for restaurants and shops, without being on a super busy street. You are literally a stone's throw from the Acropolis museum and the metro station, so you can get anywhere you want with ease. For an American audience, you will find the rooms to be a bit small and the bathroom a bit tight. But, this is not the land of the sprawling suburban Holiday Inn - and this is actually a very normal sized European hotel room. It is very newly renovated and well appointed, with a comfortable bed, wood-look tiled floor, ample closet space and a small minibar/fridge. The shower is amazing and the hot water was never ending. Breakfast was also really good- there were stuffed grape leaves, spinach and feta pie, boiled eggs, bread, ham and cheese, honey,jam, butter, and granola for the delicious yogurt (you know, Greek yogurt - except better than US grocery brands and just called yogurt here!). Perhaps one of the nicest elements of breakfast is that you can have it in open air or the roof with a killer view of the Acropolis! Two doors down in one direction is a small grocery to get drinks and snacks and other essentials as needed, and across the street is a souvlaki place that is open late. This hotel also offered great value for cost and I would stay here again another time. I didn't see any of the other hotels that I had considered before booking and arriving and have hotel envy. I was fully pleased with my experience here!

reviews.title: A nice surprise in am amazing location.
reviews.text: This family owned hotel has 20 rooms which allows the staff to provide exceptional service & high quality accommodations just steps from the Acropolis Museum metro. It was a nice size room with with a fabulous Queen size bed. The staff had a difficult time translating the sizes but the key thing is to ask for the one that has one large mattress vs two twins put together. I believe this is 160 cm. The roof top private bar is for guests only and breakfast is served there. That was an incredible surprise - with both savory mezza items alongside traditional sweets that are such a treat - yogurt & all the toppings!! The younger member of the team, Angeliko was a gem - speaking many languages, researching Athens sites, helping with anything but most of all proving intimate insight to the culture! The hotel is just 7 mo thx o!x so we wish them well!

reviews.title: Akropoli metro entrance only a few steps away, Great service
reviews.text: Stayed 3 nights here. Akropoli metro entrance only a few steps away from this hotel. Fantastic location. Lots of good food within 2 minutes (try Liondi). Great service, friendly, helpful, front desk ( one of the most helpful was Panos)and breakfast staff. I posted Actual view from rooftop restaurant, very near to akropoli. Highly recommended, will return.

reviews.title: Lovely Boutique Hotel Near Acropolis
reviews.text: This is a beautiful hotel, tucked into a side street just one block from the Acropolis Metro Station, and within easy walking distance of the side entrance to the Acropolis. Restaurants of many types are easily within walking distance. Our room was comfortable and clean. The breakfast had a suitable variety of food, although none of it was hot or warm. The staff was VERY friendly and helpful, with advice about restaurants, sights to see, transportation, local stores, and any other topic. From the rooftop bar, the Acropolis and Parthenon are easily visible, and especially beautiful at night (see picture, taken one evening while sipping a glass of a local liquor). When we had to leave very early our last day to catch an early flight, since we left before the breakfast was open, they even arranged to have a box breakfast ready for us to take to the airport. I was very pleased with this hotel, and would not hesitate to recommend it to others.

reviews.title: What a gem!
reviews.text: My daughter and I stayed at AD Athens on our first trip to this city. The room was small but quiet, very clean and modern! The staff were extraordinarily friendly and really demonstrated what customer service is all about! The breakfast each morning was hosted by a lovely woman and the meal was delicious! The hotel is located under the Acropolis and there is an amazing view from the little bistro upstairs. The metro is just a few meters away from the front door and there are several wonderful restaurants nearby. This place is a gem! We would certainly go back again!

reviews.title: A PERFECT HOTEL
reviews.text: An amazing hotel indeed the hotel is perfect in every aspect and complete it gives the feeling that your home and the staff were amazing such as all the people who works in the front desk, cleaning crew and who works in the kitchen i would want to mention all their names and i wanted to thank them all from all my heart for that amazing experience we had

reviews.title: First time in Greece and we picked a winner
reviews.text: I can not rate this place highly enough!! From the moment we arrived we were welcomed by the warm and friendly staff. This incredibly hospitality actually started from the time we made the booking and I started sending emails to them asking for advice. Once we arrived they offered excellent suggestions about what to do and where to go whilst here (places that we didnt think of going to... Thanks Panos and team) The excellent service of staff extends past reception to the cleaning staff and hospitality staff in the Bar/restaurant. A special thanks must also go to Angelo for extra travel tips for our journey beyond Athens and also for treating us to bubbles on our honeymoon trip! Our room /bathroom was clean and stylish and even coming from Australia where we are use to space, we found the room spacious enough for us. The location of this place was AMAZING! A stones throw from the Acropolis (with a killer view of it from the rooftop bar/restaurant. Right next to a metro station and to the touristy Plaka neighborhood for fantastic food and people watching! I had received very mixed reviews about Athens from friends that have travelled. However the two days that we have spent here we have had a wonderful experience that far exceeded our expectations. AD Luxury Rooms and Suites certainly played a big part in our memorable experience!

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: This place has impressed me. Very nice staff, clean, perfect location. Walk to everything. The Plaka, museum, Parthenon, great Restuarants and shopping. Breakfast on the rooftop is breath taking and delicious. I will always try to stay here when in Athens.

reviews.title: Excellent Location and Great Value
reviews.text: We stayed here for 2 nights. The hotel is very close to the side entrance of the Acropolis which is important because we wanted to get there early in the morning before the crowds arrive. It is also close to Plaka with many shops and restaurants. There is a big supermarket 1 block away from the hotel. We booked a suite and it is quite spacious. The only problem is that the shower area is not completed enclosed so when showering the toilet may get wet. Also note that no toilet paper can be flushed down the toilet. The breakfast buffet is small but quite delicious. Staff at reception is very friendly. Overall we highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.title: solo traveler
reviews.text: Location was great. Clean, breakfast very good but best of all Angelo at the front desk . He was fabulous, helpful, organized airport transportation including packing my breakfast. Angelo helped make the most of my time in Athens.

reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text: It was a very nice and charming experince to be there. Very good staff very polite and helpful to us. Food was good also. Walkies are nice and must try. Room was quiet good and with impressive views i like most.

reviews.title: Friendly and great place to stay!
reviews.text: This is a new-ish hotel. Rooms were spacious and very clean. Bathroom was spacious too. Air-cond and hot shower worked well. Everything was modern and new. This is a small hotel with 5 floors- each floor 4 rooms. Rooftop breakfast was great as there were few people and the spread although small was all delicious and seemed home-made. I loved the figs, stuffed vine leaves, jam and iced-lemon tea. Location was just opposite the Acropolis Museum and lots of touristy area. However they had no iron or ironing board though we were able to get it later via the receptionist. The receptionist – Angelos spoke excellent English and was very friendly and helpful. He is a gem and we liked him. He gave tips such as to buy a Combo Acropolis ticket at the Roman Agora as there is no queue there and ascend Acropolis from that entrance.

reviews.title: It's so fantastic I'm worried I won't get a room next time
reviews.text: We found this charming hotel after our first spot turned out to be dreadful. The AD Athens has only been open a week or so, but it couldn't be a more welcoming place or more centrally located. It is literally 15 paces from the Acropolis Metro. The rooms are well appointed with lovely showers and spacious closets. And the view from the 6th floor roof is beyond belief. The breakfast is delightful and caters to most tastes while keeping its Greek flavor. We stayed for 5 days and couldn't be happier. If I didn't like the people here so much and want them to succeed so much, I might not have reviewed it because it's going to be a really hot place to stay in just a few months.

reviews.title: STYLISH HOTEL WITH GREAT LOCATION
reviews.text: Very recently opened new hotel right next to the Acropolis and Plaka. Simple and modern welcoming reception with Angelo greeting you with a smile and plenty of information. An exclusive view of the Acropolis from the roof top where a delicious Greek breakfast is served and great for a relaxing drink before going to bed for the night. Good sized modern room very nicely set and comfortable. Although room was clean it was obvious that it was hurriedly made up at the last moment and it looked like the floor was only partly washed up at the room entrance which was still wet.

reviews.title: Great location, superb staff
reviews.text: We stayed at AD Athens for 3 nights -- this hotel surpassed our expectations! The room we had was a bit on the smaller side, but it was neat, clean, and comfortable. Breakfast spread was limited, but good. The rooftop has great views of the Acropolis! What makes this hotel a gem -- the location and its staff. From the moment we checked in to check out, Angelo in particular made sure everything was in order -- he provided excellent tips on sightseeing and local restaurants, made the necessary reservations when needed, and ensured we had breakfast boxes in the morning (we checked out very early to catch the Ferry). The location of the hotel is fantastic -- the major areas and sights are within walking distance. You'd be in Plaka within 5-10mins, Monastiraki within 15-20mins, and the Acropolis in 5 mins. We even walked to Thissio (a nice quaint area on the other side of the Acropolis) for dinner on our last evening in Athens, and that was an easy 15-20min stroll. We would not hesitate to come back to AD Athens. Thank you again Angelo (and friends!)

reviews.title: Great location - perfect for short stay
reviews.text: Hotel was 1km walk from most of the main sites and shopping area called Plaka, so no taxis were needed whilst there. Reception was very helpful - thank you Angelo! Rooms are slightly small but for short stay no problem but you can always book a superior room. Breakfast was average but coffee good, beautiful view of Parthenon from rooftop whilst eating breakfast. Check out time was at 12pm so nice and convenient if you want to get more sightseeing done in the morning. Would return!

reviews.title: Service with a smile
reviews.text: We stayed in this hotel for several nights recently and were very pleased with the facilities and service. The room was quite small but totally adequate. The location is outstanding and the service was exemplary. We will definitely come back here if we visit Athens again.

reviews.title: Excellent brand new hotel in Plaka below the Acropolis
reviews.text: This former hospital has been turned into a solid boutique hotel with spacious rooms, clean modern bathrooms, excellent new beds, strong air conditioning, fantastic wifi and friendly service. Big bonus to have it 20 steps away from the Acropolis Metro stop and a lovely rooftop garden to enjoy your free delicious daily buffet breakfast. Great value and short walk to the entrance to the Acropolis as you enjoy the lively Plaka at night at your doorstep.

reviews.title: Perfect location for exploring Athens
reviews.text: We have stayed twice at this hotel - before and after visiting the Islands. Cannot fault it - especially the staff. They were exceptional and could not have been more helpful. The view of the Acropolis from the roof where you have breakfast is stunning. Metres from the Acropolis metro station and Acropolis museum, and not far from the entrance to the Acropolis. Would definitely stay again.

reviews.title: Beautiful rooms and fabulous breakfast
reviews.text: Very close to the acropolis and in front of acropolis museum. Rooms clean and large. Luxurious bathroom. Staff very friendly and helpful. Rich breakfast in terrace in front of the acropolis. Warmly suggested.

reviews.title: Great little Hotel!
reviews.text: From the moment we stepped into the foyer we had nothing but friendly service from the team of young men who man the front desk! The wealth of knowledge that Angelos had to share was so helpful and also a shout out to the sailor who worked on Saturday morning who gave us lots of tips for our sailing trip which we used that we did on checkout- sorry for not remembering your name!! Location is great and the rooms very comfortable- bed was fabulous! Breakfast was served with a great view up to the Acropolis and the yoghurt and pastries are so delicious. Walking distance to lots of sight seeing sights and Plaka and it's eateries very close. If I came to Athens again I would stay without a doubt at this Hotel!

reviews.title: Wonderful Christmas Holiday Stay
reviews.text: We stayed for 8 nights over the Christmas Holiday. The hotel is perfectly located across the street from the Acropolis Museum and 100 feet from a subway station. But the thing that makes this hotel a winner is its small size and great staff (especially Donato). Everyone was incredibly nice from making suggestions, and giving directions to arranging day trips for us. I can't say enough nice things about the quality of the rooms and breakfast, etc., but it was the service and the attentiveness to detail that really stand out. One great moment was eating breakfast on the top floor and watching the sun come up over the Acropolis. Excellent!

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Stayed here for 5 days while attending a convention at zappeion. Great staff (especially angelo), location (with closeby shops and restos as well as walking distance to the acropolis and metro) and breakfast with awesome view. True value for money for the area its in.

reviews.title: I love this place!
reviews.text: I stayed here for three nights while travelling with my mother. I have zero complaints. The hotel staff are amazing. They're all very kind and helpful. This hotel appears to have been renovated recently. The beds are really comfortable and the rooms are an adequate size. Our bathroom space was a little tight, but the shower was amazing with body jets. The rooftop bar, where they serve breakfast every morning, had a great view of the Acropolis. When we checked in, our room wasn't ready yet so they allowed us to leave our bags and go to the rooftop and have breakfast. We really appreciated that. This hotel is also in a great location. It's just outside of the Plaka neighborhood and next to the Acropolis metro station. There are also quite a few restaurants around the corner. I highly recommend this place!

reviews.title: Best Place to Stay, Great Location & Staff
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed at this hotel from 5-7 Sep 2018. The location is super central (Acropolis metro 🚇station is barely 50m away, very affordable at €2.70 for 2 trips of 90-min each anywhere) and you can walk to Plaka, Acropolis and the Acropolis Museum (all stops for the Sights of Athens Blue Hop On Hop Off tour bus which has the best deal amongst all 3, only €16 per pax for 2 days on all 5 lines and €12 if you have Booking.com’s QR code). The view from the 6th floor breakfast area is amazing (see pics). The room we had, 203, is a little small, with an equally small, but well fitted bathroom, but has a king bed which is very comfortable. At night there is a huge variety of cafes nearby for food. The Monastiraki flea market is a short walk from the hotel. The front desk staff, Panos (morning) and Angelo (evening) are extremely helpful and so willing to help with any enquiries. Angelo was especially helpful in offering to print our boarding passes and directions for laundromat etc. The ride from the airport is €38 (fixed rate) or its very easy to take the Metro too.

reviews.title: Amazing location & staff. Brilliant value!
reviews.text: We stayed for three nights before flying to Santorini. This was the cheapest of three hotels on this trip, but I was very pleasantly surprised at the quality of the accommodation and service. The room: we had a two room on the first floor, it had clearly been recently renovated and he decor and fittings were all of a high standard. Staff: All he staff were helpful and friendly, with special mention going to Angel on the front desk, who was a wealth of information and always welcomed us with a huge smile! He sorted our airport transfer and breakfast boxes upon leaving for our early morning flight. He’s real asset to the hotel. The location: Fantastic. Very close to he major tourist spots and only a 2 min walk from the Acropolis Museum, which I’d recommend visiting before visiting the Acropolis (an Angel tip!). There’s a variety of nice restaurants nearby and a wine bar on the corner. I’m not one for staying in the same place twice, however if I do visit Athens in future I wouldn’t hesitate to book here again.

reviews.title: Perfect hotel, with the best location and people
reviews.text: AD Athens Luxury Hotel its a brand new boutique hotel located in the city center near all the main tourist attractions and a metro station. The rooms are really nice and clean. All the hotel staff are very kind and always willing to help you making you feel welcome. The breakfast in the rooftop with the view at the akropoli was the best! We will definitely stay again next time in Athens.

reviews.title: Great little hotel with fun modern decor
reviews.text: Small and intimate, with friendly and helpful staff. Room was clean and bright and had a great shower, and a fully stocked mini bar with prices that don't try to gouge you like most mini bars. The buffet was vast, with many choices, and best of all, was served on the rooftop with views of the acropolis. Also, LOCATION, LOCATION, LOCATION!

reviews.title: Great location and friendly staff!
reviews.text: Stayed at AD Luxury for 2 nights - great experience. Hotel is a new property and very close to Plaka. Within 5 minutes you have access to shops, restaurants, metro and Acropolis. The staff is what made the experience superior. For example, our taxi driver was incorrectly charging us the rate from the airport to the hotel and one of the hotel staff intervened and informed us that it was a flat rate. Really appreciated the help. They also helped us print our boarding passes for our flight, arranged taxis to the airport, provided recommendations for our journey to Crete, arranged early breakfast boxes and recommendations on where to eat. I appreciated the close attention they paid to us! Highly recommend and will definteley stay here next time in Athens.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Our stay at AD was superb. The staff was very accommodating to our needs, especially Aris, who helped us with buying online Acropolis tickets and recommending a nice restaurant for lunch closeby. Our room was clean and comfortable, and our bathroom recently renovated. But, our utmost favorite part of our stay was the breakfast! Located on the 6th floor with awesome views to the Acropolis, typical greek food was served - very delicious!

reviews.title: First trip to Athens
reviews.text: Our first trip to Athens was fantastic. The hotel was excellent our room very nice. Staff were very helpful, friendly and welcoming. The front desk host was extremely helpful. He explained exactly where we were in relation to the Acropolis and the other sites we planned to visit. The location is perfect for visiting the main sites in Athens. Our breakfast on the roof with a fantastic view of the acropolis was amazing. The breakfast crew were helpful and very welcoming, really made each of our days start out right. I, we would definitely stay at the AD Luxury hotel again.

reviews.title: Fantastic hotel with fantastic staff
reviews.text: Absolutely loved staying here, great location, rooms were great, outstanding staff, extremely friendly and helpful, Angelo on front desk deserves special mention as does Alice, but all the staff were superb !

reviews.title: Beautiful boutique hotel. Just book it!
reviews.text: New boutique hotel located conveniently right outside Acropolis station. Just one min walk to many recommended restaurants on tripadvisor below the hotel, two min walk to the Acropolis museum and three min walk to the Acropolis. Five min walk to Plaka. Despite being in such a bustling place, the hotel is located on a quiet side street, with views of the Acropolis from the hotel’s bar. You can’t beat that! Attentive and friendly hotel staff. Thank you for packing breakfast for us as we had to catch a very early flight. The free upgrade and bottles of wine was a pleasant surprise for us. Room was clean, bathroom was spacious and good toiletries. The breakfast selection is small which consists of mainly cold food like yogurt, fruits, cold cuts and toasts. Hot and cold drinks are self service. Though it doesn’t boast hot breakfast buffet like many hotels, it is good enough. If you don’t like what is offered, there are three to four cafes just below the hotel that you can go to.

reviews.title: Great location and wonderful staff!
reviews.text: I stayed at the AD Rooms and Suites May 15-17 2018. The location was great, very close the the Acropolis and the accompany metro station, walking distance to the Plaka. Our room was neat and clean. Breakfast was served from the rooftop lounge area and the view was incredible. The best thing about this hotel was the staff. The front desk staff were wonderful with recommendations for tours, restaurants, etc. They were all very accommodating. The rooms were neat and clean. I would stay there again and highly recommend.

reviews.title: Excellent location
reviews.text: Just next to the Acropolis metro station. Convenient to visit Acropolis and museum. Many restaurants nearby and they open till mid-night. Breakfast is great. Hotel room is comfortable and clean. Are staff are friendly especially a young man who has passion on his job.

reviews.title: Nice apartments in a perfect location
reviews.text: We stayed at AD Athens last week and were happy with the stay and the rooms. We had two rooms and both were relatively large rooms. The hotel is located right next to the Acropolis Museum and within a 2-3 minute walk from all the tourist attractions. The neighborhood is safe and very vibrant. The staff is very friendly and accommodating. They arranged airport transfers for us with a taxi driver who was knowledgeable and equally friendly. One suggestion I have is if they could add a sliding door to the shower. The shower is quite fancy but the enclosure is pretty small and without a door. So, the water tends to splash out easily. This didn't cause much discomfort for us but something for the owners to think about.

reviews.title: Great start to a smart hotel!
reviews.text: This is an excellently situated gem of a hotel. Family run and with some lovely perks literally 40 steps to the Akropoly metro station, and I'm short, 5 minutes walk to the Acropolis, 5 to the Acropolis museum, 2 blocks from a full grocery store, not to mention the well stocked mini bar, the great AC, the excellent spread at breakfast (included) and the view of the Acropolis as you dine. Beds are comfortable, bathrooms are nice looking though spare in design. Rooms are large for a city hotel. I think luxury is pushing it yet, but in fairness they've been open a week today. The hotel staff are fabulous polyglots and they do speak your language. We're a Spanish speaking family and the evening desk clerk's Spanish was gorgeous, as was his English. The day clerk, Stavros speaks English and French and of course they are both also Greek. I believe one or both also speak German as well. We really liked this hotel. The location is so terrific, the staff so lovely, and the rooms so reminiscent of our home in Madrid (it feels less like a hotel than a flat rental) that we really did feel at home here.

reviews.title: Very good and functional
reviews.text: Staff are fantastic, friendly and helpful! WiFi works well and the location is perfect for visiting all the major monuments as it is easy to walk anywhere and the metro station is literally in front of the door! View of the Acropolis from the breakfast area, the hotel is kept very clean and someone is always present at the entrance. The bed was comfortable and the room decor welcoming. Asked for pickup service from the airport and driver was late and when leaving another driver didn't show in the morning - had to call a taxi to get to the airport. The breakfast is not up to a four star standard and one morning the cold cuts were stale and pastries were hard, maybe old from the previous day or two..... No handles on the windows to open them to change the air in the room.

reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: Amazing service, very friendly and hospitable. Always obliging, the rooms were great, clean, new and nice location being so close to the metro, museum and plaka. The breakfast was great and view from the roof is spectacular. Would visit again.

reviews.title: Ok but not what expected 🙁
reviews.text: When making our two room reservation back in March two of the main reasons we chose this hotel was the location and the photos of the rooms with a view of the acropolis. When checking in we where told the hotel only had one room with a view and it was taken ☹️. Never any where on hotels.com did it say one room with view. There is a view of the acropolis on the rooftop patio but not the same as a room view. The location is close to the acropolis walking distance and the subway station that was a perk. It does get noisy at night with people walking around and cars since it’s in a busy area. Room was clean and a good size just disappointed about the view.

reviews.title: The receptionist made the difference!
reviews.text: We spent 3 days in this hotel in April and our best souvenir is the receptionist. He was very helpful with the reservations we had to make for our flight to Santorini, our train Kalambaka and so on. He took also charge of the refund procedure for the sea-jet reservation that was cancelled due to the seamen's strike, Every time we would come back to this hotel after a visit, he would greet us cheerfully and engage in a conversation with us. Besides, he speaks many languages fluently, English, Spanish and French among them. His name is Angel and we still wish he would come and visit us some day.

reviews.title: A Great Place To Stay in Athens
reviews.text: This hotel was booked after reading the TripAdvisor reviews. It’s in a great location- within walking distance to acropolis & other neighborhoods such as Plaka, if you like longer walks. One piece of information which wasn’t easily available online is that the hotel does NOT have parking. If you have a car, then it better be tiny (ex. Smart car) because street parking will be challenging. The hotel is modern. They keep the entry door locked & the front desk person lets you in. Like most European elevators, there’s is tiny. The room we were in was spacious. Bathroom was nice, especially the shower with spa panel. The drainage inside the shower wasn’t the best. Bed & pillows were comfortable. Refrigerator and safe come in handy. Breakfast was impressive for a boutique hotel. Very nice selection with a view of acropolis from the dining area. Anna was there to greet us each morning. Overall, I’d recommend this hotel.

reviews.title: Fantastic hotel
reviews.text: First of all, most of my life is on the road and I stay in Hotels 50+ nights a year, usually at 5 star hotels. This small family hotel is one of the best hotels I've stayed at for two reasons. It's new so it's very clean and nice, and at a great location so price/performance is good but above all, it's the staff that pleases. The staff has genuine smile and amazing willingness to help. For example, we asked for a restaurant recommendation. one usually gets a list of names but they called 2-3 best ones, tried to reserve the best view, draw the route on the map etc. You can really feel the genuine desire to help. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Great location, breakfast
reviews.text: Best location, walked most everywhere we wanted to go. Took metro from airport to hotel, didn't need taxi or car. Breakfast was extensive, buffet. We had a view of the Acropolis each morning at breakfast. We went up to the breakfast/bar to have a pre-dinner drink and viewed the Acropolis lit up at night. Room was modern, efficient, plenty of hot water for a shower.

reviews.title: Gem of a hotel, rooftop bar awesome
reviews.text: Location 10/10 Service 10/10 Room 10/10 Value 10/10 A really great place to stay! Right outside the Acropolis and a stone throw from the train station and restaurants. The rooms are small but have great air conditioning and the facilities within the room are excellent. The front desk is open 24/7 and they are always willing to help with anything you might need (especially guiding the attractions around Athens). There is a really cool rooftop bar that has a great view of the Parthenon. Would definitely return.

reviews.title: Staff are outstanding.
reviews.text: This is a brilliant hotel. The location is perfect - just 20 metres from an entrance to the Acropolis Metro station and close to the Acropolis and the Acropolis Museum. It is in the heart of an area with restaurants, shops, cafes, a mini mart and everything a visitor needs. The rooms are modern, clean and a reasonable size. The shower is excellent with unlimited hot water and great pressure. Breakfast is available at a wonderful roof-top terrace with great views to the Acropolis. It is a great photographic spot for day and night photographs. Juices, cereals, yogurts, cold meats and cheeses, fruits, breads, sweet pastries, dolmadakia (traditional Greek food made from rice and herbs stuff into grape leaves) and more are available together with great coffee, a selection of teas, and hot chocolate. You will not go hungry! What sets this hotel apart from others, however, is the wonderful staff. Without exception we found everyone from the front desk to the restaurant to the room staff and management outstanding. It really felt that we were treasured guests in a wonderful private home. After travelling for over 40 years, this is my first hotel review. I was moved to write it because our visit was memorable. I'm sure you will find the same.

reviews.title: Christmas in Athens
reviews.text: Clean rooms. Extremely polite and helpful staff. Good location. Easy access to city centre. Acropolis museum is 2 minutes walk from the hotel. Safe surroundings. Lots of small cafes next to the hotel.

reviews.title: A great choice for visiting Iguazu Falls
reviews.text: This hotel is a few minutes cab ride into town and set in a beautiful tropical garden. There is a lovely pool and a restaurant if you want to stay in. The breakfast is O.K. The rooms are large with king size beds that are comfortable and everything is very clean. This is a good pick.

reviews.title: Very spacious and comfortable
reviews.text: We only stayed 2 nights and our flight was late at night. The arranged airport transfer wasn't there to meet us but the airport arrivals arranged a car and receipt and the hotel gave us a refund. The rooms and bathroom are spacious and it was lovely to be able to have a bath and good nights sleep. Breakfast was adequate, although there was an issue with electricity on our first morning so not able to use toaster. We managed to catch a local bus to town (only 15 peso single fare) the first day, but unfortunately the next day no buses passed and we had to arrange a taxi (80 peso). Here we found the main bus station and got tickets to the Brazilian side of the falls and upon returning to town we then went to the Argentina side, unfortunately you can't go directly from Brazilian side to Argentina side. The buses travelled past our hotel, I'm not sure if we could have got on closer to the hotel if we had tickets from online, but you could get off outside the hotel if you wanted to. We stayed on to return to main town for restaurants. We managed to have a quick look around the butterfly house and snake/reptile enclosures on site, but mostly we were out and about.

reviews.title: Great Hotel and Service. Really authenic and cool.
reviews.text: Stayed two nights in Feb 2017 and found the hotel to really be a unique, great ambiance property. From the outside looks like not much, but when you go in, the property has a great courtyard, nature preserve, small but adequate walk in pool and bar, small Spanish chapel with stained glass and a zoo. It even has a walk-in butterfly house, snake house, crocodile, etc, I can't say enough about this place being cool. The staff are all very, very accommodating and helpful. Many speak English. The restaurant on site is very good as we had lunch and diner there-white tablecloth but not too expensive-just right. The breakfast was included and consisted of 4 or 5 fruits, cereals, scrambled eggs, ham, cheese, a number of different pastries, juices, coffee, tea. Not extensive but adequate and very good. Room was large and very clean with nice flat screen, individual a/c, bidet, hair dryer, walk in shower and tub. Good water pressure and hot water quantity was not a problem. Bed was very comfortable. Nice large rustic desk. Rooms open into courtyard and chapel yard. Rooms had safe and refrigerator. Rooms are very nice and have a quaint, old Argentina flair. Cab to downtown was 80pisos or $6usd. Cab to Falls was about $20. Hotel offered free airport shuttle but you must make arrangements prior to arrival and departure as shuttle only runs as needed and is not sourced at the hotel. You should check on shuttle as it may be no longer free-not sure-it was when we stayed. All in all, we loved this charming property and enjoyed our stay. Would return in an instant.

reviews.title: Fantastic hotel!
reviews.text: I loved this hotel! Stayed here while visiting the Falls in December 2016. The room was clean and big, tv, a/c, and WiFi all worked well. The staff was excellent and I thought the food was great (only ate at the hotel one night). The grounds were well maintained and love how it's sort of a conservatory with many animals and plants. I highly recommend a stay here if you're in the area!

reviews.title: Great place to stay if you are visiting the Iguazzu falls
reviews.text: This lovely new hotel has wonderfully large rooms with very comfortable beds. The property seems to have once been a zoo and a wander around the back reveals cages with crocodiles, snakes and other animals . I'm not sure what their plans are for this but it has great potential. The pool looked very inviting and the lush tropical gardens were beautiful .The staff at the front desk and the restaurant did not seem to be able to speak much English which was a little difficult at times but generally I would highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.title: Pueblito Iguazu
reviews.text: Hotel was cheap and had a great restaurant and a pool outside. Rooms were air conditioned. Wifi didn't work in my room for some reason but it was good in the lobby. Cabs operate right in front of the hotel. The bus stop is also in front of the hotel but for some reason it was never in the same spot twice which made it hard to get to the main bus station in the town (el pueblito). Very happy I found this hotel.

reviews.title: A mini Zoo !
reviews.text: El Pueblito is a very new resort. The rooms are huge, modern and very clean. The beds and pillows were wonderfully comfortable. We stayed 2 nights, in order to visit Iguazu Falls, but the Hotel is so comfortable, you could easily stay longer. There are numerous private outdoor areas to relax, a swimming pool to cool off in and hammocks to laze around on. This Hotel is set out on a large piece of land, adjacent to jungle. The Hotel has its own collection of turtles, snakes (including anaconda) , Chamelions and a Butterfly House. The grounds are beautifully kept and it is nice to walk around and explore the area. Breakfast was buffet style and evening meals and a bar are available.

reviews.title: Enjoyable stay
reviews.text: We spent 3 nights here as our base for the trip to the Falls. The rooms are enormous and it felt very Spanish with a very nice little chapel in the grounds. The environment is featured heavily and it’s attached to an environmental Centre with many reptiles. The staff were very helpful and the poolside location for a snack and a drink in the heat of the late afternoon was very enticing. The breakfast was perfectly enjoyable but the evening restaurant was outstanding. The menu is not vast but we had several different dishes and all were excellent. Whilst you are a little way from the Centre of the town 100 pesos in a taxi and you’re there ! Recommended

reviews.title: Experience nature and calm at the Pueblito Iguazu
reviews.text: El Pueblito Iguazú offers a relaxing and comfortable environment for the tourists that are looking for a vacation surrounded by vegetation and nature. The rooms are nicely furnished with a king size bed, closet,small fridge, hand crafted wooden chairs and small table and desk. Wi fi works from a set up time ( 8 am to 10 pm ) in the rooms and it is not fast speed. Wifi works in the reception. Individual lights switches on the room, makes possible to illuminate areas separately. The washroom is clean and neat. It contains all the accessories needed for a great staying: hair dryer, towels as much as you request, lotion, shower gels, shampoo and conditioner. The meals are exquisite. The menu offers a variety of regional foods and wines of different types. Staff cares for the customers and the small details to make them feel excellent Transportation such as public city bus, taxi, remis are available to go to Cataratas and downtown areas. Touristic attractions such as Arapuka ( trees conservation and awareness, regional gifts, food etc); Horse back riding through a reserve and jungle, prescious stones and mines ; are at a walking distance of 100 to 300 metres.from the hotel. I plan to come back as my family and I experienced an indescriptible wonderful experience. Thank you! Silvana Herrera ( Winnipeg, Canada)

reviews.title: El Pueblito Puerto Iguazu --- highly recommend
reviews.text: On arrival, on the hotel appearance on the outside was nothing much to give away the little paradise inside. El Pueblito is a small hotel, the beautiful sculpted gardens with swimming pool with hundreds of butterflies fluttering around, the eco park with snake enclosure, a glass house with exotic plants and a pond were certainly a pleasant surprise. The rooms are enormous, beautifully and tastefully furnished. Free WiFi in the rooms. Friendly staff welcomed us with a glass of fresh juice. It is a shame we stayed only 2 days.

reviews.title: Eco centre stay
reviews.text: The eco centre is in beutiful surroundings with on site access to wild life and native flora. It has a focus on environmental sustainability and the grounds are well kept, with the fauna well looked after. The room was tired, musty and several powerpoints, wifi and fixtures didnt work. Pillows were lumpy and unusable and everything felt damp.This was disappointing and it made being sustainable more difficult as we needed to run the shower longer to get hot water and leave the aircon on to counter the dampness. The buidings and ammenities were rundown, with our door having large cracks that insects were able to come through. The pool was lovely but very slippery and the decking was broken and a hazard. Staff were friendly and tried really hard to accomodate gluten free. Unfortunately we were unlucky enough to be affected by the food, possibly from cross contamination or language barriers with some staff. The centre provides an excellent menu, and meals were delicious. Our waitress Lucia was exceptionally professional in providing GF alternatives. The hotel did not seem to be geared to English clients, with all brochures of attractions in Spanish, so translator apps got a good workout during our stay. Outside ammenities were attractive but there were no services to order food or drinks at the pool or while enjoying the grounds, which was a real shame and a missed opportunity for them and us.

reviews.title: Wonderful days in Iguazu
reviews.text: Its a wonderful place for relaxing. Absolutly friendly and warmharded staff who takes care all the time. The rooms are very big and equipped with all the necessary things you need. Also i can recommed the restaurant. Thanks for the enjoyable time.

reviews.title: Environmentally conscious
reviews.text: El Pueblito is a spacious hotel set in a lovely tropical garden setting. It is some distance from the centre of town, however taxis are cheap. The rooms were huge; mine was upstairs overlooking trees and a chapel. There is pool with a poolside bar, and a restaurant on the premises. Breakfast was a buffet. I enjoyed the meal I had in the restaurant one night. Staff were helpful and friendly. Wifi was poor and only in the main lobby.

reviews.title: Smelly and hot
reviews.text: We were very disappointed with our accommodations. Apparently, we erroneously received an older, non-renovated room. It smelled musty, the bathroom was old and moldy and the air conditioner didn’t work well. We asked for a different room and were told that while we had been given the wrong room, there were no other rooms. They were unclear on reducing the bill and quite honestly, I had no idea what they were charging me when I left. The lunch food was not very edible although I heard dinner was somewhat better. All I kept thinking during my stay was that I wished I had booked somewhere else.

reviews.title: Excellent place to stay for visiting Iguazu Falls
reviews.text: Huge and spacious rooms with air condition. Very friendly and service oriented staff. If you like nature the bio enter is an added bonus. The swimming pool is a great place to refresh after a long day of hiking.

reviews.title: Reasonable place to stay
reviews.text: This was a good place to stay for the two nights we were in Iguazu. The room was very spacious and clean and looked really nice. We had TV and airconditioning, but no WIFI in the room. There is free WIFI at reception desk. There is a restaurant, which serves free breakfast and a good dinner. The restaurant is however not open during the day. The little zoo has various snakes, kaimans, butterflies, and is probably very interesting for kids. One thing to note, small insects likes spiders will get into the room - just part of the climate down there. All in all, this is a good hotel at a reasonable price.

reviews.title: Cancelled prepaid reservation 9 hours before arrival to accommodate current guest that wanted to stay extra day
reviews.text: Received cancellation email 9 hours before arrival even though in contact night before. Let current guests keep my prepaid room so they could stay extra night. He Booked me into a big city hotel with lower review rating. Big hotel in city vs. small b&b type hotel in butterfly eco garden? Need I say more?

reviews.title: I would return here!
reviews.text: Nice walks through their little jungle with a butterfly house and orchid room...a good place to stroll and relax. Staff were very helpful, and even though most had only basic English (some staff were much more bilingual) they tried very hard to be helpful. Breakfast buffet was excellent with plates of baked breakfast goods, cheese, and deli thin ham; pitchers of juice and yogurt; cereal, bread, and scrambled eggs.
