reviews.title: Not friendly
reviews.text: Not a warm welcome from owner, just arrived from long journey first words was get ur shoes off with no explanation as other people were allowed shoes. Small bedroom and shared bathroom. Breakfast was slow and impersonal no marmalade or jams available. Parking a nightmare on small courtyard taken up by 2 rangerovers so getting in and out was difficult. Not again.

reviews.title: DISGRACE to be called a B&B
reviews.text: Where do I start!!!! Upon arrival; no room for our car as the monstrosity of two range rovers were taking up most of the cramped driveway (first rules of business...parking: allow your customers to park as a priority ! Fail!!) Welcome; if you can call it that! The stone faced expressionless woman that was namely the host barked that I removed shoes, to walk onto wood! Interesting concept! Anyway, we let this slide! The room was clean, freshly laundered, very comfy pillows which was the only saving grace. Bedroom floorboards were creaking from late at night to early morning, you could hear every step so our nights sleep was highly disturbed, perhaps these need to be maintained prior to allowing other guests to stay. If this was a premier inn we would have got our nights sleep guarantee refund! And perhaps a warmer welcome. Moving onto breakfast; not sure you can certify calling it that when the poached eggs were hard- recall this being near boiled. Toast cold, service without a smile and seemingly one person serving! It seems the money has been invested on anything but the business! Must say cats were cute ! Do not stay unless you want a cold, unwelcome stay with a terrible breakfast! Oh and to pay the privilege for this! Never to return!

reviews.title: Fantastic hosts
reviews.text: Olde Hall is a lovely old building which has been beautifully renovated in a modern style. The room we chose was light and tastefully decorated, and although it did not have an en suite, the bathroom was easily accessible and always available when needed. What made the stay for us was the hospitality; David and Hazel were perfect hosts. David greeted us warmly and offered us lots of suggestions for places to visit, and even insisted on phoning a restaurant we mentioned to check if it was open. These little touches make a big difference and made us feel as though we were staying with friends. Breakfast was beautifully cooked and all locally sourced produce. Thanks again!

reviews.title: Great base to explore Norfolk
reviews.text: I booked to stay at The Olde Hall as a last minute idea in order to have a good base in a great location to visit the Norfolk coastline! This B&B did not disappoint me, in fact I was pleasantly surprised! I arrived later than arranged but the owner sent me a message explaining how to get in and where my room was which was really kind of her, and her instructions made perfect sense! My room was clean and tidy and the bed was so comfy! The owner was so helpful, giving me great advice on where to visit and top places to eat during my stay, she made me feel so comfortable and welcome... like nothing was too much trouble for her! I believe if you want a good base to stay, in a good B&B which does exactly what it states/ claims, then this is the place to visit and is great value for money! I will definitely be back soon!

reviews.title: Brilliant hosts comfortable and responsibly priced
reviews.text: Had a great time at the Olde Hall B&B The hosts couldn't do enough for you and we're very friendly and helpful the rooms are top class and excellently decorated the bed and clean and comfortable, breakfast is well made with a choice of various yogurts cereals and other appetisers, free wi-fi and television in your room truly makes it a home from home. Thanks

reviews.title: Welcoming experience
reviews.text: I booked to stay last minute, not having time to check reviews location etc. I was overwhelmed by this fabulous B&B, my room was beautiful, warm and cosy. Very clean and the bed was like home from home. The owners were very kind, pleasent and welcoming. I was provided with a range of options for breakfast and nothing was too much trouble. My breakfast was perfect followed by a range of cereals, fruit and juices. I would highly recommend to anyone whether for business or leisure.

reviews.title: Good room, good breakfast but a few niggles
reviews.text: We stayed here for one night in August and the booking process was easy and seamless. Our stay was good but with a few niggles So what was good: 1. The bed was exceptionally comfortable with good bedding 2. The Room was clean and nicely decorated and well equipped 3. Breakfast was great - pancakes were amazing and the full English was good 4. The lady who served breakfast was lovely, chatty and welcoming 5. The door entry system is really good and easy to use so that you can freely come and go. The not so good: 1. This is a old building and our room was below a shared bathroom - the floorboards above creak and this woke us a number of times and also the noise from the bathroom is audible in the room and again this awoke us so we had woken at least four times during the night 2. Parking is very tight with only 4 spaces available 3. Use of the pool had a £10 surcharge if not staying more than 2 nights and you had to pre book use of the pool and you were allocated a 1 hour slot. This wasn't made clear before booking and we had wanted to use the pool after a long day driving Other things to note are you need to pre order your breakfast and also let them know what time you will be having your cooked breakfast. This was not an issue at all for us and worked well. Also you need to remove your shoes at the door and leave them in shoe trays by the front door - disposable slippers are provided. We hadn't been told this until we reached our room and we were made to feel a little uncomfortably that we still had our shoes on. I totally accept this is the owners home and must be respected but we had genuinely not realised that this was one of the requirements upon arrival. We ensured our shoes were removed each time following this. Overall this is a nice B & B but with some changes it could be great.

reviews.title: Overnight Thursday 2nd July
reviews.text: Wonderful place to stay. Just on the outskirts of Bacton. It had great charm. The en-suite double room had everything needed - It even had bath robes in the wardrobe. Breakfast was terrific. We will definitely be back.

reviews.title: Lovely room but ........
reviews.text: I stayed in Holkham room with ensure which was lovely with everything you could wish for and the bed was lovely and comfortable, with lovely pillows and bed linen, toiletries were lovely. The breakfast was the poorest breakfast I have had anywhere, it was a comedy of errors!!!! We were moved from 9.00 to 9.30 but the lady who showed us in but the lady who was doing breakfast was expecting us at 9.00 as she hadn't been made aware of change but that being the case nothing was ready not even the coffee and tea! There was no yoghurt, fresh fruit out only jars of cereal, the breakfasts came out one at a time which is ridiculous as there was five of us and by the time my husband was served the first two had finished their breakfasts, my eggs benedict was appalling with enough vile sauce to drown it which I left, my egg yolks were solid yuk. The toast was cold so all in all not the best, there should be more than one person on at breakfast as the lady clearly couldn't cope. I don't know who was cooking breakfast on some of the reviews as she wasn't at Olde Hall when we were staying. Shame as our room was lovely.

reviews.title: Great value room and tasty quality breakfast.
reviews.text: We stayed for 3 nights at the olde hall in the small double with shared bathroom, the room was clean and good standard of furnishings, nicely decorated. We used this just as base to sleep as we spent most ours days exploring the broads and Norfolk coast, so the small cozy Holkham room we opted for (because it was cheaper) was not a problem, and although the bathroom was shared it was just 2 doors away. The house is light and airy as open plan, breakfast was good selection, cooked to perfection and tasty. We found the hosts to be friendly but not too much. Contactable if you required assistance or advice but also left to enjoy your privacy. Free parking and free wifi, no restrictions on returning home late as door does not get locked as with some establishments we have stayed at previously. Great cooked breakfast and variety all at very cheap cost considering the quality of furnishings, food served and location. We would have paid double to triple in nearby Cromer for a similar stay in may

reviews.title: Very relaxing & freindly
reviews.text: I stayed in Blakeney room. A double room which was very clean and comfortable. As a solo traveller it was fine. For a couple, it may be a bit of a squeeze. The breakfast was lovely and certainly set me up for the day. Menu choice very good too but they do ask to pre-book the day before your choice. The only reason for not giving an excellent rating was the shared bathroom arrangement. Another bathroom option would be more convenient. The existing one however is very clean. A two minute walk to a beautiful quiet, unspoilt sandy beach. I would definitely make a return visit. Thank you Olde Hall.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: I have stayed several times now and never been disappointed. The room was very comfortable and the staff very friendly and welcoming. I would highly recommend staying here if you're thinking of visiting the Bacton area.

reviews.title: Outstanding B&B
reviews.text: 4 of us booked 2 rooms at this excellent B&B and we were all impressed not only by the cleanliness, décor and location but by the special touches normally reserved for top class hotels - quality shower gels and lotions, beds turned down at night and first class service from David and Hazel who were not only most helpful from the time we booked until the time we left, but also lovely hosts. The breakfast was fantastic with fresh fruit, yoghurts, cereals (with optional toppings) toast and a full English with eggs cooked to your personal liking. This B&B is truly top-notch and is excellent value for money - we all agreed Olde Hall is by far the best B&B we have ever stayed in. Thanks David and Hazel for a great stay

reviews.title: Business Trip
reviews.text: Immaculate, spacious, beautifully decorated rooms in a stunning property. Extremely pleasant and helpful hosts who let you potter around but are always on hand should you need anything. A fairly new business but no doubt one that will be a roaring success!

reviews.title: Great Stay At Olde Hall
reviews.text: we stayed recently at Hazel and Dave's B&B and thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Very good location, between the coast and Norwich — and the little extra touches (and the great breakfast) made for a great time at a very reasonable price. We will definitely stay again! Jeff and Bev

reviews.title: Swimming
reviews.text: Decided to give the pool a go with a few friends booked an hours slot for 7-8pm. We arrived a little early to give us time to change however we were soon greeted with signs saying stick to your allocated time slot or you will be charged extra. Outside the pool area is a dim lite area where signs ask you to remove your shoes and leave them, glad it wasn’t raining. After removing our shoes we entered the pool area to find a dark room with uneven slippery flooring and no light switches. Spent a few minutes in the dark looking for lights until we discovered a small switch on the wall, which lite it enough for us to then gradually find touches to turn on and a few overhead lights. The changing room was clean tidy, glad I went with all females though as no separate area for males to change. ‘Shower before entering the pool’, I would if your shower worked! Lovely heated pool, steps could do with a hand rail. Could also do with being all one depth so you could swim lengths abit better. Had rope dangling in the water and half the pool was in the dark. Didn’t feel overly safe, very eerie atmosphere. Really need to consider laying some new flooring that is more flat and less of a trip hazard. As most the floor was uneven and bumpy. Be a nice place during the day to have a chilled swim with friends or kids but don’t think I’ll be visiting again.

reviews.title: Comfortable accommodation
reviews.text: Arrived to let self into property. The rooms provided were very comfortable and. We ordered our breakfast for the following day before our arrival, and each day at breakfast for the next day, good food choice of what you wanted. We were asked if we had any special dietary requirements. Recommended

reviews.title: Lovely room, comfortable bed
reviews.text: We had a great stay at this B&B. Stylish room with en suite, quality bedding & towels with extra touches like mini toiletries & biscuits. The owners were very helpful & were able to find us a time to use the pool even though it was very booked up (we paid £10 for 1 hour exclusive use of the pool as we booked room only). The wifi wasn't very reliable on the first night but seemed to be OK on the other days. Everything else was great & we would definitely stay again!

reviews.title: A great find
reviews.text: Having struggled to find anywhere to stay in the area for ages this more than fills the gap. Top notch breakfast. Most enjoyable! A handy location for those needing to be near Mundesley, Bacton or North Walsham Would love to use the pool next time but we were too tired after work!

reviews.title: Beautiful Olde Hall B&B
reviews.text: Thank you for such wonderful visits to your beautiful B&B. Hazel and Paul were perfect hosts, helping us in all ways, meeting our travel needs and requests. The house was lovely, quiet and a perfect respite from the major hotels. We highly recommend this B&B to anyone wishing to stay there. Everything was fresh, new, clean, pretty and top class. The breakfasts were amazing and we felt so at home in such a loving home and family business. We can't wait to visit Bacton again and we plan on staying in the Olde Hall just down the road from the historic Priory of Bromholm, a famous Catholic site and pilgrim retreat from long ago. Thank you Hazel, you were the best and we loved meeting you. We appreciate you sharing your beautiful home with us.

reviews.title: friendly and professional place to stay
reviews.text: Hazel and Dave make you feel very welcome, a very clean and lovely house to stay in. Wonderful breakfast in the morning couldn't ask for more. Anything you needed they would go out of their way to make sure they could help. Only stopped one night so missed out on the pool, will make sure next time we have our swimming things 😊

reviews.title: Relaxing weekend in Bacton at Olde Hall
reviews.text: Just arrived back from staying at Olde Hall for a long weekend. We had an ensuite room downstairs. The room was a good size, spotlessly clean with very comfy bed and pillows (I want some of those pillows!) and was beautifully decorated. The room was off the main lounge/dining area but was very quiet and had every attention to detail (spa products in bathroom, slippers and full selection of filter coffee/and teas). They also gave us use of the pool for 1 hour over the weekend which was a lovely addition to our stay. I loved having the pool to ourselves, the water was lovely and warm and pool area was very modern and clean. Highly recommend this place and only 10 minutes to the most gorgeous unspoilt beaches in Norfolk. The breakfasts were amazing too, such a fab choice (Eggs Florentine and American Pancakes to name a few!) Their full English also went done well using the local produce, cooked to order at a time of your choosing. Highly recommend for a lovely weekend away.

reviews.title: Hope to stay again!
reviews.text: would highly recommend staying at the Olde Hall, didnt feel like a traditional B&B but more like you were Dave and Hazels house guests! who made you feel right at home! luvely clean rooms and showering facilties plus the indoor pool and sauna which made my stays even more relaxing! Locally there are a couple of pubs,big sandy beaches ideal for a quiet break.

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: Attention to detail coupled with a casual approach is a good description of our stay. It must be difficult as b&b owners to get the balance right between being friendly on the one hand and potentially over bearing on the other. Hazel and Dave have struck gold with their intelligent approach: they care but don't fuss - this for me is what I yearn for in a b&b! Luxury bedroom, quality food and hospitable owners. A 2 night stay with a dip in the pool, free wifi in the rooms all for a very reasonable cost. Thank you and Good Luck with your venture.

reviews.title: Surprisingly good...
reviews.text: 7 of us stayed here while on a cycling trip in Norfolk and although Bacton may not be the most inspiring of places this B&B is well worth staying at. Certainly the best breakfast we have had while 'on tour' and very hospitable hosts.

reviews.title: Weekend break
reviews.text: My second time at Olde Hall, lovely double room which has a boutique feel about it, fantastic breakfast and a super local area to explore. The beach is just a five minute walk away. Totally recommend.

reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: Holiday to visit local animal shelters & to visit a new area. Booked last minute & we weren't disappointed. We were made to feel very welcome. Breakfast was divine & nothing was too much trouble. Room was first class, laid out in a thoughtful & imaginative way. Would thoroughly recommend.

reviews.title: First Class
reviews.text: This is an exceptional Bed and Breakfast run by lovely hard working people. It is also located in a great spot close to the coast and also with good access to the surrounding area. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Excellent standard bed and breakfast
reviews.text: Lovely quaint room in a nice house. very good standard compared with other bed and breakfasts we have stayed in for the same price. Lots of choice for breakfast and well presented. Great value for what we paid.

reviews.title: Lovely bed and breakfast!
reviews.text: We would highly recommend this bed and breakfast in Bacton. Hazel and Dave worked so hard to meet our needs. We had very clean and comfortable accommodation which was beautifully decorated. Thankyou so much for all your excellent hospitality Hazel and Dave!

reviews.title: As good as it gets
reviews.text: If you are looking for great accommodation in this neck of the woods look no further. We had a relaxing week here and can't fault the room or the food. The little extras provided were a good touch. The breakfast is well presented and varied. Though the full English was excellent we tried other menu items and we weren't disappointed. The room was well furnished and the bed very comfortable. No sleep problems here. The use of the private pool was another bonus. Hazel and David are friendly, attentive hosts and make sure everything is done to make your stay the pleasure it should be. If we return to this area of Norfolk this will be our first choice of places to stay.

reviews.title: One word... amazing! Highly recommended.
reviews.text: We stayed for 3 nights. Dave and Hazel simply excel and can't do enough to ensure your stay is just perfect. Their welcome was warm and friendly. The location was spot on, within easy reach of everything Norfolk has to offer. The facilities are 5*, like a luxury hotel without the high price. The breakfast simply stunning and the pool and sauna, WOW! This B&B is highly recommended, you will not be disappointed.

reviews.title: Mr & Mrs Henry
reviews.text: We have already contacted our friends to rebook in the near future. Just what we needed and we didn't have to fly abroad. We had good accommodation, an excellent nights rest, superb breakfast, and a supportive and polite host. What more could you ask for to recharge our life's batteries?

reviews.title: Stop Over in Bacton
reviews.text: A lovely B&B in a remote part of Norfolk all very clean and modern, me & my husband had the holkham en suite room & could not ask for better. We stayed here on our way up to Cromer from Great Yarmouth as we were cycling, there is also a pool which I think you can hire out for an additional cost. The breakfast was first class all freshly cooked a wide selection of fruits cereal & local jams Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Wonderful in every way!
reviews.text: We booked last minute and had help as had problems with our laptop. Hazel was amazing so welcoming and really made the whole process hassle free. The location is easy to find but very peaceful and relaxing. Plenty of places to eat to all tastes nearby just few minutes drive. The building is stunning and our room was lovely. Perfectly clean and tranquil. The best nights sleep we have had in ages. We wish we had stayed longer and can not to return. Nina and Mauro x

reviews.title: Lovely weekend away!
reviews.text: We booked this as a weekend away for our wedding anniversary. It was a lovely B&B, we liked the little touches of slippers and dressing gown, biscuits and tea in the room and a bottle of water and chocolate when we came back on our first night. The breakfast was great, kept us going all day till dinner! The area is nice and quiet, beautiful beaches and great to get away from the busyness of life. Sadly we didn't have time to try the swimming pool, a reason to go back!

reviews.title: Great find
reviews.text: Loved this place. Lovely rooms, good facilities, very friendly hosts and lovely breakfast. Well situated in quiet spot convenient for village an beach. Pool and sauna were a great plus and were not expensive to use.

reviews.title: Great Hosts
reviews.text: We had a very enjoyable stay at Olde Hall B&B. Hazel and Dave were very attentive with a eye for the extra details you don't find in most B&B's. We felt nothing was too much trouble. The breakfast was one of the best we have ever had with lots of lovely extras. When we are back in the area we would stay again thanks guys :-) :-)

reviews.title: Pleasant overnight stay
reviews.text: The check in was fine after a text conversation with the helpful (owner?) Hazel a few days before hand. Hazel also offered advice on a walk we were doing in the area which was nice of her. The Holkham room we stayed in was en-suite and very clean and with a very comfortable bed. The room had tea and coffee and biscuits which we enjoyed and there was also a bottle opener which came in handy! The shower wasn't very powerful though. There is a nice fish and chip about a 5 minute walk away in Bacton which is obviously popular as it was queuing out the door on the Saturday night! The breakfast was decent on the Sunday morning.

reviews.title: !!!...I Tried to Find a Fault...!!!
reviews.text: After reading all the Good Stuff about this B&B, I looked for something to complain about...!!! Dammit, I couldn't find a thing... This B&B and the proprietors has to be just about the best that I have ever stayed at. David and Hazels extremely warm welcome was excelant, the bed rooms and dining area were 100% spotless. Attention to detail in everything they did was way above what any normal person would expect. Help and advice was available at all times and the Swimming Pool, was wonderful. Finally:- The Food, This could "Not be Bettered" ( and I'm Fussy )... My Wife and I would put This B&B at the top of "Any" list and can not recomend it highley enough. PS:- The free wi-fi was mega fast...

reviews.title: Only just OK!
reviews.text: Started at the Olde hall for four nights. Booked room only so this review is based solely on the room. At the time of booking we were advised that the bathroom is shared and that we were in the superior room. As we were intending to be out all day this didn't bother us. However a few things niggled me about the room. Firstly there was no dressing table despite there being ample room. This really caused me some hassle in the mornings getting ready and sadly caused me to leave a make up stain on the duvet which remained for the entire duration of our stay. All the furniture was very low down I joked it was like dolls house furniture and didn't really fit the theme of the room as it was very modern. The headboard was extremely annoying and we had to jam a cushion behind it every night because each time you turned over it banged against the wall. The lampshades were held on with sellotape. Just a bit shoddy! The bathroom is a little grotty I'm afraid. It really could do with some updating however it was clean and serviceable. The house itself is beautiful and in a lovely area. The beach at Bacton is just gorgeous. Never saw the owners so can't comment on hospitality however the lady who met us on the day we checked in was lovely.

reviews.title: Fabulous stay
reviews.text: We stayed at Olde Hall for a long weekend. Absolutely loved the setting, the beach is very close. Clean rooms with smart TVs if it's raining. We paid a little extra to hire the pool for an hour which was nice too.

reviews.title: Friendly
reviews.text: A very pleasant stay excellent breakfast only issue was the sauna was broken whilst we were there but the pool was very good. The owners were very friendly and offered great advice about places to visit .

reviews.title: Not recommended at all. May be ok in summer
reviews.text: Cold, no central heating anywhere in the house. -5 degrees outside. No breakfast available although I contacted the owner day before arrival and being advertised as a bed and breakfast. In fairness the room was of good quality. But let myself into the house and out on instructions from owner over the phone. Never saw anyone except the cats. Sorry not the way to run a business!

reviews.title: Highly recommended
reviews.text: Really can recommend this lovely B and B. Beautiful rooms in lovely house. The indoor pool is great and heated 33degrees. The owners are a lovely friendly couple. Bacton is a pretty village with shop and very good cafe close to B and B. And beach very near by. We had twice already friends/relative booked in and they really enjoyed the stay. We are going regular to the olde hall indoor pool what can be hired per hour. There is also a sauna and lovely shower and bathroom.

reviews.title: An Excellent Choice
reviews.text: Excellent service, great value and location. I worked at the Bacton gas terminal so olde hall was very convenient for me. Free parking and fast WiFi. Room was decent, modern and clean. Breakfast was very well cooked and it had onsite swimming pool which was a nice bonus. I was able to arrive outside check in hours with no trouble. Nice place

reviews.title: Excellent Stay
reviews.text: I recently stayed at the Olde Hall B&B with my sister. The hotel, room and bathroom were really lovely, very clean and beautifully decorated. Hazel and Dave were really welcoming and helpful, happy to tell us about the local area and recommended places for us to go. Would definitely stay again and recommend to others looking for a pleasent and relaxing stay.

reviews.title: Relaxing break
reviews.text: Very comfortable stay. Only disappointment really was lack of breakfast due to kitchen refurb as the food had looked great on the website. We were fully refunded for this however. David was very friendly and helpful and when he heard it was our anniversary, we came home from a meal out to a bottle of Prosecco on ice and some chocs which was a lovely gesture, thanks.

reviews.title: Perfection
reviews.text: Just returned from a weekend at Olde Hall B&B and couldn't be more impressed. Our hosts went above and beyond all expectations, very attentive without being overbearing. Competitively priced, yet the standard of care and attention is what you might expect for a much higher priced venue. The room was immaculate, as was the rest of the property. Well stocked with tea/coffee making facilities, the bed is by far the most comfortable we have had the pleasure to sleep in. Breakfast was amazing, with lots of choice and the attention to detail was fabulous. After spending the day shopping, we returned to find the bottle of wine we had brought with us, was chilling in an ice bucket and some snacks had been provided. Although we did not partake ourselves, there is also an indoor pool. A very pleasant stay, one we would highly recommend. (Oh and the cats are adorable too) Thank you for a lovely weekend

reviews.title: Birthday Treat
reviews.text: My Boyfriend and I Stayed here the weekend just gone for his birthday. Our room and bathroom (shared) were clean, fresh and tastefully decorated. Hazel and Dave were welcoming and were very generous for us to use the pool for an hour free of charge for my boyfriends birthday as we didn't realise we had only book a room without breakfast and use of the pool. We were also left to find cupcakes with a' happy birthday' message in our room after returning from an evening stroll , was a nice surprise. we would definitely stay again, thank you for a relaxed and pleasant stay. (Next time we'll be sure to book breakfast)

reviews.title: Great Bed & Breakfast
reviews.text: Warm and friendly atmosphere , great location , very clean and tidy and the bed was comfortable . The breakfast was superb and plentiful and the staff were friendly and attentive could not fault anything during my stay. As the title says Great B&B

reviews.title: Excellent B&B
reviews.text: For discovering the coast this is a perfect b&b in a lovely location. Proprietors were very helpful in giving tips on places to visit and eat locally. Breakfast was delicious with a lot of variety and will cater to your tastes. Will definitely stay again.

reviews.title: All you need
reviews.text: The owners are very friendly and keen to help. The room has good quality decor and the bed was comfortable. In terms of quantity and quality the breakfast is all you need and more. For a business trip I found the free wi-fi of good quality. I will look to use this place again

reviews.title: Only visited the pool
reviews.text: We didn't stay at the B&B but instead hired the adjoining private pool for a little pool party action. You book online and then pay at the venue. There is a changing area and shower as well as a separate toilet just for the use of the pool. The water was lovely, very warm and there is a small patio outside and a couple of loungers at the top end of the pool. The facilities were very clean. Left to our own devises and spent a completely undisturbed couple of hours. We took our own giant floaties as well as snorkels and had lots of fun. My only criticism would be the lack of a hand hold to get down the steps into the pool, not an essential for most but a nice to have when you are stepping into water and are unsure of how deep/wide the steps might be.

reviews.title: Excellent Bed and Breakfast
reviews.text: This bed and breakfast is excellent for value for money. Our room was lovely and so much nicer and better equipped than some more expensive places I have stayed in. The hosts were very welcoming and looked after all our needs. Breakfast was fantastic! Great location for going to see the seals at Horsey Gap. If you are in this area I would definitely recommend you stay at the Olde Hall Bed and Breakfast.

reviews.title: Odd indeed
reviews.text: A previous review describes Olde Hall as “odd” and I completely agree. Accommodation was ok. It was clean and the location for exploring the area is excellent. The B&B had no atmosphere and we felt awkward staying there. Breakfast was unusual as you all sit around a large table together. We were lucky as the other guests were extremely nice to talk to. But not ideal talking to complete strangers over breakfast. The whole experience was strange and very odd.

reviews.title: Highly recommended
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed here for two nights over the May Bank holiday weekend. We were very pleased with our room, beautiful decorated and with an ensuite. Lovely robes and slippers provided. ( The only room with an ensuite so we were very happy with this.) Hazel and David were very welcoming and attentive and especially helpful with booking restaurants on this busy weekend, we would have been driving around all night without their help! They phoned and booked for us and we had two very enjoyable meals. The swimming pool is very nice and as B and B guests you get an hour free. It was very and warm and relaxing after our 10 mile walk along the beaches. The breakfasts were great, a good choice of cooked dishes including eggs Benedict, and a choice of cereals, very nice fresh mixed fruit and continental choices if you wish. A lovely good value place for a weekend away. Lots of walks, beaches and the Broads within easy reach. Being extremely picky? A bigger bath towel please!!

reviews.title: don't forget the dog !
reviews.text: stayed for a couple of nights and found the experience excellent. The host ( Hazel ) is a million dollars - she really cares about her business and does all in her power to make your stay enjoyable. Extensive menu for breakfast, and all is prepared with skill. We all sat around one large table which encouraged conversation and drinking too much coffee - absolutely great. My room had a shared bathroom, but with only one other room, so it didn't cause a problem. Electronic outside entrance door was a great idea - so you could come and go without formality at any time. Comfortable bed and a modern clear telly in my room - what more could you want - I think there was drink making facilities, but my memory is not great as you will realise when I tell you that I drove away on the last day without my dog. I went back the following day to collect him and he had been well looked after and had come to no harm. I guess I should tell you that the dogs name is Mutley and he is my alarm clock !! All in all, if you want a friendly reasonably priced B&B - go for it. kindest regards Andy

reviews.title: Very Impressed
reviews.text: We were impressed with this B&B, we stayed whilst visiting family in Cromer. Lovely clean room, well stocked with tea, coffee and biscuits. Onsite Pool was a nice bonus it was warm and clean. Good choice of breakfast and was excellent. We went to the local pub the poachers for a meal which was also good and nice atmosphere. Visited the seals pups in Horsey we would recommend ! We shall return soon we had a lovely time.

reviews.title: bright, clean and friendly
reviews.text: My visit to The Olde Hall Bed and Breakfast, was very pleasant, the greeting was very warm and friendly, my room was very clean, bright and bed was nice and comfy, the extra bits, from a nice radio, coffee pot plus kettle and TV. I had a good nights sleep followed by a nice well set out breakfast. and all for a very good price, well worth the money. The only problem all though only minor, was the post code told me it was on the right and not the left, also a little further down so took a few minuets to find, However look for a tall flag pole complete with a flag right hand side, opposite the bed and breakfast / hotel entrance and you are there. I will be happy to stay there again.

reviews.title: glad we went
reviews.text: Last minute booking , decided to vist family in cromer .cromer was booked up so found olde hall bacton which was easy drive to cromer .a good base to explore also drove to wroxham .we had a room which shared a shower and toilet. Which was clean and no problem .hazel made us welcome .bed turned down at night and yummy chocs on pillow .breakfast was very nice .fruit and cerals topping all very luxurious. For the price we paid was surprised at the quality of every thing .hazel and freind your doing a great job .welldone .if there was one little niggle it would be to move the light in room so its over the bed .tall people bang there heads .

reviews.title: Wall-to-wall quality
reviews.text: We booked 3 rooms at this property for 1 night. I will start off by saying that we are far more used to hotels than B&B accommodation but this stay was perfect! We probably wondered around more than most guests due to having multiple rooms booked but were made to feel entirely welcome. We booked room-only so cannot comment on food or the pool, however the feel and décor of the accommodation was nothing but comfort and quality so cannot assume any difference here. The feel is a perfect mix between traditional and modern, which only gets better on closer inspection, the wood is real, the sheets thick, and the owners friendly (but not overbearing). One room has a en suite and the others share bathrooms but this is not a problem at all. There are two of the most friendly cats in the world at this property, so keep in mind if allergic, however they are discouraged from entering guest rooms. Rooms all have individual heating, tea/coffee making facilities and a smart TV. If you are visiting the area for a quieter getaway or a base to visit friends/family, look no further, genuinely!!

reviews.title: Norfolk Hidden Gem!
reviews.text: Really enjoyed staying here. Everything was clean and tidy. The manager was amazing. Made sure we had everything we needed. Was very attentive. How anyone can complain about staying here is beyond me!! Will definitely be booking again. Breakfast was perfect Relaxed and friendly atmosphere. Good night's sleep added bonus was the cats!

reviews.title: Fantastic...
reviews.text: If, God forbid, I had to leave home this is the place I'd like to live. The hosts are great, the food fantastic, the facilities excellent, it's so comfortable, and, when the weather is nice, Bacton, the beach and North Norfolk are pretty good as well.

reviews.title: Consistently good service
reviews.text: When visiting family in the area this is our preferred B and B. The staff are lovely and attentive and the food is to die for! Rooms are also of perfect size and offer great value! We are yet to have any negatives and have stayed here a number of times Thanks to the staff at Olde hall for consistently providing a top tier service

reviews.title: Nice place to stay
reviews.text: Very nice place to stay. Walking distance to the beach. The owner was accommodating to our needs. Breakfast was very good. We stayed one night down stairs which had a private bathroom and the next night upstairs which had a shared bathroom. Everything was clean and quiet.

reviews.title: a very nice stay - will stay longer next time!
reviews.text: my wife & i wanted a quiet night away and we were not let down. Made to feel very welcome from start to finish. We had a lovely meal at a near by pub and enjoyed seeing the lighthouse and the unspoilt beach nearby.

reviews.title: Odd place
reviews.text: Me and my wife were visiting friends in Bacton and needed a B&B for 1 night, after reading reviews on T/A thought this would be a good choice, Booked an en-suite room £85, 1st impression on arrival was good and the Olde Hall is a nice character building, plenty of space to park, being the only guests staying that day helped not sure how it would work in peak season. As we found out the owner of the property was away so her mother was left in charge, The greet at the door was ok, other reviews have said they were asked to remove their shoes on entering something I would of refused to do, the runner in the hallway was covered in cat hairs and cat hairs were evident throughout. Our room was on the ground floor and on entering we was hit with an awful damp smell, we hadn’t even uttered a word and was told don’t worry it’s the old furniture that smells, it was damp ! Also the room was stone cold, with temps outside of -2 not ideal, The ensuite was shocking, poorly lit and had a noisy fan that came on with the light, also lots of cracked tiles, poor shower and a very old dirty white enclosure, shoddy workmanship all round, old soap had been left in the shower also the towels had blood stains on them and when we asked for them to be changed was told they were rust marks. Breakfast served in the main room was just ok, I had the full English, presented well but cheap sausages and a rubbery egg and cold toast, my wife had poached eggs on toast which was actually just 1 poached egg on 1 slice of toast served on a saucer. Would we stay at the Olde Hall again NO !

reviews.title: Superb!!!
reviews.text: Me and my boyfriend stayed here for 2 nights the weekend just gone. Dave and Hazel were absolutely brilliant, we had everything we wanted and needed. A lot of attention to detail which was very nice. Service was good, room was to very high standard. Breakfast was amazing, espescially the eggs benedict :) and there was a lot to choose from too. Private heated pool was a lovely treat as well, a really relaxing way to spend the evening. 10/10 for this B&B, we will definately be coming back some time this year again.

reviews.title: Excellent Place
reviews.text: We had a lovely stay with Hazel. Place is beautiful and set in a very charming part of Bacton, roughly half a mile away from beach. Our bedroom was very spacious with everything you could possibly need and the breakfast delicious. All at very competitive price - would strongly recommend!

reviews.title: Excellent,quiet B&B
reviews.text: We had a very pleasant, 3-night stay at The Olde Hall. The room was very comfortable and clean. The weather was cold for April but room temperature could be controlled easily via thermostatted radiator. We found the feather duvet very hot on the first night and this was changed to a sheet and light blanket when we told the lady who looks after the place the next morning. Breakfast was very good and plentiful. We were the only guests but did not use the lounge as the seats were very low and not suitable for older guests. We had TV and Wi-Fi in the bedroom so this didn't inconvenience us. My husband used the pool on two occasions and thought this was a great facility to have in a B&B! Bacton is a very convenient place to stay for getting around north Norfolk and I would recommend this B&B very highly. We would definitely return.

reviews.title: Good but...
reviews.text: The B&B is very good not too far from the beach in a very quite place, the people who are running it are very welcoming, helpful and caring, the heated swimming pool was a bonus, the room and bathroom were clean with all you need, and because this was a trip for a birthday they put a bottle of wine in the room and a card as part of a complementary gift from them. They also added a free hour of use of the swimming pool. The only pity were the mattresses which were at the end of their life, so whether you have a back problem or not, make sure that they have managed to buy a new one as they were planning to do after we highlighted the problem. They were very helpful in fact they swapped the mattress with another from a different room but unfortunately it didn't resolve the issue. They tried to call us the first day of our stay to offer to change the booking so that we had the option to not stay for the second night, but they didn't leave any message on the answering machine so we thought it was just to let us know about the change of the mattress. We learned Sunday morning about the offer. We had a long chat about mattresses and they were going to look into buying new one so we are confident that is going to happen.

reviews.title: Pool hire
reviews.text: We booked to Hire the pool for a hour in October so we could take our 2 1/2 year old plus our 4 week old newborn, I booked the pool online and gave my card details and was told to pay by cash otherwise my card would be debited, which I knew as we had hired the pool many times as we live in Paston which is around 4 miles away. I had to phone the owners on the Sunday to inform them that we would be unable to make the Monday swim as my wife was rushed to hospital on the Saturday having not long given birth. I didn’t think anything more about it as my concern was my wife and me looking after our two children. After checking my bank a few days later I was surprised that my account was debited with the cost of the pool hire, I phoned and spoke to the owner and was informed I had to give 48hrs notice I did say to the owner you wasn’t on my mind the day my wife was rushed into hospital, she informed me we are a small business so we have to charge, I said thanks very much we would not use you again, we are a small business too and have local people who use us, perhaps the compassion on some business does not exist any more. Will never use again

reviews.title: Andy & Jim
reviews.text: Fantastic stay. Came down for the weekend with my dad, we loved it and would definitely recommend, clean and comfortable. Dave and Hazel could not have done more. P.s. The take away fruit salads were the cherry on the top, excuse the pun CHEERS DAVE !!!!

reviews.title: Business b+b stay!
reviews.text: Exellent place to stay! Dave and Hazel (owners) were very friendly and there to help out! Great to be able to have use of the pool and sauna. Exellent breakfast, more than enough choice and food! Will hopefully be back again soon.

reviews.title: Gorgeous Place And Lovely Hosts
reviews.text: A truly superb, modern, and well kept B&B with tasteful chic rooms, that provide everything you could need for your stay. Not to mention great hosts who can't do enough for you. The pool is warm and relaxing, a real taste of luxury. Everything you need for some r&r at the beautiful Norfolk Coast.

reviews.title: Lovely place to stay
reviews.text: We stayed for a week at Olde Hall. The owner went above and beyond to be helpful she was a wonderful host. We felt so welcome it was like staying with friends. We had the small double room upstairs at the back of the hall with a shared bathroom. The room has views over the fields and was very quiet. Furnishings were clean and modern. There was a wide selection of cooked breakfasts on offer and I think we managed to try each one between us! We can safely say they are all delicious with generous helpings! There is also a private pool attached to the house which can be hired out an hour at a time and really sets this apart from other places to stay in the area. There is a lovely pub and beach about 15-20mins stroll away and plenty of places to visit further afield such as Blakeney point for the seals, Cromer and Mundsley for characterful seaside villages. All in all we would thoroughly recommend Olde Hall as a place to stay.

reviews.title: Fantastic retreat
reviews.text: Olde Hall is very well situated, just a short walk to a lovely beach. The breakfast was super and kept me going all day, the rooms are excellent quality, simply the best B&B I have stayed in. Tip, book direct with the owner.

reviews.title: Lovely Norfolk B&B
reviews.text: My husband booked us into Olde Hall B&B for the August Bank Holiday weekend to use as a base whilst we explored a bit of North Norfolk. We had a few issues finding the B&B in the dark, but the owner was more than helpful on the phone turning on as many lights as possible & heading outside to find us! Once in we had a lovely room, beautifully presented, & well suited to our needs. On our first morning we had breakfast at the cafe across the road which the owners had arranged due to a previous commitment, & our second morning we enjoyed the full hospitality of Olde Hall which we couldn't fault. We very much enjoyed out short weekend stay & would definitely recommend, thank you.

reviews.title: Short break
reviews.text: A very quiet and stylish house the room and facilities were top class, the standard of service was excellent, the food (full English) was delicious and the amount and range was very good. I have read that others found the room to be cold, in our case we found the opposite until we realised how to operate the digital radiator thermostat. All in all I am happy to recommend.

reviews.title: A little gem in Norfolk!
reviews.text: Had a wonderful one night stay at the Olde Hall in Bacton, Norfolk. The bedroom was lovely and clean, bed was so, so comfortable, one of the best nights sleep ever!! Breakfast was fantastic, superb selection, and cooked to perfection. If you are ever in this area and are looking for somewhere to stay, come and try the Olde Hall, you will not be disappointed.

reviews.title: Fabulous B & B
reviews.text: My partner and I have just returned home from a lovely stay here. The facilities were top notch, the room was very clean and had everything we needed to make our stay comfortable. Our hosts were fantastic and our stay was made even more special by the small extras such as chocolates on our pillow after a night out for dinner and ironing my partner's shirt before we left. We would recommend this place to anyone staying in the local area and hope to return soon.

reviews.title: Recent visit to Olde Hall B & B
reviews.text: Easy to find, clean, great breakfast & very friendly hosts. Highly recommended. It was ideal for our 2 night stay. Only downside was creaking floorboards above us early in the mornings (old building)?

reviews.title: Perfect stay
reviews.text: Perfect location as a luxurious base for visiting the coast of Norfolk , our room was beautifully decorated we stayed 2 nights whilst we attended a friends wedding . As previously mentioned the little extras such as amazingly comfortable bedding and snuggly towels make all the difference . Hazel and Dave have created splendid welcoming place to stay for a weekend treat away . We will definitely be recommending to family and friends

reviews.title: Great week-end
reviews.text: Our daughter and son-in-law had bought us a week-end here as present for being 'parents of the bride'. We stayed at the beginning of October. The room was lovely and comfortable. As we were the only guests the owners had booked a day away on Saturday so couldn't do breakfast but more than made up for it on Sunday !! It was great to be able to have a swim before breakfast in the private pool. Even the kitten managing to sneak into our room provided a laugh- and we don't really do cats! Being able to discuss running was a bonus. Would highly recommend this as a base for exploring North Norfolk.

reviews.title: Lovely place to visit and relax
reviews.text: Me and my girlfriend visited here for a bit of peace and quiet. The owners are very friendly and the facilities are superb. Having a swimming pool attached to the B and B is a super bonus. We will definetly be coming back soon. The accommodation is very clean and tidy. The atmosphere is friendly and sociable. The area is very good for people looking for a peaceful break away.

reviews.title: Lovely weekend away
reviews.text: Lovely guest house in a lovely setting in North Norfolk. Check-in was easily done via calls/texts from the very helpful owner, Hazel. The room (Holkham) was well kitted-out and served us well. Breakfast was amazing and our thanks to Yvonne & Jane for sorting this. Thoroughly recommend this place! Will definitely go back.

reviews.title: FAB-U-LOUS !!!
reviews.text: This B & B is just something so amazing ...that you just have to go there to find a service that you won't find in the best hotels......rooms so well appointed and everything you could wish for....Dave and Hazel the owners are so obliging and helpful and ensure that your every need is catered for !! The use of the swimming pool is just the icing on the cake....beautifully warm and relaxing !!.....will certainly return !!

reviews.title: A wonderful stay at Olde Hall Bacton
reviews.text: Nice room , lovely décor, cosy room, great breakfast I stayed in the Blakeney room for a week whilst working locally, good price for decent accommodation. I will stay here next time I’m in the area. I used the pool once was nice to relax after a long day at work water was lovely and warm. Highly recommend staying if you working in the area.

reviews.title: Lovely, friendly B&B
reviews.text: Bacton is a delightful village on the North Norfolk coast - quiet and unspoilt. One of Norfolk's best kept secrets. We stayed for 2 nights at Olde Hall, which were very enjoyable. Olde Hall is in a really nice location sitting just in front of the village recreation ground, and a 5 - 10 minute walk to the beach. Our room was clean and comfortable. Quite small, but large enough to be comfortable. Some of the rooms are not en-suite, and generally we only book en-suite ourselves, but there wasn't one available for when we booked. However, the bathroom (shared with one other room) was almost adjacent and perfectly nice, with a decent shower etc., so really wasn't an issue to us. There is also a private pool which is available for use - a nice touch. We didn't use, but really nice to know it is there. Hazel was very welcoming, the atmosphere relaxed, so we felt totally at ease. Breakfast was lovely, good quality ingredients, with a varied choice of options. Ever predictable, I chose a traditional English. Breakfast itself is flexible insofar as time, being asked what time we would like which was really nice. To summarise, a great little B&B, and definitely one to consider if you are looking to stay in the area. I'm sure you won't be disappointed!

reviews.title: Swimming pool review
reviews.text: Hey ya just thought I’d give my review. Me and gf came for our first time at 11am. And was amazing swim. Temperature was lovely and warm. We kept door open a bit so have a cool breeze too. All in all 10/10. I Need to find a group of friends to do handstands with. We will be back very soon 🙂 Matt.

reviews.title: VERY QUAINT & VERY PLEASANT
reviews.text: We booked the room online & was responded to very promptly & politey by Hazel the owner who provided key code & our room location which was the ' Holt ' room upstairs. We didn't mind taking our shoes off as it maintained the floor cleanliness. We gave her our ETA of between 5-5.30. we were informed that no one would be there to greet us after 5.30. We arrived at approx 5.20. Why they left early & couldn't wait a few minutes is beyond me . Would have been nice to be greeted but it didn't bother us. It was a lovely beautifully modern furnished place with authentic wooden floors & beams & very clean. Same goes for our room which was quite small but nicely decorated & cosey with everything we needed except bath robes ( which were supposed to be provided ) We Shared a bathroom on upstairs landing which was nicely done & clean. It was no bother. The large Breakfast table was immaculately set out with everything you needed. The Full English with toast & butter was lovely with no excess fat or grease (like you get at many B&Be) & the pancakes with yogurt & banana were exceptional. Best I've ever had. Food presentation top notch. Very creaky staircase even on tip toes so always conscious of disturbing other guests. It's nice having character but noise is noise. A couple arrived late in the night & made a right racket! We wanted to stay an extra night which was all sorted by text. Hazel was very helpful & we paid her the difference at breakfast next morning. She was also helpful with recommending places to visit & eat. We had a lovely home cooked evening meal overlookong the sea at the Poachers Pocket pub only a pleasant 15 minute walk up the road. Overall, we had a very pleasant stay, slept well in a comfy bed had a lovely filling breakfast & we would definitely return again. So thumbs up ☺👍

reviews.title: Fantastic Accommodation & Hosts
reviews.text: Karel & David are lovely hosts, welcoming you to their immaculate b&b. The accomodation is spotless with every extra you could think of provided. Karel kindly booked Water Taxis on the Able Tasman for us and recommended great restaurants to eat. Cumbria House is in a tranquil street, only a short walk from the center of Nelson making it the perfect location. Thankyou for making us feel so welcome .

reviews.title: Highest Quality Accommodation, close to Town Centre
reviews.text: Cambrian House, run by Carol and David, is a small quality B&B that delivers a relaxing and restful stay close to the centre of Nelson. Lovely rooms with all the facilities and warm, friendly service - nicely low key - from the owners. Beautifully prepared and served breakfast in a splendid dining room of a house that reflects the turn of the 19th century with lots of interesting pictures and artefacts. Close to the centre and good restaurants (mostly at the Cathedral end of Trafalgar Street. You will not find bustling nightlife in Nelson, and it is all the better for that. Visit the iSite for really great advice and also check out with Carol and David before any trips as they have excellent knowledge of the local area. Loved our 2 night stay and thanks for both our hosts for making it so enjoyable.

reviews.title: this is a real find
reviews.text: we stayed only 1 night but it left a mark Karel was very pleasant and the house is bueatifully presented our room was well appointed and spacious and the bed very comfortable would recommend any traveller to stay here breakfast in the main dinning room was great

reviews.title: Delightful Hosts
reviews.text: Karel and David are very genial hosts and most helpful. We really enjoyed our stay here - large comfortable rooms, plenty of info, wi-fi, reasonably close to town centre, easy parking. Nice outside sitting area at the back - just right for aperatifs. Laundry service was an added bonus. Just two downsides for us: lack of hot water one day - soon rectified; and eggs at breakfast tended to be a tad overcooked. Recommended.

reviews.title: Super stay - again!
reviews.text: This is the second time I have stayed at Cambria House and I would happily return again and again. Karel and David are wonderful hosts. They are friendly and helpful without being intrusive and their rooms are large and comfortable. The simple but high quality breakfast is taken round the big table in the dining room giving you the opportunity to speak to other visitors. There's an outside space and indoor lounge for guests use and easy parking out the front for those with a car. Wifi is free and it's an easy, flat 10 minute walk to shops and restaurants. Look no further for B&B accommodation in Nelson-- unless Cambria House is fully booked!

reviews.title: Lovely home, lovely hosts!
reviews.text: This B&B has so much charm and character! I was travelling by myself and stayed in the Rata room at the front of the house with the bay window. The picture on the website doesn't do the room justice! The old fireplace with original slate mantle and the built in woodwork is beautiful. It is well decorated to give it the old heritage charm; yet, the bathroom is modern. The bathoom is not large, but it was fine for me. Karel was very helpful. Her recommendations for things to do were exactly what I was looking for! The B&B is conveniently located to the city centre...easy walking distance. I had a wonderful time and I hope to return one day.

reviews.title: Highly recommended
reviews.text: We booked Cambria House when we were back home in the uk and it was the best one hour spent looking for accommodation in Nelson. The accommodation is of the highest standard, the rooms are spacious and well appointed and Kareland David were great hosts. Karel was also able to help plan our two days there and book the trips which was very helpful. Thoroughly enjoyed Nelson and if you are there on a Saturday try the market. They even had Morris dancers.

reviews.title: Very Nice!
reviews.text: We stayed here for 2 nights, and received a free upgrade to a beautiful and comfortable room. Unfortunately for us we were out on trips all the time, so did not get time to enjoy the rooms & garden sufficiently, which was a real shame. Karen was really kind and offered to cook for us at 5:40am so that we could get to the airport. I call that above & beyond the call of duty - and breakfast was lovely -Thank you so much Karen. :-).

reviews.title: Nice B&B
reviews.text: Nice B&B in a Victorian house, but with modern and clean bathrooms with underfloor heating so we were pleased about that. Breakfast was lovely and the house is a 10-15min walk from the town centre which has many nice restaurants and bike rental facilities (we used Bike Barn). It's about an hour's drive from Kaiteriteri where most Abel Tasman activities start.

reviews.title: An excellent choice!
reviews.text: This is an excellent and reasonably priced B&B, only 5 to 10 minutes walk from Nelson city centre. Karel and David are very helpful and welcoming. Indeed Karel was a great help in arranging an appointment for my wife at a local hairdresses. Our room had a large King-size bed with all the makings for tea and coffee. Biscuits for our early morning cuppa were available in the breakfast room. Wi-fi is available for those with their own computer but there is also a PC available for guest use. A full cooked breakfast is provided, as well as all the necessaries for a continental breakfast and all made from local produce. The house is a lovely weatherboard one and I particularly liked the kauri doors and window frames. I would recommend Cambria House to anyone

reviews.title: Helpful hosts, good accommodation but slightly pricey
reviews.text: We stayed two nightsat this B&B, located about 15 minutes walk from Nelson centre. Hosts were friendly and provided lots of advice about places to eat and visit and routes to take. They also booked a boat trip at Abel Tasman for us. Breakfasts were suberb, amongst the best we had in New Zealand. Room was large and comfortable, but not long off needing some refurbishment. A computer was available for guests to access internet at no cost. Tea and coffee making facilities were provided in the room and in guest lounge. Cost seemed slightly high compared to other B&Bs we stayed at in New Zealand, nevertheless would still recommend Cambria House.

reviews.title: Luxury B & B gem in Nelson
reviews.text: We were two couples booked into Cambria House B & B for 3 nights. We were welcomed by Karel, who along with her husband David, run this very excellent establishment. Each room is en-suite with a large bedroom. All are well decorated, and impeccably clean. For breakfast, there is…

reviews.title: Wonderful Stay for a Last Minute Traveler
reviews.text: I was in a bit of a bind needing a room very last minute. The owners were wonderfully accommodating, answering my phone call at 10pm and giving me the internet advertised rate (from expedia.com). The room and bathroom were HUGE, I only wish I had more time to enjoy them! In addition to a huge glass shower, there was a separate stand-alone bathtub! I knew from my booking that breakfast was included, but didn't realize the selection would be so vast. I was able to choose salmon, scrambled eggs + veggies in addition to the coffee, fresh cereal, toast + jam. The owners also stored my bag for the day, as my flight wasn't until 7pm & called me a cab when I needed to get to the airport. My only regret was not checking in earlier. The owners were a delight and I would definitely recommend Cambria House if you are looking for a quaint B+B in Nelson.

reviews.title: Great B&B
reviews.text: We had a lovely couple of nights staying at Cambria House. The rooms and beds are very comfortable and the breakfasts are lovely. Karel and David are perfect hosts and gave us lots of useful information regarding places to see and eat in Nelson. Cambria House is in a small quiet street about 10 minutes walk from the centre of town. It's ideally situated for exploring Nelosn and has plenty of off street parking. We'd definitely return here if we get back to New Zealand.

reviews.title: Excellent choice for Nelson
reviews.text: My partner and I were a little apprehensive having not stayed at a B&B before but this all changed when we arrived at beautiful Cambria House. We were in town for a wedding and the hosts were extremely accommodating, with tips on what to see in our short stay and ordering us a cab on the day of the wedding. The location is great, an easy 10 minute walk to the centre of town with a big selection of shops and cafes. The room itself was one of the best we have stayed, with a very comfortable bed and heated floors in the bathroom. Eating breakfast with other guests is not something I've done before but was great for picking up travelling tips. A highlight of New Zealand by far, would recommend Cambria House to anyone!

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: This is a really lovely B and B. the room we had was lovely, with some nice personal touches. Great bathroom too. There was also a lovely yard to sit in which was great after a day of sight seeing. Owners were very welcoming and helpful too in guiding us to things to do in Nelson. Brill breakfast. Highly recommend a visit

reviews.title: Lovely bed and breakfast in Nelson, NZ
reviews.text: We so enjoyed our 2-night stay at Cambria House in Nelson. The location was perfect for walking into town and taking the shopping, restaurants, gardens and even a hike to the center of New Zealand. The cottage setting was surrounded by flowers, so cozy and comfortable. Carol gave us special attention with delicious home-cooked breakfasts before we left early for our tour of Abel Tasman National Park.

reviews.title: Loverly B&B and right in town
reviews.text: Great property and lovely hosts. Rooms were immaculate and had everything we needed. The property in right in town and the hosts are there and willing to help with anything. Breakfast was substantial and a great start to the day. Would certainly stay again

reviews.title: So comfortable
reviews.text: The room and bathroom were of a very high standard with lots of lovely features in the bathroom - underfloor heating, stand alone bath, large shower etc. Some nice touches in the bedroom too including complimentary Port. Breakfast was wonderful with a good selection of quality produce beautifully presented.

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: We really loved it here, the breakfasts were excellent. Our one criticism would be that for a four night stay our room was very small. The laundry service was brilliant and the owners were super and extremely helpful with giving us ideas of where we could visit.

reviews.title: Better than hotels
reviews.text: We discovered on our trip to New Zealand that boutique B&B's can often be nicer places to stay than larger hotels and Cambria House falls into this category. Karel and David are excellent welcoming hosts and and,in addition to their hospitality, can provide lots of helpful and interesting information on the Nelson area. The B&B is situated in a quiet street a short distance from the town centre and with easy access from Highway 6. Nelson is also a good place to be based for the beaches around Kaiteriteri and Abel Tasman National Park. Breakfast is taken around one large table in the dining room which made it interesting to meet and chat to other guests. The food was very good too!

reviews.title: Lovely B&B, Good Location for Exploring Area by Car
reviews.text: We stayed at the Cambria House for two nights in December. Our room was large and airy, with a large private bathroom. Our hosts were very, very accommodating, making calls and reservations for us, driving us into town in the evening. Karel makes a wonderful, custom breakfast, great for getting a start on the day. Since we were in Nelson largely for the sites outside of town, e.g. Abel Tasman National Park and local Wineries, it is an area best explored by car.

reviews.title: Excellent breakfast
reviews.text: We only stayed one night in Nelson during our tour of New Zealand and were very satisfied with Cambria House. It is a beautifully furnished house with a sitting room and outside deck area available to guests and off-road parking We had a comfortable bedroom with a modern en-suite shower. The owner (Carol) made us very welcome and gave us advice about the area and where to eat. Complimentary tea and coffee was available in the sitting room, along with a glass of sherry. There were also tea and coffee making facilities in our bedroom and complimentary chocolates. The highlight of our stay was the breakfast with a choice of cereals and several cooked options. I had the Marlborough smoked salmon and scrambled egg while my husband had a full cooked breakfast. Followed by toast and marmalade, it was just what we needed to set us up for another day on the road.

reviews.title: Nice place, helpful people
reviews.text: We came to stay one night before our big hike .... we were worried because we weren't sure how to get to the pickup place, what to expect, what we needed....This couple made sure that all of our needs were met by phoning the agency that was providing the hike...in fact, she was able to get them to come and pick us up. We were able to store our belongings at the B&B while we were gone...(We stayed there on our return). There home is lovely...Our room was small, but it was big enough for our needs...it was clean, had a T.V. private bathroom and internet. If you wanted sherry, it was complimentary....there were snacks, if you were hungry....I liked the home made cookies. We sat out in the garden, which was quiet, and beautiful.

reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our two nights at this old B&B. The friendly hosts really made us very welcome in their lovely home. The chocolates and sherry were an added bonus. David's extensive knowledge of the local and wider environment was of assistance to overseas visitors such as ourselves. Rosanne & John Munns Queensland Australia.

reviews.title: Clean, comfortable B&B
reviews.text: Cambria House was a clean and comfortable B&B that seemed more like a hotel than a B&B. It advertises itself as a "luxury" B&B which might be overstating things. It is a fine place to stay, but if I found myself in Nelson again, it wouldn't be my first choice.

reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text: Karel and David really do put the guest first: everything you could want is available; they are helpful with tour ideas and restaurants; breakfasts have great choice. I found nothing to complain about. A real oasis in the midst of quite ordinary service elsewhere.

reviews.title: Its website states 'Luxury' - maybe some years ago...
reviews.text: We stayed here for 3 nights. The website states that this is a luxury B&B. That may have been true many years ago and yet of all the B&B that we stayed at on this month long trip, it was the least level of luxury that we enjoyed. The room was relatively small, particularly for 3 nights, with very limited storage for clothes etc. The bathroom was tiny with very limited places to place the necessary bathing and shaving items. When looking closely the room had quite a lot of cobwebs and whilst generally clean, it was in need of a deeper clean, I suggest. The couple who run the business were very pleasant and helpful with information about the local area. The breakfast was OK and we had it early each day so that we could explore the area more. I would not recommend the location of Nelson for more than 1 or maximum 2 days as there is a limited choice in the area. The highlight was a boat trip and walk.

reviews.title: Lovely house, fantastic location and wonderful hosts
reviews.text: We stayed at Cambria house for 2 nights as part of our honeymoon trip around New Zealand. The house is beautiful and our room was very large with a comfy bed. The bathroom was fantastic with a free standing bath and seperate shower. Karel's breakfasts were very good and she happily accomodated our request for an early breakfast when we were travelling to Abel Tasman for the day. She was also very helpful in booking our Abel Tasman trip.

reviews.title: Really very comfortable with such wonderful hosts !!
reviews.text: We moved from another highly rated B&B in Nelson but it was no match for this one ! We had a superior room which was large, very comfortable with a gorgeous bathroom and very quiet. The hosts could not have been more friendly and helpful in all respects. A lovely couple with whom we felt immediately at home . Breakfasts were excellent and the house and courtyard had much character. The position too was convenient with a 10 minute stroll into Nelson centre. Highly recommended by us and certainly one of the best stays during our month in New Zealand !!

reviews.title: Wonderful B and B!
reviews.text: We had the good fortune to spend 3 nights in this beautiful old home that has approx 6 rooms with private baths. The owner is a wonderful and charming woman who goes out of her way to provide great service and comfort. The home is situated an easy walk from the Travalgar St shopping and dining district. Breakfasts were custom designed to our tastes, room and bed were comfortable, and the room size and bathroom were more than adequate. We felt at home in this wonderful facility!

reviews.title: great hospitality
reviews.text: We (4 adults) found Cambria House very comfortable and welcoming. Hosts had good knowledge of area and had time to chat. Rooms spacious and all mod cons provided. Lovely lounge to relax in with a plentiful supply of tea and biscuits. Breakfasts delicious with plenty of choice. Needed to drive to centre for restuarants but good choice. Thankyou for lovely stay

reviews.title: Well located and very comfortable B & B
reviews.text: We spent 3 nights at Cambria House, one of our longer stays during our tour of NZ. So glad, what a lovely place Nelson is. Our room was very spacious and had everything we needed. The breakfasts were good and set us up of the day ahead. Karel and David are pleasant and helpful hosts. As mentioned in a previous post, Cambria House is in a small quiet street about 10 minutes easy walk from the centre of town so great for finding somewhere to eat in the evening and ideally placed to explore the town and wider area.

reviews.title: Very good
reviews.text: Stayed one night en route to Abel Tasman and found our stay very satisfactory. We were given room 1 and sat outside the patio door for a pre dinner drink in dappled sunshine. Didn't have the complimentary sherry in our room as prefer beer and wine. Lovely bath although water pressure slow to fill it. Less than ten minute walk to the cathedral restaurant area and straight forward to navigate. Bed very comfortable and tea making facility good apart from needing to go to dining room fridge for the milk we forgot to get the previous evening. Breakfast good with tasty local smoked salmon. Plunger coffee was a bit weak for us but we do like strong coffee so should have asked accordingly. Parking was off road. Nice place to stay.

reviews.title: Hidden Gem
reviews.text: My third business trip to Nelson, there is no need to stay anyplace else. Such comfort and care. Pays to phone and book , unless you like paying higher internet prices. The rooms are so large, peaceful and the breakfast.......well that's a whole other story.

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: Absolutely lovely place to stay, small and comfortable, run by charming people. A very comfortable room, use of a large lounge and a beautiful small garden at the rear, and within easy walking distance of the town centre. The owner couldn't have been more welcoming and helpful, and does a great breakfast. Everything a good B & B should be, and such a nice contrast to a big hotel.

reviews.title: Great little find
reviews.text: Lovely small B&B run by the lovely Karen and David, made to feel very welcome and nothing was too much trouble. Very comfortable, great breakfasts, good recommendations for tours. Highly recommended.Would certainly go back if we were in Nelson again.

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: We were very happy with our 3 day stay at Cambria House in Nelson. The owners were very helpful with information on activities and travel. Dave had extensive knowledge on routes to travel. The food and guest room were terrific. Quite with a nice garden adjacent.

reviews.title: Terrific B&B in Nelson with a Lovely Proprietor
reviews.text: We just left Nelson after 3 nights at the wonderfully located Cambria House and the most accommodating proprietor Karol. We stayed there on the recommendation of our Australian travel agent who knows NZ inside out. We found the location perfect for our needs, just a short walk from everything, with delicious breakfast and roomy accommodations. Karol helped us in so many ways, providing early breakfasts at 6:45 AM before our early excursions and assisting us with directions and reservations. As an example of her extreme kindness, we had a problem with our pickup shuttle service this morning which might have caused us to miss the bus to Picton ferry, and Karol took it upon herself to call for a taxi and then must have paid for it as we were not responsible for the charge upon arrival. That is going far above and beyond and is service that one cannot value enough. It is a beautiful home where you feel like you are at home! Karol is so non-intrusive that we barely knew that she was around, and yet when you needed her she was right there. She lent us a bag for our Abel Tasman sea kayaking trip and a knapsack, our choice. She arranged for laundry service at a very reasonable price all done the same day. What else can I add, if not to say just go!

reviews.title: Unforgettable accommodation in Nelson from an English lady.
reviews.text: Karel was the perfect hostess. Warm and efficient, she looked after me admirably including, after seeing my walking stick, driving me to and from places in Nelson out of the kindness of her heart. Breakfast was superb. Homemade muesli and fresh fruit, scrambled egg and home smoked salmon washed down with fresh coffee and orange juice, eaten at a fine old mahogany table.The house is old and elegant and the garden beautiful, well sited on a quiet edge of the town easily walkable in minutes. Cambria House would delight the fussiest and most discerning traveller. I felt very fortunate to have found it.

reviews.title: Excellent hosts and accommodation
reviews.text: A delightful B&B where you are immediately made welcome by Karen and David. Enjoyable breakfasts and tea making and other facilities readily available. A short walk into town with a range of restaurants.

reviews.title: Excellent B & B with great hosts
reviews.text: A wonderful place for a relaxing time. Karel and David Wallace were gracious hosts with lots of information about the areas history as well as information about what to do and where to eat etc. Plenty of talk with the other guests over breakfast about yesterdays activities and todays plans. As for the breakfasts; they were excellent!

reviews.title: Great place to stay, excellent location
reviews.text: Cambria House is a home from home place to stay, really comfortable rooms with great extras such as free use of the computer with internet access. Karel was friendly and helped us to book our trip to the Abel Tasman National Park (about an hour away). Just 5 mins walk into Nelson.

reviews.title: Comfortable rooms homely
reviews.text: Cambria house was very nice and in a good position for walking in to Nelson. The breakfasts were very good and the owners were both friendly and knowledgeable about the area. Made a nice change from hotels.

reviews.title: Lovely people, lovely property
reviews.text: Room really nicely presented with ensuite. Very good cooked breakfast, excellent cookies! Karen & David were great hosts, always available and able to provide information about Nelson, directions, places of interest and the weather!
