Good location, about 10 mins walk into the centre of the town with the cathedral, really interesting regional museum, variety of bars, restaurants.

reviews.title: Excellent and warm B & B
reviews.text: I can only confirm the excellent reports others have given. We stayed two nights at Cambria House, situated in a quiet area. From the moment of our arrival Karel and David, a warm couple, took good care of us. We told her of our plans to go to Abel Tasman, and she got the tickets organised straightaway.The room was lovely, and had a nice patio and garden to sit in and have a cup of tea. The breakfast was delicious, and set us up for our trips. It is a nice walk to the centre. Karel gave some recommendations where to eat, there are plenty of good places. We ate at the Cafe Affair, which has the speciality of stone grille cooking, which you do yourself, fish or meat - great experience. We enjoyed it so much we went back the second night. There was a nice walk back via the park and the river. Our only regret is that it is so far from England, or we would regularly stay at Cambria House.

reviews.title: Perfect place to start.
reviews.text: We stayed at Cambria house for two nights at the very start of our two week tour of the South Island. We arrived late at night which would ordinarily be problematic at a guest house, however Karel and David were extremely accommodating. Not only were we warmly welcomed in the middle of the night, Karel also prepared breakfast (a delicious full English) early in the morning so that we could make the bus for our day trip. A wonderful place to stay, with a lovely room and extremely comfortable bed. Only a five minute walk into the centre of Nelson. I really recommend a stay at Cambria House.

reviews.title: What a lovely stay
reviews.text: Stayed here for two nights with my husband. The house, the food and the hosts Karel and David were lovely. They were very helpful with driving directions when the route we had planned to use was closed by cyclone Gita. All of the little extra touches made it a wonderful stay.

reviews.title: Classy B and B with excellent hosts
reviews.text: We stayed in this lovely boutique B And B for 3 nights during our Australia and New Zealand tour. the room we were allocated was comfortable and a good size with attractive furniture and a comfortable bed. It was off season and we were the only guests. It is located just a few minutes walk from the town centre but in a quiet residential street. Breakfast was excellent and served in an attractive dining room at a time of our choosing. Wifi was free and reliable. Our hosts were very helpful with local knowledge and advice. A guest lounge was available with a selection of books magazines and CDs although we in fact spent most of our time out and about.

reviews.title: A Real Gem
reviews.text: We stayed a Cambria House for two nights while in Nelson on a very special visit. My Father's maternal great-grandparents were among the first German immigrants to land there in 1843. After suffering more than a year of hardship and suffering they were forced to re-emigrate to Australia. Our only hardship was in having to leave after too short a stay! Hosts Karen and David were very welcoming and eager to hear our story. They were also very helpful in giving us suggestions as to how to get to get to our places of interest. Our accommodation was very comfortable and roomy and the hearty breakfasts were a great way to start the day. We are already planning to return in 2018 for the 175th anniversary of our ancestors’ arrival and Cambria House will be at the top of the list of places to stay.

reviews.title: Warm and comfortable
reviews.text: The owner Carol could not have been more gracious as we had early departures each morning and she made us a wonderful lite breakfast. Her home is wonderful and walking distance to town. Our room was large with a separate tub and shower. Two patio areas and a living room and den. Good free WiFi. Would highly recommend.

reviews.title: Beautiful house run by very kind owner.
reviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Cambria House which is in a pleasant location convenient for the city centre. Karel is very kind and helpful and looked after us very well. Our room was very comfortable and well furnished and the sizeable bathroom had good facilities. We had freshly cooked breakfasts looking out to the pretty garden, a lovely place to stay.

reviews.title: Excellent place to see Nelson and Abel Tasman
reviews.text: Comfortable, great location, quiet, excellent help from owners. Travel advice very helpful. Patio to relax in. Delicious breakfast. A lovely river walk is a couple of blocks away, and it's a short drive or walk into town for meals.

reviews.title: Lovely B&B
reviews.text: Our hosts Karel & David made us feel very welcome at our first stop. The breakfast was wonderful. The house is so close to town that we enjoyed a few walks out. Karel suggested visiting the center of New Zealand and it did not disappoint! We would not hesitate on staying here again if we are ever back in New Zealand. Panamas was close by and the best dinner in Nelson. Ken & Joy

reviews.title: Great location for Abel Tasman National Park & Nelson/Marlborough Wineries
reviews.text: Karel was a great host and provided excellent information on things to do, restaurants, etc. We stayed for 4 nights in the deluxe suite, which was large and very comfortable. It was an easy 10 minute walk into town. Good breakfast menu, all cooked fresh. Would definitely recommend to our friends.

reviews.title: Best in Nelson
reviews.text: What a joy to stay here. Came home with house envy. Comfortable and spacious accommodation. Lovely breakfast in a family friendly dining room where you get to eat with other guests around a huge table and share stories. Karole and Dave could not have been more helpful, booking a trip to Abel Tasmin national park for us. Nothing was too much trouble for them. Wonderful stay, highly recommended.

reviews.title: Ideal place for Nelson
reviews.text: We had 3 nights at the Cambria House to explore the Nelson area. This is a first rate B&B with wonderful rooms, nice outdoor area, wifi, TV and comfortable common areas. The breakfast is exceptional and they have wine available to purchase to have in your room if you didn't take the time to pick something up during the day. Attractive place and relaxing. Our only complaint was low water pressure in the shower but not a big deal. Every little thing was provided for as you would expect from an experienced Inn keeper. It's an easy 10 min. walk into Nelson.

reviews.title: Great place, great service
reviews.text: Lovely B&B just 10 mins walk from the centre of Nelson. David and Karel were great hosts and nothing was too much trouble, Great room very clean and well decorated.

reviews.title: Comfortable and welcoming
reviews.text: We had a twin room (4) at the front of this house on a fairly quiet road about 10 mins walk from the city centre. The room with en-suite shower was fine for our 2 night stay, and there was ample tea making facilities, chocolate and biscuits freely available. Karel was an excellent source of information and even booked our boat trip to the national park. The WiFi is best from the sitting or dining room The breakfast was excellent and the smoked salmon very tasty. They source local products which makes a lovely change. A great place to stay enroute to the ferry

reviews.title: Great B&B
reviews.text: We spent 2 lovely nights here. Carol was so very gracious. We needed to leave early each morning and Carol was extremely accommodating in offering to make us breakfast before the normal breakfast times. The house was close enough for us to walk to town. The room was clean and cozy. Thanks Carol for a great stay!

reviews.title: Pretty B&B
reviews.text: Lovely house in a very quiet location but close to shops and restaurants. Very welcoming host. Lovely bedroom with nice furnishings and amenities and a complimentary decanter of port! Good breakfast served in a lovely dining room.

reviews.title: Lovely Bed and Breakfast, Nice Owner
reviews.text: My wife and I toured New Zealand for a month during February and March 2017. We have provided reviews of all the places we stayed at during our tour. To see the reviews of the other places we stayed at please click on my name to the left and then when the box comes up click on my name again. We stayed in Cambria House for two nights. We wanted to book a water taxi to the Abel Tasman National Park and take a walk along the coast. Carol, the owner, was very helpful and made the bookings on our behalf. She also gave us some good advice regarding which walks to take. The bed was very comfortable and the bedding and room was very clean. The breakfast was excellent and Carol went out of her way to provide sourdough bread for my wife and also cooked some beans, which were not on the menu, especially for me. There is off street parking available at the front of the property. The property is in a residential area about 15 minutes walk from the restaurant area.

reviews.title: Visit to Abel Tasman Nat'l. Park
reviews.text: Our hosts, Carol and David were wonderful people who shared their knowledge of Nelson, the surrounding area, & Abel Tasman Nat'l. Park to help us enjoy the area. Carol suggested Hopgoods for dinner & made our reservation. She also provided us with info about the Nelson Art Festival Parade. David told us about driving south to St. Arnaud to see the alpine lake there and follow the Wairau River valley road to Marlborough to our next stop in Blenheim. Their breakfasts were delicious.

reviews.title: 2 Day stay in Cambria House
reviews.text: As part of a 3 week tour of New Zealand we stopped at Cambria House in Nelson for 2 nights. The accommodation was fantastic, exceptionally clean, and Karel could not have been more helpful. It was just 10 minutes walk from the centre of Nelson with its vibrant market and restaurants. The House was immaculately furnished and all the modern conveniences were available either in your room or in the nearby dining area. Internet was free via the family PC. Breakfast was excellent and served between 7:30 - 9:30 although when we were leaving early to visit Abel Tasman Karel served it at around 7am. All in all I would thoroughly recommend this B&B.

reviews.title: More than adequate!
reviews.text: Very comfortable B and B with (small) baths and showers, very comfortable beds and delicious breakfast in a rather chilly dining room! Delightful and very helpful hostess and we would recommend this as a nice place to stay for a couple of nights!

reviews.title: New Zealand tour
reviews.text: Very comfortable, clean and fairly large room with small bathtub, (I got in but couldn't get out), and a shower. Very welcoming hosts Karel and David provided good information on where to eat and things to see on our onward journey. Breakfast really nice, cooked from locally sourced produce.

reviews.title: Quiet and within easy walking distance of the town
reviews.text: We stayed here for just one night. The room we had was at the front of the house overlooking the quiet street allowing a good nights sleep in a comfortable bed. The room was small and clean but didn't allow for easy relaxing other than using the bed or to view TV. There is a lounge area but we didn't think the seating was particularly comfortable and with no other quests using the area at the time didn't feel too friendly. More like a magazine layout. Breakfast was adequate but compared to other B&B offerings we had during our visit to NZ was below average. The place didn't have any feeling of friendliness and our host whilst not being rude kept conversation to the business in hand. Parking is on the public road. We can't comment on value for money as the accommodation was booked as part of a tailored package. For dinner it is a ten minute walk into the centre of the town.

reviews.title: We were afraid to eat the breakfast
reviews.text: My wife and I were having a great day until we came to check in at Cambria House. Even with a giant bird pooping on her. We were about 20 mins early for check-in, only to find the door locked (as she wanted to clean up the droppings from her hair). After knocking once, a kind Chinese gentleman (another guest) opened the door and advised us to wait in the foyer. We did so and the owners of Cambria House turned up, 5 mins late at 1405. Not a big deal. I noticed the old man was carrying some groceries so I kindly opened the door from the inside to help him. I was met with aggression and surprise. "Who are you?" He asked. I explained and he followed up with "what are you doing here inside" and " this is our house" , "how did you get inside" - clearly because I'm black I must have broken in. The abusive tirade went on until he just walked away and it was continued by his wife Karel. She instantly decided to lay abuse on us as well without having heard what her husband had said or what we could offer. It was quite clear that if they'd seen a white person rather that a black person opening the door it probably would have been OK. They seemed surprised that a white and black person could also be married - offering us the twin room instead of our booked double. I fear in the South they are unfamiliar with the possibility of multiracial couples. Later Karel and her husband (who came back smelling of beer and cigarettes) came back to supposedly apologize and abuse us again while telling us we were welcome to stay or go but informing us that we were at fault and they would NOT refund. We had booked two rooms - another for my wife's mother who had just arrived. We asked for a refund and were refused. So we stayed - read: had no option. The bed was uncomfortable. The room was cold and musty smelling. It was a long walk to town - as far to the town as the town is across. There's plenty of closer lodgings. I couldn't eat breakfast as they'd made us feel so terribly unwelcome / uncomfortable and spoiled our trip to Nelson. If you are wearing a long white hood this might be the perfect place to stay. It was the most unpleasant stay we've ever had in any accommodation in the world. Thanks Karel and David - if you aren't expecting people in your house then don't run a B&B.

reviews.title: Cambria House - very nice!
reviews.text: Cambria House was a very nice place to stay in Nelson. The room was large and comfortable. Beautiful garden in front of the house. Location was close to the city center - any easy walk. Breakfast was hardy and tasty. Hosts were friendly and helpful. Liked having internet access.

reviews.title: Excellent...
reviews.text: Excellent bed and breakfast in a great location, walking distance from the shops and restaurants of Nelson. Karel and David couldn't have been more helpful and really made us feel welcome - almost 'at home' (except without the cooking, cleaning and washing up of course!). Lovely rooms, great garden, nice touch having free use of internet, tasty breakfast and heaps of info and help on local attractions. Great place to stay.

reviews.title: Real luxury
reviews.text: I was a little apprehensive prior to arriving, having had a bad experience of another 'luxury lodge'. I shouldn't have worried - Karel and David were excellent hosts and the luxury suite was just that. The room was beautifully equipped with luxury furnishings and thoughtful extra touches such as chocolates and port. Free internet access for guests was a bonus and the amount of information available to guests about the local area was superb. Breakfast is taken at a large table in the breakfast room, and, whilst not usually my thing, was very convivial and helped by David's friendliness and helpfulness. Wouldn't hesitate to return here.

reviews.title: 3 night stay during December 2018
reviews.text: We spent 3 nights at Cambria House between Christmas and New Year. We loved Nelson in general and Cambria House in particular. David and Karel were attentive hosts. Our room was spacious and immaculately clean, the breakfasts were excellent and Brenda was very happy to put David's well-honed medical skills to great use when she fell and suffered a badly cut knee, which is recovering nicely, thank you, 2 1/2 weeks later! Thanks and best wishes

reviews.title: Best
reviews.text: We highly recommend this accommodation based on our very positive experience We felt warmly welcomed, comfortable and well informed about attractions and activities in the area. We enjoyed talking with the host about life, history and family and the links with the area So much nicer than a motel experience Nelson vs Masterton? Our vote is Nelson🤗. Thanks for hosting us

reviews.title: Friendly and welcoming, a real home from home
reviews.text: After three flights from the UK, we wanted a place that was easy to find and welcoming, and we got just that. Much better than a corporate hotel, we were left to relax and get to grips with time zones, whilst being fed a great breakfast and useful advice in equal measure. Karen and David were great hosts and the room was spacious and had loads of character. Highly recommended

reviews.title: effortless style and maximum comfort, this B&B is a cut above the rest
reviews.text: my husband and i were travelling through Nelson on our honeymoon and stumbled on Cambria House. We had no idea what a gem it was going to be. It is set in a residential leafy avenue, just over the bridge from the main CBD in Nelson. From the word go you know you are going to be in for a treat. the front garden is immaculate, stunning display of flowers and carefully chosen ornaments to complement the washboard loook of the house - all tended by the owners themselves who clealry take a huge pride in their house. Entering the house we felt immediately at home, the furnishings are so well put together - stylish, in a boutique way, but with the added sense of a real home. The guest lounge felt like the sort of place you really would like to hang out in - made that much more appealing by the free port and brandy! the room itself was of one of the highest standard i have seen - its up there with the level of quality you would expect in a 5 star coran type hotel. The bed was super comfy, the pillows and duvet were full on luxury. The bathroom was the real star - a free standing huge bath, a hug walk in shower with, stunning decor, heated floors and heat lamp lights. We were also hugely impressed by the quality of the breakfasts in the morning. The owners are really freidnly and nice and helped many of the guests with travel plans, ideas, advice and bookings. to top it off there was free wi fi as well! although we were off to see some amazing places in the south island we were actually very sad to leave cambria house because it was so lovely, we would definately stay there again if we went back to Nelson, its a perfect place for a bit of luxury.

reviews.title: Comfortable, welcoming and well located B and B
reviews.text: We stayed at Cambria House for two nights and were warmly welcomed by Karel, the owner. The house is pretty, in a residential street and within walking distance of the town. There is an attractive sitting area in the garden and comfortable places to sit inside. Our room was next to the front door of the house and therefore subject to the noise of other guests coming and going. The bedroom and shower room were both quite small and hot and there was no air conditioning. Karel gave us some good ideas for the best places to visit during our short stay. She made delicious breakfast to order. We would describe it as comfortable and homely, but our room was definitely not luxury.

reviews.title: Good base for Nelson area visit
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our two night stay at this delightful property, within a 15 minute walk to Nelson town.Karel and David made us feel really at home and as they are N.Z born and bred had a vast knowledge of this beautiful country. Our room was very comfy although we did find the en suite rather small (a minor detail).Breakfast was excellent with plenty of choice and top ingredients.Another nice touch was the free wi fi which in many of the big hotels you have to pay for.If you need to book any trips Karel is always there to arrange it for you.Parking is close at hand at the front of the property.

reviews.title: Lovely B and B
reviews.text: We were given a warm welcome by Carol and made to feel very comfortable from the start. There was a lovely sitting room and a decked garden area with shading. Tea and coffee making facilities and use of a fridge in the dining room as well as tea and coffee facilities in the rooms. Cambria House is a short walk into the centre of Nelson. Nelson is a great little town with a different selection of restaurants and pubs.

reviews.title: Unfriendly, unwelcoming hosts
reviews.text: Our group of four adults had booked an overnight stay. My son and I arrived shortly after my daughter and her husband had experienced a rude and unwelcoming interaction with the host (David). Karel met me and quickly attempted to justify her husband's behaviour towards my daughter and her husband. A swift and unconditional apology from David for the unpleasant initial interaction would have gone a long way to repairing the situation and reducing the tension. Unfortunately the apology which was eventually provided was too long in coming and appeared to be grudgingly given. So although the accommodation was adequate our interaction with the hosts (Karel and David) left us feeling unwelcome, awkward and uncomfortable.

reviews.title: A Gem
reviews.text: We have just come back to the UK after spending nearly five weeks in New Zealand, easily the most extraordinarily beautiful and spectacular country we have ever visited. Although based in Christchurch with our daughter, we toured the South Island extensively and experienced a wide range of accommodation of differing quality. Easily the best, although closely followed by The Brothers in Dunedin, was Cambria House in Nelson. This is an absolute gem. Beautifully furnished and appointed, our room was exquisite with the most spacious and roomy bathroom you could imagine. The lounge was equally comfortable and a delicious cooked breakfast at a large dining table was a perfect opportunity to share experiences with fellow travellers. After staying almost exclusively in large chain hotels, we had forgotten what a joy it is to connect with others "on the road". The owners were welcoming and full of excellent information. We cannot imagine returning to NZ without a stopover in Cambria House and Nelson itself, which is well worth a visit. Diolch i Ty Cambria o Gymru Sian and Tony Jenkins

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: Having stayed in a few B&B’s on our travels around NZ, we were bitterly disappointed with this place. Our room was full of cobwebs and smelt damp. It was old in style (furniture) however looked very tired all over, even the bedspread!!! We saw the landlady our arrival for 5 minutes and after that didn’t clap eyes on the owners again. Didn’t appear to be overly friendly. Maybe it was a bad couple of days for them, however customers shouldn’t sense this if it was. There was no visitors book that we are aware of and no requests for reviews. Mind you we didn’t see the owners when we left at/after breakfast!!

reviews.title: Loved Nelson, and Cambria a House.
reviews.text: Excellent, all we wanted. We were made very welcome, clean and comfy room with a really good breakfast. Interesting meeting other travellers at the breakfast table and sharing our experiences of New Zealand. A perfect base for our stay in Nelson, with perfect hosts.

reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.text: Karol has thought of everything to make this B and B a great place to stay. Centrally located. If you are in town on a Saturday, make sure to go to the Farmer's Market.

reviews.title: Good B&B
reviews.text: Good boutique type B&B and David and Karel made us feel really welcome. Our room was a bit dated (although the bahroom wasn't) and there was a some dust but nothing serious. The room was a very warm, and being ground floor it wasn't possibe to leave the windows open. The public areas are great. Location is OK - its a short walk to town. Breakfast was good quality apart from the coffee, although some may find the communal table a bit off-putting.

reviews.title: Perfect Hosts
reviews.text: An extremely well run B&B. I can only repeat and agree with all points made by other previous reviewers. Suffice to say that hosts Karel & David go out of their way to ensure you have a pleasant stay making it "a home from home".Their advice and recommendations ensured that our three day stay with them gave us a flavour of both Nelson and the Abel Tasman National Park. Our large room with a garden verandah together with the modern bathroom made for a very comfortable and pleasant stay. A delicious and hearty breakfast of choices always provided us with a proper start to our day. In addition the choice of free sherry or port if required in the evening added a unique touch.

reviews.title: wonderful stay
reviews.text: We stayed twice. Once in room 1 and once in room 4. Both rooms were lovely and quiet. Keral and David, the proprietors were absolutely charming...the breakfast was delicious...the bathrooms very modern and convenient. I'd have to say it was probably the best place we stayed on our 5 week NZ trip. Highly recommend it. Lovely garden patio for enjoying breakfast.

reviews.title: The perfect base and perfect hosts
reviews.text: We stayed at Cambria House at the end of a tour of South Island. We had family near by so this was an obvious choice for us to stay at Cambria House as the location was perfect. However, we do not think we could have picked a better place ourselves, it was perfect in every way. The hosts, Karel and David could not do enough for us and were informative yet respectful of our privacy. They were flexible with our arrival and departure times to suit our ongoing plans and the place itself is just beautiful. The breakfast is plentiful with a large variety to choose from and the added free wifi was just incredible. If you don't have your own device there is a pc for your use, this is very rare in NZ but so useful for keeping in touch with home. We would not hesitate to stay again and would highly recommend anybody wanting to stay close to the centre of Nelson without all the bustle.

reviews.title: Cambria House - gateway to Nelson
reviews.text: We only spent one night at Cambria House, but it was a nice place to stay. The room was clean and well - appointed. Karel was a friendly hostess, breakfast was good and the location was very convenient in terms of proximity to Nelson and its attractions. (Walking distance to the downtown area, shopping and restaurants, the cathedral, Queens Garden, the river walk and Center of NZ)

reviews.title: Delightful hosts and first class accommodation
reviews.text: Beautiful residence near city with a 'presidential' size bedroom and ensuite. Bright large dining room with excellent breakfast choices. Lovely hosts. The B&B is a short pleasant walk back into town. There is also a nice low set timber landing at back to relax by the garden. Outstanding one of the best.

reviews.title: warm and friendly
reviews.text: We spent several nights at Cambria House in Nelson on our recent trip to New Zealand. We enjoyed being in a neighborhood that was an easy walk into town. The Wallaces were welcoming, gracious hosts. The Nelson area was well worth the visit.

reviews.title: A perfect bed and breakfast
reviews.text: A superior bed and breakfast is how it markets itself and it meets those boasts easily. We had a very friendly welcome from both of our hosts who could not do enough to help you. The huge room had period furniture and also had an equally large bathroom with both a bath and separate shower cabinet and a bonus was a switch for under floor heating. Our room had the usual TV but also had a DVD player and full micro stereo system with use of the house CD's and DVD’s if we wished. Breakfast was served at our designated time of juice, muesli / cereal followed by a choice of cooked breakfast with toast and the usual jams and honey. One choice at breakfast was smoked salmon and scrambled eggs. All were served freshly cooked to our requirements. Karel and David both were very helpful in suggesting places to visit and eat e.g. a bus and boat trip to Abel Tasman Nature Reserve for a very interesting walk. The bus picked us up from just around the corner and Karel did all the hard work by booking the trip for us. We, like all guests, had free use of David's desktop computer with full access to the internet at no cost. Most unusual in New Zealand. A quiet place that is very close to the centre of Nelson. Really the perfect place to stay.

reviews.title: Excellent Stay after a rough ferry crossing from Wellington
reviews.text: Although we only stayed here for one night, we thoroughly enjoyed it. As other visitors have said the hosts were extremely friendly and helpful, especially after we arrived fairly late following the ferry crossing and and wet drive down to Nelson. After leaving our cases in the spacious and comfortable room, we were given recommendations for restaurants in town. The choice of restaurants in Nelson is excellent and it was pity is was so wet that evening because the main area in town for restaurants is just great for open-air dining on the wide pavements. In fact after breakfast the following morning we went back to the town centre just to stroll around (it was sunny) and found lots of locals sitting outside the restaurants having coffee and brunch (Sunday morning). We were really pleasantly surprised about Nelson and would have preferred to stay at least one more night, but unfortunately our scheule didnt have that flexibility. Cambria House is excellent and the hosts provide excellent accommodation and breakfasts, Recommend to anyone looking a peaceful stay on their NZ Holiday.

reviews.title: Step back with this character house.
reviews.text: A very warm welcome from Karel & David. Whilst the bedroom was perhaps a little small the facilities were great. Big lounge with sherry! and free wi fi. Breakfasts were wonderful.This is a great base to see the area.Particularly Abel Tasman Park. Nelson is a lovely town with lots of restaurants and a pleasant buzz.We should have stayed longer.

reviews.title: Homely
reviews.text: We stayed here for three nights. Karel was great. She gave us really good information about the area and because of her we saw some wonderful places. David was wonderful at giving accurate weather forecasts! Breakfast at a communal table was actually really nice. Everyone we met was touring NZ like ourselves so it was helpful to get recommendations and hear peoples opinion of places. Cambria House is very close to town but in a lovely peaceful street. It isn't a five star hotel but it is a warm and friendly B and B.

reviews.title: Don't look any further
reviews.text: Fantastic B&B just an easy 5/10 minute walk to the centre of Nelson. Karel and David are very welcoming and helpful hosts. I had a beautiful, spacious room, comfy bed and was served a wonderful breakfast every morning at the large dining room table. Tea and coffee with fresh milk and homemade biscuits were available all day, along with a bowl of fruit. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend Cambria House to anyone in the area looking for accomodation.

reviews.title: Loved Cambria House
reviews.text: Karol and David extended us a warm welcome on our arrival and tended to our every need throughout our stay. We stayed in a luxury room which had plenty of space with thoughtful touches abound. There was a computer for the sole use of the guests which was very useful for catching up on e-mails, etc. Breakfasts were superb and Karol's home made biscuits were always available and should not be missed. Cambria House was a 5-10 minutes walk from the restaurants in Nelson.

reviews.title: Fabulous service, gorgeous lodge
reviews.text: Our family of 6 thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Summit Ridge and were so impressed by the service given to us by Keith, Ann and all the staff. We truly felt welcomed and at home, and we loved how roomy the whole lodge was. The kids loved the games lounge, and the dinners were amazing. Great location - close to everything with the village shuttle stop just out the front door. Would really love to visit again!

reviews.title: We Will Be Back
reviews.text: We had two queen suites next to each other. One room had a queen & the other 2 singles for the kids. Both rooms were neat & tidy & looked to be recently remodeled, had a fridge & tea/coffee making facilities.The only negative was there was no floor heating so the rooms were cold at times. We were supplied with an extra heater which made all the difference. There was wifi on each floor so the signal was always strong. Keith & Anne were great hosts, always happy & smiling. All queries were handled very professionally. The food was fantastic. We had 2 courses each so we would share 2 entrees & 2 deserts between the 4 of us & choose our own main course. We also received complimentary appetizers & bread rolls. We tried everything over our 5 night stay. Breakfast was continental buffet & order hot food. All hot food was fresh & hot. Merrin was one our servers, she was a pleasure to be around, always happy & friendly. I told Anne to hang on to her. We skied to & from the Lodge no problem after a lesson or two, otherwise you can catch the shuttle that stops only meters away. We didn't use the spa or sauna as we ran out of time. I would recommend this lodge to everyone.

reviews.title: True hospitality from the lovely host and hostess
reviews.text: I was staying at Summit Ridge in the second week of the Queensland School Holiday with my husband, our two little boys and a friend's son. We all had a fantastic stay at the mezzanine apartment. The owners Anne and Keith were just extraordinary in helping us to feel at home. The upstairs area in our room was big enough to fit in a queen size sofa bed and an another bedroom for the adults. We also loved the common room area where the kids can get entertained with videos and games. The lodge had a very positive vibe indeed and the food from the restaurant was absolutely beautiful. The staff at the restaurant had great attention to details and the kids were really well looked after. Most importantly, Anne and Keith was kind enough to help us out when we almost got stuck because of road closure. We would definitely recommend this lodge to our friends, family and any viewer who are thinking to travel to Falls Creek.

reviews.title: Amazing and unbelievable food too!
reviews.text: Along with a group of 20 cyclists my wife, son and I recently stayed at Summit Ridge for the 3 Peaks race. It was our second time for 3 Peaks and also for Summit Ridge. The ambiance of the restaurant was vibrant, with the open fire and pleasant music made for a number of fun evenings. The food was unbelievable quality and service second to none. Definitely a great family and group friendly option for Falls Creek anytime of the year! We will be back.... again.....

reviews.title: Lovely Stay
reviews.text: I spent 5 nights in June at Summit Ridge Alpine Lodge with my husband and 5 year old son and also with another family. We each stayed in Mezzanine Level. The lodge is boutique but very beautiful and family friendly. Keith and Anne are very lovely people and very welcoming , could not ask for better hosts. Nothing was too much trouble and they were very helpful right from the beginning. The room itself was very spacious and nicely decorated. Most important thing was it’s very clean and tidy. The lodge also has a drying room and a ski storage room, very convenient. There’s a free shuttle stop right outside the lodge to the chairlift. What surprise us the most staying at the Summit Ridge was the fine dining restaurant quality food at the lodge, we didn’t dine anywhere else during our stay as we didn’t feel there’s a need to. The food wasn’t just tasty but the presentation of the food was 5 star quality. The Staff at the restaurants were very friendly. The weather wasn’t all good during our 5 nights stay so didn’t ski for all 5 days but really didn’t feel like missing much as all of us were looking forward to dinner time at the restaurant  Overall, the trip and the stay was very enjoyable. Great location, beautiful lodge and hosts, great tasty food, convenient location and the kids both could do wombat ‘s ramble after this trip. Would love to return for more if we have a chance again this winter. Keith and Anne, thank you so much for being so welcoming, you make our trip extra memorable. Looking forward to visiting again soon…^_^

reviews.title: awesome trip
reviews.text: We stayed at Summit Ridge for 2 nights in August for a trip away. We stayed in the mezzanine room and enjoyed every second of our trip. Keith and the staff went out of their way to let us know how/where to get around and were great hosts. The food was amazing and by far the best that we ate while staying on the mountain. the drying room was so convenient for us and really helped us to change quickly after a long day on the slopes. thanks again keith and we look forward to many more stays in the future! after taking into account the time saved by staying on the mountain and the included meals the trip was value for money. we even enjoyed a few hours in the spa!

reviews.title: Excellent stay with great services and food!
reviews.text: Stayed for a total of 6 nights in a mezzanine suite with families comprising young kids. The room are cosy and sufficiently big for 5 of us. The room and water heater work great and there is a spa as well as sauna. It also has "in house" tobanggan for use, which my kids love to play right outside the accommodation. The transport to lift is also right outside the resort although we could ski right there (2mins). The food (included) were first class in presentation and quality. The stay was wonderful with the hosts Keith and Anne (and waitresses Penny and Jackie) displaying great attention and services each day. They were friendly, attentive and often goes above and beyond what is required to make our stay great. In particular, when we almost have to cancel our trips due to some urgent family matters, Keith was kind enough to offer alternate proposals and they also help us with some personal administrative issues that we needed to attend here. Couldn't have ask for better services. The kids love it here. Highly recommended and would return.

reviews.title: Excellent restaurant and lounge, good basic accomodation
reviews.text: It was the restaurant and lounge, which we had patronised over many years, that attracted us to the lodge. It would be fair to say the accommodation is not at the same standard as the restaurant, but nevertheless it is adequate, and the management is professional. Entry and exit to the ski room can be a bit of a struggle depending on conditions.

reviews.title: Too much of a good thing
reviews.text: Stayed here with my daughters last week being the first time we haven't used 'apartment' style accomodation. From the very moment we arrived and met Keith and Anne our hosts, we were made to feel like part of their family.They couldn't do enough to make us feel welcome the whole week. With food included in the cost I couldn't believe the value eating 5 star food every night.The staff were super friendly and greeted us by name every breakfast and dinner. The location of the Lodge is perfectly placed in the Village to easily access Slalom Plaza or the Village Bowl.We'll never be going back to cooking our own meals again in apartments. Summit Ridge every time now!

reviews.title: Loved it!!!
reviews.text: We had such an amazing family holiday and the hospitality from Keith, Ann and all of there staff made it so much better. As all of the other reviews mention the food is AMAZING!!! you could even stay there for a week and have something different cooked for your breakfast very day, and it is included in your stay. We would often ask for some hot chocolates for the kids in the afternoon and my wife and I would have a glass of wine from there very extensive wine list, this was never a drama even when the kitchen was not open. I would highly recommend the place and great ski in ski out location.

reviews.title: Great Hosts and Great Location
reviews.text: We are now sitting by the log fire waiting for our over snow transfer after spending 6 fabulous days of ski in ski out accommodation at this great lodge. There are new hosts Keith and Ann who are very enthusiastic and treat everyone as part of the family, happy to have a chat or leave you to your selves if you so desire. Although the rooms are not huge , they are spotlessly clean and feature a comfy King Bed which is all you need at the end of a long day skiing. The restaurant menu has a wide variety of top class meals and an extensive wine list - there is no need to go elsewhere. Will we come again - you bet , we are already planning a longer stay next season.

reviews.title: Bliss in the Aussie snowfields
reviews.text: While it might not be quite in the centre of Falls Creek Village, this ski/board in ski/board out location, coupled with some of the best food on the mountain, cosy rooms, a HUGE wine list and great breakfasts makes a stay in the snow here very enjoyable.

reviews.title: It's The Whole Package
reviews.text: Look No Further if you want the WHOLE Package. Summit Ridge Alpine Lodge is just perfect in every way; The Food is 5 Star, from dinner to breakfast. Keith and his team are just awesome, the most friendly and nicest people you will meet. Location...Location...Location, shuttle stop right near the front door, Ski In Ski Out (I prefer Board In Board Out), easy access to lifts, just perfect. Easy walk to all areas of the resort. I had the Duck for dinner, it was the best duck I have ever had....Perfection, so I had it two nights in a row. Also have the Beef for entree, so good. The Food is amazing. It's so nice to end your day with a glass of wine sitting by the fire, nice great. Thanks guys, thanks for an awesome stay.

reviews.title: No kids, No Snow but awesome service, staff and food
reviews.text: After spending several months working to hard, we decided we ( my partner and I) deserved an extended weekend away from the kids at the snow. We placed our booking and hoped that we would be skiing the slopes in no time. Unfortunately the snow didn't arrive. However we kept our booking and went. We received a very warm welcome and where shown to our room. It had the basics and we made ourselves at home. We ate dinner 2 of our 3 nights in the lodges restaurant, I must say the steak, lamb and duck was absolutely divine and cooked perfectly. The staff went out of there way to make sure we had every thing we needed and kept our glasses flowing. They were extremely friendly and happily joined in with our jokes and good times. I would highly recommend this lodge to anyone if your looking for a great friendly atmosphere with staff who go out of there way to make ur stay comfortable and are happy to give advice on the mountains attractions. Thanks for a good weekend

reviews.title: Wined and Dined
reviews.text: Came here for dinner the other night after hearing A LOT of high praise and amazing comments for food and I was not disappointed. In fact quite the opposite, I was blown away and left to roll out the door because I was so over indulged and well looked after. The staff and owner are fabulous, smiley, friendly, on the ball and eager to please. The photos I saw online do not do you justice. Those plates are gloriously generous. I was expecting the fabulous and gourmet flavor combinations and techniques, but I was not expecting the plate size. I came in absolutely starving and still struggled to finish (though I persevered) but unfortunately I just couldn't make room for the dessert (even though that had been my main intention). Doesn't matter though, as it just gives me even more reasons to have to come back and try the rest of the menu. Thank You for a fabulous evening of fine food.

reviews.title: Fantastic!
reviews.text: Just spent a wonderful week at the Summit Ridge, Keith, Anne and the rest of the staff were excellent hosts and went out of their way to make us welcome and assist us in any way possible. Keith arranged all our skiing equipment, passes and lessons before hand so we just had to collect them from the shop over the road and then a 10 minute ski down to the main lift. The food was excellent, we were full board so got to try everything on the breakfast and dinner menus and they were all superb and well matched with a sumptuous wine list. There were six in our party so we had a mezzanine room for the two adults and two kids, and also a bunk room for the two older kids. If I'm brutally honest, then it is a little dated, but it's a ski lodge and in many ways this added to its charm. The kids made full use of the sledges, shovels and snow ball gun which were all provided and had a great time just messing around in the snow field outside. The lounge/dinning area was really charming with a big open fire and plenty of comfy sofas, just the spot for an after dinner night cap. I read the "Disappointed" review below and other than the issue with the shower temperature - which admittedly was a bit of a pain - I couldn't disagree more. We had a wonderful time there and Keith and Anne really made the difference, this is a really homely, comfortable lodge and I would recommend it to anyone.

reviews.title: Compared to what it cost to stay - ok to average
reviews.text: Very nicely renovated, classy and romantic dining room - just as the pics on their website. Beautiful view of snow laden gum trees as you have your meal. Meals were ok - they do try, but did not have the flavor, snap and pop I'd expect from a top class restaurant that they're trying to be. Also, vegetarians, dont bother - nothing for you on the menu and well, you'll get the dish sans meat. Service was pretty good - once or twice we got the sense that it was a bit forced. Wendy was great however, knowledgeable and very enthusiastic. Pre-paid guests might have had a slightly shorter menu than other diners - what we saw on the display board outside was different to the menus given to us during our stay. Facilities were excellent, drying rooms, etc, ski in, ski out, not far from the runs & ticket office. Just be aware that it'll cost you close to $100 in oversnow transport to get you gear up there and back to the car park. Didn't see much of Simon, except when he was lighting the fire or working on his ski-do parked outside. The mezzanine suite is in reality a lot smaller than the photos suggest, and don't drink too much - the stairs up to the mezzanine is little more than a ladder (you can't turn you back to it and walk down). Sure we'll stay there again, we had a great time - just next time we'll try to haggle a more fitting cheaper price....

reviews.title: Can't Beat It
reviews.text: I have just enjoyed my second visit to Summit Ridge Alpine Lodge after visiting last year. It's just a wonderful as it was last year. Excellent location (ski in/ski out), absolutely brilliant food, awesome wines, wonderful hosts (Anne and Keith) and comfortable accommodation. My husband and I had a wonderful few days. Highly recommended! Thanks Anne and Keith for another great stay.

reviews.title: Superb yet again!
reviews.text: We have been going to Summit Ridge for 9 years. This place just keeps getting better and better. Keith and Ann are amazing hosts and their staff are friendly. They make an effort to know you and make sure you're having a great time. Ski in/out is easy because the lodge is high up. The food is amazing. This year it was outstanding, the banana chocolate igloo is a must. Can't wait to go again next year. Keep up the good work team!

reviews.title: Loved Summit Ridge. Cool room, great food and helpful and friendly owners.
reviews.text: I took the kids away for a 3 day ski break at the start of he holidays (Sat 14 -Tue 17 Sep 2013). It was late in the season but still plenty of snow up top for 3 solid days of skiing. We stayed in a mezzanine room, the kids slept upstairs and I was on the sofa bed downstairs. Great views out to the north and plenty of room for our gear. The owners organised our lift passes, lessons and gear hire. We were able to drive right up to the door to unload as the roads were clear, oherwise you would take the shuttle. They have a Spa and Sauna, which is great after a hard days skiing, and a fully equipped drying room. Gear hire was across the road at Cedarwood and when you check out just leave the gear in the drying room and they will come and pick it up! The restaurant was terrific. Some of the best food I've eaten anywhere, let alone on the mountain. The kids said it was the best restaurant food (entree pork belly, mains duck and lamb cutlets) they'd ever had. Great wine selection and a really nice local beer on tap. They pride themselves on their local sourcing of produce and NE Victoria has plenty to offer in that regard. My son is a coeliac and they were easily able to accomodate his gluten free diet for dinners. For breakfast he brought his own favourite GF cereal and a loaf of GF bread. No problem. Thanks Ann & Keith, we'll be back! :-)

reviews.title: Incredible food served in an incredible environment.
reviews.text: My experience at the Summit Ridge restaurant was flawless. I enjoyed an entire three course meal here and was absolutely delighted with the service, environment and mostly the food. I'll definitely be having another meal here next time I'm in Falls Creek.

reviews.title: Weekend Stay
reviews.text: The Mezzanine room we stayed in was great, comfortable and warm. But that's not what this review is mainly about. We had dinner in the restaurant and what a dinner it was. I can see why this restaurant is an award winner, Judy had the gnocchi, I had the snapper, wonderfull presentation and flavours to die for. Thanks to Ann, Keith, and all the staff for making our stay so pleasant.

reviews.title: P.E.R.F.E.C.T.
reviews.text: Perfect location. Wonderful staff. Super comfortable and clean rooms. Great location. We stuffed them around a little bit with our booking as I messed up dates and then had a funeral so got there late, it was a mess. The staff were amazing about it though, so empathetic and did everything they could to help. It was much appreciated btw. The lounge is wonderful. The restaurant is amazing. Even though we could hardly afford it we kept eating there every night because it was the best in Falls Creek in my opinion. I'd stay there as first choice every visit.

reviews.title: Great, but too pricey for a single person.
reviews.text: Comfortable clean room. Friendly staff. Incredible food. Quite expensive for a single person. Room prices are p/person (not p/room). Location is up very steep hills and on outskirts of the village. I would stay here again, but only with another person

reviews.title: Amazing dinner
reviews.text: Amazing dinner. The duck was sensational. Steak was cooked perfectly and not to mention the fondant is to die for. Best restaurant on the mountain. The staff are so friendly and accommodating. A must for a night out. Wine selection is fantastic.

reviews.title: Awesome ski in Ski out, incredible restaurant, spacious rooms, super family friendly
reviews.text: Just winding up our 1 week June holidays stay at Summit Ridge chalet at Falls Creek with family. Magnificient a la carte restaurant cuisine (try the duck and the barramundi). Breakfast you have a choice of range of cereals and muslei to eggs florentine and every which way, including big breakfast. Rooms are spacious, fresh and functional. Big open fire lodge feel. Staff dote on even the kids "Can I have..."). Ski in ski out via access trail means you can whip back to the lodge to pick up missing goggles in 3 mins turn around. Ski and board hire 50 m up the road so you can swap boards/skis at a whim...and its discounted as a SR guest. Add it up; it's the best package. PS. Book the restaurant prior - the whole mountain is onto it. It's seriously good food, multi award winning with a boutique wine list. Im more a beer man and there are wicked craft beers on offer.

reviews.title: Great stay over Queen's birthday weekend
reviews.text: We stayed over the Queen's birthday weekend to enjoy the opening of the ski season at Falls Creek. Our stay at Summit Ridge was very pleasant. We stayed in one of the Mezzanine lofts. The loft was very cozy and warm. Admittedly, the steps/ladder to climb to the mezzanine (where the bed is) are quite steep. Not a big deal but with sore ski legs, or after a few drinks, the steps can be a bit of a challenge. Our loft faced the road, and whilst pleasant, the lofts at the back of the lodge seem to offer better views. The lodge has free wifi but usage is limited to 300mb per day which is more than plenty for browsing the net/emailing but maybe not so if you wish to video skype. Mobile Unfortunately, the restaurant was closed during our stay so we did not get to experience the food (which apparently is very good). However, a basic continental breakfast (cereals & breads) was provided every morning between 07:30 and 09:00. Whilst good, we thought it could have been enhanced by some fresh produce such as fresh fruit and perhaps some cuts of cold meats & cheese etc. The location of the lodge may appear pretty far from the action, but everything is within walking distance. A (bus) stop for the village shuttle is right next to the lodge and it takes you and your gear across the village. The lodge has a very comfy and welcoming common room with a fire place that always appears to be burning. It's a great place to chill out with a drink after a day on the slopes. Staff were very friendly and helpful. In short, we enjoyed our stay and will definitely come back.

reviews.title: Wonderful, family friendly ski resort
reviews.text: What can be said about Summit Ridge that hasn't already been said? We've just had 5 sensational days here with our two eight year old boys and we honestly couldn't fault the place. Keith and Ann were wonderful hosts; they know all their guests' names and because it's such an intimate lodge, everyone gets to know each other and you really do feel part of a big family. There are so many little things that make Summit Ridge special - the food, the staff, the local knowledge; everything just happens without any fuss. One of our boys fell ill towards the end of our stay and Keith drove us to the clinic - it's this sort of service that will keep us coming back to Summit Ridge.

reviews.title: Fantastic in ski season, luxury in the offseason.
reviews.text: We stayed at Summit Ridge last winter and found the standard of accommodation and restaurant equal if not better than our experiences in France, Austria, Canada, and USA. We found this surprising considering the relative size of Falls Creek. We recently returned for a weekend in the off-season, during the Melbourne food and wine festival, and although the Lodge was only opened for the weekend, everything was just as fantastic. Just how you open a resort for one weekend in a remote location and still maintain 5-star service is a mystery to us. We dined both nights on the degustation menu with matching wines and everything was superb.

reviews.title: Family ski trip
reviews.text: I had no idea where to stay when I started researching our ski trip - I had emailed a few other places with queries but hadn't heard anything back after a couple of days. My 14 yo son actually came across Summit Ridge online and suggested it, so I also emailed them with my queries. Keith replied back straight away, before the others that I'd emailed before contacting him - this seemed a good sign to me that he was interested in accommodating us! I booked with him and he made it an easy process, always giving me the information that I'd asked for. When we arrived, Anne was literally at the door and greeted us by name - another great sign. The rooms are as in the photos - small - but very comfortable. The sofa foldabed was actually extremely comfortable (wasn't expecting that!), as was the big bed upstairs in the mezzanine. The restaurant was the best - hands down - that we ate in at Falls Creek. Brilliant breakfasts (included in nightly tariff) and dinners, while not cheap (but then again, nothing is at Falls), were of excellent quality - we loved everything that we ordered. Wait staff were superb - special thanks to Jordy who we enjoyed chatting with on a number of occasions, he was great. Location is good and the drying room has ample room for boots and hanging. Thanks Anne & Keith - we thoroughly enjoyed our holiday.

reviews.title: Loved our Stay at Summit Ridge
reviews.text: We have now stayed at Summit Ridge thee times over the last two ski seasons and would highly recommend this lodge to any one who is looking for a first class stay in the snow where everything is taken care of. On our last trip we stayed in one of the upper floor rooms that had a great loft set up for the bedroom which left ample space in the lower section for a comfortable lounge and TV area. As every one know that visits the snow, space is always at a premium but the rooms at Summit Ridge where a perfect size for a great week of skiing. While the rooms where excellent the dinning room and bar area were absolutely fantastic, the open fire place was always underway when we made our way in for drinks before dinner and we always made the most of the leather lounges for a chat with other guests and a few beers before dinner. The food was always top quality, basically what you would expect in any fine dinning restaurant, and there was never any shortage of good wines on the list to choose from. Overall we had a great week in the snow that was made even better by the hospitality of the staff at Summit Ridge and the well presented alpine lodge. We will be going back again this year for another stay, now all we need is 2M of snow to top things off.

reviews.title: Excellent place to stay
reviews.text: I stayed at Alpine Summit recently (7 March - 10 March 2014), not for the ski season but for the 3 peaks cycle challenge. Simply a great place to stay. Opening only for the week for the cycle event, the quality of food was amazing. The owners and staff were also amazing and well suited to their occupation. Keith, if you read this, thanks to you and your staff for your hospitality.

reviews.title: Excellent Food, Staff and Location
reviews.text: We stayed for 8 days in September and although the season was winding down the fresh snow kept us out! Continental breakfast at this time of year which is the case with most places. It was oh so nice to know the restaurant was catering for full dinner every night - the food was excellent as is the wine list! The room was always cleaned meticulously. Great location with the bus stop just outside the door. A special thanks to Anne and Keith for taking such good care of one of us who due to overabundance of enthusiasm at the aforementioned fresh snow was bed bound for the last two days with a torn knee ligament. The supersized coffee and treats were very therapeutic! See you next year!

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Well, after my partner and I booked our holiday ski package we began to read reviews of the Summit Ridge Alpine Lodge and noticed some varying differences with personal accounts of their stays, so we had to wait and see for ourselves so that we may form our own opinion. On our return we were motivated to provide our own review, which, we hope, will appeal to anyone who appreciates a carefree, no-fuss, holiday. The accommodation: Adequate. This may seem like a dull turn to use, but what I am saying is that if you are looking for a spacious 5 star resort room you may be a little dissappointed. Having never been skiing before I had no idea what to expect, but my partner told me that this far exceeded any ski lodge she had stayed at for a similar price. Adequate was all we needed. We had a lounge to sit on to watch TV. We had a roomy bathroom with a bath; and for those who have returned from a day of skiing will know - a hot, deep bath is possibly the most relaxing and soothing luxury imaginable. Upstairs was a king size bed - again very rewarding at the end of a day on the slopes. Each window in the lodge has beautiful views; whether it be from the restaurant or from our room. There was plenty of space to hang and stack our clothes, a fridge, tea and coffee making facilities and pretty much everything that we needed. It was modern, clean, fresh and serviced as often as we wanted. The restaurant: Possibly the most superb food I have ever tasted. We knew that the restaurant had won many awards, so the expectation was high. The food excelled our expectations. We tried nearly everything on the menu and was surprised at how perfect the flavours came together. They have a huge range of some of the best quality wines available, and were able to match a wine to perfectly compliment each course. The staff: This is what will make the difference between a wonderful, memorable experience and a holiday easily forgotten. The hosts were superb. Their professionalism and attention to detail ensured that we were looked after and had everything that we needed. Each member of the "team" were exceptional in their helpful service and friendly manner. If we needed to employ staff, we would have stolen them all! Thank you all so much for the above and beyond service and help you provided. The experience: My partner and I would wake up in the morning, wander dow to the restaurant for a beautiful cooked breakfast, grab our ski gear and head for the slopes. Then at the end of the day we'd return from the slopes, leave our ski gear in the drying room, stagger to our room, have a bath and a glass of wine before dinner. We would spend much of the day deciding what wonderful meal we would have that night. We then would have an after dinner drink on the lounge by the fire, before making our way to our heated room for a cosy night in. Each guest we bumped into during the day made similar raving comments. The conclusion: We loved it, and will definately return again.

reviews.title: Location, food & hospitality at its best!
reviews.text: Stayed for three nights at Summit and had an excellent time, the large mezzanine room is so spacious and all our needs were met for a comfortable stay with a baby and toddler in tow! Ski in ski out location too was just excellent and the food in the restaurant is delicious. Highly recommended!

reviews.title: Great location, great food!
reviews.text: I stayed in Summit Ridge for the first time last year and I must say I was very impressed. Being able to put my skis on and slide to a lift from out the front of the lodge was such a treat. The lodge itself is kept immaculately clean and the restaurant is simply gorgeous. Wendy and Simon and the entire team were so helpful and accommodating during our stay which is really comforting being so far from home. I would not hesitate in recommending this hotel to people who want a fantastic lodge experience, fine food and wine and a location second to none. Great holiday.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I booked our holiday based on Trip Advisor reviews and it is for that reason that I feel I need to write this review honestly. This place was, in a word, disappointing. On booking, we were promised so many things for the children, none if which we found or were offered once we arrived. Firstly - the fire was either not on or burning out. The restaurant was often cold. The waitress at breakfast was really rude to us. It was as if we had interrupted her to order breakfast. And changing my kids order from poached eggs to fried eggs was a huge issue, "alterations to the menu add time". Well, I should've listened to her warning. We waited 1 hour for breakfast! Needless to say, even though we had paid for breakfast every morning, we went elsewhere. That is precious time on the slopes. The rooms. We had a mezzanine room. It was FREEZING on the top level. No heating up there at all. Not to mention the dangerous ladder to get up to the top floor. With my children it was a worry. The shower temp was a battle every day. Either freezing cold or boiling hot. So annoying with 6 of us to shower, just took forever. The TV in the room didn't work properly. The reception kept dropping out. Anne was lovely. Although our plates were taken while we were still eating on our first night, the food in the restaurant was very good. Just don't make any changes to the menu! God forbid you like your eggs fried rather than poached. Normally in a lodge, the owners will come and ask how your day was, what runs you did etc. Keith couldn't have been more absent if he wasn't there. And when we did see him we hardly got an acknowledgement. Anne was ever present and a very lovely lady. There are so many other little things that i don't have time to mention, but it was just overall disappointing. I'm really surprised that it is number 1 on here. Makes me wonder actually.

reviews.title: Best food fantastic service!
reviews.text: What a great little gem in the mountains! We had a very warm and friendly welcome by jackie who seated us by the fire where we had a few glasses of bubbly before we were escorted to our table. Our waiter for the evening was penny, her service was above and beyond and made our evening something to remember, she always had a smile and was extremely grateful amd nothing was too hard. The food was exquisite! My husband had the duck and i the pork and we followed with a delightful ice cream selection. We highly recommend this restaurant to anyone, the service was first class as was the food! Thank you for such a nice evening away from the children!

reviews.title: The Perfect Alpine Escape
reviews.text: Summit ridge is the perfect alpine escape from the city. The lodge is absolutely immaculate and the friendly owners were always around to assist us with any questions we had about falls creek. The room was a great size and serviced daily so it was nice to come back from a day skiing to a fresh clean room everyday. They also have the float tank which we found the best way to get rid of the aches and pains of a day on the mountain. I wish i could have my own. Summit ridge also has a restaurant which in our opinion the best dining experience falls creek has to offer. The dining room is beautiful with leather couches in front of a fire place and very smart and contempary layout of dark wood tables and leather bound chairs. Just walking into the dining room is a very warm and welcoming feel. The food we had was unbelievable. I had gnocchi to start and my girlfriend had parpadelle which we are told is all hand made in house by the chefs and was amazing. I dont think you see that much at falls creek. For mains My girlfriend had duck and i had the slow cooked rack of lamb. We were speechless at the quality of food to come out of a ski lodge setting. All this was complimented with a while list a could have sat and chipped away at for days. The staff were very switched on with the wine and pairing to the dishes we selected. Overall we had an amazing time at summit ridge, ive just booked our holiday for this year again at summit and cannot wait to get there. Truely exceptional.

reviews.title: Friendly, comfortable and very welcoming
reviews.text: Located in the village, it's only a short walk or ski to nearby restaurants, bars, cafes as well as the slopes. Amazing hiking available near by too! Keith and Anne are the most welcoming and warm hosts I have ever come across. Nothing was ever a problem and they came with amazing suggestions of things to see and do in the area. The restaurant at Summit Ridge is incredible. The food and service were second to none. Jacquie in the restaurant took amazingly good care of us and was a lot of fun to chat to. If you are after a comfortable, modern, clean and convenient place to stay, then you should definitely consider Summit Ridge. We couldn't fault them on anything. We will be going back, without question!

reviews.title: A brilliant place to stay at Falls
reviews.text: A great place to stay when skiing at Falls Creek. Comfy apartments, an outstanding restaurant and the owners are super friendly and helpful. We 5 nights here with fantastic conditions and were sorry to leave. Ski in ski out no problems helped by one of the best ski seasons they've had. Great place and somewhere we hope to return to.

reviews.title: 3 Peaks of Perfect
reviews.text: A group of us recently attended the 3 Peaks Cycling event at Falls Creek. We had the pleasure of staying at Summitt Ridge. There was approx 15 to 20 of us. All with cycling gear and many requests. The team at Summitt Ridge were very accommodating with our requests [cyclists can be demanding]. We had chosen to have all meals at their restaurant as a group, this was a wise choice as food was fantastic, service was great and the fire place really set the scene! Accommodation was fine, although fitting 3 guys into a room and bikes made it cosy! I will be back again to see Keith and the crew, although next time I will bring the family as there was plenty to do! Thank you Glenn Cream - part of the Condev / Ray White Surfers Paradise Group!

reviews.title: Nicely located, friendly owner and staff, first class dining!
reviews.text: I stayed here for 2 nights with my wife and 2 kids. The room rate quoted were reasonable. We received a warm welcome from Keith and his wife (i guess) and explained clearly about the room, services, foods etc. They really take care of all our needs. You can either walk to the ski area or jump into the free shuttle provided in Falls Creek. Please remember that you are not allowed to park your car inside the village area except for loading in 30 minutes and you can only park your car at the designated area before the entrance of the village, without which you will be handed over a fine! Your kids will be much happier as they do have toys, playstation and reading books at their lounge upstairs. The rooms are spacious and greatly designed to cater us. The smoking area is within the designated corner but with a nice view too!! We had dinner here in the restaurant with a fine dining concept. The foods are marvellous with great services by their staffs. They remind us on our breakfast for tomorrow so that you dont miss the foods. Of course will be back again! Thumbs up!!

reviews.title: A rare find in the most beautiful location
reviews.text: My 5 year old daughter and I have just returned from the most fabulous 7 day stay at Summit Ridge. What can we say! Well...we had the most amazing holiday due in no small part to Ann, Keith and their team. They really are hosts extraordinaire! We felt like part of the family from the minute we arrived. In fact, the family atmosphere was everywhere and kids and adults mingled happily every evening in front of the glorious open fire before sitting down to a sumptuous dinner in the Summit Ridge Restaurant. The food was simply impeccable, I could not fault it at all and the servings and choices were extremely generous. Coming from Adelaide, where great restaurants are the norm, I was quietly surprised at how amazing the food was. The rooms were just perfect. A toasty haven when you needed some ‘down time’. Having the opportunity to sink into a nice warm bath after a perfect day on the slopes, was also just what the Doctor ordered. This was my Daughters first time at the snow and I am just so delighted we chose to stay at Summit Ridge. She made so many friends at the lodge and the tower lounge provided the kids with Wii, DVD’s, board games, sofas and fun fun fun. Wow, what a memorable holiday! I would highly recommend Summit Ridge to everyone and anyone. You will not be disappointed.

reviews.title: A home away from home in your Alpine village
reviews.text: I found Keith and Anne (owner operators) to be extremely helpful and accommodating from our first contact. Nothing was too much trouble and both were very flexible with accommodating and caring for our party of 11. We all felt very welcome and at home from the beginning of our stay until leaving 8 days later. The Mezzanine suites were very comfortable and offered beautiful views across the village and surrounding mountains. The restaurant evening menu is more than adequate with choice, offering a variety of entree, main and dessert, most nights a special main was also offered. The quality of food was first class in every respect far exceeding our expectations. The breakfast options were brilliant with sufficient food to keep you on track until dinner. The very friendly waitstaff only added to the experience, nothing was too much trouble, a credit to Keith and Anne. The lodge is located high in the Falls Creek village with a short ski to either Falls Express chair or The Eagle chair. The home ski run from the mountain delivers you to the front door of The Lodge in a matter of minutes, a gentle gradient track suitable for the beginner, a more challenging option is available for those who desire. If you are looking for accommodation with a full board option, very convenient with children then you need not go past SUMMIT RIDGE ALPINE LODGE. Did I mention the ski storage and drying room was quite large and very efficient. We all had an excellent week and Keith amazed us with his ability to bring on so much snow. Thankyou Keith, Anne and staff. We will return next year.

reviews.title: A real treat
reviews.text: We visit Falls Creek every year for our annual ski trip. This year we stayed at Summit Ridge and thoroughly enjoyed it. We booked direct and got a great price. Had to make a couple of room and date changes after booking and Keith handled them politely and swiftly without any fuss. We were warmly greeted on arrival by Ann who explained all the ins and outs. First the room, it is of typical size for a lodge - smallish but definitely not pokey. We had a mezzanine room which had a comfy king size bed upstairs and our 8 year old son installed himself on the sofa bed downstairs. The room was warm and had fantastic views down the valley and up to the International Poma. It was clean and modern with plenty of storage and a nice bathroom. The ski room was great. It is heated well so all your gear dries out and is warm when you put it on. There is even a heated boot rack, a real luxury for us as we've only experienced cold and damp ski rooms before. There is a spa and sauna downstairs (so no view) which we made good use of at the end of the day. Towels and robes are provided. Then dinner! We had breakfast and two course dinner included with the tariff. The dining room is lovely with a big open fire, leather lounges to relax in with a pre-dinner drink and that lovely view onto the snow gums. Ann and her team of Jacqui and Penny really made us feel at home and nothing was ever a fuss. I loved sitting in front of the fire with a drink and amuse bouche while perusing the menu. You can stay there until your meals arrive at your table. There's a separate kids menu but no separate dining time for them. The food is excellent. At least 4 stars for both adults and kids menu. They use mostly local produce and are employing all the latest trends and tricks. It was another real treat each day. Full breakfast was included and I doubt anybody would go wanting. There's a communal lounge upstairs with books, old school games, a DVD library, Wii, PS3 and their associated games. A great spot for the kids to get to know each other or to hang out and read a book if the weather's off. All up, we had a great trip this year and Summit Ridge was a big part of that experience. Thanks!

reviews.title: Great Accommodation!
reviews.text: Clean, comfortable and stylish. The service was personal and genuine. I was more than happy with the stay and the food offered in the restaurant is exceptional. True ski in/ski out with excellent drying facilities. Overall this is a quality property and I would not take any notice of poor reviews without good reason. I look forward to staying there again.

reviews.title: A wonder winter escape
reviews.text: We stayed for two nights in July 2013. It was our second stay but our first since Keith and Anne have taken over last season. The accomodation is good and comfortable. We stayed in a queen room this time as last time we stayed in a mezzanine suite and although that accomodation is a bit larger, we preferred to be on the same level. We were lucky to have room 17 which is at the end and has two windows and is super quiet. The dinners are exactly as other guests have explained. Lovely and a highlight every day. The breakfasts are a bit plain but there is a hot a la catre limited menu and help yourself toast and cereals etc. i remember the breakfasts during our stay 3 years ago were quite a bit better There is a lovely welcoming lounge area with leather sofas and a big open log fire. Every night we would relax there after dinner with wine, or a book, or a game of scrabble or chess. There is also another lounge area on the first floor which is geared towards children with games, a tv, lounges, and even a wii. There is a small 4-6 person spa and dry sauna which is great after a day on the slopes. Summit ridge is in a great ski in, ski out location too. You need to prebook your snow mobile transport to the loading bay 24 hours in advance. We were not informed of this but we're lucky we could fit in with other guests who had prebooked it. The accomodation is child friendly and all the staff are friendly. Anne, the hostess, allowed us to checkout an hour late as there was not anyone coming in to our room immediately - she is extremely friendly and warm. We will definitely be back.

reviews.title: Best thing was the food!!
reviews.text: The best thing about this place is the food - world class and consitently brillant!! The rooms however are another story - average at best - no way are the mezzanine rooms 4.5 stars - old and dated and not at all comforatable. However, I can't say enough about the restaurant here - truly sensational - we had a package that included a 2 course dinner every night and as there were 4 of us, we worked our way through the menu during our 6 night stay - not a dud to be found!! Would stay there again for the food alone!! Falls Creek in general was a nice place, and the skiiing was surprisingly good, however there needs to be a general attitude adjustment with regards to service provision all round as most service was provided with disinterest and surliness (talking oversnow drivers, shop staff etc NOT the staff at Summit Ridge) which really is unacceptable considering the high prices of everything at Australian snow resorts

reviews.title: Fantastic stay
reviews.text: We spent a week at Summit Ridge and had a fantastic stay. Anne met us when we arrived and was friendly and accommodating. Her husband Keith often had a quick chat with us by the fire and was extremely friendly. The staff were excellent - Kelly, Jordan and Frankie - nothing was too much trouble. We could not possibly fault their service. The food was exceptional - dinners were amazing. We tried each item on the menu and our plates were always clean.
