Food was sourced from local ingredients and the house made bread was something we looked forward to. The chef would always send out a pre-dinner and pre-dessert item which was a nice touch. A great breakfast menu was on offer with a variety of hot items as well as cereals/yoghurt/toast/juice/tea/coffee which was great before a big day on the slopes. if you left here hungry - there is something wrong. Rooms were clean and cosy. Comfortable king size bed. Tiny bit of noise from kitchen fan below but certainly not enough to irritate or keep you awake. Thanks everyone for a fantastic stay.

reviews.title: Some days in life can be just perfect.
reviews.text: Some days in life can be perfect...But for that you need to be in the perfect time - AT the perfect place - so was our Summit Ridge experience. With the underlying luxury of everything being thought of in advance, service and hospitality would definitely rate five star but a delicate, easy and efficient guest care from Anne and Keith rates ten stars. Restaurant food and service is brilliant, it's ambience enchanting. Fireplace, wine and music with fine taste. Comfortable beds, clean, warm and comfy spaces. We had spectacular views from the bed window in a mezzanine suite. We stayed in skiing season and had lots of snow. My 5 year old enjoyed every minute spend here, he was impressed with the access to all the entraining gadgets in the TV area. I look forward to many more visits to come.

reviews.title: Amazing holiday
reviews.text: We stayed at Summit Ridge for a 3 night mid week break. When looking for a hotel Keith emailed me back within 1/2hr of asking for a quote and was so helpful and friendly before we had even booked with them. They were so helpful when we stay at the hotel and nothing was too much for them! THe location was perfect for us with our 2 little ones!

reviews.title: Good time
reviews.text: We stayed for 5 days with 4 days skiing and had a good stay at Alpine Lodge. We enjoyed the bed on the mezzanine, we had no problem with the ladder but this might be an issue for some. It was definately an older fit out but was roomy and confortable enough for us, plenty of storage. Anne and Keith were friendly and helpful as were all the staff. The storage and drying room was great, toasty warm before going out each day. Getting to it was a bit tricky with the melting snow but manageable ( we got the hang of it by the 3rd day), it was great to have an almost ski in/out ( snow dependant) option as well a very close shuttle stop. The evenings were lovely with an excellent wine selection ( and happy hour) and amazing food with a good variety, very classy. The atmosphere was fun and friendly a real ski lodge feel. We really had a lovely time and can definately recommend, we will be back for sure.

reviews.title: Perfect Weekend Away
reviews.text: We stayed 3 nights at Summit Ridge. The location was fantastic, was perfectly situated for skiing on and off the slopes. Everyone was lovely, Keith & Anne were very hospitable and our waitress Penny-Lane made our evening dining even more enjoyable! The reviews are true, the food and wine is incredible. Just be sure not to arrive too late in the evening :)

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: We come every year to Summit Ridge and it keeps getting better and better. The location is great which allows for easy ski in and ski out. The restaurant is the highlight. The food is exquisite. The best thing about this place is the owners and staff. They are friendly and welcoming. Exactly what you need when on a break.

reviews.title: Warm & welcoming
reviews.text: Greeted by Keith on arrival with a warm welcome. The Lodge was fantastic. Our room was modern with a huge bathroom. Fantastic views from the large windows. The spa & sauna were the best place to be after spending the day outside to help iron out the kinks & tired muscles. Rates are great & would highly recommend this place.

reviews.title: From the minute we arrived to the time we left, it was absolutely perfect.
reviews.text: The hosts and staff at Summit Ridge were outstanding!!! They were welcoming, warm and nothing was too much trouble. The rooms and facilities were excellent.The included breakfast was fabulous. Perfect start to a day on the mountain. Coming home and relaxing by the fire with a nice glass of red, before enjoying an award winning meal in the cosy restaurant was a highlight. The ski in ski out location is fantastic and we can't recommend Summit Ridge highly enough, we will definitely be back.

reviews.title: Great Staff & Location
reviews.text: We stayed with two young kids.(8&11) The rooms are smallish but there is a shared area for the kids as well as a lodge spa which my kids loved. The food was fantastic and the staff very friendly. The location is great as even though the roads were cleared when we stayed the shuttle stop is right next door so not far to walk in ski boots and we skied back to the lodge at the end of the day. We slept well as we were tired from a full day's skiing. Would stay again.

reviews.title: Bonus: Dessert included with the main course
reviews.text: Summit Ridge staff were welcoming and friendly. Our meal was delicious including the dessert special in the attached photo. The large fireplace added to the relaxed, warm atmosphere. Glad we booked ... we got the last available table.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: We stayed here at the beginning of the snow season and had the place to ourselves. Keith and Ann really looked after us. The room was cosy, the spa was hot, but the highlight was the dinner each night - every dish we tried was fantastic. I highly recommend Summit Ridge and can't wait to go back.

reviews.title: Like returning home!
reviews.text: A home away from home. We just adore this place. Anne and Keith are the hosts with the most. If you are looking for a place which the kiddlets and parents will just love, look no further. The food is amazing too, missing the place already! Jackie and Penny were the icing on the cake! Will certainly be back for round three.

reviews.title: Good location, but a few issues...
reviews.text: The best thing about Summit Ridge is definitely the location and the dining area which features in the photos on their website. However the rooms are basic, and we had a few 'issues' such as being unable to get wireless from our room, and feeling like we were imposing somewhat by requesting a vegetarian alternative to their 'all meat' menu. Staff were generally great apart from one less than helpful person on our last day there, which was a shame. Very accessible from the ski field but be aware that there are a few logistical issues in gettting a lot of gear up on oversnow transport.

reviews.title: What a gem among the snow
reviews.text: This hotel has very friendly staff, especially the manager. The room was cozy room, fireplace, wonderful snow view outside the windows. Snuggling in bed or walking in the snowy road was a wonderful experience! I want to go back! Do book well ahead with them though.

reviews.title: Over promised , under delivered
reviews.text: They sell it as a 4 and a half star resort.The rooms are 2 to 3 star at best, mezzanine style , VERY SMALL, and very dated. Frankly a shade above backpacker standard in my opinion. The resturant is the only thing this property has going for it and even that is over hyped by managment. Service is inconsistant, Wendy is nice however the less said about Simon the better. Given the price vs the standardMy advise would be , stay elswhere and check in to the resturant while your up there.

reviews.title: Fabulous hospitality and food
reviews.text: We stayed 3 nights in late July, and had the best family holiday ever. The hotel was really lovely, and the hosts were just amazing. We were made welcome on arrival, and they did a great job of making a personal service, but without being invasive. The restaurant was great, and they were flexible about getting us in for early dinners, and making minor adjustments to the menu to accomodate our 3 year old son. The room was clean and bright, with a huge King bed, and a pull out sofa bed on the ground floor section. The pull out was good, but perhaps a bit small for more than one person. The drying room for ski gear was very well kitted out, and convenient to access. We will definitely be going back, and, if we had known how much we would enjoy the holiday, we definitely would have booked a full week away.

reviews.title: Great choice for Falls Creek
reviews.text: We stayed at Summit Ridge in July 18 during a very good ski season. It is located on one of the higher streets in Falls close to a snow cat stop and would be no problem skiing from the lodge down to Slalom plaza. We were in a comfortable mezzanine room with our son, it was well heated and had good warm showers,although a little small. The hosts Keith and Anne and all the staff were very friendly and professional and the ski facilities were perfectly adequate. No review of Summit Ridge would be complete though without mentioning the restaurant. The breakfasts were just what you needed for a day of skiing - wholesome and nourishing, equal to an upmarket cafe, but with bonus mountain view. The dinners were delicious creations that were sometimes so beautifully presented it felt a shame to eat them. We had a lovely stay and highly recommended

reviews.title: Food Lovers Delight
reviews.text: We stayed for a week in early September. We had the 2 course dinner and breakfast package. The food was amazing, the best on the mountain. Anne, Keith and the staff were very friendly and couldn't do enough for you. The rooms have everything, tv, fridge, wifi. They are only small but you're only sleeping in them. The facilities are great, large drying/change room, sauna and spa, lounge area with open fire for pre dinner drinks. While we couldn't ski down to the lift at this time of year, the shuttle stops right outside and you can still ski back to across the road from the front door. Overall a perfect place for a couple to stay.

reviews.title: Perfect in every way.
reviews.text: Thank you Anne and Keith and Merrin for making our family holiday so perfect. As a family we hadn't been away together for 17 years and with a little one (2 year old) in tow we weren't' exactly sure how it would all go. With 5 of us we chose a mezzanine suite and a double room and it was perfect. My only little concern and certainly not a criticism is the ladder type stairs to go up to our top floor. Whilst our little one was never left unattended we had to set some firm rules about going near the stair opening. We used a lounge cushion as a door on the stairs, but a little gate would have been handy. The bathroom was huge and reading some of the other reviews I'd like to say that we didn't have any trouble with the water temperature. The location is great and made it easy to walk or ski to other locations. The restaurant was outstanding and our only criticism of that was that the food was so delicious that we couldn't decide what to have each night. After our first visit to the restaurant we found that they always had a table set up for us with the high chair and were very amenable in getting food out quickly for the child and making sure that she got her ice cream with topping. We enjoyed our friendly chats with Anne, Keith and Merran and our little one loved Merran so much that she would race in and give her a big hug. The friendly, comfortable service was outstanding and I would recommend Summit Ridge to anyone.

reviews.title: Welcoming,Comfortable with Sensational Dining
reviews.text: I have just returned from a weekend stay at Summit Ridge with family and friends. Whilst the decor in my room was somewhat dated, it was very clean, comfortable and had a beautiful view. I found the staff to be incredibly pleasant and helpful. The highlight of the stay would have to be my evenings spent in the restaurant. Each evening started with a leisurely drink lounging in front of the fire, followed by an exceptional dining experience with superb food and wine.

reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: Well appointed, first class food and service. Good location. Friendly staff. Would not hesitate in staying here again. Anne was very welcoming on our arrival and nothing was too much trouble for the staff.

reviews.title: fabulous food
reviews.text: We stayed in a mez room for 3 nights. Great location with ski in/out. Helpful and friendly staff and the food was sensational. I am a Cordon Bleu trained cook and I could not fault our dinners - truly delicious and a good wine list. The Mez room are smaller than they look on the net and a very steep ladder. Comfortable king size bed but the decor a little dated - some fresh white linen and larger towels could go a long way! Bathroom basic standard motel/hotel style but the bath is not full length for the tall folk like me. We had a white-out, windy day so did not go up the mountain and got an in- house massage which was pricey ( as you would expect ) but very good. TV VERY SMALL and not great reception but you can cope with that. Breakfast was fine and generally a nice warm atmosphere it was a shame you could not relax in front of the fire during the day as the dining room/sitting area is closed after breakfast until the evening. One thing that drove me mad was the Beatles music at every breakfast! There is another small, lounge for guests but not that cosy. I would certainly go again - not 5 * but very comfortable and good on all fronts.

reviews.title: Spectacular Summit Ridge 😊
reviews.text: My partner and I stayed for four nights during the school holidays. The moment we walked in we could feel the great vibes and hospitality. The room was clean, comfortable, had everything we needed, and great views! When we sat down for dinner that night we were so glad that we had opted in for the 2 course dinner and breakfast option. The food was absolutely amazing!! Service was fantastic too. We also took advantage of the spa and sauna after the slopes each day. Thank you for an excellent holiday! We will definitely be back.

reviews.title: A great escape
reviews.text: We had a fantastic stay (2 nights) here. Clean and comfy rooms, with a cozy common area featuring a wood fire. Very affordable too. The owners went out of their way to make us feel at home. Will definitely be back!

reviews.title: Astonishing, Full Board almost makes the skiing/boarding a side show
reviews.text: Our first of what will be many stays at Summit Ridge was memorable in the best of ways. We would be delighted to find a restaurant of this standard in Melbourne but the ingredients, balance, preparation and creativity found here tucked up in the Falls village is quite remarkable. In reputation SR’s restaurant is the best in resort, and that’s saying something when a couple of others are good. Best for our young kids an early 5:30pm sitting, but you need to book in advance (at breakfast). The pick of the menu during our stay was the unbelievably good Duck that narrowly pips other wonderful dishes like the Char-grilled Scotch Fillet and Lamb Rump. Great available wines were available to compliment dinner. The complimentary tasters between courses were a lovely touch. It was easy to linger over their generous cooked breakfast with all the menu options you could wish for, good coffee and a wonderful view down the mountain. The inviting lounge open fire and comfortable sofas made for cosy pre-dinner drinks. Other aspects were the view from our room windows, a well ordered system of separate ski and warm drying rooms and having shuttle stop 6 right outside. Being situated on the highest road in the village makes for reliable easy ski in and out, easy ski down to Slalom Plaza. The location is a short walk to the quieter Village Bowl with brand new Summit Chair and awesome coffee and sunny windows of the Be Foodstore. The friendly staff were warm, welcoming and considerate. The in-room bath was great for kids and the spa/sauna were a hit. The renovated rooms were not large but clean and well equiped, more than comfortable. My only fault was to find the hot water in short supply briefly at 5:30 but it was kids bath time so not surprising.

reviews.title: Worth it in every way!
reviews.text: Summit ridge is one of those places that is exceptional in all areas. The restaurant, lounge and staff are warm and inviting.... the food is off the charts, amazing. We have stayed at Summit ridge in 2013, 2014 and this year only had one day free to travel to Falls Creek but had to make a special stop for dinner at Summit Ridge. It was worth it in every way. Thank you to Keith, Anne and your team for providing such an exceptional experience every time. We would highly recommend staying, dining, visiting here if you have the chance. See you next year!

reviews.title: Good for short stay, but not very good for ski in ski out
reviews.text: We came here for ski, but we have wrong idea about the location, it took us at least 15 minutes to drag our ski equipment to close ski lift. It's not recommendable to stay if you do want to have lots of fun on snow sport. It's very dangerous for people to walk down to their ski equipment storage area since they don't allow people to walk into their resort, My husband fell down once to pick up my snowboard, fortunately it didn't course any injure. Room is all right, food is fantastic. Came back again ?? if we don't want to do any ski activities.

reviews.title: Lovely Alpine Atmosphere
reviews.text: Had dinner here two nights and thoroughly enjoyed the ambiance, friendly service and delicious food. Too many establishments at Falls Creek value uninviting hipness in service and atmosphere. Summit Ridge know what people want after a long day on the slopes and are happy to provide it - warmth and hospitality at a reasonable cost.

reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text: This is one of the friendliest, most welcoming places that we have ever stayed. Upon arrival we were treated by name like missing friends. I mentioned that it was our wedding anniversary when we arrived and were surprised at dinner with a "Happy Anniversary" plate of home made chocolates. Our room was clean and pleasant and guests could use a washing machine and dryer complete with washing powder at no extra charge - very handy for washing smelly ski socks at the end of a long day skiing. The food at the restaurant was excellent, well priced and the wine list extensive and of fine quality. Our rooms slept two, which was great for us as our kids are older and had their own bunk rooms. Thoroughly enjoyed every minute of our stay and we are looking forward to going back next year.

reviews.title: Very Good value
reviews.text: First timers at Falls Creek, we had a front facing mezzanine suite next to the family lounge, rather than the rear room requested but the room was quiet despite the Lodge being fully booked( although there were very few children there) and the view to the front was also attractive in heavy snow. Rooms have adjustable heating so not over warm, the location is good with ski rental very close, ski in and out, several close eating options, and all in a much nicer spot than the lift areas. See my separate review of their excellent restaurant. Good facilities and very good value compared to some much pricier apartment options we considered.

reviews.title: Frequent Flyer
reviews.text: I've been to Summit Ridge a few times now and I keep coming back so they are certainly doing more than one thing right! The mountain location is amazing, the place is very tidy and the facilities available are of top standard. The service and value for money couldn't be better and the restaurant has the best steak i've ever tasted. I highly recommend Summit Ridge to you and know you won't be disappointed.

reviews.title: Not bad
reviews.text: We stayed at Summit Ridge in 2006, and for the price we expected it to be very comfortable. Overall it wasn't bad, the food was very good, the room was OK, a little pokey and the stairs to the mezzanine could be a bit tricky to negotiate with sore legs. The service was a little let down at times. We too had a run in with Simon, over fresh towels, he be impolite at times. And on occasion we found ourselves waiting for a long time for drink orders, eventually having to cancel them. The final problem was the location of our room was directly over the kitchen and you could here kitchen noise (coldroom door) until the restaurant closed. All in all, not major problems. Other than that we really enjoyed ourselves here, with good snow it is a good ski in/ski out spot, the ski storage area is convenient and dinners were quite romantic with great atmosphere and views of the falling snow. Wendy was a very good hostess, all up we would go back to stay at the Summit Ridge again.

reviews.title: A wonderful experience
reviews.text: We had a 5 day stay in Summit Ridge with our two kids, 5 &6. We found the staff very welcoming and friendly. The food was truely incredible and kids were well catered for too. The rooms were nice, the pull out couch for the kids a bit hard but for the littlies it didn't matter, our bed was fine. The facilities were great ( easy storage plus drying room for all the winter gear and nice sitting room). We had a great stay, would recommend ++

reviews.title: Don't expect any sleep
reviews.text: Our stay was a horrible experience. The rooms downstairs are under the kitchen and restaurant. The noise from these is unrelenting and loud and goes til well past 1030pm and starts again early morning. We were unable to get much sleep due to the noise. The lounge area with the open fireplace is also very rarely open for use. Consider carefully before booking

reviews.title: Best snow experience in Aus
reviews.text: 3rd year here and always great! Friendly warm ski lodge. Fantastic food and great wine selection. Relexing by the fire or in a spa after day of skiing is best. Common area is well stocked with DVD's games and books so family won't be bored on bad weather days.

reviews.title: P.Penner
reviews.text: My grandkids aged 10-14 stayed here while visiting. They said it was the best Hotel they ever stayed in. From the warm welcome from Kaffi to their excellent breakfast that actually gave them choices they don’t usually have as kids with allergies. They had a wonderful time in the pool and on the waterslides, the hotel was clean and comfortable.

reviews.title: Quiet, relaxing, fun, great breakfast!
reviews.text: We stayed here over Christmas with our four kids, we all had a great time in the pool, slide was a BIG hit and the hot tub was nice & hot!! Rooms were very clean and quiet. Our kids also enjoyed the free high speed internet and spent lots of time on u-tube. The breakfast was fresh and very tasty, loved the all day free coffee, teas, hot chocolate and popcorn! Super 8 was great!

reviews.title: Our Stay at Rimbey's Super 8
reviews.text: We had a great stay. The rooms were very clean, and fresh. The staff went above and beyond to get us on to the bottom floor where there was access to the parking lot for smoking. Exceptional stay.

reviews.title: Stay in Rimbey
reviews.text: We stayed a couple nites in association with a Balloon Festival that was held in Rimbey. I understand this hotel was one of the sponsors. We had a great time. The service was bar none. Rooms were super clean. Staff were extremely friendly and curtious. would gladly stay there again,.Only draw back is there is no restaurant close just a A&W. and the restaurants in town closed up early.

reviews.title: Excellent Stay in Rimbey!
reviews.text: The service was amazing and the rooms were very roomy and clean. We traveled with our small children and the ladies made us feel at home by providing a crib, bedding and catering to our picky 3 year old's needs at breakfast time! We will definitely stay there again!

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: The staff was super friendly. (Even as they said no drinking in the pool area. Lol) Never have I ever had a stay in a hotel that ALL of the staff was this nice. Rooms were clean and bright! Continental breakfast was also tasty.

reviews.title: This was my best motel that I ever stayed at...staff was...
reviews.text: This was my best motel that I ever stayed at...staff was phenominal...couldn't ask for anything better

reviews.title: Business
reviews.text: Although this was a one night stay, I was welcomed warmly, room was clean, and they also hosted a dinner as a client appreciation. I especially appreciated the constant supply of hot/cold beverages, fruit and the goodies i.e. popcorn. Good value for the price.

reviews.title: Ministry ambassador
reviews.text: Only went to A and W which is attached To Hotel. Love A & W Had an uncle Berger, onion rings and Root bear Nice staff Ate inside the a and w Did not have 2 for 1 coupons Really filling meal Not busy in restaurant

reviews.title: One of the best places we have ever stayed!
reviews.text: The rooms were nothing fancy, but very clean and the cleaning staff was wonderful. The check in staff was great (especially Larry!) and this was generally overall a great experience. This is the 2nd time we stayed there and will be going back! So funny to see such a great place in the middle of no where! But sure am glad it is there. We have a family reunion at Gull Lake and alot of us stay here, especially with kids to use the pool and hot tub. Pet friendly and if you can, book a room on the ground floor and your door will lead you right outside! Good food area. Can't say enough good things.

reviews.title: great it was all good a a a a as a a a a a a a a a a a a a...
reviews.text: great it was all good a a a a as a a a a a a a a a a a a a a a a a a a a a a a a a a a a a a a a a a a

reviews.title: Lovely experience for the family
reviews.text: We have had an excellent and highly enjoyable stay in this hotel. The daily continental breakfast is delicious, and hot meal selection varies daily. It is close to town, with many things for families to do and activities to keep the kids busy. The hotel is spacious and bright, and the staff are amazing. Katie in housekeeping took it upon herself to make the stay more comfortable for my two children by creating little 'sleeping bags' out of the bedding on the bed that they shared. We were all very impressed and grateful. Definitely the place to stay in central Alberta!

reviews.title: Very good motel
reviews.text: Staff very good and friendly like always..love this place.. always clean Would recommend this place to anyone who in the rimbey area as its always a lovely place 😉😉 Rimbey nice community with lots of good shopping experience

reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: Friendly greeting at front desk Room clean King size bed Clean bathroom with soap shampoo etc Location great Very good breakfast fruit waffles toast coffee juice or tea everything was fresh Popcorn machine with popcorn in the evening Good parking Well lit at night

reviews.title: Beware: Will not accept cancellation with 15 days notice. Unacceptable
reviews.text: We booked Rimbey SUPER 8 hotel over the phone a couple of months ago for the end of July as we live overseas and planned on attending a wedding in the area. We provided our credit card information as we thought they would process a "pre-authorized" order , not post and charge the account. Today we tried to call to cancel the reservation and after going through 4 reps and nearly one hour on the telephone we had no success. Each rep claimed to pass our complaint on to their superior but we never reached a manager even after several requests. Finally, one representative said that they were unable to process cancellation because our booking was "non-cancellable". We stated that we never heard of such a policy and that we were never informed that this was a non-cancellable booking. After all, why would we agree to this when everyone knows you can make reservation and cancel it if's done within a reasonable time. We called 2 weeks in advance just to be told that we are not eligible to receive our money back. When we provided our credit card, we were under the impression that we were simply providing card information for blocking the amount from our card. We have since learned that they had processed our credit card as a "sale" and not as a "pre-authorization". Bottom line: We are going to complain to our credit card company and request to have the charge reversed. Warning: Be careful when dealing with Super 8. Even when you call their call centre, they sound like the classic "Magic Water" salesman. In our opinion, there is nothing "Super" about Super 8.

reviews.title: WOW !! Best hotel in the area
reviews.text: The staff accomadated several families from various parts of the province, in a very professional curteous and compassionate manner. We have spent a great number of nights in hotels throughout the world and have never been treated better. The best experience in a lot of years. Thank you from all parties in this group. I am sure everyone will be back.

reviews.title: Thanks for great stay at your hotel
reviews.text: I was one of the pilots staying at your hotel during the balloon event this spring. The hotel and the hospitality of the staff was absolutely wonderful. They were such clean rooms and comfortable beds. Having the use of the briefing room at your hotel for our event was a real treat. The staff went out of their way to give us excellent service. I appreciate all you did for us and hope I can be invited back to enjoy another stay at your hotel.

reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.text: Stayed here for one night while on business. I was surprized at how nice it was. Popcorn when I arrived and the room was really nice, clean and new. I did use the hot tub and pool and they were great. There is an A&W attached if you need to grab a bite to eat. Breakfast was OK and they did waffles. I will stay here the next time I am in Rimbey.

reviews.title: Happy Happy Happy
reviews.text: Our family just had our second annual 'Christmas Party at our local Super 8. Everything went so well last year that we decided to do it again. This venue is perfect for us to combine our family/staff Christmas Party. The staff is knowledgable and friendly. The breakfast was awesome. The meeting room is practically sound proof (which is important for our family group of 30+). We enjoy a potluck supper which works well in the banquet room because it has a kitchen sink, mini frig, tables, chairs and TV/DVD as well as our own private full bathroom. We all had rooms which were comfortable, clean and closely located to the meeting room as well as use of the pool. The family loves the larger swimming pool, hot tub and giant water slide. Just a terrific experience all around. Thanks you Super 8 staff!!! See you next year.

reviews.title: awesome
reviews.text: Our stay was great the motel was clean and well maintained all the staff were friendly and courteous. We look forward to coming back soon.

reviews.title: Rimby
reviews.text: Overall good experience, the pillows labelled Firm were soft, and the soft ones were firm, but we figured it out!

reviews.title: Accommodations Super 8 Rimbey
reviews.text: . My stay in Rimbey was work related. Early to bed and early to rise to get to the work site 50 kms away. Arriving back at the motel, the room was always clean and desk clerk always phoned to see if everything was OK. Not too many places do that.

reviews.title: Above and beyond
reviews.text: We recently stayed at Canalta Rimbey. Gabrielle met us in a very friendly and efficient manner as we checked in. Just minutes after arriving in our room, we received a phone call from her welcoming us and thanking us for choosing Canalta and wanted to ensure everything was OK with the room and let us know to be sure to call if we needed anything. As it turned out, the room had an unpleasant odor in it and she promptly had us a new, odor free room. (Perhaps a pet had soiled the carpet or something) We were attending the National Equestrian Vaulting Competition, and due to the judges delayed flight, it went longer than anticipated and we missed getting dinner before every restaurant in town was closed for the night. Katie was so helpful and concerned for us that she pulled out some of the breakfast items to satisfy our hunger before our heading to bed. She seemed genuinely interested in us and wanted us to share video of the girls performances with her the next night. We were so impressed with the booking process and generous cancellation policy as well as the super friendly and helpful staff. The pool and slide are great, and of course, who doesn't love A&W? We'd definitely recommend it to others.

reviews.title: Business trip to Rimbey
reviews.text: Nice clean room, nice hot tub, friendly and helpful staff. I will stay here the next time I am in Rimbey.

reviews.title: Very impressed with this hotel located in Rimbey - great...
reviews.text: Very impressed with this hotel located in Rimbey - great management and staff very friendley and concerened. Rooms very clean and accomodating.

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: What an excellent hotel! The rooms are spacious, very clean. The pool is wonderful, hot breakfast every morning. Hotel staff was incredible. Only suggestion I would offer is to lower the temperature on the hot tub.

reviews.title: clean rooms comfy beds
reviews.text: over all was great but Pool room was very cold ,continental breakfast is not long enough nor was there selection or variety

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: Rooms were clean and quiet, beds were comfortable, pool had fresh water, hot tub had the right temperature, water slide was fun and fast, breakfast was better than the usual muffins and cereal, Connie and the staff were excellent. We plan on staying there again next year.

reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: My family and I stayed in Rimbey in July and loved it. The room was perfect for us and very clean and comfortable. We forgot to pack swimsuits but if we come back we definitely will! Breakfast was very good and the staff was all friendly. Great stay, thank you!

reviews.title: The cleanest I have ever seen at any motel
reviews.text: The girls at front desk were the most friendliest and helpful to us when we needed help with the computer room

reviews.title: Best Super 8 Ever
reviews.text: TheWife, usually very picky, said this was the very best Super 8 stay ever. Everything was as expected or better, and Konnie and the rest of the staff were excellent. We'll be back with the balloons next year!

reviews.title: Rimbey Super 8
reviews.text: Room was clean, updated (furniture/decorating), nice little kitchen area in our room with small fridge/stove burners. Continental breakfast was great.

reviews.title: Attending a family wedding in Rimbey and this hotel was...
reviews.text: Attending a family wedding in Rimbey and this hotel was convenient. Although the original room we had reserved wasn't available we were satisfied with the option. Staff was pleasant and welcoming.

reviews.title: The Best Super 8!!
reviews.text: We chose to stay at this hotel because of a school activity. I was hesitant because of a previous Super 8 stay we had in Red Deer that was not very good. However this was by far the most clean, friendly, accommodating Super 8 I have stayed at. The staff welcomed us with homemade cookies for the students and invited the adults for complimentary tea or coffee in the warm sitting area where they had the Olympics on the big screen! The complimentary breakfast was wonderful especially being able to make your own granola parfait's! Would stay here again and again!

reviews.title: Excellent stay....
reviews.text: We stayed over the August long weekend for a reunion in Bluffton. The hotel was great location and was great over all....nice spread for breakfast, comfy and clean rooms and great Pool which was clean and lots of fun for the kids! The only minor hassle we had was to have our keys redone pretty much every day! Not that big of a deal. Front staff and housekeepers very friendly. Nice to use bbq one evening too!

reviews.title: Excellent - 4th stay!
reviews.text: Clean hotel, awesome staff, good breaky and overall wonderful place. We stay here every time our family has a reunion and consider it our second home! Can't go wrong. Also great pool for the kids (and adults!).

reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel last week, the wonderful staff went above and beyond for us as we were there for a funeral. We were offered a compassionate discount for our stay there and just treated royally while we were there. Pet friendly too, YEAH! The rooms are clean and the beds are very comfortable, the kids loved the popcorn they made most of the day, and the water slide. We will definitely stay there again if ever in Rimbey, quaint little town!! Thank you to the front desk staff and the chambermaids for all your great service!

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Awesome hotel was there visiting my spouse as he was staying there for work he was running late ft desk clerk shauna was helpful interesting good conversation till he was off work 😊☺clean great rm great breakfast will come bk

reviews.title: Accommodates Hockey Families
reviews.text: We were one of two hockey teams that stayed here this past weekend. The hotel is clean, comfortable and the staff are awesome. Shout out to ALL staff especially Kaffi. Pool was very clean as well. Lots available for breakfast and if that doesn’t work for you A&W is attached to the hotel. They have a decent size meeting room (lots of tables and chairs) that we were able to use which had a massive dry erase board....good for a few games of Win, Lose or Draw.

reviews.title: We were very happy with the hotel. Clean rooms, excellent...
reviews.text: We were very happy with the hotel. Clean rooms, excellent breakfast, great service! We chose it for the "three double bed" room option which worked perfectly for us. Would definitely return!

reviews.title: 5 Star Hotel in Rimbey! Exceeds expectations!
reviews.text: I was one of the pilots flying in the First Annual Hot Air Affair Ballooning event in Rimbey. The people of Rimbey were friendly, courteous and kind. The town was a pleasure to fly in and over. The Super 8 motel exceeded my expectations. This is the nicest Super 8 I have seen and ever stayed in. The hotel and the hospitality of the staff was top notch. If you are visiting Rimbey or passing through and looking for a place to stay and relax this is the top choice. Thank you Rimbey Super 8 and Konnie Meissner for your customer service excellence! B

reviews.title: Who knew the service could be so amazing in small town Rimbey!
reviews.text: I arrived at 7:30 am - and did not think Id get into my room before my conference but Connie set me up right away - even upgrading me - which was such a nice treat to be able clean up and get ready in the room prior to hosting a training session there all day. Then at the end of the night - we were talking about how our popcorn was going to be dinner and Katie overheard us. She got us left over food from the client appreciation dinner - we could not have been happier!! The staff here are so kind and so helpful. Thanks ladies for making a not super exciting stay in Rimbey a lovely one!!!

reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: We stayed here for a hockey tournament and it was perfect for us. We had a room that had a separate sitting area from the bed, which was great when having little ones. The pool and waterslide were a hit with the kids, and there is usually a hot tub, which was under maintenance at that time. The breakfast in the morning was really good! Hot items, eggs, waffles, and lots of cold choices. Great buffet, and what made it even better was that they kept the buffet open later than usual to accommodate some of the players who hadn't made it down yet for breakfast. Terrific customer service! Would definitely stay there again!

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Our room was amazing. Separate bedroom divided by french doors. weren't expecting this. Awesome breakfast!! Loved the waffle maker! and the little extras that some continental breakfasts don't have. A great experience. Will definitely stay again.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Cleaning staff talked loudly outside my room at 6:30 am Went to breakfast at 8:20 (end time for breakfast is 9), and the ham and eggs were empty and not restocked. When leaving the pool, a staff member approached my children (ages 14, 11 & 9) and asked them if they were going to run in the halls...I didn't appreciate them being approached for a crime not committed.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: I stay here 5 nights a week it’s a home away from home the staff are very nice the rooms are always clean and quiet you get a great breakfast and like dinner three time a week Rimbey is also a very cool town with everything you need so if you find yourself stuck in a snow storm definitely check your self into the Rimbey canalta

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: The hospitality was always something to look forward to in my week stay here, karrie was extremely friendly and fun to talk to. The food was delicious every morning and every dinner that was was served, would definitely stay again!!!

reviews.title: Fantastic hotel :)
reviews.text: We stayed at the Super 8 in Rimbey in June 2012. The room was clean and spacious. The staff were all friendly and helpful. The pool area was clean and well maintained (and the waterslide goes really fast !! LOL). The room was quiet and the hotel was very well kept. We enjoyed the free breakfast (with lots of choices) in the morning. We really enjoyed our stay at the Rimbey Super 8 and would definitely choose this hotel again if we were in the area.

reviews.title: Great accomodations
reviews.text: We were pleasantly surprised to find this great hotel in Rimbey. The staff were very accomodating and the room was great.

reviews.title: My great stay at Super 8
reviews.text: My recent stay at Super 8 was great! I spent 13 nights at this Rimbey Alberta location and glad I stayed here. The service was friendly and helpfull, and the rooms couldn't have been cleaner each day. I look forward to staying at this location again, work or pleasure. Thank you.

reviews.title: OVER AND ABOVE PERSONALIZED SERVICE
reviews.text: From the moment we arrived Karrie at the front desk welcomed us and treated us like family. She called us by name and truly understands what great customer service is all about. The entire stay was great and i would recommend the Canalta to anyone travelling in that area. Colin S.

reviews.title: Life's Great at the Rimbey Super 8!!!
reviews.text: Very much enjoyed my stay at the Rimbey Super 8. The staff was very helpful and understanding to meeting all of our needs. Looking forward to returning!!!

reviews.title: Nice place to stay
reviews.text: Rooms are fantastic. They are big, clean, huge tall ceilings, good TV. No menu for TV, but they have a cheat sheat for stations, but nothing for programs.

reviews.title: Being Spoiled at The Super 8!
reviews.text: This is my first time staying at The Super 8 and I would highly recommend it to anyone! The hotel staff is very friendly, helpful and always available when you need them! They show enthusiasm for their job & treat you like you are a guest in their home, always going the extra mile to make you feel comfortable and welcome. I love staying healthy and found the amenities to be challenging and perfect for me to stay on top of my excercise schedule. I enjoy the energy at the hotel and look forward to the friendly smiles I receive every morning that start my day off just right! Thank you Super 8 staff for making my stay a wonderful one!

reviews.title: Super 8 weekend
reviews.text: Was pleasently surprised at the excellent quality of the hotel. Breakfast is super! Will stay again.

reviews.title: Very clean and comfortable hotel. Staff were very...
reviews.text: Very clean and comfortable hotel. Staff were very accommodating. Didn't stay for the breakfast so can't remark on that.

reviews.title: Home
reviews.text: Katie, you are a ray of sunshine in the early morning and what a fabulous breakfast!!! I really enjoyed meeting you!😀. See you soon. Super 8 is blessed to have you. Rooms are clean, feels like home away from home. Staff is accommodating friendly, and fun😊. The breakfast is great and lots of selection, hotel has a bright cheery feel, with a great exercise room and pool. Would definitely be back😀

reviews.title: Great property, fabulous staff
reviews.text: Spent the weekend at the Canalta with our hockey team. The manager, Konnie was fantastic to deal with to secure our group booking and we appreciated the extras they provided to us. All of the other staff were extremely pleasant and helpful. The hotel rooms are very clean and nicely set up and the pool and waterslide were a hit with the kids. A fabulous stay at the Canalta Rimbey.

reviews.title: Rimbey on Business
reviews.text: For a small town hotel this one exceeds all expectations. Konnie and Pat work very hard to make sure that every guest has a wonderful stay. The rooms are very clean and spacious. Above brand standards and an excellent hotel and staff. Thanks Konnie and Pat for making the stay amazing!

reviews.title: Great Stay during the Rimbey Hot Air Affair
reviews.text: What a great hotel. Rooms are very nice, especially the suite which we were fortunately upgraded to. Comfortable beds!! The staff is wonderful as well, very friendly and we were treated very well. I highly recommend staying at this hotel!

reviews.title: Lovely place
reviews.text: I had the privilege of staying at this Motel and it was absolutely awesome.. Staff were so very friendly as well as the room was just wonderful.. very good place to stay, and would recommend this place to anyone staying in the Rimbey area

reviews.title: Wedding Weekend
reviews.text: My daughters wedding reception was in Rimbey, and based on other Trip Advisor reviews we chose the Canalta to house the family and friends for the weekend. I made numerous calls to book rooms for our guests, change reservations and even to cancel rooms when I overbooked and was always treated like a valued guest. I also appreciated the effort they went to to sign me up for their rewards program because they knew it would net me some great free gift cards! The rooms were spacious and nicely decorated, beds comfy and I am always happy to have the fridge and microwave in the room for convenience. Finally, a fabulous complementary hot breakfast, definitely worth getting up early for! Just a great stay!

reviews.title: great stay
reviews.text: As usual the super 8 in Rimbey was flawless. The staff was friendly and efficient and the room was great. Even though the hotel was full my room was quiet. Breakfast was busy but smooth and well stocked

reviews.title: Great people, great place to stay!
reviews.text: This is a very upscale Super 8. Well appointed, clean, spacious rooms. Large comfortable lobby area where the complimentary breakfast is available. There is a hot tub, water slide and pool, plus meeting rooms. The staff were very attentive to special diet needs and were very friendly and helpful with all requests. This would be our first choice if we were staying again in the area.

reviews.title: Above and Beyond Service
reviews.text: The staff at this establishment was excellent. Katie in Particular was very accommodating to our late night check in and overall demeanour. We had been having lots of fun at a wedding and she made sure that we were fed and watered before we went to bed. The rooms were clean and comfortable and I will definitely be back. Thanks again to Katie and the rest of the Super 8 staff !!!

reviews.title: Very nice hotel
reviews.text: We spent one night slept very well.Really enjoyed the breakfast that comes with the room. The free Wireless internet kept us connected to the world. I would stay here again without even thinking about it.

reviews.title: Every one at the Super 8 is the best and rooms are perfect
reviews.text: I stayed at the super 8 for months and was realy good i will stay there again as long as in Rimbey

reviews.title: Great weekend stay with our hockey team
reviews.text: Great overall stay for our hockey families. All front desk staff, were very kind, courteous, and accommodating. Special thanks to Karrie and Kaffi. Rooms were clean and comfortable, pool/waterslide were great, and the continental breakfast was well stocked with a great variety. Thanks again.

reviews.title: Stayed here for work
reviews.text: I recently stayed here for an extended period of time for work (20 days) and I was impressed. I've stayed in lots of different hotels over the years but this one was very tidy. Great gym, great pool and hot tub area. Friendly staff and a nice atmosphere made my stay enjoyable. The breakfast is your typical hotel food, but it filled my stomach all the same. There is an A&W attached to the hotel so you never have to go far for a quick bite. Overall, very nice and comfortable.

reviews.title: Exceptional Service
reviews.text: I am working in the Rimbey area and inadvertently lost my weekly reservation to one of the town's other "finer" hotels. I was pleasantly surprised by the courteous staff and hospitality at the Canalta Hotel. The rooms are very spacious, well appointed, clean and comfortable. There is a continental breakfast with a different hot food selection every morning. On Wednesday evenings the hotel makes supper for its guests at no charge. The hotel is well appointed with a pool, slide, hot tub and exercise room. A&W is attached to the hotel, and their food is always fresh, hot and fast. Katie and Pat have made me feel very at home at the hotel, and I believe they go out of their way to ensure all their guests are well looked after comfortable at all times. I am enjoying my stay at the Canalta and would truly recommend it to anyone looking for a clean, comfortable hotel at a very reasonable rate.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: The staff is terrific and accommodating. The breakfast is good. The establishment is clean and modern.

reviews.title: Rimbey, AB, Super 8
reviews.text: Internet connect was slow. Great staff- very helpful and knowledgeable. I forgot my mouse and connection cord and staff supplied me with them. Excellent place to stay..Would recommend this motel to anyone going to Rimbey. Don Green, Calgary, AB.

reviews.title: Great hotel with amazing front deck service
reviews.text: Had a wonderful stay and had great service overall. Amazing front deck help. Very helpful and accommodation with everything that we needed help with. Clean big room was a major plus for me and my family during our stay here. Would definitely come and stay in this hotel again

reviews.title: A really pleasant stay
reviews.text: I spent a week here while taking care of some family business and really enjoyed my stay. The staff were outstanding. They really went out of their way to make my stay pleasant. The rooms were clean and comfortable. The hot tub was relaxing and the hotel was quiet. I'll stay here again.

reviews.title: wonderful
reviews.text: we were very much pleased & the staff were pleasant & went out of there way to to help in any way they could . Would highly recommend your facility to anyone.

reviews.title: Very nice but pricey for the locale
reviews.text: The room was very nice and the staff friendly and helpful. The room was very nice and clean. The breakfast in the morning was "okay". There may not have been enough guests to warrant continuous fresh hot foods but there was other choices to make up for the cold rubber eggs and dry cold meats. I was there for a business meeting and if it were not for the group rate offered, which by the way is the regular rate of the Best Western down the road, I probably would not have stayed there. It's a lot more money than the Best Western for the same luxuries. The internet/wifi also crashed in the whole hotel and I had to submit a paper that evening, so that was not very impressive. Fortunately, it was up and running before my deadline. Again the staff was very helpful with that. I was on the ground floor, away from the highway so the room was very nice and quiet. There are work crews staying there but they seem respectful of other guests. Overall I was happy but unless they get some better rates this hotel will not be my first choice.

reviews.title: Good experience
reviews.text: Had a very good stay at this hotel. Very clean. Courteous staff. Our room was by the elevator so a bit noisy when people were getting up to leave early in the morning. Breakfast room was very comfortable and nicely set up with lots of windows and a big TV to see the news. Swimming pool was great. We were disappointed that the hot tub was out of order. Excellent quality hotel for being in a small town. Would stay there again.

reviews.title: Fantastic room
reviews.text: The room was very large and clean.There were 2 queen beds, a settee, arm chair and kitchenette. Paid a little higher price but it was worth it for the comfort. The hotel had a pool and hot tub, and hot continental breakfast. As a special touch, we needed a corkscrew for wine and the desk also supplied wine glasses. We would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Clean and quiet
reviews.text: My room was quiet despite the hotel being full. Complimentary breakfast my coworkers enjoyed. No attached restaurant so we ate in town each evening. Staff was very friendly and helpful! We also rented the banquet room and everything required was provided!

reviews.title: Excellent hotel with friendly agent Karrie to greet us when we got there
reviews.text: This hotel was excellent value. Large rooms, high ceilings, well decorated. Front desk agent Karrie was excellent, making conversation and making everything seamless for us. Constructive Feedback: housekeeping knocked on our door before checkout time, the shower floor was extremely slippery and had no shower mat, the blinds didn't quite block all the light, and the pillowcases were so starchy they bordered on scratchy. We were staying in town for a wedding and felt that even our discounted rate of $129 was a bit expensive for such a small town, being accustomed to rates around $100 for this level of hotel.

reviews.title: We found the staff very helpful and the room was very clean...
reviews.text: We found the staff very helpful and the room was very clean and quiet and easy to get to , we would recommend this hotel to anyone traveling through the area. Gerald & Pat Raspberry

reviews.title: Just like coming home..
reviews.text: The staff are all great, treat us all like we're family!! If you're away on business, coming back to the Rimbey Super 8 is as close to a home away from home as you can get. Thanks for all you do! Lu

reviews.title: Exceeded expectations
reviews.text: I had my wedding reception in Rimbey and most of my family and friends stayed at the hotel. I was very plesantly surprised with everything. The rooms were very nice and the breakfast was great! The kids loved the waterslide.

reviews.title: Always Great
reviews.text: This hotel is extremely clean and the staff always pleasant with a willingness to go above and beyond. A great hot breakfast included!

reviews.title: Hospitable
reviews.text: This is a great place so spend the night. The staff are extremely friendly offering meals and popcorn to guests. Rooms are very clean and spacious. Very close to town. Continental breakfast helps out the low cost of rooms.

reviews.title: Great Super 8
reviews.text: On a two week trip I stayed at super 8 and HOJO hotels all the way for the Wyndom points. This was the most expensive place I stayed, but the three nights I stayed here were by far the nicest experience of the whole trip.

reviews.title: This is my review
reviews.text: I only "hotel it" a few times a year but do recognize when my patronage is appreciated! Right from check in to check out, everything was above par, even compared to other Super 8's I have enjoyed.

reviews.title: Visiting for a wedding
reviews.text: Loved this hotel, staff was very helpful and friendly, room was clean , spacious ,lovely amenities, linens, bed was super comfy, we like a firm mattress. Only thing I would improve on was the towels were kind of rough and not in keeping with the rest of the room. Breakfast was great and the lady very helpful and friendly. Pool looked clean and fun and awesome workout room.

reviews.title: Relaxing time at Super 8 at Rimbey
reviews.text: The hotel looked new, the staff was very friendly and they tried to make our stay as nice and comfortable as possible. Room was clean and nice.I would only say that the lighting of the room should be better. We enjoyed very good breakfast with lots of choices ( waffles, eggs, sausages,cereal, hashbrowns....). After breakfast you can enjoy quite large swimming pool with slide and hot tub. Over all our stay was enjoyable weekend in nice and quiet location of Rimbey, Alberta .

reviews.title: went for a kids hockey tournament and the pool was broke...
reviews.text: went for a kids hockey tournament and the pool was broke which was the whole reason we picked this hotel,our peep hole was reversed so everyone in the hall way could see in our whole room,no privacy,will not stay at a super 8 again.

reviews.title: Awesome staff, nice facility, wi fi was a bit problematic...
reviews.text: Awesome staff, nice facility, wi fi was a bit problematic at times with a poor connection, I would stay here again in a heartbeat.

reviews.title: Hockey
reviews.text: Had a wonderful stay with our hockey team over the weekend. The service from the front desk was amazing and a huge thank you for everything! The kids had a blast on the waterslide and in the pool! Will definitely stay there again!

reviews.title: Overall excellent
reviews.text: Stayed over night this pass week and found the room quite clean, sanitized and overall great value.

reviews.title: Pillows
reviews.text: Great stay. Our basement flooded so we needed somewhere to stay and the Super 8 was our choice. My only complaint is the pillows. They are to thick and hard

reviews.title: Totally exceeded expectations!!!!
reviews.text: From a super check in, friendly staff, clean rooms (comfy bed), an awesome swimming pool to keep my 9 year old happy our weekend ended with a free breakfast!!!! Thank you so much Super 8 we will always stay there if we have to come back to Rimby.

reviews.title: Simply excellent!
reviews.text: Got here from the ferry port after a delayed crossing...over an hour late. It was a pitch dark night and the B&B took a bit of finding, but the directions were sufficient to make sure we didn't get too lost. Iain was waiting for us and welcomed us in, helping with the cases and stuff, and more to the point, offered us a nice cold beer in our room. Just the job! As has been noted on other reviews, the house is spotless, the room we were in was absolutely beautiful - large, spacious well appointed with an impressive bathroom cunningly hidden behind the mirrored wall closet. In the morning the view from the room was beautiful looking out over the airport to the coast, watching the planes fly in literally a few hundred feet away. There's a lovely veranda outside the room, but at 7am at the end of October the weather wasn't exactly conducive to sitting on a deck chair....still, in the summer this would be a beautiful place to relax. Breakfast prepared to order by Iain was excellent ....tasty and filling, and afterwards we had a lovely long chat with Iain and Karen about Stornoway, Lewis and life in general. All in all, we were sorry that we were only there for one night, and would happily make this a base for future trips out to Lewis. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Fabulous B&B by the airport
reviews.text: I stayed here on my own for one night on a business trip. Ian and Karen are so friendly and welcoming and made me feel at home straight away. It is right next to the airport so very handy if you don't know the area. Karen offered me some fresh milk to make some tea which was lovely. The room was lovely and spacious with a balcony and sea view! Breakfast was perfect and is cooked to order. I will definitely return if I am ever on the island again.

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text: Outstanding stay. Ian & Karen are first class hosts and provide the best breakfasts on the island - stayed at many other BB whilst on Harris & Lewis and Ian's breakfast especially his black pudding won by a mile. Our room was very spacious, spotless and comfortable. Would certainly stay here again if returning to Lewis. Loved the view from the balcony. Thank you for an excellent stay.

reviews.title: Possibly the best B&B I have ever stayed in
reviews.text: We stayed one night only, but would have been happy to stay a lot longer. Spacious, modern room and bathroom, fabulous veranda, great sea views... Friendly and great service. Scrambled eggs for breakfast to rival my mother's... Can't think of anything else I would have wanted...

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Very nice stay in a beautiful room, lovely breakfast. The views out to see are very nice, midnight sun! Spacious bathroom, coffee and tea, hosts are welcoming and very helpful. Close to town aiport and ferry

reviews.title: frank and julie
reviews.text: Could not have wished for better , lovely room and great views , Karen and Iain are the perfect hosts and have so much useful info about the island , the house and rooms are immaculate and cannot be faulted , a return trip would definately be on the cards,but booking early would be a must

reviews.title: Top notch
reviews.text: From being met at the airport to my leaving two days later nothing was left wanting. The best B&B room I've ever had, modern, well equipped, great view. Breakfast was top notch. Hosts did everythign they could. Very relaxed atmosphere in the house.

reviews.title: Great location & views
reviews.text: Stayed here for two nights just before Christmas. It's in a great location near the airport and a short hop into Stornoway. Karen & Iain were excellent hosts and provided some wine & beer on arrival after a rather bumpy (and delayed) flight in from the mainland. Great room with 'hidden' en-suite and views across the bay. Breakfast was great with a good choice and quality to boot, especially the sausages. Wouldn't hesitate to return.

reviews.title: Just wonderful
reviews.text: I chanced upon the Solas Guest House back in the summer when having to go to the Western Isles with my work at short notice. They had a last minute cancellation and someone else's loss was most definitely my gain. I have had occasion to stay there another four times since and each time it's the same. The many other favourable reviews of the Solas Guest House have it spot on: warm, welcoming, comfortable, home from home, wish we'd stayed longer etc etc.. Karen and Iain are the loveliest couple who make it their business to ensure your stay with them is unforgettable. And they succeed. As for the breakfasts, absolutely top class, better than any hotel I've ever stayed in. My working assignment is now at an end, but if I should return, work or play, I know exactly where I'll be staying.

reviews.title: Wonderful Stay - Great Breakfast
reviews.text: The property is very close to the airport but in a secluded spot with wonderful views. Ideal for anyone flying in or only a 15min drive from the port at Stornoway. We arrived at Tarbert (Harris) from the Isle of Skye but it only took us an hour to drive to the property. The accommodation is exceptional our bedroom and bathroom were large and spotless and all rooms have a balcony which is lovely for relaxing with a drink whilst watching the sea or the planes taking off and landing. Breakfast was perfect Ian makes his own sausages and they were the best we have had in any B&B everything perfectly cooked and presented , I loved the pretty place mats which only added to the attention to detail that Karen and Ian have put into making this B&B a special place, they are great hosts and run a fantastic B&B which we hope to one day return to.

reviews.title: Wouldn't stay anywhere else in Stornoway
reviews.text: I have stayed with Karen and Iain several times when in Stornoway for work. I would not want to stay in any other hotel or guest house - couldn't get the same personal service, food, beautiful room and fantastic view of the bay. Icing on the cake this visit was the fantastic weather and standing on the balcony at 4am stargazing. It was AMAZING! Thanks to both of you again.

reviews.title: Quite possibly, my favourite location - ever!!!
reviews.text: Solas is an amazing Guest House, situated in a beautiful location in a spectacular part of Scotland - what more could you ask for. The rooms and beds are comfortable and spotlessly clean. The view from my room and the balcony was spectacular - in all weathers. I was working in Stornoway for a week, this was my home from home. I felt welcome, comfortable and well fed - breakfast was lovely and fills you for the day! Karen and Ian are great hosts, and it was a pleasure staying at Solas. Thank you very much! I cannot commend you enough.

reviews.title: Lovely room, warm welcome, views to die for and fantastic breakfasts!
reviews.text: The large room was even nicer than the website photos - not just warm and welcoming, but it had a touch of style.We slept well in the comfortable bed and enjoyed the teas, coffees and hot chocolate with biscuits and chocolates in our room which were replenished each day. Mind you,after our huge and varied breakfasts , it wasn't easyto find a corner for more food. I could hardly drag my husband from the balcony and the sea views. Our hosts were very welcoming - a glass of wine on arrival and cheery words each morning. A perfect tranquil break.

reviews.title: As good as ever
reviews.text: In many walks of life getting to the top is difficult but staying there even more so. I imagine it’s much the same in the hospitality business too. If so, then Solas Guest House have succeeded on both counts, being the best and staying the best. We were there for a few nights last week, a return visit after nearly five years. There Is nothing quite like Island and Highland hospitality and the welcome that comes with it and in that vein there’s nothing to match the genuine warmth and welcome that awaits you from Karen and Iain in their lovely home (which instantly becomes yours as well). It’s just as we remember it ( lovely breakfasts, beautifully appointed rooms, stunning views) and our three night stay passed all too quickly. We won’t be wanting to leave it another four or five years before the next time. As a reviewer perhaps it’s not for me to comment on the reviews of others but I would venture to suggest that 70 plus of us most certainly have this right and that the one dissenter hasn’t.

reviews.title: 3rd stay and still as good as ever
reviews.text: 3rd trip to Stornoway and 3rd stay at the guest house. The quality and welcome was as good as ever, the food is great and the room lovely. The views over the bay were lovely. Well done to the fantastic couple who run this wee gem of a guest house

reviews.title: Shabby treatment
reviews.text: We booked this guest house back in February for the 31st May this year. When booking there was a space for special requests and we requested if it was possible for a soft bed or a mattress topper because I have a spinal disorder. We heard nothing until the 12th May some three weeks before we were due to book in, when we received an email that went into my spam box saying that "if you have a bad back I suggest you stay home". I thought at first that it was indeed spam so I rang to speak to the proprietor, at first he said that was not sure if he had sent this email and he would check and let me know. Ten minutes later he admitted that he had indeed sent it. I told him that I was very upset and that I thought he was very rude and could have phoned to say that he had not got a soft bed and there was no need to wait until so close to our booking to say this. He apologised and I left it at that, but tonight I received another email to say that he had cancelled our booking and again did not have the decency to let us en lknow other than by booking. com's email. All I can say is that we have had a lucky escape from a very rude man. Although it is very late in the day we have been lucky enough to find somewhere else to stay.

reviews.title: Absolute gem.
reviews.text: A beautiful home in a beautiful location, Caroline and Iain couldn’t have been more attentive or helpful. The accommodation was spotlessly clean and the breakfast was plentiful and extremely tasty. Hearty recommend.

reviews.title: Wonderful!
reviews.text: My other half and I enjoyed a wee break together and chose to stay in style at Solas. Sooooo much better than any other hotel in town. Karen and Ian were very welcoming and made us feel at home. We were even offered a wee drink after a day out! The room was gorgeous (the whole house is stunning!) and decorated very well. The Superior Room had the most amusing (yes, amusing) panoramic view. You got the whole coastline and beach to your right, then the airport runways to your left! You can hear the planes, but there are not many and it wasn't actually disturbing. The balcony (enter the wind at your own peril) had a second inside door to doubly protect the room from the northerly wind. This also helped reduce the noise from next door (the taxis know it as the B&B that looks at the airport). There was a great selection of teas, coffee and hot chocolate in the room. The shower was massive and really powerful (let it run for a few minutes to heat up!). The wifi was decent too. The breakfast is awesome. Ian makes his own sausages and they are lovely. There is a good selection and it is all freshly cooked for you (you fill out a menu request the night before). Filled me up for the whole day! It is 2 minutes from the airport and 3 miles from town (9 pound for a taxi). We 100% recommend staying here.

reviews.title: A great place to stay
reviews.text: An absolutely delightful B and B. Our room was huge, beautiful decor, every comfort. The ensuite was as huge as the room. Stunning view out over the water. We arrived soaking wet having cycled 50 miles in tha rain but Karen and Iain could not have been more welcoming as we dripped into their immaculate house. Not only that but they felt so sorry for us they poured us each a huge glass of red wine which could not have been more welcome. Also phoned to book us into a restaurant for the evening and helped sort our taxi. Breakfast was enormous, just what we needed for the next 50 mile ride.

reviews.title: what a find
reviews.text: such charming hosts - who have a very smart house we were very comfortable indeed - breakfast was fantastic and Iain and Karen were delightful and informative - and then went beyond the call too! Thank you for making us so welcome.

reviews.title: excellent
reviews.text: All you could want a friendly, welcoming, clean environment. Breakfast was wonderful , best sausages everything in the cooked breakfast was well cooked and hot. Bed clean, fresh and comfortable. Shower was powerful bathroom roomy. Parking beside the house. Everything you want when your away from home. Will be back.

reviews.title: Simply the best!!!!
reviews.text: We stayed here as part of our honeymoon and we weren't disappointed. The owners Karen and Iain were fantastic- they made us so welcome. The house itself was beautifully decorated and our room was so comfortable with a fabulous view. The food was great and I honestly can't fault it at all. The whole experience was perfect. We wouldn't stay anywhere else but Solas house now. Well done to Karen and Iain. You have a wonderful home made more special by your own personalities. It was a real pleasure!

reviews.title: Warm welcome and peaceful accomodation
reviews.text: I stayed here overnight on business and received such a warm welcome. The room was amazing with a view over the beach from my balcony and the breakfast next morning was excellent and cooked to order. The owners could not do enough to ensure i had a great stay and i will definately return.

reviews.title: Wonderful Lewis Hospitality
reviews.text: We stayed two nights at this beautiful guest house with our wonderful hosts Karen and Iain and it comes highly recommended. It is located 10mins from Stornoway and centrally located to many of the spectacular drives around Lewis and some good restaurants in Stornoway. This is a stunningly designed home and the two guest rooms are large with walk- in wardrobes and large bathrooms. Breakfast was fantastic, offering both continental and full Scottish. Iain’s homemade sausages were a real treat, but the best part of our stay was the wonderful hospitality we experienced. They are a beautiful couple who did everything possible to make our stay enjoyable.

reviews.title: Fantastic!
reviews.text: We chose Solas from reviews we read here on Trip Advisor and they were right on. Iain and Karen couldn't have been more accommodating and friendly hosts. The breakfasts were fantastic - porridge (oatmeal), toast, eggs, croissants, fresh fruit, delicious sausage made by Iain himself (we regret we didn't request sausage until our last morning), great coffee... Due to various plans we had, our schedule had us out the door EARLY each morning and there was never a problem having our breakfast available when we needed it. Our room was large and comfortable. Perfectly clean. And it had a deck with a lovely view past the small airport to the water.

reviews.title: The only place to stay while visiting the Isle of Lewis
reviews.text: I cannot say enough great things about this place. Modern, updated, awesome food and absolutely lovely. If you want top notch accomodiations, this is your place. The rooms all have beautiful views of the water and great sitting areas outside each room. The layout of the rooms is great. The bedroom and bathrooms are divided by a closet area so if a person is sleeping in and the other is getting ready, they do not disturb each other. There is an airport close, but we never heard one plane our entire trip, even though I did see one take off. The food is great and that is an understatement. My only regret was that we could not stay longer. I have learned over the years that when I find a great place, I always return. I will be back to this location in the future and I am actually looking forward to when I can return because it was that great.

reviews.title: We fully agree with the excellant reviews!
reviews.text: This lovely guest house and home is a wonderfull find and we thoroughly enjoyed every aspect of our 3 night stay. Karen and Iain are great hosts and yes the breakfasts are first class (Iain being in charge). Our large immaculate room had a lovely view and its own balcony, what more could you want! We loved our time in Lewis and Harris and this accomodation and hospitality made our holiday perfect.

reviews.title: Five luxury at B&B price
reviews.text: When I arrived I was made to feel so welcome and it was like visiting distant family relatives. I cannot put into words how warm, sincere and homely the welcome was. The room is by far the most luxurious room in which I have ever stayed. I've never stayed in five star luxury but I should imagine this is what it would be like. Massive space and a balcony as well with a huge bed, leather seats and a large television. The shower was just brilliant - so much space and room to move. Breakfast was amazing with a variety of cereal choices as well as fruit and yoghurts. The full Scottish breakfast was absolutely delicious. Iain and Karen are the perfect hosts. Nothing is too much trouble for them. I have never made to feel so welcome and relaxed. Iain even brought me a couple of bottles of beer which was on top of the already complimentary water and biscuits in the room. I cannot recommend Solas Guest House highly enough as the perfect place to stay while visiting the Outer Hebrides.

reviews.title: Lovely !
reviews.text: Lovely guest house ! We actually stayed here in May 14 but this is me just getting round to leaving reviews ... Both myself and boyfriend had never stayed in a guest house/ b&b before and I was a tad apprehensive but would definitely recommend, much nicer than some hotels I have stayed in ! Warm and welcoming couple, separate clean modern bedroom and bathroom, small touches such as a bottle of beer and glass of wine as we wee getting ready to go out really makes a difference, we had to leave early in the morning (6am!) but we were still offered breakfast or food to take with us, lovely lovely place, would recommend !

reviews.title: Five Star Guest-House
reviews.text: The Solas is definately the best guest-house that we've ever stayed at. Hosts Karen and Iain could not be more hospitable--nothing is too much trouble. The room we had (balcony with sea view) was spacious and spotlessly clean. As other guests have commented, the breakfast is excellent, and sets you up for the day. We stayed five nights in order to explore Lewis, but could easily have spent the whole time sitting on our balcony taking in the beautiful views and listening out for the corncrakes in the adjacent meadow. Anyone visiting the Stornoway area should look no further than the Solas---a great place to stay. Mike and Fran, (Banffshire).

reviews.title: AN ABSOLUTE GEM IN STORNOWAY
reviews.text: My Partner Dave and I had only 1 night stay in the Solus last Monday, unfortunately as within minutes of arriving I wished I had booked a few more nights. Ian and Karen, the owners were lovely and fantastic hosts. The house was stunning, the room with the balcony and stunning views was fantastic, really impressed with the hidden ensuite, only topped off by a delicious breakfast (Ian's porridge was ace). Would highly recommend. Thanks again for your lovely hospitality and a great start to a wonderful week, although the Solus took a bit of living up to. Ellie & Dave

reviews.title: Outstanding
reviews.text: We arrived late on the last ferry to Lewis and our host, Ian, greeted us at the door and immediately began to care for us. Our room was spacious and comfortable with a glorious view of the beach. Breakfasts were large and delicious. I can highly recommend Solas House and would gladly return.

reviews.title: Beautiful B&B
reviews.text: Had a very pleasant night here.. would have liked to stay longer. Karen and Ian made us feel really at home and suggested a few things to do while on the island which proved to be very sound advice. Thanks

reviews.title: Great 2 days on the Isle of Lewis
reviews.text: Iain and Karen were wonderful! Very welcoming and informative. The room was nice and private with remodeled en suite bath. The view was amazing - straight, clear view to the ocean and breaking waves. The breakfast was superb with plenty of options. Location couldn't be better, far enough out for good views and quiet, but only about 5-10 minutes from the largest town on the island.

reviews.title: Beautiful home
reviews.text: Solas House is a modern home overlooking Stornoway Airport and the bay beyond. The owners, Karen and Iain have created a warm and welcoming environment for their guests.
