Our room was terrific, very spacious, balcony, beautiful en-suite and the extras you get in hotels. There is a large parking area and it's very easy to find, follow signs for the airport and it's the large, modern house standing guard over the terminal building! We would recommend this property.

reviews.title: Coming Home
reviews.text: I stayed in the house of Caren and Ian for a longer periode and i can say without hesitation: It was always like coming home. Dont be afraid of the nearby airport! There are not many flights, and no flights at night. Enjoy the very nice rooms, excellent beds and clean bathrooms. The breakfast is also of outstanding quality, as Ian is a butcher and knows whats good. I would and will stay again! Thank you both, Peter, Berlin

reviews.title: The perfect B&B in a great location
reviews.text: What a wonderful place to stay the night (and longer if we could have done). Ian and Karen were perfect hosts making us feel like friends (rather than first night guests) right from the start. Everything was first class from the room with great views, excellent amenities and a very comfortable bed to the house itself, the great kitchen and tasty breakfast. There was nothing that could be improved and I would recommend this place to anyone visiting Lewis. Thank you Ian and Karen for helping to make our stay so enjoyable.

reviews.title: Stornoway's Great Secret.
reviews.text: This beautiful and spotlessly clean home is without doubt the best B and B that my family and I have ever stayed in. The stunning location and ever changing views that surround it are matched by the charm and character of your hosts Iain and Karen. They are a credit to themselves and this charming island and it's people. Nothing is too much trouble, and their attention to detail in all aspects surpasses what one would reasonably expect. They offer superb value for money especially with Iain's bumper Scottish breakfast !! They will make your stay memorable for all the best reasons and we will be returning. This is one secret that needs to be shared for others to experience. The Tew Family ...South Wales UK

reviews.title: Awesome B&B and hosts
reviews.text: This bed and breakfast is fabulous, and so are the people who own it. It's a beautiful house, our room was amazing, and nice views too. We had encoutered some trouble with our travel plans just as we got here, and the owners, who never met us before, went above and beyond to help us out. It was just amazing. The breakfast was excellent too. It's very close to the airport if you are flying in, but close to town also.

reviews.title: a warm welcome in a magical place
reviews.text: This was a repeat visit and the warmth of the welcome was second to none. Spotless and extremely comfortable, spacious accommodation with thoughtful attention to detail, augmented by magnificent views and the most excellent breakfast - not to mention the generous offer of glass of wine when I got there (and an unexpected phone call from Ian before my arrival, planned on foot from the airport, to say please could he come and pick me up, owing to the rain!). Ian and Karen are delightful hosts and I heartily recommend this as a must stay guest house in Stornoway.

reviews.title: The highlight of our journey
reviews.text: Where do I start? This place is truly wonderful. The hosts, really friendly, good sense of humor and informative, the room - wow, soooo lush and with an amazing view, the breakfast - really delicious, the location - very unusual with the airport but fun to watch the planes taking off and landing, though the room faces the sea. We hope to come back next year and actually land on that airport and stay at Solas.

reviews.title: Superb B&B near Stornaway
reviews.text: I can only echo what other reviewers have said about Solas House - it is stunning! Beautiful house and ensuite room with everything you could want - this has been designed with great care and skill. Fabulous sea views, the planes are really interesting to watch, and there's not the slightest noise disturbance. Iain and Karen are such lovely welcoming people. Iain obviously knows his food & cooks excellent breakfasts - it's a great pity they don't run a restaurant too! So take a taxi into Stornaway and the Digby Chick - great food and people. We would stay here again anytime and can't recommend it enough - and what value for money!.

reviews.title: Perfection!
reviews.text: This is the best guest house we have ever stayed in! This is like a 4* hotel t=rather than a guest house. The whole house is immaculately clean and the room was spacious and extremely comfortable. The hosts were wonderful and nothing was a problem. The breakfasts were to die for. Basically, Solas Guest House was just wonderful and we wish Iain and Karen all the very best and would like to thank them for their wonderful hospitaility. Ali & Pete xx

reviews.title: Great Hosts
reviews.text: Great place to stay if you are in Stornaway. Just a few minutes drive out from the centre. Very large comfortable modern room with balcony and sea view. Karen and Iain are incredibly welcoming and friendly. One of the best B&Bs we have ever stayed at. Don't hesitate - book now and enjoy a great place and great hospitality.

reviews.title: Best guest house I have stayed in- Read the reviews and book it!
reviews.text: Pleased to see everyone thinks the same about this place. I stayed for one night on a business trip. Beautiful views, really handy location, and immaculate house. Huge room, bathroom and balcony and decor is stunning - really high quality. As a lone female traveller on business I loved working with the uninterrupted views to the sea, really decent wifi and the biggest range of tea, coffee, milk (and biscuit!) supply I have come across anywhere I have stayed. Breakfast was hugely varied, cooked to order and (as it snowed overnight) I was helped on my way by Ian who even cleared my car for me. If you are looking for somewhere beautiful, relaxing in an amazing house that is way more beautiful (and way cleaner) than your own....but still feels like home- book it. Karen and Ian - I had a great time- you are running an amazing business and are great company. Hope to see you again

reviews.title: Most amazing guest house
reviews.text: Our room and the view were amazing! Ideally located as super close to the airport and the W5 bus stops nearby. Such welcoming owners who helped us with info so much. Top notch breakfast, whole place was spotless! Couldn't ask for anything more. Thanks so much!

reviews.title: Quite Simply Exceptional
reviews.text: My husband & I stayed at the Solas Guest House for one night during a trip to Harris & Lewis. I wished we had been staying for longer. Karen & Ian were excellent hosts and there house was beautiful and very well designed. Our room was very spacious with a large balcony which ,if the weather had been better we would have enjoyed the wine and beer kindly given to us by Ian, after a long day on St Kilda it was much appreciated. Breakfast was of the highest quality .

reviews.title: Superb B&B (especially if you love planes!)
reviews.text: Difficult to write another review that doesn't repeat what others have said - it really is a lovely home and beautifully furnished. Our large room had a balcony and as has been mentioned the house is at the end of the runway at the airport - great if you're an Avgeek!! Great fun to watch the planes land and take off. Forget about a diet when you come here as the breakfast is great! Iain and Karen are wonderful cooks and hosts. Would definitely recommend and return here!

reviews.title: Amazing place
reviews.text: Undoubtably the nicest guest house we have ever stayed in the views were incredible and I have already told all my friends , if you go to Stornoway it's a must to stay here.A big thanks to Iain and Karen for being such great hosts and hope to see you both again Graham & Trudi

reviews.title: Perfection
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed for a few nights at the end of our honeymoon trip to the islands. We were given a lovely warm welcome by Iain and Karen and shown to the most beautiful room. It was spotless, comfortable and had everything we could have needed or wanted. The location by the airport was a bonus, it was fun to watch the planes coming and going. The breakfast was just brilliant, and the sausages were the best I've tasted in a long time! Staying here was really the perfect end to the trip, a massive thank you for making it so special.

reviews.title: 10 out of 10
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed in this lovely guest house just outside stornoway. On arrival we were met by Ian and Karen who made us feel very welcome. They showed us to our lovely room which had patio doors that led out onto a balcony with stunning views. Ian offered us a complimentary drink of our choice, we sat on the balcony with a glass of red wine and watched the sun set over the bay.The large bed was very comfortable. In the morning our breakfast was amazing! I had porridge followed by a full scottish fry, which had the nicest sausages ive eaten and of course the famous stornoway black pudding. We would highly recommend staying in this lovely guest house. We'll be back :-)

reviews.title: Hard to find better
reviews.text: We stayed two nights, late in October. Iain and Karen were excellent hosts, making you feel right at home from the moment you arrive. The room was spacious, great ensuite, and a beautiful view. It is close to the airport, but as Karen said, it is not Heathrow, and throughout our time there had no noise etc from it. Breakfasts were superb to top the whole experience off. If we return to Lewis there is no doubt where we will book.

reviews.title: How alll B&B's Should be
reviews.text: It is no surprise to me that this is a 5 out of 5 guest house - everything about my stay here was perfect. The views are tremendous, the room was comfortable, exceptionally clean and Ian and Karen could not have provided a warmer welcome. Only complaint is that I cannot buy the sausages that Ian makes himself and cooks you for breakfast - just amazing! Will definitely stay here again and will be suggesting the same to all my staff.

reviews.title: Perfect stay - lovely hosts
reviews.text: I have just returned yesterday from my stay at the Solas Guest House and had such a great time I wanted to write this review while it is still fresh in my mind. My colleague and I stayed here for 3 nights from 14th-17th January. We came in from Glasgow and Edinburgh so arrived at different times. On arrival at the Airport I could immediately see the house it is in an excellent location some 300yrds from the airport but dont let that put you off it is a very quiet airport with flights starting from around 9am and finishing not long after 7pm. I didnt hear the planes in those times either unless the balcony doors were open. As soon as you arrive at Solas you feel instantly welcome, in some b&bs the service is great but you just don't feel at home - however Karen and Iain are warm and friendly and excellent hosts.You instantly feel welcome and it doesn't feel contrived at all - just genuine. Karen and Iain really make this place what it is - nothing is too much of a bother. They are there if you need them but give you the space and privacy you require. They also offered a welcome G&T which was gladly accepted on our arrival! Another point which makes it so special is the breakfasts!! Iain is a butcher and you can tell - the cooked breakfast was beautifully cooked and the sausages to die for! A must if you go! Now to the rooms which were equally great! I was in the larger room which was beautifully decorated and very big with plenty of space. My colleagues room was also decorated to a high standard and although slightly smaller than mine it was very spacious also. Each room has an en-suite bathroom with very powerful shower. The rooms both have a balcony overlooking the bay and my colleague and I had the luck to witness the sunrise from our balconies watching the Bright orange full moon go down - quite a sight! The beds were very comfortable and cozy with plenty of pillows and the blackout curtains ensured the room was pitch black at night - this must be a huge benefit in the summer when it is light for most of the day! All in all we had an amazing time - the rooms were gorgeous which was important to us, the breakfasts were amazing and the hosts fantastic. I would have no hesitations booking here again and will recommend it to anyone. Hopefully I will have an opportunity to return as I have no doubts this is the best on the island - you would be mad not to go here!

reviews.title: Travelling around Scotland and this is by far the best so far!
reviews.text: We were welcomed into the house by Karen and shown around our room. It is the biggest and best room I have ever stayed in and over the years and on this trip, I have stayed in a few. The bed was huge and there was a balcony which opened out onto a sea view. There was a huge walk in wardrobe and an even bigger ensuite bathroom. Breakfast was served in a well situated dining room and was one of the best breakfasts I have ever had, and certainly the best sausages and eggs!! The location is perfect just 5 mins outside Stornaway right by the airport and easy to find, I would recommend this place to anyone. Our stay could not have been any more perfect!!

reviews.title: outstanding
reviews.text: I have stayed with Karen & Ian twice now and both times have been blown away by the room, the view, the breakfast and most importantly the owners. I cannot recommend them or their beautiful home highly enough. Both my companion and I loved everything about our stay.

reviews.title: Absolutely unbelievable.....
reviews.text: .....realising a long held 'ambition' we finally completed the classic Outer Hebrides/Cape Wrath/'top end'/Orkneys journey, one of the most rewarding and enjoyable we have ever undertaken - and with a 'decent breeze' blowing onshore for most of the time the midgies were largely kept at bay! Privileged to have stayed at some stunning places around the Globe, I must say that 'Solas' was a real wowser of a find! We stayed for two nights during early September, and on departing concluded that this accommodation had overtaken our most favourite Scottish hotel - no names, no pack drill but the Ryder Cup is due to take place there shortly - and in our view secured our own personal No.1 slot. On arrival we were greeted by the friendly, affable and easy going hosts, Karen and Ian, and shown to a quite breath taking, spacious room with a balcony, chairs, so no further encouragement needed.Dig the Bells out of the suitcase and sit and enjoy the wonderful sea view. Everything about this place is absolutely 'top notch' from bedroom, to bathroom, to toiletries, to towels. As for breakfast, well y'all better be hungry! Scrambled eggs and sausages to die for! Ooh la la! We compliment you both Karen, Ian for the immaculate standards you have set. Thank you so much for your thoughtful hospitality, 'Bravo!', well done, and we wish you much, much success during the years ahead.......

reviews.title: Outstanding
reviews.text: We stayed at the Solar during the Easter holiday and it is fair to say this is an exceptional guest house. It is extremely convenient to the Airport and we were given a very warm welcome by the owners, Ian and Karen and shown through the their beautiful home to our room that was as breathtaking as the views from the balcony. Ian's breakfast was to die for and we were sad that we were only staying one night. It is also fair to say that the hosts instinctively know when to welcome and chat and when to leave you in peace. We would not hesitate to stay there again or throughly recommend it to anyone visiting this beautiful part of the world

reviews.title: best in scotland
reviews.text: Stayed here for 4 days in june (our second visit) Iain and Karen( the owners) are the most delightful couple you could meet.The accommodation is absolutely first class and the food is the same. Our only problem we had was that we only stayed four days! however we hope to rectify this next year.

reviews.title: Excellent B+B
reviews.text: Over in the Western Isles for work, company had pre-booked accommodation for me so I had no idea what to expect. Once I found my way to the B+B a pleasant surprise indeed was had. A spacious room with a top quality En-suite bathroom, a balcony looking out over the bay / airport though not much to see given it was heading towards the evening. Reliably informed that the sunrise and sunset are worth looking out for. Popped back into Stornoway for dinner, and met on my return by the host with an offer of a couple of beers to wash down my dinner. Gratefully accepted. Breakfast was duly ordered the night before and was extremely nice. Best scrambled eggs I have ever tasted, wish I could make them as nice as this myself. A thoroughly fine residence with charming owners. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Lovely b&b
reviews.text: This was the first b&b we stayed at on a 3 day road trip. The place is run by a lovely couple which you can tell truly cares about their guests. Our bedroom was very spacious with a good size en-suite bathroom. The decor is very modern so you don't feel like being away from home. Our room came with a balcony with a lovely view over the bay and Stornoway airport. Solas Guest House is located in a quiet and relaxing area of the island and was perfect after a long day on the road. Breakfast was great and the scrambled eggs divine! One of my best b&b experiences so far, I highly recommend this place.

reviews.title: Terrific
reviews.text: Guesthouse with two spacious, well designed and comfortable rooms - each with its own balcony that looks across field towards the sea. From the balcony you can get a wonderful view into dark night sky and, when the night is clear, sit under a canopy of stars. In the background there is just the sound of sea and the wind. In the daytime, it is very quiet except for during the handful of flights from the nearby small airport. The view across to the airport is itself enjoyable - small propeller planes taking off from time to time to the mainland. Like tumbling back in time. Owners Karen and Iain have thought through all the details with great care and host in a way which is both low key and relaxed but also very attentive. The guest house is immaculately maintained. A substantial breakfast is provided. My mother and I stayed four nights while touring Lewis and Harris and would happily have stayed longer.

reviews.title: High standard B&B in convenient location
reviews.text: We received a warm welcome from a fairly young couple at this pleasant B&B, and they immediately made a restaurant reservation for us. Our room (they have 2) was large and comfortable, though a little stuffy, as they had been unable to open the patio doors (no windows) due to windy weather. The room was well furnished and decorated to a high standard. The huge bathroom was hidden behind closet doors. The bathroom had ample supplies of toiletries, but the exhaust fan was not working. Plenty of tea, coffee shortbread and chocolates were on offer in the room. The house is well planned and the 2 guest rooms were well separated, and a private deck is outside each guest room. While the airport can be noisy during the day, it was closed at night, and it did not present any problems for us. It opens at 6:30 am but if the patio doors are shut, there is no noise. The traditional and excellent breakfast was offered, including fruit and yogurt, served in quality surroundings. The B&B is close to the ferry, and is a short distance from Stornoway. Recommended

reviews.title: No need to look elsewhere.....
reviews.text: Stayed for one night on business and can't speak Hulu enough of this place. Carol and Ian are such great hosts, the house is great, and we were made to feel so welcome. I would usually stay in hotels but Stornoway is not flush with comfortable establishments. Breakfast was legendary !! The rooms were huge with great facilities. Just a no brainier everyone.........book to stay here Thanks again to Carol and Ian

reviews.title: Absolutly fantastic!!!
reviews.text: We were stunned by the warm welcome and the absolutly gorgeous room. The bathroom is behind a mirror closet door and is utterly spotless. The hosts are very pleasant,warmhearted and charming. The view from the balcony was awesome as well.We wished we could have stayed longer!

reviews.title: Our only Disappointing Experience
reviews.text: If you read my other reviews, you’ll see I like to emphasize the positive. As a policy, I don’t give bad reviews. We own a couple of rental properties so I’m very sympathetic towards owners and appreciative of their efforts. Unfortunately there was nothing in this case for me to to work with. We showed up with our daughter who unexpectedly joined us and so we asked if she could just throw her sleeping pad on the floor in our room. Owner became upset at the suggestion, so we immediately said we understood and said we’d send her to town to stay at the youth hostel and just my wife and I would stay as booked. For some unknown reason, he decided this would not work for him, “too much hassle,” he declared, and refused to let my wife and I stay as booked. He promised to give us a refund so we went elsewhere. But then he refused to give a refund. Perhaps there is a cultural issue that I don’t understand, but seems he was altogether inflexible, tense, and dishonest in not refunding as he promised to do several times. Sorry, but I can’t recommend this place.

reviews.title: This is how to do it!
reviews.text: B & B does not come better than this! Karen and Ian are the perfect hosts - warm, welcoming and so friendly and their house is stunning. Beautifully equipped in a stunning location with panoramic views from the bedroom balconies. But what makes it truly special are the hosts - they could not have been nicer and went out of their way to make our stay special.

reviews.title: Lovely place, incredible location, amazing views, friendly and great breakfast
reviews.text: Lovely place, about 3 Miles from the ferry. Incredible location next to a small airfield. The view from my bed out the balcony doors was stunning. Ian was lovely, very welcoming. And made a mean breakfast, exactly what I needed for my cycling.

reviews.title: Home from home
reviews.text: We have been travelling to the UK over many years and stayed in all sorts of nice B&B. But Solas has topped them all, it's such an amazing place to stay, Karen and Iain are extremely nice and welcoming hosts, you immediately feel like home, being a good friend or even a member of the family. The house is impeccable, provides huge, comfy and luxurious rooms. In the morning you get a hearty breakfast, all fresh and delicious, yum. The house lies in a tranquil location, although Stornoway Airport is just "round the corner", but no activity at night there. Practical if you arrive either by plane or ferry. Karen and Iain, thanks so much for having us and sharing your lovely home with us. We will definitely return to the Outer Hebrides and no question, we will love to stay with you again. Thanks and kind regards Heidi + Ernst Jeanette + Ivo from Switzerland

reviews.title: A Bright Star in Stornoway
reviews.text: We had a two day break in Stornoway and had booked Solas on the 2nd night, on arriving we instantly wished we had booked it for both nights. We received a warm welcome from Karen and Iain and were shown to our first floor room by Karen, the room was stunning with access to a seated veranda with fantastic views of the beach. Access to the en-suite is hidden behind the mirror wardrobes and was huge as well as being spotless. Karen provided us with excellent information about touring the local area which was very helpful and after a great day visiting the Calanais Standing Stones, the Black Houses and Bosta beach when we arrived back at the guest house we were welcomed by Iain who offered us a glass of wine for our room. Iain is in charge of breakfast which is cooked to order and was excellent with very generous portions. This will be our first choice when we return to Stornoway and we would definately recommend this guest house which was just perfection.

reviews.title: What a Gem!
reviews.text: Myself and my husband visited Stornoway as our last stop on a tour of the Outer Hebrides and we couldn't have landed at a better place than Solas. Absolutley perfect in every way, the room was very spacious and immaculate with huge shower and a generous supply of coffee, tea, hot chocolate and biscuits. Iain and Karen were the perfect hosts and we would not hesitate to return should we get the opportunity. It is well located near the airport so close enough to the town but with the peacefulness of the sea views. The airport did not bother us at all with minimal volumes of flights happening on a daily basis. Can't recommend this enough and can't wait to go back. The Isle of Lewis is also a gem in itself and we were very sad to leave!

reviews.title: Simply the Best
reviews.text: From the moment you arrive at Solas Guest House you are made to feel welcome, provided with an excellent and comfortable room, a classic breakfast and friendly approachable people. A great experience.

reviews.title: Third visit
reviews.text: This is the third visit to Solas and this is without doubt one of the very best B&Bs in Britain. Iaan and Caren are marvelous hosts (best porridge we have ever tasted),the rooms are immaculate and the views are glorious and the sunsets superb, cannot wait to go back.

reviews.title: Best Guest House I've ever stayed in
reviews.text: The standard of the guest house was really outstanding. Lovely room and great views outside on the balcony overlooking Broad Bay. The breakfast was of an exceptionally high standard and the hosts couldn't have been nicer. Definitely be back - on an island full of overpriced hotels and B&Bs, this was fantastic value for money and will recommend to everyone.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Had one night there excellent very friendly couple.the view was outstanding also recomended a excellent place to eat in stornaway was not disappointed The house was off the highest standard would definitely go back but for longer .

reviews.title: Five star stay
reviews.text: This accommodation is *five star* all the way. We had a very warm welcome, from Karen on arrival, after a very trying journey. I was very impressed by the modern house, everything was spacious and spotlessly clean. The bedroom was, as advertised, with a balcony overlooking the sea and the airport. (The airport only handles small passenger planes so there was no intrusion of noise. But proved interesting, watching the aircraft landing and taking off.) The bedroom was large and comfortable, with a large double bed. The room had everything a traveller needs, including a good selection of hot drinks, with an electric kettle. The bathroom was also very spacious, with a spacious shower unit, with toiletries, a toilet and wash hand basin. There was no bath. The breakfast room was also very spacious and the food selection was very good and the food I had, was cooked beautifully by Ian. The ingredients were locally sourced, and of the highest quality and tasted very good, (I would recommend the full Scottish breakfast). The TV had all of the Free View Channels including radio, and the Wi-Fi speed was good and reliable, and worked out on the balcony. There being only two guest rooms parking is not a problem, and the location of the house is only two or three minutes drive from the town. This Guest House is exceptional and the owners could not be more helpful in offering advice as to what to see, or where to go. The two night stay was certainly a five star experience, and being a Grumpy Old man, I had no cause, in this stay, to be grumpy.

reviews.title: Charming house, GREAT host.
reviews.text: After staying with Lian & Karen last year (2016) we knew we would return. My wife and I have vacationed in Scotland 8 times in the last 15 years. When we find a B&B that we like we return when in the area. Solas is one of the places we would not miss if visiting the Isle of Lewis.

reviews.title: Fabulous stop over in Stornoway
reviews.text: This Guest House situated very conveniently for the Airport was a fabulous place to stay, Karen and Iain were the perfect hosts and despite the rather strong winds we enjoyed the view over the bay.from our balcony. We were sorry that we could only stay 2 nights but we managed to do all we wanted on the island. Highly recommend a visit here.

reviews.title: Five Star Relaxation Experience with a homely touch
reviews.text: My partner & I stayed at the Solas Guest House for three nights during a trip to Harris & Lewis. Driving down towards Solas Guest House, along a narrow counrty road with a view of a beautiful open bay, we knew this was a special location. We were welcomed in by Karen & Ian as if we were family visiting them after a long time apart. They were excellent hosts and their house was warm,welcoming and beautifully designed. Our room was very spacious, modern and offered a fantastic view of the open bay from the room's large private balcony. Breakfast...what can I say? This is one of the best breakfast I have eaten in all of the hotels and guest houses I have stayed in and nothing was too much for Ian or Karen to and they provided a breakfast which suited all types of people. All in all I am confident in saying that this was one of my top 3 accommodations I have ever stayed in and that is including my year spent travelling different countries. If you are ever in Stornoway this is a must stay Guest House and i will certainly be using Ian and Karen when i next visit Lewis and Harris.

reviews.title: A very pleasant surprise
reviews.text: Working on Lewis for a week i couldnt get booked into Stornoway til after my 3rd day because of the MOD Gaelic Festival. Luckily there was a room availavle at the Solas Guest Houst which is 3 miles outside Stornoway in a beautiful location near the beach. I have to say that the standard of the rooms was very high.The are large, modern, immaculate and all with great views. I found the hosts Moira and Iain very warm and welcoming and couldnt help me enough. The breakfasts were first class and Iain being a butcher provides with the best of stuff. Next time im back in Lewis i will be staying here again and i highly recommend it to anyone who may be on business, or with a family or for a quiet break, this is a first class guest house with great hosts. Will

reviews.title: Beautiful luxury B&B in Stornoway!
reviews.text: The most beautiful B&B that I have ever seen. The hosts Ian and Karen are very friendly and hospitable. We can highly recommend this place! PS: It is very popular and often booked out. If available, we would recommend to book two or more nights.

reviews.title: What a lovely stay
reviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our little break here. The accommodation is lovely and having the balcony was great as you got the view of the water at one side and the airport...which does not affect your stay, on the other? It was also nice for a wee tipple after dinner. We were made to feel welcome and even tried to encourage our hosts to get a few hens...I hope they do. We were supposed to stay 2 nights but due to personal probs had to miss a night. This is a great place in Lewis to stay. We would recommend it highly.

reviews.title: What a beautiful place run by great hosts
reviews.text: Iain and Karen run the best bed & breakfast I think we have visited. The welcome, the beautiful room with all its facilities and stunning views, assistance in booking a taxi, information on local landmarks and a great breakfast cooked by Iain. We only stayed 1 night but wished it could have been more, it just didn't fit in to our schedule. We WILL return, probably on our next Harris Gin run.

reviews.title: Awsome hotel and location
reviews.text: This hotel is now named Hotel Grand Elite and is still a confusing situation for people who only know the old name of High Street Grande. This having said We stayed 6 days and found the room and the breakfast very good and the hotel staff very pleasant. The hotel is set away from the heavy trafic. It is centrally located for all tourist attractions and all shops and a super market is just around the cornernear the post office. DWe went every day to the Sagar Papaji Ka Dhaba restaurant in the Hanuman Tekdi road, which was a 10 minutes walk. Opposite the restaurant you can buy a take away beer in one of the bars. With exception of the traffic it was a safe place to walk in the evening.

reviews.title: Excellent Hotel. Worth for money.
reviews.text: We stayed there from 29th Aug to 31st Aug for 2 Nights. Check In was easy , because of the non-availability of standard rooms we booked they upgraded us to Directors Special Room. Breakfast was complimentary but it was horrible. We didn't take it next day. The location is in ABIDS which has good access to all the famous locations. Karachi Bakery, Famous Ice Cream is at a walkable distance. The staff was courteous. However they were not able to serve tea at around 10 PM which is disappointing. Overall the experience was nice. Will prefer to stay at the hotel in future.

reviews.title: Nice Place to Stay
reviews.text: Nice Place to Stay. Center of the City and Good Locality. Staff of Hotel friendly and cooperative. Need to improve facilities. Best Budget hotel.Rooms are spacious and well maintained. Food also good. Wi-Fi is also good.

reviews.title: The worst experience that I ever had at any hotel
reviews.text: Booked one room through make my trip. Reached rather early. They told I had to wait till 1200 PM which I did. Again they asked me to wait for 30 minutes more. As I could not wait, I came away without waiting for them as I had some urgent business. Even the amount was not refunded though I didn't use the room.

reviews.title: Good family hotel in Abids
reviews.text: We stayed 3 days in March from 26 to 28. The rooms are spacious and well furnished. comfortable beds and ac in good working condition. The best part is the hotel location. It is in the abids market area and close to all shopping places. Situated next to Metro Shoe shop and Big Shop in Mall. You can get auto to travel to most of the tourist places like charminar, salar jung and hussain sagar. Grand Hotel located near to this serves good food at cheap price - a chicken biryani costs Rs 160 and is sufficient for 2 adults. The hotel offers a travel desk and you can arrange car at good prices for a day visit to Ramoji. The hotel staff are helpful. The only inconvenience we faced was that we were asked to wait for 3 hours as the check in time was 12 noon.

reviews.title: Budgeted stay
reviews.text: The rooms r spacious and as shown in d pics.stay was comfortable.dont expect much from the staff,rooms were clean with proper branded biotique toileteries provided.A c was also gud.I got a deal from mmt n got d rooms for 900 so the stay was also affordable to me as compared to d price i paid.In breakfast for 3 of us they gave 1 plate dosa idli n mysore bhajji n tea.over all we were out most of d time for shopping n sightseeing so kinda ajdusted.

reviews.title: Decent Family Hotel
reviews.text: Pros: Rooms are clean and big The price is good. I booked it through makemytrip. Air-condition is good. WiFi has good speed close to Nampally railway station Don't order room service. It sucks. There is Kamath in Nampally station road. Also you get decent lunch buffet in Hotel Harsha, opposite to railway station Near by restaurants: 1. Kamath in

reviews.title: nice centrally located hotel
reviews.text: Now renamed as grand elite hotel, it is centrally situated in Abids. Rooms are spacious, clean, and well maintained. Staffs are cordial and helpful. Food quality is good. There is a associated travel desk near the reception. The travel agent is friendly and helpful. Although the travel agent neatly managed car and sightseeing during our stay there, at the time of Airport dropping we have to wait for nearly one hour and almost failed our journey for some car problem, as they do not have own car and driver for emergency purpose. So be careful for Airport dropping. Another thing is that they do not provide Tea maker in room (however room service is available all the time). Good place to stay in the midst of main city.

reviews.title: good stay with good service
reviews.text: Best hotel had a good stay with family.rooms are clean good service and helpful staff. near to Railwaly Station.near to abid market place and sight seeing places.silent place in the,crowded market, Iscon temple is just besides.

reviews.title: good hotel
reviews.text: It is a good hotel to stay. it has all basic enmities required for a business hotel. Though the complimentary breakfast was not that good but manageable. i have to appreciate their internet facility. it was too good.

reviews.title: nice experience
reviews.text: Food and room service was good.nice hospitality.have a good quality food.even when there is hot out side.still we r cool in hotel.very efficient staff ready to serve. I like very much.life time experience.

reviews.title: Worth for Money
reviews.text: Service & cleanliness was good. Best part is it was located very near to Isckon temple and shopping areas. Travel Help Desk also cooperated well and guided us for the city tour. Totally it was worth for the money paid.

reviews.title: good budget hotel
reviews.text: Located in thr heart of the city , spacious clean rooms and supportive staff . Value for money .....good service is provided in the hotel.i would like to recommend to all,thank you for the good stay....

reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text: Room was not clean. AC display was not working. Both in remote and AC. Phone was also not working properly. Corridor was full of dust. Breakfast was not good. Flask and tea cups were of very bad condition. Not at all neat. I am just wondering how this hotel got 3* In short very bad experience.

reviews.title: the ditiest place I ever stayed at
reviews.text: Booked via Makemytrip (under the new name "Grand Elite Hotel") I was looking forward to three days Hyderabad - but arriving at the place in a really rotten neighbourhoud the dream of a nice stay in Hyderabad became a nightmare. The matrass was as hard as a bed made of wood layed upon some springs. Walking barefoot in the room gave you the unwelcomed sensation of sand and dirt particles you where stepping on everywhere in the room, the bed sheet was used and smelled after the last people having slept there, I do not know how many ... .Mirrors and windows have not been cleaned for some years, the bathroomdoor was rotten and someone tried to fix it with some sort of metal years ago - the metal was also rotten and showed dangerous, dirty edges. Taking a shower there means to feel more dirty than before. Even the lift was dirty inside. Yes, they offered us an other room to stay and the repeated there meaningless "sorry, sorry" after we showed them the photos we took - the trip was spoiled and we run away not caring if they would give us the money back or not, staying in such a place was too dangerous.

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Rooms are clean, spacious, well arranged and comfortable. The location of hotel is in center to ABIDS. Overall it is a nice place to stay. The bed are little hard, but seeing the overall amenities and comfort it may be overlooked also.

reviews.title: Average stay with poor hospitality
reviews.text: There are many pros and cons about this hotel which i can just list it down. 1. Area- Hotel is located in a well crowded market/ business area with public transportation is easily available. 2. Check In/Checkout - 24 hrs check out is not available for people who book online. No English speaking staff at reception after office hours. Not provided the bill at the time of check out and given the reason that printer is not working!. Struggled and followed up for almost 10 days to get the bill soft copy. 3. Rooms - The room which i stayed was spacious with a big flat screen TV, dining table, well air conditioned with modern amenities but poorly maintained by the staff. AC drainage pipeline is connected to bathroom and washbasin area and kept open. AC remote is without battery cover and not working properly.Sleep quality was OK but rooms are not sound proof. Bed and bed sheet was good. 4. Food- Food quality was just average, quantity supplied was huge for 1 person. There is a restaurant attached with the hotel which you can order food to the room. you can find many good restaurants near by the area as the city itself is famous for tasty food. Overall i will give 2.5 out of 5 ignoring the fact that i had a bad experience to get the bill from reception.

reviews.title: Excellent Stay
reviews.text: Very good location, near to Namapally Station. Cooperative staff, excellent services. Amazing food. Rooms are in good condition. A definite "YES" to this hotel. Thanks to Cleartrip for getting such amazing deals. If you are visiting, do book this hotel. Best Value @ very reasonable price.

reviews.title: Beyond my expectations
reviews.text: I stayed there with my college friends for 4 days, it was college tour.The rooms which we get were simply superb, it was spacious clean and all facilities were there. Though 4 persons were there in one room even then it was not congested. Secondly, breakfast which were having over there was so yummy & varieties were unlimited. washrooms were also very clean. The room interior was also very good. It was very happy stay over there & ya would like to visit again.

reviews.title: Ideal location but property could have maintained better
reviews.text: My only reason for selecting this hotel was that they are offering 4 bed room for family. Since my mother was travelling with me and she needs continuous assistance, we have opted out of booking other hotels as we have to book two rooms for 4 persons. Hotel is very badly maintained and needs a facelift. It has restaurant but very arrogant staff who are not behaving with the customers. It was a shock for me and I have vacated the hotel well before I have planned to stay. This is my first hotel stay which left me with a sour feeling.

reviews.title: Hyderabad Trip 01 Nov to 06 Nov 2014
reviews.text: Hotel is clean and rooms are ok but breakfast is almost same everyday. Hotel staff is good but not so prompt in service. Travel desk is good and driver of vehicle Mr Amjad is really very nice person he took us almost all place in hyderabad and guide very accurately. Thank you amjadbhai

reviews.title: Budget stay! Great Location!
reviews.text: Rooms were clean and well kept. Ground staff were helpful. Breakfast was okay. Best part is, it is near all the attractions of the old city Hyderabad. Hotel has free wifi and recommended for budget stay!

reviews.title: Nice family stay for couple of days
reviews.text: This hotel is located beside the big shopping mall. Market area is just outside the hotel. Rooms are good. But need little bit maintenance. They have a effective travel desk who can help you to plan to trip. I booked a deluxe room for 3 days. During my stay I had real problem with the breakfast they are offering. They offered only south indian foods like Idli,chatni,sambar, Upma. They should introduce some variation. They don't have in house restaurant and they bring food from Hotel Grand. You can have real good biriyani from this hotel.

reviews.title: Excellent stay in Hyderabad
reviews.text: I stayed in this hotel for four days with my family. I took two deluxe rooms here and both the rooms were clean and tidy. Bathrooms were clean. Management was friendly. This hotel offers buffet break fast and the restaurant attached to the hotel (Masti Restaurant) offers delicious food. The staff in the restaurant were friendly. This hotel has an underground car parking facility. There is a travel desk in the hotel, which is is helpful for tourists. They arranged a car and a driver cum guide for me to go to various tourist locations in Hyderabad. The driver Amjad was a perfect driver. The only problem with this hotel was that I got hot water only one day in my stay here. The spring beds are a little hard, so some people may feel it a little annoying. Highly recommended for families. Pros:- Comfortable stay Car parking facility Friendly staff Good Restaurant Travel desk Silent atmosphere Cons:- Spring beds

reviews.title: Nice stay
reviews.text: We booked this hotel and it was little difficult to locate. The locals The hotel is near to all shopping attractions. The rooms are spacious but the water is hard. Happy for what we paid. This hotel is also known as Hotel High Street Grande.

reviews.title: Not worth what I "spent for"
reviews.text: 24 Hours Checkout: Not valid for online booking (big surprise -as I got booking done via clear trip had a big conversation but end of it was the words like " whatever you say we'll take the room at 12:00") Food Quality: Awful, only two items they serve (both south indian out of which one is always Idli); Even from Room Service their non-veg stinks and is rock solid as if its ages old. Service: Very slow - infact despite of regular reminders twice they forgot to bring my order

reviews.title: Great service and perfect value for money
reviews.text: My first visit to Hyderabad with my family. One of the few economical options for a family room, the hotel turned out to be in a central area surrounded by very good shops and factory outlets within few metres and Iscon temple a couple of steps. The connectivity from here to all tourist attractions in Hyderabad was very good making the trip easy and comfortable. The customer service and help from the hotel staff was excellent even after checking out of the room. Will definitely stay here again and recommend to family and friends.

reviews.title: Good and nice
reviews.text: The rooms are pretty awesome. The location is very convenient. Room service is also good. Cost effective choice, if you book rooms here. The food is a bit overpriced and spicy. No restaurant in the hotel, only room service. It was a good experience!

reviews.title: Very bad Administation
reviews.text: Hotel is located at an excellant place.But they employed primitive room cleaning staff who were banging the doors so hard that they almost broke tbe doors thus disturbing guests.The owneship of the hotel has no cotroll over the staff.One of the recepionist asked me for money by way of tip .I refused to give.Becuase of complescency of management.,standards of this hotel is coming down.I stpped staying in this hotel.I stayed at this hotel for the last 4 years on number of occations.

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: I have stayed this hotel for two days. The hotel is very neat and maintained well. The staffs are very polite and helpful. The hotel location is also good and very near to tourist places. The complimentary breakfast for the first day was also very good. I would certainly prefer this hotel for my next visit to Hyderabad. I also suggest others this hotel for a nice stay at Hyderabad.

reviews.title: Terrible Experience, They Don't Know What Hotel is !!!
reviews.text: I have never Imagined that a Hotel which is rated so high can be of so worst level. What to share what to leave. 1. Staff was so arrogant they didn't listen to us for any service or their mistake other then giving a fresh excuse for each and every thing. 2. Room was horrible dirty when we checked in at 11 P.M. 3. Latches of Wash Rooms were not working at all. 4. In breakfast they failed to provide anything. They couldn't manage even Bread Slices. 5. Billing for room services for those items which we didn't avail at all. Pure NO NO NO.

reviews.title: I liked the Hospitality and committed personal.
reviews.text: I was really not sure earlier before visiting this hotel and was in 2 minds should i book this hotel rooms or not ? I checked to this hotel with my 2 groups of family on 31st Dec 15 and stayed there till 4 Jan 16 and found all management and staff personal were very kind, humble and supportive. My stay with family was fantastic and moreover the service and staff were always there for our service. Breakfast was good and is near to all old places in OLD city. Charminar and Mecca Masjid is only 2 KMS from this hotel and you can go by Auto Rickshaw per seat in only RS 15 per person. Remember you have very famous Restaurant i.e "GRAND HOTEL" exactly backside of this hotel near Hyderabad GPO Post office Building, where you get very Yummy and Tasty foods like Biryani. I suggest one should try MUTTON Biryani and IRANI tea. I bet no one can eat a complete biryani plate as the food quality is very good and cost is very cheap. 5 person can easily have COMBO MUTTON BIRYANI plate of 390 only. Food is very very very cheap and excellent. I sincerely thank Hotel's Travel Desk personal named MOHAMMAD YOUSUF who really took care of our transport and ensure we got all our tickets in hotel itself without visiting actual place and standing in queue. In case if anyone is looking for transport, I request you to consult him for better tour arrangement. I also thank "Dattu", front desk office in this HOTEL, who sincerely stick to his words committed over phone and provided excellent services to me and other guest in hotel. Next time, for sure will visit this place with more number of peoples. Guys you may try to stay with family in this hotel as i had a very good experience for 5 days. HAPPY NEW YEAR to all Hotel staff and Keep up to good work. Regards, Mohammad Sarfaraz

reviews.title: Good hotel for short stay
reviews.text: Hotel was hard to find. Taxi to airport from hotel was slightly expensive Nothing wrong with the hotel, nothing very special. Feel the rooms were lacking in natural light. Good place to stay if you are visiting Hyderabad for travel/tourism

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: Had a good stay at Grand Elite Hotel. The hospitality and the services are good.the food was of great quality and taste. Morning complimentary breakfast catered all varieties. Overall it was very good.

reviews.title: Excellant
reviews.text: The stay was very comfortable, neat and clean, warm hospitality, in total everything was very pleasant and we really enjoyed our holiday. We will recommend all our freinds, relatives & wellwishers of our experience in this hotel.

reviews.title: Excellent Hotel to be in with family
reviews.text: The quality of rooms n food was good. The only drawback was limited veg items for lunch n dinner. Otherwise wifi,staff,accessibility to tourist places was really gud. Would highly recommend it to frnds n family. Wish to be there again the next time round.

reviews.title: Superb Hotel
reviews.text: It is having almost 5 star look.Most comfortable rooms with Lord Balajee welcoming you.It has been a lucky hotel. Whenever I stayed there my work had got done easily.It has been located in heart of the Hyderabad city.And you feel as though you are in peaceful place without any noise.

reviews.title: Good Budget Centrally
reviews.text: Good Budget Property, we had a great stay in hyderabad and the staff was courteous at the front office, The hotel has 100 percent veg restaurant catering to all the needs. overall had a good stay in hyderabad

reviews.title: excellent
reviews.text: service above your expectations..quality of breakfast well maintained.. tasty dinner .. nice stay at low price.. staffs cooperative and very well behaved... all additional requirement like vehicle or tickets for tour are arranged without any hesitation

reviews.title: Clean and Spacious Rooms..
reviews.text: Rooms are pretty spacious and well maintained.In my first stint, i had some problem with the Air Condition.. then had to re-visit reception to get into another room which had proper Air Condition system. Decent and well behaved staff Excellent food. But if you are accustomed to a soft bed, then you might have to think twice before booking here. Sleep quality is not that great. As compared with other hotels, I expected a soft and plush beds in the room but for my fortune, I had a very hard bed.

reviews.title: Very Good
reviews.text: I stayed in the hotel three days with family. The hotel situated in a lonely and peaceful place. The hotel staff were very pleasant and helpful to us. The breakfast was not fine. If we will visit hyderabad next time sure that we stay here.

reviews.title: Grand Elite Hotel- need to improve
reviews.text: I gave 3 pts as it needs to improve- no refrigerator, old-age furniture, no cloth hanger in cupboards, split AC water leakage, washrooms must be more cleaner. breakfast has very limited items. Major landmark is Big Bazaar/ GPO at Abids circle, nearby is a great restaurant named Grand & many shops for grocery items/ food. This circle is hub for almost all transport in the city.

reviews.title: Nice Place
reviews.text: Nice place to stay and the staff's were co-operative. Centrally located near to All Shopping places. Very near to Hyderabad Railway Station. Breakfast was very simple but that is more than enough as they provide different dishes everyday with Bread.

reviews.title: good
reviews.text: we stayed in family room for two days. The room was clean. staff was good and polite. Hotel location was good. It was middle of hyderabad. Travel desk was good and very expensive. budget hotel. good hotel for short stay.

reviews.title: very good experience
reviews.text: first of all it is value for money, the room is a star category and the service staff very also very polite and the hotel is clean and very well maintained. and the hotel is also centrally located this is a major advantage

reviews.title: Mr Adkar
reviews.text: Ok kind of hotel with no restaurant facility.. Location wise good for only stay pour pose ... Beds are too hard ... Service is quick and prompt ...as centrally located can visit all tourist destinations in Hyderabad... Should improve on breakfast and beds....

reviews.title: Decent Reveiw
reviews.text: Centrally Located and visit, Pricing is very good with kind of ambience, courteous staff. I stayed there for two days with family and found the place very decent and we get good deals on on line bookings

reviews.title: good for stay
reviews.text: i stayed in hoel from 18th to 21 June 2015. hotel intirior is very good with cleaniness. resto of hotel is ok. the best part is it is centrally located at ABIDS area. and very convienient to go all torist places. But the management is very poor. Specially reception counter. we need to call altleast 3 times for even water and tea also. need to be improved.

reviews.title: Overall Good..!
reviews.text: Overall Satisfactory experience..!! But it is not 4 star property... so dont expect service like that..!! But i would like to mention that it is not Bad hotel and location either..!! Looks are Deceptive..is the phrase which suits the Hotel, The photos which is shown about the Hotel shows that the Hotel is 4 star property..But actually it is not..Though photos are not fake but taken from such view, that in photos it appears that Hotel is very spacious and Looks wise wonderful..But it is in very small Lane and not at all spacious..!! To summarize don't expect 4 star Treatment..!!

reviews.title: A very good centrally located hotel
reviews.text: Hotel High Street Grande (now renamed Hotel Elite Grand) is very conveniently located in Abids, the heart of Hyderabad. Rooms are very clean, well arranged and polite staff attending to your needs. The best part is the reception is open 24 hours and late check in is not a hassle at all. Breakfast is on the house, while not a large spread out, is satisfactory. The restaurant closes down early, but the room service arranges dinner from nearby eateries at a very reasonable price even upto 11:30 p.m at night.

reviews.title: Only boasting...but not up to the mark
reviews.text: Please do not be fooled by the pics shown to you....Those pics are absolutely fake...I am not saying that this is a worst property but it is not a 3* hotel for sure.... The only thing is location and the breakfast was allegedly buffet which only had idly,poha(half beaten rice),bread... Only stay here if you are real tight on budget and that you have to be near to Isckon temple premises..Otherwise you can have lot of choices around here

reviews.title: Good family hotel
reviews.text: We stayed there for 3 days. The rooms are clean, spacious. All the amenities were in good conditions like ac, TV & lights. The only problem is in bathroom. They don't have indoor food, they order food from another restaurant. Common light were not proper. Overall experience is between good & average.

reviews.title: Poor Hotel
reviews.text: I stayed in this hotel for 6 days, I have travelled across south and I have never seen more pathetic hotel than this one.. The hot water in not available in the evening, the so called complimentary break fast is pathetic... Too bad..

reviews.title: Best Budget hotel ........!
reviews.text: I stayed along with my friends for 3 nights (26th july to 29th july 2014), overall good experience. 1. check in very easy and short. 2. check out even more easy. 3. Rooms are spacious and clean but bath room is small and basic. 4. high speed internet very efficient. 5. limited breakfast menu, no English breakfast. But taste was good. 6. For vegetarians little problem as they don't have only veg restaurant. 7. Location is more convenient for tourist spots and transport. 8. lobby of hotel rooms is small and always smells cigarette smoke. 9. Friendly staff. 10. only complaint is regarding drinking water not supplied in room and also very cheap and limited supply of toiletry products. 11. overall good experience.

reviews.title: Perfect Hotel in Hyderabad
reviews.text: Nice hotel & Hospitality too. Nice staff. Especially the owner Mr Rao is personally entertained. Well return of your money. Well Interior, But the mattress are with spring, which is uncomfortable to sleep. Hotel is one of the best hotel in Hyderabad.

reviews.title: Best value for money near Nampally Station
reviews.text: Located few hundred meters away from the Nampally station in Hyderabad, High street Grande is a great place to stay. I have stayed quite a few times and they always have great unbeatable prices via cleartrip. Clean beds, clean washrooms, free wifi, breakfast included in the price are some of the positive factors that make me stay here. Never stayed overnight, but for those short 1-2 day trips, this is a perfect place to stay.

reviews.title: High Street Grand
reviews.text: This hotel has been located in the heart of the city and the best in its category.You can save lot of time in transportation .You can be very comfortably with our privacy being intact. Rooms are spacious and airy.And break fast is also very good.

reviews.title: Bad rooms and bad policies
reviews.text: The hotel has a strange policy, even though they had rooms available because of early check-in I had to pay the extra money. The room I got had only one window which opened to a wall of the adjacent building so essentially no natural light in the room. Food is below average and the breakfast buffet is only for 1 hour. Location is nothing great as the entire roads are one way so if you take vehicle it's a roundabout to go to any other places.

reviews.title: Nice Stay!!
reviews.text: Its a very nice hotel at a reasonable price. it provides a complimentary meal. The rooms are quite good. The staff is helpful. It provides good services. Nice locality of the hotel. Provides Cab service to and fro from a place. Overall, its oriented towards good hospitality.

reviews.title: Very nice to say
reviews.text: So good to stay free Wi-Fi if they provide breakfast it will good This is only draws back Those who want stay family it's very nice Just beside the hotel there is iskon temple It's very near to shopping also

reviews.title: Family
reviews.text: The hotel is good but the inside rooms in the toilet bathrooms tabs were not fit properly no 24 hours hot water. breakfast is not that great no Assistant was available to help they should make arrangement for airport pick up drop. location of the hotel is good thank you

reviews.title: Very Satisfied
reviews.text: Great staff, room and wifi connectivity. Also this place is pretty centrally located and as easy to get to from the bus stop. Polite and helpful staff. I didn't try the food so cant tell you about that. The only problem was hot water. But thats about it.

reviews.title: ARNAV
reviews.text: The hotel Service has improved drastically and the restaurant service has also improved dramatically from my last visit. There hotel is real value for money, the rooms are really spacious. If on visit to hyderabad we will save time and money in terms of travel and time. The visit to hyderabad can be completed in very fast time and the lunch can be done in the hotel visiting all the places of visit in hyderabad.

reviews.title: Pathetic service
reviews.text: The place is nothing but ordinary and service even worse. Ambience is dull and rooms are poorly decorately. The staff and presentation is poor. Breakfast buffet is thumns down. Not at all worth staying!

reviews.title: A convenient stay
reviews.text: Located in key Abids area. Cordial staff, good service, the complimentary breakfast is okay but could be better if they have medu vada on alternative days. I, for one, was satisfied. I will stay there again.

reviews.title: grand ellite hotel exp
reviews.text: Rooms were good and spacious..Poor breakfast. 15 mins walk from nampally railway station and its near to sultan bazaar. Travel desk also available. Better to have food from restaurants outside.........

reviews.title: Nice location in abids
reviews.text: Yes it was a good hotel we book a family room for three days my room no was 203 it's nice room with 2 double beds Easley 4 members can sleep bathroom was nice hot water coming from 6 to 10 but our request they provide us at 4 o clock in morning as we have to go srisailm early in the morning the manager was very humble to us the travel desk was a little bit costly overall good to stay there

reviews.title: good and decent hotel
reviews.text: stayed in this hotel for 2 nights the hotel is good the rooms are better and well maintained but the room service is bit late..over all nice and cozy and at an affordable price and everything is accessible from hotel

reviews.title: Good, budget hotel.
reviews.text: I found this hotel on tripadvisor and booked it through booking.com. Our experience was good. It is well located near the Iskcon temple in Abeds. Shopping and transportation is no problem. Rooms are large and in good condition. Staff is good, helped us in airport transportation. Offered a clock room for free for 8 hours. Breakfast was nice. Not a star hotel but value for money at this price. I recommend it.

reviews.title: Grand elite hotel is terrible
reviews.text: First of all there are no proper lights in room half of its not functioning, no proper latches for toilets,housekeeping very poor, breakfast quality very poor.... Hotel close to all tourist places but need to improve standard of services drastically...

reviews.title: Service
reviews.text: The hotel has been located in the heart of the city.I stayed in this Hotel on 29-04-2013.This Hotel was not being maintained appropriately.The was no hot water.The taps in the bath room are not closing once you open them.This hotel has been manned by young boys who did not know how to welcome guests and how to speak politely which is more important than anything else.The primitive nature of the staff may cause damage to the reputation of thehotel.

reviews.title: Appearances can be deceiving
reviews.text: We selected this hotel in Hyderabad for our stay and the following features was listed in its website 1. Complimentary breakfast 2. free wifi connection 3. 24 hrs hot water facility 4. well maintained rooms 5.prompt service 6. good views etc... Now let us see What we found out 1. To our utter disbilief we found out that this hotel does not have a restaurant although it provides complimentary breakfast!!.and the breakfast consists of idly, chutney and tea. WTH?? 2. No wifi signal detected upto our knowledge 3. If you need to take bath in hot water at night, well, thats not possible coz. here hot water is on only from 7 to 12 in the morning. Ridiculous isn't it? 4.I am posting the photos and you decide how the rooms are maintained 5. Ya that seems okay, coz, if we order tea at 7 in the morning we will get it within an hour and a half.That seems justified. 6. And regarding views, the hotel is surrounded by other buildings so we can have a good view of other structures sans Nature. So My advise when u plan to visit Hyderabad next time, do a detailed check on hotel by contacting people who stayed there before rather than checking the hotels website.

reviews.title: Stay at this hotel
reviews.text: I stayed with my family for two days for the peripod from 2nd to 4th october.Tariff are very reasonable after huge discount although this hotel is in the heart of the city and naturally well connectivity.Staff are cooperative and helpful.Manager of the hotel still need to be approachable and who should guide the staff to attend the requirements/needs of the tourists at the earliest possible time and his assistants at the reception should guide/ offer any help them voluntarily in the matters of sight seeing although this hotel have one transport desk.Catering services still needs improvement and keep the eatables ready instead of make the tourist to wait for minutes together.On the whole, we recommend other tourists to stay in this hotel and enjoy.

reviews.title: One of the worst hotels experienced.
reviews.text: No hot water, no breakfast available even at 9.15 am.. Either items finished or absolutely cold, 1 person arranged breakfast, tea that is brought from outside, since hotel does not have it's own restaurant. Wonder why false claims made of restaurant and other luxuries, when even basic amenities such as cleanliness is also a big aspect. Old and dirty look everywhere.. How could it be considered in premium category? Hopeless hotel!

reviews.title: Nice Hotel
reviews.text: The hotel is a nice one to stay if you are looking to book a hotel in abids. It has got a travel desk which can help you to make most of your hyderabad trip and also has a spa where you can relax your body. With near proximity to most of the markets in abids, staying in this hotel will definitely give you some pleasant memories

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: Good: Hotel location is good, most of the sight seeing places are nearby and can go by auto. Staff is very much cooperative. WI-fi/internet is available. Food is good and can order authentic dishes like biryani. Rooms are in good condition. Not Good: Hot water is not available 24 hours, only from 6am to 9am. Market shops are all around. ISKON temple is next to hotel. No balcony/terrace to any of the room. View is not good from hotel window.

reviews.title: Depressing ghost town
reviews.text: I understand its cheap, but you really do get what you pay for here and nothing more. Hotels in Thailand can be very cheap but also very nice... this was beyond basic. We had 2 nights booked and left after 1... reasons being mixed with how much we disliked the hotel and how minging Patong is in general. Its like Magaluf on steroids 😷😷 The hotel is very depressing when you walk in and reception had the strangest smell. There was also oddly not 1 person around aside from the receptionist. We had booked a room with a balcony but were given the wrong room and couldnt be provided with the right room until the next day but tbh didnt really matter as the "mountain" view was more like a rubbish dump with mountains in view behind it. I requested free breakfast to compensate the breakfast which we had but it was the worst breakfast of the holiday. The breakfast room is so hot and humid you barely want to sit there. The room was clean enough but very dull and the tv didnt work. We went out to explore Patong n hated it so much we packed up the next morning. I wouldnt waste another day in Patong nor this hotel.

reviews.title: Great Roof Top Pool
reviews.text: What's not to like about a roof top pool? Nice clean rooms in a great location away from the noise of Patong sea front but within walking distance. Very friendly staff and scooter hire right next door and lots of great restaurants and massage parlours.

reviews.title: Budget Hotel
reviews.text: If you’re looking for decent hotel within your budget i highly recommend this hotel. Bike Rentals, Massage Service available at reception. 5 mins walk to Banzaan fresh market and Jungceylon shopping center.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: Sorry but disappointing stay, ok but cleanliness is a big concern. 3 stars usually mean no frills but should not mean unclean. Location good, check in easy, unfortunately room was below 3 star level. Other peoples' hair everywhere, big step into bath/shower with no handle so not suitable to people with movement difficulties, rooftop pool is nice but no idea where the pool towels were. Found them at reception. Steep steps (be very careful), no lights after dark. Bathroom product packaging actually mouldy. Balcony had no furniture so couldn't actually enjoy using it. Went to go for a nap in the afternoon, pulled back the sheets and found small bugs crawling around (about 10), called reception, housekeeper attended, brushed them off and said 'no bugs now'. Was refused a room change, hard for them to agree to them to change the sheets, I advised I would go out for about an hour to let them do this. Came back about 2 hours later and sheets not changed. Spoke to different reception girl, went through the same song and dance, (can not move rooms, fully booked, no rooms avail), struggle again to get the sheets changed, said it would be another hour or so. Went out for dinner came back, no change to sheets, sat in foyer in reception to wait for the housekeeper to attend. 5 mins later... new room found! (It was around 10.30pm by now) Was my first night after overnight flight so I was utterly exhausted, slept and checked out 6am next morning. Wifi good, even reached next door restaurant (really good food there) Keep looking for better hotels, or pay a bit more

reviews.title: first class service
reviews.text: 3rd time of staying at the addplus hotel and it was as good as ever date 22/5/18--9/6/18 have already planned next visit nov 18 ..as it is low season at this time breakfasts are bit different,,buffet for fruit /bread and order hot food ..all staff excellent and very helpful,my room was big -cleaned daily to good standard..highly recommended.location is great and near to market and resturants with larger market due to be up and running shortly

reviews.title: Poor : At best a Lodge
reviews.text: I don't blame Addplus Hotel & Spa. They do not have the necessary experience or the infrastructure. For those who understand hotels, it is at best a lodge. I will give you the reason as to why I mention what I mention : A) The basics are not there. They are yet grappling withe their basic air-conditioning. We were shifted twice. The same has jog yet been rectified. B) there are two English Channels. The telecast was at best grainy; resembling the one which we used to have pre 1980's. C) the bathroom doesn't even have a shower curtain D) the room has a defunct telephone - making it impossible to contact the reception. I really do not blame them as Addplus doesn't have the necessary infrastructure. I was booked through Thomas Cook who have been the culprit of booking me here. Thomas Cook claims that they have the necessary experience of 173 years. I beg to differ and I am sharing with you as is where is basis feedback. I am yet staying with them and I really do not know how I need to spend my remaining 02 days with them,

reviews.title: Great Staff, Close to everything, but not too close!
reviews.text: Stayed here for two weeks and I was impressed. This hotel is a great value for the price. Yes, there are many nicer hotels, but for a budget hotel this one is hard to beat! The staff is very friendly. the hotel is very clean and the stand out is by far the breakfast buffet!!

reviews.title: The location and the roof top pool are the selling points.
reviews.text: You can walk to JungCeylon Shopping Centre in under five minutes, for a break from Thai Life and Heat. Just a little refreshing before taking on the Lifestyle of Patong, however saying that, the beach, Bangla Road & Paradise Centre are all a ten minute stroll, no Tuk Tuk required There is a sign in the entrance to the lift, which basically says two Fat people at a time with luggage or four Skinny people with luggage

reviews.title: Was pretty good
reviews.text: This hotel was in a good location, so close to Bangla road and all the restaurants! the absolute best part about it was the size, the rooms were huge and the beds seemed even larger then a king size and pretty comfy too! I had a few problems with the air con tho as it took forever for the room to get cold and I ended up changing rooms and it was a little bit better in the second one! Also, the shower is a tiny bit dangerous as the water floods the floor a little bit and I was pretty worried I was going to slip when stepping out of the bathtub, so if your an older person/couple then PLEASE be cautious of this as I would hate to see someone slip and be injured! Over all the hotel was awesome and amazingly priced and I will definitely be back! 😁

reviews.title: Great location, great price!
reviews.text: Large room and clean , It's in short walking distance to the biggest shopping mall in patong The rooms are modern and kept in good condition, beds super comfy. The staff were really helpful and kind. Nice Pool and view from Top of The Hotel 9th Floor I will back to stay at Addplus in next vacation.

reviews.title: Back again
reviews.text: We came back for a 2nd time for 4 nights, For a budget hotel its very good for the price. The only faults I can point out is - The cleaners in the morning will come into your room in the morning while your still there. I had to eventually put a chair against the door. Allthough after 3 days stay ..mysteriously appeared a do not disturb/make up room card appeared on the door handle. We had water distruption for some hours maybe through no fault of their own. The safe could not be used when checking into the room and needed the master key to reset. Other than that very comortable stay, Comfy beds is one of the reason I returned. Aircon worked well and not to far from where you need to go in Patong.

reviews.title: Good budget hotel.
reviews.text: 10-15 minutes walk to Jungceylon Mall. Breakfast spread was ok. A good budget hotel in Phuket. The massage there is affordable and good too, though there won't be any problem in finding any there. There's a convenient store nearby too. Rooms was pretty decent, with basic necessities. Check in and out was smooth.

reviews.title: Mixed feelings
reviews.text: First off check in was easy and the front desk staff are friendly. Taken to our room which is a good size and luckily we were on level 7 and had a view other wise we would be staring into another hotel. No seats and no ashtray on the balcony but ya get over that. This hotel is not a far distance if you would like to walk to the beach or bangla rd but directly around the hotel there is a whole lot of nothing, walking one direction there is a tip or something and it smells so I suggest walking towards jungelcylon shopping center at night a tuk tuk is 200 bht. The cleaner on our floor walked into our room almost everyday, She opened the door and stuck her head in and then knocked, to bad if one of us had just got out of the shower or something. I don't think the sheets on our bed got changed for 5 days she just made the bed so it looked nice, changed the towels and gave us new water. Also when getting a taxi tell them hallo patong because nobody knows where addplus is.

reviews.title: 3 weeks at patong
reviews.text: i did booked the standrad room but if i did arrived at the Hotel i take a look for it i tanke the upgrade. standrad room is just go for Backpackers or just visitor that ne a bad to sleep. bad Internet old Hotel no pool and room direct to the street with bad aircondion. the premiun room r much better at all of it. so dont Forget ist not a four star Hotel. the Location is great may 10 min to walt to bangla road an 5 min more to the beach. all at all nice Hotel breakfast is typical Thai and ok.

reviews.title: Great for a few nights!
reviews.text: We stayed here for two nights, it wasn't what we expected when we arrived, however the room and bathroom were big, clean and the aircon was good. We didn't have a balcony however we didn't need one for the time we spent in the room. It was in a good location, 10 minute walk to the beach and a 5 minute walk from the 'walking street' (pub street). There was a roof top pool which was a decent size and was clean, definitely needed in the heat!

reviews.title: cosy clean hotel
reviews.text: i stayed here for 13 nights in June 2017 couldn't fault this hotel one bit great location walking distance from the night life and local shopping centre i would recommend staying here i have stayed in more expensive places in phuket and nothing beats the service from this hotel

reviews.title: First time in Thailand
reviews.text: When I first read the reviews on this hotel I was sceptical to say the least, though my worries were for nothing. We picked up a taxi from the airport for 800 bhat, it took around an hour maybe longer but beware the taxi driver took us to a tour place and we ended up booking a tour but it turned out to be amazing, just not fun when you just want to go to bed and someone’s going on in your ear! We had a great time at add plus hotel, no problems at all. The staff were super friendly, check in was quick just what we needed after a 13 hour flight! Our room was huge, I think it was called superior something. Nice big bed, clean, we had a balcony which was ok only our view was of the next hotel but that wasn’t an issue. A few people have said about the bathroom and yes I do agree it’s like a death zone after a shower as the water runs off the side and floods the floor so something would need to be done about that especially with children. But we just put a towel down on the floor and put it out on the balcony to dry, so again not a huge issue for us. They have a decent pool up on the rooftop we only spent 2 days up there as we went to the beach most days but it was nice, never too busy you could always get a sunbed we even had it to ourselves for a few hours. The hotel is within walking distance of the shopping centre, Patong beach, the famous Bangla road and there’s a street food market stalls within 5 min walk. I can’t comment on the breakfast as they said it would be 300 baht per day for the two of us so we just went next door to “hallo Patong” hotel & restaurant and their food didn’t disappoint! We did speak to other guests about the hotel breakfast and they didn’t speak highly of it. Overall we would come back to this hotel, we had no problems what so ever and everyone we had spoken to said the same. I guess it’s just difference of opinion, thankyou add plus hotel for a lovely stay!

reviews.title: Budget hotel but still comfortable
