reviews.text: Stayed at the AddPlus for 4 nights last week and was pleased with the establishment (for the price). The rooms looked as though they had been modernised, beds were hard but bearable and we didn't get much noise in our room. The location isn't far from Bangla Road, maybe like a 10-15 minute walk if pottering along and there is an abundance of delish restaurants near by and a 7-11 a couple of doors up. The service was also friendly and helpful when asking questions. The negatives would have to be the shower in the bathroom, we had one that would flood around the edges and it left our floor very wet. Our bathroom needed a good deep clean too. The pool is quite small and there isn't much of an atmosphere on the top floor, its lacking music and more seating. Overall, decent stay for what we paid.

reviews.title: Lovely!
reviews.text: We stayed here for four nights and I couldn't fault the hotel or staff - only fault was the cleaner asking for a 3000 baht tip (£60 in English money... Was she having a laugh). But the room was immaculate, bed was comfy, the pool and views were brilliant and staff helped with everything we wanted. Would definitely stay here again. Price was very reasonable also especially as was only a short walk to the beach and main town.

reviews.title: Ok, but definitely not great
reviews.text: Booked this hotel for 5 days with a friend. The room was ok, but the bathroom window was incredibly weird. There is a giant window from the bathroom into the bedroom with blinds that don't cover the whole window well. The shower had no curtain as well, so you had to actively avert your eyes when in the bedroom as to not accidentally see the other person in the shower/bathroom. Very annoying. There is construction going on right nearby the hotel, so you wake up to jackhammers at 8am. There were weird stains on my bed I didn't notice until the second day, we almost ran out of toilet paper the first day and there wasn't more in the room, and breakfast was definitely not worth it. The room was simple - no drawers, but beds were fine otherwise, and location was good because it was within easy walking distance to the beach and to the party street area. However, I would choose a different place if I was in the area again.

reviews.title: Suited to our trip
reviews.text: This hotel was a great price for our 2 week stay. The focus of our trip to Thailand was to visit islands so we spent a lot of our time out on trips and not in the hotel. The hotel is in a good location near a shopping centre, the beach and Bangla road but far away enough to get a good nights sleep. The hotel room itself is quite spacious and pleasant. It was cleaned every day however the bed linen was only changed about 3 times during our 2 week stay. The staff were pleasant throughout our stay also. I think the hotel rooms were to a good standard however the hotel front and lobby could do with an upgrade to look more appealing especially the spa part. Overall I would recommend this hotel to those who planned to be out exploring Thailand and not to those who spend a lot relaxing within their hotel or resort.

reviews.title: Dirty bedding...
reviews.text: If I could give this place 0/5 I would. This hotel was not the cheapest hotel out of the 7 we stayed in whilst in Thailand but definitely the worst. After reading previous reviews about cleanliness I was a little nervous at arriving at the Add Plus. I was correct to be worried.. after the man on reception showed us the the room I decided to pull back the duvet to inspect the bed linen, there was makeup stains and dirty marks on the underside of the duvet cover and pillows, they were filthy -it looked to us like they’d been turned over rather than changed!! Upon going back to reception to complain he came back up to have a look and take photos of the bedding. He then said.. they will be changed the next day, as if he expected us to sleep in a dirty bed that night......not on your life!!!!!!!!! We were horrified at the suggestion and demanded to be changed rooms. The alternative room was better but still not great.. By this time it was after 7pm we’d been travelling for most of the day and were tired and hungry so had to settle for it. We were only there for 2 nights but we couldn’t wait to move on. There was no shower screen so the bathroom floor would get soaked everytime we had a shower and the bathroom door wouldn’t close. The rooms are also extremely tired and dated, all the furniture looked like it needed a good scrub or even better replacing. Am so glad breakfast wasn’t included after seeing the cleanliness of the rooms... NEVER AGAIN!!!!!!

reviews.title: Decent hotel good location
reviews.text: Good hotel for a very reasonable price. Great location. Only 5 mins from shopping centre and a further 5 mins to bangala road. Room very clean and towels changed and bed dressed every day. Nice size pool on the rooftop which has good views. Wifi very good.

reviews.title: One word awesome
reviews.text: The addplus hotel and spa in patong is one of the best places ive stayed. The staff are amazing gracious and friendly. Our room was made up every morning without fail. My husband and I stayed here for 14 days and loved every minute of it. The roof top pool is an excellent spot to relax and enjoy the views. And the hotel is located in prime position 5 minute walk so you save of tuk tuks. They also have a full spa treatments service area to. Wonderful wonderful place to stay. ⭐⭐⭐⭐ rating

reviews.title: Cheap and not that good
reviews.text: We completed the other 5 days of our honeymoon in the hotel, the bed wasn't one big bed, it was kind of 2 beds merged together, the room wasn't comfortable and we changed it after the first night. I know it was suitable for the price but it wasn't as we thought about it at first. We knew that the pool was good but we didn't try it. The breakfast wasn't that good

reviews.title: Great Value for Money
reviews.text: I had read the reviews about this hotel, which was a mixed bag. So it was with hesitation I arrived after the 17 hours from the UK. I arrived at 9am and was told by Reception my room would be ready around 1pm. I explained I need sleep after my journey. The staff took me to what turned out to be a budget room, I'd book a superior room for my stay. It was clean and had Air Con a basic requirement in the Patong humidity. The bathroom was basic with a shower hanging on the wall. Opposite the toilet in wet room set up. Later after an investigation of Patong I returned and was shown to my actual room. This was clean and modern and the bathroom was a separate to toilet area. The view from my room was to the hills that surround Patong. On the top of the hotel was a small lovely pool surrounded by sun loungers and a covered shaded area. I didn't have the breakfast so can't comment on that. Its location is good. Within a 5 minute stroll to the Jung Ceylon shopping centre. So about 7 minutes from Bangla walking street and 10 from the Beach. Overall I say this is a good location, with nice pool. For a little more you can get a good standard of room.

reviews.title: Normal Service and Cheap Price.
reviews.text: I booked 3 double rooms at this hotel for 3 nights. Rooms is so spacious and good view from balcony. The location is quite far from Patong Beach and Bang La Road where was exciting at night. I found some Vietnamese staff here and It was so easy to communicate and they are so helpful, friendly. The Thai Food was spicy and sweet, it is same Chinese Cuisine.

reviews.title: Comfy & Clean
reviews.text: For a nice place to stay on a budget Add Plus hits the spot, Big Bed, lots of space and with a good breakfast, Roof top pool is a nice place to cool off with good views of the city and the bay. 10 - 15 min walk to Bangala Rd

reviews.title: I would go for 5⭐️ for them 👍🏼
reviews.text: Cleanness well kept (only around bath in the bathroom some inadequacy). Staff rather nice and friendly. Location of Addplus is good with crowded Phangmuang Sai Kor road to cross as an only disadvantage (u will get that if u know how Thais drive cars and scooters on multi-line roads 😆). We got deluxe room for couples, and I gotta say it was one of our favorites of all the trip acco. Although the rooftop pool with a pretty nice view goes for a pig plus for them. In general I will of course recommend that place 👌🏽

reviews.title: Excellent,great location & can't fault!
reviews.text: Stayed from Friday 31/05/2014 through Thursday 12/06/2014.we even unexpectedly had to leave 1 day earlier & they gave back 1 nights money no questions asked.will Defo stay here again!Pun is so nice & even the owner & his wife are lovely too.Where would u get the owner himself bringing u sightseeing full day!Totally awesome!

reviews.title: Very nice hotel
reviews.text: The hotel was very nice and confortable. Big room with a nice view. Unfortunately for us, during our stay, the swimming pool was closed ... The detail which would be communicate BEFORE the reservation. The hotel situated next the AddPlus propose to use it's swimming pool, but it's really not the same thing if you reserved and pay for a hotel with swimming pool.

reviews.title: Great Location and great value for money
reviews.text: After been travelling all the way from Chang Mai down to Phuket we wanted to have a chilled week to relax in some nice hotels and this hotel was amazing for the price we had to pay ! The room was amazing and would cost 30 times the amount to stay in a hotel like this from where I am from . Nothing to fault about the big and spacious en-suite room.. Thailand definitely has to be the best value for money.. The rooftop pool was so relaxing as it wasn't full of kids. Conveniently located about a 10 minute walk from the hustle and bustle of Patong beach and all the night markets.

reviews.title: Mh51
reviews.text: 4 visit in a year this time for 3 months...great hotel, great location shame that a night market opened and closed nearby but still a small night market 3 mins away..rooms are bug and cleaned to a high standard every day.staff are all very helpful and nothing is to big a problem..would recommend this hotel 4* ++++++

reviews.title: Good location
reviews.text: I stayed for 3 nights at Addplus Hotel Patong, the location is easy to access and nearby many restaurants, shopping center and other tourist attraciton. My room was quite big and clean. But the staff is not really friendly and helpful. Overall I like this hotel, for budget vacation !!

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: The aircon barely works so hot I could not sleep!! Asked for a roll out bed which the website says they have and they said they had none left so my friend had to sleep on the floor!! Terrible hotel , terrible location literally right on the road the photos are so misleading! Pool is dirty! Don't stay here there are many other places same price but much much better !!!! From a sad New Zealand traveler x

reviews.title: Don’t do it!
reviews.text: We were due to stay at this hotel for 2 weeks but left a week early as we were so unhappy. Firstly the photographs that were displayed by the website were not reflective of the current state of the property. On arrival we were told we had been upgraded so I would have hated to see what a basic room looked like. Ours was in need of decorating at the very least. The bed linen was not clean and getting in and out of the shower was dangerous not helped by the fact there was no shower curtain so the floor flooded each time you used it. We decided not to have breakfast at the hotel as we had seen cockroaches on the floor and as it opened onto a back lane there was a strong smell of drains. When we tried to speak with staff they were disinterested and on more than one occasion were asleep on the sofas in the reception area. Leaving a week early was a relief but again staff did not seem overly concerned by our comments so I doubt there will be any changes made. Our advice-don’t put yourself through it.

reviews.title: Average but comfortable
reviews.text: stayed for 3 nights in april, very budget looking from the outside, a little difficult to get suitcases etc into the building, rooms were average size, bed was a nice size very comfortable. the bathroom had a large bathtub attached to the shower, quite high to get in and out of however. When going to use bathtub water came out brown not sure if that's a hotel issue or a Phuket issue. mini bar wasn't stocked but that is ok cause a mini mart and a 7 eleven located next door. located very close to patong and juncelyon shopping centre walking time under 10 minutes. pool was nice on the roof and was quiet enough to relax in. the staff had some communication issues in understanding us requiring more pillows and when asked for extra towels they gave us them from the massage palour which were quite ripped apart. however for price paid the hotel is good, great location and a great place to sleep and relax.

reviews.title: Not so good
reviews.text: Positives are the room is good available in size,clean and restaurant is reasonable price. Staff are nice. Negatives. The rooster in the morning and afternoon just doesnt stop i was on the 7th floor. You heard every door slamming shut and sounds like a gun shot going off. Worst sleep for the week i stayed here. Sorry guys fits the doors in was terriable

reviews.title: An average stay
reviews.text: Stayed here while we were in Patong. The hotel is set across around 9 floors and has a small roof top pool. Unfortunately our trip coincided with some terrible weather so we weren’t able to get the most out of the pool however the rooms are a good size with a safe deposit. Location is a short walk to the Junglecyon and about 15 minutes to the beach. I would recommend this hotel although we stayed in Crystal Beach for a similar cost and located a minutes walk from the beach and bars.

reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: Really great hotel for the price. Near all the action of Bangla road (20 min walk) but Hotel was quiet so easy to have a good nights sleep. Had a great stay here and would recommend to others. Pool although quite small was clean and had great views all around. On day of leaving Manager was extremely kind to let us store luggage & have a shower in a spare room before our departure at 6pm. They (the staff couldn't have done more) Really helpful & lovely people. Will stay again !!

reviews.title: Good for a cheap hotel
reviews.text: The hotel itself was reasonably tidy and clean. The room has clearly recently been renovated and was to a good quality. However whilst the beds were made each day the bedding was never change through out our time here. The facilities were basic with the pool having no bar or music and the reception and hotel front could do with a revamp to class it up a little.

reviews.title: The hotel management are ready to help to their guests
reviews.text: First of all we would like to say big thanks to hotel management (genral and reservation manager) of AddPlus hotel in Phuket for real help and solve the problem of Anextour which this operator didnt try to solve. The problem is - we have booked tour in Thailand with Anextour (russian tour operator) and when we arrived to Phuket we realized that Anex booked room for us in old building, that doesnt belong to the hotel since september. The rooms are awfull. Anextour in this situation wasn't ready to help explaining this situation like the hotel is overbooked and sold our room to chineese people. That was lie, because Anex just cheat to the tourist during selling the tour. In fact Anex will give the hostel. The hotel manager found the decision and finally we are living in good new room. So be carriful with your operator. And thanks to the hotel management. Olga D Victoriya N

reviews.title: nice hotel, nice room, clean
reviews.text: stayed two nights here, price I think was around 50$ Canadian per night. no hot water for shower though, not sure if there was a problem but some hotels just didn't seem to have hot water. 1km walk to patong beach, .5 km away from closet good market with lots of vendors selling street meat, fruit etc.

reviews.title: Large room with Value Money
reviews.text: Nice location and very large room, located on the center of Patong City. The top floor swimming pool is fantastic view. Staff are very helpful and lovely. Recommend for long stay and love the night life.

reviews.title: Great hotel, great staff, big rooms,
reviews.text: Just stayed for 12 nights left yesterday, great hotel, lovely rooftop pool, staff are great, 15 min walk to Patong beach, shopping centre 5 min walk away. WIFI is decent as well. I will be back to stay again. Nice little restaurant at the side ideal for a light bite or a few drinks.

reviews.title: Quite good for a budget hotel
reviews.text: A decent place to stay & the price for the stay is affordable. The only thing that bugs me is they don't provide any toothbrush. if you plan to stay in Patong for more than 5 days i suggest you should stay here. In addition it a 5mins walk to the shopping center & 10 mins walk to the beach & bangla st.

reviews.title: Good hotel to stay
reviews.text: Stayed at the AddPlus with my family (4 pers) for 12 nights in march 2016 and was pleased with the establishment (for the price). The rooms as good and WiFi works well on the eighth floor. The location great, a 10-15 minute walk to beach, market and Jungceylon, nice pool on the roof.

reviews.title: AddPlus Hotel & Spa
reviews.text: This is a great hotel. The Rooms are Big and comfortable. With shower and Bath tub. They is a great pool on the ninth floor over looking the city. I must warn you that across the street they have just started building a hotel or shopping centre. They was no noise when I was there. If you are a light sleeper ask for room other side of main road. The beach is 10 minute walk.

reviews.title: Amazing experience with Addplus Hotel & Spa
reviews.text: At first I wasn't really sure either I've made a good decision to choose this hotel for my stay in Phuket or not. Later it turned out to be an excellent choice. Patong beach is hardly 10 minutes walk away. Absolute value for money, cozy & pleasant. 7/11 Mart and several currency exchange booths can be found nearby the hotel as well. A complete package for me at a reasonable price.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: We were in the rear rooms they are very good for the money, the air con is fantastic, beds very comfy and all clean, showers a large walk in shower, a fridge is also provided, this is a great budget hotel and the staff are great

reviews.title: unreal
reviews.text: stopped here for a couple of nights on our travels and did not expect much for the price however one of the best places we have stopped in the whole of Asia, loads of shops and malls around and was exactly what we needed , really clean and even had a fridge in the room perfect for the price , could not fault

reviews.title: Love it.
reviews.text: We are staying here 13 nights, and we loved it, pool on the roof is great. Room is nice and comfortable, great shower. Road is a bit dusty but that is due to roadworks going on. The owners and staff are very nice and helpful, quick to help with your needs. There are a couple of English speaking staff, owners are super friendly. We would recommend this hotel to others, we plan on staying here every time we visit Thailand , and as far as not many people speaking English , we are in Thailand . It's only a 5 minute walk to jungceylon shopping centre and Bangla road, where the night life is, at the end of Bangla rd is the beach, 10 min walk max.. Hotel not completely finished, but still great and will be fantastic when done.....

reviews.title: cheap clean accessible
reviews.text: For a budget hotel very good, we had no Night staff friendly and very helpful Day staff lucky to get a greeting but will help if you approach them Restaurant staff friendly 1 excellent cleaner Massage ladies lovely

reviews.title: First time traveling solo
reviews.text: Traveling solo for the first time. Stayed there from 31st dec to 4th jan 2017. I like everything abt the hotel and room are spacious but the breakfast not that fanstatic. The hotel is accessible when you came out from the hotel turn to your right and you can see the mall and apposite the mall you can go to banzaan night market which start at 6pm. The bangla st and Patong beach is on the other side of the mall. Best to change $ at the mall their rate is slightly higher than the one nearby hotel. For tour activities, outside the hotel there's a lady called Ponrly she gave a reasonable price and speak English. Overall I enjoyed my stay although I'm alone and I would stay at this hotel again. P.s For taxi booking you can get from the airport 800 baht you will reach within 45 mins but if you took minibus it will take you 2 hours cuz you will share with other tourists.

reviews.title: holiday 7th nov to 22 nov 2017
reviews.text: buget hotel ..excellent staff..very clean ..basic breakfast was fine..stayed 2 weeks and would stay again..nice big rooms not to far from shopping mall..bangla road, only 15 min walk to beach..good resturants local ..nb use street food vendors very good ...can not praise this hotel and staff enough air con very good.

reviews.title: Beware. What you pay for is what you get
reviews.text: This hotel is one of the worst hotels in Phuket. My sister and her daughter stayed there for 10 nights. Should have realised when the kettle didn't work that it wasn't going to be a nice stay. She tried for 4 days to get a new kettle ......... language barrier was a big problem. Breakfast was minimal and not nice. The television did not work. Room cleaned when they felt like it. I don't think they changed the linen in the ten nights that they where there. I positive they didn't ......... we've been home for a week now and my sister noticed bites on her daughters back when she asked her how long she'd had them for "....... I've had them since we where in Phuket....... turns out that the hotel has had bed bugs as others have written. So I guess the linen hadn't been changed!!! And to top it off they where woken every morning by a rooster. Which we could hear fromthe millennium hotel where we stayed. And the pool was under maintenance for the first 3 days.

reviews.title: Value for money and decent location
reviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here, Its in good location nearby to the mall and around 15 mins to Bangla Rd Upon checking in we received an unexpected upgrade from superior - deluxe room, Huge modern room with a decent size balcony at the back part of the hotel, enough room for 2 chairs and a table. but not provided. Excellent free internet stable and fast connection TV channels were also excellent I counted at least 50 The fridge doesn't contain the usual mini bar beverages etc, so there's more room for your own stuff. Very good air con, and really comfortable beds (soft) with clean bedding. The shower was great (good pressure and plenty of hot water) & also big bath tub. The water quality on the other hand was brackish in color similar to weak tea. The Rooftop pool was OK decent size for that kind of hotel. Cant comment on their breakfast as I opted out Motorbike hire next door to hotel Excellent value for money

reviews.title: Acceptable
reviews.text: I had stayed at this hotel for 3 nights while I am spending my vacation in Phuket. Overall, the staffs are yet well trained for foreign tourists as not all of them can speak well english except for a Thailand girl which is pretty helpful. Apparently, pictures from the website is difference than the actual outlook. Luckily, the cleanliness is still under acceptable level. However, their room cleaning service most probably will be completed around 1pm. Thus, do don't expect too high if you back to hotel before that.

reviews.title: Overall Very Much Satisfying & fantastic
reviews.text: Rooms were well furnished and equipped with all modern comfort items. Breakfast was nice enough.Room Service was prompt. View from Room was excellent.Distance from Patong Beach was really less. Grocery shops,ATMs everything was close to Hotel.

reviews.title: Good Hotel for a Great Price
reviews.text: This is a good place to stay with a large, spacious room with clean bedding. The hotel is quite modern, and for the price you pay, you get great value. The downsides are the towels which are often old and off white but still clean. The bathroom keeps flooding around the edges when we have a shower and water spills on the floor. If you keep the exhaust fan and AC on at night, the water dries up by the morning so it is OK. Breakfast is OK for what you pay, my favourites are the fried rice and egg. There is a selection of juice. Coffee is strong with fresh milk available too. For the price you pay at this hotel, it is good value for money. Strong airconditioning and the people are lovely. I would stay here again.

reviews.title: Old portion of hotel not good
reviews.text: The old portion of hotel not good new portion was awaome pleasealways book in new portion of bulding breakfast not good staff is good i enjoy pool hotel chrge us extra money for new portion rooms which they not mention while booking please i suggest to book room in new portion of hotel

reviews.title: Nice stay
reviews.text: Stayed here for one night - hotel was nice and clean and staff friendly. Our room was spacious and bright but lots of ants everywhere. They all seemed to disappear within 10 minutes of us being there. The pool is nice and on roof top so a good view over Phuket. We were told by friends of ours who had stayed the night before also that the breakfast was terrible so we didn't even try it, so I can't comment on that. Overall was a nice stay and can't complain for the price we paid.

reviews.title: Not For From Main area
reviews.text: Thaifood restaurant available around Hotel..... 7/11 store next door.. 8 Mins walk to Jungceylon Mall...as well as Bangla Street..though to the Beach... Hotel pool on roof & slight renovation going on... Rooms are ok with safe & other ammeties.

reviews.title: No hot water, bad experience
reviews.text: Unhelping staff, ugly and not super clean rooms. NO HOT WATER and it's normal (they laughed at us when we asked for it, not even a sorry). Bed and AC are ok. You can find a better hotel for this price.

reviews.title: Great spacious deluxe room at low-cost in Patong beach
reviews.text: Amazing how we got this great deal with Addplus Hotel. Our deluxe room comes with ABF, parking garage, bath tub and free Wi-Fi. Locates right few steps from Juncylon shopping center and local evening foods market.

reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text: Came back today to stay at ADDPLUS HOTEL AND SPA. Got a welcome back hug. Nice and quiet but just a 5 min walk to Bangla Rd. Their spa and massage is now open and just had a foot and leg massage with shoulders and head. I could feel myself going to sleep, it was great. Going to get a few more. Helpful staff, if there is ever a problem they are onto it straight away. Love this place.

reviews.title: Fantastic hotel
reviews.text: Room very nice spacious with balcony very modern and clean. Cleaning lady absolutly amazing everyday stop to talk to me very pleasent recommend for me places to go in thailand she was amazing and very friendly. Reception people very nice and helpfully. I also was using massage in the hotel and I have to say big thank you for the spa girls they are amazing as well. Good location about 15 mins walk to the beach very nice clean and quiet place for holidays.Very highly recommended. Bathroom nice size with big shower space.

reviews.title: 5 night stay
reviews.text: Stayed at the Addplus for 5 nights. One of the most friendly hotels I have ever stayed at. The location was just far enough away from the action of the night club area, but not that far. great size room. Everything I needed was provided. The recption staff were always on hand if you needed anything or information. House Keeping were fantastic, room was made up every day and the hotel is very clean. Thank again guys will be back again..

reviews.title: Absolutely great!
reviews.text: The hotel has a great location (near to the mall and around 15 mins from the Bangla road) and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay here. The top floor swimming pool has an amazing view. Staffs are helpful and friendly and the hotel is quiet. Highly recommended for a romantic stay with your partner.

reviews.title: Très sympa !
reviews.text: Hello We stayed 9 days in this hotel and found it almost perfect. Of course it's not a 5 star hotel like in Europe but it is very nice. The rooms are clean, we had new towels every day and bottles of water as well. The breakfast is simple but we had everything we needed. Tea, coffee, eggs, bread, jam and fruits. During or stay we had a little problem : the hotel took the money twice out of our bank account. We talked to the manager at the reception and he was very helpful. He gave us our money back in euros ! Moreover, the hotel is not far from the beach. There are cheap restaurants everywhere. Very good location !

reviews.title: Great location, but not great hotel
reviews.text: The most unfriendly staff and manager you will ever get. The room is quite big, but doesn't help if the telephone is broken, cockroaches in the room, dirty and extremely old towels. Small holes in towels. Could not use the wash basin, because the outlet which open the plug was broken. Breakfast also not good. The location are great, and 10 minutes walk to Patong beach and all the night markets.The rooftop swimming pool had an amazing outlook over Phuket.

reviews.title: 3 night stay
reviews.text: We have gone round the hotel few times in order to find the car park. In the end I had to get out of car and hotel employee showed me to an underground car park that we have to get into through an alleyway. The alleyway was blocked by people lighting up candles and praying and a street food seller which we had to ask to move. The car park only fits 2 cars and the drive is so steep we scraped the bumper on the rental car. Hotel itself was reasonably clean however we had ants in the room and the sheets were torn in several places. Shower was very good but Aircon tools while to kick in with the thermostat not working properly. It was set to 22 degrees but I woke up in middle of night freezing cold so we ended up setting it to much higher temperature. Hotel overlooks the slums and a field where I the first two nights was a stage set up and band started to play rock songs until 1 am. Since then hotel has only single glazing we didn't get much sleep even with earplugs Inthe music was extremelyn noisy.the pool area was nice and not too busy but the jets on the side of pool did not work. On the whole it was cheap few nights but I wouldn't stay here again.

reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.text: Nice place to stay! Spacious rooms. Breakfast had good variety of both English and Thai food. 10 minutes walk to Bangla street and Patong beach. Needs some maintainence in the washroom . We stayed in a deluxe room with city views that was very spacious but the bath tub had some wear n tear.

reviews.title: Better places to stay
reviews.text: Arrived here 10/06/14.5star no way they have a phone in room but u can't make phone calls,joke.we buy our own toilet paper because were sick of asking for it,joke.view outback local rubbish tip,joke.rooster out back.my wife slipped on wet floor yesterday we told them we went out came back it still had puddles.joke.staff next to useless owners nice enough but would never think of staying here ever again.final word hotel is a joke

reviews.title: Bad stuff
reviews.text: Very bad stuff a ever saw in thiland they are not friendly at all and the manger are vain really very bad experience I ever seen in thiland no one take ur bags to the room very few stuff air condition not working good the view from the room is terrible

reviews.title: AddPlus Hotel
reviews.text: Staff are Great. Asked to change room not a problem. Don't get room at back of hotel. They is waste ground at back holding animals. cockerel start making noise at 5 am every day, through out the day. Not good if you want quite sleep. The hotel has a great pool in the roof, just lounge there all day. The problem with our stay no tv for 3 weeks. It is properly fixed now. The location of hotel is great 5 minute walk to shopping centre and 10 walk to beach. Take some additional hangers with you.

reviews.title: Big room, New hotel
reviews.text: New room very clean and comfortable, hotel staff very friendly. Swimming pool on the top floor so nice you can see sea view and Patong city view. just walk 2 minute to Jungceylon shopping mall and Patong city.

reviews.title: CLEAN, QUIET, relaxing and welcoming
reviews.text: We stayed here for 2 weeks as we were in Patong for a wedding and we absolutely loved it. Rooms get cleaned daily, unless you place the do not disturb sign outside. Fresh towels, bottles of water and toilet roll daily. Bed is made and your own mess tidied up and floor swept. Great to come home to a fresh, clean room after a hot day out! Aircon is AMAZING we hardly turned it off. We had a frameless walk in shower which was HUGE. Water pressure was GREAT. Staff are friendly and the cleaners even helped us find an all day taxi we hired to take us all over Phuket town and back for only 1800 baht for 6 hours 😊 There is a tourism kiosk, laundry service, currency exchange booth, restaurants and 7/11 just outside. The mall Jungceylon is literally 2min walk down the road as well as the night markets. EXCELLENT Location. Pool on the roof is clean and tidy, AMAZING view of mountains and Patong town/ ocean. The breakfasts get old quick as they do not change much but they are great for the first few days. I will defiantly be staying here again. Only down side would be at the back of the hotel there are rows of tin sheds where people live and it does kill the view a bit but it is also an eye opener to see how less fortunate people live so also a positive I guess.

reviews.title: Clean, large room and very convenient
reviews.text: Addplus Hotel and Spa is very clean, friendly and convenient place to stay. With huge room and nice views from the window, just minutes to the beach and the shopping mall - it's definitely very good value for money! The hotel looks quite new or just renovated. The staff is very friendly and the place is very quite. It;'s also very safety to stay there. I will definitely recommended this place to my friends in Australia and Europe. Thanks you AddPlus!

reviews.title: Disaster
reviews.text: I booked the hotel for 4 nights through Agoda seeing the hotel pictures in their website, its completely different please do not believe on the pictures. It's not a family hotel at all. The hotel is filthy dominated by street girls. We immediately check out after staying only for 10 mins.

reviews.title: Dirty and cold shower
reviews.text: The room was small and quite dirty. Nothing looked like the pictures. There were no hot water in the shower - it was apparently normal for the staff who didn't feel sorry about that at all. Avoid this hotel!!

reviews.title: Decent
reviews.text: Stayed here during Christmas and New year, nice hotel decent sized room (I'm certain I booked the deluxe room) good view if you're on the 6th floor plus, or else you're looking into another balcony about 10 feet away. It was a shower/bath and if you had a stand up shower then the bathroom floor would quickly become soaking wet (you'd need more than a full sized towel to dry up) Wi-Fi connection was good on the 7th floor. Roof top pool was okay, could have more Sun beds though as a couple times I had to sit on the floor. Disappointed there was no roof top bar. You're At a great location for the Da Hood street food market. And the Jungceylon shopping centre. All in all, it's not bad and would stay again.

reviews.title: Thieves
reviews.text: It's a five star they say. It's recently built. They charge an arm and a leg but you notice they've charged half price to someone checking-in right in front of you. No professionalism at front desk. Just one person speaks english at reception. No back-up generator to replace the black-out. I was in the dark, in my room for 1 1/2 hrs. No one knocked on my door to double-check if I needed anything or at least supply me a flash light to go around in my room. Half hour walk from the beach. Located on a very busy, dusty, crowded street. Do not approach this hotel unless you are stuck and have no choice.

reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: Stayed for seven days and couldn't fault it Great Hotel in a good location Easy five minute walk to everything Nice roof top pool Good breakfast Nice room Good value for the price Had an enjoyable stay

reviews.title: Excellent in everything.
reviews.text: We have been in treebo corporate inn for 6 days. It was very good experience. Room service was excellent, food was excellent and not very expensive. Staff was very good in everything. Just there was problem in wifi connectivity. One most good thing was that this hotel situated in main market where i found everything nearby. Overall it was very good experience with this hotel.

reviews.title: Pleasant short stay in Jaipur
reviews.text: My experience of staying in hotel was very good. Behavior of all staff including the Manager was nice all were soft spoken and were on one call away. Amenities was excellent and especially the location was awesome. Each facility was in surroundings. Would really like to stay here again if I visit to Jaipur again.

reviews.title: Overwhelmed from a small hotel
reviews.text: I had to stay over for night halt at Jaipur for our main visit to Ajmer Sharif . With my in laws on-board on this two day hectic travel and on a budget constraint, choosing Treebo corporate inn for a night stay was a great find . I must say to find a good hotel with decently good rooms and great beds and bathrooms just under rs 2000 is itself is a task , but Treebo lived up it's advertisement with all the good things to offer . When you get over delivered on short budget is when you get bowled over . Everyone expects luxury when you pay for it and none when you pay less .In our case it was just a little luxury with very less to pay for . Thumbs up !! Treebo corporate inn and it's staff .

reviews.title: Value for money
reviews.text: Spacious, clean room with good service. Very limited choices in breakfast but the food is excellent. Staff is also very supportive and always ready to help. Hotel food items could have changed a little and cheese sandwich could have been a good in size.

reviews.title: Value for money
reviews.text: So there is a new app called Treebo it's like OYO but after hearing lot of complaints about OYO we tried this app. So we were 5 friends so we got pretty good deal from this app. It is located near raja park Jaipur.. easily accessible from Google maps... Rooms were neat and clean... Staff was courteous and sweet. Food is to be improved otherwise rest of the service by the hotel was great. Service :5 Food: 3 Nature: 5

reviews.title: Experience was good
reviews.text: Ecperienve was really very good. Service was best. Staffs were very coprative. In location we can say that its the heart of the jaipur. You can and and try once you will defintely love it and you will love to stay there only.

reviews.title: place for stay at affordable price and amidst city
reviews.text: Hotel rroms are available at resonable prices compared to high cost rooms being the tourist destination. Location is idle for movement to any part of Jaipur city .A near by place for marketing at justified prices as the place is not common for foreign tourists .rooms are good as 3 star category .Room service is also good .

reviews.title: Absolutely fantastic room for the price quoted .
reviews.text: The hotel was located right in the middle of the city and with markets right next to it to cater to your shopping and eating list . The room was fantastic for the price quoted and the amenities provided was allright . Although quality of towels could have been improved . Also I don't mind paying little extra on rent provided food quality is also improved

reviews.title: value for money
reviews.text: Pros Location was in centre of the market. Food was good with not many options. Staff was good and eager to help out. Cons Room not ready when we reached and had to wait on reception for 15 minutes at 2 PM Hot water not available for first 30 minutes and after doing all testing staff figured out that tank was empty. Hot water runs out of tap after 15 minutes of running water, which is clear wastage of water.

reviews.title: ““nice stay excellent staff”
reviews.text: The staff are very friendly and they made us feel at home and also awesome breakfast, nice room and decent staff. Loved the food at their restaurant and centrally located hotel. The hotel is in city, 15-20 min from station and airport, the ambiance is good, well maintained. One of the most recommend place to stay in Jaipur. PERFECT!

reviews.title: Best Location & Good Budget Hotel
reviews.text: Great Hotel. Very friendly & Helpful Staffs. Good Food. Budget Hotel. Great Location. Well furnished rooms and comfortable bed. Must Stay Property. They dont have swimming pool. A missing component. Suggestion: I wish, there could be some addition to their Buffet Breakfast Menu. Change Needed: Rooms above the Kitchen area, the windows of those rooms are not proper to hold the smoke of the Tandoor. We had issue of smoke on few days out of a week stay. Other rooms are perfectly fine. And if possible, hotel management should consider the sound proof gates in its room, as we can hear sound from lobby outside the room.

reviews.title: Excellent hotel both for tourist and business travelers
reviews.text: Treebo is the chain with good reputation. And hotel Corporate Inn just confirms that. As only I opened the door and heard nice relaxing music in the reception I realized that sure I want to stay here longer. Very nice staff and comfortable clean room only increased that wish. Other advantages are very very comfortable bed, fridge, complementary mineral water, tea and coffee in the room. And it is impossible not to mention great breakfast which includes even fruits. Hotel is located in very nice area with many shops and restaurants nearby. Also which is the best for me - at least three gardens are there in only 5 minutes distance by walk. I had little misunderstanding with my booking. But the hotel staff fixed everything in the best way. So I'm thankful to everyone of the hotel team. Their amiability and politeness made difficult situation solvable. I enjoy staying here and I can advice hotel to all travelers. It will be good both for tourists and for business voyagers.

reviews.title: good for low budget. clean and decent.
reviews.text: this hotel is good for low budget travellers. the interiors are very basic, nothing fancy. had stayed here as part of attending a wedding. ideally located near govind marg and pink square mall. the food at the hotel was also decent. i had sandwich and paranthas(aloo+gobhi),curd, veg cutlets, tea, all were very well done and freshly made. major tourist destinations like hawa mahal jal mahal are closely located. bapu bazaar is within 10-15 mins drive from this hotel. major shopping area M.i ROAD which has major restaurants, is also very nearby. the rooms are spacious, 3 people can comfortably live in one room. the bathroom was clean and spacious. the A/C was working well, the room has a fan also. there is a small tv in the room. has a lift which works well. there is a terrace where you can sit and have tea etc and enjoy the weather. a local market,which is very huge, is just located next to the hotel. this market has everything from chemist to shopping to bakeries and general stores etc. basically the hotel is located in a residential area. getting in and out from the area is very easy. you can get autos from near the hotel very easily. the bad things- -there is no key hole in the doors of the room, so you cant see who is knocking the door, this is very bad from security point of view. the bed sheet was though washed, but it was old and had stains on it. though it was changed to a new one at the very intimation given to them, but it should have not been there in the first place. i dont know if the hotel is used by many travelers or not, may be that we all were staying in a big group for the wedding so they had organised things well. but my experience was good with the hotel. the tariff also is decent.

reviews.title: Jaipur Visit - Dec 3rd Week
reviews.text: Room was good. However, the bathroom tile was slippery and had to be very careful. High time they change their towels, linens, blankets .. so torn and old. Staff - the worst kind of service. They were not bothered to help us even with the luggage to the cab, yes, we had settled the payment and checked out. Restaurant - over priced with no quality or quantity in the food. Breakfast was hopeless too.

reviews.title: Not a nice experience
reviews.text: The bathroom had issue with its drainage system..it also did not had curtains in bathroom for shower ...due to which entire bathroom gets wet.Water draining was not there..so water flushed out..and then in early morning they gave me another room's bathroom to have only bath...Could not have complementary break fast also after that..

reviews.title: Happy and want to visit again
reviews.text: Hi all, my experience was so grateful.staff is so supported and they take care for guest check in and check out. Hotel atmosphere was too good and interior of room and lobby was grateful. I have a good time in hotel. Hotel provide free WiFi facility.staff show courtesy in dealing with guest and in there service. Thanks Regards Shubham 9664289785

reviews.title: No inhouse kitchen available
reviews.text: Break fast timing 8am to 10am , zero co operative front desk, No response from reception and other staff. Connectivity issue, we reached early and ask for twin bed, hotel don't have twin bed facility's, Must required to upgrade them self front off me many ppl asking for WiFi Issue.

reviews.title: Nice & cozy room at the heart of jaipur
reviews.text: The best thing about the hotel is its location, centrally placed to all major tourist places and famous markets. I reached there in the evening and check in was very smooth. The rooms are well lit, spacious and clean. I felt room service was slow but good. I had breakfast included in my booking, menu wise options were less, Puri sabzi, bread butter, aloo pakode and you could order egg items too, although items were not a lot, they were very tasty, so all in all, I was satisfied with breakfast. Would definitely recommend the room

reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.text: Good location and breakfast is very tasty staff service is good room is neat and clean it's good choice to chose this hotel in this budget hotel is good if would go to jaipur I will prefere this hotel only thanks treeboo

reviews.title: Perfect stay venue in Jaipur nearby to most of the tourist places..
reviews.text: I enjoyed my stay in Treebo corporate Inn hotel, staff was very humble and give quick response to your rereque, breakfast which was given complimentary with stay was good, only you have to work on to improve the cusicus quality of bed..

reviews.title: Good service
reviews.text: Very helpful and sincere staff. At good location. Clean room and environment. Is in budget for services provided. Good connectivity to all places. Good for both family trip and business trip. Food quality is good.

reviews.title: Its a good avg.hotel
reviews.text: I was book hotel for me and my friend its a simpal businesses hotel rooms are good and clean ...room size is very average oak rooms there is some sweet rooms are available bathroom is clean with average sized , buffet breakfast is available but average breakfast over all good for one days stay ...in raja park in this budget you can stay a top hotel chain hotel like park prime ,ramada,dodas palace ,pepper mint ,kings corner, mango hotel ,soveniour prime etc. Very cold reception

reviews.title: Efficient service, value for money
reviews.text: We stayed here for a day as we could not get booking for more days. The rooms are decent and equipped with all facilities like TV, cable. Washroom and bathroom were clean and well equipped. Good breakfast spread.

reviews.title: A must stay property
reviews.text: Very nice chain of hotels treebo .. which has a class of its own ... Of this one 1. Location is very nice ... It feel safe 2. Rooms are occupied so whn with family .. again it feels safe 3. Room are neat and clean 4 . Bathroom clean 5. Beds soft6.Room well structured and feels good7.breakfast tasty and menu was okay8. Satff very friendly Overly experience was very very nice for a stay with family ... And a must stay hotel Infact i have shot a video of it and very soon going to post it on youtube ...

reviews.title: bad
reviews.text: water faucet repeatedly spoilt 2 days and getting stuck ...breakfast in adequate/ most things getting over /fruits missing on day 2 - even after asking pantry had to approach reception to get things on table had to pay extra for third person although the misleading bigger room size on Line clearly ffit to sleep 3 ... persons and there was no facility for booking 3 guests in one room ON LINE

reviews.title: Worth every penny
reviews.text: This place was amazing for my 2days of stay in jaipur. I actually came here on vacation with my family. Rooms where super clean, food was great.. only thing that was not up to the mark was their super fast wifi which was fast from it. Staff was very caring & helpful. My experience was super cool. Thank you Treebo!

reviews.title: Excellent services
reviews.text: Nice clean and tidy hotel. Staffs are nice n helpful. Bed is gud. Interior is very gud and pleasing. Breakfast served was hot and tasty. Toiletries were kept as assured. Coffee preparation kit is there so that u can have as much as coffee u desire

reviews.title: " Good Hospitality and Awesome Services"
reviews.text: Since last one years, I am frequent visitor to Jaipur and stay in the Treebo Corporate Inn Hotel. They Maintained consistency in the hospitality. Rooms are well maintained. Food quality is good. Good caring team. The hotel Front Desk Staffs Mr. Nirmal and Mr. Puranmal Verma is very helpful and will guide u throughout your stay.The hotel staffs were very helpful.:))Overall experience was awesome. I'll recommend dis hotel to every couple and families:). You wont regret,just be there:)

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Everything is good and perfect specially room service , one thing it values for your money, plus the location is superb easy access to market and the mall is so close, even their is a park next to hotel.

reviews.title: Very nice hotel at this price and location.
reviews.text: Very good business hotel at a perfect location and at a good price. Staff is helpful and polite. Food is also good. I live in this hotel every fortnight from last several years. Go for this hotel without any thoughts.

reviews.title: Excellent service, room and staff!
reviews.text: We loved staying at treebo corporate inn hotel, nice clean room and bathroom, excellent staff, very helpful with everything we needed. Everything was perfect. With a great location. We will come back without any doubt

reviews.title: Non-professional staff...no hospitality knowledge
reviews.text: We booked a room online. When we arrived and checked in, we asked for two more days extension of our stay. Receptionist Manoj told we have to book online and continue staying in the same room. But next day morning they fast moved us to another smaller room though we paid more than first room. In a hurry we forgot our expensive ring on the table. We asked the staff many times about the ring but there was no reply back. The blanket cover was very badly torn and when we asked housekeeping staff to change it they accepted it normally and told that they can't do anything about it((( The third night when we came back late after temple visits the same guy Manoj stopped us and asked to pay for tea we drank. Usually it is done at the time of checked out((( So very bad experience. Looks like the people in the hotel don't need a job. So no efforts for good hospitality.

reviews.title: An Average property
reviews.text: Couldn't get hot water in the morning inspire of keeping the geyser on for 30 mins .WC was not properly flushed at the time of check in.Card machine was not working at the time of check out.Overall a very average experience.Got the feeling of an old property being renovated .much better options available in city like Jaipur

reviews.title: Average Hotel. Costlier as compared to nearby options.
reviews.text: Bathroom was choking up a lot. Air Conditioner didn't have remote control. No hot water available during the day, i guess it was a solar heater with limited capacity. Breakfast was average. Staff at reception seemed disinterested. Smaller room size as compared to nearby Hotel Stay Fine which costs the same. Definitely not a 3-star hotel.

reviews.title: Amazing stay!
reviews.text: Value for money stay with excellent comfort. All facilities available as stated on the site. Such comfortable stay for family. Highly recommended for all. Located at prime location and all facilities available in less than 0.5 km

reviews.title: Wonderful stay at Treebo
reviews.text: This was my 2nd trip to Jaipur after a long time and I chose Treebos to book this hotel for me. Rooms are spacious with good amenities. Staff are friendly especially Manoj at reception. Housekeeping staff were helpful and prompt at their course of service. Located centrally and easily accessible from any nook of the road.Breakfast has limited options though .Wifi was slow which should be focussed upon especially for corporate travellers. Overall a memorable stay.

reviews.title: WORST HOTEL STAY EXPERIENCE I EVER HAD
reviews.text: Worst Hotel Stay I Ever Had. GO at ur own risk >Poor Service and food quality. >Poor and unfriendly management. >They burnt out my clothes after charge 15 INR per clothes and said its not their responsibility. > Never ever visit this pathetic poor place ever. > NO Wifi on second floor.

reviews.title: good hotel
reviews.text: cleen rooms. rate are afortable. good food. complimentry breakfast is also good compared to other hotels. location is good. plus point axis ank atm is just at the side. staff s also good. would advice peaple going to jaipur corporate in is ideal hotel to stay in.

reviews.title: Pleasant stay
reviews.text: We visited hotel Treebo corporate Jaipur during January'18, it was a family visit. Though the hotel does not have enough space available for parking but still there are lot more reasons to stay there. Room was spacious and clean. Staff was polite and service was good. We stayed there for two nights and overall we are satisfied. The options available during breakfast were limited and request hotel management to take a note of it.

reviews.title: Economical Hotel in Raja Park Market
reviews.text: Economical hotel in Raja Park Market..Rooms are okay...As some party was going on which created a lot of disturbance with loud music... Breakfast was pathetic in which we have to compromise only with bread butter and tea..

reviews.title: Decent place to stay
reviews.text: This hotel is located in the middle of busy Raja Park. The rooms are pretty okay and hygienic. As its in a market place, there are good places to eat nearby. Their breakfast is pretty disappointing with very limited options.

reviews.title: Good and Nice Hotel -But front office Manger Behavior is very unprofessional & untorrable
reviews.text: Quality of Food is excellent and great hospitality by down line staff, room is specious and great housekeeping is too good. BUT the front office Manager attitude and behavior is not pleasant and problem solving. When I request to Front office Manger to sort out hot water issue as I have booked the room specially bcoz of bath tub facility and if we will not get the hot water in bath tub then how we will take the bath instead of solving the problem he has advised me to check out from hotel.. IS this is the way to treat your guest...???..Do he is having the right to decide my tour...??? Seriously this not the way to treat your guest if you r working in a hospitality sector.. He was keep arguing instead of solving the problem. Secondly keep the manual register for guest feed back at front office and it should be subject to audit of stay of each guest. As their wash not feed back register otherwise I will share the pic of my feed back. On 6th Wifi of hotel was not working,

reviews.title: Ideal location to stay
reviews.text: Not at all happy with the items kept and quality of breakfast. The person attending F & B service, at least should suggest the options of items other than whatever kept for buffet. (eg. i was not knowing that boiled eggs or egg omelet is also served if demanded. I came to know when i saw in somebody else's plate. Also the room in which i was staying, the position of bed and TV was not at all acceptable.

reviews.title: Slightly disappointed
reviews.text: I will just point out the shortcomings I came across in the Hotel room. The toiletries were not replaced every day. Besides the bath room had plumbing issues like shower leaking. Fresh towels were also not provided for each day. Room size was bit too small even for the Oak room type. Overlooking these faults I had a pleasant stay in Jaipur.

reviews.title: Substandard service.
reviews.text: The rooms were not as clean as desired. The blankets provided were filthy and on request to change the same, the staff replied that is all they have. Moreover there were guests in the other room few of whom were drunk and were running in corridor and thus we couldn’t even sleep properly.

reviews.title: Pleasant stay
reviews.text: Great location - tucked away in a quiet lane, yet close to the vibrant Raja Park market. Rooms are okay, though the cleanliness of the linen can be improved. Restaurant ambience can be improved. Overall, good value for money.

reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: I stay more then 10 days, Hotel location was very good. They have good rooms with nice furniture. Hotel service and staff is good. Morning breakfast was very good every day new items in breakfast. I would like to visit again.

reviews.title: Nice room poor service
reviews.text: Very beautiful room as good as shown in picture. Extra bed is also comfortable. Restaurant is very good. Only manager's attitude not good. We had given room with bathtub. After waiting for an hour hot water not came from gyser. When asked solar hot water given but within a minute manager called very rudely that tub can't be filled 3 to 4 time. You should ADJUST. And we had to adjust for 3 days. Shameless enough to give water in bucket but not reparing gyser

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: We stayed for 3 days all I can say is amazing service and rooms were in great condition such a worth of money.the morning breakfast buffet service was top notch and top of all the location of the hotel is near to all tourist attraction near the city.👍🏼

reviews.title: Not worth money spent
reviews.text: Paid exhorbitant for a super deluxe room but the bathroom had no lock, flush wasn't working well foot of the chairs in room was rusty. Staff wasn't cooperative. According to the room the tariff was too much. Overall average.

reviews.title: Good service by hotel reception
reviews.text: We have asked for change of room because of old linen smell they have immediately changed the room and gave me an another deluxe room. Food was good even drivers accommodation also good. Did 1 night stay on 28 th night . Centrally located near main market of jaipur

reviews.title: good hotel, value for money
reviews.text: Clean hotel, good bathroom, nice room clean towels and bed cover every day Free coffee and thee on the room Breakfast rather poor Internet have to be renewed username and password every 12 hours, can be done in better way

reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text: The bedding was torn. When I asked to replace they gave a bad cover that had patches too. The bathroom towels were yellow instead of white. There was rat in the breakfast area. I would not recommend this hotel at all.

reviews.title: Great stay, great prices.
reviews.text: The room and the bathroom was fully clean and tidy which for me is the most important. It is nearby to most places. Cabs are easily available. Restaurants are available near by if you would like to have a change. The food is good, not very oily. Just one very small thing, the restaurant needs some renovation...very small things...like the sofa. Rest all was awesome. Good staff behaviour, 24 hours service, etc.

reviews.title: Good value for money
reviews.text: We booked 5 rooms here and got the deal at a very reasonable price. Rooms were clean and service was good. Place is bit far from city palace and all but near raja park market. It's tucked away in a quiet location. Breakfast had only 3 options- Poha, bread omelette, pao bhaji. They cam improve their breakfast menu. Otherwise the taste was good.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: over all hotel management and staff was excellent. My family really enjoyed a stay in hotel and also suggested me to prefer treebo at any other places we will visit in future. Only thing is it will be better if the hotel has its own vehicles so that it can arrange site seeing for tourists so that family will feel safe and enjoy more and more.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: It was expected to be the standard of Treebo and a three star hotel facilities but unfortunately nothing is like that it disappointed so much even no food according to menu was available, very few workers and as far as cleanliness concern it's all disappointing.

reviews.title: You cannot go wrong with this hotel.
reviews.text: One of the value for money hotels we stayed in our 17 days long trip. Rooms were very big, very neat and the sleep quality was the best. Not to mention the good breakfast spread they had as complimentary. Only thing from a biker point was that they had limited parking facility and open to the road.

reviews.title: bedt place for a calm stay in Goa
reviews.text: Best place with have a calm stay away from all the party. Try to book from make my trip to get some offers. I stayed there at 1500 for 2 night that's half rate of one night. It's not between the market but not even far from the market. To go to other beaches like calangut, baga and other u need a bike or a car which is easy available of u ask at the reception.

reviews.title: Very Good and Budget Hotel for a Stay
reviews.text: The rooms are very good. The Hotel Staff is very cooperative and always available. It is very good Budget hotel located at a very good location of Raja Park. The Facilities are also very good. I stayed for 4 Days and I enjoyed my stay. The price I paid for stay was worth. Overall, Very Good Experience and Stay.

reviews.title: Very comfortable stay with hospitable staff. Breakfast (complimentary) was awesome)
reviews.text: Nice location. Very comfortable stay. The parking area is in open. It is not covered. Though it did not matter. The breakfast was in buffet style with North and South Indian mix dishes. The restaurant services to the room were excellent. The only gap I could realize was absence of trolley to shift luggage by staff. Especially when it came to shift luggage to second floor.

reviews.title: Nice stay
reviews.text: Nice comfortable rooms, good location, restaurant and food quality was quite good but no proper parking space is there, and check out time is too early. Staff service was average.thanks to goibibo and treebo

reviews.title: Great experince staying at Treebo Corporate Inn, Jaipur
reviews.text: Loved the place esp its location, staff and the food. got it 2 days before our travel and found it a perfect place in the price we paid for. There was also good space for parking which is a struggle in some of the venues. Staff was courteous and friendly and the rooms were spacious. Would surely come next time!

reviews.title: Complaint
reviews.text: Staff response not properly, Room service was very slow, spacialy request for front disk morning breakfast in room but not provide, some many time stay in treebo other Hotels experience is excellent but my first experience in treebo corporate inn was very poor so i am totally disappointed, please improve your service.

reviews.title: Do not stay at this hotel!!!
reviews.text: The cleanliness of the room was awful. I stayed for 4 nights and they did not clean my room once. This I could cope with as I was not in my room much anyway. The staff barely speak English, which is not too much of a problem until you have an issue you need to sort out. When checking out, the staff insisted I had not paid, even though I showed them the company invoice that stated clearly that I had paid. I also showed them a bank statement showing that I had paid. Again they insisted that I hadn't. They have now charged my credit card, so I've now paid twice for the stay. DO NOT STAY HERE! It's not worth the hassle!

reviews.title: Comfortable Rooms. Very Good Location, Value for Money
reviews.text: Stayed in Treebo Corporate Inn for one Night with my friend during my trip to Bhangarh. Very good property available for a budget price in a prime location in Jaipur. Rooms are very comfortable, staff is very friendly, parking available and value for money. Stay here if you are looking for a hotel in a prime location like Raja Park in Jaipur. Breakfast is complimentary and good.

reviews.title: Nice Hotel
reviews.text: Location of hotel is excellent. It locates in a market area Raja Park. Excellent place for shopping. Rooms are Nice and have good space. Staff is friendly and supportive. Food quality is good. Value for money hotel.

reviews.title: Bring Your Own Pillow
reviews.text: First off the complex is mostly residential. RCI owns a few duplexes. Ours was a two bedroom with a full kitchen. Each bedroom has its own bathroom. The living room area was small with only one sofa. Given that there were 4 adults and 2 kids this was inadequate. My title says my next complaint. I have never has a pillow like this in my life. It was like a brick! Everything else about the unit was good, clean in good repair, ac worked. The pool in the main area was ok but a bit small. This wasn't a huge problem as it wasn't very busy. My daughter did cut her toe on a patio block, but was probably just a freak occurence. One day the hot tub was really just luke warm. Had the breakfast buffet one morning. It was relatively cheap, but that was because of the limited selection (pancakes, eggs, sausage, bacon). Food was good though. My in-laws complained about the price of golf so they didn't even go ($70 per person plus $38 for a cart). I don't golf so I have no clue if this is accurate. Overall it was good for a place to stay, but given the "exclusivity" you are supposed to receive, I was underwhelmed.

reviews.title: BEWARE
reviews.text: I came for 4 days stay, to visit Waterton, the nearest place to hung out. The resort is really for people who loves to Golf. Its not for family with kids. We used the resort only to sleep and use the swimming pool. It happen that we are the last one to use the swimming pool and the hot tub, and it break down, The management give us the bills to pay fix the common facility that everybody used, which was been broken, before then. The wear and tear of the resort, the guest will be liable, so WHATS OUT!! We had a horrible vacation under. It will be the first and last.

reviews.title: Wedding
reviews.text: The places is awesome place to stay The view is great You can see deer in the morning or evening The golf coarse look great and always busy The food is great and the service is great also We where here for the daughters wedding and the staff where awesome looking after us and helping out with every we need

reviews.title: Hurricanes Hockey Camp
reviews.text: Resort community. Excellent for families. Very clean units. Fully contained suites. Bbq on deck with patio furniture. Area very quiet. Pool and hot tub. Also restaurant available. Staff are very friendly. Excellent 18 hole golf course.

reviews.title: How exciting away from home
reviews.text: Awesome staff, Mike & Jim are so friendly & informative. They are all 2 bedrooms which are very comfortable.it gives you everything you need. Very clean, quiet and very relaxing.we didn't golf, but the course looks beautiful and very well maintained. Full kitchen so helped with not having to eat out. Very large balcony with gas BBQ. Location is perfect. So much to see just outside Lethbridge, Head Smashed In Buffalo Jump,Frank Slide, & the Galt Museum in the city was very interesting. WILL BE BACK!

reviews.title: Golf destination...?.
reviews.text: Before reading this you should know we left from Fairmont, BC to go to Lethbridge AB from one golf destination to another....So...we were thinking that we we would go from one great golf community to another...going to paradise canyon but we were disappointed with the accommodations. The place we had booked was close to the golf course - but found that only one of the units would "maybe" have had a view - that would keep us at this course for the "week" we had planned - Sadly we left after one night sleep. The unit we were in had a view - of a weed ridden - sand/dirt hill - right at the patio door (maybe 10'-15' off patio). The other window had a view of bush/road. The layout of room was awful/ackward "Stay here for a week?", it would have felt like confinement. We did book a tee time(thinking that if the golf was good we would put up with the bad unit) but only to find that the golf course has 8 holes that are permanently - cart path only. So for those of you not able to walk freely or need limited walking, to complete a round of golf, this may not be a course for you. Ultimately, we cancelled our round once we saw the posted info/rules for this particular course - should have planned week two better, we won't make that mistake again.

reviews.title: Great resort and magnificent golf course.
reviews.text: We were very pleased with our stay at Paradise Canyon, the food, amenities and staff are very good and the golf course is well kept and quite challenging. It is quiet and well maintained and easily accessible.

reviews.title: Be pampered by the Best!
reviews.text: Even before we arrived, we received a friendly note from the resort to tell us not to rely on our GPS due to a new road, and got a partial map to show us how to get there. That was only the start of what followed. Jim Swanton, the Customer Service Manager who throughout our week's stay here was more like a butler to us and contributed greatly to a wonderful vacation. This truly is PARADISE! It has everything you'd want and need and what you can ask for. The rest can be found either in town or in the vicinity. If you are sports oriented, there is golf, tennis, pool, etc. If you want to relax, it's as restful and quiet as the night. If you want to party, go to town or a casino. If you're hungry or thirsty, it has a classy restaurant & bar. If you crave up to date news, you get a newspaper delivered to you daily or you can watch the Cable TV. There is Wi-Fi too. I'm telling you, You owe it to yourself to be here! You'll never regret it. Jim Swanson will make sure of that. He even gave my wife some flowers as a departing gift & we thought that was really sweet.

reviews.title: Great Visit!
reviews.text: My wife and I, along with our 6-month old daughter, stayed at Paradise Canyon for a week through RCI. Mike was a great help before I booked in making sure our needs were taken care of, and stayed in contact after booking up until we left home to come to Lethbridge. Once there, we checked in late, and our packet was waiting for us as promised. The Saturday orientation breakfast with Jim was great, and he made sure we were well taken care of during our stay. Didn't get a chance to play any golf, but did visit the pro shop, and everyone was very friendly and helpful. Ate dinner at the on-site restaurant once and were underwhelmed. Overall, it was a great place to stay as a base for exploring all that southern Alberta has to offer. Waterton Lakes is less than 2 hours away, and Dinosaur Provincial Park is just over 2 hours away, both worth the drives. Just a couple of negatives: The free in-room WiFi was very spotty. With being in a canyon, cell service was also minimal, so if you're needing internet connectivity, you'll have to drive up and out of the canyon. The pack-and-play crib we were given for our daughter looked like it hadn't been cleaned in a while. We picked up some sheets at the local WalMart to use.

reviews.title: Very nice condo for a week
reviews.text: We, two couples, stay at at one of their two bedroom condos complete with two bathrooms, complete kitchen, washer & dryer, small outside patio, complete with gas grill, and table & chairs. The furnishings were very adequate and up to date. Queen size beds in both bathrooms. Electric stove, and about 15 cu ft refrig with ice maker. Newspaper delivered each day. TV in L.R. & each B.R., coffee pot, tea kettle, pots, pans & dishes all furnished, including towels,soap, TP and hairdryers. This complex is basically a golfing community, which look to be well kept up. Ate dinner at the club house resturant twice and was pleased with the meals and service. Would definitely stay here again if in the area.

reviews.title: Beautiful place
reviews.text: Great place. Accommodations were spotless and well stocked. The staff was very helpful and friendly and the view from our room was outstanding. Great golf course to go along with it all. Will definitely return.

reviews.title: A week away.
reviews.text: Nice and quiet saw friends and visit family . Yes I could see the deer and coyote every morning and again in the afternoon. Good to be there again. Next time in de winter when it is cold weather I would like the upstairs unit. .Early fall or spring the main floor unit is fine. Dan.

reviews.title: Very clean, well maintained unit.
reviews.text: It's clean and well maintained. Quality furniture and flooring, etc, although getting a little older now. Need some wheels to get there as is quite a ways from nearest stores/restaurants. Nice and quiet. Private attached garage in the upper condo units. Nothing much at resort unless you golf. (Fine for us as weren't looking for activities, but kids might not like). Nice place, but had to take a star off due to exorbitantly high resort fee, which gets you nothing to do with amenities. They claim it is 'to cover the Carbon Tax applied by the government'. Previously, there was no fee in out of season. Now, this 'resort' fee basically doubles your RCI booking fee.

reviews.title: Well maintained resort, very good and difficult golf course, good staff but a little off the beaten track.
reviews.text: A very nice resort. I was travelling with my elderly parents and we upgraded to a larger space for $200 extra and we had an excellent view. The apartment was well furnished, clean and well maintained. The extra cost was good value. The staff were all very good. The pool was a little small. It was in a private area that had a large hot tub and overlooked the golf course and nice views beyond.We did not eat in the restaurant so we cannot make any comments about it.The resort was a bit off the beaten track and a car is essential. Not a great deal to do around Lethbridge but we still enjoyed our stay. There are some nice parks. Probably only a small thing but we visited the small town of Picture Butte and went into the bakery. Great selection of cakes and we had 3 coffees and 3 cakes for $9. Amazing value. We also bought some of their local bread, I can't recall the name but just ask for their best bread and we also bought some of their Gouda which was imported from Holland.

reviews.title: Fantastic Paradise Canyon
reviews.text: From reception to departure Jim at the resort made our experience absolutely fantastic. Our accommodations were super, the golf course superb and the service by all staff was incredible. Very personable so much so that we felt at home from the start to the end and really didn't want to leave. The history in the area is unbelievable with the Head smashed in Buffalo jump to the Tyrell museum up in Drumheller. Lethbridge has all the amenities from shopping to eating to theatre(movies).

reviews.title: Great place to stay in lethbridge
reviews.text: We loved our condo. If you can, go for a 2 bedroom 2nd floor unit with a view. Although it was only the two of us, the space with a 2 bedroom was super. Yes, we paid a daily $25 service charge, but only for the first week. Frankly, it’s worth it if staying 2 weeks. Clean, comfortable, well maintained and organized. Loved being in an area with year round permanent residents. The clubhouse and condo looked well cared for with pride in the resort. Yes, it’s about 15 min from downtown, so pick your groceries on the way in. Only about 1 km walk from the outlying suburbs of Lethbridge, it’s in a nice safe neighbourhood. The city of 100,000 was easy to drive around and featured lots of local community activities. We’ll be back!

reviews.title: Comfortable, quiet
reviews.text: Very comfortable condo with two bedrooms, two bathrooms, good air conditioning, comfortable sleeping & sitting arrangements, well equipped kitchen. Good location for day trips to Waterton Lakes and other historic centers around southeast AB. Good customer service for checkin checkout although hours are limited. Great phone and email contact. Ours was a second floor condo so we knew about the entrance stairs. It was a bit of a surprise to have stairs inside. Good to know if you have any mobility issues.

reviews.title: Great unit and service
reviews.text: Reviewed May 16, 2013 We stayed at Paradise Canyon in June 2013. We had to check in 2 days late and Jim Swanton front desk manager was very helpful in setting up our late check in. The unit we had was very spacious and provided a nice view of the golf course. We drove to Banff with the intent of returning the next day and then checking out the day after that. We got caught in the flooding in Canmore, Alberta for 3 days, but we called Jim and he arranged to have our bags and clothes stored until we could return and check out. It was a wonderful week if we ignore the flood. The condo is lovely as is the restaurant, and Jim was great. Mona and Larry

reviews.title: Incredible Experience
reviews.text: I want to start by stating that Jim and his staff are absolutely wonderful. Jim called us 2 days prior to ask us if we had any special requests. He also (after we asked for a reference to a good restaurant for our anniversary) had called ahead to a restaurant (converted from a water tower). This was the nicest restaurant we had eaten at in a long time drinks and dinner was $104 with tip and it was so worth it. The staff was excellent the whole time. Jim also called us the first day and told me to reschedule my golf game for that day and go to Waterton Park as we would not be able to see it later in the week due to weather (good call weather got bad on the day we were going to go)... who does this stuff?
