Overall I cannot say enough good about the whole staff. Amy, Matt and Ashley in Restaurant, Mike at front desk, Justin, Jay and Stephanie in Pro Shop... all were amazing..... GO HERE AND STAY!

reviews.title: Not happy
reviews.text: This is a boring place. They charge extras fees per day for no activity. staff are not friendly and helpful. The place is very far the small town and they have no transport to anywhere. Very hot and dry

reviews.title: Windy city
reviews.text: We stayed in a two bedroom unit which was very nice and roomy, modern and bright. Full size kitchen with everything you need it except a place to put your groceries that don't require the fridge other than just on the counter top. It also has two full baths which is a big plus. On the negative side a note that's taped on the fridge door tells you that if you use strong spices or anything that will leave any odour you will be subject to a cleaning fee of $60. Saying that they will have to clean the carpets and drapes. With the wind in this city all they would have to do is open the windows for a couple of hours and the smell would be gone. You also have an extra fee of $35 each if it's the golf season and per unit if its not. This gives you 10% off food and 20% golf ..we golfed twice and ate at the clubhouse three times and the discounts did not add up to the $70 we paid for the vip pass. And this is a non negotiable fee.

reviews.title: Week in Paradise
reviews.text: The condo, golf course and restaurant were all very nice. Our only dissatisfaction was the golf tournament that hampered our full experience. We were only able to get in one round of golf because we weren't allowed to use the course or other recreation facilities for 5 of the 7 days.

reviews.title: A resort for a relaxing holiday
reviews.text: Paradise Canyon is found in a quiet location for a relaxing holiday. A car is needed for transportation as this is a location away from the busy city of 100,000. We don`t do golf and still enjoy Paradise Canyon every time we visit . One evening we were on the patio and the deer were on top of the Canyon grassing peacefully as we sat and watched.

reviews.title: Golfing at the end of October ?
reviews.text: Beautiful course, well maintained and great conditions at the end of the year. Temperature was mild at 10c-14c, partially cloudy and a little windy in Thursday and calm on Friday . We golfed back to back days and we loved it! Greens we're in great condition as well as the fairway and rough. This is a real treat to golf and the scenery is breathtaking on some holes . If your ever in Lethbridge in the spring, summer or fall and you don't know what to do, go for s round. The course is very challenging but fair.

reviews.title: Recent stay at Paradise Canyon resort
reviews.text: We found the resort to be excellent and everything you want in a get away. What was more impressive was Jim and his staff. We had a couple issues with bookings (dates etc) which the staff handled in a very friendly, professional and accommodating way. Quite often the staff can make or break a stay at a quality resort and the staff here is first class all the way. I would recommend this resort to anyone based on the experience and service provided to us.. Thank you to Jim and all his staff you guys / gals are fantastic.... Quinton

reviews.title: Fantastic Experience! Don't Miss this resort!
reviews.text: We had a most wonderful experience at Paradise Canyon Golf Resort. The pictures were "spot-on" , our accommodations were perfect for our needs and the staff, led by Mr. Jim Swanton, was the best we have EVER encountered. Prior to our visit, Mr. Swanton sent emails which got us even more excited about our visit. We have visited many resorts but have never had such a positive experience. Mr. Swanton definitely runs a "Ship-Shape" organization. He is the most personable resort manager that we have ever encountered. This resort deserves huge accolades for such customer service. Paradise Canyon is very worthy of it's Gold Crown distinction. The only downfall for us was that we didn't get to stay longer. We even received an email to welcome us back on a return visit when possible~NOW THAT'S CUSTOMER SERVICE! Do yourself a favor & don't miss this golden opportunity!

reviews.title: Fabulous!
reviews.text: Jim is top notch! He and his staff do a great job of keeping things clean and are so friendly. From the time you check in you feel like you are a part of a community not just a welcome guest. We are not golfers but thoroughly enjoyed our stay--immaculate accommodations. We did not use the pool or any other facilities. We stayed in May for 2 weeks and again in September. We had everything we needed in our unit to relax after busy days. People live in this subdivision and though it is quite a drive down into the valley, the view is great, the deer abundant and the atmosphere quiet and peaceful. The resort/neighbour sits at the bottom of the canyon with the Oldman River running alongside. Home away from home.

reviews.title: very poor comparison to worldwide RCI resorts
reviews.text: Very disappointed for a home town resort as expensive daily $25 resort fee for no pools, hot tubs or spa, just a closed golf course and poor exercise facilities. I guess you got a newspaper and Wi-Fi for the daily fee...big deal!!

reviews.title: Dinner Buffet was excellent but boy, what a golf course!
reviews.text: I don't play golf but worldl I ever like to play this course. Dinner buffet for a private group was excellent....the resort and setting just outstanding. The open bar was a bit pricey and we were disappointed with the one Cesar that we ordered....I'll take a Bloody Mary any time. All we did was have a buffet with a Friendship Force group....we got there late and so I can't say much about anything but the dinner and bar.

reviews.title: A short and sweet getaway
reviews.text: We came here for the long weekend for a break from life. The condos are very nice and have full kitchens, bathrooms, 2 bedrooms, patio with barbeque, a garage and decorated very nicely. The pool and hot tub are just outside the clubhouse and are well maintained. The temperature of both are very comfortable. We do not golf so did not use the golf course but it is very beautiful. We enjoyed our stay but found the $25.00 a day resort fee to be expensive. If we come back again, it would be a short stay again for this reason.

reviews.title: For a group of friends, Paradise Canyon is great
reviews.text: Our group stayed in 3 units at Paradise Canyon for a week while in Lethbridge. For our group to have a couple team gatherings, use the pool and hit a couple rounds at the golf course... it worked out great. Cons - is a fair distance from anything (not a big deal, just make sure you have a vehicle) - the cleaning service can take some time so be proactive if you need anything (towels and what not) Pros - condos have great space (we had 4 per condo) - golf course is challenging and plays well - the staff treated us great, Jim from the front office went out of his way to make sure we were taken care of from first day till last day. If you like golf and relaxing, this should be more then adequate for you.

reviews.title: Review of Paradise Canyon Golf Resort
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful here!! I paid extra for an upgraded unit, which was very spacious and in excellent condition, but I don’t know how it compares to a regular unit. My upper balcony overlooked the entire 15th hole of their gorgeous golf course........lots of activity on the golf course too!!

reviews.title: noisy rooms, but nice staff
reviews.text: Stayed for a week in a lower level condo. We could hear eveything going on upstairs. No noise insulation. Lethbridge looks more like a retirement community. Nice people but no energy or character. 1 day is enough here. With 2 hr drive to sites u can stretch that out to 3 days at most. The resort has a basic workout facility where 50% of the equipment works. You can get a basketball and tennis racketsto fillin the day. Really a golfing destination.

reviews.title: Boy's Golf Outing
reviews.text: Stayed in one of the two bedroom condo's and it was perfect for our trip. Furthest from the hole on a par 3 to decide who got the air mattress, supplied by the facility. Fully equipped kitchen with an out door patio and barbecue. The course had some winter kill, but the greens were excellent and a challenging track. Staff treated us well. Third time here and will return.

reviews.title: Men's World Curling Championship in Lethbridge, AB
reviews.text: Attended the first class Curling in Lethbridge. . The City and Resort were extremely hospitable. Jim Swanton and Mike Smart at the resort took care of all our questions and made our stay very enjoyable.

reviews.title: Quiet, beautiful spot
reviews.text: I will cover the bad, then the good. We did an RCI timeshare exchange for this. We should have asked for another unit. The unit we were in was a "step down" unit. (In U.S. terms it would be called a daylight basement). It was 12 - 14 steps to reach our entrance door. The people above us had already checked in and took our parking space for one of their four vehicles. The next day we asked the front desk manager Jim Swanton, if we should expect some courtesy for parking. He was very pleasant, said "of course, and he would call them". From their license plate we could tell they were from Victoria. (I hope they read this). Yes, we did get a parking place, but clearly they didn't like to be told to leave us a space because thereafter they tramped, jumped and thumped above us. Now the bed situation. The main bedroom, though roomy, had a very cheap, standard sized be me a bad back ache. The second small bedroom had two even smaller twin beds. Cramped to be sure. The dishwasher: I cleaned the filter and must have dug 1/3 cup of gunk out of it including part of a crayon, cloth (dish rag??) and you name it. Very dirty. The fireplace didn't work and the blind on the entry door was trashed. I reported both, then we went out. (Fireplace glass needs cleaned as part of routine maintenance). When we returned there was a new blind installed and the fireplace worked. Sunday brunch a bit over rated, but for $10.75 we can't complain too much, even though it did not include juice or coffee/tea. Surprising but that is what travel is all about. Now the GOOD. Large, new, nicely appointed spacious living/kitchen unit. Two full baths, en-suite clothes washer and dryer and soap for washer. Nice view over the golf course, but limited because of the large overhanging deck of the unit above. It was surprising and nice to receive each day the morning paper left at the door and signed with a cheery note from Jim. Jim, Colette and other staff were a great help in helping us with the technology of our iphone and ipad and we give many thanks to the pleasantness of all.

reviews.title: Felt like Home
reviews.text: Loved the fully stocked kitchen. Few have measuring spoons, so many utensils, and blender. 2 cutting boards! Very spacious and clean. Sheets were clean and crisp. Beautiful views and quiet. Practially sound proof. Could not hear guests below and they had 2 yr old and baby! Suite included all the comforts of home and felt like home away from home Comfortable furniture and bed was very comfy. Convenient having walking path right outside our door. (golf path) very scenic by river. Spacious large kitchen with plenty of counter space for 2 chefs in the kitchen. Thoroughly enjoyed meeting Jim the manager. He was one of our highlights this past weekend.

reviews.title: Great Scrapbook getaway
reviews.text: Always getting us all the tables and lights we need and a great place to scrap book for several days.Staff are very friendly and easy to work with. Restaurant on sight if we didn't want to cook. Great place for a winter getaway of scrapbooking.

reviews.title: great town and location.
reviews.text: we love to have the ability to do the laundry and do our own cooking (if we choose) while on vacation. This condo provided everything that we needed and was very clean with a great location. Trip the Tabor corn on the cob if you get a chance.

reviews.title: Exceptional Location, Exceptional Customer Service...
reviews.text: We have stayed at Paradise Canyon Golf Resort several times, and each of our stays has been exceptional, due - in no small part - to Jim Swanton and his Team. Quite honestly, Jim could 'teach' Customer Service! His enthusiasm, and kind attention to detail are unprecedented! On our last visit, we attended the Orientation Breakfast, and we were most pleased! We spent some time after the breakfast, sharing stories of our visit to the Lethbridge area, and getting to know some of the other visitors. The units are particularly well-maintained, modern, clean, fully equiped, and nicely situated to catch some of the beautiful river valley views. Neither my husband or I golf, but that certainly doesn't stop us from enjoying the Resort. Great riverside walking, just steps from the Units. Lethbridge is a great jumping-off spot for day trips to many location in Southern Alberta: Waterton Lakes National Park, Fort McLeod Museum, Writing On Stone Park(not to be missed!), and the Great Canadian Barn Dance (SO much fun!) - just to name a few! We'll be back!

reviews.title: good golf
reviews.text: My husband wanted a last chance to golf this season so we used one of our RCI timeshares to stay here. First...the area has so many new streets and subdivisions that our GPS had us driving in circles until we saw the direction signage. Check in wasn't until 4 so we headed to Walmart to get groceries for the week...which is a bit of a drive. Stock up before you check in... The Resort looks more like a subdivision with privately owned home. We stayed on the bottom floor of a duplex or was it a triplex. Our unit had one bedroom with a full kitchen, patio, living room. It also had an additional bedroom with its own private entrance that could be rented separately or used as a second bedroom to our unit. We weren't impressed with the quality of the unit. Very builder grade. Dated furniture and bedding. Kitchen was 1990's. The windows only had the cheap vertical blinds and no draperies to block the light. We had a family with kids over us and they bounced and danced all day. There didn't seem to much to entertain kids. Pool was closed, its only seasonal. And little annoying things like little flies on the greasy range hood light bulbs and different types and watts of light bulbs in the ceiling light...so easy to remedy. But the wifi was good and my husband did enjoy the golf course... We had checked in for the week but only stayed 3 days..

reviews.title: Beautiful Place
reviews.text: The condo went above our expectations. It was a beautiful unit, a place I would actually live full time. If we are ever back in the Lethbridge area we will definitely stay here again.The neighbors were very friendly. We saw deer every morning and evening driving out of the resort. We had a very pleasant time.

reviews.title: Beautiful location
reviews.text: This was our first stay at Paradise Canyon Golf resort. The unit was very modern, clean, and fully equipped. Beds were comfortable. Our daughter and grandchildren joined us fora couple of nights and there was lots of room. The views from the bedrooms over the valley was lovely even in the winter. Our son joined us for the Friday night Prime Rib buffet offered in the main centre. Delicious meal with good choices. We also enjoyed the Sunday morning breakfast buffet with gorgeous views all around. The service provided by Chantelle was excellent. Thank you for going the extra mile to obtain some gluten free pancakes for my son. Please add some more gluten free choices to your menu if possible.

reviews.title: Great golf course!!!!
reviews.text: Wouldn't of minded the $35 per person fee if there was actually a fitness center. Fitness center is sup-par, some loose weights but the multi-function machines were broken. Treadmills not up to standard. Range balls appear years old.

reviews.title: Beautiful, scenic, quiet, and fun.
reviews.text: There is so much to say about this resort. The beauty is indescribable, you simply have to go there. The golf, albeit a little pricey, is incredible. One highlight was going on a hike with THE OWNER of the resort. The condo was nice, and the staff were very accommodating. The only downside was the fee to use the pool and the other facilities. It cost my family of four $140 for the week. This is the first resort I have ever paid this type of fee at. However, the fee did cover wifi costs, which was nice. While I don't usually go to the same resort twice, I would consider returning to Paradise!

reviews.title: A Very Fun & Interesting Place
reviews.text: My sister and I wanted to do a grand tour of Canadian parks such as beautiful Waterton International Park and Lake Louise and Banff and also Glacier National Park just over the Canadian-US border, this was a great headquarters location. We flew into Calgary and toured all around the area, this location is a couple of hours from Calgary. Be sure to take Alberta Highway 22, the Cowboy Trail, if you get a chance because it is absolutely awesome, breathtakingly green and lush and beautiful, rolling hills and ranches as far as the eye can see. It is reminiscent of the Scottish Highlands!! Paradise Canyon Golf Resort is located on the outskirts of Lethbridge, a fun and interesting and unique city. The Resort has a wonderful golf course, very interestingly shaped, and the accommodations were great. It is a two-story condo with a view of the golf course, a full kitchen very well stocked, a washer & dryer, two nice bedrooms w/ 2 nice bathrooms, very comfortable beds, full air conditioning, color tv, a great deck with nice big barbecue, clubhouse pool, great views, and even a garage to pull into (first time we've had that on vacation!) Service excellent, with a personalized newspaper behind the door every day. You'll want to try the clubhouse food a couple of times but there is a splendid variety of restaurants available in town you'll want to try. (also nearby is the site of one of the world's largest and tallest metal train trestles, neat!) And you have to go to Waterton International Park nearby which is really outstanding and magnificent, take the boat ride on the lake, it's incredible! (also the site of the old and haunting Prince of Wales Hotel). All in all a great experience and wonderful customer service.

reviews.title: Another great weekend in Lethbridge
reviews.text: This was our second trip to the Paradise Canyon resort. Once again we had a great time. The condos are very nicely appointed. This time we dined more in the restaurant than doing our own food preps.The condos do have a full kitchen so it makes it very easy to do your own meals if you so desire. The living area is quite spacious which gave us the opportunity to host a little party while there. We were able to fit thirteen adults in the living room for some catching up. The resorts customer service manager, Jim Swanton, was excellent. He phoned us a week ahead of checking in to see if there was any special needs or reservations we might need during our visit. While there he made sure that everything ran smoothly, which it did. For any further trips to Lethbridge we would love to stay at Paradise Canyon again.

reviews.title: Good units except for the WI-FI
reviews.text: The facilities in the 2bedroom condos are spacious & clean. The problem is that the WI-FI is such poor quality, one has to stand right beside the modem to be able to use it. Being in the canyon, cellphone network is also rather poor. Some networks had no service.

reviews.title: Golfing?
reviews.text: Nice course. Not many trees or water hazards but lots of rolling hills. Beautiful views. The staff was very friendly and helpful. They were patient in explaining the GPS in the cart. Only played nine holes but was enough for rusty players.

reviews.title: Great round of golf!
reviews.text: As the name implies this golf course is in a canyon. It is beautiful but can be very windy. We went a few days after a major hail storm and expected the greens to be rough but they were in very good shape! The staff were friendly and very helpful. Bring your sunscreen!

reviews.title: VERY small 2 bedroom unit - felt like a cheap motel
reviews.text: 2 bedroom unit was VERY small.Bathroom off the room with 2 queen beds was shower only, sink and toilet in space so small that only one person would fit in room at a timeBedroom had 2 beds and one chest of drawers; no luggage racks or place to put luggage. No desk or chairs. No mirror except in the small bathroom.Kitchen had no garbage disposal. Stove fan didn’t work – wouldn’t turn off without removing the knob and turning it by hand. Living area was very small with one couch and one chair only. Key entry to unit was difficult to operate – new key needs to be made.Only resort requiring $149.00 nonrefundable fee to pay for items that most resorts offer for free. Restaurant food was 10% off but breakfast was not available until 10:00 am.Green fees were 20% off but this only amounted to $10.00 for a nine hole round of play. The outdoor swimming pool was not heated so it was cold. We never used the workout room after looking at it because it was small, and looked run down. Also, it did not have much equipment. Overall, the accommodation were the poorest in our 25 years plus history with RCI. I would not recommend this resort to anyone.

reviews.title: Truly "Paradise"
reviews.text: In late July, we enjoyed a week-long timeshare exchange at this lovely, WELL-SITUATED resort. There's a little of something for everyone. Golf is NOT our game; but, the course looked lovely, set along the Oldman River. There are two tennis courts (also used for "Pickle Ball"!) and an outdoor pool. A full-service restaurant is available for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Location is what sets THIS "Paradise" apart, as it is only about an hour & a half from Waterton Lakes National Park, and not that much further across the border to Glacier National Park. To the west is Head-Bashed-In Buffalo Jump, a UNESCO site; and, nearby the historic NWMP Fort McLeod... with its magical, RCMP horse "musical ride". If one visits Buffalo Jump on a Wednesday, one can see some spirited, professional "pow-wow" Indian Dancing. The accessible, small city of Lethbridge is about 15-20 minutes from the resort. Lethbridge is quite attractive, with 16% "green space" mandated throughout the city. There are numerous historical interests, including North America's 1909 longest and highest steel trestle bridge. One can also visit "Fort Whoop-up", a late 19th century "whiskey post". Nikka Yuko Japanese Garden provides a relaxing escape from the daily grind. Cultural (theater and music) events are available depending on the season. And, if one enjoys a change from one's everyday cuisine, there are many ethnic restaurants to try. We enjoyed exellent Cuban, Afghani, Vietnamese, and Guatamalan fare. There are also Italian, Japanese, Chinese and several other restaurant types. As to Paradise Canyon Golf Resorts' accommodations, they were "perfect"... totally comfortable and well maintained; with fully-equipped kitchen, balcony with barbeque, etc. Best of all is the service, friendliness, and helpfulness of the resort staff... especially "Jim". A "highlight", suggested by Jim to start the week, was a Saturday visit to the "Farmers' Market" featuring wonderful produce, fruits, and baked goods from the surrounding farms and Hutterite community.

reviews.title: A week in Paradise
reviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Paradise Canyon Golf Resort. Host, Jim Stanton, was very friendly and knowledgeable about the resort and the surrounding area. He was also very accommodating. The resort is quiet and in a secluded area, set along the Old Man River and the Coulees, yet close to all amenities.

reviews.title: A must stay for the golfer and the non golfer
reviews.text: Everything you read about Jim in other Tripadvisor reviews is correct. Every resort needs a "Jim". He called us several days before we left home and followed up with an email giving us directions. Every morning we received a newspaper with a short message in Jim's handwriting. We are golfers but because we were having a family reunion for Thanksgiving, we left our clubs at home. We walked part of the course and it is great shape. The unit we rented through RCI was an "A" unit. It handled six people for sleeping easily and we had up to 12 people for meals. Good size unit and in good condition. It appeared to have had updating done. We were quite surprised that it did not a hide-away bed but rather a blow-up bed (much taller than any blow up mattresses that we have see. The two people using the blow-up found it very comfortable. We had a great week at Paradise Canyon. This is not our first visit to this resort and it certainly will not be our last. Only Negative: Barbecue is old and needs replacing. Hopefully that is on their list for next year. Resort Tip: Leave your swim suits at home after September 30. Both the pool and hot tub are closed after this date. Too bad - we would have enjoyed a hot-tub in mid October.

reviews.title: Beware!!!
reviews.text: My friend & I have just returned for 5 days’ vacation using a time share at Paradise Golf Canyon Resort. Very disappointed on how the site manager treat us. He won't even accept our explanations on the broken pump. We admitted that we pressed the hot tub button to check if its working which we normally do on the last few days. But he said that it caused more damage on the pump and he'll charge us a portion of the price of a new pump. FYI. That pump was already broken since our first day and we have been using it for 4 days now and still broken. In short, a portion of the price of a new pump has been charged to us. First time I've heard that a customer is charged for a "PUBLIC FACILITY" that was already broken in the first place!!! To the site manager, I suggest to please close the hot tub if you knew that is already broken to avoid charging your customers!!! I would rate this resort as 1 star with regards to how they treat us, very poor customer service. This would be our first and last visit on this resort. Would NOT RECOMMEND this place to anyone!!!

reviews.title: Golfers Heaven
reviews.text: We love to golf and this course is amazing. It is in wonderful shape, with lush green grass. We played 3 times and each time got more comfortable with the course. Our tri level condo was clean and sizable for our needs. Two bedroom, two bath with full laundry facilities. We had a single car garage as well. The canyon is beautiful and walking around the grounds provides serenity. Jim at the RCI desk was quite helpful and knowledgable about the area. We did a lot of exploring while in Lethbridge.

reviews.title: Resort
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful. The condo has everything you need and more. The view is spectacular. The staff will go the extra for you. This is 5 th time here. Will keep coming back to paradise. Condo has a deck, gas BBQ, washer and dryer. Garage for parking.

reviews.title: A lovely road trip
reviews.text: We wanted to try a different RCI exchange from our usual at Elk Horn in Manitoba. The drive up was great and the pictures were accurate to the accommodations. Our unit was a 2 bedroom attached condo. We had 2 balconies facing the front and were very pleased with the view and spent much time outside every day. As opposed to the 1 bedroom that faced the back and looked straight into a huge hill with zero view. Our unit was very clean but starting to be a bit dated. The beds were terrific with what felt like newer mattresses and that is important to me. Everything was in good shape in the throughout the condo. The furniture was leather and far too soft for my liking or a bit old...it looked lovely but too soft for me. The condo was right in the community and we felt like neighbours rather than renters as everyone we met were very kind and friendly. The amenities were great and we made use of them all. Daily free putting greens and driving range balls. The pool and hot tub were never busy and always clean too. Jim was fantastic as he answered all our questions, gave us information on surrounding areas to visit, he was entertaining (even sang me an old school song....which I knew!!). He always had a story to share about the history of the area or one of his many travels. Loved Jim!! He is a real

reviews.title: Clean and Comfortable
reviews.text: Our two bedroom, two bathroom condo was very clean and comfortable. The kitchen was well stocked; pots, pans, plates, glasses, barbecue. The linens were good quality and the beds very comfortable conducive to great sleeps. The location is quiet, and the back of our unit was on the golf course. We had Sunday brunch in the restaurant, great! The only complaint is about trying to book our tee time. After purchasing the $200 gift card to get "free" wifi, we were told there was a golf tournament so had to book our golf on a different day. The young man in the pro shop could have a better attitude. The golf course is great, need to return for another round!

reviews.title: Great for family gatherings
reviews.text: Our 'core family' is local but members live out of town. For our family with grown children and grandchildren, we find Paradise Canyon ideal. Each family unit has their own space; yet we are on the same campus and can share in the resort's amenities (seasonal).

reviews.title: Nice and quiet
reviews.text: The condo is in a golf community. While we don't golf, the area was well maintained and we made good use of the restaurant, outdoor pool (smaller pool good for younger childern) and hot tub. The unit was very nice. Instead of a fold-out couch, our unit had a self unflating air-bed which worked out great. We enjoy the Lethbridge area and we were there for the beginning of the corn harvest which supplied some excellent eating of the famous Taber Corn. We visited Head Smashed In Buffalo Jump, Writing-on-Stone Provincial Park and Franks Slide and highly recommend them all.

reviews.title: Excellent accomodation
reviews.text: The staff were so friendly and helpful that you felt you could ask them anything, anytime. Great accommodation with two bedrooms, two bathrooms, balcony looking over to the hills on which deer appeared from time to time. A quiet area but easy to get to Waterton and local attractions. Super weekend brunch which is well worth going to.

reviews.title: Jim Swanton front desk manager made our stay the best!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradise Canyon golf resort for the week of May10-17th2013, Jim Swanton front desk manager was the most helpful and informative front desk manager we have ever encountered. We are fortunate to be able to travel all over the world and so this is a huge compliment. He is 78 years old going on 25, so much enthusiasm, experience, committment and going the extra mile. Our first room had too many stairs and so we told Jim and he immediately moved us. We needed help finding things to do, where to eat etc. and Jim was totally into helping us. He made our week so much fun. Thanks for a wonderful week. The condo is lovely as is the restaurant, but Jim was the frosting on the cake. Patty and Jim helena, mt.

reviews.title: Thanksgiving Sunday Brunch?
reviews.text: What do the words "Thanksgiving Sunday Brunch" @ $20 per person, conjure up in your mind? We had phoned earlier to confirm they were having a Thanksgiving Brunch. I was assured that they were. We arranged to have the family join us. But sent messages to the ones who had not arrived yet, to offer them the option to cancel as soon as we found out that it was only a breakfast bar. 1. I foolishly thought there would be a lunch option to the "brunch" when you arrive after 11am. Nope. We arrived at 1pm, no lunch option in the three food warmers. Just breakfast items that consisted of scrambled eggs, potatoes, bacon, ham and eggs benedict that looked okay but should have been removed and hour or so earlier. There is a separate area where you can ask the chef for a 1 or 2 egg omelette and a side table with a choice of a few desserts. 2. There was no trimming that one would expect at a Thanksgiving Brunch. No turkey, chicken, beef... but there was ham and bacon. 3. The experience was an overall disappointment.

reviews.title: High Resort Fees, nice apartment
reviews.text: Basically a 2-bedroom duplex. The units are among a number of homes that are owned. We got one of the upstairs units that also had a garage. Unit is good size. Furniture and beds comfortable. Has an outdoor space with a grill. Full kitchen. Laundry in the room. Main complaint is the resort fee. We stayed 6 nights and it was about $250 CAD. That is the highest I have ever encountered. That was supposed to also include "cleaning fees" but housekeeping (although we did not need it) never stopped by during our stay.

reviews.title: Italian Dinner
reviews.text: What a wonderful experience. Came for the Italian Feast and left amazed. Buffet style service, food was hot, plentiful, and extremely tasty. The service was prompt and friendly. The Tiramisu.... brought me back to the cafe in Venice. Chef Connor and his team did an exceptional job. Looking forward to the next feast.

reviews.title: Pros and Cons
reviews.text: Some things in room needed to be upgraded/maintained(couch, kitchenware, kitchen sink, sliding door, etc.), however, everything was spotlessly clean and nicely decorated.Younger managing staff seemed to do the bare essential and nothing more.Staff at resort restaurant were extremely pleasant, helpful and accommodating (even to my gluten-free diet restrictions!).Elderly man at front desk when checking out was very kind, sweet and gave us that personal touch that was very much appreciated!

reviews.title: Daily fees are too high for the amenities offered.
reviews.text: Increase of fees from $25, a visit to $25, a day seems like a huge increase. When no additional amenities were added from one stay to the next. BBQ was not in good working order. The kitchen equipment needed repairs; the fry pan’s handle was not attached, name just one of the problems. Housekeeping staff was quick to fix the TV issue.

reviews.title: personable, wonderful customer service
reviews.text: We travelled here last year at the end of August 2014. The place is wonderful although we didn't spend much time here do to so many surrounding activities. Personalized paper daily (thanks Jim), maps and loads of help with questions. We used this as a base to explore Waterton National Park and Glacier National Park, Montana. It was the first choice due to it's distance from our activities; and although tiring after a long day of hiking...the drive to and from Waterton and GNP was relaxing and beautiful with countryside and scenery of the Big Sky everywhere. I was glad for the inconvenience of the long drive. We had a two bedroom timeshare/the rooms were clean, two bathrooms, fireplace full kitchen. I loved the decor and it was quiet. No complaints whatsoever!

reviews.title: Great time
reviews.text: Highly recommend this resort. One of the best places we have been. Jim and mike very friendly and helpful. Clean and well maintained. We had a condo overlooking the 15th hole...beautiful golf course. But watch those greens...fast!!! We would definitely go back.

reviews.title: Italian Night had disgusting food
reviews.text: Buffet- wilted salad, tomatoes rock hard. Veggies undercooked. Chicken cacciatore consisted mostly of chicken wings and backs. Spaghetti with meatballs ? Really? No meatballs. Diners hovered over spaghetti platter to wait for meatballs. Diners also hovered over dessert table awaiting advertised tiramisu. Absolutely horrible dining experience . $30 each. You should be ashamed Tony & Rocco !

reviews.title: Breath taking Surrondings amazing Golf course, highly recomended!
reviews.text: From the Golf carts and GPS to the professional service and welcome of the Paradise Canyon team we had a wonderful time playing through this course. There is beauty and challenge on every hole, hole 12 is on an elevate tee box down to the banks of the river. The 12th green is surrounded by challenge, short you are in the rough, right or left to far and you are playing out of the sand trap, to long and you have donated a ball to the river god’s. Never the less the incredible beauty takes the edge off of any challenge. Golfers add this to your list. Enjoy

reviews.title: Golf Cart Charges - BEWARE
reviews.text: This course usually opens up a few weeks earlier than its northerly neighbors given the location. It is a great golf course with scenic views. However, this is one of those courses that charges a full cart for single players and not by seat. It's too bad a course like this needs to nickle and dime players.

reviews.title: Resort Fees
reviews.text: Just a Nice place, drop the daily resort fee as there is nothing special.Had to wash dishes before we could use them, not all but plates and bowls where not clean.Fridge was old and noisy, microwave would time out but still be running.DVD remote was not working batteries were corroded.

reviews.title: non oilfers stay away
reviews.text: given a basement suite with no outside access..no view..1 km walk to any amenities. We have never stayed in an RCI resort that did not offer either a deck or patio for relaxing or entertaining. I think the 5 star reviews are from golfers who do not spend any time in the condo( really a basement suite. Very disappointed

reviews.title: A True Paradise
reviews.text: We had a week-long stay in the resort in early June and had a fabulous time golfing, playing tennis and exploring the city. Our condo was clean, quiet, spacious and modern. We only made plans to visit Glacier National Park and were not sure how to spend the rest of the week. Jim, the sweet and kind manager, put our worries to rest. He called us into his office and give my whole family a detailed orientation of the city and places to see and things to do. I kept the map he drew for us as a souvenir. We filled the rest of the day playing on the beautiful and well maintained golf course as well as the tennis courts, which can use a little make over. This is truly a vacation we will always remember.

reviews.title: Quick Canadian Getaway
reviews.text: Love this place. Beware if you want garage (Unit A), you also get the stairs. Unit B is ground floor and there is a parking pad right outside the unit. Staff very friendly, helpful and prompt to help with any problem. Unit is clean and spacious unless you are quilters with extra tables, then big enough for 2. Would recommend for anyone with business or conference in Lethbridge.

reviews.title: May 1 to May 6 2016
reviews.text: Third time stay. Golf Course in great condition thanks to the early spring. The facility has been maintained in an exemplary fashion. Truly deserves a four star rating at least. Prompt and courteous service, with clean, comfortable, fully furnished 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom Condo. Sleeps 6.

reviews.title: Non-golfer week at Paradise Canyon
reviews.text: My sister and I stayed at the Paradise Canyon resort for a week, using this as a base to see the sights around the area. We are not golfers, but enjoyed the community in which our condo was located. It's a bit out on its own, but that added to the quietness and beauty of the resort. The condo was nice, but the best part of the week at this resort was one outstanding man . . . Jim Swanton. His official title is "customer service manager" but in reality he is the heart of this resort. When we were at the Tourist Information Center in Lethbridge, we were told about Jim and what an amazing man he is. Well, he certainly is. He goes above and beyond to make guests feel at home. He gave us information about what to do during our week there and answered many questions. Every morning he gets up early to hand deliver the newspaper to your condo door so you don't have to drive up to the main lobby to get it. But even more than that, he always added a personal handwritten note on the front of the paper. What a great way to start the day. On our last day, not only was there his handwritten note, but also little Canadian flags and Lethbridge pins as a remembrance of our time there. I always knew Canadians were the friendliest people. Jim Is a great representative of Canada. The resort is fortunate he is a part of their staff.

reviews.title: Lethbridge condo
reviews.text: Very nice condo clean inside .Lots of places to visit in Lethbridge.Golf course was still open even though we did not use it.Not that easy getting to the east side of Lethbridge from here had to drive north quite a ways to get across the river to the east side of Lethbridge where most of the restaurants and food stores are.

reviews.title: Southern Alberta Gem!
reviews.text: While in Lethbridge, every golfer should experience this golf course. The course condition was great especially the greens. Nicely appointed clubhouse with good food. Fair prices, friendly staff. Need to stay hydrated on the warm days as the area can get very hot as the course is situated down in the river valley surrounded by cactus filled coulee's.

reviews.title: Relaxing spot for family weekend in February.
reviews.text: We stay in resort in February family long weekend. Great location by Old Man River. Nice, quiet and relaxing. The unit that we got it 2 bedroom with 2 washrooms and full kitchen, garage and parking lot. Big patio on top of the garage. Very clean and taking care of. Even it was a February but we have a beautiful weather with +12C. The restaurant was closed ( open just for golfing season) but open Friday and Saturday for dinner buffet, and brunch for Sunday. Food was tasty and fresh. In an hour and half away from there we got to Writing - on - Stone Provincial Park. Waterton Provincial Park close by too. Places that you must see if you in the area.

reviews.title: Wonderful even if you do not play golf
reviews.text: We just spent a week here with a time share exchange. We were here with friends who booked through booking.com. We were in 2 very different unit types, both with their pros and cons. Here are the descriptions of the units. We were in a "B" unit. This is perfect if you have any mobility issues as it is all on one level, no stairs. This is a 2 bedroom, 2 bath that will accomodate 4 people comfortably and any more than that will be a squeeze. Living room area has a couch and chair, full kitchen that is well stocked, and a small patio with BBQ off the living room. 3 TVs - living room, and each bedroom. Unit A is much larger and will accomodate 6 people very comfortably. But if there are any mobility issues, this is the wrong unit. You will go up about 10 steps to the front door. Bedrooms and kitchen/dining is on the first level. Living room, a very nice patio and BBQ are on a second level. Unit A also has a garage. There are no planned activities at this resort. There is a golf course and tennis courts, a small but very nice pool and hot tub, and a dining room and lounge on site. (We did not eat here, so cannot comment.) The customer service is exceptional. Jim is fantastic. He even places a call to your home prior to your check in date to touch base. He is very knowledgeable about the area. And when we checked out, there was a flower for our daughter. You need a car here, and you need to be prepared for some longer drives, 1 - 2.5 hours one way. But everything is worth it. This is a great place to stay even if you don't play golf (and we don't.) One other weird note. We were not only questioned at Customs at the Calgary airport about why we would be going to Lethbridge, but we were sent to secondary screening. Our friends drove across the border and were also questioned in great detail. We related this to Jim, and he said that this is not unusual. I guess Customs agents cannot understand why Americans would visit Lethbridge,. But don't let them fool you. This resort is fabulous, (did I mention that the morning paper is delivered daily to your door?), and the area is well worth visitng.

reviews.title: Very nice golf course
reviews.text: We only played the golf course once but it was very nice, the tee boxes were like a green.. Tough course. The town house was nice ,had our own garage which was a nice touch.Played golf at Waterton lake not too bad , Picture Butte it was great value, they have 27 holes, nice course..and we went to Magrath course it was ok too.. good prices $35-40... Paradise was $70......

reviews.title: WORST PROPERTY IN MONDARMANI!!!
reviews.text: We were 4 friends travelling from kolkata. We all were excited about the road trip.After a tiring journey of 170 kms we get to know that the hotel will not provide us with the accommodation. We made the booking from make my trip and we showed them the booking too. The reasons stated by hotel authorities to deny accommodation were :- 1)Sir we dint get any mail from anyone about your booking. 2)We are sold out today. 3)Actually we have non-ac rooms available today. 4)We strictly prohibit stags checking into our property. 5)And the last one was its election time so the police has asked us not to check-in any guest. Adding to the entire episode was the unprofessional and rude behaviour of the hotel reception people. Called up make my trip and had a word with them. They said the hotel shows an inventory of rooms in mmts site. So we caught them red handed that even when they had rooms they dint give us. Finally we left that property and went to check with other hotels in the terrible heat. Every hotel welcomed us and finally we checked into a hotel. Conclusion:FELT INSULTED AND HARASSED because of their unprofessional behaviour. This property is a BIG NO NO from my end. Please book at your own risk or plan to take a courts stay order for a successful stay!!!

reviews.title: Don't fall for the ads
reviews.text: Photographs of the hotel, in their website is very appealing. If fact, when you get in the hotel, you will find resemblance. But your agony will start when you prepare getting in the room. At first, the door locks doesn't work properly. Almost every time, you try unlocking the door, for sure will require the assistance of the hotel staffs. Next comes the electric switches. Connections are faulty in most of the cases and almost all the rooms. To switch on a light or a TV, you might have to press the "Off" to switch it on. About the TV, you would be lucky enough, if the set is tuned. After checking in, it was around 3-4 hours later TV was fixed. During summer time, AC is a must in this place, however, do check if its working properly. May of our co-traveler, staying in other rooms, faced issues with the AC. Some of the earlier reviewers mentioned that for double occupancy, they were given only one towel and had to ask for toiletries. No exception for me too. Yes, we too had to ask for the extra towel, soap etc. So, if you are having a double occupancy in a room, please do ensure that you ask for the extra towel, soap etc., unless you are ready to share the one that is provided. Food options are very less. If fact, there isn't any dining space in the hotel. You need to pre-order your food to be served, and are priced bit higher than that are available in the adjoining hotels. Only advantage is that it's conveniently situated on the beach and have arrangement for shower outside while getting into the hotel. It also have a small part and resting benches where you can spend a lazy evening or a early morning sunrise.

reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: Excellent Hotel. Great Experience Value For Money. Friendly Stuff. It was great fantabulous experience in this hotel. I am happy and Statisfied. Rooms are clean stuff are good . Food was excellent. More love to see beach from hotel room.

reviews.title: HORRIBLE
reviews.text: If you are thinking to go to this hotel, go at your own risk and only to sit in the reclining beach chairs overlooking the sea and yes the games room. If you are going for no hassles stay, I think you should avoid. The rooms and food are horrible. I took a suite with a rack rate of Rs 7400 per day. First the AC was not working, so they changed the room. Second, the balcony grill has worn out in such a way, that a little pressure will make you fall 2 stories. Tolerated. The TV remotes were not working. Resolved after half an hour. The bathrooms were stinking of urine. The hotel puts off the AC 8 to 9 am and then 5pm to 8pm. The morning schedule was not informed to us. We could not avail the swimming pool because it was closed. Next came at 10.30 pm , there was no water in the bathroom. The pump had to be started and we could avail after 15 minutes, waiting to wash our hands after dinner. Next day morning check out at 11 am. They told us we can stay till 12, but they switched off the AC at 11 without informing us. That is when I blasted and I could not take it anymore.

reviews.title: GOOD WITH BEST OF THE SERVICES
reviews.text: LOCATIONWISE, AMBIENCEWISE AND FOODWISE, THE BEST HOTEL. NOT TO FORGET THE COURTEOUS SERVICE. The garden and play area for the children is abundant. Relax in the sitting area near the perimeter or just relax from the balcony of the suit. Food is awesome but available on order only. Though there is no vast choice but common foods are available. No electricity. Hotels run on generators. So little bit costly. Adventure sports available just outside the hotel.

reviews.title: At the moment one of the best experience for budget travellers
reviews.text: Nice property for budget stay and wonderful food. I am a little sursprised to see some real bad reviews, however, in my opinion this is a very accomodating property for the money they charge unless you are looking for lavish stay. Rooms are decent, pool is nice, location is the best and on the beach and above everything the food they serve is amazing. Rinku is the manager and he is a smart manager and knows how to treat guests and who needds what. Other resorts like sana and suncity are there to spoil your experiemce and pockets. Do stay here if you are with family or groups. Sourav from the booking team is extremely fast and quick decission maker too. I strongly recommend if you are looking for good beach experience and suggest you dont go if you are one of those high budget guys .. Food is HALAL.

reviews.title: Homely atmosphere... Friendly staff... Great location
reviews.text: This is not for the ones who are looking for 5* treatment and amenities. Go there on weekdays to get the optimum service. Service staff are bit slow but the empathy towards the guests are amazing. Food is very good but available in limited variety.

reviews.title: A pleasant weekend spent on the Bank of Sea....
reviews.text: The property is simply awesome. With large lawn and children play ground, amazing swimming pool, leisurely deck chairs facing the sea, mouthwatering food not only at Lunch and Dinner but also at your deck by the sea side in the evening ----- Every single thing is fabulous... Ample car parking space, courteous staff will enrich your experience of weekend holidaying...

reviews.title: excellent hotel
reviews.text: location is very good, hotel rooms are decent, entire premises is thoughtfully planned, very good for the families with little children and kids, promenade along the coast is just fantastic. food is good, staffs are well trained and cordial and prompt. chanchal saha, kolkata

reviews.title: Good location, bad hotel with horrible service and moderate food
reviews.text: I stayed in this hotel with my family along with other 5 families for 1 nights. We have 6 rooms booked and consider this feedback from all of us. We visit there on the 1st weekend of the September 2015:-- 1. Good location. It’s just on the beach like other Mandarmani hotels. But to reach this hotel you need to travel at the end of Mandarmani and need to drive through beach which may be risky due to wet sand and your vehicle may got stuck. But once you reach the hotel the lawn on the beach is magnificent. So for location ****. 2. Cleanliness, wow what’s that. This hotel doesn’t believe on this. Rooms are damped, toilets full of stains and anybody would think twice before using it. Swimming pool full of insects and bugs, and they will charge you for swimming costume, though we didn’t use the pool looking at the condition of the pool. Floor not cleaned for long time. There is not –ve rating otherwise I would definitely give them -5star. They are on top of it from below. For cleanliness *. 3. Friendly and welcome is zero, a BIG ZERO. The manager had his own groups of friends arrive on the same time and they seem to be only important to him. Any service you say was not up to the mark. If you want to order for food or drinks let them know at least 1 hr early. We arrived in a big group and already placed our fixed at the time of booking but all the menu were altered and serve as per them. Even we pay them extra as per food menu. Again -5star and specially to that rough Manager. For service * star. 4. Bed was small but ok. AC should only work on limited time. We will give ** star. 5. Food quality was not good but adjustable. But the service finally took away all the charm. For food **. We suggest don’t some to this hotel. Overall stay from our side. *

reviews.title: worst hotel
reviews.text: the service and behaviour of staff is very rude and unprofessional, moreover rooms are poorly maintain. not recommended for booking, moreover the staff behaving like that they are doing obligation on us by serving

reviews.title: worst management ever
reviews.text: The hotel room was nice but the management was terrible . they dont had cups to serve tea . We asked for more tea bags but they refused . The management for very poor and families stay away . A very very bad hotel

reviews.title: Great location. Great service.
reviews.text: It is never too late to write a review for a great service. My parents, uncle and aunt had the pleasure of being served by ADB in Dec 2015. We had booked a sea facing suite. Rooms had all the basic amenities and were clean. Since they were all senior citizens, there was a special attendant who was detailed for their special requests re food and other daily stuffs. I had the immense support of their Calcutta office employee, Sabrina, who made sure that my smallest of the request were taken into consideration, right from choosing the right room (while sharing the pictures beforehand), arranging pick up and drop and having detailed a personal attendant for the room.

reviews.title: Great location and nothing else!
reviews.text: It's around a 15-min drive from the main beach of Mandarmani. While it does keep the unwanted crowd at bay, the only way to the hotel is by a drive on the beach. That being illegal, might be put to rest. On the one hand it provides you with a beautiful beachfront pool and sitting area, it takes away all your happiness with below standard, overpriced food. The rooms too are not well kept with the walls showing signs of decay and taps and showers leaking. There's no reason why I should go back.

reviews.title: The most happening place in Mandarmoni
reviews.text: I prefer ADB Kanvas as my one and only place to stay in Mandarmoni since 2015 as it is one of the few happening hotels in Mandarmoni specifically in the evening. One will find ample options to enjoy starting from Two Swimming Pools, Badminton Court, Children Gardens, Game Room, Sea Facing sitting and dining facility and so on. One can also enjoy the music and lighting in the evening. Complimentary breakfast is awesome with so many items to choose from. Lunch and Dinner menu is also good. Restaurant is well decorated and there's also a Banquet Hall for party and etc. Overall MUST VISIT PLACE.

reviews.title: Peaceful, Romantic, Short Stay!
reviews.text: We stayed here for 1 night. It was a sweet and short stay. Though we had a booking on ground floor, but they provided us a good room in 2nd floor with view and balcony. Pool was clean and beautiful. We enjoyed a lot. Beautification is done with lightings, fountains, a big lawn with beautiful seating space and kids play area with cute rabbits. They provide swimming costume free of cost. Staffs are helpful. food we didn't try there except breakfast which was okay. Resort can be renovated or kept well maintained.

reviews.title: Need some Maintenance
reviews.text: We booked 2 suites which have 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom in each...rooms are tidy but dustbin was not clean... Told one of the staff but no steps were taken...bathroom is ok ok....only the main door has lock, the other doors don't have any...balcony was not clean enough...the wooden railings are very risky....rotted and loose...the corridors are not clean also...there was a dump room that was open and not looking good...many things are dumped in front of the stair...lights are enough in both room...mini fridges were working in both rooms...towels and beddings were clean...swimming pool needs a serious maintenance... The water was green, pond like colour...no cotton dress were allowed in the pool...they provide dress free of cost which were ok... foods were fine...complimentary buffet breakfast had puri, sabzi, upma, bada, sambhar, bread, butter, boiled egg, scrambled egg, tea- coffee, cornflakes and milk only for kids... room service was ok type...

reviews.title: Good location,Ok hotel
reviews.text: The location of this hotel is really good and the beach facing sitting area us the best part about it . Beach in this side is not crowded,which is a plus point. Coming to the hotel, food is overpriced, and not many options are available.We were in ground floor and rooms had a strange odour. I am assuming, first floor rooms were better. Hotel staff can be more friendly, specially the one sitting in reception area. I am not going back to this hotel for sure.

reviews.title: Very poor Service Compared to the pricing
reviews.text: The price of the resort is quite costly. But the rooms we got was not upto the mark. AC was not working most of the time. The bathrooms were not clean enough. Very poorly maintained property. Limited parking space, had trouble parking my Duster. All the staffs will literally ask you for tips. I will recommend it only if you don't get any other place in Mandarmani.

reviews.title: Fast deteriorating property
reviews.text: Excellently placed in Mandarmoni, with a nice layout to start with, having a vast openness to the sea front where hours can be spent! Alas , the property is falling to pieces, and fast! I've been there a year back, it was so good I decided to revisit with my friends. Now, I find ill maintenance all around from rooms, balconies, bathrooms, windows, doors, locks, knobs, switches, taps, tiles and most AC units!! Garden and lobby sides strewn with rubbish, bottles, beer cans! Garden grass submerged in muddy water, rotting wooden garden chairs etc. Eyes meet management dilapidation everywhere! Only grace was the good food, nice staff, trying to do their best and the sea front seating area; but unfortunately that too was marred by loud and foul music played by a DJ from 6-11pm. Its sad!

reviews.title: Mandarmani sea view hotel
reviews.text: Mandarmani has a lot of places to stay, I prefer one on the beach with sea view from room. This hotel is not over priced has a swimming pool and all sea facing rooms have a balcony. I am vegetarian and getting food good to my taste is difficult still i really liked it here. There is a garden and beach sitting area too in front of the property. There are other more expensive hotels in mandarmani but if want to spend unnecessarily on room rate then surely go for this one. i would like stay here again.

reviews.title: Typical Bong Hotel
reviews.text: The property location is good but being run with untrained and cheap human resources. Ill maintained property and highly non professional attitude. However, it's a safe place. Only plus point with this property.

reviews.title: A Pleasant Surprise
reviews.text: ...to start with, I had a very decent stay at the property...there is room for improvement...but, hey, where aint??? I went to Mandarmoni in the last week of March, and stayed in this hotel for a period of 3 days. I stayed in a Van Gogh, and if i remember correctly, it was room #203. I had booked my stay through makemytrip.com, which somehow claims that the hotel has a swimming pool. No other site does. That having been one of the main necessity on my part, I did goof up at my research. Mandarmoni itself is best enjoyed mid-week, to avoid crowd, and the location of the hotel helps avoiding unnecessary revelry. It is close to the mohona, and hence far-fetched. But there are a couple of shops and eateries around, in case you are in the mood for fresh crabs n lobsters, cooked rather desi style. I was a little worried about my stay, having read some less than heartwarming reviews. Especially, about the quality of food, housekeeping and the power outage. But, during my stay, contrary to the reviews, I loved the food, and the staff was very accommodating and cordial. As for the power outage, it is a norm throughout the beach. So can't blame this hotel alone. Maybe escalating the tariffs nominally n providing power throughout makes sense. A part of the hotel is still coming up, n i believe once the place is totally up and running, it will be a very suave property on perhaps the most peaceful part of the beach. Also, I found it a safe place, where you can be at ease with family n women around. The receptionist, for one, is helpful enough to make some exceptions for you, if you need a chilled out time with your partner or family, by the sea, while maybe another college group is around having their share of fun. Having said all that i said, I had a feeling that the hotel is underemployed, and a ice machine would really help. Otherwise, it's a tidy n chic place to go stay in, for a few days away from the bustle. Im glad I didn't heed negative reviews, and would book my stay there, again, whenever im in Mandarmoni. Keep up the good work, fellas!!

reviews.title: Neat and Clean property with authentic food
reviews.text: I have stayed in the property from 01/06/2013 to 03/06/2013 - 2 Nights with my Wife and Daughter, they have arranged pick up from Chaulkhola. The best thing I liked is there Room with a View, Food and most of all I liked the big garden with sitting facility, Child park for the in house members facing the sea. The sitting place was so nice that my time passed on enjoying with my family.

reviews.title: Weekend by Seaside
reviews.text: Stayed during Easters holidays - 2nights. Pros : 1. One of the very few hotels giving value for money in this area 2. Rooms are spacious (stayed in 2nd floor) 3. Food is very good, infact, the best part of this hotel 4. Location is another plus as far as proximity to sea-beach is concerned 5. Room service and house keeping staff are very courteous and generally prompt. 6. Childrens' park is a decent one. Cons; 1. Reception staff including manager may need to introspect client handling. 2. There are two small sized pools, however, one was under maintenance leading to overcrowding in the only one left 3. No tubes or lifebuoys available even for kids 4. Contrary to advertised timing of 20 hrs, AC runs for a far shorter period. 5. No outside food is allowed even if same options are not available in the hotel. 6. Breakfast spread is very limited Bottom line : Although the area is dotted with hotels, very few offer minimum value for money. This is one of the better options available.

reviews.title: Pathetic to say the least!!
reviews.text: So,we drive 4 hours from kolkata..and come to this so called resort!! At the entrance we are greeted by 3 goon looking people and inspite of having a booking through make my trip,we are denied a room stating that mmt has made a mistake and they dont have rooms available. After a bit of arguing they say that staff is not available!! I speak to MMT guys and it is told to us that they have no rooms and it was a mistake? Instead of being courteous they tell us that it is not their fault and wont take any bookings. Left stranded and tired after a long journey and this is the reception!! Never going to come back to this stupid and inhospitable hotel!!

reviews.title: Not good
reviews.text: This was by far the worst resort that I have stayed in. Let me talk about the good stuff first, the place around the hotel was nice and clean and the manager was quite nice, and service oriented but that was about it. Now the bad stuff: • Hotel priced more than the surrounding hotels which has more amenities than this hotel • Room clearly said that 2 pax will check in but one towel was provided and we had to always ask for things like soap etc • During checking in we were told that there will be power outage from 5.30 AM to 7.30 AM! 3 PM to 7 PM • Aircon outage from 5.30 AM to 7.30 AM! 4pm to 8.30 PM, seriously if you wanted to have that long a power outage how does that make it a relaxing holiday? Upon requesting to not do the cut in the morning, they said they have to keep the same rules all through out which I TOTALLY respect, but on sat sun when more people put pressure then they had cave in and turn it on earlier. So much for same rules for all tourists! • There were restrictions for humans to go out of the resort for a walk after 11 PM but dogs could come inside the resort areas for a free stride! • Hot was definitely not hot for shower

reviews.title: A Short trip at ADB
reviews.text: The rooms are pretty ordinary . Bathrooms are also . The good part is its location . You have to travel 500 m on beach to reach the hotel .Have knowledge of high tide and low tide timings . Reception people doesnt know hospitality . The other staffs are ok . The menu card shows lots of items but unfortunately 50% is available only . And also you cannot bring your own favourite items from outside , inspite they cannot provide the items . Also book directly ,because make my trip has charged heavily as commision on the rooms which we came to know upon arrival . But overall we took 4 rooms from 13 - 15/11/15 . The stay was good . The swimming pool was good also . 4 Hrs AC will not work

reviews.title: Over all Good hotel at right place
reviews.text: I had a short trip to Mandarmani, after checking review i was bit concern, Considering a place which doesnt have electricity,all the hotel are forced to run on generate , and people are coming on week end and other holidays only, rest of the days hotel are almost closed,Most of hotel cant afford to have professional staff,they have local people employed in hotel to look after guest. But Adb Kanvas is almost best hotel considering all the above conditions. 1 Its on the beach ,you walk for 100 Met and you find your self in sea 2. It has got two big well maintained green lawn, having seating arrangement looking sea, its turns to party venue in night. 3. Its has got playing area for kids, swimming pool, 4. Room are good, having accommodation for 2 adult, they have few studio room for four adult which is the best you have big balcony over looking sea, 5 Food they serve has got limitation hence its economical too, its good what ever they have, snacks were good. But need improvement 6.Hotel need regular maintenance, 7 Staff were good helpful, no problem with services, The best part is they have a system that one staff will look after your all room services, 8 Need change room with bath close to swimming pool

reviews.title: A Getaway
reviews.text: Dingy rooms, poor service, dirty linen, dim lights, untidy wiring, stinking washrooms, pathetic food, unhygienic conditions, noisy lobby, shoddy restaurant, poor service describe the hotel perfectly. Location is the best possible in Mandarmani with beach front and massive area

reviews.title: Awsome Trip
reviews.text: This Hotel is Good for Family. All the Hotel Staffs are Familiers. Their behaviours are Too Good. Kids have play ground. We enjoyed very Much. Also It's better for Oldage Persons. Swming Pool is Good Condition. It's in front of Beach, You may seat here long time and they will offer food there.

reviews.title: Awesome Stay, Peaceful & Excellent hotel
reviews.text: I visited Mandarmani last year in Oct'14 and i chose to stay at ADB Kanvas. I booked the hotel from makemytrip yet i was skeptical about how the hotel would be. When i finally reached the hotel, it just took my breathe away. Firstly, the hotel is located far away from the hush hush crowd in mandarmani so you can actually find some peace. Location was awesome and serene . I booked a sea facing room in 2nd floor and it was awesome. The view @ a full moonlit night was so beautiful that i was at the loss of words. The room was well furnished, clean, well maintained .Interiors were also nice. The washroom was fantastic . Complimentary breakfast was superb and we ordered our lunch and dinner at the hotel itself. Food was nice and tasty, served in the room so we didnt have to go out. You can sit for hours and grab a beer and relax on the couch and gaze at the sea. Perfect for couples to spend some time with each other. The hotel staff was friendly and courteous. Overall, an experience to remember. I would recommend ADB kanvas to my friends and family.

reviews.title: RESORT ON THE BEACH
reviews.text: One of my business associates had visited Mandarmani with his family and recommended this Resort by the name ADB KANVAS. The name itself is well knowned by all visiting Mandarmani. I booked for 2 rooms for 2 nights with my family . The receptionist welcomed us with warm greetings and saw that my stay with family was good and pleasant . Our stay was wonderful and we had no difficulty from checkin to checkout which was handled in a professional manner. The staffs was all well mannered and catered to our requirements as required. Ladies and kids had no problem and really enjoyed their stay.

reviews.title: The best you ever wish for a short vacation
reviews.text: We had spent the new year's eve at this resort and got more then what we had expected. We stayed in room 1201 which gave us a clear view of the sea from the attached balcony. The room was excellent with all modern amenities. Add to it the lush green lawns and the children play area you get the best value for your money.The icing on the cake was however the party they had organised to usher the new year. With a paltry charge of only 1500/- per room( not per head), they provided unlimited drinks( premium brands) supplemented with delicious starters & followed by dinner. The ambiance was set up with good music played by the DJ ,and the bonfire with fire works was just the perfect party you can ever wish on a new year's eve. The staff were very courteous , room service was excellent and had ample space for car parking.Would definitely visit this resort again.

reviews.title: Weekend Gateway
reviews.text: The place is on the beach and is beautifully located. The speciality of this hotel is it's deck area which has an open view of beach. They play good music at evening where u can enjoy the view with drinks and food. We were two girls, and were a bit skeptical about safety. But it's completely safe. We stayed at ground floor, which has a side view of beach from balcony. The ones at first floor has front view of beach. The staff are very cordial and always on their toes to serve you. The pool area is also great, kept clean and well maintained. They allow to have booze and enjoy the swim. The food is also good. Oh yes.. they gave a complimentary goodie to us. At last, I recommend everyone to stay in this hotel of they visit Mandarmani.

reviews.title: Speechless
reviews.text: As a frequent traveler, I cant imagine a better place than Mandermani. First I was little confused to see the distance of the Hotel from the city centre, but after my arrival I was stunned and surprised . Starting from booking the hotel to receptionist, food service boy, Swimming pool incharge, cleaner, Guard boy everybody was just stunning. Their service is very good. Obviously if you want a 5 start hotel then dont go there, but if you want a fantastic hotel with comfort, relaxation and LOVE, just go there and see what Mandermani and ADB Kanvas Hotel have. Even in this rainy season they are fantastic. People of the sorruddings are also very simple and cordial. May God protect them and protect this area.

reviews.title: Average hotel
reviews.text: We have stayed in this hotel from 26 sep for three night with my doughter and wife. This hotel check in time is 2 pm. Our room and bathroom are not properly cleaned Poor service... No trasport facility.. horible Rooms with sepage on the wall all over room service is not good staff is not at all friendly to customer Avoid to staying in this hotel

reviews.title: ADB Kanvas is the Best Stay at Mandarmoni
reviews.text: I have visited Kanvas on 31st along with my family and friends for 3 days . and we feel the best ever staying place at Mondarmoni , I have visited mondarmoni earlier also 3 times in other hotel , but this one is the best place to spend with family and friends . Totally sea View hotel from corner of hotel /Room you can see . lots of entertainment for kids, Play , Swimming, Also at 31st night there was fabulous program , Songs, dance , DJ ,arrangement also beautiful fire crackers show at resort still midnight . All of us enjoyed lots . Played Badminton.Carom. Big lawn in front of hotel ... which is the best part of this hotel Decent, clean hotel and friendly staff. Rooms are very good , comfortable ,price within reach as per room . Good Food quality , all type of food is available and all are very testy . arrangement and supply of Food is very good . Staffs of this hotels is very good well behavior . Car parking facility also good .

reviews.title: Must have seen better days
reviews.text: The rooms are in a sorry state of disrepair. The toilets had to be cleaned under supervision before use. The dumping ground left of the driveway is an eyesore. There are better hotels in the vicinity and this should be the last option. Glad to be have checked out early.

reviews.title: Avoid this property and don't recommend anyone
reviews.text: Very bad service, AC was not cooling at all, If you ask for anything then u have to remind them frequently ( I asked one bed sheet at afternoon and I got it at night ), Swimming Pool water is so dirty which is not maintained properly .....after all it was a very bad experience we got from there and will not recommend anyone.

reviews.title: Peaceful Beach experience
reviews.text: We stayed at ADB Kanvas during 2nd week of January'15 and had a wonderful experience there. This is one of the best beach hotels in West Bengal and ideal for couples, families and Small friend groups. Lots of activities for the Kidz, Sun Bathing for couples and a fabulous beach facing the front. This hotel has got it's arrangements for small gathering where you can opt for a Bon-Fire, Bar at the lawn, and a team of excellent service boys. Foods are good. This is a bit costly option in Mandarmoni but worth spending the money for it's location, service and confort. Rooms are quite clean, well equipped with modern facilities. you can surely bet on it for a short weekend or a family gathering.

reviews.title: It was good
reviews.text: We went there on our first trip to Mandarmoni . The hotel was clean and tidy but the major problem is that there are frequent powercuts.There is a free place to stay for drivers to stay(if you are going by car) . The breakfast is free so there is always a rush in the restaurant. The food is okay, not to mention about the soup. The night sky view and the lawn are excellent.

reviews.title: ADB-Kanvas On The Canvas Of Six 60-plus!!
reviews.text: Beaches are beaches when it comes to water and sand, but the atmosphere is what matters most….Good location, congenial ambience is what one looks for on a vacation. Yes, if one place could encapsulate Mandarmani; ADB Kanvas would get our vote. Blessed with miles of natural motorable coastline, it is definitely a paradise for beach-lovers. The Hotel is bang on the sea beach. We reached the hotel at about 11 am, the waves rushed up to us at the gate, then turned and retreated, tossing up hot and humid breeze along the seaside. The heavy glittering metal of the stiff sun was just too harsh for the sixty plus group. So, without any delay, we checked in- six of us. Two suits…No: 2015, & No: 2016 were allotted to us. And then, there were a few issues that had to be fought with… 1) Air conditioner The area does not have electricity, so the hotel provides power through DG sets, barring a few hours in the morning and evening every day. Unfortunately, the day we entered, they had some generator issues, so they could not switch on the ac till 12.30 pm in the afternoon. But, it's amazing how the blue tides bring along some respite, some good adventure and fun, in fact, all in a package.  ACs were, of course switched on later at the designated time. 2) Dining Hall We headed towards the dining hall looking for an authentic homely Midnapuri style Bengali meal. The first meal was, honestly disappointing. The curries were far too bland…and insipid. We, the skilful housewives had to figure out ways to re-create the flavours, crunch level, and even temperature …and Voila! Reasonably good meals were served, thereafter, for the next two days with same ingredients from the same cooks. The only let-down was the flies flitting around our plates…it made the eating experience totally abhorrent and repulsive, to say the least.A can of mosquito repellent visible in one of the sideboards inside the dining area was a cause of consternation for health reasons. The problem was reported at the desk. 3) Bathroom Roof The newly constructed bathrooms were clean, hygienic… The only issue was the leaking bathroom-roof of Room No: 2015. Hope they do something about it. There’s some construction work going on in the hotel, so I presume, this was a temporary snag. We did report the matter at the reception. My POV is, they should refrain from allotting such half-finished rooms to the guests. 4) The broken sofa-cum-bed in the second room @2015. This was, perhaps, the least we could expect. Around mid-night, the unit actually ‘split’ horizontally. The front portion had wheels…. so, it reeled out effortlessly, making crevices in the middle. The person sleeping on the bed was actually trapped in the gap. How can a hotel of this standard provide such cheap and dangerous furniture!? The room tariff is not cheap either… But, there are definitely many positive points. A) The hotel staff is very friendly and provide personalized services to the full satisfaction of guests. God bless, Vivekananda who was such a help. B) Evenings are enchanting A good manicured garden is in front of the hotel, where one can sit and relax watching seaside activities. Or, one can avail shared trekkers or reserved vehicles and ride along the beach. During high tides, the waves lash against the compound wall of the hotel…so, one can stand at the gate and feel the waves lapping at the ankles, with time stretching in the closeness of ocean under the moon and the stars. The phenomenon of AC not working between 5 pm to 8 pm then becomes irrelevant. Even with a few hiccups cropping up , ADB Kanvas is recommended for discerning travellers to Mandarmani.
