reviews.title: one of the worst hotels i have ever stayed
reviews.text: i went to mandarmoni on 21st march and stayed in hotel adb kanvas for the weekend.it was one of my most horrible weekend trips.the ac worked only between 10 pm to 6am.and that was also switched off at 5am waking me up from sleep at 5am during a holiday.the breakfast which was complimentary was just poori and 1 subji with boiled eggs which i could not eat being a vegetarian.i would not recommend anyone to go there.

reviews.title: Nice Property worst Mangement
reviews.text: Well this is 2nd time I am staying in this property and now it is in a very sad state. The hotel staffs are manner less who doesn't know a bit about hospitality. The manager is the worst person in this entire property who doesn't know how to talk and is ready to fight with you. The staff behaves like a local goon and this time they messed with us in a FIST FIGHt. The service is at worst and food is something where my suggestion will be to have pulao and dal. The chef makes manchurian gravy when asked for hot & sour soup, garnish with red chilli and pepper in each and everything. My request to the management is to change the staff and maintain professionalism else this nice property will be ruined.

reviews.title: Good hotel. Can be better
reviews.text: Decent, clean hotel and friendly staff. Not exactly a 5 star property but still a very good hotel to stay. Food is good, has swimming pool, play area, badminton court and hammocks. Bonfires were arranged at night. Quality of food is also very good and the buffet breakfast was excellent. Would recommend this hotel.

reviews.title: Rude staff and poor service!
reviews.text: The hotel only looks good on the outside. The rooms are average and the bathrooms shabby and zero maintenance. Food is okay. We checked out at 12 but took a room as we had to wait for lunch to leave. Ours was a group of 23 people including 8 small kids but the hotel staff disconnected the ac and refused to reconnect because we were on extension. They even disconnected the electricity to our room for a while! On the whole, it definitely isn't worth your money!

reviews.title: Worth a visit
reviews.text: We stayed at Kanvas from November 18 till November 20. The hotel is perfectly located at the beach. There are sea facing rooms. But the best part is the sitting area overlooking the sea where dinner is served on request as you enjoy the waves hitting almost the hotel boundary. There is a big play area for kids which also faces the sea. The food is good. But with every positive point there are a few negative ones too. The rooms need a little more attention. The room service is not upto mark. There are few employees who takes every effort to attend the guests but then there are few who lacks basic communication skill sitting at the phone and takes 3 calls just to confirm the food order of a 2 year old. There are people from room service who suggests taking the restaurant instead of room service for lunch or dinner as the guests might accidentally make the bed sheets dirty. Well keeping aside these few things its a trip we will remember specially for the property. A very good one. If you are keeping high hopes like 5 star service you maybe a bit disappointed but considering the remoteness of the place i think that should be considered. I would be going back to Kanvas again on my next visit to Mandarmoni 😊

reviews.title: Worst hotel ever
reviews.text: It has been the worst stay ever in a hotel for me. Consider the following points : 1. The a/c was not working half the time, though we stayed in the second best room in the hotel. 2. Half the food from the menu is not available. 3. When our car got stuck at 8pm in the beach sand, there was no cooperation lend from the hotel staff. Staff from other hotels helped us. 4. During check put we ourselves had to carry the luggage from the second from to our car. There was no staff. 5. The gate doesn't open before 6am, so if you are planning to go for a drive early morning, it will not be successful. 6. The behavior of the staff is terrible. This is my fourth visit to Mandarmani, and my first stay at ADB Kanvas, and sure will never book into this hotel ever. Book other hotels and have lovely holidays :)

reviews.title: Worst and ill maintained property with rude behaviour
reviews.text: We booked two rooms from a well known travel portal. One was for 3 pax (on the ground floor) and another was on 1st floor(2 pax). First of all they charged us for 3 pax on the grnd floor room but did not provide anything extra. On requesting for 4-5 times they relented and provided us an extra pillow and a towel. They promised us to provide an extra cot but even after repeated requests it did not come. The room had a tea-coffee maker but with no ingredients (milk,sugar,coffee powder,tea bags) to make them. On requesting they said they ran out of stock. The rooms was ragged and washroom was unclean. The pool water was dirty. The staffs are very impolite including the management. Avoid this property at all cost.

reviews.title: Awesome weekend getaway...
reviews.text: 1.The pool - Superb place for chillin' out. Better to carry your own synthetic swimming costume or you can also rent one from them for free. 2.The food - Breakfast is the best which is complimentary buffet with many options. I loved their Luchi and Chholar dal.They also serve cereals, egg bhurji, boiled eggs, fruit juice etc. Lunch and dinner have wide range of choices be it indian or chinese or bengali.Food quality is ok but the price is high. Restaurant is quite large. They also have a banquet hall next to it. 3.Rooms are well furnished with all modern amenities, fully air-conditioned with TV, tea-maker etc. ACs work fine. Huge wardrobes. King-size beds with bedside cabinets on both side. There is only one electrical wall socket, so better carry a multi-plug socket or a power strip. Big and clean bathrooms with all complimentary toiletries, modern sanitary wares, water heaters etc. Room service is good.The bellhops provided extra pillows and blankets readily when asked. We stayed at room no 1001,1002 and 1003 at the ground floor. Each room has its own balcony.These rooms are not sea-facing and lack any view. 4.There is a small yet well-equipped air-conditioned gym.Good for a quick work out session.It has a high-end electronic treadmill, a cross-trainer, a multigym machine and few dumbbells. 5.The air-conditioned game-room has facility for snooker, carrom and table tennis. 6.They have a spa just by the side of the pool with wide range of service. 7.You can sit and enjoy the sea breeze at their beach side corridor furnished with recliners,tables and chairs. An awesome place to hangout in the evening. 8.They have a big playground for kids with slides,stairs,swingsets,seasaw etc.They also have a small enclosure with rabbits inside it. 9.They provide car service for pickup and drop off. 10.The staffs are helpful and attend to all needs whenever asked for.They don't pester for tips. N.B. - One tip for the first-timers. Eat at the beach-side shack at just 2 mins walk from here.They serve excellent food at much lower price and that also in the open sea-air.They'll prepare food according to your choice if you pre-order eg hilsa,chingri malaikari or other fish preparations.

reviews.title: Stay was enjoyable and pleasant
reviews.text: We have visited Mandarmani during the vacations with family and booked two rooms on the ground floor for 3 days . The stay was great indeed and within budget. Away from all hustle and bustle The balcony was sea facing . I liked everything over there. Service provided Very good. Great place.

reviews.title: A nice resort with scope of improvements.
reviews.text: Excellent location with nice swimming pool and out of the world food quality; however the games room needs serious improvement and the hotel management should work intensively on telephone etiquette, attentiveness, people positive attitude, smile and promptness. I will still love to come back and recommend ADB Kanvas.

reviews.title: Beach Resort stone's throw away
reviews.text: I stayed here for a night this Valentine's day. The Resort is location is awesome. No crowd no traffic also it has a nice pool and kids play area. The service was good but not comparable to any metropolitan city's hotel, Though the food was really good. Hotel had arranged the candle light dinner for us. I was little disappointed from the room. It was good but not maintained. Hotel owner should look forward for some renovation in the hotel.

reviews.title: An average hotel in dire need of some sincere staffs
reviews.text: I had stayed for 2 Nights and 3 days with family and had rented 2 rooms during April 2013.The views from the rooms were excellent....no doubts about that, the hotel served very nice Bengali cuisines.However the management needs to hire some trained staffs as the current workforce is unprofessional and very slow.....The room walls were damp and need immediate service..... I would rate this hotel an average one, however if the management takes the right steps soon then it would be a must visit place for fooding & lodging.... All the best.....

reviews.title: Beautiful resort.
reviews.text: In Mondarmani ADB Kanvas is one of the best resorts. Mondarmani is a beautiful beach side place. beaches are cleaner, serene, quieter and very beautiful.MondaArmani is calm n cool. One can find lots of beach activities like watwr scooter, raft riding para gliding. ADB Kanvas is right next to the week. And staying there u can enjoy mondarmani beaches and it's activities to the fullest.The location is awesome. Rooms are beautiful clean. Staffs are courteous. Food is excellent. The lounge area at the entrance of d resort has lots of loungers facing the sea and u can simply relax and watch the sun rise n sunset. that is my fav spot of the resort. At night they host DJ Night there. The resort has its gym, swimming pool, restaurant, kid's park n lounge. It is an ideal place to relax and refresh in a weekend.

reviews.title: Awful service
reviews.text: The hotel is a very dirty hotel including the rooms and acessories inside the room like linens and towels. The per day rentals is very high compared to the rooms and the service expected at that price. Not a professionaly run property. They have a fantastic lawn and playing area for kids though. Hope this review is helpfull to other travellers planning to stay in that hotel to be better prepared on what to expect. There is but one person in the hotel who can provide you exceptional personalized service and his name is Somnath. He is an amazing guy among that rudeness , indifference & chaos that Kanvas is. Do request for him to be your attendant in case you happen to land up inspite of this review. Thanks.

reviews.title: Maintenance Low
reviews.text: Stayed here at the resort for a night 6/2/16. The location is excellent...but the maintenance of the hotel is really bad. we had to change the room twice because washrooms were not functional ...once the cistern was leaking and 2nd the shower not working..also the basin pipe was leaking. Whoever is the owner has built it with a lot of thought and the designing is truly beautiful. but am afraid ...with this quality of maintenance it wont last long Food was good There was a DJ in the garden...till 11:30 in the night...for those of us who want to escape the city travails...like noise and sound pollution....this DJ was a real painful. had to be closed in the room for the whole evening... They have a Big Hall...DJ could be played indoors.. Also...No lifts...

reviews.title: Best Resort in Mandermani ADB Canvas
reviews.text: I visited ADB Canvas with my family ( wife,daughter and 75 year old mother) for 3 days on 1st Jan to 3rd Jan.2016. It was one my best staying at Mandermani with lot of entertainment , game and good food at Canvas. I got a very good welcome by Manager Mr. Arunavo and one Mr. Sampad .I got the best room 1101 with a beautiful balcony sitting where you can watch half of the mandermani. The Foods are very tasty and we enjoyed chiness dishes lot. You can't miss the Crab and Mutton curry if you are non-veg food lovers. They suggested some veg dishes for my mother who is vegeterian and she loved those. Their Food Manager- Rintu is always there to help you with his smiling face. On 1st Jan evening we enjoyed some good entertainment at their green lawn with singer and dancers from kolkata. ALso there was a huge craker show at resort at midnight which is great to watch.The next day Complimentary breakfast in Garden was a real surpise with hot puri, sabji, omlete, bread, idli,bara etc. It was like picnic when all boarders were taking breakfast in their lawn and garden which is almost on the beach. My daughter loved the swiming pool and spend lot of time there after sea bath. I enjoyed playing Badminton with other Boarder. If you don't find player the staffs of hotel is there too play with you ( and they play really good ). at night the resort looks really good with nice illumination and you can watch the sea siiting on their lawn. I am happy that my mother and daughter loved this place and they are fully satisfied in this short trip due to very nice hospitality on Canvas staffs.

reviews.title: Pathetic
reviews.text: The rooms are old and have damp all over. The latches and locks are broken. We were 24 of us & had multiple rooms. Ac's in few rooms weren't working. The food was not at all tasty. Food was semi cooked and the complimentary bfast didn't have proper menu. The washrooms have leaking taps and pipes. The parking area is very dirty and can at max accommodate 8-9 cars.

reviews.title: Rubbish Hotel ! Absolutely no maintenance
reviews.text: We had taken 3 rooms in this hotel for 1 night ( Family ) Unhygienic Place, Bed Sheets had multiple holes..curtains were dirty, staff was untrained, quality of food was very bad, shabby rooms, electrical points were not fully functional, Dog & cow dung in garden area, and best part dinning area had no table or fan. most of the places doors and windows were rusted, rooms and lobby requires painting,swimming pool was dirty and lacked maintenance with green water. Not worth the money at all. Please avoid staying with family.

reviews.title: Poor hygiene standards, property in desperate need of a facelift
reviews.text: Spent the weekend at ADB Kanvas. While many of the reviews were pretty good, our expectations were high. But we were disappointed by the overall feel of the hotel. While the lawns and outer areas are well-maintained, the rooms were a disaster in terms of basic cleanliness. Mouldy pillows that we could not use, unpleasant smell in the room, washroom was grimy and not sanitised; no shower curtain or toilet paper; had to request for both and the shower curtain provided was filthy; just the overall feel of the room left us disillusioned. I wish the rooms were given as much attention as the outer areas. They have badminton nets but carry your own rackets; the ones provided at the hotel were so terrible that all the strings had come apart and couldn't be used, and what was even more amazing was the fact that for a property of that size, they only had two badminton rackets. The food was okay. Restaurant and front desk service was okay, but overall, nota great experience, and we wouldn't be going back there any time soon.

reviews.title: Good Destination for weekend Tour
reviews.text: I have visited with my family at ADB Kanvas hotel at Mandarmoni on 30th Dec 2018 to 1st Jan2019 , very much good experiences during stay over there , rooms are perfect and clean , foods are very much quality food and delicious , and the environment/food/ staff of this hotel is the best of any hotels at Mondarmoni , 3days musical dhamaka with Lots of Crackers enjoyed lot. we feel we never enjoyed such year end ever before . Indoor games , SPA , also attract us to go this hotel again . All staffs are very helpful .

reviews.title: Disappointed to an extent that will recommend to avoid this Hotel
reviews.text: We stayed for 2 days in this hotel and the moment I stepped into the reception my heart sank. I had taken my parents, my sister’s two month old baby and my 16 month old son; not the kind of group who can afford to be forgiving to amenities and facilities. The place was dirty, the people behind the desk did not even offer a welcome smile and there were flies all around. It took me 10 mins to figure out that the hotel is situated adjacent to a fish storage where during this season the dried fish are processed; hence the flies. The rooms were no better either. I would not say that it has design problems or anything of that sort. But the colour of the walls, the lighting, the furnitures could have been much better. The core of the problem was poor maintenance. The rooms looked shabby and unclean. We had three rooms and none of them had all the lights working. Two rooms had small refrigerators but the other did not and when asked the manager offered a stupid statement that refrigerators are not offered with these rooms and they have only been kind to offer in a few. The rooms my parents stayed did not have a phone or the very basic menu card. And the menu card reminds, the food in this hotel is fair in terms of quality but priced extremely high. A plate of plain rice ( not basmati ) costs 70 rupees, I hope that will serve as a fair indicator. The complementary breakfast was not upto the mark. The menu was limited and did not change for two consecutive days. Simple things like juice, cakes or sweets were not offered. A few good things; the lawns are big, there are ample places around the lawn for you to sit and enjoy the views of the sea. The swimming pool, outdoor badminton court was well maintained, the games rooms had all the required pieces as well. I am not sure about the gym as I did not venture there. On a nutshell, the property needs better management in terms of housekeeping and kitchen services. They can not just bank on their lawns to keep having guests at the price point that they operate in.

reviews.title: COUNTRY CLUB IN MANDARMONI
reviews.text: ADB KANVAS,Mandarmani is a beach resort near mohana in Purba Medinipur district of South Bengal, one of the southern districts of West Bengal. It is almost 180km from Kolkata Airport on the Kolkata-Digha route and just 14km from Chaulkhola . How to reach :- Mandarmani is best reached by road. The nearest train station is at Contai and the nearest airport is at Kolkata. How to reach :- Mandarmani is best reached by road. The nearest train station is at Contai and the nearest airport is at Kolkata. By road : The road route from Kolkata is: Esplanade - 63km - Kolaghat - 3km - Mecheda - 80km - Contai - 12.3km - Chawalkhola - 4km - Kalindi - 4km - Dadan Patra Bar - 6km -Mandarmoni -Total 163km As you travel from Kolkata, after crossing the VidyaSagar Setu take the Kona Express Way. After driving a while turn left to get the Mumbai Road. Drive till you reach Kolaghat. From here take left for the Digha Route. 2km before reaching Contai Town you get Contai By-Pass road. This road is around 3km long and would give you relief from the crowded city drive. It is a short-cut and again falls onto the Kolkata-Digha road. You drive another 10 km to reach Chawalkhola. If you come by bus get down at Chawalkhola and you can hire private vehicles from here to take you to your destination. Even the resorts have car pick-up facilities from Contai/Chawalkhola. Contact them earlier to avail the same. Take a left turn from Chawalkhola and follow the village road (be ready for a bumpy ride) till it ends. It is around 8km. This village road ends into a green beautiful sea side village called 'Dadon-Patro-Bar'. Here there are number of resorts newly created and some coming up, providing tourist a warm and fascinating stay within lush green landscape overlooking the sea-shore. This is the first group of resorts of Mandarmani. You can plan staying still further to experience an exciting drive ahead. As this road concludes, you can drive down from the road onto the wet beach and drive forward for 6km or so along this lonely stretch to reach another group of resorts of Mandarmani. If you choose the second option, donot drive after dark on the beach since it is pitch dark, and there is no one in the vicinity till you reach your resort. So you should start well in time. Enthusiasts please note that Mandarmani boasts of her truly virgin, 13km long motorable beach, longest in India. Total drive time from Kolkata to Mandarmani would be 3.5 hours. Also take prior information of high tides (only in the rainy season), because during high tides water may reach upto the motorable stretch of the beach. hired car usually charge 3000-3500 one way. By bus : From Kolkata, catch a bus at Esplanade or at Howrah headed for Chawalkhola. You can avail any bus service headed towards Digha. State Transport Buses are available , fare is as cheap as 76 INR per head. A number of Dlux couches are runing daily having fare 100 to 110 INR. Whiteliners in Kolkata - Digha route (Rs 160/- per head) from Esplanade starts at 7.30 am By Train: From Howrah to Digha Flag Station About ADB Kanvas: only 6 rooms are allotted to country club 1207 to 1209 and 1107 to 1109 which are on the backside of hotel and are not beach facing rooms.Rooms are average a/c rooms.foods are very good but quite costly.outside parcel food are not allowed.go for package buffet which is cheaper.no such activity is there in hotel other than swimming pool ,night music.there is a good park for kids.room a/c is switched off from 6 to 8:30 pm.for country club members room they will switch off the a/c every one hour you have to call them to on it again. what to do in Mandarmoni? 1.ATV BIKES 300 rs/400mts 2.SPEED BOAT RIDE 200/head 3.PARA GLIDING 1200/head 4.ZORBI ROLLER 500/head 5.MECHANICAL BULL 100/5min 6.KRISHNA TEMPLE IN ROSE VALLEY PROPERTY 7.ROPEWAY 11 AM TO 3 PM ROSE VALLEY PROPERTY 8.TOY TRAIN 4 PM TO 6 PM ROSE VALLEY PROPERTY 9.RED CRAB

reviews.title: If its Mandarmani...it should be ADB Kanvas
reviews.text: celebrated 2018 yearend and new year 2019 at ADB Kanvas with family. Excellent arrangement with great food ( lot of variety and good taste ) ...super party with lot of music,dance, fun ..fire crakers,,,,,,,, The resort is very neat and clean ...they added another swimming pool adjacent to existing pool Buffet breakfast, lunch and dinner under package was really worthy Overall a great experience...........interested to visit during HOLI as some guests told that the celebration of Holi in ADB Kanvas is excellent and one of the best at Mandarmani.

reviews.title: Lovely break
reviews.text: We were looking for a break for quiet some time. And then we all got leave from respective offices together finally. The only place we Kolkatans can think of for a short break (of a day) is Mandarmani. Some of our friends had been to this hotel previously and they strongly recommended it. Mandarmani needless to say provides a perfect break from our daily mundane activities. ADB in particular is a very well maintained refuge. Mandarmani still has its own power problems. All hotels are still run by generators. So all of them gives power a miss for 3 hrs from 11 am to 2 pm (generally). But the best part of ADB Kanvas is that they put the AC off but the rest of the points continue to operate, which you won't get in any other hotel in the same range in Mandarmani. Constructions is still on. Another new phase is expected within some months. The Room 1101 is perhaps the best room any seaside hotel can provide. The one above that is also good with good views but 1101 has a large private balcony with jhula. All the other rooms in this hotel provides partial view of the sea from the balcony as well as from the cozy sofa built inside each room. The service is very good. Rooms are also too good. We stayed in Rooms 1001, 1002 & 1003. They are also quite good. We had booked the hotel from Kolkata 2 days prior to our visit, bargained with the Manager and negotiated on a particular rate. When we reached the hotel, the Manager was not there. The staff billed us as per tariff. We called up the Manager and he advised his staff to bill as per the negotiated rate. No confusion at all. So overall we had a nice little experience at ADB Kanvas, Mandarmani. Cons : 1) Food option is very less though price is a bit on the higher side (infact it is so for all hotels in Mandarmani). 2) But by far the greatest disadvantage for ADB Kanvas is the entrance. The local people prevented us from going through the beach and instead diverted us to the narrow road behind the hotels. This road is so narrow at places that we (travelling in a XUV) became very afraid of our vehicle tumbling down in the adjacent meadows. Thank god nothing like that happened because of the faithful hand in our car behind the steering wheels.

reviews.title: Dishonesty is no good!
reviews.text: Let me start with the positive part of the review ... we stayed in Room 1101 which probably has the best views you can ever get on a beach side hotel. A large 400sqft odd balcony adds to the whole pleasure. Thats about it as far the good stuff goes. Now comes the list of grievances: 1. We had negotiated the room rate at Rs. 4000/night over telephone but on check out we were asked to pay at Rs. 4500/night. This was absolute dishonesty and spoilt the two days of relaxation we were hoping to get. A whole lot of discussions got us nowhere and they did not care about the feedback we would be sharing on the social networks. They said they were used to such threats from others, which means they have done this before. It was just about the money. 2. Power: The whole hotel runs on DG sets with fluctuating power. The AC keeps switching on and off and leaks water all the time. The TV has a bad signal problem which results in hazy pictures and is just about as large as a computer monitor ... about 18 inches. There is a mandatory power cut for about 3hrs/day everyday. 3. Room: A walls have a damp problem and there are big damp spots all over the room. They have a comfortable bed though. 4. Food: Lunch must be ordered at breakfast time, dinner at lunch time and breakfast at dinner time, if you want your food on time. They need this much time to prepare food and they are frank about it. Food isn't bad as such. 4. Road: Road access is poor and limited. You must drive over the beach to reach the hotel and during high tides, you need to take a kaccha road over which only a single vehicle can pass at a time. There are ditches on both side of the road which makes the journey risky. 5: Staff: Absolutely untrained staff though courteous. In finality, just Room 1101 and the room above have great views. Apart from that, this hotel is run by untrained and dishonest staff. This hotel charges are 3 star rates but the service is pretty much 1 or 2 star.

reviews.title: Best Beach side property in Mandarmani
reviews.text: Bang on the sea beach this is the best beach side property in Mandarmani. You need to drive through the beach to reach the resort. Therefore it is important to reach before it gets dark and there are high tides. This property has huge open areas , beach facing lawns, Swimming pool, Bar. The staff are mostly locals and very helpful. However the two things that they can do to upgrade the standard of services are- Train their staff by professional trainers and do some serious pest controlling activities to do away with the flies. Rest all fine. Kids to senior citizens, everyone will have a great time here.

reviews.title: Unhygienic,untidy,unclean,uncouth and uninterested
reviews.text: It has everything going against it, right from unclean bedsheets and water being served, dusty and dirty staircase, with a dog roaming around freely ( maybe a resident dog..but why inside?). The rooms itself were untidy and clean signs of no housekeeping being done regularly. The bathrooms had rusted taps and shower . The service standard is very slow and you do not expect any smile on the face of the employees , clear lack of motivation. When asked for an extra service ( which is not paid for) please be expected to be flatly refused. Like free wifi, however you can never get any signal. Talking about the food, we had buffet bkfast, lunch and dinner, but its all very basic bengali fare, dont expect tasty food here, edible at the most.The worst part is that they are least concerned to make changes and improve themselves. So stay here at your own risk.

reviews.title: Good service and surroundings
reviews.text: I went with a group of friends and stayed in this hotel for 2 days. The hotel is in a good location. Little away from crowd. A good maintained park cum garden is there in front of the hotel. You can spend leisure time in relax at the park. The lighting is really good , so spending good time in the garding in evening will be a rocking idea, All rooms are clean and foods are really good. All the other service is also nice.

reviews.title: Good exterior but problems in service
reviews.text: We visited this hotel these days (Dec 19/20 year 2015).. Property looks good.. Located at the furthest part of mandarmoni. Its by the sea, has a nice pool, garden and sunbath area.. Badminton court, children park etc.. In room flooring , and interiors are fine, though from most of the rooms there is no view of sea.. We stayed in a Van Gough room, room size is decent, but lack of cleanliness.. Flies are very very disturbing.. In the walls some areas are swollen up by salt.. Washrooms are good though.. In restaurant they dont have a set menu.. Its all a la carte basis.. Charges of food are on a higher side, but quality is good.. Though this is an Ac room, AC did not work for the entire stay.. Make it a point if u visit during summer..!! Overall, a better service and maintenance can make it the best one..

reviews.title: The Best Sea facing Deck in Mandarmoni
reviews.text: We were 10 school friends and wanted to have a great evening by the Sea. We chose this one and had a gala time there. Rooms are ok and many of them are sea facing. Food is good but a bit costly, so it is advised that you go for a deal which includes room and all meals. They have 2 neat & clean swimming pools side by side. There is Spa by the poolside. The best thing about this hotel is itz big sea facing deck. in the evening they will set up tables there so that you can have drinks and food served at the seaside. We started in the evening and the time flew, the last 3 of us went back to our room at 3 in the morning!! The only con is the airconditioning in the dining hall is not sufficient when the hotel is in full capacity, which usually is during the weekends. Will definitely visit again.

reviews.title: Stay away if you have a family.
reviews.text: The rooms were dirty and infested with pests like ants, cockroaches and spiders. We had a 5 year old and a 6 month old and so we wanted to check out a day earlier as spiders were found on the 6 month old when he was sleeping. They insisted that we would have to pay 50% cancellation charge. Having said that the location is very good and so is the outdoor area. If only they improve their rooms an kept them clean.

reviews.title: Location is very good. Rooms could have been better.
reviews.text: Location is the best what I can say of this property. Rooms are big, but could have been better in terms of maintenance. Bathroom was shabby. Pool not so well maintained. Food was ok. Breakfast menu was short . The Deck facing the sea is the best thing of this property. Except that nothing is that attractive . Rooms need refurbishment urgently. Staffs were good and supportive though.

reviews.title: a perfect holyday at adb kanvas
reviews.text: adb kanvas is very execellent hotel. it is also very peaceful. hotel location is best at mandarmani.excellent service, nice surroundings,hotel staff are very friendly. luxurious feel. rooms are nice and clean.overall it was amazing experience at adb kanvas.

reviews.title: Good place for families
reviews.text: We stayed there for a weekend booked seven rooms for a team of 17 comprised of five kids. We booked the grand category rooms all of which had an attached balcony. Room as well as bathroom was spacious & clean. Food was also good. They arranged a tandoor right next to the beach in the evening with music that was really awesome. Service was very good. I had a eleven month old kid & asked room service to boil the rice in a separate cooker that we carried for her which they did gleefully. They have a nice lawn n clean sitting arrangement right next to the beach where you can relax with family.

reviews.title: Great place to spend quality time with Family
reviews.text: This is a nice resort right on the beach. Rooms are well appointed, spacious and clean. Toilet is also clean and provided with toiletries and clean towel. Room service is also prompt and courteous. Staffs are helpful. The resturant is cosy and the food is also Tasty. Both Veg and non-veg options are available.Breakfast is complementary and the menu is also good with many options. There is swimming pool which is well maintained.There is also a game room with carom and table tenis.

reviews.title: Waste of money
reviews.text: I am a Country Club member and I booked my vacation at ADB Kanvas hotel, Mandermoni, West medinapur, Kolkata, from 27th Feb to 3rd Mar. 2014. But after staying for 2 Days I am very much unsatisfied with the service provided by the hotel. I never expected that Country club would tie-up with such type of hotel whose service is much below par than other country club properties. I will suggest all Country club member not to book this hotel instead go for SunCity resort. More over the Manager is not courteous with the guest. They offered me the most third class room at the back-side of the resort. On requesting to change, manager told me that I will have to pay extra amount. According to him country club do not pay much for the rooms. How come Country club tie up with such resort which do not have the following facilities : 1. No Activities for children/Women member. 2. No Swimming pool, 3. No Geyser/exhaust fan in the bathroom. 4. A/c is only formality, had to request every time to switch ON the A/C . 5. Every day there is no power from 4pm to 6pm. 6. No Bar , but claimed at their web site. 7. No internet /Wifi facility but claimed at their site. 8. No Dustbin in the room, only small dustbin at bathroom that too without garbage bag. 9. Food quality is good, but very expensive compared to the quantity. No discount for CC members. 10. Last but not the least, Rooms are small and congested which is at the backside of the hotel. Jimut Bahan Roy

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: The place looked good on the outside, prefect location, nice landscaping (though small area) with a gazebo and chairs facing the beach. You can see that it was well constructed with decent sized rooms, bathroom and balcony(stayed in the suite). But the very poor maintenance just ruins the feel - floors and ceiling were not clean and there were splashes of paint everywhere. Added to that, the water in the bathrooms had a stench and the AC worked only at times (due to some electricity issues). The toiletries provided were a bare minimum given that it was a suite package. I definitely expected more and have to say, it was not wort the money spent.

reviews.title: Nice Hotel for weekend stay
reviews.text: Located just on the beach, its a very nice hotel for weekend stay, staffs are friendly enough. The most beautiful part of the hotel is the sitting place just on the beach front where you can relax on the chairs enjoying the sea.

reviews.title: Poorly maintained shabby place
reviews.text: Stayed at this property for a night. Can't remember anything praiseworthy about this hotel. Rooms are poorly maintained bathrooms are dirty Service is poor Pool is not well maintained. In room service or outdoor service is absolutely pathetic. A.c. does not work well. Extremely unfriendly to visitors

reviews.title: Good and Peaceful stay
reviews.text: The service was good. The staff members were helpful, meals were served properly and good care was taken of each individual's need. Room were big and clean. The location was the best which i liked about this hotel as it was in front of the beach. The deck in front of the lawn was a great idea. Snacks were served and songs were played too to enjoy the evening breeze while sitting on the deck. The swimming pool was kept clean, there was a garden area for the kids to play and there was a badminton area too where i enjoyed playing with my brother till late evening, Despite all the good points there were few things which i didnt like much one was that there were a lot of mosquitoes in the lawn and near the deck area which made it difficult to sit for a long time and quite a few things in the room/garden area need to be repaired or a new one should be bought like the swings, lights in the washroom etc Overall my stay at ADB Kanvas was peaceful and relaxing, enjoyed a lot with my family and would definitely want to come back here for my next trip.

reviews.title: Famiky outing
reviews.text: Infra of the hotel is very good but poorly maintained dog was loitering in the 2nd floor and eating for left over plates very dirty place. Bad food. With the available infra much better can be done. Also very cheap crowd.

reviews.title: Good Location and decent property
reviews.text: I had visited this property for a weekend during September,2013 with my family. Overall the experience is nice and we had a good time. Following are the highlights: 1. Property and rooms are good, clean and maintained 2. Direct access to Sea and beach 3. Staffs are helpful 4. The road to reach the hotel was pathetic during those period. (Totally broken due to rain) 5. Construction work was going on for the other parts of the hotel (but there was no noise and disturbance for that) Overall it is nice experience to stay there for a weekend with family.

reviews.title: Week End in Paradise
reviews.text: I had booked this hotel through Cleartrip. First i want to thanks cleartrip for suggesting the hotels. At Mandarmoni ADB Kanvas is one the best hotels I have ever stayed. The communication road is not good, but when u will reach to the hotel after clearing the hurdles u will find the paradise in mandarmoni. The ambiance of the hotel is awasome, staffs are very good specially I want to mention that the behavior of the Manger is excellent. Food Quality is superb, a little bit costly. The rooms are well maintained and room service is also very good. If u want to spend some good time I will personally suggest this hotel.

reviews.title: average
reviews.text: average hotel, food is not as exciting but if you are looking to stay near the beach this is the perfect hotel.... cleaniless of the hotel is just ok. Enjoy the beach but the hotel is not a luxurious place. A budgeted hotel with basic amnesties

reviews.title: Once upon a time there was a good hotel called ADB Kanvas.
reviews.text: We had visited the hotel for 1st time on mid of 2013.It was amazing experience for us. The property was newly developed and properly maintained. We had visited there again end of 2013, before we visited there we booked hotel form Kolkata by Hotel’s agent and we booked a deal for accommodation +food which induced predefined Lunch ,Evening Snacks ,Dinner, Next day Breakfast, lunch. They trouble started as soon as we reached there ,”the manager” denied any kind of predefined menu ,they reason was he had not received any notification from their Kolkata office. But anyway, luckily we managed to retrieve soft copy of email confirmation and then”the manager” negotiated with us .He told since they had not received the intimation earlier, all of the menu items could not be arrange. Anyway, we forced to negotiate. Finally, we visited again on 5th September; 2015.They told us the story about newly inaugurated swimming pool and extension of building. We book the hotel for INR 2400/- per person twin share basis which included food also. On arrival, it was a nightmare for us. The entry road was in bad shape and car with lower GC was prone to scratch –either under belly or in front bumper or both. When we asked for the room,”the manager” offered us the same rooms which we usually preferred to stay. The room was almost without any maintenance .They bed sheet was dirty and with some spot of blood and human extract. The floor was hardly cleaned. The balcony was the worse, iron grill was totally rusted. The curtain was without any cleaning probably from the when they had started the business. The ultimate was the toilet cum bathroom. I bet you would never found such toilet cum bathroom in dormitory or even in 50 rupee hotel. I bet you would failed to stop yourself from vomiting after through examine the commode. It was awful. Regarding the service and Food: it’s completely the evaluation of your calmness and patience. Call them any time, they will offer service within 10 minutes .But long lasting 10 minutes .You never knew what is 10 minutes stand for. I can recall they had periodically chatting themselves about another group of visitors which are close their manager and all of the stuff devoted all of their time for that group of people and a result during lunch and dinner we spend almost endless time and it was really frustrated why our kids cried for food. They server in terrible manner like offered Chatni and Papad at fast and “Teley Bhaja” as last item of menu. When we started arguing that they menu was not the same what we had asked for they actually not able to response properly.”The manager” rushed to us and instead of begging apology started to describe how difficult to handle such a small group like us . Since the tripadvisor does not allowed us to provide any –ve * , I do like to provide single * for everything. Currently the hotel is bigger and offered so many things in paper, but the hotel proprietor must think about the maintainability /cleanness/service/quality and overall guest retention policy.

reviews.title: Great time at Mondarmoni
reviews.text: The hotel location is great. Rooms are decent and staff are well trained. The best part was the promenade along the beach and the play area for the kids. The Bengali dishes were excellent. The only part they can probably improve is the Chinese cuisine , which was average. The overall stay was very pleasant.

reviews.title: lovely federation town
reviews.text: I look for 3 things in accommodation: cleanliness; comfy bed and a hot shower - this place ticked all these boxes. A small room but it's fine; The staff weren't over friendly on arrival or on departure. I wasn't asked if everything was ok - just given a "thanks" when handing back the key. I did love that you get real milk and not "long life" type milk. Great for morning coffee! Even though there was a microwave, there were no plates if you wanted to put food on them. As a budget motel, this is a good place to stay

reviews.title: Great Tidy Overnighter!
reviews.text: What a great last minute booking this was. Our room was small but clean and tidy, comfy bed and pillows and contained the basic appliances. Very good for the overnight charge and couldn't hear main road traffic.

reviews.title: Only just a hotel
reviews.text: Owners definitely need a personality review, room are small and can hardly get around to the bed if there is a bag in the way, bed was old and noisy and uncomfortable, curtains in bathroom were filthy, nothing a good soak in some napisan wouldn't fix, in house restaurant appeared to be somewhat expensive and certainly not extensive, some what older place, but you get what you pay for.

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: This was the second stay at Tally Ho Motor Inn. Both visits offered great service, comfortable beds & clean rooms all at an affordable price. I had one of Dee's lovely home cooked meals. Paul & Dee have great Rep rates and packages.

reviews.title: Friendly Hosts and Delicious Dinner
reviews.text: We were travelling north and stayed overnight at the Tally Ho Motor Inn. The room was comfortable and clean with plenty of hot water in the bathroom. We decided to have dinner in the restaurant and it was delicious. Breakfast next morning was included which consisted of juice, cereal, toast and tea or coffee. The hosts were very friendly. We didn't have any dog but this is a dog friendly motel well worth a visit.

reviews.title: Clean and Comfy!
reviews.text: This was a lovely motel in a location that was convenient for everything you want to see and do in and around Tenterfield. I was travelling with my elderly parent and this was a great place with everything we needed.

reviews.title: FRIENDLY AND WELCOMING
reviews.text: The owners are lovely and make you feel like you are a friend. Meals can be ordered to your room and are home cooked this includes breakfast if you wish. The rooms have a lounge to sit on instead of a chair and balancing on the bed. We always ask for room 21 which has full size refrigerator and is roomy and at the end of the row of rooms which is quiter.

reviews.title: Good Enough
reviews.text: Oldish motel that had had some renovations. "Double Bed" in a room smaller than our own home master bedroom but very clean. Shower was strong & enjoyable. Being Sunday night 4th jan, the restaurant wasn't open so needed to find a chinese restaurant in town for a takeaway. Owners were friendly and helpful but at $95 was a little pricey for what was provided. Did have free WIFI which was a bonus.

reviews.title: Great spot to stay while hiking and exploring the area
reviews.text: Was very close to all the areas we wanted to visit. The rates were reasonable especially since we were hardly there. We stayed for two nights. The owner was very friendly and the room was clean and well maintained.

reviews.title: Genuinely pet-friendly motel
reviews.text: Clean, comfortable room where we could have our dog inside with us. Owners genuinely like dogs and made us feel welcome. Room service dinner arrived promptly and was good quality. Free continental breakfast in their restaurant was an added bonus. Definitely recommended for pet owners.

reviews.title: Clean and comfortable. Great value
reviews.text: The Bathroom and toilet were absolutely spotless. It's a priority item, I feel, in any positive review. Must be clean. Thankfully this motel delivers. Friendly check-in. Asked if I had any questions about local area. Motel was very well located and had great air-con. The Wi-fi is included in the price. Would certainly return!

reviews.title: a nice surprise
reviews.text: I stayed for 2 nights because of some family business that my father and I were attending to. The hosts were very friendly and helpful. We stayed in 2 single rooms at very reasonable rates...and had a continental breakfast included. The rooms were quite comfortable. Mine was quiet and there was an electric blanket on the bed....a good thing mid winter on the new England tablelands. The hotel is quite pretty and has plenty of space. Would definitely stay again.

reviews.title: Comfortable
reviews.text: Very nice motel,comfortable bed,friendly staff. Water in shower not that great took hot water awhile to come through and not very much. Room was nice and dark so we had a good night sleep. Didn't have any food off the menu, thought it was a bit pricey.

reviews.title: Excellent Location
reviews.text: Owners very friendly and helpfull! Bed very comfortable and even had electric blanket which a lot of motels we have stayed in over winter don't have,Water for shower very good and hot , Dinner meals excellent and had a good variety of vegetables , Complimentary breakfast great also , We would definitely stay again if we travelled that way and would recommend to anyone

reviews.title: Spotless Quality
reviews.text: Friendly service from booking to check out. Quiet location, immaculately presented room without a speck of dust to be found. The window coverings provided complete blockout of light from outside. The toiletries and refreshment selection is good quality including fresh milk! The bed is comfortable, not too hard and not too soft, with linens of a very high standard. The pillows are supportive and snuggly. The Wi-Fi is reliable too. This is my 2nd stay here and will continue to be my chosen accomodation for future trips.

reviews.title: Clean and comfortable
reviews.text: This neat and clean motel on the outskirts of Tenterfield was well priced and met our expectations as a budget motel. The host was friendly and helpful- we checked in after 8pm with no problem and our early departure was also no problem. Breakfast was included with the price but our 6am departure was earlier than the kitchen starting for the day. Our friendly host brought around a tray with bread for toasting in the room, butter and jams, milk and cereals and juice, as tea/coffee was available in the room. The room was quiet and the bed comfortable- to summarise, a very good budget motel.

reviews.title: Great place to stay with your pet
reviews.text: Stayed here whilst traveling through to Queensland, very friendly and helpful staff, and very accommodating for my dog. definitely will be staying here again. Room was clean and good size. Hotel is also close to good area to walk your dog.

reviews.title: CLEAN, FRIENDLY, LOVELY LARGE ROOMS
reviews.text: The rooms are large and have a microwave, good size fridge and a lounge to sit on while watching TV. The meals are home cooked, which is a change from the usual take-away. Breakfast is great and just the thing to get you on the road for travelling. We always stay here for the comfort and friendly staff. The bed is large and comfortable which makes the stay enjoyable. The car is under cover which is good when there is a frost in the mornings.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: We was planning to camp but as the weather was super cold we decided to get a last minute room here and in so glad we did was awesome. We arrived around 8.30pm and was greeted by (forgot his name) a man at the reception and he was really informative and helpful. We had got the smallest room but it was perfect for us. There was everything you needed and the room was super clean! First time staying in a motel and would 100% stay here again i loved it. Parking right outside you door all covered. Thank you so much and look forward to staying again.

reviews.title: A great overnight stay.
reviews.text: Great location on main highway to and from Queensland. Very friendly and curtious service, Beautiful homecook meals, accommodates large vehicles ie car & trailer or trucks. Room clean and tidy. A great hot water in shower. Nice and quiet.

reviews.title: country hospitality plus
reviews.text: Hard to believe you get this quality for the price,the room was very clean, comfortable and well equipped, reverse cycle AC meant the room was lovely and warm, but quite so didn't disturb my sleep.The staff were very friendly and helpful, and dinner was a joy, i ordered it at reception and it was delivered to my room, hot, home cooked and excellent quality, i really appreciated being able to eat at six pm. After driving all day having to wait till 7 or 8 for a meal is too much. I would definitely recommend this motel to anyone visiting Tenterfield. The undercover parking was a bonus -1 at 7am, no ice on my car.

reviews.title: We always stay at Tally Ho Motor Inn when we visit Tenterfield.
reviews.text: Tenterfield and environs are beautiful, well worth exploring over a few days. You'll need somewhere nice to stay and there is no better place than the Tally Ho Motor Inn. Approaching the Tally Ho, you will see that the grounds and buildings are well maintained. The gardens are a delight. Checking in will put a smile on your face because you will be warmly welcomed with genuine hospitality and courtesy by managers Paul and Dee. Rooms at the Tally Ho are all ground level, so there is no trudging with your bags upstairs, a boon to the aged and infirm, or people like me who are just plain lazy. Every room has UNDERCOVER parking directly outside, so if it is raining when you arrive you can unpack in comfort. This is genuine undercover parking that easily covers a large car, not just a scimpy awning that covers your bonnet and windscreen! I like my car, so knowing that it has a roof over it at night makes me feel good. Paul and Dee offer home cooked meals, just like Mum used to make, delivered with a smile to your door. When we go there we ask for the rissoles and vegies. Sounds boring and bland you say? You've not tasted rissoles like this before! About 20 minutes away from arrival at the Tally Ho, I start salivating just thinking about the rissoles. Do yourself a favour and ask for them when you stay. They are legendary. Rates are great and the rooms are well appointed, tidy and scrupulously clean. You will find the shower and toilet in your room to be as clean as an operating theatre, I'm not kidding, these facilities are SERIOUSLY clean! It is a testimony to the high standards and ethics of the staff at the Tally Ho. You will be surprised how quiet the rooms are. You won't lay awake at night because of traffic noise. In Winter, the rooms are warm and cosy. We are repeat stayers at the Tally Ho and we will certainly be staying there again when we return to Tenterfield. Our first stay was overnight, the next was a long weekend. The Tally Ho is close by a large park that is a glorious sight in Autumn, a time when all of Tenterfield looks dressed to impress in Autumnal shades. Go and see Tenterfield and be sure to stay at the Tally Ho Motor Inn.

reviews.title: Great for overnight
reviews.text: We stayed in winter - the room was well equipped with heated air-con, electric blankets, plenty of extra blankets if needed, and hot-hot-hot shower. Enjoyed the fireplace in the dining room at breakfast time. Owners are friendly and very helpful - particularly with ensuring a wi-fi connection (which was a bit temperamental at first).

reviews.title: Friendly Hotel, Friendly staff
reviews.text: We arrived here after 12+ hours on the road. We chose this particular hotel as we heard they had a pet friendly room. The rooms are clean and basic and exactly what we expected. We had dinner in their dining room - the homestyle meals are cooked by the wife whilst the husband waits on the tables. Apart from being a bit too expensive the meals were quite fine and the veggies were good (I expected frozen veg but was presently surprised). The local red wine was really good! As we would be checking out in the early hours of the morning, we arranged all our breakfast goodies before we turned in for the night. This consisted of a toaster, toast, condiments, juice, milk etc and this was very much appreciated. I would stay here again. Its not 5 star but it's everything you need if passing through.

reviews.title: Good budget motel
reviews.text: I stayed recently during a golf trip with my son. The room was clean and well presented. It was set well back from the road, and traffic noise was NOT a problem. Whilst in-room dining was available, we took the short stroll into the main street to dine at two of the local pubs. Conveniently located to Tenterfield Golf Club, less than 5min up the road.

reviews.title: Great value
reviews.text: What a find. The budget rooms are small BUT the air conditioning works very well and the rooms are extremly clean. They offer excellent value for a stopover. The restaurant is available if you book but the town is just over 1km away. If you want grand space ans services then this is not the one but what they offer is fantastic. Booked online and received a good deal. Happy travels.

reviews.title: Tally Ho, Tenterfield
reviews.text: I stayed 3 nights in the Tally Ho, and found it to be very pleasant. The owners were very friend and accomodating to my needs. The rooms were very clean, and the bathroom had been modernised. Car parking is outside the room, and it is undercover. It is a budget motel and it is on the highway, and I was surprised that the traffic noise was not too bad.

reviews.title: OWNERS WERE HAPPY TO OBLIGE
reviews.text: We booked on Wotif.com not knowing that the webiste has been taken over. We arrived late to find no room avaiable. However, there had been a cancellation and the ownders gave us the room for the same price, which was nice. All good, as reasonable motels go, good shower pressure. Crisp white cotton sheets are always the way forward?

reviews.title: Well appointed and convenient
reviews.text: Chosen as a wayside stop on a road trip, it proved to be a lucky choice. A neat clean motel with comfortable well appointed rooms. Both a dinner and breakfast menu are on offer. The dinner was a very well cooked simple meal very hearty.

reviews.title: Excellent location for a weekend away with a family
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed over on a trip to Tamworth. We arrived 30 minutes later than their receptions 9.30pm closing time, having rung to tell them we were behind schedule. We arranged for the room to be left unlocked and to leave the key left inside. To our surprise we were still met by one of the hosts well past their closing time. As it was winter, he had turned the heater on in our room ready for our arrival. We thought it was a nice touch. Most of the rooms are set well away from the road, and as a result we experienced very little traffic noise during the night. The beds in our room are firm, the bathroom clean and tidy. Plenty of toiletries and spare blankets are included. Tea and Coffee facilities with real milk is also included. They cater for Golf groups and have their own bus. Parking is undercover too. They also provide a free breakfast between 7am and 8am to all guests, in their dining room, with a choice of white, wholemeal or raisin toast, a good selection of cereals, Tea, Coffee and fruit juice. They have home cooked meals in the evening too for a reasonable price.

reviews.title: No better place to stay
reviews.text: Back on the road again travelling on the New England Hwy through Tenterfield stopped at the Tally Ho Motel the friendliness won me straight away, one of the best things the standard of stay depended on me I was offered Budget or upgraded accommodation I chose the queen room it was fantastic. Just one of the attractions was home cooked meals, who needs a chef when you can cook like Dee. Ordered our meals could have them in our rooms or join Paul and Dee in their restaurant which we did the friendly conversation and information on the area was great. The other thing I thought was great was the washing up in our room we were told to leave it and it would be done for us, how great is that most motels have a charge if you don't clean up. To sumerise our stay was great arrived given our room everything done for us all we had to do was sit back and relax. Highly recommend Tally Ho.

reviews.title: Representative friendly
reviews.text: I am rep,and recently stopped in to try out the accommodation . The staff advise me that have a great rep deal which includes room, dinner etc. it works and it's about time motels were looking after the countless representatives that are out there. When I started working in my industry 16 years ago motels had signs out side stating " Reps welcome" or similar. But with the mining boom etc that has been lost. Suggest you try out the motel and do your own review.

reviews.title: VERY COMFORTABLE .. CLEAN .. INEXPENSIVE .. FRIENDLY MANAGEMENT
reviews.text: This motel is worth the stop. Admittedly the rooms are small, however they are very clean and comfortable .. just what is needed for an overnight stay I took a group of 7 to this venue and EVERYONE was delighted with their room Management is supreme - more than helpful - and very friendly Moreover, the venue is close to everything worth visiting, while you're in the area .. but at the same time, located in a peaceful part of town We'll be back

reviews.title: Great Stay, Great Host
reviews.text: Only stayed overnight, but Paul couldn't do enough. We make this place a definite stopover on our future bike rides! A motor bike crash on the way to Tenterfield left one of our guys injured. We all made it to the motel, checked in and Paul was more than happy to drive our friend to the hospital. Paul actually park went in and got a wheelchair and helped him into emergency and then returned 3 hours later, picking our friend up and drove him back to the motel - unbelievable! Paul couldn't do enough. I could go on, as he made sure our friend was comfortable, rang through to have a pizza delivered and also helped the next morning to load the bike onto a trailer. If you're wanting to stay anywhere in Tenterfield - stay at the Tally Ho Motel! The rooms where clean and tidy, comfortable bed and a great shower! We'll be back, hopefully less trouble next time.....

reviews.title: Ideal for overnight stay
reviews.text: Our driving holiday (with the pet dog) started well with an overnight stay here. We received a friendly welcome at Reception before parking in an undercover spot right out front of our pet-friendly room. The room itself was compact, spotlessly clean and had a comfortable bed. We opted to eat in town however there is a restaurant on-site for dinner and breakfast if desired. Although situated on the main road running through town we heard little road noise from our room. We thoroughly recommend this motel and would stay here again when next in Tenterfield.

reviews.title: Disappointed stay
reviews.text: It only cost $95 but that's what it felt too and some. Room very small..bed low & hard. Not well laid out. On Booking .com they had it for $86 but we were told when we went there they couldn't change the $ on it which was a strange one to start with. They did have large shower..micro wave..toaster but that's it.

reviews.title: Great Motor Inn with two of the most beautiful hosts
reviews.text: Greeted by reception who had a really friendly warmth about her and made me feel like I was at home among family. The room was so clean and tidy I couldn't fault it. We slept comfortably. In the morning host Paul saw my daughter was interest in some crystals and was happy to teach her about them and also great places to go to find them. I never write reviews but I was so impressed with my stay and the hosts that I highly recommend and will stay again. Mandi and Phoebe

reviews.title: Passing through
reviews.text: What wonderful owners they went the extra mile to make our stay great we arrived very late into nite due to motel double bookings in Warrick we decided to drive on to Tenterfield I'm so glad we did We would recommend this motel it wasclean and tidy and comfortable I left my watch behind and was posted back in good condition thank you for your honesty

reviews.title: Excellent, warm and comfortable
reviews.text: In the area on assignment, my wife and I stayed a week. The rooms were comfortable, clean and well appointed. Staff were friendly, informative and supportive. Great chef with a modest menu of hearty meals, earthy and unpretentious even when stretched with both motel and restaurant filled to capacity. We will be returning frequently.

reviews.title: Friendly place with a variety of rooms and prices
reviews.text: Dee and Paul are just lovely hosts. Nothing was too much bother for them. The rooms start at $70 odd a night for a small single. We were there for a couple of nights and really appreciated the extra space that a family room offered. The water pressure was good, there's free WiFi, parking by the room and the rooms we were in were set back from the road. All in all an excellent stay :-)

reviews.title: Excellent Budget Motel with great Staff
reviews.text: This motel had only recently been taken over by new managers who were very helpful, friendly and great to have a chat to. At the time they didn't have a chef for the restaurant, so the managers wife treated us to a delicious home cooked meal after a long day of travel. Our room was well appointed and comfortable and the motel looked to be well maintained. We will certainly stay there the next time we are in Tenterfield.

reviews.title: lovely place to stay
reviews.text: We travel with our 2 spoilt dogs and found this place to stay so we all could have a little rest. The place was spotlessly clean and you would never have known it was a pet friendly room. Catering for the colder months offering reverse cycle air con and electric blankets made it toastie warm. They also offer meals for the weary travellers in the onsite restaurant, included in price was a continental breakie and there was plenty there if you were hungry. Would recommend this to anyone who reads this and anyone who asks for a nice place to stay in Tenterfield.

reviews.title: Great value
reviews.text: This is a great motel with Exellent staff and amenities every thing clean as a pin working and of good standard for rate . Resturant meals are Exellent quality home style meals at very reasonable price this motel definatly punches above its weight . Will stay again

reviews.title: Lovely Overnight Stop
reviews.text: I was really on a budget so hadn't expected much but what a great little find. Lovely couple managing the place made my son and I welcome and cooked us dinner for a reasonable price. Nice dining area with fire on an cool winter morning. Room was small but bed very comfy, shower good pressure and free wifi. Very, very clean. Very happy with our stay.

reviews.title: Very clean and comfortable
reviews.text: I travel away for work and the Tally Ho suits me for a stay on my way home. This is the second time I have stayed here and find it spotlessly clean and very comfortable.Dee is friendly and willing to help if required. The small single rooms are perfect for one and priced to match. Only wished I had seen the home cooked meals, I'll be back and have one next time. Great motel.

reviews.title: ColJoy
reviews.text: Hosts, Paul & Dee Quinn, make the stay so relaxing and couldn't do enough to help. The room was very clean, comfortable bed, service great. Bathroom room had all toiletries provided and very clean. We had a lovely home cooked dinner and breakfast. All this at an affordable price. The newly renovated Queen Rooms a delight. Paul was telling us that there are great plans for events coming to Tenterfield soon! Looking forward to returning there!

reviews.title: very bad experence
reviews.text: these people have only been in the business 6 months according to another motel owner in the area. They are very rude and pictures of the rooms shown are not what you get, also tyhe board out the from tells prices much cheaper than what you have to pay. most rooms have double beds I did not know any Motel still have double beds also must vacate by 9:30. WE GOT A PHONE CALL AT 9:35 AND TOLD THAT WERE SUPPOSE TO BE OUT. We read a review of breakfast included, well this was some other time and place. Maybe if we had bought dinner as the owner had wanted us to we might have been treated better. We often stop in Tenterfield to have a meal at the coachman cafe, which is VERY GOOD AND WELL PRICED.

reviews.title: CLEAN, FRIENDLY AND SO CONVENIENT
reviews.text: The room is small but clean and your car is undercover. Meals (dinner) are to the room and are basic home cooked variety. Breakfast is excellent and the staff are very friendly and helpful. The room is airconditioned and there is a TV and free WIFI. This is our third stay here and we will be definately staying again.

reviews.title: Friendly.Comfortable and a very easy experience
reviews.text: I will be staying here again on my next trip..Gary and Cheryl are very easy and friendly to deal with and nothing was to much trouble..the room was spotless and very quiet. The meals are very nice and abundent,,thanks again.

reviews.title: Convenient and Friendly
reviews.text: The staff are very attentive and the motor inn is located a 10 minute walk from the city centre. Only concern is that the dog in the property next door decided to give us a song for about 10 minutes late at night...not much they can do about that though.

reviews.title: Stayed at better
reviews.text: As a retired couple we have stayed at a few motor inns in Tenterfield and I'm afraid this motel is not among our favourites. A bit tired and I feel more suited to construction workers than the travelling public. At best the room is adequate for an overnight stay I suppose. The lady receptionist was efficient without being over friendly. Might give it a miss next time.

reviews.title: Friendly, comfortable, convenient
reviews.text: We found the motel clean, comfortable and as it was cold the airco was excellent. Hosts were welcoming and low fuss, it was great stopover. Highly recommended. We travel with our wee furman and he was able to stay like he could in Europe, much appreciated. The breakfast was lovely.

reviews.title: Ideal for overnighter on a trip.
reviews.text: Well-priced and good value. Friendly service. Good honest meals at pub prices. Not pretentious and would stay again. Located right on the New England highway but I certainly wasn't kept awake by highway noise. Motorcyclist friendly.

reviews.title: Very Comfortable - would stay there again
reviews.text: A short way out of town and although on the highway, very little road noise at night. Comfortable room if a little small, with adequate furnishings. Good bed - slept very well. Complimentary breakfast and a reasonable dinner menu in the dining room.

reviews.title: Dog friendly room! Makes road trips with our dog a breeze...
reviews.text: What we love about The Tally Ho Motel is the fact that they have a dog friendly room. We drive from Sydney to Brisbane once or twice a year and love being able to stay overnight somewhere convenient that our Labrador is welcome. Basic but clean rooms, great value, on site breakfast and the owners are helpful. Great location near parks and the road out of town.

reviews.title: Affordable and best value for money.
reviews.text: Me and my patner, stayed at this motel in June 2011 and it was a pleasant stay. The staff/ owner was very nice and friendly. She told us about the neighbor-hood and good places to visit. I will recommend this motel for affordable price and good service.

reviews.title: Comfortable & Clean
reviews.text: We had a three night stay and was very welcomed by the owner. The owner informed us at check in that we could have a look at the room that we booked through Booking.com as he stated that it was a little small for a 3 night stay. He suggested a larger room with more facilities for an extra $10.00 per night. After checking the smaller room and the larger room, we chose to take the larger room which was very comfortable for our 3 night stay. They will cook a home cooked meal if you order from the desk and also will deliver your meal to your room if required. The car parking is undercover which was great as we experienced a storm each night on our stay in Tenterfield. The location was very quiet even though the Tally Ho is on the highway. This motel has free WiFi in the rooms. We would stay there again if ever in the area.

reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: We stayed here on our way to queensland for a holiday with the intention of staying the night to break up the trip. Although this hotel wasn't our first pick it proved an excellent find. The rooms were clean, neat and tidy. Reception staff were excellent and provided complimentary breakfast which was a nice gesture. Highly recommend for travellers after a simple one night hotel.

reviews.title: Tenterfield
reviews.text: Friendly and very helpful staff. Comfy room with all amenities. Breakfast inc next morning was lovely and in front of a warm fire in the small dining room. Close to town and cafes for evening meal. Car was parked under carport right outside room

reviews.title: Clean, comfortable & friendly
reviews.text: We stayed here from 5/6/15 till 8/6/15 we couldn't find fault in our stay. As a family aged from 87 down to 7 the room was roomy, amenities just right to suit all our needs. I know we will definitely be back as mum has previously stayed here & only stays here when visiting Tenterfield keep up the great work & thank you for the wondeffull service :)

reviews.title: Clean Comfortable and great shower
reviews.text: Value for money :) This Motel was clean and comfortable...and really easy to find. The reverse cycle air con was quiet and the shower had great pressure and was lovely and hot. The staff were VERY pleasant and I ordered dinner at reception. It was delivered to my room and was hot and delicious. I only stayed overnight to break my trip and would highly recommend this place. Undercover parking too.

reviews.title: Ovanight at the tally ho in winter
reviews.text: The reception desk was friendly and had my internet booking all ready when I arrived. The room was clean warm and well appointed. There was undercover parking which was good given the very heavy frost in the morning. This is not a super modern motel but a comfortable older style that is well maintained.

reviews.title: You get what you pay for.
reviews.text: We had been travelling all day and were tired so only wanted a comfortable place to sleep. After reading the glowing reviews and wondering why it wasn't rated higher on tripadvisor we decided on Tally Ho for the night. We didn't prebook and upon checkin she just went through the motions without any enthusiasm. She asked if we wanted a queen room and when we said yes she asked for $104. I have since learnt that on TA, when is says rooms from $92, it is possibly for a double budget room. I didn't think motels still had double beds these days, but the room was so small "it wouldn't fit a queen in it" (her words not mine). When I asked if we could see the room she said it was too hot and showed us photos instead. She also said that the bathroom was the same size in both the double and queen rooms. So we decided on the double and boy, was it tiny. I havn't seen such a small room since the 1980's in Canberra. The room was very hot when we walked in but the air con kicked in and the room and bathroom were cool after 10 minutes or so. There was a block out blind on the window above the kitchette which worked well in keeping the afternoon sun out. It would have been great to have one in the bathroom as well. There was a small cupboard to hang clothes and a very small table with 2 chairs. 2 people could not pass each other comfortably between the bed and table. The bed was pretty comfortable but you could hear and feel the springs when you rolled over. Pillows were excellent and the room and bathroom were spotless. They're using water saving heads (understandable in the drought) in the tiny shower and sink which may make it difficult for a woman with thick hair to wash it. We slept very well, the room was quiet and we didn't hear any road noise at all. When I returned the key in the morning the woman was friendly and thanked me for telling her about a light that wasn't working.

reviews.title: Comfy place
reviews.text: Stayed here for one night in a queen size room. The room was clean and tidy, Bathroom was really clean with all toiletries provided which sometimes is unusual for a budget style motel. Bed was really good, quiet with only the odd bit of noise of a truck passing bye. Breakfast was good and also very reasonable in terms of price. ($8 for scrambled eggs and toast). The hosts Paul and Dee were very good in servicing customers. Overall yes I could recommend this place to stay again. When in town definitely visit the golf club and have the Chicken parmy.

reviews.title: great overnighter
reviews.text: A great place on the edge of town for an overnight stay or even as a base to explore this beautiful and historical part of northern NSW. Comfortable and clean rooms, friendly owners and undercover parking, make this a great stay. At $80 a double including a continental breakfast, this is one i'll be keeping on my list when travelling the New England Hwy.

reviews.title: !! BRILLIANT !!
reviews.text: If you think the rooms are great, it doesn't stop there ... management is very friendly and helpful, always ready to suggest amazing places to visit while in Tenterfield. I have recommended my friends to this motel - and they always come back as I do - delighted

reviews.title: Wonderfully accommodating
reviews.text: The Tally Ho, run by Paul and Dee... what can I say but they are the most genuine people. Kindest people. Extremely accommodating. During February 2019, as part of a NSW Government contingent to engage fires in both National Parks and private property in the area we were fortunate enough to stay at the Tally Ho. Over the 8 nights we stayed we were treated with such genuine kindness. They went out of there way to make our stay as comfortable, and restful as possible. Which was an absolute blessing considering what we were there for. The time we spent at the Tally Ho, with Paul and Dee, was without a doubt the most memorable thing. The rooms are well equipped, comfortable beds (excellent after a hard days work). The rooms were very clean, and they had some great environmental initiatives to reduce waste without sacrificing the quality of their rooms. Dee is an absolutely amazing cook (we were fortunate enough to be treated to great meals and an awesome pavlova). From the time we arrived to the moment we left we were treated in the most welcoming way, never a dull moment we all left with great memories, great stories, and sore chests from all the laughter. I will definitely be staying at the Tally Ho again! Again from all the Crews, thank you for your brilliant hospitality and we wish you all the best in the future.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Renovated rooms that were clean and tidy. Good comfy beds. I stayed in one of the family rooms and found it great. Newish bathrooms and everything worked. Friendly staff. Can't complain. Reasonable rates. Would stay there again.

reviews.title: Great Motor Inn with great people who really care.
reviews.text: Amazing hospitality.......I arrived at the Tally Ho Motor Inn with an injured leg after a motorcycle accident and Paul without question took me to the hospital and picked me up to take me back to the motel. Bloody unbelievable service. Can't speak highly enough about how I was treated. Would recommend to anyone.

reviews.title: Convenient Tenterfield stop-over
reviews.text: Simple, low-cost and convenient, with all basic facilities. Pleasant staff. Home-cooked meals, and well-selected, very reasonably-priced wine list. Room comfortably warm on a chill Tenterfield evening. Beautiful park almost adjacent. Under-cover parking.I would stay here again.

reviews.title: 1950s vintage
reviews.text: Staff were friendly and courteous but bed was like a rock and the air conditioner was very noisy, the whole place needs revamping. The location was handy, right on the main road and we had a room at the back so no traffic noise.

reviews.title: Great overnight stop after camping 5 nights in Girraween NP
reviews.text: This is a top value budget motel. Paul and Dee gave us a warm, friendly welcome and our room was well appointed and absolutely spotless. We also appreciated the undercover parking. The home cooked meal in the dining room was plate licking good! Thank you Dee.

reviews.title: Great service and very comfortable
reviews.text: Modern clean rooms. Crisp sheets and the bed was comfortable. Asked for assistance tuning my television and it wasn't a problem. Complimentary light breakfast, perfect start to the day. Traffic noise not a problem. Would definitely stay again.

reviews.title: Sydney to Rainbow Beach
reviews.text: Clean, tidy, warm room. Exactly what we needed after a long drive. Staff really friendly and helpful. Easy to check in late a night. Clean bathroom with all you need. Internet works there. Flat screen tv with plenty of channels. Definitely would stay there again. Greay competitive price compared to the rest of town.

reviews.title: Newly renovated room, excellent value, friendly owner/managers
reviews.text: Very comfortable stay, BYO Restaurant, basic but good home cooking. Quiet room that was recently renovated and very comfortable, internet access included in the most reasonable tarriff as well as a light breakfast. Will stay there again. Lester

reviews.title: A+ warm and friendly.
reviews.text: Great location. First good impression was the warm welcome then undercover parking (it was raining). Room was good, comfy, clean,tidy. Great home cooked meals in restaurant. Didn't have any complaints for the price.
